AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shift_self.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shift_self
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shift_self.header:
theorem shift_self (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (coarseShift y n μ) μ = y μ + finK (L μ) n

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shift_ne.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shift_ne
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shift_ne.header:
theorem shift_ne (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ) {μ ν : Fin 3} (h : ν ≠ μ) :
    (coarseShift y n μ) ν = y ν

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shift_sub.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shift_sub
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shift_sub.header:
theorem shift_sub (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    (coarseShift x n μ) ν - (coarseShift y n μ) ν = x ν - y ν

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.gamma_shift.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.gamma_shift
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.gamma_shift.header:
theorem gamma_shift (s n : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    coarseGammaPath s (coarseShift y n μ) (coarseShift x n μ) = coarseGammaPath s y x

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.mem_block_iff.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.mem_block_iff

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shiftEquiv.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shiftEquiv
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shiftEquiv.header: def shiftEquiv (n : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : PeriodicLatticeSite L ≃ PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.block_sum_shift.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.block_sum_shift
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.block_sum_shift.header:
theorem block_sum_shift {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β] (s ell n : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1)
    (hfit' : ∀ ν, ((coarseShift y n μ) ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1)
    (F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → β) :
    ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, F (coarseShift x n μ)
      = ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf (coarseShift y n μ) s ell, F x

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curlS.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curlS
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curlS.header: def curlS (s : ℕ) (F : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladA.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladA
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladA.header:
def ladA (s : ℕ) (F : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3))
    (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladA_cons.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladA_cons
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladA_cons.header:
theorem ladA_cons (s : ℕ) (F : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (ν : Fin 3) (p : List (Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    ladA s F y (ν :: p) μ n = ladA s F (coarseShift y s ν) p μ n + ladA s F y [ν] μ n

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladA_rung.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladA_rung
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladA_rung.header:
theorem ladA_rung (s : ℕ) (F : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (ν μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    ladA s F y [ν] μ (n + 1) = curlS s F y ν μ + ladA s F (coarseShift y s μ) [ν] μ n

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.rungA_le.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.rungA_le
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.rungA_le.header:
theorem rungA_le (s : ℕ) (F : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (ν μ : Fin 3) (Q : ℝ) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
      (∀ t ∈ rungPlaqs s ν μ y n, |curlS s F t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2| ≤ Q) →
      |ladA s F y [ν] μ n| ≤ (n : ℝ) * Q

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladA_le.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladA_le
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladA_le.header:
theorem ladA_le (s : ℕ) (F : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (Q : ℝ) :
    ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
      (∀ t ∈ ladPlaqs s μ n y p, |curlS s F t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2| ≤ Q) →
      |ladA s F y p μ n| ≤ (p.length : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) * Q)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.blk_split.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.blk_split
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.blk_split.header:
theorem blk_split (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (F : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (hfit : ∀ ν, (c.1 ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1) :
    blkAngle s ell F c
      = ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ *
          (pathAngle s F c.1 (coarseGammaPath s c.1 x)
            - pathAngle s F (cPlusS s ell c) (coarseGammaPath s c.1 x)
            + pathAngle s F x (List.replicate ell c.2))

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.phiB.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.phiB
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.phiB.header: def phiB (s ell : ℕ) (F : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (z w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.strB.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.strB
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.strB.header: def strB (s ell : ℕ) (F : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ρ : Fin 3) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.blk_split3.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.blk_split3
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.blk_split3.header:
theorem blk_split3 (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (F : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (hfit : ∀ ν, (c.1 ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1) :
    blkAngle s ell F c = phiB s ell F c.1 c.1 - phiB s ell F c.1 (cPlusS s ell c)
      + strB s ell F c.1 c.2

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.phiB_shift.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.phiB_shift
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.phiB_shift.header:
theorem phiB_shift (s ell n : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (F : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ)
    {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hfit : ∀ ν, (z ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1)
    (hfit' : ∀ ν, ((coarseShift z n μ) ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1) :
    phiB s ell F z (coarseShift z n μ) = phiB s ell F (coarseShift z n μ) (coarseShift z n μ)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.strB_shift.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.strB_shift
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.strB_shift.header:
theorem strB_shift (s ell n : ℕ) (μ ρ : Fin 3) (F : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ)
    {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hfit : ∀ ν, (z ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1)
    (hfit' : ∀ ν, ((coarseShift z n μ) ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1) :
    strB s ell F (coarseShift z n μ) ρ
      = ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf z s ell, ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹
          * pathAngle s F (coarseShift x n μ) (List.replicate ell ρ)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curl_blk_identity.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curl_blk_identity
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curl_blk_identity.header:
theorem curl_blk_identity (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (F : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3)
    (hdvd : ∀ ρ, s * ell ∣ L ρ + 1) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (s * ell)) :
    curlS (s * ell) (blkAngle s ell F) y ν μ
      = ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹
          * ladA s F x (List.replicate ell ν) μ ell

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.linT.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.linT
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.linT.header:
def linT (ell : ℕ) (f : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ
  | 0 => f
  | l + 1 => blkAngle (ell ^ l) ell (linT ell f l)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.linT_curl.header:
theorem linT_curl (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (f : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (q0 : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.hol_congr.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.hol_congr
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.hol_congr.header:
theorem hol_congr (s : ℕ) (V V' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :
    ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L), (∀ b ∈ pathBonds s y p, V b = V' b) →
      coarsePathHolonomy s V y p = coarsePathHolonomy s V' y p

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ubarSU2_congr.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ubarSU2_congr
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ubarSU2_congr.header:
theorem ubarSU2_congr (s ell : ℕ) (V V' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, ∀ b ∈ loopBonds s ell c x, V b = V' b)
    (hc : ∀ b ∈ pathBonds s c.1 (List.replicate ell c.2), V b = V' b) :
    ubarSU2 s ell V c = ubarSU2 s ell V' c

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ubarSU2_torusCfg_a.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ubarSU2_torusCfg_abs
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ubarSU2_torusCfg_a.header:
theorem ubarSU2_torusCfg_abs (s ell : ℕ) (F : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hbr : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, |loopAngle s ell F c x| < Real.pi) :
    ubarSU2 s ell (torusCfg F) c = torus (blkAngle s ell F c)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cl_mono.header:

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pathBonds_aligned.header:

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopBonds_aligned.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopBonds_aligned
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopBonds_aligned.header:
theorem loopBonds_aligned (s ell : ℕ) (hdvd : ∀ ρ, s * ell ∣ L ρ + 1)

    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell) :

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopAngle_eq_ladA.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopAngle_eq_ladA
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopAngle_eq_ladA.header:
theorem loopAngle_eq_ladA (s ell : ℕ) (F : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell) :
    loopAngle s ell F c x = ladA s F c.1 (coarseGammaPath s c.1 x) c.2 ell

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopAngle_le.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopAngle_le
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopAngle_le.header:
theorem loopAngle_le (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (F : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell)
    (Q : ℝ) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (h : ∀ t ∈ ladPlaqs s c.2 ell c.1 (coarseGammaPath s c.1 x), |curlS s F t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2| ≤ Q) :
    |loopAngle s ell F c x| ≤ 3 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * (ell : ℝ) * Q

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.tower_torus.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.tower_torus
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.tower_torus.header:
theorem tower_torus (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (f : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (q0 : ℝ)
    (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (h0 : ∀ y ν μ, |curlS 1 f y ν μ| ≤ q0) (n : ℕ)
    (hdvd : ∀ ρ, ell ^ n ∣ L ρ + 1)
    (hsmall : ∀ m < n, 3 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * (ell : ℝ) * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ m * q0) < Real.pi) :
    ∀ l ≤ n, ∀ c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ l) →
      ubarTowerSU2 ell (torusCfg f) l c = torus (linT ell f l c)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_torus_le.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_torus_le
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_torus_le.header: theorem dv_torus_le (θ : ℝ) : dv (torus θ) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * |θ|

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.tower_torus_curv.header:

    (hdvd : ∀ ρ, ell ^ n ∣ L ρ + 1)
    (hsmall : ∀ m < n, 3 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * (ell : ℝ) * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ m * q0) < Real.pi)
    (l : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ n) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ l))

AdalyFormal.M2BallCharts.vertex_zchAC.name: AdalyFormal.M2BallCharts.vertex_zchAC
AdalyFormal.M2BallCharts.vertex_zchAC.header:
theorem vertex_zchAC {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (hcov : CoversOm0p ell M fc k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) {j : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k)
    {x0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx0 : x0 ∈ S.Om j) {w : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hw : pdist w x0 ≤ 3 * (M * ell ^ j))
    {r : ℕ} (hr7 : r ≤ 7 * M * ell ^ j) (hR : 45 * ell + 30 + 2 * fc ≤ R) (hs : 24 ≤ bigSide M ell (j - 1))
    {α₀ η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀) {U : LinkCfg L} (hP : PerCubeRegular2H ell M fc 12 k S α₀ η U)
    (hsm : (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ * ((ell : ℝ) ^ (j - 1))⁻¹ + 12 * M * α₀ * (((ell : ℝ) ^ (j - 1))⁻¹) ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (ht12 : (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ * ((ell : ℝ) ^ (j - 1))⁻¹ ≤ 2)
    (hsmall : (4 * cB 1152 5 + 1) * (3 * ((bigSide M ell (j - 1) - 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 * Fv ell M (j - 1) α₀ ≤ 1)
    (n : Fin 3 → ℕ) :
    ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2,
      ZCh U g w (Ib r (bigSide M ell (j - 1)) (qv r (bigSide M ell (j - 1)) w n) Finset.univ)
        (fun _ => KT1 4 1152 * (3 * ((bigSide M ell (j - 1) - 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) * Fv ell M (j - 1) α₀)
        (fun _ => KT2 4 1152 * Fv ell M (j - 1) α₀)

AdalyFormal.M2BallCharts.ball_chart_posA.name: AdalyFormal.M2BallCharts.ball_chart_posAC
AdalyFormal.M2BallCharts.ball_chart_posA.header:
theorem ball_chart_posAC {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (hcov : CoversOm0p ell M fc k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 24 ≤ M) {j : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k)
    {x0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx0 : x0 ∈ S.Om j) {w : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hw : pdist w x0 ≤ 3 * (M * ell ^ j))
    {r : ℕ} (hr7 : r ≤ 7 * M * ell ^ j) (hnw : ∀ σ : Fin 3, 2 * r + 2 ≤ L σ + 1) (hR : 45 * ell + 30 + 2 * fc ≤ R)
    {α₀ η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀) {U : LinkCfg L} (hP : PerCubeRegular2H ell M fc 12 k S α₀ η U)
    (hX : (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ Xthr ell M) :
    ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2, GChart U g (Ball w r)
      (CC ell M * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ * ((ell : ℝ) ^ (j - 1))⁻¹))
      (CC ell M * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ * (((ell : ℝ) ^ (j - 1))⁻¹) ^ 2))

AdalyFormal.M2BallCharts.plq_classAC.name: AdalyFormal.M2BallCharts.plq_classAC
AdalyFormal.M2BallCharts.plq_classAC.header:
theorem plq_classAC {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hcov : CoversOm0p ell M fc k S) (hell : 0 < ell)

    (h3 : periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν ∈ S.Om 0)

    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) :

AdalyFormal.M2BallCharts.ball_chart_zero.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header: theorem loop_110 (e : ℝ) : loopAngle 1 2 (fW e) cW (st 1 1 0) = 4 * e

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.loop_111
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header: theorem loop_111 (e : ℝ) : loopAngle 1 2 (fW e) cW (st 1 1 1) = 6 * e

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header: theorem bondAngle_cW (e : ℝ) : bondAngle 1 2 (fW e) cW = 2 * e

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header: theorem blkAngle_cW (e : ℝ) : blkAngle 1 2 (fW e) cW = 19 / 4 * e

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem loop_branch {e : ℝ} (he : 0 ≤ e) (he6 : 6 * e < Real.pi) :

      0 ≤ loopAngle 1 2 (fW e) cW x ∧ loopAngle 1 2 (fW e) cW x < Real.pi

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.ubarSU2_VW
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem ubarSU2_VW {e : ℝ} (he : 0 ≤ e) (he6 : 6 * e < Real.pi) :
    ubarSU2 1 2 (VW e) cW = torus (19 / 4 * e)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.four_one_sub_cos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header: theorem four_one_sub_cos (θ : ℝ) : 4 * (1 - Real.cos θ) = 8 * Real.sin (θ / 2) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.sqrt_four_one_sub_cos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem sqrt_four_one_sub_cos (θ : ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (4 * (1 - Real.cos θ)) = Real.sqrt 8 * |Real.sin (θ / 2)|

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.frobNorm_VW
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem frobNorm_VW (e : ℝ) (b : PeriodicLatticeEdge LW) :
    frobNorm ((VW e b : M2) - 1) = Real.sqrt (4 * (1 - Real.cos e))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.frobSupBond_VW
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header: theorem frobSupBond_VW (e : ℝ) : frobSupBond (VW e) = Real.sqrt (4 * (1 - Real.cos e))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem ubarCoarse_VW_at {e : ℝ} (he : 0 ≤ e) (he6 : 6 * e < Real.pi) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.frobSupBond_ubarCoarse_VW_ge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem frobSupBond_ubarCoarse_VW_ge {e : ℝ} (he : 0 ≤ e) (he6 : 6 * e < Real.pi) :
    Real.sqrt (4 * (1 - Real.cos (19 / 4 * e))) ≤ frobSupBond (ubarCoarse 2 (VW e))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.strict_comparison
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem strict_comparison {c e : ℝ} (hc0 : 0 < c) (hc : c < 19 / 4) (he : 0 < e)
    (he8 : e ≤ 8 / 19) (hed : e ≤ (19 / 4 - c) / 10) :
    c * Real.sqrt (4 * (1 - Real.cos e)) < Real.sqrt (4 * (1 - Real.cos (19 / 4 * e)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.blocking_rate_ge_19_4
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem blocking_rate_ge_19_4 {c : ℝ} (hc : c < 19 / 4) :
    ¬ (∀ V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 LW,
        frobSupBond (ubarCoarse 2 V) ≤ c * frobSupBond V)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.no_uniform_constant_below_19_4
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem no_uniform_constant_below_19_4 {c : ℝ} (hc : c < 19 / 4) :
    ¬ (∀ (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L),
        frobSupBond (ubarCoarse 2 V) ≤ c * frobSupBond V)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.blocking_rate_sandwich
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem blocking_rate_sandwich (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 LW) :
    frobSupBond (ubarCoarse 2 V)
        ≤ AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.blkConst * frobSupBond V
      ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, c < 19 / 4 → ¬ (∀ W : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 LW,
          frobSupBond (ubarCoarse 2 W) ≤ c * frobSupBond W)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.prescaling_budget_deficit
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem prescaling_budget_deficit (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≤ 4) :
    ¬ (∀ V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 LW,
        frobSupBond (ubarCoarse 2 V) ≤ c * frobSupBond V)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.prescaling_does_not_absorb
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem prescaling_does_not_absorb {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (M : ℝ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, M < (19 / 4 : ℝ) ^ n * (a / 4 ^ n)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.frobSupBond_VW_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header: theorem frobSupBond_VW_pos {e : ℝ} (he : 0 < e) (hpi : e < Real.pi) : 0 < frobSupBond (VW e)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem holonomy_witness (e : ℝ) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.holonomyElem (VW e)
      (st 0 0 1, ⟨(1, 2), by decide⟩) = torus (2 * e)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.witness_has_curvature
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem witness_has_curvature {e : ℝ} (he : 0 < e) (hpi : 2 * e < Real.pi) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.holonomyElem (VW e)
      (st 0 0 1, ⟨(1, 2), by decide⟩) ≠ 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.constant_family_below_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem constant_family_below_two (t : ℝ) (ht : -1 ≤ t) (ht' : t < 1) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * (1 + t)) < 19 / 4

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.pathAngle_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem pathAngle_const (s : ℕ) (e : ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (P : List (Fin 3)) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.loopAngle_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem loopAngle_const (s ell : ℕ) (e : ℝ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : loopAngle s ell (fun _ => e) c x = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.blkAngle_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem blkAngle_const (s ell : ℕ) (e : ℝ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem torusCfg_const (e : ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem transfer_cross_check (e : ℝ) :

      ∧ ubarSU2 1 2 (torusCfg (fun _ : PeriodicLatticeEdge LW => e)) cW = torus e ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header: theorem transfer_cross_check_agrees (e : ℝ) : torus (2 * e) = torus e ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate.holonomyDefectSq_torus
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem holonomyDefectSq_torus

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem defectSq_eq_frobNorm_sq (θ : ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AbelianBlockingRate..header:
theorem witness_IsRegularHolonomy {e : ℝ} (he : 0 ≤ e) (h4 : 4 * e ≤ Real.pi) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gaugeActA
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.header: noncomputable def gaugeActA (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : Bond L → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gaugeInv
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.header: def gaugeInv (γ : GaugeFn L) : GaugeFn L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gaugeMul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.header: def gaugeMul (γ δ : GaugeFn L) : GaugeFn L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gaugeActA_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.header:
theorem gaugeActA_apply (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) :
    gaugeActA γ A b = RMap (γ b.1) (A b)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gaugeTransform_comp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.header:
theorem gaugeTransform_comp (γ δ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :
    periodicGaugeTransform γ (periodicGaugeTransform δ U)
      = periodicGaugeTransform (gaugeMul γ δ) U

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gaugeTransform_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.header:
theorem gaugeTransform_one (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :
    periodicGaugeTransform (fun _ => (1 : SU2)) U = U

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gaugeMul_inv_left
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.header: theorem gaugeMul_inv_left (γ : GaugeFn L) : gaugeMul (gaugeInv γ) γ = fun _ => (1 : SU2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gaugeTransform_inv
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.header:
theorem gaugeTransform_inv (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :
    periodicGaugeTransform (gaugeInv γ) (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) = U

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.shi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.shift_step_false
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.shi.header:
theorem shift_step_false (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeStep x (μ, false)) μ = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.per.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.periodicPathHolonomy_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.per.header:
theorem periodicPathHolonomy_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) :
    periodicPathHolonomy (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) x s
      = γ x * periodicPathHolonomy U x s * (γ (periodicPathEndpoint x s))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.tra.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.transportPath_endpoint
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.tra.header:
theorem transportPath_endpoint (c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :
    periodicPathEndpoint c (transportPath c x μ i) = pathSite x μ i

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.rZe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.rZeroA_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.rZe.header:
theorem rZeroA_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) :
    rZeroA (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) c x (gaugeActA γ A) μ ell
      = RMap (γ c) (rZeroA U c x A μ ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.lin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.lineCoarseRestrictCov_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.lin.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCov_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (ell : ℕ) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L ell) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) ell (gaugeActA γ A) b
      = RMap (γ b.1.1) (lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell A b)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.mem.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.mem_kerQ_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.mem.header:
theorem mem_kerQ_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (hker : ∀ b : CoarseBond L ell, lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell A b = 0) :
    ∀ b : CoarseBond L ell,
      lineCoarseRestrictCov (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) ell (gaugeActA γ A) b = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.cur.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.curlValueCovariant_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.cur.header:
theorem curlValueCovariant_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    curlValueCovariant (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (gaugeActA γ A) p
      = RMap (γ p.1) (curlValueCovariant U A p)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.dst.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.dstarDQuadForm_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.dst.header:
theorem dstarDQuadForm_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    dstarDQuadForm (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (gaugeActA γ A) = dstarDQuadForm U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.nor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.norm_RMap
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.nor.header: theorem norm_RMap (g : SU2) (X : SuTwo) : ‖RMap g X‖ = ‖X‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.bon.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.bondEnergy_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.bon.header:
theorem bondEnergy_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    bondEnergy (gaugeActA γ A) = bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.axi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.axialGauge_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.axi.header:
theorem axialGauge_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (ell : ℕ) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hadm : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell →
      ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y ell → ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, A b = 0) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell →
      ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y ell →
        ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, gaugeActA γ A b = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gaugeActA_eq_zero_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.header:
theorem gaugeActA_eq_zero_iff (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    gaugeActA γ A = 0 ↔ A = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gaugeGradSupBond

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.fou.header: theorem four_sqrt_two_mul {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) : 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * a = Real.sqrt (32 * a ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.coe.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.coe.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.del.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.deltaJ_gaugeRegular_coercive_exact
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.del.header:
theorem deltaJ_gaugeRegular_coercive_exact
    (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ L μ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hadm : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2 →
      ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y 2 → ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, A b = 0)
    (hkerU : ∀ b : CoarseBond L 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov U 2 A b = 0)
    (hthr : 64 * frobSupBond (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) ^ 2
      ≤ (1 / 108) * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4))
    (hsmall : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((1 / 108) * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4)
        - 64 * frobSupBond (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) ^ 2)
        - 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond (periodicGaugeTransform γ U)) :
    (Real.sqrt ((1 / 108) * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4)
        - 64 * frobSupBond (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) ^ 2)
        - 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond (periodicGaugeTransform γ U)) ^ 2 * bondEnergy A
      ≤ dstarDQuadForm U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.del.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.deltaJ_gaugeRegular_coercive
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.del.header:
theorem deltaJ_gaugeRegular_coercive
    (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ L μ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (α₀ : ℝ) (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hthr : 96 * α₀ ^ 2 ≤ gammaZeroLit)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (hreg : GaugeRegular α₀ U) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hadm : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2 →
      ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y 2 → ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, A b = 0)
    (hkerU : ∀ b : CoarseBond L 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov U 2 A b = 0) :
    coercConst α₀ * bondEnergy A ≤ dstarDQuadForm U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.fro.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.frobSupBond_spike_ge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.fro.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.header: noncomputable def gaugedCurvedU : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 witL5

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.cur.header: theorem curvedU_dir_one (x : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5) : curvedU (x, (1 : Fin 3)) = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gau.header:
theorem gaugedCurved_coercivity :

        gaugedCurvedU ≠ periodicGaugeTransform δ V) ∧
      (2 : ℝ) ≤ frobSupBond gaugedCurvedU ∧
      GaugeRegular (frobSupBond curvedU) gaugedCurvedU ∧
      0 < bondEnergy gaugedCurvedA ∧
      (1 / 4000 : ℝ) * bondEnergy gaugedCurvedA ≤ dstarDQuadForm gaugedCurvedU gaugedCurvedA

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.neg.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.fro.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.cen.header: noncomputable def centerU (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.par.header: noncomputable def parityGauge (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : GaugeFn L

theorem parity_flip {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ∣ n) (v : ℕ) (hv : v < n) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.cen.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gam.header:

        ≤ dstarDQuadForm gaugedCurvedU gaugedCurvedA

      coercConst (1 / 500) * bondEnergy (gaugeActA (spikeGauge (rotElem 1) (siteZero witL5)) witA)
        ≤ dstarDQuadForm
            (periodicGaugeTransform (spikeGauge (rotElem 1) (siteZero witL5)) (trivialU witL5))
            (gaugeActA (spikeGauge (rotElem 1) (siteZero witL5)) witA)

theorem pAx_smul (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ell : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_eq_zero_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_zero_field
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_.header:
theorem pAx_zero_field (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ell : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.dirZ.header: noncomputable def dirZeroSegment (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Finset (Bond L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.dirZ.header:
theorem dirZeroSegment_subset (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    dirZeroSegment y x ⊆ staircasePath y x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.mem_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.mem_dirZeroSegment_of_mem_staircasePath
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.mem_.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.path.header:
theorem pathIntegral_axisField (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (X : SuTwo)
    (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pathIntegral (axisField (0 : Fin 3) c X) y x = (∑ b ∈ dirZeroSegment y x, c b.1) • X

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.axis.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.axisSegment_self_empty
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.axis.header:
theorem axisSegment_self_empty (base : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (a : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.axis.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.axisSegment_succ_singleton
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.axis.header:
theorem axisSegment_succ_singleton (base : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    axisSegment base μ (base μ).val ((base μ).val + 1) = {(base, μ)}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.corn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.corner2_apply_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.corn.header: theorem corner2_apply_zero (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : (corner2 y x) 0 = y 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.dirZ.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.dirZeroSegment_eq_empty
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.dirZ.header:
theorem dirZeroSegment_eq_empty (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (h : (x 0).val = (y 0).val) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.dirZ.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.dirZeroSegment_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.dirZ.header:
theorem dirZeroSegment_succ (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (h : (x 0).val = (y 0).val + 1) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.altC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.altC_corner2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.altC.header: theorem altC_corner2 (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5) : altC (corner2 y x) = altC y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.norm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.norm_sq_altC_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.norm.header:
theorem norm_sq_altC_smul (z : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5) :
    ‖(altC z) • rotGen‖ ^ 2 = ‖rotGen‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.path.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pathIntegral_altField_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.path.header:
theorem pathIntegral_altField_norm_sq (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5)
    (hx : x ∈ blockOf y 2) :
    ‖pathIntegral (axisField (0 : Fin 3) altC rotGen) y x‖ ^ 2
      = if (x 0).val = (y 0).val + 1 then ‖rotGen‖ ^ 2 else 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.coar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.coarseLattice_eq_piFinset
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.coar.header:
theorem coarseLattice_eq_piFinset (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) :
    CoarseLattice L ell
      = Fintype.piFinset (fun μ : Fin 3 =>
          Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (L μ + 1) => i.val % ell = 0))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bloc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.blockOf_slice_eq_piFinset
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bloc.header:
theorem blockOf_slice_eq_piFinset (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) :
    (blockOf y ell).filter (fun x => (x 0).val = (y 0).val + 1)
      = Fintype.piFinset (fun μ : Fin 3 =>
          Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (L μ + 1) =>
            (y μ).val ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < (y μ).val + ell ∧ (μ = 0 → i.val = (y μ).val + 1)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.card.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.card_blockOf_slice_witL5
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.card.header:
theorem card_blockOf_slice_witL5 (y : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5)
    (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val % 2 = 0) :
    ((blockOf y 2).filter (fun x => (x 0).val = (y 0).val + 1)).card = 4

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxB.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxBlock_altField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxB.header:
theorem pAxBlock_altField (y : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5) (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val % 2 = 0) :
    pAxBlock (axisField (0 : Fin 3) altC rotGen) 2 y = 4 * ‖rotGen‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_altField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_.header:
theorem pAx_altField :
    pAx (axisField (0 : Fin 3) altC rotGen) (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2 = 108 * ‖rotGen‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bond.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bondEnergy_altField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bond.header:
theorem bondEnergy_altField :
    bondEnergy (axisField (0 : Fin 3) altC rotGen) = 216 * ‖rotGen‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.gaug.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.gauge_fixing_sees_the_closed_mode
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.gaug.header:
theorem gauge_fixing_sees_the_closed_mode :
    deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected curvedRegularU
        (axisField (0 : Fin 3) altC rotGen) = 0
      ∧ AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.qCLM curvedRegularU 2
          (WithLp.toLp 2 (axisField (L := witL5) (0 : Fin 3) altC rotGen) : BondFnL2 witL5) = 0
      ∧ pAx (axisField (0 : Fin 3) altC rotGen) (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2
          = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * bondEnergy (axisField (0 : Fin 3) altC rotGen)
      ∧ 0 < pAx (axisField (0 : Fin 3) altC rotGen) (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.ofLp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.ofLp_add_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.ofLp.header:
theorem ofLp_add_apply (A B : BondFnL2 L) (b : Bond L) :
    (WithLp.ofLp (A + B)) b = (WithLp.ofLp A) b + (WithLp.ofLp B) b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.ofLp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.ofLp_smul_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.ofLp.header:
theorem ofLp_smul_apply (c : ℝ) (A : BondFnL2 L) (b : Bond L) :
    (WithLp.ofLp (c • A)) b = c • (WithLp.ofLp A) b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.path.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pathIntegral_ofLp_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.path.header:
theorem pathIntegral_ofLp_add (A B : BondFnL2 L) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pathIntegral (WithLp.ofLp (A + B)) y x
      = pathIntegral (WithLp.ofLp A) y x + pathIntegral (WithLp.ofLp B) y x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.path.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pathIntegral_ofLp_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.path.header:
theorem pathIntegral_ofLp_smul (c : ℝ) (A : BondFnL2 L) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pathIntegral (WithLp.ofLp (c • A)) y x = c • pathIntegral (WithLp.ofLp A) y x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxB.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxBil
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxB.header:
noncomputable def pAxBil (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ell : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxB.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxBil_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxB.header:
theorem pAxBil_apply (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ell : ℕ) (A B : BondFnL2 L) :
    pAxBil S ell A B = ∑ y ∈ S, ∑ x ∈ (blockOf y ell).erase y,

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxB.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxBil_symm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxB.header:
theorem pAxBil_symm (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ell : ℕ) (A B : BondFnL2 L) :
    pAxBil S ell A B = pAxBil S ell B A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxO.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxOp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxO.header:
noncomputable def pAxOp (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ell : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxCLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxC.header:
noncomputable def pAxCLM (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ell : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.inne.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.inner_pAxCLM_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.inne.header:
theorem inner_pAxCLM_eq (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ell : ℕ) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    (inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 A : BondFnL2 L) (pAxCLM S ell (WithLp.toLp 2 A)) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.inne.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.inner_pAxCLM_eq'
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.inne.header:
theorem inner_pAxCLM_eq' (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ell : ℕ) (v : BondFnL2 L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxC.header:
theorem pAxCLM_symm (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ell : ℕ) (u v : BondFnL2 L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxCLM_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxC.header:
theorem pAxCLM_pos (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ell : ℕ) (v : BondFnL2 L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.norm.header:
theorem norm_toLp_sq (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 A : BondFnL2 L)‖ ^ 2 = bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.inne.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.inner_pAxCLM_altVec
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.inne.header:
theorem inner_pAxCLM_altVec :
    (inner ℝ altVec (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2 altVec) : ℝ) = 108 * ‖rotGen‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.inne.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.inner_pAxCLM_altVec_eq_half
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.inne.header:
theorem inner_pAxCLM_altVec_eq_half :
    (inner ℝ altVec (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2 altVec) : ℝ) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖altVec‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxCLM_alternating_demand_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxC.header:
theorem pAxCLM_alternating_demand_iff (γ δ : ℝ) :
    ((γ - δ) * ‖altVec‖ ^ 2
        ≤ (inner ℝ altVec (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2 altVec) : ℝ))
      ↔ γ - δ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_axisField_eq_zero_of_even_vanishing
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_.header:
theorem pAx_axisField_eq_zero_of_even_vanishing (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (X : SuTwo)
    (h : ∀ z : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (z 0).val % 2 = 0 → c z = 0) :
    pAx (axisField (0 : Fin 3) c X) (CoarseLattice L 2) 2 = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bloc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.blockC
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bloc.header: noncomputable def blockC (z : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bloc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.blockC_transverse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bloc.header:
theorem blockC_transverse (z : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5) (ν : Fin 3) (hν : ν ≠ (0 : Fin 3)) :
    blockC (periodicLatticeShift z ν) = blockC z

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bloc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.blockC_even_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bloc.header:
theorem blockC_even_eq_zero (z : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5) (h : (z 0).val % 2 = 0) :
    blockC z = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.deltaK_blockField_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.delt.header:
theorem deltaK_blockField_eq_zero :
    deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected curvedRegularU (axisField (0 : Fin 3) blockC rotGen) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_blockField_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_.header:
theorem pAx_blockField_eq_zero :
    pAx (axisField (0 : Fin 3) blockC rotGen) (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2 = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bloc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.blockField_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bloc.header:
theorem blockField_ne_zero :
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (axisField (L := witL5) (0 : Fin 3) blockC rotGen) : BondFnL2 witL5) ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.deltaK_plus_pAx_not_coercive
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.delt.header:
theorem deltaK_plus_pAx_not_coercive (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) :
    ¬ (∀ A : Bond witL5 → SuTwo,
        γ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 A : BondFnL2 witL5)‖ ^ 2
          ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected curvedRegularU A
            + pAx A (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.rZer.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.rZeroA_axisField_ell2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.rZer.header:
theorem rZeroA_axisField_ell2
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (d : Fin 3) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (X : SuTwo) (hfix : LinkFixed U X)
    (cMinus x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    rZeroA U cMinus x (axisField d c X) μ 2
      = (if μ = d then c x + c (periodicLatticeShift x d) else 0) • X

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bloc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.blockOf_eq_piFinset
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bloc.header:
theorem blockOf_eq_piFinset (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) :
    blockOf y ell = Fintype.piFinset (fun μ : Fin 3 =>
      Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (L μ + 1) =>
        (y μ).val ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < (y μ).val + ell))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.card.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.card_blockOf_witL5
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.card.header:
theorem card_blockOf_witL5 (y : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5)
    (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val % 2 = 0) : (blockOf y 2).card = 8

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bloc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.blockC_pair_on_zero_block
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.bloc.header:
theorem blockC_pair_on_zero_block (x : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5)
    (hx : x ∈ blockOf (fun _ => (0 : Fin (witL5 0 + 1))) 2) :
    blockC x + blockC (periodicLatticeShift x (0 : Fin 3)) = -1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.line.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.lineCoarseRestrictCov_blockField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.line.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCov_blockField :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov curvedRegularU 2 (axisField (0 : Fin 3) blockC rotGen) zeroCoarseBond
      = (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) • rotGen

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.qCLM.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.qCLM_blockField_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.qCLM.header:
theorem qCLM_blockField_ne_zero :
    qCLM curvedRegularU 2
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (axisField (L := witL5) (0 : Fin 3) blockC rotGen) : BondFnL2 witL5) ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.both.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.both_gauge_clauses_are_load_bearing
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.both.header:
theorem both_gauge_clauses_are_load_bearing :
    (deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected curvedRegularU (axisField (0 : Fin 3) altC rotGen) = 0
        ∧ qCLM curvedRegularU 2 altVec = 0
        ∧ 0 < pAx (axisField (0 : Fin 3) altC rotGen) (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2)
      ∧ (deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected curvedRegularU (axisField (0 : Fin 3) blockC rotGen) = 0
        ∧ pAx (axisField (0 : Fin 3) blockC rotGen) (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2 = 0
        ∧ qCLM curvedRegularU 2
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (axisField (L := witL5) (0 : Fin 3) blockC rotGen) :
              BondFnL2 witL5) ≠ 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.corn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.corner1_apply_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.corn.header: theorem corner1_apply_zero (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : (corner1 y x) 0 = y 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.stai.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.staircasePath_coord_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.stai.header:
theorem staircasePath_coord_zero {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {b : Bond L}
    (hb : b ∈ staircasePath y x) (hd : b.2 ≠ 0) : b.1 0 = y 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_eq_zero_of_support_off_coarse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_.header:
theorem pAx_eq_zero_of_support_off_coarse (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (ell : ℕ)
    (hA : ∀ b : Bond L, A b ≠ 0 → b.2 ≠ 0 ∧ (b.1 0).val % ell ≠ 0) :
    pAx A (CoarseLattice L ell) ell = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_dipole_at_odd_slice_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_.header:
theorem pAx_dipole_at_odd_slice_eq_zero
    (s s' : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (w : SuTwo) (ell : ℕ)
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (hs : (s 0).val = 1) (hs' : (s' 0).val = 1) :
    pAx (fun e : Bond L =>
      ((if e = (s, μ) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if e = (s', μ) then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) • w)
      (CoarseLattice L ell) ell = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.dipo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.dipole_field_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.dipo.header:
theorem dipole_field_ne_zero (s s' : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (w : SuTwo)
    (hss : s ≠ s') (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    (fun e : Bond L =>
        ((if e = (s, μ) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if e = (s', μ) then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) • w)
      ≠ (fun _ => (0 : SuTwo))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_blind_to_nonzero_odd_slice_dipole
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAx_.header:
theorem pAx_blind_to_nonzero_odd_slice_dipole
    (s s' : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (w : SuTwo) (ell : ℕ)
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (hs : (s 0).val = 1) (hs' : (s' 0).val = 1)
    (hss : s ≠ s') (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    (fun e : Bond L =>
        ((if e = (s, μ) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if e = (s', μ) then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) • w)
        ≠ (fun _ => (0 : SuTwo))
      ∧ pAx (fun e : Bond L =>
          ((if e = (s, μ) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if e = (s', μ) then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) • w)
        (CoarseLattice L ell) ell = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.stai.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.staircasePath_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.stai.header: theorem staircasePath_self (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : staircasePath y y = ∅

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.path.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pathIntegral_succ_diff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.path.header:
theorem pathIntegral_succ_diff (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (y x x' : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hsucc : (x 0).val = (y 0).val + 1)
    (h0 : x' 0 = y 0) (h1 : x' 1 = x 1) (h2 : x' 2 = x 2) :
    pathIntegral A y x - pathIntegral A y x' = A (corner2 y x, (0 : Fin 3))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxB.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxBlock_le_pAx
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.pAxB.header:
theorem pAxBlock_le_pAx (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ell : ℕ)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ S) : pAxBlock A ell y ≤ pAx A S ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.norm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.norm_sq_pathIntegral_le_pAxBlock
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.norm.header:
theorem norm_sq_pathIntegral_le_pAxBlock (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (ell : ℕ)
    {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ blockOf y ell) :
    ‖pathIntegral A y x‖ ^ 2 ≤ pAxBlock A ell y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.norm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.norm_sq_tree_bond_le_pAx
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.norm.header:
theorem norm_sq_tree_bond_le_pAx (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L))
    (ell : ℕ) (y x x' : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ S)
    (hx : x ∈ blockOf y ell) (hx' : x' ∈ blockOf y ell)
    (hsucc : (x 0).val = (y 0).val + 1)
    (h0 : x' 0 = y 0) (h1 : x' 1 = x 1) (h2 : x' 2 = x 2) :
    ‖A (corner2 y x, (0 : Fin 3))‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * pAx A S ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.tree.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.tree_control_nonvacuous_at_altField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialCoercivity.tree.header:
theorem tree_control_nonvacuous_at_altField :
    ‖(AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.axisField (0 : Fin 3)
        AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.altC
        AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen)
      ((fun _ => 0 : PeriodicLatticeSite AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUDomainWitness.witL5),
        (0 : Fin 3))‖ ^ 2
      = ‖AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.Ax.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.Ax
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.Ax.header: def Ax (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) : Finset (Bond L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.mem_Ax.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.mem_Ax
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.mem_Ax.header:
theorem mem_Ax {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {ell : ℕ} {b : Bond L} :
    b ∈ Ax y ell ↔ ∃ x ∈ blockOf y ell, x ≠ y ∧ b ∈ staircasePath y x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.AxLocus.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.AxLocus
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.AxLocus.header: def AxLocus (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) : Submodule ℝ (Bond L → ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.mem_AxL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.mem_AxLocus
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.mem_AxL.header:
theorem mem_AxLocus {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {ell : ℕ} {B : Bond L → ℝ} :
    B ∈ AxLocus y ell ↔ ∀ b ∈ Ax y ell, B b = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.AxUnion.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.AxUnionLocus
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.AxUnion.header: def AxUnionLocus (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ell : ℕ) : Submodule ℝ (Bond L → ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.mem_AxU.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.mem_AxUnionLocus
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.mem_AxU.header:
theorem mem_AxUnionLocus {S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {ell : ℕ} {B : Bond L → ℝ} :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.axUnion.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.axUnionLocus_eq_iInf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.axUnion.header:
theorem axUnionLocus_eq_iInf (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ell : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.cmp95Ax.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.cmp95AxLocus
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.cmp95Ax.header: abbrev cmp95AxLocus (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) : Submodule ℝ (Bond L → ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.witness.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.witnessBond0_mem_Ax
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.witness.header: theorem witnessBond0_mem_Ax : axWitnessTrunkBond ∈ Ax witnessY witnessEll

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.witness.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.witnessOutsideBond_not_mem_Ax
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.witness.header:
theorem witnessOutsideBond_not_mem_Ax :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.blockOf.header: theorem blockOf_one (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : blockOf y 1 = {y}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.Ax_one.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.Ax_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.Ax_one.header: theorem Ax_one (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Ax y 1 = ∅

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.AxLocus.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.AxLocus_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.AxLocus.header: theorem AxLocus_one (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : AxLocus y 1 = ⊤

AdalyFormal.Balaban.AxialContour.Ax_dege.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging.longBondValueSuTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..header:
noncomputable def longBondValueSuTwo {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging.longBondValueSuTwo_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..header:
theorem longBondValueSuTwo_add {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (A1 A2 : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) :
    longBondValueSuTwo (A1 + A2) x μ ell =
      longBondValueSuTwo A1 x μ ell + longBondValueSuTwo A2 x μ ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging.longBondValueSuTwo_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..header:
theorem longBondValueSuTwo_smul {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (c : ℝ) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) :
    longBondValueSuTwo (c • A) x μ ell = c • longBondValueSuTwo A x μ ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging.longBondValueSuTwo_ell2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..header:
theorem longBondValueSuTwo_ell2 {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    longBondValueSuTwo A x μ 2 = A (x, μ) + A (periodicLatticeShift x μ, μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging.qPrimeSuTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..header:
noncomputable def qPrimeSuTwo {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell : ℕ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging.qPrimeSuTwo_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..header:
theorem qPrimeSuTwo_add {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell : ℕ) (A1 A2 : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (b : LatticeOperators.CoarseBond L ell) :
    qPrimeSuTwo ell (A1 + A2) b = qPrimeSuTwo ell A1 b + qPrimeSuTwo ell A2 b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging.qPrimeSuTwo_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..header:
theorem qPrimeSuTwo_smul {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (b : LatticeOperators.CoarseBond L ell) :
    qPrimeSuTwo ell (c • A) b = c • qPrimeSuTwo ell A b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging.qPrimeSuTwoLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..header:
noncomputable def qPrimeSuTwoLM (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging.shift0_witnessY_ne_witnessY
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..header: theorem shift0_witnessY_ne_witnessY : periodicLatticeShift witnessY 0 ≠ witnessY

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging.qPrimeSuTwo_deltaWitnessConfig

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..header: def refOrigin : PeriodicLatticeSite witnessL

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BackgroundAveraging.refSteps_endpoint

    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (z : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}) : ℝ

BackwardCert.sum_prev_reindex.name: BackwardCert.sum_prev_reindex
BackwardCert.sum_prev_reindex.header:
theorem sum_prev_reindex {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (φ : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell} → Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    (∑ z : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell},
        ∑ μ : Fin 3, φ ((coarseShiftEquiv ell μ hdvd).symm z) μ)
      = ∑ z : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}, ∑ μ : Fin 3, φ z μ

BackwardCert.geomForm_eq_sum_localGeomBa.header:

    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < L μ + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) :
    geomForm ell B
      = ∑ z : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell},
          LocalGeomBackward ell hdvd B z

BackwardCert.geomInequality_of_backwardB.header:

    (B : Bond L → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ z : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell},
      0 ≤ LocalGeomBackward ell hdvd B z) :
    GeomInequality ell B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.frobSq_smul.header: theorem frobSq_smul (r : ℝ) (X : M2) : frobSq (r • X) = r ^ 2 * frobSq X

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.IsSu2.smul.header: theorem IsSu2.smul {X : M2} (hX : IsSu2 X) (r : ℝ) : IsSu2 (r • X)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.nu_Yof.header: theorem nu_Yof (g : SU2) : nu (Yof g) = Real.sin (su2Angle g)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.kappa_le.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.kappa_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.kappa_le.header: theorem kappa_le {g : SU2} (h : su2Angle g ≤ Real.pi / 2) : su2Kappa g ≤ Real.pi / 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_lipschit.header:

theorem Yof_exp {X : M2} (hX : IsSu2 X) (h : nu X ≤ Real.pi) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.sq_eq_real.header: theorem sq_eq_real {X : M2} (hX : IsSu2 X) : X * X = (-(nu X ^ 2)) • (1 : M2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.central_expand_.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.isSu2_listSum.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.isSu2_listSum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.isSu2_listSum.header:
theorem isSu2_listSum : ∀ (L : List M2), (∀ X ∈ L, IsSu2 X) → IsSu2 L.sum
  | [], _ => by simpa using IsSu2.zero
  | X :: L, h => by
      rw [List.sum_cons]
      exact (h X (by simp)).add (isSu2_listSum L (fun Y hY => h Y (by simp [hY])))

theorem frobNorm_listSum_le : ∀ (L : List M2),
    frobNorm L.sum ≤ (L.map frobNorm).sum
  | [] => by simp [frobNorm, frobSq]
  | X :: L => by
      rw [List.sum_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      exact le_trans (frobNorm_add_le X L.sum)
        (by linarith [frobNorm_listSum_le L])

theorem frobNorm_listMap_nonneg : ∀ (L : List M2), 0 ≤ (L.map frobNorm).sum
  | [] => by simp
  | X :: L => by
      rw [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      linarith [frobNorm_nonneg X, frobNorm_listMap_nonneg L]

                                                                                       
                                                                                               
                      
theorem bch2_telescope_core : ∀ (L : List M2), (∀ X ∈ L, IsSu2 X) →
    (L.map frobNorm).sum ≤ 1/8 →
    su2Exp (su2Log (expProd L)) = expProd L ∧
      frobNorm (su2Log (expProd L) - L.sum) ≤ 14 * ((L.map frobNorm).sum) ^ 2
  | [], _, _ => by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [expProd_nil, su2Log_one, su2Exp_zero]
      · rw [expProd_nil, su2Log_one, List.sum_nil, sub_zero]
        simp [frobNorm, frobSq]
  | X :: L, hmem, hsmall => by
      have hX : IsSu2 X

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.frobNorm_listMa.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_eq_half_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_eq_half_pi_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_eq_half_.header:
theorem su2Log_eq_half_pi_smul {g : SU2} (h : su2Angle g = Real.pi / 2) :
    su2Log g = (Real.pi / 2) • (g : M2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_lipschit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_lipschitz_attained_on_boundary
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_lipschit.header:
theorem su2Log_lipschitz_attained_on_boundary {g g' : SU2}
    (h : su2Angle g = Real.pi / 2) (h' : su2Angle g' = Real.pi / 2) :
    frobNorm (su2Log g - su2Log g')
      = (Real.pi / 2) * frobNorm ((g : M2) - (g' : M2))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.sharp_num.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.sharp_num
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.sharp_num.header: theorem sharp_num : su2Log sG - su2Log sG' = Real.pi • wJ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.sharp_den.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.sharp_den
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.sharp_den.header: theorem sharp_den : ((sG : SU2) : M2) - ((sG' : SU2) : M2) = (2 : ℝ) • wJ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.frobNorm_sharp_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.frobNorm_sharp_num
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.frobNorm_sharp_.header: theorem frobNorm_sharp_num : frobNorm (su2Log sG - su2Log sG') = Real.pi * Real.sqrt 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.frobNorm_sharp_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.frobNorm_sharp_den
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.frobNorm_sharp_.header:
theorem frobNorm_sharp_den :
    frobNorm (((sG : SU2) : M2) - ((sG' : SU2) : M2)) = 2 * Real.sqrt 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_lipschit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_lipschitz_attained
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_lipschit.header:
theorem su2Log_lipschitz_attained :
    frobNorm (su2Log sG - su2Log sG')
      = (Real.pi / 2) * frobNorm (((sG : SU2) : M2) - ((sG' : SU2) : M2))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.sharp_pair_sepa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.sharp_pair_separated
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.sharp_pair_sepa.header: theorem sharp_pair_separated : 0 < frobNorm (((sG : SU2) : M2) - ((sG' : SU2) : M2))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_lipschit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_lipschitz_constant_sharp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_lipschit.header:
theorem su2Log_lipschitz_constant_sharp {c : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ g g' : SU2, su2Angle g ≤ Real.pi / 2 → su2Angle g' ≤ Real.pi / 2 →
      frobNorm (su2Log g - su2Log g') ≤ c * frobNorm ((g : M2) - (g' : M2))) :
    Real.pi / 2 ≤ c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_lipschit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_lipschitz_isLeast
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_lipschit.header:
theorem su2Log_lipschitz_isLeast :
    IsLeast {c : ℝ | ∀ g g' : SU2, su2Angle g ≤ Real.pi / 2 → su2Angle g' ≤ Real.pi / 2 →
        frobNorm (su2Log g - su2Log g') ≤ c * frobNorm ((g : M2) - (g' : M2))} (Real.pi / 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_not_lips.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_not_lipschitz_three_halves
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_not_lips.header:
theorem su2Log_not_lipschitz_three_halves :
    ¬ (∀ g g' : SU2, su2Angle g ≤ Real.pi / 2 → su2Angle g' ≤ Real.pi / 2 →
      frobNorm (su2Log g - su2Log g') ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * frobNorm ((g : M2) - (g' : M2)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.frobNorm_orth_d.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.frobNorm_orth_den
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.frobNorm_orth_d.header:
theorem frobNorm_orth_den :
    frobNorm (((sG : SU2) : M2) - ((sK : SU2) : M2)) = 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_lipschit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_lipschitz_attained_orthogonal
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.su2Log_lipschit.header:
theorem su2Log_lipschitz_attained_orthogonal :
    frobNorm (su2Log sG - su2Log sK)
      = (Real.pi / 2) * frobNorm (((sG : SU2) : M2) - ((sK : SU2) : M2))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.orth_pair_separ.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.orth_pair_separated
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.orth_pair_separ.header: theorem orth_pair_separated : 0 < frobNorm (((sG : SU2) : M2) - ((sK : SU2) : M2))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.frobNorm_orth_n.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.frobNorm_orth_num
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.frobNorm_orth_n.header: theorem frobNorm_orth_num : frobNorm (su2Log sG - su2Log sK) = Real.pi

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.log_iG_sub.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.log_iG_sub
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.log_iG_sub.header: theorem log_iG_sub : su2Log iG - su2Log iG' = (Real.pi / 2) • wJ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.coe_iG_sub.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.coe_iG_sub
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.coe_iG_sub.header:
theorem coe_iG_sub :
    ((iG : SU2) : M2) - ((iG' : SU2) : M2) = (Real.sqrt 2) • wJ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.lipschitz_stric.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.lipschitz_strict_inside
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.lipschitz_stric.header:
theorem lipschitz_strict_inside :
    frobNorm (su2Log iG - su2Log iG')
      < (Real.pi / 2) * frobNorm (((iG : SU2) : M2) - ((iG' : SU2) : M2))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.h2prime_attaine.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.h2prime_attained_at_sG
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.h2prime_attaine.header:
theorem h2prime_attained_at_sG :
    frobNorm (su2Log sG) =
      (Real.pi / (2 * Real.sqrt 2)) * frobNorm (((sG : SU2) : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.h2prime_constan.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.h2prime_constant_lower
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.h2prime_constan.header:
theorem h2prime_constant_lower {c : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ g : SU2, su2Angle g ≤ Real.pi / 2 →
      frobNorm (su2Log g) ≤ c * frobNorm ((g : M2) - 1)) :
    Real.pi / (2 * Real.sqrt 2) ≤ c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.h2prime_isLeast.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.h2prime_isLeast
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.h2prime_isLeast.header:
theorem h2prime_isLeast :
    IsLeast {c : ℝ | ∀ g : SU2, su2Angle g ≤ Real.pi / 2 →
        frobNorm (su2Log g) ≤ c * frobNorm ((g : M2) - 1)} (Real.pi / (2 * Real.sqrt 2))

BlockFaithful.origin_mem_coarse.name: BlockFaithful.origin_mem_coarse
BlockFaithful.origin_mem_coarse.header: theorem origin_mem_coarse (ell : ℕ) : (0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) ∈ CoarseLattice L ell

BlockFaithful.refBlock.name: BlockFaithful.refBlock
BlockFaithful.refBlock.header:
def refBlock (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) :
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}

BlockFaithful.prevSite_self.name: BlockFaithful.prevSite_self
BlockFaithful.prevSite_self.header: theorem prevSite_self (μ : Fin 3) : ((prevSite μ : PeriodicLatticeSite L) μ).val = L μ - 1

BlockFaithful.prevSite_ne.name: BlockFaithful.prevSite_ne
BlockFaithful.prevSite_ne.header:
theorem prevSite_ne (μ ν : Fin 3) (h : ν ≠ μ) :
    ((prevSite μ : PeriodicLatticeSite L) ν) = 0

BlockFaithful.prevSite_mem.name: BlockFaithful.prevSite_mem
BlockFaithful.prevSite_mem.header:
theorem prevSite_mem (μ : Fin 3) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    (prevSite μ : PeriodicLatticeSite L) ∈ CoarseLattice L 2

BlockFaithful.prevμ_refBlock_eq.name: BlockFaithful.prevμ_refBlock_eq
BlockFaithful.prevμ_refBlock_eq.header:
theorem prevμ_refBlock_eq (μ : Fin 3) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    (coarseShiftEquiv 2 μ hdvd).symm (refBlock L 2)
      = ⟨prevSite μ, prevSite_mem μ hdvd⟩

BlockFaithful.localGeomBackward_refBlock.name: BlockFaithful.localGeomBackward_refBlock_explicit
BlockFaithful.localGeomBackward_refBlock.header:
theorem localGeomBackward_refBlock_explicit
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1)) (B : Bond L → ℝ) :
    LocalGeomBackward 2 hdvd B (refBlock L 2)
      = ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ∑ μ : Fin 3,
            (lineCoarseRestrict 2 B (⟨prevSite μ, prevSite_mem μ hdvd⟩, μ)) ^ 2
        + (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) * ∑ μ : Fin 3,
            ∑ p ∈ slabPlaqs (⟨prevSite μ, prevSite_mem μ hdvd⟩, μ), (curlValue B p) ^ 2
        - (1 / 3) * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3) * ∑ μ : Fin 3,
            topFaceEnergy B (prevSite μ) 2 μ
        + 6 * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) *
            ∑ b ∈ bondsInBlock (0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) 2, (B b) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.blo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.blockMean
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.blo.header: noncomputable def blockMean (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.mea.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.meanForm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.mea.header: noncomputable def meanForm (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.blo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.blockForm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.blo.header: noncomputable def blockForm (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.sum.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.sumSq2_split
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.sum.header:
theorem sumSq2_split (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    sumSq2 n f = var2 n f + (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (blockMean n f) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.blo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.block_operator_gap_general
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.blo.header:
theorem block_operator_gap_general (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    blockForm n a f ≥ (min 1 a / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * sumSq2 n f

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.blo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.block_operator_gap
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockOperatorGap.blo.header:
theorem block_operator_gap (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (a : ℝ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    blockForm n a f ≥ (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * sumSq2 n f

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.bondIn.header: abbrev bondInBlock (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) (b : Bond L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.bondsI.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.bondsInBlock
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.bondsI.header: def bondsInBlock (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) : Finset (Bond L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.mem_bo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.mem_bondsInBlock
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.mem_bo.header:
theorem mem_bondsInBlock {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {ell : ℕ} {b : Bond L} :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.plaqIn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.plaqInBlock
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.plaqIn.header: abbrev plaqInBlock (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.plaqsI.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.plaqsInBlock
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.plaqsI.header: def plaqsInBlock (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) : Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.mem_pl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.mem_plaqsInBlock
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.mem_pl.header:
theorem mem_plaqsInBlock {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {ell : ℕ} {p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L} :
    p ∈ plaqsInBlock y ell ↔ plaqInBlock y ell p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.nextBl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.nextBlock_mem_coarseLattice

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.period.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.periodicLatticeShift_coord_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.period.header:
theorem periodicLatticeShift_coord_ne {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    {μ ν : Fin 3} (hν : ν ≠ μ) : (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν = x ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.noWrap.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.noWrap_of_bondInBlock

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir0_b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir0_bond_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir0_b.header:
theorem dir0_bond_eq_zero {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (hstrict : ell < L 0 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (b : Bond L) (hb2 : b.2 = 0) (hbb : bondInBlock y ell b) :
    B b = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.z0.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.z0
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.z0.header: def z0 (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.z0_coo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.z0_coord0
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.z0_coo.header: theorem z0_coord0 (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : (z0 y x) 0 = y 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.z0_coo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.z0_coord_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.z0_coo.header:
theorem z0_coord_ne (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {ν : Fin 3} (hν : ν ≠ 0) :
    (z0 y x) ν = x ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK.header: def zK (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (k : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_zer.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_zer.header: theorem zK_zero (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : zK y x 0 = z0 y x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_suc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_suc.header:
theorem zK_succ (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (k : ℕ) :
    zK y x (k + 1) = periodicLatticeShift (zK y x k) 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_coo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_coord0
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_coo.header:
theorem zK_coord0 (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (k : ℕ) :
    (zK y x k 0).val = ((y 0).val + k) % (L 0 + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_coo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_coord_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_coo.header:
theorem zK_coord_ne (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (k : ℕ) {ν : Fin 3} (hν : ν ≠ 0) :
    (zK y x k) ν = x ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_wal.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_walkLength
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_wal.header:
theorem zK_walkLength (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hge : (y 0).val ≤ (x 0).val)
    (hlt : (x 0).val < L 0 + 1) : zK y x ((x 0).val - (y 0).val) = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_coo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_coord0_eq_of_le

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.z0_bon.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.z0_bond1_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.z0_bon.header:
theorem z0_bond1_eq_zero {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (hstrict1 : ell < L 1 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ blockOf y ell)
    (hshift1 : periodicLatticeShift x 1 ∈ blockOf y ell) :
    B (z0 y x, (1 : Fin 3)) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_mem.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_mem_blockOf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.zK_mem.header:
theorem zK_mem_blockOf {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hx : x ∈ blockOf y ell) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ (x 0).val - (y 0).val) :
    zK y x k ∈ blockOf y ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.shift1.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.shift1_zK_mem_blockOf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.shift1.header:
theorem shift1_zK_mem_blockOf {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (hstrict1 : ell < L 1 + 1)
    (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ blockOf y ell)
    (hshift1 : periodicLatticeShift x 1 ∈ blockOf y ell) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ (x 0).val - (y 0).val) :
    periodicLatticeShift (zK y x k) 1 ∈ blockOf y ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.shift0.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.shift0_shift1_zK_mem_blockOf

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir1_s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir1_step_eq_curl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir1_s.header:
theorem dir1_step_eq_curl {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ}
    (hstrict0 : ell < L 0 + 1) (hstrict1 : ell < L 1 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ blockOf y ell)
    (hshift1 : periodicLatticeShift x 1 ∈ blockOf y ell) {k : ℕ}
    (hk1 : k + 1 ≤ (x 0).val - (y 0).val) :
    curlValue B (zK y x k, ⟨((0 : Fin 3), (1 : Fin 3)), by decide⟩)
      = B (zK y x (k + 1), (1 : Fin 3)) - B (zK y x k, (1 : Fin 3))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.telesc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.telescope_sum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.telesc.header:
theorem telescope_sum (φ : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (φ (k + 1) - φ k) = φ n - φ 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir1_b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir1_bondSq_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir1_b.header:
theorem dir1_bondSq_le {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ}
    (hstrict0 : ell < L 0 + 1) (hstrict1 : ell < L 1 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (b : Bond L) (hb2 : b.2 = 1) (hbb : bondInBlock y ell b) :
    (B b) ^ 2 ≤ ((ell : ℝ) - 1) *
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range ((b.1 0).val - (y 0).val),
        (curlValue B (zK y b.1 k, ⟨((0 : Fin 3), (1 : Fin 3)), by decide⟩)) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.w0.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.w0
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.w0.header: def w0 (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.w0_coo.header: theorem w0_coord0 (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : (w0 y x) 0 = y 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.w0_coo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.w0_coord1
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.w0_coo.header: theorem w0_coord1 (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : (w0 y x) 1 = y 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.w0_coo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.w0_coord2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.w0_coo.header: theorem w0_coord2 (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : (w0 y x) 2 = x 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.wK.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.wK
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.wK.header: def wK (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (k : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.wK_zer.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.wK_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.wK_zer.header: theorem wK_zero (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : wK y x 0 = w0 y x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.wK_suc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.wK_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.wK_suc.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.wK_coo.header:
theorem wK_coord_ne (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (k : ℕ) {ν : Fin 3} (hν : ν ≠ 1) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.wK_coo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.wK_coord0
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.wK_coo.header: theorem wK_coord0 (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (k : ℕ) : (wK y x k) 0 = y 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir2_s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir2_stepA_eq_curl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir2_s.header:
theorem dir2_stepA_eq_curl {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ}
    (hstrict0 : ell < L 0 + 1) (hstrict2 : ell < L 2 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ blockOf y ell)
    (hshift2 : periodicLatticeShift x 2 ∈ blockOf y ell) {k : ℕ}
    (hk1 : k + 1 ≤ (x 0).val - (y 0).val) :
    curlValue B (zK y x k, ⟨((0 : Fin 3), (2 : Fin 3)), by decide⟩)
      = B (zK y x (k + 1), (2 : Fin 3)) - B (zK y x k, (2 : Fin 3))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.z0_mem.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.z0_mem_blockOf

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.shift2.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.shift2_wK_bond1_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.shift2.header:
theorem shift2_wK_bond1_eq_zero {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (hstrict2 : ell < L 2 + 1)
