AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir2_s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir2_stepB_eq_curl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir2_s.header:
theorem dir2_stepB_eq_curl {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (hstrict2 : ell < L 2 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ blockOf y ell)
    (hshift2 : periodicLatticeShift x 2 ∈ blockOf y ell) {k : ℕ}
    (hk1 : k + 1 ≤ (x 1).val - (y 1).val) :
    curlValue B (wK y x k, ⟨((1 : Fin 3), (2 : Fin 3)), by decide⟩)
      = B (wK y x (k + 1), (2 : Fin 3)) - B (wK y x k, (2 : Fin 3))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir2_b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir2_bondSq_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir2_b.header:
theorem dir2_bondSq_le {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ}
    (hstrict0 : ell < L 0 + 1) (hstrict2 : ell < L 2 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (b : Bond L) (hb2 : b.2 = 2) (hbb : bondInBlock y ell b) :
    (B b) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1)) *
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range ((b.1 0).val - (y 0).val),
          (curlValue B (zK y b.1 k, ⟨((0 : Fin 3), (2 : Fin 3)), by decide⟩)) ^ 2
       + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range ((b.1 1).val - (y 1).val),
          (curlValue B (wK y b.1 k, ⟨((1 : Fin 3), (2 : Fin 3)), by decide⟩)) ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir1_b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir1_bond_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir1_b.header:
theorem dir1_bond_eq_sum {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ}
    (hstrict0 : ell < L 0 + 1) (hstrict1 : ell < L 1 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (b : Bond L) (hb2 : b.2 = 1) (hbb : bondInBlock y ell b) :
    B b = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range ((b.1 0).val - (y 0).val),
        curlValue B (zK y b.1 k, ⟨((0 : Fin 3), (1 : Fin 3)), by decide⟩)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir2_b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir2_bond_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.dir2_b.header:
theorem dir2_bond_eq_sum {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ}
    (hstrict0 : ell < L 0 + 1) (hstrict2 : ell < L 2 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (b : Bond L) (hb2 : b.2 = 2) (hbb : bondInBlock y ell b) :
    B b = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range ((b.1 0).val - (y 0).val),
          curlValue B (zK y b.1 k, ⟨((0 : Fin 3), (2 : Fin 3)), by decide⟩))
        + (∑ k ∈ Finset.range ((b.1 1).val - (y 1).val),
          curlValue B (wK y b.1 k, ⟨((1 : Fin 3), (2 : Fin 3)), by decide⟩))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.blockP.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.blockPoincareConst_bound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.blockP.header: theorem blockPoincareConst_bound (ell : ℕ) : (2 * ell) * (ell * ell) ≤ 3 * ell ^ 3

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.shift2.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.plaq01.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.plaq01_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.plaq01.header:
theorem plaq01_mem {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (hstrict1 : ell < L 1 + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.plaq02.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.plaq12.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.plaq12_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.plaq12.header:
theorem plaq12_mem {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (hstrict2 : ell < L 2 + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.steps_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.steps_bondInBlock
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.steps_recover
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.steps_.header:
theorem steps_recover {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    {b : Bond L} {p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L} (hp : p ∈ steps y ell b) :
    b.1 2 = p.1 2 ∧

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.steps_.header:
theorem steps_hK {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (b : Bond L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.bondAb.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.bondAbs_sq_sum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.bondAb.header:
theorem bondAbs_sq_sum {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (B : Bond L → ℝ)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, (bAbs B y ell b) ^ 2 = ∑ b ∈ bondsInBlock y ell, (B b) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.plaqAb.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.plaqAbs_sq_sum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.plaqAb.header:

    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) :
    ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, (pAbs B y ell p) ^ 2
      = ∑ p ∈ plaqsInBlock y ell, (curlValue B p) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.steps_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.steps_hTri
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.steps_.header:
theorem steps_hTri {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ}
    (hstrict0 : ell < L 0 + 1) (hstrict1 : ell < L 1 + 1) (hstrict2 : ell < L 2 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (b : Bond L) :
    bAbs B y ell b ≤ ∑ p ∈ steps y ell b, pAbs B y ell p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.block_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.block_poincare
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.block_.header:
theorem block_poincare {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ}
    (hstrict0 : ell < L 0 + 1) (hstrict1 : ell < L 1 + 1) (hstrict2 : ell < L 2 + 1)

    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :
    ∑ b ∈ bondsInBlock y ell, (B b) ^ 2
      ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * ∑ p ∈ plaqsInBlock y ell, (curlValue B p) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.block_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.block_poincare_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincare.block_.header:
theorem block_poincare_nonvacuous :

        ≤ 3 * (witnessEll : ℝ) ^ 3
            * ∑ p ∈ plaqsInBlock witnessY witnessEll, (curlValue innerConfig p) ^ 2 ∧

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareLemma24.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareLemma24.region_2123
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareLemma24.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.w.header:
theorem weighted_add_sq (a b t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    (a + b) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + 1 / t) * a ^ 2 + (1 + t) * b ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.l.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.leg_bound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.l.header:
theorem leg_bound (stp : Bnd → Finset Plq) (S : Finset Plq) (g : Plq → ℝ) (K M : ℕ)
    (hsub : ∀ b, stp b ⊆ S) (hK : ∀ b, (stp b).card ≤ K)
    (hM : ∀ p, AdalyFormal.Migration.BlockPoincare.plaqMultiplicity stp p ≤ M)
    (_hgnn : ∀ p, 0 ≤ g p) :
    ∑ b : Bnd, (∑ p ∈ stp b, g p) ^ 2 ≤ (K : ℝ) * M * ∑ p ∈ S, (g p) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.t.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.two_leg_core
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.t.header:
theorem two_leg_core (stpA stpB : Bnd → Finset Plq) (SA SB : Finset Plq)
    (bondAbs : Bnd → ℝ) (plaqAbs : Plq → ℝ) (KA KB MA MB : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hsubA : ∀ b, stpA b ⊆ SA) (hsubB : ∀ b, stpB b ⊆ SB)
    (hKA : ∀ b, (stpA b).card ≤ KA) (hKB : ∀ b, (stpB b).card ≤ KB)
    (hMA : ∀ p, AdalyFormal.Migration.BlockPoincare.plaqMultiplicity stpA p ≤ MA)
    (hMB : ∀ p, AdalyFormal.Migration.BlockPoincare.plaqMultiplicity stpB p ≤ MB)
    (hbnn : ∀ b, 0 ≤ bondAbs b) (hpnn : ∀ p, 0 ≤ plaqAbs p)
    (hTri : ∀ b, bondAbs b ≤ (∑ p ∈ stpA b, plaqAbs p) + (∑ p ∈ stpB b, plaqAbs p)) :
    ∑ b : Bnd, (bondAbs b) ^ 2
      ≤ (1 + 1 / t) * (KA : ℝ) * MA * (∑ p ∈ SA, (plaqAbs p) ^ 2)
        + (1 + t) * (KB : ℝ) * MB * (∑ p ∈ SB, (plaqAbs p) ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.steps_eq_union
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem steps_eq_union (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) (b : Bond L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.stepsB_eq_dir12
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem stepsB_eq_dir12 {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {ell : ℕ} {b : Bond L}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.steps_hTri_split
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem steps_hTri_split {ell : ℕ}
    (hstrict0 : ell < L 0 + 1) (hstrict1 : ell < L 1 + 1) (hstrict2 : ell < L 2 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (b : Bond L) :
    bAbs B y ell b ≤ (∑ p ∈ stepsA y ell b, pAbs B y ell p)
      + (∑ p ∈ stepsB y ell b, pAbs B y ell p)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.stepsA_hK
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem stepsA_hK (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) (b : Bond L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.stepsB_hK
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem stepsB_hK (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) (b : Bond L) :
    (stepsB y ell b).card ≤ ell - 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.stepsA_recover
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem stepsA_recover {ell : ℕ} {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {b : Bond L}
    {p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L} (hp : p ∈ stepsA y ell b) :
    b.1 1 = p.1 1 ∧ b.1 2 = p.1 2 ∧ 1 ≤ (b.1 0).val - (y 0).val ∧
      b.2 = (if p.2 = (⟨((0:Fin 3),(1:Fin 3)), by decide⟩ : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections)
        then (1 : Fin 3) else 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.stepsB_hM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem stepsB_hM {ell : ℕ} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :

theorem plaqsAB_union (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem stepsA_sub {ell : ℕ} (hstrict1 : ell < L 1 + 1) (hstrict2 : ell < L 2 + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.blockPoincareSharpConst_lt
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.b.header:
theorem blockPoincareSharpConst_lt (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) :
    blockPoincareSharpConst ell < 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.block_poincare_sharp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.b.header:
theorem block_poincare_sharp {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict0 : ell < L 0 + 1) (hstrict1 : ell < L 1 + 1) (hstrict2 : ell < L 2 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :
    ∑ b ∈ bondsInBlock y ell, (B b) ^ 2
      ≤ blockPoincareSharpConst ell * ∑ p ∈ plaqsInBlock y ell, (curlValue B p) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.r.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.region_2123_sharp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.r.header:
theorem region_2123_sharp {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict0 : ell < L 0 + 1) (hstrict1 : ell < L 1 + 1) (hstrict2 : ell < L 2 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell) :
    inBlockBondEnergy ell B ≤ blockPoincareSharpConst ell * inBlockCurlEnergy ell B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.bcoef
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.b.header: noncomputable def bcoef (ell : ℕ) (C : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.n.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.needed_2123_constant
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.n.header:
theorem needed_2123_constant (ell : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    bcoef ell C ≤ 108 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4
      ↔ C ≤ (108 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4 - 6 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) / (54 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.n.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.needed_2123_constant_lt_two_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.n.header:
theorem needed_2123_constant_lt_two_sq (ell : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    (108 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4 - 6 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) / (54 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 + 1) < 2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.p.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.printed_const_fails_requirement
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.p.header:
theorem printed_const_fails_requirement (ell : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    108 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4 < bcoef ell (3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sharp_const_meets_requirement_ell2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem sharp_const_meets_requirement_ell2 :
    bcoef 2 (blockPoincareSharpConst 2) = 675 ∧ (675 : ℝ) ≤ 108 * (2 : ℝ) ^ 4

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sharp_const_meets_requirement_ell3
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem sharp_const_meets_requirement_ell3 :
    bcoef 3 (blockPoincareSharpConst 3) = 7846 ∧ (7846 : ℝ) ≤ 108 * (3 : ℝ) ^ 4

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sharp_const_fails_requirement_ell4
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem sharp_const_fails_requirement_ell4 :
    bcoef 4 (blockPoincareSharpConst 4) = 39021 ∧ 108 * (4 : ℝ) ^ 4 < 39021

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sharp_bcoef_expand
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem sharp_bcoef_expand (ell : ℕ) :
    bcoef ell (blockPoincareSharpConst ell)
      = 54 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 5 - 54 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4 - 53 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3
        + 59 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 - (ell : ℝ) + 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sharp_bcoef_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem sharp_bcoef_le (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) :
    bcoef ell (blockPoincareSharpConst ell) ≤ 54 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 5

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sharp_size_bound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem sharp_size_bound (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell) :
    bondNormSq B ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 5 * coarseQEnergy ell B
      + bcoef ell (blockPoincareSharpConst ell) * totalCurlEnergy B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.l.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.lemma24_sharpened
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.l.header:
theorem lemma24_sharpened (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell) :
    (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergy ell B + totalCurlEnergy B
      ≥ (1 / 54) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) * bondNormSq B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.l.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.h.header: theorem hAlt_succ (m : ℕ) : hAlt (m + 1) = - hAlt m

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.c.header:
theorem coord_mod (ell y x : ℕ) (hy : y % ell = 0) (h1 : y ≤ x) (h2 : x < y + ell) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.p.header:
theorem plaq_shift_bound {ell : ℕ} (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L} (hp : p ∈ plaqsInBlock y ell) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sw_dir1_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem sw_dir1_val (ell : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    sw ell (x, (1 : Fin 3)) = if (x 0).val % ell = 0 then 0 else hAlt ((x 2).val % ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sw_dir2_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem sw_dir2_val (ell : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    sw ell (x, (2 : Fin 3)) = (-2 : ℝ) * (((x 1).val % ell : ℕ) : ℝ) * hAlt ((x 2).val % ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sw_dir0_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header: theorem sw_dir0_val (ell : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : sw ell (x, (0 : Fin 3)) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.p.header:
theorem plaq_dir_cases (q : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sw_curl01
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem sw_curl01 (ell : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hstep0 : ((periodicLatticeShift x 0) 0).val % ell = (x 0).val % ell + 1) :
    curlValue (sw ell) (x, dir01)
      = (if (x 0).val % ell = 0 then hAlt ((x 2).val % ell) else 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sw_curl02
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem sw_curl02 (ell : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    curlValue (sw ell) (x, dir02) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sw_curl12
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem sw_curl12 (ell : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hstep1 : ((periodicLatticeShift x 1) 1).val % ell = (x 1).val % ell + 1)
    (hstep2 : ((periodicLatticeShift x 2) 2).val % ell = (x 2).val % ell + 1) :
    curlValue (sw ell) (x, dir12)
      = (if (x 0).val % ell = 0 then (-2 : ℝ) * hAlt ((x 2).val % ell) else 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sw_curl_dichotomy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem sw_curl_dichotomy {ell : ℕ}
    (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1)) (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    {p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L} (hp : p ∈ plaqsInBlock y ell) :
    curlValue (sw ell) p = 0
      ∨ ((p.1 0).val % ell = 0 ∧ (curlValue (sw ell) p) ^ 2 ≤ 4)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.a.header: def axialPlaqs (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) : Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.a.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.axialPlaqs_card
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.a.header:
theorem axialPlaqs_card {ell : ℕ} {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sw_rhs_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem sw_rhs_le {ell : ℕ}

    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sum_sq_range

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sw_blkBond_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem sw_blkBond_sq {ell : ℕ} {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (hfit : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val + ell ≤ L μ + 1) {a j m : ℕ}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sw_lhs_ge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.block_poincare_constant_lower_bound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.b.header:
theorem block_poincare_constant_lower_bound {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1)) (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (K : ℝ)
    (h : ∑ b ∈ bondsInBlock y ell, (sw ell b) ^ 2
          ≤ K * ∑ p ∈ plaqsInBlock y ell, (curlValue (sw ell) p) ^ 2) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.l.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.lower_bound_over_sq_grows
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.l.header:
theorem lower_bound_over_sq_grows (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.n.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.no_subcubic_block_poincare
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.n.header:
theorem no_subcubic_block_poincare {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell)

    (h : ∀ B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell,

    ((ell : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 * (2 * (ell : ℝ) - 1) / 18 ≤ K

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.sharp_within_factor_18
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.s.header:
theorem sharp_within_factor_18 (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.p.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.printed_exponent_unreachable_ell21

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.ga.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.gammaVarStrided_constU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.ga.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.lo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.loopVar_constU

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.fr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.frobNorm_coarsePathHolonomy_sub_one_le

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.we.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.weight_sum_eq_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.we.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.ub.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.ubarSU2_sub_one_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.ub.header:
theorem ubarSU2_sub_one_le (s ell : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (Lreal eps Nplaq beta : ℝ)
    (hsum : ∑ _x ∈ AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBlockOf c.1 s ell,
      ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ = 1)
    (hUc : frobNorm (((coarseBondVar s ell V c : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ Lreal * eps)
    (hloop : ∀ x ∈ AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBlockOf c.1 s ell,
      frobNorm (((loopVar s ell V c x : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ Nplaq * beta)
    (hbranch : su2Log (su2Exp (blockExponent
        (AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBlockOf c.1 s ell)
        (fun _ => ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹) (fun x => loopVar s ell V c x)))
      = blockExponent (AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBlockOf c.1 s ell)
        (fun _ => ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹) (fun x => loopVar s ell V c x)) :
    frobNorm ((ubarSU2 s ell V c : M2) - 1) ≤ Lreal * eps + (Real.pi / 2 * Nplaq) * beta

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.ub.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.ubarSU2_sub_one_le_lattice
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.ub.header:

    (hfit : ∀ μ, (c.1 μ).val + s * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    (hloop : ∀ x ∈ AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBlockOf c.1 s ell,
      frobNorm (((loopVar s ell V c x : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ Nplaq * beta)
    (hbranch : su2Log (su2Exp (blockExponent
        (AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBlockOf c.1 s ell)
        (fun _ => ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹) (fun x => loopVar s ell V c x)))
      = blockExponent (AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBlockOf c.1 s ell)
        (fun _ => ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹) (fun x => loopVar s ell V c x)) :
    frobNorm (((ubarSU2 s ell V c : SU2) : M2) - 1)
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * frobSupBond V + (Real.pi / 2 * Nplaq) * beta

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.fr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.frobNorm_diagSU2_pow

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.fr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.frobSq_gOf

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.fr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.frobSq_gOf_sq

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.blocking_ratio_two

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.no.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.no_contraction_constant

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.th.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.threshold_not_preserved
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.th.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.ub.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.ubarTowerSU2_frobSupBond

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.fi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.fibre_bound_at_blockedBackground
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.fi.header:
theorem fibre_bound_at_blockedBackground (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.ub.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.ubarSU2_constU_ne_trivialU

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.es.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.estimate_hypotheses_hold_at_constU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.es.header:

          (fun _ => ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹) (fun x => loopVar s ell (constU g L) c x)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoint_append
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoin.header:
theorem endpoint_append (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s t : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) :
    periodicPathEndpoint y (s ++ t)
      = periodicPathEndpoint (periodicPathEndpoint y s) t

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.holonom.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.holonomy_append
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.holonom.header:
theorem holonomy_append {G : Type*} [Group G] (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s t : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) :
    periodicPathHolonomy U y (s ++ t)
      = periodicPathHolonomy U y s * periodicPathHolonomy U (periodicPathEndpoint y s) t

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.holonom.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.holonomy_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.holonom.header:
theorem holonomy_gauge {G : Type*} [Group G] (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) :
    periodicPathHolonomy (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) y s
      = γ y * periodicPathHolonomy U y s * (γ (periodicPathEndpoint y s))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.revStep.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.revSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.revStep.header: def revSteps (s : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) : List (Fin 3 × Bool)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.revStep.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.revSteps_cons
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.revStep.header:
theorem revSteps_cons (st : Fin 3 × Bool) (rest : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) :
    revSteps (st :: rest) = revSteps rest ++ [(st.1, !st.2)]

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.step_fl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.step_flip
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.step_fl.header:
theorem step_flip (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (st : Fin 3 × Bool) :
    periodicLatticeStep (periodicLatticeStep y st) (st.1, !st.2) = y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoint_revSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoin.header:
theorem endpoint_revSteps (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) :
    periodicPathEndpoint (periodicPathEndpoint y s) (revSteps s) = y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.straigh.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.straightSeg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.straigh.header: def straightSeg (ν : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) : List (Fin 3 × Bool)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy.header: def shiftBy (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoint_straightSeg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoin.header:
theorem endpoint_straightSeg (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) :
    periodicPathEndpoint z (straightSeg ν m) = shiftBy z ν m

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy.header: theorem shiftBy_zero (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) : shiftBy x ν 0 = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy.header:
theorem shiftBy_succ (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) :
    shiftBy x ν (m + 1) = shiftBy (periodicLatticeStep x (ν, true)) ν m

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy_apply_of_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy.header:
theorem shiftBy_apply_of_ne (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {ν μ : Fin 3} (h : μ ≠ ν) (m : ℕ) :
    shiftBy x ν m μ = x μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy.header:
theorem shiftBy_val (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) :
    ((shiftBy x ν m) ν).val = ((x ν).val + m) % (L ν + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoint_seg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoin.header:
theorem endpoint_seg (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (v : Fin (L μ + 1)) (k : ℕ)
    (h : (z μ).val + k = v.val) :
    periodicPathEndpoint z (List.replicate k (μ, true)) = Function.update z μ v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.contour.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.contourSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.contour.header: def contourSteps (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : List (Fin 3 × Bool)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.contour.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.contourFamily
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.contour.header: def contourFamily (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Finset (List (Fin 3 × Bool))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.contour.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.contourFamily_nonempty
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.contour.header:
theorem contourFamily_nonempty (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (contourFamily y x).Nonempty

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.contour.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.contourFamily_card_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.contour.header:
theorem contourFamily_card_pos (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    0 < (contourFamily y x).card

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoint_contourSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoin.header:
theorem endpoint_contourSteps (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hle : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val ≤ (x μ).val) :
    periodicPathEndpoint y (contourSteps π y x) = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.endpoint_of_mem_contourFamily

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.cPlus.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.cPlus
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.cPlus.header: def cPlus (ell : ℕ) (c : CoarseBond L) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.dvd_gap.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.dvd_gap
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.dvd_gap.header:
theorem dvd_gap {ell a N : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdN : ell ∣ N) (hda : ell ∣ a) (h : a < N) :
    a + ell ≤ N

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy_le_shiftBy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy.header:
theorem shiftBy_le_shiftBy {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {ν : Fin 3} (hdvd : ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    {cm x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hc : cm ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (hx : x ∈ blockOf cm ell) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((shiftBy cm ν ell) μ).val ≤ ((shiftBy x ν ell) μ).val

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.card_co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.card_coord_window
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.card_co.header:
theorem card_coord_window {n : ℕ} (a ell : ℕ) (hroom : a + ell ≤ n) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin n => a ≤ v.val ∧ v.val < a + ell)).card = ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.card_bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.card_blockOf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.card_bl.header:
theorem card_blockOf {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :
    (blockOf y ell).card = ell ^ 3

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.loopSte.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.loopSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.loopSte.header: def loopSteps (ell : ℕ) (ν : Fin 3) (Γ Γ' : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) : List (Fin 3 × Bool)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.loopSte.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.loopSteps_closed
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.loopSte.header:
theorem loopSteps_closed (ell : ℕ) (c : CoarseBond L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    {Γ Γ' : List (Fin 3 × Bool)}
    (hΓ : periodicPathEndpoint c.1 Γ = x)
    (hΓ' : periodicPathEndpoint (cPlus ell c) Γ' = shiftBy x c.2 ell) :
    periodicPathEndpoint c.1 (loopSteps ell c.2 Γ Γ') = c.1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.LogExpA.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.LogExpAd
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.LogExpA.header: structure LogExpAd (G 𝔤 : Type*) [Group G] [AddCommGroup 𝔤] [Module ℚ 𝔤]

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.innerAv.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.innerAvg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.innerAv.header:
noncomputable def innerAvg (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)
    (c : CoarseBond L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 𝔤

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blockedGauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.header:
noncomputable def blockedGauge (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)
    (c : CoarseBond L) : G

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.coarseG.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.coarseGaugeTransform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.coarseG.header:
def coarseGaugeTransform (ell : ℕ) (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G) (V : CoarseBond L → G) :
    CoarseBond L → G

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.loopHol.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.loopHolonomy_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.loopHol.header:
theorem loopHolonomy_gauge (ell : ℕ) (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (c : CoarseBond L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    {Γ Γ' : List (Fin 3 × Bool)}
    (hΓ : periodicPathEndpoint c.1 Γ = x)
    (hΓ' : periodicPathEndpoint (cPlus ell c) Γ' = shiftBy x c.2 ell) :
    periodicPathHolonomy (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) c.1 (loopSteps ell c.2 Γ Γ')
      = γ c.1 * periodicPathHolonomy U c.1 (loopSteps ell c.2 Γ Γ') * (γ c.1)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.innerAv.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.innerAvg_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.innerAv.header:
theorem innerAvg_gauge (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (c : CoarseBond L)
    (hdvd : ell ∣ (L c.2 + 1)) (hc : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ blockOf c.1 ell) :
    innerAvg P ell (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) c x = P.ad (γ c.1) (innerAvg P ell U c x)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blockedGauge_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.header:
theorem blockedGauge_gauge (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (c : CoarseBond L)
    (hdvd : ell ∣ (L c.2 + 1)) (hc : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :
    blockedGauge P ell (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) c
      = coarseGaugeTransform ell γ (blockedGauge P ell U) c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blockedGaugeAsConfig
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.header:
noncomputable def blockedGaugeAsConfig (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) :
    PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blockedGaugeMap
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.header:
noncomputable def blockedGaugeMap (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (ell : ℕ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) : CoarseBond L → G

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.gaugeCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.gaugeCovariant_blockedGauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.gaugeCo.header:
theorem gaugeCovariant_blockedGauge (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (ν : Fin 3)
    (hdvd : ell ∣ (L ν + 1)) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeCovariant
      (FineConfig := PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)
      (CoarseConfig := {c : CoarseBond L // c.2 = ν ∧ c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L ell} → G)
      (GaugeFn := PeriodicLatticeSite L → G)
      periodicGaugeTransform
      (fun γ V c => γ (c : CoarseBond L).1 * V c * (γ (cPlus ell (c : CoarseBond L)))⁻¹)
      (fun U c => blockedGauge P ell U (c : CoarseBond L))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Faithfu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.FaithfulLogExpAd
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Faithfu.header:
structure FaithfulLogExpAd (G 𝔤 : Type*) [Group G] [AddCommGroup 𝔤] [Module ℚ 𝔤]
    extends LogExpAd G 𝔤

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Faithfu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.FaithfulLogExpAd.exp_log_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Faithfu.header: theorem exp_log_one (F : FaithfulLogExpAd G 𝔤) : F.exp (F.log 1) = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Faithfu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.FaithfulLogExpAd.exp_not_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Faithfu.header: theorem exp_not_const (F : FaithfulLogExpAd G 𝔤) (h : ∀ A B : 𝔤, F.exp A = F.exp B) : False

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Faithfu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.FaithfulLogExpAd.log_not_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Faithfu.header: theorem log_not_const (F : FaithfulLogExpAd G 𝔤) (h : ∀ g g' : G, F.log g = F.log g') : False

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Faithfu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.FaithfulLogExpAd.log_injOn
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Faithfu.header:
theorem log_injOn (F : FaithfulLogExpAd G 𝔤) {g g' : G} (hg : F.dom g) (hg' : F.dom g')
    (h : F.log g = F.log g') : g = g'

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Faithfu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.FaithfulLogExpAd.log_witness_ne_log_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Faithfu.header: theorem log_witness_ne_log_one (F : FaithfulLogExpAd G 𝔤) : F.log F.witness ≠ F.log 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.twisted.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.twistedLogExp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.twisted.header: def twistedLogExp (q : ℚ) : LogExpAd (Multiplicative ℚ) ℚ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blockedGauge_discardingLogExp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.header:
theorem blockedGauge_discardingLogExp (ell : ℕ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Multiplicative ℚ) L) (c : CoarseBond L) :
    blockedGauge discardingLogExp ell U c
      = periodicPathHolonomy U c.1 (straightSeg c.2 ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blockedGauge_twistedLogExp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.header:
theorem blockedGauge_twistedLogExp (q : ℚ) (ell : ℕ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Multiplicative ℚ) L) (c : CoarseBond L) :
    blockedGauge (twistedLogExp q) ell U c
      = Multiplicative.ofAdd q * periodicPathHolonomy U c.1 (straightSeg c.2 ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.discard.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.discardingLogExp_ne_trivial
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.discard.header:
theorem discardingLogExp_ne_trivial :
    discardingLogExp ≠ trivialLogExp (Multiplicative ℚ) ℚ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.no_fait.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.no_faithful_of_exp_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.no_fait.header:
theorem no_faithful_of_exp_const {P : LogExpAd G 𝔤} (hc : ∀ A B : 𝔤, P.exp A = P.exp B)
    (F : FaithfulLogExpAd G 𝔤) : F.toLogExpAd ≠ P

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.no_fait.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.no_faithful_discarding
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.no_fait.header:
theorem no_faithful_discarding (F : FaithfulLogExpAd (Multiplicative ℚ) ℚ) :
    F.toLogExpAd ≠ discardingLogExp

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.no_fait.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.no_faithful_twisted
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.no_fait.header:
theorem no_faithful_twisted (q : ℚ) (F : FaithfulLogExpAd (Multiplicative ℚ) ℚ) :
    F.toLogExpAd ≠ twistedLogExp q

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.no_fait.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.no_faithful_trivial
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.no_fait.header:
theorem no_faithful_trivial (F : FaithfulLogExpAd G 𝔤) :
    F.toLogExpAd ≠ trivialLogExp G 𝔤

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.LoopsIn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.LoopsInDomain
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.LoopsIn.header:
def LoopsInDomain (F : FaithfulLogExpAd G 𝔤) (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.loopsIn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.loopsInDomain_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.loopsIn.header:
theorem loopsInDomain_trivialU (F : FaithfulLogExpAd G 𝔤) (ell : ℕ) (c : CoarseBond L) :
    LoopsInDomain (L := L) F ell (fun _ => (1 : G)) c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Guarded.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.GuardedBlocking
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Guarded.header:
structure GuardedBlocking (G 𝔤 : Type*) [Group G] [AddCommGroup 𝔤] [Module ℚ 𝔤]
    (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Guarded.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.GuardedBlocking.value_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Guarded.header: theorem value_eq : B.value = blockedGauge B.P.toLogExpAd B.ell B.U B.c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Guarded.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.GuardedBlocking.exp_log_loop
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Guarded.header:
theorem exp_log_loop {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ blockOf B.c.1 B.ell)
    {Γ : List (Fin 3 × Bool)} (hΓ : Γ ∈ contourFamily B.c.1 x)
    {Γ' : List (Fin 3 × Bool)}
    (hΓ' : Γ' ∈ contourFamily (cPlus B.ell B.c) (shiftBy x B.c.2 B.ell)) :
    B.P.exp (B.P.log (periodicPathHolonomy B.U B.c.1 (loopSteps B.ell B.c.2 Γ Γ')))
      = periodicPathHolonomy B.U B.c.1 (loopSteps B.ell B.c.2 Γ Γ')

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Guarded.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.GuardedBlocking.loop_log_injective
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Guarded.header:
theorem loop_log_injective {x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hx : x ∈ blockOf B.c.1 B.ell) (hy : y ∈ blockOf B.c.1 B.ell)
    {Γ₁ Γ₂ Γ₁' Γ₂' : List (Fin 3 × Bool)}
    (h1 : Γ₁ ∈ contourFamily B.c.1 x)
    (h1' : Γ₁' ∈ contourFamily (cPlus B.ell B.c) (shiftBy x B.c.2 B.ell))
    (h2 : Γ₂ ∈ contourFamily B.c.1 y)
    (h2' : Γ₂' ∈ contourFamily (cPlus B.ell B.c) (shiftBy y B.c.2 B.ell))
    (heq : B.P.log (periodicPathHolonomy B.U B.c.1 (loopSteps B.ell B.c.2 Γ₁ Γ₁'))
        = B.P.log (periodicPathHolonomy B.U B.c.1 (loopSteps B.ell B.c.2 Γ₂ Γ₂'))) :
    periodicPathHolonomy B.U B.c.1 (loopSteps B.ell B.c.2 Γ₁ Γ₁')
      = periodicPathHolonomy B.U B.c.1 (loopSteps B.ell B.c.2 Γ₂ Γ₂')

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Guarded.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.GuardedBlocking.loopsInDomain_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Guarded.header:
theorem loopsInDomain_gauge (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G) :
    LoopsInDomain B.P B.ell (periodicGaugeTransform γ B.U) B.c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Guarded.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.GuardedBlocking.gaugeTransform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Guarded.header: def gaugeTransform (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G) : GuardedBlocking G 𝔤 L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Guarded.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.GuardedBlocking.value_gaugeTransform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.Guarded.header:
theorem value_gaugeTransform (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G) :
    (B.gaugeTransform γ).value = γ B.c.1 * B.value * (γ (cPlus B.ell B.c))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.truncL_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.truncL_not_compatible
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.truncL_.header: theorem truncL_not_compatible : ¬ (∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (truncL μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.trunc_c.header: theorem trunc_carrier_rejected (B : GuardedBlocking G 𝔤 truncL) (h : B.ell = 2) : False

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.no_guar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.no_guarded_card_four

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.toAdd_l.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.toAdd_loopSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.toAdd_l.header:
theorem toAdd_loopSteps (f : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℚ) (ell : ℕ) (c : CoarseBond L)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {Γ Γ' : List (Fin 3 × Bool)}
    (hΓf : AllForward Γ) (hΓ'f : AllForward Γ')
    (hΓ : periodicPathEndpoint c.1 Γ = x)
    (hΓ' : periodicPathEndpoint (cPlus ell c) Γ' = shiftBy x c.2 ell) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (periodicPathHolonomy (fun b => Multiplicative.ofAdd (f b)) c.1
        (loopSteps ell c.2 Γ Γ'))
      = fwdSum f c.1 Γ + fwdSum f x (straightSeg c.2 ell)
        - fwdSum f (cPlus ell c) Γ' - fwdSum f c.1 (straightSeg c.2 ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.wexpone.header:
theorem wexponent_pos :
    0 < ∑ x ∈ blockOf wc.1 2, (((2 : ℕ) : ℚ) ^ 3)⁻¹ • innerAvg ratLogExp 2 wU wc x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blockedGauge_ne_coarseHolonomy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.header:
theorem blockedGauge_ne_coarseHolonomy :
    blockedGauge ratLogExp 2 wU wc ≠ periodicPathHolonomy wU wc.1 (straightSeg wc.2 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.wH_eq_o.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.wH_eq_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.wH_eq_o.header: theorem wH_eq_one : periodicPathHolonomy wU wc.1 (straightSeg wc.2 2) = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blockedGauge_nonconstant_pinned
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.header:
theorem blockedGauge_nonconstant_pinned :
    blockedGauge ratLogExp 2 (fun _ => (1 : Multiplicative ℚ)) wc
      ≠ blockedGauge ratLogExp 2 wU wc

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blockedGauge_ne_trivialLogExp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.header:
theorem blockedGauge_ne_trivialLogExp :
    blockedGauge ratLogExp 2 wU wc ≠ blockedGauge (trivialLogExp (Multiplicative ℚ) ℚ) 2 wU wc

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.coarseL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.coarseLattice_nonempty
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.coarseL.header:
theorem coarseLattice_nonempty (ell : ℕ) (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    (fun _ : Fin 3 => (0 : Fin (L _ + 1))) ∈ CoarseLattice L ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.coarseB.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.coarseBond_subtype_nonempty
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.coarseB.header:
theorem coarseBond_subtype_nonempty (ell : ℕ) (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ν : Fin 3) :
    Nonempty {c : CoarseBond L // c.2 = ν ∧ c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.trivial.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.trivialLogExp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.trivial.header: def trivialLogExp (G 𝔤 : Type*) [Group G] [AddCommGroup 𝔤] [Module ℚ 𝔤] : LogExpAd G 𝔤

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blockedGauge_trivialLogExp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.header:
theorem blockedGauge_trivialLogExp {G : Type*} [Group G] (ell : ℕ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (c : CoarseBond L) :
    blockedGauge (trivialLogExp G ℚ) ell U c
      = periodicPathHolonomy U c.1 (straightSeg c.2 ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.trivial.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.trivial_still_covariant
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.trivial.header:
theorem trivial_still_covariant {G : Type*} [Group G] {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (c : CoarseBond L)
    (hdvd : ell ∣ (L c.2 + 1)) (hc : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :
    blockedGauge (trivialLogExp G ℚ) ell (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) c
      = coarseGaugeTransform ell γ (blockedGauge (trivialLogExp G ℚ) ell U) c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.holonom.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.holonomy_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.holonom.header:
theorem holonomy_trivialU {G : Type*} [Group G] (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (s : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) :
    periodicPathHolonomy (fun _ => (1 : G)) y s = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.holonom.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.holonomy_revSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.holonom.header:
theorem holonomy_revSteps {G : Type*} [Group G] (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) :
    periodicPathHolonomy U (periodicPathEndpoint y s) (revSteps s)
      = (periodicPathHolonomy U y s)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blockedGauge_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.header:
theorem blockedGauge_trivialU {G 𝔤 : Type*} [Group G] [AddCommGroup 𝔤] [Module ℚ 𝔤]
    (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (hlog1 : P.log 1 = 0) (hexp0 : P.exp 0 = 1) (ell : ℕ)
    (c : CoarseBond L) :
    blockedGauge P ell (fun _ => (1 : G)) c = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blockedGauge_ell_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.header:
theorem blockedGauge_ell_one {G 𝔤 : Type*} [Group G] [AddCommGroup 𝔤] [Module ℚ 𝔤]
    (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (hlog1 : P.log 1 = 0) (hexp0 : P.exp 0 = 1)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (c : CoarseBond L) :
    blockedGauge P 1 U c = periodicPathHolonomy U c.1 (straightSeg c.2 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netStep.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netStep.header:
def netSteps : List (Fin 3 × Bool) → ℤ
  | [] => 0
  | st :: rest => (if st.2 then (1 : ℤ) else -1) + netSteps rest

@[simp] theorem netSteps_nil : netSteps [] = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netStep.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netSteps_append
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netStep.header:
theorem netSteps_append (s t : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) :
    netSteps (s ++ t) = netSteps s + netSteps t

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netStep.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netSteps_revSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netStep.header: theorem netSteps_revSteps (s : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) : netSteps (revSteps s) = - netSteps s

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netStep.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netSteps_replicate
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netStep.header:
theorem netSteps_replicate (μ : Fin 3) (k : ℕ) :
    netSteps (List.replicate k (μ, true)) = (k : ℤ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netStep.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netSteps_straightSeg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netStep.header: theorem netSteps_straightSeg (ν : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) : netSteps (straightSeg ν m) = (m : ℤ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netStep.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netSteps_contourSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netStep.header:
theorem netSteps_contourSteps (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    netSteps (contourSteps π y x)
      = ((x (π 0)).val - (y (π 0)).val : ℕ) + (((x (π 1)).val - (y (π 1)).val : ℕ) : ℤ)
        + (((x (π 2)).val - (y (π 2)).val : ℕ) : ℤ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.holonom.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.holonomy_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.holonom.header:
theorem holonomy_const {G : Type*} [Group G] (g : G) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (s : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) :
    periodicPathHolonomy (fun _ => g) y s = g ^ (netSteps s)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy_disp_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.shiftBy.header:
theorem shiftBy_disp_eq {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {ν : Fin 3} (hdvd : ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    {cm x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hc : cm ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (hx : x ∈ blockOf cm ell) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((shiftBy x ν ell) μ).val - ((shiftBy cm ν ell) μ).val = (x μ).val - (cm μ).val

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netStep.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netSteps_loop_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.netStep.header:
theorem netSteps_loop_zero {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (c : CoarseBond L)
    (hdvd : ell ∣ (L c.2 + 1)) (hc : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ blockOf c.1 ell)
    {Γ Γ' : List (Fin 3 × Bool)} (hΓ : Γ ∈ contourFamily c.1 x)
    (hΓ' : Γ' ∈ contourFamily (cPlus ell c) (shiftBy x c.2 ell)) :
    netSteps (loopSteps ell c.2 Γ Γ') = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blockedGauge_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.header:
theorem blockedGauge_const {G 𝔤 : Type*} [Group G] [AddCommGroup 𝔤] [Module ℚ 𝔤]
    (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (hlog1 : P.log 1 = 0) (hexp0 : P.exp 0 = 1)
    {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (g : G) (c : CoarseBond L)
    (hdvd : ell ∣ (L c.2 + 1)) (hc : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :
    blockedGauge P ell (fun _ => g) c = g ^ (ell : ℤ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blockedGauge_nonconstant
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.blocked.header:
theorem blockedGauge_nonconstant :
    ∃ (Lw : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (c : CoarseBond Lw)
      (U₁ U₂ : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Multiplicative ℚ) Lw),
      blockedGauge ratLogExp 2 U₁ c ≠ blockedGauge ratLogExp 2 U₂ c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.toVec
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: noncomputable def toVec (M : M2) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 4)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.frobNorm_eq_norm_toVec
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem frobNorm_eq_norm_toVec (M : M2) : frobNorm M = ‖toVec M‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.toVec_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem toVec_add (M N : M2) : toVec (M + N) = toVec M + toVec N

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.toVec_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem toVec_smul (c : ℂ) (M : M2) : toVec (c • M) = c • toVec M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.toVec_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem toVec_zero : toVec (0 : M2) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.frobNorm_add_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem frobNorm_add_le (M N : M2) : frobNorm (M + N) ≤ frobNorm M + frobNorm N

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.frobNorm_real_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem frobNorm_real_smul (c : ℝ) (M : M2) :
    frobNorm ((c : ℂ) • M) = |c| * frobNorm M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.frobNorm_sum_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem frobNorm_sum_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → M2) :
    frobNorm (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, frobNorm (f i)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.trace_re_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem trace_re_eq (g : SU2) : (Matrix.trace (g : M2)).re = 2 * ((g : M2) 0 0).re

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.normSq_re_im
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem normSq_re_im (z : ℂ) : Complex.normSq z = z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.re_e00_sq_le_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem re_e00_sq_le_one (g : SU2) : ((g : M2) 0 0).re ^ 2 ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.trace_re_div_two_le_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem trace_re_div_two_le_one (g : SU2) : (Matrix.trace (g : M2)).re / 2 ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.neg_one_le_trace_re_div_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem neg_one_le_trace_re_div_two (g : SU2) : -1 ≤ (Matrix.trace (g : M2)).re / 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.cos_su2Angle
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem cos_su2Angle (g : SU2) : Real.cos (su2Angle g) = (Matrix.trace (g : M2)).re / 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.sin_half_su2Angle_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem sin_half_su2Angle_nonneg (g : SU2) : 0 ≤ Real.sin (su2Angle g / 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.sin_su2Angle_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem sin_su2Angle_nonneg (g : SU2) : 0 ≤ Real.sin (su2Angle g)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.frobSq_sub_one_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem frobSq_sub_one_eq (g : SU2) :
    frobSq ((g : M2) - 1) = 4 - 2 * (Matrix.trace (g : M2)).re

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.frobSq_sub_one_angle
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem frobSq_sub_one_angle (g : SU2) :
    frobSq ((g : M2) - 1) = 8 * Real.sin (su2Angle g / 2) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.frobNorm_sub_one_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem frobNorm_sub_one_eq (g : SU2) :
    frobNorm ((g : M2) - 1) = 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sin (su2Angle g / 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.frobSq_sub_conjTranspose
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem frobSq_sub_conjTranspose (g : SU2) :
    frobSq ((g : M2) - (g : M2)ᴴ) = 8 * Real.sin (su2Angle g) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.frobSq_su2Log_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem frobSq_su2Log_eq (g : SU2) (h1 : g ≠ 1) (h2 : g ≠ su2NegOne) :
    frobSq (su2Log g) = 2 * su2Angle g ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.frobNorm_su2Log_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem frobNorm_su2Log_eq (g : SU2) (h2 : g ≠ su2NegOne) :
    frobNorm (su2Log g) = Real.sqrt 2 * su2Angle g

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.frobNorm_su2Log_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem frobNorm_su2Log_le (g : SU2) : frobNorm (su2Log g) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * su2Angle g

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.frobNorm_su2Log_le_pi_div_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem frobNorm_su2Log_le_pi_div_two (g : SU2) :
    frobNorm (su2Log g) ≤ (Real.pi / 2) * frobNorm ((g : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.frobNorm_sub_one_le_frobNorm_su2Log
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem frobNorm_sub_one_le_frobNorm_su2Log (g : SU2) (h2 : g ≠ su2NegOne) :
    frobNorm ((g : M2) - 1) ≤ frobNorm (su2Log g)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.blockExponent
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: noncomputable def blockExponent {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (W : ι → SU2) : M2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.blockedLink
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
noncomputable def blockedLink {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (W : ι → SU2) (Uc : SU2) :
    SU2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.frobNorm_blockExponent_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem frobNorm_blockExponent_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (W : ι → SU2)
    (c : ℝ) (hw : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ w x) (hsum : ∑ x ∈ s, w x = 1)
    (hbd : ∀ x ∈ s, frobNorm (su2Log (W x)) ≤ c) :
    frobNorm (blockExponent s w W) ≤ c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.frobNorm_su2Exp_sub_one_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem frobNorm_su2Exp_sub_one_le (H : M2) (hbranch : su2Log (su2Exp H) = H) :
    frobNorm ((su2Exp H : M2) - 1) ≤ frobNorm H

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.blockedLink_sub_one_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem blockedLink_sub_one_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (W : ι → SU2) (Uc : SU2)
    (Lreal eps Nplaq beta : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ w x) (hsum : ∑ x ∈ s, w x = 1)
    (hUc : frobNorm ((Uc : M2) - 1) ≤ Lreal * eps)
    (hloop : ∀ x ∈ s, frobNorm ((W x : M2) - 1) ≤ Nplaq * beta)
    (hbranch : su2Log (su2Exp (blockExponent s w W)) = blockExponent s w W) :
    frobNorm ((blockedLink s w W Uc : M2) - 1)
      ≤ Lreal * eps + (Real.pi / 2 * Nplaq) * beta

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.lassoCount
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: def lassoCount {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℕ) (ν : Fin d) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.lassoCount_dir_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem lassoCount_dir_one {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℕ) (h : 0 < d) :
    lassoCount x ⟨0, h⟩ = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.lassoCount_dir_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem lassoCount_dir_two (x : Fin 3 → ℕ) : lassoCount x 1 = x 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.lassoCount_dir_three
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem lassoCount_dir_three (x : Fin 3 → ℕ) : lassoCount x 2 = x 0 + x 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.cylCount
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: def cylCount {d : ℕ} (ell : ℕ) (x : Fin d → ℕ) (μ : Fin d) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.revCount
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: def revCount {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℕ) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.surfCount
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: def surfCount {d : ℕ} (ell : ℕ) (x : Fin d → ℕ) (μ : Fin d) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.plaqCount
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: def plaqCount (d ell : ℕ) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.KbConst
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: noncomputable def KbConst (d ell : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.sum_fin_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem sum_fin_val (d : ℕ) : ∑ ν : Fin d, (ν : ℕ) = d.choose 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.cylCount_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem cylCount_le {d : ℕ} (ell : ℕ) (x : Fin d → ℕ) (μ : Fin d) (hx : ∀ ρ, x ρ ≤ ell - 1) :
    cylCount ell x μ ≤ (d - 1) * ell * (ell - 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.revCount_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem revCount_le {d : ℕ} (ell : ℕ) (x : Fin d → ℕ) (hx : ∀ ρ, x ρ ≤ ell - 1) :
    revCount x ≤ (d.choose 2) * (ell - 1) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.surfCount_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem surfCount_le {d : ℕ} (ell : ℕ) (x : Fin d → ℕ) (μ : Fin d) (hx : ∀ ρ, x ρ ≤ ell - 1) :
    surfCount ell x μ ≤ plaqCount d ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.cylCount_eq_at_max
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem cylCount_eq_at_max {d : ℕ} (ell : ℕ) (μ : Fin d) :

    (d ell k : ℕ) (eps beta : ℕ → ℝ)
    {ι : Type*} (s : ℕ → Finset ι) (w : ℕ → ι → ℝ) (W : ℕ → ι → SU2) (Uc : ℕ → SU2)
    (hw : ∀ l, ∀ x ∈ s l, 0 ≤ w l x)
    (hsum : ∀ l, ∑ x ∈ s l, w l x = 1)
    (hUc : ∀ l, l < k → frobNorm ((Uc l : M2) - 1) ≤ (ell : ℝ) * eps l)
    (hloop : ∀ l, l < k → ∀ x ∈ s l,
        frobNorm ((W l x : M2) - 1) ≤ (plaqCount d ell : ℝ) * beta l)
    (hbranch : ∀ l, l < k →
        su2Log (su2Exp (blockExponent (s l) (w l) (W l))) = blockExponent (s l) (w l) (W l))
    (hnext : ∀ l, l < k →
        eps (l + 1) ≤ frobNorm ((blockedLink (s l) (w l) (W l) (Uc l) : M2) - 1)) :
    ∀ l, l < k → eps (l + 1) ≤ (ell : ℝ) * eps l + KbConst d ell * beta l

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem blockedLink_sub_one_le_of_curvature {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (W : ι → SU2)
    (Uc : SU2) (Lreal eps Nplaq beta : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ w x) (hsum : ∑ x ∈ s, w x = 1)
    (hUc : frobNorm ((Uc : M2) - 1) ≤ Lreal * eps)
    (hloop : ∀ x ∈ s, frobNorm ((W x : M2) - 1) ≤ Nplaq * beta)
    (hsmall : Nplaq * beta < 2 * Real.sqrt 2) :
    frobNorm ((blockedLink s w W Uc : M2) - 1)
      ≤ Lreal * eps + (Real.pi / 2 * Nplaq) * beta

    (hw : ∀ l, ∀ x ∈ s l, 0 ≤ w l x)
    (hsum : ∀ l, ∑ x ∈ s l, w l x = 1)
    (hUc : ∀ l, l < k → frobNorm ((Uc l : M2) - 1) ≤ (ell : ℝ) * eps l)
    (hloop : ∀ l, l < k → ∀ x ∈ s l,
        frobNorm ((W l x : M2) - 1) ≤ (plaqCount d ell : ℝ) * beta l)
    (hsmall : ∀ l, l < k → (plaqCount d ell : ℝ) * beta l < 2 * Real.sqrt 2)
    (hnext : ∀ l, l < k →
        eps (l + 1) ≤ frobNorm ((blockedLink (s l) (w l) (W l) (Uc l) : M2) - 1)) :
    ∀ l, l < k → eps (l + 1) ≤ (ell : ℝ) * eps l + KbConst d ell * beta l
