      = (g * plaqHol V y ρ ν * g⁻¹) * (g * pathHol V y [(ν, true), (ρ, true)])

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.plaqHol_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem plaqHol_self {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (y : LatSite d) (ρ : Fin d) :
    plaqHol V y ρ ρ = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.shiftS_comm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem shiftS_comm {d : ℕ} (y : LatSite d) (ρ ν : Fin d) :
    shiftS (shiftS y ρ 1) ν 1 = shiftS (shiftS y ν 1) ρ 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.pathHol_transpose_cons
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem pathHol_transpose_cons {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (y : LatSite d)
    (ρ ν : Fin d) (rest : List (Step d)) :
    pathHol V y ((ρ, true) :: (ν, true) :: rest)
      = plaqHol V y ρ ν * pathHol V y ((ν, true) :: (ρ, true) :: rest)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.coordSteps_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem coordSteps_succ {d : ℕ} (μ : Fin d) (n : ℕ) :
    coordSteps μ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (μ, true) :: coordSteps μ ((n : ℕ) : ℤ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.conj_prod_map
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem conj_prod_map {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (g : SU2)
    (ps : List (SU2 × (LatSite d × Fin d × Fin d))) :
    ((ps.map (fun q => (g * q.1, q.2))).map
        (fun q => q.1 * plaqHol V q.2.1 q.2.2.1 q.2.2.2 * q.1⁻¹)).prod
      = g * (ps.map (fun q => q.1 * plaqHol V q.2.1 q.2.2.1 q.2.2.2 * q.1⁻¹)).prod * g⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.slide_step_along_coordSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem slide_step_along_coordSteps {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2)
    (ρ μ : Fin d) (n : ℕ) : ∀ (y : LatSite d) (rest : List (Step d)),
    ∃ ps : List (SU2 × (LatSite d × Fin d × Fin d)),
      ps.length = n ∧
      pathHol V y ((ρ, true) :: (coordSteps μ ((n : ℕ) : ℤ) ++ rest))
        = (ps.map (fun q => q.1 * plaqHol V q.2.1 q.2.2.1 q.2.2.2 * q.1⁻¹)).prod
          * pathHol V y (coordSteps μ ((n : ℕ) : ℤ) ++ (ρ, true) :: rest)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.mu_step_extends_leg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem mu_step_extends_leg {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (y : LatSite d) (μ : Fin d)
    (n : ℕ) (rest : List (Step d)) :
    pathHol V y ((μ, true) :: (coordSteps μ ((n : ℕ) : ℤ) ++ rest))
      = pathHol V y (coordSteps μ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ++ rest)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.mu_slide_entries_are_trivial
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem mu_slide_entries_are_trivial {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (y : LatSite d)
    (μ : Fin d) (g : SU2) :
    g * plaqHol V y μ μ * g⁻¹ = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.slide_list_along_coordSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem slide_list_along_coordSteps {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (μ : Fin d) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (p : List (Step d)), (∀ e ∈ p, e.2 = true) →
    ∀ (y : LatSite d) (rest : List (Step d)),
    ∃ ps : List (SU2 × (LatSite d × Fin d × Fin d)),
      ps.length = n * p.length ∧
      pathHol V y (p ++ (coordSteps μ ((n : ℕ) : ℤ) ++ rest))
        = (ps.map (fun q => q.1 * plaqHol V q.2.1 q.2.2.1 q.2.2.2 * q.1⁻¹)).prod
          * pathHol V y (coordSteps μ ((n : ℕ) : ℤ) ++ (p ++ rest))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.coordSteps_length
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem coordSteps_length {d : ℕ} (ρ : Fin d) (m : ℤ) :
    (coordSteps ρ m).length = m.natAbs

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.stairSteps_length
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem stairSteps_length {d : ℕ} (y x : LatSite d) :
    (stairSteps y x).length
      = (((List.finRange d).reverse.map (fun ρ => (x ρ - y ρ).natAbs)).sum)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.coordSteps_forward
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem coordSteps_forward {d : ℕ} (ρ : Fin d) {m : ℤ} (hm : 0 ≤ m) :
    ∀ e ∈ coordSteps ρ m, e.2 = true

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.stairSteps_forward
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem stairSteps_forward {d : ℕ} {y x : LatSite d} (h : ∀ ρ, y ρ ≤ x ρ) :
    ∀ e ∈ stairSteps y x, e.2 = true

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.slide_list_past_step
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem slide_list_past_step {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (b : Fin d) :
    ∀ (p : List (Step d)), (∀ e ∈ p, e.2 = true) →
    ∀ (y : LatSite d) (rest : List (Step d)),
    ∃ ps : List (SU2 × (LatSite d × Fin d × Fin d)),
      ps.length = p.length ∧
      pathHol V y (p ++ ((b, true) :: rest))
        = (ps.map (fun q => q.1 * plaqHol V q.2.1 q.2.2.1 q.2.2.2 * q.1⁻¹)).prod
          * pathHol V y ((b, true) :: (p ++ rest))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.slide_list_past_list
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem slide_list_past_list {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) :
    ∀ (q p : List (Step d)), (∀ e ∈ p, e.2 = true) → (∀ f ∈ q, f.2 = true) →
    ∀ (y : LatSite d) (rest : List (Step d)),
    ∃ ps : List (SU2 × (LatSite d × Fin d × Fin d)),
      ps.length = p.length * q.length ∧
      pathHol V y (p ++ (q ++ rest))
        = (ps.map (fun r => r.1 * plaqHol V r.2.1 r.2.2.1 r.2.2.2 * r.1⁻¹)).prod
          * pathHol V y (q ++ (p ++ rest))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.shiftS_cancel
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem shiftS_cancel {d : ℕ} (y : LatSite d) (ρ : Fin d) :
    shiftS (shiftS y ρ 1) ρ (-1) = y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.stepHol_back
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem stepHol_back {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (y : LatSite d) (a : Fin d) :
    stepHol V (stepEnd y (a, true)) (a, false) = (stepHol V y (a, true))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.pathHol_invSteps_single
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem pathHol_invSteps_single {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (y : LatSite d) (a : Fin d) :
    pathHol V (stepEnd y (a, true)) (invSteps [(a, true)]) = (stepHol V y (a, true))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.pathHol_step_then_back
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem pathHol_step_then_back {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (y : LatSite d) (a : Fin d)
    (rest : List (Step d)) :
    pathHol V y ((a, true) :: (a, false) :: rest) = pathHol V y rest

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.pathEnd
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
def pathEnd {d : ℕ} : LatSite d → List (Step d) → LatSite d
  | y, [] => y
  | y, e :: rest => pathEnd (stepEnd y e) rest

theorem pathEnd_append {d : ℕ} (p q : List (Step d)) :
    ∀ y : LatSite d, pathEnd y (p ++ q) = pathEnd (pathEnd y p) q

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.pathEnd_append
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem pathEnd_append {d : ℕ} (p q : List (Step d)) :
    ∀ y : LatSite d, pathEnd y (p ++ q) = pathEnd (pathEnd y p) q

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.pathHol_append
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem pathHol_append {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (p q : List (Step d)) :
    ∀ y : LatSite d, pathHol V y (p ++ q) = pathHol V y p * pathHol V (pathEnd y p) q

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.surfProd
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
def surfProd {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2)
    (ps : List (SU2 × (LatSite d × Fin d × Fin d))) : SU2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.surfProd_nil
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem surfProd_nil {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) : surfProd V [] = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.surfProd_append
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem surfProd_append {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2)
    (ps qs : List (SU2 × (LatSite d × Fin d × Fin d))) :
    surfProd V (ps ++ qs) = surfProd V ps * surfProd V qs

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.surfProd_conj
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem surfProd_conj {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (g : SU2)
    (ps : List (SU2 × (LatSite d × Fin d × Fin d))) :
    surfProd V (ps.map (fun q => (g * q.1, q.2))) = g * surfProd V ps * g⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.Deform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: def Deform {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (n : ℕ) (Z W : List (Step d)) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.Deform.of_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem Deform.of_eq {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) {Z W : List (Step d)} (h : Z = W) :
    Deform V 0 Z W

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.Deform.conv
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem Deform.conv {d : ℕ} {V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2} {n m : ℕ} {Z W Z' W' : List (Step d)}
    (h : Deform V n Z W) (hn : n = m) (hZ : Z = Z') (hW : W = W') : Deform V m Z' W'

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.Deform.trans
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem Deform.trans {d : ℕ} {V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2} {n m : ℕ} {Z W X : List (Step d)}
    (h₁ : Deform V n Z W) (h₂ : Deform V m W X) : Deform V (n + m) Z X

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.Deform.append_right
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem Deform.append_right {d : ℕ} {V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2} {n : ℕ} {Z W : List (Step d)}
    (h : Deform V n Z W) (r : List (Step d)) : Deform V n (Z ++ r) (W ++ r)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.Deform.append_left
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem Deform.append_left {d : ℕ} {V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2} {n : ℕ} {Z W : List (Step d)}
    (h : Deform V n Z W) (p : List (Step d)) : Deform V n (p ++ Z) (p ++ W)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.deform_swap
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem deform_swap {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (p q : List (Step d))
    (hp : ∀ e ∈ p, e.2 = true) (hq : ∀ f ∈ q, f.2 = true) :
    Deform V (p.length * q.length) (p ++ q) (q ++ p)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.deform_leg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem deform_leg {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (μ : Fin d) (n : ℕ) (p : List (Step d))
    (hp : ∀ e ∈ p, e.2 = true) :
    Deform V (n * p.length) (p ++ coordSteps μ ((n : ℕ) : ℤ))
      (coordSteps μ ((n : ℕ) : ℤ) ++ p)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.shiftS_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem shiftS_add {d : ℕ} (y : LatSite d) (ρ : Fin d) (m n : ℤ) :
    shiftS (shiftS y ρ m) ρ n = shiftS y ρ (m + n)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.shiftS_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem shiftS_zero {d : ℕ} (y : LatSite d) (ρ : Fin d) : shiftS y ρ 0 = y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.stepEnd_flip
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem stepEnd_flip {d : ℕ} (y : LatSite d) (e : Step d) :
    stepEnd (stepEnd y e) (e.1, !e.2) = y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.stepHol_flip
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem stepHol_flip {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (y : LatSite d) (e : Step d) :
    stepHol V (stepEnd y e) (e.1, !e.2) = (stepHol V y e)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.invSteps_cons
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem invSteps_cons {d : ℕ} (e : Step d) (t : List (Step d)) :
    invSteps (e :: t) = invSteps t ++ [(e.1, !e.2)]

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.invSteps_append
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem invSteps_append {d : ℕ} (p q : List (Step d)) :
    invSteps (p ++ q) = invSteps q ++ invSteps p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.pathHol_cancel_invSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem pathHol_cancel_invSteps {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) :
    ∀ (p : List (Step d)) (y : LatSite d) (rest : List (Step d)),
      pathHol V y (p ++ invSteps p ++ rest) = pathHol V y rest

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.pathHol_loop_invSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem pathHol_loop_invSteps {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (y : LatSite d)
    (p : List (Step d)) : pathHol V y (p ++ invSteps p) = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.pcL
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
def pcL : List ℕ → ℕ
  | [] => 0
  | a :: t => a * t.sum + pcL t

theorem pcL_nil : pcL [] = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.pcL_nil
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem pcL_nil : pcL [] = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.pcL_cons
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem pcL_cons (a : ℕ) (t : List ℕ) : pcL (a :: t) = a * t.sum + pcL t

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.pcL_append_singleton
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem pcL_append_singleton (l : List ℕ) (a : ℕ) : pcL (l ++ [a]) = pcL l + l.sum * a

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.deform_blocks_reverse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem deform_blocks_reverse {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2)
    (g : Fin d → List (Step d)) :
    ∀ ds : List (Fin d), (∀ ρ ∈ ds, ∀ e ∈ g ρ, e.2 = true) →
      Deform V (pcL (ds.map (fun ρ => (g ρ).length))) (ds.reverse.flatMap g) (ds.flatMap g)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.coordSteps_natCast
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem coordSteps_natCast {d : ℕ} (ρ : Fin d) (m : ℕ) :
    coordSteps ρ ((m : ℕ) : ℤ) = List.replicate m (ρ, true)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.coordSteps_natCast_length
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem coordSteps_natCast_length {d : ℕ} (ρ : Fin d) (m : ℕ) :
    (coordSteps ρ ((m : ℕ) : ℤ)).length = m

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.coordSteps_swap
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem coordSteps_swap {d : ℕ} (ρ : Fin d) (m n : ℕ) :
    coordSteps ρ ((m : ℕ) : ℤ) ++ coordSteps ρ ((n : ℕ) : ℤ)
      = coordSteps ρ ((n : ℕ) : ℤ) ++ coordSteps ρ ((m : ℕ) : ℤ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.deform_block_past_leg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem deform_block_past_leg {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (μ : Fin d) (ell : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d → ℕ) (ρ : Fin d) :
    Deform V (ell * (if ρ = μ then 0 else x ρ))
      (coordSteps ρ ((x ρ : ℕ) : ℤ) ++ coordSteps μ ((ell : ℕ) : ℤ))
      (coordSteps μ ((ell : ℕ) : ℤ) ++ coordSteps ρ ((x ρ : ℕ) : ℤ))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.deform_leg_to_front
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem deform_leg_to_front {d : ℕ} (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (μ : Fin d) (ell : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d → ℕ) :
    ∀ ds : List (Fin d),
      Deform V (ell * (ds.map (fun ρ => if ρ = μ then 0 else x ρ)).sum)
        (ds.flatMap (fun σ => coordSteps σ ((x σ : ℕ) : ℤ)) ++ coordSteps μ ((ell : ℕ) : ℤ))
        (coordSteps μ ((ell : ℕ) : ℤ) ++ ds.flatMap (fun σ => coordSteps σ ((x σ : ℕ) : ℤ)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.natExt
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: def natExt {d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.natExt_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header: theorem natExt_val {d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → ℕ) (ν : Fin d) : natExt w (ν : ℕ) = w ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.listSum_range_map
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem listSum_range_map (X : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((List.range n).map X).sum = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.map_finRange_eq_map_range
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem map_finRange_eq_map_range {d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → ℕ) :
    (List.finRange d).map w = (List.range d).map (natExt w)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.finRange_map_sum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem finRange_map_sum {d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → ℕ) :
    ((List.finRange d).map w).sum = ∑ ν : Fin d, w ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.pcL_range_map
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem pcL_range_map (X : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    pcL ((List.range n).map X) = ∑ ν ∈ Finset.range n, (∑ ρ ∈ Finset.range ν, X ρ) * X ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.pcL_finRange_eq_revCount
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.loop_is_conj_plaquette_product
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem loop_is_conj_plaquette_product {d : ℕ} (ell : ℕ) (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2)
    (μ : Fin d) (xn : Fin d → ℕ) (hxn : ∀ ρ, xn ρ ≤ ell - 1) :
    ∃ ps : List (SU2 × (LatSite d × Fin d × Fin d)),
      ps.length = surfCount ell xn μ ∧
      pathHol V 0 (gammaLoopSteps ell μ (fun ρ => (xn ρ : ℤ)))
        = (ps.map (fun q => q.1 * plaqHol V q.2.1 q.2.2.1 q.2.2.2 * q.1⁻¹)).prod

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.loop_bound_of_config
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem loop_bound_of_config {d : ℕ} (ell : ℕ) (V : LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (μ : Fin d)
    (xn : Fin d → ℕ) (hxn : ∀ ρ, xn ρ ≤ ell - 1) (beta : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hplaq : ∀ (y : LatSite d) (ρ ν : Fin d), frobNorm ((plaqHol V y ρ ν : M2) - 1) ≤ beta) :
    frobNorm (((pathHol V 0 (gammaLoopSteps ell μ (fun ρ => (xn ρ : ℤ))) : SU2) : M2) - 1)
      ≤ (plaqCount d ell : ℝ) * beta

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.link_recursion_of_config
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockingLinkEstimate.header:
theorem link_recursion_of_config
    (d ell k : ℕ) (μ : Fin d) (eps beta : ℕ → ℝ)
    (V : ℕ → LatSite d → Fin d → SU2) (w : ℕ → (Fin d → ℕ) → ℝ) (Uc : ℕ → SU2)
    (blk : Finset (Fin d → ℕ)) (hblk : ∀ x ∈ blk, ∀ ρ, x ρ ≤ ell - 1)
    (hw : ∀ l, ∀ x ∈ blk, 0 ≤ w l x) (hsum : ∀ l, ∑ x ∈ blk, w l x = 1)
    (hUc : ∀ l, l < k → frobNorm ((Uc l : M2) - 1) ≤ (ell : ℝ) * eps l)
    (hbeta : ∀ l, l < k → 0 ≤ beta l)
    (hcurv : ∀ l, l < k → ∀ (y : LatSite d) (ρ ν : Fin d),
        frobNorm ((plaqHol (V l) y ρ ν : M2) - 1) ≤ beta l)
    (hsmall : ∀ l, l < k → (plaqCount d ell : ℝ) * beta l < 2 * Real.sqrt 2)
    (hnext : ∀ l, l < k → eps (l + 1) ≤ frobNorm ((blockedLink blk (w l)
        (fun x => pathHol (V l) 0 (gammaLoopSteps ell μ (fun ρ => (x ρ : ℤ)))) (Uc l) : M2) - 1)) :
    ∀ l, l < k → eps (l + 1) ≤ (ell : ℝ) * eps l + KbConst d ell * beta l

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.bridge.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.bridge_constructed
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.bridge.header:
theorem bridge_constructed
    (Delta P : H →L[ℝ] H) (Q : H →L[ℝ] K) (Qstar : K →L[ℝ] H) (a γ q : ℝ)
    (hadj : ∀ (x : H) (B : K), (inner ℝ (Qstar B) x : ℝ) = (inner ℝ B (Q x) : ℝ))
    (hDsym : ∀ u v : H, (inner ℝ u (Delta v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (Delta u) v : ℝ))
    (hPsym : ∀ u v : H, (inner ℝ u (P v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (P u) v : ℝ))
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hDP : ∀ x : H, γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (Delta x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ))
    (hQsurj : Function.Surjective Q)
    (hQ : ∀ x : H, ‖Q x‖ ≤ q * ‖x‖) (B : K) :
    (γ / q ^ 2) * ‖B‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ B
          (sOp Delta P Q Qstar a γ hadj hγ ha hDP
            (qstar_injective_of_surjective Q Qstar hadj hQsurj) B) : ℝ) - a * ‖B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.bridge.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.bridge_constructed_with_source
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.bridge.header:
theorem bridge_constructed_with_source
    (Delta P : H →L[ℝ] H) (Q : H →L[ℝ] K) (Qstar : K →L[ℝ] H) (a γ q ε : ℝ)
    (hadj : ∀ (x : H) (B : K), (inner ℝ (Qstar B) x : ℝ) = (inner ℝ B (Q x) : ℝ))
    (hDsym : ∀ u v : H, (inner ℝ u (Delta v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (Delta u) v : ℝ))
    (hPsym : ∀ u v : H, (inner ℝ u (P v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (P u) v : ℝ))
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hDP : ∀ x : H, γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (Delta x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ))
    (hQsurj : Function.Surjective Q)
    (hQ : ∀ x : H, ‖Q x‖ ≤ q * ‖x‖) (src : K → ℝ)
    (hsrc : ∀ B : K, |src B| ≤ ε * ‖B‖ ^ 2) (hthr : ε < γ / q ^ 2) (B : K) (hB : ‖B‖ ≠ 0) :
    0 < (inner ℝ B
          (sOp Delta P Q Qstar a γ hadj hγ ha hDP
            (qstar_injective_of_surjective Q Qstar hadj hQsurj) B) : ℝ) - a * ‖B‖ ^ 2 - src B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.bridge.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.bridge_at_lattice_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.bridge.header:
theorem bridge_at_lattice_trivialU {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    (Delta P : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L) (a γ : ℝ)
    (hDsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L, (inner ℝ u (Delta v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (Delta u) v : ℝ))
    (hPsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L, (inner ℝ u (P v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (P u) v : ℝ))
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hDP : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L,
      γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (Delta x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ))
    (B : CoarseFnL2 L ell) :
    (γ / ‖qCLM (trivialU L) ell‖ ^ 2) * ‖B‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ B
          (sOp Delta P (qCLM (trivialU L) ell) (qstarCLM (trivialU L) ell) a γ
            (qCLM_hadj (trivialU L) ell) hγ ha hDP
            (qstar_injective_of_surjective _ _ (qCLM_hadj (trivialU L) ell)
              (qCLM_surjective_trivialU hell hdvd)) B) : ℝ) - a * ‖B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.bridge.header:
theorem bridge_at_curvedRegularU
    (Delta P : BondFnL2 witL5 →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 witL5) (a γ : ℝ)
    (hDsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 witL5, (inner ℝ u (Delta v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (Delta u) v : ℝ))
    (hPsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 witL5, (inner ℝ u (P v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (P u) v : ℝ))
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hDP : ∀ x : BondFnL2 witL5,
      γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (Delta x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ))
    (B : (LinearMap.range
      (qCLM curvedRegularU 2 : BondFnL2 witL5 →ₗ[ℝ] CoarseFnL2 witL5 2))) :
    (γ / ‖qCLM curvedRegularU 2‖ ^ 2) * ‖B‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ B
          (sOp Delta P (qRange (qCLM curvedRegularU 2)) (qRangeStar curvedRegularU) a γ
            (qRange_hadj curvedRegularU) hγ ha hDP
            (qstar_injective_of_surjective _ _ (qRange_hadj curvedRegularU)
              (qRange_surjective (qCLM curvedRegularU 2))) B) : ℝ) - a * ‖B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.piCLM.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.piCLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.piCLM.header:
noncomputable def piCLM (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (DeltaPrimePi : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L) : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.piCLM_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.piCLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.piCLM_.header:
theorem piCLM_apply (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (DeltaPrimePi : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L) (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    piCLM U DeltaPrimePi x
      = AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.deltaKCLMNormalized U x - DeltaPrimePi x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.piCLM_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.piCLM_symm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.piCLM_.header:
theorem piCLM_symm (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (DeltaPrimePi : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L)
    (hPiSym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L,
      (inner ℝ u (DeltaPrimePi v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (DeltaPrimePi u) v : ℝ)) (u v : BondFnL2 L) :
    (inner ℝ u (piCLM U DeltaPrimePi v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (piCLM U DeltaPrimePi u) v : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.deltaK.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.deltaKCLMNormalized_coercive
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.deltaK.header:
theorem deltaKCLMNormalized_coercive
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (γ₀ : ℝ)
    (h310 : ∀ A : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.Bond L → SuTwo,
      γ₀ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 A : BondFnL2 L)‖ ^ 2
        ≤ AdalyFormal.Balaban.NormalizationAudit.deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected U A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.hDP_of.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.hDP_of_source_chain
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.hDP_of.header:
theorem hDP_of_source_chain
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (DeltaPrimePi P : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L) (γ₀ δ : ℝ)
    (h310 : ∀ A : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.Bond L → SuTwo,
      γ₀ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 A : BondFnL2 L)‖ ^ 2
        ≤ AdalyFormal.Balaban.NormalizationAudit.deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected U A)
    (hpi : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, |(inner ℝ x (DeltaPrimePi x) : ℝ)| ≤ δ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hPpos : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, (0 : ℝ) ≤ (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ)) (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    (γ₀ - δ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ x (piCLM U DeltaPrimePi x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.bridge.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.bridge_source_chain_at_curvedRegularU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.bridge.header:
theorem bridge_source_chain_at_curvedRegularU
    (DeltaPrimePi P : BondFnL2 witL5 →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 witL5) (a γ₀ δ : ℝ)
    (hPiSym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 witL5,
      (inner ℝ u (DeltaPrimePi v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (DeltaPrimePi u) v : ℝ))
    (hPsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 witL5, (inner ℝ u (P v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (P u) v : ℝ))
    (hγδ : 0 < γ₀ - δ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (h310 : ∀ A : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.Bond witL5 → SuTwo,
      γ₀ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 A : BondFnL2 witL5)‖ ^ 2
        ≤ AdalyFormal.Balaban.NormalizationAudit.deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected
            curvedRegularU A)
    (hpi : ∀ x : BondFnL2 witL5, |(inner ℝ x (DeltaPrimePi x) : ℝ)| ≤ δ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hPpos : ∀ x : BondFnL2 witL5, (0 : ℝ) ≤ (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ))
    (B : (LinearMap.range
      (qCLM curvedRegularU 2 : BondFnL2 witL5 →ₗ[ℝ] CoarseFnL2 witL5 2))) :
    ((γ₀ - δ) / ‖qCLM curvedRegularU 2‖ ^ 2) * ‖B‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ B
          (sOp (piCLM curvedRegularU DeltaPrimePi) P (qRange (qCLM curvedRegularU 2))
            (qRangeStar curvedRegularU) a (γ₀ - δ)
            (qRange_hadj curvedRegularU) hγδ ha
            (hDP_of_source_chain curvedRegularU DeltaPrimePi P γ₀ δ h310 hpi hPpos)
            (qstar_injective_of_surjective _ _ (qRange_hadj curvedRegularU)
              (qRange_surjective (qCLM curvedRegularU 2))) B) : ℝ) - a * ‖B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCLM_eq_fineMapOf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCL.header:
theorem fineCLM_eq_fineMapOf {ell : ℕ} (Delta P : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L)
    (Q : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] CoarseFnL2 L ell) (Qstar : CoarseFnL2 L ell →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L)
    (a : ℝ) (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.fineMapOf (L := L) (K := CoarseFnL2 L ell)
        (fun y => Delta y) (fun y => P y) (fun y => Q y) (fun B => Qstar B) a x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.hG1_fi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.hG1_fineMapOf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.hG1_fi.header:

      (inner ℝ (Qstar B) x : ℝ) = (inner ℝ B (Q x) : ℝ))
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hDP : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L,
      γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (Delta x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ))
    (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.fineMapOf (L := L) (K := CoarseFnL2 L ell)
        (fun y => Delta y) (fun y => P y) (fun y => Q y) (fun B => Qstar B) a
        (gOne Delta P Q Qstar a γ hadj hγ ha hDP x) = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.h310_u.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.h310_unrestricted_impossible_at_witnessU

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCL.header:
noncomputable def fineCLM (Delta P : H →L[ℝ] H) (Q : H →L[ℝ] K) (Qstar : K →L[ℝ] H) (a : ℝ) :
    H →L[ℝ] H

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCL.header:
theorem fineCLM_apply (Delta P : H →L[ℝ] H) (Q : H →L[ℝ] K) (Qstar : K →L[ℝ] H) (a : ℝ) (x : H) :
    fineCLM Delta P Q Qstar a x = Delta x + P x + a • Qstar (Q x)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCLM_inner
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCL.header:
theorem fineCLM_inner (Delta P : H →L[ℝ] H) (Q : H →L[ℝ] K) (Qstar : K →L[ℝ] H) (a : ℝ)
    (hadj : ∀ (x : H) (B : K), (inner ℝ (Qstar B) x : ℝ) = (inner ℝ B (Q x) : ℝ)) (x : H) :
    (inner ℝ x (fineCLM Delta P Q Qstar a x) : ℝ)
      = (inner ℝ x (Delta x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ) + a * ‖Q x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCLM_coercive
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCL.header:
theorem fineCLM_coercive (Delta P : H →L[ℝ] H) (Q : H →L[ℝ] K) (Qstar : K →L[ℝ] H) (a γ : ℝ)
    (hadj : ∀ (x : H) (B : K), (inner ℝ (Qstar B) x : ℝ) = (inner ℝ B (Q x) : ℝ))
    (hDP : ∀ x : H, γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (Delta x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ)) (x : H) :
    γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 + a * ‖Q x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (fineCLM Delta P Q Qstar a x) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCLM_symm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCL.header:
theorem fineCLM_symm (Delta P : H →L[ℝ] H) (Q : H →L[ℝ] K) (Qstar : K →L[ℝ] H) (a : ℝ)
    (hadj : ∀ (x : H) (B : K), (inner ℝ (Qstar B) x : ℝ) = (inner ℝ B (Q x) : ℝ))
    (hDsym : ∀ u v : H, (inner ℝ u (Delta v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (Delta u) v : ℝ))
    (hPsym : ∀ u v : H, (inner ℝ u (P v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (P u) v : ℝ)) (u v : H) :
    (inner ℝ u (fineCLM Delta P Q Qstar a v) : ℝ)
      = (inner ℝ (fineCLM Delta P Q Qstar a u) v : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.fineCL.header:

    (hadj : ∀ (x : H) (B : K), (inner ℝ (Qstar B) x : ℝ) = (inner ℝ B (Q x) : ℝ))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.sOp_ne.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeInverse.sOp_ne_zero

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.pAb.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.hDP.header:

    (hadj : ∀ (x : H) (B : K), (inner ℝ (Qstar B) x : ℝ) = (inner ℝ B (Q x) : ℝ))
    (hDPa : ∀ x : H, γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ x (Delta x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ) + a * ‖Q x‖ ^ 2) (x : H) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.bri.header:
theorem bridge_constructed_a_absorbed
    (Delta P : H →L[ℝ] H) (Q : H →L[ℝ] K) (Qstar : K →L[ℝ] H) (a γ q : ℝ)
    (hadj : ∀ (x : H) (B : K), (inner ℝ (Qstar B) x : ℝ) = (inner ℝ B (Q x) : ℝ))
    (hDsym : ∀ u v : H, (inner ℝ u (Delta v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (Delta u) v : ℝ))
    (hPsym : ∀ u v : H, (inner ℝ u (P v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (P u) v : ℝ))
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hDPa : ∀ x : H, γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ x (Delta x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ) + a * ‖Q x‖ ^ 2)
    (hQsurj : Function.Surjective Q)
    (hQ : ∀ x : H, ‖Q x‖ ≤ q * ‖x‖) (B : K) :
    (γ / q ^ 2) * ‖B‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ B
          (sOp Delta (pAbsorb P Q Qstar a) Q Qstar 0 γ hadj hγ le_rfl
            (hDP_pAbsorb_of_hDPa Delta P Q Qstar a γ hadj hDPa)
            (qstar_injective_of_surjective Q Qstar hadj hQsurj) B) : ℝ)

      ↔ (γ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (dirConstField (L := L) d X) : BondFnL2 L)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.bri.header:
theorem bridge_at_VReg_hypotheses_unsatisfiable
    {K : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℝ K] [Nontrivial K]
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (DeltaPrimePi P : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L)
    (Q : BondFnL2 L → K) (Qstar : K → BondFnL2 L)
    (G : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L) (T S : K →L[ℝ] K) (a γ δ q : ℝ)
    (hadj : ∀ (x : BondFnL2 L) (B : K),
      (inner ℝ (Qstar B) x : ℝ) = (inner ℝ B (Q x) : ℝ))
    (hPiSym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L,
      (inner ℝ u (DeltaPrimePi v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (DeltaPrimePi u) v : ℝ))
    (hpi : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, |(inner ℝ x (DeltaPrimePi x) : ℝ)| ≤ δ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hPpos : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, (0 : ℝ) ≤ (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ))
    (hPsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L, (inner ℝ u (P v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (P u) v : ℝ))
    (hGW : ∀ B : K, (fun v : BondFnL2 L => v ∈ VReg U) (G (Qstar B)))
    (hT : ∀ B : K, T B = Q (G (Qstar B)))
    (hG1 : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L,
      fineMapOf (piExtendedMap (fun y => deltaKCLMNormalized U y) DeltaPrimePi) P Q Qstar a (G x)
        = x)
    (hTS : ∀ B : K, T (S B) = B)
    (hγδ : 0 < γ - δ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (h310W : ∀ A : Bond L → SuTwo, (fun v : BondFnL2 L => v ∈ VReg U) (WithLp.toLp 2 A) →
      γ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 A : BondFnL2 L)‖ ^ 2 ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected U A)
    (hQ : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, ‖Q x‖ ≤ q * ‖x‖) (B : K)
    (hWker : ∀ v : BondFnL2 L, v ∈ VReg U → Q v = 0) :
    False

    (hPiSym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 witL5,
      (inner ℝ u (DeltaPrimePi v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (DeltaPrimePi u) v : ℝ))
    (hPsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 witL5, (inner ℝ u (P v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (P u) v : ℝ))
    (hγδ : 0 < γ₀ - δ)
    (h310a : H310A curvedRegularU γ₀ a)
    (hpi : ∀ x : BondFnL2 witL5, |(inner ℝ x (DeltaPrimePi x) : ℝ)| ≤ δ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hPpos : ∀ x : BondFnL2 witL5, (0 : ℝ) ≤ (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ))
    (B : (LinearMap.range
      (qCLM curvedRegularU 2 : BondFnL2 witL5 →ₗ[ℝ] CoarseFnL2 witL5 2))) :
    ((γ₀ - δ) / ‖qCLM curvedRegularU 2‖ ^ 2) * ‖B‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ B
          (sOp (piCLM curvedRegularU DeltaPrimePi)
            (pAbsorb P (qRange (qCLM curvedRegularU 2)) (qRangeStar curvedRegularU) a)
            (qRange (qCLM curvedRegularU 2)) (qRangeStar curvedRegularU) 0 (γ₀ - δ)
            (qRange_hadj curvedRegularU) hγδ le_rfl
            (hDP_pAbsorb_of_hDPa (piCLM curvedRegularU DeltaPrimePi) P
              (qRange (qCLM curvedRegularU 2)) (qRangeStar curvedRegularU) a (γ₀ - δ)
              (qRange_hadj curvedRegularU)
              (hDPa_of_source_chain curvedRegularU DeltaPrimePi P a γ₀ δ h310a hpi hPpos))
            (qstar_injective_of_surjective _ _ (qRange_hadj curvedRegularU)
              (qRange_surjective (qCLM curvedRegularU 2))) B) : ℝ)

    (γ - δ) * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (axisField (L := witL5) (0 : Fin 3) altC rotGen) :
        BondFnL2 witL5)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 (axisField (L := witL5) (0 : Fin 3) altC rotGen) : BondFnL2 witL5)
          (P (WithLp.toLp 2 (axisField (L := witL5) (0 : Fin 3) altC rotGen) :
            BondFnL2 witL5)) : ℝ)

          (sOp (piCLM curvedRegularU (0 : BondFnL2 witL5 →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 witL5))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CStarDeltaKCCoercive.header:
theorem cStarDstarDC_coercive
    (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ L μ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (a : ℝ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (Dinv : CoarseBond L 2 → (SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo))
    (hinv : ∀ c : CoarseBond L 2,
      (coeffDc U 2 c (droppedBondLast 2 c)).comp (Dinv c) = LinearMap.id)
    (Btil : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hax : ∀ y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y' ∈ CoarseLattice L 2 →
      ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y' 2 →
      ∀ e ∈ staircasePath y' x, Btil e = 0)
    (hdrop : ∀ c : CoarseBond L 2, Btil (droppedBondLast 2 c) = 0)
    (hthr : 64 * frobSupBond U ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 108) * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4))
    (hsmall : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((1 / 108) * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4) - 64 * frobSupBond U ^ 2)
        - 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond U) :
    (Real.sqrt ((1 / 108) * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4) - 64 * frobSupBond U ^ 2)
        - 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond U) ^ 2 * bondEnergy Btil
      ≤ cStarDstarDCForm a 2 U Dinv Btil

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CStarDeltaKCCompose..header:

    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]

          (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell (C Btil))

      ↔ (γ₀ + a) * covCoarseBondInner (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell (C Btil))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CStarDeltaKCCompose..header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CStarReconciliation..header:
theorem dropAll_axial {ell : ℕ} (B : Bond L → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CStarReconciliation..header:
theorem sandwich_of_restricted {W : Type*} (q : (Bond L → SuTwo) → ℝ) (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (C : W → (Bond L → SuTwo)) (V : (Bond L → SuTwo) → Prop)
    (hrange : ∀ w : W, V (C w))
    (hres : ∀ B : Bond L → SuTwo, V B → γ * bondEnergy B ≤ q B)
    (en : W → ℝ) (hbridge : ∀ w : W, en w ≤ bondEnergy (C w)) (w : W) :
    γ * en w ≤ q (C w)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CStarReconciliation..header:

    (C : (Bond L → SuTwo) → (Bond L → SuTwo)) (V : (Bond L → SuTwo) → Prop)
    (sect : (Bond L → SuTwo) → (Bond L → SuTwo))
    (hsect : ∀ B, V B → C (sect B) = B)
    (hsand : ∀ w, γ * bondEnergy w ≤ q (C w))
    (hupper : ∀ B, V B → bondEnergy B ≤ κ * bondEnergy (sect B))
    (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) (hB : V B) :
    (γ / κ) * bondEnergy B ≤ q B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.scalar_val

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.diag11
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:
theorem diag11 (hah : Hᴴ = -H) (htr : Matrix.trace H = 0) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.alg_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:
theorem alg_sq (hah : Hᴴ = -H) (htr : Matrix.trace H = 0) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.comb_frobSq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:
theorem comb_frobSq (hah : Hᴴ = -H) (htr : Matrix.trace H = 0) (c d : ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.comb_det
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:
theorem comb_det (hah : Hᴴ = -H) (htr : Matrix.trace H = 0) (c d : ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.exp_closed
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.blkConst_ge_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header: theorem blkConst_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ blkConst

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.blkConst_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header: theorem blkConst_pos : (0 : ℝ) < blkConst

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.frobSupBond_ubarCoarse_le_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:
theorem frobSupBond_ubarCoarse_le_two (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:
theorem blkTower_ubar_succ (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:
theorem frobSupBond_wit (Lam : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha8 : a ^ 2 ≤ 8) :
    frobSupBond (constU (gOf (1 - a ^ 2 / 4)) Lam) = a

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.frobSupBond_blocked_wit
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:
theorem frobSupBond_blocked_wit (Lam : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {a : ℝ} (ha8 : a ^ 2 ≤ 8) :
    frobSupBond (ubarCoarse 2 (constU (gOf (1 - a ^ 2 / 4)) Lam))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.blocked_wit_gt
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:
theorem blocked_wit_gt (Lam : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {a : ℝ} (hpos : 0 < a) (hle : a ≤ 1) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:
theorem classPropagation_fails_for_ubarSU2 (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.refutation_witness_facts
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:
theorem refutation_witness_facts {alpha0 : ℝ} (hpos : 0 < alpha0) (hle : alpha0 ≤ 1)
    (Lam : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    frobSupBond (constU (gOf (1 - alpha0 ^ 2 / 4)) Lam) = alpha0
      ∧ 0 < frobSupBond (constU (gOf (1 - alpha0 ^ 2 / 4)) Lam)
      ∧ ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette Lam,
          AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.holonomyElem
            (constU (gOf (1 - alpha0 ^ 2 / 4)) Lam) p = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:

      = Real.sqrt (2 * (1 + t)) * frobSupBond (constU (gOf t) L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.no_contraction_ubarCoarse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:
theorem no_contraction_ubarCoarse {c : ℝ} (hc : c < 2) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.blkConst_two_sided
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.header:
theorem blkConst_two_sided (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :

theorem curlWitnessConfig_eq_zero_of_dir_ne {x : PeriodicLatticeSite AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.coarseRes.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.coarseRestrict_witness_term2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.coarseRes.header:
theorem coarseRestrict_witness_term2 :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.coarseRes.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.coarseRestrict_witness_term4
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.coarseRes.header:
theorem coarseRestrict_witness_term4 :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.coarseCur.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.coarseCur.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.coarseCurl_coarseRestrict_ne_coarsePlaquetteRestrict_curl_witness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.coarseCur.header:
theorem coarseCurl_coarseRestrict_ne_coarsePlaquetteRestrict_curl_witness :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarseCurlEnergyCov
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header:
noncomputable def coarseCurlEnergyCov {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarseCurlEnergyCov_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header:
theorem coarseCurlEnergyCov_nonneg {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V : CoarseLinkConfiguration L ell) (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.trivialV
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header: noncomputable def trivialV (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) : CoarseLinkConfiguration L ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarseCurlCov_trivialV
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header:
theorem coarseCurlCov_trivialV {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (p : CoarsePlaquette L ell) :
    coarseCurlCov hdvd (trivialV L ell) B p = coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd B p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarseCurlEnergyCov_trivialV
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header:
theorem coarseCurlEnergyCov_trivialV {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) :
    coarseCurlEnergyCov hdvd (trivialV L ell) B = coarseCurlEnergySuTwo hdvd B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarseSegSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header: def coarseSegSteps (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) : List (Fin 3 × Bool)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarseBackground
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header:
noncomputable def coarseBackground

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarseBackground_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header:
theorem coarseBackground_trivialU (ell : ℕ) :
    coarseBackground (trivialU L) ell = trivialV L ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarseCurlCov_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header:
theorem coarseCurlCov_trivialU {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (p : CoarsePlaquette L ell) :
    coarseCurlCov hdvd (coarseBackground (trivialU L) ell) B p = coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd B p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarseCurlEnergyCov_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header:
theorem coarseCurlEnergyCov_trivialU {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) :
    coarseCurlEnergyCov hdvd (coarseBackground (trivialU L) ell) B
      = coarseCurlEnergySuTwo hdvd B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarseSegSteps_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header: theorem coarseSegSteps_one (μ : Fin 3) : coarseSegSteps μ 1 = [(μ, true)]

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarseBackground_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header:
theorem coarseBackground_one
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (c : CoarseBond L 1) : coarseBackground U 1 c = U (c.1.1, c.2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarseShift_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header:
theorem coarseShift_one (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift y 1 μ = periodicLatticeShift y μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarseCurlCov_one_eq_curlCovariant
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header:
theorem coarseCurlCov_one_eq_curlCovariant
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hdvd1 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (1 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : CoarsePlaquette L 1) :
    coarseCurlCov hdvd1 (coarseBackground U 1) (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U 1 A) p
      = curlValueCovariant U A ((p.1.1, p.2) : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarsePlaquette_one_bijective
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header:
theorem coarsePlaquette_one_bijective :
    Function.Bijective
      (fun p : CoarsePlaquette L 1 => ((p.1.1, p.2) : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarseCurlEnergyCov_one_eq_plaqEnergy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header:
theorem coarseCurlEnergyCov_one_eq_plaqEnergy
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hdvd1 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (1 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    coarseCurlEnergyCov hdvd1 (coarseBackground U 1) (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U 1 A)
      = plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM U A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarseCurlEnergyCov_one_eq_deltaJ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header:
theorem coarseCurlEnergyCov_one_eq_deltaJ
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hdvd1 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (1 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    [(CovariantHjMinimizer.deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful 1 levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    coarseCurlEnergyCov hdvd1 (coarseBackground U 1) (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U 1 B)
      = deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful 1 levels U B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.SummedTransferRegularUCov
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header: def SummedTransferRegularUCov : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.summedTransferCov_ell1
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header:
theorem summedTransferCov_ell1
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hdvd1 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (1 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    [(CovariantHjMinimizer.deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful 1 levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    (1 : ℝ) * coarseCurlEnergyCov hdvd1 (coarseBackground U 1) (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U 1 B)
      ≤ deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful 1 levels U B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant.coarseCurlEnergyCov_genuinely_background_dependent
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlCovariant..header:
theorem coarseCurlEnergyCov_genuinely_background_dependent :
    coarseCurlEnergyCov (L := AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL) (fun _ => one_dvd _)
        (coarseBackground myTrivialU 1) (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM myTrivialU 1 myWitnessConfig)
      ≠ coarseCurlEnergyCov (L := AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL) (fun _ => one_dvd _)
        (coarseBackground witnessU 1) (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM witnessU 1 myWitnessConfig)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.coordScalar
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.c.header: noncomputable def coordScalar (μ ν : Fin 3) (h : Fin (L ν + 1) → ℝ) : Bond L → ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.coordField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.c.header: noncomputable def coordField (μ ν : Fin 3) (h : Fin (L ν + 1) → ℝ) (w : SuTwo) : Bond L → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.coordField_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.c.header:
theorem coordField_apply (μ ν : Fin 3) (h : Fin (L ν + 1) → ℝ) (w : SuTwo) (b : Bond L) :
    coordField μ ν h w b = if b.2 = μ then h (b.1 ν) • w else 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.shift_coord_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.header:
theorem shift_coord_ne {μ ν : Fin 3} (hne : ν ≠ μ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν = x ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.shiftBack_coord_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.header:
theorem shiftBack_coord_ne {μ ν : Fin 3} (hne : ν ≠ μ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ) ν = x ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.shiftIter_coord_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.header:
theorem shiftIter_coord_ne {μ ν : Fin 3} (hne : ν ≠ μ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (j : ℕ) :
    ((fun z => periodicLatticeShift z μ)^[j] x) ν = x ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.shift_coord_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.header:
theorem shift_coord_self (ν : Fin 3) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (periodicLatticeShift x ν) ν = x ν + 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.sum_site_coord
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.header:
theorem sum_site_coord (ν : Fin 3) (F : Fin (L ν + 1) → ℝ) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, F (x ν)
      = (Fintype.card ((j : {j : Fin 3 // j ≠ ν}) → Fin (L j.1 + 1)) : ℝ) * ∑ t, F t

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.card_other_coords_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.c.header:
theorem card_other_coords_pos (ν : Fin 3) :
    0 < (Fintype.card ((j : {j : Fin 3 // j ≠ ν}) → Fin (L j.1 + 1)) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.n.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.norm_sq_coordField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.n.header:
theorem norm_sq_coordField (μ ν : Fin 3) (h : Fin (L ν + 1) → ℝ) (w : SuTwo)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (d : Fin 3) :
    ‖coordField μ ν h w (x, d)‖ ^ 2 = if d = μ then h (x ν) ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 else 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.bondEnergy_coordField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.b.header:
theorem bondEnergy_coordField (μ ν : Fin 3) (h : Fin (L ν + 1) → ℝ) (w : SuTwo) :
    bondEnergy (coordField μ ν h w)
      = (∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, h (x ν) ^ 2) * ‖w‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.f.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.flatCurl_coordField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.f.header:
theorem flatCurl_coordField (μ ν : Fin 3) (hlt : ν < μ) (h : Fin (L ν + 1) → ℝ) (w : SuTwo)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    flatCurlValue (coordField μ ν h w) p
      = if p.2.1.1 = ν ∧ p.2.1.2 = μ then (h (p.1 ν + 1) - h (p.1 ν)) • w else 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.p.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.plaqEnergy_coordField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.p.header:
theorem plaqEnergy_coordField (μ ν : Fin 3) (hlt : ν < μ) (h : Fin (L ν + 1) → ℝ) (w : SuTwo) :
    plaqEnergy (flatCurlValue (coordField μ ν h w))
      = (∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (h (x ν + 1) - h (x ν)) ^ 2) * ‖w‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.Q.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.Q_coordField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.Q.header:
theorem Q_coordField (ell : ℕ) (μ ν : Fin 3) (hne : ν ≠ μ) (h : Fin (L ν + 1) → ℝ) (w : SuTwo)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell (coordField μ ν h w) c
      = ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)
          * (if c.2 = μ then (ell : ℝ) * ∑ x ∈ blockOf c.1.1 ell, h (x ν) else 0)) • w

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.d.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.div_coordField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.d.header:
theorem div_coordField (μ ν : Fin 3) (hne : ν ≠ μ) (h : Fin (L ν + 1) → ℝ) (w : SuTwo)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    gradCovariantAdjointValue (trivialU L) (coordField μ ν h w) y = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.sqN
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.header: noncomputable def sqN (p : ℕ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.sqProfile
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.header: noncomputable def sqProfile (p : ℕ) (t : Fin (2 * p + 1)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.sqProfile_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.header: theorem sqProfile_zero (p : ℕ) : sqProfile p (0 : Fin (2 * p + 1)) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.sum_sqN
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.header: theorem sum_sqN (p : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * p + 1), sqN p k = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.sum_sqN_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.header: theorem sum_sqN_sq (p : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * p + 1), (sqN p k) ^ 2 = 2 * (p : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.sum_sqProfile

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.c.header:
theorem coarseCurlPoincareAtScale_instance_one_two
    (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ L μ)
    (hdvd₀ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (1 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hdvdm : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ((1 * 2 : ℕ)) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hadm : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L (1 * 2) →
      ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y (1 * 2) →
      ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, B b = 0)
    (hker : ∀ c : CoarseBond L (1 * 2), lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) (1 * 2) B c = 0) :
    (1 / 1728 : ℝ) * covCoarseBondInner (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) 1 B)
        (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) 1 B)
      ≤ coarseCurlEnergyCov hdvd₀ (coarseBackground (trivialU L) 1)
          (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) 1 B)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlPoincare.s.header:
theorem suTwo_sharp_size_bound {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hadm : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell →
      ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y ell → ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, A b = 0) :
    bondEnergy A
      ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 5 * covCoarseBondInner (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell A)
            (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell A)
        + AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.bcoef ell
            (AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockPoincareSharp.blockPoincareSharpConst ell)
          * plaqEnergy (flatCurlValue A)

    (hker : ∀ c : CoarseBond L m, lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) m B c = 0) :
    ((1 : ℝ) / 56 / (m : ℝ) ^ 5)
        * covCoarseBondInner (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) 1 B)

        ≤ coarseCurlEnergyCov hdvd₀ (coarseBackground (trivialU L) e)
            (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) e (scField e n w)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.scExt
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header: def scExt (m : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeExtent

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.scExt_add_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header: theorem scExt_add_one {m : ℕ} (h : 1 ≤ m) (μ : Fin 3) : scExt m μ + 1 = 6 * m

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.n.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.not_coarseCurlPoincareAtScale
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.n.header: theorem not_coarseCurlPoincareAtScale (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) : ¬ CoarseCurlPoincareAtScale m

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.w.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.witness_summary
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.w.header:
theorem witness_summary {e n : ℕ} (he : 2 ≤ e) (h2e : 2 * e ≤ n)
    {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hdvdn : ∀ μ : Fin 3, n ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hdvd₀ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, e ∣ (L μ + 1)) {w : SuTwo} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    0 < covCoarseBondInner (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) e (scField e n w))
          (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) e (scField e n w))
      ∧ coarseCurlEnergyCov hdvd₀ (coarseBackground (trivialU L) e)
          (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) e (scField e n w)) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sawN
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header: noncomputable def sawN (q k : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sawN_lo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header: theorem sawN_lo (q k : ℕ) (h : k ≤ 2 * q + 2) : sawN q k = (k : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sawN_mid
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header:
theorem sawN_mid (q k : ℕ) (h1 : ¬ (k ≤ 2 * q + 2)) (h2 : k ≤ 6 * q + 6) :
    sawN q k = 4 * (q : ℝ) + 4 - (k : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sawN_hi
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header:
theorem sawN_hi (q k : ℕ) (h1 : ¬ (k ≤ 2 * q + 2)) (h2 : ¬ (k ≤ 6 * q + 6)) :
    sawN q k = (k : ℝ) - (8 * (q : ℝ) + 8)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sawN_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header: theorem sawN_zero (q : ℕ) : sawN q 0 = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sawN_period
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header: theorem sawN_period (q : ℕ) : sawN q (8 * q + 8) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sawN_antisymm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header: theorem sawN_antisymm (q a b : ℕ) (hab : a + b = 8 * q + 8) : sawN q a = - sawN q b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sum_sawN
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header: theorem sum_sawN (q : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (8 * q + 8), sawN q k = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sawN_step
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header: theorem sawN_step (q v : ℕ) (hv : v < 8 * q + 7) : (sawN q (v + 1) - sawN q v) ^ 2 = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sum_sawN_sq_ge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header:
theorem sum_sawN_sq_ge (q : ℕ) :
    ((q : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (8 * q + 8), (sawN q k) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sawExt
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header: def sawExt (q : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeExtent

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sawExt_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header: theorem sawExt_apply (q : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : sawExt q μ = 8 * q + 7

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sawProfile
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header: noncomputable def sawProfile (q : ℕ) (ν : Fin 3) : Fin (sawExt q ν + 1) → ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sawProfile_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header:
theorem sawProfile_zero (q : ℕ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    sawProfile q ν (0 : Fin (sawExt q ν + 1)) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sum_sawProfile
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header: theorem sum_sawProfile (q : ℕ) (ν : Fin 3) : ∑ t, sawProfile q ν t = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sum_sawProfile_sq_ge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header:
theorem sum_sawProfile_sq_ge (q : ℕ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    ((q : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 ≤ ∑ t, (sawProfile q ν t) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sawProfile_diff_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header:
theorem sawProfile_diff_sq (q : ℕ) (ν : Fin 3) (t : Fin (sawExt q ν + 1)) :
    (sawProfile q ν (t + 1) - sawProfile q ν t) ^ 2 = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.sum_sawProfile_diff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header:
theorem sum_sawProfile_diff (q : ℕ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    ∑ t, (sawProfile q ν (t + 1) - sawProfile q ν t) ^ 2 = 8 * (q : ℝ) + 8

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.S.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.SAW
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.S.header: noncomputable def SAW (q : ℕ) (w : SuTwo) : Bond (sawExt q) → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.saw_coarse_site_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header:
theorem saw_coarse_site_zero (q : ℕ) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite (sawExt q)}
    (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice (sawExt q) (8 * q + 8)) (μ : Fin 3) : (y μ).val = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.saw_block_univ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.SAW_kerQ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.S.header:
theorem SAW_kerQ (q : ℕ) (w : SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond (sawExt q) (8 * q + 8)) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU (sawExt q)) (8 * q + 8) (SAW q w) c = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.saw_energies
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header:
theorem saw_energies (q : ℕ) (w : SuTwo) :
    bondEnergy (SAW q w) * (∑ t, (sawProfile q 1 (t + 1) - sawProfile q 1 t) ^ 2)
      = plaqEnergy (flatCurlValue (SAW q w)) * (∑ t, (sawProfile q 1 t) ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.saw_bond_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header: theorem saw_bond_pos (q : ℕ) {w : SuTwo} (hw : w ≠ 0) : 0 < bondEnergy (SAW q w)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.saw_forces_bound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.s.header:
theorem saw_forces_bound {γ : ℝ} (q : ℕ) (hγ : 0 < γ) {w : SuTwo} (hw : w ≠ 0)
    (h : γ * bondEnergy (SAW q w) ≤ plaqEnergy (flatCurlValue (SAW q w))) :
    γ * ((q : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 ≤ 8 * (q : ℝ) + 8

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.f.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.fibreOne_of_scaled
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurlScaleTwo.f.header:
theorem fibreOne_of_scaled {r : ℕ} (h : CoarseCurlPoincareScaled r) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.pathTransport_nil
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem pathTransport_nil {G : Type*} [Group G] (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.pathTransport_append

theorem pathTransport_append {G : Type*} [Group G] (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.corner1_apply_one

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.corner1_apply_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header: theorem corner1_apply_zero (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : (corner1 y x) 0 = y 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.corner2_apply_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header: theorem corner2_apply_zero (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : (corner2 y x) 0 = y 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.pathSite_leg2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem pathSite_leg0 {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (h : (y 0).val ≤ (x 0).val) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.staircaseEndpoint_of_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem staircaseEndpoint_of_le {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.staircaseEndpoint_of_mem_block
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem staircaseEndpoint_of_mem_block {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {ell : ℕ}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.staircaseEndpoint_truncates

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.witnessY_not_mem_offBlockAnchor_block

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header: theorem staircaseBonds_self (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : staircaseBonds y y = []

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.pathTransport_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem pathTransport_one {G : Type*} [Group G] (bs : List (Bond L)) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.staircaseTransport_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem staircaseTransport_trivialU (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
noncomputable def coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU_add
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU_smul
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU U ell (c • lam) y =
      c • coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU U ell lam y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.coarseRestrictSiteCovariantULM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
noncomputable def coarseRestrictSiteCovariantULM
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.coarseRestrictSiteCovariantULM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem coarseRestrictSiteCovariantULM_apply
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    coarseRestrictSiteCovariantULM U ell lam = coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU U ell lam

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU_trivialU (ell : ℕ) (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU (trivialU L) ell lam y = coarseRestrictSiteCovariant ell lam y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU_trivialU_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU_trivialU_eq (ell : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.RMap_inv_apply_cancel
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem RMap_inv_apply_cancel (U : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (Y : SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.RMap_eq_zero_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem RMap_eq_zero_iff (U : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (Y : SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.pathTransport_singleton
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem pathTransport_singleton {G : Type*} [Group G] (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.axisBonds_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem axisBonds_succ (base : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.pathTransport_axisBonds_gaugeTransform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem pathTransport_axisBonds_gaugeTransform {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)
    (base : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    pathTransport (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (axisBonds base μ n) =
      γ base * pathTransport U (axisBonds base μ n) * (γ (pathSite base μ n))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.staircaseTransport_gaugeTransform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem staircaseTransport_gaugeTransform {G : Type*} [Group G]

    {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (h : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val ≤ (x μ).val) :
    staircaseTransport (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) y x =
      γ y * staircaseTransport U y x * (γ x)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.staircaseTransport_gaugeTransform_of_mem_block
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem staircaseTransport_gaugeTransform_of_mem_block {G : Type*} [Group G]

    {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {ell : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ blockOf y ell) :
    staircaseTransport (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) y x =
      γ y * staircaseTransport U y x * (γ x)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransported.coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU_gaugeTransform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU_gaugeTransform
    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :

      RMap (γ y) (coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU U ell lam y)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseRestrictTransp.header:
theorem mem_kernelSubspaceCovU_gaugeTransform
    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovarianc.header:
theorem shift_mod_formula (ell m : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (hm : 0 < m) (c : ℕ) (hc : c < ell * m) :
    (c + ell) % (ell * m) = ell * ((c / ell + 1) % m) + c % ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovarianc.header:
theorem div_eq_iff_range (ell j x : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) :
    x / ell = j ↔ ell * j ≤ x ∧ x < ell * j + ell

theorem mul_add_div_of_lt (ell k r : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (hr : r < ell) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovarianc.header:
theorem succ_mod_inj {m a b : ℕ} (ha : a < m) (hb : b < m) (h : (a + 1) % m = (b + 1) % m) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovarianc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovariance.coarseShift_blockCoord_mu
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovarianc.header:
theorem coarseShift_blockCoord_mu {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {μ : Fin 3}
    (hdvd : ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy0 : (y μ).val % ell = 0)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ((y μ).val ≤ (x μ).val ∧ (x μ).val < (y μ).val + ell) ↔
      (((coarseShift y ell μ) μ).val ≤ ((coarseShift x ell μ) μ).val ∧
        ((coarseShift x ell μ) μ).val < ((coarseShift y ell μ) μ).val + ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovarianc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovariance.coarseShift_mem_blockOf_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovarianc.header:
theorem coarseShift_mem_blockOf_iff {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {μ : Fin 3}
    (hdvd : ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    x ∈ blockOf y ell ↔ coarseShift x ell μ ∈ blockOf (coarseShift y ell μ) ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovarianc.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovarianc.header:
theorem coarseShift_blockOf_eq_image {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {μ : Fin 3}
    (hdvd : ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :
    blockOf (coarseShift y ell μ) ell =
      Finset.image (fun x : PeriodicLatticeSite L => coarseShift x ell μ) (blockOf y ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovarianc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovariance.coarseRestrict_shift_intertwine
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovarianc.header:
theorem coarseRestrict_shift_intertwine {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {μ : Fin 3}
    (hdvd : ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (hy' : coarseShift y ell μ ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (A : Bond L → ℝ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    coarseRestrict ell A (⟨coarseShift y ell μ, hy'⟩, ν) =
      coarseRestrict ell (fun b => A (coarseShift b.1 ell μ, b.2)) (⟨y, hy⟩, ν)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovarianc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovariance.coarseShift_blockCoord_mu_needs_alignment
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseShiftCovarianc.header:
theorem coarseShift_blockCoord_mu_needs_alignment :
    ¬ ∀ (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL),
      (((y 0).val ≤ (x 0).val ∧ (x 0).val < (y 0).val + AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll)) →
      (((coarseShift y AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll 0) 0).val ≤
          ((coarseShift x AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll 0) 0).val ∧
        ((coarseShift x AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll 0) 0).val <
          ((coarseShift y AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll 0) 0).val +
            AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercUMainKernel.ker.header:
theorem kernelStrengthened_rejects_junk (ell : ℕ)
    (h : (jCohyp (Lat := Lat) Uconfig ell).V
          = AdalyFormal.Balaban.Anchoring.anchoredVInter (Lat := Lat) ell ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (U : Uconfig), ((jCohyp (Lat := Lat) Uconfig ell).Δ k U).adjoint
          = (jCohyp (Lat := Lat) Uconfig ell).Δ k U) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (U : Uconfig) (v : HH Lat),
          0 ≤ (inner ℝ v ((jCohyp (Lat := Lat) Uconfig ell).Δ k U v) : ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (U : Uconfig) (c : ℝ), (jCohyp (Lat := Lat) Uconfig ell).Δ k U
          ≠ c • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (HH Lat)) ∧
        (∃ (U : Uconfig) (k₁ k₂ : ℕ), k₁ ≠ k₂ ∧ (jCohyp (Lat := Lat) Uconfig ell).Δ k₁ U
          ≠ (jCohyp (Lat := Lat) Uconfig ell).Δ k₂ U) ∧
        HasKernel (jCohyp (Lat := Lat) Uconfig ell).Δ ∧
        KernelMono (jCohyp (Lat := Lat) Uconfig ell).Δ ∧
        KernelGrows (jCohyp (Lat := Lat) Uconfig ell).Δ) : False

def CoercivityHypothesis.ofUnrestricted {H Uconfig : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [Nontrivial H] [Nontrivial Uconfig]
    (Δ : ℕ → Uconfig → H →L[ℝ] H) (γ'' : ℝ) (γ''_pos : 0 < γ'')
    (coercive : ∀ (k : ℕ) (U : Uconfig) (v : H), γ'' * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ v (Δ k U v))
    (Δ_nonconstant : ∃ (k : ℕ) (U₁ U₂ : Uconfig), U₁ ≠ U₂ ∧ Δ k U₁ ≠ Δ k U₂) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityHypothesis.header:
