    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [Nontrivial H] [Nontrivial Uconfig]
    (Δ : ℕ → Uconfig → H →L[ℝ] H) (γ'' : ℝ) (γ''_pos : 0 < γ'')
    (coercive : ∀ (k : ℕ) (U : Uconfig) (v : H), γ'' * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ v (Δ k U v))
    (Δ_nonconstant : ∃ (k : ℕ) (U₁ U₂ : Uconfig), U₁ ≠ U₂ ∧ Δ k U₁ ≠ Δ k U₂) :
    (CoercivityHypothesis.ofUnrestricted Δ γ'' γ''_pos coercive Δ_nonconstant).Δ = Δ
      ∧ (CoercivityHypothesis.ofUnrestricted Δ γ'' γ''_pos coercive Δ_nonconstant).γ'' = γ''

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityHypothesis.header:

    ∀ B ∈ h.V, (h.γ'' - ε) * ‖B‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ B (h.Δ k U₂ B)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.coercive_strict_at_some_point

    (p.1, p.2.1.1) ≠ (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1) ∧
    (p.1, p.2.1.1) ≠ (p.1, p.2.1.2) ∧
    (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1, p.2.1.2) ≠ (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1) ∧
    (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1, p.2.1.2) ≠ (p.1, p.2.1.2) ∧
    (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1) ≠ (p.1, p.2.1.2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.sp.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.sp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.spike_curl_of_touches
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.sp.header:

    ∃ g : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ,
      curlValueCovariant U (spikeWitness b₀) p = (RMap g suTwoWitness : SuTwo) ∨
        curlValueCovariant U (spikeWitness b₀) p = -(RMap g suTwoWitness : SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.no.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.sp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.spike_commutatorMatrixSum_eq_zero

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.sp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.spike_deltaPrimeSecondTerm_eq_zero

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.sp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.spike_deltaPrimeFirstTerm_of_not_touches
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.sp.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.sp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.spike_deltaPrimeFirstTerm_of_touches
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercivityRegular.sp.header:
theorem spike_deltaPrimeFirstTerm_of_touches

      = AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.covSiteInner lam src)
    (hadj : ∀ w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo,
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.covSiteInner w dstarA
        = AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHj.covBondInner
            (AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantOperators.gradValueCovariant U w) A)
    (hproj : siteEnergy src ≤ siteEnergy dstarA)
                              
    {γstar : ℝ} (hγstar : 0 < γstar) (hagg : AggregateFibreBound L U γstar)
                                      
    (hcrit : deltaPiConst (24 * etaInvSq * α₀) kappaTree ≤ γstar * (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2)) :
    γstar * bondEnergy A
        ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected U A + pAx A (CoarseLattice L 2) 2
      ∧ gammaFibre * bondSup A
        ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected (trivialU L) A + pAx A (CoarseLattice L 2) 2
      ∧ |deltaPrimePiForm U J lam A|
        ≤ deltaPiConst (24 * etaInvSq * α₀) kappaTree * bondEnergy A
      ∧ ∀ k : ℕ,
          0 < gammaSeq γstar (deltaPiConst (24 * etaInvSq * α₀) kappaTree) (1 / 2 : ℝ) k
            ∧ γstar
              ≤ gammaSeq γstar (deltaPiConst (24 * etaInvSq * α₀) kappaTree) (1 / 2 : ℝ) k

theorem covariant_door_must_fire :
    ∃ A : Bond cwL → SuTwo,
      lineCoarseRestrictCov cwU 2 A = cwF
      ∧ A ≠ 0
      ∧ AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.holonomyElem cwU
          (AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.zeroSite cwL,
            (⟨(0, 1), by decide⟩ : AdalyFormal.Target.ClayStatement.PeriodicPlaquetteDirections))
          ≠ (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
      ∧ AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.holonomyElem cwUbar
          (AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.zeroSite (coarseExtent cwL 2),
            (⟨(0, 1), by decide⟩ : AdalyFormal.Target.ClayStatement.PeriodicPlaquetteDirections))
          ≠ (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
      ∧ 0 < gammaCovLattice (1 / 10 ^ 20) (1 / 10 ^ 20) 1 (1 / 10 ^ 12) (1 / 10 ^ 12)
      ∧ 0 < gammaCovLattice (1 / 10 ^ 20) (1 / 10 ^ 20) 1 (1 / 10 ^ 12) (1 / 10 ^ 12)
          * bondEnergy A
      ∧ 0 < deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected cwU A + pAx A (CoarseLattice cwL 2) 2
      ∧ gammaCovLattice (1 / 10 ^ 20) (1 / 10 ^ 20) 1 (1 / 10 ^ 12) (1 / 10 ^ 12) * bondEnergy A
          ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected cwU A + pAx A (CoarseLattice cwL 2) 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantDoor.covari.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantDoor.covariant_next_must_fire
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantDoor.covari.header:
theorem covariant_next_must_fire :
    VCurved (coarseExtent cwL 2) cwUbar
        (WithLp.ofLp (WithLp.toLp 2 (vWitFine (Lc := coarseExtent cwL 2) rotGen)))
      ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (vWitFine (Lc := coarseExtent cwL 2) rotGen) :
          BondFnL2 (coarseExtent cwL 2)) ≠ 0
      ∧ 0 < (gammaCovLattice (1 / 10 ^ 20) (1 / 10 ^ 20) 1 (1 / 10 ^ 12) (1 / 10 ^ 12)
              - 272 * (1 / 10 ^ 20 : ℝ)) / ‖qCLM cwU 2‖ ^ 2
            * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (vWitFine (Lc := coarseExtent cwL 2) rotGen) :
                BondFnL2 (coarseExtent cwL 2))‖ ^ 2
      ∧ 0 < (inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 (vWitFine (Lc := coarseExtent cwL 2) rotGen) :
              BondFnL2 (coarseExtent cwL 2))
            (cwCovariantRung.next
              (WithLp.toLp 2 (vWitFine (Lc := coarseExtent cwL 2) rotGen))) : ℝ)
      ∧ (gammaCovLattice (1 / 10 ^ 20) (1 / 10 ^ 20) 1 (1 / 10 ^ 12) (1 / 10 ^ 12)
              - 272 * (1 / 10 ^ 20 : ℝ)) / ‖qCLM cwU 2‖ ^ 2
            * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (vWitFine (Lc := coarseExtent cwL 2) rotGen) :
                BondFnL2 (coarseExtent cwL 2))‖ ^ 2
          ≤ (inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 (vWitFine (Lc := coarseExtent cwL 2) rotGen) :
              BondFnL2 (coarseExtent cwL 2))
            (cwCovariantRung.next
              (WithLp.toLp 2 (vWitFine (Lc := coarseExtent cwL 2) rotGen))) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantFibreTransf.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantFibreTransf.header:
theorem Q_inter_local_curved (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))

    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hyc : y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2) (μ : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantFibreTransf.header:
theorem bond_energy_local_curved (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    {α₀ : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hsup : frobSupBond U ≤ α₀)

      lineCoarseRestrictCov U 2 A b = 0)
    (b : Bond L) :
    ‖A b‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (1 + ε) * 69088 * (localG A (cc b.1) + localG A (cc (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantFibreTransf.header:

        (gradValueCovariant (trivialU AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL) lam)

          coarseRestrictSiteCovariant AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll lam

theorem bondShiftEquiv_symm_apply {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (b : Bond L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.inflow_sum_reindex
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.header:
theorem inflow_sum_reindex
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, hsInner (lam (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)) (RMap (U b)⁻¹ (A b)) =
      ∑ c : Bond L,
        hsInner (lam c.1)
          (RMap (U (periodicLatticeShiftBack c.1 c.2, c.2))⁻¹
            (A (periodicLatticeShiftBack c.1 c.2, c.2)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CrossSectionPositivi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CrossSectionPositivity.sq_sum_split
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CrossSectionPositivi.header:
theorem sq_sum_split {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    ∑ x ∈ s, (f x) ^ 2
      = (∑ x ∈ s, (f x - (∑ y ∈ s, f y) / s.card) ^ 2)
        + (s.card : ℝ) * ((∑ y ∈ s, f y) / s.card) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CrossSectionPositivi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CrossSectionPositivity.operator_form_iff_poincare
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CrossSectionPositivi.header:
theorem operator_form_iff_poincare (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (G meanBar SumSq Var : ℝ) (hdecomp : SumSq = Var + L ^ 2 * meanBar ^ 2) :
    (G / L ^ 3 + meanBar ^ 2 / L ^ 2 ≥ SumSq / L ^ 4) ↔ (Var ≤ L * G)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CrossSectionPositivi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CrossSectionPositivity.cross_section_2127_iff_poincare
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CrossSectionPositivi.header:
theorem cross_section_2127_iff_poincare {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (L G : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (hcard : (s.card : ℝ) = L ^ 2) :
    (G / L ^ 3 + ((∑ y ∈ s, f y) / L ^ 2) ^ 2 / L ^ 2 ≥ (∑ x ∈ s, (f x) ^ 2) / L ^ 4)
      ↔ (∑ x ∈ s, (f x - (∑ y ∈ s, f y) / s.card) ^ 2 ≤ L * G)

theorem step_lift_facts (lvl : CurvedLevel Λ c rho sigma) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (Λ μ + 1))
    {Dpi : BondFnL2 Λ →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 Λ} (hpi : PiCorrectionBound Dpi delta)
    (r : Rung (BondFnL2 Λ) (BondFnL2 (coarseExtent Λ 2)) (piOp lvl.op Dpi))
    (hQeq : ∀ x : BondFnL2 Λ, r.Q x = qLevel hdvd x)
    (hPeq : r.P = pAxCLM (CoarseLattice Λ 2) 2)
    (B : BondFnL2 (coarseExtent Λ 2)) :
    ((inner ℝ (r.G (r.Qstar (r.S B))) (lvl.op (r.G (r.Qstar (r.S B)))) : ℝ)
        + (inner ℝ (r.G (r.Qstar (r.S B)))
            (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice Λ 2) 2 (r.G (r.Qstar (r.S B)))) : ℝ)
        ≤ (inner ℝ B (r.next B) : ℝ) + delta * ‖r.G (r.Qstar (r.S B))‖ ^ 2)
      ∧ ((defKappa rho sigma - defA c * delta) * ‖r.G (r.Qstar (r.S B))‖ ^ 2
        ≤ defA c * (inner ℝ B (r.next B) : ℝ) + defB * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
      ∧ curlEnergy (WithLp.ofLp B)
        ≤ 1 / 2 * curlEnergy (WithLp.ofLp (r.G (r.Qstar (r.S B))))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKU.curlValueCov.header:
theorem curlValueCovariant_trivialU (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    curlValueCovariant (trivialU L) A p =
      A (p.1, p.2.1.1) + A (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1, p.2.1.2) -
        A (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1) - A (p.1, p.2.1.2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKU.curlCovarian.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKU.curlCovariantAdjointValue_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKU.curlCovarian.header:
theorem curlCovariantAdjointValue_trivialU (F : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) :
    curlCovariantAdjointValue (trivialU L) F b =
      (∑ σ : Fin 3, if hlt : b.2 < σ then
          F (b.1, ⟨(b.2, σ), hlt⟩) - F (periodicLatticeShiftBack b.1 σ, ⟨(b.2, σ), hlt⟩)
        else 0)
      + (∑ σ : Fin 3, if hlt : σ < b.2 then
          F (periodicLatticeShiftBack b.1 σ, ⟨(σ, b.2), hlt⟩) - F (b.1, ⟨(σ, b.2), hlt⟩)
        else 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKU.deltaKUOp_tr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKU.deltaKUOp_trivialU_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKU.deltaKUOp_tr.header:
theorem deltaKUOp_trivialU_apply (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) :
    deltaKUOp (trivialU L) A b =
      (∑ σ : Fin 3, if hlt : b.2 < σ then
          curlValueCovariant (trivialU L) A (b.1, ⟨(b.2, σ), hlt⟩) -
            curlValueCovariant (trivialU L) A (periodicLatticeShiftBack b.1 σ, ⟨(b.2, σ), hlt⟩)
        else 0)
      + (∑ σ : Fin 3, if hlt : σ < b.2 then
          curlValueCovariant (trivialU L) A (periodicLatticeShiftBack b.1 σ, ⟨(σ, b.2), hlt⟩) -
            curlValueCovariant (trivialU L) A (b.1, ⟨(σ, b.2), hlt⟩)
        else 0)

    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnit_eq_minSwap_schur
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaKUnit_eq_minSwap_schur (ell : ℕ) (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.covP.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.covPlaqInner_smul_left
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.covP.header:
theorem covPlaqInner_smul_left (c : ℝ) (A B : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo) :
    covPlaqInner (c • A) B = c * covPlaqInner A B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.covP.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.covPlaqInner_smul_right
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.covP.header:
theorem covPlaqInner_smul_right (c : ℝ) (A B : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo) :
    covPlaqInner A (c • B) = c * covPlaqInner A B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.covP.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.covPlaqInner_smul_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.covP.header:
theorem covPlaqInner_smul_self (c : ℝ) (A : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo) :
    covPlaqInner (c • A) (c • A) = c ^ 2 * covPlaqInner A A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.covP.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.covPlaqInner_sub_left
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.covP.header:
theorem covPlaqInner_sub_left (A B C : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnit_zero_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnit_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaKUnit_smul {ell : ℕ} (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (c : ℝ) {B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo} (hB : B ∈ liftableUnitFields ell levels U) :
    deltaKUnit ell levels U (c • B) = c ^ 2 * deltaKUnit ell levels U B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.curl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.curlImageCovProjFaithful_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.curl.header:
theorem curlImageCovProjFaithful_add (ell : ℕ) (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (X Y : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo) :
    curlImageCovProjFaithful ell levels U (X + Y)
      = curlImageCovProjFaithful ell levels U X + curlImageCovProjFaithful ell levels U Y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.curl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.curlImageCovProjFaithful_sub
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.curl.header:
theorem curlImageCovProjFaithful_sub (ell : ℕ) (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (X Y : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo) :
    curlImageCovProjFaithful ell levels U (X - Y)
      = curlImageCovProjFaithful ell levels U X - curlImageCovProjFaithful ell levels U Y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.hjCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.hjCorrectionTargetCovFaithful_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.hjCo.header:
theorem hjCorrectionTargetCovFaithful_add (ell : ℕ) (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]

    hjCorrectionTargetCovFaithful ell levels U (A1 + A2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.hjCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.hjCorrectionTargetCovFaithful_sub
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.hjCo.header:
theorem hjCorrectionTargetCovFaithful_sub (ell : ℕ) (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]

    hjCorrectionTargetCovFaithful ell levels U (A1 - A2)
      = hjCorrectionTargetCovFaithful ell levels U A1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaJ_eq_covPlaqInner_target
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaJ_eq_covPlaqInner_target (ell : ℕ) (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))

      = covPlaqInner (hjCorrectionTargetCovFaithful ell levels U A0)
          (hjCorrectionTargetCovFaithful ell levels U A0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaJ_parallelogram
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaJ_parallelogram (ell : ℕ) (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (A1 A2 : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful ell levels U (A1 + A2)
        + deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful ell levels U (A1 - A2)
      = 2 * deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful ell levels U A1
        + 2 * deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful ell levels U A2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnit_parallelogram
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaKUnit_parallelogram {ell : ℕ} (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    {B1 B2 : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo}
    (h1 : B1 ∈ liftableUnitFields ell levels U)
    (h2 : B2 ∈ liftableUnitFields ell levels U) :
    deltaKUnit ell levels U (B1 + B2) + deltaKUnit ell levels U (B1 - B2)
      = 2 * deltaKUnit ell levels U B1 + 2 * deltaKUnit ell levels U B2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnitPolar
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
noncomputable def deltaKUnitPolar (ell : ℕ) (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (B1 B2 : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnitPolar_diag
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaKUnitPolar_diag {ell : ℕ} (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    {B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo} (hB : B ∈ liftableUnitFields ell levels U) :
    deltaKUnitPolar ell levels U B B = deltaKUnit ell levels U B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnit_is_quadratic_form
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaKUnit_is_quadratic_form {ell : ℕ} (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (c : ℝ) {B1 B2 : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo}
    (h1 : B1 ∈ liftableUnitFields ell levels U)
    (h2 : B2 ∈ liftableUnitFields ell levels U) :
    deltaKUnit ell levels U (0 : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) = 0
  ∧ deltaKUnit ell levels U (c • B1) = c ^ 2 * deltaKUnit ell levels U B1
  ∧ deltaKUnit ell levels U (B1 + B2) + deltaKUnit ell levels U (B1 - B2)
      = 2 * deltaKUnit ell levels U B1 + 2 * deltaKUnit ell levels U B2
  ∧ deltaKUnitPolar ell levels U B1 B1 = deltaKUnit ell levels U B1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.unit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.unitFibre_ell0_eq_empty_of_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.unit.header:
theorem unitFibre_ell0_eq_empty_of_ne_zero (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    {B : CoarseBond L 0 → SuTwo} (hB : B ≠ 0) :
    unitFibre 0 levels U B = (∅ : Set (Bond L → SuTwo))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.fibr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.fibreEnergies_ell0_eq_empty_of_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.fibr.header:
theorem fibreEnergies_ell0_eq_empty_of_ne_zero (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))

    fibreEnergies 0 levels U B = (∅ : Set ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnit_ell0_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaKUnit_ell0_eq_zero (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (B : CoarseBond L 0 → SuTwo) :
    deltaKUnit 0 levels U B = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.coar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.coarseWitness0
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.coar.header: noncomputable def coarseWitness0 : CoarseBond witL7 0 → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnit_ell0_collapse_is_not_vacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaKUnit_ell0_collapse_is_not_vacuous :
    coarseWitness0 ≠ 0
  ∧ deltaKUnit 0 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) coarseWitness0 = 0
  ∧ unitFibre 0 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) coarseWitness0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.fibr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.fibreEnergies_bddBelow
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.fibr.header:
theorem fibreEnergies_bddBelow (ell : ℕ) (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.unit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.unitFibre_subset_oneLevelUniv
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.unit.header:
theorem unitFibre_subset_oneLevelUniv {ell : ℕ} (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.fibr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.fibreEnergies_subset_oneLevelUniv
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.fibr.header:
theorem fibreEnergies_subset_oneLevelUniv {ell : ℕ} (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U (oneLevelUniv L)).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) :
    fibreEnergies ell levels U B ⊆ fibreEnergies ell (oneLevelUniv L) U B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnit_oneLevelUniv_le_of_lift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaKUnit_oneLevelUniv_le_of_lift {ell : ℕ} (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U (oneLevelUniv L)).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    {B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo} {A0 : Bond L → SuTwo}
    (h0 : A0 ∈ unitFibre ell levels U B) :
    deltaKUnit ell (oneLevelUniv L) U B ≤ deltaKUnit ell levels U B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnit_pos_of_pos_oneLevelUniv
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaKUnit_pos_of_pos_oneLevelUniv {ell : ℕ} (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U (oneLevelUniv L)).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    {B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo} {A0 : Bond L → SuTwo}
    (h0 : A0 ∈ unitFibre ell levels U B)
    (hpos : 0 < deltaKUnit ell (oneLevelUniv L) U B) :
    0 < deltaKUnit ell levels U B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnit_pos_or_unitFibre_empty
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaKUnit_pos_or_unitFibre_empty {ell : ℕ} (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U (oneLevelUniv L)).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo)
    (hpos : 0 < deltaKUnit ell (oneLevelUniv L) U B) :
    0 < deltaKUnit ell levels U B ∨ unitFibre ell levels U B = (∅ : Set (Bond L → SuTwo))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7un.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7unit
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7un.header: noncomputable def B7unit : CoarseBond witL7 2 → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7_m.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7_mem_unitFibre
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7_m.header:
theorem B7_mem_unitFibre :
    B7 ∈ unitFibre 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) B7unit

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7un.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7unit_mem_liftableUnitFields
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7un.header:
theorem B7unit_mem_liftableUnitFields :
    B7unit ∈ liftableUnitFields 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnit_B7unit_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaKUnit_B7unit_pos :
    0 < deltaKUnit 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) B7unit

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7_a.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7_add_B7'_mem_unitFibre
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7_a.header:
theorem B7_add_B7'_mem_unitFibre :
    B7 + B7' ∈ unitFibre 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) B7unit

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.two_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.two_distinct_lifts_same_value
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.two_.header:
theorem two_distinct_lifts_same_value :
    B7 ∈ unitFibre 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) B7unit
  ∧ B7 + B7' ∈ unitFibre 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) B7unit
  ∧ B7 ≠ B7 + B7'
  ∧ deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) B7
      = deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) (B7 + B7')

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.unit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.unit_level_form_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.unit.header:
theorem unit_level_form_nonvacuous :
    B7unit ≠ 0
  ∧ B7unit ∈ liftableUnitFields 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7)
  ∧ 0 < deltaKUnit 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) B7unit
  ∧ B7 ≠ B7 + B7'

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.quad.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.quadratic_form_laws_nonvacuous_at_B7unit
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.quad.header:
theorem quadratic_form_laws_nonvacuous_at_B7unit (c : ℝ) :
    B7unit ≠ 0
  ∧ B7unit ∈ liftableUnitFields 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7)
  ∧ 0 < deltaKUnit 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) B7unit
  ∧ deltaKUnit 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) (c • B7unit)
      = c ^ 2 * deltaKUnit 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) B7unit

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.witL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.witL7_one_dvd
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.witL.header: theorem witL7_one_dvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (1 : ℕ) ∣ (witL7 μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.y70_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.y70_shift0_coarse1
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.y70_.header: theorem y70_shift0_coarse1 : coarseShift y70 1 0 ∈ CoarseLattice witL7 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.y70_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.y70_shift1_coarse1
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.y70_.header: theorem y70_shift1_coarse1 : coarseShift y70 1 1 ∈ CoarseLattice witL7 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.Q1_B.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.Q1_B7'_origin
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.Q1_B.header:
theorem Q1_B7'_origin :
    lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU witL7) 1 B7' ((⟨y70, y70_coarse1⟩, 0) : CoarseBond witL7 1)
      = suTwoWitness

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.Q1_B.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.Q1_B7'_shifted
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.Q1_B.header:
theorem Q1_B7'_shifted (hmem : coarseShift y70 1 1 ∈ CoarseLattice witL7 1) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU witL7) 1 B7'
        ((⟨coarseShift y70 1 1, hmem⟩, 0) : CoarseBond witL7 1)
      = -suTwoWitness

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.coar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.coarseCurl_Q1_B7'
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.coar.header:
theorem coarseCurl_Q1_B7' :
    coarseCurlSuTwo witL7_one_dvd (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU witL7) 1 B7')
        ((⟨y70, y70_coarse1⟩, ⟨(0, 1), hlt01⟩) :
          AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.CoarsePlaquette witL7 1)
      = (2 : ℝ) • suTwoWitness

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.stok.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.stokesPhi_Q1_B7'_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.stok.header:
theorem stokesPhi_Q1_B7'_pos :
    0 < stokesPhi 1 witL7_one_dvd y70_coarse1 hlt01 suTwoWitness
        (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU witL7) 1 B7')

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7'_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7'_mem_unitFibre_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7'_.header:
theorem B7'_mem_unitFibre_zero :
    B7' ∈ unitFibre 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnit_zero_witL7
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaKUnit_zero_witL7 :
    deltaKUnit 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) 0 = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.stri.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.strict_energy_removal
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.stri.header:
theorem strict_energy_removal :
    B7' ∈ unitFibre 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) 0
  ∧ deltaKUnit 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) 0 = 0
  ∧ 0 < dstarDQuadForm (trivialU witL7) B7'

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.ener.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.energy_second_difference
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.ener.header:
theorem energy_second_difference
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A v : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    dstarDQuadForm U A + dstarDQuadForm U (A + v + v)
      = 2 * dstarDQuadForm U (A + v) + 2 * dstarDQuadForm U v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7_a.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7_add_two_B7'_mem_unitFibre
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.B7_a.header:
theorem B7_add_two_B7'_mem_unitFibre :
    B7 + B7' + B7' ∈ unitFibre 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) B7unit

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.remo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.removal_strict_at_B7unit
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.remo.header:
theorem removal_strict_at_B7unit :
    deltaKUnit 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) B7unit
        < dstarDQuadForm (trivialU witL7) B7
  ∨ deltaKUnit 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) B7unit
        < dstarDQuadForm (trivialU witL7) (B7 + B7')
  ∨ deltaKUnit 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) B7unit
        < dstarDQuadForm (trivialU witL7) (B7 + B7' + B7')

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.fine.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.fine_energy_eq_deltaKUnit_add_schurDefect
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.fine.header:
theorem fine_energy_eq_deltaKUnit_add_schurDefect {ell : ℕ}
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (A0 : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (h2 : RcovLM U levels (gradCovariantAdjointLM U A0) = 0) :
    dstarDQuadForm U A0
      = deltaKUnit ell levels U (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A0)
        + covPlaqInner (curlImageCovProjFaithful ell levels U (curlCovariantLM U A0))
            (curlImageCovProjFaithful ell levels U (curlCovariantLM U A0))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnit_le_dstarD
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaKUnit_le_dstarD {ell : ℕ} (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (A0 : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (h2 : RcovLM U levels (gradCovariantAdjointLM U A0) = 0) :
    deltaKUnit ell levels U (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A0) ≤ dstarDQuadForm U A0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.coll.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.collapsed_eq_deltaKUnit_add_two_terms
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.coll.header:
theorem collapsed_eq_deltaKUnit_add_two_terms {ell : ℕ}
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (A0 : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (h2 : RcovLM U levels (gradCovariantAdjointLM U A0) = 0) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.NormalizationAudit.deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected U A0
      = deltaKUnit ell levels U (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A0)
        + covPlaqInner (curlImageCovProjFaithful ell levels U (curlCovariantLM U A0))
            (curlImageCovProjFaithful ell levels U (curlCovariantLM U A0))
        + AdalyFormal.Balaban.NormalizationAudit.deltaPrimeQuadFormNormalizedTransported U A0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.coll.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.collapsed_ell0_carries_no_unit_content
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.coll.header:
theorem collapsed_ell0_carries_no_unit_content
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful 0 levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (A0 : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (h2 : RcovLM U levels (gradCovariantAdjointLM U A0) = 0) :
    deltaKUnit 0 levels U (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U 0 A0) = 0
  ∧ AdalyFormal.Balaban.NormalizationAudit.deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected U A0
      = covPlaqInner (curlImageCovProjFaithful 0 levels U (curlCovariantLM U A0))
          (curlImageCovProjFaithful 0 levels U (curlCovariantLM U A0))
        + AdalyFormal.Balaban.NormalizationAudit.deltaPrimeQuadFormNormalizedTransported U A0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnit_ell1_eq_dstarD
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaKUnit_ell1_eq_dstarD (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful 1 levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (A0 : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (h2 : RcovLM U levels (gradCovariantAdjointLM U A0) = 0) :
    deltaKUnit 1 levels U (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U 1 A0) = dstarDQuadForm U A0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.schu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.schurDefect_pos_witL7
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.schu.header:
theorem schurDefect_pos_witL7 :
    0 < covPlaqInner
        (curlImageCovProjFaithful 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7)
          (curlCovariantLM (trivialU witL7) B7'))
        (curlImageCovProjFaithful 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7)
          (curlCovariantLM (trivialU witL7) B7'))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaPrimeNormalizedTransported_trivialU_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaPrimeNormalizedTransported_trivialU_eq_zero (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.NormalizationAudit.deltaPrimeQuadFormNormalizedTransported
        (trivialU L) A = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnit_lt_collapsed_at_B7'
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaKUnit_lt_collapsed_at_B7' :
    deltaKUnit 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7)
        (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU witL7) 2 B7')
      < AdalyFormal.Balaban.NormalizationAudit.deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected
          (trivialU witL7) B7'

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.deltaKUnit_ne_collapsed_at_B7'
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.delt.header:
theorem deltaKUnit_ne_collapsed_at_B7' :
    deltaKUnit 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7)
        (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU witL7) 2 B7')
      ≠ AdalyFormal.Balaban.NormalizationAudit.deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected
          (trivialU witL7) B7'

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.coll.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.collapsed_lt_deltaKUnit_at_deltaWitness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.coll.header:
theorem collapsed_lt_deltaKUnit_at_deltaWitness :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.NormalizationAudit.deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected
        witnessU deltaWitnessConfig
      < deltaKUnit 1 (oneLevelUniv AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL) witnessU
          (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM witnessU 1
            deltaWitnessConfig)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.no_o.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.no_ordering_between_collapsed_and_unit
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKUnitLevel.no_o.header:
theorem no_ordering_between_collapsed_and_unit :
    deltaKUnit 2 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7)
        (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU witL7) 2 B7')

    [InnerProductSpace ℝ K] [Nontrivial K]
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (J : Bond L → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (Lam : (Bond L → SuTwo) → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)
    (DeltaPrimePi P : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L) (W : BondFnL2 L → Prop)
    (Q : BondFnL2 L → K) (Qstar : K → BondFnL2 L)
    (G : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L) (T S : K →L[ℝ] K) (a γ q Jsup kappa : ℝ)
    (hadj : ∀ (x : BondFnL2 L) (B : K),
      (inner ℝ (Qstar B) x : ℝ) = (inner ℝ B (Q x) : ℝ))
    (hPiSym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L,
      (inner ℝ u (DeltaPrimePi v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (DeltaPrimePi u) v : ℝ))
    (hRiesz : ∀ A : Bond L → SuTwo,
      (inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 A : BondFnL2 L) (DeltaPrimePi (WithLp.toLp 2 A)) : ℝ)
        = deltaPrimePiForm U J (Lam A) A)
    (hJ : ∀ b, frobNorm (J b) ≤ Jsup) (hk0 : 0 ≤ kappa)
    (hlam : ∀ A : Bond L → SuTwo, siteEnergy (Lam A) ≤ kappa ^ 2 * bondEnergy A)
    (hPpos : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, (0 : ℝ) ≤ (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ))
    (hPsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L, (inner ℝ u (P v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (P u) v : ℝ))
    (hGW : ∀ B : K, W (G (Qstar B)))
    (hTdef : ∀ B : K, T B = Q (G (Qstar B)))
    (hG1 : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L,
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.fineMapOf
        (AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.piExtendedMap
          (fun y => AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.deltaKCLMNormalized U y) DeltaPrimePi)
        P Q Qstar a (G x) = x)
    (hTS : ∀ B : K, T (S B) = B)
    (hγδ : 0 < γ - deltaPiConst Jsup kappa) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (h310W : ∀ A : Bond L → SuTwo, W (WithLp.toLp 2 A) →
      γ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 A : BondFnL2 L)‖ ^ 2
        ≤ AdalyFormal.Balaban.NormalizationAudit.deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected U A)
    (hQ : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, ‖Q x‖ ≤ q * ‖x‖) (B : K) :
    ((γ - deltaPiConst Jsup kappa) / q ^ 2) * ‖B‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ B (S B) : ℝ) - a * ‖B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.p.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.pairBil_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.p.header:
theorem pairBil_apply
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)
    (f g : (Bond L → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    pairBil U p f g A B
      = (Matrix.trace (smulILM (f A) * g B * imHolonomy U p)).re
        - (Matrix.trace (smulILM (g B) * f A * imHolonomy U p)).re

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.f.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.firstBilPlaq_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.f.header:
theorem firstBilPlaq_apply
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    firstBilPlaq U p A B
      = (Matrix.trace (smulILM (curlMatLM U p A) * smulILM (curlMatLM U p B)
          * (reHolonomy U p - 1))).re

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.secondBilPlaq_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.s.header:
theorem secondBilPlaq_apply
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    secondBilPlaq U p A B
      = pairBil U p (b1LM U p) (b2LM p) A B + pairBil U p (b1LM U p) (b3LM p) A B
        + pairBil U p (b1LM U p) (b4LM U p) A B + pairBil U p (b2LM p) (b3LM p) A B
        + pairBil U p (b2LM p) (b4LM U p) A B + pairBil U p (b3LM p) (b4LM U p) A B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.bilPlaq_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.b.header:
theorem bilPlaq_apply
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    bilPlaq U p A B = firstBilPlaq U p A B + secondBilPlaq U p A B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.bilPlaq_atoms
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.b.header:
theorem bilPlaq_atoms
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    bilPlaq U p A B
      = (Matrix.trace (smulILM (curlMatLM U p A) * smulILM (curlMatLM U p B)
            * (reHolonomy U p - 1))).re
        + ((Matrix.trace (smulILM (b1LM U p A) * b2LM p B * imHolonomy U p)).re
            - (Matrix.trace (smulILM (b2LM p B) * b1LM U p A * imHolonomy U p)).re)
        + ((Matrix.trace (smulILM (b1LM U p A) * b3LM p B * imHolonomy U p)).re
            - (Matrix.trace (smulILM (b3LM p B) * b1LM U p A * imHolonomy U p)).re)
        + ((Matrix.trace (smulILM (b1LM U p A) * b4LM U p B * imHolonomy U p)).re
            - (Matrix.trace (smulILM (b4LM U p B) * b1LM U p A * imHolonomy U p)).re)
        + ((Matrix.trace (smulILM (b2LM p A) * b3LM p B * imHolonomy U p)).re
            - (Matrix.trace (smulILM (b3LM p B) * b2LM p A * imHolonomy U p)).re)
        + ((Matrix.trace (smulILM (b2LM p A) * b4LM U p B * imHolonomy U p)).re
            - (Matrix.trace (smulILM (b4LM U p B) * b2LM p A * imHolonomy U p)).re)
        + ((Matrix.trace (smulILM (b3LM p A) * b4LM U p B * imHolonomy U p)).re
            - (Matrix.trace (smulILM (b4LM U p B) * b3LM p A * imHolonomy U p)).re)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.p.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.pairBil_witness_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrimeOperator.p.header:
theorem pairBil_witness_eq
    (f g : (Bond witnessL → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (A B : Bond witnessL → SuTwo)
    {X Y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ} (hf : f A = X) (hg : g B = Y) :
    pairBil witnessU witnessPlaquette f g A B
      = (Matrix.trace (Complex.I • X * Y * !![0, -Complex.I; Complex.I, 0])).re
        - (Matrix.trace (Complex.I • Y * X * !![0, -Complex.I; Complex.I, 0])).re

    (hB : Complex.I • curlMatLM witnessU witnessPlaquette B = Y) :
    firstBilPlaq witnessU witnessPlaquette A B
      = (Matrix.trace (X * Y * (-(1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)))).re

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DiscreteNeumannPoinc.header:

    ∑ i ∈ range n, ∑ j ∈ range n, (phi i - phi j) ^ 2
      = 2 * n * (∑ i ∈ range n, (phi i) ^ 2) - 2 * (∑ i ∈ range n, phi i) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DiscretePoincare.phy.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DiscretePoincare.physical_poincare_uniform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DiscretePoincare.phy.header:
theorem physical_poincare_uniform (n : ℕ) (phi : ℕ → ℝ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hmz : meanZero n phi) :
    physicalQuadForm n phi ≥ 2 * physicalNormSq n phi

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DiscretePoincare.mea.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DiscretePoincare.meanZero_necessary
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DiscretePoincare.mea.header:
theorem meanZero_necessary (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    dirichletEnergy n (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) = 0 ∧
    sumSq n (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) = n ∧
    ¬ sumSq n (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
        ≤ ((n : ℝ) * (n - 1) / 2) * dirichletEnergy n (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DiscretePoincare.cmp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DiscretePoincare.cmp89_pi_sq_claim_false_at_n2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DiscretePoincare.cmp.header:
theorem cmp89_pi_sq_claim_false_at_n2 :
    ¬ (physicalQuadForm 2 counterexamplePhi
        ≥ Real.pi ^ 2 * physicalNormSq 2 counterexamplePhi)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.perio.header:
theorem periodicCoordDist_comm (n : ℕ) (a b : Fin (n + 1)) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.perio.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.periodicSiteDist_comm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.perio.header:
theorem periodicSiteDist_comm (s t : PeriodicLatticeSite Lat) :

theorem mem_bigBlock {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lat} {M : ℕ} :

def bigBlockUnion (centers : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite Lat)) (M : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.bigBl.header:
theorem bigBlockUnion_pair (c1 c2 : PeriodicLatticeSite Lat) (M : ℕ) :
    bigBlockUnion ({c1, c2} : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite Lat)) M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.Margi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.MarginCondition
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.Margi.header: def MarginCondition (Lambda LambdaK : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite Lat)) (bound : ℕ) : Prop

theorem domainSequence_nonvacuous :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.l1dis.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.l1dist_ne_periodicSiteDist_verdict
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.l1dis.header:
theorem l1dist_ne_periodicSiteDist_verdict :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.nesti.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.nesting_fails_at_mutated_blockSize
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.nesti.header:
theorem nesting_fails_at_mutated_blockSize :

        bigBlock witnessCenterK 20)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.tiny_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.tiny_periodicSiteDist_le_three
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.tiny_.header:
theorem tiny_periodicSiteDist_le_three (s t : PeriodicLatticeSite tinyLat) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.tiny_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.tiny_no_margin_ge_three
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.tiny_.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.bigBl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.bigBlock_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DomainSequence.bigBl.header:
theorem bigBlock_one (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lat) :

Ell2Discharge.geomInequality_of_admissib.name: Ell2Discharge.geomInequality_of_admissible_ell2_of_backwardReindex
Ell2Discharge.geomInequality_of_admissib.header:
theorem geomInequality_of_admissible_ell2_of_backwardReindex
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) < L μ + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L 2)
    (Hreindex : ∀ z : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2},
        ∃ (c : ℝ) (fc : Fin 80 → ℝ), 0 ≤ c ∧
          LocalGeomBackward 2 hdvd B z
            = c * sosQuadValue (BackwardTCert.backCertSparse.map castSparse) fc) :
    GeomInequality 2 B

Ell2RefBlock.freecoord.name: Ell2RefBlock.freecoord
Ell2RefBlock.freecoord.header: def freecoord (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : ∀ μ, 4 ≤ L μ) (B : Bond L → ℝ) : Fin 80 → ℝ

Ell2RefBlock.topFace_total_freecoord.name: Ell2RefBlock.topFace_total_freecoord
Ell2RefBlock.topFace_total_freecoord.header:
theorem topFace_total_freecoord (hL : ∀ μ, 4 ≤ L μ) (B : Bond L → ℝ) :
    (∑ μ : Fin 3, topFaceEnergy B (prevSite μ) 2 μ)
      = ∑ i ∈ QSlabExpand.topIds, (freecoord L hL B i) ^ 2

Ell2RefBlock.geomInequality_of_admissibl.name: Ell2RefBlock.geomInequality_of_admissible_ell2_of_refBlockSOS
Ell2RefBlock.geomInequality_of_admissibl.header:
theorem geomInequality_of_admissible_ell2_of_refBlockSOS
    (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ L μ)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L 2)
    (Href : ∀ (C : Bond L → ℝ), C ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L 2 →
        ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧
          LocalGeomBackward 2 hdvd C (refBlock L 2)
            = c * sosQuadValue (BackwardTCert.backCertSparse.map castSparse) (freecoord L hL C))
    (Htrans : ∀ z : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2},
        ∃ (C : Bond L → ℝ), C ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L 2 ∧
          LocalGeomBackward 2 hdvd B z = LocalGeomBackward 2 hdvd C (refBlock L 2)) :
    GeomInequality 2 B

EnergyEval.inBlock_energy_dir0_drop.name: EnergyEval.inBlock_energy_dir0_drop
EnergyEval.inBlock_energy_dir0_drop.header:
theorem inBlock_energy_dir0_drop (hstrict0 : (2 : ℕ) < L 0 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L 2) :
    (∑ b ∈ bondsInBlock (0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) 2, (B b) ^ 2)
      = ∑ b ∈ (bondsInBlock (0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) 2).filter (fun b => b.2 ≠ 0), (B b) ^ 2

EnergyEval.pinned_inBlock0_eq_zero.name: EnergyEval.pinned_inBlock0_eq_zero
EnergyEval.pinned_inBlock0_eq_zero.header:
theorem pinned_inBlock0_eq_zero (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) < L μ + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L 2)
    {b : Bond L} (hbb : bondInBlock (0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) 2 b)
    (hpin : pinnedInBlock0 b) : B b = 0

EnergyEval.inBlock_energy_full_drop.name: EnergyEval.inBlock_energy_full_drop
EnergyEval.inBlock_energy_full_drop.header:
theorem inBlock_energy_full_drop (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) < L μ + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L 2) :
    (∑ b ∈ bondsInBlock (0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) 2, (B b) ^ 2)
      = ∑ b ∈ (bondsInBlock (0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) 2).filter
          (fun b => ¬ pinnedInBlock0 b), (B b) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.fie.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.fieldPull
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.fie.header: def fieldPull (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (B : Bond L → ℝ) : Bond L → ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.sit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.siteTransl_injective
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.sit.header:
theorem siteTransl_injective (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Function.Injective (fun x : PeriodicLatticeSite L => v + x)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.shi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.shift_transl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.shi.header:
theorem shift_transl (v w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    periodicLatticeShift (v + w) μ = v + periodicLatticeShift w μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.ite.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.iterate_shift_transl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.ite.header:
theorem iterate_shift_transl (v x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (j : ℕ) :
    (fun z => periodicLatticeShift z μ)^[j] (v + x)
      = v + (fun z => periodicLatticeShift z μ)^[j] x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.coarseShift_transl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.coa.header:
theorem coarseShift_transl (v w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift (v + w) ell μ = v + coarseShift w ell μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.tra.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.translate_mod_formula
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.tra.header:
theorem translate_mod_formula (ell m : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (hm : 0 < m)
    (V : ℕ) (hV : V % ell = 0) (hVlt : V < ell * m) (X : ℕ) (hX : X < ell * m) :
    (V + X) % (ell * m) = ell * (((V / ell) + (X / ell)) % m) + X % ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.tra.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.transl_blockCoord
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.transl_mem_blockOf_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.tra.header:
theorem transl_mem_blockOf_iff {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {v y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hv : v ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    x ∈ blockOf y ell ↔ (v + x) ∈ blockOf (v + y) ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.sit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.siteTransl_bijective
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.sit.header:
theorem siteTransl_bijective (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Function.Bijective (fun x : PeriodicLatticeSite L => v + x)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.tra.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.transl_blockOf_eq_image
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.tra.header:
theorem transl_blockOf_eq_image {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {v y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hv : v ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :
    blockOf (v + y) ell = Finset.image (fun x : PeriodicLatticeSite L => v + x) (blockOf y ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.tra.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.transl_topCoord

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.cro.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.crossSectionTop_transl_image
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.cro.header:
theorem crossSectionTop_transl_image {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {v y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hv : v ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (μ : Fin 3) :
    crossSectionTop (v + y) ell μ
      = Finset.image (fun x : PeriodicLatticeSite L => v + x) (crossSectionTop y ell μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.top.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.topFaceEnergy_transl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.top.header:
theorem topFaceEnergy_transl {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {v y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hv : v ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (B : Bond L → ℝ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    topFaceEnergy B (v + y) ell μ = topFaceEnergy (fieldPull v B) y ell μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.bon.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.bondTransl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.bon.header: def bondTransl (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (b : Bond L) : Bond L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.bon.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.bondTransl_injective
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.bon.header: theorem bondTransl_injective (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Function.Injective (bondTransl v)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.bon.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.bondsInBlock_transl_image
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.bon.header:
theorem bondsInBlock_transl_image {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {v y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hv : v ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :
    bondsInBlock (v + y) ell = Finset.image (bondTransl v) (bondsInBlock y ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.bon.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.bondsInBlock_energy_transl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.bon.header:
theorem bondsInBlock_energy_transl {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {v y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hv : v ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (B : Bond L → ℝ) :
    ∑ b ∈ bondsInBlock (v + y) ell, (B b) ^ 2
      = ∑ b ∈ bondsInBlock y ell, (fieldPull v B b) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.pla.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.plaqTransl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.pla.header:
def plaqTransl (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    PeriodicLatticePlaquette L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.pla.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.plaqTransl_injective
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.pla.header: theorem plaqTransl_injective (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Function.Injective (plaqTransl v)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.cur.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.curlValue_transl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.cur.header:
theorem curlValue_transl (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (B : Bond L → ℝ)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    curlValue B (plaqTransl v p) = curlValue (fieldPull v B) p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.sla.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.slabPlaqs_transl_image
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.sla.header:
theorem slabPlaqs_transl_image {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {v y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hv : v ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (hvy : v + y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (μ : Fin 3) :
    slabPlaqs ((⟨v + y, hvy⟩ : {z // z ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}), μ)
      = Finset.image (plaqTransl v)
          (slabPlaqs ((⟨y, hy⟩ : {z // z ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}), μ))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.sla.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.slabPlaqs_energy_transl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.sla.header:
theorem slabPlaqs_energy_transl {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {v y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hv : v ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (hvy : v + y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (B : Bond L → ℝ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∑ p ∈ slabPlaqs ((⟨v + y, hvy⟩ : {z // z ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}), μ), (curlValue B p) ^ 2
      = ∑ p ∈ slabPlaqs ((⟨y, hy⟩ : {z // z ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}), μ),
          (curlValue (fieldPull v B) p) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.lin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.lineIntegralValue_transl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.lin.header:
theorem lineIntegralValue_transl (ell : ℕ) (v x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (B : Bond L → ℝ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    lineIntegralValue ell B (v + x) μ = lineIntegralValue ell (fieldPull v B) x μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.lin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.lineCoarseRestrict_transl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.lin.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrict_transl {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {v y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hv : v ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (hvy : v + y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (B : Bond L → ℝ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    lineCoarseRestrict ell B ((⟨v + y, hvy⟩ : {z // z ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}), μ)
      = lineCoarseRestrict ell (fieldPull v B) ((⟨y, hy⟩ : {z // z ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}), μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.add.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.add_mem_coarse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.add.header:
theorem add_mem_coarse {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {v w : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hv : v ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (hw : w ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :
    v + w ∈ CoarseLattice L ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.coarseShift_prevSite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.coa.header:
theorem coarseShift_prevSite (μ : Fin 3) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    coarseShift (prevSite μ) 2 μ = (0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.pre.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.prevMu_gen
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.pre.header:
theorem prevMu_gen (μ : Fin 3) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (z : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2}) :
    (coarseShiftEquiv 2 μ hdvd).symm z
      = ⟨z.1 + prevSite μ, add_mem_coarse hdvd z.2 (prevSite_mem μ hdvd)⟩

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.loc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.localGeomBackward_transl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.loc.header:
theorem localGeomBackward_transl (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1)) (B : Bond L → ℝ)
    (z : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2}) :
    LocalGeomBackward 2 hdvd B z
      = LocalGeomBackward 2 hdvd (fieldPull z.1 B) (refBlock L 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.tra.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.transl_blockCoord_needs_alignment
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.tra.header:
theorem transl_blockCoord_needs_alignment :
    ¬ ∀ (v y x : PeriodicLatticeSite AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL),
      (((y 0).val ≤ (x 0).val ∧ (x 0).val < (y 0).val + AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll) →
        (((v + y) 0).val ≤ ((v + x) 0).val ∧
          ((v + x) 0).val < ((v + y) 0).val + AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.tra.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.transl_val_offset
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.tra.header:
theorem transl_val_offset {ρ : Fin 3} {v base w : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hdvd : 2 ∣ (L ρ + 1)) (hvρ : (v ρ).val % 2 = 0) (hbρ : (base ρ).val % 2 = 0)
    (hw : (w ρ).val = (base ρ).val ∨ (w ρ).val = (base ρ).val + 1) :
    ((v + w) ρ).val = ((v + base) ρ).val + ((w ρ).val - (base ρ).val)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.tra.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.transl_update
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.tra.header:
theorem transl_update (v f : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (k : Fin 3) (val : Fin (L k + 1)) :
    v + Function.update f k val = Function.update (v + f) k (v k + val)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.cor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.corner1_transl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.cor.header:
theorem corner1_transl (v y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    corner1 (v + y) (v + x) = v + corner1 y x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.cor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.corner2_transl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.EnergyIntertwine.cor.header:
theorem corner2_transl (v y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :

      ∧ (1 / 3316224 : ℝ) * bondEnergy (altMode (L := L) w)
          ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected (trivialU L) (altMode (L := L) w)
            + pAx (altMode (L := L) w) (CoarseLattice L 2) 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreAggregate.aggre.header:
theorem aggregate_numeric_at_alternating :

      ∧ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected (trivialU witL5)

        = 108 * ‖AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen‖ ^ 2
      ∧ 0 < ‖AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen‖ ^ 2
      ∧ (1 / 3316224 : ℝ) * (216 * ‖AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen‖ ^ 2)
          ≤ 108 * ‖AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.curl.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.path.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.pathIntegral_split
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.path.header:
theorem pathIntegral_split (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pathIntegral A y x
      = (∑ b ∈ axisSegment y 2 (min (y 2).val (x 2).val) (max (y 2).val (x 2).val), A b)
        + (∑ b ∈ axisSegment (corner1 y x) 1 (min (y 1).val (x 1).val)
            (max (y 1).val (x 1).val), A b)
        + (∑ b ∈ axisSegment (corner2 y x) 0 (min (y 0).val (x 0).val)
            (max (y 0).val (x 0).val), A b)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.corn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.corner1_addOff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.corn.header:
theorem corner1_addOff (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val % 2 = 0) (r s t : ℕ)
    (hr : r ≤ 1) (hs : s ≤ 1) (ht : t ≤ 1) :
    corner1 y (addOff y (off3 r s t)) = addOff y (off3 0 0 t)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.corn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.corner2_addOff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.corn.header:

    (hr : r ≤ 1) (hs : s ≤ 1) (ht : t ≤ 1) :
    corner2 y (addOff y (off3 r s t)) = addOff y (off3 0 s t)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.path.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.pathIntegral_off3
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.path.header:
theorem pathIntegral_off3 (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val % 2 = 0) (r s t : ℕ)
    (hr : r ≤ 1) (hs : s ≤ 1) (ht : t ≤ 1) :
    pathIntegral A y (addOff y (off3 r s t))
      = (if t = 1 then A (y, 2) else 0)
        + (if s = 1 then A (addOff y (off3 0 0 t), 1) else 0)
        + (if r = 1 then A (addOff y (off3 0 s t), 0) else 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.tree.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.tree_bonds_vanish
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.tree.header:
theorem tree_bonds_vanish (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val % 2 = 0)
    (hI : ∀ r s t : ℕ, r ≤ 1 → s ≤ 1 → t ≤ 1 →
      pathIntegral A y (addOff y (off3 r s t)) = 0) :
    A (addOff y (off3 0 0 0), 2) = 0 ∧ A (addOff y (off3 0 0 0), 1) = 0
      ∧ A (addOff y (off3 0 0 1), 1) = 0 ∧ A (addOff y (off3 0 0 0), 0) = 0
      ∧ A (addOff y (off3 0 1 0), 0) = 0 ∧ A (addOff y (off3 0 0 1), 0) = 0
      ∧ A (addOff y (off3 0 1 1), 0) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.nont.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.nontree_bonds_vanish
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.nont.header:
theorem nontree_bonds_vanish (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hc : closedFlat A) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val % 2 = 0)
    (hI : ∀ r s t : ℕ, r ≤ 1 → s ≤ 1 → t ≤ 1 →
      pathIntegral A y (addOff y (off3 r s t)) = 0) :
    A (addOff y (off3 1 0 0), 1) = 0 ∧ A (addOff y (off3 1 0 1), 1) = 0
      ∧ A (addOff y (off3 1 0 0), 2) = 0 ∧ A (addOff y (off3 0 1 0), 2) = 0
      ∧ A (addOff y (off3 1 1 0), 2) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.intr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.intra_block_vanishes
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.intr.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.inte.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.inter_step
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.inte.header:
theorem inter_step (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hc : closedFlat A) (hP : pAx A (CoarseLattice L 2) 2 = 0)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val % 2 = 0)
    (e e' : Fin 3 → ℕ) (he : ∀ ν, e ν ≤ 1) (he' : ∀ ν, e' ν ≤ 1)
    (μ ν : Fin 3) (hne : ν ≠ μ) (hzero : e ν = 0) (hone : e' ν = e ν + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.inte.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.inter_block_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.inte.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.line.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.lineCoarse_trivial_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.line.header:
theorem lineCoarse_trivial_two (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hyc : y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2) (μ : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.trip.header:

    (b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.CoarseBond L 2) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 2 (oddAltMode w) b = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.oddA.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.oddAltMode_not_closed
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.oddA.header:
theorem oddAltMode_not_closed (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (w : SuTwo) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    ¬ closedFlat (oddAltMode (L := L) w)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.oddA.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.oddAltMode_field_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.oddA.header:
theorem oddAltMode_field_ne (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (w : SuTwo) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    oddAltMode (L := L) w ≠ fun _ => 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.clau.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.clauses_are_load_bearing
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.clau.header:
theorem clauses_are_load_bearing (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (w : SuTwo)
    (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    ((altMode (L := L) w ≠ fun _ => 0) ∧ closedFlat (altMode (L := L) w)
        ∧ (∀ b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.CoarseBond L 2,
            lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 2 (altMode w) b = 0)
        ∧ pAx (altMode (L := L) w) (CoarseLattice L 2) 2 ≠ 0)
      ∧ ((blockMode (L := L) w ≠ fun _ => 0) ∧ closedFlat (blockMode (L := L) w)
        ∧ pAx (blockMode (L := L) w) (CoarseLattice L 2) 2 = 0
        ∧ ¬ (∀ b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.CoarseBond L 2,
            lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 2 (blockMode w) b = 0))
      ∧ ((oddAltMode (L := L) w ≠ fun _ => 0)
        ∧ (∀ b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.CoarseBond L 2,
            lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 2 (oddAltMode w) b = 0)
        ∧ pAx (oddAltMode (L := L) w) (CoarseLattice L 2) 2 = 0
        ∧ ¬ closedFlat (oddAltMode (L := L) w))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.clau.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.clauses_are_load_bearing_at_rotGen
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.clau.header:
theorem clauses_are_load_bearing_at_rotGen (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    (AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen ≠ 0)
      ∧ ((altMode (L := L) AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen ≠ fun _ => 0)
        ∧ closedFlat (altMode (L := L) AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen)
        ∧ pAx (altMode (L := L) AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen)
            (CoarseLattice L 2) 2 ≠ 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.curl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.curlEnergy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.curl.header: noncomputable def curlEnergy (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.curl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.curlEnergy_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.curl.header: theorem curlEnergy_nonneg (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : 0 ≤ curlEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.norm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.norm_sq_flatCurl_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.norm.header:
theorem norm_sq_flatCurl_le (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    ‖flatCurlValue A p‖ ^ 2 ≤ curlEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.sq_f.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.sq_four
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.sq_f.header:
theorem sq_four (a b c d : SuTwo) :
    ‖a + b + c + d‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2 + ‖c‖ ^ 2 + ‖d‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.curl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.curl_solve
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.curl.header:
theorem curl_solve (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) (h : μ < ν) :
    A (periodicLatticeShift z μ, ν)
      = flatCurlValue A (z, ⟨(μ, ν), h⟩) + (-A (z, μ)) + A (periodicLatticeShift z ν, μ)
        + A (z, ν)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.intr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.intra_block_energy_bound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.intr.header:
theorem intra_block_energy_bound (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val % 2 = 0)
    (e : Fin 3 → ℕ) (he : ∀ ν, e ν ≤ 1) (μ : Fin 3) (heμ : e μ = 0) :
    ‖A (addOff y e, μ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 352 * (pAxBlock A 2 y + curlEnergy A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.intr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.intra_bond_energy_bound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.intr.header:
theorem intra_bond_energy_bound (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (hz : (z μ).val % 2 = 0) :
    ‖A (z, μ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 352 * (pAxBlock A 2 (cc z) + curlEnergy A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.intr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.intra_bond_energy_bound_global
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.intr.header:
theorem intra_bond_energy_bound_global (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (hz : (z μ).val % 2 = 0) :
    ‖A (z, μ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 352 * (pAx A (CoarseLattice L 2) 2 + curlEnergy A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.intr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.intra_bond_energy_bound_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.intr.header:
theorem intra_bond_energy_bound_nonvacuous (w : SuTwo) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    0 < ‖altMode (L := L) w ((zeroSite L), (0 : Fin 3))‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.quan.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.quantitative_bound_is_homogeneous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.quan.header:
theorem quantitative_bound_is_homogeneous (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (t : ℝ) (b : Bond L)
    (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ell : ℕ) :
    ‖(fun c => t • A c) b‖ ^ 2 = t ^ 2 * ‖A b‖ ^ 2
      ∧ curlEnergy (fun c => t • A c) = t ^ 2 * curlEnergy A
      ∧ pAx (fun c => t • A c) S ell = t ^ 2 * pAx A S ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.inte.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.inter_step_bound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.inte.header:
theorem inter_step_bound (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val % 2 = 0)
    (u v : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hu : ∀ ν, u ν ≤ 1) (hv : ∀ ν, v ν ≤ 1) (μ ν : Fin 3) (hne : ν ≠ μ)
    (hzero : u ν = 0) (hone : v ν = u ν + 1) (hrest : ∀ ρ, ρ ≠ ν → v ρ = u ρ) :
    ‖A (addOff y v, μ) - A (addOff y u, μ)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 2820 * (pAx A (CoarseLattice L 2) 2 + curlEnergy A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.inte.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.inter_dev_bound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.inte.header:
theorem inter_dev_bound (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val % 2 = 0)
    (e : Fin 3 → ℕ) (he : ∀ ν, e ν ≤ 1) (μ : Fin 3) (heμ : e μ = 1) :
    ‖A (addOff y e, μ) - A (periodicLatticeShift y μ, μ)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 11280 * (pAx A (CoarseLattice L 2) 2 + curlEnergy A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.bloc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.block_summand_dev
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.bloc.header:
theorem block_summand_dev (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val % 2 = 0)
    (e : Fin 3 → ℕ) (he : ∀ ν, e ν ≤ 1) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ‖(A (addOff y e, μ) + A (periodicLatticeShift (addOff y e) μ, μ))
        - A (periodicLatticeShift y μ, μ)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 23264 * (pAx A (CoarseLattice L 2) 2 + curlEnergy A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.Q_in.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.Q_inter_bound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.Q_in.header:
theorem Q_inter_bound (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.bond.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.bond_energy_bound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.bond.header:
theorem bond_energy_bound (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hQ : ∀ b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.CoarseBond L 2,
      lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 2 A b = 0)
    (b : Bond L) :
    ‖A b‖ ^ 2 ≤ 69088 * (pAx A (CoarseLattice L 2) 2 + curlEnergy A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.quan.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.quantitative_implies_qualitative
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.quan.header:
theorem quantitative_implies_qualitative (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.trip.header:
theorem triple_kernel_trivial_witL5 (A : Bond witL5 → SuTwo) (hc : closedFlat A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.bond.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.bond_energy_bound_witL5
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.bond.header:
theorem bond_energy_bound_witL5 (A : Bond witL5 → SuTwo)
    (hQ : ∀ b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.CoarseBond witL5 2,
      lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU witL5) 2 A b = 0) (b : Bond witL5) :
    ‖A b‖ ^ 2 ≤ 69088 * (pAx A (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2 + curlEnergy A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.clau.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.clauses_are_load_bearing_witL5
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.clau.header:
theorem clauses_are_load_bearing_witL5 :
    ((altMode (L := witL5) AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen ≠ fun _ => 0)
        ∧ closedFlat (altMode (L := witL5) AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen)
        ∧ (∀ b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.CoarseBond witL5 2,
            lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU witL5) 2
              (altMode AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen) b = 0)
        ∧ pAx (altMode (L := witL5) AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen)
            (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2 ≠ 0)
      ∧ ((blockMode (L := witL5) AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen ≠ fun _ => 0)
        ∧ closedFlat (blockMode (L := witL5) AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen)
        ∧ pAx (blockMode (L := witL5) AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen)
            (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2 = 0
        ∧ ¬ (∀ b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.CoarseBond witL5 2,
            lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU witL5) 2
              (blockMode AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen) b = 0))
      ∧ ((oddAltMode (L := witL5) AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen ≠ fun _ => 0)
        ∧ (∀ b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.CoarseBond witL5 2,
            lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU witL5) 2
              (oddAltMode AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen) b = 0)
        ∧ pAx (oddAltMode (L := witL5) AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen)
            (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2 = 0
        ∧ ¬ closedFlat (oddAltMode (L := witL5) AdalyFormal.Balaban.BridgeRestricted.rotGen))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.deltaK_trivialU_eq_curlEnergy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.delt.header:
theorem deltaK_trivialU_eq_curlEnergy (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.clos.header:
theorem closedFlat_iff_deltaK_zero (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.trip.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.triple_kernel_trivial_deltaK
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.trip.header:
theorem triple_kernel_trivial_deltaK (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.bond.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.bond_energy_bound_deltaK
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.bond.header:

      lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 2 A b = 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.bond.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.bondEnergy_le_with_volume_factor
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.bond.header:
theorem bondEnergy_le_with_volume_factor (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.ell1.header:
theorem ell1_pAx_vacuous (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.evalFinsetLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.e.header:
noncomputable def evalFinsetLM (s : Finset (Bond L)) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.evalFinsetLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.e.header:
theorem evalFinsetLM_apply (s : Finset (Bond L)) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : ↥s) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.evalFinsetLM_surjective
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.e.header:
theorem evalFinsetLM_surjective (s : Finset (Bond L)) :
