AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.k.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.ker_evalFinsetLM_eq_admissibleSubspaceCov
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.k.header:
theorem ker_evalFinsetLM_eq_admissibleSubspaceCov (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ)
    (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (hx : x ∈ blockOf y ell) :
    LinearMap.ker (evalFinsetLM (staircasePath y x)) = admissibleSubspaceCov y x ell hy hx

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.f.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.finrank_ker_evalFinsetLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.f.header:
theorem finrank_ker_evalFinsetLM (s : Finset (Bond L)) [FiniteDimensional ℝ (Bond L → SuTwo)] :
    Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (evalFinsetLM (L := L) s)) =
      Module.finrank ℝ (Bond L → SuTwo) - Module.finrank ℝ (↥s → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.f.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.finrank_admissibleSubspaceCov
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.f.header:
theorem finrank_admissibleSubspaceCov (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ)
    (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (hx : x ∈ blockOf y ell)
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ (Bond L → SuTwo)] :
    Module.finrank ℝ (admissibleSubspaceCov y x ell hy hx) =
      Module.finrank ℝ (Bond L → SuTwo) - Module.finrank ℝ (↥(staircasePath y x) → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.f.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.finrank_anchoredVCov
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.f.header:
theorem finrank_anchoredVCov {Lat : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lat)

    [FiniteDimensional ℝ (Bond Lat → SuTwo)] :
    Module.finrank ℝ (anchoredVCov y x ell hy hx) =
      Module.finrank ℝ (Bond Lat → SuTwo) - Module.finrank ℝ (↥(staircasePath y x) → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.g.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.gradCovariantAdjointLM_L2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.gradCovariantAdjointLM_L2_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.g.header:
theorem gradCovariantAdjointLM_L2_apply {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.f.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.finrank_siteFnL2_lt_finrank_anchoredVCov_witness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.f.header:
theorem finrank_siteFnL2_lt_finrank_anchoredVCov_witness :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.exists_forced_witness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.e.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.o.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.oneScaleCoercivity_su2_false_at_witness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ForcedIntersection.o.header:
theorem oneScaleCoercivity_su2_false_at_witness
    (h : ∃ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ ∧
      ∀ (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) witnessL)
        (B : BondFnL2 witnessL),

        γ * ‖B‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ B (BondSU2Space.bondLaplacianCovCLM_L2 U B)) : False

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.coarseShift_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.co.header: theorem coarseShift_zero (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : coarseShift x 0 μ = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.coarseShift_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.co.header:
theorem coarseShift_succ (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift x (n + 1) μ = periodicLatticeShift (coarseShift x n μ) μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.coarseShift_coarseShift_comm

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.pe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.periodicLatticeShift_coarseShift_comm

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.li.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.lineIntegralValue_eq_sum_coarseShift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.li.header:
theorem lineIntegralValue_eq_sum_coarseShift (ell : ℕ) (A : Bond L → ℝ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    lineIntegralValue ell A x μ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, A (coarseShift x j μ, μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.li.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.lineIntegral_bigSquare_stokes
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.li.header:
theorem lineIntegral_bigSquare_stokes (ell : ℕ) (A : Bond L → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν) :
    lineIntegralValue ell A x μ + lineIntegralValue ell A (coarseShift x ell μ) ν
      - lineIntegralValue ell A (coarseShift x ell ν) μ - lineIntegralValue ell A x ν
    = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell,
        curlValue A (coarseShift (coarseShift x j ν) i μ, ⟨(μ, ν), hlt⟩)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.li.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.lineCoarseRestrict_shifted_block
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.li.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrict_shifted_block {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {μ : Fin 3}
    (hdvd : ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (hy' : coarseShift y ell μ ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (A : Bond L → ℝ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    lineCoarseRestrict ell A (⟨coarseShift y ell μ, hy'⟩, ν) =
      (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * ∑ x ∈ blockOf y ell, lineIntegralValue ell A (coarseShift x ell μ) ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.coarseCurl_lineCoarseRestrict_eq_blockSum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.co.header:
theorem coarseCurl_lineCoarseRestrict_eq_blockSum {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → ℝ)
    (y : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell})
    (d : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections) :
    coarseCurlValue hdvd (lineCoarseRestrict ell A) (y, d) =
      (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * ∑ x ∈ blockOf y.1 ell, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell,
          curlValue A (coarseShift (coarseShift x j d.1.2) i d.1.1, d)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.su.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.sum_coarse_blocks
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.su.header:
theorem sum_coarse_blocks {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ∑ y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell, ∑ x ∈ blockOf y ell, f x = ∑ x, f x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.su.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.sum_sq_coarseCurl_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.su.header:
theorem sum_sq_coarseCurl_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → ℝ) (d : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections) :
    (ell : ℝ) * ∑ y : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell},
        (coarseCurlValue hdvd (lineCoarseRestrict ell A) (y, d)) ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ z : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (curlValue A (z, d)) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.faithful_U1_coercivity_lower
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.fa.header:
theorem faithful_U1_coercivity_lower {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → ℝ) :
    (ell : ℝ) * ∑ p : CoarsePlaquette L ell,
        (coarseCurlValue hdvd (lineCoarseRestrict ell A) p) ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ q : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, (curlValue A q) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.faithful_U1_coercivity_gamma0_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.fa.header:
theorem faithful_U1_coercivity_gamma0_one {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → ℝ) :
    ∑ p : CoarsePlaquette L ell, (coarseCurlValue hdvd (lineCoarseRestrict ell A) p) ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ q : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, (curlValue A q) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.lo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.lower_coercivity_for_any_extension
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.lo.header:
theorem lower_coercivity_for_any_extension {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (B : CoarseBond L ell → ℝ) (A : Bond L → ℝ)
    (hQ : lineCoarseRestrict ell A = B) :
    (ell : ℝ) * ∑ p : CoarsePlaquette L ell, (coarseCurlValue hdvd B p) ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ q : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, (curlValue A q) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.eu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.euclidean_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.eu.header:
theorem euclidean_norm_sq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ‖v‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, (v i) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.faithful_U1_coercivity_lower_norm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.fa.header:
theorem faithful_U1_coercivity_lower_norm {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : BondSpace L) :
    (ell : ℝ) * ‖coarseCurlCLM L ell hdvd (lineCoarseRestrictCLM L ell A)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ ‖curlCLM L A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.me.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.mem_coarseLattice_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.me.header: theorem mem_coarseLattice_one (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : y ∈ CoarseLattice L 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.blockOf_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.bl.header: theorem blockOf_one (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : blockOf y 1 = {y}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.li.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.lineCoarseRestrict_one_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.li.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrict_one_apply (A : Bond L → ℝ)
    (y : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L 1}) (μ : Fin 3) :
    lineCoarseRestrict 1 A (y, μ) = A (y.1, μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.coarseCurl_one_eq_curl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.co.header:
theorem coarseCurl_one_eq_curl (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (1 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → ℝ)
    (y : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L 1})
    (d : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections) :
    coarseCurlValue hdvd (lineCoarseRestrict 1 A) (y, d) = curlValue A (y.1, d)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.ca.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.calibration_ell_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.ca.header:
theorem calibration_ell_one (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (1 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → ℝ) :
    (1 : ℝ) * ∑ p : CoarsePlaquette L 1,
        (coarseCurlValue hdvd (lineCoarseRestrict 1 A) p) ^ 2
      = ∑ q : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, (curlValue A q) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.bu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.bumpField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.bu.header: noncomputable def bumpField : Bond AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL → ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.su.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.sum_sq_curl_bumpField_ge_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.su.header:
theorem sum_sq_curl_bumpField_ge_one :
    (1 : ℝ) ≤ ∑ q : PeriodicLatticePlaquette AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL,
      (curlValue bumpField q) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.mu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.mutation_doubled_constant_fails
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.mu.header:
theorem mutation_doubled_constant_fails :
    ¬ (∀ (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ), 0 < ell →
        ∀ (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → ℝ),
        2 * (ell : ℝ) * ∑ p : CoarsePlaquette L ell,
            (coarseCurlValue hdvd (lineCoarseRestrict ell A) p) ^ 2
          ≤ ∑ q : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, (curlValue A q) ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.li.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.lineIntegralValue_coarseShift_comm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.li.header:
theorem lineIntegralValue_coarseShift_comm (ell m : ℕ) (A : Bond L → ℝ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {μ ν : Fin 3} (h : μ ≠ ν) :
    lineIntegralValue ell A (coarseShift x m μ) ν =
      lineIntegralValue ell (fun b => A (coarseShift b.1 m μ, b.2)) x ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.li.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.lineIntegralValue_coarseShift_same
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.li.header:
theorem lineIntegralValue_coarseShift_same (ell m : ℕ) (A : Bond L → ℝ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    lineIntegralValue ell A (coarseShift x m μ) μ =
      lineIntegralValue ell (fun b => A (coarseShift b.1 m μ, b.2)) x μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.li.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.lineCoarseRestrict_shift_intertwine
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FourierFaithfulU1.li.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrict_shift_intertwine {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {μ : Fin 3}
    (hdvd : ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (hy' : coarseShift y ell μ ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (A : Bond L → ℝ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    lineCoarseRestrict ell A (⟨coarseShift y ell μ, hy'⟩, ν) =
      lineCoarseRestrict ell (fun b => A (coarseShift b.1 ell μ, b.2)) (⟨y, hy⟩, ν)

FreeCellReindex.LocalGeom.header:

FreeCellReindex.geomForm_eq_sum_localGeo.name: FreeCellReindex.geomForm_eq_sum_localGeom
FreeCellReindex.geomForm_eq_sum_localGeo.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.dropped.header:
theorem droppedBondLast_injective {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.isDropp.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_d.header:
theorem fullC_dropped {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (Dinv : CoarseBond L ell → (SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo)) (B : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_a.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_a.header:
theorem fullC_add
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {ell : ℕ}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_s.header:
theorem fullC_smul
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {ell : ℕ}
    (Dinv : CoarseBond L ell → (SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo)) (a : ℝ) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullCLM.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullCLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullCLM.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullCLM.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullCLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullCLM.header:
theorem fullCLM_apply
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (Dinv : CoarseBond L ell → (SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo)) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    fullCLM U ell Dinv B = fullC U ell Dinv B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_eq_reparamC_on_reads
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_e.header:
theorem fullC_eq_reparamC_on_reads {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (Dinv : CoarseBond L ell → (SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo)) (B : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) (b : Bond L) (hb : ReadsBond ell c b) :
    fullC U ell Dinv B b =
      reparamCSuTwo U ell c (droppedBondLast ell c) (Dinv c) B b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_m.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_mem_kerQ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_m.header:
theorem fullC_mem_kerQ {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (Dinv : CoarseBond L ell → (SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo))
    (hinv : ∀ c : CoarseBond L ell,
      (coeffDc U ell c (droppedBondLast ell c)).comp (Dinv c) = LinearMap.id)
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ∀ c : CoarseBond L ell, lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell (fullC U ell Dinv B) c = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_m.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_mem_ker
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_m.header:
theorem fullC_mem_ker {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (Dinv : CoarseBond L ell → (SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo))
    (hinv : ∀ c : CoarseBond L ell,
      (coeffDc U ell c (droppedBondLast ell c)).comp (Dinv c) = LinearMap.id)
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    fullC U ell Dinv B ∈ LinearMap.ker (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_a.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_axialGauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_a.header:
theorem fullC_axialGauge {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (Dinv : CoarseBond L ell → (SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo)) (B : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hB : ∀ y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y' ∈ CoarseLattice L ell →
      ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y' ell →
      ∀ e ∈ staircasePath y' x, B e = 0) :
    ∀ y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y' ∈ CoarseLattice L ell →
      ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y' ell →
      ∀ e ∈ staircasePath y' x, fullC U ell Dinv B e = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coarseB.header:
theorem coarseBond_base_not_dropped {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)

    (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (μ : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.originS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.originSite_coarse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.originS.header:
theorem originSite_coarse {ell : ℕ} :
    (fun _ => 0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) ∈ CoarseLattice L ell

    (Dinv : CoarseBond L ell → (SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo)) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.dropZer.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.dropZero_single
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.dropZer.header:
theorem dropZero_single (b₀ : Bond L) (w : SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullCLM.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.shift_a.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.shift_apply_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.shift_a.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.dropped.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.droppedBondLast_two

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coeffDc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coeffDc_ell2_op
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coeffDc.header:
theorem coeffDc_ell2_op (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))

    (c : CoarseBond L 2) :
    coeffDc U 2 c (droppedBondLast 2 c) = (1 / 8 : ℝ) • RMap (U (c.1.1, c.2))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.dinvEll.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.dinvEll2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.dinvEll.header:

theorem fullC_ell2_mem_kerQ (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))

    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ∀ c : CoarseBond L 2,

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_ell2_axialGauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_e.header:
theorem fullC_ell2_axialGauge (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))

    ∀ y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y' ∈ CoarseLattice L 2 →
      ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y' 2 →
      ∀ e ∈ staircasePath y' x, fullC U 2 (dinvEll2 U) B e = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullCLM.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullCLM_ell2_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullCLM.header:
theorem fullCLM_ell2_ne_zero (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.pathSit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.pathSite_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.pathSit.header:
theorem pathSite_add (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (a b : ℕ) :
    pathSite (pathSite x μ a) μ b = pathSite x μ (a + b)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coordSt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coordSteps_pathSite_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coordSt.header:
theorem coordSteps_pathSite_self (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : m < L μ + 1) : Q1Real.coordSteps y (pathSite y μ m) μ = m

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coordSt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coordSteps_pathSite_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coordSt.header:
theorem coordSteps_pathSite_ne (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) (h : ν ≠ μ) :
    Q1Real.coordSteps y (pathSite y μ m) ν = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.leg_eq_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.leg_eq_pathSite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.leg_eq_.header:
theorem leg_eq_pathSite (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ d : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) (hm : m < L μ + 1)
    (base : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hb : base d = y d) :
    Q1Real.straightSegment base (pathSite y μ m) d =
      if d = μ then List.replicate m (μ, true) else []

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.gammaPa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.gammaPath_pathSite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.gammaPa.header:
theorem gammaPath_pathSite (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) (hm : m < L μ + 1) :
    Q1Real.GammaPath y (pathSite y μ m) = List.replicate m (μ, true)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.straigh.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.straightSegment_pathSite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.straigh.header:
theorem straightSegment_pathSite (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : i < L μ + 1) :
    Q1Real.straightSegment x (pathSite x μ i) μ = List.replicate i (μ, true)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.transpo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.transportPath_hit
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.transpo.header:
theorem transportPath_hit (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (ell i : ℕ)
    (hi : i < ell) (hle : ell ≤ L μ + 1) :
    transportPath y (pathSite y μ (ell - 1 - i)) μ i = List.replicate (ell - 1) (μ, true)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.pathSit.header:
theorem pathSite_mem_block {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.hit_uni.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.hit_unique
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.hit_uni.header:
theorem hit_unique {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    (hfit : (y μ).val + ell ≤ L μ + 1) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ blockOf y ell)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i < ell) (heq : pathSite x μ i = pathSite y μ (ell - 1)) :
    x = pathSite y μ (ell - 1 - i)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coeffDc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coeffDc_general
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coeffDc.header:
theorem coeffDc_general {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) (v : SuTwo) :
    coeffDc U ell c (droppedBondLast ell c) v
      = (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) • RMap (dropTransport U ell c) v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coeffDc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coeffDc_general_op
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coeffDc.header:

    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.dinvC_h.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.dinvC_hinv
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.dinvC_h.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coeffDc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coeffDc_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coeffDc.header:
theorem coeffDc_ne_zero {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_u.header:
theorem fullC_unconditional_mem_kerQ {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)

    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ∀ c : CoarseBond L ell,

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_u.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_unconditional_axialGauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullC_u.header:
theorem fullC_unconditional_axialGauge {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)

    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hB : ∀ y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y' ∈ CoarseLattice L ell →

    ∀ y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y' ∈ CoarseLattice L ell →

      ∀ e ∈ staircasePath y' x, fullC U ell (dinvC U ell) B e = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullCLM.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullCLM_unconditional_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.fullCLM.header:
theorem fullCLM_unconditional_ne_zero {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)

    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coeffDc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coeffDc_ell2_eq_general
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.coeffDc.header:
theorem coeffDc_ell2_eq_general (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.dinvEll.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.dinvEll2_eq_dinvC

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.freeBon.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.freeBon.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.freeBond_coord_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.freeBon.header:
theorem freeBond_coord_one {ell : ℕ} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)

    ((freeBond ell y).1 1).val = (y 1).val + 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.freeBon.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.freeBond_coord_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.freeBon.header:
theorem freeBond_coord_two {ell : ℕ} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.freeBon.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.freeBon.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.freeBond_not_mem_staircase
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.freeBon.header:
theorem freeBond_not_mem_staircase {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.admissi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.admissibleWitness_at_freeBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.admissi.header:
theorem admissibleWitness_at_freeBond {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.admissi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.admissibleWitness_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.admissi.header:
theorem admissibleWitness_ne_zero {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)

    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.admissi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.admissibleWitness_mem_kerQ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.admissi.header:
theorem admissibleWitness_mem_kerQ {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.admissi.header:
theorem admissibleWitness_mem_ker {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.admissi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.admissibleWitness_axialGauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullReparamC.admissi.header:
theorem admissibleWitness_axialGauge {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.coarse.header: noncomputable def coarseDelta {ell : ℕ} (c : CoarseBond L ell) (v : SuTwo) : CoarseField L ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fineDe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fineDelta
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fineDe.header: noncomputable def fineDelta (b : Bond L) (v : SuTwo) : FineField L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.coarse.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.coarseDelta_same
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.coarse.header: theorem coarseDelta_same {ell : ℕ} (c : CoarseBond L ell) (v : SuTwo) : coarseDelta c v c = v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.coarse.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.coarseDelta_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.coarse.header:
theorem coarseDelta_ne {ell : ℕ} {c c' : CoarseBond L ell} (v : SuTwo) (h : c' ≠ c) :
    coarseDelta c v c' = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fineDe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fineDelta_same
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fineDe.header: theorem fineDelta_same (b : Bond L) (v : SuTwo) : fineDelta b v b = v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fineDe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fineDelta_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fineDe.header: theorem fineDelta_ne {b b' : Bond L} (v : SuTwo) (h : b' ≠ b) : fineDelta b v b' = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.norm_c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.norm_coarseDelta
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.norm_c.header:
theorem norm_coarseDelta {ell : ℕ} (c : CoarseBond L ell) (v : SuTwo) :
    ‖coarseDelta c v‖ = ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.norm_f.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.norm_fineDelta
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.norm_f.header: theorem norm_fineDelta (b : Bond L) (v : SuTwo) : ‖fineDelta b v‖ = ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoLift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.header: noncomputable def suTwoLift (ell : ℕ) (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.lastLa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.lastLayerLift_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.lastLayerLift_neg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.lastLa.header:
theorem lastLayerLift_neg {ell : ℕ} (f : CoarseBond L ell → ℝ) {b : Bond L}
    (h : ¬ (b.1 b.2).val % ell = ell - 1) : lastLayerLift ell f b = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoLift_scalar
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.header:
theorem suTwoLift_scalar (ell : ℕ) (f : CoarseBond L ell → ℝ) (v : SuTwo) (b : Bond L) :
    suTwoLift ell (fun c => f c • v) b = (lastLayerLift ell f b) • v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoLift_factor
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.header:
theorem suTwoLift_factor {ell : ℕ} (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) :
    suTwoLift ell F b =
      (lastLayerLift ell (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) b) •
        F (⟨blockCorner ell b.1, blockCorner_mem b.1⟩, b.2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoLift_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.header:
theorem suTwoLift_add (ell : ℕ) (F G : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) :
    suTwoLift ell (F + G) b = suTwoLift ell F b + suTwoLift ell G b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoLift_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.header:
theorem suTwoLift_smul (ell : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) :
    suTwoLift ell (a • F) b = a • suTwoLift ell F b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoLiftLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.header:
noncomputable def suTwoLiftLM (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) :
    CoarseField L ell →ₗ[ℝ] FineField L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoLiftLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.header:
theorem suTwoLiftLM_apply (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) (F : CoarseField L ell) :
    suTwoLiftLM L ell F = suTwoLift ell F

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoLiftCLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.header:
noncomputable def suTwoLiftCLM (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) :
    CoarseField L ell →L[ℝ] FineField L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoLiftCLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.header:
theorem suTwoLiftCLM_apply (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) (F : CoarseField L ell) :
    suTwoLiftCLM L ell F = suTwoLift ell F

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.cTwoLM.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.cTwoLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.cTwoLM.header:
noncomputable def cTwoLM (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (ell : ℕ) : FineField L →ₗ[ℝ] FineField L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qcLM.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qcLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qcLM.header:
noncomputable def qcLM (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (ell : ℕ) : FineField L →ₗ[ℝ] CoarseField L ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.cTwoCL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.cTwoCLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.cTwoCL.header:
noncomputable def cTwoCLM (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (ell : ℕ) : FineField L →L[ℝ] FineField L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qcCLM.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qcCLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qcCLM.header:
noncomputable def qcCLM (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (ell : ℕ) : FineField L →L[ℝ] CoarseField L ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.cTwoCL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.cTwoCLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.cTwoCL.header:
theorem cTwoCLM_apply (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (ell : ℕ) (B : FineField L) : cTwoCLM U ell B = fullC U ell (dinvC U ell) B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qcCLM_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qcCLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qcCLM_.header:
theorem qcCLM_apply (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (ell : ℕ) (A : FineField L) : qcCLM U ell A = lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.transf.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.transfer_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.transf.header:
theorem transfer_apply (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (ell : ℕ) (F : CoarseField L ell) :
    (cTwoCLM U ell ∘L suTwoLiftCLM L ell) F = fullC U ell (dinvC U ell) (suTwoLift ell F)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.lineIn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.lineIntegralValue_eq_pathSite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.lineIn.header:
theorem lineIntegralValue_eq_pathSite (ell : ℕ) (A : Bond L → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (μ : Fin 3) : lineIntegralValue ell A x μ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, A (pathSite x μ i, μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.blockC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.blockCorner_read_hit
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.blockC.header:
theorem blockCorner_read_hit {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ blockOf y ell) (μ : Fin 3) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < ell)
    (hcond : ((pathSite x μ i) μ).val % ell = ell - 1) :
    blockCorner ell (pathSite x μ i) = y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.lineCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo_suTwoLift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.lineCo.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo_suTwoLift {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L ell) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo ell (suTwoLift ell F) b = F b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qc_com.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qc_comp_suTwoLift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qc_com.header:
theorem qc_comp_suTwoLift {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    qcCLM (trivialU L) ell ∘L suTwoLiftCLM L ell
      = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (CoarseField L ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.restFu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.restFunctional_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.restFu.header:
theorem restFunctional_eq {ell : ℕ}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (c : CoarseBond L ell)
    (b₀ : Bond L) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    restFunctional U ell c b₀ B
      = lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell B c - coeffDc U ell c b₀ (B b₀)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.dropTr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.dropTransport_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.dropTr.header:
theorem dropTransport_trivialU {ell : ℕ} (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    dropTransport (trivialU L) ell c = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.dinvC_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.dinvC_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.dinvC_.header:
theorem dinvC_trivialU {ell : ℕ} (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    dinvC (trivialU L) ell c = ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3) • LinearMap.id

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.coeffD.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.coeffDc_trivialU_dropped
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.coeffD.header:
theorem coeffDc_trivialU_dropped {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    coeffDc (trivialU L) ell c (droppedBondLast ell c)
      = ((1 : ℝ) / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) • LinearMap.id

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.droppe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.droppedBondLast_lastLayer
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.droppe.header:
theorem droppedBondLast_lastLayer {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    ((pathSite c.1.1 c.2 (ell - 1)) c.2).val % ell = ell - 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoLift_droppedBondLast
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.header:
theorem suTwoLift_droppedBondLast {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    suTwoLift ell F (droppedBondLast ell c) = (ell : ℝ) • F c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullC_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullC_suTwoLift_at_dropped
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullC_.header:
theorem fullC_suTwoLift_at_dropped {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    fullC (trivialU L) ell (dinvC (trivialU L) ell) (suTwoLift ell F) (droppedBondLast ell c)
      = (-((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 - (ell : ℝ))) • F c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.dinvC_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.dinvC_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.dinvC_.header:
theorem dinvC_apply {ell : ℕ}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) (v : SuTwo) :
    dinvC U ell c v = ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3) • RMap (dropTransport U ell c)⁻¹ v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.rmap_i.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.rmap_inv_cancel
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.rmap_i.header:
theorem rmap_inv_cancel {ell : ℕ}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) (v : SuTwo) :
    RMap (dropTransport U ell c)⁻¹ (RMap (dropTransport U ell c) v) = v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullC_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullC_suTwoLift_at_dropped_general
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullC_.header:
theorem fullC_suTwoLift_at_dropped_general {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    fullC U ell (dinvC U ell) (suTwoLift ell F) (droppedBondLast ell c)
      = (ell : ℝ) • F c
        - ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3) • RMap (dropTransport U ell c)⁻¹
            (lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell (suTwoLift ell F) c)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullC_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullC_suTwoLift_at_dropped_via_general
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullC_.header:
theorem fullC_suTwoLift_at_dropped_via_general {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    fullC (trivialU L) ell (dinvC (trivialU L) ell) (suTwoLift ell F) (droppedBondLast ell c)
      = (-((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 - (ell : ℝ))) • F c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.transf.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.transfer_value_two_routes_agree
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.transf.header:
theorem transfer_value_two_routes_agree {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    (-((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 - (ell : ℝ))) • F c
      = (ell : ℝ) • F c
        - ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3) • RMap (dropTransport (trivialU L) ell c)⁻¹
            (lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell (suTwoLift ell F) c)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.norm_s.header:
theorem norm_suTwoLift_le {ell : ℕ} (F : CoarseField L ell) (b : Bond L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.ell_le.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.ell_le_cube_sub

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.norm_t.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.norm_transfer_apply_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.norm_t.header:
theorem norm_transfer_apply_le {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (F : CoarseField L ell) :
    ‖(cTwoCLM (trivialU L) ell ∘L suTwoLiftCLM L ell) F‖ ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 - (ell : ℝ)) * ‖F‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.opNorm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.opNorm_transfer_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.opNorm.header:
theorem opNorm_transfer_eq {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    ‖cTwoCLM (trivialU L) ell ∘L suTwoLiftCLM L ell‖ = (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 - (ell : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullyS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullySupplied_false
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullyS.header:
theorem fullySupplied_false {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (Lreal : ℝ) (d : ℕ) (Ccorr α₀ : ℝ)
    (hlt : Lreal ^ ((d : ℝ) - 1) < (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 - (ell : ℝ)) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullyS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullySupplied_false_at_faithful_scale
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullyS.header:
theorem fullySupplied_false_at_faithful_scale {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (Ccorr α₀ : ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullyS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullySupplied_false_at_witness_lattice
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullyS.header:
theorem fullySupplied_false_at_witness_lattice (Ccorr α₀ : ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoLift_injective
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.suTwoL.header:
theorem suTwoLift_injective {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    Function.Injective (suTwoLiftCLM L ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.norm_q.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.norm_qc_apply_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.norm_q.header:
theorem norm_qc_apply_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))

    ‖lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo ell A b‖ ≤ ‖A‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.opNorm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.opNorm_qc_le_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.opNorm.header:
theorem opNorm_qc_le_one {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qc_cla.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qc_clause3
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qc_cla.header:
theorem qc_clause3 {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.one_le.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.one_le_opNorm_cTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.one_le.header:
theorem one_le_opNorm_cTwo {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qc_not.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qc_not_injective
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.qc_not.header:
theorem qc_not_injective {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.transf.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.transfer_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.transf.header:
theorem transfer_ne_zero {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullyS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullySupplied_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.FullySupplied.fullyS.header:
theorem fullySupplied_iff {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.site_eq_of_val_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sit.header:
theorem site_eq_of_val_eq {p q : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (h : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (p μ).val = (q μ).val) : p = q

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.site_eq_of_agree
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sit.header:
theorem site_eq_of_agree {z w : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (μ : Fin 3)
    (hoff : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ν ≠ μ → z ν = w ν) (hval : (z μ).val = (w μ).val) : z = w

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.upd.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.update_eq_of_agree
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.upd.header:
theorem update_eq_of_agree {z w : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (μ : Fin 3)
    (hoff : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ν ≠ μ → z ν = w ν) : Function.update z μ (w μ) = w

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sva.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sval
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sva.header:
theorem sval (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (h : (x μ).val < L μ) :
    ((periodicLatticeShift x μ) μ).val = (x μ).val + 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sap.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sapp_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sap.header:
theorem sapp_ne (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) (h : ν ≠ μ) :
    periodicLatticeShift x μ ν = x ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sva.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sval_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sva.header:
theorem sval_ne (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) (h : ν ≠ μ) :
    ((periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν).val = (x ν).val

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gIn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gInner
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gIn.header:
def gInner (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Bool → Bool → PeriodicLatticeSite L
  | false, false => y
  | false, true  => periodicLatticeShift y 2
  | true,  false => periodicLatticeShift y 1
  | true,  true  => periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift y 2) 1

                                                                                             
         
theorem gInner_true (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (c : Bool) :
    gInner y true c = periodicLatticeShift (gInner y false c) 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gIn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gInner_true
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gIn.header:
theorem gInner_true (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (c : Bool) :
    gInner y true c = periodicLatticeShift (gInner y false c) 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCorner
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCo.header: def gCorner (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : Bool × Bool × Bool) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCorner_false
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCo.header:
theorem gCorner_false (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (b c : Bool) :
    gCorner y (false, b, c) = gInner y b c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCorner_true
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCo.header:
theorem gCorner_true (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (b c : Bool) :
    gCorner y (true, b, c) = periodicLatticeShift (gInner y b c) 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gOf.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gOff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gOf.header: def gOff (p : Bool × Bool × Bool) (μ : Fin 3) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gOf.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gOff_le_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gOf.header: theorem gOff_le_one (p : Bool × Bool × Bool) (μ : Fin 3) : gOff p μ ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gIn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gInner_false_agree
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gIn.header:
theorem gInner_false_agree (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (c : Bool) :
    ∀ ν : Fin 3, ν ≠ 2 → gInner y false c ν = y ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gIn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gInner_agree_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gIn.header:
theorem gInner_agree_one (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (b c : Bool) :
    ∀ ν : Fin 3, ν ≠ 1 → gInner y b c ν = gInner y false c ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCorner_agree_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCo.header:
theorem gCorner_agree_zero (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a b c : Bool) :
    ∀ ν : Fin 3, ν ≠ 0 → gCorner y (a, b, c) ν = gInner y b c ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gIn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gInner_val0
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gIn.header:
theorem gInner_val0 (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (b c : Bool) :
    ((gInner y b c) 0).val = (y 0).val

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gIn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gInner_val1
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gIn.header:
theorem gInner_val1 (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ)
    (b c : Bool) : ((gInner y b c) 1).val = (y 1).val + (if b then 1 else 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gIn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gInner_val2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gIn.header:
theorem gInner_val2 (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ)
    (b c : Bool) : ((gInner y b c) 2).val = (y 2).val + (if c then 1 else 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCorner_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCo.header:
theorem gCorner_val (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ)
    (p : Bool × Bool × Bool) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((gCorner y p) μ).val = (y μ).val + gOff p μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCorner_mem_block
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCo.header:
theorem gCorner_mem_block (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ)
    (p : Bool × Bool × Bool) : gCorner y p ∈ blockOf y 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.blo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.blockOf_two_eq_image
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.blo.header:
theorem blockOf_two_eq_image (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ) :
    blockOf y 2 = Finset.image (gCorner y) (Finset.univ : Finset (Bool × Bool × Bool))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCorner_injOn
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCo.header:
theorem gCorner_injOn (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ) :
    Set.InjOn (gCorner y) ↑(Finset.univ : Finset (Bool × Bool × Bool))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCorner_inj
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gCo.header:
theorem gCorner_inj (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ)
    {p q : Bool × Bool × Bool} (h : gCorner y p = gCorner y q) : p = q

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sum.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sum_block_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sum.header:
theorem sum_block_eq (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ)
    (F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf y 2, F x = ∑ p : Bool × Bool × Bool, F (gCorner y p)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sum.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sum_bool3
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sum.header:
theorem sum_bool3 {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] (G : Bool × Bool × Bool → M) :
    ∑ p : Bool × Bool × Bool, G p =
      G (false, false, false) + G (true, false, false) + G (false, true, false)
        + G (true, true, false) + G (false, false, true) + G (true, false, true)
        + G (false, true, true) + G (true, true, true)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gammaTreeBondsTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.header: def gammaTreeBondsTwo (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Finset (Bond L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gammaTails_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.header:
theorem gammaTails_ne (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ) :
    y ≠ periodicLatticeShift y 2 ∧ y ≠ periodicLatticeShift y 1
      ∧ y ≠ periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift y 2) 1
      ∧ periodicLatticeShift y 2 ≠ periodicLatticeShift y 1
      ∧ periodicLatticeShift y 2 ≠ periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift y 2) 1
      ∧ periodicLatticeShift y 1 ≠ periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift y 2) 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sum.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sum_gammaTreeBondsTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.sum.header:
theorem sum_gammaTreeBondsTwo (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ)
    (H : Bond L → ℝ) :
    ∑ b ∈ gammaTreeBondsTwo y, H b =
      H (y, 2) + H (y, 1) + H (periodicLatticeShift y 2, 1) + H (y, 0)
        + H (periodicLatticeShift y 2, 0) + H (periodicLatticeShift y 1, 0)
        + H (periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift y 2) 1, 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.cor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.corner1_apply_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.cor.header:
theorem corner1_apply_ne (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) (h : ν ≠ 2) :
    corner1 y x ν = y ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.cor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.corner1_gCorner
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.cor.header:
theorem corner1_gCorner (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ)
    (p : Bool × Bool × Bool) :
    corner1 y (gCorner y p) = gInner y false p.2.2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.cor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.corner2_gCorner
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.cor.header:
theorem corner2_gCorner (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ)
    (p : Bool × Bool × Bool) :
    corner2 y (gCorner y p) = gInner y p.2.1 p.2.2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.min.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.min_max_gCorner
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.min.header:
theorem min_max_gCorner (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ)
    (p : Bool × Bool × Bool) (μ : Fin 3) :
    min (y μ).val ((gCorner y p) μ).val = (y μ).val
      ∧ max (y μ).val ((gCorner y p) μ).val = (y μ).val + gOff p μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gammaTreeBondsTwo_eq_biUnion_staircasePath
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.header:
theorem gammaTreeBondsTwo_eq_biUnion_staircasePath
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ) :
    gammaTreeBondsTwo y = (blockOf y 2).biUnion (staircasePath y)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gammaTransport
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.header:
noncomputable def gammaTransport
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Bool × Bool × Bool → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ
  | (false, false, false) => 1
  | (false, false, true)  => U (y, 2)
  | (false, true,  false) => U (y, 1)
  | (true,  false, false) => U (y, 0)
  | (false, true,  true)  => U (y, 2) * U (periodicLatticeShift y 2, 1)
  | (true,  false, true)  => U (y, 2) * U (periodicLatticeShift y 2, 0)
  | (true,  true,  false) => U (y, 1) * U (periodicLatticeShift y 1, 0)
  | (true,  true,  true)  =>
      U (y, 2) * U (periodicLatticeShift y 2, 1)
        * U (periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift y 2) 1, 0)

                                                                                                
noncomputable def gammaM
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (p : Bool × Bool × Bool) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gammaM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.header:
noncomputable def gammaM
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (p : Bool × Bool × Bool) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gammaM_root
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.header:
theorem gammaM_root (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    gammaM U lam y (false, false, false) = lam y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.nor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.norm_gammaM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.nor.header:
theorem norm_gammaM (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (p : Bool × Bool × Bool) : ‖gammaM U lam y p‖ = ‖lam (gCorner y p)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.step_y2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.ste.header:
theorem step_y2 : ‖gammaM U lam y (false, false, true) - gammaM U lam y (false, false, false)‖
    = ‖gradValueCovariant U lam (y, 2)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.step_y1
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.ste.header:
theorem step_y1 : ‖gammaM U lam y (false, true, false) - gammaM U lam y (false, false, false)‖
    = ‖gradValueCovariant U lam (y, 1)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.step_y0
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.ste.header:
theorem step_y0 : ‖gammaM U lam y (true, false, false) - gammaM U lam y (false, false, false)‖
    = ‖gradValueCovariant U lam (y, 0)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.step_s2_1
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.ste.header:
theorem step_s2_1 : ‖gammaM U lam y (false, true, true) - gammaM U lam y (false, false, true)‖
    = ‖gradValueCovariant U lam (periodicLatticeShift y 2, 1)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.step_s2_0
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.ste.header:
theorem step_s2_0 : ‖gammaM U lam y (true, false, true) - gammaM U lam y (false, false, true)‖
    = ‖gradValueCovariant U lam (periodicLatticeShift y 2, 0)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.step_s1_0
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.ste.header:
theorem step_s1_0 : ‖gammaM U lam y (true, true, false) - gammaM U lam y (false, true, false)‖
    = ‖gradValueCovariant U lam (periodicLatticeShift y 1, 0)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.step_s12_0
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.ste.header:
theorem step_s12_0 : ‖gammaM U lam y (true, true, true) - gammaM U lam y (false, true, true)‖
    = ‖gradValueCovariant U lam (periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift y 2) 1, 0)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gamma_block_poincare
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.header:
theorem gamma_block_poincare
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ)
    (hmean : ∑ p : Bool × Bool × Bool, gammaM U lam y p = 0) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf y 2, ‖lam x‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 8 * ∑ b ∈ gammaTreeBondsTwo y, ‖gradValueCovariant U lam b‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gammaTreeBondsTwo_tail_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.header:
theorem gammaTreeBondsTwo_tail_mem (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2) :
    ∀ b ∈ gammaTreeBondsTwo y, b.1 ∈ blockOf y 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gammaTreeBondsTwo_pairwiseDisjoint
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.header:
theorem gammaTreeBondsTwo_pairwiseDisjoint (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    ((CoarseLattice L 2 : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) :
        Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)).PairwiseDisjoint gammaTreeBondsTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gamma_poincare_assembly
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.header:
theorem gamma_poincare_assembly
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hmean : ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2, ∑ p : Bool × Bool × Bool, gammaM U lam y p = 0) :
    siteEnergy lam ≤ 8 * bondEnergy (gradValueCovariant U lam)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.hla.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.hlam_at_kappa_sq_768_gamma
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.hla.header:
theorem hlam_at_kappa_sq_768_gamma
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam src dstarA : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hmean : ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2, ∑ p : Bool × Bool × Bool, gammaM U lam y p = 0)
    (hweak : bondEnergy (gradValueCovariant U lam)
      = AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.covSiteInner lam src)
    (hadj : ∀ w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo,
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.covSiteInner w dstarA
        = AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHj.covBondInner (gradValueCovariant U w) A)
    (hproj : siteEnergy src ≤ siteEnergy dstarA) :
    siteEnergy lam ≤ 768 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.Qpr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.QprimeTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.Qpr.header:
noncomputable def QprimeTwo
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    (PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] (PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.Qpr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.QprimeTwo_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.Qpr.header:
theorem QprimeTwo_apply
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    QprimeTwo U lam y = ∑ p : Bool × Bool × Bool, gammaM U lam y p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gamma_poincare_assembly_of_mem_ker
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gam.header:
theorem gamma_poincare_assembly_of_mem_ker
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hker : lam ∈ LinearMap.ker (QprimeTwo U)) :
    siteEnergy lam ≤ 8 * bondEnergy (gradValueCovariant U lam)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gau.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gaugeParam_mem_ker_QprimeTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.gau.header:
theorem gaugeParam_mem_ker_QprimeTwo
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (Δ M G R : (PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] (PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo))
    (hM : ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo, QprimeTwo U x = 0 → M x = 0)
    (hG : ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo, G ((Δ + M) x) = x)
    (hR : LinearMap.range R = Submodule.map Δ (LinearMap.ker (QprimeTwo U)))
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    G (R f) ∈ LinearMap.ker (QprimeTwo U) ∧ Δ (G (R f)) = R f

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.poi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.poincare_for_gaugeParam
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.poi.header:
theorem poincare_for_gaugeParam
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (Δ M G R : (PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] (PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo))
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hM : ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo, QprimeTwo U x = 0 → M x = 0)
    (hG : ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo, G ((Δ + M) x) = x)
    (hR : LinearMap.range R = Submodule.map Δ (LinearMap.ker (QprimeTwo U)))
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    siteEnergy (G (R f)) ≤ 8 * bondEnergy (gradValueCovariant U (G (R f)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.kap.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.kappa_bound_and_criterion_closes
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaContourTree.kap.header:
theorem kappa_bound_and_criterion_closes
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam src dstarA : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hmean : ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2, ∑ p : Bool × Bool × Bool, gammaM U lam y p = 0)
    (hweak : bondEnergy (gradValueCovariant U lam)
      = AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.covSiteInner lam src)
    (hadj : ∀ w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo,
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.covSiteInner w dstarA
        = AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHj.covBondInner (gradValueCovariant U w) A)
    (hproj : siteEnergy src ≤ siteEnergy dstarA) :
    siteEnergy lam ≤ 768 * bondEnergy A
      ∧ AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaRecursion.UniformStepGamma
          (KappaBound.deltaPiConstLocal (24 * (4 / 10 ^ 10 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt 768)) (1/2 : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaRecursion.bridg.header:
theorem bridge_step_abstract {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {K : Type*}
    [SeminormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℝ K] [Nontrivial K]
    (Delta DeltaPi P : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L) (W : BondFnL2 L → Prop)
    (Q : BondFnL2 L → K) (Qstar : K → BondFnL2 L)
    (G : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L) (T S : K →L[ℝ] K) (a γ δ q : ℝ)
    (hadj : ∀ (x : BondFnL2 L) (B : K),
      (inner ℝ (Qstar B) x : ℝ) = (inner ℝ B (Q x) : ℝ))
    (hDeltaSym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L,
      (inner ℝ u (Delta v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (Delta u) v : ℝ))
    (hPiSym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L,
      (inner ℝ u (DeltaPi v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (DeltaPi u) v : ℝ))
    (hpi : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, |(inner ℝ x (DeltaPi x) : ℝ)| ≤ δ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hPpos : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, (0 : ℝ) ≤ (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ))
    (hPsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L, (inner ℝ u (P v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (P u) v : ℝ))
    (hGW : ∀ B : K, W (G (Qstar B)))
    (hT : ∀ B : K, T B = Q (G (Qstar B)))
    (hG1 : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L,
      fineMapOf (piExtendedMap Delta DeltaPi) P Q Qstar a (G x) = x)
    (hTS : ∀ B : K, T (S B) = B)
    (hγδ : 0 < γ - δ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hDeltaCoercW : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, W x → γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (Delta x) : ℝ))
    (hQ : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, ‖Q x‖ ≤ q * ‖x‖) :
    CoerciveOn (coarse156 S a) ((γ - δ) / q ^ 2)

    (hG1 : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L,
      fineMapOf (piExtendedMap Delta DeltaPi) P Q Qstar a (G x) = x)
    (hTS : ∀ B : BondFnL2 L, T (S B) = B)

    divDrift U A y =
      ∑ μ : Fin 3, (RMap (U (periodicLatticeShiftBack y μ, μ))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GeneralUHodgeDrift.n.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GeneralUHodgeDrift.norm_divDrift_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GeneralUHodgeDrift.n.header:

    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L, RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α) :
    ‖divDrift U A y‖
      ≤ 2 * α * ∑ μ : Fin 3, ‖A (periodicLatticeShiftBack y μ, μ)‖

    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L, RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α) :
    ‖divDrift U A y‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 12 * α ^ 2 * ∑ μ : Fin 3, ‖A (periodicLatticeShiftBack y μ, μ)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GeneralUHodgeDrift.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GeneralUHodgeDrift.siteEnergy_divDrift_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GeneralUHodgeDrift.s.header:
theorem siteEnergy_divDrift_le
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L, RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α) :
    siteEnergy (divDrift U A) ≤ 12 * α ^ 2 * bondEnergy A

GeomScratch.geom_from_perc.name: GeomScratch.geom_from_perc
GeomScratch.geom_from_perc.header:
theorem geom_from_perc {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (B : Bond L → ℝ)
    (hPerC : ∀ c : CoarseBond L ell,
      (1 / 3) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) * topFaceEnergy B c.1.1 ell c.2
        ≤ (ell : ℝ) * (lineCoarseRestrict ell B c) ^ 2
          + (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * regionCurlEnergy B c.1.1 ell c.2
          + (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * boundaryCorr B c.1.1 ell c.2)
    (hF1 : bondNormSq B - inBlockBondEnergy ell B
        ≤ ∑ c : CoarseBond L ell, topFaceEnergy B c.1.1 ell c.2)
    (hF2 : ∑ c : CoarseBond L ell, boundaryCorr B c.1.1 ell c.2
        ≤ 6 * inBlockBondEnergy ell B) :
    (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergy ell B + (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * slabCurlEnergy ell B
      ≥ (1 / 3) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) * (bondNormSq B - inBlockBondEnergy ell B)
        - 6 * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * inBlockBondEnergy ell B

GeomScratch.inBlockBondEnergy_eq_sum.name: GeomScratch.inBlockBondEnergy_eq_sum

GeomScratch.shift_notMem_iff_top.name: GeomScratch.shift_notMem_iff_top
GeomScratch.shift_notMem_iff_top.header:

GeomScratch.bondsBasedIn_split.name: GeomScratch.bondsBasedIn_split
GeomScratch.bondsBasedIn_split.header:
theorem bondsBasedIn_split {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < L μ + 1)

GeomScratch.sum_topFace_eq_Sbet.name: GeomScratch.sum_topFace_eq_Sbet
GeomScratch.sum_topFace_eq_Sbet.header:
theorem sum_topFace_eq_Sbet {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)

GeomScratch.sum_topFace_ge_Sbet.name: GeomScratch.sum_topFace_ge_Sbet
GeomScratch.sum_topFace_ge_Sbet.header:
theorem sum_topFace_ge_Sbet {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)

GeomScratch.lemma24_from_perC.header:
theorem lemma24_from_perC {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.HjMinimizer.hjExtens.header:

    (h1 : lineCoarseRestrictCLM L ell A0 = B) (h2 : RProj levels ((gradCLM L).adjoint A0) = 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.HjMinimizer.hjExtens.header:

    (d : Fin 3) (q0 : (refSite L hL i 0).val = (x 0).val) (q1 : (refSite L hL i 1).val = (x 1).val)

HrefBlk.blkBond_mem.header:
theorem blkBond_mem (hL : ∀ μ, 4 ≤ L μ) (j : Fin 80) (d : Fin 3)
    (hd : freeDir j = d)
    (hv0 : (refSite L hL j 0).val = 0 ∨ (refSite L hL j 0).val = 1)
    (hv1 : (refSite L hL j 1).val = 0 ∨ (refSite L hL j 1).val = 1)
    (hv2 : (refSite L hL j 2).val = 0 ∨ (refSite L hL j 2).val = 1)
    (hdz : (refSite L hL j d).val = 0)
    (hnp : ¬ EnergyEval.pinnedInBlock0 (freeCellBond L hL j)) :
    bondInBlock (0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) 2 (freeCellBond L hL j)
      ∧ ¬ EnergyEval.pinnedInBlock0 (freeCellBond L hL j)

HrefBlk.filter_eq_image.name: HrefBlk.filter_eq_image
HrefBlk.filter_eq_image.header:
theorem filter_eq_image (hL : ∀ μ, 4 ≤ L μ) :
    (bondsInBlock (0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) 2).filter (fun b => ¬ EnergyEval.pinnedInBlock0 b)
      = Finset.image (freeCellBond L hL) blkIds

HrefBlk.blk_total_freecoord.name: HrefBlk.blk_total_freecoord
HrefBlk.blk_total_freecoord.header:
theorem blk_total_freecoord (hL : ∀ μ, 4 ≤ L μ) (C : Bond L → ℝ)
    (hC : C ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L 2) :
    (∑ b ∈ bondsInBlock (0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) 2, (C b) ^ 2)
      = ∑ i ∈ blkIds, (freecoord L hL C i) ^ 2

HrefQSlab.lineIntegralValue_two.name: HrefQSlab.lineIntegralValue_two
HrefQSlab.lineIntegralValue_two.header:
theorem lineIntegralValue_two (C : Bond L → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    lineIntegralValue 2 C x μ = C (x, μ) + C (periodicLatticeShift x μ, μ)

HrefQSlab.prevSite0_fits.header:
theorem prevSite0_fits (hL : ∀ μ, 4 ≤ L μ) :

HrefQSlab.shift0_coord_ne.name: HrefQSlab.shift0_coord_ne
HrefQSlab.shift0_coord_ne.header:

HrefQSlab.fin3_two.header: theorem fin3_two {μ : Fin 3} (h0 : μ ≠ 0) (h1 : μ ≠ 1) : μ = 2

HrefQSlab.pinOrig0.header:

HrefQSlab.freeIdent0.name: HrefQSlab.freeIdent0
HrefQSlab.freeIdent0.header:
theorem freeIdent0 (hL : ∀ μ, 4 ≤ L μ) (C : Bond L → ℝ) (idx : Fin 80) (s : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (q0 : (refSite L hL idx 0).val = (s 0).val) (q1 : (refSite L hL idx 1).val = (s 1).val)
    (q2 : (refSite L hL idx 2).val = (s 2).val) (hd : freeDir idx = 0) :
    C (s, (0 : Fin 3)) = C (freeCellBond L hL idx)

HrefQSlab.siteFn_inj.name: HrefQSlab.siteFn_inj
HrefQSlab.siteFn_inj.header:
theorem siteFn_inj (hL : ∀ μ, 4 ≤ L μ) :
    ∀ f ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3 → Fin 2)), ∀ g ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3 → Fin 2)),
      (fun μ : Fin 3 => (⟨((prevSite (0:Fin 3) : PeriodicLatticeSite L) μ).val + (f μ).val, by
        have := (f μ).isLt; have := prevSite0_fits hL μ; omega⟩ : Fin (L μ + 1)))
      = (fun μ : Fin 3 => (⟨((prevSite (0:Fin 3) : PeriodicLatticeSite L) μ).val + (g μ).val, by
        have := (g μ).isLt; have := prevSite0_fits hL μ; omega⟩ : Fin (L μ + 1))) → f = g

HrefQSlab.line0_blocksum.name: HrefQSlab.line0_blocksum
HrefQSlab.line0_blocksum.header:
theorem line0_blocksum (hL : ∀ μ, 4 ≤ L μ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1)) (C : Bond L → ℝ)
    (hC : C ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L 2) :
    (∑ x ∈ blockOf (prevSite (0 : Fin 3) : PeriodicLatticeSite L) 2, lineIntegralValue 2 C x 0)
      = 2 * (C (freeCellBond L hL 64) + C (freeCellBond L hL 67)
             + C (freeCellBond L hL 71) + C (freeCellBond L hL 74))

HrefQSlab.line_reindex0.name: HrefQSlab.line_reindex0
HrefQSlab.line_reindex0.header:
theorem line_reindex0 (hL : ∀ μ, 4 ≤ L μ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1)) (C : Bond L → ℝ)
    (hC : C ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L 2) :
    lineCoarseRestrict 2 C (⟨prevSite 0, prevSite_mem 0 hdvd⟩, 0)
      = (1 / 8) * (freecoord L hL C 64 + freecoord L hL C 67
                   + freecoord L hL C 71 + freecoord L hL C 74)

HrefQSlab.prevSite_fits.name: HrefQSlab.prevSite_fits
HrefQSlab.prevSite_fits.header:
theorem prevSite_fits (hL : ∀ μ, 4 ≤ L μ) (κ : Fin 3) :

HrefQSlab.shift1_coord_ne.name: HrefQSlab.shift1_coord_ne
HrefQSlab.shift1_coord_ne.header:

HrefQSlab.siteFn_inj_mu.header:

    ∀ f ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3 → Fin 2)), ∀ g ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3 → Fin 2)),
      (fun ν : Fin 3 => (⟨((prevSite κ : PeriodicLatticeSite L) ν).val + (f ν).val, by
        have := (f ν).isLt; have := prevSite_fits hL κ ν; omega⟩ : Fin (L ν + 1)))
      = (fun ν : Fin 3 => (⟨((prevSite κ : PeriodicLatticeSite L) ν).val + (g ν).val, by
        have := (g ν).isLt; have := prevSite_fits hL κ ν; omega⟩ : Fin (L ν + 1))) → f = g

HrefQSlab.pinDir2.name: HrefQSlab.pinDir2
HrefQSlab.pinDir2.header:
theorem pinDir2 (hL : ∀ μ, 4 ≤ L μ) (C : Bond L → ℝ) (hC : C ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L 2)

HrefQSlab.pinPrev1.name: HrefQSlab.pinPrev1
HrefQSlab.pinPrev1.header:
