    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    Bond L → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.j.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.jointJ_def
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.j.header:
theorem jointJ_def (etaInvSq : ℝ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (b : Bond L) :
    jointJ etaInvSq U b = (etaInvSq : ℂ) •
      (AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.imHolonomy U (jointPl L b 0)
        - AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.imHolonomy U (jointPl L b 1)
        + AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.imHolonomy U (jointPl L b 2)
        - AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.imHolonomy U (jointPl L b 3))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.t.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.trivialU_fix
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.t.header: theorem trivialU_fix (v : SuTwo) (b : Bond L) : RMap ((trivialU L) b) v = v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.j.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.joint_instantiation_flat
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.j.header:
theorem joint_instantiation_flat :
    gammaAgg * bondEnergy (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen)
        ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected (trivialU witL5) (altMode rotGen)
          + pAx (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen) (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2
      ∧ gammaFibre * bondSup (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen)
        ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected (trivialU witL5) (altMode rotGen)
          + pAx (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen) (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2
      ∧ |deltaPrimePiForm (trivialU witL5) (jointJ 1 (trivialU witL5))
            (altSite ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • rotGen)) (altMode rotGen)|
        ≤ deltaPiConst (24 * 1 * (25 / 10 ^ 14 : ℝ)) kappaTree
            * bondEnergy (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen)
      ∧ ∀ k : ℕ,
          0 < AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaRecursion.gammaSeq gammaAgg
                (deltaPiConst (24 * 1 * (25 / 10 ^ 14 : ℝ)) kappaTree) (1 / 2 : ℝ) k
            ∧ gammaAgg
              ≤ AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaRecursion.gammaSeq gammaAgg
                  (deltaPiConst (24 * 1 * (25 / 10 ^ 14 : ℝ)) kappaTree) (1 / 2 : ℝ) k

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.curvedAggU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.c.header:
noncomputable abbrev curvedAggU :
    PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) witL5

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.curvedAggU_curved
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.c.header:
theorem curvedAggU_curved :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.holonomyElem curvedAggU curvedPlaq
      ≠ (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.curvedFamilyU_fix_rotGen
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.c.header:
theorem curvedFamilyU_fix_rotGen (t : ℝ) (b : Bond witL5) :
    RMap (curvedFamilyU t b) rotGen = rotGen

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.curved_criterion_closes
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.c.header:
theorem curved_criterion_closes :
    deltaPiConst (24 * 1 * curvedAggAlpha) kappaTree
      ≤ gammaAggCurved curvedAggAlpha * (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.g.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.gammaAggCurved_upper
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.g.header:
theorem gammaAggCurved_upper (α₀ : ℝ) (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) :
    gammaAggCurved α₀ ≤ 1 / (2 * 3316224)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.curved_criterion_fails_at_thirteen
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.c.header:
theorem curved_criterion_fails_at_thirteen :
    ¬ (deltaPiConst (24 * 1 * (13 / 10 ^ 14 : ℝ)) kappaTree
        ≤ gammaAggCurved (13 / 10 ^ 14 : ℝ) * (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.j.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.joint_instantiation_curved
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.j.header:
theorem joint_instantiation_curved :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.holonomyElem curvedAggU curvedPlaq
        ≠ (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
      ∧ 0 < gammaAggCurved curvedAggAlpha
      ∧ gammaAggCurved curvedAggAlpha * bondEnergy (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen)
        ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected curvedAggU (altMode rotGen)
          + pAx (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen) (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2
      ∧ gammaFibre * bondSup (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen)
        ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected (trivialU witL5) (altMode rotGen)
          + pAx (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen) (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2
      ∧ |deltaPrimePiForm curvedAggU (jointJ 1 curvedAggU)
            (altSite ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • rotGen)) (altMode rotGen)|
        ≤ deltaPiConst (24 * 1 * curvedAggAlpha) kappaTree
            * bondEnergy (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen)
      ∧ ∀ k : ℕ,
          0 < AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaRecursion.gammaSeq (gammaAggCurved curvedAggAlpha)
                (deltaPiConst (24 * 1 * curvedAggAlpha) kappaTree) (1 / 2 : ℝ) k
            ∧ gammaAggCurved curvedAggAlpha
              ≤ AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaRecursion.gammaSeq (gammaAggCurved curvedAggAlpha)
                  (deltaPiConst (24 * 1 * curvedAggAlpha) kappaTree) (1 / 2 : ℝ) k

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.h.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.hproj_fails_at_unit_ratio
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.h.header:
theorem hproj_fails_at_unit_ratio (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {w : SuTwo}
    (hUw : ∀ b : Bond L, RMap (U b) w = w) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    ¬ (siteEnergy (gradCovariantAdjointValue U (gradValueCovariant U (altSite ((1 : ℝ) • w))))
        ≤ siteEnergy (gradCovariantAdjointValue U (altMode w)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.j.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.joint_config_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.j.header:
theorem joint_config_nonvacuous :
    0 < gammaAgg * bondEnergy (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen)
      ∧ 0 < deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected (trivialU witL5) (altMode rotGen)
          + pAx (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen) (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2
      ∧ 0 < bondSup (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen)
      ∧ altSite ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • rotGen) (zeroSite witL5) = (1 / 4 : ℝ) • rotGen

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.j.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.jointJ_trivialU_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.j.header:
theorem jointJ_trivialU_eq_zero (etaInvSq : ℝ) (b : Bond L) :
    jointJ etaInvSq (trivialU L) b = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.i.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.iComm_collinear
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.i.header: theorem iComm_collinear (a b : ℝ) (w : SuTwo) : iComm (a • w) (b • w) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.a.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.altMode_eq_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.a.header:
theorem altMode_eq_smul (w : SuTwo) (b : Bond L) :
    altMode w b = (if b.2 = 0 then par b.1 else (0 : ℝ)) • w

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.p.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.piBondValue_eq_zero_at_config
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.p.header:
theorem piBondValue_eq_zero_at_config (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {w : SuTwo}
    (hUw : ∀ b : Bond L, RMap (U b) w = w) (c : ℝ) (b : Bond L) :
    piBondValue U (altSite (c • w)) (altMode w) b = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.d.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.deltaPrimePiForm_eq_zero_at_config
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.d.header:
theorem deltaPrimePiForm_eq_zero_at_config (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {w : SuTwo}
    (hUw : ∀ b : Bond L, RMap (U b) w = w) (c : ℝ)
    (J : Bond L → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    deltaPrimePiForm U J (altSite (c • w)) (altMode w) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.clause_three_is_trivial_at_both
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.c.header:
theorem clause_three_is_trivial_at_both :
    deltaPrimePiForm (trivialU witL5) (jointJ 1 (trivialU witL5))
        (altSite ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • rotGen)) (altMode rotGen) = 0
      ∧ deltaPrimePiForm curvedAggU (jointJ 1 curvedAggU)
        (altSite ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • rotGen)) (altMode rotGen) = 0
      ∧ ∀ b : Bond witL5, jointJ 1 (trivialU witL5) b = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.R.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.RMap_periodicPathHolonomy_fix
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.R.header:
theorem RMap_periodicPathHolonomy_fix
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {v : SuTwo}
    (hUv : ∀ b : Bond L, RMap (U b) v = v) :
    ∀ (steps : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
      RMap (periodicPathHolonomy U x steps) v = v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.r.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.rZeroA_of_line
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.r.header:
theorem rZeroA_of_line
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {v : SuTwo}
    (hUv : ∀ b : Bond L, RMap (U b) v = v) (coef : Bond L → ℝ) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hA : ∀ b : Bond L, A b = coef b • v)
    (cMinus x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.rZeroA U cMinus x A μ ell
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, A (AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite x μ i, μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.l.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.lineCoarseRestrictCov_eq_flat_of_line
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.l.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCov_eq_flat_of_line
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {v : SuTwo}
    (hUv : ∀ b : Bond L, RMap (U b) v = v) (coef : Bond L → ℝ) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hA : ∀ b : Bond L, A b = coef b • v) (ell : ℕ)
    (b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.CoarseBond L ell) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell A b = lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell A b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.a.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.altMode_Q_covariant
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.a.header:
theorem altMode_Q_covariant (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {w : SuTwo}
    (hUw : ∀ b : Bond L, RMap (U b) w = w)
    (b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.CoarseBond L 2) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov U 2 (altMode w) b = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.curved_config_Q_covariant
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.c.header:
theorem curved_config_Q_covariant
    (b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.CoarseBond witL5 2) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov curvedAggU 2 (altMode rotGen) b = 0
      ∧ lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU witL5) 2 (altMode rotGen) b = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.j.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.joint_instantiation_flat_general
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.j.header:
theorem joint_instantiation_flat_general (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    gammaAgg * bondEnergy (altMode (L := L) rotGen)
        ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected (trivialU L) (altMode rotGen)
          + pAx (altMode (L := L) rotGen) (CoarseLattice L 2) 2
      ∧ gammaFibre * bondSup (altMode (L := L) rotGen)
        ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected (trivialU L) (altMode rotGen)
          + pAx (altMode (L := L) rotGen) (CoarseLattice L 2) 2
      ∧ |deltaPrimePiForm (trivialU L) (jointJ 1 (trivialU L))
            (altSite ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • rotGen)) (altMode rotGen)|
        ≤ deltaPiConst (24 * 1 * (25 / 10 ^ 14 : ℝ)) kappaTree
            * bondEnergy (altMode (L := L) rotGen)
      ∧ ∀ k : ℕ,
          0 < AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaRecursion.gammaSeq gammaAgg
                (deltaPiConst (24 * 1 * (25 / 10 ^ 14 : ℝ)) kappaTree) (1 / 2 : ℝ) k
            ∧ gammaAgg
              ≤ AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaRecursion.gammaSeq gammaAgg
                  (deltaPiConst (24 * 1 * (25 / 10 ^ 14 : ℝ)) kappaTree) (1 / 2 : ℝ) k

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.j.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.joint_instantiation_two_extents
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.j.header:
theorem joint_instantiation_two_extents :
    (gammaAgg * bondEnergy (altMode (L := witL3) rotGen)
        ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected (trivialU witL3) (altMode rotGen)
          + pAx (altMode (L := witL3) rotGen) (CoarseLattice witL3 2) 2)
      ∧ (gammaAgg * bondEnergy (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen)
        ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected (trivialU witL5) (altMode rotGen)
          + pAx (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen) (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2)
      ∧ Fintype.card (Bond witL3) ≠ Fintype.card (Bond witL5)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.j.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.joint_instantiation_curved_with_covariant_Q
AdalyFormal.Balaban.JointInstantiation.j.header:
theorem joint_instantiation_curved_with_covariant_Q :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.holonomyElem curvedAggU curvedPlaq
        ≠ (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
      ∧ (∀ b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.CoarseBond witL5 2,
          lineCoarseRestrictCov curvedAggU 2 (altMode rotGen) b = 0
            ∧ lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU witL5) 2 (altMode rotGen) b = 0)
      ∧ 0 < gammaAggCurved curvedAggAlpha
      ∧ gammaAggCurved curvedAggAlpha * bondEnergy (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen)
        ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected curvedAggU (altMode rotGen)
          + pAx (altMode (L := witL5) rotGen) (CoarseLattice witL5 2) 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.gaugePara.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.gaugeParam_mem_ker_and_solves
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.gaugePara.header:
theorem gaugeParam_mem_ker_and_solves
    (Q : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (Δ M G R : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)
    (hM : ∀ x : E, Q x = 0 → M x = 0)
    (hG : ∀ x : E, G ((Δ + M) x) = x)
    (hR : LinearMap.range R = Submodule.map Δ (LinearMap.ker Q))
    (f : E) :
    Q (G (R f)) = 0 ∧ Δ (G (R f)) = R f

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.ctrlQ_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.header: theorem ctrlQ_apply (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ctrlQ p = p.1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.ctrlD_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.header: theorem ctrlD_apply (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ctrlD p = (p.2, 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.ctrlM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.header: theorem ctrlM_apply (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ctrlM p = p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.ctrlG_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.header: theorem ctrlG_apply (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ctrlG p = (p.1 - p.2, p.2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.ctrlR_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.header: theorem ctrlR_apply (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ctrlR p = (p.1, 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.ctrl_hG
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.header: theorem ctrl_hG : ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ, ctrlG ((ctrlD + ctrlM) x) = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.ctrl_hR_pointwise
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.header:
theorem ctrl_hR_pointwise (f : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ctrlQ ((0, f.1) : ℝ × ℝ) = 0 ∧ ctrlD ((0, f.1) : ℝ × ℝ) = ctrlR f

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.ctrl_hM_fails
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.header: theorem ctrl_hM_fails : ctrlQ ((0, 1) : ℝ × ℝ) = 0 ∧ ctrlM ((0, 1) : ℝ × ℝ) ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.ctrl_hR_needed
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.Control.c.header:
theorem ctrl_hR_needed :
    (∀ x : ℝ, x = 0 → (0 : ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) x = 0)
      ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, (LinearMap.id : ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
            (((LinearMap.id : ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) + (0 : ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) x) = x)
      ∧ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.id : ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
          ≠ Submodule.map (LinearMap.id : ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.id : ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ))
      ∧ (LinearMap.id : ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.norm_appl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.norm_apply_le_of_selfadjoint_idempotent
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.norm_appl.header:
theorem norm_apply_le_of_selfadjoint_idempotent
    (R : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) (hidem : ∀ x : E, R (R x) = R x)
    (hsa : ∀ x y : E, (inner ℝ (R x) y : ℝ) = (inner ℝ x (R y) : ℝ)) (v : E) :
    ‖R v‖ ≤ ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.contracti.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.contraction_needs_idempotent
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.contracti.header:
theorem contraction_needs_idempotent (v : E) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    ‖((2 : ℝ) • (LinearMap.id : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)) v‖ > ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.transport.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.transport_step_norm_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.transport.header:
theorem transport_step_norm_eq
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)
    (g : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ‖RMap (g * U (x, μ)) (lam (periodicLatticeShift x μ)) - RMap g (lam x)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.transport.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.transport_step_flat_differs
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.transport.header:
theorem transport_step_flat_differs :

        suTwoWitness‖
      ≠ ‖RMap (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) suTwoWitness
        - RMap (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) suTwoWitness‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.norm_add3.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.norm_add3_sq_le_three
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.norm_add3.header:
theorem norm_add3_sq_le_three (a b c : E) :
    ‖a + b + c‖ ^ 2 ≤ 3 * (‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2 + ‖c‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.abs_hsInn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.abs_hsInner_le'
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.abs_hsInn.header: theorem abs_hsInner_le' (a b : SuTwo) : |hsInner a b| ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖b‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.covSiteIn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.covSiteInner_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.covSiteIn.header:
theorem covSiteInner_self (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    covSiteInner f f = siteEnergy f

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.covSiteIn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.covSiteInner_sq_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.covSiteIn.header:
theorem covSiteInner_sq_le (f g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    covSiteInner f g ^ 2 ≤ siteEnergy f * siteEnergy g

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.covBondIn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.covBondInner_sq_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.covBondIn.header:
theorem covBondInner_sq_le (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.sum_tail_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.sum_tail_sq_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.sum_tail_.header:
theorem sum_tail_sq_eq (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ‖lam b.1‖ ^ 2 = 3 * siteEnergy lam

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.sum_head_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.sum_head_sq_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.sum_head_.header:
theorem sum_head_sq_eq (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ‖lam (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)‖ ^ 2 = 3 * siteEnergy lam

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.bondEnerg.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.bondEnergy_grad_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.bondEnerg.header:
theorem bondEnergy_grad_le
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    bondEnergy (gradValueCovariant U lam) ≤ 12 * siteEnergy lam

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.siteEnerg.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.siteEnergy_le_of_adjoint
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.siteEnerg.header:
theorem siteEnergy_le_of_adjoint
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (S : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hadj : ∀ w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo,
      covSiteInner w S = covBondInner (gradValueCovariant U w) A) :
    siteEnergy S ≤ 12 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.siteEnerg.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.siteEnergy_le_of_poincare
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.siteEnerg.header:
theorem siteEnergy_le_of_poincare
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam src : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (Psq rsq : ℝ)
    (hrsq : 0 ≤ rsq)
    (hweak : bondEnergy (gradValueCovariant U lam) = covSiteInner lam src)
    (hPoin : siteEnergy lam ≤ Psq * bondEnergy (gradValueCovariant U lam))
    (hsrc : siteEnergy src ≤ rsq * bondEnergy A) :
    siteEnergy lam ≤ rsq * Psq ^ 2 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.hlam_at_k.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.hlam_at_kappa_sq_768
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.hlam_at_k.header:
theorem hlam_at_kappa_sq_768
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam src dstarA : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hweak : bondEnergy (gradValueCovariant U lam) = covSiteInner lam src)
    (hPoin : siteEnergy lam ≤ 8 * bondEnergy (gradValueCovariant U lam))
    (hadj : ∀ w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo,
      covSiteInner w dstarA = covBondInner (gradValueCovariant U w) A)
    (hproj : siteEnergy src ≤ siteEnergy dstarA) :
    siteEnergy lam ≤ 768 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.deltaPiCo.header: noncomputable def deltaPiConstLocal (Jsup kappa : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.univ_eq_b.header:
theorem univ_eq_biUnion_blocks (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.siteEnerg.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.siteEnergy_eq_sum_blocks
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.siteEnerg.header:
theorem siteEnergy_eq_sum_blocks (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell)

    siteEnergy lam = ∑ y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell, ∑ x ∈ blockOf y ell, ‖lam x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.sum_treeB.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.sum_treeBonds_le_bondEnergy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.sum_treeB.header:
theorem sum_treeBonds_le_bondEnergy (G : Bond L → SuTwo) (ell : ℕ)
    (tb : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Finset (Bond L))
    (hdisj : ((CoarseLattice L ell : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) :
        Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)).PairwiseDisjoint tb) :
    ∑ y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell, ∑ b ∈ tb y, ‖G b‖ ^ 2 ≤ bondEnergy G

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.poincare_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.poincare_assembly
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.poincare_.header:
theorem poincare_assembly
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (G : Bond L → SuTwo) (ell : ℕ)
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (tb : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Finset (Bond L))
    (hdisj : ((CoarseLattice L ell : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) :
        Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)).PairwiseDisjoint tb)
    (hblock : ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell,
        ∑ x ∈ blockOf y ell, ‖lam x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 8 * ∑ b ∈ tb y, ‖G b‖ ^ 2) :
    siteEnergy lam ≤ 8 * bondEnergy G

AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.poincare_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.poincare_assembly_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.KappaBound.poincare_.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LastLayerNoGo.kernel.header:

        v ∈ Anchoring.anchoredVInter (Lat := Lat) ell ∧ rgDelta (Lat := Lat) n v = 0) ↔
      (∃ b₁ b₂ : Bond Lat, b₁ ≠ b₂ ∧
        blockRepBond (Lat := Lat) n b₁ = blockRepBond (Lat := Lat) n b₂ ∧
        ¬ OnSomeStaircase Lat ell b₁ ∧ ¬ OnSomeStaircase Lat ell b₂)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LastLayerNoGo.ctrlDe.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeFourier.dft_c.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.crud.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.crude_const_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.crud.header:
theorem crude_const_le (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ 3) :
    (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1) / 2 ≤ (n : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.xsec.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.xsec_poincare_smallL
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.xsec.header:
theorem xsec_poincare_smallL (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ 3) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    var2 n f ≤ (n : ℝ) * gradEnergy2 n f

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.cros.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.cross_section_2127_smallL
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.cros.header:
theorem cross_section_2127_smallL (n : ℕ) (hn1 : 1 ≤ n) (hn3 : n ≤ 3) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    gradEnergy2 n f / (n : ℝ) ^ 3 + (sum2 n f / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ 2 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2
      ≥ sumSq2 n f / (n : ℝ) ^ 4

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.slab.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.slab_assembly_scalar
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.slab.header:
theorem slab_assembly_scalar (ell : ℝ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell)
    (Q P Ptot Pslab Sin Sbet : ℝ)
    (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (_hP : 0 ≤ P) (_hPtot : 0 ≤ Ptot) (_hPslab : 0 ≤ Pslab)
    (hSin : 0 ≤ Sin) (_hSbet : 0 ≤ Sbet)
    (hSummed : ell * Q + Pslab / ell ^ 2
        ≥ (1 / 3) * (1 / ell ^ 3) * Sbet - 6 * (1 / ell ^ 2) * Sin)
    (hRegion : Sin ≤ 3 * ell ^ 3 * Ptot)
    (hPtotLeP : Ptot ≤ P)
    (hPslabLeP : Pslab ≤ ell ^ 2 * P) :
    ell * Q + P ≥ (1 / 108) * (1 / ell ^ 4) * (Sin + Sbet)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.lemm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.lemma24_from_slab_hyps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.lemm.header:
theorem lemma24_from_slab_hyps {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ}
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict0 : ell < L 0 + 1) (hstrict1 : ell < L 1 + 1) (hstrict2 : ell < L 2 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell)
    (Pslab Sbet : ℝ) (hPslab : 0 ≤ Pslab) (hSbet : 0 ≤ Sbet)
                                                                                      
    (hSummed : (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergy ell B + Pslab / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2
        ≥ (1 / 3) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) * Sbet
          - 6 * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * inBlockBondEnergy ell B)
                                     
    (hPtotLeP : inBlockCurlEnergy ell B ≤ totalCurlEnergy B)
                                           
    (hPslabLeP : Pslab ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * totalCurlEnergy B)
                                        
    (hNorm : bondNormSq B = inBlockBondEnergy ell B + Sbet) :
    (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergy ell B + totalCurlEnergy B
      ≥ (1 / 108) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * bondNormSq B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.lemm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.lemma24_from_slab_hyps'
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.lemm.header:
theorem lemma24_from_slab_hyps' {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ}
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict0 : ell < L 0 + 1) (hstrict1 : ell < L 1 + 1) (hstrict2 : ell < L 2 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell)
    (Pslab Sbet : ℝ) (hPslab : 0 ≤ Pslab) (hSbet : 0 ≤ Sbet)
    (hSummed : (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergy ell B + Pslab / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2
        ≥ (1 / 3) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) * Sbet
          - 6 * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * inBlockBondEnergy ell B)
    (hPtotLeP : inBlockCurlEnergy ell B ≤ totalCurlEnergy B)
    (hPslabLeP : Pslab ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * totalCurlEnergy B)
    (hNorm : bondNormSq B = inBlockBondEnergy ell B + Sbet) :
    Lemma24Conclusion ell B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.sum_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.sum_inBlock_le_univ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.sum_.header:
theorem sum_inBlock_le_univ {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {ell : ℕ} (baseSite : ι → PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (S : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Finset ι)
    (hS : ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (i : ι), i ∈ S y → baseSite i ∈ blockOf y ell)
    (g : ι → ℝ) (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ g i) :
    ∑ y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell, ∑ i ∈ S y, g i ≤ ∑ i : ι, g i

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.inBl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.inBlockCurl_le_total
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.inBl.header:
theorem inBlockCurl_le_total {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (B : Bond L → ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.inBl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.inBlockBond_le_norm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.inBl.header:
theorem inBlockBond_le_norm {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (B : Bond L → ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.lemm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.lemma24_from_star
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.lemm.header:
theorem lemma24_from_star {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ}
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict0 : ell < L 0 + 1) (hstrict1 : ell < L 1 + 1) (hstrict2 : ell < L 2 + 1)
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell)
    (hStar : (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergy ell B + totalCurlEnergy B
        ≥ (1 / 3) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) * (bondNormSq B - inBlockBondEnergy ell B)
          - 6 * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * inBlockBondEnergy ell B) :
    Lemma24Conclusion ell B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.slab.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.slab_incidence_card
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.slab.header:
theorem slab_incidence_card {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ}
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.star.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.star_from_geom
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.star.header:
theorem star_from_geom {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ}
    (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (B : Bond L → ℝ)
    (hGeom : (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergy ell B + (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * slabCurlEnergy ell B
        ≥ (1 / 3) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) * (bondNormSq B - inBlockBondEnergy ell B)
          - 6 * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * inBlockBondEnergy ell B) :
    (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergy ell B + totalCurlEnergy B
        ≥ (1 / 3) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) * (bondNormSq B - inBlockBondEnergy ell B)
          - 6 * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * inBlockBondEnergy ell B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.lemm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.lemma24_from_geom
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24Assembly.lemm.header:
theorem lemma24_from_geom {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.faceSite_val_mu
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.header:
theorem faceSite_val_mu (hell : 0 < ell) (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1) (i j : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.faceSite_val_nu1
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.header:
theorem faceSite_val_nu1 (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < ell) (j : ℕ) :
    ((faceSite y ell μ i j) (nu1 μ)).val = (y (nu1 μ)).val + i

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.header:
theorem faceSite_val_nu2 (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1) (i : ℕ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < ell) :
    ((faceSite y ell μ i j) (nu2 μ)).val = (y (nu2 μ)).val + j

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.faceSite_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.header:
theorem faceSite_mem (hell : 0 < ell) (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1)
    {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < ell) (hj : j < ell) :
    faceSite y ell μ i j ∈ crossSectionTop y ell μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.face_sum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.header:
theorem face_sum (hell : 0 < ell) (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ∑ x ∈ crossSectionTop y ell μ, g x
      = ∑ i ∈ range ell, ∑ j ∈ range ell, g (faceSite y ell μ i j)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.faceSite_succ_nu1
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.header:
theorem faceSite_succ_nu1 (i j : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.faceField_sumSq2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.faceField_sum2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.header:
theorem faceField_sum2 (hell : 0 < ell) (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.face_poincare
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.header:
theorem face_poincare (hell : 0 < ell) (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1) (B : Bond L → ℝ) :
    topFaceEnergy B y ell μ
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * gradEnergy2 ell (faceField B y ell μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.faceSite_injOn
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.header:
theorem faceSite_injOn (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.gr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.grid_sq_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.gr.header:
theorem grid_sq_le {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) (Φ : ℕ → ℕ → ι)
    (S : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => Φ p.1 p.2) (s : Set (ℕ × ℕ)))
    (hsub : ∀ p ∈ s, Φ p.1 p.2 ∈ S) :
    ∑ p ∈ s, (f (Φ p.1 p.2)) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ b ∈ S, (f b) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.faceShift_val_mu
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.faceShiftBond_nu1_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.header:
theorem faceShiftBond_nu1_mem (hell : 0 < ell) (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.faceShiftBond_nu2_mem

      ∈ bondsInBlock (coarseShift y ell μ) ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.re.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.regionCurl_split
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.re.header:
theorem regionCurl_split (B : Bond L → ℝ) :
    regionCurlEnergy B y ell μ
      = (∑ x ∈ crossSectionTop y ell μ, (xsecCurl B x μ (nu1 μ)) ^ 2)
        + ∑ x ∈ crossSectionTop y ell μ, (xsecCurl B x μ (nu2 μ)) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.pr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.prod_sub
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.pr.header:
theorem prod_sub (hell : 0 < ell) :
    (range (ell - 1) ×ˢ range ell : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) ⊆ range ell ×ˢ range ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.pr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.prod_sub'
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.pr.header:
theorem prod_sub' (hell : 0 < ell) :
    (range ell ×ˢ range (ell - 1) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) ⊆ range ell ×ˢ range ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.su.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.subgrid_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.su.header:
theorem subgrid_le (hell : 0 < ell) (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1)
    (s : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) (hs : s ⊆ range ell ×ˢ range ell) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ∑ p ∈ s, (g (faceSite y ell μ p.1 p.2)) ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ x ∈ crossSectionTop y ell μ, (g x) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.face_2124
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.header:
theorem face_2124 (hell : 0 < ell) (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1) (B : Bond L → ℝ) :
    gradEnergy2 ell (faceField B y ell μ)
      ≤ 3 * regionCurlEnergy B y ell μ + 6 * boundaryCorr B y ell μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.blkSite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.header: def blkSite (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i j k : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.faceSite_eq_blkSite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.fa.header:
theorem faceSite_eq_blkSite (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (i j : ℕ) :
    faceSite y ell μ i j = blkSite y μ i j (ell - 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.coarseShift_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.co.header:
theorem coarseShift_add (W : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a b : ℕ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift (coarseShift W a ν) b ν = coarseShift W (a + b) ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.coarseShift_comm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.co.header:
theorem coarseShift_comm (W : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a b : ℕ) {ν ρ : Fin 3} (h : ν ≠ ρ) :
    coarseShift (coarseShift W a ν) b ρ = coarseShift (coarseShift W b ρ) a ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.blkSite_shift_mu
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.header:
theorem blkSite_shift_mu (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i j k m : ℕ) :
    coarseShift (blkSite y μ i j k) m μ = blkSite y μ i j (k + m)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.blkSite_next
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.header:
theorem blkSite_next (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (ell i j t : ℕ) :
    blkSite y μ i j (ell + t) = blkSite (coarseShift y ell μ) μ i j t

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.blkSite_val_nu1
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.header:
theorem blkSite_val_nu1 (hfit : ∀ ν, (z ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < ell) (j k : ℕ) :
    ((blkSite z μ i j k) (nu1 μ)).val = (z (nu1 μ)).val + i

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.blkSite_val_nu2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.header:
theorem blkSite_val_nu2 (hfit : ∀ ν, (z ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1) (i : ℕ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < ell)
    (k : ℕ) : ((blkSite z μ i j k) (nu2 μ)).val = (z (nu2 μ)).val + j

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.blkSite_val_mu
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.header:
theorem blkSite_val_mu (hfit : ∀ ν, (z ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1) (i j : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < ell) :
    ((blkSite z μ i j k) μ).val = (z μ).val + k

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.blkSite_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.header:
theorem blkSite_mem (hfit : ∀ ν, (z ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1)
    {i j k : ℕ} (hi : i < ell) (hj : j < ell) (hk : k < ell) :
    blkSite z μ i j k ∈ blockOf z ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.lo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.longBond_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.lo.header:
theorem longBond_mem (hfit : ∀ ν, (z ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1)
    {i j r : ℕ} (hi : i < ell) (hj : j < ell) (hr : r + 1 < ell) :
    (blkSite z μ i j r, μ) ∈ bondsInBlock z ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.blkSite_injOn3
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.header:
theorem blkSite_injOn3 (hfit : ∀ ν, (z ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1) :
    Set.InjOn (fun q : (ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ => blkSite z μ q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2)
      ((((range ell ×ˢ range ell) ×ˢ range ell : Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ))) : Set ((ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.in.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.inj_sq_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.in.header:
theorem inj_sq_le {ι κ : Type*} [DecidableEq κ] (s : Finset ι) (Φ : ι → κ) (S : Finset κ)
    (f : κ → ℝ) (hinj : Set.InjOn Φ (s : Set ι)) (hsub : ∀ a ∈ s, Φ a ∈ S) :
    ∑ a ∈ s, (f (Φ a)) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ b ∈ S, (f b) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.lo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.long_sum_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.lo.header:
theorem long_sum_le (hell : 0 < ell) (hfit : ∀ ν, (z ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1) (B : Bond L → ℝ) :
    ∑ q ∈ (range ell ×ˢ range ell) ×ˢ range (ell - 1),
        (B (blkSite z μ q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2, μ)) ^ 2
      ≤ blockBondEnergy B z ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.blkSite_base_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.header:
theorem blkSite_base_mem (hell : 0 < ell) (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1)
    {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < ell) (hj : j < ell) :
    blkSite y μ i j 0 ∈ crossSectionBase y ell μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.ba.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.base_sum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.ba.header:
theorem base_sum (hell : 0 < ell) (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ∑ x ∈ crossSectionBase y ell μ, g x
      = ∑ i ∈ range ell, ∑ j ∈ range ell, g (blkSite y μ i j 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.block_sum3
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bl.header:
theorem block_sum3 (hell : 0 < ell) (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf y ell, g x
      = ∑ i ∈ range ell, ∑ j ∈ range ell, ∑ k ∈ range ell, g (blkSite y μ i j k)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.of.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.offIdx_card_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.of.header: theorem offIdx_card_le (ell : ℕ) : ((offIdx ell).card : ℝ) ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.of.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.offR_split
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.of.header:
theorem offR_split (hell : 0 < ell) :
    offR ell = range (ell - 1) ∪ Finset.Ico ell (2 * ell - 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.of.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.offR_disj
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.of.header:
theorem offR_disj (hell : 0 < ell) :
    Disjoint (range (ell - 1)) (Finset.Ico ell (2 * ell - 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.sh.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.shift_slice_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.sh.header:
theorem shift_slice_le (hell : 0 < ell) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < ell) (h : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hnn : ∀ r, 0 ≤ h r) :
    ∑ m ∈ (range ell).filter (fun m => ¬ (k + m = ell - 1)), h (k + m)
      ≤ ∑ r ∈ offR ell, h r

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.of.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.offSum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.of.header: noncomputable def offSum (B : Bond L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.Q_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.Q_decomp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.Q_.header:
theorem Q_decomp (hell : 0 < ell) (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1)
    (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (B : Bond L → ℝ) :
    lineCoarseRestrict ell B (⟨y, hy⟩, μ)
      = (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) * faceSumLong B y ell μ
        + (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * offSum B y ell μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.of.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.offSum_energy_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.of.header:
theorem offSum_energy_le (hell : 0 < ell) (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1)
    (hfit' : ∀ ν, ((coarseShift y ell μ) ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1) (B : Bond L → ℝ) :
    ∑ q ∈ (range ell ×ˢ range ell) ×ˢ offIdx ell,
        (B (blkSite y μ q.1.1 q.1.2 (q.2.1 + q.2.2), μ)) ^ 2
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * boundaryCorr B y ell μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.boundaryCorr_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.bo.header:
theorem boundaryCorr_nonneg (B : Bond L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    0 ≤ boundaryCorr B y ell μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.cs.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.cs_2125
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.cs.header:
theorem cs_2125 (hell : 0 < ell) (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1)
    (hfit' : ∀ ν, ((coarseShift y ell μ) ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1)
    (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (B : Bond L → ℝ) :
    (1 / 3) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) * (faceSumLong B y ell μ) ^ 2
      - (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * boundaryCorr B y ell μ
    ≤ (ell : ℝ) * (lineCoarseRestrict ell B (⟨y, hy⟩, μ)) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.pe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.perC_bond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.pe.header:
theorem perC_bond (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    (1 / 3) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * topFaceEnergy B c.1.1 ell c.2
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * (lineCoarseRestrict ell B c) ^ 2
        + (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * regionCurlEnergy B c.1.1 ell c.2
        + 3 * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * boundaryCorr B c.1.1 ell c.2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.Le.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.Lemma24ConclusionCorrected
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.Le.header: noncomputable def Lemma24ConclusionCorrected (ell : ℕ) (B : Bond L → ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.corrected_of_lemma24
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.co.header:
theorem corrected_of_lemma24 (hell : 0 < ell) (B : Bond L → ℝ)
    (h : Lemma24Conclusion ell B) : Lemma24ConclusionCorrected ell B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.le.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.lemma24_general_ell
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.le.header:
theorem lemma24_general_ell (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (B : Bond L → ℝ) (hB : B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter L ell) :
    Lemma24ConclusionCorrected ell B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.wi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.witL3_strict
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.wi.header: theorem witL3_strict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, (3 : ℕ) < witL3 ν + 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.wi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.witL3_dvd
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.wi.header: theorem witL3_dvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, (3 : ℕ) ∣ (witL3 ν + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.le.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.lemma24_general_ell_nonvacuous_ell3
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Lemma24GeneralEll.le.header:
theorem lemma24_general_ell_nonvacuous_ell3 :
    (0 : ℝ) < (1 / 180) * (1 / ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 5) * bondNormSq (generalWrapConfig witL3)
    ∧ (1 / 180) * (1 / ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 5) * bondNormSq (generalWrapConfig witL3)
        ≤ ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * coarseQEnergy 3 (generalWrapConfig witL3)
          + totalCurlEnergy (generalWrapConfig witL3)
    ∧ (0 : ℝ) < ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * coarseQEnergy 3 (generalWrapConfig witL3)
        + totalCurlEnergy (generalWrapConfig witL3)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.displa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.displacement_witnessMElem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.displa.header:
theorem displacement_witnessMElem :
    ‖RMap witnessMElem suTwoWitness - suTwoWitness‖ = isRegularCeil

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.su_coe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.su_coe_mul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.su_coe.header:
theorem su_coe_mul (g h : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    ((g * h : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
      = (g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) * (h : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq_conjTranspose
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.header: theorem frobSq_conjTranspose (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : frobSq Mᴴ = frobSq M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq_neg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.header: theorem frobSq_neg (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : frobSq (-M) = frobSq M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.header:
theorem frobSq_smul (c : ℂ) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    frobSq (c • M) = Complex.normSq c * frobSq M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq_add_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.header:
theorem frobSq_add_le (A B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    frobSq (A + B) ≤ 2 * frobSq A + 2 * frobSq B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq_mul_left_isometry
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.header:
theorem frobSq_mul_left_isometry (W M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hW : Wᴴ * W = 1) :
    frobSq (W * M) = frobSq M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobNo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobNorm_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobNo.header: theorem frobNorm_eq (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : frobNorm M = Real.sqrt (frobSq M)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobNo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobNorm_mul_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobNo.header:
theorem frobNorm_mul_le (A B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    frobNorm (A * B) ≤ frobNorm A * frobNorm B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobNo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobNorm_sub_le_sqrt_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobNo.header:
theorem frobNorm_sub_le_sqrt_two (A B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    frobNorm (A - B) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * (frobNorm A + frobNorm B)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.normSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.normSq_trace_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.normSq.header:
theorem normSq_trace_le (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    Complex.normSq (Matrix.trace M) ≤ 2 * frobSq M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.abs_re.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.abs_re_trace_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.abs_re.header:
theorem abs_re_trace_le (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    |(Matrix.trace M).re| ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.abs_im.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.abs_im_trace_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.abs_im.header:
theorem abs_im_trace_le (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    |(Matrix.trace M).im| ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq_coe_suTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.header: theorem frobSq_coe_suTwo (X : SuTwo) : frobSq (X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) = 2 * ‖X‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobNo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobNorm_coe_suTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobNo.header:
theorem frobNorm_coe_suTwo (X : SuTwo) :
    frobNorm (X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) = Real.sqrt 2 * ‖X‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq_inv_sub_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.header:
theorem frobSq_inv_sub_one (g : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    frobSq (((g⁻¹ : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
      = frobSq ((g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq_mul_sub_one_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.header:
theorem frobSq_mul_sub_one_le (g h : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    frobSq (((g * h : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
      ≤ 2 * frobSq ((g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
        + 2 * frobSq ((h : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq_holonomy_sub_one_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.header:
theorem frobSq_holonomy_sub_one_le
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L, frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    frobSq ((holonomyElem U p : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ 32 * α ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.shift_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.shift_comm_local
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.shift_.header:
theorem shift_comm_local (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hne : μ ≠ ν) :
    periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν
      = periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x ν) μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.holono.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.holonomyElem_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.holono.header:
theorem holonomyElem_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    holonomyElem (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) p
      = γ p.1 * holonomyElem U p * (γ p.1)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq_holonomy_gauge_invariant
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.header:
theorem frobSq_holonomy_gauge_invariant (γ : GaugeFn L)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    frobSq ((holonomyElem (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) p : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
      = frobSq ((holonomyElem U p : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq_holonomy_of_gaugeRegular
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.frobSq.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.abs_im.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.abs_im_trace_comm_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.abs_im.header:
theorem abs_im_trace_comm_le (X Y M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    |(Matrix.trace ((X * Y - Y * X) * M)).im|
      ≤ 4 * frobNorm X * frobNorm Y * frobNorm M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.abs_im.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.abs_im_trace_commSum_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.abs_im.header:
theorem abs_im_trace_commSum_le (a1 a2 a3 a4 M S : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hS : S = (a1 * a2 - a2 * a1) + (a1 * a3 - a3 * a1) + (a1 * a4 - a4 * a1)
      + (a2 * a3 - a3 * a2) + (a2 * a4 - a4 * a2) + (a3 * a4 - a4 * a3)) :
    |(Matrix.trace (S * M)).im|
      ≤ 4 * frobNorm M * (frobNorm a1 * frobNorm a2 + frobNorm a1 * frobNorm a3
          + frobNorm a1 * frobNorm a4 + frobNorm a2 * frobNorm a3 + frobNorm a2 * frobNorm a4
          + frobNorm a3 * frobNorm a4)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.deltaK.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.deltaK_gaugeRegular_coercive
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.deltaK.header:
theorem deltaK_gaugeRegular_coercive
    (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ L μ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hreg : GaugeRegular assemblyAlpha U) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hadm : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2 →
      ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y 2 → ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, A b = 0)
    (hkerU : ∀ b : CoarseBond L 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov U 2 A b = 0) :
    assemblyGamma * bondEnergy A ≤ deltaKQuadFormCorrected U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.deltaK.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.deltaK_lemma_existential_threshold
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.deltaK.header:
theorem deltaK_lemma_existential_threshold
    (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ L μ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    ∃ γ₀ : ℝ, 0 < γ₀ ∧ ∃ thr : ℝ, 0 < thr ∧
      ∀ U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L,
        GaugeRegular thr U →
        ∀ A : Bond L → SuTwo,
          (∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2 →
            ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y 2 → ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, A b = 0) →
          (∀ b : CoarseBond L 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov U 2 A b = 0) →
          γ₀ * bondEnergy A ≤ deltaKQuadFormCorrected U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.assemb.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.assembled_lemma_via_reparam
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssembly.assemb.header:
theorem assembled_lemma_via_reparam
    {Btilde : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Btilde] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Btilde]
    (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ L μ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (Cf : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L →
      (Btilde →L[ℝ] AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantOperators.BondFnL2 L))
    (Kc : ℝ) (hKc : 0 < Kc)
    (hlow : ∀ U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L,
      GaugeRegular assemblyAlpha U → ∀ Bt : Btilde,
        ‖Bt‖ ^ 2 ≤ Kc * bondEnergy (AdalyFormal.Balaban.BondSU2Space.bondFnL2Equiv L (Cf U Bt)))
    (hax : ∀ U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L,
      GaugeRegular assemblyAlpha U → ∀ Bt : Btilde,
        ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2 →
          ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y 2 → ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x,
            AdalyFormal.Balaban.BondSU2Space.bondFnL2Equiv L (Cf U Bt) b = 0)
    (hker : ∀ U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L,
      GaugeRegular assemblyAlpha U → ∀ Bt : Btilde,
        ∀ b : CoarseBond L 2,
          lineCoarseRestrictCov U 2
            (AdalyFormal.Balaban.BondSU2Space.bondFnL2Equiv L (Cf U Bt)) b = 0) :
    ∃ γ₀ : ℝ, 0 < γ₀ ∧
      ∀ U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L,
        GaugeRegular assemblyAlpha U → ∀ Bt : Btilde,
          γ₀ * ‖Bt‖ ^ 2 ≤ deltaKQuadFormCorrected U
            (AdalyFormal.Balaban.BondSU2Space.bondFnL2Equiv L (Cf U Bt))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LemmaAssemblyNormali.header:
theorem assembled_normalized_lemma_via_reparam
    {Btilde : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Btilde] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Btilde]
    (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ L μ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (Cf : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L →
      (Btilde →L[ℝ] AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantOperators.BondFnL2 L))
    (Kc : ℝ) (hKc : 0 < Kc)
    (hlow : ∀ U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L,
      GaugeRegular normAlpha U → ∀ Bt : Btilde,
        ‖Bt‖ ^ 2 ≤ Kc * bondEnergy (AdalyFormal.Balaban.BondSU2Space.bondFnL2Equiv L (Cf U Bt)))
    (hax : ∀ U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L,
      GaugeRegular normAlpha U → ∀ Bt : Btilde,
        ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2 →
          ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y 2 → ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x,
            AdalyFormal.Balaban.BondSU2Space.bondFnL2Equiv L (Cf U Bt) b = 0)
    (hker : ∀ U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L,
      GaugeRegular normAlpha U → ∀ Bt : Btilde,
        ∀ b : CoarseBond L 2,
          lineCoarseRestrictCov U 2
            (AdalyFormal.Balaban.BondSU2Space.bondFnL2Equiv L (Cf U Bt)) b = 0) :
    ∃ γ₀ : ℝ, 0 < γ₀ ∧
      ∀ U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L,
        GaugeRegular normAlpha U → ∀ Bt : Btilde,
          γ₀ * ‖Bt‖ ^ 2 ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected U
            (AdalyFormal.Balaban.BondSU2Space.bondFnL2Equiv L (Cf U Bt))

    LatticeOperators.coarseRestrict witnessEll (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralAveragin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralAveraging.lineCoarseRestrictLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralAveragin.header:
noncomputable def lineCoarseRestrictLM (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralAveragin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralAveraging.lineCoarseRestrictLMH
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralAveragin.header:
noncomputable def lineCoarseRestrictLMH (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralAveragin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralAveraging.lineCoarseRestrictCLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralAveragin.header:
noncomputable def lineCoarseRestrictCLM (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) :
    BondSpace L →L[ℝ] CoarseBondSpace L ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralAveragin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralAveraging.lineCoarseRestrictCLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralAveragin.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCLM_apply (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) (A : BondSpace L) :
    coarseBondEquiv L ell (lineCoarseRestrictCLM L ell A) =
      lineCoarseRestrict ell (bondEquiv L A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCov
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCov_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCov_add {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A1 A2 : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L ell) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell (A1 + A2) b =
      lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell A1 b + lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell A2 b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCov_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCov_smul {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L ell) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell (c • A) b = c • lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell A b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCovLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCovLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCovLM_apply {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L ell) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A b = lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell A b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.header:
noncomputable def lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell : ℕ)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L ell) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCov_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCov_trivialU {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell : ℕ) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (b : CoarseBond L ell) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell A b = lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo ell A b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo_smul_fixed
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo_smul_fixed {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell : ℕ)
    (f : Bond L → ℝ) (v : SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L ell) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo ell (fun e => f e • v) b = (lineCoarseRestrict ell f b) • v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCov_const_witness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCov_const_witness (v : SuTwo) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU witnessL) witnessEll (fun _ => v)
        (⟨witnessY, witnessY_coarse⟩, 0) = v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.coarseRestrictCovariant_const_witness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.header:
theorem coarseRestrictCovariant_const_witness (v : SuTwo) :
    coarseRestrictCovariant witnessEll (fun _ => v) (⟨witnessY, witnessY_coarse⟩, 0) =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) • v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.faithful_ne_convicted_on_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.header:
theorem faithful_ne_convicted_on_const :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU witnessL) witnessEll (fun _ => suTwoWitness)
        (⟨witnessY, witnessY_coarse⟩, 0) ≠
      coarseRestrictCovariant witnessEll (fun _ => suTwoWitness)
        (⟨witnessY, witnessY_coarse⟩, 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCov_witnessL_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCov_witnessL_eq
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) witnessL) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : Bond witnessL → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond witnessL ell) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell A b = (1 / (ell : ℝ)) • q1RealMain U ell A b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCov_genuinely_U_dependent
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCov_genuinely_U_dependent :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU witnessL) witnessEll d4ConfigSuTwo targetCoarseBond ≠
      lineCoarseRestrictCov witnessU witnessEll d4ConfigSuTwo targetCoarseBond

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCov_d4_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCov_d4_trivialU :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU witnessL) witnessEll d4ConfigSuTwo targetCoarseBond =
      (1 / 8 : ℝ) • suTwoWitness

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCov_d4_witnessU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCov_d4_witnessU :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov witnessU witnessEll d4ConfigSuTwo targetCoarseBond =
      -((1 / 8 : ℝ) • suTwoWitness)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.sum_gradCovariant_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.header:
theorem sum_gradCovariant_trivialU {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell : ℕ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, gradValueCovariant (trivialU L) lam (pathSite x μ i, μ) =
      lam (pathSite x μ ell) - lam x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCov_gradCovariant_trivialU_intertwines
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovarian.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCov_gradCovariant_trivialU_intertwines {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {μ : Fin 3} (hdvd : ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell (gradValueCovariant (trivialU L) lam) (⟨y, hy⟩, μ) =
      (1 / (ell : ℝ)) •
        (coarseRestrictSiteCovariant ell lam (coarseShift y ell μ) -
          coarseRestrictSiteCovariant ell lam y)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.fibre.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.fibre
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.fibre.header: def fibre (S : Set E) (Q : E → F) (B : F) : Set E

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.mem_fibre.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.mem_fibre
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.mem_fibre.header:
theorem mem_fibre {S : Set E} {Q : E → F} {B : F} {A : E} :
    A ∈ fibre S Q B ↔ A ∈ S ∧ Q A = B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.schur.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.schur
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.schur.header: noncomputable def schur (q : E → ℝ) (S : Set E) (Q : E → F) (B : F) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.bddBelow_ima.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.bddBelow_image_of_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.bddBelow_ima.header:
theorem bddBelow_image_of_nonneg {q : E → ℝ} {S : Set E} {Q : E → F} (B : F)
    (hq : ∀ A ∈ S, 0 ≤ q A) : BddBelow (q '' fibre S Q B)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.total_of_sch.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.total_of_schur
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.total_of_sch.header:
theorem total_of_schur {q : E → ℝ} {S : Set E} {Q : E → F} {n : F → ℝ} {γ : ℝ} {𝒜 : Set F}
    (hq : ∀ A ∈ S, 0 ≤ q A)
    (h : ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, γ * n B ≤ schur q S Q B) :
    ∀ A ∈ S, Q A ∈ 𝒜 → γ * n (Q A) ≤ q A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.schur_of_tot.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.schur_of_total
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.schur_of_tot.header:
theorem schur_of_total {q : E → ℝ} {S : Set E} {Q : E → F} {n : F → ℝ} {γ : ℝ} {𝒜 : Set F}
    (hsurj : ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, (fibre S Q B).Nonempty)
    (h : ∀ A ∈ S, Q A ∈ 𝒜 → γ * n (Q A) ≤ q A) :
    ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, γ * n B ≤ schur q S Q B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_iff.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_iff.header:
theorem minSwap_iff {q : E → ℝ} {S : Set E} {Q : E → F} {n : F → ℝ} {γ : ℝ} {𝒜 : Set F}
    (hsurj : ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, (fibre S Q B).Nonempty)
    (hq : ∀ A ∈ S, 0 ≤ q A) :
    (∀ B ∈ 𝒜, γ * n B ≤ schur q S Q B)
      ↔ (∀ A ∈ S, Q A ∈ 𝒜 → γ * n (Q A) ≤ q A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_mpr_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_mpr_needs_nonempty
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_mpr_.header:
theorem minSwap_mpr_needs_nonempty :
    (∀ A ∈ ({0} : Set ℝ), (id A) ∈ ({1} : Set ℝ) → (1 : ℝ) * (id A) ^ 2 ≤ A ^ 2) ∧
    ¬ (∀ B ∈ ({1} : Set ℝ), (1 : ℝ) * B ^ 2
        ≤ schur (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) ({0} : Set ℝ) id B)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_mp_n.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_mp_needs_bddBelow
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_mp_n.header:
theorem minSwap_mp_needs_bddBelow :
    (∀ B ∈ ({0} : Set ℝ), (1 : ℝ) * (0 : ℝ)
        ≤ schur id (Set.univ : Set ℝ) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) B) ∧
    ¬ (∀ A ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), (1 : ℝ) * (0 : ℝ) ≤ id A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.fibre_datum_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.fibre_datum_satisfies_total
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.fibre_datum_.header:
theorem fibre_datum_satisfies_total {q : E → ℝ} {Q : E → F} {n : F → ℝ} (γ : ℝ)
    {A : E} [Zero F] (hQ : Q A = 0) (hn : n 0 = 0) (hqA : 0 ≤ q A) :
    γ * n (Q A) ≤ q A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.schur_eq_zer.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.schur_eq_zero_of_zero_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.schur_eq_zer.header:
theorem schur_eq_zero_of_zero_mem {q : E → ℝ} {S : Set E} {Q : E → F} [Zero E] [Zero F]
    (h0 : (0 : E) ∈ S) (hQ0 : Q 0 = 0) (hq0 : q 0 = 0) (hq : ∀ A ∈ S, 0 ≤ q A) :
    schur q S Q 0 = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_iff_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_iff_inner
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_iff_.header:
theorem minSwap_iff_inner {q : E → ℝ} (S : Submodule ℝ E) (Q : E →L[ℝ] F) {γ : ℝ} {𝒜 : Set F}
    (hsurj : ∀ B ∈ 𝒜, (fibre (S : Set E) (fun A => Q A) B).Nonempty)
    (hq : ∀ A ∈ S, 0 ≤ q A) :
    (∀ B ∈ 𝒜, γ * ‖B‖ ^ 2 ≤ schur q (S : Set E) (fun A => Q A) B)
      ↔ (∀ A ∈ S, Q A ∈ 𝒜 → γ * ‖Q A‖ ^ 2 ≤ q A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_nonv.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_nonvacuous_witness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_nonv.header:
theorem minSwap_nonvacuous_witness :
    (∀ B : ℝ, B ∈ fibre (Set.univ : Set ℝ) id B) ∧
    (∀ A ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), (0 : ℝ) ≤ A ^ 2) ∧
    (0 : ℝ) < (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 ∧
    (∀ B ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), (1 : ℝ) * B ^ 2 ≤ schur (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) Set.univ id B) ∧
    (∀ A ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), id A ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) →
      (1 : ℝ) * (id A) ^ 2 ≤ (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.deltaJ_eq_ds.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.deltaJ_eq_dstarDQuadForm_hjExtension
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.deltaJ_eq_ds.header:
theorem deltaJ_eq_dstarDQuadForm_hjExtension {ell : ℕ}
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (A0 : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful ell levels U A0
      = dstarDQuadForm U (hjExtensionCovFaithful ell levels U A0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.deltaJ_ge_of.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.deltaJ_ge_of_total_on_hjInvariant
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.deltaJ_ge_of.header:
theorem deltaJ_ge_of_total_on_hjInvariant {ell : ℕ}
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (C : Set (Bond L → SuTwo)) (n : (CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) → ℝ) (γ : ℝ)
    (hinv : ∀ A ∈ C, hjExtensionCovFaithful ell levels U A ∈ C)
    (htot : ∀ A ∈ C, γ * n (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A) ≤ dstarDQuadForm U A)
    (A0 : Bond L → SuTwo) (hA0 : A0 ∈ C) :
    γ * n (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A0) ≤ deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful ell levels U A0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.slice.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.slice

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.slice_hjExte.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.slice_hjExtension_invariant
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.slice_hjExte.header:
theorem slice_hjExtension_invariant {ell : ℕ}
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (hA : A ∈ slice levels U) :
    hjExtensionCovFaithful ell levels U A ∈ slice levels U

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.unitClause_h.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.unitClause_hjExtension_invariant
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.unitClause_h.header:
theorem unitClause_hjExtension_invariant {ell : ℕ}
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (𝒜 : Set (CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hA : lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A ∈ 𝒜) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell (hjExtensionCovFaithful ell levels U A) ∈ 𝒜

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.sliceOver.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.sliceOver
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.sliceOver.header:
def sliceOver {ell : ℕ} (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (𝒜 : Set (CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo)) : Set (Bond L → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.sliceOver_hj.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.sliceOver_hjExtension_invariant
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.sliceOver_hj.header:
theorem sliceOver_hjExtension_invariant {ell : ℕ}
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (𝒜 : Set (CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (hA : A ∈ sliceOver levels U 𝒜) :
    hjExtensionCovFaithful ell levels U A ∈ sliceOver levels U 𝒜

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_tran.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_transfer
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.minSwap_tran.header:
theorem minSwap_transfer {ell : ℕ}
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (𝒜 : Set (CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo)) (n : (CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) → ℝ) (γ : ℝ)
    (htot : ∀ A, A ∈ slice levels U → lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A ∈ 𝒜 →
      γ * n (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A) ≤ dstarDQuadForm U A)
    (A0 : Bond L → SuTwo) (h1 : A0 ∈ slice levels U)
    (h2 : lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A0 ∈ 𝒜) :
    γ * n (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A0) ≤ deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful ell levels U A0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.loopField_un.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.loopField_unit_shadow_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.loopField_un.header:
theorem loopField_unit_shadow_eq_zero (m : ℕ) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU (WitnessInequality.wExt m)) (WitnessInequality.wEll m)
      (NilLevelTarget.loopField m) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.loopField_sa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.loopField_satisfies_minSwap_total
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.loopField_sa.header:
theorem loopField_satisfies_minSwap_total (m : ℕ) (γ : ℝ)
    (n : (CoarseBond (WitnessInequality.wExt m) (WitnessInequality.wEll m) → SuTwo) → ℝ)
    (hn : n 0 = 0) :
    γ * n (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU (WitnessInequality.wExt m))
        (WitnessInequality.wEll m) (NilLevelTarget.loopField m))
      ≤ dstarDQuadForm (trivialU (WitnessInequality.wExt m)) (NilLevelTarget.loopField m)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.loopField_re.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.loopField_refutes_fine_but_not_unit
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.loopField_re.header:
theorem loopField_refutes_fine_but_not_unit (m : ℕ)
    (n : (CoarseBond (WitnessInequality.wExt m) (WitnessInequality.wEll m) → SuTwo) → ℝ)
    (hn : n 0 = 0) :
    0 < RegularUPerturbation.bondEnergy (NilLevelTarget.loopField m) ∧
    n (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU (WitnessInequality.wExt m)) (WitnessInequality.wEll m)
      (NilLevelTarget.loopField m)) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.constField.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.constField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.constField.header: def constField (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (c : SuTwo) : Bond L → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.curl_constFi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.curl_constField_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.curl_constFi.header:
theorem curl_constField_trivialU (c : SuTwo) :
    curlCovariantLM (trivialU L) (constField L c) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.div_constFie.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.div_constField_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.div_constFie.header:
theorem div_constField_trivialU (c : SuTwo) :
    gradCovariantAdjointLM (trivialU L) (constField L c) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.constField_m.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.constField_mem_slice
AdalyFormal.Balaban.MinSwap.constField_m.header:
theorem constField_mem_slice (c : SuTwo) (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))

    (z z' : PeriodicLatticeSite (wExt m)) (ν ρ : Fin 3) (hρ : ρ ≠ ν)
    (hsame : ∀ σ : Fin 3, σ ≠ ρ → (z σ).val = (z' σ).val)
    (hz : (z ρ).val = 0) (hz' : (z' ρ).val = 1) (K : ℕ) :
    pathSite z ν K ∈ blockOf y (wEll m) ↔ pathSite z' ν K ∈ blockOf y (wEll m)

    (hz : (z ρ).val = 0) (hz' : (z' ρ).val = 1) (v : SuTwo) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU (wExt m)) (wEll m) (Pi.single ((z, ν) : Bond (wExt m)) v) c

    (hnz : (outsideBonds Lambda ∪ axBonds S' ell).card + 24 + 64 ≤ 191)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.NonFlatBackground.ho.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.NonFlatBackground.holonomyElem_expand
AdalyFormal.Balaban.NonFlatBackground.ho.header:
theorem holonomyElem_expand

    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    holonomyElem U p = U (p.1, p.2.1.1) * U (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1, p.2.1.2) *
      (U (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1))⁻¹ * (U (p.1, p.2.1.2))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.NonFlatBackground.ho.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.NonFlatBackground.holonomyElem_periodicGaugeTransform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.NonFlatBackground.ho.header:
theorem holonomyElem_periodicGaugeTransform

    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    holonomyElem (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) p = γ p.1 * holonomyElem U p * (γ p.1)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.NonFlatBackground.ho.header:
theorem holonomyElem_periodicGaugeTransform_eq_one_iff

    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    holonomyElem (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) p = 1 ↔ holonomyElem U p = 1
