            (deltaKCLMNormalized (trivialU L) (r.G (r.Qstar (r.S B)))) : ℝ)
          + (inner ℝ (r.G (r.Qstar (r.S B))) (r.P (r.G (r.Qstar (r.S B)))) : ℝ))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.Vz.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.VzeroAtOrigin_excludes_siteConst
AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.Vz.header:
theorem VzeroAtOrigin_excludes_siteConst {g : Fin 3 → SuTwo} {ρ : Fin 3} (hg : g ρ ≠ 0) :
    ¬ VzeroAtOrigin (WithLp.toLp 2 (siteConstCoarse (L := L) g))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.tw.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.twoSite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.tw.header:
noncomputable def twoSite (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * 2 ≤ L μ + 1) :
    PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.tw.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.twoSite_coarse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.tw.header:
theorem twoSite_coarse (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * 2 ≤ L μ + 1) :
    twoSite L hwide ∈ CoarseLattice L 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.tw.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.twoSite_ne_zeroSite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.tw.header:
theorem twoSite_ne_zeroSite (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * 2 ≤ L μ + 1) :
    twoSite L hwide ≠ AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreCoercivity.zeroSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.of.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.offOriginMode
AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.of.header: noncomputable def offOriginMode (w : SuTwo) : CoarseBond L 2 → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.of.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.offOriginMode_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.of.header:
theorem offOriginMode_mem (w : SuTwo) :
    VzeroAtOrigin (WithLp.toLp 2 (offOriginMode (L := L) w))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.Vz.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.VzeroAtOrigin_nontrivial
AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.Vz.header:
theorem VzeroAtOrigin_nontrivial (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * 2 ≤ L μ + 1) {w : SuTwo} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    VzeroAtOrigin (WithLp.toLp 2 (offOriginMode (L := L) w))
      ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (offOriginMode (L := L) w) : CoarseFnL2 L 2) ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.Le.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.LevelClass

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.le.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.levelClass_trivial
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.le.header:
theorem levelClass_trivial (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (k : ℕ) {alpha0 : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ alpha0) :
    LevelClass L k alpha0 (fun j => trivialU (levelExtent L j))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.ds.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.dstarDQuadForm_trivialU_eq_curlEnergy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.ds.header:
theorem dstarDQuadForm_trivialU_eq_curlEnergy (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    dstarDQuadForm (trivialU L) A = curlEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.cu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.curlEnergy_le_bondEnergy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.cu.header: theorem curlEnergy_le_bondEnergy (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : curlEnergy A ≤ 16 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.cu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.curlDrift_eq_sub
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.cu.header:
theorem curlDrift_eq_sub
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    curlDrift U A p = curlValueCovariant U A p - flatCurlValue A p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.ab.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.abs_sq_sub_sq_le_drift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.ab.header:
theorem abs_sq_sub_sq_le_drift
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    |‖curlValueCovariant U A p‖ ^ 2 - ‖flatCurlValue A p‖ ^ 2|
      ≤ ‖curlDrift U A p‖ * (‖curlValueCovariant U A p‖ + ‖flatCurlValue A p‖)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.ab.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.abs_dstarD_sub_curlEnergy_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.ab.header:
theorem abs_dstarD_sub_curlEnergy_le {alpha0 : ℝ} (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha0)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hsup : frobSupBond U ≤ alpha0) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    |dstarDQuadForm U A - curlEnergy A| ≤ 48 * alpha0 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.ab.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.abs_deltaK_sub_curlEnergy_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.ab.header:
theorem abs_deltaK_sub_curlEnergy_le {alpha0 : ℝ} (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha0)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hsup : frobSupBond U ≤ alpha0) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    |deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected U A - curlEnergy A|
      ≤ pertConst * alpha0 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.pe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.pertOp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.pe.header:
noncomputable def pertOp (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.ba.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.baseLevel_add_pertOp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.ba.header:
theorem baseLevel_add_pertOp
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    (baseLevel L).op + pertOp U = deltaKCLMNormalized U

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.pe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.pertOp_symm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.pe.header:
theorem pertOp_symm (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (u v : BondFnL2 L) :
    (inner ℝ u (pertOp U v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (pertOp U u) v : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.ab.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.abs_inner_pertOp_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.ab.header:
theorem abs_inner_pertOp_le {alpha0 : ℝ} (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha0)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hsup : frobSupBond U ≤ alpha0) (v : BondFnL2 L) :
    |(inner ℝ v (pertOp U v) : ℝ)| ≤ pertConst * alpha0 * ‖v‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.in.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.inner_pertOp_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.in.header:
theorem inner_pertOp_eq (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (v : BondFnL2 L) :
    (inner ℝ v (pertOp U v) : ℝ)
      = (inner ℝ v (deltaKCLMNormalized U v) : ℝ)
        - (inner ℝ v (deltaKCLMNormalized (trivialU L) v) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.in.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.inner_add_pertOp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.in.header:
theorem inner_add_pertOp (D : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (v : BondFnL2 L) :
    (inner ℝ v ((D + pertOp U) v) : ℝ)
      = (inner ℝ v (D v) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ v (pertOp U v) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.pe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.perturbed_gf_on_preimage
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.pe.header:
theorem perturbed_gf_on_preimage (lvl : Level Λ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (Λ μ + 1))
    (hdvd' : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (coarseExtent Λ 2 μ + 1))
    {alpha0 : ℝ} (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha0)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) Λ)
    (hsup : frobSupBond U ≤ alpha0) (u : BondFnL2 Λ)
    (hu : VLat (coarseExtent Λ 2) (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel hdvd u))) :
    (gammaStar - pertConst * alpha0) * ‖u‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ u ((lvl.op + pertOp U) u) : ℝ)
        + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice Λ 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.la.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.lattice_perturbed_gf_on_preimage
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.la.header:
theorem lattice_perturbed_gf_on_preimage (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (Λ μ + 1))
    (hdvd' : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (coarseExtent Λ 2 μ + 1))
    {alpha0 : ℝ} (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha0)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) Λ)
    (hsup : frobSupBond U ≤ alpha0) (u : BondFnL2 Λ)
    (hu : VLat (coarseExtent Λ 2) (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel hdvd u))) :
    (gammaStar - pertConst * alpha0) * ‖u‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ u (deltaKCLMNormalized U u) : ℝ)
        + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice Λ 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.Le.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.Level.op_dominates_flat
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.Le.header:
theorem Level.op_dominates_flat (lvl : Level Λ) (v : BondFnL2 Λ) :
    (inner ℝ v (deltaKCLMNormalized (trivialU Λ) v) : ℝ) ≤ (inner ℝ v (lvl.op v) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.dr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.dressed_dominates_lattice
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.dr.header:
theorem dressed_dominates_lattice (lvl : Level Λ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) Λ) (v : BondFnL2 Λ) :
    (inner ℝ v (deltaKCLMNormalized U v) : ℝ) ≤ (inner ℝ v ((lvl.op + pertOp U) v) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.le.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.levelExtent_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.le.header:
theorem levelExtent_pos {k : ℕ} (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : j ≤ k) (μ : Fin 3) : 0 < levelExtent L j μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.le.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.levelExtent_succ_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.le.header:
theorem levelExtent_succ_pos {k : ℕ} (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : j ≤ k) (μ : Fin 3) : 0 < levelExtent L (j + 1) μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.la.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.lattice_uniform_perturbed_coercive
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.la.header:
theorem lattice_uniform_perturbed_coercive (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {k : ℕ}
    (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k)
    {alpha0 : ℝ} (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha0)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (levelExtent L j))
    (hsup : frobSupBond U ≤ alpha0) (u : BondFnL2 (levelExtent L j))
    (hu : VLat (levelExtent L (j + 1))
      (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel (levelOK_of_pow hpow hj).1 u))) :
    (gammaStar - pertConst * alpha0) * ‖u‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ u (deltaKCLMNormalized U u) : ℝ)
        + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice (levelExtent L j) 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.to.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.tower_uniform_perturbed_coercive
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.to.header:
theorem tower_uniform_perturbed_coercive (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {k : ℕ}
    (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k)
    {alpha0 : ℝ} (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha0)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (levelExtent L j))
    (hsup : frobSupBond U ≤ alpha0) (u : BondFnL2 (levelExtent L j))
    (hu : VLat (levelExtent L (j + 1))
      (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel (levelOK_of_pow hpow hj).1 u))) :
    (gammaStar - pertConst * alpha0) * ‖u‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ u (((towerAt L ha hpow j (by omega)).op + pertOp U) u) : ℝ)
        + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice (levelExtent L j) 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.cl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.class_uniform_coercive
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.cl.header:
theorem class_uniform_coercive (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {k : ℕ}
    (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {alpha0 : ℝ} (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha0)
    (U : ∀ j : ℕ, PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
      (levelExtent L j))
    (hU : LevelClass L k alpha0 U) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) (u : BondFnL2 (levelExtent L j))
    (hu : VLat (levelExtent L (j + 1))
      (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel (levelOK_of_pow hpow hj).1 u))) :
    (gammaStar - pertConst * alpha0) * ‖u‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ u (deltaKCLMNormalized (U j) u) : ℝ)
        + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice (levelExtent L j) 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.coercive_on_VSrc_perturbed
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.co.header:
theorem coercive_on_VSrc_perturbed (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {alpha0 : ℝ} (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha0)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hsup : frobSupBond U ≤ alpha0) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hA : AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSrc hdvd4
      (AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 2 A)) :
    (gammaStar - pertConst * alpha0) * bondEnergy A
      ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected U A + pAx A (CoarseLattice L 2) 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.wi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.witU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.wi.header:
noncomputable def witU (Λ : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) Λ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.wi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.witU_curved
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.wi.header:
theorem witU_curved (Λ : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hpos : 0 < Λ 1) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.holonomyElem (witU Λ)
        (zeroSite Λ,
          (⟨(0, 1), by decide⟩ : AdalyFormal.Target.ClayStatement.PeriodicPlaquetteDirections))
      ≠ (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.wi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.witClassU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.wi.header:
noncomputable def witClassU (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (j : ℕ) :
    PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (levelExtent L j)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.wi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.witClassU_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.wi.header:
theorem witClassU_mem (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (k : ℕ) :
    LevelClass L k (1 / 10 ^ 20) (witClassU L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.cl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.class_uniform_coercive_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.cl.header:
theorem class_uniform_coercive_nonvacuous (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {k : ℕ}
    (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.holonomyElem (witClassU L j)
        (zeroSite (levelExtent L j),
          (⟨(0, 1), by decide⟩ : AdalyFormal.Target.ClayStatement.PeriodicPlaquetteDirections))
        ≠ (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
      ∧ ∃ u : BondFnL2 (levelExtent L j),
          VLat (levelExtent L (j + 1))
              (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel (levelOK_of_pow hpow hj).1 u))
            ∧ u ≠ 0
            ∧ qLevel (levelOK_of_pow hpow hj).1 u ≠ 0
            ∧ 0 < gammaZero (1 / 10 ^ 20) * ‖u‖ ^ 2
            ∧ 0 < (inner ℝ u (deltaKCLMNormalized (witClassU L j) u) : ℝ)
                + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice (levelExtent L j) 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.pr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.prL_extents_reexport
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.pr.header:
theorem prL_extents_reexport :
    (∀ μ : Fin 3, levelExtent witL 0 μ = 15) ∧ (∀ μ : Fin 3, levelExtent witL 1 μ = 7)
      ∧ (∀ μ : Fin 3, levelExtent witL 2 μ = 3)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.no.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.nonvacuous_depth_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.no.header:
theorem nonvacuous_depth_zero :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.holonomyElem (witClassU witL 0)
        (zeroSite (levelExtent witL 0),
          (⟨(0, 1), by decide⟩ : AdalyFormal.Target.ClayStatement.PeriodicPlaquetteDirections))
        ≠ (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
      ∧ ∃ u : BondFnL2 (levelExtent witL 0),
          VLat (levelExtent witL 1)
              (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel (levelOK_of_pow witL_pow (by omega : 0 ≤ 1)).1 u))
            ∧ u ≠ 0
            ∧ qLevel (levelOK_of_pow witL_pow (by omega : 0 ≤ 1)).1 u ≠ 0
            ∧ 0 < gammaZero (1 / 10 ^ 20) * ‖u‖ ^ 2
            ∧ 0 < (inner ℝ u (deltaKCLMNormalized (witClassU witL 0) u) : ℝ)
                + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice (levelExtent witL 0) 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.no.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.nonvacuous_depth_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.no.header:
theorem nonvacuous_depth_one :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.holonomyElem (witClassU witL 1)
        (zeroSite (levelExtent witL 1),
          (⟨(0, 1), by decide⟩ : AdalyFormal.Target.ClayStatement.PeriodicPlaquetteDirections))
        ≠ (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
      ∧ ∃ u : BondFnL2 (levelExtent witL 1),
          VLat (levelExtent witL 2)
              (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel (levelOK_of_pow witL_pow (by omega : 1 ≤ 1)).1 u))
            ∧ u ≠ 0
            ∧ qLevel (levelOK_of_pow witL_pow (by omega : 1 ≤ 1)).1 u ≠ 0
            ∧ 0 < gammaZero (1 / 10 ^ 20) * ‖u‖ ^ 2
            ∧ 0 < (inner ℝ u (deltaKCLMNormalized (witClassU witL 1) u) : ℝ)
                + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice (levelExtent witL 1) 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.to.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.tower_perturbed_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.to.header:
theorem tower_perturbed_nonvacuous (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {k : ℕ}
    (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) :
    ∃ u : BondFnL2 (levelExtent L j),
      VLat (levelExtent L (j + 1)) (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel (levelOK_of_pow hpow hj).1 u))
        ∧ u ≠ 0
        ∧ qLevel (levelOK_of_pow hpow hj).1 u ≠ 0
        ∧ 0 < gammaZero (1 / 10 ^ 20) * ‖u‖ ^ 2
        ∧ 0 < (inner ℝ u (((towerAt L ha hpow j (by omega)).op
              + pertOp (witClassU L j)) u) : ℝ)
            + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice (levelExtent L j) 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.to.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.tower_perturbed_nonvacuous_depth_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.to.header:
theorem tower_perturbed_nonvacuous_depth_one :
    ∃ u : BondFnL2 (levelExtent witL 1),
      VLat (levelExtent witL 2) (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel (levelOK_of_pow witL_pow
          (by omega : 1 ≤ 1)).1 u))
        ∧ u ≠ 0
        ∧ qLevel (levelOK_of_pow witL_pow (by omega : 1 ≤ 1)).1 u ≠ 0
        ∧ 0 < gammaZero (1 / 10 ^ 20) * ‖u‖ ^ 2
        ∧ 0 < (inner ℝ u (((towerAt witL (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1) witL_pow 1
              (by omega)).op + pertOp (witClassU witL 1)) u) : ℝ)
            + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice (levelExtent witL 1) 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.pe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.pert_bound_needs_hypothesis
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.pe.header:
theorem pert_bound_needs_hypothesis :
    ¬ (∀ (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
          AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.co.header:
theorem covariant_perturbed_gf_on_preimage (lvl : Level Λ)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (Λ μ + 1))
    (hdvd' : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (coarseExtent Λ 2 μ + 1))
    (Ubar : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (coarseExtent Λ 2))
    {abar : ℝ} (habar : 0 ≤ abar) (hsupbar : frobSupBond Ubar ≤ abar)
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (hgc : 0 < gammaCurved abar eps)
    {alpha0 : ℝ} (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha0)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) Λ)
    (hsup : frobSupBond U ≤ alpha0) (u : BondFnL2 Λ)
    (hu : VCurved (coarseExtent Λ 2) Ubar (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel hdvd u))) :
    (gammaLevel 1 0 0 (gammaCurved abar eps) - pertConst * alpha0) * ‖u‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ u ((lvl.op + pertOp U) u) : ℝ)
        + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice Λ 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.covariant_uniform_perturbed_coercive
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.co.header:
theorem covariant_uniform_perturbed_coercive (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {k : ℕ}
    (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k)
    (Ubar : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
      (levelExtent L (j + 1)))
    {abar : ℝ} (habar : 0 ≤ abar) (hsupbar : frobSupBond Ubar ≤ abar)
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (hgc : 0 < gammaCurved abar eps)
    {alpha0 : ℝ} (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha0)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (levelExtent L j))
    (hsup : frobSupBond U ≤ alpha0) (u : BondFnL2 (levelExtent L j))
    (hu : VCurved (levelExtent L (j + 1)) Ubar
      (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel (levelOK_of_pow hpow hj).1 u))) :
    (gammaLevel 1 0 0 (gammaCurved abar eps) - pertConst * alpha0) * ‖u‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ u (deltaKCLMNormalized U u) : ℝ)
        + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice (levelExtent L j) 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.covariant_uniform_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PerturbationRoute.co.header:
theorem covariant_uniform_nonvacuous (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {k : ℕ}
    (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.holonomyElem (witClassU L j)
        (zeroSite (levelExtent L j),
          (⟨(0, 1), by decide⟩ : AdalyFormal.Target.ClayStatement.PeriodicPlaquetteDirections))
        ≠ (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
      ∧ AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.holonomyElem (witClassU L (j + 1))
        (zeroSite (levelExtent L (j + 1)),
          (⟨(0, 1), by decide⟩ : AdalyFormal.Target.ClayStatement.PeriodicPlaquetteDirections))
        ≠ (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
      ∧ ∃ u : BondFnL2 (levelExtent L j),
          VCurved (levelExtent L (j + 1)) (witClassU L (j + 1))
              (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel (levelOK_of_pow hpow hj).1 u))
            ∧ u ≠ 0
            ∧ qLevel (levelOK_of_pow hpow hj).1 u ≠ 0
            ∧ 0 < (gammaLevel 1 0 0 (gammaCurved (1 / 10 ^ 20) 1)
                - pertConst * (1 / 10 ^ 20 : ℝ)) * ‖u‖ ^ 2
            ∧ 0 < (inner ℝ u (deltaKCLMNormalized (witClassU L j) u) : ℝ)
                + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice (levelExtent L j) 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) (hMB : ‖M‖ ≤ B)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.sq_ad.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.sq_add_three_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.sq_ad.header: theorem sq_add_three_le (x y z : ℝ) : (x + y + z) ^ 2 ≤ 3 * (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + z ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.cube_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.cube_decomposition
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.cube_.header:
theorem cube_decomposition (ell : ℕ) (Ψ : Cube ell → ℝ) (p : Cube ell)
    (hz : A0 ell (A1 ell (A2 ell Ψ)) = 0) :
    Ψ p = (Ψ - A0 ell Ψ) p + (A0 ell (Ψ - A1 ell Ψ)) p
        + (A0 ell (A1 ell (Ψ - A2 ell Ψ))) p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.cube_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.cube_poincare
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.cube_.header:
theorem cube_poincare (ell : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (Ψ : Cube ell → ℝ)
    (hmz : ∑ p : Cube ell, Ψ p = 0) :
    cSumSq ell Ψ ≤ (3 * (ell : ℝ) * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) / 2)
      * (cE0 ell Ψ + cE1 ell Ψ + cE2 ell Ψ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.cE1_e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.cE1_eq_stepIdx
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.cE1_e.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.cE2_e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.cE2_eq_stepIdx
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.cE2_e.header:
theorem cE2_eq_stepIdx (ell : ℕ) (Ψ : Cube ell → ℝ) :
    cE2 ell Ψ = ∑ j : StepIdx ell, (Ψ (cubeOf2' j) - Ψ (cubeOf2 j)) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.stepB.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.stepBond_injOn
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.stepB.header:
theorem stepBond_injOn (ell : ℕ) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (μ : Fin 3)
    (co : StepIdx ell → Cube ell) (hco : Function.Injective co) :
    ∀ t ∈ (CoarseLattice L ell) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (StepIdx ell)),
      ∀ t' ∈ (CoarseLattice L ell) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (StepIdx ell)),
        stepBond ell co μ t = stepBond ell co μ t' → t = t'

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.three.header:
theorem three_sets_sum_le (g : Bond L → ℝ) (hg : ∀ e, 0 ≤ g e) (S0 S1 S2 : Finset (Bond L))
    (h01 : Disjoint S0 S1) (h02 : Disjoint S0 S2) (h12 : Disjoint S1 S2) :
    ∑ e ∈ S0, g e + ∑ e ∈ S1, g e + ∑ e ∈ S2, g e ≤ ∑ e : Bond L, g e

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.dir_s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.dir_sum_eq_image
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.dir_s.header:
theorem dir_sum_eq_image (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (ell : ℕ)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (μ : Fin 3) (co : StepIdx ell → Cube ell)
    (hco : Function.Injective co) :
    ∑ t ∈ (CoarseLattice L ell) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (StepIdx ell)),
        (LatticeOperators.gradValue lam (stepBond ell co μ t)) ^ 2
      = ∑ e ∈ Finset.image (stepBond ell co μ)
          ((CoarseLattice L ell) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (StepIdx ell))),
          (LatticeOperators.gradValue lam e) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.block.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.block_energy_sum_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.block.header:
theorem block_energy_sum_le (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (ell : ℕ)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    ∑ y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell,
        (cE0 ell (fun p => lam (chart y ell p)) + cE1 ell (fun p => lam (chart y ell p))
          + cE2 ell (fun p => lam (chart y ell p)))
      ≤ ∑ e : Bond L, (LatticeOperators.gradValue lam e) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.latti.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.lattice_block_poincare
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.latti.header:
theorem lattice_block_poincare (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (ell : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hker : ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell, ∑ x ∈ blockOf y ell, lam x = 0) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (lam x) ^ 2
      ≤ (3 * (ell : ℝ) * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) / 2)
        * ∑ e : Bond L, (LatticeOperators.gradValue lam e) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.eucli.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.euclid_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.PoincareBridge.eucli.header:
theorem euclid_norm_sq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :

            ≤ (inner ℝ v (LatticeOperators.siteLaplacianCLM (fun _ => 7) v) : ℝ))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.nsmul_one_val.header: theorem nsmul_one_val (n k : ℕ) : (k • (1 : Fin (n + 1))).val = k % (n + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.nsmul_one_eq.header: theorem nsmul_one_eq (n : ℕ) (x : Fin (n + 1)) : x.val • (1 : Fin (n + 1)) = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.iterate_add_o.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.iterate_add_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.iterate_add_o.header:
theorem iterate_add_one (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (n + 1)) (k : ℕ) :
    (fun y : Fin (n + 1) => y + 1)^[k] a = a + k • (1 : Fin (n + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.coordSteps.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.coordSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.coordSteps.header: def coordSteps {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (a b : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.straightSegme.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.periodicPathE.header:
theorem periodicPathEndpoint_append {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.straightSegme.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.straightSegment_endpoint
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.straightSegme.header:
theorem straightSegment_endpoint {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (a b : PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.GammaPath.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.GammaPath
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.GammaPath.header: def GammaPath {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : List (Fin 3 × Bool)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.GammaPath_end.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.GammaPath_endpoint
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.GammaPath_end.header:
theorem GammaPath_endpoint {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    periodicPathEndpoint y (GammaPath y x) = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.coordSteps_se.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.coordSteps_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.coordSteps_se.header:
theorem coordSteps_self {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (a : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.straightSegme.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.straightSegment_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.straightSegme.header:
theorem straightSegment_self {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (a : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.GammaPath_sel.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.GammaPath_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.GammaPath_sel.header:
theorem GammaPath_self {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (a : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    GammaPath a a = []

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.periodicPathH.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.periodicPathHolonomy_append
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.periodicPathH.header:
theorem periodicPathHolonomy_append {G : Type*} [Group G] {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (s1 s2 : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) :
    periodicPathHolonomy U x (s1 ++ s2) =
      periodicPathHolonomy U x s1 * periodicPathHolonomy U (periodicPathEndpoint x s1) s2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.transportPath.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.rZeroA.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.rZeroA

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.rZeroA_add.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.rZeroA_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.rZeroA_add.header:
theorem rZeroA_add {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (cMinus x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (A1 A2 : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) :
    rZeroA U cMinus x (A1 + A2) μ ell = rZeroA U cMinus x A1 μ ell + rZeroA U cMinus x A2 μ ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.rZeroA_smul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.rZeroA_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.rZeroA_smul.header:
theorem rZeroA_smul {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (cMinus x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (c : ℝ) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) :
    rZeroA U cMinus x (c • A) μ ell = c • rZeroA U cMinus x A μ ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.rZeroA_ell2.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.rZeroA_ell2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.rZeroA_ell2.header:
theorem rZeroA_ell2 {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (cMinus x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) :
    rZeroA U cMinus x A μ 2 =
      RMap (periodicPathHolonomy U cMinus (transportPath cMinus x μ 0)) (A (x, μ)) +
      RMap (periodicPathHolonomy U cMinus (transportPath cMinus x μ 1))
        (A (periodicLatticeShift x μ, μ))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain.header:
noncomputable def q1RealMain (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    witnessL) (ell : ℕ) (A : Bond witnessL → SuTwo)
    (b : LatticeOperators.CoarseBond witnessL ell) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_ad.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_ad.header:
theorem q1RealMain_add (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    witnessL) (ell : ℕ) (A1 A2 : Bond witnessL → SuTwo)
    (b : LatticeOperators.CoarseBond witnessL ell) :
    q1RealMain U ell (A1 + A2) b = q1RealMain U ell A1 b + q1RealMain U ell A2 b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_sm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_sm.header:
theorem q1RealMain_smul (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    witnessL) (ell : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (A : Bond witnessL → SuTwo)
    (b : LatticeOperators.CoarseBond witnessL ell) :
    q1RealMain U ell (c • A) b = c • q1RealMain U ell A b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_al.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_altWeight
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_al.header:
theorem q1RealMain_altWeight (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    witnessL) (ell : ℕ) (A : Bond witnessL → SuTwo)
    (b : LatticeOperators.CoarseBond witnessL ell) :
    (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) • ∑ x ∈ blockOf b.1.1 ell, rZeroA U b.1.1 x A b.2 ell
      = ((ell : ℝ))⁻¹ • q1RealMain U ell A b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real.header:
noncomputable def Q1Real (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    witnessL) : (Bond witnessL → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ]
    (LatticeOperators.CoarseBond witnessL witnessEll → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_apply.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_apply.header:
theorem Q1Real_apply (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) witnessL)
    (A : Bond witnessL → SuTwo) (b : LatticeOperators.CoarseBond witnessL witnessEll) :
    Q1Real U A b = q1RealMain U witnessEll A b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.rZeroA_trivia.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.rZeroA_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.rZeroA_trivia.header:
theorem rZeroA_trivialU {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (cMinus x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) :
    rZeroA (AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.trivialU L) cMinus x A μ ell =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, A (pathSite x μ i, μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_tr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_tr.header:
theorem q1RealMain_trivialU (ell : ℕ) (A : Bond witnessL → SuTwo)
    (b : LatticeOperators.CoarseBond witnessL ell) :
    q1RealMain (AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.trivialU witnessL) ell A b =
      (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) • ∑ x ∈ blockOf b.1.1 ell, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
        A (pathSite x b.2 i, b.2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.witnessY_uniq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.witnessY_unique_contributor
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.witnessY_uniq.header:
theorem witnessY_unique_contributor :
    ∀ x ∈ blockOf witnessY witnessEll, x ≠ witnessY →
      x ≠ witnessY ∧ periodicLatticeShift x 0 ≠ witnessY

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_de.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_deltaWitnessConfig
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_de.header:
theorem q1RealMain_deltaWitnessConfig
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) witnessL) :
    q1RealMain U witnessEll deltaWitnessConfig targetCoarseBond = (1 / 8 : ℝ) • suTwoWitness

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_deltaW.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_deltaWitnessConfig
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_deltaW.header:
theorem Q1Real_deltaWitnessConfig
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) witnessL) :
    Q1Real U deltaWitnessConfig targetCoarseBond = (1 / 8 : ℝ) • suTwoWitness

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_delta_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_delta_background_independent
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_delta_.header:
theorem Q1Real_delta_background_independent :
    Q1Real (AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.trivialU witnessL) deltaWitnessConfig
        targetCoarseBond =
      Q1Real witnessU deltaWitnessConfig targetCoarseBond

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_deltaW.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_deltaWitnessConfig_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_deltaW.header:
theorem Q1Real_deltaWitnessConfig_ne_zero
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) witnessL) :
    Q1Real U deltaWitnessConfig targetCoarseBond ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.d4ConfigSuTwo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.d4ConfigSuTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.d4ConfigSuTwo.header: noncomputable def d4ConfigSuTwo : Bond witnessL → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.transportPath.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.transportPath_to_site1_direct
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.transportPath.header:
theorem transportPath_to_site1_direct :
    transportPath witnessY site1 (0 : Fin 3) 0 = [((0 : Fin 3), true)]

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.transportPath.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.transportPath_to_site1_shift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.transportPath.header:
theorem transportPath_to_site1_shift :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_d4.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_d4ConfigSuTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealMain_d4.header:
theorem q1RealMain_d4ConfigSuTwo
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) witnessL) :
    q1RealMain U witnessEll d4ConfigSuTwo targetCoarseBond =
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) • RMap (U (witnessY, (0 : Fin 3))) suTwoWitness

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_d4_tri.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_d4_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_d4_tri.header:
theorem Q1Real_d4_trivialU :
    Q1Real (AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.trivialU witnessL) d4ConfigSuTwo
        targetCoarseBond = (1 / 4 : ℝ) • suTwoWitness

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_d4_wit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_d4_witnessU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_d4_wit.header:
theorem Q1Real_d4_witnessU :
    Q1Real witnessU d4ConfigSuTwo targetCoarseBond = -((1 / 4 : ℝ) • suTwoWitness)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_d4_gen.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_d4_genuinely_U_dependent
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.Q1Real_d4_gen.header:
theorem Q1Real_d4_genuinely_U_dependent :
    Q1Real (AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.trivialU witnessL) d4ConfigSuTwo
        targetCoarseBond ≠
      Q1Real witnessU d4ConfigSuTwo targetCoarseBond

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.transport_var.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.transport_varies_within_single_x
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.transport_var.header:
theorem transport_varies_within_single_x :
    RMap (periodicPathHolonomy witnessU witnessY (transportPath witnessY witnessY 0 0))
        suTwoWitness ≠
      RMap (periodicPathHolonomy witnessU witnessY (transportPath witnessY witnessY 0 1))
        suTwoWitness

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealKernel.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealKernel
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealKernel.header:
noncomputable def q1RealKernel (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    witnessL) : Submodule ℝ (Bond witnessL → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.deltaWitnessC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.deltaWitnessConfig_notMem_q1RealKernel
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.deltaWitnessC.header:
theorem deltaWitnessConfig_notMem_q1RealKernel
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) witnessL) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealKernel_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealKernel_ne_top
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.q1RealKernel_.header:
theorem q1RealKernel_ne_top (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    witnessL) : q1RealKernel U ≠ ⊤

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.checkerConfig.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.checkerConfigSuTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.checkerConfig.header: noncomputable def checkerConfigSuTwo : Bond witnessL → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.checkerConfig.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.checkerConfigSuTwo_pointwise_cancel
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.checkerConfig.header:
theorem checkerConfigSuTwo_pointwise_cancel (x : PeriodicLatticeSite witnessL) :
    checkerConfigSuTwo (x, (0 : Fin 3)) +
      checkerConfigSuTwo (periodicLatticeShift x 0, (0 : Fin 3)) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_sq_pil.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_sq_pilp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_sq_pil.header:
theorem norm_sq_pilp {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (x : PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => SuTwo)) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : ι, ‖WithLp.ofLp x i‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_coord_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_coord_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_coord_.header:
theorem norm_coord_le {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (x : PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => SuTwo)) (i : ι) :
    ‖WithLp.ofLp x i‖ ≤ ‖x‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.blockIdx.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.blockIdx
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.blockIdx.header: def blockIdx (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L × ℕ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.fineBond.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.fineBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.fineBond.header: def fineBond (μ : Fin 3) (t : PeriodicLatticeSite L × ℕ) : Bond L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.card_blockI.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.card_blockIdx
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.card_blockI.header:
theorem card_blockIdx {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :
    (blockIdx y ell).card = ell ^ 4

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.pathSite_in.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.pathSite_injective
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.pathSite_in.header:
theorem pathSite_injective (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (fun x : PeriodicLatticeSite L => pathSite x μ i)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_lineCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_lineCoarseRestrictCov_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_lineCo.header:
theorem norm_lineCoarseRestrictCov_le {ell : ℕ}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    ‖lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell A c‖
      ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * ∑ t ∈ blockIdx c.1.1 ell, ‖A (fineBond c.2 t)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_sq_lin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_sq_lineCoarseRestrictCov_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_sq_lin.header:
theorem norm_sq_lineCoarseRestrictCov_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    ‖lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell A c‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * ∑ t ∈ blockIdx c.1.1 ell, ‖A (fineBond c.2 t)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.read_injOn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.read_injOn
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.read_injOn.header:
theorem read_injOn {ell i : ℕ}
    (p q : (_ : CoarseBond L ell) × PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hp : p ∈ Finset.univ.sigma (fun c : CoarseBond L ell => blockOf c.1.1 ell))
    (hq : q ∈ Finset.univ.sigma (fun c : CoarseBond L ell => blockOf c.1.1 ell))
    (heq : ((pathSite p.2 p.1.2 i, p.1.2) : Bond L) = (pathSite q.2 q.1.2 i, q.1.2)) :
    p = q

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.sum_coarse_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.sum_coarse_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.sum_coarse_.header:
theorem sum_coarse_le {ell : ℕ}
    (g : Bond L → ℝ) (hg : ∀ b, 0 ≤ g b) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L ell, ∑ t ∈ blockIdx c.1.1 ell, g (fineBond c.2 t)
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * ∑ b : Bond L, g b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.multiplicit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.multiplicity_exact
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.multiplicit.header:
theorem multiplicity_exact {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (a : Bond L → ℝ) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L ell, ∑ t ∈ blockIdx c.1.1 ell, (a (fineBond c.2 t)) ^ 2
      = (ell : ℝ) * ∑ z : Bond L, (a z) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_norm_s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_norm_sq_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_norm_s.header:
theorem qCLM_norm_sq_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    ‖qCLM U ell A‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) * ‖A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_opNorm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_opNorm_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_opNorm.header:
theorem qCLM_opNorm_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    ‖qCLM U ell‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_opNorm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_opNorm_lt_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_opNorm.header:
theorem qCLM_opNorm_lt_one {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    ‖qCLM U ell‖ < 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.lineCoarseR.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.lineCoarseRestrictCov_bondDelta
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.lineCoarseR.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCov_bondDelta {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (μ : Fin 3) (v : SuTwo) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell (bondDelta (y, μ) v)
        ((⟨y, hy⟩ : {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L // z ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}), μ)
      = (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) • RMap (periodicPathHolonomy U y (transportPath y y μ 0)) v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.deltaWitnes.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.deltaWitness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.deltaWitnes.header: noncomputable def deltaWitness (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_qCLM_d.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_qCLM_deltaWitness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_qCLM_d.header:
theorem norm_qCLM_deltaWitness {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤ ‖qCLM U ell (deltaWitness L)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_opNorm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_opNorm_ge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_opNorm.header:
theorem qCLM_opNorm_ge {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤ ‖qCLM U ell‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qSumCLM.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qSumCLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qSumCLM.header:
noncomputable def qSumCLM (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (ell : ℕ) : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] CoarseFnL2 L ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.summing_var.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.summing_variant_one_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.summing_var.header:
theorem summing_variant_one_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    1 ≤ ‖qSumCLM U ell‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.summing_var.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.summing_variant_not_lt_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.summing_var.header:
theorem summing_variant_not_lt_one {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    ¬ (‖qSumCLM U ell‖ < 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.lineCoarseR.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.lineCoarseR.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo_const {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (v : SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo ell
        (fun _ : Bond L => v) c = v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.card_site_e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.card_site_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.card_site_e.header:
theorem card_site_eq {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    Fintype.card (PeriodicLatticeSite L) = ell ^ 3 * (CoarseLattice L ell).card

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.card_bond_e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.card_bond_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.card_bond_e.header:
theorem card_bond_eq {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    Fintype.card (Bond L) = ell ^ 3 * Fintype.card (CoarseBond L ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.constWitnes.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.constWitness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.constWitnes.header: noncomputable def constWitness (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_constW.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_constWitness_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_constW.header:
theorem norm_constWitness_sq (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    ‖constWitness L‖ ^ 2 = (Fintype.card (Bond L) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_qCLM_t.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_qCLM_trivialU_constWitness_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.norm_qCLM_t.header:
theorem norm_qCLM_trivialU_constWitness_sq {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    ‖qCLM (trivialU L) ell (constWitness L)‖ ^ 2
      = (Fintype.card (CoarseBond L ell) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_trivia.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_trivialU_opNorm_ge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_trivia.header:
theorem qCLM_trivialU_opNorm_ge {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    Real.sqrt (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3)
      ≤ ‖qCLM (trivialU L) ell‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_trivia.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_trivialU_opNorm_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_trivia.header:
theorem qCLM_trivialU_opNorm_eq {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    ‖qCLM (trivialU L) ell‖
      = Real.sqrt (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_two_si.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_two_sided_curvedRegularU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.qCLM_two_si.header:
theorem qCLM_two_sided_curvedRegularU :
    (1 : ℝ) / 16 ≤ ‖qCLM curvedRegularU 2‖ ∧ ‖qCLM curvedRegularU 2‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 / 8)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.opNorm_boun.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.opNorm_bound_at_one_is_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.opNorm_boun.header:
theorem opNorm_bound_at_one_is_one (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration
    (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (1:ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    ‖qCLM U 1‖ ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite.header: def pathSite (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite_zero.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite_zero.header: theorem pathSite_zero (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : pathSite x μ 0 = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite_succ.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite_succ.header:
theorem pathSite_succ (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :
    pathSite x μ (i + 1) = periodicLatticeShift (pathSite x μ i) μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.longBondValue.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.longBondValue
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.longBondValue.header: def longBondValue (A : Bond L → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.longBondValue_a.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.longBondValue_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.longBondValue_a.header:
theorem longBondValue_add (A1 A2 : Bond L → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) :
    longBondValue (A1 + A2) x μ ell = longBondValue A1 x μ ell + longBondValue A2 x μ ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.longBondValue_s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.longBondValue_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.longBondValue_s.header:
theorem longBondValue_smul (c : ℝ) (A : Bond L → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    (ell : ℕ) : longBondValue (c • A) x μ ell = c * longBondValue A x μ ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum.header:
noncomputable def qOnePathSum {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell : ℕ)
    (A : Bond L → ℝ) (b : LatticeOperators.CoarseBond L ell) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_add.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_add.header:
theorem qOnePathSum_add {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell : ℕ) (A1 A2 : Bond L → ℝ)
    (b : LatticeOperators.CoarseBond L ell) :
    qOnePathSum ell (A1 + A2) b = qOnePathSum ell A1 b + qOnePathSum ell A2 b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_smu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_smu.header:
theorem qOnePathSum_smul {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (A : Bond L → ℝ)
    (b : LatticeOperators.CoarseBond L ell) :
    qOnePathSum ell (c • A) b = c * qOnePathSum ell A b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSumLM.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSumLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSumLM.header:
noncomputable def qOnePathSumLM (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) :
    (Bond L → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (LatticeOperators.CoarseBond L ell → ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSumLM_a.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSumLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSumLM_a.header:
theorem qOnePathSumLM_apply (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) (A : Bond L → ℝ) :
    qOnePathSumLM L ell A = qOnePathSum ell A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSumCLM.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSumCLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSumCLM.header:
noncomputable def qOnePathSumCLM (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) :
    LatticeOperators.BondSpace L →L[ℝ] LatticeOperators.CoarseBondSpace L ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.longBondValue_e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.longBondValue_ell2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.longBondValue_e.header:
theorem longBondValue_ell2 (A : Bond L → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    longBondValue A x μ 2 = A (x, μ) + A (periodicLatticeShift x μ, μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.periodicLattice.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.periodicLatticeShift_injective
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.periodicLattice.header:
theorem periodicLatticeShift_injective (μ : Fin 3) :
    Function.Injective (fun x : PeriodicLatticeSite L => periodicLatticeShift x μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.sum_ite_eq_of_m.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.sum_ite_eq_of_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.sum_ite_eq_of_m.header:
theorem sum_ite_eq_of_mem {s : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {a : PeriodicLatticeSite L} :
    ∑ x ∈ s, (if x = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = if a ∈ s then 1 else 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.sum_ite_shift_e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.sum_ite_shift_eq_of_mem

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.site1_mem_block.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.site1_mem_block
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.site1_mem_block.header: theorem site1_mem_block : site1 ∈ blockOf witnessY witnessEll

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.witnessY_mem_bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.witnessY_mem_block
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.witnessY_mem_bl.header: theorem witnessY_mem_block : witnessY ∈ blockOf witnessY witnessEll

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.targetCoarseBon.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.targetCoarseBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.targetCoarseBon.header: noncomputable def targetCoarseBond : LatticeOperators.CoarseBond witnessL witnessEll

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.d4Config.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.d4Config
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.d4Config.header: noncomputable def d4Config : Bond witnessL → ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_d4C.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_d4Config
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_d4C.header: theorem qOnePathSum_d4Config : qOnePathSum witnessEll d4Config targetCoarseBond = 1 / 8

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.coarseRestrict_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.coarseRestrict_d4Config
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.coarseRestrict_.header:
theorem coarseRestrict_d4Config :
    LatticeOperators.coarseRestrict witnessEll d4Config targetCoarseBond = 1 / 16

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_ne_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_ne_coarseRestrict_d4Config
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_ne_.header:
theorem qOnePathSum_ne_coarseRestrict_d4Config :
    qOnePathSum witnessEll d4Config targetCoarseBond ≠
      LatticeOperators.coarseRestrict witnessEll d4Config targetCoarseBond

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.checkerConfig.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.checkerConfig
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.checkerConfig.header: noncomputable def checkerConfig : Bond witnessL → ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.checker_shift_f.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.checker_shift_flips
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.checker_shift_f.header:
theorem checker_shift_flips (x : PeriodicLatticeSite witnessL) :
    (periodicLatticeShift x 0) 0 = x 0 + 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.checker_pointwi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.checker_pointwise_cancel
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.checker_pointwi.header:
theorem checker_pointwise_cancel (x : PeriodicLatticeSite witnessL) :
    checkerConfig (x, (0 : Fin 3)) + checkerConfig (periodicLatticeShift x 0, (0 : Fin 3)) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.longBondValue_c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.longBondValue_checkerConfig_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.longBondValue_c.header:
theorem longBondValue_checkerConfig_eq_zero (x : PeriodicLatticeSite witnessL) :
    longBondValue checkerConfig x 0 2 = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_che.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_checkerConfig_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_che.header:
theorem qOnePathSum_checkerConfig_eq_zero (b : LatticeOperators.CoarseBond witnessL witnessEll) :
    qOnePathSum witnessEll checkerConfig b = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSumCLM_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSumCLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSumCLM_.header:
theorem qOnePathSumCLM_apply (ell : ℕ) (A : LatticeOperators.BondSpace witnessL) :
    LatticeOperators.coarseBondEquiv witnessL ell (qOnePathSumCLM witnessL ell A) =
      qOnePathSum ell (LatticeOperators.bondEquiv witnessL A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSumCLMa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSumCLMasLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSumCLMa.header:
noncomputable abbrev qOnePathSumCLMasLM :
    LatticeOperators.BondSpace witnessL →ₗ[ℝ] LatticeOperators.CoarseBondSpace witnessL
    witnessEll

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.mem_CoarseLatti.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.mem_CoarseLattice_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.mem_CoarseLatti.header:
theorem mem_CoarseLattice_one {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    y ∈ CoarseLattice L 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.blockOf_one_eq_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.blockOf_one_eq_singleton
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.blockOf_one_eq_.header:
theorem blockOf_one_eq_singleton {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    blockOf y 1 = {y}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_one.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_one_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_one.header:
theorem qOnePathSum_one_eq {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (A : Bond L → ℝ)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    qOnePathSum 1 A (⟨y, mem_CoarseLattice_one y⟩, μ) = A (y, μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_con.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_con.header:
theorem qOnePathSum_const {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (c : ℝ)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (hfit : ∀ ν, (y ν).val + ell ≤ L ν + 1) (μ : Fin 3) :
    qOnePathSum ell (fun _ => c) (⟨y, hy⟩, μ) = c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_con.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_const_witness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.qOnePathSum_con.header:
theorem qOnePathSum_const_witness (c : ℝ) :
    qOnePathSum witnessEll (fun _ => c) targetCoarseBond = c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.const_notMem_ke.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.const_notMem_ker_of_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.const_notMem_ke.header:
theorem const_notMem_ker_of_ne_zero (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (fun _ : Bond witnessL => c) ∉ LinearMap.ker (qOnePathSumLM witnessL witnessEll)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.card_coarseBond.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.card_coarseBond_lt_card_bond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.card_coarseBond.header:
theorem card_coarseBond_lt_card_bond :
    Fintype.card (LatticeOperators.CoarseBond witnessL witnessEll) <
      Fintype.card (Bond witnessL)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.sum.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.sum_block_eq_sum_corners
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.sum.header:
theorem sum_block_eq_sum_corners {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ)
    (F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf y 2, F x = ∑ p : Bool × Bool × Bool, F (gCorner y p)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.car.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.card_blockOf_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.car.header:
theorem card_blockOf_two (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hfit : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val + 2 ≤ L μ + 1) :
    (blockOf y 2).card = 2 ^ 3

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.car.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.card_blockOf_two_real
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.car.header:
theorem card_blockOf_two_real (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hfit : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val + 2 ≤ L μ + 1) :
    (((blockOf y 2).card : ℝ)) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 : ℕ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.gCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.gCorner_off
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.gCo.header:
theorem gCorner_off (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ)
    (p : Bool × Bool × Bool) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((gCorner y p) μ).val - (y μ).val = gOff p μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.sta.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.staircaseBonds_gCorner
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.sta.header:
theorem staircaseBonds_gCorner (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ) (p : Bool × Bool × Bool) :
    staircaseBonds y (gCorner y p)
      = axisBonds y 2 (gOff p 2) ++ axisBonds (gInner y false p.2.2) 1 (gOff p 1)
          ++ axisBonds (gInner y p.2.1 p.2.2) 0 (gOff p 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.axi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.axisBonds_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.axi.header:
theorem axisBonds_zero (base : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    axisBonds base μ 0 = ([] : List (Bond L))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.axi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.axisBonds_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.axi.header:
theorem axisBonds_one (base : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    axisBonds base μ 1 = [((base, μ) : Bond L)]

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.gam.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.gammaTransport_eq_staircaseTransport
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.gam.header:
theorem gammaTransport_eq_staircaseTransport
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hlt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < L μ)
    (p : Bool × Bool × Bool) :
    staircaseTransport U y (gCorner y p) = gammaTransport U y p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.gCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.gCorner_apply_axis
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.gCo.header:
theorem gCorner_apply_axis (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : Bool × Bool × Bool) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (gCorner y p) μ = if gOff p μ = 1 then (periodicLatticeShift y μ) μ else y μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.gIn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.gInner_apply_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.gIn.header: theorem gInner_apply_zero (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (b c : Bool) : (gInner y b c) 0 = y 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.gam.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.gammaPath_gCorner
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.gam.header:
theorem gammaPath_gCorner (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QPrimeDenotation.kap.header:

    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam src dstarA : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hker : lam ∈ LinearMap.ker (QprimeBalaban U hdvd))
    (hweak : bondEnergy (gradValueCovariant U lam)
      = AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.covSiteInner lam src)
    (hadj : ∀ w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo,
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.covSiteInner w dstarA
        = AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHj.covBondInner (gradValueCovariant U w) A)
    (hproj : siteEnergy src ≤ siteEnergy dstarA) :
    siteEnergy lam ≤ 768 * bondEnergy A
      ∧ AdalyFormal.Balaban.GammaRecursion.UniformStepGamma
          (KappaBound.deltaPiConstLocal (24 * (4 / 10 ^ 10 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt 768)) (1/2 : ℝ)

deltaPrimePi_bound_kappa_discharged_qpri.header:
theorem deltaPrimePi_bound_kappa_discharged_qprime
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (J : Bond L → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (lam src dstarA : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (Jsup : ℝ)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hker : lam ∈ LinearMap.ker (QprimeBalaban U hdvd))
    (hweak : bondEnergy (gradValueCovariant U lam)
      = AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.covSiteInner lam src)
    (hadj : ∀ w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo,
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.covSiteInner w dstarA
        = AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHj.covBondInner (gradValueCovariant U w) A)
    (hproj : siteEnergy src ≤ siteEnergy dstarA)
    (hJ : ∀ b, frobNorm (J b) ≤ Jsup) :
    |deltaPrimePiForm U J lam A| ≤ deltaPiConst Jsup kappaTree * bondEnergy A

deltaPrimePi_bound_at_regular_U_qprime.name: deltaPrimePi_bound_at_regular_U_qprime
deltaPrimePi_bound_at_regular_U_qprime.header:
theorem deltaPrimePi_bound_at_regular_U_qprime
    {α₀ etaInvSq : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hη : 0 ≤ etaInvSq)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hreg : GaugeRegular α₀ U)
    (J : Bond L → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (pl : Bond L → Fin 4 → PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)
    (hJdef : ∀ b, J b = (etaInvSq : ℂ) •
      (AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.imHolonomy U (pl b 0)
        - AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.imHolonomy U (pl b 1)
        + AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.imHolonomy U (pl b 2)
        - AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.imHolonomy U (pl b 3)))
    (lam src dstarA : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hker : lam ∈ LinearMap.ker (QprimeBalaban U hdvd))
    (hweak : bondEnergy (gradValueCovariant U lam)
      = AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.covSiteInner lam src)
    (hadj : ∀ w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo,
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.covSiteInner w dstarA
        = AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHj.covBondInner (gradValueCovariant U w) A)
    (hproj : siteEnergy src ≤ siteEnergy dstarA) :
    |deltaPrimePiForm U J lam A|
      ≤ deltaPiConst (24 * etaInvSq * α₀) kappaTree * bondEnergy A

composed_coercivity_general_qprime.name: composed_coercivity_general_qprime
composed_coercivity_general_qprime.header:
theorem composed_coercivity_general_qprime
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {α₀ etaInvSq : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hη : 0 ≤ etaInvSq)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hreg : GaugeRegular α₀ U)
    (J : Bond L → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (pl : Bond L → Fin 4 → PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)
    (hJdef : ∀ b, J b = (etaInvSq : ℂ) •
      (AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.imHolonomy U (pl b 0)
        - AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.imHolonomy U (pl b 1)
        + AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.imHolonomy U (pl b 2)
        - AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.imHolonomy U (pl b 3)))
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hQ : ∀ b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.CoarseBond L 2,
      lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 2 A b = 0)
    (lam src dstarA : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)
    (hker : lam ∈ LinearMap.ker (QprimeBalaban U hdvd))
    (hweak : bondEnergy (gradValueCovariant U lam)
      = AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.covSiteInner lam src)
    (hadj : ∀ w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo,
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.covSiteInner w dstarA
        = AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHj.covBondInner (gradValueCovariant U w) A)
    (hproj : siteEnergy src ≤ siteEnergy dstarA)
    {γstar : ℝ} (hγstar : 0 < γstar) (hagg : AggregateFibreBound L U γstar)
    (hcrit : deltaPiConst (24 * etaInvSq * α₀) kappaTree ≤ γstar * (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2)) :
    γstar * bondEnergy A
        ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected U A + pAx A (CoarseLattice L 2) 2
      ∧ gammaFibre * bondSup A
        ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected (trivialU L) A + pAx A (CoarseLattice L 2) 2
      ∧ |deltaPrimePiForm U J lam A|
        ≤ deltaPiConst (24 * etaInvSq * α₀) kappaTree * bondEnergy A
      ∧ ∀ k : ℕ,
          0 < gammaSeq γstar (deltaPiConst (24 * etaInvSq * α₀) kappaTree) (1 / 2 : ℝ) k
            ∧ γstar
              ≤ gammaSeq γstar (deltaPiConst (24 * etaInvSq * α₀) kappaTree) (1 / 2 : ℝ) k

        ⟨AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.witnessY, by decide⟩ = 0

QSlabExpand.blockOf_fits_eq_image.header:
theorem blockOf_fits_eq_image (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ)

QSlabExpand.topIds0_freeDir.header: theorem topIds0_freeDir : ∀ i ∈ topIds0, freeDir i = 0

QSlabExpand.topIds2_freeDir.name: QSlabExpand.topIds2_freeDir

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.pathStep_.header: theorem pathStep_zero (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : pathStep x μ 0 = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.pathStep_.header:
theorem pathStep_apply_ne (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) (j : ℕ) (h : ν ≠ μ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.pathStep_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.pathStep_apply_self_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.pathStep_.header:
theorem pathStep_apply_self_val (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (j : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.pathStep_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.pathStep_bijective

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.blockCorn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.blockCorner_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.blockCorn.header:
theorem blockCorner_val (ell : ℕ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.lastLayer.header: noncomputable def lastLayerLift (ell : ℕ) (f : CoarseBond L ell → ℝ) (b : Bond L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.lastLayer.header:
theorem lastLayerLift_add (ell : ℕ) (f g : CoarseBond L ell → ℝ) (b : Bond L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.lastLayer.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.lastLayerLift_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.lastLayer.header:
theorem lastLayerLift_smul (ell : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f : CoarseBond L ell → ℝ) (b : Bond L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.residue_h.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.residue_hit_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.residue_h.header:
theorem residue_hit_iff {ell i j : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hi : i < ell) (hj : j < ell) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.lineInteg.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.lineIntegralValue_lastLayerLift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.lineInteg.header:
theorem lineIntegralValue_lastLayerLift {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.lineCoars.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.lineCoarseRestrict_lastLayerLift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.lineCoars.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.coarseBon.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.read_sum_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.read_sum_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.read_sum_.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.qcOp_opNo.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.SuppliedC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.SuppliedClauses
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.SuppliedC.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.suppliedC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.suppliedClauses_imp_clauses
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.suppliedC.header:
theorem suppliedClauses_imp_clauses {ell : ℕ} (Lreal : ℝ) (d : ℕ) (Ccorr α₀ : ℝ)

    Claim18Carrier.Clauses (Hfine := BondSpace L) (Hcoarse := CoarseBondSpace L ell)
      Lreal d Ccorr α₀ C2 (qcOp L ell) (qcSection L ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.suppliedC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.suppliedClauses_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.suppliedC.header:
theorem suppliedClauses_iff {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (Lreal : ℝ) (d : ℕ) (Ccorr α₀ : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ Ccorr) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀)
    (C2 : BondSpace L →L[ℝ] BondSpace L) :
    SuppliedClauses L ell Lreal d Ccorr α₀ C2 ↔
      ((1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ (BondSpace L) → 1 ≤ ‖C2‖) ∧
        ‖C2 ∘L qcSection L ell‖ ≤ Lreal ^ ((d : ℝ) - 1) ∧
        C2 ∘L qcSection L ell ≠ 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.supplied_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.supplied_blocks_zero_C2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.supplied_.header:
theorem supplied_blocks_zero_C2 {ell : ℕ} (Lreal : ℝ) (d : ℕ) (Ccorr α₀ : ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.supplied_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.supplied_blocks_zero_transfer
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.supplied_.header:
theorem supplied_blocks_zero_transfer {ell : ℕ} (Lreal : ℝ) (d : ℕ) (Ccorr α₀ : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.supplied_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.supplied_forces_noninjective
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.supplied_.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.blockOf_o.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.blockOf_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.blockOf_o.header: theorem blockOf_one (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : blockOf y 1 = {y}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.supplied_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.supplied_unsatisfiable_at_ell_one

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.qcOp_ne_z.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.qcOp_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.qcOp_ne_z.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.one_le_fi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.one_le_finrank_coarse

theorem two_le_finrank_bondSpace {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.nextCorne.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.nextCornerSite_mem_coarse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.nextCorne.header:
theorem nextCornerSite_mem_coarse {ell : ℕ} (h : ell < L 0 + 1) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.nextCorne.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.nextCornerSite_ne_origin
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.nextCorne.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.lastLayer.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.lastLayerSite_mem_block
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.lastLayer.header:
theorem lastLayerSite_mem_block {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (h : ell < L 0 + 1) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.blockCorn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.blockCorner_step_out
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.blockCorn.header:
theorem blockCorner_step_out {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (h : ell < L 0 + 1) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.constExtL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.constExtLift_not_section
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.constExtL.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.constExtL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.constExtLift_zero_no_discharge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QcEquation.constExtL.header:
theorem constExtLift_zero_no_discharge {ell : ℕ} :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.inStepBl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.inStepBlock
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.inStepBl.header: abbrev inStepBlock (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s ell : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBloc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBlockOf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBloc.header: def stepBlockOf (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s ell : ℕ) : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.mem_step.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.mem_stepBlockOf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.mem_step.header:
theorem mem_stepBlockOf {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {s ell : ℕ} :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBloc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBlockOf_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBloc.header:
theorem stepBlockOf_one (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) :
    stepBlockOf y 1 ell = blockOf y ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.self_mem.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.self_mem_stepBlockOf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.self_mem.header:
theorem self_mem_stepBlockOf (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {s ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.card_ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.card_stepBlockOf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.card_ste.header:
theorem card_stepBlockOf (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + s * ell ≤ L μ + 1) :
    (stepBlockOf y s ell).card = ell ^ 3

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.witnessY.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.witnessY_not_fit
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.witnessY.header: theorem witnessY_not_fit : ¬ (∀ μ : Fin 3, (witnessY μ).val + 2 * 3 ≤ witnessL μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBloc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBlockOf_subset_blockOf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBloc.header:
theorem stepBlockOf_subset_blockOf {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {s ell : ℕ} :
    stepBlockOf y s ell ⊆ blockOf y (s * ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.blockOf_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.blockOf_subset_of_mem_stepBlockOf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.blockOf_one_eq_singleton
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.blockOf_.header: theorem blockOf_one_eq_singleton (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : blockOf y 1 = {y}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.not_mem_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.not_mem_stepBlockOf_ell_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.not_mem_.header:
theorem not_mem_stepBlockOf_ell_zero (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ) :
