AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBloc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBlockOf_one_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepBloc.header: theorem stepBlockOf_one_one (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : stepBlockOf y 1 1 = {y}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarseSh.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarseShift_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarseSh.header:
theorem coarseShift_one (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift y 1 μ = pathSite y μ 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.pathSite.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.pathSite_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.pathSite.header:
theorem pathSite_add (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (a b : ℕ) :
    pathSite (pathSite y μ a) μ b = pathSite y μ (b + a)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePathHolonomy_nil
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.header:
theorem coarsePathHolonomy_nil {G : Type*} [Group G] (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    coarsePathHolonomy s V y [] = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePathHolonomy_cons
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.header:
theorem coarsePathHolonomy_cons {G : Type*} [Group G] (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    (rest : List (Fin 3)) :
    coarsePathHolonomy s V y (μ :: rest)
      = V (y, μ) * coarsePathHolonomy s V (coarseShift y s μ) rest

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePathEndpoint_cons
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.header:
theorem coarsePathEndpoint_cons (s : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    (rest : List (Fin 3)) :
    coarsePathEndpoint s y (μ :: rest) = coarsePathEndpoint s (coarseShift y s μ) rest

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePathEndpoint_append
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.header:
theorem coarsePathEndpoint_append (s : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p q : List (Fin 3)) :
    coarsePathEndpoint s y (p ++ q)
      = coarsePathEndpoint s (coarsePathEndpoint s y p) q

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePathHolonomy_append
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.header:
theorem coarsePathHolonomy_append {G : Type*} [Group G] (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p q : List (Fin 3)) :
    coarsePathHolonomy s V y (p ++ q)
      = coarsePathHolonomy s V y p * coarsePathHolonomy s V (coarsePathEndpoint s y p) q

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePathEndpoint_replicate
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.header:
theorem coarsePathEndpoint_replicate (s : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    coarsePathEndpoint s y (List.replicate n μ) = pathSite y μ (s * n)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePathHolonomy_one_replicate
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.header:
theorem coarsePathHolonomy_one_replicate {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (base : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    coarsePathHolonomy 1 V base (List.replicate n μ) = pathTransport V (axisBonds base μ n)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarseCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarseCoordSteps_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarseCo.header:
theorem coarseCoordSteps_one {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (μ : Fin 3)
    (h : (y μ).val ≤ (x μ).val) :
    coarseCoordSteps 1 y x μ = (x μ).val - (y μ).val

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarseGa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarseGammaPath_one_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarseGa.header:
theorem coarseGammaPath_one_eq {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (h : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val ≤ (x μ).val) :
    coarseGammaPath 1 y x = List.replicate ((x 2).val - (y 2).val) 2 ++
      (List.replicate ((x 1).val - (y 1).val) 1 ++
        List.replicate ((x 0).val - (y 0).val) 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePathHolonomy_one_eq_staircaseTransport
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.header:
theorem coarsePathHolonomy_one_eq_staircaseTransport {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (h : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val ≤ (x μ).val) :
    coarsePathHolonomy 1 V y (coarseGammaPath 1 y x) = staircaseTransport V y x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAver.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAverage
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAver.header:
noncomputable def stepAverage (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAver.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAverage_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAver.header:
theorem stepAverage_add (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (lam1 lam2 : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    stepAverage s V ell (lam1 + lam2) y = stepAverage s V ell lam1 y + stepAverage s V ell lam2 y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAver.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAverage_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAver.header:
theorem stepAverage_smul (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    stepAverage s V ell (c • lam) y = c • stepAverage s V ell lam y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAver.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAverage_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAver.header:
theorem stepAverage_one
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    stepAverage 1 V ell lam y = coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU V ell lam y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAver.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAverage_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAver.header:
theorem stepAverage_trivialU (s ell : ℕ) (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    stepAverage s (trivialU L) ell lam y
      = (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) • ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, lam x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAver.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAverage_covariantly_constant

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
noncomputable def Qcomposite
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ) :
    ℕ → (PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) → (PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)
  | 0 => fun lam => lam
  | (j + 1) => fun lam => stepAverage (ell ^ j) (bg j) ell (Qcomposite bg ell j lam)

                                                    
theorem Qcomposite_zero
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : Qcomposite bg ell 0 lam = lam

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposite_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
theorem Qcomposite_zero
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : Qcomposite bg ell 0 lam = lam

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposite_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
theorem Qcomposite_succ
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell j : ℕ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    Qcomposite bg ell (j + 1) lam
      = stepAverage (ell ^ j) (bg j) ell (Qcomposite bg ell j lam)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposite_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
theorem Qcomposite_one
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    Qcomposite bg ell 1 lam = coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU (bg 0) ell lam

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposite_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
theorem Qcomposite_add
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell j : ℕ)
    (lam1 lam2 : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    Qcomposite bg ell j (lam1 + lam2) = Qcomposite bg ell j lam1 + Qcomposite bg ell j lam2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposite_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
theorem Qcomposite_smul
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell j : ℕ)
    (c : ℝ) (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    Qcomposite bg ell j (c • lam) = c • Qcomposite bg ell j lam

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.QcompositeLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
noncomputable def QcompositeLM
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell j : ℕ) :
    (PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] (PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.QcompositeLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
theorem QcompositeLM_apply
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell j : ℕ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    QcompositeLM bg ell j lam = Qcomposite bg ell j lam

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAver.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAverage_ell_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAver.header:
theorem stepAverage_ell_zero (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposite_ell_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
theorem Qcomposite_ell_zero
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (j : ℕ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Qcomposite bg 0 (j + 1) lam y = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposite_ell_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
theorem Qcomposite_ell_one
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (j : ℕ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    Qcomposite bg 1 j lam = lam

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarseGa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarseGaugeTransform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarseGa.header:
def coarseGaugeTransform {G : Type*} [Group G] (s : ℕ) (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarseGa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarseGaugeTransform_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarseGa.header:
theorem coarseGaugeTransform_one {G : Type*} [Group G] (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) :
    coarseGaugeTransform 1 γ V = periodicGaugeTransform γ V

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePathHolonomy_coarseGaugeTransform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.header:
theorem coarsePathHolonomy_coarseGaugeTransform {G : Type*} [Group G] (s : ℕ)
    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    coarsePathHolonomy s (coarseGaugeTransform s γ V) y p
      = γ y * coarsePathHolonomy s V y p * (γ (coarsePathEndpoint s y p))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.mul_coar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.mul_coarseCoordSteps
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.mul_coar.header:
theorem mul_coarseCoordSteps {s : ℕ} {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (μ : Fin 3)
    (hle : (y μ).val ≤ (x μ).val) (hdvd : s ∣ ((x μ).val - (y μ).val)) :
    s * coarseCoordSteps s y x μ = (x μ).val - (y μ).val

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarsePathEndpoint_coarseGammaPath

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAver.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAverage_gaugeTransform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAver.header:
theorem stepAverage_gaugeTransform (s : ℕ)
    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    stepAverage s (coarseGaugeTransform s γ V) ell (fun x => RMap (γ x) (lam x)) y
      = RMap (γ y) (stepAverage s V ell lam y)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposite_gaugeTransform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
theorem Qcomposite_gaugeTransform
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (j : ℕ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    Qcomposite (fun l => coarseGaugeTransform (ell ^ l) γ (bg l)) ell j
        (fun x => RMap (γ x) (lam x))
      = fun y => RMap (γ y) (Qcomposite bg ell j lam y)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposite_local
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
theorem Qcomposite_local
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell j : ℕ)
    {lam lam' : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo} {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), lam x = lam' x) :
    Qcomposite bg ell j lam y = Qcomposite bg ell j lam' y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.ancOf.header: def ancOf (y x₁ x₀ : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.ancOf_ze.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.ancOf_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.ancOf_ze.header: theorem ancOf_zero (y x₁ x₀ : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ancOf y x₁ x₀ 0 = x₀

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.ancOf_on.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.ancOf_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.ancOf_on.header: theorem ancOf_one (y x₁ x₀ : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ancOf y x₁ x₀ 1 = x₁

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.ancOf_tw.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.ancOf_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.ancOf_tw.header: theorem ancOf_two (y x₁ x₀ : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ancOf y x₁ x₀ 2 = y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepVar_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepVar_eq_holonomy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepVar_.header:
theorem stepVar_eq_holonomy (ell : ℕ)
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (anc : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite L) (l : ℕ) :
    stepVar ell bg anc l
      = coarsePathHolonomy (ell ^ l) (bg l) (anc (l + 1))
          (coarseGammaPath (ell ^ l) (anc (l + 1)) (anc l))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposite_two_expand
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
theorem Qcomposite_two_expand
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Qcomposite bg ell 2 lam y
      = (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) • ∑ x₁ ∈ stepBlockOf y (ell ^ 1) ell,
          (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) • ∑ x₀ ∈ stepBlockOf x₁ (ell ^ 0) ell,
            RMap (gammaVar ell bg (ancOf y x₁ x₀) 2) (lam x₀)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposite_trivial_tower_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
theorem Qcomposite_trivial_tower_one (ell : ℕ) (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    Qcomposite (fun _ => trivialU L) ell 1 lam = coarseRestrictSiteCovariant ell lam

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposite_background_dependent
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
theorem Qcomposite_background_dependent :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.deltaTwo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.deltaTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.deltaTwo.header: noncomputable def deltaTwo : PeriodicLatticeSite witnessL → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.towerAtO.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.towerAtOne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.towerAtO.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposite_two_deltaTwo_value
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
theorem Qcomposite_two_deltaTwo_value

    Qcomposite (towerAtOne V) 2 2 deltaTwo witnessY

AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposite_two_level_one_dependent
AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.Qcomposi.header:
theorem Qcomposite_two_level_one_dependent :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.matCL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.matCLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.matCL.header:
theorem matCLM_apply {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.block.header: theorem blockRepSite_one (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lat) : blockRepSite 1 x = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.block.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.blockRepBond_one

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.floor.header: theorem floorMul_mono (n : ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≤ b) : a / n * n ≤ b / n * n

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.floor.header: theorem floorMul_le (n a : ℕ) : a / n * n ≤ a

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.floor.header: theorem floorMul_idem {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (a : ℕ) : (a / n * n) / n * n = a / n * n

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.sumCL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.sumCLMof_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.sumCL.header:
theorem sumCLMof_apply (r : Bond Lat → Bond Lat) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Bond Lat))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.delta.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.deltaOf_id_eq_id

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.flatL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.flatLadder_fails_rg_scale_dependence
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.flatL.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.rgDel.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.rgDel.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.sumCL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.sumCLMof_single_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.sumCL.header:
theorem sumCLMof_single_ne_zero (r : Bond Lat → Bond Lat) (b : Bond Lat) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.sumCL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.sumCLMof_tower

theorem sumCLMof_tower {a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a ∣ b) :

theorem sumCLMof_eq_zero_of_deltaOf (r : Bond Lat → Bond Lat)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.finra.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.finrank_V_le_card_coarse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.finra.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.card_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.card_coarseBondIdx_le_three
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.card_.header:
theorem card_coarseBondIdx_le_three {n : ℕ} (hn : ∀ μ : Fin 3, Lat μ + 1 ≤ n) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.rgDel.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.rgDelta_pow_tower
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.rgDel.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.rgDel.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.rgDelta_pow_ker_mono

    {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Bond Lat)} (hv : rgDelta (Lat := Lat) (ell ^ k₁) v = 0) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.rgDel.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.rgDelta_pow_one_k_constant
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.rgDel.header:
theorem rgDelta_pow_one_k_constant (k : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.rgDel.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.rgDelta_pow_one_fails_rg_scale_dependence
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.rgDel.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.rgDel.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.rgDelta_pow_zero_ne_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCoarse.rgDel.header:
theorem rgDelta_pow_zero_ne_one {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (μ₀ : Fin 3) (h : 1 ≤ Lat μ₀) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.eq_zero.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.eq_zero_of_coercive_of_apply_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.eq_zero.header:

    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hc : ∀ v ∈ V, γ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ v (Δ v) : ℝ))
    {v : H} (hv : v ∈ V) (h0 : Δ v = 0) : v = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.not_coe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.not_coercive_of_mem_ker
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.not_coe.header:
theorem not_coercive_of_mem_ker (Δ : H →L[ℝ] H) (V : Submodule ℝ H)
    {v : H} (hv : v ∈ V) (hvne : v ≠ 0) (h0 : Δ v = 0) :
    ¬ ∃ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ ∧ ∀ w ∈ V, γ * ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ w (Δ w) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.apply_e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.apply_eq_zero_of_factor
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.apply_e.header:
theorem apply_eq_zero_of_factor (A : W →L[ℝ] H) (B : H →L[ℝ] W) {v : H} (h : B v = 0) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.factor_.header:

    {v : H} (hv : v ∈ V) (h0 : B v = 0) : v = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.factor_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.factor_injective_on_subtype
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.factor_.header:
theorem factor_injective_on_subtype (A : W →L[ℝ] H) (B : H →L[ℝ] W) (V : Submodule ℝ H) (γ : ℝ)
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hc : ∀ v ∈ V, γ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ v ((A.comp B) v) : ℝ)) :
    Function.Injective ((B : H →ₗ[ℝ] W).comp V.subtype)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.finrank.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.finrank_le_of_coercive_factor
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.finrank.header:
theorem finrank_le_of_coercive_factor [FiniteDimensional ℝ H] [FiniteDimensional ℝ W]
    (A : W →L[ℝ] H) (B : H →L[ℝ] W) (V : Submodule ℝ H) (γ : ℝ)
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hc : ∀ v ∈ V, γ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ v ((A.comp B) v) : ℝ)) :
    Module.finrank ℝ V ≤ Module.finrank ℝ W

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.Coerciv.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.CoercivityHypothesis.factor_injOn

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.Coerciv.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.CoercivityHypothesis.finrank_V_le_of_factor
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.Coerciv.header:

    (k : ℕ) (U : Uconfig) (A : W →L[ℝ] H) (B : H →L[ℝ] W)
    (hfac : cohyp.Δ k U = A.comp B) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.no_unif.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.no_uniform_ladder_of_one_small_rung
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.no_unif.header:
theorem no_uniform_ladder_of_one_small_rung (cohyp : Balaban.CoercivityHypothesis H Uconfig)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.no_unif.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.no_uniform_ladder_of_one_coarsening_rung
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.no_unif.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.coerciv.header:
theorem coercive_factor_exists_witness :
    ∃ (V : Submodule ℝ ℝ) (γ : ℝ) (A B : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ),
      V ≠ ⊥ ∧ 0 < γ ∧ ∀ v ∈ V, γ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ v ((A.comp B) v) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.not_coe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.not_coercive_of_mem_ker_fires
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.not_coe.header:
theorem not_coercive_of_mem_ker_fires :
    ¬ ∃ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ ∧ ∀ w ∈ (⊤ : Submodule ℝ ℝ),
        γ * ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ w ((0 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) w) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.bot_coe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.bot_coercive_trivially
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.bot_coe.header:
theorem bot_coercive_trivially (Δ : H →L[ℝ] H) (γ : ℝ) :
    ∀ v ∈ (⊥ : Submodule ℝ H), γ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ v (Δ v) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.zero_ga.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.zero_gamma_no_constraint
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RGLadderCore.zero_ga.header:
theorem zero_gamma_no_constraint (V : Submodule ℝ H) :
    ∀ v ∈ V, (0 : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ v ((0 : H →L[ℝ] H) v) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq.header: noncomputable def frobSq (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq.header: theorem frobSq_nonneg (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : 0 ≤ frobSq M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq_eq_trace
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq.header:
theorem frobSq_eq_trace (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    frobSq M = (Matrix.trace (M * Mᴴ)).re

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq_mul_right_isometry
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq.header:
theorem frobSq_mul_right_isometry (M W : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hW : W * Wᴴ = 1) :
    frobSq (M * W) = frobSq M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq_sub_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq.header:
theorem frobSq_sub_le (A B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    frobSq (A - B) ≤ 2 * frobSq A + 2 * frobSq B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq_mul_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobSq.header:
theorem frobSq_mul_le (A B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    frobSq (A * B) ≤ frobSq A * frobSq B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNorm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNo.header: noncomputable def frobNorm (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNorm_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNo.header: theorem frobNorm_nonneg (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : 0 ≤ frobNorm M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNorm_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNo.header: theorem frobNorm_sq (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : frobNorm M ^ 2 = frobSq M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.norm_s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.norm_sq_eq_half_frobSq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.norm_s.header:
theorem norm_sq_eq_half_frobSq (Y : SuTwo) :
    ‖Y‖ ^ 2 = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * frobSq (Y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.norm_R.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.norm_RMap_sub_self_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.norm_R.header:
theorem norm_RMap_sub_self_le (U : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (X : SuTwo) :
    ‖RMap U X - X‖ ≤ 2 * frobNorm ((U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) * ‖X‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.norm_R.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.norm_RMap_one_sub_self_le_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.norm_R.header:
theorem norm_RMap_one_sub_self_le_zero (X : SuTwo) :
    ‖RMap (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) X - X‖ ≤ 0

RatSOSEval.listSum_finsetSum_comm.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.coar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.coarse_le_of_shifted_bound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.coar.header:
theorem coarse_le_of_shifted_bound
    (hadj : IsAdjointPair Q Qstar) (hMG : ∀ x : H, M (G x) = x)
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : 0 ≤ a)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.coar.header:

    (γ / q ^ 2 + a) * (inner ℝ B (coarseComposite Q G Qstar B) : ℝ) ≤ ‖B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.coar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.coarse_sym

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.brid.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.bridge_coercive_prim
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.brid.header:
theorem bridge_coercive_prim
    (hadj : IsAdjointPair Q Qstar)

    (γ / q ^ 2) * ‖B‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ B (S B) : ℝ) - a * ‖B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.brid.header:
theorem bridge_coercive_with_source_prim
    (src : K → ℝ) (ε : ℝ)
    (hadj : IsAdjointPair Q Qstar)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.deltaKQuadForm_coercive_of_G1_inverse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.delt.header:
theorem deltaKQuadForm_coercive_of_G1_inverse
    (F : RGScaleFamily H) (k : ℕ) (M : H →L[ℝ] H) (γ q ε : ℝ)
    (hadj : IsAdjointPair (F.Q k) (F.Qstar k))
    (hMsym : ∀ u v : H, (inner ℝ u (M v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (M u) v : ℝ))
    (hMG : ∀ x : H, M (G1 F k x) = x)
    (hGM : ∀ x : H, G1 F k (M x) = x)
    (hunit : IsUnit ((F.Q k).comp ((G1 F k).comp (F.Qstar k))))
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : 0 ≤ F.a k)
    (hMcoerc : ∀ x : H,
      γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 + (F.a k) * ‖(F.Q k) x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (M x) : ℝ))
    (hQ : ∀ x : H, ‖(F.Q k) x‖ ≤ q * ‖x‖)
    (hsrc : ∀ B : H, |2 * (inner ℝ (F.H1 k (F.Dtilde2 k B)) (F.J k) : ℝ)| ≤ ε * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    (B : H) :
    (γ / q ^ 2 - ε) * ‖B‖ ^ 2 ≤ deltaKQuadForm F k B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.delt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.deltaKQuadForm_coercive_of_fine_coercivity
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.delt.header:
theorem deltaKQuadForm_coercive_of_fine_coercivity
    (F : RGScaleFamily H) (k : ℕ) (M₀ : H →L[ℝ] H) (γ q ε : ℝ)
    (hadj : IsAdjointPair (F.Q k) (F.Qstar k))
    (hM₀sym : ∀ u v : H, (inner ℝ u (M₀ v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (M₀ u) v : ℝ))
    (hMG : ∀ x : H, M₀ (G1 F k x) + (F.Qstar k) ((F.a k) • (F.Q k) (G1 F k x)) = x)
    (hGM : ∀ x : H, G1 F k (M₀ x + (F.Qstar k) ((F.a k) • (F.Q k) x)) = x)
    (hunit : IsUnit ((F.Q k).comp ((G1 F k).comp (F.Qstar k))))
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : 0 ≤ F.a k)
    (hcoerc : ∀ x : H, γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (M₀ x) : ℝ))
    (hQ : ∀ x : H, ‖(F.Q k) x‖ ≤ q * ‖x‖)
    (hsrc : ∀ B : H, |2 * (inner ℝ (F.H1 k (F.Dtilde2 k B)) (F.J k) : ℝ)| ≤ ε * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    (B : H) :
    (γ / q ^ 2 - ε) * ‖B‖ ^ 2 ≤ deltaKQuadForm F k B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.brid.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.bridge_from_fine_operator
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.brid.header:
theorem bridge_from_fine_operator
    {K : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℝ K] [Nontrivial K]
    (Delta P : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L) (W : BondFnL2 L → Prop)
    (Q : BondFnL2 L → K) (Qstar : K → BondFnL2 L)
    (G : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L) (T S : K →L[ℝ] K) (a γ q : ℝ)
    (hadj : ∀ (x : BondFnL2 L) (B : K),
      (inner ℝ (Qstar B) x : ℝ) = (inner ℝ B (Q x) : ℝ))
    (hDeltaSym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L,
      (inner ℝ u (Delta v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (Delta u) v : ℝ))
    (hGW : ∀ B : K, W (G (Qstar B)))
    (hDeltaCoercW : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, W x → γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (Delta x) : ℝ))
    (hPpos : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, (0 : ℝ) ≤ (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ))
    (hPsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L, (inner ℝ u (P v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (P u) v : ℝ))
    (hT : ∀ B : K, T B = Q (G (Qstar B)))
    (hG1 : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, fineMapOf Delta P Q Qstar a (G x) = x)
    (hTS : ∀ B : K, T (S B) = B)
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hQ : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, ‖Q x‖ ≤ q * ‖x‖) (B : K) :
    (γ / q ^ 2) * ‖B‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ B (S B) : ℝ) - a * ‖B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.brid.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.bridge_from_piExtended_normalized_threeTen
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.brid.header:
theorem bridge_from_piExtended_normalized_threeTen
    {K : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℝ K] [Nontrivial K]
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (DeltaPrimePi P : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L) (W : BondFnL2 L → Prop)
    (Q : BondFnL2 L → K) (Qstar : K → BondFnL2 L)
    (G : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L) (T S : K →L[ℝ] K) (a γ δ q : ℝ)
    (hadj : ∀ (x : BondFnL2 L) (B : K),
      (inner ℝ (Qstar B) x : ℝ) = (inner ℝ B (Q x) : ℝ))
    (hPiSym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L,
      (inner ℝ u (DeltaPrimePi v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (DeltaPrimePi u) v : ℝ))
    (hpi : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, |(inner ℝ x (DeltaPrimePi x) : ℝ)| ≤ δ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hPpos : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, (0 : ℝ) ≤ (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ))
    (hPsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L, (inner ℝ u (P v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (P u) v : ℝ))
    (hGW : ∀ B : K, W (G (Qstar B)))
    (hT : ∀ B : K, T B = Q (G (Qstar B)))
    (hG1 : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L,
      fineMapOf (piExtendedMap (fun y => deltaKCLMNormalized U y) DeltaPrimePi) P Q Qstar a (G x)
        = x)
    (hTS : ∀ B : K, T (S B) = B)
    (hγδ : 0 < γ - δ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (h310W : ∀ A : Bond L → SuTwo, W (WithLp.toLp 2 A) →
      γ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 A : BondFnL2 L)‖ ^ 2 ≤ deltaKQuadFormNormalizedCorrected U A)
    (hQ : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, ‖Q x‖ ≤ q * ‖x‖) (B : K) :
    ((γ - δ) / q ^ 2) * ‖B‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ B (S B) : ℝ) - a * ‖B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.brid.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.bridge_with_source_of_sourceFree

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RecursiveBridge.delt.header:

    (hsa : ∀ x y : 𝔄, ⟪G2 x, y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x, G2 y⟫_ℝ)
    (hQadj : ∀ (x : 𝔄) (f : 𝔅t), ⟪Qts f, x⟫_ℝ = ⟪f, Qt x⟫_ℝ)
    (hKpos : ∀ f : 𝔅t, 0 ≤ ⟪f, Kt f⟫_ℝ)
                                            
    (γG : ℝ) (hγG : 0 ≤ γG) (hG2 : ∀ A : 𝔄, ⟪A, G2 A⟫_ℝ ≤ γG * ‖A‖ ^ 2)
    (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hT : ∀ B : 𝔅, ‖rightFactor Qs Dbs mus B‖ ≤ κ * ‖B‖)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUCurvedWitnes.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUCurvedWitness.curved_regularU_coercivity
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUCurvedWitnes.header:
theorem curved_regularU_coercivity :
                                                                                      
    holonomyElem curvedU curvedPlaq ≠ (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) ∧
    (∀ (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5 → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
        (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) witL5),
        (∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette witL5, holonomyElem V p = 1) →
        curvedU ≠ periodicGaugeTransform γ V) ∧
    IsRegularHolonomy curvedU (8 / 16000001 : ℝ) ∧
    0 < frobSupBond curvedU ∧
                                                                   
    (∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5, y ∈ CoarseLattice witL5 2 →
        ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5, x ∈ blockOf y 2 →
        ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, curvedA b = 0) ∧
    (∀ c : CoarseBond witL5 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov curvedU 2 curvedA c = 0) ∧
                                
    curvedA ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < bondEnergy curvedA ∧
                                                                
    0 < Real.sqrt ((1 / 108) * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4) - 64 * frobSupBond curvedU ^ 2)
        - 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond curvedU ∧
    (1 / 4000 : ℝ) ≤
      (Real.sqrt ((1 / 108) * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4) - 64 * frobSupBond curvedU ^ 2)
        - 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond curvedU) ^ 2 ∧
    (Real.sqrt ((1 / 108) * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4) - 64 * frobSupBond curvedU ^ 2)
        - 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond curvedU) ^ 2 * bondEnergy curvedA
      ≤ dstarDQuadForm curvedU curvedA

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUCurvedWitnes.header:

    ∃ (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) witL5)
      (A : Bond witL5 → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette witL5),
      holonomyElem U p ≠ (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) ∧
      (∀ (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5 → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
          (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) witL5),
          (∀ q : PeriodicLatticePlaquette witL5, holonomyElem V q = 1) →
          U ≠ periodicGaugeTransform γ V) ∧
      IsRegularHolonomy U (8 / 16000001 : ℝ) ∧
      0 < frobSupBond U ∧
      (∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5, y ∈ CoarseLattice witL5 2 →
          ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite witL5, x ∈ blockOf y 2 →
          ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, A b = 0) ∧
      (∀ c : CoarseBond witL5 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov U 2 A c = 0) ∧
      A ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < bondEnergy A ∧
      0 < Real.sqrt ((1 / 108) * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4) - 64 * frobSupBond U ^ 2)
          - 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond U ∧
      (1 / 4000 : ℝ) ≤
        (Real.sqrt ((1 / 108) * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4) - 64 * frobSupBond U ^ 2)
          - 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond U) ^ 2 ∧
      (Real.sqrt ((1 / 108) * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4) - 64 * frobSupBond U ^ 2)
          - 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond U) ^ 2 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.suCoo.header:
theorem suCoordLM_coarseCurlSuTwo {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (i : Fin 3)
    (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (p : CoarsePlaquette L ell) :
    suCoordLM i (coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd B p)
      = coarseCurlValue hdvd (fun c => suCoordLM i (B c)) p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.coars.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.coarseCurlEnergySuTwo_eq_sum_coord
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.coars.header:
theorem coarseCurlEnergySuTwo_eq_sum_coord {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) :
    coarseCurlEnergySuTwo hdvd B
      = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : CoarsePlaquette L ell,
          (coarseCurlValue hdvd (fun c => suCoordLM i (B c)) p) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.plaqE.header:
theorem plaqEnergy_curl_trivialU_eq_sum (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.ell_c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.ell_coarseCurlEnergy_le_plaqEnergy_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.ell_c.header:
theorem ell_coarseCurlEnergy_le_plaqEnergy_trivialU {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.lineC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.lineCoarseRestrictCov_hjExtension
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.lineC.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.delta.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.schur.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.schur_ge_ell_coarseCurlEnergy_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.schur.header:
theorem schur_ge_ell_coarseCurlEnergy_trivialU {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.lineC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.lineCoarseRestrictCov_one_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.lineC.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.coars.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.covCo.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.gamma.header:
theorem gamma0_coercivity_fibre_one
    (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ L μ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful 1 levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hadm : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L 2 →
      ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y 2 → ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, B b = 0)
    (hkerU : ∀ c : CoarseBond L 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov U 2 B c = 0)
    (hthr : 64 * frobSupBond U ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 108) * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4))
    (hsmall : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((1 / 108) * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4) - 64 * frobSupBond U ^ 2)
        - 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond U) :
    (Real.sqrt ((1 / 108) * (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4) - 64 * frobSupBond U ^ 2)
        - 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond U) ^ 2
        * covCoarseBondInner (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U 1 B) (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U 1 B)
      ≤ deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful 1 levels U B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.regul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.regularU_constant_lower
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.regul.header:
theorem regularU_constant_lower {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hle : a ≤ 1 / 500) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.coars.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.coars.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.coarseCurlPoincare_fibre_one_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.coars.header:
theorem coarseCurlPoincare_fibre_one_trivialU
    (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ L μ) (hdvd2 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))

    (hker : ∀ c : CoarseBond L 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 2 B c = 0) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.coars.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.lhs_v.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.lhs_vanishes_when_constraint_equals_fibre
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.lhs_v.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.gamma.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.gamma0_fibre_one_nondegenerate
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.gamma.header:
theorem gamma0_fibre_one_nondegenerate
    (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ L μ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hreg : frobSupBond U ≤ 1 / 500)
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful 1 levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection] :
    0 < (1 / 25600 : ℝ) * covCoarseBondInner
          (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U 1 (RegularUDomainWitnessGeneralU.genWitness U))
          (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U 1 (RegularUDomainWitnessGeneralU.genWitness U)) ∧
      (1 / 25600 : ℝ) * covCoarseBondInner
          (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U 1 (RegularUDomainWitnessGeneralU.genWitness U))
          (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U 1 (RegularUDomainWitnessGeneralU.genWitness U))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.gamma.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.gamma0_fibre_one_at_curved
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.gamma.header:
theorem gamma0_fibre_one_at_curved (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level RegularUDomainWitness.witL5))

    DeltaPrime.holonomyElem RegularUCurvedWitness.curvedU RegularUCurvedWitness.curvedPlaq
        ≠ (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) ∧

          (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM RegularUCurvedWitness.curvedU 1 RegularUCurvedWitness.curvedA)
          (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM RegularUCurvedWitness.curvedU 1 RegularUCurvedWitness.curvedA) ∧
      (1 / 25600 : ℝ) * covCoarseBondInner
          (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM RegularUCurvedWitness.curvedU 1 RegularUCurvedWitness.curvedA)
          (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM RegularUCurvedWitness.curvedU 1 RegularUCurvedWitness.curvedA)

            RegularUCurvedWitness.curvedA

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.no_co.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem curlDrift_apply
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    curlDrift U A p =
      (RMap (U (p.1, p.2.1.1)) (A (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1, p.2.1.2)) -
        A (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1, p.2.1.2)) -
      (RMap (U (p.1, p.2.1.2)) (A (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1)) -
        A (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.curlDrift_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem curlDrift_trivialU (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    curlDrift (trivialU L) A = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.deltaJ_sub_eq_inner
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem deltaJ_sub_eq_inner
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    dstarDQuadForm U A - dstarDQuadForm (trivialU L) A =
      inner ℝ (toPlaqL2 (curlValueCovariant U A) - toPlaqL2 (curlValueCovariant (trivialU L) A))
        (toPlaqL2 (curlValueCovariant U A) + toPlaqL2 (curlValueCovariant (trivialU L) A))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.abs_deltaJ_sub_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem abs_deltaJ_sub_le
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    |dstarDQuadForm U A - dstarDQuadForm (trivialU L) A| ≤
      ‖toPlaqL2 (curlValueCovariant U A) - toPlaqL2 (curlValueCovariant (trivialU L) A)‖ *
        (Real.sqrt (dstarDQuadForm U A) + Real.sqrt (dstarDQuadForm (trivialU L) A))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.norm_RMap_sub_self_le_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem norm_RMap_sub_self_le_two (U : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (X : SuTwo) :
    ‖RMap U X - X‖ ≤ 2 * ‖X‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.norm_curlDrift_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem norm_curlDrift_le
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    ‖curlDrift U A p‖ ≤
      2 * RMapLipschitz.frobNorm
            ((U (p.1, p.2.1.1) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) *
          ‖A (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1, p.2.1.2)‖ +
      2 * RMapLipschitz.frobNorm
            ((U (p.1, p.2.1.2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) *
          ‖A (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.norm_curlDrift_trivialU_le_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem norm_curlDrift_trivialU_le_zero (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    ‖curlDrift (trivialU L) A p‖ ≤ 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.plaqEnergy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header: noncomputable def plaqEnergy (f : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.bondEnergy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header: noncomputable def bondEnergy (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.plaqEnergy_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header: theorem plaqEnergy_nonneg (f : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo) : 0 ≤ plaqEnergy f

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.bondEnergy_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header: theorem bondEnergy_nonneg (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : 0 ≤ bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.norm_toPlaqL2_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem norm_toPlaqL2_sq (f : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo) :
    ‖toPlaqL2 f‖ ^ 2 = plaqEnergy f

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.norm_toPlaqL2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem norm_toPlaqL2 (f : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo) :
    ‖toPlaqL2 f‖ = Real.sqrt (plaqEnergy f)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.norm_curlDrift_sq_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem norm_curlDrift_sq_le
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L, RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α) :
    ‖curlDrift U A p‖ ^ 2 ≤
      8 * α ^ 2 *
        (‖A (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1, p.2.1.2)‖ ^ 2 +
         ‖A (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1)‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.dir_proj2_fiber_card_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem dir_proj2_fiber_card_le (j : Fin 3) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun dir : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections => dir.1.2 = j)).card ≤ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.dir_proj1_fiber_card_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem dir_proj1_fiber_card_le (j : Fin 3) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun dir : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections => dir.1.1 = j)).card ≤ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.sum_dir_proj2_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem sum_dir_proj2_le (w : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hw : ∀ ρ, 0 ≤ w ρ) :
    ∑ dir : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections, w dir.1.2 ≤ 2 * ∑ ρ : Fin 3, w ρ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.sum_dir_proj1_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem sum_dir_proj1_le (w : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hw : ∀ ρ, 0 ≤ w ρ) :
    ∑ dir : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections, w dir.1.1 ≤ 2 * ∑ ρ : Fin 3, w ρ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.sum_nbr1_sq_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem sum_nbr1_sq_le (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, ‖A (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1, p.2.1.2)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 2 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.sum_nbr2_sq_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem sum_nbr2_sq_le (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, ‖A (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 2 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.plaqEnergy_curlDrift_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem plaqEnergy_curlDrift_le
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L, RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α) :
    plaqEnergy (curlDrift U A) ≤ 32 * α ^ 2 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.norm_curlDrift_L2_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem norm_curlDrift_L2_le
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L, RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α) :
    Real.sqrt (plaqEnergy (curlDrift U A))
      ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * α * Real.sqrt (bondEnergy A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.norm_toPlaqL2_curlDrift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem norm_toPlaqL2_curlDrift
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ‖toPlaqL2 (curlValueCovariant U A) - toPlaqL2 (curlValueCovariant (trivialU L) A)‖
      = Real.sqrt (plaqEnergy (curlDrift U A))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.abs_deltaJ_sub_L2_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem abs_deltaJ_sub_L2_le
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L, RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α) :
    |dstarDQuadForm U A - dstarDQuadForm (trivialU L) A| ≤
      4 * Real.sqrt 2 * α * Real.sqrt (bondEnergy A) *
        (Real.sqrt (dstarDQuadForm U A) + Real.sqrt (dstarDQuadForm (trivialU L) A))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.frobSupBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
noncomputable def frobSupBond
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.frobNorm_le_frobSupBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem frobNorm_le_frobSupBond
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (b : Bond L) :
    RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ frobSupBond U

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.frobSupBond_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem frobSupBond_nonneg
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    0 ≤ frobSupBond U

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.norm_curlDrift_L2_le_sup
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem norm_curlDrift_L2_le_sup
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    Real.sqrt (plaqEnergy (curlDrift U A))
      ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond U * Real.sqrt (bondEnergy A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.abs_deltaJ_sub_L2_le_sup
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.header:
theorem abs_deltaJ_sub_L2_le_sup
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    |dstarDQuadForm U A - dstarDQuadForm (trivialU L) A| ≤
      4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond U * Real.sqrt (bondEnergy A) *
        (Real.sqrt (dstarDQuadForm U A) + Real.sqrt (dstarDQuadForm (trivialU L) A))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobV.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobVec
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobV.header: noncomputable def frobVec (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 2 × Fin 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobV.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobVec_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobV.header: theorem frobVec_add (M N : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : frobVec (M + N) = frobVec M + frobVec N

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobV.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobVec_sub
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobV.header: theorem frobVec_sub (M N : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : frobVec (M - N) = frobVec M - frobVec N

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.norm_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.norm_frobVec_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.norm_.header: theorem norm_frobVec_sq (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : ‖frobVec M‖ ^ 2 = frobSq M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobN.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobNorm_eq_norm_frobVec
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobN.header: theorem frobNorm_eq_norm_frobVec (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : frobNorm M = ‖frobVec M‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobN.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobNorm_add_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobN.header:
theorem frobNorm_add_le (M N : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    frobNorm (M + N) ≤ frobNorm M + frobNorm N

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobSq_conjTranspose
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobS.header: theorem frobSq_conjTranspose (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : frobSq Mᴴ = frobSq M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobN.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobNorm_conjTranspose
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobN.header: theorem frobNorm_conjTranspose (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : frobNorm Mᴴ = frobNorm M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobSq_mul_left_iso
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobS.header:
theorem frobSq_mul_left_iso (W M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hW : Wᴴ * W = 1) :
    frobSq (W * M) = frobSq M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobN.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobNorm_mul_left_iso
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobN.header:
theorem frobNorm_mul_left_iso (W M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hW : Wᴴ * W = 1) :
    frobNorm (W * M) = frobNorm M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.su_co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.su_coe_inv
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.su_co.header:
theorem su_coe_inv (A : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    ((A⁻¹ : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
      = ((A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ))ᴴ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.su_co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.su_conjTranspose_mul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.su_co.header:
theorem su_conjTranspose_mul (A : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    ((A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ))ᴴ * (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobN.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobNorm_su_inv_sub_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobN.header:
theorem frobNorm_su_inv_sub_one (A : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    frobNorm ((A⁻¹ : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) =
      frobNorm ((A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobN.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobNorm_su_mul_sub_one_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobN.header:
theorem frobNorm_su_mul_sub_one_le (a b : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    frobNorm ((↑(a * b) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤
      frobNorm ((a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) +
        frobNorm ((b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobN.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobNorm_holonomy_sub_one_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.frobN.header:
theorem frobNorm_holonomy_sub_one_le {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (steps : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    frobNorm ((↑(periodicPathHolonomy U x steps) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤
      (steps.length : ℝ) * frobSupBond U

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.norm_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.norm_RMap_holonomy_sub_self_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.norm_.header:
theorem norm_RMap_holonomy_sub_self_le {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (steps : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (X : SuTwo) :
    ‖RMap (periodicPathHolonomy U x steps) X - X‖ ≤
      2 * (steps.length : ℝ) * frobSupBond U * ‖X‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.norm_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.norm_rZeroA_trivialU_sub_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.norm_.header:
theorem norm_rZeroA_trivialU_sub_le {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (cMinus x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) :
    ‖rZeroA (trivialU L) cMinus x A μ ell - rZeroA U cMinus x A μ ell‖ ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, 2 * ((transportPath cMinus x μ i).length : ℝ) * frobSupBond U *
        ‖A (pathSite x μ i, μ)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.norm_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.norm_lineCoarseRestrictCov_trivialU_sub_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.norm_.header:
theorem norm_lineCoarseRestrictCov_trivialU_sub_le {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L ell) :
    ‖lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell A b - lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell A b‖ ≤
      (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * ∑ x ∈ blockOf b.1.1 ell, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
        2 * ((transportPath b.1.1 x b.2 i).length : ℝ) * frobSupBond U *
          ‖A (pathSite x b.2 i, b.2)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.strai.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.straightSegment_length
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.strai.header:
theorem straightSegment_length {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (a b : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (straightSegment a b μ).length = coordSteps a b μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.coord.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.coordSteps_update_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.coord.header:
theorem coordSteps_update_ne {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (a b : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    {ν κ : Fin 3} (w : Fin (L κ + 1)) (h : ν ≠ κ) :
    coordSteps (Function.update a κ w) b ν = coordSteps a b ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.pathS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.pathSite_coord_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.pathS.header:
theorem pathSite_coord_self {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    (i : ℕ) : (pathSite x μ i) μ = x μ + i • (1 : Fin (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.coord.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.coordSteps_straight_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.coord.header:
theorem coordSteps_straight_eq {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    (i : ℕ) : coordSteps x (pathSite x μ i) μ = i % (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.coord.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.coordSteps_lt_of_inBlock
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.coord.header:
theorem coordSteps_lt_of_inBlock {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {cMinus x : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    {ell : ℕ} (hx : inBlock cMinus ell x) (ν : Fin 3) : coordSteps cMinus x ν < ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.trans.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.transportPath_length_le

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.norm_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.norm_lineCoarseRestrictCov_trivialU_sub_le_uniform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.norm_.header:
theorem norm_lineCoarseRestrictCov_trivialU_sub_le_uniform {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L ell) :
    ‖lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell A b - lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell A b‖ ≤
      (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * ∑ x ∈ blockOf b.1.1 ell, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
        2 * (4 * ell : ℝ) * frobSupBond U * ‖A (pathSite x b.2 i, b.2)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.pathS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.pathSite_eq_shiftEquiv_pow
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.pathS.header:
theorem pathSite_eq_shiftEquiv_pow {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pathSite x μ i = ((periodicLatticeShiftEquiv (L := L) μ) ^ i) x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.sum_p.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.sum_pathSite_comp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.sum_p.header:
theorem sum_pathSite_comp {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :

    (∑ b : CoarseBond L ell, ∑ x ∈ blockOf b.1.1 ell, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUQChain.norm_.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.pairM_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.pairM_sub_left
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.pairM_.header: theorem pairM_sub_left (M N P : M2) : pairM (M - N) P = pairM M P - pairM N P

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.pairM_.header: theorem pairM_add_left (M N P : M2) : pairM (M + N) P = pairM M P + pairM N P

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.pairM_.header: theorem pairM_smul_left (r : ℂ) (M P : M2) : pairM (r • M) P = r * pairM M P

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.pairM_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.pairM_sub_right
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.pairM_.header: theorem pairM_sub_right (M N P : M2) : pairM M (N - P) = pairM M N - pairM M P

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.pairM_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.pairM_neg_right
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.pairM_.header: theorem pairM_neg_right (M N : M2) : pairM M (-N) = - pairM M N

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.pairM_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.pairM_smul_right
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.pairM_.header: theorem pairM_smul_right (r : ℂ) (M P : M2) : pairM M (r • P) = r * pairM M P

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.pairM_.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extD_a.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extD_adjoint
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extD_a.header:
theorem extD_adjoint (η : ℝ) (A : Bond L → M2)
    (F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → M2)
    (hF : ∀ x μ ν, F x μ ν = - F x ν μ) :
    (∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ ν : Fin 3, pairM (extD η A x μ ν) (F x μ ν))
      = 2 * ∑ b : Bond L, pairM (A b) (extDStar η F b)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extD_s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extD_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extD_s.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extDSt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extDStar_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extDSt.header:
theorem extDStar_smul (η : ℝ) (r : ℂ)
    (F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → M2) (b : Bond L) :
    extDStar η (fun x μ ν => r • F x μ ν) b = r • extDStar η F b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extD_e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extD_eta
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extD_e.header:
theorem extD_eta (η : ℝ) (A : Bond L → M2) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extDSt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extDStar_eta
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extDSt.header:
theorem extDStar_eta (η : ℝ) (F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → M2) (b : Bond L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extDSt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extDStarD_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extDSt.header:
theorem extDStarD_smul (η : ℝ) (r : ℂ) (A : Bond L → M2) (b : Bond L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extDSt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extDStarD_eta
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extDSt.header:
theorem extDStarD_eta (η : ℝ) (A : Bond L → M2) (b : Bond L) :
    extDStarD η A b = ((((η⁻¹) ^ 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) • extDStarD 1 A b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extDSt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extDStarD_chartA
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extDSt.header:
theorem extDStarD_chartA (η : ℝ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (b : Bond L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.frobNo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.frobNorm_extD_one_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.frobNo.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.frobNo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.frobNorm_extDStarD_one_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.frobNo.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.src353.header:
theorem src3536FaithfulLog_of_gaugeRegular (Lj c α : ℝ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (hLj : 1 ≤ Lj) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hthr : 12 * Real.pi * α < c * (Lj ^ 3)⁻¹)
    (hbranch : ∀ h : SU2, frobNorm ((h : M2) - 1) ≤ α → su2Exp (su2Log h) = h)
    (hreg : GaugeRegular α U) (cube : Finset (Bond L)) :
    Src3536FaithfulLog Lj c cube U

theorem frobNorm_holonomy_le_of_bonds (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (K : ℝ)
    (h0 : frobNorm ((V (p.1, p.2.1.1) : M2) - 1) ≤ K)
    (h1 : frobNorm ((V (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1, p.2.1.2) : M2) - 1) ≤ K)
    (h2 : frobNorm ((V (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1) : M2) - 1) ≤ K)
    (h3 : frobNorm ((V (p.1, p.2.1.2) : M2) - 1) ≤ K) :
    frobNorm ((holonomyElem V p : M2) - 1) ≤ 4 * K

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.not_sr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.not_src3536FaithfulLog_of_curvature_cube
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.not_sr.header:
theorem not_src3536FaithfulLog_of_curvature_cube {Lj c : ℝ}

    (cube : Finset (Bond L))
    (hb0 : ((p.1, p.2.1.1) : Bond L) ∈ cube)
    (hb1 : ((periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1, p.2.1.2) : Bond L) ∈ cube)
    (hb2 : ((periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1) : Bond L) ∈ cube)
    (hb3 : ((p.1, p.2.1.2) : Bond L) ∈ cube)
    (hbig : 4 * (c * Lj⁻¹) ≤ frobNorm ((holonomyElem U p : M2) - 1)) :
    ¬ Src3536FaithfulLog Lj c cube U

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.exists.header:
