AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.extDSt.header:
theorem extDStarD_regionU_zero {b : Bond bigLat} (hb : InCube b.1) :
    extDStarD 1 (logField regionU) b = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.exists.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.exists_faithfulRegion_witness_onSourceCube
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.exists.header:
theorem exists_faithfulRegion_witness_onSourceCube (c α : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hα : 4 * α < 2 * Real.sqrt 2) :
    ∃ (cube : Finset (Bond bigLat)) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 bigLat),
      IsSourceCube 1 cube ∧ Src3536FaithfulLog 1 c cube U ∧ ¬ GaugeRegular α U

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Src353.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Src3536FaithfulAll
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Src353.header: def Src3536FaithfulAll (η Lj c : ℝ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Src353.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Src3536FaithfulAllLog
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Src353.header: def Src3536FaithfulAllLog (Lj c : ℝ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.src353.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.src3536FaithfulAll_eta_free
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.src353.header:
theorem src3536FaithfulAll_eta_free (η Lj c : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :
    Src3536FaithfulAll η Lj c U ↔ Src3536FaithfulAllLog Lj c U

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.src353.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.src3536FaithfulAllLog_of_gaugeRegular
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.src353.header:
theorem src3536FaithfulAllLog_of_gaugeRegular (Lj c α : ℝ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (hLj : 1 ≤ Lj) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hthr : 12 * Real.pi * α < c * (Lj ^ 3)⁻¹)
    (hbranch : ∀ h : SU2, frobNorm ((h : M2) - 1) ≤ α → su2Exp (su2Log h) = h)
    (hreg : GaugeRegular α U) :
    Src3536FaithfulAllLog Lj c U

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.src353.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.src3536FaithfulLog_empty_collapse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.src353.header:
theorem src3536FaithfulLog_empty_collapse (Lj c : ℝ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :
    Src3536FaithfulLog Lj c (∅ : Finset (Bond L)) U

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.not_sr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.not_src3536FaithfulAllLog_wideness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.not_sr.header:
theorem not_src3536FaithfulAllLog_wideness (c α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (hα2 : α ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt 2) (hband : 4 * c ≤ α) :
    ∃ U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 bigLat,
      GaugeRegular α U ∧ ¬ Src3536FaithfulAllLog 1 c U

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coordS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coordSecondDiff_separation_control
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coordS.header:
theorem coordSecondDiff_separation_control :
    ¬ ∃ (A : Bond sepLat → M2) (b : Bond sepLat),
      (∀ ν : Fin 3, coordSecondDiff A b ν = 0) ∧ coordSecondDiff A b 0 ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.source.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.sourceCubeBonds_zero_eq_empty
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.source.header:
theorem sourceCubeBonds_zero_eq_empty (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    sourceCubeBonds y 0 = (∅ : Finset (Bond L))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.interi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.interiorCubeBondsF
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.interi.header: def interiorCubeBondsF (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ) : Finset (Bond L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.mem_in.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.mem_interiorCubeBondsF
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.mem_in.header:
theorem mem_interiorCubeBondsF {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {s : ℕ} {b : Bond L} :
    b ∈ interiorCubeBondsF y s ↔
      inBlock y s b.1 ∧ inBlock y s (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.interi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.interiorCubeBondsF_subset
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.interi.header:
theorem interiorCubeBondsF_subset (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ) :
    interiorCubeBondsF y s ⊆ sourceCubeBonds y s

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coord_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coord_interval_card
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coord_.header:
theorem coord_interval_card {n : ℕ} (a s : ℕ) (h : a + s ≤ n) :
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun z => a ≤ z.val ∧ z.val < a + s)).card = s

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.block_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.block_card_of_fit
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.block_.header:
theorem block_card_of_fit (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ)
    (hfit : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val + s ≤ L μ + 1) :
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)).filter (inBlock y s)).card = s ^ 3

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.source.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.sourceCubeBonds_card_of_fit
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.source.header:
theorem sourceCubeBonds_card_of_fit (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ)
    (hfit : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val + s ≤ L μ + 1) :
    (sourceCubeBonds y s).card = 3 * s ^ 3

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coord_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coord_interval_succ_card
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coord_.header:
theorem coord_interval_succ_card {n : ℕ} (a s : ℕ) (hfit : a + s ≤ n + 1) (hprop : s < n + 1) :
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))).filter
        (fun z => (a ≤ z.val ∧ z.val < a + s)
          ∧ (a ≤ ((z + 1 : Fin (n + 1))).val
              ∧ ((z + 1 : Fin (n + 1))).val < a + s))).card = s - 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.interi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.interiorCubeBondsF_card
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.interi.header:
theorem interiorCubeBondsF_card (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ)
    (hfit : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val + s ≤ L μ + 1) (hprop : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s < L μ + 1) :
    (interiorCubeBondsF y s).card = 3 * (s ^ 2 * (s - 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.carrie.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.carrier_gap_at_ten
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.carrie.header:
theorem carrier_gap_at_ten (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hfit : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val + 10 ≤ L μ + 1) (hprop : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 10 < L μ + 1) :
    (sourceCubeBonds y 10).card = 3000
      ∧ (interiorCubeBondsF y 10).card = 2700
      ∧ (sourceCubeBonds y 10).card - (interiorCubeBondsF y 10).card = 300

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.PrintedCube.region
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.header: def region (C : PrintedCube L) : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.PrintedCube.bonds
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.header: def bonds (C : PrintedCube L) : Finset (Bond L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.PrintedCube.mem_region
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.header:
theorem mem_region {C : PrintedCube L} {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} :
    x ∈ C.region ↔ ∀ μ : Fin 3, (C.base μ).val ≤ (x μ).val ∧ (x μ).val < (C.base μ).val + C.side

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.PrintedCube.mem_bonds
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.header:
theorem mem_bonds {C : PrintedCube L} {b : Bond L} :
    b ∈ C.bonds ↔ inBlock C.base C.side b.1 ∧ inBlock C.base C.side (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.PrintedCube.base_mem_region_of_mem_bonds
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.header:
theorem base_mem_region_of_mem_bonds {C : PrintedCube L} {b : Bond L} (hb : b ∈ C.bonds) :
    b.1 ∈ C.region

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.PrintedCube.head_mem_region_of_mem_bonds
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.header:
theorem head_mem_region_of_mem_bonds {C : PrintedCube L} {b : Bond L} (hb : b ∈ C.bonds) :
    periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ C.region

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.shift_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.shift_val_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.shift_.header:
theorem shift_val_self {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {μ : Fin 3} (h : (x μ).val + 1 < L μ + 1) :
    ((periodicLatticeShift x μ) μ).val = (x μ).val + 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.shift_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.shift_val_of_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.shift_.header:
theorem shift_val_of_ne {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {μ ν : Fin 3} (h : ν ≠ μ) :
    ((periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν).val = (x ν).val

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blowUp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blowUp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blowUp.header: def blowUp (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ell : ℕ) : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.mem_bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.mem_blowUp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.mem_bl.header:
theorem mem_blowUp {S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {ell : ℕ} {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} :
    x ∈ blowUp S ell ↔ ∃ y ∈ S, inBlock y ell x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockSide
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockS.header: def blockSide (M Lb j : ℕ) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockSide_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockS.header: theorem blockSide_zero (M Lb : ℕ) : blockSide M Lb 0 = M

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockSide_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockS.header: theorem blockSide_succ (M Lb j : ℕ) : blockSide M Lb (j + 1) = blockSide M Lb j * Lb

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockSide_dvd_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockS.header: theorem blockSide_dvd_succ (M Lb j : ℕ) : blockSide M Lb j ∣ blockSide M Lb (j + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockSide_dvd_of_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockS.header:
theorem blockSide_dvd_of_le {M Lb : ℕ} {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) :
    blockSide M Lb i ∣ blockSide M Lb j

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockSide_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blockS.header: theorem blockSide_pos {M Lb : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hLb : 1 ≤ Lb) (j : ℕ) : 0 < blockSide M Lb j

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coarse.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coarseCorner
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coarse.header: def coarseCorner (ell : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coarse.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coarseCorner_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coarse.header:
theorem coarseCorner_val (ell : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((coarseCorner ell x) μ).val = (x μ).val / ell * ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coarse.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coarseCorner_mem_coarseLattice
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.coarse.header:
theorem coarseCorner_mem_coarseLattice {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    coarseCorner ell x ∈ CoarseLattice L ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.inBloc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.inBlock_coarseCorner
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.inBloc.header:
theorem inBlock_coarseCorner {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    inBlock (coarseCorner ell x) ell x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.le_coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.le_coarseCorner_of_dvd
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.le_coa.header:
theorem le_coarseCorner_of_dvd {ell a b : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (ha : ell ∣ a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    a ≤ b / ell * ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.DomainTower
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.header: structure DomainTower (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (k M Lb : ℕ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.DomainTower.mem_Omega
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.header:
theorem mem_Omega {j : ℕ} {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} :
    x ∈ D.Omega j ↔ ∃ y ∈ D.Oc j, inBlock y (blockSide M Lb j) x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.DomainTower.mem_Lam
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.header:
theorem mem_Lam {j : ℕ} {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} :
    y ∈ D.Lam j ↔ y ∈ D.Oc j ∧ y ∉ D.Omega (j + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.DomainTower.mem_Shell
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.header:
theorem mem_Shell {j : ℕ} {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} :
    x ∈ D.Shell j ↔ ∃ y ∈ D.Lam j, inBlock y (blockSide M Lb j) x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.DomainTower.lam_subset_oc
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.header: theorem lam_subset_oc (j : ℕ) : D.Lam j ⊆ D.Oc j

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.DomainTower.shell_subset_omega
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.header: theorem shell_subset_omega (j : ℕ) : D.Shell j ⊆ D.Omega j

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.DomainTower.omega_antitone
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.header: theorem omega_antitone {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) : D.Omega j ⊆ D.Omega i

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.DomainTower.shell_disjoint
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.header:
theorem shell_disjoint {i j : ℕ} (hij : i < j) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hi : x ∈ D.Shell i) (hj : x ∈ D.Shell j) : False

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.DomainTower.shell_disjoint'
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Domain.header:
theorem shell_disjoint' {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≠ j) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hi : x ∈ D.Shell i) (hj : x ∈ D.Shell j) : False

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.IsBloc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.IsBlockUnionAt
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.IsBloc.header: def IsBlockUnionAt (M Lb j : ℕ) (C : PrintedCube L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.isBloc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.isBlockUnionAt_of_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.isBloc.header:
theorem isBlockUnionAt_of_le {M Lb i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j) {C : PrintedCube L}
    (h : IsBlockUnionAt M Lb j C) : IsBlockUnionAt M Lb i C

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.PrintedOmegaData
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.header: structure PrintedOmegaData (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (k M Lb : ℕ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.PrintedOmegaData.blockCorner_mem_region
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.header:
theorem blockCorner_mem_region {C : PrintedCube L} (hC : P.Class C)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ C.region) (hxs : x ∈ P.D.Shell (P.idx C)) :
    ∃ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L,
      y ∈ C.region ∧ y ∈ P.D.Shell (P.idx C) ∧ ((y, 0) : Bond L) ∈ C.bonds

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.PrintedOmegaData.two_clause_rigid
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.header:
theorem two_clause_rigid {C : PrintedCube L} (hC : P.Class C) (j : ℕ)
    (hcont : ∀ x ∈ C.region, (∃ μ : Fin 3, ((x, μ) : Bond L) ∈ C.bonds) →
      x ∈ P.D.Shell j ∪ P.D.Shell (j + 1))
    (hmeet : (C.region ∩ P.D.Shell j).Nonempty) :
    j = P.idx C

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.WireOm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.WireOmegaShape
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.WireOm.header: structure WireOmegaShape (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (k : ℕ) (Cls : Finset (Bond L) → Prop)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.bondsB.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.bondsBased
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.bondsB.header: def bondsBased (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) : Finset (Bond L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.mem_bo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.mem_bondsBased
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.mem_bo.header:
theorem mem_bondsBased {S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {b : Bond L} :
    b ∈ bondsBased S ↔ b.1 ∈ S

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.PrintedOmegaData.idxOf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.header: noncomputable def idxOf (cube : Finset (Bond L)) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.PrintedOmegaData.idxOf_spec
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.header:
theorem idxOf_spec {cube : Finset (Bond L)} (h : P.ClsOf cube) :
    ∃ C : PrintedCube L, P.Class C ∧ cube = C.bonds ∧ P.idxOf cube = P.idx C

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.PrintedOmegaData.toWireShape
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.Printe.header: noncomputable def toWireShape : WireOmegaShape L k P.ClsOf

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.mem_bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.mem_blowUp_coarseLattice
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.mem_bl.header:
theorem mem_blowUp_coarseLattice {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    x ∈ blowUp (CoarseLattice L ell) ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blowUp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blowUp_empty
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.blowUp.header:
theorem blowUp_empty (ell : ℕ) :
    blowUp (∅ : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) ell = ∅

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.degene.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.degenerateTower
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.degene.header:
def degenerateTower (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (k M Lb : ℕ) (hM : 2 ≤ M) (hLb : 1 ≤ Lb) :
    DomainTower L k M Lb

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.degene.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.degenerate_shell_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.degene.header:
theorem degenerate_shell_zero {k M Lb : ℕ} (hM : 2 ≤ M) (hLb : 1 ≤ Lb)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : x ∈ (degenerateTower L k M Lb hM hLb).Shell 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.degene.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.degenerate_shell_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.degene.header:
theorem degenerate_shell_pos {k M Lb : ℕ} (hM : 2 ≤ M) (hLb : 1 ≤ Lb) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≠ 0)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : x ∉ (degenerateTower L k M Lb hM hLb).Shell j

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.printe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.printedOmegaDegenerate
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.printe.header:
def printedOmegaDegenerate (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (k M Lb : ℕ) (hM : 2 ≤ M) (hLb : 1 ≤ Lb) :
    PrintedOmegaData L k M Lb

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.exists.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.exists_witnessExtent
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.exists.header: theorem exists_witnessExtent : ∃ L : PeriodicLatticeExtent, WitnessExtent L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnessOc
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.header:
def witnessOc (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : ℕ → Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)
  | 0 => CoarseLattice L 2
  | 1 => (CoarseLattice L 4).filter (fun y => ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < 48)
  | _ + 2 => ∅

theorem two_pos : (0 : ℕ) < 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnessOc_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.header: theorem witnessOc_zero (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : witnessOc L 0 = CoarseLattice L 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnessOc_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.header:
theorem witnessOc_one (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    witnessOc L 1 = (CoarseLattice L 4).filter (fun y => ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val < 48)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnessOc_succ_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.header: theorem witnessOc_succ_succ (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (n : ℕ) : witnessOc L (n + 2) = ∅

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnessTower_Omega_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.header:
theorem witnessTower_Omega_one (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    x ∈ (witnessTower L).Omega 1 ↔ ∀ μ : Fin 3, (x μ).val < 48

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnessTower_Lam_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.header:
theorem witnessTower_Lam_one (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    (witnessTower L).Lam 1 = witnessOc L 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnessTower_Shell_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.header:
theorem witnessTower_Shell_one (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    x ∈ (witnessTower L).Shell 1 ↔ ∀ μ : Fin 3, (x μ).val < 48

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnessTower_Shell_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.header:
theorem witnessTower_Shell_zero (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    x ∈ (witnessTower L).Shell 0 ↔ ∃ μ : Fin 3, 48 ≤ (x μ).val

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeOn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeOne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeOn.header: def cubeOne (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : WitnessExtent L) : PrintedCube L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeTw.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeTw.header: def cubeTwo (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : WitnessExtent L) : PrintedCube L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeOn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeOne_base_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeOn.header:
theorem cubeOne_base_val (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : WitnessExtent L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((cubeOne L hL).base μ).val = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeOn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeOne_side
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeOn.header:
theorem cubeOne_side (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : WitnessExtent L) :
    (cubeOne L hL).side = 40

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeTw.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeTwo_base_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeTw.header:
theorem cubeTwo_base_val (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : WitnessExtent L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((cubeTwo L hL).base μ).val = 48

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeTw.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeTwo_side
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeTw.header:
theorem cubeTwo_side (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : WitnessExtent L) :
    (cubeTwo L hL).side = 20

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeTw.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeTwo_ne_cubeOne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeTw.header:
theorem cubeTwo_ne_cubeOne (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : WitnessExtent L) :
    cubeTwo L hL ≠ cubeOne L hL

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnessOmega
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.header:
noncomputable def witnessOmega (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : WitnessExtent L) :
    PrintedOmegaData L 1 2 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnessOmega_idx_two_valued
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.header:
theorem witnessOmega_idx_two_valued (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : WitnessExtent L) :
    (witnessOmega L hL).idx (cubeOne L hL) = 1
      ∧ (witnessOmega L hL).idx (cubeTwo L hL) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeOn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeOne_bonds_ne_cubeTwo_bonds
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.cubeOn.header:
theorem cubeOne_bonds_ne_cubeTwo_bonds (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : WitnessExtent L) :
    (cubeOne L hL).bonds ≠ (cubeTwo L hL).bonds

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnessOmega_wire_idx_two_valued
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.witnes.header:
theorem witnessOmega_wire_idx_two_valued (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : WitnessExtent L) :
    (witnessOmega L hL).toWireShape.idx (cubeOne L hL).bonds = 1
      ∧ (witnessOmega L hL).toWireShape.idx (cubeTwo L hL).bonds = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.exists.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.exists_printedOmegaData_idx_two_valued
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityGap.exists.header:
theorem exists_printedOmegaData_idx_two_valued :
    ∃ (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (P : PrintedOmegaData L 1 2 2)
      (C₁ C₂ : PrintedCube L), P.Class C₁ ∧ P.Class C₂ ∧ P.idx C₁ = 1 ∧ P.idx C₂ = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.h.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.holonomyDefectSq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.h.header:
noncomputable def holonomyDefectSq
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.I.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.IsRegularHolonomy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.I.header:
noncomputable def IsRegularHolonomy
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (Mα₀ : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.h.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.holonomyDefectSq_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.h.header:
theorem holonomyDefectSq_nonneg
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)

    0 ≤ holonomyDefectSq U p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.h.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.holonomyDefectSq_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.h.header:
theorem holonomyDefectSq_trivialU (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.t.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.trivialU_isRegularHolonomy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.t.header:
theorem trivialU_isRegularHolonomy {Mα₀ : ℝ} (hMα₀ : 0 ≤ Mα₀) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.centralHolonomyU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.c.header:
noncomputable def centralHolonomyU :
    PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.h.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.holonomyElem_periodicGaugeTransform_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.h.header:
theorem holonomyElem_periodicGaugeTransform_trivialU
    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    holonomyElem (periodicGaugeTransform γ (trivialU (L := L))) p = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.starGaugeFn
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.s.header:
noncomputable def starGaugeFn :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.p.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.pureGaugeU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularityHolonomy.p.header:
noncomputable def pureGaugeU :
    PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.pat.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.pathSite_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.pat.header:
theorem pathSite_eq (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :
    pathSite x μ i = Function.update x μ (x μ + i • (1 : Fin (L μ + 1)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.pat.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.pathSite_apply_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.pat.header:
theorem pathSite_apply_ne (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) (h : ν ≠ μ) :
    pathSite x μ i ν = x ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.pat.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.pathSite_apply_self_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.pat.header:
theorem pathSite_apply_self_val (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :
    ((pathSite x μ i) μ).val = ((x μ).val + i) % (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.Rea.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.ReadsBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.Rea.header: def ReadsBond (ell : ℕ) (c : CoarseBond L ell) (b : Bond L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.lin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.lineCoarseRestrictCov_congr
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.lin.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCov_congr
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (B₁ B₂ : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L ell)
    (h : ∀ b, ReadsBond ell c b → B₁ b = B₂ b) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell B₁ c = lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell B₂ c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.droppedBondLast
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.header: def droppedBondLast (ell : ℕ) (c : CoarseBond L ell) : Bond L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.droppedBondLast_reads_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.header:
theorem droppedBondLast_reads_self {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    ReadsBond ell c (droppedBondLast ell c)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.coarse_coord_add_ell_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.coa.header:
theorem coarse_coord_add_ell_le {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (μ : Fin 3)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t % ell = 0) (htn : t < L μ + 1) : t + ell ≤ L μ + 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.droppedBondLast_not_reads
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.header:
theorem droppedBondLast_not_reads {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (c c' : CoarseBond L ell) (hne : c ≠ c') :
    ¬ ReadsBond ell c (droppedBondLast ell c')

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.con.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.constraint_indep_of_other_droppedBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.con.header:
theorem constraint_indep_of_other_droppedBond {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (c c' : CoarseBond L ell) (hne : c ≠ c') (B : Bond L → SuTwo) (v : SuTwo) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell (Function.update B (droppedBondLast ell c') v) c
      = lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell B c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.axi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.axisSegment_base_mem_block
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.axi.header:
theorem axisSegment_base_mem_block {ell : ℕ} {y x base : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {d : Fin 3}
    (hx : ∀ ν : Fin 3, (y ν).val ≤ (x ν).val ∧ (x ν).val < (y ν).val + ell)
    (hbase : ∀ ν : Fin 3, (y ν).val ≤ (base ν).val ∧ (base ν).val < (y ν).val + ell)
    {e : Bond L}
    (he : e ∈ AdmissibleSubspace.axisSegment base d
            (min (y d).val (x d).val) (max (y d).val (x d).val)) :
    ∀ ν : Fin 3, (y ν).val ≤ (e.1 ν).val ∧ (e.1 ν).val < (y ν).val + ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.sta.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.staircasePath_base_mem_block

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.droppedBondLast_base_mem_block
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.header:
theorem droppedBondLast_base_mem_block {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    (droppedBondLast ell c).1 ∈ blockOf c.1.1 ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.droppedBondLast_not_mem_staircase
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.header:
theorem droppedBondLast_not_mem_staircase {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (c : CoarseBond L ell)
    (y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy' : y' ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ blockOf y' ell) :
    droppedBondLast ell c ∉ AdmissibleSubspace.staircasePath y' x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.coo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.coordSteps_shift_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.coo.header:
theorem coordSteps_shift_self (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (hL : 0 < L μ) :
    Q1Real.coordSteps y (periodicLatticeShift y μ) μ = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.coo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.coordSteps_shift_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.coo.header:
theorem coordSteps_shift_ne (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) (h : ν ≠ μ) :
    Q1Real.coordSteps y (periodicLatticeShift y μ) ν = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.leg.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.leg_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.leg.header:
theorem leg_eq (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ d : Fin 3) (hL : 0 < L μ)
    (base : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hb : base d = y d) :
    Q1Real.straightSegment base (periodicLatticeShift y μ) d
      = if d = μ then [(d, true)] else []

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.gam.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.gammaPath_shift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.gam.header:
theorem gammaPath_shift (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (hL : 0 < L μ) :
    Q1Real.GammaPath y (periodicLatticeShift y μ) = [(μ, true)]

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.hol.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.holonomy_singleStep
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.hol.header:
theorem holonomy_singleStep
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    periodicPathHolonomy U y [(μ, true)] = U (y, μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.tra.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.transport_terms_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.tra.header:
theorem transport_terms_eq
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (hL : 0 < L μ) :
    periodicPathHolonomy U y (Q1Real.transportPath y y μ 1) = U (y, μ) ∧
    periodicPathHolonomy U y
      (Q1Real.transportPath y (periodicLatticeShift y μ) μ 0) = U (y, μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.rea.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.readers_ell2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.rea.header:
theorem readers_ell2 (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (c : CoarseBond L 2)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (i : ℕ) (hx : x ∈ blockOf c.1.1 2) (hi : i < 2)
    (heq : (pathSite x c.2 i, c.2) = droppedBondLast 2 c) :
    (x = c.1.1 ∧ i = 1) ∨ (x = periodicLatticeShift c.1.1 c.2 ∧ i = 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.yB_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.yB_coarse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.yB_.header: theorem yB_coarse : yB ∈ CoarseLattice witnessL witnessEll

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.xMi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.xMid_mem_block
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.xMi.header: theorem xMid_mem_block : xMid ∈ blockOf witnessY witnessEll

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.droppedBond_couples_witness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.header:
theorem droppedBond_couples_witness :
    ReadsBond witnessEll cA (droppedBond witnessEll cB)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.droppedBond_not_decoupled
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.header:
theorem droppedBond_not_decoupled :
    ¬ (∀ (c c' : CoarseBond witnessL witnessEll), c ≠ c' →
        ¬ ReadsBond witnessEll c (droppedBond witnessEll c'))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.droppedBond_mem_staircase_witness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.header:
theorem droppedBond_mem_staircase_witness :
    droppedBond witnessEll cA ∈ AdmissibleSubspace.staircasePath witnessY xMid

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.droppedBond_not_off_staircases
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCDisjoint.dro.header:
theorem droppedBond_not_off_staircases :
    ¬ (∀ (c : CoarseBond witnessL witnessEll) (y' : PeriodicLatticeSite witnessL),
        y' ∈ CoarseLattice witnessL witnessEll →
        ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite witnessL, x ∈ blockOf y' witnessEll →
          droppedBond witnessEll c ∉ AdmissibleSubspace.staircasePath y' x)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.droppe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.droppedBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.droppe.header: def droppedBond (ell : ℕ) (c : CoarseBond L ell) : Bond L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.IsFree.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.IsFreeBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.IsFree.header: def IsFreeBond (ell : ℕ) (c : CoarseBond L ell) (b : Bond L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.droppe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.droppedBond_targetCoarseBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.droppe.header:
theorem droppedBond_targetCoarseBond :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.site1_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.site1_ne_droppedBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.site1_.header:
theorem site1_ne_droppedBond :
    ((site1 : PeriodicLatticeSite witnessL), (0 : Fin 3)) ≠
      droppedBond witnessEll targetCoarseBond

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.droppe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.droppedBond_eq_offset_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.droppe.header:
theorem droppedBond_eq_offset_zero (ell : ℕ) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    droppedBond ell c = (AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite c.1.1 c.2 0, c.2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.droppe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.droppedBond_eq_lastOffset_of_le_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.droppe.header:
theorem droppedBond_eq_lastOffset_of_le_one {ell : ℕ} (hell : ell ≤ 1) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    droppedBond ell c = (AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite c.1.1 c.2 (ell - 1), c.2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.droppe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.droppedBond_ne_lastOffset_witness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.droppe.header:
theorem droppedBond_ne_lastOffset_witness :

      (AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite
        (targetCoarseBond : CoarseBond witnessL witnessEll).1.1
        (targetCoarseBond : CoarseBond witnessL witnessEll).2 (witnessEll - 1),
       (targetCoarseBond : CoarseBond witnessL witnessEll).2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.constr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.constraintFunctional
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.constr.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.constr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.constraintFunctional_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.constr.header:
theorem constraintFunctional_apply

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.dropZe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.dropZero_apply

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.coeffD.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.coeffDc_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.coeffD.header:
theorem coeffDc_apply
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) (b₀ : Bond L) (v : SuTwo) :
    coeffDc U ell c b₀ v = lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell (Pi.single b₀ v) c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.repara.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.reparamCSuTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.repara.header:
noncomputable def reparamCSuTwo
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) (b₀ : Bond L) (Dc_inv : SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo) :
    (Bond L → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] (Bond L → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.repara.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.reparamCSuTwo_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.repara.header:
theorem reparamCSuTwo_apply
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) (b₀ : Bond L) (Dc_inv : SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo) (B : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (b : Bond L) :
    reparamCSuTwo U ell c b₀ Dc_inv B b =
      (if b = b₀ then 0 else B b) +
        (if b = b₀ then -(Dc_inv (restFunctional U ell c b₀ B)) else 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.repara.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.reparamCSuTwo_free_bond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.repara.header:
theorem reparamCSuTwo_free_bond
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) (b₀ : Bond L) (Dc_inv : SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo) (B : Bond L → SuTwo)
    {b : Bond L} (hb : b ≠ b₀) :
    reparamCSuTwo U ell c b₀ Dc_inv B b = B b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.repara.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.reparamCSuTwo_at_b0
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.repara.header:
theorem reparamCSuTwo_at_b0
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) (b₀ : Bond L) (Dc_inv : SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    reparamCSuTwo U ell c b₀ Dc_inv B b₀ = -(Dc_inv (restFunctional U ell c b₀ B))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.constr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.constraintFunctional_reparamC_split
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.constr.header:
theorem constraintFunctional_reparamC_split
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) (b₀ : Bond L) (Dc_inv : SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    constraintFunctional U ell c (reparamCSuTwo U ell c b₀ Dc_inv B) =
      restFunctional U ell c b₀ B + coeffDc U ell c b₀
        (reparamCSuTwo U ell c b₀ Dc_inv B b₀)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.repara.header:

    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)

    (hinv : (coeffDc U ell c b₀).comp Dc_inv = LinearMap.id) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell (reparamCSuTwo U ell c b₀ Dc_inv B) c = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.repara.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.repara.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.restFu.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ReparamCSuTwo.repara.header:

            lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 1 (chiField (L := L) w) c = 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ScaleInduction.level.header:
theorem levels_separated_at_general_fibre {e n : ℕ} (he : 2 ≤ e) (h2e : 2 * e ≤ n) (hedvd : e ∣ n)
    (hdvdn : ∀ μ : Fin 3, n ∣ (L μ + 1)) {w : SuTwo} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    (∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L n →
        ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, scField e n w b = 0)
      ∧ (∀ c : CoarseBond L n, lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) n (scField e n w) c = 0)
      ∧ 0 < covCoarseBondInner (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) e (scField e n w))
            (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) e (scField e n w))

    windowSum (curlCovariantLM (trivialU L) v) p

    (h₂ : P₂ ∈ Finset.univ.sigma (fun p : CoarsePlaquette L ell => blockOf p.1.1 ell))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SplitBaseCase.base_c.header:
theorem base_case_of_window_factoring {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.abs_stok.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.abs_stokesPhi_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.abs_stok.header:
theorem abs_stokesPhi_le {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))

    |AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.stokesPhi ell hdvd hy hlt w X|

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.flatQ_en.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.flatQ_energy_le_of_mem_kerQ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.flatQ_en.header:
theorem flatQ_energy_le_of_mem_kerQ
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hker : ∀ b : CoarseBond L 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov U 2 B b = 0) :
    (∑ b : CoarseBond L 2, ‖lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) 2 B b‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.stokes_p.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.stokes_pairing_annihilated_nil_level_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.stokes_p.header:
theorem stokes_pairing_annihilated_nil_level_two
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.CoarseLattice L 2)
    {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν) (w : SuTwo)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U
      ([] : List (AdalyFormal.Balaban.KernelSubspace.Level L))).HasOrthogonalProjection]

    (B : Bond L → SuTwo)

        ([] : List (AdalyFormal.Balaban.KernelSubspace.Level L)) U) :
    |covPlaqInner (AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.stokesU 2 y hlt w)
        (curlCovariantLM U B)|
      ≤ frobSupBond U * Real.sqrt (dstarDQuadForm U B)
          * (2304 * Real.sqrt 3
              * Real.sqrt (covPlaqInner (AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.stokesU 2 y hlt w)
                  (AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.stokesU 2 y hlt w))
            + 147456 * Real.sqrt 3 * ‖w‖)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.gradCova.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.gradCovariantAdjointValue_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.gradCova.header:
theorem gradCovariantAdjointValue_gauge

    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)

    gradCovariantAdjointValue (periodicGaugeTransform γ U)
        (AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gaugeActA γ A) y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.divFree_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.divFree_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.divFree_.header:
theorem divFree_gauge (γ : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.GaugeFn L)

        (AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gaugeActA γ A) y = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.fibreRev.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.fibreReversePoincare_gaugeRegular_level_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.fibreRev.header:
theorem fibreReversePoincare_gaugeRegular_level_two

    (hreg : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.GaugeRegular (1 / (4 * 10 ^ 7)) U)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hker : ∀ b : CoarseBond L 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov U 2 A b = 0)
    (hdiv : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, gradCovariantAdjointValue U A y = 0) :
    bondEnergy A ≤ 497664 * dstarDQuadForm U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.fibreRev.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.fibreReversePoincare_nil_gaugeRegular_level_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StokesCommU.fibreRev.header:
theorem fibreReversePoincare_nil_gaugeRegular_level_two
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))

    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U
      ([] : List (AdalyFormal.Balaban.KernelSubspace.Level L))).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (hreg : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.GaugeRegular (1 / (4 * 10 ^ 7)) U)

    (hv : v ∈ gaugeConstraintSubspaceCovFaithful 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepPathSite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header: def stepPathSite (s : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepPathSite_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepPathSite_zero (s : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    stepPathSite s x μ 0 = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepPathSite_one_stride
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepPathSite_one_stride (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :
    stepPathSite 1 x μ i = pathSite x μ i

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coarseShift_eq_pathSite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.header:
theorem coarseShift_eq_pathSite (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift y s μ = pathSite y μ s

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepPathSite_eq_endpoint
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepPathSite_eq_endpoint (s : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :
    coarsePathEndpoint s x (List.replicate i μ) = stepPathSite s x μ i

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepPathSite_apply_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepPathSite_apply_ne (s : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) (i : ℕ)
    (h : ν ≠ μ) : stepPathSite s x μ i ν = x ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepPathSite_apply_self_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepPathSite_apply_self_val (s : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :
    ((stepPathSite s x μ i) μ).val = ((x μ).val + s * i) % (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepPathSite_injective
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepPathSite_injective (s : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) {x x' : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (h : stepPathSite s x μ i = stepPathSite s x' μ i) : x = x'

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coarseValAt
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.header:
noncomputable def coarseValAt (s : ℕ) (A : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (μ : Fin 3) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coarseValAt_of_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.header:
theorem coarseValAt_of_mem {s : ℕ} (A : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hz : z ∈ CoarseLattice L s) (μ : Fin 3) : coarseValAt s A z μ = A (⟨z, hz⟩, μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coarseValAt_of_not_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.header:
theorem coarseValAt_of_not_mem {s : ℕ} (A : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hz : z ∉ CoarseLattice L s) (μ : Fin 3) : coarseValAt s A z μ = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coarseValAt_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.header:
theorem coarseValAt_add {s : ℕ} (A B : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (μ : Fin 3) : coarseValAt s (A + B) z μ = coarseValAt s A z μ + coarseValAt s B z μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coarseValAt_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.header:
theorem coarseValAt_smul {s : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (A : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (μ : Fin 3) : coarseValAt s (c • A) z μ = c • coarseValAt s A z μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.nor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.norm_coarseValAt_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.nor.header:
theorem norm_coarseValAt_le {s : ℕ} (A : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (μ : Fin 3) : ‖coarseValAt s A z μ‖ ≤ ‖coarseValAt s A z μ‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.mem.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.mem_coarseLattice_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.mem.header: theorem mem_coarseLattice_one (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : z ∈ CoarseLattice L 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coarseValAt_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.header:
theorem coarseValAt_one (A : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseValAt 1 A z μ = A (⟨z, mem_coarseLattice_one z⟩, μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepBlock_mem_coarseLattice
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepPathSite_mem_coarseLattice
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepPathSite_mem_coarseLattice {s : ℕ} (hdvdS : ∀ ν : Fin 3, s ∣ (L ν + 1))
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ CoarseLattice L s) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :
    stepPathSite s x μ i ∈ CoarseLattice L s

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepBondAvgAt
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
noncomputable def stepBondAvgAt (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepBondAvg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
noncomputable def stepBondAvg (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L (s * ell)) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepBondAvgAt_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepBondAvgAt_add (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A B : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    stepBondAvgAt s V ell (A + B) c μ
      = stepBondAvgAt s V ell A c μ + stepBondAvgAt s V ell B c μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepBondAvgAt_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepBondAvgAt_smul (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (A : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    stepBondAvgAt s V ell (r • A) c μ = r • stepBondAvgAt s V ell A c μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepBondAvg_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepBondAvg_add (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A B : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L (s * ell)) :
    stepBondAvg s V ell (A + B) b = stepBondAvg s V ell A b + stepBondAvg s V ell B b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepBondAvg_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepBondAvg_smul (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (A : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L (s * ell)) :
    stepBondAvg s V ell (r • A) b = r • stepBondAvg s V ell A b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepBondAvgLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
noncomputable def stepBondAvgLM (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ) :
    (CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] (CoarseBond L (s * ell) → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepBondAvgLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepBondAvgLM_apply (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L (s * ell)) :
    stepBondAvgLM s V ell A b = stepBondAvg s V ell A b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qSt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qStepCLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qSt.header:
noncomputable def qStepCLM (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ) :
    CoarseFnL2 L s →L[ℝ] CoarseFnL2 L (s * ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qSt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qStepCLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qSt.header:
theorem qStepCLM_apply (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : CoarseFnL2 L s) (b : CoarseBond L (s * ell)) :
    WithLp.ofLp (qStepCLM s V ell A) b = stepBondAvg s V ell (WithLp.ofLp A) b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coarsePathHolonomy_one_eq_periodic
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.header:
theorem coarsePathHolonomy_one_eq_periodic {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    coarsePathHolonomy 1 U y p = periodicPathHolonomy U y (p.map (fun ν => (ν, true)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coarseGammaPath_one_map
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.header:
theorem coarseGammaPath_one_map (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (coarseGammaPath 1 y x).map (fun ν : Fin 3 => (ν, true)) = GammaPath y x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coarseTransportPath_one_map

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepBondAvgAt_one_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepBondAvgAt_one_eq (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    {ell : ℕ} (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    (hell : ell ≤ L μ + 1) :
    stepBondAvgAt 1 U ell (fun e : CoarseBond L 1 => A (e.1.1, e.2)) c μ
      = (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) • ∑ x ∈ blockOf c ell, rZeroA U c x A μ ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coarseBondOneEquiv
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.header: def coarseBondOneEquiv (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : CoarseBond L 1 ≃ Bond L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepBondAvg_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepBondAvg_one (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    {ell : ℕ} (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L (1 * ell)) (b' : CoarseBond L ell)
    (hsite : b.1.1 = b'.1.1) (hdir : b.2 = b'.2) (hell : ell ≤ L b.2 + 1) :
    stepBondAvg 1 U ell (fun e => A (coarseBondOneEquiv L e)) b
      = lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell A b'

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCompositeCLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCo.header:
noncomputable def qCompositeCLM
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ) :
    (j : ℕ) → (CoarseFnL2 L 1 →L[ℝ] CoarseFnL2 L (ell ^ j))
  | 0 => ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (CoarseFnL2 L 1)
  | (j + 1) => (qStepCLM (ell ^ j) (bg j) ell).comp (qCompositeCLM bg ell j)

theorem qCompositeCLM_zero
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : CoarseFnL2 L 1) : qCompositeCLM bg ell 0 A = A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCompositeCLM_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCo.header:
theorem qCompositeCLM_zero
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : CoarseFnL2 L 1) : qCompositeCLM bg ell 0 A = A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCompositeCLM_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCo.header:
theorem qCompositeCLM_succ
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell j : ℕ) :
    qCompositeCLM bg ell (j + 1)
      = (qStepCLM (ell ^ j) (bg j) ell).comp (qCompositeCLM bg ell j)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCompositeCLM_succ_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCo.header:
theorem qCompositeCLM_succ_apply
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell j : ℕ)
    (A : CoarseFnL2 L 1) :
    qCompositeCLM bg ell (j + 1) A = qStepCLM (ell ^ j) (bg j) ell (qCompositeCLM bg ell j A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCompositeCLM_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCo.header:
theorem qCompositeCLM_one
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : CoarseFnL2 L 1) : qCompositeCLM bg ell 1 A = qStepCLM 1 (bg 0) ell A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.sum.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.sum_coarseValAt_normSq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.sum.header:
theorem sum_coarseValAt_normSq (s : ℕ) (A : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) :
    ∑ e : Bond L, ‖coarseValAt s A e.1 e.2‖ ^ 2 = ∑ f : CoarseBond L s, ‖A f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.blo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.block_sum_le_total
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.blo.header:
theorem block_sum_le_total (s ell i : ℕ) (F : Bond L → ℝ) (hF : ∀ e, 0 ≤ F e) :
    ∑ b : CoarseBond L (s * ell), ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf b.1.1 s ell,
        F (stepPathSite s x b.2 i, b.2)
      ≤ ∑ e : Bond L, F e

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.nor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.norm_stepBondAvgAt_sq_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.nor.header:
theorem norm_stepBondAvgAt_sq_le {s ell : ℕ}
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hcard : (stepBlockOf c s ell).card = ell ^ 3) :
    ‖stepBondAvgAt s V ell A c μ‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf c s ell, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
          ‖coarseValAt s A (stepPathSite s x μ i) μ‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qSt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qStepCLM_normSq_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qSt.header:
theorem qStepCLM_normSq_le {s ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hs : 0 < s)

    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCompositeCLM_opNorm_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.qCo.header:

    (hdvd : ∀ j' < j, ∀ ν : Fin 3, (ell ^ j' * ell) ∣ (L ν + 1)) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coarseGammaPath_replicate_stride
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepPathSite_mem_stepBlock_of_lt {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}

    (hfit : ∀ ν : Fin 3, (c ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepPathSite_eq_far_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepPathSite_eq_far_iff {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (μ : Fin 3)
    (hfit : ∀ ν : Fin 3, (c ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1) (hroom : s * ell < L μ + 1)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c s ell) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < ell) :
    stepPathSite s x μ i = stepPathSite s c μ ell ↔ (1 ≤ i ∧ x = stepPathSite s c μ (ell - i))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coarseValAt_farDelta
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.header:
theorem coarseValAt_farDelta {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {μ : Fin 3}
    (hfit : ∀ ν : Fin 3, (c ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1) (hroom : s * ell < L μ + 1)
    (ht : stepPathSite s c μ ell ∈ CoarseLattice L s) (w : SuTwo)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c s ell) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < ell) :
    coarseValAt s (coarseDelta s (⟨stepPathSite s c μ ell, ht⟩, μ) w) (stepPathSite s x μ i) μ
      = if 1 ≤ i ∧ x = stepPathSite s c μ (ell - i) then w else 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.sum.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.sum_range_ite_one_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.sum.header:
theorem sum_range_ite_one_le {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (n : ℕ) (z : M) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, if 1 ≤ i then z else 0) = (n - 1) • z

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.far.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.farDelta_weighted_sum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.far.header:
theorem farDelta_weighted_sum {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {μ : Fin 3}
    (hfit : ∀ ν : Fin 3, (c ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1) (hroom : s * ell < L μ + 1)
    (ht : stepPathSite s c μ ell ∈ CoarseLattice L s) (w : SuTwo)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℕ → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    (∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf c s ell, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
        RMap (g x i) (coarseValAt s (coarseDelta s (⟨stepPathSite s c μ ell, ht⟩, μ) w)
          (stepPathSite s x μ i) μ))
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
          (if 1 ≤ i then RMap (g (stepPathSite s c μ (ell - i)) i) w else 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepBondAvgAtNoTransport
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
noncomputable def stepBondAvgAtNoTransport (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepBondAvgAtGammaOnly
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
noncomputable def stepBondAvgAtGammaOnly (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : CoarseBond L s → SuTwo) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepBondAvgAt_farDelta_value
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepBondAvgAt_farDelta_value {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    {μ : Fin 3} (hfit : ∀ ν : Fin 3, (c ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1) (hroom : s * ell < L μ + 1)
    (ht : stepPathSite s c μ ell ∈ CoarseLattice L s)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (w : SuTwo) :
    stepBondAvgAt s V ell (coarseDelta s (⟨stepPathSite s c μ ell, ht⟩, μ) w) c μ
      = (((ell - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)
          • RMap (coarsePathHolonomy s V c (List.replicate ell μ)) w

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepBondAvgAtNoTransport_farDelta_value
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepBondAvgAtNoTransport_farDelta_value {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s)
    {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {μ : Fin 3}
    (hfit : ∀ ν : Fin 3, (c ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1) (hroom : s * ell < L μ + 1)
    (ht : stepPathSite s c μ ell ∈ CoarseLattice L s)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (w : SuTwo) :
    stepBondAvgAtNoTransport s V ell (coarseDelta s (⟨stepPathSite s c μ ell, ht⟩, μ) w) c μ
      = (((ell - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) • w

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepBondAvgAtGammaOnly_farDelta_value
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepBondAvgAtGammaOnly_farDelta_value {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s)
    {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {μ : Fin 3}
    (hfit : ∀ ν : Fin 3, (c ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1) (hroom : s * ell < L μ + 1)
    (ht : stepPathSite s c μ ell ∈ CoarseLattice L s)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (w : SuTwo) :
    stepBondAvgAtGammaOnly s V ell (coarseDelta s (⟨stepPathSite s c μ ell, ht⟩, μ) w) c μ
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, (if 1 ≤ i then
          (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)
            • RMap (coarsePathHolonomy s V c (List.replicate (ell - i) μ)) w else 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coarsePathHolonomy_replicate_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.header:
theorem coarsePathHolonomy_replicate_one (s : ℕ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coarsePathHolonomy_replicate_two

theorem stepPathSite_mem_stepBlock_of_base {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) {c y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (μ : Fin 3) (hy : y ∈ stepBlockOf c s ell) (hyμ : (y μ).val = (c μ).val) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < ell)

    stepPathSite s y μ k ∈ stepBlockOf c s ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.stepPathSite_eq_far_iff_base
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.ste.header:
theorem stepPathSite_eq_far_iff_base {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) {c y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (μ : Fin 3) (hfit : ∀ ν : Fin 3, (c ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1) (hroom : s * ell < L μ + 1)
    (hyμ : (y μ).val = (c μ).val)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c s ell) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < ell) :
    stepPathSite s x μ i = stepPathSite s y μ ell ↔ (1 ≤ i ∧ x = stepPathSite s y μ (ell - i))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coarseValAt_farDelta_base
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.coa.header:
theorem coarseValAt_farDelta_base {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) {c y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    {μ : Fin 3} (hfit : ∀ ν : Fin 3, (c ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1) (hroom : s * ell < L μ + 1)
    (hyμ : (y μ).val = (c μ).val)
    (ht : stepPathSite s y μ ell ∈ CoarseLattice L s) (w : SuTwo)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c s ell) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < ell) :
    coarseValAt s (coarseDelta s (⟨stepPathSite s y μ ell, ht⟩, μ) w) (stepPathSite s x μ i) μ
      = if 1 ≤ i ∧ x = stepPathSite s y μ (ell - i) then w else 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.far.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.farDelta_weighted_sum_base
AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.far.header:
theorem farDelta_weighted_sum_base {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) {c y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    {μ : Fin 3} (hfit : ∀ ν : Fin 3, (c ν).val + s * ell ≤ L ν + 1) (hroom : s * ell < L μ + 1)
    (hy : y ∈ stepBlockOf c s ell) (hyμ : (y μ).val = (c μ).val)
    (ht : stepPathSite s y μ ell ∈ CoarseLattice L s) (w : SuTwo)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℕ → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    (∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf c s ell, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
        RMap (g x i) (coarseValAt s (coarseDelta s (⟨stepPathSite s y μ ell, ht⟩, μ) w)
          (stepPathSite s x μ i) μ))
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
          (if 1 ≤ i then RMap (g (stepPathSite s y μ (ell - i)) i) w else 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.far.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.farDelta_sum_two

def coarseLinkList (ell : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L → List (Fin 3) →

theorem coarsePathHolonomy_eq_linkProd {G : Type*} [Group G] (ell : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3)) :

    PeriodicLatticeSite L → List (Fin 3) → ℕ
  | _, [] => 0
  | y, μ :: rest => (if (y, μ) = e0 then 1 else 0) + linkCount ell e0 (coarseShift y ell μ) rest

theorem linkCount_eq_count (ell : ℕ) (e0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L × Fin 3)
