    inner ℝ X Y =
      -(1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        (Matrix.trace ((X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) * (Y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ))).re

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_entries
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_e.header:
theorem hsInner_entries (X Y : SuTwo) :
    hsInner X Y =
      -(1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        ((X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 0 0 * (Y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 0 0 +
          (X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 0 1 * (Y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 1 0 +
          (X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 1 0 * (Y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 0 1 +
          (X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 1 1 * (Y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 1 1).re

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.conjTrans.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.conjTranspose_mul_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.conjTrans.header:
theorem conjTranspose_mul_self (U : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)ᴴ * (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_R.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_RMap
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_R.header:
theorem hsInner_RMap (U : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (X Y : SuTwo) :
    hsInner (RMap U X) (RMap U Y) = hsInner X Y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.inner_RMa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.inner_RMap
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.inner_RMa.header:
theorem inner_RMap (U : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (X Y : SuTwo) :
    inner ℝ (RMap U X) (RMap U Y) = inner ℝ X Y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.RIsometry.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.RIsometry
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.RIsometry.header: noncomputable def RIsometry (U : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : SuTwo →ₗᵢ[ℝ] SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.RIsometry.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.RIsometry_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.RIsometry.header:
theorem RIsometry_apply (U : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (X : SuTwo) :
    RIsometry U X = RMap U X

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_R.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_RMap_witness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_R.header:
theorem hsInner_RMap_witness :
    hsInner (RMap witnessMElem pauliE3) (RMap witnessMElem pauliE3) = 1 ∧
      RMap witnessMElem pauliE3 ≠ pauliE3

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.ambientFo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.ambientForm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.ambientFo.header: noncomputable def ambientForm (A B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_eq_ambientForm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_e.header:
theorem hsInner_eq_ambientForm (X Y : SuTwo) :
    hsInner X Y = ambientForm (X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (Y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.ambientFo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.ambientForm_not_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.ambientFo.header:
theorem ambientForm_not_nonneg :
    ¬ ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ, 0 ≤ ambientForm A A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInnerUn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInnerUnnormalized
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInnerUn.header: noncomputable def hsInnerUnnormalized (X Y : SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_n.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_ne_unnormalized
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_n.header:
theorem hsInner_ne_unnormalized :
    hsInner pauliE3 pauliE3 ≠ hsInnerUnnormalized pauliE3 pauliE3

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.trace_sq_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.trace_sq_pauliE3
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.trace_sq_.header:
theorem trace_sq_pauliE3 :
    (Matrix.trace ((pauliE3 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) *
      (pauliE3 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ))).re = -2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.continuou.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.continuous_id_ambient_to_norm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.continuou.header:
theorem continuous_id_ambient_to_norm :
    @Continuous SuTwo SuTwo instTopologicalSpaceSubtype
      (@UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace SuTwo PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace)
      id

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.continuou.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.continuous_id_norm_to_ambient
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.continuou.header:
theorem continuous_id_norm_to_ambient :
    @Continuous SuTwo SuTwo (@UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace SuTwo PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace)
      instTopologicalSpaceSubtype
      id

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.suTwo_com.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.suTwo_complete_eq_instCompleteSpaceSuTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.suTwo_com.header:
theorem suTwo_complete_eq_instCompleteSpaceSuTwo :
    suTwo_complete =
      ambient_uniformSpace_eq_norm_uniformSpace ▸ (instCompleteSpaceSuTwo : CompleteSpace SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.suTwo_dec.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.suTwo_decompose
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.suTwo_dec.header:
theorem suTwo_decompose (X : SuTwo) :
    X = ((X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 0 1).im • pauliE1 +
        ((X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 0 1).re • pauliE2 +
        ((X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 0 0).im • pauliE3

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.span_paul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.span_pauli_eq_top
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.span_paul.header:
theorem span_pauli_eq_top :
    Submodule.span ℝ ({pauliE1, pauliE2, pauliE3} : Set SuTwo) = ⊤

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.entry11_e.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.entry11_eq_neg_entry00
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.entry11_e.header:
theorem entry11_eq_neg_entry00 (X : SuTwo) :
    (X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 1 1 = -((X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 0 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_self_entries
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.hsInner_s.header:
theorem hsInner_self_entries (X : SuTwo) :
    hsInner X X = ((X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 0 0).im ^ 2
      + Complex.normSq ((X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 0 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.conjTrans.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_diagonal
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.conjTrans.header:
theorem conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_diagonal (X : SuTwo) :
    (X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)ᴴ * (X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
      = Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 2 => ((hsInner X X : ℝ) : ℂ))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.l2op_norm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.l2op_norm_sq_eq_hsInner
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.l2op_norm.header:
theorem l2op_norm_sq_eq_hsInner (X : SuTwo) :
    ‖(X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)‖ * ‖(X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)‖ = hsInner X X

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.norm_sear.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.norm_search_is_the_hsInner_instance
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.norm_sear.header:
theorem norm_search_is_the_hsInner_instance :
    (inferInstance : Norm SuTwo)
      = (@NormedAddCommGroup.toNorm SuTwo instNormedAddCommGroupSuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.fibre_nor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.fibre_norms_agree
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.fibre_nor.header:
theorem fibre_norms_agree (X : SuTwo) :
    @norm SuTwo (@NormedAddCommGroup.toNorm SuTwo suTwoFibreOp) X = ‖X‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.fibre_nor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.fibre_norm_instances_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.fibre_nor.header:
theorem fibre_norm_instances_eq :
    (@NormedAddCommGroup.toNorm SuTwo suTwoFibreOp)
      = (inferInstance : Norm SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.bondFnL2_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.bondFnL2_op_fibre_norm_instances_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.bondFnL2_.header:
theorem bondFnL2_op_fibre_norm_instances_eq (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    (@NormedAddCommGroup.toNorm (BondFnL2 L)
        (@PiLp.normedAddCommGroup 2 (Bond L) (fun _ => SuTwo) _ _ (fun _ => suTwoFibreOp)))
      = (inferInstance : Norm (BondFnL2 L))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.bondFnL2_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.bondFnL2_norms_agree
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.bondFnL2_.header:
theorem bondFnL2_norms_agree (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (v : BondFnL2 L) :
    @norm (BondFnL2 L) (@NormedAddCommGroup.toNorm (BondFnL2 L)
        (@PiLp.normedAddCommGroup 2 (Bond L) (fun _ => SuTwo) _ _ (fun _ => suTwoFibreOp))) v
      = ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.ctrlHermi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.ctrlHermitian_breaks
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.ctrlHermi.header:
theorem ctrlHermitian_breaks :
    ctrlHermitianᴴ * ctrlHermitian
      ≠ Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 2 => ((ambientForm ctrlHermitian ctrlHermitian : ℝ) : ℂ))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.ctrlNonTr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.ctrlNonTraceless_breaks
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoInner.ctrlNonTr.header:
theorem ctrlNonTraceless_breaks :
    ∀ c : ℂ, ctrlNonTracelessᴴ * ctrlNonTraceless ≠ Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 2 => c)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.coe_mul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.coe_mul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.coe_mul.header: theorem coe_mul (g h : SU2) : ((g * h : SU2) : M2) = (g : M2) * (h : M2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.coe_inv.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.coe_inv
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.coe_inv.header: theorem coe_inv (g : SU2) : ((g⁻¹ : SU2) : M2) = (g : M2)ᴴ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.conj_mem.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.conj_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.conj_mem.header:
theorem conj_mem (g : SU2) {M : M2} (h : M ∈ Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    (g : M2) * M * (g : M2)ᴴ ∈ Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.conj_mem.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.conj_mem_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.conj_mem.header:
theorem conj_mem_iff (g : SU2) (M : M2) :
    (g : M2) * M * (g : M2)ᴴ ∈ Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ
      ↔ M ∈ Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2Exp_o.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2Exp_of_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2Exp_o.header:
theorem su2Exp_of_mem {A : M2} (h : NormedSpace.exp A ∈ Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    ((su2Exp A : SU2) : M2) = NormedSpace.exp A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2Exp_o.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2Exp_of_not_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2Exp_o.header:
theorem su2Exp_of_not_mem {A : M2}
    (h : NormedSpace.exp A ∉ Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : su2Exp A = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.trace_co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.trace_conj
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.trace_co.header:
theorem trace_conj (g : SU2) (X : SU2) :
    Matrix.trace ((g : M2) * (X : M2) * (g : M2)ᴴ) = Matrix.trace (X : M2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2Angle.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2Angle_conj
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2Angle.header: theorem su2Angle_conj (g X : SU2) : su2Angle (g * X * g⁻¹) = su2Angle X

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2Kappa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2Kappa_conj
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2Kappa.header: theorem su2Kappa_conj (g X : SU2) : su2Kappa (g * X * g⁻¹) = su2Kappa X

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_log_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_log_conj
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_log_.header: theorem su2_log_conj (g X : SU2) : su2Log (g * X * g⁻¹) = adMap g (su2Log X)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_exp_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_exp_ad
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_exp_.header: theorem su2_exp_ad (g : SU2) (A : M2) : su2Exp (adMap g A) = g * su2Exp A * g⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2LogEx.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2LogExp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2LogEx.header: noncomputable def su2LogExp : LogExpAd SU2 M2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.adMap_ne.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.adMap_ne_zero_ne_id
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.adMap_ne.header:
theorem adMap_ne_zero_ne_id :
    ∃ (g : SU2) (A : M2), adMap g A ≠ A ∧ adMap g A ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_exp_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_exp_log_conjTorus
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_exp_.header:
theorem su2_exp_log_conjTorus (h : SU2) {t : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t < Real.pi) :
    su2Exp (su2Log (h * torus t * h⁻¹)) = h * torus t * h⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_exp_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_exp_log_of_conjPrincipal
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_exp_.header: theorem su2_exp_log_of_conjPrincipal {g : SU2} (hg : conjPrincipal g) : su2Exp (su2Log g) = g

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.conjPrin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.conjPrincipal_conj
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.conjPrin.header:
theorem conjPrincipal_conj {g : SU2} (hg : conjPrincipal g) (k : SU2) :
    conjPrincipal (k * g * k⁻¹)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_conj.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_conjTranspose_eq_adjugate
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_conj.header:
theorem su2_conjTranspose_eq_adjugate (g : SU2) :
    (g : M2)ᴴ = !![(g : M2) 1 1, -(g : M2) 0 1; -(g : M2) 1 0, (g : M2) 0 0]

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_e11.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_e11
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_e11.header: theorem su2_e11 (g : SU2) : (g : M2) 1 1 = star ((g : M2) 0 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_e10.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_e10
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_e10.header: theorem su2_e10 (g : SU2) : (g : M2) 1 0 = - star ((g : M2) 0 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_norm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_normSq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_norm.header:
theorem su2_normSq (g : SU2) :
    Complex.normSq ((g : M2) 0 0) + Complex.normSq ((g : M2) 0 1) = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_trac.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_trace_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_trac.header: theorem su2_trace_two (g : SU2) (h : Matrix.trace (g : M2) = 2) : g = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_trac.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_trace_neg_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2_trac.header: theorem su2_trace_neg_two (g : SU2) (h : Matrix.trace (g : M2) = -2) : g = su2NegOne

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2Angle.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2Angle_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2Angle.header: theorem su2Angle_mem (g : SU2) : 0 ≤ su2Angle g ∧ su2Angle g ≤ Real.pi

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.sin_su2A.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.sin_su2Angle_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.sin_su2A.header:
theorem sin_su2Angle_ne_zero (g : SU2) (h1 : g ≠ 1) (h2 : g ≠ su2NegOne) :
    Real.sin (su2Angle g) ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_congr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_congr
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_congr.header: theorem dg_congr {a b c d : ℂ} (h0 : a = c) (h1 : b = d) : dg a b = dg c d

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_smul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_smul.header: theorem dg_smul (x a b : ℂ) : x • dg a b = dg (x * a) (x * b)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_conjT.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_conjTranspose
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_conjT.header: theorem dg_conjTranspose (a b : ℂ) : (dg a b)ᴴ = dg (star a) (star b)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_sub.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_sub
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_sub.header: theorem dg_sub (a b c d : ℂ) : dg a b - dg c d = dg (a - c) (b - d)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_mul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_mul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_mul.header: theorem dg_mul (a b c d : ℂ) : dg a b * dg c d = dg (a * c) (b * d)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_det.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_det
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_det.header: theorem dg_det (a b : ℂ) : (dg a b).det = a * b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_trace.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_trace
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_trace.header: theorem dg_trace (a b : ℂ) : Matrix.trace (dg a b) = a + b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_00.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_00
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_00.header: theorem dg_00 (a b : ℂ) : dg a b 0 0 = a

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_11.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_11
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_11.header: theorem dg_11 (a b : ℂ) : dg a b 1 1 = b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_01.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_01
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_01.header: theorem dg_01 (a b : ℂ) : dg a b 0 1 = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_10.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_10
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.dg_10.header: theorem dg_10 (a b : ℂ) : dg a b 1 0 = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_pos.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_pos_form
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_pos.header:
theorem cexp_pos_form (t : ℝ) :
    Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) = Complex.cos (t : ℂ) + Complex.sin (t : ℂ) * Complex.I

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_neg.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_neg_form
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_neg.header:
theorem cexp_neg_form (t : ℝ) :
    Complex.exp (-((t : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      = Complex.cos (t : ℂ) - Complex.sin (t : ℂ) * Complex.I

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_mul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_mul_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_mul.header:
theorem cexp_mul_one (t : ℝ) :
    Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (-((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_mul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_mul_one'
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_mul.header:
theorem cexp_mul_one' (t : ℝ) :
    Complex.exp (-((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) * Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_sta.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_star
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_sta.header:
theorem cexp_star (t : ℝ) :
    star (Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) = Complex.exp (-((t : ℂ) * Complex.I))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_sta.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_star'
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_sta.header:
theorem cexp_star' (t : ℝ) :
    star (Complex.exp (-((t : ℂ) * Complex.I))) = Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_re.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_re
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.cexp_re.header: theorem cexp_re (t : ℝ) : (Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re = Real.cos t

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.singleBondS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.singleBondSpike
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.singleBondS.header: noncomputable def singleBondSpike : Bond AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.shift1_spik.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.shift1_spikeSite_ne_spikeSite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.shift1_spik.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.singleBondS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.singleBondSpike_at_term2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.singleBondS.header:
theorem singleBondSpike_at_term2 :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.singleBondS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.singleBondSpike_at_term3
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.singleBondS.header:
theorem singleBondSpike_at_term3 :
    singleBondSpike (periodicLatticeShift spikeSite (1 : Fin 3), (0 : Fin 3)) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.curlValueCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.curlValueCovariant_smul_singleBondSpike
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.curlValueCo.header:
theorem curlValueCovariant_smul_singleBondSpike (U : Config AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL) (c : ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.curlValueCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.curlValueCovariant_smul_singleBondSpike_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.curlValueCo.header:
theorem curlValueCovariant_smul_singleBondSpike_ne_zero (U : Config AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.spikeC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.spikeC
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.spikeC.header: noncomputable def spikeC : ℝ →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.spikeC_appl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.spikeC_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.spikeC_appl.header:
theorem spikeC_apply (t : ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.spikeC_sati.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.spikeC_satisfies_isBalabanReparam
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TheLemma.spikeC_sati.header:
theorem spikeC_satisfies_isBalabanReparam (Mα₀thresh : ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.uni.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.unitSitesOf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.uni.header:
def unitSitesOf (ell₀ ell₁ : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Finset {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L // z ∈ CoarseLattice L ell₀}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.uni.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.unitToCoarse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.uni.header:
noncomputable def unitToCoarse (ell₀ m : ℕ) (B : CoarseBond L ell₀ → SuTwo)
    (c : CoarseBond L (ell₀ * m)) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.uni.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.unitToCoarse_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.uni.header:
theorem unitToCoarse_add (ell₀ m : ℕ) (B1 B2 : CoarseBond L ell₀ → SuTwo)
    (c : CoarseBond L (ell₀ * m)) :
    unitToCoarse ell₀ m (B1 + B2) c = unitToCoarse ell₀ m B1 c + unitToCoarse ell₀ m B2 c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.uni.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.unitToCoarse_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.uni.header:
theorem unitToCoarse_smul (ell₀ m : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (B : CoarseBond L ell₀ → SuTwo)
    (c : CoarseBond L (ell₀ * m)) :
    unitToCoarse ell₀ m (r • B) c = r • unitToCoarse ell₀ m B c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.uni.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.unitToCoarseLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.uni.header:
noncomputable def unitToCoarseLM (ell₀ m : ℕ) :
    (CoarseBond L ell₀ → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] (CoarseBond L (ell₀ * m) → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.pat.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.pathSite_succ_mul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.pat.header:
theorem pathSite_succ_mul (u : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i ell₀ : ℕ) :
    pathSite u μ ((i + 1) * ell₀) = coarseShift (pathSite u μ (i * ell₀)) ell₀ μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.pat.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.pathSite_mul_coarse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.pat.header:
theorem pathSite_mul_coarse (ell₀ : ℕ) (hdvd₀ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell₀ ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {u : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hu : u ∈ CoarseLattice L ell₀) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∀ i : ℕ, pathSite u μ (i * ell₀) ∈ CoarseLattice L ell₀

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.shi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.shift_mul_blockOf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.shi.header:
theorem shift_mul_blockOf {ell₀ : ℕ} (hell₀ : 0 < ell₀)
    (hdvd₀ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell₀ ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {u : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hu : u ∈ CoarseLattice L ell₀) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∀ i : ℕ, blockOf (pathSite u μ (i * ell₀)) ell₀
      = (blockOf u ell₀).image (fun x => pathSite x μ (i * ell₀))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.mul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.mult_add_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.mul.header: theorem mult_add_le {a b e : ℕ} (ha : e ∣ a) (hb : e ∣ b) (h : a < b) : a + e ≤ b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.blo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.blockOf_eq_biUnion_units
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.blo.header:
theorem blockOf_eq_biUnion_units {ell₀ ell₁ : ℕ} (hell₀ : 0 < ell₀) (hsplit : ell₀ ∣ ell₁)
    (hdvd₀ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell₀ ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell₁) :
    blockOf y ell₁ = (unitSitesOf ell₀ ell₁ y).biUnion (fun u => blockOf u.1 ell₀)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.uni.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.units_pairwiseDisjoint
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.uni.header:
theorem units_pairwiseDisjoint (ell₀ ell₁ : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Set.PairwiseDisjoint ↑(unitSitesOf ell₀ ell₁ y)
      (fun u : {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L // z ∈ CoarseLattice L ell₀} => blockOf u.1 ell₀)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.uni.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.unit_block_sum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.uni.header:
theorem unit_block_sum {ell₀ m : ℕ} (hell₀ : 0 < ell₀)
    (hdvd₀ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell₀ ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell₀ * m)) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ)
    (G : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ u ∈ unitSitesOf ell₀ (ell₀ * m) y, ∑ z ∈ blockOf (pathSite u.1 μ (i * ell₀)) ell₀, G z
      = ∑ x ∈ blockOf y (ell₀ * m), G (pathSite x μ (i * ell₀))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.sum.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.sum_range_mul_decomp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.sum.header:
theorem sum_range_mul_decomp {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (m ell₀ : ℕ) (hell₀ : 0 < ell₀)
    (g : ℕ → M) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m * ell₀), g k
      = ∑ p ∈ Finset.range m ×ˢ Finset.range ell₀, g (p.1 * ell₀ + p.2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.tow.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.tower_law
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.tow.header:
theorem tower_law {ell₀ m : ℕ} (hell₀ : 0 < ell₀) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdvd₀ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell₀ ∣ (L μ + 1)) (v : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    unitToCoarse ell₀ m (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell₀ v)
      = lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) (ell₀ * m) v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.ker.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.ker_translation
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelArrows.ker.header:
theorem ker_translation {ell₀ m : ℕ} (hell₀ : 0 < ell₀) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdvd₀ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell₀ ∣ (L μ + 1)) (v : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) (ell₀ * m) v = 0
      ↔ unitToCoarse ell₀ m (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell₀ v) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.d.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.droppedBond4_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.d.header:
theorem droppedBond4_ne (c : CoarseBond witL7 4) (s : PeriodicLatticeSite witL7)
    (hs : (s 0).val = 0) : droppedBondLast 4 c ≠ ((s, 0) : Bond witL7)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.B.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.B7_no_dropped
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.B.header: theorem B7_no_dropped : ∀ c : CoarseBond witL7 4, B7 (droppedBondLast 4 c) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.d.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.dropZero_B7
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.d.header:
theorem dropZero_B7 (c : CoarseBond witL7 4) :
    dropZero (droppedBondLast 4 c) B7 = B7

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.f.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.fullC_fixes_B7
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.f.header:
theorem fullC_fixes_B7 :
    fullC (trivialU witL7) 4 (dinvC (trivialU witL7) 4) B7 = B7

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.sandwich_positivity
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.s.header:
theorem sandwich_positivity :
    0 < cStarDeltaKCFormCorr split24 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7)
        (dinvC (trivialU witL7) 4) B7

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.sandwich_energy_bound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSandwich.s.header:
theorem sandwich_energy_bound :
    (1 / 64 : ℝ) * bondEnergy B7
      ≤ cStarDeltaKCFormCorr split24 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7)
          (dinvC (trivialU witL7) 4) B7

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.schur_le_raw_at_split
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.s.header:
theorem schur_le_raw_at_split (S : LevelSplit) (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful S.fibre levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    deltaKCorr S levels U B ≤ dstarDQuadForm U B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.collapsed_pairing_dead
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.c.header:
theorem collapsed_pairing_dead (ell : ℕ) (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) (hB : B ∈ gaugeConstraintSubspaceCovFaithful ell levels U)
    (u : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo)
    (hu : ∀ v ∈ gaugeConstraintSubspaceCovFaithful ell levels U,
      covPlaqInner u (curlCovariantLM U v) = 0) :
    covPlaqInner u (curlCovariantLM U B) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.collapsed_factoring_dead
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.c.header:
theorem collapsed_factoring_dead {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (Dinv : CoarseBond L ell → (SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo))
    (hinv : ∀ c : CoarseBond L ell,
      (coeffDc U ell c (droppedBondLast ell c)).comp (Dinv c) = LinearMap.id)
    (Btil : Bond L → SuTwo) (φ : (CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) :
    φ (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell (fullC U ell Dinv Btil)) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.w.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.windowMult
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.w.header:
noncomputable def windowMult (ell : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.stokesU_eq_mult
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.s.header:
theorem stokesU_eq_mult (ell : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν)
    (w : SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    stokesU ell y hlt w p = ((windowMult ell y hlt p : ℝ)) • w

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.w.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.windowMult_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.w.header:
theorem windowMult_le (ell : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    windowMult ell y hlt p ≤ ell * ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.sum_windowMult
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.s.header:
theorem sum_windowMult (ell : ℕ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν) :
    ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, windowMult ell y hlt p = ell ^ 5

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.stokesU_self_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.s.header:
theorem stokesU_self_le (ell : ℕ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν)
    (w : SuTwo) :
    covPlaqInner (stokesU ell y hlt w) (stokesU ell y hlt w)
      ≤ ((ell : ℝ)) ^ 7 * hsInner w w

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.stokesU_self_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.s.header:
theorem stokesU_self_pos (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν) {w : SuTwo} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    0 < covPlaqInner (stokesU ell y hlt w) (stokesU ell y hlt w)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.d.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.deltaJ_ge_coarse_curl_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.d.header:
theorem deltaJ_ge_coarse_curl_sq {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν)
    {w : SuTwo} (hw : w ≠ 0) (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH (trivialU L) levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels (trivialU L)).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    (ell : ℝ) * (hsInner w (coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd
        (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell B)
        ((⟨y, hy⟩, ⟨(μ, ν), hlt⟩) : CoarsePlaquette L ell))) ^ 2 / hsInner w w
      ≤ deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful ell levels (trivialU L) B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.t.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.third_level_energy_bound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.t.header:
theorem third_level_energy_bound :
    (1 / 64 : ℝ) * bondEnergy B7
      ≤ deltaKCorr split24 (oneLevelUniv witL7) (trivialU witL7) B7

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.g.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.general_U_pairing_control
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelSchurGap.g.header:
theorem general_U_pairing_control {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν)
    (w : SuTwo)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    |covPlaqInner (stokesU ell y hlt w) (curlCovariantLM U B)
        - stokesPhi ell hdvd hy hlt w (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell B)|
      ≤ Real.sqrt (covPlaqInner (stokesU ell y hlt w) (stokesU ell y hlt w))
          * (4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond U * Real.sqrt (bondEnergy B))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.hsI.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.hsInner_zero_right
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.hsI.header: theorem hsInner_zero_right (X : SuTwo) : hsInner X (0 : SuTwo) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.hsI.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.hsInner_add_right
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.hsI.header: theorem hsInner_add_right (X Y Z : SuTwo) : hsInner X (Y + Z) = hsInner X Y + hsInner X Z

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.hsI.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.hsInner_sub_right
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.hsI.header: theorem hsInner_sub_right (X Y Z : SuTwo) : hsInner X (Y - Z) = hsInner X Y - hsInner X Z

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.hsI.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.hsInner_smul_right
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.hsI.header: theorem hsInner_smul_right (X Y : SuTwo) (r : ℝ) : hsInner X (r • Y) = r * hsInner X Y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.hsI.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.hsInner_sum_right
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.hsI.header:
theorem hsInner_sum_right {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → SuTwo) (X : SuTwo) :
    hsInner X (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, hsInner X (f i)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.per.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.periodicLatticeShift_comm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.per.header:
theorem periodicLatticeShift_comm (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {μ ν : Fin 3} (h : μ ≠ ν) :
    periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν
      = periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x ν) μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.pat.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.pathSite_shift_comm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.pat.header:
theorem pathSite_shift_comm (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {ρ σ : Fin 3} (h : ρ ≠ σ) (i : ℕ) :
    pathSite (periodicLatticeShift x ρ) σ i = periodicLatticeShift (pathSite x σ i) ρ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.pat.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.pathSite_comm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.pat.header:
theorem pathSite_comm (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {μ ν : Fin 3} (h : μ ≠ ν) (i j : ℕ) :
    pathSite (pathSite x μ i) ν j = pathSite (pathSite x ν j) μ i

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.pat.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.pathSite_eq_coarseShift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.pat.header:
theorem pathSite_eq_coarseShift (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) :
    pathSite x ν ell = coarseShift x ell ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.lin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.lineSum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.lin.header:
noncomputable def lineSum (ell : ℕ) (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (μ : Fin 3) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.win.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.window_curl_sum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.win.header:
theorem window_curl_sum (ell : ℕ) (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell,
        curlValueCovariant (trivialU L) v
          (pathSite (pathSite x μ i) ν j, ⟨(μ, ν), hlt⟩)
      = lineSum ell v x μ - lineSum ell v (coarseShift x ell ν) μ
        + (lineSum ell v (coarseShift x ell μ) ν - lineSum ell v x ν)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.coarseCurlSuTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.coa.header:
noncomputable def coarseCurlSuTwo {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (p : CoarsePlaquette L ell) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.coarseCurlSuTwo_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.coa.header:
theorem coarseCurlSuTwo_add {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B1 B2 : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (p : CoarsePlaquette L ell) :
    coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd (B1 + B2) p = coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd B1 p + coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd B2 p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.coarseCurlSuTwo_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.coa.header:
theorem coarseCurlSuTwo_smul {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (c : ℝ) (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (p : CoarsePlaquette L ell) :
    coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd (c • B) p = c • coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd B p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.ell.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.ell4_smul_lineCoarseRestrict
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.ell.header:
theorem ell4_smul_lineCoarseRestrict (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (v : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (b : CoarseBond L ell) :
    ((ell : ℝ) ^ 4) • lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell v b
      = ∑ x ∈ blockOf b.1.1 ell, lineSum ell v x b.2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.sto.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.stokes_flat
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.sto.header:
theorem stokes_flat {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf y ell, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell,
        curlValueCovariant (trivialU L) v (pathSite (pathSite x μ i) ν j, ⟨(μ, ν), hlt⟩)
      = ((ell : ℝ) ^ 4) •
          coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell v)
            ((⟨y, hy⟩, ⟨(μ, ν), hlt⟩) : CoarsePlaquette L ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.win.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.windowSet
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.win.header: def windowSet (ell : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L × ℕ × ℕ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.win.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.windowPlaq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.win.header:
def windowPlaq {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν)
    (t : PeriodicLatticeSite L × ℕ × ℕ) : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.sto.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.stokesU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.sto.header:
noncomputable def stokesU (ell : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν)
    (w : SuTwo) : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.sto.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.stokesPhi
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.sto.header:
noncomputable def stokesPhi (ell : ℕ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν)
    (w : SuTwo) : (CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.sto.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.stokesPhi_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.sto.header:
theorem stokesPhi_apply (ell : ℕ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν)
    (w : SuTwo) (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) :
    stokesPhi ell hdvd hy hlt w B = ((ell : ℝ) ^ 4) *
      hsInner w (coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd B ((⟨y, hy⟩, ⟨(μ, ν), hlt⟩) : CoarsePlaquette L ell))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.cov.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.covPlaqInner_stokesU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.cov.header:
theorem covPlaqInner_stokesU (ell : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν)
    (w : SuTwo) (X : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo) :
    covPlaqInner (stokesU ell y hlt w) X
      = ∑ t ∈ windowSet ell y, hsInner w (X (windowPlaq hlt t))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.sto.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.stokes_factoring
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.sto.header:
theorem stokes_factoring {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν)
    (w : SuTwo) (v : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    covPlaqInner (stokesU ell y hlt w) (curlCovariantLM (trivialU L) v)
      = stokesPhi ell hdvd hy hlt w (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell v)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.del.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.deltaJ_ge_dual_pairing_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.del.header:
theorem deltaJ_ge_dual_pairing_sq (ell : ℕ) (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) (u : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo)
    (hu : ∀ v ∈ gaugeConstraintSubspaceCovFaithful ell levels U,
      covPlaqInner u (curlCovariantLM U v) = 0)
    (hupos : 0 < covPlaqInner u u) :
    (covPlaqInner u (curlCovariantLM U B)) ^ 2 / covPlaqInner u u
      ≤ deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful ell levels U B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.pa.header: def pathSiteBack (s : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.pa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.pathSiteBack_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.pa.header: theorem pathSiteBack_zero (s : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : pathSiteBack s μ 0 = s

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.pa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.pathSiteBack_succ'
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.pa.header:
theorem pathSiteBack_succ' (s : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :
    pathSiteBack s μ (i + 1) = pathSiteBack (periodicLatticeShiftBack s μ) μ i

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.pa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.pathSite_eq_iff_back
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.pa.header:
theorem pathSite_eq_iff_back (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∀ (i : ℕ) (s : PeriodicLatticeSite L), pathSite x μ i = s ↔ x = pathSiteBack s μ i

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.sh.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.shiftBack_apply_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.sh.header:
theorem shiftBack_apply_ne (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {μ ρ : Fin 3} (h : ρ ≠ μ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.pa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.pathSiteBack_apply_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.pa.header:
theorem pathSiteBack_apply_ne {μ ρ : Fin 3} (h : ρ ≠ μ) :
    ∀ (i : ℕ) (s : PeriodicLatticeSite L), (pathSiteBack s μ i) ρ = s ρ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.sh.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.shiftBack_update_comm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.sh.header:
theorem shiftBack_update_comm (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {μ ν : Fin 3} (h : ν ≠ μ)

    periodicLatticeShiftBack (Function.update z ν a) μ
      = Function.update (periodicLatticeShiftBack z μ) ν a

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.pa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.pathSiteBack_update_comm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.pa.header:
theorem pathSiteBack_update_comm {μ ν : Fin 3} (h : ν ≠ μ) (a : _) :
    ∀ (i : ℕ) (s : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
      pathSiteBack (Function.update s ν a) μ i = Function.update (pathSiteBack s μ i) ν a

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.di.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.dipole
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.di.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.di.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.dipole_apply_plus
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.di.header:
theorem dipole_apply_plus {s s' : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hne : s ≠ s') (μ : Fin 3) (w : SuTwo) :
    dipole s s' μ w (s, μ) = w

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.Q_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.Q_dipole_apply_offdir
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.Q_.header:
theorem Q_dipole_apply_offdir (ell : ℕ) (s s' : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (w : SuTwo)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) (hc : c.2 ≠ μ) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell (dipole s s' μ w) c = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.Q_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.Q_dipole_apply_dir
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.Q_.header:
theorem Q_dipole_apply_dir (ell : ℕ) (s s' : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (w : SuTwo)
    (yc : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell (dipole s s' μ w) (yc, μ)
      = (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) •
          (((∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
              if pathSiteBack s μ i ∈ blockOf yc.1 ell then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
            - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
              if pathSiteBack s' μ i ∈ blockOf yc.1 ell then (1 : ℝ) else 0) • w)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.Q_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.Q_dipole_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.Q_.header:
theorem Q_dipole_zero (ell : ℕ) {s s' : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {μ ν : Fin 3} (hνμ : ν ≠ μ)

    (hwin : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell →
      (((y ν).val ≤ (s ν).val ∧ (s ν).val < (y ν).val + ell) ↔
        ((y ν).val ≤ (s' ν).val ∧ (s' ν).val < (y ν).val + ell)))
    (w : SuTwo) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell (dipole s s' μ w) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.coarseCurlSuTwo_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelWitness.co.header:
theorem coarseCurlSuTwo_apply {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ}
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν)
    (h1 : AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.coarseShift y ell μ ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (h2 : AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.coarseShift y ell ν ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :
    coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd B
        ((⟨y, hy⟩, ⟨(μ, ν), hlt⟩) : AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.CoarsePlaquette L ell)
      = B (⟨y, hy⟩, μ)
        + B (⟨AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.coarseShift y ell μ, h1⟩, ν)
        - B (⟨AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.coarseShift y ell ν, h2⟩, μ)
        - B (⟨y, hy⟩, ν)

Thm315Core.printed_factors_are_adjoint.name: Thm315Core.printed_factors_are_adjoint
Thm315Core.printed_factors_are_adjoint.header:
theorem printed_factors_are_adjoint
    (hQ : ∀ (A : 𝔄) (B : 𝔅), ⟪Qs B, A⟫_ℝ = ⟪B, Q A⟫_ℝ)

Thm315Core.sandwich_psd.header:
theorem sandwich_psd (G2t : 𝔄 →L[ℝ] 𝔄) (C : 𝔅 →L[ℝ] 𝔅)

    (hadj : ∀ (A : 𝔄) (B : 𝔅),

Thm315Core.sandwich_form_le.name: Thm315Core.sandwich_form_le
Thm315Core.sandwich_form_le.header:
theorem sandwich_form_le (G2t : 𝔄 →L[ℝ] 𝔄) (C : 𝔅 →L[ℝ] 𝔅)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.unitToCo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.unitToCoarseCov_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.unitToCo.header:

    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (r : ℝ)
    (B : CoarseBond L ell₀ → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L (ell₀ * m)) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_la.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_law_cov_at_trivial
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_la.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_com.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_compose
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_com.header:
theorem norm_compose (ell₀ m : ℕ) :
    (1 / (m : ℝ) ^ 4) * (1 / (ell₀ : ℝ) ^ 4) = 1 / ((ell₀ : ℝ) * (m : ℝ)) ^ 4

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.lhs_expa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.lhs_expand
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.lhs_expa.header:
theorem lhs_expand {ell₀ m : ℕ} (hell₀ : 0 < ell₀)
    (hdvd₀ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell₀ ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L (ell₀ * m)) :
    unitToCoarseCov ell₀ m V (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell₀ v) c
      = (1 / ((ell₀ : ℝ) * (m : ℝ)) ^ 4) •
          ∑ u ∈ unitSitesOf ell₀ (ell₀ * m) c.1.1, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m,
            ∑ x ∈ blockOf u.1 ell₀, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell₀,
              RMap (lhsTransport ell₀ V U c.1.1 u.1 x c.2 i j)
                (v (pathSite x c.2 (i * ell₀ + j), c.2))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.rhs_expa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.rhs_expand
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.rhs_expa.header:
theorem rhs_expand {ell₀ m : ℕ} (hell₀ : 0 < ell₀)
    (hdvd₀ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell₀ ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L (ell₀ * m)) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U (ell₀ * m) v c
      = (1 / ((ell₀ : ℝ) * (m : ℝ)) ^ 4) •
          ∑ u ∈ unitSitesOf ell₀ (ell₀ * m) c.1.1, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m,
            ∑ x ∈ blockOf u.1 ell₀, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell₀,
              RMap (rhsTransport ell₀ U c.1.1 x c.2 i j)
                (v (pathSite x c.2 (i * ell₀ + j), c.2))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.Transpor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.TransportCompose

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_la.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_law_cov_of_transportCompose
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_la.header:
theorem tower_law_cov_of_transportCompose {ell₀ m : ℕ} (hell₀ : 0 < ell₀)
    (hdvd₀ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell₀ ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L (ell₀ * m))
    (h : TransportCompose ell₀ m V U c.1.1 c.2) :
    unitToCoarseCov ell₀ m V (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell₀ v) c
      = lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U (ell₀ * m) v c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_RMa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_RMap
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_RMa.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_tra.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_transport_diff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_tra.header:
theorem norm_transport_diff (ell₀ : ℕ)
    (V U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (y u x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i j : ℕ) (Y : SuTwo) :
    ‖RMap (lhsTransport ell₀ V U y u x μ i j) Y - RMap (rhsTransport ell₀ U y x μ i j) Y‖
      = ‖RMap (towerDefect ell₀ V U y u x μ i j) Y - Y‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_la.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_law_cov_error_bound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_la.header:
theorem tower_law_cov_error_bound {ell₀ m : ℕ} (hell₀ : 0 < ell₀)
    (hdvd₀ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell₀ ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L (ell₀ * m)) :
    ‖unitToCoarseCov ell₀ m V (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell₀ v) c
        - lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U (ell₀ * m) v c‖
      ≤ (1 / ((ell₀ : ℝ) * (m : ℝ)) ^ 4) *
          ∑ u ∈ unitSitesOf ell₀ (ell₀ * m) c.1.1, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m,
            ∑ x ∈ blockOf u.1 ell₀, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell₀,
              ‖RMap (towerDefect ell₀ V U c.1.1 u.1 x c.2 i j)
                  (v (pathSite x c.2 (i * ell₀ + j), c.2))
                - v (pathSite x c.2 (i * ell₀ + j), c.2)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_la.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_law_cov_of_zero_defect
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_la.header:
theorem tower_law_cov_of_zero_defect {ell₀ m : ℕ} (hell₀ : 0 < ell₀)
    (hdvd₀ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell₀ ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L (ell₀ * m))
    (h : ∀ u ∈ unitSitesOf ell₀ (ell₀ * m) c.1.1, ∀ i ∈ Finset.range m,
      ∀ x ∈ blockOf u.1 ell₀, ∀ j ∈ Finset.range ell₀,
        RMap (towerDefect ell₀ V U c.1.1 u.1 x c.2 i j)
            (v (pathSite x c.2 (i * ell₀ + j), c.2))
          = v (pathSite x c.2 (i * ell₀ + j), c.2)) :
    unitToCoarseCov ell₀ m V (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell₀ v) c
      = lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U (ell₀ * m) v c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_RMa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_RMap_mul_sub_self_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_RMa.header:
theorem norm_RMap_mul_sub_self_le (g h : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (X : SuTwo) :
    ‖RMap (g * h) X - X‖ ≤ ‖RMap h X - X‖ + ‖RMap g X - X‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_RMa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_RMap_inv_sub_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_RMa.header:
theorem norm_RMap_inv_sub_self (g : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (X : SuTwo) :
    ‖RMap g⁻¹ X - X‖ = ‖RMap g X - X‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_RMa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_RMap_hol_sub_self_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_RMa.header:
theorem norm_RMap_hol_sub_self_le {α : ℝ}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (X : SuTwo)
    (hU : ∀ b : Bond L, ‖RMap (U b) X - X‖ ≤ α) :
    ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : List (Fin 3 × Bool)),
      ‖RMap (periodicPathHolonomy U y s) X - X‖ ≤ (s.length : ℝ) * α

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_RMa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_RMap_coarseHol_sub_self_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.norm_RMa.header:
theorem norm_RMap_coarseHol_sub_self_le {α : ℝ} (ell : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (X : SuTwo)
    (hV : ∀ b : Bond L, ‖RMap (V b) X - X‖ ≤ α) :
    ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3)),
      ‖RMap (coarsePathHolonomy ell V y p) X - X‖ ≤ (p.length : ℝ) * α

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.towerDef.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.towerDefect_norm_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.towerDef.header:
theorem towerDefect_norm_le {α : ℝ} (ell₀ : ℕ)
    (V U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (X : SuTwo)
    (hU : ∀ b : Bond L, ‖RMap (U b) X - X‖ ≤ α)
    (hV : ∀ b : Bond L, ‖RMap (V b) X - X‖ ≤ α)
    (y u x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i j : ℕ) :
    ‖RMap (towerDefect ell₀ V U y u x μ i j) X - X‖
      ≤ (((coarseTransportPath ell₀ y u μ i).length : ℝ)
          + ((transportPath (pathSite u μ (i * ell₀)) (pathSite x μ (i * ell₀)) μ j).length : ℝ)
          + ((transportPath y x μ (i * ell₀ + j)).length : ℝ)) * α

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.expansio.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.expansion_card
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.expansio.header:
theorem expansion_card {ell₀ m : ℕ} (hell₀ : 0 < ell₀)
    (hdvd₀ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell₀ ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hdvd₁ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (ell₀ * m) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell₀ * m)) :
    ∑ u ∈ unitSitesOf ell₀ (ell₀ * m) y, ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range m, ∑ _x ∈ blockOf u.1 ell₀,
      ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range ell₀, (1 : ℝ) = ((ell₀ : ℝ) * (m : ℝ)) ^ 4

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_la.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_law_cov_error_uniform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_la.header:
theorem tower_law_cov_error_uniform {ell₀ m : ℕ} (hell₀ : 0 < ell₀) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdvd₀ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell₀ ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hdvd₁ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (ell₀ * m) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L (ell₀ * m)) (E : ℝ)
    (hE : ∀ u ∈ unitSitesOf ell₀ (ell₀ * m) c.1.1, ∀ i ∈ Finset.range m,
      ∀ x ∈ blockOf u.1 ell₀, ∀ j ∈ Finset.range ell₀,
        ‖RMap (towerDefect ell₀ V U c.1.1 u.1 x c.2 i j)
            (v (pathSite x c.2 (i * ell₀ + j), c.2))
          - v (pathSite x c.2 (i * ell₀ + j), c.2)‖ ≤ E) :
    ‖unitToCoarseCov ell₀ m V (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell₀ v) c
        - lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U (ell₀ * m) v c‖ ≤ E

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.link_dis.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.link_displacement_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.link_dis.header:
theorem link_displacement_le {α₁ : ℝ}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (X : SuTwo)
    (hU : ∀ b : Bond L,
      RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α₁) :
    ∀ b : Bond L, ‖RMap (U b) X - X‖ ≤ 2 * α₁ * ‖X‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_la.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_law_cov_error_alpha
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.tower_la.header:
theorem tower_law_cov_error_alpha {ell₀ m : ℕ} (hell₀ : 0 < ell₀) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdvd₀ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell₀ ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hdvd₁ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (ell₀ * m) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L (ell₀ * m))
    {α₁ Kv : ℝ} (N : ℕ) (hα₁ : 0 ≤ α₁)
    (hUf : ∀ b : Bond L, RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α₁)
    (hVf : ∀ b : Bond L, RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((V b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α₁)
    (hv : ∀ b : Bond L, ‖v b‖ ≤ Kv)
    (hlen : ∀ u ∈ unitSitesOf ell₀ (ell₀ * m) c.1.1, ∀ i ∈ Finset.range m,
      ∀ x ∈ blockOf u.1 ell₀, ∀ j ∈ Finset.range ell₀,
        (coarseTransportPath ell₀ c.1.1 u.1 c.2 i).length
          + (transportPath (pathSite u.1 c.2 (i * ell₀)) (pathSite x c.2 (i * ell₀)) c.2 j).length
          + (transportPath c.1.1 x c.2 (i * ell₀ + j)).length ≤ N) :
    ‖unitToCoarseCov ell₀ m V (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell₀ v) c
        - lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U (ell₀ * m) v c‖ ≤ (N : ℝ) * (2 * α₁ * Kv)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.self_mem.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.self_mem_blockOf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.self_mem.header:

      decide ((if st.2 then (y, st.1) else (periodicLatticeStep y st, st.1)) = b₀)
        || hitsBond b₀ (periodicLatticeStep y st) rest

    (T : {z : PeriodicLatticeSite witL7 // z ∈ CoarseLattice witL7 2} →
      ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite witL7 → ℕ → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (x₀ : PeriodicLatticeSite witL7) (hx₀ : (x₀ (0 : Fin 3)).val = 4)
    (u₀ : {z : PeriodicLatticeSite witL7 // z ∈ CoarseLattice witL7 2})
    (hu₀ : u₀ ∈ unitSitesOf 2 (2 * 2) y7) (hx₀m : x₀ ∈ blockOf u₀.1 2) :
    (∑ u ∈ unitSitesOf 2 (2 * 2) y7, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 2, ∑ x ∈ blockOf u.1 2,
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range 2,
          RMap (T u i x j)

      = RMap (T u₀ 0 x₀ 0) suTwoWitness

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.level.header:
theorem level_gf_on_preimage (lvl : Level Λ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (Λ μ + 1))
    (hdvd' : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (coarseExtent Λ 2 μ + 1)) (u : BondFnL2 Λ)
    (hu : VLat (coarseExtent Λ 2) (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel hdvd u))) :
    gammaV * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ u (lvl.op u) : ℝ)
      + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice Λ 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.next_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.next_coercive_on_VLat
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.next_.header:
theorem next_coercive_on_VLat (lvl : Level Λ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (Λ μ + 1))
    (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * 2 ≤ Λ μ + 1)
    (hdvd' : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (coarseExtent Λ 2 μ + 1)) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    {B : BondFnL2 (coarseExtent Λ 2)} (hB : VLat (coarseExtent Λ 2) (WithLp.ofLp B)) :
    gammaV / ‖qCLM (trivialU Λ) 2‖ ^ 2 * ‖B‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ B ((levelRung lvl hdvd hwide ha).next B) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.header:
noncomputable def tower (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∀ (k : ℕ), (∀ i, i < k → LevelOK L i) → Level (levelExtent L k)
  | 0, _ => baseLevel L
  | (k + 1), h =>
      stepLevel (tower L ha k (fun i hi => h i (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hi)))
        (h k (Nat.lt_succ_self k)).1 (h k (Nat.lt_succ_self k)).2 ha

@[simp] theorem tower_zero_op (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (h : ∀ i, i < 0 → LevelOK L i) :
    (tower L ha 0 h).op = deltaKCLMNormalized (trivialU L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower_law
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.header:
theorem tower_law (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (k : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i, i < k + 1 → LevelOK L i) :
    (tower L ha (k + 1) h).op
      = (levelRung (tower L ha k (fun i hi => h i (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hi)))
          (h k (Nat.lt_succ_self k)).1 (h k (Nat.lt_succ_self k)).2 ha).next

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.level.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.levelOK_below
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.level.header:
theorem levelOK_below {k : ℕ} (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : m ≤ k + 1) : ∀ i, i < m → LevelOK L i

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.towerAt
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.towerAt_law
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.header:
theorem towerAt_law (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {k : ℕ}
    (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) :
    (towerAt L ha hpow (j + 1) (by omega)).op
      = (levelRung (towerAt L ha hpow j (by omega))
          (levelOK_of_pow hpow hj).1 (levelOK_of_pow hpow hj).2 ha).next

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.level.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.levelExtent_even
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.level.header:
theorem levelExtent_even {k : ℕ} (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : j ≤ k + 1) : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (levelExtent L j μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower_uniform_coercive
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.header:
theorem tower_uniform_coercive (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {k : ℕ}
    (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k)
    (u : BondFnL2 (levelExtent L j))
    (hu : VLat (levelExtent L (j + 1))
      (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel (levelOK_of_pow hpow hj).1 u))) :
    gammaStar * ‖u‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ u ((towerAt L ha hpow j (by omega)).op u) : ℝ)
        + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice (levelExtent L j) 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.vLat_.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.vLat_.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.vLat_.header: theorem vLat_zero (Λ' : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : VLat Λ' (0 : Bond Λ' → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.level.header:
theorem levelExtent_four {k : ℕ} (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) {j : ℕ}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.miles.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.milestone_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.miles.header:
theorem milestone_nonvacuous (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {k : ℕ}
    (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) :
    ∃ B : BondFnL2 (levelExtent L (j + 1)),
      VLat (levelExtent L (j + 1)) (WithLp.ofLp B) ∧ B ≠ 0
        ∧ 0 < gammaStar / ‖qCLM (trivialU (levelExtent L j)) 2‖ ^ 2 * ‖B‖ ^ 2
        ∧ 0 < (inner ℝ B ((towerAt L ha hpow (j + 1) (by omega)).op B) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower_uniform_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.header:
theorem tower_uniform_nonvacuous (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {k : ℕ}
    (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) :
    ∃ u : BondFnL2 (levelExtent L j),
      VLat (levelExtent L (j + 1)) (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel (levelOK_of_pow hpow hj).1 u))
        ∧ u ≠ 0
        ∧ qLevel (levelOK_of_pow hpow hj).1 u ≠ 0
        ∧ 0 < gammaStar * ‖u‖ ^ 2
        ∧ 0 < (inner ℝ u ((towerAt L ha hpow j (by omega)).op u) : ℝ)
            + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice (levelExtent L j) 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.level.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.level_gf_on_preimage_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.level.header:
theorem level_gf_on_preimage_nonvacuous (lvl : Level Λ)
    (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (Λ μ + 1)) :
    ∃ u : BondFnL2 Λ,
      VLat (coarseExtent Λ 2) (WithLp.ofLp
          (qLevel (AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.two_dvd_of_four hdvd4) u))
        ∧ u ≠ 0
        ∧ qLevel (AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.two_dvd_of_four hdvd4) u ≠ 0
        ∧ 0 < gammaV * ‖u‖ ^ 2
        ∧ 0 < (inner ℝ u (lvl.op u) : ℝ)
            + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice Λ 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.vSrc_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.vSrc_preimage_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.vSrc_.header:
theorem vSrc_preimage_nonvacuous (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    ∃ A : Bond L → SuTwo,
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSrc hdvd4 (lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 2 A)
        ∧ A ≠ 0
        ∧ lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 2 A ≠ 0
        ∧ 0 < gammaV * bondEnergy A
        ∧ 0 < curlEnergy A + pAx A (CoarseLattice L 2) 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.vLat_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.vLat_is_load_bearing
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.vLat_.header:
theorem vLat_is_load_bearing (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (Λ μ + 1))
    {g : Fin 3 → SuTwo} {ρ : Fin 3} (hg : g ρ ≠ 0) {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ) :
    (¬ (γ * bondEnergy (suTwoLift 2 (siteConstCoarse (L := Λ) g))
        ≤ curlEnergy (suTwoLift 2 (siteConstCoarse (L := Λ) g))
          + pAx (suTwoLift 2 (siteConstCoarse (L := Λ) g)) (CoarseLattice Λ 2) 2))
      ∧ ¬ VLat (coarseExtent Λ 2)
          (pullS (by norm_num) (AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.two_dvd_of_four hdvd4)
            (siteConstCoarse (L := Λ) g))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.vWitF.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.vWitFine_value
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.vWitF.header:
theorem vWitFine_value (hpos : 1 < Λ 0 + 1) (w : SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.vWitF.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.vWitFine_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.vWitF.header:
theorem vWitFine_ne_zero (hpos : 1 < Λ 0 + 1) {w : SuTwo} (hw : w ≠ 0) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.hcurl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.hcurl_is_load_bearing
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.hcurl.header:
theorem hcurl_is_load_bearing (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (Λ μ + 1)) (hp : 1 < Λ 0 + 1)
    {w : SuTwo} (hw : w ≠ 0) (a : ℝ) :
    ∃ v : BondFnL2 Λ, v ≠ 0
      ∧ (0 : ℝ) < curlEnergy (WithLp.ofLp v)
      ∧ (inner ℝ v ((0 : BondFnL2 Λ →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 Λ) v) : ℝ) = 0
      ∧ (inner ℝ v (fineCLM (piOp (0 : BondFnL2 Λ →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 Λ) 0)
          (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice Λ 2) 2) (qLevel hdvd) (qLevelStar hdvd) a v) : ℝ) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.fine_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.fine_hypothesis_kernel_route
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.fine_.header:
theorem fine_hypothesis_kernel_route (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (Λ μ + 1))

    ∃ v : BondFnL2 Λ, v ≠ 0
      ∧ qLevel hdvd v = 0
      ∧ VLat (coarseExtent Λ 2) (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel hdvd v))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.witL_.header: theorem witL_pow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (1 + 2) ∣ (witL μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.depth.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.depth_two_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.depth.header:
theorem depth_two_nonvacuous :

        ∧ 0 < gammaStar / ‖qCLM (trivialU (levelExtent witL 1)) 2‖ ^ 2 * ‖B‖ ^ 2
        ∧ 0 < (inner ℝ B ((towerAt witL one_pos_real witL_pow 2 (by omega)).op B) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.depth.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.depth_one_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.depth.header:
theorem depth_one_nonvacuous :

        ∧ 0 < gammaStar / ‖qCLM (trivialU (levelExtent witL 0)) 2‖ ^ 2 * ‖B‖ ^ 2
        ∧ 0 < (inner ℝ B ((towerAt witL one_pos_real witL_pow 1 (by omega)).op B) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower_uniform_depth_zero_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.header:
theorem tower_uniform_depth_zero_nonvacuous :
    ∃ u : BondFnL2 (levelExtent witL 0),
      VLat (levelExtent witL 1)
          (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel (levelOK_of_pow witL_pow (show (0 : ℕ) ≤ 1 by omega)).1 u))
        ∧ u ≠ 0
        ∧ qLevel (levelOK_of_pow witL_pow (show (0 : ℕ) ≤ 1 by omega)).1 u ≠ 0
        ∧ 0 < gammaStar * ‖u‖ ^ 2
        ∧ 0 < (inner ℝ u ((towerAt witL one_pos_real witL_pow 0 (by omega)).op u) : ℝ)
            + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice (levelExtent witL 0) 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower_uniform_depth_one_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.header:
theorem tower_uniform_depth_one_nonvacuous :
    ∃ u : BondFnL2 (levelExtent witL 1),
      VLat (levelExtent witL 2)
          (WithLp.ofLp (qLevel (levelOK_of_pow witL_pow (show (1 : ℕ) ≤ 1 by omega)).1 u))
        ∧ u ≠ 0
        ∧ qLevel (levelOK_of_pow witL_pow (show (1 : ℕ) ≤ 1 by omega)).1 u ≠ 0
        ∧ 0 < gammaStar * ‖u‖ ^ 2
        ∧ 0 < (inner ℝ u ((towerAt witL one_pos_real witL_pow 1 (by omega)).op u) : ℝ)
            + (inner ℝ u (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice (levelExtent witL 1) 2) 2 u) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.oneIs.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.oneIso
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.oneIs.header: noncomputable def oneIso (Λ : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : BondFnL2 Λ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] CoarseFnL2 Λ 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.qStep.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.qStep_apply_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.qStep.header:
theorem qStep_apply_eq (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * 2 ≤ Λ μ + 1) (x : BondFnL2 Λ)

    stepBondAvg 1 (trivialU Λ) 2 (WithLp.ofLp (oneIso Λ x)) b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.qCLM_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.qCLM_eq_qStep
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.qCLM_.header:
theorem qCLM_eq_qStep (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * 2 ≤ Λ μ + 1) (x : BondFnL2 Λ) :
    (qStepCLM 1 (trivialU Λ) 2 (oneIso Λ x) : CoarseFnL2 Λ 2) = qCLM (trivialU Λ) 2 x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.qCLM_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.qCLM_opNorm_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.qCLM_.header:
theorem qCLM_opNorm_le (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (Λ μ + 1))
    (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * 2 ≤ Λ μ + 1) :
    ‖qCLM (trivialU Λ) 2‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 / 8)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.qCLM_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.qCLM_normSq_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.qCLM_.header:
theorem qCLM_normSq_le (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (Λ μ + 1))
    (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * 2 ≤ Λ μ + 1) :
    ‖qCLM (trivialU Λ) 2‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 8

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower_next_coercive_uniform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower_next_uniform_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.header:
theorem tower_next_uniform_nonvacuous (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {k : ℕ}
    (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) :
    ∃ B : BondFnL2 (levelExtent L (j + 1)),

        ∧ 0 < (inner ℝ B ((towerAt L ha hpow (j + 1) (by omega)).op B) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower_next_uniform_depth_two_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.header:

        ∧ 0 < (inner ℝ B ((towerAt witL one_pos_real witL_pow 2 (by omega)).op B) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.step_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.step_curl_sharp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.step_.header:
theorem step_curl_sharp (lvl : Level Λ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (Λ μ + 1))
    (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * 2 ≤ Λ μ + 1) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (B : BondFnL2 (coarseExtent Λ 2)) :
    2 * curlEnergy (WithLp.ofLp B)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.towerAt_op_ne_lattice
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.tower.header:
theorem towerAt_op_ne_lattice (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {k : ℕ}
    (hpow : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ^ (k + 2) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) :
    (towerAt L ha hpow (j + 1) (by omega)).op
      ≠ deltaKCLMNormalized (trivialU (levelExtent L (j + 1)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.level.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.level_zero_two_routes_agree
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerMilestone.level.header:
theorem level_zero_two_routes_agree (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (u : BondFnL2 L)
    (hu : VLat (coarseExtent L 2)

    (gammaStar * ‖u‖ ^ 2

        ≤ curlEnergy (WithLp.ofLp u) + pAx (WithLp.ofLp u) (CoarseLattice L 2) 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.piOp_ze.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.piOp_sy.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.piOp_symm

    ∧ (∀ γ : ℝ, CoerciveOn (⇑(campaignTaxedLadder.op k)) γ →
        γ ≤ gammaSeq gammaFibre campaignDelta (1 / 2 : ℝ) k)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockQ.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockQ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockQ.header: noncomputable def blockQ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockQs.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockQstar
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockQs.header: noncomputable def blockQstar : ℝ →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockQ_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockQ_hadj
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockQ_.header:
theorem blockQ_hadj (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (B : ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ (blockQstar B) x : ℝ) = (inner ℝ B (blockQ x) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockQ_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockQ_bound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockQ_.header:
theorem blockQ_bound (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    ‖blockQ x‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 / 2) * ‖x‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRung
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRu.header:
noncomputable def blockRung (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    Rung (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ℝ (c • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRung_q_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRu.header: theorem blockRung_q_sq (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) : (blockRung c hc).q ^ 2 = 1 / 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRung_next
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRu.header:
theorem blockRung_next (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (B : ℝ) :
    (blockRung c hc).next B = (2 * c) * B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRung_bound_sharp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRu.header:
theorem blockRung_bound_sharp (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    c / (blockRung c hc).q ^ 2 = 2 * c
    ∧ (∀ B : ℝ, (inner ℝ B ((blockRung c hc).next B) : ℝ) = (2 * c) * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    ∧ (∀ γ : ℝ, CoerciveOn (⇑(blockRung c hc).next) γ → γ ≤ 2 * c)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRung_tower_law
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRu.header:
theorem blockRung_tower_law (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hΔ : CoerciveOn (⇑(c • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))) γ) :
    CoerciveOn (⇑(blockRung c hc).next) (2 * γ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRung_next_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.blockRu.header: theorem blockRung_next_eq (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) : (blockRung c hc).next = mulCLM (2 * c)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.twoStep.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.twoStep_op
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.twoStep.header:
theorem twoStep_op (hc : 0 < c) (hθ : 0 < θ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (B : ℝ) :
    (scalarRung (2 * c) θ a (by linarith) hθ ha).next B = ((2 * c) / θ ^ 2) * B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.twoStep.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.twoStep_tie
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.twoStep.header: theorem twoStep_tie (hc : 0 < c) : (blockRung c hc).next = mulCLM (2 * c)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.twoStep.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.twoStep_coercive
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.twoStep.header:
theorem twoStep_coercive (hc : 0 < c) (hθ : 0 < θ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hΔ : CoerciveOn (⇑(c • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))) γ) :
    CoerciveOn (⇑((blockRung c hc).next)) (2 * γ)
    ∧ CoerciveOn (⇑((scalarRung (2 * c) θ a (by linarith) hθ ha).next)) ((2 * γ) / θ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.twoStep.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.twoStep_sharp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.twoStep.header:
theorem twoStep_sharp (hc : 0 < c) (hθ : 0 < θ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (∀ B : ℝ, (inner ℝ B ((scalarRung (2 * c) θ a (by linarith) hθ ha).next B) : ℝ)
        = ((2 * c) / θ ^ 2) * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    ∧ (∀ γ : ℝ, CoerciveOn (⇑((scalarRung (2 * c) θ a (by linarith) hθ ha).next)) γ →
        γ ≤ (2 * c) / θ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.step_mo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.step_moves_operator
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.step_mo.header:
theorem step_moves_operator {c θ : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ ≠ 1) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, (scalarRung c θ 0 hc hθ le_rfl).next B ≠ mulCLM c B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.a_term_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.a_term_is_load_bearing
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.a_term_.header:
theorem a_term_is_load_bearing {c θ a : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hθ : 0 < θ) (ha : 0 < a) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.ladder_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.ladder_determined
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.ladder_.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.trivial.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.trivial_carrier_makes_coercivity_empty
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.trivial.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.piOp_eq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.piOp_eq_piExtendedMap

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.header:

    (hγ : 0 < γ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hDP : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L,
      γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (Δ x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ)) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.latticeRung_tower_law
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.header:
theorem latticeRung_tower_law {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    (Δ P : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L) (a γ : ℝ)
    (hDsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L, (inner ℝ u (Δ v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (Δ u) v : ℝ))

      γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (Δ x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ)) :
    CoerciveOn
      (⇑(latticeRung hell hdvd hwide Δ P a γ hDsym hPsym hPpos hγ ha hDP).next)
      (γ / ‖qCLM (trivialU L) ell‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.latticeRungPi
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.header:
noncomputable def latticeRungPi {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))

    (Δ Dpi P : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L) (a γ δ : ℝ)
    (hDsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L, (inner ℝ u (Δ v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (Δ u) v : ℝ))

    (hγδ : 0 < γ - δ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hpi : PiCorrectionBound Dpi δ)
    (hDP : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L,
      γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (Δ x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ)) :
