AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.latticeRungPi_tower_law
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.header:
theorem latticeRungPi_tower_law {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * ell ≤ L μ + 1)

    (hDsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L, (inner ℝ u (Δ v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (Δ u) v : ℝ))
    (hPiSym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L, (inner ℝ u (Dpi v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (Dpi u) v : ℝ))
    (hPsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L, (inner ℝ u (P v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (P u) v : ℝ))
    (hPpos : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, (0 : ℝ) ≤ (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ))

    (hpi : PiCorrectionBound Dpi δ)
    (hDP : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L,
      γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (Δ x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ)) :

      (⇑(latticeRungPi hell hdvd hwide Δ Dpi P a γ δ hDsym hPiSym hPsym hPpos hγδ ha hpi
          hDP).next)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.piCorre.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.piCorrectionBound_of_piForm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.piCorre.header:
theorem piCorrectionBound_of_piForm
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (J : Bond L → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (Lam : (Bond L → SuTwo) → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)
    (Dpi : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L) (Jsup kappa : ℝ)
    (hT : ∀ A : Bond L → SuTwo,
      (inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 A : BondFnL2 L) (Dpi (WithLp.toLp 2 A)) : ℝ)
        = deltaPrimePiForm U J (Lam A) A)
    (hJ : ∀ b, frobNorm (J b) ≤ Jsup) (hk0 : 0 ≤ kappa)
    (hlam : ∀ A : Bond L → SuTwo, siteEnergy (Lam A) ≤ kappa ^ 2 * bondEnergy A) :
    PiCorrectionBound Dpi (deltaPiConst Jsup kappa)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.latticeRungPi_tower_law_at_deltaPiConst
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.header:
theorem latticeRungPi_tower_law_at_deltaPiConst {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (J : Bond L → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (Lam : (Bond L → SuTwo) → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)
    (Δ Dpi P : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L) (a γ Jsup kappa : ℝ)
    (hDsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L, (inner ℝ u (Δ v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (Δ u) v : ℝ))
    (hPiSym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L, (inner ℝ u (Dpi v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (Dpi u) v : ℝ))
    (hPsym : ∀ u v : BondFnL2 L, (inner ℝ u (P v) : ℝ) = (inner ℝ (P u) v : ℝ))
    (hPpos : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, (0 : ℝ) ≤ (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ))
    (hγδ : 0 < γ - deltaPiConst Jsup kappa) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hT : ∀ A : Bond L → SuTwo,
      (inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 A : BondFnL2 L) (Dpi (WithLp.toLp 2 A)) : ℝ)
        = deltaPrimePiForm U J (Lam A) A)
    (hJ : ∀ b, frobNorm (J b) ≤ Jsup) (hk0 : 0 ≤ kappa)
    (hlam : ∀ A : Bond L → SuTwo, siteEnergy (Lam A) ≤ kappa ^ 2 * bondEnergy A)
    (hDP : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L,
      γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (Δ x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ)) :
    CoerciveOn
      (⇑(latticeRungPi hell hdvd hwide Δ Dpi P a γ (deltaPiConst Jsup kappa) hDsym hPiSym hPsym
          hPpos hγδ ha (piCorrectionBound_of_piForm U J Lam Dpi Jsup kappa hT hJ hk0 hlam)
          hDP).next)
      ((γ - deltaPiConst Jsup kappa) / ‖qCLM (trivialU L) ell‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.piForm_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.piForm_interface_vanishes_on_gauge_slice
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.piForm_.header:
theorem piForm_interface_vanishes_on_gauge_slice

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.piCorre.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.piCorrectionBound_zero_of_zero_current
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.piCorre.header:
theorem piCorrectionBound_zero_of_zero_current
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.deltaPr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.deltaPrimeSource_is_a_summand_of_deltaK

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.latticeRungAtDeltaK
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.header:
noncomputable def latticeRungAtDeltaK {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.latticeRungAtDeltaK_tower_law
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.header:
theorem latticeRungAtDeltaK_tower_law {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.latticeRungPiAtDeltaK
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.header:
noncomputable def latticeRungPiAtDeltaK {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.latticeRungPiAtDeltaK_tower_law
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.header:
theorem latticeRungPiAtDeltaK_tower_law {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (Dpi : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.latticeRungAtDeltaK_hDP_refuted_at_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerOneStep.lattice.header:
theorem latticeRungAtDeltaK_hDP_refuted_at_trivialU
    (hdvd2 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ) :

    [FiniteDimensional ℝ H] [Nontrivial H] [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℝ K]
    (Δ P : H →L[ℝ] H) (Q : H →L[ℝ] K) (Qstar : K →L[ℝ] H)
    (hadj : ∀ (x : H) (B : K), (inner ℝ (Qstar B) x : ℝ) = (inner ℝ B (Q x) : ℝ))
    (hDPpos : ∀ x : H, (0 : ℝ) ≤ (inner ℝ x (Δ x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ))
    (hker : ∀ x : H,
      (inner ℝ x (Δ x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ) = 0 → Q x = 0 → x = 0) :
    ∃ γ₀ : ℝ, 0 < γ₀ ∧ ∀ x : H,
      γ₀ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ x (Δ x) : ℝ) + (inner ℝ x (P x) : ℝ) + 1 * ‖Q x‖ ^ 2

theorem toIdx_toFine (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (a : PeriodicLatticeSite (coarseExtent L ell)) : toIdx L ell (toFine L ell a) = a

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.toFin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.toFine_toIdx
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.toFin.header:
theorem toFine_toIdx (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :
    toFine L ell (toIdx L ell y) = y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.toFin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.toFine_shift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.toFin.header:
theorem toFine_shift (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (a : PeriodicLatticeSite (coarseExtent L ell)) (μ : Fin 3) :
    toFine L ell (periodicLatticeShift a μ) = coarseShift (toFine L ell a) ell μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.pullb.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.pullback
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.pullb.header:
noncomputable def pullback (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B : CoarseBond L ell → ℝ) : Bond (coarseExtent L ell) → ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.curlF.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.curlFree_pullback
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.curlF.header:
theorem curlFree_pullback (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B : CoarseBond L ell → ℝ) (hB : ∀ p : CoarsePlaquette L ell, coarseCurlValue hdvd B p = 0) :
    U1AnchorPoincare.CurlFree (pullback hell hdvd B)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.coars.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.coarse_curlFree_eq_grad_add_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.coars.header:
theorem coarse_curlFree_eq_grad_add_const (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (B : CoarseBond L ell → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ p : CoarsePlaquette L ell, coarseCurlValue hdvd B p = 0) :
    ∃ (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (c : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ∀ (y : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}) (μ : Fin 3),
        B (y, μ) = h (coarseShift y.1 ell μ) - h y.1 + c μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.siteL.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.siteLift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.siteL.header:
noncomputable def siteLift (ell : ℕ) (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.coars.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.coarseRestrictSite_siteLift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.coars.header:
theorem coarseRestrictSite_siteLift (hell : 0 < ell) (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :
    coarseRestrictSite ell (siteLift ell h) y = h y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.curlC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.curlCLM_gradCLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.curlC.header:
theorem curlCLM_gradCLM (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (lam : SiteSpace L) :
    curlCLM L (gradCLM L lam) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.const.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.constBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.const.header: noncomputable def constBond (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (c : Fin 3 → ℝ) : BondSpace L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.bondE.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.bondEquiv_constBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.bondE.header:
theorem bondEquiv_constBond (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (c : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    bondEquiv L (constBond L c) = fun b : Bond L => c b.2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.curlC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.curlCLM_constBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.curlC.header:
theorem curlCLM_constBond (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (c : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    curlCLM L (constBond L c) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.lineC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.lineCoarseRestrict_constBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.lineC.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrict_constBond (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (c : Fin 3 → ℝ) (b : CoarseBond L ell) :
    lineCoarseRestrict ell (fun bd : Bond L => c bd.2) b = c b.2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.exist.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.exists_flat_with_same_Q
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.exist.header:
theorem exists_flat_with_same_Q (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (A0 : BondSpace L)
    (hflat : coarseCurlCLM L ell hdvd (lineCoarseRestrictCLM L ell A0) = 0) :
    ∃ A1 : BondSpace L, curlCLM L A1 = 0 ∧
      lineCoarseRestrictCLM L ell A1 = lineCoarseRestrictCLM L ell A0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.faith.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.faithfulLevels_hlev
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.faith.header:
theorem faithfulLevels_hlev {levels : List (Level L)} (hmem : (ell, Finset.univ) ∈ levels)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (hlam : lam ∈ kernelSubspace levels)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : coarseRestrictSite ell lam y = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.lineC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.lineCoarseRestrictCLM_gradCLM_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.lineC.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCLM_gradCLM_eq_zero (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (lam : SiteSpace L)
    (hlam : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, coarseRestrictSite ell (siteEquiv L lam) y = 0) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCLM L ell (gradCLM L lam) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.exist.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.exists_gaugeConstraint_with_same_curl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorCoarse.exist.header:
theorem exists_gaugeConstraint_with_same_curl (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (levels : List (Level L))
    (hlev : ∀ lam ∈ kernelSubspace levels, ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L,
      coarseRestrictSite ell lam y = 0)
    (A0 : BondSpace L)
    (hflat : coarseCurlCLM L ell hdvd (lineCoarseRestrictCLM L ell A0) = 0) :
    ∃ v ∈ gaugeConstraintSubspace ell levels, curlCLM L v = curlCLM L A0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.shi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.shift_apply_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.shi.header:
theorem shift_apply_ne (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (μ ν : Fin 3) (h : ν ≠ μ) :
    periodicLatticeShift x μ ν = x ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coarseShift_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coa.header: theorem coarseShift_zero (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (μ : Fin 3) : coarseShift x 0 μ = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coarseShift_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coa.header:
theorem coarseShift_one (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift x 1 μ = periodicLatticeShift x μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coarseShift_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coa.header:
theorem coarseShift_succ (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (k : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift x (k + 1) μ = periodicLatticeShift (coarseShift x k μ) μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.shi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.shift_commute
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.shi.header:
theorem shift_commute (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    Function.Commute (fun z : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ => periodicLatticeShift z μ)
      (fun z => periodicLatticeShift z ν)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coarseShift_comm_gen
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coa.header:
theorem coarseShift_comm_gen (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (k m : ℕ) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift (coarseShift x k μ) m ν = coarseShift (coarseShift x m ν) k μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.shi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.shift_coarseShift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.shi.header:
theorem shift_coarseShift (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (k : ℕ) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) k ν =
      periodicLatticeShift (coarseShift x k ν) μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.shi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.shift_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.shi.header:
theorem shift_val (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((periodicLatticeShift x μ) μ).val = ((x μ).val + 1) % (Λ μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coarseShift_period
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coa.header:
theorem coarseShift_period (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift x (Λ μ + 1) μ = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.exi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.exists_coarseShift_of_agree
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.exi.header:
theorem exists_coarseShift_of_agree (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (μ : Fin 3)
    (h : ∀ ν, ν ≠ μ → x ν = y ν) : ∃ k : ℕ, coarseShift x k μ = y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.eq_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.eq_of_shiftInvariant
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.eq_.header:
theorem eq_of_shiftInvariant {α : Type*} (g : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ → α)
    (hg : ∀ (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (μ : Fin 3), g (periodicLatticeShift x μ) = g x)
    (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) : g x = g y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.Cur.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.CurlFree
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.Cur.header: def CurlFree (A : Bond Λ → ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.tra.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.transport
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.tra.header:
theorem transport {A : Bond Λ → ℝ} (hA : CurlFree A) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    A (periodicLatticeShift x ν, μ) - A (x, μ) =
      A (periodicLatticeShift x μ, ν) - A (x, ν)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.cur.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.curlValue_sub
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.cur.header:
theorem curlValue_sub (F G : Bond Λ → ℝ) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette Λ) :
    curlValue (fun b => F b - G b) p = curlValue F p - curlValue G p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.cur.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.curlValue_of_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.cur.header:
theorem curlValue_of_const (c : Fin 3 → ℝ) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette Λ) :
    curlValue (fun b : Bond Λ => c b.2) p = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.lin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.lineIntegralValue_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.lin.header:
theorem lineIntegralValue_zero (A : Bond Λ → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    lineIntegralValue 0 A x ν = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.lin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.lineIntegralValue_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.lin.header:
theorem lineIntegralValue_succ (k : ℕ) (A : Bond Λ → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    lineIntegralValue (k + 1) A x ν =
      lineIntegralValue k A x ν + A (coarseShift x k ν, ν)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.lin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.lineIntegralValue_sub
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.lin.header:
theorem lineIntegralValue_sub (k : ℕ) (F G : Bond Λ → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    lineIntegralValue k (fun b => F b - G b) x ν =
      lineIntegralValue k F x ν - lineIntegralValue k G x ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.lin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.lineIntegralValue_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.lin.header:
theorem lineIntegralValue_const (k : ℕ) (c : Fin 3 → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    lineIntegralValue k (fun b : Bond Λ => c b.2) x ν = (k : ℝ) * c ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.lin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.lineIntegralValue_shift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.lin.header:
theorem lineIntegralValue_shift {A : Bond Λ → ℝ} (hA : CurlFree A) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ)
    (μ ν : Fin 3) (k : ℕ) :
    lineIntegralValue k A (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν - lineIntegralValue k A x ν =
      A (coarseShift x k ν, μ) - A (x, μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.hol.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.holonomy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.hol.header: noncomputable def holonomy (A : Bond Λ → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (ν : Fin 3) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.hol.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.holonomy_shift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.hol.header:
theorem holonomy_shift {A : Bond Λ → ℝ} (hA : CurlFree A) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ)
    (μ ν : Fin 3) : holonomy A (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν = holonomy A x ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.hol.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.holonomy_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.hol.header:
theorem holonomy_const {A : Bond Λ → ℝ} (hA : CurlFree A) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ)
    (ν : Fin 3) : holonomy A x ν = holonomy A y ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.hol.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.holonomy_sub
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.hol.header:
theorem holonomy_sub (F G : Bond Λ → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    holonomy (fun b => F b - G b) x ν = holonomy F x ν - holonomy G x ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.hol.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.holonomy_gradValue
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.hol.header:
theorem holonomy_gradValue (f : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ)
    (ν : Fin 3) : holonomy (gradValue f) x ν = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.hol.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.holonomy_const_field
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.hol.header:
theorem holonomy_const_field (c : Fin 3 → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    holonomy (fun b : Bond Λ => c b.2) x ν = ((Λ ν : ℝ) + 1) * c ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.zer.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.zeroOut
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.zer.header: def zeroOut (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (ν : Fin 3) : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.zer.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.zeroOut_apply_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.zer.header: theorem zeroOut_apply_self (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (ν : Fin 3) : zeroOut x ν ν = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.zer.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.zeroOut_apply_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.zer.header:
theorem zeroOut_apply_ne (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) {ν μ : Fin 3} (h : μ ≠ ν) :
    zeroOut x ν μ = x μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coarseShift_zeroOut
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.coa.header:
theorem coarseShift_zeroOut (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift (zeroOut x ν) ((x ν).val) ν = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.zer.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.zeroOut_shift_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.zer.header:
theorem zeroOut_shift_self (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    zeroOut (periodicLatticeShift x ν) ν = zeroOut x ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.zer.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.zeroOut_shift_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.zer.header:
theorem zeroOut_shift_ne (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) {μ ν : Fin 3} (h : μ ≠ ν) :
    zeroOut (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν = periodicLatticeShift (zeroOut x ν) μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.pot.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.potential
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.pot.header: noncomputable def potential (A : Bond Λ → ℝ) (ν : Fin 3) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.pot.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.potential_grad
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.pot.header:
theorem potential_grad {A : Bond Λ → ℝ} (ν : Fin 3)
    (hhol : ∀ z : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ, holonomy A z ν = 0) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) :
    potential A ν (periodicLatticeShift x ν) - potential A ν x = A (x, ν)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.pot.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.potential_shiftInvariant
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.pot.header:
theorem potential_shiftInvariant {A : Bond Λ → ℝ} {μ ν : Fin 3} (h : μ ≠ ν)
    (hinv : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ, A (periodicLatticeShift y μ, ν) = A (y, ν))
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) :
    potential A ν (periodicLatticeShift x μ) = potential A ν x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.shi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.shiftInvariant_of_component_zero

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.gau.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.gauge_step
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.gau.header:
theorem gauge_step {A : Bond Λ → ℝ} (hA : CurlFree A)
    (hhol : ∀ (z : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (ρ : Fin 3), holonomy A z ρ = 0)
    (ν : Fin 3) (D : Fin 3 → Prop)
    (hD : ∀ δ, D δ → ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ, A (y, δ) = 0) (hνD : ¬ D ν) :
    ∃ f : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ → ℝ,
      CurlFree (fun b => A b - gradValue f b) ∧
      (∀ (z : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) (ρ : Fin 3),
        holonomy (fun b => A b - gradValue f b) z ρ = 0) ∧
      (∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ, A (y, ν) - gradValue f (y, ν) = 0) ∧
      (∀ δ, D δ → ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ, A (y, δ) - gradValue f (y, δ) = 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.cur.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.curlFree_eq_grad_add_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.cur.header:
theorem curlFree_eq_grad_add_const {A : Bond Λ → ℝ} (hA : CurlFree A) :
    ∃ (f : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ → ℝ) (c : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ∀ b : Bond Λ, A b = f (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - f b.1 + c b.2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.cur.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.curlFree_of_grad_add_const
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.cur.header:
theorem curlFree_of_grad_add_const (f : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ → ℝ) (c : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    CurlFree (fun b : Bond Λ => f (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - f b.1 + c b.2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.con.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.const_not_gradValue
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.con.header:
theorem const_not_gradValue (ν : Fin 3) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ) :
    ¬ ∃ f : PeriodicLatticeSite Λ → ℝ,
        ∀ b : Bond Λ, (if b.2 = ν then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = gradValue f b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.sin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.singleSite_decomposition_is_free
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1AnchorPoincare.sin.header:
theorem singleSite_decomposition_is_free
    (A : Bond (fun _ => 0 : PeriodicLatticeExtent) → ℝ) :
    ∃ (f : PeriodicLatticeSite (fun _ => 0 : PeriodicLatticeExtent) → ℝ) (c : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ∀ b : Bond (fun _ => 0 : PeriodicLatticeExtent),
        A b = f (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - f b.1 + c b.2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.toLp_bo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.toLp_bondFnL2Equiv_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.toLp_bo.header:
theorem toLp_bondFnL2Equiv_eq {Lat : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (X : BondFnL2 Lat) :
    WithLp.toLp 2 (bondFnL2Equiv Lat X) = X

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.toLp_in.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.toLp_injective
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.toLp_in.header:
theorem toLp_injective {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] :
    Function.Injective (WithLp.toLp 2 : V → WithLp 2 V)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.toLp_ze.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.toLp_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.toLp_ze.header:
theorem toLp_zero {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.u1_coer.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.u1_coercivity
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.u1_coer.header:
theorem u1_coercivity
    {Lat : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    {Btilde : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Btilde] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Btilde]
    (C : Btilde →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 Lat)
    (Mα₀thresh : ℝ) (hMα₀thresh_pos : 0 < Mα₀thresh)
    (hC : IsBalabanReparam Mα₀thresh C) :
    ∃ γ₀ : ℝ, 0 < γ₀ ∧
      ∀ Bt : Btilde,
        γ₀ * ‖Bt‖ ^ 2 ≤ deltaKQuadFormCorrected (trivialU (L := Lat)) (bondFnL2Equiv Lat (C Bt))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.u1_coer.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.u1_coercivity_spikeC_instance
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.u1_coer.header:
theorem u1_coercivity_spikeC_instance (Mα₀thresh : ℝ) (hpos : 0 < Mα₀thresh) :
    ∃ γ₀ : ℝ, 0 < γ₀ ∧ ∀ Bt : ℝ,
      γ₀ * ‖Bt‖ ^ 2 ≤
        deltaKQuadFormCorrected (trivialU (L := AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL))
          (bondFnL2Equiv AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL (spikeC Bt))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.u1_conc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.u1_conclusion_fails_for_windC
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1Coercivity.u1_conc.header:
theorem u1_conclusion_fails_for_windC {Lat : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (μ0 : Fin 3) :
    ¬ (∃ γ₀ : ℝ, 0 < γ₀ ∧ ∀ Bt : ℝ,
        γ₀ * ‖Bt‖ ^ 2 ≤
          deltaKQuadFormCorrected (trivialU (L := Lat)) (bondFnL2Equiv Lat (windC Lat μ0 Bt)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.su.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.sum_gradWitnessLam_plain
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.su.header:
theorem sum_gradWitnessLam_plain (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL)) :
    (∑ x ∈ S, gradWitnessLam x) = if CoarseCurl.curlWitnessSite ∈ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.su.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.sum_gradWitnessLam_shift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.su.header:
theorem sum_gradWitnessLam_shift (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL))
    (μ : Fin 3) (pre : PeriodicLatticeSite AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL)
    (hpre : periodicLatticeShift pre μ = CoarseCurl.curlWitnessSite) :
    (∑ x ∈ S, gradWitnessLam (periodicLatticeShift x μ)) = if pre ∈ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.coarseRestrict_gradWitness_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.co.header:
theorem coarseRestrict_gradWitness_eq (y : PeriodicLatticeSite AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL)
    (hy : y ∈ AdmissibleSubspace.CoarseLattice AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL
      AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll)
    (μ : Fin 3) (pre : PeriodicLatticeSite AdmissibleSubspace.witnessL)
    (hpre : periodicLatticeShift pre μ = CoarseCurl.curlWitnessSite) :
    coarseRestrict AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll gradWitnessConfig (⟨y, hy⟩, μ) =
      (1 / 16 : ℝ) *
        ((if pre ∈ AdmissibleSubspace.blockOf y AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
          - (if CoarseCurl.curlWitnessSite ∈
              AdmissibleSubspace.blockOf y AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll then (1 : ℝ) else 0))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.co.header:
theorem coarseRestrict_gradWitness_term1 :
    coarseRestrict AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll gradWitnessConfig

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.coarseRestrict_gradWitness_term2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.co.header:
theorem coarseRestrict_gradWitness_term2 :
    coarseRestrict AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll gradWitnessConfig

            coarseShift_mem_coarseLattice witnessHdvd AdmissibleSubspace.witnessY_coarse 0⟩,
          (1 : Fin 3)) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.coarseRestrict_gradWitness_term3
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.co.header:
theorem coarseRestrict_gradWitness_term3 :
    coarseRestrict AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll gradWitnessConfig
        (⟨coarseShift AdmissibleSubspace.witnessY AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll 1,
            coarseShift_mem_coarseLattice witnessHdvd AdmissibleSubspace.witnessY_coarse 1⟩,
          (0 : Fin 3)) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.coarseRestrict_gradWitness_term4
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.co.header:
theorem coarseRestrict_gradWitness_term4 :
    coarseRestrict AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll gradWitnessConfig
        (⟨AdmissibleSubspace.witnessY, AdmissibleSubspace.witnessY_coarse⟩, (1 : Fin 3))
      = -1 / 16

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.coarseCurl_of_coarseRestrict_gradWitness_value
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.co.header:
theorem coarseCurl_of_coarseRestrict_gradWitness_value :
    coarseCurlValue witnessHdvd (coarseRestrict AdmissibleSubspace.witnessEll gradWitnessConfig)
        (⟨AdmissibleSubspace.witnessY, AdmissibleSubspace.witnessY_coarse⟩, coarseWitnessDirs)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.no.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.no_commuting_square_valueLevel
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.no.header:
theorem no_commuting_square_valueLevel

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1CommutingSquare.no.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1LeadingCoercivity..header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrict_hjExtensionCovFaithful (ell : ℕ)
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (A0 : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell (hjExtensionCovFaithful ell levels U A0) =
      lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1LeadingCoercivity..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1LeadingCoercivity.gaugeFixed_hjExtensionCovFaithful
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1LeadingCoercivity..header:

    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (A0 : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (h : RcovLM U levels (gradCovariantAdjointLM U A0) = 0) :
    RcovLM U levels (gradCovariantAdjointLM U (hjExtensionCovFaithful ell levels U A0)) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1LeadingCoercivity..name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1LeadingCoercivity.faithfulCovCoercivity_of_gaugeFixedCurlCoercivity
AdalyFormal.Balaban.U1LeadingCoercivity..header:
theorem faithfulCovCoercivity_of_gaugeFixedCurlCoercivity (ell : ℕ)
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (γ₀ : ℝ) (hGF : GaugeFixedCurlCoercivity ell levels U γ₀)
    (A0 : Bond L → SuTwo) (hA0 : RcovLM U levels (gradCovariantAdjointLM U A0) = 0) :
    γ₀ * covCoarseBondInner (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A0) (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A0)
      ≤ deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful ell levels U A0

theorem coarseShift_eq_shiftBy (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (m : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.coarseP.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.coarseP.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.cPlusS.header: def cPlusS (s ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.cPlusS_.header:
theorem cPlusS_eq (s ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.coarseB.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.loopVar.header:
def loopVar (s ell : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : G

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.strided.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.stridedBlockedGauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.strided.header:
noncomputable def stridedBlockedGauge (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (s ell : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : G

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.coarseB.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.coarseBondVar_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.coarseB.header:
theorem coarseBondVar_gauge (s ell : ℕ) (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    coarseBondVar s ell (coarseGaugeTransform s γ V) c
      = γ c.1 * coarseBondVar s ell V c * (γ (cPlusS s ell c))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.gammaVa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.gammaVarStrided_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.gammaVa.header:
theorem gammaVarStrided_gauge (s ell : ℕ) (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell) :
    gammaVarStrided s ell (coarseGaugeTransform s γ V) c x
      = γ c.1 * gammaVarStrided s ell V c x * (γ (cPlusS s ell c))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.loopVar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.loopVar_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.loopVar.header:
theorem loopVar_gauge (s ell : ℕ) (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell) :
    loopVar s ell (coarseGaugeTransform s γ V) c x
      = γ c.1 * loopVar s ell V c x * (γ c.1)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.strided.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.stridedBlockedGauge_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.strided.header:
theorem stridedBlockedGauge_gauge (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (s ell : ℕ)
    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    stridedBlockedGauge P s ell (coarseGaugeTransform s γ V) c
      = coarseGaugeTransform (s * ell) γ (stridedBlockedGauge P s ell V) c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.UbarTow.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.UbarTower
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.UbarTow.header:
noncomputable def UbarTower (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (ell : ℕ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L
  | 0 => U
  | l + 1 => stridedBlockedGauge P (ell ^ l) ell (UbarTower P ell U l)

@[simp] theorem UbarTower_zero (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (ell : ℕ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) : UbarTower P ell U 0 = U

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.UbarTow.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.UbarTower_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.UbarTow.header:
theorem UbarTower_gauge (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (ell : ℕ) (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (l : ℕ) :
    UbarTower P ell (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) l
      = coarseGaugeTransform (ell ^ l) γ (UbarTower P ell U l)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.UbarTow.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.UbarTower_gauge'
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.UbarTow.header:
theorem UbarTower_gauge' (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (ell : ℕ) (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (l : ℕ) :
    UbarTower P ell (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) l
      = AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.coarseGaugeTransform (ell ^ l) γ
          (UbarTower P ell U l)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.output_.header:
theorem output_stride_is_s_mul_ell (s ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    cPlusS s ell c = coarseShift c.1 (s * ell) c.2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.tower_s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.tower_stride
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.tower_s.header:
theorem tower_stride (ell l : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    cPlusS (ell ^ l) ell c = coarseShift c.1 (ell ^ (l + 1)) c.2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.UbarTow.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.UbarTower_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.UbarTow.header:
theorem UbarTower_one (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) :
    UbarTower P ell U 1 = stridedBlockedGauge P 1 ell U

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.stepBlo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.stepBlockOf_nonempty
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.stepBlo.header:
theorem stepBlockOf_nonempty (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {s ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hs : 0 < s) : (stepBlockOf y s ell).Nonempty

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.tower_b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.tower_block_nonempty
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.tower_b.header:
theorem tower_block_nonempty (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (l : ℕ) :
    (stepBlockOf y (ell ^ l) ell).Nonempty

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.stepBlo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.stepBlockOf_ell_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.stepBlo.header:
theorem stepBlockOf_ell_zero (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ) :
    stepBlockOf y s 0 = ∅

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.stepBlo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.stepBlockOf_stride_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.stepBlo.header:
theorem stepBlockOf_stride_zero (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) :
    stepBlockOf y 0 ell = ∅

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.exp_zer.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.exp_zero_conj
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.exp_zer.header: theorem exp_zero_conj (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (g : G) : g * P.exp 0 * g⁻¹ = P.exp 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.strided.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.stridedBlockedGauge_ell_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.strided.header:
theorem stridedBlockedGauge_ell_zero (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    stridedBlockedGauge P s 0 V c = P.exp 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.stepBlo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.stepBlockOf_ell_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.stepBlo.header:
theorem stepBlockOf_ell_one (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    stepBlockOf y s 1 = {y}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.coarseG.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.coarseGammaPath_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.coarseG.header:
theorem coarseGammaPath_self (s : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    coarseGammaPath s y y = []

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.strided.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.stridedBlockedGauge_ell_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.strided.header:
theorem stridedBlockedGauge_ell_one (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    stridedBlockedGauge P s 1 V c = P.exp (P.log 1) * V c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.UbarTow.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.UbarTower_ell_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.UbarTow.header:
theorem UbarTower_ell_zero (P : LogExpAd G 𝔤) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (l : ℕ) :
    UbarTower P 0 U (l + 1) = fun _ => P.exp 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.contour.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.contourSteps_id
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.contour.header:
theorem contourSteps_id :
    contourSteps 1 witnessY witnessX = [((0 : Fin 3), true), ((2 : Fin 3), true)]

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.contour.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.contourSteps_swap
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.contour.header:
theorem contourSteps_swap :
    contourSteps (Equiv.swap 0 2) witnessY witnessX
      = [((2 : Fin 3), true), ((0 : Fin 3), true)]

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.blockOf.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.blockOf_ne_stepBlockOf
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.blockOf.header: theorem blockOf_ne_stepBlockOf : blockOf witnessY 4 ≠ stepBlockOf witnessY 2 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.tower_f.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.tower_feeds_Qcomposite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.tower_f.header:
theorem tower_feeds_Qcomposite {𝔤 : Type*} [AddCommGroup 𝔤] [Module ℚ 𝔤]
    (P : LogExpAd (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) 𝔤) (ell : ℕ)
    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (j : ℕ) (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    Qcomposite (UbarTower P ell (periodicGaugeTransform γ U)) ell j
        (fun x => RMap (γ x) (lam x))
      = fun y => RMap (γ y) (Qcomposite (UbarTower P ell U) ell j lam y)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cbT.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cbToBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cbT.header:
def cbToBond (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.bon.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.bondToCb
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.bon.header:
def bondToCb (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
