AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cbE.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cbEquiv
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cbE.header:
def cbEquiv (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    CoarseBond L ell ≃ Bond (coarseExtent L ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cpT.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cpToPlaq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cpT.header:
def cpToPlaq (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) (q : CoarsePlaquette L ell) :
    PeriodicLatticePlaquette (coarseExtent L ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pla.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.plaqToCp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pla.header:
def plaqToCp (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (coarseExtent L ell)) : CoarsePlaquette L ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cpE.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cpEquiv
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cpE.header:
def cpEquiv (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    CoarsePlaquette L ell ≃ PeriodicLatticePlaquette (coarseExtent L ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pullS
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.header:
def pullS (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) : Bond (coarseExtent L ell) → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pullS_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.header:
theorem pullS_apply (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (e : Bond (coarseExtent L ell)) :
    pullS hell hdvd F e = F (bondToCb hell hdvd e)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pullS_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.header:
theorem pullS_add (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (F G : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) :
    pullS hell hdvd (F + G) = pullS hell hdvd F + pullS hell hdvd G

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pullS_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.header:
theorem pullS_smul (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (t : ℝ)
    (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) :
    pullS hell hdvd (t • F) = t • pullS hell hdvd F

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cEn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cEnergy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cEn.header: noncomputable def cEnergy (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.bon.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.bondEnergy_pullS
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.bon.header:
theorem bondEnergy_pullS (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) : bondEnergy (pullS hell hdvd F) = cEnergy F

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.fla.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.flatCurl_pullS
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.fla.header:
theorem flatCurl_pullS (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (coarseExtent L ell)) :
    flatCurlValue (pullS hell hdvd F) p = coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd F (plaqToCp hell hdvd p)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coarseCurlEnergy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coa.header:
noncomputable def coarseCurlEnergy (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coarseCurlEnergy_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coa.header:
theorem coarseCurlEnergy_nonneg (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) : 0 ≤ coarseCurlEnergy hdvd F

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cur.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.curlEnergy_pullS
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.cur.header:
theorem curlEnergy_pullS (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) :
    curlEnergy (pullS hell hdvd F) = coarseCurlEnergy hdvd F

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.two.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.two_dvd_of_four
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.two.header:
theorem two_dvd_of_four (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coarse_two_dvd
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coa.header:
theorem coarse_two_dvd (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (coarseExtent L 2 μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coarse_extent_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coa.header:
theorem coarse_extent_pos (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (μ : Fin 3) :
    1 < coarseExtent L 2 μ + 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pullC
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.header:
noncomputable def pullC (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B : CoarseBond L 2 → SuTwo) : Bond (coarseExtent L 2) → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pullC_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.header:
theorem pullC_apply (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B : CoarseBond L 2 → SuTwo) (e : Bond (coarseExtent L 2)) :
    pullC hdvd4 B e = B (bondToCb two_pos' (two_dvd_of_four hdvd4) e)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSrc
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSr.header: def VSrc (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (B : CoarseBond L 2 → SuTwo) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSrc_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSr.header:
theorem VSrc_zero (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    VSrc hdvd4 (fun _ : CoarseBond L 2 => (0 : SuTwo))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pullC_siteConstCoarse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.header:
theorem pullC_siteConstCoarse (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (g : Fin 3 → SuTwo) :
    pullC hdvd4 (AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.siteConstCoarse (L := L) g)
      = fun e : Bond (coarseExtent L 2) => g e.2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.sit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.siteConst_not_VSrc
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.sit.header:
theorem siteConst_not_VSrc (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {g : Fin 3 → SuTwo} {ρ : Fin 3} (hg : g ρ ≠ 0) :
    ¬ VSrc hdvd4 (AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.siteConstCoarse (L := L) g)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pullC_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.header:
theorem pullC_eq (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (B : CoarseBond L 2 → SuTwo) :
    pullC hdvd4 B = pullS two_pos' (two_dvd_of_four hdvd4) B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coarse_fibre_bound_on_VSrc
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coa.header:
theorem coarse_fibre_bound_on_VSrc (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {B : CoarseBond L 2 → SuTwo} (hB : VSrc hdvd4 B) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.FibreAggregate.gammaAgg * cEnergy B
      ≤ coarseCurlEnergy (two_dvd_of_four hdvd4) B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.sum.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.sum_over_blocks
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.sum.header:
theorem sum_over_blocks {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (hell : 0 < ell)
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M) :
    ∑ y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell, ∑ x ∈ blockOf y ell, f x
      = ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, f x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.sum.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.sum_shift_invariant
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.sum.header:
theorem sum_shift_invariant {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (μ ν : Fin 3) (i j : ℕ)
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, f (pathSite (pathSite x μ i) ν j)
      = ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, f x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coarseCurl_sq_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coa.header:
theorem coarseCurl_sq_le (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (q : CoarsePlaquette L ell) :
    ‖coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd (lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell v) q‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) *
        ∑ x ∈ blockOf q.1.1 ell, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell,
          ‖flatCurlValue v (pathSite (pathSite x q.2.1.1 i) q.2.1.2 j, q.2)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coarseCurlEnergy_Q_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coa.header:
theorem coarseCurlEnergy_Q_le (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    coarseCurlEnergy hdvd (lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell v)
      ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ)) * curlEnergy v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coercive_on_VSrc_preimage
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coe.header:
theorem coercive_on_VSrc_preimage (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hA : VSrc hdvd4 (AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCov
      (trivialU L) 2 A)) :
    gammaV * bondEnergy A ≤ curlEnergy A + pAx A (CoarseLattice L 2) 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wSi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wSign
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wSi.header: noncomputable def wSign {Lc : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (b : Bond Lc) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWitFine
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWi.header: noncomputable def vWitFine {Lc : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (w : SuTwo) : Bond Lc → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wSi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wSign_of_dir_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wSi.header:
theorem wSign_of_dir_ne {Lc : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {b : Bond Lc} (h : b.2 ≠ 1) :
    wSign b = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wSi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wSign_of_even
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wSi.header:
theorem wSign_of_even {Lc : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {b : Bond Lc} (h : (b.1 0).val % 2 = 0) :
    wSign b = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWitFine_vanishes_on_Ax
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWi.header:
theorem vWitFine_vanishes_on_Ax {Lc : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (w : SuTwo)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lc} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice Lc 2) {b : Bond Lc} (hb : b ∈ Ax y 2) :
    vWitFine (Lc := Lc) w b = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wSi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wSign_dir_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wSi.header:
theorem wSign_dir_one {Lc : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lc)
    (hodd : (x 0).val % 2 = 1) :
    wSign ((x, (1 : Fin 3)) : Bond Lc) = if (x 1).val % 2 = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else -1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wSi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wSign_line_cancel
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wSi.header:
theorem wSign_line_cancel {Lc : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (heven : (2 : ℕ) ∣ (Lc 1 + 1))
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lc) :
    wSign ((x, (1 : Fin 3)) : Bond Lc)
      + wSign ((periodicLatticeShift x 1, (1 : Fin 3)) : Bond Lc) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWitFine_lineSum_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWi.header:
theorem vWitFine_lineSum_zero {Lc : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (heven : (2 : ℕ) ∣ (Lc 1 + 1))
    (w : SuTwo) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lc) (μ : Fin 3) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.ThirdLevelStokes.lineSum 2 (vWitFine (Lc := Lc) w) x μ = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWitFine_Q_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWi.header:
theorem vWitFine_Q_zero {Lc : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (heven : (2 : ℕ) ∣ (Lc 1 + 1))
    (w : SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond Lc 2) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU Lc) 2
      (vWitFine (Lc := Lc) w) c = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWitCoarse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWi.header:
noncomputable def vWitCoarse (_hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (w : SuTwo) :
    CoarseBond L 2 → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pullC_vWitCoarse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.pul.header:
theorem pullC_vWitCoarse (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (w : SuTwo) :
    pullC hdvd4 (vWitCoarse hdvd4 w) = vWitFine (Lc := coarseExtent L 2) w

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWitCoarse_mem_VSrc
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWi.header:
theorem vWitCoarse_mem_VSrc (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (w : SuTwo) :
    VSrc hdvd4 (vWitCoarse hdvd4 w)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.witSite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wit.header:
noncomputable def witSite (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    PeriodicLatticeSite (coarseExtent L 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWitCoarse_value
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWi.header:
theorem vWitCoarse_value (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (w : SuTwo) :
    vWitCoarse hdvd4 w
        (bondToCb two_pos' (two_dvd_of_four hdvd4) ((witSite hdvd4, (1 : Fin 3)))) = w

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWitCoarse_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.vWi.header:
theorem vWitCoarse_ne_zero (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) {w : SuTwo} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    vWitCoarse hdvd4 w ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSrc_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSr.header:
theorem VSrc_add (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {B B' : CoarseBond L 2 → SuTwo} (h : VSrc hdvd4 B) (h' : VSrc hdvd4 B') :
    VSrc hdvd4 (B + B')

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSrc_smul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSr.header:
theorem VSrc_smul (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (t : ℝ)
    {B : CoarseBond L 2 → SuTwo} (h : VSrc hdvd4 B) : VSrc hdvd4 (t • B)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.wit.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.witness_coarseCurl_pos

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSrc_nontrivial
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSr.header:
theorem VSrc_nontrivial (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    ∃ B : CoarseBond L 2 → SuTwo, VSrc hdvd4 B ∧ B ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coercive_on_VSrc_L2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coe.header:
theorem coercive_on_VSrc_L2 (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) (x : BondFnL2 L)
    (hx : VSrc hdvd4 (AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCov
      (trivialU L) 2 (WithLp.ofLp x))) :
    gammaV * ‖x‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ x (deltaKCLMNormalized (trivialU L) x) : ℝ)
        + (inner ℝ x (pAxCLM (CoarseLattice L 2) 2 x) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.nex.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.next_coercive_on_VSrc
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.nex.header:
theorem next_coercive_on_VSrc (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (r : Rung (BondFnL2 L) (CoarseFnL2 L 2) (deltaKCLMNormalized (trivialU L)))
    (hP : r.P = pAxCLM (CoarseLattice L 2) 2) (hQ : r.Q = qCLM (trivialU L) 2)
    {B : CoarseFnL2 L 2} (hB : VSrc hdvd4 (WithLp.ofLp B)) :
    gammaV / r.q ^ 2 * ‖B‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ B (r.next B) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSrc_carrier_nontrivial
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSr.header:
theorem VSrc_carrier_nontrivial (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (r : Rung (BondFnL2 L) (CoarseFnL2 L 2) (deltaKCLMNormalized (trivialU L))) :
    ∃ B : CoarseFnL2 L 2, VSrc hdvd4 (WithLp.ofLp B) ∧ B ≠ 0
      ∧ r.G (r.Qstar (r.S B)) ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coarse_wide
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.coa.header: theorem coarse_wide (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * 2 ≤ L μ + 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.nex.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.next_coercive_on_VSrc_at_honestRung
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.nex.header:
theorem next_coercive_on_VSrc_at_honestRung (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {B : CoarseFnL2 L 2} (hB : VSrc hdvd4 (WithLp.ofLp B)) :
    gammaV / (AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.honestLatticeRung ha
        (two_dvd_of_four hdvd4) (coarse_wide hdvd4)).q ^ 2 * ‖B‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ B ((AdalyFormal.Balaban.OnRangeCoercivity.honestLatticeRung ha
          (two_dvd_of_four hdvd4) (coarse_wide hdvd4)).next B) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSrc_is_load_bearing
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VRestrictedRoute.VSr.header:
theorem VSrc_is_load_bearing (hdvd4 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (4 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {g : Fin 3 → SuTwo} {ρ : Fin 3} (hg : g ρ ≠ 0) {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ) :
    (¬ (γ * bondEnergy (suTwoLift 2 (siteConstCoarse (L := L) g))
        ≤ curlEnergy (suTwoLift 2 (siteConstCoarse (L := L) g))
          + pAx (suTwoLift 2 (siteConstCoarse (L := L) g)) (CoarseLattice L 2) 2))
      ∧ ¬ VSrc hdvd4 (siteConstCoarse (L := L) g)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.BalabanCovarianceData
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
structure BalabanCovarianceData (H K : Type*)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℝ K]

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.solutionOperator
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header: noncomputable def solutionOperator (D : BalabanCovarianceData H K) : K →L[ℝ] H

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.solutionOperator_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem solutionOperator_apply (D : BalabanCovarianceData H K) (B : K) :
    solutionOperator D B = D.Gstar (D.Qstar (D.CompInv B))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.interpolates
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem interpolates (D : BalabanCovarianceData H K) (B : K) :
    D.Q (solutionOperator D B) = B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.Ginv_solutionOperator
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem Ginv_solutionOperator (D : BalabanCovarianceData H K) (B : K) :
    D.Ginv (solutionOperator D B) = D.Qstar (D.CompInv B)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.isMinimal
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem isMinimal (D : BalabanCovarianceData H K) (B : K) (A : H) (hA : D.Q A = B) :
    (inner ℝ (solutionOperator D B) (D.Ginv (solutionOperator D B)) : ℝ) ≤
      inner ℝ A (D.Ginv A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.isMinimal_unique
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem isMinimal_unique (D : BalabanCovarianceData H K)
    (hposdef : ∀ x : H, (inner ℝ x (D.Ginv x) : ℝ) = 0 → x = 0)
    (B : K) (A : H) (hA : D.Q A = B)
    (heq : (inner ℝ A (D.Ginv A) : ℝ) =
      inner ℝ (solutionOperator D B) (D.Ginv (solutionOperator D B))) :
    A = solutionOperator D B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.matCLM
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
noncomputable def matCLM {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (M : Matrix m n ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ m

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.matCLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem matCLM_apply {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (M : Matrix m n ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    WithLp.ofLp (matCLM M x) = M *ᵥ (WithLp.ofLp x)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.witness_Ginv_Gstar
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem witness_Ginv_Gstar (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    witnessGinv (witnessGstar x) = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.witness_Gstar_Ginv
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem witness_Gstar_Ginv (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    witnessGstar (witnessGinv x) = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.witness_Ginv_selfAdjoint
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem witness_Ginv_selfAdjoint (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    (inner ℝ (witnessGinv x) y : ℝ) = inner ℝ x (witnessGinv y)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.witness_Ginv_posSemidef
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem witness_Ginv_posSemidef (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    (0 : ℝ) ≤ inner ℝ x (witnessGinv x)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.witness_Q_Qstar_adjoint
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem witness_Q_Qstar_adjoint (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :
    (inner ℝ (witnessQ x) y : ℝ) = inner ℝ x (witnessQstar y)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.witness_Comp_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem witness_Comp_eq (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :
    witnessComp x = witnessQ (witnessGstar (witnessQstar x))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.witness_Comp_CompInv
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem witness_Comp_CompInv (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :
    witnessComp (witnessCompInv x) = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.witness_CompInv_Comp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem witness_CompInv_Comp (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :
    witnessCompInv (witnessComp x) = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.witnessData
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
noncomputable def witnessData : BalabanCovarianceData
    (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.witnessB
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header: noncomputable def witnessB : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.witness_solutionOperator_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem witness_solutionOperator_eq :
    WithLp.ofLp (solutionOperator witnessData witnessB) = ![3, 2]

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.witness_solutionOperator_eq'
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem witness_solutionOperator_eq' :
    solutionOperator witnessData witnessB = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![3, 2]

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.witnessNaive
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header: noncomputable def witnessNaive : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.witnessNaive_satisfies_constraint
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header: theorem witnessNaive_satisfies_constraint : witnessData.Q witnessNaive = witnessB

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.witness_beats_naive
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem witness_beats_naive :
    (inner ℝ (solutionOperator witnessData witnessB)
        (witnessData.Ginv (solutionOperator witnessData witnessB)) : ℝ) <
      inner ℝ witnessNaive (witnessData.Ginv witnessNaive)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.witness_isMinimal_instance
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem witness_isMinimal_instance :
    (inner ℝ (solutionOperator witnessData witnessB)
        (witnessData.Ginv (solutionOperator witnessData witnessB)) : ℝ) ≤
      inner ℝ witnessNaive (witnessData.Ginv witnessNaive)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.mutation_Gstar_zero_fails
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem mutation_Gstar_zero_fails :
    ¬ (∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        witnessGinv ((0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) x) = x)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.mutation_Gstar_id_fails
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem mutation_Gstar_id_fails :
    ¬ (∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        witnessGinv ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) x) = x)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.mutation_Q_zero_fails
AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjector.header:
theorem mutation_Q_zero_fails (CompInv' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :
    ¬ (∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1),
        (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))
          (witnessGstar (witnessQstar (CompInv' x))) = x)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNormSq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNo.header: noncomputable def fineNormSq (w : ℝ) (A : BondFnL2 L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.coarse.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.coarseNormSq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.coarse.header: noncomputable def coarseNormSq {ell : ℕ} (w : ℝ) (B : CoarseFnL2 L ell) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNormSq_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNo.header: theorem fineNormSq_eq (w : ℝ) (A : BondFnL2 L) : fineNormSq w A = w * ‖A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.coarse.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.coarseNormSq_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.coarse.header:
theorem coarseNormSq_eq {ell : ℕ} (w : ℝ) (B : CoarseFnL2 L ell) :
    coarseNormSq w B = w * ‖B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNormSq_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNo.header: theorem fineNormSq_nonneg {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 ≤ w) (A : BondFnL2 L) : 0 ≤ fineNormSq w A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.source.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.source_normalisation_sums_to_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.source.header:
theorem source_normalisation_sums_to_one {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :
    (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * ((AdalyFormal.Balaban.QCLMNorm.blockIdx y ell).card : ℝ) = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.levelW.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.levelWeight_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.levelW.header:
theorem levelWeight_pos {ell : ℕ} {η : ℝ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hη : 0 < η) (d : ℤ) (j : ℕ) :
    0 < levelWeight ell η d j

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.levelW.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.levelWeight_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.levelW.header:
theorem levelWeight_succ (ell : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (d : ℤ) (j : ℕ) :
    levelWeight ell η d (j + 1) = (ell : ℝ) ^ (d - 2) * levelWeight ell η d j

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.levelW.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.levelWeight_one_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.levelW.header:
theorem levelWeight_one_eq (ell : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (d : ℤ) :
    levelWeight ell η d 1 = (ell : ℝ) ^ (d - 2) * levelWeight ell η d 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_ratio_uniform_in_level
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_ratio_uniform_in_level {ell : ℕ} {η : ℝ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hη : 0 < η) (d : ℤ)
    (j : ℕ) :
    levelWeight ell η d (j + 1) / levelWeight ell η d j = (ell : ℝ) ^ (d - 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.zpow_n.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.zpow_neg_natCast_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.zpow_n.header: theorem zpow_neg_natCast_eq (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : a ^ (-(n : ℤ)) = 1 / a ^ n

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_const_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_const_eq {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (d : ℤ) :
    (ell : ℝ) ^ (d - 2) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) = (ell : ℝ) ^ (d - 5)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_norm_sq_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_norm_sq_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (d : ℤ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    coarseNormSq (levelWeight ell η d 1) (qCLM U ell A)
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ (d - 5) * fineNormSq (levelWeight ell η d 0) A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.overal.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.overall_constant_cancels
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.overal.header:
theorem overall_constant_cancels {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (d : ℤ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    a * coarseNormSq (levelWeight ell η d 1) (qCLM U ell A)
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ (d - 5) * (a * fineNormSq (levelWeight ell η d 0) A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_const_eta_free
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_const_eta_free {ell : ℕ} (η η' : ℝ) (d : ℤ) :
    levelWeight ell η d 1 / levelWeight ell η d 0
      = levelWeight ell η' d 1 / levelWeight ell η' d 0
    ∨ levelWeight ell η d 0 = 0 ∨ levelWeight ell η' d 0 = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNormSq_constWitness
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNo.header:
theorem fineNormSq_constWitness (w : ℝ) (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    fineNormSq w (constWitness L) = w * (Fintype.card (Bond L) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNormSq_constWitness_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNo.header:
theorem fineNormSq_constWitness_pos {ell : ℕ} {η : ℝ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hη : 0 < η) (d : ℤ)
    (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    0 < fineNormSq (levelWeight ell η d 0) (constWitness L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_norm_sq_eq_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_norm_sq_eq_trivialU {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {η : ℝ} (d : ℤ) :
    coarseNormSq (levelWeight ell η d 1) (qCLM (trivialU L) ell (constWitness L))
      = (ell : ℝ) ^ (d - 5) * fineNormSq (levelWeight ell η d 0) (constWitness L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.Weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.WeightedRatioBound
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.Weight.header:
def WeightedRatioBound (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (d : ℤ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (c : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weightedRatioBound_holds
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weightedRatioBound_holds {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (d : ℤ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    WeightedRatioBound L ell η d U ((ell : ℝ) ^ (d - 5))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_sharp_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_sharp_trivialU {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (d : ℤ) {c : ℝ}
    (hc : WeightedRatioBound L ell η d (trivialU L) c) :
    (ell : ℝ) ^ (d - 5) ≤ c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNorm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fineNo.header: noncomputable def fineNorm (w : ℝ) (A : BondFnL2 L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.coarse.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.coarseNorm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.coarse.header: noncomputable def coarseNorm {ell : ℕ} (w : ℝ) (B : CoarseFnL2 L ell) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_pointwise_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_pointwise_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (d : ℤ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    coarseNorm (levelWeight ell η d 1) (qCLM U ell A)
      ≤ Real.sqrt ((ell : ℝ) ^ (d - 5)) * fineNorm (levelWeight ell η d 0) A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_pointwise_eq_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_pointwise_eq_trivialU {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {η : ℝ} (d : ℤ) :
    coarseNorm (levelWeight ell η d 1) (qCLM (trivialU L) ell (constWitness L))
      = Real.sqrt ((ell : ℝ) ^ (d - 5)) * fineNorm (levelWeight ell η d 0) (constWitness L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_const_three
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header: theorem weighted_const_three {ell : ℕ} : (ell : ℝ) ^ ((3 : ℤ) - 5) = 1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_sqrt_const_three
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_sqrt_const_three {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) :
    Real.sqrt ((ell : ℝ) ^ ((3 : ℤ) - 5)) = 1 / (ell : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_norm_sq_le_three
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_norm_sq_le_three {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    coarseNormSq (levelWeight ell η 3 1) (qCLM U ell A)
      ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * fineNormSq (levelWeight ell η 3 0) A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_q_three_lt_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_q_three_lt_one {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) :
    Real.sqrt ((ell : ℝ) ^ ((3 : ℤ) - 5)) < 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_q_three_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_q_three_pos {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) :
    0 < Real.sqrt ((ell : ℝ) ^ ((3 : ℤ) - 5))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_norm_sq_le_on_coarse_subset
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_norm_sq_le_on_coarse_subset {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (d : ℤ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (S : Finset (CoarseBond L ell)) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    levelWeight ell η d 1 * ∑ c ∈ S, ‖WithLp.ofLp (qCLM U ell A) c‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ (d - 5) * fineNormSq (levelWeight ell η d 0) A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.qCLM_d.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.qCLM_deltaWitness_coord
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.qCLM_d.header:
theorem qCLM_deltaWitness_coord {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    ‖WithLp.ofLp (qCLM U ell (deltaWitness L))
        ((⟨(fun _ => 0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L), siteZeroMem L ell⟩ :
            {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L // z ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}), (0 : Fin 3))‖
      = 1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.deltaW.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.deltaWitness_sum_off_support
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.deltaW.header:
theorem deltaWitness_sum_off_support (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    ∑ b ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (((fun _ => 0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L), (0 : Fin 3)) : Bond L)),
        ‖WithLp.ofLp (deltaWitness L) b‖ ^ 2 = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fine_r.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fine_restriction_not_free
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.fine_r.header:
theorem fine_restriction_not_free {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (d : ℤ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (c : ℝ) :
    ¬ (levelWeight ell η d 1
          * ∑ b ∈ ({((⟨(fun _ => 0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L), siteZeroMem L ell⟩ :
                {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L // z ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}), (0 : Fin 3))} :
              Finset (CoarseBond L ell)),
              ‖WithLp.ofLp (qCLM U ell (deltaWitness L)) b‖ ^ 2
        ≤ c * (levelWeight ell η d 0
          * ∑ b ∈ (Finset.univ.erase
                (((fun _ => 0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L), (0 : Fin 3)) : Bond L)),
              ‖WithLp.ofLp (deltaWitness L) b‖ ^ 2))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_uniformStepGamma_three
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_uniformStepGamma_three {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {γ₀ δ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ₀)
    (hfix : δ ≤ γ₀ * (1 - (1 / (ell : ℝ)) ^ 2)) :
    UniformStepGamma δ (1 / (ell : ℝ))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_q_two_eq_half
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header: theorem weighted_q_two_eq_half : Real.sqrt (((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((3 : ℤ) - 5)) = 1 / 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_uniformStepGamma_at_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header: theorem weighted_uniformStepGamma_at_two : UniformStepGamma 1 (1 / 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_route_survives
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_route_survives {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    (∀ A : BondFnL2 L, coarseNorm (levelWeight ell η 3 1) (qCLM U ell A)
        ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ)) * fineNorm (levelWeight ell η 3 0) A)
    ∧ (1 : ℝ) / (ell : ℝ) < 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_curvedRegularU_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_curvedRegularU_two {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (A : BondFnL2 witL5) :
    coarseNorm (levelWeight 2 η 3 1) (qCLM curvedRegularU 2 A)
      ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * fineNorm (levelWeight 2 η 3 0) A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_curvedRegularU_two_nogo_hypothesis_fails
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header: theorem weighted_curvedRegularU_two_nogo_hypothesis_fails : ¬ ((1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_trivialU_two_witL5_sharp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_trivialU_two_witL5_sharp {η : ℝ} :
    coarseNormSq (levelWeight 2 η 3 1) (qCLM (trivialU witL5) 2 (constWitness witL5))
      = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * fineNormSq (levelWeight 2 η 3 0) (constWitness witL5)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_trivialU_two_witL5_best
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_trivialU_two_witL5_best {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) {c : ℝ}
    (hc : WeightedRatioBound witL5 2 η 3 (trivialU witL5) c) : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.one_le.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.one_le_zpow_of_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.one_le.header: theorem one_le_zpow_of_nonneg {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 ≤ n) : 1 ≤ a ^ n

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.zpow_l.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.zpow_lt_one_of_neg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.zpow_l.header: theorem zpow_lt_one_of_neg {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) {n : ℤ} (hn : n < 0) : a ^ n < 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_lt_one_iff_lt_five
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_lt_one_iff_lt_five {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (d : ℤ) :
    (ell : ℝ) ^ (d - 5) < 1 ↔ d < 5

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_inverted_direction_still_lt_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_inverted_direction_still_lt_one {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) :
    (ell : ℝ) ^ (-((3 : ℤ) - 2) - 3) < 1 ∧ (ell : ℝ) ^ (-((3 : ℤ) - 2) - 3) = 1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_exponent_arithmetic_general_d
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_exponent_arithmetic_general_d {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (d : ℤ) :
    (ell : ℝ) ^ (d - 2) * (ell : ℝ) ^ (-d) = (ell : ℝ) ^ (-2 : ℤ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_at_two_collapses
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_at_two_collapses {ell : ℕ} (η : ℝ) (A : BondFnL2 L)
    (B : CoarseFnL2 L ell) :
    fineNormSq (levelWeight ell η 2 0) A = ‖A‖ ^ 2
    ∧ coarseNormSq (levelWeight ell η 2 1) B = ‖B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.unweig.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.unweighted_recovered_from_weighted
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.unweig.header:
theorem unweighted_recovered_from_weighted {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    ‖qCLM U ell A‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) * ‖A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_const_five
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header: theorem weighted_const_five {ell : ℕ} : (ell : ℝ) ^ ((5 : ℤ) - 5) = 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_nogo_fires_at_exponent_five
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_nogo_fires_at_exponent_five {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ¬ UniformStepGamma δ 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_sharp_five
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_sharp_five {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) {c : ℝ} (hc : WeightedRatioBound L ell η 5 (trivialU L) c) :
    (1 : ℝ) ≤ c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weighted_nogo_fires_at_exponent_six
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.weight.header:
theorem weighted_nogo_fires_at_exponent_six {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    ((1 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt ((ell : ℝ) ^ ((6 : ℤ) - 5)))
    ∧ ¬ UniformStepGamma δ (Real.sqrt ((ell : ℝ) ^ ((6 : ℤ) - 5)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.summin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.summing_variant_weighted_not_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeightedQNorm.summin.header:
theorem summing_variant_weighted_not_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hwide : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    ¬ (∀ A : BondFnL2 L, coarseNormSq (levelWeight ell η 3 1) (qSumCLM U ell A)
        ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * fineNormSq (levelWeight ell η 3 0) A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.norm_sq_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.norm_sq_eq_hsInner
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.norm_sq_.header: theorem norm_sq_eq_hsInner (X : SuTwo) : ‖X‖ ^ 2 = hsInner X X

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.inner_eq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.inner_eq_norm_sq_self
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.inner_eq.header: theorem inner_eq_norm_sq_self (X : SuTwo) : inner ℝ X X = ‖X‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.shift_sh.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.shift_shiftBack_comm'
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.shift_sh.header:
theorem shift_shiftBack_comm' (s : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShiftBack s ν) μ =
      periodicLatticeShiftBack (periodicLatticeShift s μ) ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.shift_sh.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.shift_shift_comm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.shift_sh.header:
theorem shift_shift_comm (s : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift s μ) ν =
      periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift s ν) μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.dfwd.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.dfwd
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.dfwd.header: noncomputable def dfwd (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.gradEner.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.gradEnergy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.gradEner.header: noncomputable def gradEnergy (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.divEnerg.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.divEnergy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.divEnerg.header:
noncomputable def divEnergy
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.Xt.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.Xt
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.Xt.header: noncomputable def Xt (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.Ct.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.Ct
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.Ct.header: noncomputable def Ct (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.gradEner.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.gradEnergy_eq_sum_Xt
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.gradEner.header:
theorem gradEnergy_eq_sum_Xt (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    gradEnergy A = ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ ν : Fin 3, Xt A μ ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.Ct_symm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.Ct_symm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.Ct_symm.header: theorem Ct_symm (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) : Ct A μ ν = Ct A ν μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.Ct_diag.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.Ct_diag
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.Ct_diag.header: theorem Ct_diag (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) : Ct A μ μ = Xt A μ μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.Xt_nonne.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.Xt_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.Xt_nonne.header: theorem Xt_nonneg (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) : 0 ≤ Xt A μ ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.gradEner.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.gradEnergy_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.gradEner.header: theorem gradEnergy_nonneg (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : 0 ≤ gradEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.divEnerg.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.divEnergy_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.divEnerg.header:
theorem divEnergy_nonneg
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : 0 ≤ divEnergy U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.curl_tri.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.curl_trivialU_eq_dfwd_sub
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.curl_tri.header:
theorem curl_trivialU_eq_dfwd_sub (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    curlValueCovariant (trivialU L) A p =
      dfwd A p.2.1.1 p.2.1.2 p.1 - dfwd A p.2.1.2 p.2.1.1 p.1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.plaqEner.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.plaqEnergy_curl_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.plaqEner.header:
theorem plaqEnergy_curl_trivialU (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM (trivialU L) A) =
      ∑ d : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections,
        (Xt A d.1.1 d.1.2 + Xt A d.1.2 d.1.1 - 2 * Ct A d.1.1 d.1.2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.ubk.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.ubk
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.ubk.header: noncomputable def ubk (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.ubk_eq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.ubk_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.ubk_eq.header:
theorem ubk_eq (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ubk A μ y = A (y, μ) - A (periodicLatticeShiftBack y μ, μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.div_expa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.div_expand_trivialU'
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.div_expa.header:
theorem div_expand_trivialU' (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    gradCovariantAdjointValue (trivialU L) A y =
      ∑ ν : Fin 3, (A (periodicLatticeShiftBack y ν, ν) - A (y, ν))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.div_eq_n.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.div_eq_neg_sum_ubk
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.div_eq_n.header:
theorem div_eq_neg_sum_ubk (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    gradCovariantAdjointValue (trivialU L) A y = - ∑ μ : Fin 3, ubk A μ y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sbp_cros.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sbp_cross
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sbp_cros.header:
theorem sbp_cross (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    (∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, inner ℝ (ubk A μ y) (ubk A ν y)) = Ct A μ ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.divEnerg.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.divEnergy_trivialU_eq_sum_Ct
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.divEnerg.header:
theorem divEnergy_trivialU_eq_sum_Ct (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    divEnergy (trivialU L) A = ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ ν : Fin 3, Ct A μ ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_plaq.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_plaqDirs
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_plaq.header:
theorem sum_plaqDirs (f : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections → ℝ) :
    ∑ d : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections, f d
      = f ⟨(0, 1), by decide⟩ + f ⟨(0, 2), by decide⟩ + f ⟨(1, 2), by decide⟩

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.weitzenb.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.weitzenbock_flat
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.weitzenb.header:
theorem weitzenbock_flat (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM (trivialU L) A) + divEnergy (trivialU L) A = gradEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sbField.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sbField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sbField.header: noncomputable def sbField (b0 : Bond L) (w : SuTwo) : Bond L → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.bondEner.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.bondEnergy_sbField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.bondEner.header:
theorem bondEnergy_sbField (b0 : Bond L) (w : SuTwo) :
    bondEnergy (sbField b0 w) = ‖w‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.dfwd_sbF.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.dfwd_sbField_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.dfwd_sbF.header:
theorem dfwd_sbField_norm_sq (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 0 < L μ) (b0 : Bond L) (w : SuTwo)
    (μ ν : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ‖dfwd (sbField b0 w) μ ν y‖ ^ 2
      = (if ((periodicLatticeShift y μ, ν) : Bond L) = b0 then ‖w‖ ^ 2 else 0)
        + (if ((y, ν) : Bond L) = b0 then ‖w‖ ^ 2 else 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_bond.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_bond_indicator
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_bond.header:
theorem sum_bond_indicator (b0 : Bond L) (c : ℝ) :
    (∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ∑ ν : Fin 3, if ((y, ν) : Bond L) = b0 then c else 0) = c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_bond.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_bond_indicator_shift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_bond.header:
theorem sum_bond_indicator_shift (b0 : Bond L) (c : ℝ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ∑ ν : Fin 3,
        if ((periodicLatticeShift y μ, ν) : Bond L) = b0 then c else 0) = c

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.gradEner.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.gradEnergy_sbField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.gradEner.header:
theorem gradEnergy_sbField (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 0 < L μ) (b0 : Bond L) (w : SuTwo) :
    gradEnergy (sbField b0 w) = 6 * ‖w‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.plaqEner.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.plaqEnergy_curl_sbField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.plaqEner.header:
theorem plaqEnergy_curl_sbField (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 0 < L μ) (y0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (w : SuTwo) :
    plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM (trivialU L) (sbField ((y0, 0) : Bond L) w)) = 4 * ‖w‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.divEnerg.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.divEnergy_sbField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.divEnerg.header:
theorem divEnergy_sbField (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 0 < L μ) (y0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (w : SuTwo) :
    divEnergy (trivialU L) (sbField ((y0, 0) : Bond L) w) = 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.numeric_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.numeric_gate_six_eq_four_add_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.numeric_.header:
theorem numeric_gate_six_eq_four_add_two (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 0 < L μ)
    (y0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (w : SuTwo) :
    plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM (trivialU L) (sbField ((y0, 0) : Bond L) w))
        + divEnergy (trivialU L) (sbField ((y0, 0) : Bond L) w)
      = gradEnergy (sbField ((y0, 0) : Bond L) w)
    ∧ plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM (trivialU L) (sbField ((y0, 0) : Bond L) w)) = 4 * ‖w‖ ^ 2
    ∧ divEnergy (trivialU L) (sbField ((y0, 0) : Bond L) w) = 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2
    ∧ gradEnergy (sbField ((y0, 0) : Bond L) w) = 6 * ‖w‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.all_ener.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.all_energies_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.all_ener.header:
theorem all_energies_zero : plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM (trivialU L) 0) = 0
    ∧ divEnergy (trivialU L) (0 : Bond L → SuTwo) = 0 ∧ gradEnergy (0 : Bond L → SuTwo) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.oneSiteT.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.oneSiteTorus_collapses
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.oneSiteT.header:
theorem oneSiteTorus_collapses (A : Bond (fun _ => 0) → SuTwo) :
    gradEnergy A = 0 ∧ divEnergy (trivialU (fun _ => 0)) A = 0
      ∧ plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM (trivialU (fun _ => 0)) A) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.divEnerg.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.divEnergy_eq_zero_of_div_free
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.divEnerg.header:
theorem divEnergy_eq_zero_of_div_free

    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (h : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L,

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.plaqEner.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.plaqEnergy_curl_eq_gradEnergy_of_div_free
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.plaqEner.header:
theorem plaqEnergy_curl_eq_gradEnergy_of_div_free (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (h : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, gradCovariantAdjointValue (trivialU L) A y = 0) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.shiftVec.header:
theorem shiftVec3_coord0 (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n0 n1 n2 : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.shiftVec.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.shiftVec3_coord1
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.shiftVec.header:
theorem shiftVec3_coord1 (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n0 n1 n2 : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.shiftVec.header:
theorem shiftVec3_coord2 (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n0 n1 n2 : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.eq_shift.header:
theorem eq_shiftVec3_of_coords (c y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n0 n1 n2 : ℕ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.exists_c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.exists_coarse_shiftVec3
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.exists_c.header:
theorem exists_coarse_shiftVec3 (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.pathSite.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.pathSite_shiftVec3
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.pathSite.header:

      ∧ AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite (shiftVec3 c n0 n1 n2) μ i = shiftVec3 c m0 m1 m2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.Tloc_non.header:
theorem Tloc_nonneg (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.single_l.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.single_le_Tloc
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.single_l.header:
theorem single_le_Tloc (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ρ : Fin 3)

    ‖dfwd A ρ μ (shiftVec3 c n0 n1 n2)‖ ^ 2 ≤ Tloc A c μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.path_tel.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.path_telescope
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.path_tel.header:
theorem path_telescope (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ρ : Fin 3) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ) :
    A ((AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite z ρ n), μ) - A (z, μ)
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, dfwd A ρ μ (AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite z ρ i)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sq_norm_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sq_norm_leg_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sq_norm_.header:
theorem sq_norm_leg_le (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ρ : Fin 3) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (n0 n1 n2 n : ℕ) (h0 : n0 < 3) (h1 : n1 < 3) (h2 : n2 < 3) (hn : n ≤ 2)
    (habs : ∀ i, i < n → ∃ m0 m1 m2 : ℕ, m0 < 3 ∧ m1 < 3 ∧ m2 < 3
      ∧ AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite (shiftVec3 c n0 n1 n2) ρ i = shiftVec3 c m0 m1 m2) :
    ‖A ((AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite (shiftVec3 c n0 n1 n2) ρ n), μ)
        - A (shiftVec3 c n0 n1 n2, μ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Tloc A c μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.absorb2.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.absorb2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.absorb2.header:
theorem absorb2 (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (i : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.absorb1.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.absorb1
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.absorb1.header:
theorem absorb1 (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n2 i : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.absorb0.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.absorb0
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.absorb0.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sq_norm_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sq_norm_shiftVec3_sub_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sq_norm_.header:
theorem sq_norm_shiftVec3_sub_le (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sq_norm_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sq_norm_A_le_Tloc
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sq_norm_.header:
theorem sq_norm_A_le_Tloc (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hker : ∀ b : CoarseBond L 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 2 A b = 0)
    {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hc : c ∈ AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.CoarseLattice L 2) (μ : Fin 3)
    (d0 d1 d2 : ℕ) (hd0 : d0 < 3) (hd1 : d1 < 3) (hd2 : d2 < 3) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_le_s.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_le_sum_of_surj
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_le_s.header:
theorem sum_le_sum_of_surj {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (t : Finset ι) (φ : ι → κ)
    (F : κ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ k, 0 ≤ F k) (hsurj : ∀ k : κ, ∃ i ∈ t, φ i = k) :
    ∑ k : κ, F k ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, F (φ i)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_coar.header:
theorem sum_coarse_shift_le (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (ρ μ : Fin 3) (n0 n1 n2 : ℕ) :

        ‖dfwd A ρ μ (shiftVec3 c n0 n1 n2)‖ ^ 2)
      ≤ ∑ w : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ‖dfwd A ρ μ w‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_coar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_coarse_Tloc_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_coar.header:
theorem sum_coarse_Tloc_le (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.sum_sq_c.header:
theorem sum_sq_component_le (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.bondEner.header:
theorem bondEnergy_pos_of_ne (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (b0 : Bond L) (h : A b0 ≠ 0) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.kerQDivF.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.kerQDivFree_level_two_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.kerQDivF.header:
theorem kerQDivFree_level_two_nonvacuous {w : SuTwo} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    (∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (twoExt μ + 1))
      ∧ (∀ b : CoarseBond twoExt 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU twoExt) 2 (nvField w) b = 0)
      ∧ (∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite twoExt,
          gradCovariantAdjointValue (trivialU twoExt) (nvField w) y = 0)
      ∧ 0 < bondEnergy (nvField w)
      ∧ 0 < plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM (trivialU twoExt) (nvField w))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.inner_RMap
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem inner_RMap (g : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (X Y : SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.RMap_apply_inv_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem RMap_apply_inv_apply (g : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (X : SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.RMap_inv_apply_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem RMap_inv_apply_apply (g : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (X : SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.inner_RMap_left
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem inner_RMap_left (g : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (X Y : SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.inner_RMap_pair

      ∑ d : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections,

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.inner_ubkcov_expand
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem inner_ubkcov_expand
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (inner ℝ (ubkcov U A μ y) (ubkcov U A ν y) : ℝ)
      = lTerm1 U A μ ν y - lTerm2 U A μ ν y - lTerm3 U A μ ν y + lTerm4 A μ ν y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.inner_dcov_expand
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem inner_dcov_expand
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (inner ℝ (dcov U A μ ν y) (dcov U A ν μ y) : ℝ)
      = rTerm1 U A μ ν y - rTerm2 U A μ ν y - rTerm3 U A μ ν y + rTerm4 A μ ν y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.sum_lTerm4_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem sum_lTerm4_eq (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.sum_lTerm2_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem sum_lTerm2_eq (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    (∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, lTerm2 U A μ ν y)
      = ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, rTerm2 U A μ ν y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.sum_lTerm3_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem sum_lTerm3_eq (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    (∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, lTerm3 U A μ ν y)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.rTerm1_eq_cornerWordSnd
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem rTerm1_eq_cornerWordSnd
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    rTerm1 U A μ ν y
      = inner ℝ (A (periodicLatticeShift y ν, μ))
          (RMap (cornerWordSnd U μ ν y) (A (periodicLatticeShift y μ, ν)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.sum_lTerm1_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem sum_lTerm1_eq (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    (∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, lTerm1 U A μ ν y)
      = (∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, rTerm1 U A μ ν y)
        + ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, defectTerm U A μ ν y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.covariant_sbp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem covariant_sbp (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    divCross U A μ ν = Ccov U A μ ν + ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, defectTerm U A μ ν y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.weitzenbock_cov
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem weitzenbock_cov (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)

    plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM U A) + divEnergy U A
      = gradEnergyCov U A + weitzDefect U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.cornerWordSnd_eq_plaqWord_mul
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem cornerWordSnd_eq_plaqWord_mul

    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    cornerWordSnd U μ ν y
      = (U (y, ν))⁻¹ * plaqWord U μ ν y * U (y, ν) * cornerWordFst U μ ν y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem defectTerm_eq_zero_of_RMap_plaqWord_id

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header: theorem weitzDefect_trivialU (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : weitzDefect (trivialU L) A = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.weitzenbock_cov_recovers_flat
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem weitzenbock_cov_recovers_flat (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    (plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM (trivialU L) A) + divEnergy (trivialU L) A
        = gradEnergyCov (trivialU L) A)
      ∧ gradEnergyCov (trivialU L) A = gradEnergy A
      ∧ (plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM (trivialU L) A) + divEnergy (trivialU L) A
          = gradEnergy A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.dcov_oneSiteTorus

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem frobNorm_word_le {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (g h : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hg : frobNorm ((g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α)
    (hh : frobNorm ((h : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α) :
    frobNorm (((g * h⁻¹ : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
      Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ 2 * α

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.frobNorm_cornerWordFst_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem frobNorm_cornerWordFst_le {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L, frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α)
    (μ ν : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    frobNorm ((cornerWordFst U μ ν y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ 2 * α

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.frobNorm_inv_sub_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem frobNorm_inv_sub_one (g : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    frobNorm (((g⁻¹ : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
      = frobNorm ((g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.frobNorm_cornerWordSnd_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem frobNorm_cornerWordSnd_le {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L, frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α)
    (μ ν : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    frobNorm ((cornerWordSnd U μ ν y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ 2 * α

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.abs_defectTerm_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem abs_defectTerm_le {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L, frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    |defectTerm U A μ ν y|
      ≤ 4 * α * (‖A (periodicLatticeShift y ν, μ)‖ ^ 2
        + ‖A (periodicLatticeShift y μ, ν)‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.sum_dir_sq_le_bondEnergy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem sum_dir_sq_le_bondEnergy (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (d : Fin 3) :
    (∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ‖A (y, d)‖ ^ 2) ≤ bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.sum_shift_dir_sq_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem sum_shift_dir_sq_eq (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (d ρ : Fin 3) :
    (∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ‖A (periodicLatticeShift y ρ, d)‖ ^ 2)
      = ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ‖A (y, d)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.abs_sum_defectTerm_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem abs_sum_defectTerm_le {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L, frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    |∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, defectTerm U A μ ν y| ≤ 8 * α * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.abs_weitzDefect_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem abs_weitzDefect_le {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L, frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : |weitzDefect U A| ≤ 72 * α * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.weitzDefect_eq_zero_of_frob_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem weitzDefect_eq_zero_of_frob_zero

    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L, frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.dcov_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem dcov_gauge (γ : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.GaugeFn L)

    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ ν : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    dcov (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gaugeActA γ A) μ ν y
      = RMap (γ y) (dcov U A μ ν y)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.ubkcov_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem ubkcov_gauge (γ : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.GaugeFn L)

    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ubkcov (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gaugeActA γ A) μ y
      = RMap (γ y) (ubkcov U A μ y)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.gradEnergyCov_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem gradEnergyCov_gauge (γ : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.GaugeFn L)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    gradEnergyCov (periodicGaugeTransform γ U)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.divEnergy_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem divEnergy_gauge (γ : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.GaugeFn L)

    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :

        (AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gaugeActA γ A) = divEnergy U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.plaqEnergy_curl_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem plaqEnergy_curl_gauge (γ : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.GaugeFn L)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM (periodicGaugeTransform γ U)
        (AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.gaugeActA γ A))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.weitzDefect_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem weitzDefect_gauge (γ : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.GaugeFn L)
