AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.abs_weitzDefect_le_of_gaugeRegular
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem abs_weitzDefect_le_of_gaugeRegular {α₀ : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hreg : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.GaugeRegular α₀ U) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    |weitzDefect U A| ≤ 72 * α₀ * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.abs_weitzenbock_cov_error
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem abs_weitzenbock_cov_error {α₀ : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hreg : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.GaugeRegular α₀ U) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    |plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM U A) + divEnergy U A - gradEnergyCov U A|
      ≤ 72 * α₀ * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.plaqEnergy_ge_of_div_free
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem plaqEnergy_ge_of_div_free {α₀ : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hreg : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.GaugeRegular α₀ U) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hdiv : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, gradCovariantAdjointValue U A y = 0) :
    gradEnergyCov U A - 72 * α₀ * bondEnergy A ≤ plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM U A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.bondEnergy_le_plaqEnergy_of_covGradPoincare
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem bondEnergy_le_plaqEnergy_of_covGradPoincare {α₀ K : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hsmall : 72 * α₀ * K < 1)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hreg : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AlphaAnalyticity.GaugeRegular α₀ U) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hdiv : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, gradCovariantAdjointValue U A y = 0)
    (hpoin : bondEnergy A ≤ K * gradEnergyCov U A) :
    bondEnergy A ≤ (K / (1 - 72 * α₀ * K)) * plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM U A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.sum_sites_dirs_eq_bondEnergy
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem sum_sites_dirs_eq_bondEnergy (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    (∑ ν : Fin 3, ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ‖A (y, ν)‖ ^ 2) = bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.gradEnergy_le_gradEnergyCov
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem gradEnergy_le_gradEnergyCov {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L, frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    gradEnergy A ≤ 2 * gradEnergyCov U A + 24 * α ^ 2 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.StableGradPoincareAtLevel
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header: def StableGradPoincareAtLevel (c : ℕ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.blockResidual
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
noncomputable def blockResidual (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.sq_norm_A_le_Tloc_stable
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem sq_norm_A_le_Tloc_stable (A : Bond L → SuTwo) {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (μ : Fin 3) (d0 d1 d2 : ℕ) (hd0 : d0 < 3) (hd1 : d1 < 3) (hd2 : d2 < 3) :
    ‖A (shiftVec3 c d0 d1 d2, μ)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 2 * ‖blockResidual A c μ‖ ^ 2 + 288 * Tloc A c μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.sum_sq_component_le_stable
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem sum_sq_component_le_stable (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (μ : Fin 3) :
    (∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ‖A (y, μ)‖ ^ 2)
      ≤ 62208 * (∑ ρ : Fin 3, Xt A ρ μ)
        + 16 * ∑ c ∈ CoarseLattice L 2, ‖blockResidual A c μ‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.bondEnergy_le_gradEnergy_add_residual
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem bondEnergy_le_gradEnergy_add_residual (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1)) :
    bondEnergy A ≤ 62208 * gradEnergy A
      + 16 * ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ c ∈ CoarseLattice L 2, ‖blockResidual A c μ‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.stableGradPoincareAtLevel_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header: theorem stableGradPoincareAtLevel_two : StableGradPoincareAtLevel 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictCov_trivialU_eq_blockResidual
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCov_trivialU_eq_blockResidual (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (b : CoarseBond L 2) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 2 A b = (1 / 16 : ℝ) • blockResidual A b.1.1 b.2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.norm_blockResidual
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem norm_blockResidual (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L 2) :
    ‖blockResidual A b.1.1 b.2‖ = 16 * ‖lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 2 A b‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.sum_blockResidual_sq_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem sum_blockResidual_sq_le
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hker : ∀ b : CoarseBond L 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov U 2 A b = 0) :
    (∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ c ∈ CoarseLattice L 2, ‖blockResidual A c μ‖ ^ 2)
      ≤ 8192 * frobSupBond U ^ 2 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.bondEnergy_le_gradEnergyCov_combined
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem bondEnergy_le_gradEnergyCov_combined
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hker : ∀ b : CoarseBond L 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov U 2 A b = 0) :
    bondEnergy A ≤ 124416 * gradEnergyCov U A
      + 1624064 * (frobSupBond U ^ 2 * bondEnergy A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.bondEnergy_le_gradEnergyCov_level_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem bondEnergy_le_gradEnergyCov_level_two
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hsmall : frobSupBond U ≤ 1 / 2000)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hker : ∀ b : CoarseBond L 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov U 2 A b = 0) :
    bondEnergy A ≤ 248832 * gradEnergyCov U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.bondEnergy_le_plaqEnergy_level_two_general_U
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem bondEnergy_le_plaqEnergy_level_two_general_U
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hsmall : frobSupBond U ≤ 1 / (4 * 10 ^ 7))
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hker : ∀ b : CoarseBond L 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov U 2 A b = 0)
    (hdiv : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, gradCovariantAdjointValue U A y = 0) :
    bondEnergy A ≤ 497664 * plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM U A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.frobSupBond_trivialU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header: theorem frobSupBond_trivialU : frobSupBond (trivialU L) = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.level_two_general_U_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem level_two_general_U_nonvacuous {w : SuTwo} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    0 < bondEnergy (AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.nvField w)
      ∧ bondEnergy (AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.nvField w)
          ≤ 497664 * plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM
              (trivialU AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.twoExt)
              (AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.nvField w))
      ∧ 0 < plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM (trivialU AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.twoExt)
          (AdalyFormal.Balaban.Weitzenbock.nvField w))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.chiField_fails_divFree
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem chiField_fails_divFree (h2 : (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L 0 + 1)) {w : SuTwo} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    ¬ (∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L,
        gradCovariantAdjointValue (trivialU L)
          (AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.chiField (L := L) w) y = 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.divFree_is_load_bearing
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem divFree_is_load_bearing (h2 : (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L 0 + 1)) {w : SuTwo} (hw : w ≠ 0) (K : ℝ) :
    ¬ (∀ A : Bond L → SuTwo,
        (∀ c : CoarseBond L 2, lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 2 A c = 0) →
        bondEnergy A ≤ K * plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM (trivialU L) A))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.consistent_with_fibre_refutation
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WeitzenbockCovariant.header:
theorem consistent_with_fibre_refutation (h2 : (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L 0 + 1)) {w : SuTwo} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    (∀ c : CoarseBond L 2,
        lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) 2
          (AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.chiField (L := L) w) c = 0)
      ∧ plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM (trivialU L)
          (AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.chiField (L := L) w)) = 0
      ∧ ¬ (bondEnergy (AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.chiField (L := L) w)
            ≤ 497664 * plaqEnergy (curlCovariantLM (trivialU L)
              (AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.chiField (L := L) w)))
      ∧ ¬ (∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L,
            gradCovariantAdjointValue (trivialU L)
              (AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUGamma0.chiField (L := L) w) y = 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.curl_eq_flat_add_drift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.header:
theorem curl_eq_flat_add_drift
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    (curlCovariantLM U v : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo)
      = (curlCovariantLM (trivialU L) v : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo)
        + curlDrift U v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.windowSum_curl_general
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.header:
theorem windowSum_curl_general {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : CoarsePlaquette L ell) :
    windowSum (curlCovariantLM U v) p
      = ((ell : ℝ) ^ 4) • coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell v) p
        + windowSum (curlDrift U v) p

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.windowSum_drift_energy_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.header:
theorem windowSum_drift_energy_le {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L,
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α) :
    ∑ p : CoarsePlaquette L ell, ‖windowSum (curlDrift U v) p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 32 * α ^ 2 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 7) * bondEnergy v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.windowSum_drift_energy_le_sup
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.header:
theorem windowSum_drift_energy_le_sup {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ p : CoarsePlaquette L ell, ‖windowSum (curlDrift U v) p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 32 * (frobSupBond U) ^ 2 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 7) * bondEnergy v

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.hol_replicate_one
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.header:
theorem hol_replicate_one {G : Type*} [Group G] {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (μ : Fin 3)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.quantitative_base_case
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.header:
theorem quantitative_base_case {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH U levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels U).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L,
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α)
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    (ell : ℝ) * coarseCurlEnergy hdvd
        (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell (hjExtensionCovFaithful ell levels U B))
      ≤ 2 * deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful ell levels U B
        + 64 * α ^ 2 * bondEnergy (hjExtensionCovFaithful ell levels U B)

    [(deltaKernelImageCovH (trivialU L) levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels (trivialU L)).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :

      ≤ 2 * deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful ell levels (trivialU L) B

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.lineCoarse_cov_sub_flat
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.header:
theorem lineCoarse_cov_sub_flat {ell : ℕ}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L ell) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell v b - lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell v b
      = (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) • ∑ x ∈ blockOf b.1.1 ell, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
          (RMap (periodicPathHolonomy U b.1.1 (transportPath b.1.1 x b.2 i))
              (v (pathSite x b.2 i, b.2)) - v (pathSite x b.2 i, b.2))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.norm_lineCoarse_cov_sub_flat_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.header:
theorem norm_lineCoarse_cov_sub_flat_le {ell : ℕ}
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (α Λ : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (hα : ∀ b : Bond L,
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L ell)
    (hlen : ∀ x ∈ blockOf b.1.1 ell, ∀ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
      (((transportPath b.1.1 x b.2 i).length : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Λ) :
    ‖lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell v b - lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell v b‖
      ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * (2 * Λ * α) *
          ∑ x ∈ blockOf b.1.1 ell, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
            ‖v (pathSite x b.2 i, b.2)‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.norm_lineCoarse_cov_sub_flat_le_block
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WindowStokesGeneralU.header:
theorem norm_lineCoarse_cov_sub_flat_le_block {ell : ℕ}

theorem plaqEnergy_flatCurl_le (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.ds.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.dstarDQuadForm_trivialU_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.ds.header:
theorem dstarDQuadForm_trivialU_le (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    dstarDQuadForm (trivialU L) A ≤ 32 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.coarseSite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.header: def coarseSite (ell : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.coarseSite_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.header:
theorem coarseSite_val (ell : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((coarseSite ell x) μ).val = ell * ((x μ).val / ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.coarseSite_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.header:
theorem coarseSite_mem (ell : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    coarseSite ell x ∈ CoarseLattice L ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.sp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.spreadBond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.sp.header: noncomputable def spreadBond (ell : ℕ) (r : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) : Bond L → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.coarse_round
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.header:
theorem coarse_round {ell Y v : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hY : Y % ell = 0)
    (h1 : Y ≤ v) (h2 : v < Y + ell) : ell * (v / ell) = Y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.coarseSite_of_coarse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.header:
theorem coarseSite_of_coarse {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) : coarseSite ell y = y

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.coarseSite_pathSite
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.header:
theorem coarseSite_pathSite {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ blockOf y ell) (μ : Fin 3) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < ell) :
    coarseSite ell (pathSite x μ i)
      = if (x μ).val + i < (y μ).val + ell then y else pathSite y μ ell

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.su.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.sum_sign_range
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.su.header:
theorem sum_sign_range {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {Y V : ℕ} (h1 : Y ≤ V) (h2 : V < Y + ell) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, (if V + i < Y + ell then (1 : ℝ) else -1)
      = 2 * (Y : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 2 * (V : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.blockRefl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.blockRefl_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.bl.header:
theorem blockRefl_val {ell : ℕ} {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {μ : Fin 3}
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hfit : (y μ).val + ell ≤ L μ + 1) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ((blockRefl ell y μ hell hfit x) μ).val
      = (y μ).val + (ell - 1 - ((x μ).val - (y μ).val))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.blockRefl_apply_ne
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.blockRefl_mem
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.blockRefl_invol

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.tw.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.two_mul_sum_coord
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.tw.header:
theorem two_mul_sum_coord {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (μ : Fin 3) :
    2 * (∑ x ∈ blockOf y ell, (x μ).val) + ell ^ 3 = ell ^ 3 * (2 * (y μ).val + ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.Q_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.Q_of_blockConst_anti
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.Q_.header:
theorem Q_of_blockConst_anti {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hconst : ∀ (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3), A (z, ν) = A (coarseSite ell z, ν))
    (hanti : ∀ (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3), A (pathSite z ν ell, ν) = - A (z, ν))
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell A c = (1 / (ell : ℝ)) • A (c.1.1, c.2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.de.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.deltaJ_le_of_competitor
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.de.header:
theorem deltaJ_le_of_competitor {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (levels : List (KernelSubspace.Level L))
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH (trivialU L) levels).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell levels (trivialU L)).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (B s : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hconst : ∀ (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3), s (z, ν) = s (coarseSite ell z, ν))
    (hanti : ∀ (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3), s (pathSite z ν ell, ν) = - s (z, ν))
    (hmatch : ∀ c : CoarseBond L ell,
      lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell B c = (1 / (ell : ℝ)) • s (c.1.1, c.2))
    (hR : RcovLM (trivialU L) levels (gradCovariantAdjointLM (trivialU L) (B - s)) = 0) :
    deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful ell levels (trivialU L) B ≤ 32 * bondEnergy s

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.de.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.deltaJ_le_of_competitor_oneLevel
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.de.header:
theorem deltaJ_le_of_competitor_oneLevel {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    [(deltaKernelImageCovH (trivialU L) (oneLevelUniv L)).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    [(curlImageCovHFaithful ell (oneLevelUniv L) (trivialU L)).HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (B s : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hconst : ∀ (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3), s (z, ν) = s (coarseSite ell z, ν))
    (hanti : ∀ (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3), s (pathSite z ν ell, ν) = - s (z, ν))
    (hmatch : ∀ c : CoarseBond L ell,
      lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell B c = (1 / (ell : ℝ)) • s (c.1.1, c.2)) :
    deltaJQuadFormCovFaithful ell (oneLevelUniv L) (trivialU L) B ≤ 32 * bondEnergy s

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.pa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.pathSite_add
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.pa.header:
theorem pathSite_add (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i j : ℕ) :
    pathSite z μ (i + j) = pathSite (pathSite z μ j) μ i

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.pa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.pathSite_period
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.pa.header:
theorem pathSite_period (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    pathSite z μ (L μ + 1) = z

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.pa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.pathSite_bijective
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.pa.header:
theorem pathSite_bijective (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (fun z : PeriodicLatticeSite L => pathSite z μ i)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.pa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.pathSite_eq_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.pa.header:
theorem pathSite_eq_iff {μ : Fin 3} {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ L μ + 1)
    (x z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pathSite x μ i = z ↔ x = pathSite z μ (L μ + 1 - i)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.su.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.sum_pathSite_reindex
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.su.header:
theorem sum_pathSite_reindex (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, A (pathSite x μ i, μ)
      = ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, A (x, μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.Q_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.Q_single_same_dir
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.Q_.header:
theorem Q_single_same_dir {ell : ℕ} (c : CoarseBond L ell) (hle : ell ≤ L c.2 + 1)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (v : SuTwo) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell (Pi.single (z, c.2) v) c
      = (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) • ((((Finset.range ell).filter
          (fun i => pathSite z c.2 (L c.2 + 1 - i) ∈ blockOf c.1.1 ell)).card : ℝ) • v)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.Q_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.Q_single_other_dir
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.Q_.header:
theorem Q_single_other_dir {ell : ℕ} (c : CoarseBond L ell) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (ν : Fin 3) (hν : ν ≠ c.2) (v : SuTwo) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell (Pi.single (z, ν) v) c = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wE.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wExt_succ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wE.header: theorem wExt_succ (m : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : wExt m μ + 1 = 2 * wEll m

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wE.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wExt_four
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wE.header: theorem wExt_four (m : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : 4 ≤ wExt m μ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wE.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wEll_dvd
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wE.header: theorem wEll_dvd (m : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : wEll m ∣ (wExt m μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wConstr_dvd
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wC.header: theorem wConstr_dvd (m : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : (2 * wEll m) ∣ (wExt m μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wSplit_fibre
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.header: theorem wSplit_fibre (m : ℕ) : (wSplit m).fibre = wEll m

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wSplit_constr
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.header: theorem wSplit_constr (m : ℕ) : (wSplit m).constr = 2 * wEll m

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.si.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.site_lt
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.si.header:
theorem site_lt {m : ℕ} (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (wExt m)) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (x μ).val < 2 * wEll m

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.coarse_at_full_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.header:
theorem coarse_at_full_val {m : ℕ} {y : PeriodicLatticeSite (wExt m)}
    (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice (wExt m) (2 * wEll m)) (μ : Fin 3) : (y μ).val = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.bl.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.block_full

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.coarse_at_fibre_val

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.Q_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.Q_full
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.Q_.header:
theorem Q_full {m : ℕ} (A : Bond (wExt m) → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond (wExt m) (2 * wEll m)) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU (wExt m)) (2 * wEll m) A c
      = (1 / ((2 * wEll m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3) • ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite (wExt m), A (x, c.2)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.su.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.sum_wField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.su.header:
theorem sum_wField {m : ℕ} (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite (wExt m), wField (L := wExt m) (wExt_four m) (x, μ)
      = if μ = 2 then suTwoWitness else 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.fu.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.fullC_wField_dropped
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.fu.header:
theorem fullC_wField_dropped {m : ℕ} (c : CoarseBond (wExt m) (2 * wEll m)) :
    fullC (trivialU (wExt m)) (2 * wEll m) (dinvC (trivialU (wExt m)) (2 * wEll m))
        (wField (L := wExt m) (wExt_four m)) (droppedBondLast (2 * wEll m) c)
      = if c.2 = 2 then -suTwoWitness else 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wCoarseTwo
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wC.header: def wCoarseTwo (m : ℕ) : CoarseBond (wExt m) (2 * wEll m)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.coarse_full_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.header:
theorem coarse_full_eq {m : ℕ} (c : CoarseBond (wExt m) (2 * wEll m)) (hc : c.2 = 2) :
    c = wCoarseTwo m

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wB.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wB_eq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wB.header:
theorem wB_eq (m : ℕ) :
    fullC (trivialU (wExt m)) (2 * wEll m) (dinvC (trivialU (wExt m)) (2 * wEll m))
        (wField (L := wExt m) (wExt_four m))
      = wField (L := wExt m) (wExt_four m)
        - (Pi.single (wDrop m) suTwoWitness : Bond (wExt m) → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.coarseSite_lt_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.co.header:
theorem coarseSite_lt_iff {m : ℕ} (z : PeriodicLatticeSite (wExt m)) (j : Fin 3) :
    ((coarseSite (wEll m) z) j).val < wEll m ↔ (z j).val < wEll m

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.pa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.pathSite_ell_coord_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.pa.header:
theorem pathSite_ell_coord_two {m : ℕ} (z : PeriodicLatticeSite (wExt m)) :
    ((pathSite z 2 (wEll m)) 2).val
      = if (z 2).val < wEll m then (z 2).val + wEll m else (z 2).val - wEll m

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wSval
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.header: noncomputable def wSval (m : ℕ) (t : ℕ) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wSval_pos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.header: theorem wSval_pos (m : ℕ) : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (wEll m : ℝ) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wSval_norm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.header:
theorem wSval_norm (m : ℕ) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖wSval m t‖ = (1 / (wEll m : ℝ) ^ 3) * ‖suTwoWitness‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wSval_shift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.header:
theorem wSval_shift {m : ℕ} {t : ℕ} (ht : t < 2 * wEll m) :
    wSval m (if t < wEll m then t + wEll m else t - wEll m) = - wSval m t

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.header: noncomputable def wS (m : ℕ) : Bond (wExt m) → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.header:
theorem wS_apply (m : ℕ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite (wExt m)) (ν : Fin 3) :
    wS m (z, ν) = if ν = 2 ∧ (z 0).val < wEll m ∧ (z 1).val < wEll m then
      wSval m (z 2).val else 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS_blockConst
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.header:
theorem wS_blockConst (m : ℕ) : ∀ (z : PeriodicLatticeSite (wExt m)) (ν : Fin 3),
    wS m (z, ν) = wS m (coarseSite (wEll m) z, ν)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS_anti
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.header:
theorem wS_anti (m : ℕ) : ∀ (z : PeriodicLatticeSite (wExt m)) (ν : Fin 3),
    wS m (pathSite z ν (wEll m), ν) = - wS m (z, ν)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.ca.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.card_bond
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.ca.header: theorem card_bond (m : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Bond (wExt m)) = 24 * (wEll m) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS_norm_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wS.header:
theorem wS_norm_le {m : ℕ} (b : Bond (wExt m)) :
    ‖wS m b‖ ≤ (1 / (wEll m : ℝ) ^ 3) * ‖suTwoWitness‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.bo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.bondEnergy_wS_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.bo.header:
theorem bondEnergy_wS_le (m : ℕ) :
    bondEnergy (wS m) ≤ 24 * (1 / (wEll m : ℝ) ^ 3) * ‖suTwoWitness‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.bo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.bondEnergy_wField
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.bo.header:
theorem bondEnergy_wField (m : ℕ) :
    bondEnergy (wField (L := wExt m) (wExt_four m)) = ‖suTwoWitness‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.fo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.forall_fin_three
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.fo.header: theorem forall_fin_three {P : Fin 3 → Prop} : (∀ ν, P ν) ↔ P 0 ∧ P 1 ∧ P 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.ba.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.back_coord
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.ba.header:
theorem back_coord {m : ℕ} (z : PeriodicLatticeSite (wExt m)) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ 2 * wEll m) :
    ((pathSite z 2 (wExt m 2 + 1 - i)) 2).val
      = if i ≤ (z 2).val then (z 2).val - i else (z 2).val + 2 * wEll m - i

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.on.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.oneSite_coord
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.on.header:
theorem oneSite_coord {m : ℕ} (ν : Fin 3) :
    ((oneSite (wExt_four m)) ν).val = if ν = 0 then 1 else 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wD.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wDrop_coord
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wD.header:
theorem wDrop_coord (m : ℕ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    ((wDrop m).1 ν).val = if ν = 2 then 2 * wEll m - 1 else 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.ba.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.back_mem_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.ba.header:
theorem back_mem_iff {m : ℕ} (z y : PeriodicLatticeSite (wExt m)) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ 2 * wEll m) :
    pathSite z 2 (wExt m 2 + 1 - i) ∈ blockOf y (wEll m)
      ↔ ((y 0).val ≤ (z 0).val ∧ (z 0).val < (y 0).val + wEll m)
        ∧ ((y 1).val ≤ (z 1).val ∧ (z 1).val < (y 1).val + wEll m)
        ∧ ((y 2).val ≤ (if i ≤ (z 2).val then (z 2).val - i else (z 2).val + 2 * wEll m - i)
            ∧ (if i ≤ (z 2).val then (z 2).val - i else (z 2).val + 2 * wEll m - i)
                < (y 2).val + wEll m)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wD.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wDrop_c2
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.wD.header: theorem wDrop_c2 (m : ℕ) : ((wDrop m).1 2).val = 2 * wEll m - 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.fi.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.filter_empty_transverse
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.fi.header:
theorem filter_empty_transverse {m : ℕ} {y : PeriodicLatticeSite (wExt m)}
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite (wExt m)) (hz0 : (z 0).val ≤ 1) (hz1 : (z 1).val ≤ 1)
    (hbad : (y 0).val = wEll m ∨ (y 1).val = wEll m) :
    ((Finset.range (wEll m)).filter (fun i =>
      pathSite z 2 (wExt m 2 + 1 - i) ∈ blockOf y (wEll m))).card = 0

AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.ca.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.card_one_lower
AdalyFormal.Balaban.WitnessInequality.ca.header:
theorem card_one_lower {m : ℕ} {y : PeriodicLatticeSite (wExt m)}

AdalyFormal.Migration.BlockPoincare.theo.header:
theorem theorem4_scalar_bound (d : ℕ) (hd2 : 2 ≤ d) (L : ℝ) (hL1 : 1 ≤ L)
    (a ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ : ℓ = (d : ℝ) * (L - 1) + L) (ha_nonneg : 0 ≤ a)
    (ha1 : a ≤ 1 / (2 * ℓ))
    (ha2 : a ≤ L ^ ((-(d : ℝ) - 1) / 2) / (24 * Real.sqrt 3 * d * (d + 1))) :
    2 * a * Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) - 1) + Real.sqrt 2 * ((1 + a) ^ ℓ - 1) / L
      ≤ Real.sqrt ((1 / (12 * (d : ℝ) ^ 2)) * L ^ (-(d : ℝ) - 1)) / 2

AdalyFormal.Migration.BlockPoincare.theo.name: AdalyFormal.Migration.BlockPoincare.theorem4_quantitativeCoercivity_corrected
AdalyFormal.Migration.BlockPoincare.theo.header:
theorem theorem4_quantitativeCoercivity_corrected
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]
    (M1 M2 : H →L[ℝ] H) (V : Submodule ℝ H)
    (d : ℕ) (L a γB ℓ : ℝ)
    (hd2 : 2 ≤ d) (hL1 : 1 ≤ L)
    (hℓ : ℓ = (d : ℝ) * (L - 1) + L)
    (hγB : γB = (1 / (12 * (d : ℝ) ^ 2)) * L ^ (-(d : ℝ) - 1))
    (ha_nonneg : 0 ≤ a)

theorem nonflatU_plaquetteBound_iff (t eps : ℝ) :

HConstruction.NfRepair.nonflatU_cap_admi.name: HConstruction.NfRepair.nonflatU_cap_admission_iff
HConstruction.NfRepair.nonflatU_cap_admi.header:

HConstruction.NfRepair.nonflatU_admissio.name: HConstruction.NfRepair.nonflatU_admission_iff
HConstruction.NfRepair.nonflatU_admissio.header:
theorem nonflatU_admission_iff (t : ℝ) :
    (∃ eps : ℝ, PlaquetteBound (nonflatU t) eps ∧

AdalySI1.Asm3.hasDerivAt_modifiedAverage.header:
theorem hasDerivAt_modifiedAverage_coe_configMul_noloop_q124
    (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2)
    (hah : ∀ e, (A e)ᴴ = -(A e)) (htr : ∀ e, Matrix.trace (A e) = 0)
    (ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hcell : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hnc2 : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 1 ell, loopVar 1 ell V0 c x ≠ su2NegOne) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ((modifiedAverage V0 ell (fun e => su2Exp (t • A e)) c : SU2) : M2))
      ((ell : ℝ) •
        ((AdalyFormal.DeltaKR85.q124Principal 1 ell V0 (fineDirToUnitBond A hah htr)
            (⟨⟨c.1, by rw [one_mul]; exact hcell⟩, c.2⟩ : CoarseBond L (1 * ell))
          : SuTwo) : M2)) 0

HConstruction.MassCMP122Astra.siteConsta.header: def siteConstant (v : SuTwo) : Site M (n := n)

HConstruction.MassCMP122Astra.grad_siteC.name: HConstruction.MassCMP122Astra.grad_siteConstant
HConstruction.MassCMP122Astra.grad_siteC.header: lemma grad_siteConstant (v : SuTwo) : grad M (siteConstant M (n := n) v) = 0

HConstruction.MassCMP122Astra.siteAverag.name: HConstruction.MassCMP122Astra.siteAverage_constant
HConstruction.MassCMP122Astra.siteAverag.header:

HConstruction.MassCMP122Astra.incoming_d.name: HConstruction.MassCMP122Astra.incoming_directionConstant

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.curl_axial.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.curl_axial
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.curl_axial.header:
theorem curl_axial (a : Scalars) (p : Plaq) :

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.curl_axial.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.curl_axial_flat
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.curl_axial.header:
theorem curl_axial_flat (a : Scalars) (p : Plaq) :
    curlValueCovariant (trivialU witnessL) (axial a) p = scalarCurl a p • pauliE2

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.covCurl_ax.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.covCurl_axial_flat
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.covCurl_ax.header: theorem covCurl_axial_flat (a : Scalars) : covCurl chosenU (axialH a) = flatCurl (axialH a)

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.a_reads_ax.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.a_reads_axis
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.a_reads_ax.header:
theorem a_reads_axis (a : Scalars) (p : Plaq) :
    a1LM chosenU p (axial a) = ((-a (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2,p.2.1.1)) • pauliE2 : SuTwo) ∧
    a2LM p (axial a) = ((-a (p.1,p.2.1.2)) • pauliE2 : SuTwo) ∧
    a3LM p (axial a) = (a (p.1,p.2.1.1) • pauliE2 : SuTwo) ∧
    a4LM chosenU p (axial a) = (a (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1,p.2.1.2) • pauliE2 : SuTwo)

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.axis_matri.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.axis_matrices_commute
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.axis_matri.header:
theorem axis_matrices_commute (s t : ℝ) :
    (Complex.I • ((s • pauliE2 : SuTwo) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) *
      (Complex.I • ((t • pauliE2 : SuTwo) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) =
    (Complex.I • ((t • pauliE2 : SuTwo) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) *
      (Complex.I • ((s • pauliE2 : SuTwo) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ))

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.commutator.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.commutator_axial_zero
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.commutator.header:
theorem commutator_axial_zero (a : Scalars) (p : Plaq) :

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.secondBilP.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.secondBilPlaq_axial_zero
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.secondBilP.header:
theorem secondBilPlaq_axial_zero (a : Scalars) (p : Plaq) :

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.reHolonomy.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.reHolonomy_cases
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.reHolonomy.header:
theorem reHolonomy_cases (p : Plaq) :
    reHolonomy chosenU p = (255/257 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) ∨
    reHolonomy chosenU p = 1

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.reHolonomy.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.reHolonomy_weight
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.reHolonomy.header:
theorem reHolonomy_weight (p : Plaq) :

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.plaqWeight.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.plaqWeight_values
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.plaqWeight.header: theorem plaqWeight_values (p : Plaq) : plaqWeight p = 255/257 ∨ plaqWeight p = 1

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.plaqWeight.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.plaqWeight_lower
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.plaqWeight.header: theorem plaqWeight_lower (p : Plaq) : (255/257 : ℝ) ≤ plaqWeight p

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.firstBilPl.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.firstBilPlaq_axial
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.firstBilPl.header:
theorem firstBilPlaq_axial (a b : Scalars) (p : Plaq) :
    firstBilPlaq chosenU p (axial a) (axial b) =
      2 * (plaqWeight p - 1) * scalarCurl a p * scalarCurl b p

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.bilPlaq_ax.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.bilPlaq_axial_diag
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.bilPlaq_ax.header:
theorem bilPlaq_axial_diag (a : Scalars) (p : Plaq) :
    bilPlaq chosenU p (axial a) (axial a) =
      2 * (plaqWeight p - 1) * (scalarCurl a p)^2

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.correction.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.correctionBil_axial
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.correction.header:
theorem correctionBil_axial (a : Scalars) :
    correctionBil chosenU (axialH a) (axialH a) =
      4 * ∑ p : Plaq, (plaqWeight p - 1) * (scalarCurl a p)^2

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.inner_axis.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.inner_axis
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.inner_axis.header: theorem inner_axis (s t : ℝ) : (inner ℝ (s • pauliE2) (t • pauliE2) : ℝ) = s*t

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.flatCurl_a.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.flatCurl_axial_energy
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.flatCurl_a.header:
theorem flatCurl_axial_energy (a : Scalars) :
    ‖flatCurl (axialH a)‖^2 = 4 * ∑ p : Plaq, (scalarCurl a p)^2

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.deltaU_axi.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.deltaU_axial_energy
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.deltaU_axi.header:
theorem deltaU_axial_energy (a : Scalars) :
    (inner ℝ (axialH a) (deltaU chosenU (axialH a)) : ℝ) =
      4 * ∑ p : Plaq, plaqWeight p * (scalarCurl a p)^2

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.deltaU_axi.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.deltaU_axial_lower
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.deltaU_axi.header:
theorem deltaU_axial_lower (a : Scalars) :
    (255/257 : ℝ) * ‖flatCurl (axialH a)‖^2 ≤
      inner ℝ (axialH a) (deltaU chosenU (axialH a))

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.pairBil_ax.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.pairBil_axis_zero
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.pairBil_ax.header:
theorem pairBil_axis_zero (p : Plaq)
    (f g : (Bond witnessL → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (A B : Bond witnessL → SuTwo) (s t : ℝ)
    (hf : f A = Complex.I • ((s • pauliE2 : SuTwo) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ))
    (hg : g B = Complex.I • ((t • pauliE2 : SuTwo) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) :
    pairBil chosenU p f g A B = 0

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.secondBilP.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.secondBilPlaq_axial
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.secondBilP.header:
theorem secondBilPlaq_axial (a b : Scalars) (p : Plaq) :
    secondBilPlaq chosenU p (axial a) (axial b) = 0

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.correction.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.correctionBil_axial_pair
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.correction.header:
theorem correctionBil_axial_pair (a b : Scalars) :
    correctionBil chosenU (axialH a) (axialH b) =
      4 * ∑ p : Plaq, (plaqWeight p - 1) * scalarCurl a p * scalarCurl b p

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.flatCurl_a.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.flatCurl_axial_inner
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.flatCurl_a.header:
theorem flatCurl_axial_inner (a b : Scalars) :
    (inner ℝ (flatCurl (axialH a)) (flatCurl (axialH b)) : ℝ) =
      4 * ∑ p : Plaq, scalarCurl a p * scalarCurl b p

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.deltaU_axi.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.deltaU_axial_bilinear
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.deltaU_axi.header:
theorem deltaU_axial_bilinear (a b : Scalars) :
    (inner ℝ (axialH a) (deltaU chosenU (axialH b)) : ℝ) =
      4 * ∑ p : Plaq, plaqWeight p * scalarCurl a p * scalarCurl b p

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.axialH_of_.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.axialH_of_pointwise
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.axialH_of_.header:
theorem axialH_of_pointwise (A : H)
    (hA : ∀ e : Bond witnessL, ∃ s : ℝ, bfl2Equiv A e = s • pauliE2) :

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.deltaU_poi.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.deltaU_pointwise_axial_lower
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.deltaU_poi.header:
theorem deltaU_pointwise_axial_lower (A : H)

    (255/257 : ℝ) * (inner ℝ A (flatDelta A) : ℝ) ≤ inner ℝ A (deltaU chosenU A)

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.plaqWeight.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.plaqWeight_cos
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.plaqWeight.header: theorem plaqWeight_cos (p : Plaq) : plaqWeight p = Real.cos theta ∨ plaqWeight p = 1

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.precisionU.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.precisionU_axial_energy
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.precisionU.header:
theorem precisionU_axial_energy (a : Scalars) :
    (inner ℝ (axialH a) (precisionU chosenU 1 (axialH a)) : ℝ) =
      4 * ∑ p : Plaq, plaqWeight p * (scalarCurl a p)^2 +
      ‖gaugeConstraintU chosenU (axialH a)‖^2 +
      8 * ‖nativeLinearQ chosenU 2 (axialH a)‖^2

HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.precisionU.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.precisionU_axial_curl_lower
HConstruction.G0Final.Hessian.precisionU.header:
theorem precisionU_axial_curl_lower (a : Scalars) :
    (255/257 : ℝ) * ‖flatCurl (axialH a)‖^2 ≤
      inner ℝ (axialH a) (precisionU chosenU 1 (axialH a))

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.pgV_mul.header:

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.rawStep_pgV.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.rawStep_pgV
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.rawStep_pgV.header:
theorem rawStep_pgV (s ell : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    rawStep s ell V (pgV s V γ) c
      = pgV (s * ell) (stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp s ell V) (nextG s ell V γ) c

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.gT.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.gT
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.gT.header:

  | j + 1 => nextG (ell ^ j) ell (bg j) (gT ell bg γ j)

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.aC.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.aC
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.aC.header:

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.rawStep_tower.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.rawStep_tower
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.rawStep_tower.header:
theorem rawStep_tower (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (j : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    rawStep (ell ^ j) ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell U j)
        (pgV (ell ^ j) (UbarTower su2LogExp ell U j) (gT ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell U) γ j)) c
      = pgV (ell ^ (j + 1)) (UbarTower su2LogExp ell U (j + 1))
          (gT ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell U) γ (j + 1)) c

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.expCfgX_aC.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.expCfgX_aC
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.expCfgX_aC.header:
theorem expCfgX_aC (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (j : ℕ)
    (hne : ∀ e, pgV (ell ^ j) (bg j) (gT ell bg γ j) e ≠ su2NegOne) :
    expCfgX (aC ell bg γ j) = pgV (ell ^ j) (bg j) (gT ell bg γ j)

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.qCompX_aC.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.qCompX_aC
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.qCompX_aC.header:
theorem qCompX_aC (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (j : ℕ)
    (hne : ∀ i, i < j → ∀ e, pgV (ell ^ i) (UbarTower su2LogExp ell U i)
      (gT ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell U) γ i) e ≠ su2NegOne) :
    qCompX ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell U) j (aC ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell U) γ 0)
      = aC ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell U) γ j

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hasDerivAt_su2Log.header:

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.antiHerm_of_hasDe.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.antiHerm_of_hasDerivAt
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.antiHerm_of_hasDe.header:
theorem antiHerm_of_hasDerivAt (G : ℝ → SU2) (v : M2)
    (hG : HasDerivAt (fun t => (G t : M2)) v 0) (hG0 : G 0 = 1) : vᴴ = -v

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.rProd_pgV.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.rProd_pgV
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.rProd_pgV.header:
theorem rProd_pgV (s ell : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2)
    (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) :
    rProd s V (pgV s V γ) y (coarseGammaPath s y x)
      = γ y * coarsePathHolonomy s V y (coarseGammaPath s y x) * (γ x)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hasDerivAt_logLoo.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hasDerivAt_logLoop
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hasDerivAt_logLoo.header:
theorem hasDerivAt_logLoop (s ell : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (γ : ℝ → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (ν : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M2)
    (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell)
    (h0y : γ 0 y = 1) (h0x : γ 0 x = 1)
    (hdy : HasDerivAt (fun t => (γ t y : M2)) (ν y) 0) (hdx : HasDerivAt (fun t => (γ t x : M2)) (ν x) 0)
    (hah : (ν x)ᴴ = -ν x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => su2Log (rProd s V (pgV s V (γ t)) y (coarseGammaPath s y x)))
      (ν y - ((coarsePathHolonomy s V y (coarseGammaPath s y x) : SU2) : M2) * ν x
        * ((coarsePathHolonomy s V y (coarseGammaPath s y x) : SU2) : M2)ᴴ) 0

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.sBlock_mem.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.sBlock_mem
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.sBlock_mem.header:

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hasDerivAt_sBlock.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hasDerivAt_sBlock
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hasDerivAt_sBlock.header:
theorem hasDerivAt_sBlock (s ell : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (γ : ℝ → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (ν : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M2) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (h0y : γ 0 y = 1) (h0B : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, γ 0 x = 1)
    (hdy : HasDerivAt (fun t => (γ t y : M2)) (ν y) 0)
    (hdB : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, HasDerivAt (fun t => (γ t x : M2)) (ν x) 0)
    (hah : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, (ν x)ᴴ = -ν x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => sBlock s ell V (pgV s V (γ t)) y)
      (∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ •
        (ν y - ((coarsePathHolonomy s V y (coarseGammaPath s y x) : SU2) : M2) * ν x
          * ((coarsePathHolonomy s V y (coarseGammaPath s y x) : SU2) : M2)ᴴ)) 0

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hasDerivAt_nextG.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hasDerivAt_nextG
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hasDerivAt_nextG.header:
theorem hasDerivAt_nextG (s ell : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (γ : ℝ → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (ν : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M2) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)

    (hah : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, (ν x)ᴴ = -ν x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => (nextG s ell V (γ t) y : M2))
      ((∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ •
        (ν y - ((coarsePathHolonomy s V y (coarseGammaPath s y x) : SU2) : M2) * ν x
          * ((coarsePathHolonomy s V y (coarseGammaPath s y x) : SU2) : M2)ᴴ))ᴴ + ν y) 0

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.gLam.header: noncomputable def gLam (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (t : ℝ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.dG.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.dG
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.dG.header:
noncomputable def dG (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite L → M2
  | 0 => fun x => ((lam x : SuTwo) : M2)
  | j + 1 => fun y =>
      (∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y (ell ^ j) ell, ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ •
        (dG ell bg lam j y - ((coarsePathHolonomy (ell ^ j) (bg j) y (coarseGammaPath (ell ^ j) y x) : SU2) : M2)
          * dG ell bg lam j x
          * ((coarsePathHolonomy (ell ^ j) (bg j) y (coarseGammaPath (ell ^ j) y x) : SU2) : M2)ᴴ))ᴴ
      + dG ell bg lam j y

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.avg_identity.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.avg_identity
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.avg_identity.header:

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.dG_eq_Qcomposite.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.dG_eq_Qcomposite

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.QlinCompX_pureGau.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.QlinCompX_pureGauge
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.QlinCompX_pureGau.header:
theorem QlinCompX_pureGauge (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)

            * dG ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell U) lam j (coarseShift c.1 (ell ^ j) c.2)

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.Qcomposite_dri.header:
theorem Qcomposite_drift_pointwise (bg : ℕ → Cfg L) (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (K : ℕ)
    (hdvd : ∀ j, j ≤ K → ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ j ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hbg : ∀ j, j < K → ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ j), ∀ μ : Fin 3, frobNorm (((bg j (y, μ) : _) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ a j)
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ∀ (j : ℕ), j ≤ K → ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ j),
      ‖Qcomposite bg ell j f y - ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ j) • ∑ x ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), f x‖

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.ginv_coercive_.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.ginv_coercive_BC_sup
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.ginv_coercive_.header:
theorem ginv_coercive_BC_sup (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a + (1 - siteMask (GF ell k Lu).Om0)))
    (PU : ℝ) (hPU : 0 ≤ PU)
    (hPoincU : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) U, ‖ν‖ ≤ PU * ‖gradL2 U ν‖)
    (nsq c1 t θ e P δ q : ℝ) (hn : 0 < nsq) (ht : 0 < t) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
                                                                   
    (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hεnn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ ε j)
    (hsup : ∀ j, j < k → frobSupBond (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U j) ≤ ε j)
    (hr : ∀ j, j < k → Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ε j) < r0)
    (hεs : ∀ j, j < k → ε j ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4))
    (hδdef : δ = Real.sqrt 12 * AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.frobSupBond U)
    (hedef : e = (1 + t) * θ + (1 + 1 / t) * ((4 * Real.sqrt 2 *
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.frobSupBond U) ^ 2 + deltaM ell k a ε ^ 2))
    (hqdef : q = Real.sqrt (1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3) + eps0Of ell k ε) (hε0nn : 0 ≤ eps0Of ell k ε)
    (hεa : eps0Of ell k ε * aFE ell k < 1)
    (hsmall : nsq * ((((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - eps0Of ell k ε * aFE ell k)) * q) * (δ * P
        + (((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - eps0Of ell k ε * aFE ell k)) * q) * P ^ 2
        * (δ + ((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - eps0Of ell k ε * aFE ell k)) * eps0Of ell k ε)) + δ) ^ 2
        + nsq * e < c1)
    (hflat : ∀ y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      c1 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ nsq * (PhiF ell k Lu a (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y
        + ‖Rproj (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (gradAdj (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y)‖ ^ 2))
    (hdp : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      |AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc U (plaqIn (GF ell k Lu).Om0) x x| ≤ θ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hPoinc1 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)),
      ‖ν‖ ≤ P * ‖gradL2 (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ν‖)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp (GF ell k Lu))) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ max (2 / ((c1 - nsq * ((((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - eps0Of ell k ε * aFE ell k)) * q) * (δ * P
        + (((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - eps0Of ell k ε * aFE ell k)) * q) * P ^ 2
        * (δ + ((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - eps0Of ell k ε * aFE ell k)) * eps0Of ell k ε)) + δ) ^ 2
        - nsq * e) / (1 + t) / nsq)) (2 * PU ^ 2) *
      ⟪x, (IngrBParams.data ⟨ell, k, Lu, hell, fullTower ell k Lu, U, a, Lam⟩).Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.eps_class_le.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.eps_class_le
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.eps_class_le.header:
theorem eps_class_le (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (e q0 : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q0) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) :
    (ell : ℝ) ^ j * e + 3 * Real.pi * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ j * q0)
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ j * (e + 3 * Real.pi * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k * q0))

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.class_eps0_bou.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.class_eps0_bound
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.class_eps0_bou.header:
theorem class_eps0_bound (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (e q0 : ℝ) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hq : 0 ≤ q0) :
    eps0Of ell k (fun j => (ell : ℝ) ^ j * e + 3 * Real.pi * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ j * q0))
      ≤ 6 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k * (e + 3 * Real.pi * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k * q0))) * Real.sqrt (1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3)

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.class_n_deltaM.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.class_n_deltaM_bound
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.class_n_deltaM.header:
theorem class_n_deltaM_bound (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (e q0 : ℝ) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hq : 0 ≤ q0)
    (hεs : ∀ j, j < k → (ell : ℝ) ^ j * e + 3 * Real.pi * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ j * q0) ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)) :
    (ell : ℝ) ^ k * deltaM ell k a (fun j => (ell : ℝ) ^ j * e + 3 * Real.pi * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ j * q0)) ≤
      Real.sqrt a * (((3600 * (ell : ℝ) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k * (e + 3 * Real.pi * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k * q0)))) / rr ell)
        * Real.exp ((3600 * (ell : ℝ) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k * (e + 3 * Real.pi * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k * q0)))) / rr ell))

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.TowerClass.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.TowerClass
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.TowerClass.header: def TowerClass (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.eps0Of.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.eps0Of
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.eps0Of.header: noncomputable def eps0Of (ell k : ℕ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.hdvd_scaleUp.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.hdvd_scaleUp
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.hdvd_scaleUp.header:
theorem hdvd_scaleUp (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) (μ : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.hQdrift_of_tow.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.hQdrift_of_tower
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.hQdrift_of_tow.header:

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.embS_surj.header:

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.embCB.header: def embCB (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (m : ℕ) (c : CoarseBond Lq m) : CoarseBond L (s * m)

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.embCB_bijectiv.header: theorem embCB_bijective (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (m : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (embCB hs m)

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.sum_embE.header:

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.sum_edge_eq_co.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.sum_edge_eq_coarse1
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.sum_edge_eq_co.header:

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.sum_embE_edge.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.sum_embE_edge
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.sum_embE_edge.header:
theorem sum_embE_edge (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (g : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.blocks_disjoin.header:

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.sum_blocks_le.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.sum_blocks_le
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.sum_blocks_le.header:
theorem sum_blocks_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (hh : ∀ z, 0 ≤ h z) :

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.pathSite_injec.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.pathSite_injective
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.pathSite_injec.header:
theorem pathSite_injective (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.sum_pathSite.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.sum_pathSite
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.sum_pathSite.header:
theorem sum_pathSite (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.T1_flat_pointw.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.T1_flat_pointwise
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.T1_flat_pointw.header:
theorem T1_flat_pointwise {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (A : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell)) :

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nr.header: def nr {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nr_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nr_nonneg
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nr_nonneg.header: theorem nr_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → SuTwo) : 0 ≤ nr w

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nr_sq.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nr_sq
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nr_sq.header: theorem nr_sq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → SuTwo) : nr w ^ 2 = ∑ i, ‖w i‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nr_add_le.header: theorem nr_add_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (w1 w2 : ι → SuTwo) : nr (w1 + w2) ≤ nr w1 + nr w2

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nr_le_of_sq.header:

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nr_eq_zero_of_.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nr_eq_zero_of_sq
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nr_eq_zero_of_.header: theorem nr_eq_zero_of_sq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → SuTwo) (h : ∑ i, ‖w i‖ ^ 2 ≤ 0) : nr w = 0

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.suOf_smul.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.suOf_smul
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.suOf_smul.header: theorem suOf_smul (r : ℝ) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) : suOf (r • v) = r • suOf v

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.suOf_sub.header: theorem suOf_sub (u v : Fin 3 → ℝ) : suOf (u - v) = suOf u - suOf v

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nrm.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nrm
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nrm.header: def nrm (m : ℕ) (Z : XS L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nrm_sq.header: theorem nrm_sq (m : ℕ) (Z : XS L) : nrm m Z ^ 2 = ∑ c : CoarseBond L m, ‖suOf (Z (c.1.1, c.2))‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nrm_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nrm_nonneg
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nrm_nonneg.header: theorem nrm_nonneg (m : ℕ) (Z : XS L) : 0 ≤ nrm m Z

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.ell_sqrt_cube.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.ell_sqrt_cube
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.ell_sqrt_cube.header: theorem ell_sqrt_cube (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) : (ell : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) = rr ell

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.thetaOf_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.thetaOf_nonneg
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.thetaOf_nonneg.header: theorem thetaOf_nonneg (ell : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) : 0 ≤ thetaOf ell ε

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.e2Majorant_num.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.e2Majorant_numeric_bc
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.e2Majorant_num.header:
theorem e2Majorant_numeric_bc {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0)

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.regTower_of_sm.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.regTower_of_small_bc
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.regTower_of_sm.header:

    (J : ℕ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hε : ∀ j, 0 ≤ ε j) (hV : ∀ j, j < J → ∀ e, frobNorm ((bg j e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε j)
    (hr : ∀ j, j < J → Real.pi / 2 * ((SmallnessBridge.Assemble.loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ε j) < r0) :

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.e2Majorant_rho.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.e2Majorant_rhoOf_zero
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.e2Majorant_rho.header: theorem e2Majorant_rhoOf_zero {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) : e2Majorant (rhoOf ell 0) = 0

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.frob_trivial_s.header:

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.eq_of_sq_eq'.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.eq_of_sq_eq'
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.eq_of_sq_eq'.header: theorem eq_of_sq_eq' {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (h : x ^ 2 = y ^ 2) : x = y

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.step_bounds.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.step_bounds
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.step_bounds.header:
theorem step_bounds (ell : ℕ) (bg bg1 : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (J : ℕ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell bg J) (hreg1 : RegTower ell bg1 J) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < J)
    (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = ell ^ j * (Lq μ + 1)) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (Lq μ + 1)) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm (((resV hs (bg j)) e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε) (hsmall : rhoOf ell ε < Real.pi / 2)
    (hbg1 : bg1 j = trivialU L) (a : XS L) :
    nrm (ell ^ j * ell) (QlinCompX ell bg (j + 1) a)
        ≤ (rr ell + thetaOf ell ε) * nrm (ell ^ j * 1) (QlinCompX ell bg j a)
    ∧ nrm (ell ^ j * ell) (QlinCompX ell bg (j + 1) a - QlinCompX ell bg1 (j + 1) a)
        ≤ rr ell * nrm (ell ^ j * 1) (QlinCompX ell bg j a - QlinCompX ell bg1 j a)
          + thetaOf ell ε * nrm (ell ^ j * 1) (QlinCompX ell bg j a)

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.seq_bound.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.seq_bound
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.seq_bound.header:
theorem seq_bound (K : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (θ F G : ℕ → ℝ) (X : ℝ) (hX : 0 ≤ X)
    (hθ : ∀ j, j < K → 0 ≤ θ j) (hF0 : F 0 ≤ X) (hG0 : G 0 = 0)
    (hF : ∀ j, j < K → F (j + 1) ≤ (r + θ j) * F j)
    (hG : ∀ j, j < K → G (j + 1) ≤ r * G j + θ j * F j) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ K → F j ≤ r ^ j * Real.exp ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, θ i) / r) * X
      ∧ G j ≤ r ^ j * ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, θ i) / r) * Real.exp ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, θ i) / r) * X

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nrm_zero.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nrm_zero
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nrm_zero.header: theorem nrm_zero {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (m : ℕ) : nrm m (0 : XS L) = 0

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.flatBg.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.flatBg
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.flatBg.header: abbrev flatBg (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.regTower_flat.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.regTower_flat
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.regTower_flat.header: theorem regTower_flat (hell : 0 < ell) (J : ℕ) : RegTower ell (flatBg ell k Lu) J

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.hsLq.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.hsLq
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.hsLq.header:
theorem hsLq (hell : 0 < ell) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) (μ : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.hdvdLq.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.hdvdLq
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.hdvdLq.header:
theorem hdvdLq (hell : 0 < ell) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < k) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ell ∣ scaleUp ell (k - j) Lu μ + 1

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.QlinCompX_zero.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.QlinCompX_zero_apply
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.QlinCompX_zero.header:
theorem QlinCompX_zero_apply (ell : ℕ) {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (a : XS L) : QlinCompX ell bg 0 a = a

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.tower_FG.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.tower_FG
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.tower_FG.header:
theorem tower_FG (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (a : XS (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ k →
      nrm (ell ^ j) (QlinCompX ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) j a)
        ≤ (rr ell) ^ j * Real.exp ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, thetaOf ell (ε i)) / rr ell) * nrm 1 a
      ∧ nrm (ell ^ j) (QlinCompX ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) j a - QlinCompX ell (flatBg ell k Lu) j a)
        ≤ (rr ell) ^ j * ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, thetaOf ell (ε i)) / rr ell)
            * Real.exp ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, thetaOf ell (ε i)) / rr ell) * nrm 1 a

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.suOf_suCoord.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.suOf_suCoord
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.suOf_suCoord.header:
theorem suOf_suCoord {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (x : BondFnL2 L) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nrm_one_suCoor.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nrm_one_suCoord
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.nrm_one_suCoor.header: theorem nrm_one_suCoord {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (x : BondFnL2 L) : nrm 1 (suCoord x) = ‖x‖

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.bidx_level.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.bidx_level
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.bidx_level.header: theorem bidx_level (p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu)) : (p.1 : ℕ) = k

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.aligned_of_tou.header:
theorem aligned_of_touching (hell : 0 < ell) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (μ : Fin 3)

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.bidx_aligned.header:

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.bidxCB.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.bidxCB
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.bidxCB.header: def bidxCB (hell : 0 < ell) (p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu)) : CoarseBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ k)

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.bidxCB_injecti.header: theorem bidxCB_injective (hell : 0 < ell) : Function.Injective (bidxCB ell k Lu hell)

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.sum_le_of_inje.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.sum_le_of_injective
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.sum_le_of_inje.header:
theorem sum_le_of_injective {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] (φ : α → β)
    (hφ : Function.Injective φ) (g : β → ℝ) (hg : ∀ b, 0 ≤ g b) :

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.Qfull_apply_le.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.Qfull_apply_level
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.Qfull_apply_le.header:
theorem Qfull_apply_level (G : TowerGeom (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (V : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hreg : RegTower G.ell (bgTower G V) G.k) (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (p : BIdx G) :
    (bondSectorOf G V).Qfull x p
      = (((G.ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ))⁻¹) • suOf (QlinCompX G.ell (bgTower G V) p.1 (suCoord x) p.2.1)

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.deltaM.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.deltaM
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.deltaM.header: def deltaM (ell k : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.hm_of_tower.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.hm_of_tower
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.hm_of_tower.header:
theorem hm_of_tower (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu), a * ((GF ell k Lu).ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ) *
        ‖(bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p - (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ deltaM ell k a ε ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.thetaOf_le.header:

AdalyFormal.BondComposite.ginv_coercive_.name: AdalyFormal.BondComposite.ginv_coercive_BC
AdalyFormal.BondComposite.ginv_coercive_.header:
theorem ginv_coercive_BC (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a + (1 - siteMask (GF ell k Lu).Om0)))
    (PU : ℝ) (hPU : 0 ≤ PU)
    (hPoincU : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) U, ‖ν‖ ≤ PU * ‖gradL2 U ν‖)
    (nsq c1 t θ e P δ q : ℝ) (hn : 0 < nsq) (ht : 0 < t) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
                                                                   
    (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε) (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j)
    (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (hδdef : δ = Real.sqrt 12 * AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.frobSupBond U)
    (hedef : e = (1 + t) * θ + (1 + 1 / t) * ((4 * Real.sqrt 2 *
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.frobSupBond U) ^ 2 + deltaM ell k a ε ^ 2))
    (hqdef : q = Real.sqrt (1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3) + eps0Of ell k ε) (hε0nn : 0 ≤ eps0Of ell k ε)
    (hεa : eps0Of ell k ε * aFE ell k < 1)
    (hsmall : nsq * ((((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - eps0Of ell k ε * aFE ell k)) * q) * (δ * P
        + (((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - eps0Of ell k ε * aFE ell k)) * q) * P ^ 2
        * (δ + ((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - eps0Of ell k ε * aFE ell k)) * eps0Of ell k ε)) + δ) ^ 2
        + nsq * e < c1)
    (hflat : ∀ y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      c1 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ nsq * (PhiF ell k Lu a (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y
        + ‖Rproj (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (gradAdj (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y)‖ ^ 2))
    (hdp : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      |AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc U (plaqIn (GF ell k Lu).Om0) x x| ≤ θ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hPoinc1 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)),
      ‖ν‖ ≤ P * ‖gradL2 (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ν‖)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp (GF ell k Lu))) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ max (2 / ((c1 - nsq * ((((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - eps0Of ell k ε * aFE ell k)) * q) * (δ * P
        + (((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - eps0Of ell k ε * aFE ell k)) * q) * P ^ 2
        * (δ + ((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - eps0Of ell k ε * aFE ell k)) * eps0Of ell k ε)) + δ) ^ 2
        - nsq * e) / (1 + t) / nsq)) (2 * PU ^ 2) *
      ⟪x, (IngrBParams.data ⟨ell, k, Lu, hell, fullTower ell k Lu, U, a, Lam⟩).Ginv x⟫

    (hβ : ∀ z μ, z ∈ IBox lo hi → z + ev μ ∈ IBox lo hi →
      frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform gP U (iota v z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1)
        + frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform gQ U (iota v z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ β)
    {p' : Z3} (hp' : p' ∈ IBox lo hi) :

AdalyFormal.M2BallCharts.level_sweep.header:
theorem level_sweep {v : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {r : ℕ} (hL : ∀ μ, 2 * r + 1 < L μ + 1) {lo hi : Z3}
    (hbox : IBox lo hi ⊆ Box r) (σ : Fin 3) (a : ℕ → ℤ) (wd : ℕ) (hwd : 1 ≤ wd)
    (hgap : ∀ k, a k + wd + 4 ≤ a (k + 1)) {U : LinkCfg L} (g : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2)
    (Dom : ℕ → Set Z3) {t1 t2 : ℝ} (ht1 : 0 ≤ t1) (ht2 : 0 ≤ t2)
    (hg : ∀ k, ZCh U (g k) v (Dom k) (fun _ => t1) (fun _ => t2))
    (hslab : ∀ k p, p ∈ IBox lo hi → (k = 0 ∨ a k - 2 ≤ p σ) → p σ ≤ a (k + 1) + wd + 2 → p ∈ Dom k)
    (dm : ℕ) (hdm : ∀ k p p', p ∈ IBox lo hi → p' ∈ IBox lo hi → a (k + 1) - 2 ≤ p σ → p σ ≤ a (k + 1) + wd + 2 →
        a (k + 1) - 2 ≤ p' σ → p' σ ≤ a (k + 1) + wd + 2 → l1 p p' ≤ dm)
    (hτ : (dm : ℝ) * (2 * t1) ≤ 2) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ G : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2,
      ZCh U G v {p | p ∈ IBox lo hi ∧ ((p σ : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ ((a (N + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ) + (wd : ℝ) + 2}
        (fun _ => glueT1 t1 ((dm : ℝ) * (2 * t1)) (kap1 (wd : ℝ)))
        (fun _ => glueT2 t1 t2 ((dm : ℝ) * (2 * t1)) (kap1 (wd : ℝ)) (kap2 (wd : ℝ)))

      ZCh U g w (Ib r (bigSide M ell (j - 1)) (qv r (bigSide M ell (j - 1)) w n) Finset.univ)

AdalySI1.C1Proof.holonomy_tangent.header:
theorem holonomy_tangent (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2)
    (hah : ∀ e, (A e)ᴴ = -(A e)) (htr : ∀ e, Matrix.trace (A e) = 0)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (q : List (Fin 3)) :
    holonomyDirDeriv V0 A 1 y q =
      (lineIntegral 1 V0 (fineDirToUnitBond A hah htr) y q : M2)
        * ((coarsePathHolonomy 1 V0 y q : SU2) : M2)

AdalySI1.C1Proof.four_leg_algebra.name: AdalySI1.C1Proof.four_leg_algebra
AdalySI1.C1Proof.four_leg_algebra.header:
theorem four_leg_algebra (p s f C : SU2) (a b e d : SuTwo) :
    ((((a : M2) * (p : M2) * (s : M2) + (p : M2) * ((b : M2) * (s : M2)))
          * (f : M2)ᴴ + (p : M2) * (s : M2) * ((e : M2) * (f : M2))ᴴ)
        * (C : M2)ᴴ + ((p * s * f⁻¹ : SU2) : M2) * ((d : M2) * (C : M2))ᴴ)
      * Ring.inverse ((p * s * f⁻¹ * C⁻¹ : SU2) : M2)
      = (a : M2) + (RMap p b : M2) - (RMap (p * s * f⁻¹) e : M2)
        - (RMap (p * s * f⁻¹ * C⁻¹) d : M2)

AdalySI1.C1Proof.su2Exp_neg_mul.header:

AdalySI1.C1Proof.near_dict.header:
theorem near_dict (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2)
    (hah : ∀ e, (A e)ᴴ = -(A e)) (htr : ∀ e, Matrix.trace (A e) = 0)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    dirDeriv V0 A c.1 (GammaPath c.1 x) 1
      = ((lineIntegral 1 V0 (fineDirToUnitBond A hah htr) c.1
          (coarseGammaPath 1 c.1 x) : SuTwo) : M2)

AdalySI1.C1Proof.four_legs.name: AdalySI1.C1Proof.four_legs
AdalySI1.C1Proof.four_legs.header:
theorem four_legs (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2)
    (hah : ∀ e, (A e)ᴴ = -(A e)) (htr : ∀ e, Matrix.trace (A e) = 0)
    (ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    rawLoopTangent V0 A ell c x
        * Ring.inverse ((loopVar 1 ell V0 c x : SU2) : M2)
      = dirDeriv V0 A c.1 (GammaPath c.1 x) 1
        + ((RMap (coarsePathHolonomy 1 V0 c.1 (coarseGammaPath 1 c.1 x))
            (lineIntegral 1 V0 (fineDirToUnitBond A hah htr) x
              (List.replicate ell c.2)) : SuTwo) : M2)
        - ((RMap (coarsePathHolonomy 1 V0 c.1 (coarseGammaPath 1 c.1 x)
              * coarsePathHolonomy 1 V0 x (List.replicate ell c.2)
              * (coarsePathHolonomy 1 V0 (cPlusS 1 ell c) (coarseGammaPath 1 c.1 x))⁻¹)
            (lineIntegral 1 V0 (fineDirToUnitBond A hah htr) (cPlusS 1 ell c)
              (coarseGammaPath 1 c.1 x)) : SuTwo) : M2)
        - ((RMap (loopVar 1 ell V0 c x)
            (lineIntegral 1 V0 (fineDirToUnitBond A hah htr) c.1
              (List.replicate ell c.2)) : SuTwo) : M2)

AdalySI1.C1Proof.frame_change.name: AdalySI1.C1Proof.frame_change
AdalySI1.C1Proof.frame_change.header:
theorem frame_change (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    ∀ v : SuTwo,
      RMap (coarseBondVar 1 ell V0 c) v
        = expOp (-(adOp ⟨ubarBracket V0 ell c,
            ubarBracket_conjTranspose V0 ell c, ubarBracket_trace V0 ell c⟩))
          (RMap (ubarSU2 1 ell V0 c) v)

AdalySI1.C1Proof.literal_deriv_frame.name: AdalySI1.C1Proof.literal_deriv_frame
AdalySI1.C1Proof.literal_deriv_frame.header:
theorem literal_deriv_frame (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2)
    (hah : ∀ e, (A e)ᴴ = -(A e)) (htr : ∀ e, Matrix.trace (A e) = 0)
    (ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    deriv (fun t : ℝ => ((loopVar 1 ell
        (configMul (fun e => su2Exp (t • A e)) V0) c x : SU2) : M2)) 0
        * Ring.inverse ((loopVar 1 ell V0 c x : SU2) : M2)
      = dirDeriv V0 A c.1 (GammaPath c.1 x) 1
        + ((RMap (coarsePathHolonomy 1 V0 c.1 (coarseGammaPath 1 c.1 x))
            (lineIntegral 1 V0 (fineDirToUnitBond A hah htr) x
              (List.replicate ell c.2)) : SuTwo) : M2)
        - ((RMap (loopVar 1 ell V0 c x)
            (expOp (-(adOp ⟨ubarBracket V0 ell c,
                ubarBracket_conjTranspose V0 ell c, ubarBracket_trace V0 ell c⟩))
              (RMap (ubarSU2 1 ell V0 c)
                (lineIntegral 1 V0 (fineDirToUnitBond A hah htr) (cPlusS 1 ell c)
                  (coarseGammaPath 1 c.1 x)))) : SuTwo) : M2)
        - ((RMap (loopVar 1 ell V0 c x)
            (lineIntegral 1 V0 (fineDirToUnitBond A hah htr) c.1
              (List.replicate ell c.2)) : SuTwo) : M2)

AdalyFormal.P409C5.region_core.header:
theorem region_core {ell M R k K j : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {x₀ : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    {P : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hK : 2 ≤ K) (hR : K * ell ≤ R)
    (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hgt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k < L μ + 1)
    (hjk : j ≤ k) (hx0 : x₀ ∈ towerBj S j)
    (hP1 : ∀ y ∈ P, pdist x₀ y ≤ K * bigSide M ell j)
    (hxP : x₀ ∈ P)
    (hsh : ∀ (μ : Fin 3) (s : ℕ), (s = bigSide M ell j ∨ s + bigSide M ell j = L μ + 1) → sh x₀ μ s ∈ P) :
    ∃ i : ℕ, i ≤ j ∧ bigSide M ell i ∣ bigSide M ell j ∧ bigSide M ell j ≤ ell * bigSide M ell i ∧
      (∀ y ∈ P, y ∈ S.Om 0 → y ∈ towerBj S i ∪ towerBj S (i + 1)) ∧
      (∃ y ∈ P, y ∈ S.Om 0 ∧ y ∈ towerBj S i) ∧
      (∃ a ∈ P, ∃ b ∈ P, a ∈ S.Om 0 ∧ b ∈ S.Om 0 ∧
        ∃ μ : Fin 3, (a μ).val / bigSide M ell i ≠ (b μ).val / bigSide M ell i)

AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_in_union.name: AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_in_union
AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_in_union.header:
theorem cube5_in_union {ell M R k j : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hgt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k < L μ + 1)
    (hD : IsDCube ell M k S j c) :
    ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ),
      IsClassSetW ell M (12 * ell) k S sites i ∧ IsClassUnion ell M k S sites i ∧
      BlockClosed (bigSide M ell i) sites ∧
      (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell j) c ∩ S.Om 0) ⊆ sites
