AdalyFormal.P409C5.tg_cube5_needs_12ell.header:
theorem tg_cube5_needs_12ell {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {N ell M A0 A B B0 : ℕ} (hN : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = N)
    (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hA0 : A0 + 1 ≤ A) (hAB : A < B) (hBB0 : B ≤ B0) (hAN : A < N)
    (hN24 : 24 * (M * ell) ≤ N)
    (F : ℕ) (hF : F + 1 ≤ 12 * ell) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hw0 : (w 0).val = A) (hw1 : (w 1).val = 0)
    (hw2 : (w 2).val = 0) :
    ¬ ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ), IsClassSetW ell M F 1 (TG A0 A B B0 L) sites i ∧
      (printedCube5 (M * ell) w ∩ (TG A0 A B B0 L).Om 0) ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_sharp_pair.name: AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_sharp_pair
AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_sharp_pair.header:
theorem cube5_sharp_pair {ell M R : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hLf : ∀ μ, Lf μ + 1 = M * ell * (4 * R + 8)) :
    ∃ S : Tower Lf, Admissible ell M R 1 S ∧ (∃ p : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧
      (∃ p : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧
      ∃ w : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf, IsPatch ell M 1 1 S 1 w ∧ IsDCube ell M 1 S 1 w ∧
        (∀ F : ℕ, F + 1 ≤ 12 * ell →
          ¬ ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)) (i : ℕ), IsClassSetW ell M F 1 S sites i ∧
            (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell 1) w ∩ S.Om 0) ⊆ sites) ∧
        (∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)) (i : ℕ), IsClassSetW ell M (12 * ell) 1 S sites i ∧
            IsClassUnion ell M 1 S sites i ∧ BlockClosed (bigSide M ell i) sites ∧
            (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell 1) w ∩ S.Om 0) ⊆ sites)

AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_in_union_scaleU.name: AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_in_union_scaleUp
AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_in_union_scaleU.header:
theorem cube5_in_union_scaleUp {ell M R k j : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hLu : ∀ μ : Fin 3, M < Lu μ + 1) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S)
    {c : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hD : IsDCube ell M k S j c) :
    ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (i : ℕ),
      IsClassSetW ell M (12 * ell) k S sites i ∧ IsClassUnion ell M k S sites i ∧
      BlockClosed (bigSide M ell i) sites ∧
      (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell j) c ∩ S.Om 0) ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.P409C5.IsDCubePrint.name: AdalyFormal.P409C5.IsDCubePrint
AdalyFormal.P409C5.IsDCubePrint.header: def IsDCubePrint (ell M k : ℕ) (S : Tower L) (j : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.P409C5.IsDCube.toPrint.name: AdalyFormal.P409C5.IsDCube.toPrint
AdalyFormal.P409C5.IsDCube.toPrint.header:
theorem IsDCube.toPrint {ell M k j : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (h : IsDCube ell M k S j c) :
    IsDCubePrint ell M k S j c

AdalyFormal.P409C5.bj_unique.name: AdalyFormal.P409C5.bj_unique
AdalyFormal.P409C5.bj_unique.header:
theorem bj_unique {S : Tower L} (hmono : ∀ j : ℕ, S.Om (j + 1) ⊆ S.Om j) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {a b : ℕ}
    (ha : x ∈ towerBj S a) (hb : x ∈ towerBj S b) : a = b

AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_index.name: AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_index
AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_index.header:
theorem cube5_index {ell M R k j : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hgt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k < L μ + 1)
    (hD : IsDCube ell M k S j c) :
    ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ),
      IsClassSetW ell M (12 * ell) k S sites i ∧ IsClassUnion ell M k S sites i ∧
      BlockClosed (bigSide M ell i) sites ∧
      (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell j) c ∩ S.Om 0) ⊆ sites ∧ (i = j ∨ i + 1 = j)

AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_print0_anchor_f.name: AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_print0_anchor_full
AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_print0_anchor_f.header:
theorem cube5_print0_anchor_full {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hgt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k < L μ + 1)
    (hjk : 0 ≤ k) (hgrid : GridCorner (bigSide M ell 0) c) (x₀ : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ dCube (bigSide M ell 0) c) (h0 : x₀ ∈ S.Om 0) (h1 : x₀ ∉ S.Om 1) :
    ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ),
      IsClassSetW ell M (12 * ell) k S sites i ∧ IsClassUnion ell M k S sites i ∧
      BlockClosed (bigSide M ell i) sites ∧
      (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell 0) c ∩ S.Om 0) ⊆ sites ∧ i = 0

AdalyFormal.P409C5.sh_mem_cube2.name: AdalyFormal.P409C5.sh_mem_cube2
AdalyFormal.P409C5.sh_mem_cube2.header:
theorem sh_mem_cube2 {c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {g r0 r : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ cubeR c r0) (hgr : r0 + g ≤ r)
    (μ : Fin 3) (s : ℕ) (hs : s = g ∨ s + g = L μ + 1) : sh x μ s ∈ cubeR c r

AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_in_union_print0.name: AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_in_union_print0
AdalyFormal.P409C5.cube5_in_union_print0.header:
theorem cube5_in_union_print0 {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hgt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k < L μ + 1)
    (hD : IsDCubePrint ell M k S 0 c) :
    (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell 0) c ∩ S.Om 0 = ∅) ∨
    ∃ sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L),
      IsClassSetW ell M (12 * ell) k S sites 0 ∧ IsClassUnion ell M k S sites 0 ∧
      BlockClosed (bigSide M ell 0) sites ∧
      (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell 0) c ∩ S.Om 0) ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_mul.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_mul
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_mul.header: theorem dv_mul (a b : SU2) : dv (a * b) ≤ dv a + dv b

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_inv.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_inv
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_inv.header: theorem dv_inv (a : SU2) : dv a⁻¹ = dv a

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_conj.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_conj
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_conj.header: theorem dv_conj (g a : SU2) : dv (g * a * g⁻¹) = dv a

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pathBonds.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pathBonds
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pathBonds.header:
def pathBonds (s : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L → List (Fin 3) → List (PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
  | _, [] => []
  | y, μ :: rest => (y, μ) :: pathBonds s (coarseShift y s μ) rest

                                                                             
theorem path_cmp (s : ℕ) (V T : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (d : ℝ) :
    ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
      (∀ b ∈ pathBonds s y p, dv (V b * (T b)⁻¹) ≤ d) →
      dv (coarsePathHolonomy s V y p * (coarsePathHolonomy s T y p)⁻¹) ≤ (p.length : ℝ) * d

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.path_cmp.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.path_cmp
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.path_cmp.header:
theorem path_cmp (s : ℕ) (V T : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (d : ℝ) :
    ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
      (∀ b ∈ pathBonds s y p, dv (V b * (T b)⁻¹) ≤ d) →
      dv (coarsePathHolonomy s V y p * (coarsePathHolonomy s T y p)⁻¹) ≤ (p.length : ℝ) * d

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.four_cmp.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.four_cmp
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.four_cmp.header:
theorem four_cmp (X1 X2 X3 X4 a b c e : SU2) :
    dv ((X1 * a) * (X2 * b) * (X3 * c)⁻¹ * (X4 * e)⁻¹)
      ≤ dv X1 + dv X2 + dv X3 + dv X4 + dv (a * b * c⁻¹ * e⁻¹)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw.header:
def pw (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) :
    SU2

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS.header:
def ladS (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (p : List (Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) : SU2

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.rungPlaqs.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.rungPlaqs
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.rungPlaqs.header:
def rungPlaqs (s : ℕ) (ν μ : Fin 3) :
    PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℕ → List (PeriodicLatticeSite L × Fin 3 × Fin 3)
  | _, 0 => []
  | y, n + 1 => (y, ν, μ) :: rungPlaqs s ν μ (coarseShift y s μ) n

                                         
def ladPlaqs (s : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    PeriodicLatticeSite L → List (Fin 3) → List (PeriodicLatticeSite L × Fin 3 × Fin 3)
  | _, [] => []
  | y, ν :: rest => rungPlaqs s ν μ y n ++ ladPlaqs s μ n (coarseShift y s ν) rest

theorem shift_add (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a b : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift y (a + b) μ = coarseShift (coarseShift y b μ) a μ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladPlaqs.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladPlaqs
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladPlaqs.header:
def ladPlaqs (s : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    PeriodicLatticeSite L → List (Fin 3) → List (PeriodicLatticeSite L × Fin 3 × Fin 3)
  | _, [] => []
  | y, ν :: rest => rungPlaqs s ν μ y n ++ ladPlaqs s μ n (coarseShift y s ν) rest

theorem shift_add (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a b : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift y (a + b) μ = coarseShift (coarseShift y b μ) a μ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shift_add.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shift_add
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shift_add.header:
theorem shift_add (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a b : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift y (a + b) μ = coarseShift (coarseShift y b μ) a μ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS_cons.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS_cons
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS_cons.header:
theorem ladS_cons (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (ν : Fin 3) (p : List (Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    ladS s V y (ν :: p) μ n
      = (V (y, ν) * ladS s V (coarseShift y s ν) p μ n * (V (y, ν))⁻¹) * ladS s V y [ν] μ n

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS_rung.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS_rung
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS_rung.header:
theorem ladS_rung (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (ν μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    ladS s V y [ν] μ (n + 1)
      = pw s V y ν μ * (V (y, μ) * ladS s V (coarseShift y s μ) [ν] μ n * (V (y, μ))⁻¹)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS_zero
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS_zero.header:
theorem ladS_zero (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (p : List (Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 3) : ladS s V y p μ 0 = 1

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS_nil.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS_nil
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS_nil.header:
theorem ladS_nil (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) : ladS s V y [] μ n = 1

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.rung_le.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.rung_le
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.rung_le.header:
theorem rung_le (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ν μ : Fin 3) (q : ℝ) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
      (∀ t ∈ rungPlaqs s ν μ y n, dv (pw s V t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ q) →
      dv (ladS s V y [ν] μ n) ≤ (n : ℝ) * q

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS_le.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS_le
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladS_le.header:
theorem ladS_le (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (q : ℝ) :
    ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
      (∀ t ∈ ladPlaqs s μ n y p, dv (pw s V t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ q) →
      dv (ladS s V y p μ n) ≤ (p.length : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) * q)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.strT.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.strT
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.strT.header:
def strT (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L
  | 0 => U
  | l + 1 => fun c => coarseBondVar (ell ^ l) ell (strT ell U l) c

theorem pw_strT_succ (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (l : ℕ)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) :
    pw (ell ^ (l + 1)) (strT ell U (l + 1)) y ν μ
      = ladS (ell ^ l) (strT ell U l) y (List.replicate ell ν) μ ell

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_strT_succ.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_strT_succ
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_strT_succ.header:
theorem pw_strT_succ (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (l : ℕ)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) :
    pw (ell ^ (l + 1)) (strT ell U (l + 1)) y ν μ
      = ladS (ell ^ l) (strT ell U l) y (List.replicate ell ν) μ ell

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_strT_succ_le.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_strT_succ_le
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_strT_succ_le.header:
theorem pw_strT_succ_le (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (l : ℕ)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) (q : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ t ∈ ladPlaqs (ell ^ l) μ ell y (List.replicate ell ν),
      dv (pw (ell ^ l) (strT ell U l) t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ q) :
    dv (pw (ell ^ (l + 1)) (strT ell U (l + 1)) y ν μ) ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * q

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_strT_le.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_strT_le
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_strT_le.header:
theorem pw_strT_le (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (q0 : ℝ)
    (h0 : ∀ y ν μ, dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ q0) :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3),
      dv (pw (ell ^ l) (strT ell U l) y ν μ) ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.hol_one.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.hol_one
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.hol_one.header:
theorem hol_one (s : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    coarsePathHolonomy s (fun _ => (1 : SU2)) y p = 1

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.strT_link_le.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.strT_link_le
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.strT_link_le.header:
theorem strT_link_le (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (e : ℝ)
    (h0 : ∀ b, dv (U b) ≤ e) :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L), dv (strT ell U l c) ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ l * e

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopVar_eq_ladS.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopVar_eq_ladS
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopVar_eq_ladS.header:
theorem loopVar_eq_ladS (s ell : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell) :
    loopVar s ell V c x = ladS s V c.1 (coarseGammaPath s c.1 x) c.2 ell

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopBonds.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopBonds
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopBonds.header:
def loopBonds (s ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    List (PeriodicLatticeEdge L)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loop_cmp.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loop_cmp
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loop_cmp.header:
theorem loop_cmp (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (V T : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell)
    (d q : ℝ) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d)
    (hd : ∀ b ∈ loopBonds s ell c x, dv (V b * (T b)⁻¹) ≤ d)
    (hq : ∀ t ∈ ladPlaqs s c.2 ell c.1 (coarseGammaPath s c.1 x),
      dv (pw s T t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ q) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) :
    dv (loopVar s ell V c x)
      ≤ (8 * (ell : ℝ) - 6) * d + 3 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * (ell : ℝ) * q

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_step.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_step
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_step.header:
theorem defect_step (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (V T : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (d q : ℝ)
    (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q)
    (hd : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, ∀ b ∈ loopBonds s ell c x, dv (V b * (T b)⁻¹) ≤ d)
    (hdc : ∀ b ∈ pathBonds s c.1 (List.replicate ell c.2), dv (V b * (T b)⁻¹) ≤ d)
    (hq : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, ∀ t ∈ ladPlaqs s c.2 ell c.1 (coarseGammaPath s c.1 x),
      dv (pw s T t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ q) :
    dv (ubarSU2 s ell V c * (coarseBondVar s ell T c)⁻¹)
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * d
        + Real.pi / 2 * ((8 * (ell : ℝ) - 6) * d + 3 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * (ell : ℝ) * q)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.aC_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.aC_nonneg
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.aC_nonneg.header: theorem aC_nonneg (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) : 0 ≤ aC ell

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.KC_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.KC_nonneg
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.KC_nonneg.header:
theorem KC_nonneg (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (hr : blkConstOf ell < (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) :
    0 ≤ KC ell

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.KC_eq.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.KC_eq
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.KC_eq.header:
theorem KC_eq (ell : ℕ) (hr : blkConstOf ell < (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) :
    KC ell * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 - blkConstOf ell) = aC ell

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_tower.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_tower
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_tower.header:
theorem defect_tower (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (hr : blkConstOf ell < (ell : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (q0 : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (h0 : ∀ y ν μ, dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ q0) :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L),
      dv (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l c * (strT ell U l c)⁻¹) ≤ KC ell * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.link_tower.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.link_tower
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.link_tower.header:
theorem link_tower (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (hr : blkConstOf ell < (ell : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (q0 e : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (h0 : ∀ y ν μ, dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ q0) (he : ∀ b, dv (U b) ≤ e)
    (l : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    dv (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l c) ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ l * e + KC ell * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curv_tower.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curv_tower
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curv_tower.header:
theorem curv_tower (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (hr : blkConstOf ell < (ell : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (q0 : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (h0 : ∀ y ν μ, dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ q0) (l : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) :
    dv (pw (ell ^ l) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l) y ν μ)
      ≤ (4 * KC ell + 1) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.blkConst_lt_sq.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.blkConst_lt_sq
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.blkConst_lt_sq.header: theorem blkConst_lt_sq (ell : ℕ) (h : 13 ≤ ell) : blkConstOf ell < (ell : ℝ) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.KC_le_sixty.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.KC_le_sixty
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.KC_le_sixty.header: theorem KC_le_sixty (ell : ℕ) (h : 14 ≤ ell) : KC ell ≤ 60

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodP.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodP
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodP.header:
def goodP (ell : ℕ) (R : PlaqT L → Prop) : ℕ → PlaqT L → Prop
  | 0, t => R t
  | l + 1, t => ∀ t' ∈ ladPlaqs (ell ^ l) t.2.2 ell t.1 (List.replicate ell t.2.1), goodP ell R l t'

                   
def goodB (ell : ℕ) (R : PlaqT L → Prop) : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop
  | 0, _ => True
  | l + 1, c =>
      (∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 (ell ^ l) ell, ∀ b ∈ loopBonds (ell ^ l) ell c x, goodB ell R l b)
      ∧ (∀ b ∈ pathBonds (ell ^ l) c.1 (List.replicate ell c.2), goodB ell R l b)
      ∧ (∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 (ell ^ l) ell,
          ∀ t ∈ ladPlaqs (ell ^ l) c.2 ell c.1 (coarseGammaPath (ell ^ l) c.1 x), goodP ell R l t)

                          
def goodL (ell : ℕ) (Rl : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop) : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop
  | 0, b => Rl b
  | l + 1, c => ∀ b ∈ pathBonds (ell ^ l) c.1 (List.replicate ell c.2), goodL ell Rl l b

theorem pw_strT_le_loc (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (R : PlaqT L → Prop)
    (q0 : ℝ) (h0 : ∀ t, R t → dv (pw 1 U t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ q0) :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) (t : PlaqT L), goodP ell R l t →
      dv (pw (ell ^ l) (strT ell U l) t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodB.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodB
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodB.header:
def goodB (ell : ℕ) (R : PlaqT L → Prop) : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop
  | 0, _ => True
  | l + 1, c =>
      (∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 (ell ^ l) ell, ∀ b ∈ loopBonds (ell ^ l) ell c x, goodB ell R l b)
      ∧ (∀ b ∈ pathBonds (ell ^ l) c.1 (List.replicate ell c.2), goodB ell R l b)
      ∧ (∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 (ell ^ l) ell,
          ∀ t ∈ ladPlaqs (ell ^ l) c.2 ell c.1 (coarseGammaPath (ell ^ l) c.1 x), goodP ell R l t)

                          
def goodL (ell : ℕ) (Rl : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop) : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop
  | 0, b => Rl b
  | l + 1, c => ∀ b ∈ pathBonds (ell ^ l) c.1 (List.replicate ell c.2), goodL ell Rl l b

theorem pw_strT_le_loc (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (R : PlaqT L → Prop)
    (q0 : ℝ) (h0 : ∀ t, R t → dv (pw 1 U t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ q0) :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) (t : PlaqT L), goodP ell R l t →
      dv (pw (ell ^ l) (strT ell U l) t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodL.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodL
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodL.header:
def goodL (ell : ℕ) (Rl : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop) : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop
  | 0, b => Rl b
  | l + 1, c => ∀ b ∈ pathBonds (ell ^ l) c.1 (List.replicate ell c.2), goodL ell Rl l b

theorem pw_strT_le_loc (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (R : PlaqT L → Prop)
    (q0 : ℝ) (h0 : ∀ t, R t → dv (pw 1 U t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ q0) :

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_strT_le_loc.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_strT_le_loc
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_strT_le_loc.header:
theorem pw_strT_le_loc (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (R : PlaqT L → Prop)

      dv (pw (ell ^ l) (strT ell U l) t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_tower_loc.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_tower_loc
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_tower_loc.header:
theorem defect_tower_loc (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (hr : blkConstOf ell < (ell : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (R : PlaqT L → Prop) (q0 : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (h0 : ∀ t, R t → dv (pw 1 U t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ q0) :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L), goodB ell R l c →
      dv (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l c * (strT ell U l c)⁻¹) ≤ KC ell * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.strT_link_le_loc.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.strT_link_le_loc
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.strT_link_le_loc.header:
theorem strT_link_le_loc (ell : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (Rl : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop) (e : ℝ) (h0 : ∀ b, Rl b → dv (U b) ≤ e) :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L), goodL ell Rl l c →
      dv (strT ell U l c) ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ l * e

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.link_tower_loc.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.link_tower_loc
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.link_tower_loc.header:
theorem link_tower_loc (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (hr : blkConstOf ell < (ell : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (R : PlaqT L → Prop) (Rl : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop)
    (q0 e : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (h0 : ∀ t, R t → dv (pw 1 U t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ q0)
    (he : ∀ b, Rl b → dv (U b) ≤ e) (l : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hcB : goodB ell R l c) (hcL : goodL ell Rl l c) :
    dv (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l c) ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ l * e + KC ell * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curv_tower_loc.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curv_tower_loc
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curv_tower_loc.header:
theorem curv_tower_loc (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (hr : blkConstOf ell < (ell : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (R : PlaqT L → Prop) (q0 : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (h0 : ∀ t, R t → dv (pw 1 U t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ q0) (l : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (ν μ : Fin 3) (hP : goodP ell R l (y, ν, μ))
    (h1 : goodB ell R l (y, ν)) (h2 : goodB ell R l (coarseShift y (ell ^ l) ν, μ))
    (h3 : goodB ell R l (coarseShift y (ell ^ l) μ, ν)) (h4 : goodB ell R l (y, μ)) :
    dv (pw (ell ^ l) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l) y ν μ)
      ≤ (4 * KC ell + 1) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodP_univ.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodP_univ
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodP_univ.header: theorem goodP_univ (ell : ℕ) : ∀ (l : ℕ) (t : PlaqT L), goodP ell (fun _ => True) l t

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodB_univ.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodB_univ
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodB_univ.header:

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodL_univ.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodL_univ
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodL_univ.header:
theorem goodL_univ (ell : ℕ) : ∀ (l : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L),

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_step_curv.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_step_curv
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_step_curv.header:
theorem defect_step_curv (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (V T : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (d P : ℝ)
    (hP0 : 0 ≤ P)
    (hdc : ∀ b ∈ pathBonds s c.1 (List.replicate ell c.2), dv (V b * (T b)⁻¹) ≤ d)
    (hP : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, ∀ t ∈ ladPlaqs s c.2 ell c.1 (coarseGammaPath s c.1 x),
      dv (pw s V t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ P) :
    dv (ubarSU2 s ell V c * (coarseBondVar s ell T c)⁻¹)
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * d + Real.pi / 2 * (3 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * (ell : ℝ) * P)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_tower_of_cu.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_tower_of_curv
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_tower_of_cu.header:
theorem defect_tower_of_curv (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (q0 C : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (n : ℕ)
    (hP : ∀ l < n, ∀ y ν μ,
      dv (pw (ell ^ l) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l) y ν μ) ≤ C * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0) :
    ∀ l ≤ n, ∀ c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L,
      dv (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l c * (strT ell U l c)⁻¹)
        ≤ 3 * Real.pi / 2 * C * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_gauge
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_gauge.header:
theorem pw_gauge (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) :
    pw 1 (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) y ν μ = γ y * pw 1 U y ν μ * (γ y)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_pw_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_pw_gauge
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_pw_gauge.header:
theorem dv_pw_gauge (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) :
    dv (pw 1 (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) y ν μ) = dv (pw 1 U y ν μ)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.su2Exp_neg_eq_inv.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.su2Exp_neg_eq_inv
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.su2Exp_neg_eq_inv.header: theorem su2Exp_neg_eq_inv {Y : M2} (hY : IsSu2 Y) : su2Exp (-Y) = (su2Exp Y)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_exp_le.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_exp_le
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_exp_le.header: theorem dv_exp_le {X : M2} (hX : IsSu2 X) : dv (su2Exp X) ≤ frobNorm X

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_exp_div_le.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_exp_div_le
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_exp_div_le.header:
theorem dv_exp_div_le {X Y : M2} (hX : IsSu2 X) (hY : IsSu2 Y)
    (hd : frobNorm X + frobNorm Y ≤ 2) :
    dv (su2Exp X * (su2Exp Y)⁻¹) ≤ frobNorm (X - Y) + 2 * Real.pi * (frobNorm X * frobNorm Y)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.frobNorm_mul_le'.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.frobNorm_mul_le'
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.frobNorm_mul_le'.header: theorem frobNorm_mul_le' (A B : M2) : frobNorm (A * B) ≤ frobNorm A * frobNorm B

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_comm_le.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_comm_le
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_comm_le.header: theorem dv_comm_le (c e : SU2) : dv (c * e * c⁻¹ * e⁻¹) ≤ 2 * (dv c * dv e)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_pw_of_chart.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_pw_of_chart
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_pw_of_chart.header:
theorem dv_pw_of_chart (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (ν μ : Fin 3) (Xa Xb Xc Xe : M2) (ε1 ε2 : ℝ)
    (ha : IsSu2 Xa) (hb : IsSu2 Xb) (hc : IsSu2 Xc) (he : IsSu2 Xe)
    (va : V (y, ν) = su2Exp Xa) (vb : V (coarseShift y 1 ν, μ) = su2Exp Xb)
    (vc : V (coarseShift y 1 μ, ν) = su2Exp Xc) (ve : V (y, μ) = su2Exp Xe)
    (na : frobNorm Xa ≤ ε1) (nb : frobNorm Xb ≤ ε1) (nc : frobNorm Xc ≤ ε1) (ne : frobNorm Xe ≤ ε1)
    (h1 : ε1 ≤ 1) (dac : frobNorm (Xa - Xc) ≤ ε2) (dbe : frobNorm (Xb - Xe) ≤ ε2) :
    dv (pw 1 V y ν μ) ≤ 2 * ε2 + (4 * Real.pi + 2) * ε1 ^ 2

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.frobNorm_csmul.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.frobNorm_csmul
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.frobNorm_csmul.header: theorem frobNorm_csmul (c : ℂ) (X : M2) : frobNorm (c • X) = ‖c‖ * frobNorm X

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.chart.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.chart
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.chart.header:
theorem chart (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η) (A : M2) (hA : HTm A) :
    IsSu2 (((η : ℂ) * Complex.I) • A) ∧
      frobNorm (((η : ℂ) * Complex.I) • A) = η * frobNorm A

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.chart_exp.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.chart_exp
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.chart_exp.header:
theorem chart_exp (X : M2) (hX : IsSu2 X) (g : SU2) (h : (g : M2) = NormedSpace.exp X) :
    g = su2Exp X

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.CubeChart.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.CubeChart
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.CubeChart.header:
structure CubeChart (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (B : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop)
    (η c1 c2 : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.plaqIn.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.plaqIn
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.plaqIn.header: def plaqIn (B : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop) (t : PlaqT L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cube_link.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cube_link

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.diff_chart.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.diff_chart
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.diff_chart.header:
theorem diff_chart (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (A1 A2 : M2) (c2 : ℝ)
    (h : frobNorm ((η⁻¹ : ℝ) • (A1 - A2)) < c2) :
    frobNorm (((η : ℂ) * Complex.I) • A1 - ((η : ℂ) * Complex.I) • A2) ≤ η ^ 2 * c2

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cube_plaq.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cube_plaq
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cube_plaq.header:
theorem cube_plaq {U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {B : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop}
    {η c1 c2 : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (K : CubeChart U B η c1 c2) (hsmall : η * c1 ≤ 1)
    (t : PlaqT L) (ht : plaqIn B t) :
    dv (pw 1 (periodicGaugeTransform K.g U) t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2)
      ≤ 2 * (η ^ 2 * c2) + (4 * Real.pi + 2) * (η * c1) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cube_tower.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cube_tower
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cube_tower.header:
theorem cube_tower (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (hr : blkConstOf ell < (ell : ℝ) ^ 2)
    {U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {B : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop}
    {η c1 c2 : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (K : CubeChart U B η c1 c2) (hsmall : η * c1 ≤ 1)
    (hc2 : 0 ≤ c2) (l : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hB : goodB ell (plaqIn B) l c) (hL : goodL ell B l c) :
    dv (ubarTowerSU2 ell (periodicGaugeTransform K.g U) l c)
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ l * (η * c1)
        + KC ell * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * (2 * (η ^ 2 * c2) + (4 * Real.pi + 2) * (η * c1) ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cube_tower_class.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cube_tower_class
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cube_tower_class.header:
theorem cube_tower_class (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (hr : blkConstOf ell < (ell : ℝ) ^ 2)
    {U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {B : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop} {η a : ℝ} (j : ℕ)
    (hη : 0 < η) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1)
    (K : CubeChart U B η (a * (((ell : ℝ) ^ j * η)⁻¹ ^ 1)) (a * (((ell : ℝ) ^ j * η)⁻¹ ^ 2)))
    (l : ℕ) (hlj : l ≤ j) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hB : goodB ell (plaqIn B) l c) (hL : goodL ell B l c) :
    dv (ubarTowerSU2 ell (periodicGaugeTransform K.g U) l c)
      ≤ a * (1 + (4 * Real.pi + 4) * KC ell) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ l / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)

AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cell_mod.name: AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cell_mod
AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cell_mod.header: theorem cell_mod {W m n r : ℕ} (hr : r < W) : (W * m + r) % (W * n) = W * (m % n) + r

AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.coord_cell.header:

    (haN : a < N) (hab : a / W = b / W) (h : (a + N - z) % N < s) : (b + N - z) % N < s

AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cellW.name: AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cellW
AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cellW.header: def cellW (ell M j : ℕ) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cellW_pos.name: AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cellW_pos
AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cellW_pos.header: theorem cellW_pos {ell M : ℕ} (j : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 0 < ell) : 0 < cellW ell M j

AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cellW_dvd_bigSide_.name: AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cellW_dvd_bigSide_of_le
AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cellW_dvd_bigSide_.header: theorem cellW_dvd_bigSide_of_le {ell M j i : ℕ} (h : j ≤ i + 2) : cellW ell M j ∣ bigSide M ell i

AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cellW_dvd_bigSide_.name: AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cellW_dvd_bigSide_pred
AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cellW_dvd_bigSide_.header: theorem cellW_dvd_bigSide_pred (ell M j : ℕ) : cellW ell M j ∣ bigSide M ell (j - 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.classCube_sat.name: AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.classCube_sat
AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.classCube_sat.header:
theorem classCube_sat {ell M R c k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hadm : Admissible ell M R k S)
    {sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {i : ℕ} (hc : IsClassCube ell M c k S sites i)
    {W : ℕ} (hW : 0 < W) (hWi : W ∣ bigSide M ell i)

AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.classCube_index_ge.name: AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.classCube_index_ge

AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.om_cell_closed.name: AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.om_cell_closed
AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.om_cell_closed.header:

    {W : ℕ} (hW : 0 < W) (hWd : W ∣ bigSide M ell (j - 1))

AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.shift_val.name: AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.shift_val
AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.shift_val.header:
theorem shift_val {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (μ τ : Fin 3) (h : (x μ).val + 1 < L μ + 1) :
    ((periodicLatticeShift x μ) τ).val = if τ = μ then (x μ).val + 1 else (x τ).val

AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cross_cells.name: AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cross_cells
AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.cross_cells.header:
theorem cross_cells {W q : ℕ} (hW : 0 < W) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    (q * W - 1) / W = q - 1 ∧ (q * W - 1 + 1) / W = q

AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.box_core.name: AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.box_core
AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.box_core.header:
theorem box_core {ell M R c k j : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (W : ℕ) (hW : 0 < W)
    (hWpred : W ∣ bigSide M ell (j - 1)) (hWidx : ∀ i, j ≤ i + 2 → W ∣ bigSide M ell i) (hjk : j - 1 ≤ k)
    (hadm : Admissible ell M R k S) (hcov : CoversOm0p ell M c k S)
    (μ ν ρ : Fin 3) (hμν : μ < ν) (hρμ : ρ ≠ μ) (hρν : ρ ≠ ν)
    (hall : ∀ τ : Fin 3, τ = μ ∨ τ = ν ∨ τ = ρ)
    (lo hi : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hle : ∀ τ, lo τ ≤ hi τ) (hhi : ∀ τ, hi τ < L τ + 1)
    (hone : ∀ τ, hi τ / W ≤ lo τ / W + 1)
    (hfree : hi ρ / W = lo ρ / W)
    (hwide : ∀ τ, τ ≠ ρ → hi τ / W ≠ lo τ / W ∨ lo τ < hi τ)
    (hΩ : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (∀ τ, lo τ ≤ (p τ).val ∧ (p τ).val ≤ hi τ) →
      ∃ x ∈ S.Om (j - 1), ∀ τ, (p τ).val / W = (x τ).val / W) :
    ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ), IsClassCube ell M c k S sites i ∧ j ≤ i + 2 ∧
      ∀ p : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (∀ τ, lo τ ≤ (p τ).val ∧ (p τ).val ≤ hi τ) → p ∈ sites

AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.box_in_class_cube.name: AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.box_in_class_cube
AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.box_in_class_cube.header:
theorem box_in_class_cube {ell M R c k j : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 0 < ell) (hjk : j - 1 ≤ k)
    (hadm : Admissible ell M R k S) (hcov : CoversOm0p ell M c k S)
    (lo hi : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hle : ∀ τ, lo τ ≤ hi τ) (hhi : ∀ τ, hi τ < L τ + 1)
    (hone : ∀ τ, hi τ / cellW ell M j ≤ lo τ / cellW ell M j + 1)
    (hfree : ∃ ρ, hi ρ / cellW ell M j = lo ρ / cellW ell M j ∧
      ∀ τ, τ ≠ ρ → hi τ / cellW ell M j ≠ lo τ / cellW ell M j ∨ lo τ < hi τ)
    (hΩ : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (∀ τ, lo τ ≤ (p τ).val ∧ (p τ).val ≤ hi τ) →
      ∃ x ∈ S.Om (j - 1), ∀ τ, (p τ).val / cellW ell M j = (x τ).val / cellW ell M j) :
    ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ), IsClassCube ell M c k S sites i ∧ j ≤ i + 2 ∧
      ∀ p : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (∀ τ, lo τ ≤ (p τ).val ∧ (p τ).val ≤ hi τ) → p ∈ sites

AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.succ_div_le.name: AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.succ_div_le
AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.succ_div_le.header: theorem succ_div_le {a W : ℕ} (hW : 0 < W) : (a + 1) / W ≤ a / W + 1

AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.unitCell_in_class_.name: AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.unitCell_in_class_cube
AdalyFormal.CoverGeom.unitCell_in_class_.header:
theorem unitCell_in_class_cube {ell M R c k j : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 0 < ell) (hjk : j - 1 ≤ k)
    (hadm : Admissible ell M R k S) (hcov : CoversOm0p ell M c k S)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : ∀ τ, (x τ).val + 1 < L τ + 1)
    (hfree : ∃ ρ, (x ρ).val / cellW ell M j = ((x ρ).val + 1) / cellW ell M j)
    (hΩ : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (∀ τ, (x τ).val ≤ (p τ).val ∧ (p τ).val ≤ (x τ).val + 1) →
      ∃ y ∈ S.Om (j - 1), ∀ τ, (p τ).val / cellW ell M j = (y τ).val / cellW ell M j) :

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.qStepComp_hasFDeri.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.qStepComp_hasFDerivAt_of_row
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.qStepComp_hasFDeri.header:
theorem qStepComp_hasFDerivAt_of_row (s ell : ℕ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.norm_frob_eq.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.norm_frob_eq
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.norm_frob_eq.header: theorem norm_frob_eq (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : ‖M‖ = frobNorm M

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.exists_r0.header: theorem exists_r0 : ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ g : M2, frobNorm (g - 1) < r → g ∈ LogReg

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.mem_LogReg_of_frob.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.mem_LogReg_of_frob_lt
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.mem_LogReg_of_frob.header: theorem mem_LogReg_of_frob_lt {g : M2} (h : frobNorm (g - 1) < r0) : g ∈ LogReg

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.BallA.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.BallA
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.BallA.header: def BallA (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (r s : ℕ) : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.mem_BallA_self.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.mem_BallA_self
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.mem_BallA_self.header: theorem mem_BallA_self {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {s : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L s) : y ∈ BallA y r s

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.BallA_sub.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.BallA_sub
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.BallA_sub.header:

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.BallA_mono.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.BallA_mono
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.BallA_mono.header: theorem BallA_mono {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {r R s : ℕ} (h : r ≤ R) : BallA y r s ⊆ BallA y R s

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.coarseShift_mem_CL.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.coarseShift_mem_CL_of_dvd
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.coarseShift_mem_CL.header:
theorem coarseShift_mem_CL_of_dvd {s : ℕ} (hd : ∀ ρ : Fin 3, s ∣ L ρ + 1) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L s) (μ : Fin 3) : ∀ m : ℕ, coarseShift y (s * m) μ ∈ CoarseLattice L s

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.block_alignedS.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.block_alignedS
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.block_alignedS.header:

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.cPlusS_aligned.header:
theorem cPlusS_aligned {s ell : ℕ} (hd : ∀ ρ : Fin 3, s ∣ L ρ + 1) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hc : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L s) : cPlusS s ell c ∈ CoarseLattice L s

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.coarsePathHolonomy.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.coarsePathHolonomy_congrA
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.coarsePathHolonomy.header:
theorem coarsePathHolonomy_congrA {G : Type*} [Group G] (s : ℕ) (hd : ∀ ρ : Fin 3, s ∣ L ρ + 1)
    {V V' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L} (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L s → AgreeAt (BallA y (s * p.length) s) V V' →
      coarsePathHolonomy s V y p = coarsePathHolonomy s V' y p

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.stridedBlockedGaug.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.stridedBlockedGauge_congrA
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.stridedBlockedGaug.header:
theorem stridedBlockedGauge_congrA {G 𝔤 : Type*} [Group G] [AddCommGroup 𝔤] [Module ℚ 𝔤]
    (P : AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.LogExpAd G 𝔤) (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hd : ∀ ρ : Fin 3, s ∣ L ρ + 1)
    {V V' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L} (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (hc : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L s)
    (h : AgreeAt (BallA c.1 (4 * (s * ell)) s) V V') :
    stridedBlockedGauge P s ell V c = stridedBlockedGauge P s ell V' c

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.rProd_congrA.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.rProd_congrA
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.rProd_congrA.header:
theorem rProd_congrA (s : ℕ) (hd : ∀ ρ : Fin 3, s ∣ L ρ + 1) {V0 V0' V1 V1' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L}
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L s) (p : List (Fin 3))
    (h0 : AgreeAt (BallA y (s * p.length) s) V0 V0') (h1 : AgreeAt (BallA y (s * p.length) s) V1 V1') :
    rProd s V0 V1 y p = rProd s V0' V1' y p

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.sBlock_congrA.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.sBlock_congrA
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.sBlock_congrA.header:
theorem sBlock_congrA (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hd : ∀ ρ : Fin 3, s ∣ L ρ + 1)
    {V0 V0' V1 V1' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L s)
    (h0 : AgreeAt (BallA y (3 * (s * ell)) s) V0 V0') (h1 : AgreeAt (BallA y (3 * (s * ell)) s) V1 V1') :
    sBlock s ell V0 V1 y = sBlock s ell V0' V1' y

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.rawStep_congrA.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.rawStep_congrA
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.rawStep_congrA.header:
theorem rawStep_congrA (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hd : ∀ ρ : Fin 3, s ∣ L ρ + 1)
    {V0 V0' V1 V1' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (hc : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L s)
    (h0 : AgreeAt (BallA c.1 (4 * (s * ell)) s) V0 V0') (h1 : AgreeAt (BallA c.1 (4 * (s * ell)) s) V1 V1') :
    rawStep s ell V0 V1 c = rawStep s ell V0' V1' c

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.qStepComp_maskA.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.qStepComp_maskA
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.qStepComp_maskA.header:
theorem qStepComp_maskA (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hd : ∀ ρ : Fin 3, s ∣ L ρ + 1) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (hc : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L s) (a : XS L) :
    qStepComp s ell V0 c a = qStepComp s ell V0 c (maskX (BallA c.1 (4 * (s * ell)) s) a)

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.fderiv_apply_comp.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.fderiv_apply_comp
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.fderiv_apply_comp.header:
theorem fderiv_apply_comp {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (H : E → XS L) (x : E)
    (hH : DifferentiableAt ℝ H x) (v : E) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    fderiv ℝ H x v e = fderiv ℝ (fun y => H y e) x v

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.fderiv2_apply_comp.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.fderiv2_apply_comp
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.fderiv2_apply_comp.header:
theorem fderiv2_apply_comp {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (H : E → XS L) (x : E)
    (hH : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 H x) (v w : E) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ H) x v w e = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => H y e)) x v w

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.maskComp.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.maskComp
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.maskComp.header:
noncomputable def maskComp (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (j : ℕ) (W : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L))
    (a : XS L) : XS L

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.maskComp_eq.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.maskComp_eq
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.maskComp_eq.header:
theorem maskComp_eq (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (j : ℕ) (W : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L))
    (a : XS L) : maskComp ell bg j W a = maskX W (qCompX ell bg j a)

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.ReadRow.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.ReadRow
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.ReadRow.header: def ReadRow (ell j : ℕ) (b : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (l : ℕ) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.Genuine.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.Genuine
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.Genuine.header: def Genuine (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (j : ℕ) (b : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.rhoT_mono'.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.rhoT_mono'
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.rhoT_mono'.header: theorem rhoT_mono' (ell : ℕ) {l l' : ℕ} (h : l ≤ l') : rhoT ell l ≤ rhoT ell l'

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.comp_genuine.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.comp_genuine
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.comp_genuine.header:
theorem comp_genuine (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (J : ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ ρ : Fin 3, ell ^ J ∣ L ρ + 1) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ J → ∀ b : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, b.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ j) →
      (∀ l e, ReadRow ell j b l e → ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ (qStepComp (ell ^ l) ell (bg l) e) 0) →
      Genuine ell bg j b

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.C2CompL_genuine.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.C2CompL_genuine
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.C2CompL_genuine.header:
theorem C2CompL_genuine (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (j : ℕ) (b : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hG : Genuine ell bg j b) (a : XS L) :
    C2CompL ell bg j a b = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun a : XS L => qCompX ell bg j a b)) 0 a a

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.QlinCompL_hasFDeri.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.QlinCompL_hasFDerivAt
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.QlinCompL_hasFDeri.header:
theorem QlinCompL_hasFDerivAt (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (j : ℕ) (b : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hG : Genuine ell bg j b) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun a : XS L => qCompX ell bg j a b)
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L => (Fin 3 → ℝ)) b).comp
        (QlinCompL ell bg j)) 0

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pcd_le_off.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pcd_le_off
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pcd_le_off.header: theorem pcd_le_off (y z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (σ : Fin 3) : pcd (L σ + 1) (y σ).val (z σ).val ≤ off y z σ

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pdist_le_of_box.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pdist_le_of_box
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pdist_le_of_box.header: theorem pdist_le_of_box {y z : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {s B : ℕ} (h : Box y s B z) : pdist y z ≤ 3 * B

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.goodPl_of_ball.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.goodPl_of_ball
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.goodPl_of_ball.header:
theorem goodPl_of_ball (ell : ℕ) (R : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Prop) :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L), (∀ z ∈ Ball y (2 * rhoT ell l), R z) → GoodPl ell R l y

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pdist_pathBonds_le.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pdist_pathBonds_le
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pdist_pathBonds_le.header:
theorem pdist_pathBonds_le (s : ℕ) : ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
    ∀ b ∈ pathBonds s y p, pdist y b.1 ≤ s * p.length

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.loop_small.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.loop_small
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.loop_small.header:
theorem loop_small (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (q0 : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (l : ℕ)
    (hdvd : ∀ ρ, ell ^ l ∣ L ρ + 1) (hN : ∀ ρ, 2 * ell ^ l < L ρ + 1)
    (hsmall : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0) ≤ 1)
    (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (he : e.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ l))
    (hR : ∀ z ∈ Ball e.1 (4 * (ell ^ l * ell) + 2 * rhoT ell l), ∀ ν μ : Fin 3, dv (pw 1 U z ν μ) ≤ q0) :
    ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf e.1 (ell ^ l) ell,
      dv (loopVar (ell ^ l) ell (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l) e x) ≤ 6 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0)

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.regRow_of_plaq.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.regRow_of_plaq
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.regRow_of_plaq.header:
theorem regRow_of_plaq (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (q0 : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (l : ℕ)
    (hdvd : ∀ ρ, ell ^ l ∣ L ρ + 1) (hN : ∀ ρ, 2 * ell ^ l < L ρ + 1)
    (hsmall : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0) ≤ 1)
    (hthr : 6 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0) < r0)
    (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (he : e.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ l))
    (hR : ∀ z ∈ Ball e.1 (4 * (ell ^ l * ell) + 2 * rhoT ell l), ∀ ν μ : Fin 3, dv (pw 1 U z ν μ) ≤ q0) :
    RegRow (ell ^ l) ell (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l) e

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pw_gauge_dv.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pw_gauge_dv
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pw_gauge_dv.header:
theorem pw_gauge_dv (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) :
    dv (pw 1 (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) y ν μ) = dv (pw 1 U y ν μ)

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pw_swap.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pw_swap
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pw_swap.header:
theorem pw_swap (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) :
    pw 1 U y ν μ = (pw 1 U y μ ν)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pw_self.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pw_self
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pw_self.header:
theorem pw_self (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) :
    pw 1 U y ν ν = 1

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.shift_eq_coarse.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.shift_eq_coarse
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.shift_eq_coarse.header: theorem shift_eq_coarse (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : coarseShift y 1 μ = periodicLatticeShift y μ

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.om_anti.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.om_anti
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.om_anti.header:
theorem om_anti {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) :
    S.Om j ⊆ S.Om i

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.cube_index_ge.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.cube_index_ge
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.cube_index_ge.header:
theorem cube_index_ge {ell M f k R : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    {sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {i : ℕ} (hq : IsClassCube ell M f k S sites i)
    {m : ℕ} {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hz : z ∈ sites) (hzm : z ∈ S.Om m) : m ≤ i + 1

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.plaq_small_class.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.plaq_small_class
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.plaq_small_class.header:
theorem plaq_small_class {ell M c k R : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {α₀ η : ℝ} {U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L}
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hη : 0 < η) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hU : ClassCoupled ell M c k S α₀ η U)
    (ha0 : 0 ≤ (c : ℝ) * M * α₀) (ha1 : (c : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ 1)
    {m : ℕ} (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : Ball z 2 ⊆ S.Om m) (ν μ : Fin 3) :
    dv (pw 1 U z ν μ) ≤ (4 * Real.pi + 4) * ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀) / (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ (m - 1))

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.classSmall_exists.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.classSmall_exists
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.classSmall_exists.header: theorem classSmall_exists (ell : ℕ) : ∃ a₀ : ℝ, 0 < a₀ ∧ ∀ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ a₀ → ClassSmall ell a

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pow_ratio_le.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pow_ratio_le
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.pow_ratio_le.header:
theorem pow_ratio_le (ell : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) {l m d : ℕ} (h : l ≤ m + d) :
    ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * (C / ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ m) ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ d * C

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.scaleUp_succ.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.scaleUp_succ
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.scaleUp_succ.header:
theorem scaleUp_succ (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (μ : Fin 3) :
    scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1 = (Lu μ + 1) * ell ^ k

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.scaleUp_dvd.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.scaleUp_dvd
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.scaleUp_dvd.header:
theorem scaleUp_dvd (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {l : ℕ} (hl : l ≤ k) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ell ^ l ∣ scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.scaleUp_big.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.scaleUp_big
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.scaleUp_big.header:
theorem scaleUp_big (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hT : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < Lu μ + 1)
    {l : ℕ} (hl : l ≤ k) (μ : Fin 3) : 2 * ell ^ l < scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.bondsLam_facts.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.bondsLam_facts

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.rhoT_gap.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.rhoT_gap
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.rhoT_gap.header:
theorem rhoT_gap (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (i : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.read_region.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.read_region
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.read_region.header:
theorem read_region {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) {j : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k) (hd : ∀ ρ : Fin 3, ell ^ j ∣ L ρ + 1)
    {b : Bond L} (hb : b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j) {l : ℕ} {e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L} (hr : ReadRow ell j b l e) :

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.classRows_read.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.classRows_read
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.classRows_read.header:
theorem classRows_read {ell M R k c : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} {α₀ : ℝ}
    {U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hT : TorusOK ell M Lu)
    (hU : ClassCoupled ell M c k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U) (hsm : ClassSmall ell ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀))
    {j : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k) {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hb : b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j)
    {l : ℕ} {e : PeriodicLatticeEdge (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hr : ReadRow ell j b l e) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ (qStepComp (ell ^ l) ell (bgTower (geomOf ell k S) U l) e) 0

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.classRows_QlinB.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.classRows_QlinB

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.classRows_read_not.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.classRows_read_not_junk
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.classRows_read_not.header:
theorem classRows_read_not_junk {ell M R k c : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} {α₀ : ℝ}
    {U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hT : TorusOK ell M Lu)

    {j : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k) {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hb : b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j)
    {l : ℕ} {e : PeriodicLatticeEdge (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hr : ReadRow ell j b l e) :
    ¬ ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (qStepComp (ell ^ l) ell (bgTower (geomOf ell k S) U l) e) 0

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.embY_shift.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.embY_shift

AdalyFormal.ClassJets.readRows_genuine_h.name: AdalyFormal.ClassJets.readRows_genuine_headline
AdalyFormal.ClassJets.readRows_genuine_h.header:
theorem readRows_genuine_headline (ell M R c : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) :
    ∃ a₀ : ℝ, 0 < a₀ ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → ∀ (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (α₀ : ℝ), 0 < α₀ → (c : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ a₀ →
        TorusOK ell M Lu → ∀ (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)), Admissible ell M R k S →
        ∀ (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)), LambdaOK2 ell M R k S Lam →
        ∀ (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)), ClassCoupled ell M c k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U →
          (∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → ∀ b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j,
              Genuine ell (bgTower (geomOf ell k S) U) j b ∧
              ∀ l e, ReadRow ell j b l e →
                ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ (qStepComp (ell ^ l) ell (bgTower (geomOf ell k S) U l) e) 0) ∧
          (∀ (hell0 : 0 < ell) (cb : CoarseBond Lu ell), CRowIn ell Lam cb →
              ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ (qStepComp 1 ell (unitBg ell k Lu hell0 (bgTower (geomOf ell k S) U k)) (cb.1.1, cb.2)) 0)

    {U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)}

    (hU : ClassCoupled ell M c k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U) (hsm : ClassSmall ell ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀))
    {j : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k) {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hb : b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j)
    (A : AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantOperators.BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    (WithLp.ofLp (QlinB (geomOf ell k S) U j A)) b
      = (WithLp.ofLp (suCoordInv (fun e => fderiv ℝ (fun a : XS (scaleUp ell k Lu) =>
          qCompX ell (bgTower (geomOf ell k S) U) j a e) 0 (suCoord A)))) b

    {U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)}

HConstruction.Carrier.deltaKForm_variati.name: HConstruction.Carrier.deltaKForm_variational
HConstruction.Carrier.deltaKForm_variati.header:
theorem deltaKForm_variational (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ)
    (D : BalabanCovarianceData (BFL2 L) (CFL2 L ell))
    (bc : AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstantA.BaseConstant) (B : CFL2 L ell) :
    deltaKForm D bc (variationalQext U ell D) (genuineSource U) B =
      (inner ℝ B (D.CompInv B) : ℝ) - AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstantA.usedAt bc 0 *
      (inner ℝ B B : ℝ) - 2 *
      (inner ℝ (solutionOperator D (Dtilde2Shape
        (fun X => nativeQ U ell (solutionOperator D X)) B)) (genuineSource U) : ℝ)

EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.g_neg_block.name: EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.g_neg_block
EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.g_neg_block.header:
theorem g_neg_block (Z : SuTwo) (h : 0 < nu (Z : M2)) :
    gOp (-(adOp Z)) = P Z +
      (Real.sin (nu (Z : M2)) * Real.cos (nu (Z : M2)) / nu (Z : M2)) • Q Z +
      (Real.sin (nu (Z : M2)) ^ 2 / nu (Z : M2)) • J Z

EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.block_mul.name: EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.block_mul
EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.block_mul.header:
theorem block_mul (Z : SuTwo) (h : 0 < nu (Z : M2)) (a b c d : ℝ) :
    (P Z + a • Q Z + b • J Z) * (P Z + c • Q Z + d • J Z) =
      P Z + (a * c - b * d) • Q Z + (a * d + b * c) • J Z

EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.inverseBlock_s.name: EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.inverseBlock_spec
EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.inverseBlock_s.header:
theorem inverseBlock_spec (Z : SuTwo) (h : 0 < nu (Z : M2))
    (hs : Real.sin (nu (Z : M2)) ≠ 0) :
    gOp (-(adOp Z)) * inverseBlock Z = 1 ∧ inverseBlock Z * gOp (-(adOp Z)) = 1

EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.gInv_neg_block.header:

theorem guarded_inverse_conjugacy (e : E ≃ₗ[ℝ] F) (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) (B : F →ₗ[ℝ] F)

CompactDictionary.symmetric_conjugacy.name: CompactDictionary.symmetric_conjugacy

    (hA : ∀ x y, ⟪A x, y⟫ = ⟪x, A y⟫)
    (hB : ∀ x y, ⟪B x, y⟫ = ⟪x, B y⟫)

    [S.HasOrthogonalProjection] [T.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (h : ∀ x, e x ∈ T ↔ x ∈ S) (x : E) :
    e (S.starProjection x) = T.starProjection (e x)

HConstruction.G0Final.compressed_schur_e.name: HConstruction.G0Final.compressed_schur_energy
HConstruction.G0Final.compressed_schur_e.header:
theorem compressed_schur_energy
    (A : E →L[ℝ] E) (V K : F →L[ℝ] E) (C J : F →L[ℝ] F)
    (hA : ∀ x y, (inner ℝ (A x) y : ℝ) = inner ℝ x (A y))
    (hVK : ∀ z, V.adjoint (K z) = z)
    (hAK : ∀ z, A (K z) = V (C z)) (x : E) :
    (inner ℝ x ((A + V.comp (J.comp V.adjoint)) x) : ℝ) =
      inner ℝ (x - K (V.adjoint x)) (A (x - K (V.adjoint x))) +
        inner ℝ (V.adjoint x) ((C + J) (V.adjoint x))

HConstruction.G0Final.strict_of_compress.name: HConstruction.G0Final.strict_of_compressed_schur
HConstruction.G0Final.strict_of_compress.header:
theorem strict_of_compressed_schur
    (A : E →L[ℝ] E) (V K : F →L[ℝ] E) (C J : F →L[ℝ] F)
    (hA : ∀ x y, (inner ℝ (A x) y : ℝ) = inner ℝ x (A y))
    (hVK : ∀ z, V.adjoint (K z) = z)
    (hAK : ∀ z, A (K z) = V (C z))
    (hpos : ∀ x : E, x ≠ 0 → (0 : ℝ) < inner ℝ x (A x))
    (hschur : ∀ z : F, z ≠ 0 → (0 : ℝ) < inner ℝ z ((C + J) z)) :
    ∀ x : E, x ≠ 0 →
      (0 : ℝ) < inner ℝ x ((A + V.comp (J.comp V.adjoint)) x)

HConstruction.G0Final.schur_lift_identit.name: HConstruction.G0Final.schur_lift_identities
HConstruction.G0Final.schur_lift_identit.header:
theorem schur_lift_identities
    (A G : E →L[ℝ] E) (V : F →L[ℝ] E) (C : F →L[ℝ] F)
    (hAG : ∀ x, A (G x) = x)
    (hGC : ∀ z, V.adjoint (G (V (C z))) = z) :
    (∀ z, V.adjoint ((G.comp (V.comp C)) z) = z) ∧
      (∀ z, A ((G.comp (V.comp C)) z) = V (C z))

HConstruction.G0Final.chosen_G0_of_compr.name: HConstruction.G0Final.chosen_G0_of_compressed_schur
HConstruction.G0Final.chosen_G0_of_compr.header:
theorem chosen_G0_of_compressed_schur
    (A : HConstruction.Covariance.H →L[ℝ] HConstruction.Covariance.H)
    (V K : F →L[ℝ] HConstruction.Covariance.H) (C J : F →L[ℝ] F)
    (hsource : HConstruction.SmallNF.chosenPrecision = A + V.comp (J.comp V.adjoint))
    (hA : ∀ x y, (inner ℝ (A x) y : ℝ) = inner ℝ x (A y))
    (hVK : ∀ z, V.adjoint (K z) = z)
    (hAK : ∀ z, A (K z) = V (C z))
    (hpos : ∀ x, x ≠ 0 → (0 : ℝ) < inner ℝ x (A x))
    (hschur : ∀ z, z ≠ 0 → (0 : ℝ) < inner ℝ z ((C + J) z)) :
    HConstruction.SmallNF.HasPhysicalG0 HConstruction.SmallNF.chosenU 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.cZero_a.header:
theorem cZero_axialGauge {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.inner_c.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.inner_c.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.inner_c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.inner_cdcOp_eq_deltaKQuadForm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.inner_c.header:
theorem inner_cdcOp_eq_deltaKQuadForm

    (hT2 : ∀ A : Bond L → SuTwo, (inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 A : BondFnL2 L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.inner_c.header:
theorem inner_cdcOp_symm (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.inner_c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.inner_cdcOp_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.inner_c.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.cdcOp_p.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.cdcOp_posDef_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.cdcOp_p.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.printed.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.printed_3_157
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.printed.header:
theorem printed_3_157 (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.range_p.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.cdcCLM_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.cdcCLM_apply
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.cdcCLM_.header:
theorem cdcCLM_apply (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.coerciv.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.coercivity_of_constructed_cdc
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.coerciv.header:
theorem coercivity_of_constructed_cdc
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (ell : ℕ) (Dinv : CoarseBond L ell → (SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo))
    (T2 : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L)
    (Ainv : TildeFn L ell →L[ℝ] TildeFn L ell)
    (hinv : ∀ w : TildeFn L ell, Ainv (cdcOp U ell Dinv T2 w) = w)
    (hsa : ∀ x y : TildeFn L ell, (inner ℝ (Ainv x) y : ℝ) = inner ℝ x (Ainv y))
    (hpos : ∀ x : TildeFn L ell, (0 : ℝ) ≤ inner ℝ x (Ainv x))
    (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hform : ∀ x : TildeFn L ell, (inner ℝ x (Ainv x) : ℝ) ≤ γ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (v : TildeFn L ell) :
    (1 / γ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ v (cdcOp U ell Dinv T2 v)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.cStarDe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.cStarDeltaKC_not_posDef
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.cStarDe.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.carrier.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.norm_le.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.cdc_clo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.cdc_closing_statement
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.cdc_clo.header:
theorem cdc_closing_statement {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (T2 : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L)
    (Ainv : TildeFn L ell →ₗ[ℝ] TildeFn L ell) :
                                                            
    (∀ (w : TildeFn L ell) (c : CoarseBond L ell),
        lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell
          (fun b => (cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w : BondFnL2 L) b) c = 0)
                                                    
    ∧ (∀ (w : TildeFn L ell) (y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L), y' ∈ CoarseLattice L ell →
        ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y' ell →
        ∀ e ∈ staircasePath y' x, (cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w : BondFnL2 L) e = 0)
                          
    ∧ Function.Injective (cZero U ell (dinvC U ell))
                                                                    
    ∧ (∀ w : TildeFn L ell, (inner ℝ w (cdcOp U ell (dinvC U ell) T2 w) : ℝ)
        = inner ℝ (cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w) (deltaK U T2 (cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w)))
                   
    ∧ (∀ B : BondFnL2 L, propagator U ell (dinvC U ell) Ainv B
        = cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) (Ainv (cZeroStar U ell (dinvC U ell) B)))
                  
    ∧ (∀ w : TildeFn L ell,
        (tildeRes (propagator U ell (dinvC U ell) Ainv (tildeExt w)) : TildeFn L ell) = Ainv w)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.finrank.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.finrank_range_cZero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.ConstructCDC.finrank.header:
theorem finrank_range_cZero
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (ell : ℕ) (Dinv : CoarseBond L ell → (SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo)) :

AdalyFormal.M2Coverage.corner_nonempty.header:
theorem corner_nonempty {M R : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hM2 : 2 ∣ M) (hR : 18 ≤ R) :
    ∃ Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent, TorusOK 2 M Lu ∧
    ∃ S : Tower (scaleUp 2 1 Lu), Admissible 2 M R 1 S ∧ CoversOm0p 2 M 12 1 S ∧
    ∃ Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu), LambdaOK2 (Lf := scaleUp 2 1 Lu) 2 M R 1 S Lam ∧
      (LamPrime 2 Lam).Nonempty ∧
    ∃ x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp 2 1 Lu), x ∈ S.Om 0 ∧
      ∀ (x' : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp 2 1 Lu)) (μ : Fin 3), (x' μ).val = (x μ).val →
        (∀ ν, ν ≠ μ → (x' ν).val = (x ν).val ∨ (x' ν).val = (x ν).val + 1) →
        ¬ ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp 2 1 Lu))) (i : ℕ), IsClassCube 2 M 12 1 S sites i ∧
          ∀ ν : Fin 3, ν ≠ μ → CurlReads sites (periodicLatticeShiftBack x' ν) ν μ ∧ CurlReads sites x' ν μ
