AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeActA_smu.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeActA_smul
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeActA_smu.header:
theorem gaugeActA_smul (γ : GaugeFn L) (c : ℝ) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    gaugeActA γ (c • A) = c • gaugeActA γ A

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeActA_com.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeActA_comp
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeActA_com.header:
theorem gaugeActA_comp (γ δ : GaugeFn L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    gaugeActA γ (gaugeActA δ A) = gaugeActA (gaugeMul γ δ) A

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeActA_one.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeActA_one
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeActA_one.header: theorem gaugeActA_one (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : gaugeActA (fun _ => (1 : SU2)) A = A

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeActA_inv.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeActA_inv_left
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeActA_inv.header:
theorem gaugeActA_inv_left (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    gaugeActA (gaugeInv γ) (gaugeActA γ A) = A

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeActA_inv.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeActA_inv_right
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeActA_inv.header:
theorem gaugeActA_inv_right (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    gaugeActA γ (gaugeActA (gaugeInv γ) A) = A

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2.header: noncomputable def gaugeL2 (γ : GaugeFn L) : BondFnL2 L ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_ofLp.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_ofLp
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_ofLp.header:
theorem gaugeL2_ofLp (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : BondFnL2 L) (b : Bond L) :
    WithLp.ofLp (gaugeL2 γ A) b = RMap (γ b.1) (WithLp.ofLp A b)

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_toLp.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_toLp
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_toLp.header:
theorem gaugeL2_toLp (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    gaugeL2 γ (WithLp.toLp 2 A) = WithLp.toLp 2 (gaugeActA γ A)

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.norm_gaugeL2.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.norm_gaugeL2
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.norm_gaugeL2.header: theorem norm_gaugeL2 (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : BondFnL2 L) : ‖gaugeL2 γ A‖ = ‖A‖

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_symm_.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_symm_apply
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_symm_.header:
theorem gaugeL2_symm_apply (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    (gaugeL2 γ).symm A = WithLp.toLp 2 (gaugeActA (gaugeInv γ) (WithLp.ofLp A))

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_symm_.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_symm_gaugeL2
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_symm_.header:
theorem gaugeL2_symm_gaugeL2 (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    (gaugeL2 γ).symm (gaugeL2 γ A) = A

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_gaugeL2_symm
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_gauge.header:
theorem gaugeL2_gaugeL2_symm (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    gaugeL2 γ ((gaugeL2 γ).symm A) = A

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.inner_gaugeL2.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.inner_gaugeL2
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.inner_gaugeL2.header:
theorem inner_gaugeL2 (γ : GaugeFn L) (A B : BondFnL2 L) :
    (inner ℝ (gaugeL2 γ A) (gaugeL2 γ B) : ℝ) = inner ℝ A B

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.norm_curl_gau.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.norm_curl_gaugeL2
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.norm_curl_gau.header:
theorem norm_curl_gaugeL2 (γ : GaugeFn L)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (gaugeL2 γ A)‖
      = ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 U A‖

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_no_bl.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_no_block_hypothesis
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2_no_bl.header:
theorem gaugeL2_no_block_hypothesis (γ : GaugeFn L) (ell : ℕ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    ‖gaugeL2 γ A‖ = ‖A‖ ∧
      ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (gaugeL2 γ A)‖
        = ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 U A‖ ∧
      (∀ b, WithLp.ofLp (qCLM (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) ell (gaugeL2 γ A)) b
        = RMap (γ b.1.1) (WithLp.ofLp (qCLM U ell A) b))

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.coarseGauge.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.coarseGauge
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.coarseGauge.header: def coarseGauge {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L') (γ : GaugeFn L) : GaugeFn L'

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.composedQ_gau.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.composedQ_gauge
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.composedQ_gau.header:
theorem composedQ_gauge {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L') (γ : GaugeFn L)
    (Ufine : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    composedQ h (periodicGaugeTransform γ Ufine) (gaugeL2 γ A)
      = gaugeL2 (coarseGauge h γ) (composedQ h Ufine A)

AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.norm_composed.name: AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.norm_composedQ_gauge
AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.norm_composed.header:
theorem norm_composedQ_gauge {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L') (γ : GaugeFn L)
    (Ufine : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    ‖composedQ h (periodicGaugeTransform γ Ufine) (gaugeL2 γ A)‖
      = ‖composedQ h Ufine A‖

AdalyFormal.M2Coverage.fnu_in_cube.name: AdalyFormal.M2Coverage.fnu_in_cube
AdalyFormal.M2Coverage.fnu_in_cube.header:
theorem fnu_in_cube {ell M c k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {α₀ η : ℝ} {U : LinkCfg L} (hη : 0 < η) (hell : 1 ≤ ell)
    (hU : PerCubeRegular2 ell M c k S α₀ η U) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀) (hsm : 4 * ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀) ≤ 1)
    {sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {i : ℕ} (hq : IsClassCube ell M c k S sites i)
    (ν μ : Fin 3) (hνμ : ν ≠ μ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (b1 : CubeBond sites (y, ν)) (b2 : CubeBond sites (periodicLatticeShift y ν, μ))
    (b3 : CubeBond sites (periodicLatticeShift y μ, ν)) (b4 : CubeBond sites (y, μ)) :
    ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ,
      frobNorm (FnuMu (periodicGaugeTransform g U) ν μ y)
        ≤ (2 * ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀) + 6 * ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀) ^ 2 + 1024 * ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀) ^ 3) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * i))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.M2Coverage.cube_index_ge.name: AdalyFormal.M2Coverage.cube_index_ge
AdalyFormal.M2Coverage.cube_index_ge.header:
theorem cube_index_ge {ell M R c k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    {sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {i : ℕ} (hq : IsClassCube ell M c k S sites i)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ sites) {j : ℕ} (hj : x ∈ towerBj S j) : j ≤ i + 1

AdalyFormal.M2Coverage.fnuLoc_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M2Coverage.fnuLoc_strat
AdalyFormal.M2Coverage.fnuLoc_strat.header:
theorem fnuLoc_strat {ell M R c k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {α₀ η : ℝ} {U : LinkCfg L} (hη : 0 < η) (hell : 1 ≤ ell)
    (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hU : ClassCoupled ell M c k S α₀ η U) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀)
    (hsm : 4 * ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀) ≤ 1) (ν μ : Fin 3) (hνμ : ν ≠ μ) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : x ∈ towerBj S j)
    (hxp : ∀ (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L), (∀ e : Bond L, (e = (y, ν) ∨ e = (periodicLatticeShift y ν, μ) ∨
        e = (periodicLatticeShift y μ, ν) ∨ e = (y, μ)) → e ∈ periodicPlaquetteBoundaryEdges p) →
      ∀ sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L), (∀ e ∈ periodicPlaquetteBoundaryEdges p, CubeBond sites e) → x ∈ sites) :
    frobNorm (AdalyFormal.IngredientFamily.FnuMuLoc (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) U ν μ y)
      ≤ (2 * ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀) + 6 * ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀) ^ 2 + 1024 * ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀) ^ 3) * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2
        * ((ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * j))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.M2Coverage.Jf_class_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M2Coverage.Jf_class_strat
AdalyFormal.M2Coverage.Jf_class_strat.header:
theorem Jf_class_strat {ell M R c k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 0 < ell)
    {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} {α₀ : ℝ} {U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (hU : ClassCoupled ell M c k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀) (hsm : 4 * ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀) ≤ 1)
    (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)) {j : ℕ} (hj : b.1 ∈ towerBj S j) :
    ‖(gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).Jf b‖
      ≤ 4 * ((2 * ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀) + 6 * ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀) ^ 2 + 1024 * ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀) ^ 3) * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2
        * ((ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * j))⁻¹)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.coarseQEnergyCov
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.coa.header:
noncomputable def coarseQEnergyCov
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.cur.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.curlEnergyCov
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.cur.header:
noncomputable def curlEnergyCov
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.SuA.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.SuAdmissible
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.SuA.header: def SuAdmissible (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.nor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.normSq_eq_hsInner
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.nor.header: theorem normSq_eq_hsInner (X : SuTwo) : ‖X‖ ^ 2 = hsInner X X

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.bon.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.bondEnergy_eq_sum_comp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.bon.header:
theorem bondEnergy_eq_sum_comp (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    bondEnergy A = ∑ i : Fin 3, bondNormSq (suComp i A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.cur.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.curlEnergyCov_trivialU_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.cur.header:
theorem curlEnergyCov_trivialU_eq_sum (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    curlEnergyCov (trivialU L) A = ∑ i : Fin 3, totalCurlEnergy (suComp i A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.coarseQEnergyCov_trivialU_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.coa.header:
theorem coarseQEnergyCov_trivialU_eq_sum (ell : ℕ) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    coarseQEnergyCov (trivialU L) ell A = ∑ i : Fin 3, coarseQEnergy ell (suComp i A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.suT.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.suTwo_lemma24_flat
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.suT.header:
theorem suTwo_lemma24_flat {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (hadm : SuAdmissible L ell A) :
    (1 / 180) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) * bondEnergy A
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergyCov (trivialU L) ell A + curlEnergyCov (trivialU L) A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.tra.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.transfer_abstract
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.tra.header:
theorem transfer_abstract {t gam Qf Pf Qc Pc N dQ dP : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hfloor : gam * N ≤ t * Qf + Pf)
    (hQ : Qf ≤ 2 * Qc + 2 * dQ) (hP : Pf ≤ 2 * Pc + 2 * dP) :
    (gam / 2) * N - (t * dQ + dP) ≤ t * Qc + Pc

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.sq_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.sq_le_two_add_two
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.sq_.header:
theorem sq_le_two_add_two {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (u v : E) :
    ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖u - v‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.coarse_drift_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.coa.header:
theorem coarse_drift_le
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {ell : ℕ}
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    (∑ c : CoarseBond L ell,
        ‖lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell A c - lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell A c‖ ^ 2)
      ≤ (64 / (ell : ℝ)) * frobSupBond U ^ 2 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.cur.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.curl_drift_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.cur.header:
theorem curl_drift_le
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    plaqEnergy (curlDrift U A) ≤ 32 * frobSupBond U ^ 2 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.coarseQ_flat_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.coa.header:
theorem coarseQ_flat_le
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {ell : ℕ}
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    coarseQEnergyCov (trivialU L) ell A
      ≤ 2 * coarseQEnergyCov U ell A + 2 * ((64 / (ell : ℝ)) * frobSupBond U ^ 2 * bondEnergy A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.cur.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.curl_flat_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.cur.header:
theorem curl_flat_le
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    curlEnergyCov (trivialU L) A
      ≤ 2 * curlEnergyCov U A + 2 * (32 * frobSupBond U ^ 2 * bondEnergy A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.cov.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.covariant_lemma24
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.cov.header:
theorem covariant_lemma24 {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (hadm : SuAdmissible L ell A) :
    ((1 / 360) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) - 96 * frobSupBond U ^ 2) * bondEnergy A
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergyCov U ell A + curlEnergyCov U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.cov.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.covariant_floor_pos_iff
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.cov.header:
theorem covariant_floor_pos_iff {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (al : ℝ) :
    0 < (1 / 360) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) - 96 * al ^ 2
      ↔ 34560 * al ^ 2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 5 < 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.thr.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.threshold_of_alpha_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.thr.header:
theorem threshold_of_alpha_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {al : ℝ} (hal0 : 0 ≤ al)
    (hal : al ≤ 1 / (186 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3)) :
    34560 * al ^ 2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 5 < 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.cov.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.covariant_lemma24_positive
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantLemma24.cov.header:
theorem covariant_lemma24_positive {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hthr : frobSupBond U ≤ 1 / (186 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (hadm : SuAdmissible L ell A) :
    0 < (1 / 360) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) - 96 * frobSupBond U ^ 2
    ∧ ((1 / 360) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) - 96 * frobSupBond U ^ 2) * bondEnergy A
        ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergyCov U ell A + curlEnergyCov U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.RMa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.RMap_negOneElem_inv
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.RMa.header: theorem RMap_negOneElem_inv : RMap negOneElem⁻¹ = (LinearMap.id : SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.RMa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.RMap_periodicPathHolonomy_negOneU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.RMa.header:
theorem RMap_periodicPathHolonomy_negOneU :
    ∀ (p : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
      RMap (periodicPathHolonomy (negOneU L) x p) = (LinearMap.id : SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo)
  | [], x => by
      show RMap (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) = _
      exact RMap_one
  | step :: rest, x => by
      have ih

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.rZe.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.rZeroA_negOneU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.rZe.header:
theorem rZeroA_negOneU (cMinus x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3)
    (ell : ℕ) :
    rZeroA (negOneU L) cMinus x A μ ell = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, A (pathSite x μ i, μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.lin.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.lineCoarseRestrictCov_negOneU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.lin.header:
theorem lineCoarseRestrictCov_negOneU (ell : ℕ) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L ell) :
    lineCoarseRestrictCov (negOneU L) ell A b = lineCoarseRestrictCov (trivialU L) ell A b

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.coa.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.coarseQEnergyCov_negOneU
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.coa.header:
theorem coarseQEnergyCov_negOneU (ell : ℕ) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    coarseQEnergyCov (negOneU L) ell A = coarseQEnergyCov (trivialU L) ell A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.cov.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.covariant_lemma24_at_center
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.cov.header:
theorem covariant_lemma24_at_center {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (hadm : SuAdmissible L ell A) :
    (1 / 180) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) * bondEnergy A
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergyCov (negOneU L) ell A + curlEnergyCov (negOneU L) A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.cen.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.center_outside_certified_class
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Center.cen.header:
theorem center_outside_certified_class {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (hadm : SuAdmissible L ell A) :
    ¬ (frobSupBond (negOneU L) ≤ 1 / (186 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))
    ∧ (1 / 360) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) - 96 * frobSupBond (negOneU L) ^ 2 < 0
    ∧ (1 / 180) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) * bondEnergy A
        ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergyCov (negOneU L) ell A + curlEnergyCov (negOneU L) A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Sharp.sq_l.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Sharp.sq_le_young
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Sharp.sq_l.header:
theorem sq_le_young {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (u v : E) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + eps) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 + (1 + 1 / eps) * ‖u - v‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Sharp.tran.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Sharp.transfer_abstract_young
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Sharp.tran.header:
theorem transfer_abstract_young {t gam Qf Pf Qc Pc N dQ dP eps : ℝ}

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Sharp.coar.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Sharp.coarseQ_flat_le_young
AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Sharp.coar.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovLemma24Sharp.cova.header:

    (γ : GaugeFn L) (hγcoarse : coarseGauge h γ = fun _ => (1 : SU2))
    (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell₀) (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell₀ < L' ν + 1)
    (hdvd0 : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell₀ ∣ (L' ν + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L')
    (hsmallU : frobSupBond U ≤ 1 / (13336 * (ell₀ : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (bc : BaseConstant) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hsmallFineGauged : ‖solutionOperator (feedDatumGen h Ufine heps (le_of_lt bc.a_pos))‖
      * rawErrorCoeff ell (periodicGaugeTransform γ Ufine) ≤ 1 / (2356 * (ell₀ : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (Qext : BondFnL2 L' → BondFnL2 L') (T : BondFnL2 L' →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L)
    (S : BondFnL2 L' →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L')
    (hS : IsSourceOperator (feedDatumGen h Ufine heps (le_of_lt bc.a_pos)) Qext (T (JsuTwo U)) S)
    (c₂ : ℝ) (hc₂ : 0 < c₂)
    (hD2 : ∀ B : BondFnL2 L', ‖Dtilde2Shape Qext B‖ ≤ c₂ * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hU : LinkDev δ U)
    (hH1 : 0 < ‖solutionOperator (feedDatumGen h Ufine heps (le_of_lt bc.a_pos))‖) (hT : 0 < ‖T‖)
    (hcard : 0 < Fintype.card (Bond L'))
    (hδ : δ < 1 / (1370001600 * (ell₀ : ℝ) ^ 6 * (rawSigmaZero ell) ^ 2
      * ‖solutionOperator (feedDatumGen h Ufine heps (le_of_lt bc.a_pos))‖ * c₂
      * (‖T‖ * Real.sqrt (2 * (Fintype.card (Bond L'))))))
    (w : TildeFn L' ell₀) (hw : w ≠ 0) :

    (D : AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.BalabanCovarianceData
          (BondFnL2 witnessL) (BondFnL2 witnessL))
    (bc : BaseConstant) (d : BondFnL2 witnessL →L[ℝ] P₁) (pen : BondFnL2 witnessL →L[ℝ] P₃)

      ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 (spikeU (torus t)) (D.Q A)‖ ≤ σ₀ * ‖d A‖ + κ * ‖D.Q A‖)

      0 < sourceTerm (assemblyDatum (spikeU (torus t)) ha)
          (bondQext (JsuTwo (spikeU (torus t)))) (JsuTwo (spikeU (torus t)))
          (cZero (spikeU (torus t)) 2 (dinvC (spikeU (torus t)) 2) w) ∧
      0 < cdcFormTrue (assemblyDatum (spikeU (torus t)) ha) bc
          (bondQext (JsuTwo (spikeU (torus t)))) (JsuTwo (spikeU (torus t)))
          (spikeU (torus t)) 2 (dinvC (spikeU (torus t)) 2) w

AdalyFormal.CurvedFine.curvedFineDatum_f.name: AdalyFormal.CurvedFine.curvedFineDatum_form_on_kernel
AdalyFormal.CurvedFine.curvedFineDatum_f.header:

AdalyFormal.CurvedFine.curvedFineDatum_e.name: AdalyFormal.CurvedFine.curvedFineDatum_equivariance
AdalyFormal.CurvedFine.curvedFineDatum_e.header:
theorem curvedFineDatum_equivariance (bc : BaseConstant) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (t : ℝ)
    (γ : GaugeFn fineL) (A : BondFnL2 fineL) (B : BondFnL2 witnessL) :
    (feedDatumGen starScale (periodicGaugeTransform γ (UfineStar t)) heps
        (le_of_lt bc.a_pos)).Ginv (AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2 γ A)
        = AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2 γ ((curvedFineDatum bc heps t).Ginv A)
      ∧ (feedDatumGen starScale (periodicGaugeTransform γ (UfineStar t)) heps
          (le_of_lt bc.a_pos)).Q (AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2 γ A)
        = AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2 (AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.coarseGauge starScale γ)
            ((curvedFineDatum bc heps t).Q A)
      ∧ solutionOperator (feedDatumGen starScale (periodicGaugeTransform γ (UfineStar t)) heps
          (le_of_lt bc.a_pos))
          (AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2 (AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.coarseGauge starScale γ) B)
        = AdalyFormal.CovariantDatum.gaugeL2 γ (solutionOperator (curvedFineDatum bc heps t) B)
      ∧ ‖solutionOperator (feedDatumGen starScale (periodicGaugeTransform γ (UfineStar t)) heps
          (le_of_lt bc.a_pos))‖ = ‖solutionOperator (curvedFineDatum bc heps t)‖

AdalyFormal.CurvedFine.terminal_posDef_a.header:
theorem terminal_posDef_at_curved_fine_datum (bc : BaseConstant) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps)

AdalyFormal.CurvedFine.exists_curved_bot.header:
theorem exists_curved_both_scales_instance (bc : BaseConstant) :
    ∃ (t eps tc : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps),
      0 < t ∧ t < Real.pi ∧ 0 < tc ∧ tc ≤ 1
      ∧ holonomyElem (UfineStar t) finePlaquette ≠ 1
      ∧ 0 < frobSupBond (UfineStar t)
      ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < rawErrorCoeff 2
          (periodicGaugeTransform (gluedGauge fSlab (fGauge s)) (UfineStar t)))
      ∧ holonomyElem (AdalyFormal.Balaban.CurvedContent.spikeU (torus tc))
          AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantOperators.witnessPlaquette ≠ 1
      ∧ ¬ Function.Injective (curvedFineDatum bc heps t).Q
      ∧ (∀ w : TildeFn witnessL 2, w ≠ 0 →
          0 < cdcFormTrue (curvedFineDatum bc heps t) bc
              (bondQext (JsuTwo (AdalyFormal.Balaban.CurvedContent.spikeU (torus tc))))
              ((curvedFineDatum bc heps t).Qstar
                (JsuTwo (AdalyFormal.Balaban.CurvedContent.spikeU (torus tc))))
              (AdalyFormal.Balaban.CurvedContent.spikeU (torus tc)) 2
              (dinvC (AdalyFormal.Balaban.CurvedContent.spikeU (torus tc)) 2) w)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BlockSum.header: def BlockSum (L : ℕ) (e : ℤ → ℝ) (b : ℤ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.stE.header: noncomputable def stE (L : ℕ) (e : ℤ → ℝ) (b : ℤ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.stF.header: noncomputable def stF (L : ℕ) (e : ℤ → ℝ) (b : ℤ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.block_closed.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.block_closed
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.block_closed.header:
theorem block_closed {L : ℕ} {e : ℤ → ℝ} {b : ℤ} {m : ℝ} (h : BlockEL L e b m) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ L →
      e (b * L + j) = stE L e b + j * stF L e b - m * (j * (j + 1) / 2) ∧
      e (b * L + j) - e (b * L + j - 1) = stF L e b - j * m

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.sum_range_id.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.sum_range_id
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.sum_range_id.header: theorem sum_range_id (n : ℕ) : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (j : ℝ) = n * (n - 1) / 2

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.sum_range_jj.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.sum_range_jj
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.sum_range_jj.header: theorem sum_range_jj (n : ℕ) : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (j : ℝ) * (j + 1) = (n - 1) * n * (n + 1) / 3

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.block_sum_eq.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.block_sum_eq
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.block_sum_eq.header:
theorem block_sum_eq {L : ℕ} {e : ℤ → ℝ} {b : ℤ} {m : ℝ} (h : BlockEL L e b m) (hs : BlockSum L e b) :
    (L : ℝ) * stE L e b + stF L e b * ((L : ℝ) * ((L : ℝ) - 1) / 2) - m * (((L : ℝ) - 1) * L * (L + 1) / 6) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.block_step.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.block_step
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.block_step.header:
theorem block_step {L : ℕ} {e : ℤ → ℝ} {b : ℤ} {m : ℝ} (h : BlockEL L e b m) :
    stE L e (b + 1) = stE L e b + L * stF L e b - m * ((L : ℝ) * (L + 1) / 2) ∧
    stF L e (b + 1) = stF L e b - L * m

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.mult_formula.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.mult_formula
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.mult_formula.header:
theorem mult_formula {L : ℕ} (hL : 2 ≤ L) {e : ℤ → ℝ} {b : ℤ} {m : ℝ} (h : BlockEL L e b m) (hs : BlockSum L e b) :
    m * (((L : ℝ) - 1) * ((L : ℝ) + 1)) = 6 * (stE L e b + stF L e b * (((L : ℝ) - 1) / 2))

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.seq_two_zeros.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.fat_two_zero.header:
theorem fat_two_zero {L : ℕ} (hL : 2 ≤ L) (e : ℤ → ℝ) (m : ℤ → ℝ) (b0 : ℤ) (N : ℕ)
    (hEL : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N → BlockEL L e (b0 + k) (m (b0 + k)))
    (hS : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N → BlockSum L e (b0 + k))
    (i j : ℕ) (hij : i < j) (hjN : j ≤ N) (hi : m (b0 + i) = 0) (hj : m (b0 + j) = 0) :
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N → m (b0 + k) = 0) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k < N → stE L e (b0 + k) = 0 ∧ stF L e (b0 + k) = 0 ∧ ∀ x : ℕ, x < L → e ((b0 + k) * L + x) = 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BlockELs.header: def BlockELs (s : ℤ) (L : ℕ) (e : ℤ → ℝ) (m : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BlockSums.header: def BlockSums (s : ℤ) (L : ℕ) (e : ℤ → ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.sumR_jj.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.sumR_jj
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.sumR_jj.header: theorem sumR_jj (n : ℕ) : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (j : ℝ) * (j + 1) = ((n : ℝ) - 1) * n * (n + 1) / 3

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_closed.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_closed
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_closed.header:
theorem blocks_closed {s : ℤ} {L : ℕ} {e : ℤ → ℝ} {m : ℝ} (h : BlockELs s L e m) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ L →
      e (s + j) = e s + j * (e s - e (s - 1)) - m * (j * (j + 1) / 2) ∧
      e (s + j) - e (s + j - 1) = (e s - e (s - 1)) - j * m

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_sum_eq.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_sum_eq
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_sum_eq.header:
theorem blocks_sum_eq {s : ℤ} {L : ℕ} {e : ℤ → ℝ} {m : ℝ} (h : BlockELs s L e m) (hs : BlockSums s L e) :
    (L : ℝ) * e s + (e s - e (s - 1)) * ((L : ℝ) * ((L : ℝ) - 1) / 2) - m * (((L : ℝ) - 1) * L * (L + 1) / 6) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_step.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_step
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_step.header:
theorem blocks_step {s : ℤ} {L : ℕ} {e : ℤ → ℝ} {m : ℝ} (h : BlockELs s L e m) :
    e (s + L) = e s + L * (e s - e (s - 1)) - m * ((L : ℝ) * (L + 1) / 2) ∧
    e (s + L) - e (s + L - 1) = (e s - e (s - 1)) - L * m

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_mult.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_mult
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_mult.header:
theorem blocks_mult {s : ℤ} {L : ℕ} (hL : 2 ≤ L) {e : ℤ → ℝ} {m : ℝ} (h : BlockELs s L e m) (hs : BlockSums s L e) :
    m * (((L : ℝ) - 1) * ((L : ℝ) + 1)) = 6 * (e s + (e s - e (s - 1)) * (((L : ℝ) - 1) / 2))

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_back_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_back_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_back_zero.header:
theorem blocks_back_zero {s : ℤ} {L : ℕ} (hL : 2 ≤ L) {e : ℤ → ℝ} {m : ℝ} (h : BlockELs s L e m) (hs : BlockSums s L e)
    (hE : e (s + L) = 0) (hF : e (s + L) - e (s + L - 1) = 0) :
    m = 0 ∧ e s = 0 ∧ e s - e (s - 1) = 0 ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ L → e (s + j) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_fwd_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_fwd_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.blocks_fwd_zero.header:
theorem blocks_fwd_zero {s : ℤ} {L : ℕ} (hL : 2 ≤ L) {e : ℤ → ℝ} {m : ℝ} (h : BlockELs s L e m) (hs : BlockSums s L e)
    (hE : e s = 0) (hF : e s - e (s - 1) = 0) :

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.layerRow_closed.header:
theorem layerRow_closed {s : ℤ} {L : ℕ} (hL : 3 ≤ L) {e : ℤ → ℝ} {m : ℝ}

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.layerRow_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.layerRow_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.layerRow_zero.header:
theorem layerRow_zero {s : ℤ} {L : ℕ} (hL : 3 ≤ L) {e : ℤ → ℝ} {m c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.chain_back_prop.header:
theorem chain_back_prop (e : ℤ → ℝ) (st : ℕ → ℤ) (ln : ℕ → ℕ) (K : ℕ)
    (hback : ∀ i, i < K → StateZero e (st (i + 1)) →

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.chain_fwd_prop.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.chain_fwd_prop
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.chain_fwd_prop.header:
theorem chain_fwd_prop (e : ℤ → ℝ) (st : ℕ → ℤ) (ln : ℕ → ℕ) (K R : ℕ)

      ∀ i : ℕ, K ≤ i → i < K + d → ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ ln i → e (st i + j) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.aF_smul.header: theorem aF_smul (r : ℝ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) : aF (r • e) = r ^ 2 * aF e

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.bF_smul.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.bF_smul
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.bF_smul.header: theorem bF_smul (C : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) : bF C (r • e) = r ^ 2 * bF C e

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.bF_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.bF_nonneg
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.bF_nonneg.header: theorem bF_nonneg (C : ℕ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) : 0 ≤ bF C e

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.Vsub.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.Vsub
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.Vsub.header: def Vsub (rowOf : ℕ → ℕ) : Submodule ℝ (Fin n → ℝ)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.mem_Vsub.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.mem_Vsub
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.mem_Vsub.header: theorem mem_Vsub {rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} {e : Fin n → ℝ} : e ∈ Vsub rowOf ↔ ∀ r : ℕ, ∑ x ∈ (univ.filter (fun x : Fin n => rowOf x.val = r)), e x = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.aF_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.aF_nonneg
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.aF_nonneg.header: theorem aF_nonneg (e : Fin n → ℝ) : 0 ≤ aF e

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.ex_zero_of_const.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.ex_zero_of_const
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.ex_zero_of_const.header: theorem ex_zero_of_const (e : Fin n → ℝ) (h : aF e = 0) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < n) : ex e k = ex e 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.aF_pos.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.aF_pos
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.aF_pos.header: theorem aF_pos (rowOf : ℕ → ℕ) {e : Fin n → ℝ} (he : e ∈ Vsub rowOf) (hne : e ≠ 0) : 0 < aF e

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BF.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BF
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BF.header: def BF (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e f : Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.qF_add.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.qF_add
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.qF_add.header: theorem qF_add (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e f : Fin n → ℝ) : qF C c (e + f) = qF C c e + 2 * BF C c e f + qF C c f

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BF_smul_right.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BF_smul_right
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BF_smul_right.header: theorem BF_smul_right (C : ℕ) (c t : ℝ) (e f : Fin n → ℝ) : BF C c e (t • f) = t * BF C c e f

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BF_add_right.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BF_add_right
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BF_add_right.header: theorem BF_add_right (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e f g : Fin n → ℝ) : BF C c e (f + g) = BF C c e f + BF C c e g

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.qF_smul.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.qF_smul
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.qF_smul.header: theorem qF_smul (C : ℕ) (c t : ℝ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) : qF C c (t • e) = t ^ 2 * qF C c e

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.quad_neg_exists.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.quad_neg_exists
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.quad_neg_exists.header: theorem quad_neg_exists (B Q : ℝ) (hB : B ≠ 0) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) : ∃ t : ℝ, 2 * t * B + t ^ 2 * Q < 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.radical_of_psd.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.radical_of_psd
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.radical_of_psd.header:
theorem radical_of_psd (rowOf : ℕ → ℕ) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (es : Fin n → ℝ) (hes : es ∈ Vsub rowOf)
    (hpsd : ∀ e : Fin n → ℝ, e ∈ Vsub rowOf → 0 ≤ qF C c e) (h0 : qF C c es = 0) :
    ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF C c es d = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.chain_crossing.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.chain_crossing
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.chain_crossing.header:
theorem chain_crossing (rowOf : ℕ → ℕ) (C : ℕ) (c1 : ℝ) (hc1 : c1 < 1) (e1 : Fin n → ℝ) (he1 : e1 ∈ Vsub rowOf)
    (hneg : qF C c1 e1 < 0) :
    ∃ cs : ℝ, c1 < cs ∧ cs < 1 ∧ (∃ es : Fin n → ℝ, es ∈ Vsub rowOf ∧ es ≠ 0 ∧ qF C cs es = 0) ∧
      (∀ e : Fin n → ℝ, e ∈ Vsub rowOf → 0 ≤ qF C cs e) ∧
      (∀ c : ℝ, cs < c → c ≤ 1 → ∀ e : Fin n → ℝ, e ∈ Vsub rowOf → e ≠ 0 → 0 < qF C c e) ∧
      (∀ es : Fin n → ℝ, es ∈ Vsub rowOf → qF C cs es = 0 → ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF C cs es d = 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.chain_mult_const.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.chain_mult_const
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.chain_mult_const.header:
theorem chain_mult_const (rowOf : ℕ → ℕ) (C : ℕ) (cs : ℝ) (es : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF C cs es d = 0) (x x' : Fin n) (hxx : rowOf x.val = rowOf x'.val) :
    BF C cs es (Pi.single x 1) = BF C cs es (Pi.single x' 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.nx.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.nx
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.nx.header: noncomputable def nx (e : Fin n → ℝ) (x : ℤ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.nx_nat.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.nx_nat
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.nx_nat.header: theorem nx_nat (e : Fin n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < n) : nx e (k : ℤ) = e ⟨k, hk⟩

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.nx_neg_one.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.nx_neg_one
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.nx_neg_one.header: theorem nx_neg_one (e : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) : nx e (-1) = nx e 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.nx_n.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.nx_n
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.nx_n.header: theorem nx_n (e : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) : nx e (n : ℤ) = nx e ((n : ℤ) - 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.Wt.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.Wt
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.Wt.header: noncomputable def Wt (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (y : ℤ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.ex_single.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.ex_single
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.ex_single.header: theorem ex_single (x : Fin n) (z : ℕ) : ex (Pi.single x (1 : ℝ) : Fin n → ℝ) z = if z = x.val then 1 else 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.dlt_single.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.dlt_single
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.dlt_single.header:
theorem dlt_single (x : Fin n) (y : ℕ) :
    dlt (Pi.single x (1 : ℝ) : Fin n → ℝ) y = (if y + 1 = x.val then 1 else 0) - (if y = x.val then 1 else 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.Wt_eq.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.Wt_eq
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.Wt_eq.header:
theorem Wt_eq (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (y : ℕ) :
    Wt C c (y : ℤ) = 1 - (1 - c) * (if y + 1 = C then 1 else 0) - (1 - c) * (if y = C then 1 else 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BF_eq_sum.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BF_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BF_eq_sum.header:
theorem BF_eq_sum (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) (e f : Fin n → ℝ) :
    BF C c e f = ∑ y ∈ range (n - 1), Wt C c (y : ℤ) * (dlt e y * dlt f y)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.dlt_nx.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.dlt_nx
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.dlt_nx.header: theorem dlt_nx (e : Fin n → ℝ) (y : ℕ) (hy : y + 1 < n) : dlt e y = nx e ((y : ℤ) + 1) - nx e (y : ℤ)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.sum_shift.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.sum_shift
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.sum_shift.header:
theorem sum_shift (h : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℕ) (hx : x < n) :
    ∑ y ∈ range (n - 1), (if y + 1 = x then h y else 0) = if 1 ≤ x then h (x - 1) else 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.sum_pt.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.sum_pt
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.sum_pt.header:
theorem sum_pt (h : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℕ) :
    ∑ y ∈ range (n - 1), (if y = x then h y else 0) = if x < n - 1 then h x else 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BF_single.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BF_single
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.BF_single.header:
theorem BF_single (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) (e : Fin n → ℝ) (x : Fin n) :
    BF C c e (Pi.single x 1) =
      Wt C c ((x.val : ℤ) - 1) * (nx e (x.val : ℤ) - nx e ((x.val : ℤ) - 1)) -
        Wt C c (x.val : ℤ) * (nx e ((x.val : ℤ) + 1) - nx e (x.val : ℤ))

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.RowGeom.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.RowGeom
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.RowGeom.header: structure RowGeom (n R : ℕ) (st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.st_mono.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.st_mono
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.st_mono.header: theorem st_mono {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeom n R st ln rowOf) {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) : st i ≤ st j

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.row_lt_n.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.row_lt_n
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.row_lt_n.header:
theorem row_lt_n {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeom n R st ln rowOf) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < R) :
    st i + ln i ≤ n

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.filter_sum_row.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.filter_sum_row
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.filter_sum_row.header:
theorem filter_sum_row {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeom n R st ln rowOf) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < R)
    (f : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (univ.filter (fun x : Fin n => rowOf x.val = i)), f x =
      ∑ j : Fin (ln i), f ⟨st i + j.val, by have := j.2; have := row_lt_n g hi; omega⟩

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowSum_of_mem.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowSum_of_mem

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowMu.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowMu
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowMu.header: noncomputable def rowMu (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) (st : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowEL_raw.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowEL_raw
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowEL_raw.header:
theorem rowEL_raw {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeom n R st ln rowOf) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) {e : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF C c e d = 0) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < R) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, j < ln i →
      Wt C c (((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) * (nx e ((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ) - nx e (((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1)) -
        Wt C c ((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ) * (nx e (((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1) - nx e ((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ)) = rowMu C c e st i

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowEL_flat.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowEL_flat
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowEL_flat.header:
theorem rowEL_flat {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeom n R st ln rowOf) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) {e : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF C c e d = 0) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < R)
    (hflat : ∀ j : ℕ, j < ln i → st i + j ≠ C - 1 ∧ st i + j ≠ C ∧ st i + j ≠ C + 1) :
    BlockELs (st i : ℤ) (ln i) (nx e) (rowMu C c e st i)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowEL_layer.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowEL_layer
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowEL_layer.header:
theorem rowEL_layer {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeom n R st ln rowOf) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) {e : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF C c e d = 0) {i0 : ℕ} (hi : i0 < R)
    (hC : st i0 = C) (hL : 3 ≤ ln i0) :
    LayerELs (C : ℤ) (ln i0) (nx e) (rowMu C c e st i0) c

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowEL_prev.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowEL_prev
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.rowEL_prev.header:
theorem rowEL_prev {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeom n R st ln rowOf) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) {e : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF C c e d = 0) {i0 : ℕ} (hi : i0 < R) (hi1 : 1 ≤ i0)
    (hC : st i0 = C) (hz : nx e (C : ℤ) = 0 ∧ nx e (C : ℤ) - nx e ((C : ℤ) - 1) = 0) :
    BlockELs (st (i0 - 1) : ℤ) (ln (i0 - 1)) (nx e) (rowMu C c e st (i0 - 1))

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.st_add_window.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.st_add_window
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.st_add_window.header:
theorem st_add_window {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeom n R st ln rowOf) (i1 Lw N : ℕ)
    (hLw : ∀ k, k ≤ N → ln (i1 + k) = Lw) : ∀ k, k ≤ N → (st (i1 + k) : ℤ) = (st i1 : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) * Lw

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.chain_tail.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.chain_tail
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.chain_tail.header:
theorem chain_tail {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeom n R st ln rowOf) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) {e : Fin n → ℝ} (he : e ∈ Vsub rowOf) (hne : e ≠ 0)
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF C c e d = 0)
    {i0 : ℕ} (hi0 : i0 < R) (hi01 : 1 ≤ i0) (hC : st i0 = C) (hL : 3 ≤ ln i0)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (hnl : ((ln i0 : ℝ) - 2) * ((ln i0 : ℝ) + 3) / 6 + 1 / c ≠ 0)
    {i1 N Lw : ℕ} (hi1 : i0 < i1) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hi1N : i1 + N < R) (hLw : ∀ k, k ≤ N → ln (i1 + k) = Lw)
    {a b : ℕ} (hab : a < b) (hbN : b ≤ N)
    (ha : rowMu C c e st (i1 + a) = 0) (hb : rowMu C c e st (i1 + b) = 0) : False

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.e1vec.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.e1vec
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.e1vec.header: noncomputable def e1vec (C L n : ℕ) : Fin n → ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.ex_e1vec.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.ex_e1vec
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.ex_e1vec.header:
theorem ex_e1vec (C L n : ℕ) (hCL : C + L ≤ n) (z : ℕ) :
    ex (e1vec C L n) z = if C ≤ z ∧ z < C + L then locVec (L - 1) (C + L - 1 - z) else 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.locVec_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.locVec_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.locVec_zero.header: theorem locVec_zero (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : locVec m 0 = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.qF_e1vec.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.qF_e1vec
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.qF_e1vec.header:
theorem qF_e1vec (K k r : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    qF (K + 1) c (e1vec (K + 1) (k + 3) ((K + 1) + (k + 3) + r)) = locEnergy (k + 2) c

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.qF_eq_sum.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.qF_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.qF_eq_sum.header:
theorem qF_eq_sum (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) (e : Fin n → ℝ) :
    qF C c e = ∑ y ∈ range (n - 1), Wt C c (y : ℤ) * (dlt e y * dlt e y)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.dlt_zero_of_qF_z.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.dlt_zero_of_qF_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.dlt_zero_of_qF_z.header:
theorem dlt_zero_of_qF_zero (C : ℕ) (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) (e : Fin n → ℝ) (hq : qF C 0 e = 0)
    (y : ℕ) (hy : y < n - 1) (h1 : y ≠ C - 1) (h2 : y ≠ C) : dlt e y = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.qF_zero_eq_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.qF_zero_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.qF_zero_eq_zero.header:
theorem qF_zero_eq_zero {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeom n R st ln rowOf) (C : ℕ)
    (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) {i0 : ℕ} (hi01 : 1 ≤ i0) (hi0 : i0 + 1 < R) (hC : st i0 = C)
    {e : Fin n → ℝ} (he : e ∈ Vsub rowOf) (hq : qF C 0 e = 0) : e = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.e1vec_mem.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.e1vec_mem

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.hnl_of_gt.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.hnl_of_gt
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.hnl_of_gt.header:
theorem hnl_of_gt (k : ℕ) (cs : ℝ) (h1 : cLoc (k + 2) < cs) (h0 : cs ≠ 0) :
    ((k + 3 : ℕ) - 2 : ℝ) * (((k + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 3) / 6 + 1 / cs ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.chain_pole.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.chain_pole
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.chain_pole.header:
theorem chain_pole {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeom n R st ln rowOf)
    {i0 K k r : ℕ} (hi01 : 1 ≤ i0) (hi0R : i0 + 1 < R) (hC : st i0 = K + 1) (hL : ln i0 = k + 3)
    (hn : n = (K + 1) + (k + 3) + r)
    {i1 N Lw : ℕ} (hi1 : i0 < i1) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hi1N : i1 + N < R) (hLw : ∀ j, j ≤ N → ln (i1 + j) = Lw) :
    ∃ cs : ℝ, cLoc (k + 2) < cs ∧ cs < 1 ∧ cs ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ es : Fin n → ℝ, es ∈ Vsub rowOf ∧ es ≠ 0 ∧
      qF (K + 1) cs es = 0 ∧ (∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF (K + 1) cs es d = 0) ∧
      ∀ a b : ℕ, a < b → b ≤ N → ¬ (rowMu (K + 1) cs es st (i1 + a) = 0 ∧ rowMu (K + 1) cs es st (i1 + b) = 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.crossing_transve.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.crossing_transversal
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.crossing_transve.header:
theorem crossing_transversal {rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (C : ℕ) (cs : ℝ) {es : Fin n → ℝ} (hes : es ∈ Vsub rowOf) (hne : es ≠ 0)
    (h0 : qF C cs es = 0) :
    0 < bF C es ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, qF C c es = (c - cs) * bF C es

AdalyFormal.CoverNec.continuous_of_inner.name: AdalyFormal.CoverNec.continuous_of_inner
AdalyFormal.CoverNec.continuous_of_inner.header: theorem continuous_of_inner (f : X → F) (h : ∀ w : F, Continuous fun t => ⟪w, f t⟫) : Continuous f

AdalyFormal.CoverNec.continuous_clm_of_i.name: AdalyFormal.CoverNec.continuous_clm_of_inner
AdalyFormal.CoverNec.continuous_clm_of_i.header:
theorem continuous_clm_of_inner {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (A : X → E →L[ℝ] F) (h : ∀ x w, Continuous fun t => ⟪w, A t x⟫) : Continuous A

AdalyFormal.CoverNec.apply_eq_zero_of_ps.name: AdalyFormal.CoverNec.apply_eq_zero_of_psd
AdalyFormal.CoverNec.apply_eq_zero_of_ps.header:
theorem apply_eq_zero_of_psd {B : E →L[ℝ] E} (hs : ∀ x y, ⟪B x, y⟫ = ⟪x, B y⟫) (hp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ⟪x, B x⟫)
    {x : E} (hx : ⟪x, B x⟫ = 0) : B x = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverNec.exists_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.CoverNec.exists_coercive
AdalyFormal.CoverNec.exists_coercive.header:
theorem exists_coercive [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {B : E →L[ℝ] E} (hs : ∀ x y, ⟪B x, y⟫ = ⟪x, B y⟫)
    (hp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ⟪x, B x⟫) (hu : IsUnit B) : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ x, c * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, B x⟫

AdalyFormal.CoverNec.curl_Upi.header:

      (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (((Upi b (z, μ) : SU2m) : M2m) * ((Upi b (periodicLatticeShift z μ, ν) : SU2m) : M2m) *
        ((Upi b (periodicLatticeShift z ν, μ) : SU2m) : M2m) * ((Upi b (z, ν) : SU2m) : M2m) +
        ((Upi b (z, ν) : SU2m) : M2m) * ((Upi b (periodicLatticeShift z ν, μ) : SU2m) : M2m) *
        ((Upi b (periodicLatticeShift z μ, ν) : SU2m) : M2m) * ((Upi b (z, μ) : SU2m) : M2m))

AdalyFormal.CoverNec.Delta_form_sum.name: AdalyFormal.CoverNec.Delta_form_sum

AdalyFormal.CoverNec.tip_counterexample.name: AdalyFormal.CoverNec.tip_counterexample
AdalyFormal.CoverNec.tip_counterexample.header:
theorem tip_counterexample {m R : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hR : 28 ≤ R) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) :
    ∃ v : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ,
      TorusOK 3 (3 ^ m) (ncLu (3 ^ m) R) ∧ Admissible 3 (3 ^ m) R 1 (gcS 3 (3 ^ m) R) ∧
      LambdaOK2 3 (3 ^ m) R 1 (gcS 3 (3 ^ m) R) (ncLam (3 ^ m) R) ∧ (ncLam (3 ^ m) R).Nonempty ∧
      (∀ α₀ : ℝ, 0 < α₀ → PerCubeRegular2 3 (3 ^ m) 12 1 (gcS 3 (3 ^ m) R) α₀ ((3 : ℝ) ^ 1)⁻¹
        (Function.update (fun _ => 1) ((xtG 3 (3 ^ m) R (by norm_num) (by positivity), 1) : Bond _) v)) ∧
      (∀ (F : ℕ) (α₀ : ℝ), 0 < α₀ → PerCubeRegularG 3 (3 ^ m) F 1 (gcS 3 (3 ^ m) R) α₀ ((3 : ℝ) ^ 1)⁻¹
        (Function.update (fun _ => 1) ((xtG 3 (3 ^ m) R (by norm_num) (by positivity), 1) : Bond _) v)) ∧
      ∀ γ₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ γ₀ → ¬ InstIneq 3 1 (by norm_num) a (ncLu (3 ^ m) R) γ₀ (gcS 3 (3 ^ m) R) (ncLam (3 ^ m) R)
        (Function.update (fun _ => 1) ((xtG 3 (3 ^ m) R (by norm_num) (by positivity), 1) : Bond _) v)

AdalyFormal.CoverNested.nested_instance.header:
theorem nested_instance {ell m R : ℕ} (hell : 3 ≤ ell) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hR : 1 ≤ R) :
    TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) (neLu (ell ^ m) R) ∧ Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R 2 (neS ell (ell ^ m) R) ∧
    LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) R 2 (neS ell (ell ^ m) R) (neLam (ell ^ m) R) ∧ (neLam (ell ^ m) R).Nonempty ∧
    (∃ Bt : Bond (neLu (ell ^ m) R) → SuTwo, OnLambdaTildeIn (neLam (ell ^ m) R) ell Bt ∧
      OnLambdaT (neLam (ell ^ m) R) Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt) ∧
    (∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu (ell ^ m) R)), (x 0).val = neC ell (ell ^ m) R →
      x ∈ (neS ell (ell ^ m) R).Om 2 ∧ x ∈ (neS ell (ell ^ m) R).Om 0 ∧
      (∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu (ell ^ m) R)))) (j : ℕ),
        IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) 12 2 (neS ell (ell ^ m) R) sites j → x ∉ sites) ∧
      pStar x ∈ plaqIn ((neS ell (ell ^ m) R).Om 0)) ∧
    (∀ (v : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (α₀ : ℝ), 0 < α₀ →
      PerCubeRegular2 ell (ell ^ m) 12 2 (neS ell (ell ^ m) R) α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ (layerCfg (neC ell (ell ^ m) R) v)) ∧
    neB' ell (ell ^ m) R < neA ell (ell ^ m) R ∧
    (∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu (ell ^ m) R)),
      neB' ell (ell ^ m) R ≤ (x 0).val ∧ (x 0).val < neA ell (ell ^ m) R →
      x ∈ (neS ell (ell ^ m) R).Om 1 ∧ x ∉ (neS ell (ell ^ m) R).Om 2)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_block_one.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_block_one

      ((min ell (L 0 + 1 - (z 0).val) : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((min ell (L 2 + 1 - (z 2).val) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (min ell (L 1 + 1 - (z 1).val)), g n

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_odd_even'.header: theorem sum_odd_even' (m : ℕ) (a : ℝ) : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, (if n % 2 = 0 then (0 : ℝ) else a) = ((m / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * a

  | z, μ :: rest => (if μ = 0 then D (z 0).val * u (z 1).val (z 2).val else 0) + uAng s D u (coarseShift z s μ) rest

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uAng_rep_ne.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uAng_rep_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uAng_rep_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uAng_rep_zero.header:
theorem uAng_rep_zero (s : ℕ) (D : ℕ → ℝ) (u : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.endpoint_rep_self.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.endpoint_rep_self
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.endpoint_rep_self.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uAng_gamma.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uAng_gamma
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uAng_gamma.header:
theorem uAng_gamma (s : ℕ) (D : ℕ → ℝ) (u : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (w y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    uAng s D u w (coarseGammaPath s y x) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (((x 0 - (Function.update (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1 (x 1)) 0).val) / s),
        D (((w 0).val + s * j) % (L 0 + 1)) *
          u (((w 1).val + s * (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s)) % (L 1 + 1))
            (((w 2).val + s * (((x 2 - y 2).val) / s)) % (L 2 + 1))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.n_eq.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.n_eq
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.n_eq.header:
theorem n_eq {s ell : ℕ} {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (x μ).val = (y μ).val + s * (((x μ - y μ).val) / s)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uTemp_angle_expr.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uTemp_angle_expr
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uTemp_angle_expr.header:
theorem uTemp_angle_expr {s ell : ℕ} {D : ℕ → ℝ} {u : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ}
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) :
    uAng s D u y (coarseGammaPath s y x) + uAng s D u x (List.replicate ell μ)
      - uAng s D u (cPlusS s ell (y, μ)) (coarseGammaPath s y x) - uAng s D u y (List.replicate ell μ) =
    (if μ = 0 then (∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, D (((y 0).val + s * j) % (L 0 + 1))) * (u (x 1).val (x 2).val - u (y 1).val (y 2).val)
       else if μ = 1 then (∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((x 0 - y 0).val / s), D (((y 0).val + s * j) % (L 0 + 1))) *
          (u (x 1).val (x 2).val - u (((x 1).val + s * ell) % (L 1 + 1)) (x 2).val)
       else (∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((x 0 - y 0).val / s), D (((y 0).val + s * j) % (L 0 + 1))) *
          (u (x 1).val (x 2).val - u (x 1).val (((x 2).val + s * ell) % (L 2 + 1))))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopVar_uTemp.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopVar_uTemp
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopVar_uTemp.header:
theorem loopVar_uTemp {s ell : ℕ} {D : ℕ → ℝ} {u : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} (hV : IsUTemp D u V)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) :
    loopVar s ell V (y, μ) x = cartan
      (if μ = 0 then (∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, D (((y 0).val + s * j) % (L 0 + 1))) * (u (x 1).val (x 2).val - u (y 1).val (y 2).val)
       else if μ = 1 then (∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((x 0 - y 0).val / s), D (((y 0).val + s * j) % (L 0 + 1))) *
          (u (x 1).val (x 2).val - u (((x 1).val + s * ell) % (L 1 + 1)) (x 2).val)
       else (∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((x 0 - y 0).val / s), D (((y 0).val + s * j) % (L 0 + 1))) *
          (u (x 1).val (x 2).val - u (x 1).val (((x 2).val + s * ell) % (L 2 + 1))))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.u1.header: noncomputable def u1 (ell : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (a1 a2 : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.u1_abs_le.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.u1_abs_le
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.u1_abs_le.header: theorem u1_abs_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (t : ℝ) (a1 a2 : ℕ) : |u1 (L := L) ell t a1 a2| ≤ |t| / 2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cnt0_eq.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cnt0_eq
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cnt0_eq.header:
theorem cnt0_eq {ell c N0 v : ℕ} (hc1 : ell ≤ c) (hc2 : c + ell ≤ N0) (hv : v < N0) (hD : Dfun c ell N0 v ≠ 0) :
    min ell (N0 - v) = ell

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bg1_isUTemp.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bg1_isUTemp
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bg1_isUTemp.header:
theorem bg1_isUTemp (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < Real.pi)
    (hc1 : ell ≤ c) (hc2 : c + ell ≤ L 0 + 1) :
    IsUTemp (Dfun c ell (L 0 + 1)) (u1 (L := L) ell t)
      (stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp 1 ell (stagCfg c t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.regBg2_level1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.regBg2_level1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.regBg2_level1.header:
theorem regBg2_level1 (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < Real.pi)
    (hc1 : ell ≤ c) (hc2 : c + ell ≤ L 0 + 1) :
    RegBg2 ell ell (stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp 1 ell (stagCfg c t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crs_fit.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crs_fit
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crs_fit.header:
theorem crs_fit {s : ℕ} (hdiv : ∀ μ, s ∣ L μ + 1) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : Crs s y) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (y μ).val + s ≤ L μ + 1

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bg1_temporal.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bg1_temporal
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bg1_temporal.header:
theorem bg1_temporal (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (hdiv : ∀ μ, ell ∣ L μ + 1) (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ)
    (htπ : |t| < Real.pi) (hc1 : ell ≤ c) (hc2 : c + ell ≤ L 0 + 1) :
    IsTemporal ell (stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp 1 ell (stagCfg c t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L))
      (fun v => Dfun c ell (L 0 + 1) v * (t / 2))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bg2_temporal.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bg2_temporal
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bg2_temporal.header:
theorem bg2_temporal (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (hdiv : ∀ μ, ell ∣ L μ + 1) (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ)
    (htπ : |t| < Real.pi) (hc1 : ell ≤ c) (hc2 : c + ell ≤ L 0 + 1) :
    IsTemporal (ell * ell)
      (stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp ell ell (stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp 1 ell (stagCfg c t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)))
      (fun v => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, (fun v' => Dfun c ell (L 0 + 1) v' * (t / 2)) ((v + ell * j) % (L 0 + 1)))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.scaleUp_succ.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.scaleUp_succ
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.scaleUp_succ.header:
theorem scaleUp_succ (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (μ : Fin 3) :
    scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1 = (Lu μ + 1) * ell ^ k

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.unit_temporal.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.unit_temporal
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.unit_temporal.header:
theorem unit_temporal (hell : 0 < ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < Real.pi)
    (hc1 : ell ≤ c) (hc2 : c + ell ≤ scaleUp ell 2 Lu 0 + 1) :
    IsTemporal 1 (unitBg ell 2 Lu hell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (stagCfg c t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell 2 Lu)) 2))
      (fun v => (fun w => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, (fun v' => Dfun c ell (scaleUp ell 2 Lu 0 + 1) v' * (t / 2))
        ((w + ell * j) % (scaleUp ell 2 Lu 0 + 1))) (ell ^ 2 * v))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stag_unit_regBg2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stag_unit_regBg2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stag_unit_regBg2.header:
theorem stag_unit_regBg2 (hell : 0 < ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < Real.pi)
    (hc1 : ell ≤ c) (hc2 : c + ell ≤ scaleUp ell 2 Lu 0 + 1) :
    RegBg2 1 ell (unitBg ell 2 Lu hell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (stagCfg c t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell 2 Lu)) 2))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stag_regTower.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stag_regTower
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stag_regTower.header:
theorem stag_regTower (hell : 0 < ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < Real.pi)
    (hc1 : ell ≤ c) (hc2 : c + ell ≤ scaleUp ell 2 Lu 0 + 1) :
    RegTower2 ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (stagCfg c t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell 2 Lu))) 2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartanOf.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartanOf
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartanOf.header: noncomputable def cartanOf (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG.header:
noncomputable def pathAngG (s : ℕ) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L → List (Fin 3) → ℝ
  | _, [] => 0
  | y, μ :: rest => θ (y, μ) + pathAngG s θ (coarseShift y s μ) rest

theorem hol_cartanOf (s : ℕ) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, coarsePathHolonomy s (cartanOf θ) y p = cartan (pathAngG s θ y p)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hol_cartanOf.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hol_cartanOf
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hol_cartanOf.header:
theorem hol_cartanOf (s : ℕ) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, coarsePathHolonomy s (cartanOf θ) y p = cartan (pathAngG s θ y p)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_append.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_append
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_append.header:
theorem pathAngG_append (s : ℕ) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (p q : List (Fin 3)) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, pathAngG s θ y (p ++ q) = pathAngG s θ y p + pathAngG s θ (coarsePathEndpoint s y p) q

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_add.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_add
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_add.header:
theorem pathAngG_add (s : ℕ) (θ θ' : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, pathAngG s (θ + θ') y p = pathAngG s θ y p + pathAngG s θ' y p

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_smul.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_smul
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_smul.header:
theorem pathAngG_smul (s : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, pathAngG s (r • θ) y p = r * pathAngG s θ y p

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_zero.header: theorem pathAngG_zero (s : ℕ) (p : List (Fin 3)) : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, pathAngG s (0 : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) y p = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopAngG.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopAngG
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopAngG.header:
noncomputable def loopAngG (s ell : ℕ) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopVar_cartanOf.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopVar_cartanOf
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopVar_cartanOf.header:
theorem loopVar_cartanOf (s ell : ℕ) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : loopVar s ell (cartanOf θ) (y, μ) x = cartan (loopAngG s ell θ y μ x)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopAngG_add.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopAngG_add
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopAngG_add.header:
theorem loopAngG_add (s ell : ℕ) (θ θ' : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    loopAngG s ell (θ + θ') y μ x = loopAngG s ell θ y μ x + loopAngG s ell θ' y μ x

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopAngG_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopAngG_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopAngG_zero.header:
theorem loopAngG_zero (s ell : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    loopAngG s ell (0 : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) y μ x = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAngG.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAngG
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAngG.header: noncomputable def blockAngG (s ell : ℕ) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAngG_add.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAngG_add
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAngG_add.header:
theorem blockAngG_add (s ell : ℕ) (θ θ' : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    blockAngG s ell (θ + θ') y μ = blockAngG s ell θ y μ + blockAngG s ell θ' y μ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sbg_cartanOf.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sbg_cartanOf
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sbg_cartanOf.header:
theorem sbg_cartanOf (s ell : ℕ) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, |loopAngG s ell θ y μ x| < Real.pi) :
    stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp s ell (cartanOf θ) (y, μ) = cartan (blockAngG s ell θ y μ)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sAngG.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sAngG
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sAngG.header: noncomputable def sAngG (s ell : ℕ) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sAngG_add.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sAngG_add
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sAngG_add.header:
theorem sAngG_add (s ell : ℕ) (θ θ' : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    sAngG s ell (θ + θ') y = sAngG s ell θ y + sAngG s ell θ' y

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartanOf_mul.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartanOf_mul
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartanOf_mul.header:
theorem cartanOf_mul (φ θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) :
    (fun b => cartanOf θ b * cartanOf φ b) = cartanOf (θ + φ)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sBlock_cartanOf.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sBlock_cartanOf
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sBlock_cartanOf.header:
theorem sBlock_cartanOf (s ell : ℕ) (φ θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, |pathAngG s θ y (coarseGammaPath s y x)| < Real.pi) :
    sBlock s ell (cartanOf φ) (cartanOf θ) y = dg (sAngG s ell θ y)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rsig.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rsig
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rsig.header: noncomputable def Rsig (s ell : ℕ) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rsig_add.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rsig_add
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rsig_add.header:
theorem Rsig_add (s ell : ℕ) (θ θ' : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) :
    Rsig s ell (θ + θ') = Rsig s ell θ + Rsig s ell θ'

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rawStep_cartanOf.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rawStep_cartanOf
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rawStep_cartanOf.header:
theorem rawStep_cartanOf (s ell : ℕ) (φ θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hloop : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, |loopAngG s ell φ c.1 c.2 x| < Real.pi)
    (hloop' : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, |loopAngG s ell (θ + φ) c.1 c.2 x| < Real.pi)
    (hS1 : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, |pathAngG s θ c.1 (coarseGammaPath s c.1 x)| < Real.pi)
    (hS2 : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf (cPlusS s ell c) s ell, |pathAngG s θ (cPlusS s ell c) (coarseGammaPath s (cPlusS s ell c) x)| < Real.pi) :
    rawStep s ell (cartanOf φ) (cartanOf θ) c = cartan (Rsig s ell θ c)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.aF.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.aF
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.aF.header: def aF (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) : XS L

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.aFL.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.aFL
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.aFL.header: noncomputable def aFL : (PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) →L[ℝ] XS L

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.aFL_apply.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.aFL_apply
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.aFL_apply.header: theorem aFL_apply (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) : aFL θ = aF θ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.toM2_aF.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.toM2_aF
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.toM2_aF.header: theorem toM2_aF (x : ℝ) : toM2 ![x, 0, 0] = dg x

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.expCfgX_aF.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.expCfgX_aF
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.expCfgX_aF.header: theorem expCfgX_aF (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) : expCfgX (aF θ) = cartanOf θ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_continuo.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_continuous
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_continuo.header:
theorem pathAngG_continuous (s : ℕ) (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Continuous (fun θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ => pathAngG s θ y p)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopAngG_continuo.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopAngG_continuous
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopAngG_continuo.header:
theorem loopAngG_continuous (s ell : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Continuous (fun θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ => loopAngG s ell θ y μ x)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAngG_continu.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAngG_continuous
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAngG_continu.header:
theorem blockAngG_continuous (s ell : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    Continuous (fun θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ => blockAngG s ell θ y μ)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sAngG_continuous.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sAngG_continuous
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sAngG_continuous.header:
theorem sAngG_continuous (s ell : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Continuous (fun θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ => sAngG s ell θ y)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rsig_continuous.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rsig_continuous
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rsig_continuous.header:
theorem Rsig_continuous (s ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    Continuous (fun θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ => Rsig s ell θ c)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.eventually_abs_lt.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.eventually_abs_lt_of_cont
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.eventually_abs_lt.header:
theorem eventually_abs_lt_of_cont {f : (PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (h0 : |f 0| < Real.pi) :
    ∀ᶠ θ in 𝓝 (0 : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ), |f θ| < Real.pi

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sAngG_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sAngG_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sAngG_zero.header: theorem sAngG_zero (s ell : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : sAngG s ell (0 : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) y = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAngG_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAngG_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAngG_zero.header:
theorem blockAngG_zero (s ell : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    blockAngG s ell (0 : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) y μ = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rsig_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rsig_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rsig_zero.header: theorem Rsig_zero (s ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : Rsig s ell (0 : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) c = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopAngG_smul.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopAngG_smul
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopAngG_smul.header:
theorem loopAngG_smul (s ell : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    loopAngG s ell (r • θ) y μ x = r * loopAngG s ell θ y μ x

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rsig_smul.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rsig_smul
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rsig_smul.header: theorem Rsig_smul (s ell : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) : Rsig s ell (r • θ) = r • Rsig s ell θ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RsigL.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RsigL
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RsigL.header: noncomputable def RsigL (s ell : ℕ) : (PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RsigL_apply.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RsigL_apply
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RsigL_apply.header: theorem RsigL_apply (s ell : ℕ) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) : RsigL s ell θ = Rsig s ell θ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qStepX_sigma3_eve.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qStepX_sigma3_eventually
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qStepX_sigma3_eve.header:
theorem qStepX_sigma3_eventually (s ell : ℕ) (φ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, |loopAngG s ell φ c.1 c.2 x| < Real.pi) :
    ∀ᶠ θ in 𝓝 (0 : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ), qStepX s ell (cartanOf φ) (aF θ) = aF (Rsig s ell θ)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qStepX_comp_aFL_e.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qStepX_comp_aFL_eventually
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qStepX_comp_aFL_e.header:
theorem qStepX_comp_aFL_eventually (s ell : ℕ) (φ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, |loopAngG s ell φ c.1 c.2 x| < Real.pi) :
    (fun θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ => qStepX s ell (cartanOf φ) (aFL θ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
      fun θ => aFL (RsigL s ell θ)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.QlinStepX_sigma3.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.QlinStepX_sigma3
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.QlinStepX_sigma3.header:
theorem QlinStepX_sigma3 (s ell : ℕ) (φ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, |loopAngG s ell φ c.1 c.2 x| < Real.pi)
    (hreg : RegBg2 s ell (cartanOf φ)) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) :
    QlinStepX s ell (cartanOf φ) (aF θ) = aF (Rsig s ell θ)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.C2StepX_sigma3.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.C2StepX_sigma3
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.C2StepX_sigma3.header:
theorem C2StepX_sigma3 (s ell : ℕ) (φ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, |loopAngG s ell φ c.1 c.2 x| < Real.pi)
    (hreg : RegBg2 s ell (cartanOf φ)) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) :
    C2StepX s ell (cartanOf φ) (aF θ) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.FormF.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.FormF
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.FormF.header: def FormF (s : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_rep_one.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_rep_one
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_rep_one.header:
theorem pathAngG_rep_one {s : ℕ} (hdiv : ∀ μ, s ∣ L μ + 1) {f : ℕ → ℝ} {θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ} (hθ : FormF s f θ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ z : PeriodicLatticeSite L, Crs s z → pathAngG s θ z (List.replicate n 1) = n * f (z 0).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_rep_ne.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_rep_ne
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_rep_ne.header:
theorem pathAngG_rep_ne {s : ℕ} (hdiv : ∀ μ, s ∣ L μ + 1) {f : ℕ → ℝ} {θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ} (hθ : FormF s f θ)
    (μ : Fin 3) (hμ : μ ≠ 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ z : PeriodicLatticeSite L, Crs s z → pathAngG s θ z (List.replicate n μ) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_gamma_f.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_gamma_f
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_gamma_f.header:
theorem pathAngG_gamma_f {s : ℕ} (hdiv : ∀ μ, s ∣ L μ + 1) {f : ℕ → ℝ} {θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ} (hθ : FormF s f θ)
    (z y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : Crs s z) :
    pathAngG s θ z (coarseGammaPath s y x) =
      (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val / s : ℕ) : ℝ) * f (z 0).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_range_id_real.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_range_id_real
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_range_id_real.header: theorem sum_range_id_real (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (i : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1) / 2

    (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < tcap ell) (hc1 : ell ≤ c) (hc2 : c + ell * ell < L 0 + 1)
    {f : ℕ → ℝ} {θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ} (hθ : FormF 1 f θ) :
    QlinCompX ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (stagCfg c t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)) 1 (aF θ) = aF (thetaSeq ell 1 θ) ∧
    QlinCompX ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (stagCfg c t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)) 2 (aF θ) = aF (thetaSeq ell 2 θ) ∧
    FormF ell (fSum ell 1 f) (thetaSeq ell 1 θ) ∧ FormF (ell ^ 2) (fSum ell 2 f) (thetaSeq ell 2 θ)

    C2CompX ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (stagCfg c t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)) 1 (aF θ) = 0 ∧
    C2CompX ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (stagCfg c t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)) 2 (aF θ) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.curl_zfun_01.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.val_shift0.header: theorem val_shift0 (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ((periodicLatticeShift x 0) 0).val = nxt (L 0) (x 0).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.val_shiftBack0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.val_shiftBack0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.val_shiftBack0.header: theorem val_shiftBack0 (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ((periodicLatticeShiftBack y 0) 0).val = prv (L 0) (y 0).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hsInner_dgS_one.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hsInner_dgS_one
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hsInner_dgS_one.header: theorem hsInner_dgS_one (Y : SuTwo) (a : ℝ) : hsInner Y (dgS a) = a * hsInner Y (dgS 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.plaq_sum_reduce.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.plaq_sum_reduce
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.plaq_sum_reduce.header:
theorem plaq_sum_reduce {U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L} (hU : CartanCfg U)
    (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (w : Bond L → SuTwo) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, if p ∈ P then holCos U p * hsInner (curlValueCovariant U w p) (curlValueCovariant U (zfun f) p) else 0) =
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if (x, q01) ∈ P then holCos U (x, q01) else 0) *
      hsInner (curlValueCovariant U w (x, q01)) (dgS (f ((periodicLatticeShift x 0) 0).val - f (x 0).val))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Wa.header: noncomputable def Wa (N : ℕ) (ω f : ℕ → ℝ) (v : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sgnNat_mod.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sgnNat_mod

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAng.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAng
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAng.header:
noncomputable def pathAng (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (s : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L → List (Fin 3) → ℝ
  | _, [] => 0
  | y, μ :: rest => (if (y 0).val = c ∧ μ = 1 then stagSign y * t else 0) + pathAng c t s (coarseShift y s μ) rest

theorem hol_stag (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, coarsePathHolonomy s (stagCfg c t) y p = cartan (pathAng c t s y p)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hol_stag.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hol_stag
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hol_stag.header:
theorem hol_stag (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, coarsePathHolonomy s (stagCfg c t) y p = cartan (pathAng c t s y p)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAng_append.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAng_append
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAng_append.header:
theorem pathAng_append (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (p q : List (Fin 3)) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, pathAng c t s y (p ++ q) = pathAng c t s y p + pathAng c t s (coarsePathEndpoint s y p) q

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAng_rep_ne.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAng_rep_ne
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAng_rep_ne.header:
theorem pathAng_rep_ne (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (hμ : μ ≠ 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, pathAng c t s y (List.replicate n μ) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stagSign_coarseSh.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stagSign_coarseShift_one
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stagSign_coarseSh.header:
theorem stagSign_coarseShift_one (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ) :
    stagSign (coarseShift y s 1) = sgnNat ((y 1).val + s)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stagSign_eq_sgnNa.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stagSign_eq_sgnNat
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stagSign_eq_sgnNa.header: theorem stagSign_eq_sgnNat (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : stagSign y = sgnNat (y 1).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sgnNat_mod_add.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sgnNat_mod_add
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sgnNat_mod_add.header: theorem sgnNat_mod_add (N a b : ℕ) (hN : 2 ∣ N) : sgnNat (a % N + b) = sgnNat (a + b)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAng_rep_one.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAng_rep_one
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAng_rep_one.header:
theorem pathAng_rep_one (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, pathAng c t s y (List.replicate n 1) =
      if (y 0).val = c then t * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, sgnNat ((y 1).val + s * j) else 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartan_half_entri.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartan_half_entries
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartan_half_entri.header:
theorem cartan_half_entries :

    ((cartan (Real.pi / 2) : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) 1 1 = -Complex.I

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RMap_h_fixed_iff.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RMap_h_fixed_iff
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RMap_h_fixed_iff.header: theorem RMap_h_fixed_iff (Y : SuTwo) : RMap (cartan (Real.pi / 2)) Y = Y ↔ diagP Y = Y

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.QlinB_zfield.header:
theorem QlinB_zfield (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hE : StagPar L ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (hdiv : ∀ μ, ell * ell ∣ L μ + 1)
    (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < tcap ell) (hc1 : ell ≤ c) (hc2 : c + ell * ell < L 0 + 1) (f : ℕ → ℝ)
    (G : TowerGeom L) (hG : G.ell = ell) :
    (QlinB G (stagCfg c t) 1 (zfield f) : BondFnL2 L) = suCoordInv (aF (thetaSeq ell 1 (thetaF f))) ∧
    (QlinB G (stagCfg c t) 2 (zfield f) : BondFnL2 L) = suCoordInv (aF (thetaSeq ell 2 (thetaF f)))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.QlinB_zero'.header: theorem QlinB_zero' (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (A : BondFnL2 L) : QlinB G U 0 A = A

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.QlinB_zfield_appl.header:
theorem QlinB_zfield_apply (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hE : StagPar L ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (hdiv : ∀ μ, ell * ell ∣ L μ + 1)
    (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < tcap ell) (hc1 : ell ≤ c) (hc2 : c + ell * ell < L 0 + 1) (f : ℕ → ℝ)
    (G : TowerGeom L) (hG : G.ell = ell) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 2) (b : Bond L) (hb : Crs (ell ^ j) b.1) :
    ((QlinB G (stagCfg c t) j (zfield f) : BondFnL2 L) b : SuTwo) =
      (if b.2 = 1 then dgS (fSum ell j f (b.1 0).val) else (0 : SuTwo))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Qfull_zfield.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Qfull_zfield
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Qfull_zfield.header:
theorem Qfull_zfield (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hE : StagPar L ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (hdiv : ∀ μ, ell * ell ∣ L μ + 1)
    (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < tcap ell) (hc1 : ell ≤ c) (hc2 : c + ell * ell < L 0 + 1) (f : ℕ → ℝ)
    (G : TowerGeom L) (hG : G.ell = ell) (hk : G.k = 2)
    (hcrs : ∀ p : BIdx G, Crs (ell ^ (p.1 : ℕ)) p.2.1.1) (p : BIdx G) :
    (QfullOf G (stagCfg c t) (zfield f) : FSp G) p =
      ((ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ))⁻¹ • (if p.2.1.2 = 1 then dgS (fSum ell (p.1 : ℕ) f (p.2.1.1 0).val) else (0 : SuTwo))
