AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sPerm_apply.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sPerm_apply
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sPerm_apply.header: theorem sPerm_apply (μ : Fin 3) (s : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : sPerm μ s x = coarseShift x s μ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sPerm_coord_ne.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sPerm_coord_ne
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sPerm_coord_ne.header:
theorem sPerm_coord_ne (μ : Fin 3) (s : ℕ) (i : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) (hν : ν ≠ μ) :
    ((sPerm μ s ^ i) x) ν = x ν

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sPerm_crs_iff.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sPerm_crs_iff
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sPerm_crs_iff.header:
theorem sPerm_crs_iff {s : ℕ} (hdiv : ∀ μ, s ∣ L μ + 1) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Crs s ((sPerm μ s ^ i) x) ↔ Crs s x

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_rep_sum.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_rep_sum
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_rep_sum.header:
theorem pathAngG_rep_sum (s : ℕ) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pathAngG s θ x (List.replicate n μ) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, θ (((sPerm μ s) ^ i) x, μ)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.alignDown.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.alignDown
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.alignDown.header: def alignDown (m : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.alignDown_val.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.alignDown_val
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.alignDown_val.header: theorem alignDown_val (m : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : (alignDown m x μ).val = m * ((x μ).val / m)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.owner_filter.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.owner_filter
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.owner_filter.header:
theorem owner_filter {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : Crs s x) :
    Finset.univ.filter (fun y : PeriodicLatticeSite L => Crs (s * ell) y ∧ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) = {alignDown (s * ell) x}

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.owner_filter_empt.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.owner_filter_empty
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.owner_filter_empt.header:
theorem owner_filter_empty {s ell : ℕ} (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : ¬ Crs s x) :
    Finset.univ.filter (fun y : PeriodicLatticeSite L => Crs (s * ell) y ∧ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) = ∅

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fit_of_crs.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fit_of_crs
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fit_of_crs.header:
theorem fit_of_crs {m : ℕ} (hdiv : ∀ μ, m ∣ L μ + 1) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : Crs m y) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (y μ).val + m ≤ L μ + 1

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cons1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cons1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cons1.header:
theorem cons1 {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (hdiv : ∀ μ, s * ell ∣ L μ + 1)
    (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (h : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if Crs (s * ell) y then h (y 0).val * Rsig s ell θ (y, 1) else 0) =
      (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) * ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L,
        (if Crs s x then h ((s * ell) * ((x 0).val / (s * ell))) * θ (x, 1) else 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_BIdx.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_BIdx
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_BIdx.header:
theorem sum_BIdx (G : TowerGeom L) (F : Fin (G.k + 1) → Bond L → ℝ) :
    ∑ p : BIdx G, F p.1 p.2.1 = ∑ j : Fin (G.k + 1), ∑ b : Bond L, (if b ∈ bondsLam G j then F j b else 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.suCoordInv_thetaO.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.suCoordInv_thetaOf
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.suCoordInv_thetaO.header: theorem suCoordInv_thetaOf (A : BondFnL2 L) (hA : SigB (WithLp.ofLp A)) : (suCoordInv (aF (thetaOf (WithLp.ofLp A))) : BondFnL2 L) = A

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.QlinB_sig.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.QlinB_sig
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.QlinB_sig.header:
theorem QlinB_sig (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hE : StagPar L ell) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < tcap ell) (hc1 : ell ≤ c) (hc2 : c + ell * ell < L 0 + 1)
    (G : TowerGeom L) (hG : G.ell = ell) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 2) (A : BondFnL2 L) (hA : SigB (WithLp.ofLp A)) :
    QlinB G (stagCfg c t) j A = suCoordInv (aF (thetaSeq ell j (thetaOf (WithLp.ofLp A))))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hsInner_dgS_dgS.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hsInner_dgS_dgS
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hsInner_dgS_dgS.header: theorem hsInner_dgS_dgS (a b : ℝ) : hsInner (dgS a) (dgS b) = a * b * hsInner (dgS 1) (dgS 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dg_add.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dg_add
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dg_add.header: theorem dg_add (a b : ℝ) : dg (a + b) = dg a + dg b

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dg_sum.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dg_sum
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dg_sum.header: theorem dg_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ) : dg (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, dg (f i)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dg_smul.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dg_smul
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dg_smul.header: theorem dg_smul (q : ℝ) (a : ℝ) : (q : ℂ) • dg a = dg (q * a)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dg_qsmul.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dg_qsmul
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dg_qsmul.header: theorem dg_qsmul (q : ℚ) (a : ℝ) : q • dg a = dg ((q : ℝ) * a)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.su2Exp_dg.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.su2Exp_dg
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.su2Exp_dg.header: theorem su2Exp_dg (a : ℝ) : su2Exp (dg a) = cartan a

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.trace_cartan_re.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.trace_cartan_re
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.trace_cartan_re.header: theorem trace_cartan_re (φ : ℝ) : (Matrix.trace ((cartan φ : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : M2)).re / 2 = Real.cos φ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.su2Angle_cartan.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.su2Angle_cartan
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.su2Angle_cartan.header: theorem su2Angle_cartan (φ : ℝ) (h : |φ| ≤ Real.pi) : su2Angle (cartan φ) = |φ|

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.kappa_sin.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.kappa_sin
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.kappa_sin.header: theorem kappa_sin (φ : ℝ) (h : |φ| < Real.pi) : (|φ| / Real.sin |φ|) * Real.sin φ = φ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.exp_sub_star.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.exp_sub_star
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.exp_sub_star.header:
theorem exp_sub_star (φ : ℝ) :
    Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) - star (Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) = 2 * Complex.I * (Real.sin φ : ℂ)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.su2Log_cartan.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.su2Log_cartan
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.su2Log_cartan.header: theorem su2Log_cartan (φ : ℝ) (h : |φ| < Real.pi) : su2Log (cartan φ) = dg φ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blocked_cartan.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blocked_cartan
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blocked_cartan.header:
theorem blocked_cartan {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (s ell : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (β : ℝ)
    (hloop : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, loopVar s ell V c x = cartan (φ x) ∧ |φ x| < Real.pi)
    (hcb : coarseBondVar s ell V c = cartan β) :
    stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp s ell V c =
      cartan ((((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ * ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, φ x) + β)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.StagSetup.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.StagSetup
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.StagSetup.header: structure StagSetup (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell c : ℕ) (G : TowerGeom L) (isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) : Prop

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zrow.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zrow
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zrow.header: noncomputable def zrow (G : TowerGeom L) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) : FSp G

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Wt.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Wt
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Wt.header: noncomputable def Wt (ell : ℕ) (isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (v : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crs_one.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crs_one
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crs_one.header: theorem crs_one (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Crs 1 x

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lev_sums.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lev_sums
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lev_sums.header:
theorem lev_sums {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdiv : ∀ μ, ell * ell ∣ L μ + 1) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (H : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if Crs (ell ^ 0) y then H 0 (y 0).val * thetaSeq ell 0 θ (y, 1) else 0)) =
      ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, H 0 (ell ^ 0 * ((x 0).val / ell ^ 0)) * θ (x, 1) ∧
    (∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if Crs (ell ^ 1) y then H 1 (y 0).val * thetaSeq ell 1 θ (y, 1) else 0)) =
      ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, H 1 (ell ^ 1 * ((x 0).val / ell ^ 1)) * θ (x, 1) ∧
    (∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if Crs (ell ^ 2) y then H 2 (y 0).val * thetaSeq ell 2 θ (y, 1) else 0)) =
      (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, H 2 (ell ^ 2 * ((x 0).val / ell ^ 2)) * θ (x, 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Hrow.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Hrow
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Hrow.header: noncomputable def Hrow (isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (j v : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pair_levels.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pair_levels
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pair_levels.header:
theorem pair_levels {ell c : ℕ} {G : TowerGeom L} {isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (S : StagSetup L ell c G isRow) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < tcap ell)
    (w : BondFnL2 L) (hw : SigB (WithLp.ofLp w)) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ (QfullOf G (stagCfg c t) w) (zrow G ρ) : ℝ) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range 3, (((ell : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹) * c0 *
        ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if Crs (ell ^ j) y then Hrow isRow ρ j (y 0).val * thetaSeq ell j (thetaOf (WithLp.ofLp w)) (y, 1) else 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pair_Q_zrow.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pair_Q_zrow
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pair_Q_zrow.header:
theorem pair_Q_zrow {ell c : ℕ} {G : TowerGeom L} {isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (S : StagSetup L ell c G isRow) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < tcap ell)
    (w : BondFnL2 L) (hw : SigB (WithLp.ofLp w)) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ (QfullOf G (stagCfg c t) w) (zrow G ρ) : ℝ) =
      c0 * ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, thetaOf (WithLp.ofLp w) (x, 1) * Wt ell isRow ρ (x 0).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sig_apply_eq.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sig_apply_eq
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sig_apply_eq.header:
theorem sig_apply_eq (A : BondFnL2 L) (hA : SigB (WithLp.ofLp A)) (b : Bond L) :
    (A b : SuTwo) = dgS (thetaOf (WithLp.ofLp A) b)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.inner_sig_zfield.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.inner_sig_zfield
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.inner_sig_zfield.header:
theorem inner_sig_zfield (u : BondFnL2 L) (hu : SigB (WithLp.ofLp u)) (g : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ u (zfield g) : ℝ) = c0 * ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, thetaOf (WithLp.ofLp u) (x, 1) * g (x 0).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.adFL_zrow.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.adFL_zrow
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.adFL_zrow.header: theorem adFL_zrow (G : TowerGeom L) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) : adFL (hGauge L) G (zrow G ρ) = zrow G ρ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.adBL_zfield.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.adBL_zfield
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.adBL_zfield.header: theorem adBL_zfield (g : ℕ → ℝ) : adBL (hGauge L) (zfield g) = zfield g

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Qfull_adBL.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Qfull_adBL
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Qfull_adBL.header:
theorem Qfull_adBL (G : TowerGeom L) (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (w : BondFnL2 L) :
    QfullOf G (stagCfg c t) (adBL (hGauge L) w) = adFL (hGauge L) G (QfullOf G (stagCfg c t) w)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.inner_Q_zrow.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.inner_Q_zrow
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.inner_Q_zrow.header:
theorem inner_Q_zrow {ell c : ℕ} {G : TowerGeom L} {isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (S : StagSetup L ell c G isRow) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < tcap ell)
    (w : BondFnL2 L) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ (QfullOf G (stagCfg c t) w) (zrow G ρ) : ℝ) = inner ℝ w (zfield (Wt ell isRow ρ))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.plaqIn_01_iff.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.plaqIn_01_iff
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.plaqIn_01_iff.header:
theorem plaqIn_01_iff (J : ℕ → Prop) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (x, q01) ∈ plaqIn {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L | J (z 0).val} ↔ J (x 0).val ∧ J (nxt (L 0) (x 0).val)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omegaW.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omegaW
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omegaW.header: noncomputable def omegaW (J : ℕ → Prop) (N0 c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (v : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hω_stag.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hω_stag
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hω_stag.header:
theorem hω_stag (J : ℕ → Prop) (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (if (x, q01) ∈ plaqIn {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L | J (z 0).val} then holCos (stagCfg c t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (x, q01) else 0) =
      omegaW J (L 0) c t (x 0).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pE_of_mem.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pE_of_mem
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pE_of_mem.header: theorem pE_of_mem (G : TowerGeom L) (y : BondFnL2 L) (hy : y ∈ bondSupp G) : ((pE G y : ↥(bondSupp G)) : BondFnL2 L) = y

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.adjoint_Wop_of_di.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.adjoint_Wop_of_div
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.adjoint_Wop_of_di.header:
theorem adjoint_Wop_of_div (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (v : BondFnL2 L) (hv : gradAdj U v = 0) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Wop G U a) v = v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.DpiFull_zfield.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.DpiFull_zfield
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.DpiFull_zfield.header:
theorem DpiFull_zfield (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (hU : CartanCfg U) (a : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (ω : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hω : ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if (x, q01) ∈ plaqIn G.Om0 then holCos U (x, q01) else 0) = ω (x 0).val) :
    DpiFull G U a (zfield f) = zfield (zprof (L 0) ω f)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Qfull_zfield_eq_z.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Qfull_zfield_eq_zrow
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Qfull_zfield_eq_z.header:
theorem Qfull_zfield_eq_zrow {ell c : ℕ} {G : TowerGeom L} {isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (S : StagSetup L ell c G isRow) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < tcap ell)
    (f : ℕ → ℝ) : QfullOf G (stagCfg c t) (zfield f) = zrow G (fun j v => ((ell : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹ * fSum ell j f v)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.diagW_massW_zrow.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.diagW_massW_zrow
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.diagW_massW_zrow.header:
theorem diagW_massW_zrow (G : TowerGeom L) (ell : ℕ) (hG : G.ell = ell) (a : ℝ) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    diagW G (massW G a) (zrow G ρ) = zrow G (fun j v => a * (ell : ℝ) ^ j * ρ j v)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Qstar_zrow.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Qstar_zrow
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Qstar_zrow.header:
theorem Qstar_zrow {ell c : ℕ} {G : TowerGeom L} {isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (S : StagSetup L ell c G isRow) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < tcap ell)
    (ρ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (QfullOf G (stagCfg c t)) (zrow G ρ) = zfield (Wt ell isRow ρ)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.MassFull_zfield.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.MassFull_zfield
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.MassFull_zfield.header:
theorem MassFull_zfield {ell c : ℕ} {G : TowerGeom L} {isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (S : StagSetup L ell c G isRow) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < tcap ell)
    (a : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    MassFull G a (bondSectorOf G (stagCfg c t)) (zfield f) =
      zfield (Wt ell isRow (fun j v => a * fSum ell j f v))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zfield_mem_bondSu.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zfield_mem_bondSupp
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zfield_mem_bondSu.header:
theorem zfield_mem_bondSupp (G : TowerGeom L) (J : ℕ → Prop) (hOm : G.Om0 = {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L | J (z 0).val})
    (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hg : ∀ v, v ≤ L 0 → ¬ J v → g v = 0) : (zfield g : BondFnL2 L) ∈ bondSupp G

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nxt_prv.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nxt_prv
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nxt_prv.header: theorem nxt_prv (N v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ N) : nxt N (prv N v) = v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zprof_supp.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zprof_supp
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zprof_supp.header:
theorem zprof_supp (J : ℕ → Prop) (N c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ N) (hJ : ¬ J v) :
    zprof N (omegaW J N c t) f v = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zfield_add.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zfield_add
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zfield_add.header: theorem zfield_add (f g : ℕ → ℝ) : (zfield (f + g) : BondFnL2 L) = zfield f + zfield g

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zfield_add'.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zfield_add'
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zfield_add'.header: theorem zfield_add' (f g : ℕ → ℝ) : (zfield (fun v => f v + g v) : BondFnL2 L) = zfield f + zfield g

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.ginvProf.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.ginvProf
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.ginvProf.header: noncomputable def ginvProf (ell : ℕ) (isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) (J : ℕ → Prop) (N0 c : ℕ) (t a : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (v : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Ginv_zfield.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Ginv_zfield
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Ginv_zfield.header:
theorem Ginv_zfield {ell c : ℕ} (t : ℝ) (U : Cfg L) (hUc : U = stagCfg c t) {G : TowerGeom L} {isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (S : StagSetup L ell c G isRow) (J : ℕ → Prop)
    (hOm : G.Om0 = {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L | J (z 0).val})
    (hrowJ : ∀ j, j ≤ 2 → ∀ v, isRow j (ell ^ j * (v / ell ^ j)) → J v)
    (htπ : |t| < tcap ell) (a : ℝ) (Jf : BondFnL2 L) (f : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : (zfield f : BondFnL2 L) ∈ bondSupp G) :
    (((baseData G U a (bondSectorOf G U) Jf).Ginv ⟨zfield f, hf⟩ : ↥(bondSupp G)) : BondFnL2 L) =
      zfield (ginvProf ell isRow J (L 0) c t a f)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Crs.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Crs
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Crs.header: def Crs (s : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Crs_shift.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Crs_shift
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Crs_shift.header:
theorem Crs_shift {s : ℕ} (hdiv : ∀ μ, s ∣ L μ + 1) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : Crs s y) (μ : Fin 3) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : s ∣ m) : Crs s (coarseShift y m μ)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.endpoint_rep_ne.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.endpoint_rep_ne
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.endpoint_rep_ne.header:
theorem endpoint_rep_ne (s : ℕ) (μ ν : Fin 3) (hνμ : ν ≠ μ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (coarsePathEndpoint s y (List.replicate n μ)) ν = y ν

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crs_endpoint_rep.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crs_endpoint_rep
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crs_endpoint_rep.header:
theorem crs_endpoint_rep {s : ℕ} (hdiv : ∀ μ, s ∣ L μ + 1) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, Crs s y → Crs s (coarsePathEndpoint s y (List.replicate n μ))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.IsTemporal.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.IsTemporal
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.IsTemporal.header: def IsTemporal (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (a : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng.header:
noncomputable def tAng (s : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L → List (Fin 3) → ℝ
  | _, [] => 0
  | y, μ :: rest => (if μ = 0 then a (y 0).val else 0) + tAng s a (coarseShift y s μ) rest

theorem hol_temporal {s : ℕ} (hdiv : ∀ μ, s ∣ L μ + 1) {V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hV : IsTemporal s V a) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, Crs s y → coarsePathHolonomy s V y p = cartan (tAng s a y p)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hol_temporal.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hol_temporal

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng_append.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng_append
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng_append.header:
theorem tAng_append (s : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (p q : List (Fin 3)) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, tAng s a y (p ++ q) = tAng s a y p + tAng s a (coarsePathEndpoint s y p) q

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng_rep_ne.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng_rep_ne
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng_rep_ne.header:
theorem tAng_rep_ne (s : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (μ : Fin 3) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, tAng s a y (List.replicate n μ) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng_rep_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng_rep_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng_rep_zero.header:
theorem tAng_rep_zero (s : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, tAng s a y (List.replicate n 0) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, a (((y 0).val + s * j) % (L 0 + 1))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng_gamma.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng_gamma
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng_gamma.header:
theorem tAng_gamma (s : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (z y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    tAng s a z (coarseGammaPath s y x) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (((x 0 - (Function.update (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1 (x 1)) 0).val) / s),
        a (((z 0).val + s * j) % (L 0 + 1))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartan_comb.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartan_comb
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartan_comb.header:
theorem cartan_comb (a b c d : ℝ) (h : a + b - c - d = 0) :
    cartan a * cartan b * (cartan c)⁻¹ * (cartan d)⁻¹ = 1

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crs_of_mem_block.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crs_of_mem_block
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crs_of_mem_block.header:
theorem crs_of_mem_block {s ell : ℕ} {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : Crs s y) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) :
    Crs s x

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.telescope_loop.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.telescope_loop
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.telescope_loop.header:
theorem telescope_loop (a : ℕ → ℝ) (s ell N y0 n0 : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n0, a ((y0 + s * j) % N) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, a ((y0 + s * n0 + s * j) % N)
      - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n0, a (((y0 + s * ell) % N + s * j) % N) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, a ((y0 + s * j) % N) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.n0_eq.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.n0_eq
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.n0_eq.header:
theorem n0_eq {s ell : ℕ} {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) :
    (x 0).val = (y 0).val + s * ((x 0 - (Function.update (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1 (x 1)) 0).val / s)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng_loop_expr.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng_loop_expr
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tAng_loop_expr.header:
theorem tAng_loop_expr {s ell : ℕ} (a : ℕ → ℝ) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (μ : Fin 3) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) :
    tAng s a y (coarseGammaPath s y x) + tAng s a x (List.replicate ell μ)
      - tAng s a (cPlusS s ell (y, μ)) (coarseGammaPath s y x) - tAng s a y (List.replicate ell μ) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopVar_temporal.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopVar_temporal

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blocked_temporal.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blocked_temporal
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blocked_temporal.header:
theorem blocked_temporal {s ell : ℕ} (hdiv : ∀ μ, s ∣ L μ + 1) {V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hV : IsTemporal s V a) :
    IsTemporal (s * ell) (stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp s ell V)
      (fun v => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, a ((v + s * j) % (L 0 + 1)))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.siteOfF.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.siteOfF
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.siteOfF.header:
def siteOfF (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s ell : ℕ) (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + s * ell ≤ L μ + 1) (hs : 0 < s)
    (f : Fin 3 → Fin ell) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stepBlockOf_eq_im.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stepBlockOf_eq_image
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stepBlockOf_eq_im.header:
theorem stepBlockOf_eq_image (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + s * ell ≤ L μ + 1) :
    stepBlockOf y s ell = Finset.image (siteOfF y s ell hfit hs) Finset.univ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.siteOfF_injective.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.siteOfF_injective
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.siteOfF_injective.header:
theorem siteOfF_injective (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + s * ell ≤ L μ + 1) : Function.Injective (siteOfF y s ell hfit hs)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_pi_coord.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_pi_coord
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_pi_coord.header:
theorem sum_pi_coord {ell : ℕ} (μ : Fin 3) (h : Fin ell → ℝ) :
    ∑ f : Fin 3 → Fin ell, h (f μ) = (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ n : Fin ell, h n

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_block_dir.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_block_dir
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_block_dir.header:
theorem sum_block_dir (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + s * ell ≤ L μ + 1) (μ : Fin 3) (g : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, g (((x μ).val - (y μ).val) / s) = (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range ell, g n

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.altsum.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.altsum
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.altsum.header: theorem altsum (v n : ℕ) : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, sgnNat (v + j) = if n % 2 = 0 then 0 else sgnNat v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.altsum_abs_le.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.altsum_abs_le
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.altsum_abs_le.header: theorem altsum_abs_le (v n : ℕ) : |∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, sgnNat (v + j)| ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAng_gamma.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAng_gamma
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAng_gamma.header:
theorem pathAng_gamma (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (w y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pathAng c t s w (coarseGammaPath s y x) =
      if (w 0).val = c then
        t * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s), sgnNat ((w 1).val + s * j) else 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartan_comb'.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartan_comb'
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartan_comb'.header:
theorem cartan_comb' (a b c d : ℝ) :
    cartan a * cartan b * (cartan c)⁻¹ * (cartan d)⁻¹ = cartan (a + b - c - d)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stagPhi.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stagPhi
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stagPhi.header: noncomputable def stagPhi (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stag_angle_expr.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stag_angle_expr
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stag_angle_expr.header:
theorem stag_angle_expr (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    pathAng c t 1 y (coarseGammaPath 1 y x) + pathAng c t 1 x (List.replicate ell μ)
      - pathAng c t 1 (cPlusS 1 ell (y, μ)) (coarseGammaPath 1 y x) - pathAng c t 1 y (List.replicate ell μ)
      = stagPhi c t μ ell y x

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopVar_stag.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopVar_stag
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loopVar_stag.header:
theorem loopVar_stag (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    loopVar 1 ell (stagCfg c t) (y, μ) x = cartan (stagPhi c t μ ell y x)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_odd_even.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_odd_even
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_odd_even.header: theorem sum_odd_even (m : ℕ) (a : ℝ) : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (2 * m), (if n % 2 = 0 then (0 : ℝ) else a) = m * a

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stagPhi_abs_lt.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stagPhi_abs_lt
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stagPhi_abs_lt.header:
theorem stagPhi_abs_lt (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < Real.pi) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    |stagPhi c t μ ell y x| < Real.pi

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bg1_stag.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bg1_stag
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bg1_stag.header:
theorem bg1_stag (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < Real.pi)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + 1 * ell ≤ L μ + 1) (μ : Fin 3) :
    stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp 1 ell (stagCfg c t) (y, μ) =
      cartan (if μ = 0 then (t / 2) * sgnNat (y 1).val *
        ((if (y 0).val = c then 1 else 0) - (if ((y 0).val + ell) % (L 0 + 1) = c then 1 else 0)) else 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.logF_contDiffAt.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.logF_contDiffAt
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.logF_contDiffAt.header: theorem logF_contDiffAt (g0 : M2) (h : |a0F g0| < 1) : ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ logF g0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.su2Log_eq_logF.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.su2Log_eq_logF
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.su2Log_eq_logF.header: theorem su2Log_eq_logF (g : SU2) : su2Log g = logF (g : M2)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mem_LogReg2_of_ne.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mem_LogReg2_of_ne_negOne
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mem_LogReg2_of_ne.header: theorem mem_LogReg2_of_ne_negOne (g : SU2) (hg : g ≠ su2NegOne) : (g : M2) ∈ LogReg2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.su2Log_comp_contD.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.su2Log_comp_contDiffAt_reg2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.su2Log_comp_contD.header:
theorem su2Log_comp_contDiffAt_reg2 {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (G : E → SU2) {n : WithTop ℕ∞} (hn : n ≤ ⊤)
    (hG : ContDiffAt ℝ n (fun A => (G A : M2)) 0) (hG0 : ((G 0 : SU2) : M2) ∈ LogReg2) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ n (fun A => su2Log (G A)) 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RegBg2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RegBg2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RegBg2.header: def RegBg2 (s ell : ℕ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.regBg2_of_ne_negO.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.regBg2_of_ne_negOne
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.regBg2_of_ne_negO.header:
theorem regBg2_of_ne_negOne (s ell : ℕ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (h : ∀ (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L), x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell → loopVar s ell V0 c x ≠ su2NegOne) :
    RegBg2 s ell V0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RegBg2_of_RegBg.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RegBg2_of_RegBg
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RegBg2_of_RegBg.header: theorem RegBg2_of_RegBg {s ell : ℕ} {V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} (h : RegBg s ell V0) : RegBg2 s ell V0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.SG_su2Exp_sum_log.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.SG_su2Exp_sum_log2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.SG_su2Exp_sum_log.header:
theorem SG_su2Exp_sum_log2 {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (q : ℚ) (G : ι → E → SU2) (hG : ∀ i ∈ s, SG (G i))
    (hreg : ∀ i ∈ s, (((G i 0 : SU2)) : M2) ∈ LogReg2) :
    SG (fun A => su2Exp (∑ i ∈ s, q • su2Log (G i A)))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.SG_avg_prod2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.SG_avg_prod2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.SG_avg_prod2.header:
theorem SG_avg_prod2 (s ell : ℕ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (hreg : RegBg2 s ell V0)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    SG (fun A : XS L => stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp s ell (prodCfgX V0 A) c)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.SG_rawStep2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.SG_rawStep2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.SG_rawStep2.header:
theorem SG_rawStep2 (s ell : ℕ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (hreg : RegBg2 s ell V0)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    SG (fun A : XS L => rawStep s ell V0 (expCfgX A) c)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qStepX_contDiffAt.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qStepX_contDiffAt2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qStepX_contDiffAt.header:
theorem qStepX_contDiffAt2 (s ell : ℕ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (hreg : RegBg2 s ell V0) : ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ (qStepX s ell V0) 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RegTower2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RegTower2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RegTower2.header: def RegTower2 (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (J : ℕ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qCompX_contDiffAt.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qCompX_contDiffAt2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qCompX_contDiffAt.header:
theorem qCompX_contDiffAt2 (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (J : ℕ)
    (hreg : RegTower2 ell bg J) : ∀ j, j ≤ J → ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ (qCompX ell bg j) 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.QlinCompX_succ2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.QlinCompX_succ2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.QlinCompX_succ2.header:
theorem QlinCompX_succ2 (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (J : ℕ)
    (hreg : RegTower2 ell bg J) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < J) :
    QlinCompX ell bg (j + 1) = (QlinStepX (ell ^ j) ell (bg j)).comp (QlinCompX ell bg j)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.C2CompX_succ2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.C2CompX_succ2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.C2CompX_succ2.header:
theorem C2CompX_succ2 (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (J : ℕ)
    (hreg : RegTower2 ell bg J) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < J) (a : XS L) :
    C2CompX ell bg (j + 1) a
      = QlinStepX (ell ^ j) ell (bg j) (C2CompX ell bg j a)
        + C2StepX (ell ^ j) ell (bg j) (QlinCompX ell bg j a)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_site_x0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_site_x0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_site_x0.header:
theorem sum_site_x0 (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (h : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, h (x 0).val = ((L 1 + 1) * (L 2 + 1) : ℕ) * ∑ v ∈ range (L 0 + 1), h v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.thetaOf_zfun.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.thetaOf_zfun
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.thetaOf_zfun.header:
theorem thetaOf_zfun {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (f : ℕ → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    thetaOf (zfun f : Bond L → SuTwo) (x, 1) = f (x 0).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.inner_zfield_zfie.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.inner_zfield_zfield
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.inner_zfield_zfie.header:
theorem inner_zfield_zfield (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (f h : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ (zfield f : BondFnL2 L) (zfield h) : ℝ) =
      c0 * (((L 1 + 1) * (L 2 + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * ∑ v ∈ range (L 0 + 1), f v * h v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_eq_sum_single.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_eq_sum_single
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_eq_sum_single.header:
theorem BF_eq_sum_single {n : ℕ} (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e f : Fin n → ℝ) :
    BF C c e f = ∑ x : Fin n, f x * BF C c e (Pi.single x 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_genForm.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_genForm
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_genForm.header:
theorem nested_genForm (hell3 : 3 ≤ ell) (hE : StagOK ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (a t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < tcap ell)
    (hN : IsUnit (GenP.Nmat (Pn ell M R (by omega) a t))) (hG1 : IsUnit (Pn ell M R (by omega) a t).G1inv)
    (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hblk : ∀ q : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range ell, g (ell * q + n) = 0) (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ)
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub (rowOfN ell M R) → BF (neC ell M R - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos t) e d = 0)
    (hS : ∀ j, j ≤ 2 → ∀ r, isRowN ell M R j r → fSum ell j (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) r = (ell : ℝ) ^ j * rhoY ell g j r) :
    GenP.genForm (Pn ell M R (by omega) a t) (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (Pn ell M R (by omega) a t) (zfun g))) =
      (Pn ell M R (by omega) a t).eta *
        (c0 * ((((scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) 1 + 1) * ((scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) 2 + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          qF (neC ell M R - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos t) e + Kc ell M R a g) -
      a * (c0 * (((neLu M R 1 + 1) * (neLu M R 2 + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        ∑ v ∈ range (neLu M R 0 + 1), g v * g v)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_row_of_isRo.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_row_of_isRowN
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_row_of_isRo.header:
theorem chain_row_of_isRowN (hg : NGeo ell M R) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) {r : ℕ} (hr : isRowN ell M R j r) :
    ∃ i, i < RN hg ∧ neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R i = r ∧ lnN ell M R i = ell ^ j

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.f0N.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.f0N
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.f0N.header: noncomputable def f0N (ell M R i1 p : ℕ) : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.gU.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.gU
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.gU.header: noncomputable def gU (M R p : ℕ) : ℕ → ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fSum_eq_rowsum.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fSum_eq_rowsum
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fSum_eq_rowsum.header:
theorem fSum_eq_rowsum (hg : NGeo ell M R) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) {r i : ℕ} (hiR : i < RN hg)
    (hir : neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R i = r) (hli : lnN ell M R i = ell ^ j) (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ) :
    fSum ell j (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) r =
      ∑ x ∈ (univ.filter (fun x : Fin (nN ell M R) => rowOfN ell M R x.val = i)), e x

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowsum_f0N.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowsum_f0N
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowsum_f0N.header:
theorem rowsum_f0N (hg : NGeo ell M R) {i1 p : ℕ} (hp : i1 + p + 1 < RN hg) {i : ℕ} (hiR : i < RN hg) :
    ∑ x ∈ (univ.filter (fun x : Fin (nN ell M R) => rowOfN ell M R x.val = i)), f0N ell M R i1 p x =
      (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((if i1 + p = i then 1 else 0) - (if i1 + p + 1 = i then 1 else 0))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hS_nested.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hS_nested
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hS_nested.header:
theorem hS_nested (hg : NGeo ell M R) {i1 : ℕ} (hi1 : i1 + (ell + 1) + R * M < RN hg)
    (hst : ∀ j, j ≤ ell + 1 → neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R (i1 + j) = ell ^ 2 * (u0N M R + j))
    (hln : ∀ j, j ≤ ell + 1 → lnN ell M R (i1 + j) = ell ^ 2) {p : ℕ} (hp : p + 1 ≤ ell + 1)
    (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ) (he : e - f0N ell M R i1 p ∈ Vsub (rowOfN ell M R)) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ 2 → ∀ r, isRowN ell M R j r →
      fSum ell j (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) r = (ell : ℝ) ^ j * rhoY ell (gU M R p) j r

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.exists_saddle.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.exists_saddle

    ∃ e : Fin n → ℝ, e - f₀ ∈ V ∧ ∀ d ∈ V, BF C c e d = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.IsCrossingN.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.IsCrossingN

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crossing_unique.header: theorem crossing_unique {ell M R : ℕ} {c1 c2 : ℝ} (h1 : IsCrossingN ell M R c1) (h2 : IsCrossingN ell M R c2) : c1 = c2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_f0N.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_f0N
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_f0N.header:
theorem BF_f0N (hg : NGeo ell M R) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (es : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ) {i1 p : ℕ} (hp : i1 + p + 1 < RN hg) :
    BF C c (f0N ell M R i1 p) es =
      (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * (rowMu C c es (stN ell M R) (i1 + p) - rowMu C c es (stN ell M R) (i1 + p + 1))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_Zchain.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_Zchain
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_Zchain.header:
theorem nested_Zchain (hg : NGeo ell M R) (hell3 : 3 ≤ ell) (hMe : ell + 1 ≤ M) :
    ∃ cs : ℝ, -1 < cs ∧ cs < 1 ∧ IsCrossingN ell M R cs ∧ ∃ i1 p : ℕ, p + 1 ≤ ell + 1 ∧ (p = 0 ∨ p = ell) ∧ i1 + (ell + 1) + R * M < RN hg ∧
      (∀ j, j ≤ ell + 1 → neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R (i1 + j) = ell ^ 2 * (u0N M R + j)) ∧
      (∀ j, j ≤ ell + 1 → lnN ell M R (i1 + j) = ell ^ 2) ∧
      ∀ M0 : ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, cs < c → c < cs + ε → c ≤ 1 →
        ∃ e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ,
          (∀ d : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub (rowOfN ell M R) → BF (neC ell M R - neP0 ell M R) c e d = 0) ∧
          (∀ j, j ≤ 2 → ∀ r, isRowN ell M R j r →
            fSum ell j (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) r = (ell : ℝ) ^ j * rhoY ell (gU M R p) j r) ∧
          qF (neC ell M R - neP0 ell M R) c e < M0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_genForm_ne.header:
theorem nested_genForm_neg (hell3 : 3 ≤ ell) (hE : StagOK ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hMe : ell + 3 ≤ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (a : ℝ) :
    ∃ cs : ℝ, Real.cos (tcap ell) < cs ∧ cs < 1 ∧ IsCrossingN ell M R cs ∧ ∃ p : ℕ, (p = 0 ∨ p = ell) ∧ ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < tcap ell → cs < Real.cos t → Real.cos t < cs + ε →

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_G1inv_eq.header:
theorem nested_G1inv_eq (hell3 : 3 ≤ ell) (hE : StagOK ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (a t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < tcap ell)
    (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ)
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub (rowOfN ell M R) → BF (neC ell M R - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos t) e d = 0)
    (hf : (zfield (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) ∈ bondSupp (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)))
    (hv : (zfield (Wt ell (isRowN ell M R) (rhoV ell M R (neC ell M R - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos t) a e)) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) ∈
      bondSupp (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R))) :
    (((Pn ell M R (by omega) a t).G1inv ⟨zfield (fe (neP0 ell M R) e), hf⟩ : ↥(bondSupp (Pn ell M R (by omega) a t).G)) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) =
      zfield (Wt ell (isRowN ell M R) (rhoV ell M R (neC ell M R - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos t) a e))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Pn_genC.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Pn_tau_adjoint.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_Q_eq.header:
theorem nested_Q_eq (hell3 : 3 ≤ ell) (hE : StagOK ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (a t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < tcap ell)
    (g : ℕ → ℝ) (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ)

    QfullOf (Pn ell M R (by omega) a t).G (stagCfg (neC ell M R) t) (zfield (fe (neP0 ell M R) e)) =
      zrow (Pn ell M R (by omega) a t).G (rhoY ell g)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.inner_Wt_split.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.inner_Wt_split
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.inner_Wt_split.header:
theorem inner_Wt_split (hell3 : 3 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ)
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub (rowOfN ell M R) → BF (neC ell M R - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos t) e d = 0) :
    (inner ℝ (zfield (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))
        (zfield (Wt ell (isRowN ell M R) (rhoV ell M R (neC ell M R - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos t) a e))) : ℝ) =
      c0 * ((((scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) 1 + 1) * ((scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) 2 + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        qF (neC ell M R - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos t) e +
      (inner ℝ (zfield (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))
        (zfield (Wt ell (isRowN ell M R) (fun j u => a * fSum ell j (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) u))) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zrow_congr_nested.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_firstTerm.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_firstTerm
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_firstTerm.header:
theorem nested_firstTerm (hell3 : 3 ≤ ell) (hE : StagOK ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (a t : ℝ) (htπ : |t| < tcap ell)
    (hN : IsUnit (GenP.Nmat (Pn ell M R (by omega) a t))) (hG1 : IsUnit (Pn ell M R (by omega) a t).G1inv)
    (g : ℕ → ℝ) (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ)
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub (rowOfN ell M R) → BF (neC ell M R - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos t) e d = 0)
    (hS : ∀ j, j ≤ 2 → ∀ r, isRowN ell M R j r → fSum ell j (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) r = (ell : ℝ) ^ j * rhoY ell g j r) :
    GenP.firstTerm (Pn ell M R (by omega) a t) (zfield g) =
      (Pn ell M R (by omega) a t).eta *
        (c0 * ((((scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) 1 + 1) * ((scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) 2 + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          qF (neC ell M R - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos t) e + Kc ell M R a g)

def isRowN : ℕ → ℕ → Prop

  | 2, v => ell ^ 2 ∣ v ∧ reg2 ell M R v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.isStart_0.header: theorem isStart_0 {w : ℕ} (h : isRowN ell M R 0 w) : isStart ell M R w

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.isStart_1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.isStart_1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.isStart_1.header: theorem isStart_1 {w : ℕ} (h : isRowN ell M R 1 w) : isStart ell M R w

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.isStart_2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.isStart_2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.isStart_2.header: theorem isStart_2 {w : ℕ} (h : isRowN ell M R 2 w) : isStart ell M R w

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowLen_0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowLen_0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowLen_0.header: theorem rowLen_0 (v : ℕ) (h : reg0 ell M R v) : rowLenN ell M R v = 1

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowLen_2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowLen_2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowLen_2.header: theorem rowLen_2 (v : ℕ) (h0 : ¬ reg0 ell M R v) (h2 : reg2 ell M R v) : rowLenN ell M R v = ell ^ 2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowLen_1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowLen_1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowLen_1.header: theorem rowLen_1 (v : ℕ) (h0 : ¬ reg0 ell M R v) (h2 : ¬ reg2 ell M R v) : rowLenN ell M R v = ell

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.reg0_not_reg2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.reg0_not_reg2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.reg0_not_reg2.header: theorem reg0_not_reg2 (hg : NGeo ell M R) {v : ℕ} (h : reg0 ell M R v) : ¬ reg2 ell M R v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tile_step.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tile_step
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tile_step.header:
theorem tile_step (hg : NGeo ell M R) {v : ℕ} (hv : isStart ell M R v) :
    v + rowLenN ell M R v ≤ neQ0 ell M R ∧
    (v + rowLenN ell M R v = neQ0 ell M R ∨ isStart ell M R (v + rowLenN ell M R v)) ∧
    (v < neP1 ell M R → v + rowLenN ell M R v ≤ neP1 ell M R) ∧
    (v < neQ1 ell M R → v + rowLenN ell M R v ≤ neQ1 ell M R)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lnN.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lnN
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lnN.header: noncomputable def lnN (ell M R : ℕ) (i : ℕ) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_succ.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_succ
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_succ.header: theorem stN_succ (i : ℕ) : stN ell M R (i + 1) = stN ell M R i + lnN ell M R i

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_zero.header: theorem stN_zero : stN ell M R 0 = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowLen_pos.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowLen_pos
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowLen_pos.header: theorem rowLen_pos (hg : NGeo ell M R) (v : ℕ) : 1 ≤ rowLenN ell M R v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_ge.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_ge
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_ge.header: theorem stN_ge (hg : NGeo ell M R) (i : ℕ) : i ≤ stN ell M R i

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.isStart_P0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.isStart_P0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.isStart_P0.header: theorem isStart_P0 (hg : NGeo ell M R) : isStart ell M R (neP0 ell M R)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_inv.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_inv
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_inv.header:
theorem stN_inv (hg : NGeo ell M R) : ∀ i, (∀ j, j < i → neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R j < neQ0 ell M R) →
    neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R i ≤ neQ0 ell M R ∧
      (neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R i < neQ0 ell M R → isStart ell M R (neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R i))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.exists_hit.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.exists_hit
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.exists_hit.header: theorem exists_hit (hg : NGeo ell M R) : ∃ i, neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R i = neQ0 ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_strict.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_strict
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_strict.header: theorem stN_strict (hg : NGeo ell M R) (i : ℕ) : stN ell M R i < stN ell M R (i + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_mono.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_mono
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_mono.header: theorem stN_mono (hg : NGeo ell M R) {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) : stN ell M R i ≤ stN ell M R j

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_strictMono.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_strictMono
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_strictMono.header: theorem stN_strictMono (hg : NGeo ell M R) {i j : ℕ} (h : i < j) : stN ell M R i < stN ell M R j

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_inj.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_inj
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_inj.header: theorem stN_inj (hg : NGeo ell M R) {i j : ℕ} (h : stN ell M R i = stN ell M R j) : i = j

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RN.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RN
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RN.header: noncomputable def RN (hg : NGeo ell M R) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RN_hit.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RN_hit
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RN_hit.header: theorem RN_hit (hg : NGeo ell M R) : neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R (RN hg) = neQ0 ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RN_lt.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RN_lt
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RN_lt.header: theorem RN_lt (hg : NGeo ell M R) : ∀ j, j < RN hg → neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R j < neQ0 ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RN_start.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RN_start
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RN_start.header: theorem RN_start (hg : NGeo ell M R) : ∀ j, j < RN hg → isStart ell M R (neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R j)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RN_pos.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RN_pos
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RN_pos.header: theorem RN_pos (hg : NGeo ell M R) : 0 < RN hg

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_RN.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_RN
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_RN.header: theorem stN_RN (hg : NGeo ell M R) : stN ell M R (RN hg) = nN ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_left.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_left
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_left.header: theorem stN_left (hg : NGeo ell M R) : ∀ i, i ≤ R * M → stN ell M R i = i

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lnN_left.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lnN_left
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lnN_left.header: theorem lnN_left (hg : NGeo ell M R) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < R * M) : lnN ell M R i = 1

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.iQ.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.iQ
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.iQ.header: noncomputable def iQ (hg : NGeo ell M R) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.iQ_hit.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.iQ_hit
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.iQ_hit.header: theorem iQ_hit (hg : NGeo ell M R) : neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R (iQ hg) = neQ1 ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_right.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_right
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_right.header: theorem stN_right (hg : NGeo ell M R) : ∀ k, k ≤ R * M → neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R (iQ hg + k) = neQ1 ell M R + k

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.iQ_RN.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.iQ_RN
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.iQ_RN.header: theorem iQ_RN (hg : NGeo ell M R) : RN hg = iQ hg + R * M

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lnN_right.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lnN_right
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lnN_right.header: theorem lnN_right (hg : NGeo ell M R) {i : ℕ} (h1 : iQ hg ≤ i) (h2 : i < RN hg) : lnN ell M R i = 1

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lnN_mid.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lnN_mid
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lnN_mid.header: theorem lnN_mid (hg : NGeo ell M R) {i : ℕ} (h1 : R * M ≤ i) (h2 : i < iQ hg) : 2 ≤ lnN ell M R i

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowOfN.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowOfN
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowOfN.header: noncomputable def rowOfN (ell M R x : ℕ) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowOfN_spec.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowOfN_spec
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowOfN_spec.header:
theorem rowOfN_spec (hg : NGeo ell M R) {x : ℕ} (hx : x < nN ell M R) :
    rowOfN ell M R x < RN hg ∧ stN ell M R (rowOfN ell M R x) ≤ x ∧ x < stN ell M R (rowOfN ell M R x + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_rowGeom.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_rowGeom
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_rowGeom.header:
theorem nested_rowGeom (hg : NGeo ell M R) :
    RowGeomD (nN ell M R) (RN hg) (R * M) (R * M) (stN ell M R) (lnN ell M R) (rowOfN ell M R)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hit_of_nojump.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hit_of_nojump
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hit_of_nojump.header:
theorem hit_of_nojump (hg : NGeo ell M R) {T : ℕ} (hT0 : neP0 ell M R < T) (hTQ : T ≤ neQ0 ell M R)
    (hnj : ∀ v, isStart ell M R v → v < T → v + rowLenN ell M R v ≤ T) :
    ∃ i, i ≤ RN hg ∧ neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R i = T

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.layer_dvd.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.layer_dvd
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.layer_dvd.header: theorem layer_dvd (hg : NGeo ell M R) : ell ^ 2 ∣ neC ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.layer_lo.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.layer_lo
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.layer_lo.header: theorem layer_lo (hg : NGeo ell M R) : neA' ell M R ≤ neC ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.layer_hi.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.layer_hi
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.layer_hi.header: theorem layer_hi (hg : NGeo ell M R) : neC ell M R + ell ^ 2 ≤ neB' ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hit_C.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hit_C
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hit_C.header: theorem hit_C (hg : NGeo ell M R) : ∃ i, i ≤ RN hg ∧ neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R i = neC ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hit_aligned2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hit_aligned2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hit_aligned2.header:
theorem hit_aligned2 (hg : NGeo ell M R) {T : ℕ} (hT : ell ^ 2 ∣ T) (hT0 : neP0 ell M R < T) (hTQ : T ≤ neQ0 ell M R) :
    ∃ i, i ≤ RN hg ∧ neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R i = T

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_level2_succ.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_level2_succ
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.stN_level2_succ.header:
theorem stN_level2_succ (hg : NGeo ell M R) {i : ℕ} (hv : isRowN ell M R 2 (neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R i)) :
    lnN ell M R i = ell ^ 2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fat_bounds.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fat_bounds
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fat_bounds.header:
theorem fat_bounds (hg : NGeo ell M R) (hM : ell ≤ M) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ ell) :
    neA ell M R ≤ ell ^ 2 * (u0N M R + j) ∧ ell ^ 2 * (u0N M R + j) < neB ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fat_reg2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fat_reg2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fat_reg2.header:
theorem fat_reg2 (hg : NGeo ell M R) (hM : ell ≤ M) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ ell) :
    isRowN ell M R 2 (ell ^ 2 * (u0N M R + j))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fat_rows.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fat_rows
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fat_rows.header:
theorem fat_rows (hg : NGeo ell M R) (hM : ell ≤ M) {i1 : ℕ} (hi1 : neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R i1 = ell ^ 2 * u0N M R) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ ell → neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R (i1 + j) = ell ^ 2 * (u0N M R + j)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_chain_data.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_chain_data
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_chain_data.header:
theorem nested_chain_data (hg : NGeo ell M R) (hM : ell + 1 ≤ M) :
    ∃ i0 i1 K k r : ℕ, R * M + 1 ≤ i0 ∧ i0 + R * M < RN hg ∧ stN ell M R i0 = K + 1 ∧ lnN ell M R i0 = k + 3 ∧
      nN ell M R = (K + 1) + (k + 3) + r ∧ neC ell M R = neP0 ell M R + (K + 1) ∧
      i0 < i1 ∧ i1 + (ell + 1) + R * M < RN hg ∧ (∀ j, j ≤ ell + 1 → lnN ell M R (i1 + j) = ell ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ j, j ≤ ell + 1 → neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R (i1 + j) = ell ^ 2 * (u0N M R + j)) ∧ k + 3 = ell ^ 2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Omv.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Omv
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Omv.header:
def Omv (ell M R : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop
  | 0, v => neP0 ell M R ≤ v ∧ v < neQ0 ell M R
  | 1, v => neP1 ell M R ≤ v ∧ v < neQ1 ell M R
  | 2, v => reg2 ell M R v
  | _, _ => False

theorem Omv_ge3 {j : ℕ} (hj : 3 ≤ j) (v : ℕ) : ¬ Omv ell M R j v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Omv_ge3.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Omv_ge3
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Omv_ge3.header: theorem Omv_ge3 {j : ℕ} (hj : 3 ≤ j) (v : ℕ) : ¬ Omv ell M R j v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Omv_site.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Omv_site
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Omv_site.header:
theorem Omv_site (j : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) :
    x ∈ (neS ell M R).Om j ↔ Omv ell M R j (x 0).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe0.header: def omGe0 (ell M R : ℕ) (j v : ℕ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mem_Lam.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mem_Lam
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mem_Lam.header:
theorem mem_Lam (j : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) (S : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))) :
    x ∈ (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)).Lam j ↔ Crs (ell ^ j) x ∧ Omv ell M R j (x 0).val ∧ ¬ Omv ell M R (j + 1) (x 0).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blk_lt.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blk_lt
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blk_lt.header: theorem blk_lt {m w q v : ℕ} (hw : m ∣ w) (hq : m ∣ q) (hwq : w < q) (hv : v < w + m) : v < q

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.down_blk.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.down_blk
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.down_blk.header:
theorem down_blk {m p q v : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hp : m ∣ p) (hpv : p ≤ v) :
    p ≤ m * (v / m) ∧ m ∣ m * (v / m) ∧ m * (v / m) ≤ v ∧ v < m * (v / m) + m

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe_iff.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe_iff
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe_iff.header:
theorem omGe_iff (j : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) (hell : 0 < ell) (hM : 0 < M) :
    OmGe (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) j x ↔ omGe0 ell M R j (x 0).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe0_3.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe0_3
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe0_3.header: theorem omGe0_3 (v : ℕ) : ¬ omGe0 ell M R 3 v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe0_2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe0_2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe0_2.header: theorem omGe0_2 (hg : NGeo ell M R) (v : ℕ) : omGe0 ell M R 2 v ↔ reg2 ell M R v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe0_mono.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe0_mono
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe0_mono.header: theorem omGe0_mono {j j' v : ℕ} (h : j ≤ j') (hv : omGe0 ell M R j' v) : omGe0 ell M R j v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe0_1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe0_1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.omGe0_1.header: theorem omGe0_1 (hg : NGeo ell M R) (v : ℕ) : omGe0 ell M R 1 v ↔ (neP1 ell M R ≤ v ∧ v < neQ1 ell M R)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dvd_scaleUp.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dvd_scaleUp
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dvd_scaleUp.header: theorem dvd_scaleUp (hell : 0 < ell) (hM : 0 < M) (μ : Fin 3) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) : ell ^ j ∣ scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R) μ + 1

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bondsLam_one_iff.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bondsLam_one_iff
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bondsLam_one_iff.header:
theorem bondsLam_one_iff (hg : NGeo ell M R) (hM : 0 < M) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) :
    (y, (1 : Fin 3)) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) j ↔ (Crs (ell ^ j) y ∧ isRowN ell M R j (y 0).val)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crs_of_bondsLam.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crs_of_bondsLam
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crs_of_bondsLam.header:
theorem crs_of_bondsLam (hg : NGeo ell M R) (hM : 0 < M) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2)
    (b : Bond (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) (hb : b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) j) : Crs (ell ^ j) b.1

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.ne_QN.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.ne_QN
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.ne_QN.header: theorem ne_QN (hell : 3 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) : neQ0 ell M R ≤ neN ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_stagSetup.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_stagSetup
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nested_stagSetup.header:
theorem nested_stagSetup (hell3 : 3 ≤ ell) (hE : StagOK ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) :
    StagSetup (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) ell (neC ell M R) (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) (isRowN ell M R)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.levN.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.levN
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.levN.header: noncomputable def levN (ell M R v : ℕ) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rstartN.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rstartN
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rstartN.header: noncomputable def rstartN (ell M R v : ℕ) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.levN_0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.levN_0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.levN_0.header: theorem levN_0 {v : ℕ} (h : reg0 ell M R v) : levN ell M R v = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.levN_2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.levN_2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.levN_2.header: theorem levN_2 {v : ℕ} (h0 : ¬ reg0 ell M R v) (h2 : reg2 ell M R v) : levN ell M R v = 2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.levN_1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.levN_1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.levN_1.header: theorem levN_1 {v : ℕ} (h0 : ¬ reg0 ell M R v) (h2 : ¬ reg2 ell M R v) : levN ell M R v = 1

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.reg0_or.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.reg0_or
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.reg0_or.header:
theorem reg0_or (hg : NGeo ell M R) {v : ℕ} (hv : neP0 ell M R ≤ v ∧ v < neQ0 ell M R) :
    reg0 ell M R v ∨ reg1 ell M R v ∨ reg2 ell M R v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.row_unique.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.row_unique
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.row_unique.header:
theorem row_unique (hg : NGeo ell M R) {v : ℕ} (hv : neP0 ell M R ≤ v ∧ v < neQ0 ell M R) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) :
    isRowN ell M R j (ell ^ j * (v / ell ^ j)) ↔ j = levN ell M R v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.isRowN_dvd.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.isRowN_dvd
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.isRowN_dvd.header: theorem isRowN_dvd {j v : ℕ} (h : isRowN ell M R j v) : ell ^ j ∣ v ∧ j ≤ 2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowLen_of_isRowN.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowLen_of_isRowN
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowLen_of_isRowN.header: theorem rowLen_of_isRowN (hg : NGeo ell M R) {j v : ℕ} (h : isRowN ell M R j v) : rowLenN ell M R v = ell ^ j

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_row_level.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_row_level
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_row_level.header:
theorem chain_row_level (hg : NGeo ell M R) {x : ℕ} (hx : x < nN ell M R) :
    neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R (rowOfN ell M R x) = rstartN ell M R (neP0 ell M R + x) ∧
    lnN ell M R (rowOfN ell M R x) = ell ^ levN ell M R (neP0 ell M R + x)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_range_mul'.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_range_mul'
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_range_mul'.header:
theorem sum_range_mul' (b : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) : ∀ a : ℕ,
    ∑ m ∈ range (b * a), g m = ∑ n ∈ range a, ∑ k ∈ range b, g (b * n + k)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fSum_eq_sum.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fSum_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fSum_eq_sum.header: theorem fSum_eq_sum (ell : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) : ∀ j v : ℕ, fSum ell j f v = ∑ k ∈ range (ell ^ j), f (v + k)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fe.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fe
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fe.header: noncomputable def fe {n : ℕ} (P0 : ℕ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) (v : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fe_at.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fe_at
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fe_at.header: theorem fe_at {n : ℕ} (P0 : ℕ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) (x : Fin n) : fe P0 e (P0 + x.val) = e x

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fe_lt.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fe_lt

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.ne_Q0_lt_N.header: theorem ne_Q0_lt_N (hell : 3 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) : neQ0 ell M R + 1 ≤ neN ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zprof_eq_BF.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zprof_eq_BF
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.zprof_eq_BF.header:
theorem zprof_eq_BF (hell3 : 3 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t : ℝ)
    (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ) (x : Fin (nN ell M R)) :
    zprof (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R) 0) (omegaW (fun v => neP0 ell M R ≤ v ∧ v < neQ0 ell M R) (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R) 0) (neC ell M R) t)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hrowJ_nested.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.levN_le.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.levN_le
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.levN_le.header: theorem levN_le (v : ℕ) : levN ell M R v ≤ 2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Wt_single.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Wt_single
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Wt_single.header:
theorem Wt_single (hg : NGeo ell M R) {v : ℕ} (hv : neP0 ell M R ≤ v ∧ v < neQ0 ell M R) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    Wt ell (isRowN ell M R) ρ v =
      (((ell : ℝ) ^ levN ell M R v)⁻¹) * ((((ell : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ levN ell M R v) * ρ (levN ell M R v) (rstartN ell M R v)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.ginv_eq_Wt.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.ginv_eq_Wt
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.ginv_eq_Wt.header:
theorem ginv_eq_Wt (hell3 : 3 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ)
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub (rowOfN ell M R) → BF (neC ell M R - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos t) e d = 0)
    (v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R) 0) :
    ginvProf ell (isRowN ell M R) (fun v => neP0 ell M R ≤ v ∧ v < neQ0 ell M R) (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R) 0) (neC ell M R) t a
        (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) v =
      Wt ell (isRowN ell M R) (rhoV ell M R (neC ell M R - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos t) a e) v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RowGeomD.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RowGeomD
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.RowGeomD.header: structure RowGeomD (n R a b : ℕ) (st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.st_monoD.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.st_monoD
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.st_monoD.header: theorem st_monoD {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) : st i ≤ st j

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.row_lt_nD.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.row_lt_nD
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.row_lt_nD.header:
theorem row_lt_nD {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < R) :
    st i + ln i ≤ n

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.filter_sum_rowD.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.filter_sum_rowD
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.filter_sum_rowD.header:
theorem filter_sum_rowD {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < R)
    (f : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (univ.filter (fun x : Fin n => rowOf x.val = i)), f x =
      ∑ j : Fin (ln i), f ⟨st i + j.val, by have := j.2; have := row_lt_nD g hi; omega⟩

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowSum_of_memD.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowSum_of_memD

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowEL_rawD.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowEL_rawD
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowEL_rawD.header:
theorem rowEL_rawD {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) {e : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF C c e d = 0) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < R) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, j < ln i →
      Wt C c (((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) * (nx e ((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ) - nx e (((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1)) -
        Wt C c ((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ) * (nx e (((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1) - nx e ((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ)) = rowMu C c e st i

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowEL_flatD.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowEL_flatD
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowEL_flatD.header:
theorem rowEL_flatD {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) {e : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF C c e d = 0) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < R)
    (hflat : ∀ j : ℕ, j < ln i → st i + j ≠ C - 1 ∧ st i + j ≠ C ∧ st i + j ≠ C + 1) :
    BlockELs (st i : ℤ) (ln i) (nx e) (rowMu C c e st i)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowEL_layerD.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowEL_layerD
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowEL_layerD.header:
theorem rowEL_layerD {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) {e : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF C c e d = 0) {i0 : ℕ} (hi : i0 < R)
    (hC : st i0 = C) (hL : 3 ≤ ln i0) :
    LayerELs (C : ℤ) (ln i0) (nx e) (rowMu C c e st i0) c

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowEL_prevD.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowEL_prevD
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rowEL_prevD.header:
theorem rowEL_prevD {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) {e : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF C c e d = 0) {i0 : ℕ} (hi : i0 < R) (hi1 : 1 ≤ i0)
    (hC : st i0 = C) (hz : nx e (C : ℤ) = 0 ∧ nx e (C : ℤ) - nx e ((C : ℤ) - 1) = 0) :
    BlockELs (st (i0 - 1) : ℤ) (ln (i0 - 1)) (nx e) (rowMu C c e st (i0 - 1))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.prevRow_fwd_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.prevRow_fwd_zero

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.layer_fwd_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.layer_fwd_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.layer_fwd_zero.header:
theorem layer_fwd_zero {s : ℤ} {L : ℕ} (hL : 3 ≤ L) {e : ℤ → ℝ} {m c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hel : LayerELs s L e m c) (hsum : BlockSums s L e)
    (hE : e s = 0) (hF : e s - e (s - 1) = 0)
    (hnl : ((L : ℝ) - 2) * ((L : ℝ) + 3) / 6 + 1 / c ≠ 0) :
    m = 0 ∧ (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ L → e (s + j) = 0) ∧ e (s + L) - e (s + L - 1) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.st_left.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.st_left
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.st_left.header: theorem st_left {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) : ∀ i, i ≤ a → st i = i

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.collar_left_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.collar_left_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.collar_left_zero.header:
theorem collar_left_zero {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) {e : Fin n → ℝ} (he : e ∈ Vsub rowOf)
    (hR : a ≤ R) : ∀ x, x < a → nx e (x : ℤ) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.radical_zero_of_f.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.radical_zero_of_first
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.radical_zero_of_f.header:
theorem radical_zero_of_first {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) {e : Fin n → ℝ} (he : e ∈ Vsub rowOf)
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF C c e d = 0)
    {i0 : ℕ} (ha1 : 1 ≤ a) (hia : a + 1 ≤ i0) (hi0b : i0 + b < R) (hC : st i0 = C) (hL : 3 ≤ ln i0)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (hnl : ((ln i0 : ℝ) - 2) * ((ln i0 : ℝ) + 3) / 6 + 1 / c ≠ 0)
    (h1 : nx e (a : ℤ) = 0) : e = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.st_add_windowD.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.st_add_windowD
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.st_add_windowD.header:
theorem st_add_windowD {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) (i1 Lw N : ℕ)
    (hLw : ∀ k, k ≤ N → ln (i1 + k) = Lw) : ∀ k, k ≤ N → (st (i1 + k) : ℤ) = (st i1 : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) * Lw

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.radical_zero_of_s.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.radical_zero_of_state
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.radical_zero_of_s.header:
theorem radical_zero_of_state {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) {e : Fin n → ℝ} (he : e ∈ Vsub rowOf)
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF C c e d = 0)
    {i0 : ℕ} (ha1 : 1 ≤ a) (hia : a + 1 ≤ i0) (hC : st i0 = C) (hL : 3 ≤ ln i0)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (hnl : ((ln i0 : ℝ) - 2) * ((ln i0 : ℝ) + 3) / 6 + 1 / c ≠ 0)
    {i1 : ℕ} (hi1 : i0 < i1) (hi1b : i1 + b < R) (hz0 : StateZero (nx e) (st i1 : ℤ)) : e = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qF_zero_eq_zeroD.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qF_zero_eq_zeroD
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qF_zero_eq_zeroD.header:
theorem qF_zero_eq_zeroD {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) (C : ℕ)
    (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) {i0 : ℕ} (hi01 : 1 ≤ i0) (hi0 : i0 + 1 < R) (hai : a ≤ i0) (hi0b : i0 + b < R) (hC : st i0 = C)
    {e : Fin n → ℝ} (he : e ∈ Vsub rowOf) (hq : qF C 0 e = 0) : e = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.e1vec_memD.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.e1vec_memD

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_smul_left.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_smul_left
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_smul_left.header: theorem BF_smul_left (C : ℕ) (c t : ℝ) (e f : Fin n → ℝ) : BF C c (t • e) f = t * BF C c e f

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_add_left.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_add_left
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_add_left.header: theorem BF_add_left (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e f g : Fin n → ℝ) : BF C c (e + f) g = BF C c e g + BF C c f g

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nx_smul.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nx_smul
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nx_smul.header: theorem nx_smul (t : ℝ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) (x : ℤ) : nx (t • e) x = t * nx e x

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nx_sub.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nx_sub
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.nx_sub.header: theorem nx_sub (e f : Fin n → ℝ) (x : ℤ) : nx (e - f) x = nx e x - nx f x

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_tailD.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_tailD
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_tailD.header:
theorem chain_tailD {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) {e : Fin n → ℝ} (he : e ∈ Vsub rowOf) (hne : e ≠ 0)
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF C c e d = 0)
    {i0 : ℕ} (ha1 : 1 ≤ a) (hia : a + 1 ≤ i0) (hC : st i0 = C) (hL : 3 ≤ ln i0)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (hnl : ((ln i0 : ℝ) - 2) * ((ln i0 : ℝ) + 3) / 6 + 1 / c ≠ 0)
    {i1 N Lw : ℕ} (hi1 : i0 < i1) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hi1N : i1 + N + b < R) (hLw : ∀ k, k ≤ N → ln (i1 + k) = Lw)
    {a b : ℕ} (hab : a < b) (hbN : b ≤ N)
    (ha : rowMu C c e st (i1 + a) = 0) (hb : rowMu C c e st (i1 + b) = 0) : False

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_poleD.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_poleD
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_poleD.header:
theorem chain_poleD {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf)
    {i0 K k r : ℕ} (ha1 : 1 ≤ a) (hb1 : 1 ≤ b) (hia : a + 1 ≤ i0) (hi0b : i0 + b < R) (hC : st i0 = K + 1) (hL : ln i0 = k + 3)
    (hn : n = (K + 1) + (k + 3) + r)
    {i1 N Lw : ℕ} (hi1 : i0 < i1) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hi1N : i1 + N + b < R) (hLw : ∀ j, j ≤ N → ln (i1 + j) = Lw) :
    ∃ cs : ℝ, cLoc (k + 2) < cs ∧ cs < 1 ∧ cs ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ es : Fin n → ℝ, es ∈ Vsub rowOf ∧ es ≠ 0 ∧
      qF (K + 1) cs es = 0 ∧ (∀ e : Fin n → ℝ, e ∈ Vsub rowOf → 0 ≤ qF (K + 1) cs e) ∧
      (∀ c : ℝ, cs < c → c ≤ 1 → ∀ e : Fin n → ℝ, e ∈ Vsub rowOf → e ≠ 0 → 0 < qF (K + 1) c e) ∧
      (∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF (K + 1) cs es d = 0) ∧
      (∀ e : Fin n → ℝ, e ∈ Vsub rowOf → qF (K + 1) cs e = 0 → ∃ t : ℝ, e = t • es) ∧
      ∀ a b : ℕ, a < b → b ≤ N → ¬ (rowMu (K + 1) cs es st (i1 + a) = 0 ∧ rowMu (K + 1) cs es st (i1 + b) = 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_comm.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_comm
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_comm.header: theorem BF_comm (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e f : Fin n → ℝ) : BF C c e f = BF C c f e

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_affine.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_affine
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_affine.header:
theorem BF_affine (C : ℕ) (c cs : ℝ) (e f : Fin n → ℝ) :
    BF C c e f = BF C cs e f + (c - cs) * (dlt e (C - 1) * dlt f (C - 1) + dlt e C * dlt f C)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qF_affine.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qF_affine
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qF_affine.header:
theorem qF_affine (C : ℕ) (c cs : ℝ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) :
    qF C c e = qF C cs e + (c - cs) * bF C e

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_self.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_self
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.BF_self.header: theorem BF_self (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) : BF C c e e = qF C c e

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blowup_bound.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blowup_bound
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blowup_bound.header:
theorem blowup_bound (C : ℕ) (V : Submodule ℝ (Fin n → ℝ)) (cs : ℝ) (es f₀ : Fin n → ℝ) (hes : es ∈ V)
    (hcs1 : -1 ≤ cs) (h0 : qF C cs es = 0) (hbF : 0 < bF C es) (hP : BF C cs f₀ es ≠ 0)
    (hpos : ∀ c : ℝ, cs < c → c ≤ 1 → ∀ d ∈ V, 0 ≤ qF C c d) (M : ℝ) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, cs < c → c < cs + ε → c ≤ 1 → ∀ f : Fin n → ℝ, f - f₀ ∈ V →
      (∀ d ∈ V, BF C c f d = 0) → qF C c f < M

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.window_rec.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.window_rec
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.window_rec.header:
theorem window_rec {L : ℕ} (hL : 2 ≤ L) (e : ℤ → ℝ) (m : ℕ → ℝ) (s0 : ℤ) (N : ℕ)
    (hEL : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N → BlockELs (s0 + (k : ℤ) * L) L e (m k))
    (hS : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N → BlockSums (s0 + (k : ℤ) * L) L e) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, k + 2 ≤ N → m (k + 2) + m k = -(4 * (L : ℝ) ^ 2 + 2) / ((L : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) * m (k + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_window_rec.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_window_rec
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_window_rec.header:
theorem chain_window_rec {R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hC2 : C + 1 < n) {e : Fin n → ℝ} (he : e ∈ Vsub rowOf)
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF C c e d = 0)
    {i0 : ℕ} (hC : st i0 = C) (hL : 3 ≤ ln i0)
    {i1 N Lw : ℕ} (hi1 : i0 < i1) (hi1N : i1 + N + b < R) (hLw : ∀ k, k ≤ N → ln (i1 + k) = Lw) (hLw2 : 2 ≤ Lw) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, k + 2 ≤ N → rowMu C c e st (i1 + k + 2) + rowMu C c e st (i1 + k) =
      -(4 * (Lw : ℝ) ^ 2 + 2) / ((Lw : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) * rowMu C c e st (i1 + k + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.phiT.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.phiT
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.phiT.header: def phiT (a : ℕ → ℝ) : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartanOf_phiT.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartanOf_phiT
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cartanOf_phiT.header: theorem cartanOf_phiT {V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {a : ℕ → ℝ} (hV : IsTemporal 1 V a) : V = cartanOf (phiT a)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_phiT.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_phiT
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_phiT.header: theorem pathAngG_phiT (s : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (p : List (Fin 3)) : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, pathAngG s (phiT a) y p = tAng s a y p

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.suCoordF_zfield.header: theorem suCoordF_zfield (f : ℕ → ℝ) : suCoordF (zfun f : Bond L → SuTwo) = aF (thetaF f)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.suCoordFInv_aF.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.suCoordFInv_aF
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.suCoordFInv_aF.header: theorem suCoordFInv_aF (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (b : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : (suCoordFInv (aF θ) : Bond L → SuTwo) b = dgS (θ b)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Q1jet_zfield_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Q1jet_zfield_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Q1jet_zfield_zero.header:
theorem Q1jet_zfield_zero {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdiv : ∀ μ, ell ∣ L μ + 1) {V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ}
    (hV : V0 = cartanOf θ) (hφ : ∀ cc : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf cc.1 1 ell, |loopAngG 1 ell θ cc.1 cc.2 x| < Real.pi)
    (hreg : RegBg2 1 ell V0) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hblk : ∀ q : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range ell, g (ell * q + n) = 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.C2tilde_zfield_ze.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.C2tilde_zfield_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.C2tilde_zfield_ze.header:

    (hV : V0 = cartanOf θ) (hφ : ∀ cc : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf cc.1 1 ell, |loopAngG 1 ell θ cc.1 cc.2 x| < Real.pi)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_BIdx_dep.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_BIdx_dep
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_BIdx_dep.header:
theorem sum_BIdx_dep {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : TowerGeom L) (F : BIdx G → ℝ) :
    ∑ p : BIdx G, F p = ∑ j : Fin (G.k + 1), ∑ b : Bond L, (if h : b ∈ bondsLam G j then F ⟨j, ⟨b, h⟩⟩ else 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.unitBondEmb_inj.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.unitBondEmb_inj
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.unitBondEmb_inj.header:
theorem unitBondEmb_inj (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) :

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.unitBondEmb_surj.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.unitBondEmb_surj
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.unitBondEmb_surj.header:

    (hb : Crs (ell ^ k) b.1) : ∃ e : Bond Lu, unitBondEmb ell k Lu hell e = b

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tau_adjoint_zfiel.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tau_adjoint_zfield
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.tau_adjoint_zfiel.header:
theorem tau_adjoint_zfield (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hcrs : ∀ b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) k, Crs (ell ^ k) b.1) (g : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell k Lu hell S) (zfield g) =
      zrow (geomOf ell k S) (fun j r => if j = k then g (r / ell ^ k) else 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Qpa_nonneg.header:

    ‖gradL2 U (siteMask G.Om0 f)‖ ^ 2 + ‖f - siteMask G.Om0 f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪f, (DelpA G U a + (1 - siteMask G.Om0)) f⟫

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.covConst_norm.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.delpA_unit.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.not_WDH_of_nearUn.header:
theorem not_WDH_of_nearUnitsRest (ell : ℕ) (hell3 : 3 ≤ ell) (hE : StagOK ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.stepAverage_diag.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.diagP_idem.header: theorem diagP_idem (X : SuTwo) : diagP (diagP X) = diagP X

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.diagP_RMap.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.diagP_RMap
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.diagP_RMap.header:
theorem diagP_RMap {V : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ} (hV : IsCartan V) (X : SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.RMap_diagP.header:
theorem RMap_diagP {V : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ} (hV : IsCartan V) (X : SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.diagP_RMap_comm.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.diagP_RMap_comm
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.diagP_RMap_comm.header:
theorem diagP_RMap_comm {V : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ} (hV : IsCartan V) (X : SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.diagP_RMap_offdi.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.diagP_RMap_offdiag
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.diagP_RMap_offdi.header:
theorem diagP_RMap_offdiag {V : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ} (hV : IsCartan V) (X : SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.diagP_grad.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.diagP_grad
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.diagP_grad.header:
theorem diagP_grad {U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L} (hU : CartanCfg U)

    diagP (gradValueCovariant U lam b) = diagP (lam (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)) - diagP (lam b.1)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.grad_diagP_comm.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.grad_diagP_comm
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.grad_diagP_comm.header:
theorem grad_diagP_comm {U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L} (hU : CartanCfg U)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) :
    gradValueCovariant U (fun x => diagP (lam x)) b = diagP (gradValueCovariant U lam b)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.grad_diagP_flat.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.grad_diagP_flat
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.grad_diagP_flat.header:
theorem grad_diagP_flat {U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L} (hU : CartanCfg U)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) :
    gradValueCovariant U (fun x => diagP (lam x)) b =
      gradValueCovariant (fun _ => (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)) (fun x => diagP (lam x)) b

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.diagP_symm.header: theorem diagP_symm (X Y : SuTwo) : ⟪diagP X, Y⟫ = ⟪X, diagP Y⟫

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.pwDiag_apply.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.pwDiag_apply
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.pwDiag_apply.header: theorem pwDiag_apply (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (f : PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => SuTwo)) (x : ι) : (pwDiag ι f) x = diagP (f x)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.pwDiag_symm.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.pwDiag_symm

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.pwDiag_adjoint.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.pwDiag_adjoint
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.pwDiag_adjoint.header: theorem pwDiag_adjoint (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (pwDiag ι) = pwDiag ι

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.lapFull_pwDiag_f.header:
theorem lapFull_pwDiag_flat {U : Cfg L} (hU : CartanCfg U) (f : SiteL2 L) :

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.layerCfg_cartan.header:

        (Function.update (fun _ => 1) ((xtG 3 (3 ^ m) R (by norm_num) (by positivity), 1) : Bond _) v)) ∧

theorem first_crossing {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (V : Submodule ℝ E) (a b : E → ℝ) (ha : Continuous a) (hb : Continuous b)
    (ha2 : ∀ (r : ℝ) (e : E), a (r • e) = r ^ 2 * a e) (hb2 : ∀ (r : ℝ) (e : E), b (r • e) = r ^ 2 * b e)
    (hbnn : ∀ e, 0 ≤ b e)
    (hpos : ∀ e ∈ V, e ≠ 0 → 0 < a e)
    (c1 : ℝ) (hc1 : c1 < 1) (e1 : E) (he1 : e1 ∈ V) (hneg : a e1 - (1 - c1) * b e1 < 0) :
    ∃ cs : ℝ, c1 < cs ∧ cs < 1 ∧ (∃ es ∈ V, es ≠ 0 ∧ a es - (1 - cs) * b es = 0) ∧
      (∀ e ∈ V, 0 ≤ a e - (1 - cs) * b e) ∧
      (∀ c : ℝ, cs < c → c ≤ 1 → ∀ e ∈ V, e ≠ 0 → 0 < a e - (1 - c) * b e)

      = hsInner (curlValueCovariant U A p) (curlValueCovariant U A p) ∧
      ((holonomyElem U p : SU2m) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) = 1) ∨
    (hsInner (curlValueCovariant U A p) (curlValueCovariant U A p) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * bilPlaq U p A A

      ((holonomyElem U p : SU2m) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) = -1)

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.amp_a.header: theorem amp_a {Q l : ℕ} (h : l + 1 = Q) : amp Q l = 5

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.amp_z.header: theorem amp_z {Q l : ℕ} (h1 : l + 1 ≠ Q) (h2 : l + 2 ≠ Q) : amp Q l = 0
