AdalyFormal.D1Literal.contrib.header: noncomputable def contrib (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2m L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.contrib_Afield.header:
theorem contrib_Afield (H : SlabH Om P Q N) (X : SuTwo) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (d : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections) :
    contrib (Uth Om Real.pi) (WithLp.ofLp (Afield Q X)) (z, d) =
      if d = d01 then Gv Q (hsInner X X) (z 0).val else 0

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.sum_layer.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.sum_layer
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.sum_layer.header:
theorem sum_layer (F : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ z : PeriodicLatticeSite L, F (z 0).val = Kcol L * ∑ a : Fin (L 0 + 1), F a.val

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.sum_ind.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.sum_ind
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.sum_ind.header:
theorem sum_ind (M c Q : ℕ) (hc : c ≤ Q) (hQ : Q < M) (v : ℝ) :
    ∑ a : Fin M, (if a.val + c = Q then v else 0) = v

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.Gv_decomp.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.Gv_decomp
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.Gv_decomp.header:
theorem Gv_decomp (Q : ℕ) (n : ℝ) (l : ℕ) :
    Gv Q n l = (if l + 1 = Q then -25 * n else 0) + (if l + 2 = Q then 9 * n else 0) + (if l + 3 = Q then 4 * n else 0)

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.amp_sq.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.amp_sq
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.amp_sq.header: theorem amp_sq (Q l : ℕ) : amp Q l ^ 2 = (if l + 1 = Q then 25 else 0) + (if l + 2 = Q then 4 else 0)

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.layer_sum_G.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.layer_sum_G
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.layer_sum_G.header:
theorem layer_sum_G (H : SlabH Om P Q N) (n : ℝ) :
    ∑ a : Fin (L 0 + 1), Gv Q n a.val = -12 * n

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.layer_sum_amp.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.layer_sum_amp
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.layer_sum_amp.header:
theorem layer_sum_amp (H : SlabH Om P Q N) :
    ∑ a : Fin (L 0 + 1), amp Q a.val ^ 2 = 29

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.form_value.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.form_value
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.form_value.header:
theorem form_value (H : SlabH Om P Q N) (X : SuTwo) :
    (inner ℝ (Afield Q X) (deltaKLocCLM (Uth Om Real.pi) (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (Afield Q X)) : ℝ)
      = -12 * Kcol L * hsInner X X

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.normsq_Afield.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.normsq_Afield
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.normsq_Afield.header:
theorem normsq_Afield (H : SlabH Om P Q N) (X : SuTwo) :
    ‖(Afield Q X : BondFnL2 L)‖ ^ 2 = 29 * Kcol L * hsInner X X

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.QlinB_supp_zero.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.QlinB_supp_zero
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.QlinB_supp_zero.header:
theorem QlinB_supp_zero {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (h9 : 9 * ell ≤ R * M) (U : Cfg L) (A : BondFnL2 L)
    (hsupp : ∀ e : Bond L, A e ≠ 0 → ∃ w : PeriodicLatticeSite L, w ∉ S.Om 0 ∧ pdist e.1 w ≤ 2)
    {j : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k) {b : Bond L} (hb : b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j) :
    (QlinB (geomOf ell k S) U j A) b = 0

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.Mass_supp_le.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.Mass_supp_le
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.Mass_supp_le.header:
theorem Mass_supp_le {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (h9 : 9 * ell ≤ R * M) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (A : BondFnL2 L)
    (hsupp : ∀ e : Bond L, A e ≠ 0 → ∃ w : PeriodicLatticeSite L, w ∉ S.Om 0 ∧ pdist e.1 w ≤ 2) :
    (inner ℝ A (MassFull (geomOf ell k S) a (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) U) A) : ℝ) ≤ a * ‖A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.Afield_hsupp.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.Afield_hsupp
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.Afield_hsupp.header:
theorem Afield_hsupp (H : SlabH Om P Q N) (X : SuTwo) (e : Bond L) (he : (Afield Q X) e ≠ 0) :
    ∃ w : PeriodicLatticeSite L, w ∉ Om ∧ pdist e.1 w ≤ 2

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.FthM_both_pi_neg.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.FthM_both_pi_neg
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.FthM_both_pi_neg.header:
theorem FthM_both_pi_neg (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M)
    {P Q N : ℕ} (H : SlabH (S.Om 0) P Q N) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha' : 29 * a < 12) (X : SuTwo) (hX : X ≠ 0) :
    ∃ v : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S)), ⟪v, FthM sJ bothSel hell0 a Lam (S := S) Real.pi v⟫ < 0

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.bondMask.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.bondMask
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.bondMask.header: noncomputable def bondMask (B : Set (Bond L)) : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.bondMask_apply.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.bondMask_apply
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.bondMask_apply.header:
theorem bondMask_apply (B : Set (Bond L)) (A : BondFnL2 L) (b : Bond L) :
    (bondMask B A) b = if b ∈ B then A b else 0

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.bondMask_symm.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.bondMask_symm
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.bondMask_symm.header:
theorem bondMask_symm (B : Set (Bond L)) (A A' : BondFnL2 L) :

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.bondMask_eq_self.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.bondMask_eq_self
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.bondMask_eq_self.header: theorem bondMask_eq_self (B : Set (Bond L)) (A : BondFnL2 L) (h : ∀ b, b ∉ B → A b = 0) : bondMask B A = A

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.bondMask_univ.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.bondMask_univ
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.bondMask_univ.header: theorem bondMask_univ (A : BondFnL2 L) : bondMask (Set.univ : Set (Bond L)) A = A

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.DpiFullM.header: noncomputable def DpiFullM (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.DeltaM_symm.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.DeltaM_symm

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.DpiFullM_symm.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.DpiFullM_symm
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.DpiFullM_symm.header:

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.DpiFullM_univ.header: theorem DpiFullM_univ (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) : DpiFullM sD allSel G U a = DpiFullS sD G U a

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.dataM_univ.header: theorem dataM_univ (P : IngrBParams) : dataM sD sJ allSel P = dataS sD sJ P

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.dataM_touch.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.dataM_touch

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.not_InstIneqM_of_n.header:
theorem not_InstIneqM_of_not_unit (sD sJ : PlaqSel) (bs : BondSel) (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (γ₀ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ₀)
    (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hnu : ¬ IsUnit (dataM sD sJ bs (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam)).Ginv)
    (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo) (h1 : OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt) (h2 : OnLambdaT Lam Bt)
    (hE : 0 < bondEnergy Bt) :
    ¬ InstIneqM sD sJ bs ell k hell a Lu γ₀ S Lam U

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.E0_DpiM_inner.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.E0_DpiM_inner
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.E0_DpiM_inner.header:
theorem E0_DpiM_inner {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (sD : PlaqSel) (bs : BondSel) (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (w : ↥(bondSupp G)) :
    ⟪w, ((pE G).comp ((DpiFullM sD bs G U a).comp (iE G))) w⟫ =
      ⟪Wop G U a (iE G w), DeltaM sD bs G U (Wop G U a (iE G w))⟫

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.FthM.header: noncomputable def FthM (θ : ℝ) : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S)) →L[ℝ] ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.FthM_diff.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.FthM_diff
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.FthM_diff.header:
theorem FthM_diff (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) (θ : ℝ) :
    FthM sJ bs hell0 a Lam (S := S) θ = FthM sJ bs hell0 a Lam (S := S) 0 +
      (pE (geomOf ell k S)).comp (((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Wop (geomOf ell k S) (Uth (S.Om 0) 0) a)).comp
        (((DeltaM selAll bs (geomOf ell k S) (Uth (S.Om 0) θ)) -
          (DeltaM selAll bs (geomOf ell k S) (Uth (S.Om 0) 0))).comp
          (Wop (geomOf ell k S) (Uth (S.Om 0) 0) a))).comp (iE (geomOf ell k S)))

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.FthM_symm.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.FthM_symm
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.FthM_symm.header:
theorem FthM_symm (θ : ℝ) (u v : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    ⟪FthM sJ bs hell0 a Lam (S := S) θ u, v⟫ = ⟪u, FthM sJ bs hell0 a Lam (S := S) θ v⟫

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.FthM_cont.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.FthM_cont
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.FthM_cont.header:
theorem FthM_cont (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) :
    Continuous fun θ => FthM sJ bs hell0 a Lam (S := S) θ

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.FthM_zero_psd.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.FthM_zero_psd
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.FthM_zero_psd.header: theorem FthM_zero_psd (ha : 0 ≤ a) : PSD (FthM sJ bs hell0 a Lam (S := S) 0)

AdalyFormal.D1Literal.exists_nonunit_Gin.name: AdalyFormal.D1Literal.exists_nonunit_GinvM
AdalyFormal.D1Literal.exists_nonunit_Gin.header:
theorem exists_nonunit_GinvM (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hneg : ∃ v : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S)), ⟪v, FthM sJ bs hell0 a Lam (S := S) Real.pi v⟫ < 0) :
    ∃ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ ∧ θ < Real.pi ∧

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.mod_add_mod'.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.mod_add_mod'
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.mod_add_mod'.header: theorem mod_add_mod' (x a b N : ℕ) : ((x + a) % N + b) % N = (x + a + b) % N

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pcd_succ_mod.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pcd_succ_mod
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pcd_succ_mod.header:
theorem pcd_succ_mod (N a b : ℕ) (ha : a < N) (hb : b < N) :
    pcd N ((a + 1) % N) ((b + 1) % N) = pcd N a b

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pcd_add_mod.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pcd_add_mod
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pcd_add_mod.header:
theorem pcd_add_mod (N a b j : ℕ) (ha : a < N) (hb : b < N) :

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_cs.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_cs
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_cs.header:
theorem pdist_cs (x z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (j : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.shift_eq_cs.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.shift_eq_cs
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.shift_eq_cs.header: theorem shift_eq_cs (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : periodicLatticeShift x μ = coarseShift x 1 μ

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.cs_succ.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.cs_succ
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.cs_succ.header:
theorem cs_succ (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (j : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) j μ = coarseShift x (j + 1) μ

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.cs_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.cs_zero
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.cs_zero.header: theorem cs_zero (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : coarseShift x 0 μ = x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_shift.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_shift
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_shift.header:
theorem pdist_shift (x z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    pdist (periodicLatticeShift x μ) (periodicLatticeShift z μ) = pdist x z

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_back.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_back
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_back.header:
theorem pdist_back (x z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    pdist (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ) (periodicLatticeShiftBack z μ) = pdist x z

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_back_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_back_le
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_back_le.header: theorem pdist_back_le (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : pdist x (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ) ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_cs_le'.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_cs_le'
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_cs_le'.header: theorem pdist_cs_le' (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (j : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : pdist (coarseShift x j μ) x ≤ j

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.shift_cs.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.shift_cs
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.shift_cs.header:
theorem shift_cs (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (j : ℕ) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    periodicLatticeShift (coarseShift x j μ) ν = coarseShift (periodicLatticeShift x ν) j μ

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.shift_inj.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.shift_inj
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.shift_inj.header:
theorem shift_inj {x z : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {ν : Fin 3} (h : periodicLatticeShift x ν = periodicLatticeShift z ν) :
    x = z

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.back_cs.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.back_cs
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.back_cs.header:
theorem back_cs (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (j : ℕ) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    periodicLatticeShiftBack (coarseShift x j μ) ν = coarseShift (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν) j μ

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.LipP.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.LipP
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.LipP.header: def LipP (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg.header: noncomputable def boxAvg (m : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.D2.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.D2
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.D2.header: def D2 (μ : Fin 3) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_bound
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_bound.header:
theorem boxAvg_bound {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (μ : Fin 3) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ z, |φ z| ≤ M) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : |boxAvg m μ φ x| ≤ M

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_eq_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_eq_of
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_eq_of.header:
theorem boxAvg_eq_of {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (μ : Fin 3) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (h : ∀ j, j < m → φ (coarseShift x j μ) = c) : boxAvg m μ φ x = c

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_nonneg.header:
theorem boxAvg_nonneg (m : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (h : ∀ z, 0 ≤ φ z) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    0 ≤ boxAvg m μ φ x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_le_one.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_le_one
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_le_one.header:
theorem boxAvg_le_one {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (μ : Fin 3) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (h : ∀ z, φ z ≤ 1)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : boxAvg m μ φ x ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_lip
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_lip.header:
theorem boxAvg_lip {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (μ : Fin 3) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (h : LipP φ c) :
    LipP (boxAvg m μ φ) c

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.D2_boxAvg.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.D2_boxAvg
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.D2_boxAvg.header:
theorem D2_boxAvg (m : ℕ) (μ ν : Fin 3) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    D2 ν (boxAvg m μ φ) x = boxAvg m μ (D2 ν φ) x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_shift_sub.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_shift_sub
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_shift_sub.header:
theorem boxAvg_shift_sub {m : ℕ} (μ : Fin 3) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    boxAvg m μ φ (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - boxAvg m μ φ x
      = (1 / (m : ℝ)) * (φ (coarseShift x m μ) - φ x)

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.D2_boxAvg_self.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.D2_boxAvg_self
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.D2_boxAvg_self.header:
theorem D2_boxAvg_self {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (μ : Fin 3) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (h : LipP φ c)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : |D2 μ (boxAvg m μ φ) x| ≤ 2 * c / m

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.grad_flat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.grad_flat
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.grad_flat.header:
theorem grad_flat (f : SiteL2 L) (b : Bond L) :
    (gradL2 (U0 L) f) b = f (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - f b.1

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lap_flat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lap_flat
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lap_flat.header:
theorem lap_flat (f : SiteL2 L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (lapFull (U0 L) f) x = ∑ μ : Fin 3, ((2 : ℝ) • f x - f (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - f (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ))

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.normSq_site.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.normSq_site
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.normSq_site.header: theorem normSq_site (f : SiteL2 L) : ‖f‖ ^ 2 = ∑ x, ‖f x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.normSq_bond.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.normSq_bond
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.normSq_bond.header: theorem normSq_bond (A : BondFnL2 L) : ‖A‖ ^ 2 = ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ∑ μ : Fin 3, ‖A (x, μ)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.normSq_grad.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.normSq_grad
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.normSq_grad.header:
theorem normSq_grad (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖gradL2 (U0 L) f‖ ^ 2 = ∑ x, ∑ μ : Fin 3, ‖f (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - f x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sum_shift.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sum_shift
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sum_shift.header:
theorem sum_shift (F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∑ x, F (periodicLatticeShift x μ) = ∑ x, F x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sum_back.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sum_back
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sum_back.header:
theorem sum_back (F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∑ x, F (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ) = ∑ x, F x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.grad_norm_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.grad_norm_le
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.grad_norm_le.header: theorem grad_norm_le (f : SiteL2 L) : ‖gradL2 (U0 L) f‖ ^ 2 ≤ 12 * ‖f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lap_norm_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lap_norm_le
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lap_norm_le.header: theorem lap_norm_le (f : SiteL2 L) : ‖lapFull (U0 L) f‖ ≤ 12 * ‖f‖

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.mulR.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.mulR
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.mulR.header: noncomputable def mulR (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) : SiteL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.mulR_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.mulR_apply
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.mulR_apply.header:
theorem mulR_apply (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    mulR φ f x = φ x • f x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lapR.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lapR
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lapR.header: def lapR (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lapR_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lapR_eq
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lapR_eq.header:
theorem lapR_eq (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    lapR φ x = -∑ μ : Fin 3, D2 μ φ x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lap_mulR_const.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lap_mulR_const
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lap_mulR_const.header:
theorem lap_mulR_const (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (v : SuTwo) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (lapFull (U0 L) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun z => φ z • v))) x = lapR φ x • v

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sum6_sq.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sum6_sq
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sum6_sq.header:
theorem sum6_sq (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    (a + b + c + d + e + f) ^ 2 ≤ 6 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 + d ^ 2 + e ^ 2 + f ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.comm_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.comm_bound
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.comm_bound.header:
theorem comm_bound (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) (Dm c : ℝ) (hDm0 : 0 ≤ Dm) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c)
    (hD : ∀ x, |lapR φ x| ≤ Dm)
    (hS : ∀ x (μ : Fin 3), |φ x - φ (periodicLatticeShift x μ)| ≤ c)
    (hB : ∀ x (μ : Fin 3), |φ x - φ (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ)| ≤ c) :
    ‖lapFull (U0 L) (mulR φ f) - mulR φ (lapFull (U0 L) f)‖ ≤ Dm * ‖f‖ + Real.sqrt 12 * c * ‖gradL2 (U0 L) f‖

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp.header: noncomputable def ramp (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a R : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp_nonneg.header: theorem ramp_nonneg (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a R : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 0 ≤ ramp w a R x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp_le_one.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp_le_one
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp_le_one.header: theorem ramp_le_one (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a R : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ramp w a R x ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.clamp_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.clamp_lip
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.clamp_lip.header: theorem clamp_lip (u v : ℝ) : |max 0 (min 1 u) - max 0 (min 1 v)| ≤ |u - v|

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_diff_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_diff_le
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pdist_diff_le.header: theorem pdist_diff_le (w x z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : |(pdist w z : ℝ) - pdist w x| ≤ pdist x z

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp_lip
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp_lip.header: theorem ramp_lip (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a R : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R) : LipP (ramp w a R) (1 / R)

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp_one.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp_one
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp_one.header:
theorem ramp_one (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a R : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : pdist w x ≤ a) :
    ramp w a R x = 1

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp_zero
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.ramp_zero.header:
theorem ramp_zero (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a R : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : a + R ≤ pdist w x) :
    ramp w a R x = 0

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_const_ball.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_const_ball
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_const_ball.header:
theorem boxAvg_const_ball {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (μ : Fin 3) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (r : ℕ) (h : ∀ z, pdist w z ≤ r + (m - 1) → φ z = c)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : pdist w x ≤ r) : boxAvg m μ φ x = c

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_zero_far.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_zero_far
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.boxAvg_zero_far.header:
theorem boxAvg_zero_far {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (μ : Fin 3) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ)
    (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ρ : ℕ) (h : ∀ z, ρ < pdist w z → φ z = 0)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : ρ + (m - 1) < pdist w x) : boxAvg m μ φ x = 0

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.smoothCut.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.smoothCut
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.smoothCut.header: noncomputable def smoothCut (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a R m : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_nonneg.header: theorem sc_nonneg (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 0 ≤ smoothCut w a R m x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_le_one.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_le_one
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_le_one.header: theorem sc_le_one (hm : 0 < m) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : smoothCut w a R m x ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_lip
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_lip.header: theorem sc_lip (hR : 0 < R) (hm : 0 < m) : LipP (smoothCut w a R m) (1 / R)

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_D2.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_D2
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_D2.header:
theorem sc_D2 (hR : 0 < R) (hm : 0 < m) (μ : Fin 3) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    |D2 μ (smoothCut w a R m) x| ≤ 2 * (1 / (R : ℝ)) / m

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_lapR.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_lapR
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_lapR.header:
theorem sc_lapR (hR : 0 < R) (hm : 0 < m) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    |lapR (smoothCut w a R m) x| ≤ 6 / ((R : ℝ) * m)

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_one.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_one
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_one.header:
theorem sc_one (hR : 0 < R) (hm : 0 < m) (r : ℕ) (hr : r + 3 * (m - 1) ≤ a) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hx : pdist w x ≤ r) : smoothCut w a R m x = 1

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_zero
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sc_zero.header:
theorem sc_zero (hR : 0 < R) (hm : 0 < m) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : a + R + 3 * (m - 1) < pdist w x) :
    smoothCut w a R m x = 0

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.siteWt_le_shift.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.siteWt_le_shift
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.siteWt_le_shift.header:
theorem siteWt_le_shift (φ χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (h : ∀ x, φ x ≤ χ x + c) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖siteWt φ f‖ ≤ Real.exp c * ‖siteWt χ f‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bondWt_le_shift.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bondWt_le_shift
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bondWt_le_shift.header:
theorem bondWt_le_shift (φ χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (h : ∀ x, φ x ≤ χ x + c) (f : BondFnL2 L) :
    ‖bondWt φ f‖ ≤ Real.exp c * ‖bondWt χ f‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ypWt_mul.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ypWt_mul
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ypWt_mul.header:
theorem ypWt_mul (G : TowerGeom L) (φ χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (v : YP G) :
    ypWt G φ (ypWt G χ v) = ypWt G (φ + χ) v

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ypWt_le_shift.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ypWt_le_shift
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ypWt_le_shift.header:
theorem ypWt_le_shift (G : TowerGeom L) (φ χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (h : ∀ x, φ x ≤ χ x + c) (v : YP G) :
    ‖ypWt G φ v‖ ≤ Real.exp c * ‖ypWt G χ v‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ypWt_zero_fn.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ypWt_zero_fn
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ypWt_zero_fn.header: theorem ypWt_zero_fn (G : TowerGeom L) (v : YP G) : ypWt G (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) v = v

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Dm_adj.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Dm_adj
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Dm_adj.header:
theorem Dm_adj (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm G U) = siteMask G.Om0 ∘L gradAdj U

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.norm_cj_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.norm_cj_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.norm_cj_le.header:
theorem norm_cj_le {A B : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup A] [InnerProductSpace ℝ A] [NormedAddCommGroup B]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ B] (T T' : A →L[ℝ] B) (δ : ℝ) (h : ‖T' - T‖ ≤ δ) (v : A) :
    ‖T' v‖ ≤ ‖T v‖ + δ * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Wop_eq_gen.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Wop_eq_gen
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Wop_eq_gen.header:
theorem Wop_eq_gen (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (hu : IsUnit (LP G U a)) (B : BondFnL2 L) :
    Wop G U a B = B - Dm G U (Gp G U a (Tfull G U B))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GpT_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GpT_eq
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GpT_eq.header:
theorem GpT_eq (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < wq G a j) (hu : IsUnit (LP G U a))
    (Gi : YP G →L[ℝ] YP G)
    (hG1 : ∀ u, (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop G U a) ∘L Xop G U a) (Gi u) = u) (B : BondFnL2 L) :
    Gp G U a (Tfull G U B) = LinvP G U a (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm G U) B)
      - LinvP G U a (Xop G U a (Gi (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop G U a) (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm G U) B))))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DmX_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DmX_eq
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DmX_eq.header:
theorem DmX_eq (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    Dm (geomOf ell k S) U (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a u)
      = Dh (geomOf ell k S) U ((psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).X u)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Xop_eq_hat.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Xop_eq_hat
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Xop_eq_hat.header:
theorem Xop_eq_hat (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a u = siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) ((psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).X u)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.term1_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.term1_bound
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.term1_bound.header:
theorem term1_bound (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖bondWt (-psiW S W ell k) (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) U a
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U) B)))‖
      ≤ (Real.sqrt 24 + (psiHypN hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).δD
          * Real.sqrt (48 / (psiHypN hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).c))
        * ‖bondWt (-psiW S W ell k) B‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Xhat_psi_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Xhat_psi_bound
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Xhat_psi_bound.header:
theorem Xhat_psi_bound (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : ‖Qh (geomOf ell k S) U a‖ ≤ q) (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖siteWt (psiW S W ell k) ((psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).X u)‖
      ≤ (4 / (psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).c) * ((q + (psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).δQ)
          * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (psiW S W ell k) u‖)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.term2_left.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.term2_left
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.term2_left.header:
theorem term2_left (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : ‖Qh (geomOf ell k S) U a‖ ≤ q) (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖bondWt (-psiW S W ell k) (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) U a
        (siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S) + sigG (geomOf ell k S)) ((psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).X u))))‖
      ≤ (Real.sqrt (12 / (psiHypN hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).c)
          + (psiHypN hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).δD * (4 / (psiHypN hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).c))
        * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((4 / (psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).c)
          * ((q + (psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).δQ)
            * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖)))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.term2_right.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.term2_right
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.term2_right.header:
theorem term2_right (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : ‖Qh (geomOf ell k S) U a‖ ≤ q) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-sigG (geomOf ell k S))
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U ∘L (psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).X) B)‖
      ≤ ((Real.sqrt (12 / (psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).c)
            + (psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).δD * (4 / (psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).c))
          * (q + (psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).δQ))
        * ‖bondWt (-psiW S W ell k) B‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.gami_w.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.gami_w
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.gami_w.header:
theorem gami_w (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (Gi : YP (geomOf ell k S) →L[ℝ] YP (geomOf ell k S))
    (hG1 : ∀ u, (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) ∘L Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) (Gi u) = u)
    (γ : ℝ) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hγ : ∀ u, ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖ ≤ γ * ‖Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a u‖)
    (w : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (Gi w)‖
      ≤ γ ^ 2 * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) w‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CWc.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CWc
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CWc.header:
noncomputable def CWc (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (q γ : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.W_decomp.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.W_decomp
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.W_decomp.header:
theorem W_decomp (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (Gi : YP (geomOf ell k S) →L[ℝ] YP (geomOf ell k S))
    (hG1 : ∀ u, (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) ∘L Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) (Gi u) = u)
    (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    Wop (geomOf ell k S) U a B = B - (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) U a
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U) B))
      - Dh (geomOf ell k S) U (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) U a (siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S) + sigG (geomOf ell k S))
          ((psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).X (Gi (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a)
            (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U) B)))))))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.adj_DmX.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.adj_DmX
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.adj_DmX.header:
theorem adj_DmX (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U) B)
      = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U ∘L (psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).X) B

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.W_wbound.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.W_wbound
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.W_wbound.header:
theorem W_wbound (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (Gi : YP (geomOf ell k S) →L[ℝ] YP (geomOf ell k S))
    (hG1 : ∀ u, (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) ∘L Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) (Gi u) = u)
    (γ : ℝ) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hγ : ∀ u, ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖ ≤ γ * ‖Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a u‖)
    (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (Wop (geomOf ell k S) U a B)‖
      ≤ CWc hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp (Real.sqrt (max a 1)) γ * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) B‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.wnorm_le_N.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.wnorm_le_N
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.wnorm_le_N.header:
theorem wnorm_le_N (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k B ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.W_wnormSq.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.W_wnormSq
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.W_wnormSq.header:
theorem W_wnormSq (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (Gi : YP (geomOf ell k S) →L[ℝ] YP (geomOf ell k S))
    (hG1 : ∀ u, (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) ∘L Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) (Gi u) = u)
    (γ : ℝ) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hγ : ∀ u, ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖ ≤ γ * ‖Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a u‖)
    (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (Wop (geomOf ell k S) U a B)
      ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * CWc hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp (Real.sqrt (max a 1)) γ ^ 2)
        * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k B

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.header:
structure WSchur (E F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F]

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.Nw_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.Nw_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.Nw_le.header: theorem Nw_le (h : E) : ‖J.Nw h‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (J.En h) / Real.sqrt J.cw

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.pair_M.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.pair_M
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.pair_M.header: theorem pair_M (z y : F) : ⟪z, y⟫ ≤ ‖J.Mw.w z‖ * ‖J.Mw.wi y‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.abs_pair_M.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.abs_pair_M
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.abs_pair_M.header: theorem abs_pair_M (u z : F) : |⟪u, z⟫| ≤ ‖J.Mw.wi u‖ * ‖J.Mw.w z‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjpGinv_Gi.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjpGinv_Gi
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjpGinv_Gi.header: theorem cjpGinv_Gi (x : E) : cjp J.ωE J.ωE J.Ginv (cjp J.ωE J.ωE J.Gi x) = x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjp_form_low.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjp_form_lower
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjp_form_low.header: theorem cjp_form_lower (y : E) : (1 - J.κ) * J.En y ≤ ⟪y, cjp J.ωE J.ωE J.Ginv y⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.sqrtE_of_pai.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.sqrtE_of_pair
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.sqrtE_of_pai.header:
theorem sqrtE_of_pair (h : E) (y : F) (hp : ⟪h, cjp J.ωE J.ωE J.Ginv h⟫ = ⟪cjm J.ωE J.ωF J.Q h, y⟫) :
    Real.sqrt (J.En h) ≤ J.Cy * ‖J.Mw.wi y‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.N_lower.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.N_lower
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.N_lower.header: theorem N_lower (u : F) : ‖J.Mw.wi u‖ ^ 2 ≤ J.bN * ⟪u, J.N u⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjpN_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjpN_eq
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjpN_eq.header:
theorem cjpN_eq : cjp J.ωF J.ωF J.N
    = cjp J.ωE J.ωF J.Q ∘L cjp J.ωE J.ωE J.Gi ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (cjm J.ωE J.ωF J.Q)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjpN_lower.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjpN_lower
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjpN_lower.header: theorem cjpN_lower (u : F) : ⟪u, J.N u⟫ - J.EN * ‖J.Mw.wi u‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪u, cjp J.ωF J.ωF J.N u⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.N_cjp_coer.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.N_cjp_coer
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.N_cjp_coer.header: theorem N_cjp_coer (u : F) : (1 / J.bN - J.EN) * ‖J.Mw.wi u‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪u, cjp J.ωF J.ωF J.N u⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjpN_Ninv.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjpN_Ninv
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjpN_Ninv.header: theorem cjpN_Ninv (w : F) : cjp J.ωF J.ωF J.N (cjp J.ωF J.ωF J.Ninv w) = w

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.Ninv_cjp.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.Ninv_cjp
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.Ninv_cjp.header:
theorem Ninv_cjp (hcN : 0 < 1 / J.bN - J.EN) (w : F) :
    (1 / J.bN - J.EN) * ‖J.Mw.wi (cjp J.ωF J.ωF J.Ninv w)‖ ≤ ‖J.Mw.w w‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjpH_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjpH_eq
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.cjpH_eq.header:
theorem cjpH_eq : cjp J.ωF J.ωE J.H
    = cjp J.ωE J.ωE J.Gi ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (cjm J.ωE J.ωF J.Q) ∘L cjp J.ωF J.ωF J.Ninv

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.H_cjp_w.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.H_cjp_w
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WSchur.H_cjp_w.header:
theorem H_cjp_w (hcN : 0 < 1 / J.bN - J.EN) (w : F) :
    ‖J.Nw (cjp J.ωF J.ωE J.H w)‖ ≤ J.CHw * ‖J.Mw.w w‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WtOK.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WtOK
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WtOK.header: def WtOK (G : TowerGeom L) (ell : ℕ) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ δ0 : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WtOK.neg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WtOK.neg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WtOK.neg.header:
theorem WtOK.neg {G : TowerGeom L} {ell : ℕ} {φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ} {θ δ0 : ℝ} (h : WtOK G ell φ θ δ0) :
    WtOK G ell (-φ) θ δ0

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WtOK.add.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WtOK.add
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WtOK.add.header:
theorem WtOK.add {G : TowerGeom L} {ell : ℕ} {φ χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ} {θ δ0 θ' δ0' : ℝ}
    (h : WtOK G ell φ θ δ0) (h' : WtOK G ell χ θ' δ0') : WtOK G ell (φ + χ) (θ + θ') (δ0 + δ0')

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WtOK.sub.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WtOK.sub
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WtOK.sub.header:
theorem WtOK.sub {G : TowerGeom L} {ell : ℕ} {φ χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ} {θ δ0 θ' δ0' : ℝ}
    (h : WtOK G ell φ θ δ0) (h' : WtOK G ell χ θ' δ0') : WtOK G ell (φ - χ) (θ + θ') (δ0 + δ0')

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Xh.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Xh
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Xh.header: noncomputable def Xh (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) : YP G →L[ℝ] SiteL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.psiOK.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.psiOK
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.psiOK.header:
theorem psiOK : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k) (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W)
    (3 * (ell : ℝ) * Real.log ell / W)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.wHyp.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.wHyp
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.wHyp.header:
noncomputable def wHyp (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (θ δ0 : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ0) (hok : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell φ θ δ0)
    (hsm : 24 * ((Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp θ - 1)) ^ 2 + 1 * (Real.sqrt a * (Real.exp δ0 - 1)) ^ 2) ≤ cs)
    (hsmD : 4 * (Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp θ - 1)) ^ 2 ≤ cs) :
    SiteHyp (SiteL2 Lf) (BondFnL2 Lf) (YP (geomOf ell k S))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.wHyp_X.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.wHyp_X
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.wHyp_X.header:
theorem wHyp_X : (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).X
    = Xh (geomOf ell k S) U a

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_DLD.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_DLD
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_DLD.header:
theorem g_DLD (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖bondWt φ (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) U a
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U) (bondWt (-φ) B))))‖
      ≤ (Real.sqrt 24 + (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).δD
          * Real.sqrt (48 / (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).c)) * ‖B‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_LD.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_LD
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_LD.header:
theorem g_LD (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖siteWt φ (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) U a (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U) (bondWt (-φ) B)))‖
      ≤ Real.sqrt (48 / (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).c) * ‖B‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_DL.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_DL
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_DL.header:
theorem g_DL (g : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ‖bondWt φ (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) U a (siteWt (-φ) g)))‖
      ≤ (Real.sqrt (12 / (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).c)
          + (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).δD
            * (4 / (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).c)) * ‖g‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_L.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_L
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_L.header:
theorem g_L (g : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ‖siteWt φ (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) U a (siteWt (-φ) g))‖
      ≤ (4 / (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).c) * ‖g‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_Qadj.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_Qadj
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_Qadj.header:
theorem g_Qadj (q : ℝ) (hq : ‖Qh (geomOf ell k S) U a‖ ≤ q) :
    ‖cjm (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).ωS
        (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).ωY
        (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).Qp‖
      ≤ q + (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).δQ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_X.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_X
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_X.header:
theorem g_X (q : ℝ) (hq : ‖Qh (geomOf ell k S) U a‖ ≤ q) (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖siteWt φ (Xh (geomOf ell k S) U a (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-φ) u))‖
      ≤ (4 / (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).c)
        * ((q + (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).δQ) * ‖u‖)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_DX.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_DX
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_DX.header:
theorem g_DX (q : ℝ) (hq : ‖Qh (geomOf ell k S) U a‖ ≤ q) (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖bondWt φ (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U (Xh (geomOf ell k S) U a (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-φ) u)))‖
      ≤ ((Real.sqrt (12 / (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).c)
          + (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).δD
            * (4 / (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).c))
          * (q + (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).δQ)) * ‖u‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_Xd.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_Xd
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_Xd.header:
theorem g_Xd (q : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq : ‖Qh (geomOf ell k S) U a‖ ≤ q) (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖siteWt φ (Xh (geomOf ell k S) U a (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-φ) u)) - Xh (geomOf ell k S) U a u‖
        ≤ (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).epsX q * ‖u‖ ∧
      ‖Dh (geomOf ell k S) U (siteWt φ (Xh (geomOf ell k S) U a (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-φ) u))
          - Xh (geomOf ell k S) U a u)‖
        ≤ (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).epsDX q * ‖u‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_DXd.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_DXd
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.g_DXd.header:
theorem g_DXd (q : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq : ‖Qh (geomOf ell k S) U a‖ ≤ q) (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖bondWt φ (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U (Xh (geomOf ell k S) U a (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-φ) u)))
        - Dh (geomOf ell k S) U (Xh (geomOf ell k S) U a u)‖
      ≤ ((wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).δD
          * ((4 / (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).c)
            * (q + (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).δQ))
        + (wHyp hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp φ θ δ0 hθ hδ0 hok hsm hsmD).epsDX q) * ‖u‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WtOK.mono.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WtOK.mono
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.WtOK.mono.header:
theorem WtOK.mono {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {G : TowerGeom L} {ell : ℕ} {φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ}
    {θ δ0 θ' δ0' : ℝ} (h : WtOK G ell φ θ δ0) (hθ : θ ≤ θ') (hδ : δ0 ≤ δ0') (hell : 0 < ell) : WtOK G ell φ θ' δ0'

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.abs_exp_sub_one_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.abs_exp_sub_one_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.abs_exp_sub_one_le.header: theorem abs_exp_sub_one_le (t T : ℝ) (h : |t| ≤ T) : |Real.exp t - 1| ≤ Real.exp T - 1

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Ds_comm.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Ds_comm
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Ds_comm.header:
theorem Ds_comm (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (U : Cfg Lf)
    (χ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (θ δ0 : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hok : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell χ θ δ0)
    (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖siteWt χ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U) (bondWt (-χ) B))
        - ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U) B‖
      ≤ Real.sqrt 3 * (ell : ℝ) * (Real.exp θ - 1) * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) B‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.XhC.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.XhC
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.XhC.header: noncomputable def XhC (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (u : YP G) : SiteL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GiC.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GiC
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GiC.header: noncomputable def GiC (G : TowerGeom L) (Gi : YP G →L[ℝ] YP G) (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (w : YP G) : YP G

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.VC.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.VC
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.VC.header: noncomputable def VC (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 L) : YP G

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ypWt_neg_add.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ypWt_neg_add
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ypWt_neg_add.header:
theorem ypWt_neg_add (G : TowerGeom L) (φ χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (u : YP G) :
    ypWt G (-(φ + χ)) (ypWt G φ u) = ypWt G (-χ) u

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.XhC_shift.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.XhC_shift
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.XhC_shift.header:
theorem XhC_shift (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (φ χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (u : YP G) :
    siteWt φ (XhC G U a χ u) = XhC G U a (φ + χ) (ypWt G φ u)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.XhC_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.XhC_zero
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.XhC_zero.header: theorem XhC_zero (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (u : YP G) : XhC G U a (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) u = Xh G U a u

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.header: structure CTData {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell M R k : ℕ) (S : Tower Lf) (W : ℕ)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.θψ_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.θψ_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.θψ_nonneg.header: theorem θψ_nonneg : 0 ≤ 2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.δψ_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.δψ_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.δψ_nonneg.header: theorem δψ_nonneg : 0 ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) * Real.log ell / W

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okPsi.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okPsi
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okPsi.header: theorem okPsi : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k) D.Θ D.Δ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okPlus.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okPlus
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okPlus.header: theorem okPlus : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + D.χ) D.Θ D.Δ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okMinus.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okMinus
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okMinus.header: theorem okMinus : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k - D.χ) D.Θ D.Δ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.iW.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.iW
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.iW.header:
noncomputable def iW (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (hξ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell ξ D.Θ D.Δ) :
    SiteHyp (SiteL2 Lf) (BondFnL2 Lf) (YP (geomOf ell k S))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.iW_epsX.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.iW_epsX
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.iW_epsX.header: theorem iW_epsX (ξ) (hξ) : (D.iW ξ hξ).epsX D.q = D.EX

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.iW_epsDX.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.iW_epsDX
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.iW_epsDX.header: theorem iW_epsDX (ξ) (hξ) : (D.iW ξ hξ).epsDX D.q = D.EDX

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hq.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hq
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hq.header: theorem hq : ‖Qh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a‖ ≤ D.q

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XhC_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XhC_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XhC_le.header:
theorem XhC_le (ξ) (hξ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell ξ D.Θ D.Δ) (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖XhC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a ξ u‖ ≤ D.nX * ‖u‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XhC_diff.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XhC_diff
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XhC_diff.header:
theorem XhC_diff (ξ) (hξ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell ξ D.Θ D.Δ) (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖XhC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a ξ u - Xh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a u‖ ≤ D.EX * ‖u‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.DXhC_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.DXhC_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.DXhC_le.header:
theorem DXhC_le (ξ) (hξ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell ξ D.Θ D.Δ) (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖bondWt ξ (Dh (geomOf ell k S) D.U (Xh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-ξ) u)))‖ ≤ D.K3 * ‖u‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.DXhC_diff.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.DXhC_diff
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.DXhC_diff.header:
theorem DXhC_diff (ξ) (hξ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell ξ D.Θ D.Δ) (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖bondWt ξ (Dh (geomOf ell k S) D.U (Xh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-ξ) u)))
        - Dh (geomOf ell k S) D.U (Xh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a u)‖ ≤ D.EDX' * ‖u‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.site_sig_psi.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.site_sig_psi
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.site_sig_psi.header:
theorem site_sig_psi (f : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ‖siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) f‖ ≤ (ell : ℝ) * ‖siteWt (psiW S W ell k) f‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.yp_psi_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.yp_psi_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.yp_psi_le.header:
theorem yp_psi_le (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (psiW S W ell k) u‖ ≤ ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.yp_psi_sig_l.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.yp_psi_sig_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.yp_psi_sig_l.header:
theorem yp_psi_sig_le (y : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (psiW S W ell k + -sigG (geomOf ell k S)) y‖ ≤ ‖y‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XhC_psi.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XhC_psi
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XhC_psi.header:
theorem XhC_psi (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    siteWt (psiW S W ell k) (Xh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a u)
      = XhC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (psiW S W ell k) (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (psiW S W ell k) u)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XC_diff_core.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XC_diff_core
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XC_diff_core.header:
theorem XC_diff_core (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (hξ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖siteWt (psiW S W ell k) (XhC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a ξ u - Xh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a u)‖
      ≤ 2 * D.EX * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (psiW S W ell k) u‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XC_diff.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XC_diff
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XC_diff.header:
theorem XC_diff (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (hξ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (XhC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a ξ u - Xh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a u)‖
      ≤ 2 * (ell : ℝ) * D.EX * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xt.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xt
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xt.header:
theorem Xt (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (hξ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (y : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (XhC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a ξ
        (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) y))‖ ≤ (ell : ℝ) * D.nX * ‖y‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xt0.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xt0
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xt0.header:
theorem Xt0 (y : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (Xh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a
        (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) y))‖ ≤ (ell : ℝ) * D.nX * ‖y‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xop_hat.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xop_hat
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xop_hat.header:
theorem Xop_hat (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a u = siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (Xh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a u)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XopC_hat.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XopC_hat
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XopC_hat.header:
theorem XopC_hat (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    siteWt ξ (Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-ξ) u))
      = siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (XhC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a ξ u)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Gam_conj_inn.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Gam_conj_inner
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Gam_conj_inn.header:
theorem Gam_conj_inner (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (a b : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ⟪ypWt (geomOf ell k S) ξ ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a) ∘L Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a)
        (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-ξ) a)), b⟫
      = ⟪siteWt ξ (Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-ξ) a)),
          siteWt (-ξ) (Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-(-ξ)) b))⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bondWt_mul.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bondWt_mul
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bondWt_mul.header:
theorem bondWt_mul (φ χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 L) :
    bondWt φ (bondWt χ B) = bondWt (φ + χ) B

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bondWt_zero_fn.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bondWt_zero_fn
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bondWt_zero_fn.header: theorem bondWt_zero_fn (B : BondFnL2 L) : bondWt (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) B = B

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.pert_gram_lower.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.pert_gram_lower
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.pert_gram_lower.header:
theorem pert_gram_lower (t N ε γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hN : 0 ≤ N) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hεγ : ε * γ ≤ 1)
    (ht : N ≤ γ * t) :
    (1 / γ ^ 2 - 2 * ε / γ - ε ^ 2) * N ^ 2 ≤ t ^ 2 - 2 * ε * N * t - ε ^ 2 * N ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.coer_to_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.coer_to_bound
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.coer_to_bound.header: theorem coer_to_bound (c A B : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (h : c * A ^ 2 ≤ A * B) : c * A ≤ B

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.inner_pert_le'.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.inner_pert_le'
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.inner_pert_le'.header:
theorem inner_pert_le' {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (a b a' b' : F)
    (X Y K d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hX : 0 ≤ X) (hY : 0 ≤ Y)
    (ha : ‖a' - a‖ ≤ d * X) (hb : ‖b' - b‖ ≤ d * Y) (hA : ‖a‖ ≤ K * X) (hB : ‖b‖ ≤ K * Y) :
    |⟪a', b'⟫ - ⟪a, b⟫| ≤ (2 * K * d + d ^ 2) * (X * Y)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xcj.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xcj
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xcj.header: noncomputable def Xcj (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) : SiteL2 Lf

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xcj_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xcj_eq
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xcj_eq.header:
theorem Xcj_eq (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    D.Xcj ξ u = siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (XhC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a ξ u)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xcj_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xcj_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xcj_le.header:
theorem Xcj_le (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (hξ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖D.Xcj ξ u‖ ≤ (ell : ℝ) * D.nX * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.X_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.X_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.X_le.header:
theorem X_le (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a u‖ ≤ (ell : ℝ) * D.nX * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xcj_diff.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xcj_diff
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Xcj_diff.header:
theorem Xcj_diff (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (hξ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖D.Xcj ξ u - Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a u‖
      ≤ 2 * (ell : ℝ) * D.EX * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GamC.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GamC
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GamC.header: noncomputable def GamC (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) : YP (geomOf ell k S)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GamC_inner.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GamC_inner
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GamC_inner.header:
theorem GamC_inner (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (a b : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ⟪D.GamC ξ a, b⟫ = ⟪D.Xcj ξ a, D.Xcj (-ξ) b⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GamC_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GamC_zero
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GamC_zero.header:
theorem GamC_zero (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    D.GamC (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) u
      = (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a) ∘L Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a) u

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Gam_conj_coe.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Gam_conj_coer
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Gam_conj_coe.header:
theorem Gam_conj_coer (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ)
    (hp : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hm : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + -ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hεγ : D.epsG * D.γ ≤ 1) (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    D.cG * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪D.GamC ξ u, u⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GamC_GiC.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GamC_GiC
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GamC_GiC.header:
theorem GamC_GiC (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (w : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    D.GamC ξ (GiC (geomOf ell k S) D.Gi ξ w) = w

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GiC_GamC.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GiC_GamC
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GiC_GamC.header:
theorem GiC_GamC (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    GiC (geomOf ell k S) D.Gi ξ (D.GamC ξ u) = u

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.pair_tau.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.pair_tau
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.pair_tau.header:
theorem pair_tau (v w : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ⟪v, w⟫ ≤ ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) v‖ * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) w‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GiC_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GiC_bound
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GiC_bound.header:
theorem GiC_bound (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ)
    (hp : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hm : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + -ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hεγ : D.epsG * D.γ ≤ 1) (w : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    D.cG * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (GiC (geomOf ell k S) D.Gi ξ w)‖
      ≤ ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) w‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Gam_diff.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Gam_diff
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Gam_diff.header:
theorem Gam_diff (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ)
    (hp : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hm : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + -ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (v : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-sigG (geomOf ell k S))
        (D.GamC ξ v - (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a) ∘L Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a) v)‖
      ≤ D.dG * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) v‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GiC_diff.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GiC_diff
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GiC_diff.header:
theorem GiC_diff (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ)
    (hp : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hm : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + -ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hεγ : D.epsG * D.γ ≤ 1) (w : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    D.cG * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (GiC (geomOf ell k S) D.Gi ξ w - D.Gi w)‖
      ≤ D.dG * D.γ ^ 2 * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) w‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.VC_pair.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.VC_pair
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.VC_pair.header:
theorem VC_pair (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) (z : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ⟪ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (VC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a ξ B), z⟫
      = ⟪bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) B,
          bondWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S) + -ξ) (Dh (geomOf ell k S) D.U (Xh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a
            (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (ξ + -sigG (geomOf ell k S)) z)))⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.VC_form.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.VC_form
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.VC_form.header:
theorem VC_form (η : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (z : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    bondWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S) + -η) (Dh (geomOf ell k S) D.U (Xh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a
        (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (η + -sigG (geomOf ell k S)) z)))
      = bondWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S) + -psiW S W ell k) (bondWt (psiW S W ell k + -η)
          (Dh (geomOf ell k S) D.U (Xh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-(psiW S W ell k + -η))
            (ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (psiW S W ell k + -sigG (geomOf ell k S)) z)))))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.bond_sig_psi.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.bond_sig_psi_le'
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.bond_sig_psi.header:
theorem bond_sig_psi_le' (f : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖bondWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S) + -psiW S W ell k) f‖ ≤ (ell : ℝ) * ‖f‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.yp_psi_sig_l.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.yp_psi_sig_le'
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.yp_psi_sig_l.header:
theorem yp_psi_sig_le' (z : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (psiW S W ell k + -sigG (geomOf ell k S)) z‖ ≤ ‖z‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.VC_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.VC_bound
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.VC_bound.header:
theorem VC_bound (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ)
    (hξ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + -ξ) D.Θ D.Δ) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (VC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a ξ B)‖
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * D.K3 * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) B‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.VC_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.VC_zero
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.VC_zero.header:
theorem VC_zero (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    VC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) B
      = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dh (geomOf ell k S) D.U ∘L Xh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a) B

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.VC_diff.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.VC_diff
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.VC_diff.header:
theorem VC_diff (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ)
    (hξ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + -ξ) D.Θ D.Δ) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (-sigG (geomOf ell k S))
        (VC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a ξ B - VC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) B)‖
      ≤ 2 * (ell : ℝ) * D.EDX' * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) B‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.gLD.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.gLD
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.gLD.header:
theorem gLD (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (hφ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell φ D.Θ D.Δ) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖siteWt φ (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dh (geomOf ell k S) D.U) (bondWt (-φ) B)))‖
      ≤ Real.sqrt (48 / D.cs) * ‖B‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.gL.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.gL
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.gL.header:
theorem gL (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (hφ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell φ D.Θ D.Δ) (g : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ‖siteWt φ (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (siteWt (-φ) g))‖ ≤ (4 / D.cs) * ‖g‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.gDLD.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.gDLD
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.gDLD.header:
theorem gDLD (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (hφ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell φ D.Θ D.Δ) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖bondWt φ (Dh (geomOf ell k S) D.U (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dh (geomOf ell k S) D.U) (bondWt (-φ) B))))‖
      ≤ (Real.sqrt 24 + D.dD * Real.sqrt (48 / D.cs)) * ‖B‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.gDL.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.gDL
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.gDL.header:
theorem gDL (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (hφ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell φ D.Θ D.Δ) (g : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ‖bondWt φ (Dh (geomOf ell k S) D.U (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (siteWt (-φ) g)))‖
      ≤ (Real.sqrt (12 / D.cs) + D.dD * (4 / D.cs)) * ‖g‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.psiN_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.psiN_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.psiN_le.header:
theorem psiN_le (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖bondWt (-psiW S W ell k) B‖ ≤ (ell : ℝ) * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) B‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.site_psi_sig.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.site_psi_sig_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.site_psi_sig.header: theorem site_psi_sig_le (f : SiteL2 Lf) : ‖siteWt (psiW S W ell k + -sigG (geomOf ell k S)) f‖ ≤ ‖f‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.site_sig_psi.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.site_sig_psi_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.site_sig_psi.header:
theorem site_sig_psi_le (f : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ‖siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S) + -psiW S W ell k) f‖ ≤ (ell : ℝ) * ‖f‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.bond_psi_sig.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.bond_psi_sig_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.bond_psi_sig.header: theorem bond_psi_sig_le (f : BondFnL2 Lf) : ‖bondWt (psiW S W ell k + -sigG (geomOf ell k S)) f‖ ≤ ‖f‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hwq.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hwq
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hwq.header: theorem hwq : ∀ j, 0 < wq (geomOf ell k S) D.a j

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.adjDmX.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.adjDmX
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.adjDmX.header:
theorem adjDmX (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a) (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) D.U) B)
      = VC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) B

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.T_split.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.T_split
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.T_split.header:
theorem T_split (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    Tfull (geomOf ell k S) D.U B = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) D.U) B
      - Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (D.Gi (VC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) B))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.TC.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.TC
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.TC.header: noncomputable def TC (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) : SiteL2 Lf

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XGV_conj.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XGV_conj
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XGV_conj.header:
theorem XGV_conj (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    siteWt ξ (Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (D.Gi (VC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (bondWt (-ξ) B))))
      = D.Xcj ξ (GiC (geomOf ell k S) D.Gi ξ (VC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a ξ B))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.TC_split.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.TC_split
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.TC_split.header:
theorem TC_split (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    D.TC ξ B = siteWt ξ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) D.U) (bondWt (-ξ) B))
      - D.Xcj ξ (GiC (geomOf ell k S) D.Gi ξ (VC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a ξ B))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.TC_diff.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.TC_diff
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.TC_diff.header:
theorem TC_diff (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (θξ δξ : ℝ) (hθξ : 0 ≤ θξ)
    (hξ : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell ξ θξ δξ)
    (hp : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hm : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + -ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hεγ : D.epsG * D.γ ≤ 1) (hcG : 0 < D.cG) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖D.TC ξ B - Tfull (geomOf ell k S) D.U B‖ ≤ D.dTc θξ * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) B‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ZC.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ZC
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ZC.header: noncomputable def ZC (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) : SiteL2 Lf

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.WC.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.WC
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.WC.header: noncomputable def WC (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) : BondFnL2 Lf

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Gp_split.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Gp_split
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Gp_split.header:
theorem Gp_split (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    Gp (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (Tfull (geomOf ell k S) D.U B)
      = LinvP (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) D.U) B)
        - LinvP (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a
            (D.Gi (VC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) B)))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.LD_form.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.LD_form
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.LD_form.header:
theorem LD_form (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    siteWt (-(sigG (geomOf ell k S) + sigG (geomOf ell k S)))
        (siteWt ξ (LinvP (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) D.U) (bondWt (-ξ) B))))
      = siteWt (psiW S W ell k + -sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (siteWt (ξ + -psiW S W ell k) (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a
          (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dh (geomOf ell k S) D.U)
            (bondWt (-(ξ + -psiW S W ell k)) (bondWt (-psiW S W ell k) B)))))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.LX_form.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.LX_form
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.LX_form.header:
theorem LX_form (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (y : SiteL2 Lf) :
    siteWt (-(sigG (geomOf ell k S) + sigG (geomOf ell k S)))
        (siteWt ξ (LinvP (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (siteWt (-ξ) y)))
      = siteWt (psiW S W ell k + -sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (siteWt (ξ + -psiW S W ell k) (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a
          (siteWt (-(ξ + -psiW S W ell k)) (siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S) + -psiW S W ell k) y))))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XGV_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XGV_eq
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XGV_eq.header:
theorem XGV_eq (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    Xop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (D.Gi (VC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (bondWt (-ξ) B)))
      = siteWt (-ξ) (D.Xcj ξ (GiC (geomOf ell k S) D.Gi ξ (VC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a ξ B)))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XGV_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XGV_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.XGV_le.header:
theorem XGV_le (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ)
    (hp : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hm : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + -ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hεγ : D.epsG * D.γ ≤ 1) (hcG : 0 < D.cG) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖D.Xcj ξ (GiC (geomOf ell k S) D.Gi ξ (VC (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a ξ B))‖
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * D.nX * ((ell : ℝ) * D.K3 / D.cG) * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) B‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ZC_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ZC_bound
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ZC_bound.header:
theorem ZC_bound (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ)
    (hp : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hm : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + -ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hn : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (ξ + -psiW S W ell k) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hεγ : D.epsG * D.γ ≤ 1) (hcG : 0 < D.cG) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖siteWt (-(sigG (geomOf ell k S) + sigG (geomOf ell k S))) (D.ZC ξ B)‖
      ≤ D.kZc * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) B‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.DLD_form.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.DLD_form
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.DLD_form.header:
theorem DLD_form (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (bondWt ξ (Dm (geomOf ell k S) D.U (LinvP (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) D.U) (bondWt (-ξ) B)))))
      = bondWt (psiW S W ell k + -sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (bondWt (ξ + -psiW S W ell k) (Dh (geomOf ell k S) D.U
          (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dh (geomOf ell k S) D.U)
            (bondWt (-(ξ + -psiW S W ell k)) (bondWt (-psiW S W ell k) B))))))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.DLX_form.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.DLX_form
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.DLX_form.header:
theorem DLX_form (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (y : SiteL2 Lf) :
    bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (bondWt ξ (Dm (geomOf ell k S) D.U (LinvP (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a
        (siteWt (-ξ) y))))
      = bondWt (psiW S W ell k + -sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (bondWt (ξ + -psiW S W ell k) (Dh (geomOf ell k S) D.U
          (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (siteWt (-(ξ + -psiW S W ell k)) (siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S) + -psiW S W ell k) y)))))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.WC_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.WC_bound
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.WC_bound.header:
theorem WC_bound (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ)
    (hp : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hm : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + -ξ) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hn : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (ξ + -psiW S W ell k) D.Θ D.Δ)
    (hεγ : D.epsG * D.γ ≤ 1) (hcG : 0 < D.cG) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (D.WC ξ B)‖ ≤ D.kWc * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) B‖

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pcd_window.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pcd_window
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pcd_window.header:
theorem pcd_window (N a b t y n : ℕ) (hb : b < N) (ha1 : y + t ≤ a) (ha2 : a + t < y + n) (hyn : y + n ≤ N)
    (h : pcd N a b ≤ t) : y ≤ b ∧ b < y + n

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pcd_le_pdist.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pcd_le_pdist
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pcd_le_pdist.header: theorem pcd_le_pdist (x z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : pcd (L μ + 1) (x μ).val (z μ).val ≤ pdist x z

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.cen_val.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.cen_val
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.cen_val.header: theorem cen_val (μ : Fin 3) : (cen y n hfit μ).val = (y μ).val + n / 2

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.mem_cube_of_near.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.mem_cube_of_near
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.mem_cube_of_near.header:
theorem mem_cube_of_near (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : pdist (cen y n hfit) z ≤ 8 * (n / 24) + 1) :
    z ∈ blockOf y n

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump.header:
noncomputable def bump (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ) (_hn : 24 ≤ n) (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1) :
    PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.r_pos.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.r_pos
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.r_pos.header:
theorem r_pos {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (n : ℕ) (hn : 24 ≤ n) (_hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1) :
    0 < n / 24

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_supp.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_supp
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_supp.header: theorem bump_supp (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : bump y n hn hfit z ≠ 0) : pdist (cen y n hfit) z ≤ 8 * (n / 24)

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_mem
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_mem.header: theorem bump_mem (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : bump y n hn hfit z ≠ 0) : z ∈ blockOf y n

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lapR_bump_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lapR_bump_mem
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lapR_bump_mem.header: theorem lapR_bump_mem (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : lapR (bump y n hn hfit) z ≠ 0) : z ∈ blockOf y n

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_one.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_one
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_one.header: theorem bump_one (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : pdist (cen y n hfit) z ≤ n / 24) : bump y n hn hfit z = 1

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_nonneg.header: theorem bump_nonneg (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 0 ≤ bump y n hn hfit z

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_lapR.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_lapR
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_lapR.header: theorem bump_lapR (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : |lapR (bump y n hn hfit) z| ≤ 6 / (((n / 24 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (n / 24 : ℕ))

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.inner_cube_sub.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.inner_cube_sub
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.inner_cube_sub.header:
theorem inner_cube_sub (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : z ∈ blockOf (cen y n hfit) (n / 24 / 3 + 1)) :
    pdist (cen y n hfit) z ≤ n / 24

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sum_bump_ge.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sum_bump_ge
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.sum_bump_ge.header: theorem sum_bump_ge : ((n / 24 / 3 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ ∑ z ∈ blockOf y n, bump y n hn hfit z

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_bound
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bump_bound.header:
theorem bump_bound (h : SiteL2 L) (c : SuTwo) (hc : ∀ z ∈ blockOf y n, (lapFull (U0 L) h) z = c) :
    ‖c‖ ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 7 ≤ Kb2 * ∑ z ∈ blockOf y n, ‖h z‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.cls.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.cls
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.cls.header: def cls (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.mem_cls.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.mem_cls
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.mem_cls.header: theorem mem_cls (x z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : z ∈ Cl.cls x ↔ Cl.anc z = Cl.anc x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.cls_eq_block.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.cls_eq_block
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.cls_eq_block.header: theorem cls_eq_block (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Cl.cls x = blockOf (Cl.anc x) (Cl.nn x)

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.self_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.self_mem
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.self_mem.header: theorem self_mem (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : x ∈ Cl.cls x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.card_cls.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.card_cls
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.card_cls.header: theorem card_cls (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ((Cl.cls x).card : ℝ) = (Cl.nn x : ℝ) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.pdist_anc.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.pdist_anc
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.pdist_anc.header: theorem pdist_anc (x z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : z ∈ Cl.cls x) : pdist (Cl.anc x) z ≤ 3 * Cl.nn x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.pdist_self_a.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.pdist_self_anc
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.pdist_self_a.header: theorem pdist_self_anc (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : pdist x (Cl.anc x) ≤ 3 * Cl.nn x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.pdist_in_cls.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.pdist_in_cls
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.pdist_in_cls.header: theorem pdist_in_cls (x z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : z ∈ Cl.cls x) : pdist x z ≤ 6 * Cl.nn x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.cls_symm.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.cls_symm
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.cls_symm.header: theorem cls_symm (x z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : z ∈ Cl.cls x ↔ x ∈ Cl.cls z

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.nn_cls.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.nn_cls
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.nn_cls.header: theorem nn_cls (x z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : z ∈ Cl.cls x) : Cl.nn z = Cl.nn x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.sum_cls_swap.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.sum_cls_swap
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.sum_cls_swap.header:
theorem sum_cls_swap (w F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ∑ x, w x * ∑ z ∈ Cl.cls x, F z = ∑ z, F z * ∑ x ∈ Cl.cls z, w x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.sum_cls_cons.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.sum_cls_const
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.sum_cls_cons.header:
theorem sum_cls_const (p : ℕ → ℝ) (F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ∑ x, p (Cl.nn x) * ∑ z ∈ Cl.cls x, F z = ∑ z, F z * (p (Cl.nn z) * (Cl.nn z : ℝ) ^ 3)

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.sum_anc_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.sum_anc_zero
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.sum_anc_zero.header:
theorem sum_anc_zero (μ k : SiteL2 L) (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ)
    (hsum : ∀ x, ∑ z ∈ Cl.cls x, μ z = 0)
    (hconst : ∀ x, γ (Cl.anc x) ≠ 0 → ∀ z ∈ Cl.cls x, k z = k x) :
    ∑ x, ⟪k x, γ (Cl.anc x) • μ x⟫ = 0

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.norm_mulR_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.norm_mulR_le
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.norm_mulR_le.header:
theorem norm_mulR_le (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (h : ∀ x, |φ x| ≤ M) :
    ‖mulR φ f‖ ≤ M * ‖f‖

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.poinc_cons.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.poinc_cons
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.poinc_cons.header:
theorem poinc_cons (μ : SiteL2 L) (P : ℝ) (hP0 : 0 ≤ P) (hP : ‖μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ P * ‖gradL2 (U0 L) μ‖ ^ 2) :
    ‖gradL2 (U0 L) μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ P * ‖lapFull (U0 L) μ‖ ^ 2 ∧ ‖μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ P ^ 2 * ‖lapFull (U0 L) μ‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.anc_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.anc_mem
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.anc_mem.header: theorem anc_mem (hB : 1 ≤ B) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Cl.anc x ∈ Cl.cls x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.cls_anc.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.cls_anc
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.cls_anc.header: theorem cls_anc (hB : 1 ≤ B) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Cl.cls (Cl.anc x) = Cl.cls x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.S_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.S_bound
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.S_bound.header:
theorem S_bound (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (μ : SiteL2 L)
    (hsum : ∀ x, ∑ z ∈ Cl.cls x, μ z = 0)
    (hP : ‖μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ 6 * ((ell : ℝ) * B) ^ 2 * ‖gradL2 (U0 L) μ‖ ^ 2)
    (K : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L))
    (hconst : ∀ x, (∀ z ∈ Cl.cls x, z ∈ K) → ∀ z ∈ Cl.cls x,
      lapFull (U0 L) (lapFull (U0 L) μ) z = lapFull (U0 L) (lapFull (U0 L) μ) x)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (R : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R) (hRB : B ≤ R)
    (hg0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) (hglip : LipP g (1 / R)) (hglap : ∀ x, |lapR g x| ≤ 6 / ((R : ℝ) * R))
    (hgK : ∀ x, g x ≠ 0 → ∀ z ∈ Cl.cls x, z ∈ K) :
    ∑ x, g x * ‖lapFull (U0 L) μ x‖ ^ 2
      ≤ CA ell * ((B : ℝ) / R) * ‖lapFull (U0 L) μ‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bond_ineq.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bond_ineq
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.bond_ineq.header:
theorem bond_ineq {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (a b : E) (p q : ℝ) :
    (p ^ 2 + q ^ 2) / 4 * ‖b - a‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪b - a, q ^ 2 • b - p ^ 2 • a⟫ + 1 / 2 * (q - p) ^ 2 * ‖a + b‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.inner_grad_grad.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.inner_grad_grad
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.inner_grad_grad.header:
