theorem inner_grad_grad (f g : SiteL2 L) :
    ⟪gradL2 (U0 L) f, gradL2 (U0 L) g⟫ = ⟪lapFull (U0 L) f, g⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.inner_bond.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.inner_bond
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.inner_bond.header:
theorem inner_bond (A A' : BondFnL2 L) :
    ⟪A, A'⟫ = ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ∑ μ : Fin 3, ⟪A (x, μ), A' (x, μ)⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lap_zero_far.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lap_zero_far
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lap_zero_far.header:
theorem lap_zero_far (F : SiteL2 L) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ρ : ℕ) (hF : ∀ z, ρ ≤ pdist w z → F z = 0)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : ρ + 1 ≤ pdist w x) : lapFull (U0 L) F x = 0

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.interior_bou.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.interior_bound
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.Classes.interior_bou.header:
theorem interior_bound (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (μ : SiteL2 L) (K : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L))
    (hconst : ∀ x, (∀ z ∈ Cl.cls x, z ∈ K) → ∀ z ∈ Cl.cls x,
      lapFull (U0 L) (lapFull (U0 L) μ) z = lapFull (U0 L) (lapFull (U0 L) μ) x)
    (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s ρY : ℕ) (hρY : s + 2 + B + 6 * (ell * B) ≤ ρY)
    (hKY : ∀ x, pdist w x ≤ s + 1 + B → ∀ z ∈ Cl.cls x, z ∈ K) :
    gradOn (U0 L) (Ball w s) (lapFull (U0 L) μ)
      ≤ CB / (B : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ x, (if pdist w x ≤ ρY then ‖lapFull (U0 L) μ x‖ ^ 2 else 0)

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.fit_of_dvd.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.fit_of_dvd
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.fit_of_dvd.header: theorem fit_of_dvd {m c N : ℕ} (hc : m ∣ c) (hN : m ∣ N) (hlt : c < N) : c + m ≤ N

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pnn.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pnn
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pnn.header: noncomputable def pnn (ell i : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.cc_mem_Rg.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.cc_mem_Rg
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.cc_mem_Rg.header: theorem cc_mem_Rg (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : cc ell i Rg x ∈ Rg ↔ x ∈ Rg

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pnn_cc.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pnn_cc
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.pnn_cc.header: theorem pnn_cc (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : pnn ell i Rg (cc ell i Rg x) = pnn ell i Rg x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.patchClasses.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.patchClasses
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.patchClasses.header: noncomputable def patchClasses : Classes L (ell ^ i) ell

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.patchClasses_anc.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.patchClasses_anc
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.patchClasses_anc.header: theorem patchClasses_anc (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : (patchClasses hell hRg hdvd).anc x = cc ell i Rg x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.patchClasses_nn.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.patchClasses_nn
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.patchClasses_nn.header: theorem patchClasses_nn (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : (patchClasses hell hRg hdvd).nn x = pnn ell i Rg x

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.qlev_class_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.qlev_class_zero
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.qlev_class_zero.header:
theorem qlev_class_zero (μ : SiteL2 L) (hμ : μ ∈ NQp (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)) (flatCfg : Cfg L))
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ∑ z ∈ (patchClasses hell hRg hdvd).cls x, μ z = 0

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lapDir_patch.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lapDir_patch
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.lapDir_patch.header:
theorem lapDir_patch (ell i : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    lapDir (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)) U f = lapFull U f

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.poinc_patch.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.poinc_patch
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.poinc_patch.header:
theorem poinc_patch {ell i : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} (hRg : BlockClosed (ell ^ (i + 1)) Rg)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (i + 1) ∣ L μ + 1) (μ : SiteL2 L)
    (hμ : μ ∈ NQp (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)) (flatCfg : Cfg L)) :
    ‖μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ 6 * ((ell : ℝ) * (ell ^ i : ℕ)) ^ 2 * ‖gradL2 (U0 L) μ‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.kcc_patch.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.kcc_patch
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.kcc_patch.header:
theorem kcc_patch {ell i : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} (hRg : BlockClosed (ell ^ (i + 1)) Rg)
    (K : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (μ : SiteL2 L)
    (hperp : lapFull (U0 L) μ ∈ (VK (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)) (flatCfg : Cfg L) K)ᗮ)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : z ∈ K) (hcz : cc ell i Rg z ∈ K) :
    lapFull (U0 L) (lapFull (U0 L) μ) z = lapFull (U0 L) (lapFull (U0 L) μ) (cc ell i Rg z)

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.epsD.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.epsD
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.epsD.header: noncomputable def epsD (ell d : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.rD_pos.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.rD_pos
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.rD_pos.header: theorem rD_pos {ell d : ℕ} (hd : 12 * ell + 10 ≤ d) : 1 ≤ rD ell d

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.rD_room.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.rD_room
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.rD_room.header: theorem rD_room {ell d : ℕ} : 7 * rD ell d + 12 * ell + 3 ≤ d ∨ d < 12 * ell + 3

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.CA_pos.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.CA_pos
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.CA_pos.header: theorem CA_pos {ell : ℕ} (hell : 1 ≤ ell) : 0 < CA ell

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.epsD_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.epsD_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.epsD_nonneg.header: theorem epsD_nonneg (ell d : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) : 0 ≤ epsD ell d

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.epsD_small.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.epsD_small
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.epsD_small.header:
theorem epsD_small (ell : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ D : ℕ, 12 * ell + 10 ≤ D ∧ ∀ d, D ≤ d → epsD ell d ≤ δ

AdalyFormal.M1Decay.harmDecay_flat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Decay.harmDecay_flat
AdalyFormal.M1Decay.harmDecay_flat.header:
theorem harmDecay_flat {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (d : ℕ) (hd : 12 * ell + 10 ≤ d) :
    HarmDecayAt ell L (flatCfg : Cfg L) (epsD ell d) d

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.inner_pert_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.inner_pert_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.inner_pert_le.header:
theorem inner_pert_le {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (a b a' b' : F)
    (X Y cA cB d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hX : 0 ≤ X) (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (hcB : 0 ≤ cB)
    (ha : ‖a' - a‖ ≤ d * X) (hb : ‖b' - b‖ ≤ d * Y) (hA : ‖a‖ ≤ cA) (hB : ‖b‖ ≤ cB) :
    |⟪a', b'⟫ - ⟪a, b⟫| ≤ d * X * (cB + d * Y) + cA * (d * Y)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.header:
structure GSplit (E F1 F2 F3 : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F1] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F1] [NormedAddCommGroup F2] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F2]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F3] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F3]

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.Nw_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.Nw_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.Nw_le.header: theorem Nw_le (x : E) : ‖J.Nw x‖ ≤ J.tt * Real.sqrt (J.En x)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.sq_sum_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.sq_sum_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.sq_sum_le.header:
theorem sq_sum_le (x : E) :
    ‖J.Y1 x‖ ^ 2 + ‖J.Y2 x‖ ^ 2 + ‖J.Y3 x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + J.cΔ) * J.En x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.Y_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.Y_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.Y_le.header:
theorem Y_le (x : E) (i : Fin 3) :
    (match i with | 0 => ‖J.Y1 x‖ | 1 => ‖J.Y2 x‖ | 2 => ‖J.Y3 x‖) ≤ J.ss * Real.sqrt (J.En x)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.cj_pair.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.cj_pair
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.cj_pair.header:
theorem cj_pair {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (ω : WPair F) (Y : E →L[ℝ] F) (x y : E) :
    ⟪Y (J.ωE.w x), Y (J.ωE.wi y)⟫ = ⟪cjm J.ωE ω Y x, cjp J.ωE ω Y y⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.piece_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.piece_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.piece_le.header:
theorem piece_le {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (ω : WPair F) (Y : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hp : ∀ x, ‖(cjp J.ωE ω Y - Y) x‖ ≤ d * ‖J.Nw x‖) (hm : ∀ x, ‖(cjm J.ωE ω Y - Y) x‖ ≤ d * ‖J.Nw x‖)
    (hY : ∀ x, ‖Y x‖ ≤ J.ss * Real.sqrt (J.En x)) (x y : E) :
    |⟪cjm J.ωE ω Y x, cjp J.ωE ω Y y⟫ - ⟪Y x, Y y⟫|
      ≤ (2 * d * J.ss * J.tt + d ^ 2 * J.tt ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (J.En x) * Real.sqrt (J.En y))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.hHB_of_split.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.hHB_of_split
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.GSplit.hHB_of_split.header:
theorem hHB_of_split (x y : E) :
    |⟪x, cjp J.ωE J.ωE J.Ginv y⟫ - ⟪x, J.Ginv y⟫|
      ≤ J.kap * (Real.sqrt ⟪x, J.Ginv x⟫ * Real.sqrt ⟪y, J.Ginv y⟫)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.pE_iE.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.pE_iE
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.pE_iE.header: theorem pE_iE (z : ↥(bondSupp G)) : pE G (iE G z) = z

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.iE_pE.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.iE_pE
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.iE_pE.header: theorem iE_pE (y : BondFnL2 L) (hy : y ∈ bondSupp G) : iE G (pE G y) = y

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bondWt_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bondWt_mem
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bondWt_mem.header: theorem bondWt_mem (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (x : ↥(bondSupp G)) : bondWt φ (iE G x) ∈ bondSupp G

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.eW.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.eW
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.eW.header: noncomputable def eW (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) : ↥(bondSupp G) →L[ℝ] ↥(bondSupp G)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.iE_eW.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.iE_eW
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.iE_eW.header: theorem iE_eW (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (x : ↥(bondSupp G)) : iE G (eW G φ x) = bondWt φ (iE G x)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.inner_E.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.inner_E
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.inner_E.header: theorem inner_E (x y : ↥(bondSupp G)) : ⟪x, y⟫ = ⟪iE G x, iE G y⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.EWP.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.EWP
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.EWP.header: noncomputable def EWP (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) : WPair ↥(bondSupp G)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.rowWt_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.rowWt_apply
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.rowWt_apply.header:
theorem rowWt_apply (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : FSp G) (p : BIdx G) :
    rowWt G φ f p = Real.exp (φ (rowBase G p)) • f p

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.rowWt_cancel.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.rowWt_cancel
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.rowWt_cancel.header: theorem rowWt_cancel (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : FSp G) : rowWt G φ (rowWt G (-φ) f) = f

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.rowWt_symm.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.rowWt_symm
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.rowWt_symm.header: theorem rowWt_symm (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f g : FSp G) : ⟪rowWt G φ f, g⟫ = ⟪f, rowWt G φ g⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.rowWP.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.rowWP
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.rowWP.header: noncomputable def rowWP (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) : WPair (FSp G)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.plaqMaskC.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.plaqMaskC
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.plaqMaskC.header:
noncomputable def plaqMaskC {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) :
    PlaqFnL2 L →L[ℝ] PlaqFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.plaqMaskC_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.plaqMaskC_apply
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.plaqMaskC_apply.header:
theorem plaqMaskC_apply {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (f : PlaqFnL2 L) :
    plaqMaskC P f = plaqMask P f

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.plaqWt_eq_plaqMul.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.plaqWt_eq_plaqMul
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.plaqWt_eq_plaqMul.header:
theorem plaqWt_eq_plaqMul {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : PlaqFnL2 L) :
    plaqWt ξ f = plaqMul (fun q => Real.exp (ξ q.1)) f

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Y1.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Y1
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Y1.header: noncomputable def Y1 : ↥(bondSupp G) →L[ℝ] PlaqFnL2 Lf

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Y2.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Y2
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Y2.header: noncomputable def Y2 : ↥(bondSupp G) →L[ℝ] SiteL2 Lf

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Y3.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Y3
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Y3.header: noncomputable def Y3 : ↥(bondSupp G) →L[ℝ] FSp G

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Kz.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Kz
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Kz.header: noncomputable def Kz : ↥(bondSupp G) →L[ℝ] PlaqFnL2 Lf

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Wb.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Wb
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Wb.header: noncomputable def Wb : ↥(bondSupp G) →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 Lf

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Δg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Δg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Δg.header: noncomputable def Δg (x y : ↥(bondSupp G)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.inner_diagW_sqrt.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.inner_diagW_sqrt
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.inner_diagW_sqrt.header:
theorem inner_diagW_sqrt (w : BIdx G → ℝ) (hw : ∀ p, 0 ≤ w p) (f g : FSp G) :
    ⟪f, diagW G w g⟫ = ⟪diagW G (fun p => Real.sqrt (w p)) f, diagW G (fun p => Real.sqrt (w p)) g⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ginv_bil.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ginv_bil
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ginv_bil.header:
theorem ginv_bil {ell k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell0 : 0 < ell) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hu : IsUnit (LP (geomOf ell k S) U a)) (x y : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    ⟪x, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data.Ginv y⟫
      = ⟪Y1 (geomOf ell k S) U (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) x, Y1 (geomOf ell k S) U (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) y⟫
        + ⟪Y2 (geomOf ell k S) U x, Y2 (geomOf ell k S) U y⟫
        + ⟪Y3 (geomOf ell k S) U a x, Y3 (geomOf ell k S) U a y⟫
        + Δg (geomOf ell k S) U a (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) x y

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okP.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okP
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okP.header: theorem okP : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + D.χ) D.Θ D.Δ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okM.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okM
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okM.header: theorem okM : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + -D.χ) D.Θ D.Δ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okMM.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okMM
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okMM.header: theorem okMM : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + -(-D.χ)) D.Θ D.Δ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okN1.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okN1
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okN1.header: theorem okN1 : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (D.χ + -psiW S W ell k) D.Θ D.Δ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okN2.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okN2
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.okN2.header: theorem okN2 : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (-D.χ + -psiW S W ell k) D.Θ D.Δ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ok0P.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ok0P
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ok0P.header: theorem ok0P : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) D.Θ D.Δ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ok0M.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ok0M
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ok0M.header: theorem ok0M : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (psiW S W ell k + -fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) D.Θ D.Δ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ok0N.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ok0N
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ok0N.header: theorem ok0N : WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell ((fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) + -psiW S W ell k) D.Θ D.Δ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ZC_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ZC_zero
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.ZC_zero.header:
theorem ZC_zero (B : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    D.ZC (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) B = Gp (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (Tfull (geomOf ell k S) D.U B)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.WC_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.WC_zero
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.WC_zero.header:
theorem WC_zero (B : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    D.WC (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) B = Wop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a B

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GpT_conj.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GpT_conj
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.GpT_conj.header:
theorem GpT_conj (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    Gp (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (Tfull (geomOf ell k S) D.U (bondWt (-ξ) B)) = siteWt (-ξ) (D.ZC ξ B)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.W_conj.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.W_conj
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.W_conj.header:
theorem W_conj (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    Wop (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (bondWt ξ B) = bondWt ξ (D.WC (-ξ) B)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.kapK.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.kapK
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.kapK.header: noncomputable def kapK (ell : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.nuD.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.nuD
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.nuD.header: noncomputable def nuD (ell : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.cYc.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.cYc
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.cYc.header: noncomputable def cYc (ell : ℕ) (ρ cw kZ kW : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.cDc.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.cDc
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.cDc.header: noncomputable def cDc (ell : ℕ) (ρ cw kZ kW : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.cDc'.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.cDc'
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.cDc'.header: noncomputable def cDc' (ell : ℕ) (ρ cw kZ kW θ' d1 : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.d1c.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.d1c
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.d1c.header: noncomputable def d1c (ell : ℕ) (θ' : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.d3c.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.d3c
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.d3c.header: noncomputable def d3c (ell : ℕ) (a Sstar θ' : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.kapK_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.kapK_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.kapK_nonneg.header: theorem kapK_nonneg (ell : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) : 0 ≤ kapK ell ρ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.nuD_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.nuD_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.nuD_nonneg.header: theorem nuD_nonneg (ell : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) : 0 ≤ nuD ell ρ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.NnE.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.NnE
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.NnE.header: noncomputable def NnE {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : TowerGeom L) (x : ↥(bondSupp G)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Kz_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Kz_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Kz_le.header:
theorem Kz_le (x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    ‖Kz (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) x‖ ≤ kapK ell ρ * D.kZc * NnE (geomOf ell k S) x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.dp_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.dp_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.dp_le.header:
theorem dp_le (u v : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    |deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc D.U (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) u v|
      ≤ nuD ell ρ * (‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖ * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) v‖)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Wb_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Wb_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Wb_le.header:
theorem Wb_le (x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (Wb (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a x)‖ ≤ D.kWc * NnE (geomOf ell k S) x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.NE.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.NE
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.NE.header:
theorem NE (x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    cw * NnE (geomOf ell k S) x ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S D.U D.a Lam).data.Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.E_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.E_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.E_nonneg.header:
theorem E_nonneg (x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    0 ≤ ⟪x, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S D.U D.a Lam).data.Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Nn_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Nn_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Nn_le.header:
theorem Nn_le (x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    NnE (geomOf ell k S) x ≤ Real.sqrt ⟪x, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S D.U D.a Lam).data.Ginv x⟫ / Real.sqrt cw

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Y1_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Y1_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Y1_le.header:
theorem Y1_le (x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    ‖Y1 (geomOf ell k S) D.U (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) x‖
      ≤ cYc ell ρ cw D.kZc D.kWc * Real.sqrt ⟪x, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S D.U D.a Lam).data.Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hL_G.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hL_G
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hL_G.header:
theorem hL_G (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (hξ : ξ = D.χ ∨ ξ = -D.χ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (μ : Fin 3) :
    |ξ x - ξ (periodicLatticeShift x μ)| ≤ θ' / (ell : ℝ) ^ stratG (geomOf ell k S) x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hL_c.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hL_c
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hL_c.header:
theorem hL_c (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (hξ : ξ = D.χ ∨ ξ = -D.χ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (μ : Fin 3) : |ξ x - ξ (periodicLatticeShift x μ)| ≤ θ'

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hL_s.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hL_s
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hL_s.header:
theorem hL_s (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (hξ : ξ = D.χ ∨ ξ = -D.χ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (μ : Fin 3) :
    |ξ (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - ξ x| ≤ θ' / (ell : ℝ) ^ AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Kz_cjp.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Kz_cjp
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Kz_cjp.header:
theorem Kz_cjp (y : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    ‖plaqWt D.χ (Kz (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) (eW (geomOf ell k S) (-D.χ) y))‖
      ≤ Real.exp (2 * θ') * kapK ell ρ * D.kZc * NnE (geomOf ell k S) y

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Kz_cjm.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Kz_cjm
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Kz_cjm.header:
theorem Kz_cjm (x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    ‖plaqWt (-D.χ) (Kz (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) (eW (geomOf ell k S) D.χ x))‖
      ≤ Real.exp (2 * θ') * kapK ell ρ * D.kZc * NnE (geomOf ell k S) x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.dpW_cj.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.dpW_cj
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.dpW_cj.header:
theorem dpW_cj (x y : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    |deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc D.U (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) (Wb (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (eW (geomOf ell k S) D.χ x))
        (Wb (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (eW (geomOf ell k S) (-D.χ) y))|
      ≤ Real.exp (2 * θ') * nuD ell ρ * D.kWc ^ 2 * (NnE (geomOf ell k S) x * NnE (geomOf ell k S) y)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Y1_diff.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Y1_diff
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Y1_diff.header:
theorem Y1_diff (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (hξ : ξ = D.χ ∨ ξ = -D.χ)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    ‖plaqWt ξ (Y1 (geomOf ell k S) D.U (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) (eW (geomOf ell k S) (-ξ) x))
        - Y1 (geomOf ell k S) D.U (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) x‖ ≤ d1c ell θ' * NnE (geomOf ell k S) x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.pair_plaq.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.pair_plaq
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.pair_plaq.header:
theorem pair_plaq (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (u v : PlaqFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ⟪u, v⟫ = ⟪plaqWt (-φ) u, plaqWt φ v⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Nn_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Nn_eq
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Nn_eq.header:
theorem Nn_eq (x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    ‖eW (geomOf ell k S) (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) x‖ = NnE (geomOf ell k S) x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Dg0.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Dg0
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Dg0.header:
theorem Dg0 (x y : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    |Δg (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) x y|
      ≤ cDc ell ρ cw D.kZc D.kWc
        * (Real.sqrt ⟪x, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S D.U D.a Lam).data.Ginv x⟫
          * Real.sqrt ⟪y, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S D.U D.a Lam).data.Ginv y⟫)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Dg1.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Dg1
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.Dg1.header:
theorem Dg1 (x y : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    |Δg (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) (eW (geomOf ell k S) D.χ x) (eW (geomOf ell k S) (-D.χ) y)|
      ≤ cDc' ell ρ cw D.kZc D.kWc θ' (d1c ell θ')
        * (Real.sqrt ⟪x, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S D.U D.a Lam).data.Ginv x⟫
          * Real.sqrt ⟪y, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S D.U D.a Lam).data.Ginv y⟫)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.d1c_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.d1c_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.d1c_nonneg.header: theorem d1c_nonneg (θ' : ℝ) (hθ' : 0 ≤ θ') : 0 ≤ d1c ell θ'

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.T_diffE.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.T_diffE
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.T_diffE.header:
theorem T_diffE (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (hξ : ξ = D.χ ∨ ξ = -D.χ)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    ‖siteWt ξ (Tfull (geomOf ell k S) D.U (iE (geomOf ell k S) (eW (geomOf ell k S) (-ξ) x)))
        - Tfull (geomOf ell k S) D.U (iE (geomOf ell k S) x)‖ ≤ D.dTc D.θχ * NnE (geomOf ell k S) x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.M_diffE.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.M_diffE
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.M_diffE.header:
theorem M_diffE (Sstar : ℝ) (Dr : RegData ell k Lu S D.U Sstar)
    (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (hξ : ξ = D.χ ∨ ξ = -D.χ)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    ‖rowWt (geomOf ell k S) ξ (Ymass (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (iE (geomOf ell k S) (eW (geomOf ell k S) (-ξ) x)))
        - Ymass (geomOf ell k S) D.U D.a (iE (geomOf ell k S) x)‖ ≤ d3c ell D.a Sstar θ' * NnE (geomOf ell k S) x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.gsplit.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.gsplit
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.gsplit.header:
noncomputable def gsplit : GSplit ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S)) (PlaqFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (FSp (geomOf ell k S))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hHB_genuine.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hHB_genuine
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.hHB_genuine.header:
theorem hHB_genuine (x y : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    |⟪x, cjp (EWP (geomOf ell k S) D.χ) (EWP (geomOf ell k S) D.χ)
          (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S D.U D.a Lam).data.Ginv y⟫
        - ⟪x, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S D.U D.a Lam).data.Ginv y⟫|
      ≤ (D.gsplit hell0 Lam ρ hρ hreg hεγ hcG cw hcw hW4 θ' hθ' hL hR8 Sstar Dr).kap
        * (Real.sqrt ⟪x, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S D.U D.a Lam).data.Ginv x⟫
          * Real.sqrt ⟪y, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S D.U D.a Lam).data.Ginv y⟫)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.diagW_apply'.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.diagW_apply'
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.diagW_apply'.header: theorem diagW_apply' (w : BIdx G → ℝ) (f : FSp G) (p : BIdx G) : diagW G w f p = w p • f p

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.diagW_mul.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.diagW_mul

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.diagW_rowWt.header:

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.omJ_sq_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.omJ_sq_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.omJ_sq_le.header:
theorem omJ_sq_le {ell M R k : ℕ} {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (b : Bond L) :
    (omJ S ell k b) ^ 2 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k b.1) ^ 2
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 6 * (((ell : ℝ) ^ AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k b.1)⁻¹) ^ 4

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.H_col.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.H_col
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.CTData.H_col.header:
theorem H_col
    (hκ1 : (D.gsplit hell0 Lam ρ hρ hreg hεγ hcG cw hcw hW4 θ' hθ' hL hR8 Sstar Dr).kap < 1)
    (hcN : 0 < 1 / (D.wschur hell0 Lam ρ hρ hreg hεγ hcG cw hcw hW4 θ' hθ' hL hR8 Sstar Dr bN hbN hext hQs hκ1).bN
      - (D.wschur hell0 Lam ρ hρ hreg hεγ hcG cw hcw hW4 θ' hθ' hL hR8 Sstar Dr bN hbN hext hQs hκ1).EN)
    (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (v : SuTwo)
    (hc0 : D.χ (rowBase (geomOf ell k S) p) = 0)
    (Cg : ℝ) (hCg0 : 0 ≤ Cg)
    (hCg : ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu),
        (((ell : ℝ) ^ AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k x)⁻¹) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-(2 * D.χ x))
      ≤ Cg * ((ell : ℝ) ^ AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k (rowBase (geomOf ell k S) p))⁻¹)
    (hlev : (p.1 : ℕ) ≤ AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k (rowBase (geomOf ell k S) p) + 1) :
    ∑ b, omJ S ell k b * ‖(iE (geomOf ell k S) ((gparams ell k Lu hell0 S D.U D.a Lam).data.H
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single p v) : FSp (geomOf ell k S)))) b‖
      ≤ Real.sqrt (3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 7 * D.a * Cg)
        * (D.wschur hell0 Lam ρ hρ hreg hεγ hcG cw hcw hW4 θ' hθ' hL hR8 Sstar Dr bN hbN hext hQs hκ1).CHw * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.M1DK.pdist_le_sumoff.name: AdalyFormal.M1DK.pdist_le_sumoff
AdalyFormal.M1DK.pdist_le_sumoff.header: theorem pdist_le_sumoff (y z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : pdist y z ≤ ∑ σ : Fin 3, off y z σ

AdalyFormal.M1DK.goodPl_pd.name: AdalyFormal.M1DK.goodPl_pd
AdalyFormal.M1DK.goodPl_pd.header:
theorem goodPl_pd (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (R : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Prop) :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L), (∀ w, pdist y w ≤ 12 * ell ^ l → R w) → GoodPl ell R l y

AdalyFormal.M1DK.goodL_pd.name: AdalyFormal.M1DK.goodL_pd
AdalyFormal.M1DK.goodL_pd.header:
theorem goodL_pd (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (Rl : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop) :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L),
      (∀ b : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, b.2 = c.2 → pdist c.1 b.1 ≤ ell ^ l → Rl b) → goodL ell Rl l c

AdalyFormal.M1DK.goodBd_pd.name: AdalyFormal.M1DK.goodBd_pd
AdalyFormal.M1DK.goodBd_pd.header:
theorem goodBd_pd (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (R : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Prop) :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L), c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ l) → (∀ σ, ell ^ l ∣ L σ + 1) →
      (∀ w, pdist c.1 w ≤ 12 * ell ^ l → R w) → GoodBd ell R l c

AdalyFormal.M1DK.pcd_blk.name: AdalyFormal.M1DK.pcd_blk
AdalyFormal.M1DK.pcd_blk.header:
theorem pcd_blk (N s a b : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (ha : a < N) (hb : b < N * s) :
    s * pcd N a (b / s) ≤ pcd (N * s) (s * a) b + s

AdalyFormal.M1DK.blk.name: AdalyFormal.M1DK.blk
AdalyFormal.M1DK.blk.header:
def blk (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    PeriodicLatticeSite Lu

AdalyFormal.M1DK.blk_val.name: AdalyFormal.M1DK.blk_val
AdalyFormal.M1DK.blk_val.header:
theorem blk_val (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (μ : Fin 3) : ((blk ell k Lu hell x) μ).val = (x μ).val / ell ^ k

AdalyFormal.M1DK.pdist_blk.name: AdalyFormal.M1DK.pdist_blk
AdalyFormal.M1DK.pdist_blk.header:
theorem pdist_blk (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ell ^ k * pdist z (blk ell k Lu hell x) ≤ pdist (embY ell k Lu hell z) x + 3 * ell ^ k

AdalyFormal.M1DK.deep_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M1DK.deep_mem
AdalyFormal.M1DK.deep_mem.header:
theorem deep_mem {ell M R k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)}
    {Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hL : LambdaOK2 ell M R k S Lam) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {y z : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu} (hy : y ∈ Lam) (D : ℕ) (hroom : pdist y z + D + 3 ≤ R * M)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hx : pdist (embY ell k Lu hell z) x ≤ D * ell ^ k) :
    x ∈ S.Om k

AdalyFormal.M1DK.BK.name: AdalyFormal.M1DK.BK
AdalyFormal.M1DK.BK.header: def BK (S : Tower L) (k : ℕ) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M1DK.chart_bounds.name: AdalyFormal.M1DK.chart_bounds
AdalyFormal.M1DK.chart_bounds.header:
theorem chart_bounds (ell M k : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (α₀ : ℝ) (U : LinkCfg L)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (A : Bond L → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : η = ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹)
    (hg : ∀ e : Bond L, ((periodicGaugeTransform g U e : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
        = NormedSpace.exp (((η : ℂ) * Complex.I) • A e))
    (hb : AdalyFormal.M1.M1Bounds S ell M 12 k α₀ η A)
    (hα : 0 ≤ α₀) (hβ1 : (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ 1) :
    (∀ e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, BK S k e → dv (periodicGaugeTransform g U e) ≤ (12 * M * α₀) / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) ∧
    (∀ t : PlaqT L, plaqIn (BK S k) t →
      dv (pw 1 (periodicGaugeTransform g U) t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2)
        ≤ (2 * (12 * M * α₀) + (4 * Real.pi + 2) * (12 * M * α₀) ^ 2) / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M1DK.pdist_shift1.name: AdalyFormal.M1DK.pdist_shift1
AdalyFormal.M1DK.pdist_shift1.header:
theorem pdist_shift1 {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {x w : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {n : ℕ} (h : pdist x w ≤ n) (d : Fin 3) :
    pdist x (coarseShift w 1 d) ≤ n + 1

AdalyFormal.M1DK.tower_near.name: AdalyFormal.M1DK.tower_near
AdalyFormal.M1DK.tower_near.header:
theorem tower_near (ell M R k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hL : LambdaOK2 ell M R k S Lam) (hT3 : ∀ μ, 3 ≤ Lu μ + 1)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (e1 q1 : ℝ) (hq1 : 0 ≤ q1)
    (hlink : ∀ e : PeriodicLatticeEdge (scaleUp ell k Lu), BK S k e → dv (V e) ≤ e1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (hplaq : ∀ t : PlaqT (scaleUp ell k Lu), plaqIn (BK S k) t → dv (pw 1 V t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ q1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2)
    (hsm : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * q1 ≤ 1)
    {y z : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu} (hy : y ∈ Lam) (hz : pdist y z + 17 ≤ R * M) (μ : Fin 3) :
    dv (AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.ubarTowerSU2 ell V k (embY ell k Lu hell z, μ)) ≤ e1 + 3 * Real.pi * q1

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsetPath.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsetPath
Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsetPath.header: def offsetPath {ell : ℕ} (o : Fin 3 → Fin ell) : List (Fin 3)

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsetPoint.header:

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsetPoint_mem.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsetPoint_mem
Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsetPoint_mem.header:
theorem offsetPoint_mem (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)

    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (s*ell)) (o : Fin 3 → Fin ell) :
    offsetPoint s y o ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsetPoint_path.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsetPoint_path
Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsetPoint_path.header:
theorem offsetPoint_path (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s*ell ∣ L μ+1)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (s*ell)) (o : Fin 3 → Fin ell) :
    coarseGammaPath s y (offsetPoint s y o) = offsetPath o

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsetPoint_shif.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsetPoint_shift

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsetPoint_inje.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsetPoint_injective
Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsetPoint_inje.header:
theorem offsetPoint_injective (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)

    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (s*ell)) :

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsets_image.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsets_image
Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.offsets_image.header:
theorem offsets_image (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s*ell ∣ L μ+1)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (s*ell)) :
    Finset.univ.image (offsetPoint s y (ell := ell)) = stepBlockOf y s ell

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.sum_block_offset.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.sum_block_offsets
Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.sum_block_offset.header:
theorem sum_block_offsets {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A]
    (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s*ell ∣ L μ+1)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (s*ell))
    (F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → A) :
    ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, F x = ∑ o : Fin 3 → Fin ell, F (offsetPoint s y o)

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.path_endpoint_al.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.path_endpoint_aligned
Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.path_endpoint_al.header:
theorem path_endpoint_aligned (s : ℕ) (hd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s ∣ L μ + 1)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L s) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    coarsePathEndpoint s y p ∈ CoarseLattice L s

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.fitted_ladder_fa.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.fitted_ladder_factor_bound
Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.fitted_ladder_fa.header:
theorem fitted_ladder_factor_bound (s : ℕ) (hd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s ∣ L μ + 1)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (β : ℝ) (hin : SublatticePlaqBound s V β)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L s)
    (μ ν : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) {g : SU2} (hg : g ∈ ladderFactorsS s V y μ ν ell) :
    frobNorm ((g : M2)-1) ≤ β

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.fitted_surface_f.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.fitted_surface_factor_bound
Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.fitted_surface_f.header:
theorem fitted_surface_factor_bound (s : ℕ) (hd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s ∣ L μ + 1)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (β : ℝ) (hin : SublatticePlaqBound s V β)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L s)
    (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) (acc rest : List (Fin 3))
    {g : SU2} (hg : g ∈ surfaceAlongS s V y μ ell acc rest) :
    frobNorm ((g : M2)-1) ≤ β

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.fitted_surface_n.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.fitted_surface_norm
Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.fitted_surface_n.header:
theorem fitted_surface_norm (s : ℕ) (hd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s ∣ L μ + 1)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hin : SublatticePlaqBound s V β)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L s)
    (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ) (acc rest : List (Fin 3)) :
    frobNorm ((((surfaceAlongS s V y μ ell acc rest).prod : SU2) : M2)-1) ≤
      (ell : ℝ) * rest.length * β

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.fitted_loop_norm.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.fitted_loop_norm
Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.fitted_loop_norm.header:
theorem fitted_loop_norm (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s*ell ∣ L μ + 1)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hin : SublatticePlaqBound s V β)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (hc : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (s*ell))
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell) :
    frobNorm (((loopVar s ell V c x : SU2) : M2)-1) ≤ 3*((ell : ℝ)^2*β)

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.fitted_rectangle.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.fitted_rectangle_norm
Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.fitted_rectangle.header:
theorem fitted_rectangle_norm (s ell : ℕ) (hd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s ∣ L μ + 1)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hin : SublatticePlaqBound s V β)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L s) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS (s*ell) (coarseBondVar s ell V) y μ ν : SU2) : M2)-1)
      ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2*β

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.gamma_at_offset.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.gamma_at_offset
Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.gamma_at_offset.header:
theorem gamma_at_offset (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s*ell ∣ L μ+1) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (hc : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (s*ell))
    (o : Fin 3 → Fin ell) :
    gammaVarStrided s ell V c (offsetPoint s c.1 o) =
      coarsePathHolonomy s V c.1 (offsetPath o) *
        coarseBondVar s ell V (offsetPoint s c.1 o, c.2) *
        (coarsePathHolonomy s V (coarseShift c.1 (s*ell) c.2) (offsetPath o))⁻¹

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.gamma_offset_rec.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.gamma_offset_rectangle
Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.gamma_offset_rec.header:
theorem gamma_offset_rectangle (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s*ell ∣ L μ+1) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (s*ell))
    (μ ν : Fin 3) (o : Fin 3 → Fin ell) :
    orientedPlaqHolS (s*ell)
      (fun c => gammaVarStrided s ell V c (offsetPoint s c.1 o)) y μ ν =
    coarsePathHolonomy s V y (offsetPath o) *
      orientedPlaqHolS (s*ell) (coarseBondVar s ell V) (offsetPoint s y o) μ ν *
      (coarsePathHolonomy s V y (offsetPath o))⁻¹

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.raw_bond_offset_.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.raw_bond_offset_mean
Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.raw_bond_offset_.header:
theorem raw_bond_offset_mean (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s*ell ∣ L μ+1) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (hc : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (s*ell)) :
    ubarSU2 s ell V c =
      loopMean Finset.univ (fun _ : Fin 3 → Fin ell => ((((ell : ℚ)^3)⁻¹ : ℚ) : ℝ))
        (fun o => gammaVarStrided s ell V c (offsetPoint s c.1 o) *
          (coarseBondVar s ell V c)⁻¹) * coarseBondVar s ell V c

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.fitted_plaquette.header:

theorem plaquette_transport {G : Type*} [Group G]

      e * (a*f*a⁻¹) * ((a*b*c⁻¹)*g⁻¹*(a*b*c⁻¹)⁻¹) *
        ((a*b*c⁻¹*d⁻¹)*h⁻¹*(a*b*c⁻¹*d⁻¹)⁻¹) * (a*b*c⁻¹*d⁻¹)

DepthUniformityFinal.Assemble.unconditio.name: DepthUniformityFinal.Assemble.unconditional_depth_uniformity
DepthUniformityFinal.Assemble.unconditio.header:
theorem unconditional_depth_uniformity (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (alpha0 : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < alpha0)
    (hcontract : 4 * 44465 * alpha0 * (ell : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2 - 1)
    (hc : 2 * alpha0 ≤ (400 * (ell : ℝ)^2)⁻¹)
    (hdepth : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell^k ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (hfine : ∀ y μ ν,
      frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS 1 U y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ alpha0 * etaSq ell k)
    (j : ℕ) (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    SublatticePlaqBound (ell^j) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U j) (2 * alpha0) ∧
    SublatticePlaqBound (ell^j) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U j)
      (2 * (alpha0 * ((ell : ℝ)^2)^j * etaSq ell k)) ∧
    SublatticePlaqBound (ell^j) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U j)
      ((alpha0 * ((ell : ℝ)^2)^j * etaSq ell k) *
        (1 + 4 * 44465 * alpha0 * etaSq ell k * geomS ell j)) ∧
    (j < k → ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell^j) →
      ∀ μ ν : Fin 3,
        frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS (ell^j) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U j) y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1)
          < alpha0)

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.repaired_depth.header:
theorem repaired_depth (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (C0 a c : ℝ)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C0) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hcontract : 4 * C0 * a * (ell : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2 - 1)
    (hc : 2 * a ≤ c) (hd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell^k ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (hp : ScaleFittedPropagation (L := L) ell C0 c)
    (hin : SublatticePlaqBound 1 V (a * etaSq ell k)) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ k → SublatticePlaqBound (ell^j) (ubarTowerSU2 ell V j)

Prop1.ScaleFittedRepair.repaired_uniform.header:

      ≤ 2 * a

theorem averagingC2_homogeneous (t r : ℝ) (A : F) :
    averagingC2 t (r • A) = r^2 • averagingC2 t A

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.cov.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.covGrad
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.cov.header: noncomputable def covGrad (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) : (S L) →L[ℝ] (H L)

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.cov.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.covCurl
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.cov.header: noncomputable def covCurl (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) : (H L) →L[ℝ] (F L)

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.cur.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.curlSquare
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.cur.header: noncomputable def curlSquare (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) : (H L) →L[ℝ] (H L)

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.cur.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.curlSquare_energy
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.cur.header:
theorem curlSquare_energy (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (A : (H L)) :
    (inner ℝ A (curlSquare U A) : ℝ) = ‖covCurl U A‖ ^ 2

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.cor.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.correctionBil
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.cor.header: def correctionBil (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) : (H L) →ₗ[ℝ] (H L) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.cor.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.correctionBil_apply
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.cor.header:
lemma correctionBil_apply (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (A B : (H L)) :
    correctionBil U A B = 32 * HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPrimeBil U (bfl2Equiv A) (bfl2Equiv B)

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.inn.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.inner_riesz
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.inn.header: lemma inner_riesz (f : (H L) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (A : (H L)) : (inner ℝ A (riesz f) : ℝ) = f A

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.fro.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.fromBil
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.fro.header: def fromBil (b : (H L) →ₗ[ℝ] (H L) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) : (H L) →L[ℝ] (H L)

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.inn.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.inner_fromBil
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.inn.header:
lemma inner_fromBil (b : (H L) →ₗ[ℝ] (H L) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (A B : (H L)) :
    (inner ℝ A (fromBil b B) : ℝ) = b A B

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.del.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.deltaU
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.del.header: def deltaU (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) : (H L) →L[ℝ] (H L)

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.del.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.deltaU_energy
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.del.header:
theorem deltaU_energy (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (A : (H L)) :
    (inner ℝ A (deltaU U A) : ℝ) = ‖covCurl U A‖^2 +
      64 * deltaPrimeQuadFormNormalizedTransported U (bfl2Equiv A)

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.del.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.deltaU_selfAdjoint
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.del.header:
theorem deltaU_selfAdjoint (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (A B : (H L)) :
    (inner ℝ (deltaU U A) B : ℝ) = inner ℝ A (deltaU U B)

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.sit.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.siteDeltaU
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.Physical.sit.header: def siteDeltaU (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) : S L →L[ℝ] S L

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.gaugeImageU.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.gaugeImageU
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.gaugeImageU.header: def gaugeImageU (t : ℝ) : Submodule ℝ SF

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.siteRU_idemp.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.siteRU_idempotent
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.siteRU_idemp.header:
lemma siteRU_idempotent (t : ℝ) :
    siteRU t * siteRU t = siteRU t

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.siteRU_adjoi.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.siteRU_adjoint
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.siteRU_adjoi.header:
lemma siteRU_adjoint (t : ℝ) :
    (siteRU t).adjoint = siteRU t

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.gaugeU_ident.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.gaugeU_identity
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.gaugeU_ident.header:
lemma gaugeU_identity (t : ℝ) :
    (gaugeConstraintU t).adjoint.comp (gaugeConstraintU t) =
      (covGrad (U t)).comp ((siteRU t).comp (covGrad (U t)).adjoint)

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.precision.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.precision
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.precision.header: def precision (t a : ℝ) : F →L[ℝ] F

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.precision_en.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.precision_energy
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.precision_en.header:
theorem precision_energy (t a : ℝ) (A : F) :
    (inner ℝ A (precision t a A) : ℝ) = ‖covCurl (U t) A‖^2 +
      64 * deltaPrimeQuadFormNormalizedTransported (U t) (bfl2Equiv A) +
      ‖gaugeConstraintU t A‖^2 + 512*a*‖CovarianceScale.incomingQ t A‖^2

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.contractedBi.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.contractedBil
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.contractedBi.header:
def contractedBil (post : V →L[ℝ] E) (hess : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] V) (J : E) :
    E →ₗ[ℝ] E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.contractedBi.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.contractedBil_apply
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.contractedBi.header:
theorem contractedBil_apply (post : V →L[ℝ] E) (hess : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] V) (J A B : E) :
    contractedBil post hess J A B = inner ℝ J (post (hess A B))

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.secondDeltaP.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.secondDeltaPort
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.secondDeltaP.header: def secondDeltaPort (t : ℝ) (H : K →L[ℝ] F) : F →L[ℝ] F

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.secondDeltaP.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.secondDeltaPort_bilinear
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.secondDeltaP.header:
theorem secondDeltaPort_bilinear (t : ℝ) (H : K →L[ℝ] F) (A B : F) :
    (inner ℝ A (secondDeltaPort t H B) : ℝ) = 256 *
      (inner ℝ (sourceFunctional t) (H (averagingHessian t A B)) +
       inner ℝ (sourceFunctional t) (H (averagingHessian t B A)))

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.secondDeltaP.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.secondDeltaPort_energy
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.secondDeltaP.header:
theorem secondDeltaPort_energy (t : ℝ) (H : K →L[ℝ] F) (A : F) :
    fineInner A (secondDeltaPort t H A) = 2 * fineInner (H (averagingC2 t A)) (JF t)

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.secondDeltaP.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.secondDeltaPort_selfAdjoint
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.secondDeltaP.header:
theorem secondDeltaPort_selfAdjoint (t : ℝ) (H : K →L[ℝ] F) (A B : F) :
    (inner ℝ (secondDeltaPort t H A) B : ℝ) = inner ℝ A (secondDeltaPort t H B)

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.secondDeltaP.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.secondDeltaPort_zero
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.secondDeltaP.header: theorem secondDeltaPort_zero (H : K →L[ℝ] F) : secondDeltaPort 0 H = 0

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.perturbation.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.perturbationPort
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.perturbation.header: def perturbationPort (t : ℝ) (H : K →L[ℝ] F) : F →L[ℝ] F

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.perturbation.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.perturbationPort_zero
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.perturbation.header: theorem perturbationPort_zero (H : K →L[ℝ] F) : perturbationPort 0 H = 0

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.perturbed_fo.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.perturbed_form
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.perturbed_fo.header:
theorem perturbed_form (t : ℝ) (H : K →L[ℝ] F) (A : F) :
    fineInner A ((precision t 1 - perturbationPort t H) A) =
      fineInner (gaugePi t A) (deltaU (U t) (gaugePi t A)) -
      2 * fineInner (H (averagingC2 t (gaugePi t A))) (JF t) +
      (1/512 : ℝ) * ‖gaugeConstraintU t A‖^2 + ‖incomingQ t A‖^2

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.sourceMatrix.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.sourceMatrix
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.sourceMatrix.header: def sourceMatrix (t : ℝ) (b : Bond fineL) : M2

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.sourceMatrix.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.sourceMatrix_scale
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.sourceMatrix.header:
theorem sourceMatrix_scale (t : ℝ) (b : Bond fineL) :
    sourceMatrix t b = (512 : ℝ) • Jsource (U t) b

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.JF_exact.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.JF_exact
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.JF_exact.header: theorem JF_exact (t : ℝ) : sourceCoordinates (JF t) = sourceMatrix t

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.JF_functiona.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.JF_functional
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.JF_functiona.header:
theorem JF_functional (t : ℝ) (A : F) :
    fineInner A (JF t) = inner ℝ A (sourceFunctional t)

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.smooth_holon.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.smooth_holonomy
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.smooth_holon.header:
theorem smooth_holonomy (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette fineL) :

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.smooth_im.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.smooth_im
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.smooth_im.header:
theorem smooth_im (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette fineL) :
    ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun t => imHolonomy (U t) p)

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.smooth_sourc.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.smooth_source_matrix
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.smooth_sourc.header:
theorem smooth_source_matrix (b : Bond fineL) :
    ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun t => Jsource (U t) b)

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.front.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.front
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.front.header: def front (ν : Fin 3) (hν : 0 < ν) : PeriodicLatticePlaquette fineL

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.back.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.back
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.back.header: def back (ν : Fin 3) (hν : 0 < ν) : PeriodicLatticePlaquette fineL

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.shift_origin.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.shift_origin_ne
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.shift_origin.header: theorem shift_origin_ne (ν : Fin 3) : periodicLatticeShift origin ν ≠ origin

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.back_origin_.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.back_origin_ne
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.back_origin_.header: theorem back_origin_ne (ν : Fin 3) : periodicLatticeShiftBack origin ν ≠ origin

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.front_hol.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.front_hol
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.front_hol.header:
theorem front_hol (t : ℝ) (ν : Fin 3) (hν : 0 < ν) :

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.back_hol.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.back_hol
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.back_hol.header:
theorem back_hol (t : ℝ) (ν : Fin 3) (hν : 0 < ν) :
    holonomyElem (U t) (back ν hν) = (rotElem t)⁻¹

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.source_entry.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.source_entry
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.source_entry.header:
theorem source_entry (t : ℝ) :
    (Jsource (U t) (origin,0) 0 1).im = -4 * rotB t

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.sourceFuncti.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.sourceFunctional_nonzero
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.sourceFuncti.header: theorem sourceFunctional_nonzero (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0) : sourceFunctional t ≠ 0

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.JF_nonzero.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.JF_nonzero
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.JF_nonzero.header: theorem JF_nonzero (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0) : JF t ≠ 0

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.unscaled_sou.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.unscaled_source_rejected
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.unscaled_sou.header: theorem unscaled_source_rejected (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0) : JF t ≠ sourceFunctional t

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.bareDelta_no.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.bareDelta_no_left_inverse
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.bareDelta_no.header:
theorem bareDelta_no_left_inverse : ¬ ∃ G : F →L[ℝ] F,
    ∀ A, G (deltaU (U 0) A) = A

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.precision_fl.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.precision_flat_energy
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.precision_fl.header:
theorem precision_flat_energy (a : ℝ) (A : F) :
    (inner ℝ A (precision 0 a A) : ℝ) = ‖covCurl (trivialU fineL) A‖^2 +
      ‖gaugeConstraintU 0 A‖^2 + 512*a*‖incomingQ 0 A‖^2

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.precision_fl.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.precision_flat_kernel_iff
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.precision_fl.header:
theorem precision_flat_kernel_iff (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (A : F) :
    precision 0 a A = 0 ↔
      covCurl (trivialU fineL) A = 0 ∧ gaugeConstraintU 0 A = 0 ∧ incomingQ 0 A = 0

HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.physicalG0_f.name: HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.physicalG0_forces_flat_jointKernel
HConstruction.DK3.FineScale.physicalG0_f.header:
theorem physicalG0_forces_flat_jointKernel (h : HasPhysicalG0 0 1) (A : F)
    (hc : covCurl (trivialU fineL) A = 0) (hg : gaugeConstraintU 0 A = 0)
    (hq : incomingQ 0 A = 0) : A = 0

HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.logs_ze.name: HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.logs_zero
HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.logs_ze.header:
lemma logs_zero (c : CoarseBond L (1 * 2)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (sourcePrincipalLogData 1 2 (trivialU L)).Zx c x = 0

HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.meanlog.name: HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.meanlog_zero
HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.meanlog.header:
lemma meanlog_zero (c : CoarseBond L (1 * 2)) :
    (sourcePrincipalLogData 1 2 (trivialU L)).Z c = 0

HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.E1_flat.name: HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.E1_flat
HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.E1_flat.header:
lemma E1_flat (c : CoarseBond L (1 * 2)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (Coeff124.ofPrincipalBackground 1 2 (trivialU L)).E1 c x = 0

HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.E2_flat.name: HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.E2_flat
HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.E2_flat.header:
lemma E2_flat (c : CoarseBond L (1 * 2)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :

HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.E3_flat.name: HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.E3_flat
HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.E3_flat.header:
lemma E3_flat (c : CoarseBond L (1 * 2)) :
    (Coeff124.ofPrincipalBackground 1 2 (trivialU L)).E3 c = 0

HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.q124_fl.name: HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.q124_flat
HConstruction.DK3.GeneralAverage.q124_fl.header:
theorem q124_flat (A : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo)
    (c : CoarseBond L (1 * 2)) :
    q124Principal 1 2 (trivialU L) A c =
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.TowerLawCov.unitToCoarseCov 1 2 (trivialU L) A c

HConstruction.DK3.GeneralSection.hit_geo.name: HConstruction.DK3.GeneralSection.hit_geometry
HConstruction.DK3.GeneralSection.hit_geo.header:
lemma hit_geometry : ∀ (c : CoarseBond L (1 * 2))
    (u : {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L // z ∈ CoarseLattice L 1}),
    u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 2 c.1.1 →
    (((u.1 c.2).val % 2 = 1 ∧ blockCorner 2 u.1 = c.1.1 ∧
      ¬ ((pathSite u.1 c.2 1 c.2).val % 2 = 1)) ∨
     (¬ ((u.1 c.2).val % 2 = 1) ∧ (pathSite u.1 c.2 1 c.2).val % 2 = 1 ∧
      blockCorner 2 (pathSite u.1 c.2 1) = c.1.1))

HConstruction.DK3.smooth_U.name: HConstruction.DK3.smooth_U
HConstruction.DK3.smooth_U.header:
theorem smooth_U (b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.Bond fineL) :
    ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun t => (U t b : M2))

HConstruction.DK3.smooth_fine_plaquette.name: HConstruction.DK3.smooth_fine_plaquette
HConstruction.DK3.smooth_fine_plaquette.header:
theorem smooth_fine_plaquette (y : FS) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun t => ((orientedPlaqHolS 1 (U t) y μ ν : SU2) : M2))

HConstruction.DK3.fine_defect_continuous.name: HConstruction.DK3.fine_defect_continuous
HConstruction.DK3.fine_defect_continuous.header:
theorem fine_defect_continuous (y : FS) (μ ν : Fin 3) : Continuous
    (fun t => frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS 1 (U t) y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1))

HConstruction.DK3.fine_defect_zero.name: HConstruction.DK3.fine_defect_zero
HConstruction.DK3.fine_defect_zero.header:
theorem fine_defect_zero (y : FS) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS 1 (U 0) y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1) = 0

HConstruction.DK3.fine_radius_exists.name: HConstruction.DK3.fine_radius_exists
HConstruction.DK3.fine_radius_exists.header:
theorem fine_radius_exists : ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < r →
    ∀ y μ ν, frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS 1 (U t) y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1)
      < alpha0 / 64

HConstruction.DK3.fine_gate.name: HConstruction.DK3.fine_gate
HConstruction.DK3.fine_gate.header:
theorem fine_gate (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ regularityRadius) :
    ∀ y μ ν, frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS 1 (U t) y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1)
      ≤ alpha0 * etaSq 2 3

HConstruction.DK3.depth3_regularity.name: HConstruction.DK3.depth3_regularity
HConstruction.DK3.depth3_regularity.header:
theorem depth3_regularity (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ regularityRadius)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 3) :
    SublatticePlaqBound (2^j) (tower t j) (2 * alpha0)

HConstruction.DK3.current_background_reg.name: HConstruction.DK3.current_background_regular
HConstruction.DK3.current_background_reg.header:
theorem current_background_regular (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ regularityRadius) :
    SublatticePlaqBound 8 (Vfine t) (2 * alpha0)

HConstruction.DK3.embed_shift.name: HConstruction.DK3.embed_shift
HConstruction.DK3.embed_shift.header:
theorem embed_shift (x : US) (μ : Fin 3) :
    embed (periodicLatticeShift x μ) =
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.coarseShift (embed x) 8 μ

HConstruction.DK3.unit_plaquette_reindex.name: HConstruction.DK3.unit_plaquette_reindex
HConstruction.DK3.unit_plaquette_reindex.header:
theorem unit_plaquette_reindex (t : ℝ) (x : US) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    DepthUniformity.Strided.orientedPlaqHolS 1 (V t) x μ ν =
    DepthUniformity.Strided.orientedPlaqHolS 8 (Vfine t) (embed x) μ ν

HConstruction.DK3.unit_background_regula.name: HConstruction.DK3.unit_background_regular
HConstruction.DK3.unit_background_regula.header:
theorem unit_background_regular (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ interval) (x : US) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNorm
      (((DepthUniformity.Strided.orientedPlaqHolS 1 (V t) x μ ν :
        AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.SU2) : AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.M2)-1) ≤ 2*alpha0

HConstruction.DK3.nativeRawQ_kernel_iff.name: HConstruction.DK3.nativeRawQ_kernel_iff
HConstruction.DK3.nativeRawQ_kernel_iff.header:
theorem nativeRawQ_kernel_iff (t : ℝ) (B : K) :
    nativeRawQ t B = 0 ↔ unitQ1 t (unitInput B) = 0

HConstruction.DK3.C_unitQ1_kernel.name: HConstruction.DK3.C_unitQ1_kernel
HConstruction.DK3.C_unitQ1_kernel.header:
theorem C_unitQ1_kernel (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ interval) (B : Reduced) :

HConstruction.DK3.crossing_end_outside.header:
theorem crossing_end_outside (c : CoarseBond unitL 2) :

HConstruction.DK3.crossing_interface.name: HConstruction.DK3.crossing_interface
HConstruction.DK3.crossing_interface.header: theorem crossing_interface (c : CoarseBond unitL 2) : interface c (crossingBond c)

HConstruction.DK3.unique_interface_cross.name: HConstruction.DK3.unique_interface_crossing
HConstruction.DK3.unique_interface_cross.header:
theorem unique_interface_crossing (c : CoarseBond unitL 2) (b : Bond unitL) :

HConstruction.DK3.sourceInterface.name: HConstruction.DK3.sourceInterface
HConstruction.DK3.sourceInterface.header: def sourceInterface (c : CoarseBond unitL 2) (b : Bond unitL) : Prop

HConstruction.DK3.crossing_sourceInterfa.name: HConstruction.DK3.crossing_sourceInterface
HConstruction.DK3.crossing_sourceInterfa.header: theorem crossing_sourceInterface (c : CoarseBond unitL 2) : sourceInterface c (crossingBond c)

HConstruction.DK3.center_not_sourceInter.name: HConstruction.DK3.center_not_sourceInterface
HConstruction.DK3.center_not_sourceInter.header:
theorem center_not_sourceInterface (c : CoarseBond unitL 2) :

HConstruction.DK3.literal_unique_b0.name: HConstruction.DK3.literal_unique_b0
HConstruction.DK3.literal_unique_b0.header:
theorem literal_unique_b0 (c : CoarseBond unitL 2) (b : Bond unitL) :

HConstruction.DK3.origin_shift_ne.name: HConstruction.DK3.origin_shift_ne
HConstruction.DK3.origin_shift_ne.header: theorem origin_shift_ne (μ : Fin 3) : periodicLatticeShift origin μ ≠ origin

HConstruction.DK3.curvature.name: HConstruction.DK3.curvature

HConstruction.DK3.CovarianceScale.output.name: HConstruction.DK3.CovarianceScale.outputBondEquiv
HConstruction.DK3.CovarianceScale.output.header: def outputBondEquiv : Bond unitL ≃ CoarseBond fineL 8

HConstruction.DK3.CovarianceScale.output.name: HConstruction.DK3.CovarianceScale.outputCoordinates_apply

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.curl_cj_diff.header:
theorem curl_cj_diff (U : Cfg Lf) (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hθ' : 0 ≤ θ')
    (hL : ∀ (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (μ : Fin 3),
      |ξ x - ξ (periodicLatticeShift x μ)| ≤ θ' / (ell : ℝ) ^ stratG (geomOf ell k S) x)
    (A : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖plaqMul (fun q => Real.exp (ξ q.1)) (plaqMask (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) (curlCovariantLM_L2 U (bondWt (-ξ) A)))
        - plaqMask (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) (curlCovariantLM_L2 U A)‖
      ≤ Real.sqrt 12 * (ell : ℝ) * (Real.exp θ' - 1) * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) A‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.curv_cj.header:
theorem curv_cj (U : Cfg Lf) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρ)
    (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (L : ℝ)
    (hL : ∀ (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (μ : Fin 3), |ξ x - ξ (periodicLatticeShift x μ)| ≤ L)
    (lam : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ‖plaqMul (fun q => Real.exp (ξ q.1)) (plaqMask (plaqIn (S.Om 0))
        (curlCovariantLM_L2 U (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U (siteWt (-ξ) lam))))‖
      ≤ Real.exp (2 * L) * (Real.sqrt 12 * ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)
        * ‖siteWt (-(sigG (geomOf ell k S) + sigG (geomOf ell k S))) lam‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Sp_loc.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Sp_loc
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Sp_loc.header:

    |Sp U p A B| ≤ (17 / Real.sqrt 2) * AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy U p)
      * Real.sqrt (plaqBondSq A p) * Real.sqrt (plaqBondSq B p)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.dp_eq_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.dp_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.dp_eq_sum.header:
theorem dp_eq_sum (U : Cfg Lf) (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette Lf)) (x y : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc U P x y
      = ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette Lf, (open Classical in if p ∈ P then Sp U p (WithLp.ofLp x) (WithLp.ofLp y) else 0)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.pbs_wt.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.pbs_wt
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.pbs_wt.header:
theorem pbs_wt (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (L : ℝ)
    (hL : ∀ (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (μ : Fin 3), |ξ x - ξ (periodicLatticeShift x μ)| ≤ L)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : c = 1 ∨ c = -1) (x : BondFnL2 Lf) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette Lf) :
    plaqBondSq (WithLp.ofLp (bondWt (c • ξ) x)) p
      ≤ Real.exp (2 * (c * ξ p.1)) * Real.exp (2 * L) * plaqBondSq (WithLp.ofLp x) p

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.dp_cj.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.dp_cj
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.dp_cj.header:
theorem dp_cj (U : Cfg Lf) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρ)

    |deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc U (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) (bondWt ξ x) (bondWt (-ξ) y)|

        * (‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) x‖ * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) y‖)

        (eps2op (witness_all_k k).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1) (epsJfree (witness_all_k k).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1)
        (dCM0 2 (rhoM0 2 k (αbw / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k) (αbw / (((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2)))
        (cBM0 2 (rhoM0 2 k (αbw / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k) (αbw / (((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2))))
      (fullTower 2 k Lu16) Set.univ (Uw k)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.instIneq_M0_class_dis.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.instIneq_M0_class_discharged
AdalyFormal.DLayer.instIneq_M0_class_dis.header:
theorem instIneq_M0_class_discharged (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a t α : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ht : 0 < t) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < Lu μ + 1) (hd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (hLB : LamBlockSum ell Lam)
    (hlinks : ∀ b, dv (U b) ≤ α / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (hplaq : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell k Lu), dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy U p) ≤ α / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2)
    (hcb : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * α ≤ 1)
    (h216 : 216 * ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α) ^ 2 < 1)
    (h1000 : (1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (hsmallU : ThetaM0 ell a t ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α) < min a 1 / 1000)
    (H : KUSmall ell ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α)) (HU : UnitSmall ell ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α))
    (M f : ℕ) (α₀ : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hf : 4 ≤ f)
    (hP : PerCubeRegular2 ell M f k (fullTower ell k Lu) α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U)
    (hsm : 4 * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀) ≤ 1)
    (θ : ℝ) (Num : M0ClassNum ell a t ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α) ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀) θ)
    (hε'op : eps2op Num * KhatM0 ell a t ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α) < 1) :
    InstIneq ell k hell a Lu
      (gam0M0 ell a t ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α) (eps2op Num) (epsJfree Num) (dCM0 ell ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α))
        (cBM0 ell ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α)))
      (fullTower ell k Lu) Lam U

AdalyFormal.DLayer.eps2op_CHf.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.eps2op_CHf
AdalyFormal.DLayer.eps2op_CHf.header:
theorem eps2op_CHf {ell : ℕ} {a t ρ β θ : ℝ} (Num : M0ClassNum ell a t ρ β θ) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.stageB2.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.stageB2
AdalyFormal.DLayer.stageB2.header:
theorem stageB2 (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a t : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∃ θ₁ > 0, ∃ ε₀ > 0, ∃ γm > 0, ∀ ρ β : ℝ, 0 ≤ ρ → ρ < ε₀ → 0 ≤ β → β < ε₀ →
      KUSmall ell ρ ∧ UnitSmall ell ρ ∧
      ∃ Num : M0ClassNum ell a t ρ β θ₁,
        γm ≤ gam0M0f ell a t ρ (eps2free Num) (epsJfree Num) (dCM0 ell ρ) (cBM0 ell ρ) ∧
        eps2op Num * KhatM0 ell a t ρ < 1 ∧
        γm ≤ gam0M0 ell a t ρ (eps2op Num) (epsJfree Num) (dCM0 ell ρ) (cBM0 ell ρ)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.instIneq_M0_class_win.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.instIneq_M0_class_window
AdalyFormal.DLayer.instIneq_M0_class_win.header:
theorem instIneq_M0_class_window (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a t : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∃ ε₀ > 0, ∃ γm > 0, ∀ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (e q0 : ℝ),
      M0RegimeR ell k Lu U a t e q0 → rhoM0 ell k e q0 < ε₀ →
      (∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < Lu μ + 1) → (∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1) →
      ∀ (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)), LamBlockSum ell Lam →
      ∀ (M f : ℕ) (α₀ : ℝ), 0 < M → 4 ≤ f → 0 ≤ α₀ →
      PerCubeRegular2 ell M f k (fullTower ell k Lu) α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U →
      4 * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀) ≤ 1 → (f : ℝ) * M * α₀ < ε₀ →
      InstIneq ell k (by omega) a Lu γm (fullTower ell k Lu) Lam U

AdalyFormal.DLayer.window_domain_curved.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.window_domain_curved
AdalyFormal.DLayer.window_domain_curved.header:
theorem window_domain_curved (ell M : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (a t : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ht : 0 < t)
    (ε₀ : ℝ) (hε₀ : 0 < ε₀) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∀ k : ℕ,
      M0RegimeR ell k (LuLM ell M) (UwA ell M k A) a t
        ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * A / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * A / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2) ∧
      rhoM0 ell k ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * A / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * A / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2) < ε₀ ∧
      (∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < LuLM ell M μ + 1) ∧ (∀ μ, ell ∣ LuLM ell M μ + 1) ∧
      PerCubeRegular2 ell M 12 k (fullTower ell k (LuLM ell M)) (A / (12 * M)) ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ (UwA ell M k A) ∧
      GlobalRegular2 ell M 12 k (A / (12 * M)) ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ (UwA ell M k A) ∧
      0 ≤ A / (12 * M) ∧ 4 * (((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M * (A / (12 * M))) ≤ 1 ∧ ((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M * (A / (12 * M)) < ε₀ ∧
      (∃ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell k (LuLM ell M)),
        0 < dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy (UwA ell M k A) p))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.M0_class_window_witne.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.M0_class_window_witnessed
AdalyFormal.DLayer.M0_class_window_witne.header:
theorem M0_class_window_witnessed (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a t : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∃ ε₀ > 0, ∃ γm > 0,
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (e q0 : ℝ),
        M0RegimeR ell k Lu U a t e q0 → rhoM0 ell k e q0 < ε₀ →
        (∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < Lu μ + 1) → (∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1) →
        ∀ (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)), LamBlockSum ell Lam →
        ∀ (M f : ℕ) (α₀ : ℝ), 0 < M → 4 ≤ f → 0 ≤ α₀ →
        PerCubeRegular2 ell M f k (fullTower ell k Lu) α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U →
        4 * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀) ≤ 1 → (f : ℝ) * M * α₀ < ε₀ →
        AdalyFormal.StatementLaneG.GenP.WellDef (PU ell k Lu (by omega) U a Lam) ∧
        InstIneq ell k (by omega) a Lu γm (fullTower ell k Lu) Lam U) ∧
      ∀ (M : ℕ), 1 ≤ M → ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∀ k : ℕ,
        M0RegimeR ell k (LuLM ell M) (UwA ell M k A) a t
          ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * A / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * A / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2) ∧
        rhoM0 ell k ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * A / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * A / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2) < ε₀ ∧
        PerCubeRegular2 ell M 12 k (fullTower ell k (LuLM ell M)) (A / (12 * M)) ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ (UwA ell M k A) ∧
        ((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M * (A / (12 * M)) < ε₀ ∧
        (∃ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell k (LuLM ell M)),
          0 < dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy (UwA ell M k A) p)) ∧
        AdalyFormal.StatementLaneG.GenP.WellDef (PU ell k (LuLM ell M) (by omega) (UwA ell M k A) a Set.univ) ∧
        InstIneq ell k (by omega) a (LuLM ell M) γm (fullTower ell k (LuLM ell M)) Set.univ (UwA ell M k A) ∧
        ∃ Bt : Bond (LuLM ell M) → SuTwo,
          AdalyFormal.StatementLane.OnLambdaTildeIn (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (LuLM ell M))) ell Bt ∧
          OnLambdaT (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (LuLM ell M))) Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧
          0 < AdalyFormal.StatementLaneG.GenP.genForm
            (gparams ell k (LuLM ell M) (by omega) (fullTower ell k (LuLM ell M)) (UwA ell M k A) a Set.univ)
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (AdalyFormal.StatementLaneG.GenP.genC
              (gparams ell k (LuLM ell M) (by omega) (fullTower ell k (LuLM ell M)) (UwA ell M k A) a Set.univ) Bt))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.SiteHyp.L_sub_cjpL.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.SiteHyp.L_sub_cjpL
AdalyFormal.DLayer.SiteHyp.L_sub_cjpL.header:
theorem L_sub_cjpL (x : S) :
    (H.L - cjp H.ωS H.ωS H.L) x
      = -(ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (cjm H.ωS H.ωE H.D - H.D) (H.D x)
          + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint H.D ((cjp H.ωS H.ωE H.D - H.D) x)
          + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (cjm H.ωS H.ωE H.D - H.D) ((cjp H.ωS H.ωE H.D - H.D) x))
        - H.m • (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (cjm H.ωS H.ωY H.Qp - H.Qp) (H.Qp x)
          + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint H.Qp ((cjp H.ωS H.ωY H.Qp - H.Qp) x)
          + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (cjm H.ωS H.ωY H.Qp - H.Qp) ((cjp H.ωS H.ωY H.Qp - H.Qp) x))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.SiteHyp.resolvent_bou.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.SiteHyp.resolvent_bound
AdalyFormal.DLayer.SiteHyp.resolvent_bou.header:
theorem resolvent_bound (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hQ : ‖H.Qp‖ ≤ q) (y : S) :
    ‖cjp H.ωS H.ωS H.Linv y - H.Linv y‖
        ≤ (4 / H.c) * H.δD * ‖H.D (H.Linv y)‖
          + (Real.sqrt (48 / H.c) * H.δD + (8 / H.c) * H.δD ^ 2 + (4 / H.c) * H.m * (2 * q * H.δQ + H.δQ ^ 2))
            * ‖H.Linv y‖ ∧
    ‖H.D (cjp H.ωS H.ωS H.Linv y - H.Linv y)‖
        ≤ Real.sqrt (12 / H.c) * H.δD * ‖H.D (H.Linv y)‖
          + (Real.sqrt 24 * H.δD + 2 * Real.sqrt (12 / H.c) * H.δD ^ 2
              + Real.sqrt (12 / H.c) * H.m * (2 * q * H.δQ + H.δQ ^ 2)) * ‖H.Linv y‖
