    (G.Linv ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint G.Qp)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gam_Gami.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gam_Gami
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gam_Gami.header: theorem Gam_Gami (u : Y) : G.H.Gam (G.Gami u) = u

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gami_Gam.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gami_Gam
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gami_Gam.header: theorem Gami_Gam (u : Y) : G.Gami (G.H.Gam u) = u

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gam_form.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gam_form
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gam_form.header: theorem Gam_form (u : Y) : ⟪u, G.H.Gam u⟫ = ‖G.H.X u‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.qb_X.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.qb_X
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.qb_X.header: theorem qb_X (u : Y) : ‖u‖ ≤ G.q * G.b * ‖G.H.X u‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpGam_coer.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpGam_coer
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpGam_coer.header: theorem cjpGam_coer (u : Y) : G.cG * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪u, cjp G.ωY G.ωY G.H.Gam u⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpGami_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpGami_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpGami_le.header: theorem cjpGami_le (w : Y) : G.cG * ‖cjp G.ωY G.ωY G.Gami w‖ ≤ ‖w‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gam_coer.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gam_coer
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gam_coer.header: theorem Gam_coer (u : Y) : G.cG * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪u, G.H.Gam u⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpGam_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpGam_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpGam_eq.header: theorem cjpGam_eq : cjp G.ωY G.ωY G.H.Gam = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (cjm G.ωY G.ωS G.H.X) ∘L cjp G.ωY G.ωS G.H.X

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gam_sub_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gam_sub_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gam_sub_le.header: theorem Gam_sub_le (u : Y) : ‖G.H.Gam u - cjp G.ωY G.ωY G.H.Gam u‖ ≤ G.dGam * ‖u‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gami_diff.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gami_diff
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Gami_diff.header: theorem Gami_diff (w : Y) : ‖cjp G.ωY G.ωY G.Gami w - G.Gami w‖ ≤ G.dGi * ‖w‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Linv_unw.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Linv_unw
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Linv_unw.header: theorem Linv_unw (y : S) : ‖G.Linv y‖ ≤ ‖y‖ / G.c ∧ ‖G.D (G.Linv y)‖ ≤ ‖y‖ / Real.sqrt G.c

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.LinvDadj_unw.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.LinvDadj_unw
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.LinvDadj_unw.header:
theorem LinvDadj_unw (v : E) :
    ‖G.Linv (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint G.D v)‖ ≤ ‖v‖ / Real.sqrt G.c ∧
    ‖G.D (G.Linv (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint G.D v))‖ ≤ ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.consts_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.consts_nonneg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.consts_nonneg.header: theorem consts_nonneg : 0 ≤ G.nX ∧ 0 ≤ G.nDX ∧ 0 ≤ G.kF ∧ 0 ≤ G.dF ∧ 0 ≤ G.gi ∧ 0 ≤ G.dGi

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjmF_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjmF_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjmF_eq.header: theorem cjmF_eq : cjm G.ωY G.ωE G.F = cjm G.ωS G.ωE G.D ∘L cjm G.ωY G.ωS G.H.X

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjX_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjX_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjX_le.header:
theorem cjX_le (u : Y) : ‖cjp G.ωY G.ωS G.H.X u‖ ≤ G.nX * ‖u‖ ∧ ‖cjm G.ωY G.ωS G.H.X u‖ ≤ G.nX * ‖u‖ ∧
    ‖G.D (cjp G.ωY G.ωS G.H.X u)‖ ≤ G.nDX * ‖u‖ ∧ ‖G.D (cjm G.ωY G.ωS G.H.X u)‖ ≤ G.nDX * ‖u‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjmF_bounds.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjmF_bounds
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjmF_bounds.header: theorem cjmF_bounds (u : Y) : ‖cjm G.ωY G.ωE G.F u‖ ≤ G.kF * ‖u‖ ∧ ‖cjm G.ωY G.ωE G.F u - G.F u‖ ≤ G.dF * ‖u‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpT_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpT_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpT_eq.header:
theorem cjpT_eq : cjp G.ωE G.ωS G.T = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (cjm G.ωS G.ωE G.D)
    - cjp G.ωY G.ωS G.H.X ∘L cjp G.ωY G.ωY G.Gami ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (cjm G.ωY G.ωE G.F)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpZ_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpZ_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpZ_eq.header: theorem cjpZ_eq : cjp G.ωE G.ωS G.Z = cjp G.ωS G.ωS G.Linv ∘L cjp G.ωE G.ωS G.T

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpW_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpW_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.cjpW_eq.header: theorem cjpW_eq : cjp G.ωE G.ωE G.W = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E - cjp G.ωS G.ωE G.D ∘L cjp G.ωE G.ωS G.Z

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.opnorm_of.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.opnorm_of
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.opnorm_of.header:
theorem opnorm_of {A B : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup A] [InnerProductSpace ℝ A] [NormedAddCommGroup B]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ B] (T : A →L[ℝ] B) (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (h : ∀ v, ‖T v‖ ≤ k * ‖v‖) : ‖T‖ ≤ k

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.F_aux.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.F_aux
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.F_aux.header:
theorem F_aux (v : E) :
    ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (cjm G.ωY G.ωE G.F) v‖ ≤ G.kF * ‖v‖ ∧
    ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (cjm G.ωY G.ωE G.F) v - ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint G.F v‖ ≤ G.dF * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.PD_bounds.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.PD_bounds
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.PD_bounds.header:
theorem PD_bounds (v : E) :
    ‖cjp G.ωY G.ωS G.H.X (cjp G.ωY G.ωY G.Gami (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (cjm G.ωY G.ωE G.F) v))‖
        ≤ G.nX * G.gi * G.kF * ‖v‖ ∧
    ‖cjp G.ωY G.ωS G.H.X (cjp G.ωY G.ωY G.Gami (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (cjm G.ωY G.ωE G.F) v))
        - G.H.X (G.Gami (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint G.F v))‖
        ≤ (G.H.epsX G.q * G.gi * G.kF + (G.q / G.c) * G.dGi * G.kF + (G.q / G.c) * G.gi * G.dF) * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.T_diff.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.T_diff
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.T_diff.header: theorem T_diff (v : E) : ‖cjp G.ωE G.ωS G.T v - G.T v‖ ≤ G.dT * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Z_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Z_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Z_le.header: theorem Z_le (v : E) : ‖cjp G.ωE G.ωS G.Z v‖ ≤ G.kZ * ‖v‖ ∧ ‖G.D (cjp G.ωE G.ωS G.Z v)‖ ≤ G.kDZ * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Z_diff.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Z_diff
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Z_diff.header:
theorem Z_diff (v : E) : ‖cjp G.ωE G.ωS G.Z v - G.Z v‖ ≤ G.dZ * ‖v‖ ∧
    ‖G.D (cjp G.ωE G.ωS G.Z v - G.Z v)‖ ≤ G.dDZ * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.W_diff.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.W_diff
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.W_diff.header: theorem W_diff (v : E) : ‖cjp G.ωE G.ωE G.W v - G.W v‖ ≤ G.dW * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.W_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.W_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.W_le.header: theorem W_le (v : E) : ‖G.W v‖ ≤ (1 + G.kDZ + G.dDZ) * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.header:
structure GinvHyp (S E Y P B : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Y]
    [NormedAddCommGroup P] [InnerProductSpace ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup B] [InnerProductSpace ℝ B]
    [CompleteSpace S] [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace Y] [CompleteSpace P] [CompleteSpace B]
    extends GamHyp S E Y

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Gm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Gm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Gm.header: noncomputable abbrev Gm : GamHyp S E Y

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Ginv_form.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Ginv_form
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Ginv_form.header:
theorem Ginv_form (f : E) : ⟪f, I.Ginv f⟫
    = ‖I.C (I.Gm.W f)‖ ^ 2 + ⟪I.Gm.W f, I.Dp (I.Gm.W f)⟫ + ‖I.Gm.T f‖ ^ 2 + I.M * ‖I.Qb f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.CW_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.CW_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.CW_eq.header: theorem CW_eq : I.C ∘L I.Gm.W = I.C - (I.C ∘L I.D) ∘L I.Gm.Z

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.cjp_CW_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.cjp_CW_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.cjp_CW_eq.header: theorem cjp_CW_eq : cjp I.ωE I.ωP (I.C ∘L I.Gm.W) = cjp I.ωE I.ωP I.C - cjp I.ωS I.ωP (I.C ∘L I.D) ∘L cjp I.ωE I.ωS I.Gm.Z

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.CW_diff.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.CW_diff
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.CW_diff.header: theorem CW_diff (v : E) : ‖cjp I.ωE I.ωP (I.C ∘L I.Gm.W) v - (I.C ∘L I.Gm.W) v‖ ≤ I.δCW * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.inv.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.inv
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.inv.header: noncomputable def inv : GinvHyp S E Y P B

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.cjpGinv_form.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.cjpGinv_form
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.cjpGinv_form.header:
theorem cjpGinv_form (f : E) : ⟪f, cjp I.ωE I.ωE I.Ginv f⟫
    = ⟪cjm I.ωE I.ωP (I.C ∘L I.Gm.W) f, cjp I.ωE I.ωP (I.C ∘L I.Gm.W) f⟫
      + ⟪cjm I.ωE I.ωE I.Gm.W f, cjp I.ωE I.ωE I.Dp (cjp I.ωE I.ωE I.Gm.W f)⟫
      + ⟪cjm I.ωE I.ωS I.Gm.T f, cjp I.ωE I.ωS I.Gm.T f⟫
      + I.M * ⟪cjm I.ωE I.ωB I.Qb f, cjp I.ωE I.ωB I.Qb f⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.pair_aux.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.pair_aux
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.pair_aux.header:
theorem pair_aux {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (u up um : V) (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (r : ℝ) (hp : ‖up - u‖ ≤ d * r) (hm : ‖um - u‖ ≤ d * r) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ‖u‖ ^ 2 - 2 * ‖u‖ * (d * r) - (d * r) ^ 2 ≤ ⟪um, up⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.dZ_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.dZ_nonneg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.dZ_nonneg.header: theorem dZ_nonneg : 0 ≤ I.Gm.dZ ∧ 0 ≤ I.Gm.dDZ ∧ 0 ≤ I.Gm.kZ ∧ 0 ≤ I.Gm.kDZ ∧ 0 ≤ I.Gm.dW ∧ 0 ≤ I.Gm.dT

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Ginv_CT.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Ginv_CT
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Ginv_CT.header: theorem Ginv_CT (f : E) : (3 / 4) * ⟪f, I.Ginv f⟫ - I.EG * ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪f, cjp I.ωE I.ωE I.Ginv f⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.G_cjp_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.G_cjp_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.G_cjp_le.header:
theorem G_cjp_le (Gi : E →L[ℝ] E) (hGi : ∀ x, I.Ginv (Gi x) = x) (cg : ℝ) (hcg : 0 < cg)
    (hcoer : ∀ f, cg * ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪f, I.Ginv f⟫) (hE : 4 * I.EG ≤ cg) (g : E) :
    (cg / 2) * ‖cjp I.ωE I.ωE Gi g‖ ≤ ‖g‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.header:
structure NHyp (S E Y P B : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Y]
    [NormedAddCommGroup P] [InnerProductSpace ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup B] [InnerProductSpace ℝ B]
    [CompleteSpace S] [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace Y] [CompleteSpace P] [CompleteSpace B]
    extends GinvHyp S E Y P B

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Iv.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Iv
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Iv.header: noncomputable abbrev Iv : GinvHyp S E Y P B

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Ginv_sym.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Ginv_sym
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Ginv_sym.header: theorem Ginv_sym (x y : E) : ⟪J.Iv.Ginv x, y⟫ = ⟪x, J.Iv.Ginv y⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Gi_sym.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Gi_sym
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Gi_sym.header: theorem Gi_sym (x y : E) : ⟪J.Gi x, y⟫ = ⟪x, J.Gi y⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Gi_cjp.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Gi_cjp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Gi_cjp.header: theorem Gi_cjp (x : E) : (J.cg / 2) * ‖cjp J.ωE J.ωE J.Gi x‖ ≤ ‖x‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Gi_cjm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Gi_cjm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Gi_cjm.header: theorem Gi_cjm (x : E) : (J.cg / 2) * ‖cjm J.ωE J.ωE J.Gi x‖ ≤ ‖x‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.N_lower.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.N_lower
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.N_lower.header: theorem N_lower (u : B) : ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ J.bN * ⟪u, J.N u⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Ginv_bil.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Ginv_bil
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Ginv_bil.header:
theorem Ginv_bil (y x : E) : ⟪y, J.Iv.Ginv x⟫
    = ⟪J.C (J.Iv.Gm.W y), J.C (J.Iv.Gm.W x)⟫ + ⟪J.Iv.Gm.W y, J.Dp (J.Iv.Gm.W x)⟫ + ⟪J.Iv.Gm.T y, J.Iv.Gm.T x⟫
      + J.M * ⟪J.Qb y, J.Qb x⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.cjpGinv_bil.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.cjpGinv_bil
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.cjpGinv_bil.header:
theorem cjpGinv_bil (y x : E) : ⟪y, cjp J.ωE J.ωE J.Iv.Ginv x⟫
    = ⟪cjm J.ωE J.ωP (J.C ∘L J.Iv.Gm.W) y, cjp J.ωE J.ωP (J.C ∘L J.Iv.Gm.W) x⟫
      + ⟪cjm J.ωE J.ωE J.Iv.Gm.W y, cjp J.ωE J.ωE J.Dp (cjp J.ωE J.ωE J.Iv.Gm.W x)⟫
      + ⟪cjm J.ωE J.ωS J.Iv.Gm.T y, cjp J.ωE J.ωS J.Iv.Gm.T x⟫
      + J.M * ⟪cjm J.ωE J.ωB J.Qb y, cjp J.ωE J.ωB J.Qb x⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.pieces_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.pieces_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.pieces_le.header:
theorem pieces_le (z : E) :
    ‖J.C (J.Iv.Gm.W z)‖ ^ 2 + ‖J.Iv.Gm.T z‖ ^ 2 + J.M * ‖J.Qb z‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪z, J.Iv.Ginv z⟫ + J.ν * J.Iv.nW ^ 2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.bil_diff.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.bil_diff
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.bil_diff.header:
theorem bil_diff {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (p pm q qp : V) (dp dq : ℝ)
    (hp : ‖pm - p‖ ≤ dp) (hq : ‖qp - q‖ ≤ dq) :
    |⟪pm, qp⟫ - ⟪p, q⟫| ≤ dp * (‖q‖ + dq) + ‖p‖ * dq

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.CW_piece.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.CW_piece
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.CW_piece.header:
theorem CW_piece (x y : E) :
    |⟪cjm J.ωE J.ωP (J.C ∘L J.Iv.Gm.W) x, cjp J.ωE J.ωP (J.C ∘L J.Iv.Gm.W) y⟫ - ⟪J.C (J.Iv.Gm.W x), J.C (J.Iv.Gm.W y)⟫|
      ≤ J.Iv.δCW * ‖x‖ * (‖J.C (J.Iv.Gm.W y)‖ + J.Iv.δCW * ‖y‖) + ‖J.C (J.Iv.Gm.W x)‖ * (J.Iv.δCW * ‖y‖)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.T_piece.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.T_piece
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.T_piece.header:
theorem T_piece (x y : E) :
    |⟪cjm J.ωE J.ωS J.Iv.Gm.T x, cjp J.ωE J.ωS J.Iv.Gm.T y⟫ - ⟪J.Iv.Gm.T x, J.Iv.Gm.T y⟫|
      ≤ J.Iv.Gm.dT * ‖x‖ * (‖J.Iv.Gm.T y‖ + J.Iv.Gm.dT * ‖y‖) + ‖J.Iv.Gm.T x‖ * (J.Iv.Gm.dT * ‖y‖)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.M_piece.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.M_piece
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.M_piece.header:
theorem M_piece (x y : E) :
    |⟪cjm J.ωE J.ωB J.Qb x, cjp J.ωE J.ωB J.Qb y⟫ - ⟪J.Qb x, J.Qb y⟫|
      ≤ J.δB * ‖x‖ * (‖J.Qb y‖ + J.δB * ‖y‖) + ‖J.Qb x‖ * (J.δB * ‖y‖)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Dp_piece.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Dp_piece
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.Dp_piece.header:
theorem Dp_piece (x y : E) :
    |⟪cjm J.ωE J.ωE J.Iv.Gm.W x, cjp J.ωE J.ωE J.Dp (cjp J.ωE J.ωE J.Iv.Gm.W y)⟫ - ⟪J.Iv.Gm.W x, J.Dp (J.Iv.Gm.W y)⟫|
      ≤ J.KD * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.consts2_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.consts2_nonneg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.consts2_nonneg.header: theorem consts2_nonneg : 0 ≤ J.X0 ∧ 0 ≤ J.Y0 ∧ 0 ≤ J.Ex ∧ 0 ≤ J.Ey

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.cjmQb_norm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.cjmQb_norm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.cjmQb_norm.header: theorem cjmQb_norm : ‖cjm J.ωE J.ωB J.Qb‖ ≤ J.qb + J.δB

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.cjpQb_norm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.cjpQb_norm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.cjpQb_norm.header: theorem cjpQb_norm : ‖cjp J.ωE J.ωB J.Qb‖ ≤ J.qb + J.δB

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.lin_of_sq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NHyp.lin_of_sq

        + mTop ell k a * (Real.sqrt ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ k) * (Real.exp δ - 1)) ^ 2) ≤ c)
    (hsmallD : 4 * (Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp θ' - 1)) ^ 2 ≤ c) :
    SiteHyp (SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (coarseC (GF ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.extM0.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.extM0
AdalyFormal.DLayer.extM0.header:
theorem extM0 (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (hm0 : 0 ≤ mTop ell k a) (δ ε0 : ℝ)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0) (hεa : ε0 * AdalyFormal.FlatExt.aFE ell k < 1)
    (hd : ∀ f, ‖gradL2 (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) f - gradL2 U f‖ ≤ δ * ‖f‖)
    (hdrift : ∀ f, ‖Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f - Qtop (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _) f‖ ≤ ε0 * ‖f‖)
    (w : coarseC (GF ell k Lu)) :
    ∃ g, Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U g = w ∧
      ⟪g, (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (gradL2 U) ∘L gradL2 U
        + mTop ell k a • (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U) ∘L Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U)) g⟫
      ≤ (((AdalyFormal.FlatExt.bFE ell k + δ * AdalyFormal.FlatExt.aFE ell k)
            / (1 - ε0 * AdalyFormal.FlatExt.aFE ell k)) ^ 2 + mTop ell k a) * ‖w‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.DelpA_sym.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.DelpA_sym
AdalyFormal.DLayer.DelpA_sym.header:
theorem DelpA_sym (f g : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Gp_sym.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Gp_sym
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Gp_sym.header:
theorem Gp_sym (f g : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Gp_adjoint.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Gp_adjoint
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Gp_adjoint.header: theorem Gp_adjoint : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Gp (GF ell k Lu) U a) = Gp (GF ell k Lu) U a

AdalyFormal.DLayer.adjX_apply.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.adjX_apply
AdalyFormal.DLayer.adjX_apply.header:
theorem adjX_apply (v : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qtop_of_NQp.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qtop_of_NQp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qtop_of_NQp.header: theorem Qtop_of_NQp (μ : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hμ : μ ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) U) : Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U μ = 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Rproj_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Rproj_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Rproj_eq.header:
theorem Rproj_eq (Gi : coarseC (GF ell k Lu) →L[ℝ] coarseC (GF ell k Lu))

      ∘L (Gp (GF ell k Lu) U a ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U))) (Gi u) = u)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Tfull_eq_T.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Tfull_eq_T
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Tfull_eq_T.header: theorem Tfull_eq_T : Tfull (GF ell k Lu) U = G.T

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Wop_eq_W.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Wop_eq_W
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Wop_eq_W.header: theorem Wop_eq_W : Wop (GF ell k Lu) U a = G.W

AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWt.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWt
AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWt.header: noncomputable def plaqWt (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) : PlaqFnL2 L →L[ℝ] PlaqFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWt_apply.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWt_apply

AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWt_neg_cancel.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWt_neg_cancel
AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWt_neg_cancel.header: theorem plaqWt_neg_cancel (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : PlaqFnL2 L) : plaqWt φ (plaqWt (-φ) f) = f

AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWt_cancel_neg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWt_cancel_neg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWt_cancel_neg.header: theorem plaqWt_cancel_neg (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : PlaqFnL2 L) : plaqWt (-φ) (plaqWt φ f) = f

AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWt_symm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWt_symm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWt_symm.header: theorem plaqWt_symm (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f g : PlaqFnL2 L) : ⟪plaqWt φ f, g⟫ = ⟪f, plaqWt φ g⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWP.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWP
AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqWP.header: noncomputable def plaqWP (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) : WPair (PlaqFnL2 L)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curlC.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.curlC
AdalyFormal.DLayer.curlC.header: noncomputable abbrev curlC (U : Cfg L) : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] PlaqFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curlC_apply.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.curlC_apply

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_shift_site.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_dir_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_dir_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_dir_le.header: theorem sum_dir_le (A : BondFnL2 L) (ν : Fin 3) : ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ‖A (y, ν)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_site_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_site_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_site_le.header:
theorem sum_site_le (f : SiteL2 L) (μ ν : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_conj_pt.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_conj_pt
AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_conj_pt.header:
theorem curl_conj_pt (U : Cfg L) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) (A : BondFnL2 L)

    ‖(plaqWt φ (curlC U (bondWt (-φ) A)) - curlC U A) p‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_conj_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_conj_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_conj_le.header:
theorem curl_conj_le (U : Cfg L) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    ‖plaqWt φ (curlC U (bondWt (-φ) A)) - curlC U A‖ ≤ 6 * (Real.exp θ' - 1) * ‖A‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_cjp_norm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_cjp_norm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_cjp_norm.header:
theorem curl_cjp_norm (U : Cfg L) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) :
    ‖cjp (bondWP φ) (plaqWP φ) (curlC U) - curlC U‖ ≤ 6 * (Real.exp θ' - 1)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_cjm_norm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_cjm_norm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_cjm_norm.header:
theorem curl_cjm_norm (U : Cfg L) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) :
    ‖cjm (bondWP φ) (plaqWP φ) (curlC U) - curlC U‖ ≤ 6 * (Real.exp θ' - 1)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_value.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_value
AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_value.header:
theorem curv_value (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    (curlC U (gradL2 U f)) p
      = RMap (U (p.1, p.2.1.1) * U (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1, p.2.1.2))
          (f (periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1) p.2.1.2))
        - RMap (U (p.1, p.2.1.2) * U (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1))
          (f (periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1) p.2.1.2))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.RMap_diff_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.RMap_diff_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.RMap_diff_le.header:
theorem RMap_diff_le (g1 g2 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (v : SuTwo) :
    ‖RMap g1 v - RMap g2 v‖
      ≤ 2 * AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNorm (((g1 * g2⁻¹ : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
          Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_pt.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_pt
AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_pt.header:
theorem curv_pt (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_le.header:
theorem curv_le (U : Cfg L) (q0 : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_norm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_norm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_norm.header:
theorem curv_norm (U : Cfg L) (q0 : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_conj_pt.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_conj_pt
AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_conj_pt.header:

    ‖(plaqWt φ (curlC U (gradL2 U (siteWt (-φ) f))) - curlC U (gradL2 U f)) p‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_conj_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_conj_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_conj_le.header:
theorem curv_conj_le (U : Cfg L) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) (q0 : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (hplaq : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy U p) ≤ q0)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_cjp_norm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_cjp_norm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_cjp_norm.header:
theorem curv_cjp_norm (U : Cfg L) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) (q0 : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (hplaq : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy U p) ≤ q0) :
    ‖cjp (siteWP φ) (plaqWP φ) (curlC U ∘L gradL2 U) - curlC U ∘L gradL2 U‖ ≤ 6 * q0 * (Real.exp (2 * θ') - 1)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_cjm_norm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_cjm_norm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.curv_cjm_norm.header:
theorem curv_cjm_norm (U : Cfg L) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) (q0 : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (hplaq : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy U p) ≤ q0) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_sq_le_pbs.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_sq_le_pbs
AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_sq_le_pbs.header:
theorem curl_sq_le_pbs (U : Cfg L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.bilPlaq_quad_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.bilPlaq_quad_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.bilPlaq_quad_le.header:

    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp.header: noncomputable def Sp (U : Cfg L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_add_left.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_add_left
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_add_left.header:
theorem Sp_add_left (U : Cfg L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A A' B : Bond L → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_add_right.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_add_right
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_add_right.header:
theorem Sp_add_right (U : Cfg L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A B B' : Bond L → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_smul_left.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_smul_right.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_smul_right
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_smul_right.header:
theorem Sp_smul_right (U : Cfg L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (c : ℝ) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_sub_left.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_sub_left
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_sub_left.header:
theorem Sp_sub_left (U : Cfg L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A A' B : Bond L → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_sub_right.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_sub_right
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_sub_right.header:
theorem Sp_sub_right (U : Cfg L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A B B' : Bond L → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_symm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_symm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_symm.header:
theorem Sp_symm (U : Cfg L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.pbs_par.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.pbs_par
AdalyFormal.DLayer.pbs_par.header:
theorem pbs_par (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (s : ℝ) :
    plaqBondSq (s • A + B) p + plaqBondSq (s • A - B) p = 2 * s ^ 2 * plaqBondSq A p + 2 * plaqBondSq B p

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_amgm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_amgm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_amgm.header:
theorem Sp_amgm (U : Cfg L) {α₀ : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hpl : AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.PlaqDef α₀ U)
    (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.amgm_to_prod.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.amgm_to_prod
AdalyFormal.DLayer.amgm_to_prod.header:
theorem amgm_to_prod (S β a b : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (h : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → |S| ≤ (β / 2) * (s * a + b / s)) : |S| ≤ β * Real.sqrt a * Real.sqrt b

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_bil_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_bil_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sp_bil_le.header:
theorem Sp_bil_le (U : Cfg L) {α₀ : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hpl : AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.PlaqDef α₀ U)
    (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.pbs_sum_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.pbs_sum_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.pbs_sum_le.header:
theorem pbs_sum_le (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, plaqBondSq (WithLp.ofLp A) p ≤ 12 * ‖A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.DeltaPrime_eq_sum.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.DeltaPrime_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.DLayer.DeltaPrime_eq_sum.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp.header: noncomputable def DpOp (U : Cfg L) : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.DLayer.inner_DpOp.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.inner_DpOp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.inner_DpOp.header:
theorem inner_DpOp (U : Cfg L) (x y : BondFnL2 L) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp_symm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp_symm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp_symm.header: theorem DpOp_symm (U : Cfg L) (x y : BondFnL2 L) : ⟪DpOp U x, y⟫ = ⟪x, DpOp U y⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.opnorm_of_bil.header:

    (h : ∀ x y, |⟪x, T y⟫| ≤ C * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖) : ‖T‖ ≤ C

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_sqrt_bound.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_sqrt_bound
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_sqrt_bound.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp_norm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp_norm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp_norm.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.rescP.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.rescP
AdalyFormal.DLayer.rescP.header:
noncomputable def rescP (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.wt_eq_resc.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.wt_eq_resc
AdalyFormal.DLayer.wt_eq_resc.header:
theorem wt_eq_resc (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    WithLp.ofLp (bondWt φ A) = Real.exp (φ p.1) • rescP φ p (WithLp.ofLp A)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.pbs_resc_sub.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.pbs_resc_sub
AdalyFormal.DLayer.pbs_resc_sub.header:
theorem pbs_resc_sub (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    plaqBondSq (rescP φ p A - A) p ≤ (Real.exp θ' - 1) ^ 2 * plaqBondSq A p

AdalyFormal.DLayer.pbs_resc.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.pbs_resc
AdalyFormal.DLayer.pbs_resc.header:
theorem pbs_resc (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    plaqBondSq (rescP φ p A) p ≤ Real.exp θ' ^ 2 * plaqBondSq A p

AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp_conj_bil.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp_conj_bil
AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp_conj_bil.header:
theorem DpOp_conj_bil (U : Cfg L) {α₀ : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hpl : AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.PlaqDef α₀ U)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) (x y : BondFnL2 L) :
    |⟪x, bondWt φ (DpOp U (bondWt (-φ) y)) - DpOp U y⟫| ≤ 816 * α₀ * (Real.exp (2 * θ') - 1) * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp_cjp_norm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp_cjp_norm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp_cjp_norm.header:
theorem DpOp_cjp_norm (U : Cfg L) {α₀ : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hpl : AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.PlaqDef α₀ U)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) :
    ‖cjp (bondWP φ) (bondWP φ) (DpOp U) - DpOp U‖ ≤ 816 * α₀ * (Real.exp (2 * θ') - 1)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp_cjm_norm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp_cjm_norm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.DpOp_cjm_norm.header:
theorem DpOp_cjm_norm (U : Cfg L) {α₀ : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hpl : AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.PlaqDef α₀ U)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) :
    ‖cjm (bondWP φ) (bondWP φ) (DpOp U) - DpOp U‖ ≤ 816 * α₀ * (Real.exp (2 * θ') - 1)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Delta_decomp.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Delta_decomp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Delta_decomp.header:
theorem Delta_decomp (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (U : Cfg (AdalyFormal.StatementLane.scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    Delta (AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.GF ell k Lu) U
      = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (curlC U) ∘L curlC U + DpOp U

AdalyFormal.DLayer.OnPath.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.OnPath
AdalyFormal.DLayer.OnPath.header:
def OnPath (s : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L → List (Fin 3) → PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop
  | _, [], _ => False
  | y, μ :: rest, e => e = (y, μ) ∨ OnPath s (coarseShift y s μ) rest e

theorem hol_congr {G : Type*} [Group G] (s : ℕ) (W W' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) :
    ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L), (∀ e, OnPath s y p e → W e = W' e) →
      coarsePathHolonomy s W y p = coarsePathHolonomy s W' y p

AdalyFormal.DLayer.hol_congr.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.hol_congr
AdalyFormal.DLayer.hol_congr.header:
theorem hol_congr {G : Type*} [Group G] (s : ℕ) (W W' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) :
    ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L), (∀ e, OnPath s y p e → W e = W' e) →
      coarsePathHolonomy s W y p = coarsePathHolonomy s W' y p

AdalyFormal.DLayer.VisStep.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.VisStep
AdalyFormal.DLayer.VisStep.header: def VisStep (s ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sBlock_congr.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sBlock_congr
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sBlock_congr.header:
theorem sBlock_congr (s ell : ℕ) (V0 V1 V1' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, ∀ e, OnPath s y (coarseGammaPath s y x) e → V1 e = V1' e) :
    sBlock s ell V0 V1 y = sBlock s ell V0 V1' y

AdalyFormal.DLayer.loopVar_congr.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.loopVar_congr
AdalyFormal.DLayer.loopVar_congr.header:
theorem loopVar_congr {G : Type*} [Group G] (s ell : ℕ) (W W' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (h1 : ∀ e, OnPath s c.1 (coarseGammaPath s c.1 x) e → W e = W' e)
    (h3 : ∀ e, OnPath s x (List.replicate ell c.2) e → W e = W' e)
    (h4 : ∀ e, OnPath s (cPlusS s ell c) (coarseGammaPath s c.1 x) e → W e = W' e)
    (h5 : ∀ e, OnPath s c.1 (List.replicate ell c.2) e → W e = W' e) :
    loopVar s ell W c x = loopVar s ell W' c x

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sbg_eq_of.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sbg_eq_of
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sbg_eq_of.header:
theorem sbg_eq_of {G 𝔤 : Type*} [Group G] [AddCommGroup 𝔤] [Module ℚ 𝔤]
    (P : AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.LogExpAd G 𝔤) (s ell : ℕ)
    (W W' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hl : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, loopVar s ell W c x = loopVar s ell W' c x)
    (hb : coarseBondVar s ell W c = coarseBondVar s ell W' c) :
    stridedBlockedGauge P s ell W c = stridedBlockedGauge P s ell W' c

AdalyFormal.DLayer.rawStep_congr.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.rawStep_congr
AdalyFormal.DLayer.rawStep_congr.header:
theorem rawStep_congr (s ell : ℕ) (V0 V1 V1' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (h : ∀ e, VisStep s ell c e → V1 e = V1' e) :
    rawStep s ell V0 V1 c = rawStep s ell V0 V1' c

AdalyFormal.DLayer.qStepX_congr.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.qStepX_congr
AdalyFormal.DLayer.qStepX_congr.header:
theorem qStepX_congr (s ell : ℕ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (a a' : XS L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (h : ∀ e, VisStep s ell c e → a e = a' e) :
    qStepX s ell V0 a c = qStepX s ell V0 a' c

AdalyFormal.DLayer.restrX.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.restrX
AdalyFormal.DLayer.restrX.header: noncomputable def restrX (P : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop) : XS L →L[ℝ] XS L

AdalyFormal.DLayer.restrX_apply.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.restrX_apply
AdalyFormal.DLayer.restrX_apply.header:
theorem restrX_apply (P : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop) (a : XS L) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    restrX P a e = if P e then a e else 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.restrX_eq_on.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.restrX_eq_on
AdalyFormal.DLayer.restrX_eq_on.header:
theorem restrX_eq_on (P : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop) (a : XS L) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (he : P e) :
    restrX P a e = a e

AdalyFormal.DLayer.restrX_zero_of.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.restrX_zero_of
AdalyFormal.DLayer.restrX_zero_of.header: theorem restrX_zero_of (P : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop) (a : XS L) (h : ∀ e, P e → a e = 0) : restrX P a = 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.QlinStepX_row_local.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.QlinStepX_row_local
AdalyFormal.DLayer.QlinStepX_row_local.header:
theorem QlinStepX_row_local (s ell : ℕ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (hreg : RegBg s ell V0)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (a : XS L) (ha : ∀ e, VisStep s ell c e → a e = 0) :
    QlinStepX s ell V0 a c = 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Foot.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Foot
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Foot.header:
def Foot (ell : ℕ) : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeEdge L → PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop
  | 0, c, e => e = c
  | j + 1, c, e => ∃ e', VisStep (ell ^ j) ell c e' ∧ Foot ell j e' e

theorem QlinCompX_zero_apply' (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (a : XS L) :
    QlinCompX ell bg 0 a = a

AdalyFormal.DLayer.QlinCompX_zero_apply'.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.QlinCompX_zero_apply'
AdalyFormal.DLayer.QlinCompX_zero_apply'.header:
theorem QlinCompX_zero_apply' (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (a : XS L) :
    QlinCompX ell bg 0 a = a

AdalyFormal.DLayer.QlinCompX_row_local.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.QlinCompX_row_local
AdalyFormal.DLayer.QlinCompX_row_local.header:
theorem QlinCompX_row_local (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (J : ℕ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell bg J) : ∀ j, j ≤ J → ∀ (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (a : XS L),
      (∀ e, Foot ell j c e → a e = 0) → QlinCompX ell bg j a c = 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach.header: def Reach (m : ℕ) (x z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_refl.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_refl
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_refl.header: theorem Reach_refl (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Reach 0 x x

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_mono.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_mono
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_mono.header: theorem Reach_mono {m m' : ℕ} (h : m ≤ m') {x z : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hr : Reach m x z) : Reach m' x z

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_trans.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_trans
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_trans.header:
theorem Reach_trans {m m' : ℕ} {x y z : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (h1 : Reach m x y) (h2 : Reach m' y z) :
    Reach (m + m') x z

AdalyFormal.DLayer.iterate_shift_foldl.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.iterate_shift_foldl
AdalyFormal.DLayer.iterate_shift_foldl.header:
theorem iterate_shift_foldl (μ : Fin 3) : ∀ (s : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
    (fun z => periodicLatticeShift z μ)^[s] x = (List.replicate s μ).foldl (fun w ν => periodicLatticeShift w ν) x
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | s + 1, x => by
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, List.replicate_succ, List.foldl_cons]
      exact iterate_shift_foldl μ s _

theorem Reach_coarseShift (s : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : Reach s x (coarseShift x s μ)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_coarseShift.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_coarseShift
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_coarseShift.header: theorem Reach_coarseShift (s : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : Reach s x (coarseShift x s μ)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_lip.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_lip
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_lip.header:
theorem Reach_lip (θ' : ℝ) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) {m : ℕ} {x z : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (h : Reach m x z) : |φ z - φ x| ≤ m * θ'

AdalyFormal.DLayer.OnPath_reach.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.OnPath_reach
AdalyFormal.DLayer.OnPath_reach.header:
theorem OnPath_reach (s : ℕ) : ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L),
    OnPath s y p e → Reach (s * p.length) y e.1
  | [], _, _, h => h.elim
  | μ :: rest, y, e, h => by
      rcases h with h | h
      · rw [h]; exact Reach_mono (Nat.zero_le _) (Reach_refl y)
      · have

AdalyFormal.DLayer.endpoint_reach.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.endpoint_reach
AdalyFormal.DLayer.endpoint_reach.header:
theorem endpoint_reach (s : ℕ) : ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
    Reach (s * p.length) y (coarsePathEndpoint s y p)
  | [], y => Reach_refl y
  | μ :: rest, y => by
      have

AdalyFormal.DLayer.steps_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.steps_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.steps_le.header:
theorem steps_le (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (a b : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    (h1 : (a μ).val ≤ (b μ).val) (h2 : (b μ).val < (a μ).val + s * ell) :
    (b μ - a μ).val / s ≤ ell - 1

AdalyFormal.DLayer.gamma_len_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.gamma_len_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.gamma_len_le.header:
theorem gamma_len_le (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) :
    (coarseGammaPath s y x).length ≤ 3 * (ell - 1)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.block_reach.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.block_reach
AdalyFormal.DLayer.block_reach.header:
theorem block_reach (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) :
    Reach (3 * (ell - 1) * s) y x

AdalyFormal.DLayer.VisStep_reach.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.VisStep_reach
AdalyFormal.DLayer.VisStep_reach.header:
theorem VisStep_reach (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (c e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (h : VisStep s ell c e) :
    Reach (Rstep ell s) c.1 e.1

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Rfoot.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Rfoot
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Rfoot.header:
def Rfoot (ell : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => 0
  | j + 1 => Rstep ell (ell ^ j) + Rfoot ell j

theorem Foot_reach (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) : ∀ (j : ℕ) (c e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L),
    Foot ell j c e → Reach (Rfoot ell j) c.1 e.1
  | 0, c, e, h => by
      have h' : e = c

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Foot_reach.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Foot_reach
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Foot_reach.header:
theorem Foot_reach (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) : ∀ (j : ℕ) (c e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L),
    Foot ell j c e → Reach (Rfoot ell j) c.1 e.1
  | 0, c, e, h => by
      have h' : e = c

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Rfoot_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Rfoot_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Rfoot_le.header:
theorem Rfoot_le (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) : ∀ j, Rfoot ell j ≤ 5 * ell ^ j
  | 0 => by simp [Rfoot]
  | j + 1 => by
      have ih

AdalyFormal.DLayer.shift_disp.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.shift_disp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.shift_disp.header: theorem shift_disp (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) : ((periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν - x ν).val ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_disp.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_disp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Reach_disp.header: theorem Reach_disp {m : ℕ} {y z : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (h : Reach m y z) (ν : Fin 3) : (z ν - y ν).val ≤ m

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sub_val_mod.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sub_val_mod
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sub_val_mod.header: theorem sub_val_mod (n : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (hN : n ∣ N) (a b : Fin N) (hb : n ∣ b.val) : (a - b).val % n = a.val % n

AdalyFormal.DLayer.card_reach_coarse_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.card_reach_coarse_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.card_reach_coarse_le.header:
theorem card_reach_coarse_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, n ∣ L ν + 1) (m : ℕ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun y : PeriodicLatticeSite L => (∀ ν, n ∣ (y ν).val) ∧ Reach m y z)).card ≤ (m / n + 1) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.DLayer.u_side_f.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.u_side_f
AdalyFormal.DLayer.u_side_f.header:
theorem u_side_f (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G U a + (1 - siteMask (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G.Om0)))
    (hB0 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G U,
      (bondSectorOf (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G U).Qfull (gradL2 U ν) = 0)
    (hG : IsUnit (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G1inv) (hN : IsUnit (GenP.Nmat (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam)))
    (C0 ε' εJ : ℝ) (hC0 : 0 < C0) (hε'0 : 0 ≤ ε') (hε'1 : ε' ≤ 1)
    (hcoer : ∀ y : ↥(bondSupp (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G),
      ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ C0 * ⟪y, (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Ginv y⟫)
    (hD2f : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G),
      |⟪A, (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Delta2 (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data_laws A⟫|
        ≤ ε' * ⟪A, (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫)
    (B : BondFnL2 Lu)
    (hJ : |⟪(PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).H1in ((PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).D2in B),
        (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Jf⟫| ≤ εJ * ‖B‖ ^ 2) :
    ∃ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      (bondSectorOf (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G U).Qfull x
          = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).tau B ∧
      ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ C0 * (⟪x, Delta (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G U x⟫ + a * (ell : ℝ) ^ k * ‖B‖ ^ 2) ∧
      (1 - ε') * (⟪x, Delta (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G U x⟫ / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
          - (ε' * a + 2 * εJ) * ‖B‖ ^ 2
        ≤ GenP.genForm (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam) B

AdalyFormal.DLayer.units_PU_f.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.units_PU_f
AdalyFormal.DLayer.units_PU_f.header:
theorem units_PU_f (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (C0 ε' : ℝ) (hC0 : 0 < C0) (hε' : ε' < 1)
    (hcoer : ∀ y : ↥(bondSupp (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G),
      ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ C0 * ⟪y, (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Ginv y⟫)
    (hD2f : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G),
      |⟪A, (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Delta2 (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data_laws A⟫|
        ≤ ε' * ⟪A, (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫)
    (hQs : Function.Injective (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Qs) :
    IsUnit (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G1inv ∧ IsUnit (GenP.Nmat (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.suCoord_zero_of.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.suCoord_zero_of
AdalyFormal.DLayer.suCoord_zero_of.header:
theorem suCoord_zero_of {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (x : BondFnL2 L) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (h : x e = 0) :
    suCoord x e = 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_row_local.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_row_local
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_row_local.header:
theorem Qfull_row_local (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu)) (hx : ∀ b, Foot ell k p.2.1 b → x b = 0) :
    (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull x p = 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.qbM.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.qbM
AdalyFormal.DLayer.qbM.header: noncomputable def qbM (ε : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.qbM_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.qbM_nonneg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.qbM_nonneg.header: theorem qbM_nonneg (ε : ℕ → ℝ) : 0 ≤ qbM ell k ε

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_norm_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_norm_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_norm_le.header:
theorem Qfull_norm_le (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ‖(bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull x‖ ≤ qbM ell k ε * ‖x‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWt.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWt
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWt.header:
noncomputable def fspWt (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) :
    FSp (GF ell k Lu) →L[ℝ] FSp (GF ell k Lu)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWt_apply.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWt_apply
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWt_apply.header:
theorem fspWt_apply (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (u : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) (p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu)) :
    (fspWt ell k Lu φ u) p = Real.exp (φ p.2.1.1) • u p

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWt_neg_cancel.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWt_neg_cancel
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWt_neg_cancel.header:
theorem fspWt_neg_cancel (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (u : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) :
    fspWt ell k Lu φ (fspWt ell k Lu (-φ) u) = u

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWt_cancel_neg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWt_cancel_neg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWt_cancel_neg.header:
theorem fspWt_cancel_neg (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (u : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) :
    fspWt ell k Lu (-φ) (fspWt ell k Lu φ u) = u

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWt_symm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWt_symm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWt_symm.header:
theorem fspWt_symm (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (u v : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) :
    ⟪fspWt ell k Lu φ u, v⟫ = ⟪u, fspWt ell k Lu φ v⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWP.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWP
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fspWP.header: noncomputable def fspWP (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) : WPair (FSp (GF ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondRestr.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondRestr
AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondRestr.header: noncomputable def bondRestr {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (P : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop) (x : BondFnL2 L) : BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.DLayer.foot_mult.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.foot_mult
AdalyFormal.DLayer.foot_mult.header:
theorem foot_mult (hell : 0 < ell) (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu), ∑ b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu), (if Foot ell k p.2.1 b then ‖x b‖ ^ 2 else 0)
      ≤ (3 * (Rfoot ell k / ell ^ k + 1) ^ 3 : ℕ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_conj_pt.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_conj_pt
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_conj_pt.header:
theorem Qfull_conj_pt (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu)) :
    (fspWt ell k Lu φ ((bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull (bondWt (-φ) x)) - (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull x) p
      = (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull (bondWt (fun z => φ p.2.1.1 - φ z) x - x) p

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_local_pt.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_local_pt
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_local_pt.header:
theorem Qfull_local_pt (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k)
    (y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu)) :
    (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull y p
      = (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull (bondRestr (Foot ell k p.2.1) y) p

AdalyFormal.DLayer.restr_resc_sq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.restr_resc_sq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.restr_resc_sq.header:
theorem restr_resc_sq (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ‖bondRestr (Foot ell k c) (bondWt (fun z => φ c.1 - φ z) x - x)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (Real.exp (Rfoot ell k * θ') - 1) ^ 2
        * ∑ b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu), (if Foot ell k c b then ‖x b‖ ^ 2 else 0)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_conj_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_conj_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_conj_le.header:
theorem Qfull_conj_le (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ‖fspWt ell k Lu φ ((bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull (bondWt (-φ) x)) - (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull x‖
      ≤ qbM ell k ε * (Real.exp (Rfoot ell k * θ') - 1) * Real.sqrt ((3 * (Rfoot ell k / ell ^ k + 1) ^ 3 : ℕ))
        * ‖x‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_cjp_norm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_cjp_norm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_cjp_norm.header:
theorem Qfull_cjp_norm (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) :
    ‖cjp (bondWP φ) (fspWP ell k Lu φ) (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull - (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull‖
      ≤ qbM ell k ε * (Real.exp (Rfoot ell k * θ') - 1) * Real.sqrt ((3 * (Rfoot ell k / ell ^ k + 1) ^ 3 : ℕ))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_cjm_norm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_cjm_norm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qfull_cjm_norm.header:
theorem Qfull_cjm_norm (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) :
    ‖cjm (bondWP φ) (fspWP ell k Lu φ) (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull - (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull‖
      ≤ qbM ell k ε * (Real.exp (Rfoot ell k * θ') - 1) * Real.sqrt ((3 * (Rfoot ell k / ell ^ k + 1) ^ 3 : ℕ))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ginvHypOf.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ginvHypOf
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ginvHypOf.header:
noncomputable def ginvHypOf (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ)
    (G0 : GamHyp (SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (coarseC (GF ell k Lu)))
    (hD : G0.D = gradL2 U) (hωE : G0.ωE = bondWP φ) (hωS : G0.ωS = siteWP φ)
    (q0 : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (hplaq : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy U p) ≤ q0)
    (α₀ : ℝ) (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hpl : AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.PlaqDef α₀ U)
    (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2) :
    GinvHyp (SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (coarseC (GF ell k Lu))
      (PlaqFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (FSp (GF ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.diagW_massW.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.diagW_massW
AdalyFormal.DLayer.diagW_massW.header:
theorem diagW_massW (a : ℝ) (u : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) :
    diagW (GF ell k Lu) (massW (GF ell k Lu) a) u = (a * (ell : ℝ) ^ k) • u

AdalyFormal.DLayer.MassFull_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.MassFull_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.MassFull_eq.header:
theorem MassFull_eq (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) :
    MassFull (GF ell k Lu) a (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U)
      = (a * (ell : ℝ) ^ k) • (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull
          ∘L (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvFull.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvFull
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvFull.header:
noncomputable def GinvFull (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Ginv_eq_full.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Ginv_eq_full
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Ginv_eq_full.header:
theorem Ginv_eq_full (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a + (1 - siteMask (GF ell k Lu).Om0)))
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ)
    (G0 : GamHyp (SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (coarseC (GF ell k Lu)))
    (hD : G0.D = gradL2 U) (hQ : G0.Qp = Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U) (hL : G0.Linv = Gp (GF ell k Lu) U a)
    (hωE : G0.ωE = bondWP φ) (hωS : G0.ωS = siteWP φ)
    (q0 : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (hplaq : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy U p) ≤ q0)
    (α₀ : ℝ) (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hpl : AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.PlaqDef α₀ U)
    (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2) :
    (ginvHypOf ell k Lu hell U a ha φ θ' hφ G0 hD hωE hωS q0 hq0 hplaq α₀ hα₀ hpl ε hreg hcl hε0 hsm).Ginv
      = GinvFull ell k Lu U a

AdalyFormal.DLayer.adjoint_smul_real.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.adjoint_smul_real
AdalyFormal.DLayer.adjoint_smul_real.header:
theorem adjoint_smul_real (c : ℝ) (A : X →L[ℝ] Y) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (c • A) = c • ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A

AdalyFormal.DLayer.X_scaled.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.X_scaled
AdalyFormal.DLayer.X_scaled.header: theorem X_scaled : G0.H.X = (t / s ^ 2) • (Gp (GF ell k Lu) U a ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Rproj_eq_scaled.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Rproj_eq_scaled
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Rproj_eq_scaled.header:
theorem Rproj_eq_scaled (v : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    Rproj (GF ell k Lu) U v
      = v - (Gp (GF ell k Lu) U a ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U))
          (((t ^ 2 / s ^ 4) • G0.Gami)
            (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Gp (GF ell k Lu) U a ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U)) v))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Tfull_eq_T_scaled.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Tfull_eq_T_scaled
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Tfull_eq_T_scaled.header: theorem Tfull_eq_T_scaled : G0.T = s • Tfull (GF ell k Lu) U

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Wop_eq_W_scaled.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Wop_eq_W_scaled
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Wop_eq_W_scaled.header: theorem Wop_eq_W_scaled : G0.W = Wop (GF ell k Lu) U a

AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjp_smul_sub.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjp_smul_sub
AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjp_smul_sub.header:
theorem cjp_smul_sub {X Z : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [InnerProductSpace ℝ X] [NormedAddCommGroup Z]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] (ωX : WPair X) (ωZ : WPair Z) (c : ℝ) (T : X →L[ℝ] Z) :
    ‖cjp ωX ωZ (c • T) - c • T‖ = |c| * ‖cjp ωX ωZ T - T‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjm_smul_sub.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjm_smul_sub
AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjm_smul_sub.header:
theorem cjm_smul_sub {X Z : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [InnerProductSpace ℝ X] [NormedAddCommGroup Z]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] (ωX : WPair X) (ωZ : WPair Z) (c : ℝ) (T : X →L[ℝ] Z) :
    ‖cjm ωX ωZ (c • T) - c • T‖ = |c| * ‖cjm ωX ωZ T - T‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.LS_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.LS_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.LS_eq.header:
theorem LS_eq (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (hm0 : 0 ≤ mTop ell k a) (f : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (((ell : ℝ) ^ k) • gradL2 U) ∘L (((ell : ℝ) ^ k) • gradL2 U)
      + (1 : ℝ) • (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ((Real.sqrt (mTop ell k a) * (ell : ℝ) ^ k) • Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U)
          ∘L ((Real.sqrt (mTop ell k a) * (ell : ℝ) ^ k) • Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U))) f
      = ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 • DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a f

AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteHypS.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteHypS
AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteHypS.header:
noncomputable def siteHypS (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (θ' δ c' δD' δQ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hbox : ∀ y ∈ (GF ell k Lu).Lam (GF ell k Lu).k, ∀ x ∈ boxF y (ell ^ k), |φ y - φ x| ≤ δ)
    (hm0 : 0 ≤ mTop ell k a)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a + (1 - siteMask (GF ell k Lu).Om0)))
    (hc : 0 < c') (hcoer : ∀ f, c' * ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * ⟪f, DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a f⟫)
    (hDD : (ell : ℝ) ^ k * (Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp θ' - 1)) ≤ δD')
    (hQQ : Real.sqrt (mTop ell k a) * (ell : ℝ) ^ k * (Real.sqrt ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ k) * (Real.exp δ - 1)) ≤ δQ')
    (hsmall : 24 * (δD' ^ 2 + 1 * δQ' ^ 2) ≤ c') (hsmallD : 4 * δD' ^ 2 ≤ c') :
    SiteHyp (SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (coarseC (GF ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ginvHypS.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ginvHypS
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ginvHypS.header:
noncomputable def ginvHypS (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ)
    (G0 : GamHyp (SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (coarseC (GF ell k Lu)))
    (hD : G0.D = ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) • gradL2 U) (hωE : G0.ωE = bondWP φ) (hωS : G0.ωS = siteWP φ)
    (q0 : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (hplaq : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy U p) ≤ q0)
    (α₀ : ℝ) (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hpl : AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.PlaqDef α₀ U)
    (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (δC' κ' δK' ν' δν' δB' : ℝ)
    (hC' : (ell : ℝ) ^ k * (6 * (Real.exp θ' - 1)) ≤ δC')
    (hK' : ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * (6 * q0) ≤ κ')
    (hdK' : ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * (6 * q0 * (Real.exp (2 * θ') - 1)) ≤ δK')
    (hν' : ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * (816 * α₀) ≤ ν')
    (hdν' : ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * (816 * α₀ * (Real.exp (2 * θ') - 1)) ≤ δν')
    (hB' : Real.sqrt (a * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3)
      * (qbM ell k ε * (Real.exp (Rfoot ell k * θ') - 1) * multB ell k) ≤ δB') :
    GinvHyp (SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (coarseC (GF ell k Lu))
      (PlaqFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (FSp (GF ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Ginv_apply.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Ginv_apply
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Ginv_apply.header:
theorem GinvHyp.Ginv_apply {S E Y P B : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Y]
    [NormedAddCommGroup P] [InnerProductSpace ℝ P] [NormedAddCommGroup B] [InnerProductSpace ℝ B]
    [CompleteSpace S] [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace Y] [CompleteSpace P] [CompleteSpace B]
    (I : GinvHyp S E Y P B) (x : E) :
    I.Ginv x = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint I.Gm.W (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint I.C (I.C (I.Gm.W x)) + I.Dp (I.Gm.W x))
      + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint I.Gm.T (I.Gm.T x) + I.M • ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint I.Qb (I.Qb x)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvS_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvS_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvS_eq.header:
theorem GinvS_eq (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a + (1 - siteMask (GF ell k Lu).Om0)))
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ)
    (G0 : GamHyp (SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (coarseC (GF ell k Lu)))
    (hm0 : 0 ≤ mTop ell k a)
    (hD : G0.D = ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) • gradL2 U)
    (hQ : G0.Qp = (Real.sqrt (mTop ell k a) * (ell : ℝ) ^ k) • Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U)
    (hL : G0.Linv = ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ ^ 2 • Gp (GF ell k Lu) U a)
    (hmpos : 0 < mTop ell k a)
    (hωE : G0.ωE = bondWP φ) (hωS : G0.ωS = siteWP φ)
    (q0 : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (hplaq : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy U p) ≤ q0)
    (α₀ : ℝ) (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hpl : AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.PlaqDef α₀ U)
    (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (δC' κ' δK' ν' δν' δB' : ℝ)
    (hC' : (ell : ℝ) ^ k * (6 * (Real.exp θ' - 1)) ≤ δC')
    (hK' : ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * (6 * q0) ≤ κ')
    (hdK' : ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * (6 * q0 * (Real.exp (2 * θ') - 1)) ≤ δK')
    (hν' : ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * (816 * α₀) ≤ ν')
    (hdν' : ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * (816 * α₀ * (Real.exp (2 * θ') - 1)) ≤ δν')
    (hB' : Real.sqrt (a * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3)
      * (qbM ell k ε * (Real.exp (Rfoot ell k * θ') - 1) * multB ell k) ≤ δB') :
    (ginvHypS ell k Lu hell U a ha φ θ' hφ G0 hD hωE hωS q0 hq0 hplaq α₀ hα₀ hpl ε hreg hcl hε0 hsm
        δC' κ' δK' ν' δν' δB' hC' hK' hdK' hν' hdν' hB').Ginv
      = ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 • GinvFull ell k Lu U a

AdalyFormal.DLayer.mem_bondSupp_full.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.mem_bondSupp_full
AdalyFormal.DLayer.mem_bondSupp_full.header: theorem mem_bondSupp_full (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) : x ∈ bondSupp (GF ell k Lu)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.data_Ginv_form.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.data_Ginv_form
AdalyFormal.DLayer.data_Ginv_form.header:
theorem data_Ginv_form (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (x : ↥(bondSupp (GF ell k Lu))) :
    ⟪x, (IngrBParams.data ⟨ell, k, Lu, hell, fullTower ell k Lu, U, a, Lam⟩).Ginv x⟫
      = ⟪(x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)), GinvFull ell k Lu U a x⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvFull_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvFull_coercive
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvFull_coercive.header:
theorem GinvFull_coercive (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a t e q0 : ℝ)
    (R : AdalyFormal.AsmM0.M0RegimeR ell k Lu U a t e q0)
    (H : AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.KUSmall ell (AdalyFormal.AsmM0.rhoM0 ell k e q0))
    (f : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * AdalyFormal.AsmM0.KhatM0 ell a t (AdalyFormal.AsmM0.rhoM0 ell k e q0)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.instIneq_M0_cond_f.header:
theorem instIneq_M0_cond_f (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (a t e q0 : ℝ) (R : M0RegimeR ell k Lu U a t e q0) (H : KUSmall ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0))
    (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < Lu μ + 1) (hd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (hLB : LamBlockSum ell Lam)
    (hG : IsUnit (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G1inv) (hN : IsUnit (GenP.Nmat (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam)))
    (ε' εJ dC cB : ℝ) (hε'0 : 0 ≤ ε') (hεJ : 0 ≤ εJ) (hcB : 0 ≤ cB)
    (hε' : ε' ≤ 1)
    (hD2f : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G),
      |⟪A, (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Delta2 (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data_laws A⟫|
        ≤ ε' * ⟪A, (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫)
    (hJ : ∀ Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo, OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt → OnLambdaT Lam Bt →
        |⟪(PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).H1in ((PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).D2in
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (Cop Lam (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Q1 Bt))), (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Jf⟫|
          ≤ εJ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (Cop Lam (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Q1 Bt) : BondFnL2 Lu)‖ ^ 2)
    (hC : ∀ Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo, OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt → OnLambdaT Lam Bt →
        ∑ b : Bond Lu, ‖Cop Lam (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Q1 Bt b - Cop Lam (q1SU2 ell) Bt b‖ ^ 2
            ≤ dC ^ 2 * ∑ b : Bond Lu, ‖Cop Lam (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Q1 Bt b‖ ^ 2 ∧
        ∑ b : Bond Lu, ‖Cop Lam (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Q1 Bt b‖ ^ 2 ≤ cB ^ 2 * bondEnergy Bt) :
    InstIneq ell k hell a Lu (gam0M0f ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) ε' εJ dC cB) (fullTower ell k Lu) Lam U

AdalyFormal.DLayer.instIneq_M0_kuniform_.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.instIneq_M0_kuniform_f
AdalyFormal.DLayer.instIneq_M0_kuniform_.header:
theorem instIneq_M0_kuniform_f (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (a t e q0 : ℝ) (R : M0RegimeR ell k Lu U a t e q0) (H : KUSmall ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0))
    (HU : UnitSmall ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0))
    (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < Lu μ + 1) (hd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (hLB : LamBlockSum ell Lam)
    (ε' εJ : ℝ) (hε'0 : 0 ≤ ε') (hεJ : 0 ≤ εJ)
    (hε' : ε' < 1)
    (hD2f : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G),
      |⟪A, (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Delta2 (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data_laws A⟫|
        ≤ ε' * ⟪A, (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫)
    (hJ : ∀ Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo, OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt → OnLambdaT Lam Bt →
        |⟪(PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).H1in ((PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).D2in
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (Cop Lam (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Q1 Bt))), (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Jf⟫|
          ≤ εJ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (Cop Lam (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Q1 Bt) : BondFnL2 Lu)‖ ^ 2) :
    InstIneq ell k hell a Lu
      (gam0M0f ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) ε' εJ (dCM0 ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)) (cBM0 ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)))
      (fullTower ell k Lu) Lam U

AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_Bsq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_Bsq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_Bsq.header:
theorem m0_Bsq :
    ((AdalyFormal.FlatExt.bFE ell k + (Real.sqrt 12 * (rhoM0 ell k e q0 / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)) * AdalyFormal.FlatExt.aFE ell k)
      / (1 - (6 * rhoM0 ell k e q0 * Real.sqrt (1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3)) * AdalyFormal.FlatExt.aFE ell k)) ^ 2
      = (ell : ℝ) ^ k * (Real.sqrt 78732 + 27 * Real.sqrt 12 * rhoM0 ell k e q0) ^ 2
        / (1 - 162 * rhoM0 ell k e q0) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_extS.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_extS
AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_extS.header:
theorem m0_extS (θ : ℝ) (hc : CondM0 ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ) (u : coarseC (GF ell k Lu)) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hC'.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hK'.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hK'

AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hdK'.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hdK'
AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hdK'.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hν'.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hν'
AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hν'.header: theorem m0_hν' : ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * (816 * (q0 / (4 * Real.sqrt 2))) ≤ νS (rhoM0 ell k e q0)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hdν'.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hdν'
AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hdν'.header:
theorem m0_hdν' (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) :
    ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * (816 * (q0 / (4 * Real.sqrt 2)) * (Real.exp (2 * (θ / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)) - 1))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hB'.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hB'
AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hB'.header:
theorem m0_hB' (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) :
    Real.sqrt (a * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3)
      * (qbM ell k (epsCl ell e q0) * (Real.exp (Rfoot ell k * (θ / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)) - 1) * multB ell k)
      ≤ δBS ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteM0.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteM0
AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteM0.header: noncomputable def siteM0 : SiteHyp (SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (coarseC (GF ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteM0_L.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteM0_L
AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteM0_L.header:
theorem siteM0_L (g : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    (siteM0 ell k Lu U a t e q0 R φ θ hφ hc).L g = ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 • DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a g

AdalyFormal.DLayer.gamM0.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.gamM0
AdalyFormal.DLayer.gamM0.header: noncomputable def gamM0 : GamHyp (SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (coarseC (GF ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ginvM0.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ginvM0
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ginvM0.header:
noncomputable def ginvM0 (H : AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.KUSmall ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)) :
