AdalyFormal.DLayer.ginvM0_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ginvM0_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ginvM0_eq.header: theorem ginvM0_eq (H : AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.KUSmall ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)) : (ginvM0 ell k Lu U a t e q0 R φ θ hφ hc H).Ginv = ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 • GinvFull ell k Lu U a

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ginvM0_EG.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ginvM0_EG
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ginvM0_EG.header: theorem ginvM0_EG (H : AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.KUSmall ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)) : (ginvM0 ell k Lu U a t e q0 R φ θ hφ hc H).EG = EGM0 ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc

AdalyFormal.DLayer.KhatM0_pos.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.KhatM0_pos
AdalyFormal.DLayer.KhatM0_pos.header: theorem KhatM0_pos : 0 < KhatM0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvFull_coer'.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvFull_coer'
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvFull_coer'.header:
theorem GinvFull_coer' (f : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    (1 / (((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * KhatM0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0))) * ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪f, GinvFull ell k Lu U a f⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvFull_isUnit.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvFull_isUnit
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvFull_isUnit.header: theorem GinvFull_isUnit : IsUnit (GinvFull ell k Lu U a)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.G_CT_M0.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.G_CT_M0
AdalyFormal.DLayer.G_CT_M0.header:
theorem G_CT_M0 (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hφ : WtLip (θ / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) φ) (hc : CondM0 ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ)
    (hEG : 4 * EGM0 ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc ≤ 1 / KhatM0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0))
    (g : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ‖bondWt φ (Ring.inverse (GinvFull ell k Lu U a) (bondWt (-φ) g))‖
      ≤ 2 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * KhatM0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) * ‖g‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_range_cube_real.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_range_cube_real
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_range_cube_real.header: theorem sum_range_cube_real (n : ℕ) : ∑ s ∈ range n, (s : ℝ) ^ 3 = ((n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1) / 2) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_range_four_real.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_range_four_real
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_range_four_real.header:
theorem sum_range_four_real (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ s ∈ range n, (s : ℝ) ^ 4
      = (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1) * (2 * (n : ℝ) - 1) * (3 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 - 3 * (n : ℝ) - 1) / 30

AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof
AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof.header: noncomputable def tprof (n t : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof
AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof.header: noncomputable def pprof (n t : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_eq_zero.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_eq_zero.header: theorem tprof_eq_zero (n t : ℕ) (h : n ≤ t) : tprof n t = 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_eq_zero.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_eq_zero.header: theorem pprof_eq_zero (n t : ℕ) (h : n ≤ t) : pprof n t = 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_moment_own.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_moment_own
AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_moment_own.header: theorem tprof_moment_own (n : ℕ) : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((s : ℝ) + 1) * tprof n s = (n : ℝ) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_moment_next.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_moment_next
AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_moment_next.header: theorem tprof_moment_next (n : ℕ) : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((n : ℝ) - 1 - (s : ℝ)) * tprof n s = 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_sum.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_sum
AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_sum.header: theorem pprof_sum (n : ℕ) : ∑ s ∈ range n, pprof n s = (n : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.abs_tprof_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.abs_tprof_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.abs_tprof_le.header: theorem abs_tprof_le (n t : ℕ) : |tprof n t| ≤ 9

AdalyFormal.DLayer.abs_pprof_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.abs_pprof_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.abs_pprof_le.header: theorem abs_pprof_le (n t : ℕ) : |pprof n t| ≤ 3 / 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_step_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_step_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_step_le.header: theorem tprof_step_le (n t : ℕ) (h : t + 1 < n) : |tprof n (t + 1) - tprof n t| ≤ 72 / n

AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_first_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_first_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_first_le.header: theorem tprof_first_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : |tprof n 0| ≤ 72 / n

AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_last_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_last_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.tprof_last_le.header: theorem tprof_last_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : |tprof n (n - 1)| ≤ 72 / n

AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_step.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_step
AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_step.header:
theorem pprof_step (n t : ℕ) (h : t + 1 < n) :
    pprof n (t + 1) - pprof n t = 6 * ((n : ℝ) - 2 * t - 2) / (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 2))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_step_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_step_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_step_le.header: theorem pprof_step_le (n t : ℕ) (h : t + 1 < n) : |pprof n (t + 1) - pprof n t| ≤ 6 / n

AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_first_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_first_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_first_le.header: theorem pprof_first_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : |pprof n 0| ≤ 6 / n

AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_last_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_last_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.pprof_last_le.header: theorem pprof_last_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : |pprof n (n - 1)| ≤ 6 / n

AdalyFormal.DLayer.SProf.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.SProf
AdalyFormal.DLayer.SProf.header: structure SProf (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (F D : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sprof_tprof.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sprof_tprof
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sprof_tprof.header: theorem sprof_tprof (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : SProf n (tprof n) 9 72

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sprof_pprof.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sprof_pprof
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sprof_pprof.header: theorem sprof_pprof (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : SProf n (pprof n) (3 / 2) 6

AdalyFormal.DLayer.SProf.F_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.SProf.F_nonneg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.SProf.F_nonneg.header: theorem SProf.F_nonneg {n : ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℝ} {F D : ℝ} (h : SProf n f F D) : 0 ≤ F

AdalyFormal.DLayer.SProf.D_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.SProf.D_nonneg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.SProf.D_nonneg.header: theorem SProf.D_nonneg {n : ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℝ} {F D : ℝ} (h : SProf n f F D) : 0 ≤ D

AdalyFormal.DLayer.cyc_step_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.cyc_step_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.cyc_step_le.header:
theorem cyc_step_le {n : ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℝ} {F D : ℝ} (h : SProf n f F D) (N t : ℕ) (hnN : n ≤ N) (ht : t < N) :
    |f ((t + 1) % N) - f t| ≤ (if t < n ∨ t = N - 1 then 2 * D / n else 0)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.point_cases_g.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.point_cases_g
AdalyFormal.DLayer.point_cases_g.header:
theorem point_cases_g (g : ℕ → ℝ) (N n D r i : ℕ) (hz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → g t = 0) (hr : r < n) (hi : i < n)
    (hcase : (D = 0 ∧ N = n) ∨ (D = 0 ∧ 2 * n ≤ N) ∨ (0 < D ∧ D + n = N ∧ 2 * n ≤ N) ∨ (n ≤ D ∧ D + 2 * n ≤ N)) :
    g ((D + r + i) % N)
      = (if D = 0 then (if r + i < n then g (r + i) else 0) else 0)
        + (if (D + n) % N = 0 then (if n ≤ r + i then g (r + i - n) else 0) else 0)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.core_line_g.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.core_line_g
AdalyFormal.DLayer.core_line_g.header:
theorem core_line_g (g : ℕ → ℝ) (N n D : ℕ) (hz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → g t = 0)
    (m1 : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((s : ℝ) + 1) * g s = (n : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (m2 : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((n : ℝ) - 1 - (s : ℝ)) * g s = 0)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hN : n ∣ N) (hD : n ∣ D) (hDN : D < N) :
    ∑ r ∈ range n, ∑ i ∈ range n, g ((D + r + i) % N) = if D = 0 then (n : ℝ) ^ 2 else 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.core_ind_g.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.core_ind_g
AdalyFormal.DLayer.core_ind_g.header:
theorem core_ind_g (g : ℕ → ℝ) (N n D : ℕ) (hz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → g t = 0)
    (m0 : ∑ s ∈ range n, g s = (n : ℝ))
    (hn : 0 < n) (hN : n ∣ N) (hD : n ∣ D) (hDN : D < N) :
    ∑ r ∈ range n, g ((D + r) % N) = if D = 0 then (n : ℝ) else 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.gfac.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.gfac
AdalyFormal.DLayer.gfac.header: noncomputable def gfac (g h : ℕ → ℝ) (μ ν : Fin 3) (t : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbK.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbK
AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbK.header: noncomputable def gbK (g h : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (c : CoarseBond L n) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbondE.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbondE
AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbondE.header: noncomputable def gbondE (g h : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) : Bond L → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.DLayer.line_factor_g.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.line_factor_g
AdalyFormal.DLayer.line_factor_g.header:
theorem line_factor_g (g : ℕ → ℝ) {M n : ℕ} (hz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → g t = 0)
    (m1 : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((s : ℝ) + 1) * g s = (n : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (m2 : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((n : ℝ) - 1 - (s : ℝ)) * g s = 0)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n ∣ M + 1) (z y : Fin (M + 1)) (hz' : n ∣ z.val) (hy : n ∣ y.val) :
    ∑ a ∈ univ.filter (fun a : Fin (M + 1) => z.val ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < z.val + n),
      ∑ i ∈ range n, g ((a + i • (1 : Fin (M + 1)) - y).val) = if z = y then (n : ℝ) ^ 2 else 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ind_factor_g.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ind_factor_g
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ind_factor_g.header:
theorem ind_factor_g (h : ℕ → ℝ) {M n : ℕ} (hz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → h t = 0) (m0 : ∑ s ∈ range n, h s = (n : ℝ))
    (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n ∣ M + 1) (z y : Fin (M + 1)) (hz' : n ∣ z.val) (hy : n ∣ y.val) :
    ∑ a ∈ univ.filter (fun a : Fin (M + 1) => z.val ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < z.val + n),
      h ((a - y).val) = if z = y then (n : ℝ) else 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Hfg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Hfg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Hfg.header: noncomputable def Hfg (g h : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) (a : Fin (L ν + 1)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.line_prod_g.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.line_prod_g
AdalyFormal.DLayer.line_prod_g.header:
theorem line_prod_g (g h : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∑ i ∈ range n, ∏ ν : Fin 3, gfac g h μ ν (((pathSite x μ i) ν - y ν).val) = ∏ ν : Fin 3, Hfg g h n μ y ν (x ν)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.block_line_sum_g.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.block_line_sum_g
AdalyFormal.DLayer.block_line_sum_g.header:
theorem block_line_sum_g (g h : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1)
    (hgz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → g t = 0) (m1 : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((s : ℝ) + 1) * g s = (n : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (m2 : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((n : ℝ) - 1 - (s : ℝ)) * g s = 0)
    (hhz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → h t = 0) (m0 : ∑ s ∈ range n, h s = (n : ℝ))
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : z ∈ CoarseLattice L n) (μ : Fin 3) (c : CoarseBond L n) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf z n, ∑ i ∈ range n, gbK g h n (pathSite x μ i) μ c
      = if c = (⟨z, hz⟩, μ) then (n : ℝ) ^ 4 else 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbondE_rightInv.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbondE_rightInv
AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbondE_rightInv.header:
theorem gbondE_rightInv (g h : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1)
    (hgz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → g t = 0) (m1 : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((s : ℝ) + 1) * g s = (n : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (m2 : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((n : ℝ) - 1 - (s : ℝ)) * g s = 0)
    (hhz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → h t = 0) (m0 : ∑ s ∈ range n, h s = (n : ℝ))
    (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) (c0 : CoarseBond L n) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n (gbondE g h n W) c0 = W c0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sbondE.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sbondE
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sbondE.header: noncomputable def sbondE (n : ℕ) (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) : Bond L → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sbondE_rightInv.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sbondE_rightInv
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sbondE_rightInv.header:
theorem sbondE_rightInv (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo)
    (c0 : CoarseBond L n) : lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n (sbondE n W) c0 = W c0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.row_eqlast_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.row_eqlast_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.row_eqlast_le.header:
theorem row_eqlast_le {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (n : ℕ) (a : Fin N) :
    ∑ t ∈ univ.filter (fun t : Fin N => t.val % n = 0), (if (a - t).val = N - 1 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.DLayer.col_or_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.col_or_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.col_or_le.header:
theorem col_or_le {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (n : ℕ) (t : Fin N) :
    ∑ a : Fin N, (if (a - t).val < n ∨ (a - t).val = N - 1 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ n + 1

AdalyFormal.DLayer.row_or_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.row_or_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.row_or_le.header:
theorem row_or_le {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n ∣ N) (a : Fin N) :
    ∑ t ∈ univ.filter (fun t : Fin N => t.val % n = 0),
      (if (a - t).val < n ∨ (a - t).val = N - 1 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.prod_schur.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.prod_schur
AdalyFormal.DLayer.prod_schur.header:
theorem prod_schur (n : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (m : Fin 3 → ℕ → ℝ) (hm0 : ∀ ν t, 0 ≤ m ν t) (R C : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hR : ∀ ν (a : Fin (L ν + 1)), ∑ t ∈ univ.filter (fun t : Fin (L ν + 1) => t.val % n = 0), m ν ((a - t).val) ≤ R ν)
    (hC : ∀ ν (t : Fin (L ν + 1)), ∑ a : Fin (L ν + 1), m ν ((a - t).val) ≤ C ν)
    (K : PeriodicLatticeSite L → CoarseBond L n → ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ y c, |K y c| ≤ if c.2 = μ then ∏ ν : Fin 3, m ν ((y ν - c.1.1 ν).val) else 0)
    (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) :
    ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ‖∑ c : CoarseBond L n, K y c • W c‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (∏ ν : Fin 3, R ν) * (∏ ν : Fin 3, C ν) * ∑ c : CoarseBond L n, ‖(if c.2 = μ then W c else 0)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_dir_split.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_dir_split
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_dir_split.header:
theorem sum_dir_split (n : ℕ) (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) :
    ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ c : CoarseBond L n, ‖(if c.2 = μ then W c else 0)‖ ^ 2 = ∑ c : CoarseBond L n, ‖W c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.abs_gfac_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.abs_gfac_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.abs_gfac_le.header:
theorem abs_gfac_le {n : ℕ} {g h : ℕ → ℝ} {Fg Dg Fh Dh : ℝ} (hg : SProf n g Fg Dg) (hh : SProf n h Fh Dh)
    (μ ν : Fin 3) (t : ℕ) : |gfac g h μ ν t| ≤ (if ν = μ then Fg else Fh) * (if t < n then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbondE_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbondE_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbondE_norm_sq.header:
theorem gbondE_norm_sq {n : ℕ} {g h : ℕ → ℝ} {Fg Dg Fh Dh : ℝ} (hg : SProf n g Fg Dg) (hh : SProf n h Fh Dh)
    (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ‖gbondE g h n W b‖ ^ 2 ≤ (Fg * Fh ^ 2) ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 3 * ∑ c : CoarseBond L n, ‖W c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.shift_val_sub.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.shift_val_sub
AdalyFormal.DLayer.shift_val_sub.header: theorem shift_val_sub {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a c : Fin N) : ((a + 1) - c).val = ((a - c).val + 1) % N

AdalyFormal.DLayer.shift_apply.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.shift_apply
AdalyFormal.DLayer.shift_apply.header:
theorem shift_apply (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν0 ν : Fin 3) :
    (periodicLatticeShift y ν0) ν = if ν = ν0 then y ν + 1 else y ν

AdalyFormal.DLayer.gmaj.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.gmaj
AdalyFormal.DLayer.gmaj.header: noncomputable def gmaj (n : ℕ) (μ ν0 : Fin 3) (Fg Dg Fh Dh : ℝ) (N : Fin 3 → ℕ) (ν : Fin 3) (t : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbK_shift_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbK_shift_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbK_shift_le.header:
theorem gbK_shift_le {n : ℕ} {g h : ℕ → ℝ} {Fg Dg Fh Dh : ℝ} (hg : SProf n g Fg Dg) (hh : SProf n h Fh Dh)
    (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (μ ν0 : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (c : CoarseBond L n) :
    |gbK g h n (periodicLatticeShift y ν0) μ c - gbK g h n y μ c|
      ≤ if c.2 = μ then ∏ ν : Fin 3, gmaj n μ ν0 Fg Dg Fh Dh (fun ν => L ν + 1) ν ((y ν - c.1.1 ν).val) else 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbondE_grad_sq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbondE_grad_sq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.gbondE_grad_sq.header:
theorem gbondE_grad_sq {n : ℕ} {g h : ℕ → ℝ} {Fg Dg Fh Dh : ℝ} (hg : SProf n g Fg Dg) (hh : SProf n h Fh Dh)
    (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (ν0 : Fin 3) (G : ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 8 * (if ν0 = μ then Dg else Dh) ^ 2 * (n + 1)
        * ∏ ν ∈ ({ν0}ᶜ : Finset (Fin 3)), (if ν = μ then Fg else Fh) ^ 2 ≤ G * n)
    (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ‖gbondE g h n W (periodicLatticeShift b.1 ν0, b.2) - gbondE g h n W b‖ ^ 2
      ≤ G * n * ∑ c : CoarseBond L n, ‖W c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sbondE_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sbondE_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sbondE_norm_sq.header:
theorem sbondE_norm_sq (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ‖sbondE n W b‖ ^ 2 ≤ (9 * (3 / 2) ^ 2) ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 3 * ∑ c : CoarseBond L n, ‖W c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sbondE_grad_sq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sbondE_grad_sq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sbondE_grad_sq.header:
theorem sbondE_grad_sq (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (ν0 : Fin 3) (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ‖sbondE n W (periodicLatticeShift b.1 ν0, b.2) - sbondE n W b‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 419904 * n * ∑ c : CoarseBond L n, ‖W c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.gradE.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.gradE
AdalyFormal.DLayer.gradE.header: noncomputable def gradE (A : BondFnL2 L) (ν : Fin 3) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.gradE_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.gradE_nonneg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.gradE_nonneg.header: theorem gradE_nonneg (A : BondFnL2 L) (ν : Fin 3) : 0 ≤ gradE A ν

AdalyFormal.DLayer.slice_le_gradE.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.slice_le_gradE
AdalyFormal.DLayer.slice_le_gradE.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.RMap_sub_id_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.RMap_sub_id_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.RMap_sub_id_le.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.RMap_trivial.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.RMap_trivial
AdalyFormal.DLayer.RMap_trivial.header: theorem RMap_trivial (b : Bond L) (v : SuTwo) : RMap (trivialU L b) v = v

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_flat_pt.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_flat_pt
AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_flat_pt.header:
theorem curl_flat_pt (A : BondFnL2 L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_flat_le.header:
theorem curl_flat_le (A : BondFnL2 L) (Γ : ℝ) (hΓ : ∀ ν, gradE A ν ≤ Γ) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.grad_trivial_apply.header:
theorem grad_trivial_apply (f : SiteL2 L) (b : Bond L) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.div_flat_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.div_flat_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.div_flat_le.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.curl_cov_diff.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.grad_cov_diff.header:
theorem grad_cov_diff (U : Cfg L) (e : ℝ) (he : ∀ b, AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv (U b) ≤ e) (f : SiteL2 L) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.div_cov_diff.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.div_cov_diff
AdalyFormal.DLayer.div_cov_diff.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.T_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.T_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.T_le.header: theorem T_le (v : E) : ‖G.T v‖ ≤ ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint G.D v‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Z_unw.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Z_unw
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.Z_unw.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GamHyp.W_unw.header: theorem W_unw (v : E) : ‖G.W v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ + ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint G.D v‖ / Real.sqrt G.c

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.CW_unw.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.CW_unw
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.CW_unw.header: theorem CW_unw (v : E) : ‖I.C (I.Gm.W v)‖ ≤ ‖I.C v‖ + I.κ * (‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint I.D v‖ / I.c)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Ginv_upper.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Ginv_upper
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Ginv_upper.header:
theorem Ginv_upper (v : E) :

      + I.ν * (‖v‖ + ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint I.D v‖ / Real.sqrt I.c) ^ 2
      + ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint I.D v‖ ^ 2 + I.M * ‖I.Qb v‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Pfl_FS.header: theorem Pfl_FS : (Pfl ell k Lu hell).FullSupp

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EopL.header: noncomputable def EopL : FSp (GF ell k Lu) →ₗ[ℝ] BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Eop.header: noncomputable def Eop : FSp (GF ell k Lu) →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)

theorem Eop_apply (u : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) (b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Eop_rightInv.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Eop_rightInv
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Eop_rightInv.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Eop_norm_sq.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Eop_norm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Eop_norm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Eop_norm.header:
theorem Eop_norm (u : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) :

theorem Eop_grad (u : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) (ν : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.cNS.header: noncomputable def cNS (a ρ δ : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.bNS.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.bNS
AdalyFormal.DLayer.bNS.header: noncomputable def bNS (a ρ δ : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.δS_nonneg.header: theorem δS_nonneg : 0 ≤ δS ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.δS_lt.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.δS_lt
AdalyFormal.DLayer.δS_lt.header: theorem δS_lt : δS ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0) < 1

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qdrift_M0.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qdrift_M0
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qdrift_M0.header:
theorem Qdrift_M0 (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sop.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sop
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sop.header: noncomputable def Sop : FSp (GF ell k Lu) →L[ℝ] FSp (GF ell k Lu)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sop_near.header:
theorem Sop_near (u : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Sop_coer.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.instIneq_M0_D.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.instIneq_M0_D
AdalyFormal.DLayer.instIneq_M0_D.header:
theorem instIneq_M0_D (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (a t e q0 : ℝ) (R : M0RegimeR ell k Lu U a t e q0) (H : KUSmall ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0))
    (HU : UnitSmall ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0))
    (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < Lu μ + 1) (hd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (hLB : LamBlockSum ell Lam)
    (SJ CH K2n CH1 KD : ℝ) (hSJ : 0 ≤ SJ) (hCH : 0 ≤ CH) (hK2n : 0 ≤ K2n) (hCH1 : 0 ≤ CH1) (hKD : 0 ≤ KD)
    (hJs : ∀ b, ‖(PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Jf b‖ ≤ SJ)
    (hHcol : ∀ (p : BIdx (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G) (v : SuTwo),
      ∑ b, ‖(iE (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G ((PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.H
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single p v) : FSp (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G))) b‖ ≤ CH * ‖v‖)
    (hK2 : ∀ z : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      ∑ p, ‖C2fullOf (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G U z p‖ ≤ K2n * ‖z‖ ^ 2)
    (hH1col : ∀ (e' : Bond Lu) (v : SuTwo),
      ∑ b, ‖((PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).H1in (WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single e' v) : BondFnL2 Lu)) b‖ ≤ CH1 * ‖v‖)
    (hKDb : ∀ B : BondFnL2 Lu, ∑ e', ‖((PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).D2in B) e'‖ ≤ KD * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    (hε' : 2 * (CH * SJ) * K2n * (((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * KhatM0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0)) < 1) :
    InstIneq ell k hell a Lu
      (gam0M0f ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) (2 * (CH * SJ) * K2n * (((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * KhatM0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0)))
        (KD * (CH1 * SJ)) (dCM0 ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)) (cBM0 ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)))
      (fullTower ell k Lu) Lam U

AdalyFormal.DLayer.instIneq_M0_D_class.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.instIneq_M0_D_class
AdalyFormal.DLayer.instIneq_M0_D_class.header:
theorem instIneq_M0_D_class (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (a t e q0 : ℝ) (R : M0RegimeR ell k Lu U a t e q0) (H : KUSmall ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0))
    (HU : UnitSmall ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0))
    (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < Lu μ + 1) (hd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (hLB : LamBlockSum ell Lam)
    (cJ C_H K2 C_H1 KD : ℝ) (hcJ : 0 ≤ cJ) (hC_H : 0 ≤ C_H) (hK2 : 0 ≤ K2) (hC_H1 : 0 ≤ C_H1) (hKD : 0 ≤ KD)
    (hJs : ∀ b, ‖(PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Jf b‖ ≤ cJ * rhoM0 ell k e q0 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3)
    (hHcol : ∀ (p : BIdx (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G) (v : SuTwo),
      ∑ b, ‖(iE (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G ((PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.H
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single p v) : FSp (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G))) b‖ ≤ C_H * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3 * ‖v‖)
    (hK2b : ∀ z : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      ∑ p, ‖C2fullOf (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G U z p‖ ≤ K2 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * ‖z‖ ^ 2)
    (hH1col : ∀ (e' : Bond Lu) (v : SuTwo),
      ∑ b, ‖((PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).H1in (WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single e' v) : BondFnL2 Lu)) b‖
        ≤ C_H1 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3 * ‖v‖)
    (hKDb : ∀ B : BondFnL2 Lu, ∑ e', ‖((PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).D2in B) e'‖ ≤ KD * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    (hε' : 2 * C_H * cJ * K2 * KhatM0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) * rhoM0 ell k e q0 < 1) :
    InstIneq ell k hell a Lu
      (gam0M0f ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) (2 * C_H * cJ * K2 * KhatM0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) * rhoM0 ell k e q0)
        (KD * C_H1 * cJ * rhoM0 ell k e q0) (dCM0 ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)) (cBM0 ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)))
      (fullTower ell k Lu) Lam U

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sqrt_cube.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sqrt_cube
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sqrt_cube.header: theorem sqrt_cube (n : ℝ) (hn : 0 ≤ n) : Real.sqrt (n ^ 3) = n * Real.sqrt n

AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_ne_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_ne_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_ne_le.header: theorem m0_ne_le : (ell : ℝ) ^ k * e ≤ rhoM0 ell k e q0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondExtM0.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondExtM0
AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondExtM0.header:
theorem bondExtM0 (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hφ : WtLip (θ / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) φ) (hc : CondM0 ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ) (u : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) :
    ∃ g : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu), (ginvM0 ell k Lu U a t e q0 R φ θ hφ hc H).Qb g = u ∧
      ⟪g, (ginvM0 ell k Lu U a t e q0 R φ θ hφ hc H).Ginv g⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ring_inverse_eq_of.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ring_inverse_eq_of
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ring_inverse_eq_of.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.iE_pE_full.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.iE_pE_full
AdalyFormal.DLayer.iE_pE_full.header: theorem iE_pE_full (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) : iE (GF ell k Lu) (pE (GF ell k Lu) x) = x

AdalyFormal.DLayer.pE_iE_full.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.pE_iE_full
AdalyFormal.DLayer.pE_iE_full.header: theorem pE_iE_full (z : ↥(bondSupp (GF ell k Lu))) : pE (GF ell k Lu) (iE (GF ell k Lu) z) = z

AdalyFormal.DLayer.iE_pE_op.header: theorem iE_pE_op : iE (GF ell k Lu) ∘L pE (GF ell k Lu) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _

AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataGinv_eq.header:
theorem dataGinv_eq :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataQs_eq.header:
theorem dataQs_eq : (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Qs

AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataQ_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataQ_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataQ_eq.header: theorem dataQ_eq : (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Q = (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull ∘L iE (GF ell k Lu)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataG_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataG_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataG_eq.header:
theorem dataG_eq (hu : IsUnit (GinvFull ell k Lu U a)) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Nf.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Nf
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Nf.header: noncomputable def Nf : FSp (GF ell k Lu) →L[ℝ] FSp (GF ell k Lu)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataN_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataN_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataN_eq.header:
theorem dataN_eq (hu : IsUnit (GinvFull ell k Lu U a)) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataH_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataH_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataH_eq.header:
theorem dataH_eq (hu : IsUnit (GinvFull ell k Lu U a)) (w : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) :
    iE (GF ell k Lu) ((PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.H w)
      = Ring.inverse (GinvFull ell k Lu U a)
          (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull (Ring.inverse (Nf ell k Lu U a) w))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Ginv_sym'.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Ginv_sym'
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.Ginv_sym'.header: theorem Ginv_sym' (x y : E) : ⟪I.Ginv x, y⟫ = ⟪x, I.Ginv y⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.N_lower_of.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.N_lower_of
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GinvHyp.N_lower_of.header:
theorem N_lower_of (Gi : E →L[ℝ] E) (hGi1 : ∀ x, I.Ginv (Gi x) = x) (cg : ℝ) (hcg : 0 < cg)
    (hcoerG : ∀ f, cg * ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪f, I.Ginv f⟫) (bN : ℝ) (hbN : 0 < bN)
    (extN : ∀ u : B, ∃ g : E, I.Qb g = u ∧ ⟪g, I.Ginv g⟫ ≤ bN * ‖u‖ ^ 2) (u : B) :
    ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ bN * ⟪u, (I.Qb ∘L Gi ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint I.Qb) u⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.qBS.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.qBS
AdalyFormal.DLayer.qBS.header: noncomputable def qBS (ell : ℕ) (a ρ : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.bNS_pos.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.bNS_pos
AdalyFormal.DLayer.bNS_pos.header: theorem bNS_pos (a ρ δ : ℝ) (hν : 0 ≤ νS ρ) : 0 < bNS a ρ δ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.CondM0.modelN.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.CondM0.modelN
AdalyFormal.DLayer.CondM0.modelN.header:
noncomputable def CondM0.modelN {ell : ℕ} {a ρ θ : ℝ} (hc : CondM0 ell a ρ θ) (cg qb bN : ℝ) (hcg : 0 < cg)
    (hEG : 4 * hc.ginv.EG ≤ cg) (hqb : 0 ≤ qb) (hbN : 0 < bN) : NHyp Z0 Z0 Z0 Z0 Z0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ENfree.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ENfree
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ENfree.header:
noncomputable def ENfree (ell : ℕ) (a t ρ θ : ℝ) (hc : CondM0 ell a ρ θ) (hK : 0 < KhatM0 ell a t ρ)
    (hEG : 4 * EGM0 ell a ρ θ hc ≤ 1 / KhatM0 ell a t ρ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_qbM_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_qbM_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_qbM_le.header: theorem m0_qbM_le : Real.sqrt (a * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3) * qbM ell k (epsCl ell e q0) ≤ qBS ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hQbN.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hQbN
AdalyFormal.DLayer.m0_hQbN.header: theorem m0_hQbN : ‖(ginvM0 ell k Lu U a t e q0 R φ θ hφ hc H).Qb‖ ≤ qBS ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GiM0.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GiM0
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GiM0.header: noncomputable def GiM0 : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu) →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GiM0_1.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GiM0_1
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GiM0_1.header:
theorem GiM0_1 (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    (ginvM0 ell k Lu U a t e q0 R φ θ hφ hc H).Ginv (GiM0 ell k Lu U a x) = x

AdalyFormal.DLayer.GiM0_2.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.GiM0_2
AdalyFormal.DLayer.GiM0_2.header:
theorem GiM0_2 (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    GiM0 ell k Lu U a ((ginvM0 ell k Lu U a t e q0 R φ θ hφ hc H).Ginv x) = x

AdalyFormal.DLayer.coerM0.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.coerM0
AdalyFormal.DLayer.coerM0.header:
theorem coerM0 (f : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    (1 / KhatM0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0)) * ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪f, (ginvM0 ell k Lu U a t e q0 R φ θ hφ hc H).Ginv f⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NopM0.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NopM0
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NopM0.header: noncomputable def NopM0 : FSp (GF ell k Lu) →L[ℝ] FSp (GF ell k Lu)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NopM0_coer.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NopM0_coer
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NopM0_coer.header:
theorem NopM0_coer (u : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) :
    (1 / bNS a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) (δS ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0))) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪u, NopM0 ell k Lu U a t e q0 R H φ θ hφ hc u⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.nM0.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.nM0
AdalyFormal.DLayer.nM0.header:
noncomputable def nM0 (hEG : 4 * EGM0 ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc ≤ 1 / KhatM0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0)) :
    NHyp (SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (coarseC (GF ell k Lu))
      (PlaqFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (FSp (GF ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.nM0_EN.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.nM0_EN
AdalyFormal.DLayer.nM0_EN.header:
theorem nM0_EN (hEG : 4 * EGM0 ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc ≤ 1 / KhatM0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0)) :
    (nM0 ell k Lu U a t e q0 R H φ θ hφ hc hEG).EN
      = ENfree ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc (KhatM0_pos ell k Lu U a t e q0 R) hEG

AdalyFormal.DLayer.H_CT_M0.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.H_CT_M0
AdalyFormal.DLayer.H_CT_M0.header:
theorem H_CT_M0 (hEG : 4 * EGM0 ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc ≤ 1 / KhatM0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0))
    (hN : ENfree ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc (KhatM0_pos ell k Lu U a t e q0 R) hEG < 1 / bNS a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) (δS ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)))
    (w : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) :
    ‖cjp (fspWP ell k Lu φ) (bondWP φ) (nM0 ell k Lu U a t e q0 R H φ θ hφ hc hEG).H w‖
      ≤ (2 * KhatM0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0)) * (qBS ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) + δBS ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ)
        / (1 / bNS a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) (δS ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)) - ENfree ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc (KhatM0_pos ell k Lu U a t e q0 R) hEG)
        * ‖w‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.cycd_step.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.cycd_step
AdalyFormal.DLayer.cycd_step.header: theorem cycd_step {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (d : Fin N) : |((cycd (d + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((cycd d : ℕ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.DLayer.phiP.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.phiP
AdalyFormal.DLayer.phiP.header: noncomputable def phiP (θ' : ℝ) (z x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.phiP_self.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.phiP_self
AdalyFormal.DLayer.phiP_self.header: theorem phiP_self (θ' : ℝ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : phiP θ' z z = 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.phiP_lip.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.phiP_lip
AdalyFormal.DLayer.phiP_lip.header: theorem phiP_lip (θ' : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ') (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : WtLip θ' (phiP θ' z)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.phiP_sum.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.phiP_sum
AdalyFormal.DLayer.phiP_sum.header:
theorem phiP_sum (θ' : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ') (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, Real.exp (-(2 * phiP θ' z x)) ≤ (2 / (1 - Real.exp (-(2 * θ')))) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.DLayer.geom_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.geom_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.geom_le.header:
theorem geom_le (n θ : ℝ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    2 / (1 - Real.exp (-(2 * (θ / n)))) ≤ n * (1 / θ + 2)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NopM0_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NopM0_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NopM0_eq.header:
theorem NopM0_eq (u : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) :
    NopM0 ell k Lu U a t e q0 R H φ θ hφ hc u
      = (Real.sqrt (a * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3) ^ 2 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2) • Nf ell k Lu U a u

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Nf_coer.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Nf_coer
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Nf_coer.header:
theorem Nf_coer (u : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) :
    ((((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (a * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3) ^ 2) * (1 / bNS a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) (δS ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0))))
      * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪u, Nf ell k Lu U a u⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Nf_isUnit.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Nf_isUnit
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Nf_isUnit.header: theorem Nf_isUnit : IsUnit (Nf ell k Lu U a)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataH_scaled.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataH_scaled
AdalyFormal.DLayer.dataH_scaled.header:
theorem dataH_scaled (hEG : 4 * EGM0 ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc ≤ 1 / KhatM0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0))
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (w : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) :
    iE (GF ell k Lu) ((PU ell k Lu (by have := R.hell; omega) U a Lam).data.H w)
      = Real.sqrt (a * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3) • (nM0 ell k Lu U a t e q0 R H φ θ hφ hc hEG).H w

AdalyFormal.DLayer.CHfree.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.CHfree
AdalyFormal.DLayer.CHfree.header:
noncomputable def CHfree (ell : ℕ) (a t ρ θ : ℝ) (hc : CondM0 ell a ρ θ) (hK : 0 < KhatM0 ell a t ρ)
    (hEG : 4 * EGM0 ell a ρ θ hc ≤ 1 / KhatM0 ell a t ρ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.hHcol_M0.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.hHcol_M0
AdalyFormal.DLayer.hHcol_M0.header:
theorem hHcol_M0 (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hc : CondM0 ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ)
    (hEG : 4 * EGM0 ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc ≤ 1 / KhatM0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0))
    (hN : ENfree ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc (KhatM0_pos ell k Lu U a t e q0 R) hEG
      < 1 / bNS a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) (δS ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)))
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu)) (v : SuTwo) :
    ∑ b, ‖(iE (GF ell k Lu) ((PU ell k Lu (by have := R.hell; omega) U a Lam).data.H
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single p v) : FSp (GF ell k Lu)))) b‖
      ≤ CHfree ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc (KhatM0_pos ell k Lu U a t e q0 R) hEG * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3 * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_mul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_mul
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_mul.header: theorem fN_mul (A B : Mt) : frobNorm (A * B) ≤ frobNorm A * frobNorm B

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_add.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_add
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_add.header: theorem fN_add (A B : Mt) : frobNorm (A + B) ≤ frobNorm A + frobNorm B

AdalyFormal.DLayer.frobSq_csmul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.frobSq_csmul
AdalyFormal.DLayer.frobSq_csmul.header: theorem frobSq_csmul (z : ℂ) (A : Mt) : frobSq (z • A) = Complex.normSq z * frobSq A

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_csmul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_csmul
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_csmul.header: theorem fN_csmul (z : ℂ) (A : Mt) : frobNorm (z • A) = ‖z‖ * frobNorm A

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_rsmul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_rsmul
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_rsmul.header: theorem fN_rsmul (r : ℝ) (A : Mt) : frobNorm (r • A) = |r| * frobNorm A

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_neg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_neg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_neg.header: theorem fN_neg (A : Mt) : frobNorm (-A) = frobNorm A

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_sub.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_sub
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_sub.header: theorem fN_sub (A B : Mt) : frobNorm (A - B) ≤ frobNorm A + frobNorm B

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_conjT.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_conjT
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_conjT.header: theorem fN_conjT (A : Mt) : frobNorm Aᴴ = frobNorm A

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_mul_unitary.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_mul_unitary
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_mul_unitary.header: theorem fN_mul_unitary (M W : Mt) (hW : W * Wᴴ = 1) : frobNorm (M * W) = frobNorm M

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_trace.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_trace
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_trace.header: theorem fN_trace (A : Mt) : ‖Matrix.trace A‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm A

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_piProj.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_piProj
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_piProj.header: theorem fN_piProj (A : Mt) : frobNorm (AdalyFormal.Balaban.SourceJ.piProj A) ≤ 2 * frobNorm A

AdalyFormal.DLayer.AHT.neg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.AHT.neg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.AHT.neg.header: theorem AHT.neg {H : Mt} (h : AHT H) : AHT (-H)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_eq_r.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_eq_r
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_eq_r.header: theorem fN_eq_r (H : Mt) : frobNorm H = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt (frobSq H / 2)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_form.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_form
AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_form.header:
theorem exp_form (H : Mt) (hH : AHT H) :
    NormedSpace.exp H = (Real.cos (Real.sqrt (frobSq H / 2))) • (1 : Mt)
      + (Real.sin (Real.sqrt (frobSq H / 2)) * (Real.sqrt (frobSq H / 2))⁻¹) • H

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sq_AHT.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sq_AHT
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sq_AHT.header: theorem sq_AHT (H : Mt) (hH : AHT H) : H * H = (-(frobSq H / 2) : ℝ) • (1 : Mt)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_expand.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_expand
AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_expand.header:
theorem exp_expand (H : Mt) (hH : AHT H) (h1 : frobNorm H ≤ 1) :
    frobNorm (NormedSpace.exp H - 1 - H - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (H * H)) ≤ frobNorm H ^ 3 / 4

AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_sub_one_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_sub_one_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_sub_one_le.header:
theorem exp_sub_one_le (H : Mt) (hH : AHT H) (h1 : frobNorm H ≤ 1) :
    frobNorm (NormedSpace.exp H - 1) ≤ 2 * frobNorm H

AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_conjT.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_conjT
AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_conjT.header: theorem exp_conjT (H : Mt) (hH : AHT H) : (NormedSpace.exp H)ᴴ = NormedSpace.exp (-H)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_unitary.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_unitary
AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_unitary.header: theorem exp_unitary (H : Mt) (hH : AHT H) : NormedSpace.exp H * (NormedSpace.exp H)ᴴ = 1

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Exp2.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Exp2
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Exp2.header: structure Exp2 (P S T : Mt) (c σ : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp2_mul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp2_mul
AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp2_mul.header:
theorem exp2_mul {P S T : Mt} {c σ : ℝ} (h : Exp2 P S T c σ) (H : Mt) (hH : AHT H)
    (h1 : σ + frobNorm H ≤ 1) :
    Exp2 (P * NormedSpace.exp H) (S + H) (T + S * H + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (H * H)) (c + 2) (σ + frobNorm H)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.S4.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.S4
AdalyFormal.DLayer.S4.header: noncomputable def S4 (H1 H2 H3 H4 : Mt) : Mt

AdalyFormal.DLayer.T4.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.T4
AdalyFormal.DLayer.T4.header: noncomputable def T4 (H1 H2 H3 H4 : Mt) : Mt

AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp4.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp4
AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp4.header:
theorem exp4 (H1 H2 H3 H4 : Mt) (h1 : AHT H1) (h2 : AHT H2) (h3 : AHT H3) (h4 : AHT H4)
    (hs : frobNorm H1 + frobNorm H2 + frobNorm H3 + frobNorm H4 ≤ 1) :
    Exp2 (NormedSpace.exp H1 * NormedSpace.exp H2 * NormedSpace.exp H3 * NormedSpace.exp H4)
      (S4 H1 H2 H3 H4) (T4 H1 H2 H3 H4) 8
      (frobNorm H1 + frobNorm H2 + frobNorm H3 + frobNorm H4)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Kc.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Kc
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Kc.header: noncomputable def Kc (H1 H2 H3 H4 : Mt) : Mt

AdalyFormal.DLayer.T4_skew.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.T4_skew
AdalyFormal.DLayer.T4_skew.header:
theorem T4_skew (H1 H2 H3 H4 : Mt) (h1 : AHT H1) (h2 : AHT H2) (h3 : AHT H3) (h4 : AHT H4) :
    T4 H1 H2 H3 H4 - (T4 H1 H2 H3 H4)ᴴ = Kc H1 H2 H3 H4

AdalyFormal.DLayer.trace_comm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.trace_comm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.trace_comm.header: theorem trace_comm (X Y : Mt) : Matrix.trace (X * Y - Y * X) = 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Kc_trace.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Kc_trace
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Kc_trace.header: theorem Kc_trace (H1 H2 H3 H4 : Mt) : Matrix.trace (Kc H1 H2 H3 H4) = 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_imP_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_imP_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_imP_le.header: theorem fN_imP_le (M : Mt) : frobNorm (imP M) ≤ frobNorm M

AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaq_expand.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaq_expand
AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaq_expand.header:
theorem plaq_expand (H1 H2 H3 H4 : Mt) (h1 : AHT H1) (h2 : AHT H2) (h3 : AHT H3) (h4 : AHT H4)
    (hs : frobNorm H1 + frobNorm H2 + frobNorm H3 + frobNorm H4 ≤ 1) :
    ∃ Rp : Mt, AdalyFormal.Balaban.SourceJ.piProj
        (imP (NormedSpace.exp H1 * NormedSpace.exp H2 * NormedSpace.exp H3 * NormedSpace.exp H4))
      = (1 / (2 * Complex.I) : ℂ) • ((2 : ℂ) • S4 H1 H2 H3 H4)
        + (1 / (2 * Complex.I) : ℂ) • Kc H1 H2 H3 H4 + Rp
      ∧ frobNorm Rp ≤ 16 * (frobNorm H1 + frobNorm H2 + frobNorm H3 + frobNorm H4) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.DLayer.shift_comm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.shift_comm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.shift_comm.header:
theorem shift_comm (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a b : Fin 3) :
    periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift y a) b = periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift y b) a

AdalyFormal.DLayer.imHol_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.imHol_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.imHol_eq.header:
theorem imHol_eq (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    imHolonomy U p = imP ((holonomyElem U p : SU2) : Mt)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.hol_coe.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.hol_coe
AdalyFormal.DLayer.hol_coe.header:
theorem hol_coe (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a b : Fin 3) (h : a < b) :
    ((holonomyElem U (y, ⟨(a, b), h⟩) : SU2) : Mt)
      = ((U (y, a) : SU2) : Mt) * ((U (periodicLatticeShift y a, b) : SU2) : Mt)
        * ((U (periodicLatticeShift y b, a) : SU2) : Mt)ᴴ * ((U (y, b) : SU2) : Mt)ᴴ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.HT_AHT.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.HT_AHT
AdalyFormal.DLayer.HT_AHT.header: theorem HT_AHT (η : ℝ) (A : Mt) (hA : Aᴴ = A ∧ Matrix.trace A = 0) : AHT (((η : ℂ) * Complex.I) • A)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_H.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_H
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_H.header: theorem fN_H (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η) (A : Mt) : frobNorm (((η : ℂ) * Complex.I) • A) = η * frobNorm A

AdalyFormal.DLayer.comm_diff.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.comm_diff
AdalyFormal.DLayer.comm_diff.header:
theorem comm_diff (a b a' b' : Mt) :
    frobNorm ((a' * b' - b' * a') - (a * b - b * a))
      ≤ 2 * frobNorm (a' - a) * frobNorm b' + 2 * frobNorm a * frobNorm (b' - b)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.comm_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.comm_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.comm_le.header: theorem comm_le (a b : Mt) : frobNorm (a * b - b * a) ≤ 2 * frobNorm a * frobNorm b

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Kc_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Kc_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Kc_le.header:
theorem Kc_le (a1 a2 a3 a4 : Mt) (m : ℝ) (h1 : frobNorm a1 ≤ m) (h2 : frobNorm a2 ≤ m) (h3 : frobNorm a3 ≤ m)
    (h4 : frobNorm a4 ≤ m) : frobNorm (Kc a1 a2 a3 a4) ≤ 12 * m ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Kc_diff.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Kc_diff
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Kc_diff.header:
theorem Kc_diff (a1 a2 a3 a4 b1 b2 b3 b4 : Mt) (m δ : ℝ)
    (ha1 : frobNorm a1 ≤ m) (ha2 : frobNorm a2 ≤ m) (ha3 : frobNorm a3 ≤ m) (ha4 : frobNorm a4 ≤ m)
    (hb1 : frobNorm b1 ≤ m) (hb2 : frobNorm b2 ≤ m) (hb3 : frobNorm b3 ≤ m) (hb4 : frobNorm b4 ≤ m)
    (d1 : frobNorm (a1 - b1) ≤ δ) (d2 : frobNorm (a2 - b2) ≤ δ) (d3 : frobNorm (a3 - b3) ≤ δ)
    (d4 : frobNorm (a4 - b4) ≤ δ) :
    frobNorm (Kc a1 a2 a3 a4 - Kc b1 b2 b3 b4) ≤ 24 * m * δ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Kpl.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Kpl
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Kpl.header: noncomputable def Kpl (H : Bond L → Mt) (ν μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Mt

AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.a1_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.a1_nonneg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.a1_nonneg.header: theorem LocRep.a1_nonneg (h : LocRep V η A a1 a2 InC) (e : Bond L) (he : InC e) : 0 ≤ a1

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Hof.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Hof
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Hof.header: noncomputable def Hof (η : ℝ) (A : Bond L → Mt) : Bond L → Mt

AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.H_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.H_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.H_le.header: theorem LocRep.H_le (h : LocRep V η A a1 a2 InC) (e : Bond L) (he : InC e) : frobNorm (Hof η A e) ≤ η * a1

AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.H_diff.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.H_diff
AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.H_diff.header:
theorem LocRep.H_diff (h : LocRep V η A a1 a2 InC) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (d d' : Fin 3)
    (h0 : InC (z, d)) (h1 : InC (periodicLatticeShift z d', d)) :
    frobNorm (Hof η A (z, d) - Hof η A (periodicLatticeShift z d', d)) ≤ η ^ 2 * a2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.curl_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.curl_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.curl_le.header:
theorem LocRep.curl_le (h : LocRep V η A a1 a2 InC) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3)
    (b1 : InC (y, ν)) (b2 : InC (periodicLatticeShift y ν, μ)) (b3 : InC (periodicLatticeShift y μ, ν))
    (b4 : InC (y, μ)) : frobNorm (curlA η A y ν μ) ≤ 2 * a2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.F_expand.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.F_expand
AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.F_expand.header:
theorem LocRep.F_expand (h : LocRep V η A a1 a2 InC) (ν μ : Fin 3) (hνμ : ν ≠ μ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (b1 : InC (y, ν)) (b2 : InC (periodicLatticeShift y ν, μ)) (b3 : InC (periodicLatticeShift y μ, ν))
    (b4 : InC (y, μ)) :
    ∃ R : Mt, FnuMu V ν μ y = (η ^ 2 : ℝ) • curlA η A y ν μ + Kpl (Hof η A) ν μ y + R
      ∧ frobNorm R ≤ 1024 * η ^ 3 * a1 ^ 3

AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.Kpl_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.Kpl_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.Kpl_le.header:
theorem LocRep.Kpl_le (h : LocRep V η A a1 a2 InC) (ν μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (b1 : InC (y, ν)) (b2 : InC (periodicLatticeShift y ν, μ)) (b3 : InC (periodicLatticeShift y μ, ν))
    (b4 : InC (y, μ)) : frobNorm (Kpl (Hof η A) ν μ y) ≤ 6 * (η * a1) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.transport_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.transport_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.transport_le.header:
theorem transport_le (W X : Mt) (hW1 : W * Wᴴ = 1) (hW2 : Wᴴ * W = 1) :
    frobNorm (W * X * Wᴴ - X) ≤ 2 * frobNorm (W - 1) * frobNorm X

AdalyFormal.DLayer.NeedBonds.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.NeedBonds
AdalyFormal.DLayer.NeedBonds.header: def NeedBonds (InC : Bond L → Prop) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) : Prop

AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.Dstar_err.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.Dstar_err
AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.Dstar_err.header:
theorem LocRep.Dstar_err (h : LocRep V η A a1 a2 InC) (ν μ : Fin 3) (hνμ : ν ≠ μ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hb : NeedBonds InC y ν μ) :
    frobNorm (DstarDir V ν (fun z => FnuMu V ν μ z) (periodicLatticeShift y ν)
        - (η ^ 2 : ℝ) • (curlA η A y ν μ - curlA η A (periodicLatticeShift y ν) ν μ))
      ≤ η ^ 3 * (20 * a1 * a2 + 2072 * a1 ^ 3 + 4096 * η * a1 ^ 4)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_ite_ne.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_ite_ne
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_ite_ne.header: theorem sum_ite_ne (μ : Fin 3) (c : ℝ) : ∑ ν : Fin 3, (if ν = μ then (0 : ℝ) else c) = 2 * c

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_sum3.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_sum3
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_sum3.header: theorem fN_sum3 (f : Fin 3 → Mt) : frobNorm (∑ ν : Fin 3, f ν) ≤ ∑ ν : Fin 3, frobNorm (f ν)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.J_local_bound.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.J_local_bound
AdalyFormal.DLayer.LocRep.J_local_bound.header:
theorem LocRep.J_local_bound (h : LocRep V η A a1 a2 InC) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (a3 : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ ν, ν ≠ μ → NeedBonds InC (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν) ν μ)
    (h3 : frobNorm (ddA η A x μ) ≤ a3) :
    frobNorm (Jfield V x μ) ≤ η ^ 3 * (a3 + 40 * a1 * a2 + 4144 * a1 ^ 3 + 8192 * η * a1 ^ 4)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.shiftF_apply.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.shiftF_apply
AdalyFormal.DLayer.shiftF_apply.header:
theorem shiftF_apply (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a c : Fin 3) :
    (periodicLatticeShift y a) c = if c = a then y c + 1 else y c

AdalyFormal.DLayer.shiftBack_apply.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.shiftBack_apply
AdalyFormal.DLayer.shiftBack_apply.header:
theorem shiftBack_apply (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a c : Fin 3) :
    (periodicLatticeShiftBack y a) c = if c = a then y c - 1 else y c

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Near.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Near
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Near.header: def Near (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.DLayer.cubeCorner.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.cubeCorner
AdalyFormal.DLayer.cubeCorner.header: def cubeCorner (g : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.DLayer.cubeCorner_grid.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.cubeCorner_grid
AdalyFormal.DLayer.cubeCorner_grid.header: theorem cubeCorner_grid (g : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : GridCorner g (cubeCorner g x)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fin_val_add_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fin_val_add_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fin_val_add_le.header: theorem fin_val_add_le {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a b : Fin N) : (a + b).val ≤ a.val + b.val

AdalyFormal.DLayer.near_mem_box.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.near_mem_box
AdalyFormal.DLayer.near_mem_box.header:
theorem near_mem_box (g s : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (hs : g + 2 < s) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : Near x y) :
    y ∈ siteBox (cubeCorner g x) s

AdalyFormal.DLayer.towerBj_full_k.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.towerBj_full_k
AdalyFormal.DLayer.towerBj_full_k.header:
theorem towerBj_full_k (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    towerBj (fullTower ell k Lu) k = Set.univ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.towerBj_full_lt.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.towerBj_full_lt
AdalyFormal.DLayer.towerBj_full_lt.header:
theorem towerBj_full_lt (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < k) :
    towerBj (fullTower ell k Lu) i = ∅

AdalyFormal.DLayer.near_self.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.near_self
AdalyFormal.DLayer.near_self.header: theorem near_self (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Near x x

AdalyFormal.DLayer.classCube_full.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.classCube_full
AdalyFormal.DLayer.classCube_full.header:
theorem classCube_full (ell M f k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hg : 0 < bigSide M ell k)
    (hs : bigSide M ell k + 2 < f * bigSide M ell k) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    IsClassCube ell M f k (fullTower ell k Lu) (siteBox (cubeCorner (bigSide M ell k) x) (f * bigSide M ell k)) k

AdalyFormal.DLayer.near_of.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.near_of
AdalyFormal.DLayer.near_of.header: theorem near_of (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (h : ∀ c, y c = x c - 1 ∨ y c = x c ∨ y c = x c + 1) : Near x y

AdalyFormal.DLayer.near_list.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.near_list
AdalyFormal.DLayer.near_list.header:
theorem near_list :
    Near x x ∧ Near x (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν) ∧ Near x (periodicLatticeShift x ν)
    ∧ Near x (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ∧ Near x (periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν) μ)
    ∧ Near x (periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x ν) μ)
    ∧ Near x (periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.frobNorm_cjM.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.frobNorm_cjM
AdalyFormal.DLayer.frobNorm_cjM.header: theorem frobNorm_cjM (g : SU2) (X : Mt) : frobNorm (AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.cjM g X) = frobNorm X

AdalyFormal.DLayer.J_class_frob.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.J_class_frob
AdalyFormal.DLayer.J_class_frob.header:
theorem J_class_frob (ell M f k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (α₀ : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hf : 4 ≤ f)
    (hP : PerCubeRegular2 ell M f k (fullTower ell k Lu) α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U)
    (hsm : 4 * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀) ≤ 1) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (μ : Fin 3) :
    frobNorm (Jfield U x μ)
      ≤ (((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹) ^ 3 * ((f * M * α₀) + 40 * (f * M * α₀) ^ 2 + 4144 * (f * M * α₀) ^ 3
          + 8192 * (f * M * α₀) ^ 4)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteWt.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteWt
AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteWt.header: noncomputable def siteWt (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) : SiteL2 L →L[ℝ] SiteL2 L

AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondWt.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondWt
AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondWt.header: noncomputable def bondWt (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteWt_apply.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteWt_apply
AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteWt_apply.header:
theorem siteWt_apply (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (siteWt φ f) x = Real.exp (φ x) • f x

AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondWt_apply.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondWt_apply
AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondWt_apply.header:
theorem bondWt_apply (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : BondFnL2 L) (b : Bond L) :
    (bondWt φ f) b = Real.exp (φ b.1) • f b

AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteWt_neg_cancel.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteWt_neg_cancel
AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteWt_neg_cancel.header: theorem siteWt_neg_cancel (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) : siteWt φ (siteWt (-φ) f) = f

AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteWt_cancel_neg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteWt_cancel_neg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteWt_cancel_neg.header: theorem siteWt_cancel_neg (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) : siteWt (-φ) (siteWt φ f) = f

AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondWt_neg_cancel.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondWt_neg_cancel
AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondWt_neg_cancel.header: theorem bondWt_neg_cancel (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : BondFnL2 L) : bondWt φ (bondWt (-φ) f) = f

AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondWt_cancel_neg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondWt_cancel_neg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondWt_cancel_neg.header: theorem bondWt_cancel_neg (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : BondFnL2 L) : bondWt (-φ) (bondWt φ f) = f

AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteWt_symm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteWt_symm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteWt_symm.header: theorem siteWt_symm (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f g : SiteL2 L) : ⟪siteWt φ f, g⟫ = ⟪f, siteWt φ g⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondWt_symm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondWt_symm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.bondWt_symm.header: theorem bondWt_symm (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f g : BondFnL2 L) : ⟪bondWt φ f, g⟫ = ⟪f, bondWt φ g⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.WtLip.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.WtLip
AdalyFormal.DLayer.WtLip.header: def WtLip (θ' : ℝ) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.DLayer.abs_exp_sub_one_le_of.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.abs_exp_sub_one_le_of
AdalyFormal.DLayer.abs_exp_sub_one_le_of.header: theorem abs_exp_sub_one_le_of (t δ : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ δ) : |Real.exp t - 1| ≤ Real.exp δ - 1

AdalyFormal.DLayer.grad_conj_sub.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.grad_conj_sub
AdalyFormal.DLayer.grad_conj_sub.header:
theorem grad_conj_sub (U : Cfg L) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) (b : Bond L) :
    (bondWt φ (gradL2 U (siteWt (-φ) f)) - gradL2 U f) b
      = (Real.exp (φ b.1 - φ (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)) - 1) • RMap (U b) (f (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_shift_sq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_shift_sq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_shift_sq.header:
theorem sum_shift_sq (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ‖f (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)‖ ^ 2 = 3 * ‖f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.grad_conj_err.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.grad_conj_err
AdalyFormal.DLayer.grad_conj_err.header:
theorem grad_conj_err (U : Cfg L) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖bondWt φ (gradL2 U (siteWt (-φ) f)) - gradL2 U f‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp θ' - 1) * ‖f‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.lap_conj_pair.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.lap_conj_pair
AdalyFormal.DLayer.lap_conj_pair.header:
theorem lap_conj_pair (U : Cfg L) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ⟪f, siteWt φ (lapFull U (siteWt (-φ) f))⟫
      = ⟪bondWt (-φ) (gradL2 U (siteWt φ f)), bondWt φ (gradL2 U (siteWt (-φ) f))⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqIn_full.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqIn_full
AdalyFormal.DLayer.plaqIn_full.header:
theorem plaqIn_full (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    plaqIn (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)).Om0 = Set.univ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Jf_norm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Jf_norm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Jf_norm.header:
theorem Jf_norm (P : IngrBParams) (b : Bond (scaleUp P.ell P.k P.Lu)) :
    ‖P.Jf b‖ = frobNorm (AdalyFormal.IngredientFamily.JfieldLoc (plaqIn P.G.Om0) P.U b.1 b.2) / Real.sqrt 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.hJs_class.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.hJs_class
AdalyFormal.DLayer.hJs_class.header:
theorem hJs_class (ell M f k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hf : 4 ≤ f)
    (hP : PerCubeRegular2 ell M f k (fullTower ell k Lu) α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U)
    (hsm : 4 * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀) ≤ 1) (b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ‖(PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Jf b‖ ≤ JSfree ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀) / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn.header: noncomputable def Dn (A B : Mt) (n : ℕ) : Mt

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn_zero.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn_zero
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn_zero.header: theorem Dn_zero (A B : Mt) : Dn A B 0 = 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn_succ.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn_succ
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn_succ.header: theorem Dn_succ (A B : Mt) (n : ℕ) : Dn A B (n + 1) = A ^ n * B + Dn A B n * A

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn_add.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn_add
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn_add.header: theorem Dn_add (A B C : Mt) (n : ℕ) : Dn A (B + C) n = Dn A B n + Dn A C n

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn_smul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn_smul
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn_smul.header: theorem Dn_smul (A B : Mt) (c : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : Dn A (c • B) n = c • Dn A B n

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.hpow_mul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.hpow_mul
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.hpow_mul.header: theorem hpow_mul (a : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : (m : ℝ) * a ^ (m - 1) * a = m * a ^ m

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.norm_Dn_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.norm_Dn_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.norm_Dn_le.header: theorem norm_Dn_le (A B : Mt) (n : ℕ) : ‖Dn A B n‖ ≤ n * ‖A‖ ^ (n - 1) * ‖B‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.norm_Rn_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.norm_Rn_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.norm_Rn_le.header:
theorem norm_Rn_le (A B : Mt) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖(A + B) ^ n - A ^ n - Dn A B n‖ ≤ (‖A‖ + ‖B‖) ^ n - ‖A‖ ^ n - n * ‖A‖ ^ (n - 1) * ‖B‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.summable_shift.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.summable_shift_exp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.summable_shift.header: theorem summable_shift_exp (a : ℝ) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * a ^ (n - 1) / n.factorial)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.summable_Dn.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.summable_Dn
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.summable_Dn.header: theorem summable_Dn (A B : Mt) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((n.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹) • Dn A B n)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL.header: noncomputable def expL (A B : Mt) : Mt

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL_add.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL_add
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL_add.header: theorem expL_add (A B C : Mt) : expL A (B + C) = expL A B + expL A C

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL_smul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL_smul
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL_smul.header: theorem expL_smul (A B : Mt) (c : ℝ) : expL A (c • B) = c • expL A B

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.real_exp_hasSu.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.real_exp_hasSum
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.real_exp_hasSu.header: theorem real_exp_hasSum (x : ℝ) : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => x ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) (Real.exp x)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.shift_exp_hasS.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.shift_exp_hasSum
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.shift_exp_hasS.header: theorem shift_exp_hasSum (a : ℝ) : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * a ^ (n - 1) / n.factorial) (Real.exp a)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.mat_exp_hasSum.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.mat_exp_hasSum
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.mat_exp_hasSum.header:
theorem mat_exp_hasSum (X : Mt) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => ((n.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹) • X ^ n) (NormedSpace.exp X)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.exp_second_ord.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.exp_second_order
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.exp_second_ord.header:
theorem exp_second_order (A B : Mt) (hB : ‖B‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖NormedSpace.exp (A + B) - NormedSpace.exp A - expL A B‖ ≤ ‖B‖ ^ 2 * Real.exp ‖A‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL_le.header: theorem expL_le (A B : Mt) : ‖expL A B‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖A‖ * ‖B‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn_one.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn_one
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.Dn_one.header: theorem Dn_one (A B : Mt) : Dn A B 1 = B

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL_sub_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL_sub_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL_sub_le.header: theorem expL_sub_le (A B : Mt) : ‖expL A B - B‖ ≤ (Real.exp ‖A‖ - 1) * ‖B‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL_zero_base.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL_zero_base
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ExpC11.expL_zero_base.header: theorem expL_zero_base (B : Mt) : expL 0 B = B

AdalyFormal.DLayer.row_le_linfty.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.row_le_linfty
AdalyFormal.DLayer.row_le_linfty.header: theorem row_le_linfty (X : Mt) (i : Fin 2) : ‖X i 0‖ + ‖X i 1‖ ≤ ‖X‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.linfty_le_of_rows.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.linfty_le_of_rows
AdalyFormal.DLayer.linfty_le_of_rows.header: theorem linfty_le_of_rows (X : Mt) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (h : ∀ i, ‖X i 0‖ + ‖X i 1‖ ≤ c) : ‖X‖ ≤ c

AdalyFormal.DLayer.linfty_le_frob.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.linfty_le_frob
AdalyFormal.DLayer.linfty_le_frob.header: theorem linfty_le_frob (X : Mt) : ‖X‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm X

AdalyFormal.DLayer.frob_le_linfty.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.frob_le_linfty
AdalyFormal.DLayer.frob_le_linfty.header: theorem frob_le_linfty (X : Mt) : frobNorm X ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * ‖X‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_second_order_F.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_second_order_F
AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_second_order_F.header:
theorem exp_second_order_F (A B : Mt) (hB : frobNorm B ≤ 1 / 2) :
    frobNorm (NormedSpace.exp (A + B) - NormedSpace.exp A - expL A B)
      ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm B ^ 2 * Real.exp (Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm A)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.expL_sub_le_F.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.expL_sub_le_F
AdalyFormal.DLayer.expL_sub_le_F.header:
theorem expL_sub_le_F (A B : Mt) :
    frobNorm (expL A B - B) ≤ 2 * (Real.exp (Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm A) - 1) * frobNorm B

AdalyFormal.DLayer.expL_le_F.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.expL_le_F
AdalyFormal.DLayer.expL_le_F.header: theorem expL_le_F (A B : Mt) : frobNorm (expL A B) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm A) * frobNorm B

AdalyFormal.DLayer.expL_sub.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.expL_sub
AdalyFormal.DLayer.expL_sub.header: theorem expL_sub (A B C : Mt) : expL A (B - C) = expL A B - expL A C

AdalyFormal.DLayer.even_exp.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.even_exp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.even_exp.header:
theorem even_exp (X Y X0 : Mt) (hX : frobNorm (X - X0) ≤ 1 / 2) (hY : frobNorm (Y - X0) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    frobNorm (NormedSpace.exp X + NormedSpace.exp Y - 2 • NormedSpace.exp X0)
      ≤ 2 * Real.exp (Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm X0) * frobNorm (X + Y - 2 • X0)
        + 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm X0) * (frobNorm (X - X0) ^ 2 + frobNorm (Y - X0) ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.even_exp_inv.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.even_exp_inv
AdalyFormal.DLayer.even_exp_inv.header:
theorem even_exp_inv (X Y X0 : Mt) (hX : frobNorm (X - X0) ≤ 1 / 2) (hY : frobNorm (Y - X0) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hE : 2 * (Real.exp (Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm X0) - 1) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    frobNorm (X + Y - 2 • X0)
      ≤ 2 * (frobNorm (NormedSpace.exp X + NormedSpace.exp Y - 2 • NormedSpace.exp X0)
        + 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm X0) * (frobNorm (X - X0) ^ 2 + frobNorm (Y - X0) ^ 2))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.lip_exp.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.lip_exp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.lip_exp.header:
theorem lip_exp (X X0 : Mt) (hX : frobNorm (X - X0) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    frobNorm (NormedSpace.exp X - NormedSpace.exp X0)
      ≤ 2 * Real.exp (Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm X0) * frobNorm (X - X0)
        + 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * Real.exp (Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm X0) * frobNorm (X - X0) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvenLimit.c2_facts.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvenLimit.c2_facts
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvenLimit.c2_facts.header:
theorem c2_facts (f : E → F) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f 0) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ y : E, ‖y‖ < δ → DifferentiableAt ℝ f y ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ f y - fderiv ℝ f 0 - fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) 0 y‖ ≤ ε * ‖y‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvenLimit.second_deri.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvenLimit.second_deriv_le_of_even
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvenLimit.second_deri.header:
theorem second_deriv_le_of_even (f : E → F) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f 0) (π : F →L[ℝ] G) (b : E) (M t0 : ℝ)
    (ht0 : 0 < t0)
    (h : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ t0 → ‖π (f (t • b) + f (-(t • b)) - (2 : ℝ) • f 0)‖ ≤ M * t ^ 2) :
    ‖π (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) 0 b b)‖ ≤ M

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_unitary_mul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_unitary_mul
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_unitary_mul.header: theorem fN_unitary_mul (W M : Mt) (hW : Wᴴ * W = 1) : frobNorm (W * M) = frobNorm M

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_su2_mul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_su2_mul
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_su2_mul.header: theorem fN_su2_mul (g : SU2) (M : Mt) : frobNorm ((g : Mt) * M) = frobNorm M

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_mul_su2.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_mul_su2
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fN_mul_su2.header: theorem fN_mul_su2 (M : Mt) (g : SU2) : frobNorm (M * (g : Mt)) = frobNorm M

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.header: structure EvQ (P Q Z : Mt) (Ke Kd τ : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.mono.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.mono
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.mono.header:
theorem EvQ.mono {P Q Z : Mt} {Ke Kd Ke' Kd' τ : ℝ} (h : EvQ P Q Z Ke Kd τ) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ)
    (he : Ke ≤ Ke') (hd : Kd ≤ Kd') : EvQ P Q Z Ke' Kd' τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.const.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.const
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.const.header: theorem EvQ.const (Z : Mt) (τ : ℝ) : EvQ Z Z Z 0 0 τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.Kd_nonneg'.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.Kd_nonneg'
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.Kd_nonneg'.header: theorem EvQ.Kd_nonneg' {P Q Z : Mt} {Ke Kd τ : ℝ} (h : EvQ P Q Z Ke Kd τ) : 0 ≤ Kd * τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.Ke_nonneg'.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.Ke_nonneg'
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.Ke_nonneg'.header: theorem EvQ.Ke_nonneg' {P Q Z : Mt} {Ke Kd τ : ℝ} (h : EvQ P Q Z Ke Kd τ) : 0 ≤ Ke * τ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.add.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.add
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.add.header:
theorem EvQ.add {P Q Z P' Q' Z' : Mt} {Ke Kd Ke' Kd' τ : ℝ} (h : EvQ P Q Z Ke Kd τ) (h' : EvQ P' Q' Z' Ke' Kd' τ) :
    EvQ (P + P') (Q + Q') (Z + Z') (Ke + Ke') (Kd + Kd') τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.smul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.smul
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.smul.header:
theorem EvQ.smul {P Q Z : Mt} {Ke Kd τ : ℝ} (h : EvQ P Q Z Ke Kd τ) (r : ℝ) :
    EvQ (r • P) (r • Q) (r • Z) (|r| * Ke) (|r| * Kd) τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.neg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.neg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.neg.header: theorem EvQ.neg {P Q Z : Mt} {Ke Kd τ : ℝ} (h : EvQ P Q Z Ke Kd τ) : EvQ (-P) (-Q) (-Z) Ke Kd τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.sum.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.sum
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.sum.header:
theorem EvQ.sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (P Q Z : ι → Mt) (Ke Kd : ι → ℝ) (τ : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, EvQ (P i) (Q i) (Z i) (Ke i) (Kd i) τ) :
    EvQ (∑ i ∈ s, P i) (∑ i ∈ s, Q i) (∑ i ∈ s, Z i) (∑ i ∈ s, Ke i) (∑ i ∈ s, Kd i) τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.avg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.avg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.avg.header:
theorem EvQ.avg {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hws : w * s.card ≤ 1)
    (P Q Z : ι → Mt) (Ke Kd τ : ℝ) (hKe : 0 ≤ Ke) (hKd : 0 ≤ Kd)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, EvQ (P i) (Q i) (Z i) Ke Kd τ) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
    EvQ (∑ i ∈ s, w • P i) (∑ i ∈ s, w • Q i) (∑ i ∈ s, w • Z i) Ke Kd τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.mul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.mul

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.inv.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.inv
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.inv.header:
theorem EvQ.inv {p q z : SU2} {Ke Kd τ : ℝ} (h : EvQ (p : Mt) (q : Mt) (z : Mt) Ke Kd τ) :
    EvQ ((p⁻¹ : SU2) : Mt) ((q⁻¹ : SU2) : Mt) ((z⁻¹ : SU2) : Mt) Ke Kd τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.const1.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.const1
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.const1.header: theorem EvQ.const1 (z : SU2) (τ : ℝ) : EvQ (z : Mt) (z : Mt) (z : Mt) 0 0 τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.exp.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.exp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.exp.header:
theorem EvQ.exp {X Y X0 : Mt} {Ke Kd τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (h : EvQ X Y X0 Ke Kd τ) (hd : Kd * τ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hE : Real.exp (Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm X0) ≤ 2) :
    EvQ (NormedSpace.exp X) (NormedSpace.exp Y) (NormedSpace.exp X0) (4 * Ke + 12 * Kd ^ 2) (7 * Kd) τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_su2Log_coe.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_su2Log_coe
AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_su2Log_coe.header: theorem exp_su2Log_coe (g : SU2) (hne : g ≠ su2NegOne) : NormedSpace.exp (su2Log g) = (g : Mt)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.log.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.log
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.log.header:
theorem EvQ.log {g g' g0 : SU2} {Ke Kd τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (h : EvQ (g : Mt) (g' : Mt) (g0 : Mt) Ke Kd τ)
    (hd : Kd * τ ≤ 1 / 4) (hg0 : frobNorm ((g0 : Mt) - 1) ≤ 1)
    (hE : 2 * (Real.exp (Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm (su2Log g0)) - 1) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    EvQ (su2Log g) (su2Log g') (su2Log g0) (2 * Ke + 60 * Kd ^ 2) (2 * Kd) τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.base.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.base
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.base.header:
theorem EvQ.base (H : Mt) (τ : ℝ) (hH : frobNorm H ≤ τ) (hτ : τ ≤ 1 / 2) :
    EvQ (NormedSpace.exp H) (NormedSpace.exp (-H)) 1 6 4 τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.hol.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.hol
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvQ.hol.header:
theorem EvQ.hol (s : ℕ) (Vp Vm Vz : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ke kd τ : ℝ) (hke : 0 ≤ ke) (hkd : 0 ≤ kd)
    (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (hV : ∀ e, EvQ ((Vp e : SU2) : Mt) ((Vm e : SU2) : Mt) ((Vz e : SU2) : Mt) ke kd τ) :
    ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
      EvQ ((coarsePathHolonomy s Vp y p : SU2) : Mt) ((coarsePathHolonomy s Vm y p : SU2) : Mt)
        ((coarsePathHolonomy s Vz y p : SU2) : Mt)
        (ke * p.length + 2 * kd ^ 2 * (p.length : ℝ) ^ 2) (kd * p.length) τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.LinkEv.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.LinkEv
AdalyFormal.DLayer.LinkEv.header: def LinkEv (V1p V1m : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (τ : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.DLayer.linkEv_prod.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.linkEv_prod
AdalyFormal.DLayer.linkEv_prod.header:
theorem linkEv_prod {V1p V1m : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (h : LinkEv V1p V1m τ)
    (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    EvQ ((V1p e * V0 e : SU2) : Mt) ((V1m e * V0 e : SU2) : Mt) (((fun _ => (1 : SU2)) e * V0 e : SU2) : Mt) 6 4 τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_hol.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_hol
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_hol.header:
theorem ev_hol (s : ℕ) {V1p V1m : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (h : LinkEv V1p V1m τ)
    (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (N : ℝ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3))
    (hp : (p.length : ℝ) ≤ N) :
    EvQ ((coarsePathHolonomy s (fun b => V1p b * V0 b) y p : SU2) : Mt)
      ((coarsePathHolonomy s (fun b => V1m b * V0 b) y p : SU2) : Mt)
      ((coarsePathHolonomy s (fun b => (fun _ => (1 : SU2)) b * V0 b) y p : SU2) : Mt) (38 * N ^ 2) (4 * N) τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_rProd.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_rProd
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_rProd.header:
theorem ev_rProd (s : ℕ) {V1p V1m : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (h : LinkEv V1p V1m τ)
    (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (N : ℝ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3))
    (hp : (p.length : ℝ) ≤ N) :
    EvQ ((rProd s V0 V1p y p : SU2) : Mt) ((rProd s V0 V1m y p : SU2) : Mt)
      ((rProd s V0 (fun _ => (1 : SU2)) y p : SU2) : Mt) (38 * N ^ 2) (4 * N) τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_log_rProd.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_log_rProd
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_log_rProd.header:
theorem ev_log_rProd (s : ℕ) {V1p V1m : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (h : LinkEv V1p V1m τ)
    (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (N : ℝ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hsm : 4 * N * τ ≤ 1 / 4)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3)) (hp : (p.length : ℝ) ≤ N) :
    EvQ (su2Log (rProd s V0 V1p y p)) (su2Log (rProd s V0 V1m y p))
      (su2Log (rProd s V0 (fun _ => (1 : SU2)) y p)) (1036 * N ^ 2) (8 * N) τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sBlock_eq_Wt.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sBlock_eq_Wt
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sBlock_eq_Wt.header:
theorem sBlock_eq_Wt (s ell : ℕ) (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    sBlock s ell V0 V1 y
      = ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, Wt ell • su2Log (rProd s V0 V1 y (coarseGammaPath s y x))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Wt_card.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Wt_card
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Wt_card.header:
theorem Wt_card (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Wt ell * ((stepBlockOf y s ell).card : ℝ) ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_sBlock.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_sBlock
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_sBlock.header:
theorem ev_sBlock (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) {V1p V1m : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {τ : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (h : LinkEv V1p V1m τ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (N : ℝ)
    (hN : 3 * (ell : ℝ) ≤ N) (hsm : 4 * N * τ ≤ 1 / 4) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    EvQ (sBlock s ell V0 V1p y) (sBlock s ell V0 V1m y) (sBlock s ell V0 (fun _ => (1 : SU2)) y)
      (1036 * N ^ 2) (8 * N) τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sBlock_one.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sBlock_one
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sBlock_one.header:
theorem sBlock_one (s ell : ℕ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    sBlock s ell V0 (fun _ => (1 : SU2)) y = 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sBlock_mem.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sBlock_mem
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sBlock_mem.header:
theorem sBlock_mem (s ell : ℕ) (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    sBlock s ell V0 V1 y ∈ AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantOperators.suTwo

AdalyFormal.DLayer.su2Exp_coe.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.su2Exp_coe
AdalyFormal.DLayer.su2Exp_coe.header:
theorem su2Exp_coe {X : Mt} (hX : X ∈ AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantOperators.suTwo) :
    ((su2Exp X : SU2) : Mt) = NormedSpace.exp X

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_exp_sBlock.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_exp_sBlock
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_exp_sBlock.header:
theorem ev_exp_sBlock (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) {V1p V1m : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {τ : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (h : LinkEv V1p V1m τ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (N : ℝ)
    (hN : 3 * (ell : ℝ) ≤ N) (hsm : 4 * N * τ ≤ 1 / 4) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : |σ| = 1) :
    EvQ ((su2Exp (σ • sBlock s ell V0 V1p y) : SU2) : Mt) ((su2Exp (σ • sBlock s ell V0 V1m y) : SU2) : Mt)
      ((su2Exp (σ • sBlock s ell V0 (fun _ => (1 : SU2)) y) : SU2) : Mt) (4912 * N ^ 2) (56 * N) τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.one_mul_cfg.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.one_mul_cfg
AdalyFormal.DLayer.one_mul_cfg.header: theorem one_mul_cfg (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) : (fun b => (fun _ => (1 : SU2)) b * V0 b) = V0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_le_inv_one_sub.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_le_inv_one_sub
AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_le_inv_one_sub.header: theorem exp_le_inv_one_sub (y : ℝ) (hy : y < 1) : Real.exp y ≤ 1 / (1 - y)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_small.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_small
AdalyFormal.DLayer.exp_small.header:
theorem exp_small (x : ℝ) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x ≤ 1 / 10) :
    2 * (Real.exp (Real.sqrt 2 * x) - 1) ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ Real.exp (Real.sqrt 2 * x) ≤ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.log_small_of.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.log_small_of
AdalyFormal.DLayer.log_small_of.header: theorem log_small_of (g : SU2) (hg : frobNorm ((g : Mt) - 1) ≤ 1 / 16) : frobNorm (su2Log g) ≤ 1 / 10

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_loopVar.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_loopVar
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_loopVar.header:
theorem ev_loopVar (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) {V1p V1m : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {τ : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (h : LinkEv V1p V1m τ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (N : ℝ)
    (hN : 3 * (ell : ℝ) ≤ N) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell) :
    EvQ ((loopVar s ell (fun b => V1p b * V0 b) c x : SU2) : Mt) ((loopVar s ell (fun b => V1m b * V0 b) c x : SU2) : Mt)
      ((loopVar s ell (fun b => (fun _ => (1 : SU2)) b * V0 b) c x : SU2) : Mt) (344 * N ^ 2) (16 * N) τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_log_loopVar.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_log_loopVar
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_log_loopVar.header:
theorem ev_log_loopVar (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) {V1p V1m : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {τ : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (h : LinkEv V1p V1m τ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (N : ℝ)
    (hN : 3 * (ell : ℝ) ≤ N) (hsm : 16 * N * τ ≤ 1 / 4) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell) (hW : frobNorm (((loopVar s ell V0 c x : SU2) : Mt) - 1) ≤ 1 / 16) :
    EvQ (su2Log (loopVar s ell (fun b => V1p b * V0 b) c x)) (su2Log (loopVar s ell (fun b => V1m b * V0 b) c x))
      (su2Log (loopVar s ell (fun b => (fun _ => (1 : SU2)) b * V0 b) c x)) (16048 * N ^ 2) (32 * N) τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_ubar.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_ubar
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_ubar.header:
theorem ev_ubar (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) {V1p V1m : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {τ : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (h : LinkEv V1p V1m τ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (N : ℝ)
    (hN : 3 * (ell : ℝ) ≤ N) (hsm : 32 * N * τ ≤ 1 / 2) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hW : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, frobNorm (((loopVar s ell V0 c x : SU2) : Mt) - 1) ≤ 1 / 16) :
    EvQ ((stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp s ell (fun b => V1p b * V0 b) c : SU2) : Mt)
      ((stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp s ell (fun b => V1m b * V0 b) c : SU2) : Mt)
      ((stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp s ell V0 c : SU2) : Mt) (78310 * N ^ 2) (228 * N) τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_rawStep.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_rawStep
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_rawStep.header:
theorem ev_rawStep (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) {V1p V1m : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {τ : ℝ}

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_log_rawStep.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_log_rawStep
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ev_log_rawStep.header:
theorem ev_log_rawStep (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) {V1p V1m : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {τ : ℝ}

    (hW : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, frobNorm (((loopVar s ell V0 c x : SU2) : Mt) - 1) ≤ 1 / 16) :
    EvQ (su2Log (rawStep s ell V0 V1p c)) (su2Log (rawStep s ell V0 V1m c)) 0 (7227000 * N ^ 2) (680 * N) τ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.linkEv_expCfgX.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.linkEv_expCfgX
AdalyFormal.DLayer.linkEv_expCfgX.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.entry_le_fN.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.entry_le_fN
AdalyFormal.DLayer.entry_le_fN.header: theorem entry_le_fN (X : Mt) (i j : Fin 2) : ‖X i j‖ ≤ frobNorm X

AdalyFormal.DLayer.fromM2_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.fromM2_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.fromM2_le.header: theorem fromM2_le (X : Mt) : ‖fromM2 X‖ ≤ frobNorm X

AdalyFormal.DLayer.even_qStepX.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.even_qStepX
AdalyFormal.DLayer.even_qStepX.header:
theorem even_qStepX (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hW : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, frobNorm (((loopVar s ell V0 c x : SU2) : Mt) - 1) ≤ 1 / 16)
    (A : XS L) (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hA : ∀ e, frobNorm (toM2 (A e)) ≤ β) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hsm : 1360 * (3 * (ell : ℝ)) * (t * β) ≤ 1) :
    ‖qStepX s ell V0 (t • A) c + qStepX s ell V0 (-(t • A)) c - (2 : ℝ) • qStepX s ell V0 0 c‖
      ≤ 7227000 * (3 * (ell : ℝ)) ^ 2 * β ^ 2 * t ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2StepX_row_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2StepX_row_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2StepX_row_le.header:
theorem C2StepX_row_le (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)

    (A : XS L) (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hA : ∀ e, VisStep s ell c e → frobNorm (toM2 (A e)) ≤ β) :
    ‖C2StepX s ell V0 A c‖ ≤ 3613500 * (3 * (ell : ℝ)) ^ 2 * β ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.mod_dvd_of.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.mod_dvd_of
AdalyFormal.DLayer.mod_dvd_of.header: theorem mod_dvd_of (s a t N : ℕ) (hN : s ∣ N) (ha : s ∣ a) (ht : s ∣ t) : s ∣ (a + t) % N

AdalyFormal.DLayer.shift_dvd.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.shift_dvd
AdalyFormal.DLayer.shift_dvd.header:
theorem shift_dvd (s t : ℕ) (hL : ∀ ν, s ∣ L ν + 1) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : ∀ ν, s ∣ (y ν).val)
