AdalyFormal.DLayer.onPath_dvd.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.onPath_dvd
AdalyFormal.DLayer.onPath_dvd.header:
theorem onPath_dvd (s : ℕ) (hL : ∀ ν, s ∣ L ν + 1) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.block_dvd.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.block_dvd
AdalyFormal.DLayer.block_dvd.header:
theorem block_dvd (s ell : ℕ) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : ∀ ν, s ∣ (y ν).val)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.cPlusS_dvd.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.cPlusS_dvd
AdalyFormal.DLayer.cPlusS_dvd.header:
theorem cPlusS_dvd (s ell : ℕ) (hL : ∀ ν, s ∣ L ν + 1) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (hc : ∀ ν, s ∣ (c.1 ν).val) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.visStep_dvd.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.visStep_dvd
AdalyFormal.DLayer.visStep_dvd.header:
theorem visStep_dvd (s ell : ℕ) (hL : ∀ ν, s ∣ L ν + 1) (c e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (hc : ∀ ν, s ∣ (c.1 ν).val)
    (h : VisStep s ell c e) : ∀ ν, s ∣ (e.1 ν).val

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Rstep_div.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Rstep_div
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Rstep_div.header: theorem Rstep_div (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) : Rstep ell s / (s * ell) ≤ 3

AdalyFormal.DLayer.card_vis_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.card_vis_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.card_vis_le.header:
theorem card_vis_le (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (hn : ∀ ν, s * ell ∣ L ν + 1)
    (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun c : CoarseBond L (s * ell) => VisStep s ell (c.1.1, c.2) e)).card ≤ 192

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_vis_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_vis_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_vis_le.header:
theorem sum_vis_le (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (hn : ∀ ν, s * ell ∣ L ν + 1)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (hg : ∀ e, 0 ≤ g e) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L (s * ell), ∑ e ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun e => VisStep s ell (c.1.1, c.2) e), g e
      ≤ 192 * ∑ e : CoarseBond L s, g (e.1.1, e.2)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.norm_suOf_sq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.norm_suOf_sq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.norm_suOf_sq.header: theorem norm_suOf_sq (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) : ‖suOf v‖ ^ 2 = frobNorm (toM2 v) ^ 2 / 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.frobSq_toM2.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.frobSq_toM2
AdalyFormal.DLayer.frobSq_toM2.header: theorem frobSq_toM2 (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) : frobSq (toM2 v) = 2 * (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 + v 2 ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.norm_suOf_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.norm_suOf_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.norm_suOf_le.header: theorem norm_suOf_le (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) : ‖suOf v‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 3 * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2Step_l1.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2Step_l1
AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2Step_l1.header:
theorem C2Step_l1 (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (hn : ∀ ν, s * ell ∣ L ν + 1)
    (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (hreg : RegBg s ell V0)
    (hW : ∀ c : CoarseBond L (s * ell), ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1.1 s ell,
      frobNorm (((loopVar s ell V0 (c.1.1, c.2) x : SU2) : Mt) - 1) ≤ 1 / 16)
    (Y : XS L) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L (s * ell), ‖suOf (C2StepX s ell V0 Y (c.1.1, c.2))‖
      ≤ K2s ell * ∑ e : CoarseBond L s, ‖suOf (Y (e.1.1, e.2))‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.boxF.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.boxF
AdalyFormal.DLayer.boxF.header: def boxF (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (m : ℕ) : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.mem_boxF.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.mem_boxF
AdalyFormal.DLayer.mem_boxF.header:
theorem mem_boxF {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {m : ℕ} :
    x ∈ boxF y m ↔ ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val ≤ (x μ).val ∧ (x μ).val < (y μ).val + m

AdalyFormal.DLayer.card_boxF_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.card_boxF_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.card_boxF_le.header: theorem card_boxF_le (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (m : ℕ) : (boxF y m).card ≤ m ^ 3

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sub_box_subset.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sub_box_subset
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sub_box_subset.header:
theorem sub_box_subset {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {s ell : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) :
    boxF x s ⊆ boxF y (s * ell)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sub_box_disjoint.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sub_box_disjoint
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sub_box_disjoint.header:
theorem sub_box_disjoint {y x x' : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {s ell : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell)
    (hx' : x' ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) (hne : x ≠ x') : Disjoint (boxF x s) (boxF x' s)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qcomposite_norm_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qcomposite_norm_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qcomposite_norm_le.header:
theorem Qcomposite_norm_le (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (ell : ℕ) (j : ℕ) (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ‖Qcomposite bg ell j lam y‖ ≤ ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ j) * ∑ x ∈ boxF y (ell ^ j), ‖lam x‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qcomposite_sq_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qcomposite_sq_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qcomposite_sq_le.header:
theorem Qcomposite_sq_le (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (j : ℕ) (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ‖Qcomposite bg ell j lam y‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ j) * ∑ x ∈ boxF y (ell ^ j), ‖lam x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.boxF_disjoint.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.boxF_disjoint
AdalyFormal.DLayer.boxF_disjoint.header:
theorem boxF_disjoint {y y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {m : ℕ} (hy : ∀ μ, m ∣ (y μ).val) (hy' : ∀ μ, m ∣ (y' μ).val)
    (hne : y ≠ y') : Disjoint (boxF y m) (boxF y' m)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.T1_pointwise_l1.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.T1_pointwise_l1
AdalyFormal.DLayer.T1_pointwise_l1.header:
theorem T1_pointwise_l1 {ell : ℕ} (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (A : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo)
    (c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell)) :
    ‖unitToCoarseCov 1 ell V A c‖ ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) *
      ∑ u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) c.1.1, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, fA A (pathSite u.1 c.2 (i * 1), c.2)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.T1_count.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.T1_count
AdalyFormal.DLayer.T1_count.header:
theorem T1_count {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (A : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell), (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) *
        ∑ u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) c.1.1, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, fA A (pathSite u.1 c.2 (i * 1), c.2)
      ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) * l1 (fA A)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.T1_l1.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.T1_l1
AdalyFormal.DLayer.T1_l1.header:
theorem T1_l1 {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (A : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell), ‖unitToCoarseCov 1 ell V A c‖ ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) * l1 (fA A)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_embE_edge'.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_embE_edge'
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_embE_edge'.header:
theorem sum_embE_edge' (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (g : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) :
    ∑ e : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lq, g (embE hs e) = ∑ c : CoarseBond L s, g (c.1.1, c.2)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_one_mul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_one_mul
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_one_mul.header:
theorem sum_one_mul (ell : ℕ) (F : PeriodicLatticeSite Lq → Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond Lq ell, F c.1.1 c.2 = ∑ c : CoarseBond Lq (1 * ell), F c.1.1 c.2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_lin.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_lin
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_lin.header:
theorem sum_lin {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) :
    ∑ i ∈ S, a * (f i + b * g i) = a * ∑ i ∈ S, f i + a * b * ∑ i ∈ S, g i

AdalyFormal.DLayer.suOf_fromM2.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.suOf_fromM2
AdalyFormal.DLayer.suOf_fromM2.header: theorem suOf_fromM2 (X : SuTwo) : suOf (fromM2 (X : M2)) = X

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qlin_l1.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qlin_l1
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qlin_l1.header:
theorem Qlin_l1 (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvdq : ∀ μ, ell ∣ Lq μ + 1) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (hreg : RegBg s ell V0)
    (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0) (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm (((resV hs V0 e : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0)
    (hsmall : rhoOf ell ε0 < Real.pi / 2) (w : XS L) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L (s * ell), ‖suOf (QlinStepX s ell V0 w (c.1.1, c.2))‖
      ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 + 1536 * ell * e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ε0)) * ∑ e : CoarseBond L s, ‖suOf (w (e.1.1, e.2))‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.dev_mul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.dev_mul
AdalyFormal.DLayer.dev_mul.header: theorem dev_mul (g h : SU2) : frobNorm (((g * h : SU2) : Mt) - 1) ≤ frobNorm ((g : Mt) - 1) + frobNorm ((h : Mt) - 1)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.dev_inv.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.dev_inv
AdalyFormal.DLayer.dev_inv.header: theorem dev_inv (g : SU2) : frobNorm (((g⁻¹ : SU2) : Mt) - 1) = frobNorm ((g : Mt) - 1)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.hol_dev.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.hol_dev
AdalyFormal.DLayer.hol_dev.header:
theorem hol_dev (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ε : ℝ) :
    ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L), (∀ e, OnPath s y p e → frobNorm (((V e : SU2) : Mt) - 1) ≤ ε) →
      frobNorm (((coarsePathHolonomy s V y p : SU2) : Mt) - 1) ≤ p.length * ε

AdalyFormal.DLayer.dev4.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.dev4
AdalyFormal.DLayer.dev4.header:
theorem dev4 (A B C D : SU2) :
    frobNorm (((A * B * C⁻¹ * D⁻¹ : SU2) : Mt) - 1)
      ≤ frobNorm ((A : Mt) - 1) + frobNorm ((B : Mt) - 1) + frobNorm ((C : Mt) - 1) + frobNorm ((D : Mt) - 1)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.loopVar_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.loopVar_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.loopVar_eq.header:
theorem loopVar_eq (s ell : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    loopVar s ell V c x = coarsePathHolonomy s V c.1 (coarseGammaPath s c.1 x)
      * coarsePathHolonomy s V x (List.replicate ell c.2)
      * (coarsePathHolonomy s V (cPlusS s ell c) (coarseGammaPath s c.1 x))⁻¹
      * (coarsePathHolonomy s V c.1 (List.replicate ell c.2))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.DLayer.loop_dev.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.loop_dev
AdalyFormal.DLayer.loop_dev.header:
theorem loop_dev (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hL : ∀ ν, s ∣ L ν + 1) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hV : ∀ e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, (∀ ν, s ∣ (e.1 ν).val) → frobNorm (((V e : SU2) : Mt) - 1) ≤ ε)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (hc : ∀ ν, s ∣ (c.1 ν).val) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell) (hell : 0 < ell) :
    frobNorm (((loopVar s ell V c x : SU2) : Mt) - 1) ≤ 8 * ell * ε

AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2CompX_zero.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2CompX_zero
AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2CompX_zero.header: theorem C2CompX_zero (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (a : XS L) : C2CompX ell bg 0 a = 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.suOf_add.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.suOf_add
AdalyFormal.DLayer.suOf_add.header: theorem suOf_add (u v : Fin 3 → ℝ) : suOf (u + v) = suOf u + suOf v

AdalyFormal.DLayer.rec_closed.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.rec_closed
AdalyFormal.DLayer.rec_closed.header:
theorem rec_closed (k : ℕ) (S T : ℕ → ℝ) (A K X ell θ : ℝ) (hell : 0 < ell) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hX : 0 ≤ X)
    (hA0 : 0 ≤ A) (hA : A ≤ θ / ell) (h0 : S 0 = 0) (hS0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ S j)
    (hS : ∀ j, j < k → S (j + 1) ≤ A * S j + K * T j) (hT : ∀ j, j < k → T j ≤ X * (1 / ell) ^ j) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ k → S j ≤ K * X * ell / (1 - θ) * (1 / ell) ^ j

AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2Comp_l1.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2Comp_l1
AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2Comp_l1.header:
theorem C2Comp_l1 (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (hloop : ∀ j, j < k → 8 * (ell : ℝ) * ε j ≤ 1 / 16)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1)
    (hA : ∀ j, j < k → 1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 + 1536 * ell * e2Majorant (rhoOf ell (ε j)) ≤ θ / ell)
    (a : XS (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ k),
        ‖suOf (C2CompX ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k a (c.1.1, c.2))‖
      ≤ K2s ell * (Real.exp ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, thetaOf ell (ε i)) / rr ell) * nrm 1 a) ^ 2 * ell / (1 - θ)
          * (1 / (ell : ℝ)) ^ k

AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2full_apply_level.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2full_apply_level
AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2full_apply_level.header:
theorem C2full_apply_level {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : TowerGeom L) (V : Cfg L)
    (hreg : RegTower G.ell (bgTower G V) G.k) (z : BondFnL2 L) (p : BIdx G) :
    C2fullOf G V z p = (((G.ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ))⁻¹) • suOf (C2CompX G.ell (bgTower G V) p.1 (suCoord z) p.2.1)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2full_l1.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2full_l1
AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2full_l1.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.thetaK2.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.thetaK2
AdalyFormal.DLayer.thetaK2.header: noncomputable def thetaK2 (ell : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.rhoOf_mono.header: theorem rhoOf_mono (ell : ℕ) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) : rhoOf ell a ≤ rhoOf ell b

AdalyFormal.DLayer.hK2_M0.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.hK2_M0
AdalyFormal.DLayer.hK2_M0.header:
theorem hK2_M0 (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))

    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hK2c : 1536 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * e2Majorant (rhoOf ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)) < 1 - 1 / (ell : ℝ))
    (z : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ p, ‖C2fullOf (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G U z p‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Q1jet_row_congr.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Q1jet_row_congr

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Q1_drift_local.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Q1_drift_local
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Q1_drift_local.header:
theorem Q1_drift_local {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0) (hsmall : rhoOf ell ε0 < Real.pi / 2)
    (hreg : RegBg 1 ell V) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    ‖Q1jet ell V B c - Q1jet ell flatCfg B c‖
      ≤ (8 * ell * ε0 + 8 * e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ε0)) *
          ∑ e ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun e => VisStep 1 ell (c.1.1, c.2) e), ‖B e‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.iotaD_l1.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.iotaD_l1
AdalyFormal.DLayer.iotaD_l1.header:
theorem iotaD_l1 {ell : ℕ} (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (w : Dset L ell Lam → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.DLayer.H0_drift_l1.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.H0_drift_l1
AdalyFormal.DLayer.H0_drift_l1.header:
theorem H0_drift_l1 {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0) (hsmall : rhoOf ell ε0 < Real.pi / 2) (hreg : RegBg 1 ell V)
    (w : Dset L ell Lam → SuTwo) :
    ∑ d : Dset L ell Lam, ‖H0 Lam (Q1jet ell V) w d - H0 Lam (AdalyFormal.IngredientFamily.q1SU2 ell) w d‖
      ≤ 192 * (8 * ell * ε0 + 8 * e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ε0)) * ∑ d : Dset L ell Lam, ‖w d‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.H0inv_l1.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.H0inv_l1
AdalyFormal.DLayer.H0inv_l1.header:
theorem H0inv_l1 {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (δ : ℝ)
    (hb : Function.Bijective (H0 Lam (Q1jet ell V))) (hδ : δ < 1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3)
    (hdrift : ∀ w : Dset L ell Lam → SuTwo, ∑ d, ‖H0 Lam (Q1jet ell V) w d - H0 Lam (AdalyFormal.IngredientFamily.q1SU2 ell) w d‖
      ≤ δ * ∑ d, ‖w d‖)
    (v : Dset L ell Lam → SuTwo) :
    ∑ d, ‖H0inv Lam (Q1jet ell V) v d‖ ≤ (∑ d, ‖v d‖) / (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 - δ)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.hLift_l1.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.hLift_l1
AdalyFormal.DLayer.hLift_l1.header:
theorem hLift_l1 {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (δ : ℝ)
    (hb : Function.Bijective (H0 Lam (Q1jet ell V))) (hδ : δ < 1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3)
    (hdrift : ∀ w : Dset L ell Lam → SuTwo, ∑ d, ‖H0 Lam (Q1jet ell V) w d - H0 Lam (AdalyFormal.IngredientFamily.q1SU2 ell) w d‖
      ≤ δ * ∑ d, ‖w d‖)
    (f : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ‖hLift Lam (Q1jet ell V) f b‖ ≤ (∑ c, ‖f c‖) / (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 - δ)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2tilde_l1.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2tilde_l1
AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2tilde_l1.header:
theorem C2tilde_l1 {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (hreg : RegBg 1 ell V) (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0) (hloop : 8 * (ell : ℝ) * ε0 ≤ 1 / 16) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L ell, ‖C2tilde ell V B c‖ ≤ K2s ell * ∑ b : Bond L, ‖B b‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.hKDb_M0.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.hKDb_M0
AdalyFormal.DLayer.hKDb_M0.header:
theorem hKDb_M0 (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (a t e q0 : ℝ) (R : M0RegimeR ell k Lu U a t e q0) (H : KUSmall ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0))
    (HU : UnitSmall ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)) (hd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hKDc : 192 * (8 * (ell : ℝ) * kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)
        + 8 * e2Majorant (rhoOf ell (kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)))) ≤ 1 / (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (B : BondFnL2 Lu) :
    ∑ e', ‖((PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).D2in B) e'‖ ≤ KDfree ell * ‖B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvenLimit.even_approx.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvenLimit.even_approx
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvenLimit.even_approx.header:
theorem even_approx (f : E → F) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f 0) (π : F →L[ℝ] G) (b : E) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < δ →
      ‖π (f (t • b) + f (-(t • b)) - (2 : ℝ) • f 0) - (t ^ 2) • π (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) 0 b b)‖ ≤ ε * t ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvenLimit.second_deri.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvenLimit.second_deriv_eq_of_even
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EvenLimit.second_deri.header:
theorem second_deriv_eq_of_even (f : E → F) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f 0) (π : F →L[ℝ] G) (b b' : E)
    (h : ∃ t0 > 0, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < t0 → π (f (t • b) + f (-(t • b))) = π (f (t • b') + f (-(t • b')))) :
    π (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) 0 b b) = π (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) 0 b' b')

AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2StepX_row_congr.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2StepX_row_congr
AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2StepX_row_congr.header:
theorem C2StepX_row_congr (s ell : ℕ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (hreg : RegBg s ell V0)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (b b' : XS L) (h : ∀ e, VisStep s ell c e → b e = b' e) :
    C2StepX s ell V0 b c = C2StepX s ell V0 b' c

AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2CompX_row_congr.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2CompX_row_congr
AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2CompX_row_congr.header:
theorem C2CompX_row_congr (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (J : ℕ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell bg J) : ∀ j, j ≤ J → ∀ (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (a a' : XS L),
      (∀ e, Foot ell j c e → a e = a' e) → C2CompX ell bg j a c = C2CompX ell bg j a' c

AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar
AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar.header: noncomputable def polar (u v : BondFnL2 L) : FSp G

AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_eq.header:
theorem polar_eq (u v : BondFnL2 L) :
    polar G U u v = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((C2fullOf_quad G U).choose u v + (C2fullOf_quad G U).choose v u)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_scale.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_scale
AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_scale.header: theorem polar_scale (u v : BondFnL2 L) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≠ 0) : polar G U (s • u) (s⁻¹ • v) = polar G U u v

AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_zero_left.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_zero_left
AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_zero_left.header: theorem polar_zero_left (v : BondFnL2 L) : polar G U 0 v = 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_l1.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_l1
AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_l1.header:
theorem polar_l1 (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hC : ∀ z : BondFnL2 L, ∑ p, ‖C2fullOf G U z p‖ ≤ K * ‖z‖ ^ 2)
    (u v : BondFnL2 L) : ∑ p, ‖polar G U u v p‖ ≤ K * ‖u‖ * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.footRes.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.footRes
AdalyFormal.DLayer.footRes.header: noncomputable def footRes (p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu)) (u : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2full_row_congr.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2full_row_congr
AdalyFormal.DLayer.C2full_row_congr.header:
theorem C2full_row_congr (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k)
    (p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu)) (z z' : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (h : ∀ e, Foot ell (p.1 : ℕ) p.2.1 e → z e = z' e) :
    C2fullOf (GF ell k Lu) U z p = C2fullOf (GF ell k Lu) U z' p

AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_row_congr.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_row_congr
AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_row_congr.header:
theorem polar_row_congr (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k)
    (p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu)) (u v : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    polar (GF ell k Lu) U u v p = polar (GF ell k Lu) U (footRes ell k Lu p u) (footRes ell k Lu p v) p

AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_row.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_row
AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_row.header:
theorem polar_row (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k)
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hC : ∀ z : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu), ∑ p, ‖C2fullOf (GF ell k Lu) U z p‖ ≤ K * ‖z‖ ^ 2)
    (p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu)) (u v : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ‖polar (GF ell k Lu) U u v p‖ ≤ K * ‖footRes ell k Lu p u‖ * ‖footRes ell k Lu p v‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.footRes_sq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.footRes_sq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.footRes_sq.header:
theorem footRes_sq (p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu)) (u : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ‖footRes ell k Lu p u‖ ^ 2 = ∑ e, if Foot ell (p.1 : ℕ) p.2.1 e then ‖u e‖ ^ 2 else 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.card_foot_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.card_foot_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.card_foot_le.header:
theorem card_foot_le (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu) => Foot ell (p.1 : ℕ) p.2.1 e)).card ≤ 648

AdalyFormal.DLayer.foot_mult_full.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.foot_mult_full
AdalyFormal.DLayer.foot_mult_full.header:
theorem foot_mult_full (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (u : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu), ‖footRes ell k Lu p u‖ ^ 2 ≤ 648 * ‖u‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.psiForm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.psiForm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.psiForm.header:
noncomputable def psiForm (ψ : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) :
    BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu) →ₗ[ℝ] BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ

AdalyFormal.DLayer.psiForm_eq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.psiForm_eq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.psiForm_eq.header:
theorem psiForm_eq (ψ : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) (u v : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    psiForm ell k Lu U ψ u v = 2 * ⟪polar (GF ell k Lu) U u v, ψ⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.psiForm_symm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.psiForm_symm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.psiForm_symm.header:
theorem psiForm_symm (ψ : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) (u v : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    psiForm ell k Lu U ψ u v = psiForm ell k Lu U ψ v u

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi.header: noncomputable def Mpsi (ψ : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu) →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi_inner.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi_inner
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi_inner.header:
theorem Mpsi_inner (ψ : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) (u v : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ⟪u, Mpsi ell k Lu U ψ v⟫ = 2 * ⟪polar (GF ell k Lu) U u v, ψ⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi_symm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi_symm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi_symm.header:
theorem Mpsi_symm (ψ : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) (u v : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ⟪Mpsi ell k Lu U ψ u, v⟫ = ⟪u, Mpsi ell k Lu U ψ v⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.pair_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.pair_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.pair_le.header:
theorem pair_le (ψ : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) (S : ℝ) (hψ : ∀ p, ‖ψ p‖ ≤ S) (X : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) :
    |⟪X, ψ⟫| ≤ S * ∑ p, ‖X p‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi_bil.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi_bil
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi_bil.header:
theorem Mpsi_bil (ψ : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) (S K : ℝ) (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hψ : ∀ p, ‖ψ p‖ ≤ S)
    (hC : ∀ z : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu), ∑ p, ‖C2fullOf (GF ell k Lu) U z p‖ ≤ K * ‖z‖ ^ 2)
    (u v : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) : |⟪u, Mpsi ell k Lu U ψ v⟫| ≤ 2 * S * K * ‖u‖ * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.opNorm_le_of_bil.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.opNorm_le_of_bil
AdalyFormal.DLayer.opNorm_le_of_bil.header:
theorem opNorm_le_of_bil {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (M : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : ℝ)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (h : ∀ u v, |⟪u, M v⟫| ≤ C * ‖u‖ * ‖v‖) : ‖M‖ ≤ C

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi_norm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi_norm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi_norm.header:
theorem Mpsi_norm (ψ : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) (S K : ℝ) (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hψ : ∀ p, ‖ψ p‖ ≤ S)
    (hC : ∀ z : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu), ∑ p, ‖C2fullOf (GF ell k Lu) U z p‖ ≤ K * ‖z‖ ^ 2) :
    ‖Mpsi ell k Lu U ψ‖ ≤ 2 * S * K

AdalyFormal.DLayer.footMul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.footMul
AdalyFormal.DLayer.footMul.header:
noncomputable def footMul (p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu)) (g : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ)
    (u : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.footMul_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.footMul_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.footMul_le.header:
theorem footMul_le (p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu)) (g : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hg : ∀ e, Foot ell (p.1 : ℕ) p.2.1 e → |g e| ≤ d) (u : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ‖footMul ell k Lu p g u‖ ≤ d * ‖footRes ell k Lu p u‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.footRes_footMul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.footRes_footMul
AdalyFormal.DLayer.footRes_footMul.header:
theorem footRes_footMul (p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu)) (g : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (u : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    footRes ell k Lu p (footMul ell k Lu p g u) = footMul ell k Lu p g u

AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_add_left.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_add_left
AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_add_left.header:
theorem polar_add_left (u u' v : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    polar (GF ell k Lu) U (u + u') v = polar (GF ell k Lu) U u v + polar (GF ell k Lu) U u' v

AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_add_right.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_add_right
AdalyFormal.DLayer.polar_add_right.header:
theorem polar_add_right (u v v' : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    polar (GF ell k Lu) U u (v + v') = polar (GF ell k Lu) U u v + polar (GF ell k Lu) U u v'

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi_cjp.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi_cjp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Mpsi_cjp.header:
theorem Mpsi_cjp (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k)
    (ψ : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) (S K : ℝ) (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hψ : ∀ p, ‖ψ p‖ ≤ S)
    (hC : ∀ z : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu), ∑ p, ‖C2fullOf (GF ell k Lu) U z p‖ ≤ K * ‖z‖ ^ 2)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hφ : WtLip (θ / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) φ) :
    ‖cjp (bondWP φ) (bondWP φ) (Mpsi ell k Lu U ψ) - Mpsi ell k Lu U ψ‖
      ≤ 2 * S * K * 648 * ((Real.exp (5 * θ) - 1) * (Real.exp (5 * θ) + 1))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteMask_univ.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteMask_univ
AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteMask_univ.header: theorem siteMask_univ (f : SiteL2 L) : siteMask (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) f = f

AdalyFormal.DLayer.DelpA_univ.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.DelpA_univ
AdalyFormal.DLayer.DelpA_univ.header:
theorem DelpA_univ (G : TowerGeom L) (hOm : G.Om0 = Set.univ) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    DelpA G U a f = lapFull U f + Qpa G U a f

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qpa_conj_inner.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qpa_conj_inner
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qpa_conj_inner.header:
theorem Qpa_conj_inner (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ⟪f, siteWt φ (Qpa G U a (siteWt (-φ) f))⟫
      = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (G.k + 1), ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L,
          if y ∈ G.Lam j then (ajSeq a G.ell j * (G.ell : ℝ) ^ j) *
            ⟪Qlev G U j y (siteWt φ f), Qlev G U j y (siteWt (-φ) f)⟫ else 0

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qlev_siteWt_shift.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qlev_siteWt_shift
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qlev_siteWt_shift.header:
theorem Qlev_siteWt_shift (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (j : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    Qlev G U j y (siteWt φ f) = Real.exp c • Qlev G U j y (siteWt (fun x => φ x - c) f)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qlev_err_sq.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qlev_err_sq
AdalyFormal.DLayer.Qlev_err_sq.header:
theorem Qlev_err_sq (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (j : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (ψ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (hψ : ∀ x ∈ boxF y (G.ell ^ j), |ψ x| ≤ δ) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖Qlev G U j y (siteWt ψ f) - Qlev G U j y f‖ ^ 2
      ≤ ((1 / (G.ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ j) * (Real.exp δ - 1) ^ 2 * ∑ x ∈ boxF y (G.ell ^ j), ‖f x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_boxes_le.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_boxes_le
AdalyFormal.DLayer.sum_boxes_le.header:
theorem sum_boxes_le (G : TowerGeom L)
    (hLk : ∀ y ∈ G.Lam G.k, ∀ μ, G.ell ^ G.k ∣ (y μ).val) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if y ∈ G.Lam G.k then ∑ x ∈ boxF y (G.ell ^ G.k), ‖f x‖ ^ 2 else 0) ≤ ‖f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteCT_form.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteCT_form
AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteCT_form.header:
theorem siteCT_form (G : TowerGeom L) (hOm : G.Om0 = Set.univ) (hell : 0 < G.ell)
    (hLlt : ∀ j, j < G.k → ∀ y, y ∉ G.Lam j)
    (hLk : ∀ y ∈ G.Lam G.k, ∀ μ, G.ell ^ G.k ∣ (y μ).val)
    (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ ajSeq a G.ell G.k)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ' δ : ℝ) (hφ : WtLip θ' φ)
    (hbox : ∀ y ∈ G.Lam G.k, ∀ x ∈ boxF y (G.ell ^ G.k), |φ x - φ y| ≤ δ) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    (1 / 2) * ⟪f, DelpA G U a f⟫
      - (9 * (Real.exp θ' - 1) ^ 2
          + 3 * (ajSeq a G.ell G.k * (G.ell : ℝ) ^ G.k) * (1 / (G.ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ G.k * (Real.exp δ - 1) ^ 2) * ‖f‖ ^ 2
      ≤ ⟪f, siteWt φ (DelpA G U a (siteWt (-φ) f))⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteCT_inv.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteCT_inv
AdalyFormal.DLayer.siteCT_inv.header:
theorem siteCT_inv (G : TowerGeom L) (hOm : G.Om0 = Set.univ) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA G U a + (1 - siteMask G.Om0)))
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (c Es : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hform : ∀ f, (1 / 2) * ⟪f, DelpA G U a f⟫ - Es * ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪f, siteWt φ (DelpA G U a (siteWt (-φ) f))⟫)
    (hcoer : ∀ f, c * ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 2) * ⟪f, DelpA G U a f⟫ - Es * ‖f‖ ^ 2) (g : SiteL2 L) :
    c * ‖siteWt φ (Gp G U a (siteWt (-φ) g))‖ ≤ ‖g‖

    (hEG : 4 * EGM1 ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc pd.νψ pd.δψ pd.νψ_nonneg (pd.δψ_nonneg hc.hθ)
      ≤ cg1 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc pd.νψ)
    (hN : EN1free ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc pd.νψ pd.δψ pd.νψ_nonneg (pd.δψ_nonneg hc.hθ)
      (KhatM0_pos ell k Lu U a t e q0 R) hcg hEG < 1 / bN1 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc pd.νψ)
    (w : FSp (GF ell k Lu)) :
    ‖cjp (fspWP ell k Lu φ) (bondWP φ) (n1M0 ell k Lu U a t e q0 R H φ θ hφ hc pd hcg hEG).H w‖

        / (1 / bN1 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc pd.νψ
          - EN1free ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc pd.νψ pd.δψ pd.νψ_nonneg (pd.δψ_nonneg hc.hθ)
              (KhatM0_pos ell k Lu U a t e q0 R) hcg hEG)
        * ‖w‖

    (νψ δψ : ℝ) (hpdν : ∀ φ, (pdOf φ).νψ = νψ) (hpdδ : ∀ φ, (pdOf φ).δψ = δψ)
    (hν : 0 ≤ νψ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δψ)
    (hcg : 0 < cg1 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc νψ)
    (hEG : 4 * EGM1 ell a (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc νψ δψ hν hδ ≤ cg1 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc νψ)
    (hN : EN1free ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) θ hc νψ δψ hν hδ (KhatM0_pos ell k Lu U a t e q0 R) hcg hEG

    cjp ωX ωZ (S ∘L T) = cjp ωY ωZ S ∘L cjp ωX ωY T

AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjm_comp.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjm_comp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjm_comp.header:
theorem cjm_comp (ωX : WPair X) (ωY : WPair Y) (ωZ : WPair Z) (S : Y →L[ℝ] Z) (T : X →L[ℝ] Y) :
    cjm ωX ωZ (S ∘L T) = cjm ωY ωZ S ∘L cjm ωX ωY T

AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjp_sub.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjp_sub
AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjp_sub.header:
theorem cjp_sub (ωX : WPair X) (ωZ : WPair Z) (S T : X →L[ℝ] Z) :
    cjp ωX ωZ (S - T) = cjp ωX ωZ S - cjp ωX ωZ T

AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjp_add.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjp_add
AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjp_add.header:
theorem cjp_add (ωX : WPair X) (ωZ : WPair Z) (S T : X →L[ℝ] Z) :
    cjp ωX ωZ (S + T) = cjp ωX ωZ S + cjp ωX ωZ T

AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjp_smul.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjp_smul
AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjp_smul.header:
theorem cjp_smul (ωX : WPair X) (ωZ : WPair Z) (c : ℝ) (T : X →L[ℝ] Z) :
    cjp ωX ωZ (c • T) = c • cjp ωX ωZ T

AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjp_id.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjp_id
AdalyFormal.DLayer.cjp_id.header: theorem cjp_id (ωX : WPair X) : cjp ωX ωX (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ X

AdalyFormal.DLayer.adjoint_cjp.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.adjoint_cjp
AdalyFormal.DLayer.adjoint_cjp.header:
theorem adjoint_cjp (ωX : WPair X) (ωZ : WPair Z) (T : X →L[ℝ] Z) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (cjp ωX ωZ T) = cjm ωZ ωX (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.adjoint_cjm.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.adjoint_cjm
AdalyFormal.DLayer.adjoint_cjm.header:
theorem adjoint_cjm (ωX : WPair X) (ωZ : WPair Z) (T : X →L[ℝ] Z) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (cjm ωX ωZ T) = cjp ωZ ωX (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.form_cjp_XtX.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.form_cjp_XtX
AdalyFormal.DLayer.form_cjp_XtX.header:
theorem form_cjp_XtX (ωX : WPair X) (ωZ : WPair Z) (T : X →L[ℝ] Z) (f : X) :
    ⟪f, cjp ωX ωX (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T ∘L T) f⟫ = ⟪cjm ωX ωZ T f, cjp ωX ωZ T f⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.xtx_cjp_lower.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.xtx_cjp_lower
AdalyFormal.DLayer.xtx_cjp_lower.header:
theorem xtx_cjp_lower (ωX : WPair X) (ωZ : WPair Z) (T : X →L[ℝ] Z) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hp : ‖cjp ωX ωZ T - T‖ ≤ δ) (hm : ‖cjm ωX ωZ T - T‖ ≤ δ) (f : X) :
    (1 / 2) * ‖T f‖ ^ 2 - 3 * δ ^ 2 * ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪f, cjp ωX ωX (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T ∘L T) f⟫

AdalyFormal.DLayer.inv_cjp_bound.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.inv_cjp_bound
AdalyFormal.DLayer.inv_cjp_bound.header:
theorem inv_cjp_bound (ωX : WPair X) (M Minv : X →L[ℝ] X) (hinv : ∀ x, M (Minv x) = x)
    (c : ℝ) (hco : ∀ h, c * ‖h‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪h, cjp ωX ωX M h⟫) (g : X) :
    c * ‖cjp ωX ωX Minv g‖ ≤ ‖g‖

AdalyFormal.DLayer.M0Core_two_domain_non.header:

    TorusOK 2 M (LuM M) ∧ 0 < α₀M M ∧ (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀M M ≤ AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.epsB / 10 ^ 300 ∧

AdalyFormal.DLayer.witness_form_pos.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.witness_form_pos
AdalyFormal.DLayer.witness_form_pos.header:
theorem witness_form_pos (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ Bt : Bond Lu16 → SuTwo,
      AdalyFormal.StatementLane.OnLambdaTildeIn (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu16)) 2 Bt ∧
      OnLambdaT (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu16)) Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧
      9e-5 * bondEnergy Bt ≤ AdalyFormal.StatementLaneG.GenP.genForm
          (gparams 2 k Lu16 (by norm_num) (fullTower 2 k Lu16) (Uw k) 1 Set.univ)
          (WithLp.toLp 2 (AdalyFormal.StatementLaneG.GenP.genC
            (gparams 2 k Lu16 (by norm_num) (fullTower 2 k Lu16) (Uw k) 1 Set.univ) Bt)) ∧
      0 < AdalyFormal.StatementLaneG.GenP.genForm
          (gparams 2 k Lu16 (by norm_num) (fullTower 2 k Lu16) (Uw k) 1 Set.univ)
          (WithLp.toLp 2 (AdalyFormal.StatementLaneG.GenP.genC
            (gparams 2 k Lu16 (by norm_num) (fullTower 2 k Lu16) (Uw k) 1 Set.univ) Bt))

    ∃ Bt : Bond (LuM M) → SuTwo,
      AdalyFormal.StatementLane.OnLambdaTildeIn (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (LuM M))) 2 Bt ∧
      OnLambdaT (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (LuM M))) Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧
      0 < AdalyFormal.StatementLaneG.GenP.genForm
          (gparams 2 k (LuM M) (by norm_num) (fullTower 2 k (LuM M)) (UwM M k) 1 Set.univ)
          (WithLp.toLp 2 (AdalyFormal.StatementLaneG.GenP.genC
            (gparams 2 k (LuM M) (by norm_num) (fullTower 2 k (LuM M)) (UwM M k) 1 Set.univ) Bt))

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ENfree_FF.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ENfree_FF
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ENfree_FF.header:
theorem ENfree_FF (ell : ℕ) (a t ρ θ : ℝ) (hc : CondM0 ell a ρ θ) (hK : 0 < KhatM0 ell a t ρ)
    (hEG : 4 * EGM0 ell a ρ θ hc ≤ 1 / KhatM0 ell a t ρ) :
    ENfree ell a t ρ θ hc hK hEG
      = FF.EN (FF.EG (cS a ρ) (δDS θ) (δQS a θ) 1 (qS a) (cGS ell a ρ θ) (δCS θ) (κS ρ) (δKS ρ θ) (νS ρ) (δνS ρ θ)
          (δBS ell a ρ θ) 1)
        (FF.nW (cS a ρ) (δDS θ) (δQS a θ) 1 (qS a) (cGS ell a ρ θ))
        (FF.dW (cS a ρ) (δDS θ) (δQS a θ) 1 (qS a) (cGS ell a ρ θ))
        (FF.δCW (cS a ρ) (δDS θ) (δQS a θ) 1 (qS a) (cGS ell a ρ θ) (δCS θ) (κS ρ) (δKS ρ θ))
        (FF.dT (cS a ρ) (δDS θ) (δQS a θ) 1 (qS a) (cGS ell a ρ θ))
        (νS ρ) (δνS ρ θ) (δBS ell a ρ θ) 1 (1 / KhatM0 ell a t ρ) (qBS ell a ρ)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EGM1_FF.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EGM1_FF
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EGM1_FF.header:

    EGM1 ell a ρ θ hc νψ δψ hν hδ = FF.EG (cS a ρ) (δDS θ) (δQS a θ) 1 (qS a) (cGS ell a ρ θ) (δCS θ) (κS ρ) (δKS ρ θ)
      (νS ρ + νψ) (δνS ρ θ + δψ) (δBS ell a ρ θ) 1

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EN1free_FF.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EN1free_FF
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EN1free_FF.header:
theorem EN1free_FF (ell : ℕ) (a t ρ θ : ℝ) (hc : CondM0 ell a ρ θ) (νψ δψ : ℝ) (hν : 0 ≤ νψ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δψ)
    (hK : 0 < KhatM0 ell a t ρ) (hcg : 0 < cg1 ell a t ρ θ hc νψ)
    (hEG : 4 * EGM1 ell a ρ θ hc νψ δψ hν hδ ≤ cg1 ell a t ρ θ hc νψ) :
    EN1free ell a t ρ θ hc νψ δψ hν hδ hK hcg hEG
      = FF.EN (FF.EG (cS a ρ) (δDS θ) (δQS a θ) 1 (qS a) (cGS ell a ρ θ) (δCS θ) (κS ρ) (δKS ρ θ) (νS ρ + νψ)
          (δνS ρ θ + δψ) (δBS ell a ρ θ) 1)
        (FF.nW (cS a ρ) (δDS θ) (δQS a θ) 1 (qS a) (cGS ell a ρ θ))
        (FF.dW (cS a ρ) (δDS θ) (δQS a θ) 1 (qS a) (cGS ell a ρ θ))
        (FF.δCW (cS a ρ) (δDS θ) (δQS a θ) 1 (qS a) (cGS ell a ρ θ) (δCS θ) (κS ρ) (δKS ρ θ))
        (FF.dT (cS a ρ) (δDS θ) (δQS a θ) 1 (qS a) (cGS ell a ρ θ))
        (νS ρ + νψ) (δνS ρ θ + δψ) (δBS ell a ρ θ) 1 (cg1 ell a t ρ θ hc νψ) (qBS ell a ρ)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.cg1_FF.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.cg1_FF
AdalyFormal.DLayer.cg1_FF.header:
theorem cg1_FF (ell : ℕ) (a t ρ θ : ℝ) (hc : CondM0 ell a ρ θ) (νψ : ℝ) :
    cg1 ell a t ρ θ hc νψ = 1 / KhatM0 ell a t ρ - νψ * FF.nW (cS a ρ) (δDS θ) (δQS a θ) 1 (qS a) (cGS ell a ρ θ) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.bN1_FF.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.bN1_FF
AdalyFormal.DLayer.bN1_FF.header:
theorem bN1_FF (ell : ℕ) (a t ρ θ : ℝ) (hc : CondM0 ell a ρ θ) (νψ : ℝ) :
    bN1 ell a t ρ θ hc νψ = bNS a ρ (δS ell ρ)
      * (1 + νψ * FF.nW (cS a ρ) (δDS θ) (δQS a θ) 1 (qS a) (cGS ell a ρ θ) ^ 2 * KhatM0 ell a t ρ)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.tdiv.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.tdiv
AdalyFormal.DLayer.tdiv.header:

AdalyFormal.DLayer.ENfree_GL.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.ENfree_GL
AdalyFormal.DLayer.ENfree_GL.header:
theorem ENfree_GL (ell : ℕ) (a t ρ θ : ℝ) (hc : CondM0 ell a ρ θ) (hK : 0 < KhatM0 ell a t ρ)
    (hEG : 4 * EGM0 ell a ρ θ hc ≤ 1 / KhatM0 ell a t ρ) :
    ENfree ell a t ρ θ hc hK hEG = GLv.EN ell a ρ θ (νS ρ) (δνS ρ θ) (1 / KhatM0 ell a t ρ)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EGM1_GL.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EGM1_GL
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EGM1_GL.header:

    EGM1 ell a ρ θ hc νψ δψ hν hδ = GLv.EG ell a ρ θ (νS ρ + νψ) (δνS ρ θ + δψ)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.EN1free_GL.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.EN1free_GL
AdalyFormal.DLayer.EN1free_GL.header:
theorem EN1free_GL (ell : ℕ) (a t ρ θ : ℝ) (hc : CondM0 ell a ρ θ) (νψ δψ : ℝ) (hν : 0 ≤ νψ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δψ)
    (hK : 0 < KhatM0 ell a t ρ) (hcg : 0 < cg1 ell a t ρ θ hc νψ)
    (hEG : 4 * EGM1 ell a ρ θ hc νψ δψ hν hδ ≤ cg1 ell a t ρ θ hc νψ) :
    EN1free ell a t ρ θ hc νψ δψ hν hδ hK hcg hEG
      = GLv.EN ell a ρ θ (νS ρ + νψ) (δνS ρ θ + δψ) (cg1 ell a t ρ θ hc νψ)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.cg1_GL.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.cg1_GL
AdalyFormal.DLayer.cg1_GL.header:
theorem cg1_GL (ell : ℕ) (a t ρ θ : ℝ) (hc : CondM0 ell a ρ θ) (νψ : ℝ) :
    cg1 ell a t ρ θ hc νψ = 1 / KhatM0 ell a t ρ - νψ * GLv.nW ell a ρ θ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.DLayer.bN1_GL.name: AdalyFormal.DLayer.bN1_GL
AdalyFormal.DLayer.bN1_GL.header:
theorem bN1_GL (ell : ℕ) (a t ρ θ : ℝ) (hc : CondM0 ell a ρ θ) (νψ : ℝ) :
    bN1 ell a t ρ θ hc νψ = bNS a ρ (δS ell ρ) * (1 + νψ * GLv.nW ell a ρ θ ^ 2 * KhatM0 ell a t ρ)

AdalyFormal.DLayer.stageA.header:
theorem stageA (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a t : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∀ θ ρ νψ δψ : ℝ, |θ| < ε → |ρ| < ε → |νψ| < ε → |δψ| < ε →
      24 * (δDS θ ^ 2 + 1 * δQS a θ ^ 2) < cS a ρ ∧ 4 * δDS θ ^ 2 < cS a ρ ∧ 0 < cGS ell a ρ θ ∧
      216 * ρ ^ 2 < 1 ∧ 162 * ρ < 1 ∧ 0 < KhatM0 ell a t ρ ∧
      4 * GLv.EG ell a ρ θ (νS ρ) (δνS ρ θ) < 1 / KhatM0 ell a t ρ ∧
      GLv.EN ell a ρ θ (νS ρ) (δνS ρ θ) (1 / KhatM0 ell a t ρ) < 1 / bNS a ρ (δS ell ρ) ∧
      0 < 1 / KhatM0 ell a t ρ - νψ * GLv.nW ell a ρ θ ^ 2 ∧
      4 * GLv.EG ell a ρ θ (νS ρ + νψ) (δνS ρ θ + δψ) < 1 / KhatM0 ell a t ρ - νψ * GLv.nW ell a ρ θ ^ 2 ∧
      GLv.EN ell a ρ θ (νS ρ + νψ) (δνS ρ θ + δψ) (1 / KhatM0 ell a t ρ - νψ * GLv.nW ell a ρ θ ^ 2)
        < 1 / (bNS a ρ (δS ell ρ) * (1 + νψ * GLv.nW ell a ρ θ ^ 2 * KhatM0 ell a t ρ))

      4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * β) ≤ 1 ∧
      216 * ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * β)) ^ 2 < 1 ∧

      ThetaM0 ell a 1 ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * β)) < min a 1 / 1000 ∧
      KUSmall ell ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * β)) ∧
      UnitSmall ell ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * β)) ∧
      4 * β ≤ 1 ∧
      ∃ Num : M0ClassNum ell a 1 ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * β)) β θ₁,
        γm ≤ gam0M0f ell a 1 ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * β)) (eps2free Num) (epsJfree Num)

theorem M0Core_general_witnessed (ell M : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ a₀ : ℝ, 0 < a₀ ∧ ∃ γ₀ : ℝ, 0 < γ₀ ∧ M0CoreBody ell M (by omega) a a₀ γ₀ ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k →
        TorusOK ell M (LuLM ell M) ∧ 0 < α₀LM M a₀ ∧ (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀LM M a₀ ≤ a₀ ∧
        GlobalRegular2 ell M 12 k (α₀LM M a₀) ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ (UwLM ell M k a₀) ∧
        (∃ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell k (LuLM ell M)),
          0 < dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy (UwLM ell M k a₀) p)) ∧
        InstIneq ell k (by omega) a (LuLM ell M) γ₀ (fullTower ell k (LuLM ell M)) Set.univ (UwLM ell M k a₀) ∧
        ∃ Bt : Bond (LuLM ell M) → SuTwo,
          AdalyFormal.StatementLane.OnLambdaTildeIn (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (LuLM ell M))) ell Bt ∧
          OnLambdaT (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (LuLM ell M))) Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧
          0 < AdalyFormal.StatementLaneG.GenP.genForm
            (gparams ell k (LuLM ell M) (by omega) (fullTower ell k (LuLM ell M)) (UwLM ell M k a₀) a Set.univ)
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (AdalyFormal.StatementLaneG.GenP.genC
              (gparams ell k (LuLM ell M) (by omega) (fullTower ell k (LuLM ell M)) (UwLM ell M k a₀) a Set.univ) Bt))

theorem reach_xi (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (s0 : ℝ) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s0) :
    ∀ (l : List (Fin 3)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (m : ℕ), l.length ≤ m →

theorem mass_row_eq (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ)
    (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) :
    (rowWt (geomOf ell k S) ξ (Ymass (geomOf ell k S) U a (bondWt (-ξ) A)) - Ymass (geomOf ell k S) U a A) p
      = Real.sqrt (massW (geomOf ell k S) a p)
          • (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) U).Qfull

theorem mass_cj_diff (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Sstar : ℝ) (D : RegData ell k Lu S U Sstar) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (θ' : ℝ) (hθ' : 0 ≤ θ')
    (hL : ∀ (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (μ : Fin 3),
      |ξ (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - ξ x| ≤ θ' / (ell : ℝ) ^ AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k x)
    (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ‖rowWt (geomOf ell k S) ξ (Ymass (geomOf ell k S) U a (bondWt (-ξ) A)) - Ymass (geomOf ell k S) U a A‖ ^ 2
      ≤ a * Estar ell Sstar ^ 2 * (Real.exp (6 * (ell : ℝ) * θ') - 1) ^ 2 * (1944 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2)
        * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) A‖ ^ 2

    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → ℝ) (d : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections)
    (Y : Finset {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}) (Pd : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L))

      - (wsB B hell0 Lam ρ hρ hreg hεγ hcG cw hcw hW4 hR8 Sstar Dr bN hbN hext hQs hκ1 c).EN)

    (hq : (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(B.θ * (R * M))) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (v : SuTwo) :
    ∑ b, omJ S ell k b * ‖(iE (geomOf ell k S) ((gparams ell k Lu hell0 S B.U B.a Lam).data.H
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single p v) : FSp (geomOf ell k S)))) b‖
      ≤ (Real.sqrt (3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 7 * B.a * Cgeo ell B.θ) * CH) * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.dlayer_clause1.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.dlayer_clause1
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.dlayer_clause1.header:
theorem dlayer_clause1 {ell M R k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} {W : ℕ}
    (B : CTBase ell M R k S W) (hell0 : 0 < ell) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (CΨ : ℝ) (hCΨ0 : 0 ≤ CΨ)
    (hcol : ∀ (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (v : SuTwo),
      ∑ b, omJ S ell k b * ‖(iE (geomOf ell k S) ((gparams ell k Lu hell0 S B.U B.a Lam).data.H
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single p v) : FSp (geomOf ell k S)))) b‖ ≤ CΨ * ‖v‖)
    (α₀ : ℝ) (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hU : M1Regular ell M 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ B.U)
    (hRM4 : 4 ≤ R * M) (hsmJ : 4 * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀) ≤ 1) (hroom : 18 * ell ≤ R * M)
    (hLu : ∀ μ, ell < Lu μ + 1) (hDQ : DQSmall ell (12 * M * α₀))
    (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S B.U B.a Lam).G)) :
    |⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S B.U B.a Lam).data.Delta2 (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S B.U B.a Lam).data_laws A⟫|
      ≤ 2 * (CΨ * (400 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀))) * K2strat ell (12 * M * α₀)
          * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * CWc B.hS B.hW B.hell B.hR B.hM B.hWR B.U B.a B.cs B.hp (Real.sqrt (max B.a 1)) B.γ ^ 2)
        * wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))

    (hχ0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x) (hχ1 : ∀ x, χ x ≤ 1) (ha1 : 0 ≤ a1) (ha1' : a1 ≤ 1)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.cutH_diff_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.cutH_diff_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.cutH_diff_le.header:
theorem cutH_diff_le (η : ℝ) (χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (A : Bond L → Mt) (a1 a2 lam : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hχ0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x) (hχ1 : ∀ x, χ x ≤ 1) (ha1 : 0 ≤ a1) (ha2 : 0 ≤ a2) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3)
    (h2 : χ (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ≠ 0 →
      η * frobNorm (A (periodicLatticeShift x μ, ν) - A (x, ν)) ≤ a2)
    (h1 : χ x ≠ 0 ∨ χ (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ≠ 0 → η * frobNorm (A (x, ν)) ≤ a1)
    (hlip : |χ (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - χ x| ≤ lam) :
    frobNorm (cutH η χ A (periodicLatticeShift x μ, ν) - cutH η χ A (x, ν)) ≤ a2 + lam * a1

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.cut_plaq.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.cut_plaq
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.cut_plaq.header:
theorem cut_plaq (η : ℝ) (χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (A : Bond L → Mt)
    (hA : ∀ e, (A e)ᴴ = A e ∧ Matrix.trace (A e) = 0) (a1 a2 lam : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hχ0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x) (hχ1 : ∀ x, χ x ≤ 1) (ha1 : 0 ≤ a1) (ha2 : 0 ≤ a2) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (h4 : 4 * a1 ≤ 1)
    (h2 : ∀ (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3), χ (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ≠ 0 →
      η * frobNorm (A (periodicLatticeShift x μ, ν) - A (x, ν)) ≤ a2)
    (h1 : ∀ (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3), χ x ≠ 0 ∨ χ (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ≠ 0 →
      η * frobNorm (A (x, ν)) ≤ a1)
    (hlip : ∀ (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3), |χ (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - χ x| ≤ lam)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy (cutCfg η χ A hA) p) ≤ 2 * (a2 + lam * a1) + 8 * a1 ^ 2 + 512 * a1 ^ 3

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.rhoM0_alpha.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.rhoM0_alpha
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.rhoM0_alpha.header:
theorem rhoM0_alpha (ell n : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (α : ℝ) :
    rhoM0 ell n (α / (ell : ℝ) ^ n) (α / ((ell : ℝ) ^ n) ^ 2) = (1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.C2Comp_depth.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.C2Comp_depth
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.C2Comp_depth.header:
theorem C2Comp_depth (ell n : ℕ) (Lu' : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (V : Cfg (scaleUp ell n Lu'))
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hlinks : ∀ b, dv (V b) ≤ α / (ell : ℝ) ^ n)
    (hplaq : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell n Lu'), dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy V p) ≤ α / ((ell : ℝ) ^ n) ^ 2)
    (hN : ∀ ρ, 2 * ell ^ n < scaleUp ell n Lu' ρ + 1)
    (hcb : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * α ≤ 1)
    (H : KUSmall ell ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α))
    (h1000 : (1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (hK2c : 1536 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α)) < 1 - 1 / (ell : ℝ))
    (a : XS (scaleUp ell n Lu')) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond (scaleUp ell n Lu') (ell ^ n),
        ‖suOf (C2CompL ell (bgTower (GF ell n Lu') V) n a (c.1.1, c.2))‖
      ≤ K2free ell ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α) * (1 / (ell : ℝ)) ^ n * nrm 1 a ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.C2Comp_depth_any.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.C2Comp_depth_any
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.C2Comp_depth_any.header:
theorem C2Comp_depth_any (ell n : ℕ) (Lu' L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : scaleUp ell n Lu' = L) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (V : Cfg L) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hlinks : ∀ b, dv (V b) ≤ α / (ell : ℝ) ^ n)
    (hplaq : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy V p) ≤ α / ((ell : ℝ) ^ n) ^ 2)
    (hN : ∀ ρ, 2 * ell ^ n < L ρ + 1)
    (hcb : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * α ≤ 1)
    (H : KUSmall ell ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α))
    (h1000 : (1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (hK2c : 1536 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α)) < 1 - 1 / (ell : ℝ))
    (a : XS L) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L (ell ^ n),
        ‖suOf (C2CompL ell (AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.UbarTower AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.su2LogExp ell V)
          n a (c.1.1, c.2))‖
      ≤ K2free ell ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α) * (1 / (ell : ℝ)) ^ n * nrm 1 a ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.distOm.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.distOm
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.distOm.header: noncomputable def distOm (S : Tower L) (n : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.distOm_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.distOm_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.distOm_le.header:
theorem distOm_le {S : Tower L} {n : ℕ} {x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ S.Om n) :
    distOm S n x ≤ pdist x y

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.distOm_spec.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.distOm_spec
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.distOm_spec.header:
theorem distOm_spec {S : Tower L} {n : ℕ} (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {y0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy0 : y0 ∈ S.Om n) :
    ∃ y ∈ S.Om n, pdist x y ≤ distOm S n x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.distOm_shift_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.distOm_shift_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.distOm_shift_le.header:
theorem distOm_shift_le {S : Tower L} {n : ℕ} {y0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy0 : y0 ∈ S.Om n)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : distOm S n (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ≤ distOm S n x + 1

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.distOm_le_shift.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.distOm_le_shift
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.distOm_le_shift.header:
theorem distOm_le_shift {S : Tower L} {n : ℕ} {y0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy0 : y0 ∈ S.Om n)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : distOm S n x ≤ distOm S n (periodicLatticeShift x μ) + 1

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.clamp_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.clamp_lip
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.clamp_lip.header: theorem clamp_lip (a b : ℝ) : |min 1 (max 0 a) - min 1 (max 0 b)| ≤ |a - b|

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiC.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiC
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiC.header: noncomputable def chiC (S : Tower L) (n : ℕ) (r0 w : ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN.header: noncomputable def chiN (S : Tower L) (n : ℕ) (r0 w : ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiC_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiC_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiC_nonneg.header: theorem chiC_nonneg (S : Tower L) (n : ℕ) (r0 w : ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 0 ≤ chiC S n r0 w x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiC_le_one.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiC_le_one
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiC_le_one.header: theorem chiC_le_one (S : Tower L) (n : ℕ) (r0 w : ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : chiC S n r0 w x ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN_nonneg.header: theorem chiN_nonneg (S : Tower L) (n : ℕ) (r0 w : ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 0 ≤ chiN S n r0 w x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN_le_one.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN_le_one
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN_le_one.header: theorem chiN_le_one (S : Tower L) (n : ℕ) (r0 w : ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : chiN S n r0 w x ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN_lip
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN_lip.header:
theorem chiN_lip (S : Tower L) (n : ℕ) (r0 w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    |chiN S n r0 w (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - chiN S n r0 w x| ≤ 1 / w

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN_eq_one.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN_eq_one
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN_eq_one.header:
theorem chiN_eq_one (S : Tower L) (n : ℕ) (r0 w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w) {x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ S.Om n)
    (hd : (pdist x y : ℝ) ≤ r0) : chiN S n r0 w x = 1

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN_ne_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.chiN_ne_zero.header:
theorem chiN_ne_zero (S : Tower L) (n : ℕ) (r0 w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (h : chiN S n r0 w x ≠ 0) : ∃ y ∈ S.Om n, (pdist x y : ℝ) < r0 + w

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.mem_prev.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.mem_prev
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.mem_prev.header:
theorem mem_prev (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) {n : ℕ} (hn1 : 1 ≤ n) (hnk : n ≤ k)
    {y z : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ S.Om n) (hd : pdist z y ≤ R * M * ell ^ (n - 1)) : z ∈ S.Om (n - 1)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.bstrat_ge_prev.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.bstrat_ge_prev
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.bstrat_ge_prev.header:
theorem bstrat_ge_prev (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) {n : ℕ} (hn1 : 1 ≤ n) (hnk : n ≤ k)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ S.Om n) (e : Bond L) (h1 : pdist e.1 y ≤ R * M * ell ^ (n - 1))
    (h2 : pdist (periodicLatticeShift e.1 e.2) y ≤ R * M * ell ^ (n - 1)) : n - 1 ≤ bstrat S k e

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.strat_le_of_near.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.strat_le_of_near
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.strat_le_of_near.header:
theorem strat_le_of_near (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) {n : ℕ} (hnk : n ≤ k) {y z : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hy : y ∈ S.Om n) (hy' : y ∉ S.Om (n + 1)) (hd : pdist y z ≤ R * (M * ell ^ (n + 1))) : strat S k z ≤ n + 1

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.row_anchor.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.row_anchor
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.row_anchor.header:
theorem row_anchor (ell k : ℕ) (S : Tower L) {n : ℕ} {b : Bond L} (hb : b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) n) :
    ∃ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ S.Om n ∧ y ∉ S.Om (n + 1) ∧ pdist b.1 y ≤ ell ^ n ∧ (∀ μ, ell ^ n ∣ (y μ).val)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.row_base_aligned.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.row_base_aligned
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.row_base_aligned.header:
theorem row_base_aligned (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    {n : ℕ} (hnk : n ≤ k) {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hb : b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) n) :
    b.1 ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ n)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.room_prev.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.room_prev
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.room_prev.header:
theorem room_prev (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hroom : 18 * ell ≤ R * M) {n : ℕ} (hn1 : 1 ≤ n) :
    2 + 2 * rhoT ell n + ell ^ n + ell ^ (n - 1) ≤ R * M * ell ^ (n - 1)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.room_next.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.room_next
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.room_next.header:
theorem room_next (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hroom : 18 * ell ≤ R * M) (n : ℕ) :
    ell ^ n + rhoT ell n ≤ R * (M * ell ^ (n + 1))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.goodN.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.goodN
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.goodN.header:
theorem goodN (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hroom : 18 * ell ≤ R * M) {n : ℕ} (hn1 : 1 ≤ n)
    (hnk : n ≤ k) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hx : chiN S n ((2 * rhoT ell n + ell ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ) ((ell : ℝ) ^ (n - 1)) x ≠ 0)
    (e : Bond L) (he : pdist x e.1 ≤ 1) : n - 1 ≤ bstrat S k e

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.alphaQ.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.alphaQ
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.alphaQ.header: noncomputable def alphaQ (ell : ℕ) (β : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.K2strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.K2strat
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.K2strat.header: noncomputable def K2strat (ell : ℕ) (β : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.alphaQ_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.alphaQ_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.alphaQ_nonneg.header: theorem alphaQ_nonneg (ell : ℕ) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 ≤ β) : 0 ≤ alphaQ ell β

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.units1.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.units1
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.units1.header: theorem units1 (η c X : ℝ) (P : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (hP : 0 < P) (h : X < c * ((P * η)⁻¹) ^ 1) : η * X ≤ c / P

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.units2.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.units2
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.units2.header:
theorem units2 (η c : ℝ) (D : Mt) (P : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (hP : 0 < P)
    (h : frobNorm (η⁻¹ • D) < c * ((P * η)⁻¹) ^ 2) : η * frobNorm D ≤ c / P ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.levelCfg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.levelCfg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.levelCfg.header:
noncomputable def levelCfg (S : Tower L) (ell n : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (A : Bond L → Mt)
    (hA : ∀ e, (A e)ᴴ = A e ∧ Matrix.trace (A e) = 0) : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.level_bounds.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.level_bounds
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.level_bounds.header:
theorem level_bounds (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hroom : 18 * ell ≤ R * M) {n : ℕ}
    (hn1 : 1 ≤ n) (hnk : n ≤ k) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (α₀ : ℝ) (A : Bond L → Mt)
    (hB : M1Bounds S ell M 12 k α₀ η A) (hHT : ∀ e, (A e)ᴴ = A e ∧ Matrix.trace (A e) = 0)
    (hβ0 : 0 ≤ 12 * (M : ℝ) * α₀) (h4 : 4 * (12 * (M : ℝ) * α₀) ≤ 1) :
    (∀ b, dv (levelCfg S ell n η A hHT b) ≤ alphaQ ell (12 * M * α₀) / (ell : ℝ) ^ n) ∧
    (∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy (levelCfg S ell n η A hHT) p)
      ≤ alphaQ ell (12 * M * α₀) / ((ell : ℝ) ^ n) ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.maskN.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.maskN
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.maskN.header: noncomputable def maskN (S : Tower L) (k n : ℕ) (x : BondFnL2 L) : BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.maskN_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.maskN_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.maskN_norm_sq.header:
theorem maskN_norm_sq (S : Tower L) (k n : ℕ) (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    ‖maskN S k n x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ e, if n ≤ bstrat S k e + 1 ∧ bstrat S k e ≤ n + 1 then ‖(WithLp.ofLp x) e‖ ^ 2 else 0

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.count_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.count_bound
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.count_bound.header:
theorem count_bound (ell k s : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    ∑ n : Fin (k + 1), (if (n : ℕ) ≤ s + 1 ∧ s ≤ (n : ℕ) + 1 then (((ell : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ))⁻¹) ^ 2 else 0)
      ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * (((ell : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.masks_le_wnorm.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.masks_le_wnorm
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.masks_le_wnorm.header:
theorem masks_le_wnorm (S : Tower L) (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    ∑ n : Fin (k + 1), (((ell : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ))⁻¹) ^ 2 * ‖maskN S k n x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * wnormSq S ell k x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.C2full_norm.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.C2full_norm
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.C2full_norm.header:
theorem C2full_norm {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.TowerGeom L) (V : Cfg L)
    (x : BondFnL2 L) (p : BIdx G) :
    ‖C2fullOf G V x p‖ = ((G.ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ))⁻¹ * ‖suOf (C2CompL G.ell (bgTower G V) p.1 (suCoord x) p.2.1)‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.gauge_C2full_nor.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.gauge_C2full_norm
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.gauge_C2full_nor.header:
theorem gauge_C2full_norm {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (z : BondFnL2 L) (p : BIdx G) :
    ‖C2fullOf G U z p‖ = ‖C2fullOf G (periodicGaugeTransform g U) (AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adBL g z) p‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.gauge_wnorm.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.gauge_wnorm
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.gauge_wnorm.header:
theorem gauge_wnorm {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (S : Tower L) (ell k : ℕ)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (z : BondFnL2 L) :
    wnormSq S ell k (AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adBL g z) = wnormSq S ell k z

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.scaleUp_split.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.scaleUp_split
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.scaleUp_split.header:
theorem scaleUp_split (ell k n : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (hnk : n ≤ k) :
    scaleUp ell n (scaleUp ell (k - n) Lu) = scaleUp ell k Lu

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.torus_big.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.torus_big
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.torus_big.header:
theorem torus_big (ell k n : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hLu : ∀ μ, ell < Lu μ + 1)
    (hnk : n ≤ k) (ρ : Fin 3) : 2 * ell ^ n < scaleUp ell k Lu ρ + 1

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.K2free_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.K2free_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.K2free_nonneg.header: theorem K2free_nonneg (ell : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hθ : thetaK2 ell ρ < 1) : 0 ≤ K2free ell ρ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.thetaK2_lt_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.thetaK2_lt_of
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.thetaK2_lt_of.header:
theorem thetaK2_lt_of (ell : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ)
    (h : 1536 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ρ) < 1 - 1 / (ell : ℝ)) : thetaK2 ell ρ < 1

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.rowF.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.rowF
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.rowF.header:
noncomputable def rowF (ell k : ℕ) (Vc : ℕ → Cfg L) (xs : ℕ → BondFnL2 L)
    (q : Σ n : Fin (k + 1), CoarseBond L (ell ^ (n : ℕ))) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.rowF_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.rowF_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.rowF_nonneg.header:
theorem rowF_nonneg (ell k : ℕ) (Vc : ℕ → Cfg L) (xs : ℕ → BondFnL2 L)
    (q : Σ n : Fin (k + 1), CoarseBond L (ell ^ (n : ℕ))) : 0 ≤ rowF ell k Vc xs q

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.rowF_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.rowF_zero
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.rowF_zero.header:
theorem rowF_zero (ell k : ℕ) (Vc : ℕ → Cfg L) (xs : ℕ → BondFnL2 L) (n : Fin (k + 1)) (hn : (n : ℕ) = 0)
    (c : CoarseBond L (ell ^ (n : ℕ))) : rowF ell k Vc xs ⟨n, c⟩ = 0

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.C2full_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.C2full_strat
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.C2full_strat.header:
theorem C2full_strat (ell M R k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hroom : 18 * ell ≤ R * M) (hLu : ∀ μ, ell < Lu μ + 1) (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀)
    (hU : M1Regular ell M 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U) (hsm : DQSmall ell (12 * M * α₀))
    (z : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ p, ‖C2fullOf (geomOf ell k S) U z p‖ ≤ K2strat ell (12 * M * α₀) * wnormSq S ell k z

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.dqSmall_exists.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.dqSmall_exists
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.dqSmall_exists.header:
theorem dqSmall_exists (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) :
    ∃ β₀ : ℝ, 0 < β₀ ∧ ∀ β : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → β ≤ β₀ → DQSmall ell β

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.thetaK2_mono.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.thetaK2_mono

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.C2full_strat_win.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.C2full_strat_window
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.C2full_strat_win.header:
theorem C2full_strat_window (ell : ℕ) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) :
    ∃ β₀ : ℝ, 0 < β₀ ∧ ∃ K2 : ℝ, 0 ≤ K2 ∧
      ∀ (M R k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
        (α₀ : ℝ), Admissible ell M R k S → 18 * ell ≤ R * M → (∀ μ, ell < Lu μ + 1) → 0 ≤ α₀ →
        (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ β₀ → M1Regular ell M 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U →
        ∀ z : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
          ∑ p, ‖C2fullOf (geomOf ell k S) U z p‖ ≤ K2 * wnormSq S ell k z

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.hC2_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.hC2_strat
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.hC2_strat.header:

    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ)
    (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hroom : 18 * ell ≤ R * M) (hLu : ∀ μ, ell < Lu μ + 1)
    (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hU : M1Regular ell M 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U) (hsm : DQSmall ell (12 * M * α₀)) :
    ∀ z : BondFnL2 (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).Lf,
      ∑ p, ‖C2fullOf (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).U z p‖
        ≤ K2strat ell (12 * M * α₀) * wnormSq (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).S (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).ell
          (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).k z

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.hC2_strat_window.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.hC2_strat_window
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.DQ.hC2_strat_window.header:
theorem hC2_strat_window (ell : ℕ) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) :

        (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ),
        Admissible ell M R k S → 18 * ell ≤ R * M → (∀ μ, ell < Lu μ + 1) → 0 ≤ α₀ →
        (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ β₀ → M1Regular ell M 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U →
        ∀ z : BondFnL2 (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).Lf,
          ∑ p, ‖C2fullOf (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).U z p‖

              (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).k z

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.drift_D_loc.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.drift_D_loc
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.drift_D_loc.header:
theorem drift_D_loc (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)
    (V : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (W : ℕ → ℕ → Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hcl : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∀ l, l < k → ∀ z ∈ W j l, z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ l) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((bgTower (GF ell k Lu) V l (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ ε j l)
    (hε0 : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∀ l, l < k → 0 ≤ ε j l)
    (hsm : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∀ l, l < k → rhoOf ell (ε j l) < Real.pi / 2)
    (hr : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∀ l, l < k → Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ε j l) < r0)
    (hW : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1),
      ∀ r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j}, ∀ l, l < (j : ℕ) →
        Ball r.1.1 (rhoT ell j - rhoT ell l) ⊆ W j l)
    (Sstar : ℝ) (hSstar : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∑ l ∈ range (j : ℕ), thetaOf ell (ε j l) ≤ Sstar)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ p, wD p * ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull x p
        - (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * delStar ell Sstar ^ 2 * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bond_rightinv_of_dr.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bond_rightinv_of_drift
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bond_rightinv_of_dr.header:
theorem bond_rightinv_of_drift (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (Dd : ℝ) (hDd : 0 ≤ Dd)
    (hdr : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      ∑ p, wD p * ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) U).Qfull x p
        - (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2 ≤ Dd * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k x)
    (hsmall : Dd * CwE ell ≤ 1 / 4) (u : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ∃ x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S)), (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).data.Q x = u ∧
      AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ≤ 4 * CwE ell * nD u ∧
      ∀ ν0 : Fin 3, gradW (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ν0 ≤ 4 * CgE ell * nD u

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.drift_D_M1.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.drift_D_M1
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.drift_D_M1.header:
theorem drift_D_M1 (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R) (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ p, wD p * ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (periodicGaugeTransform g U)).Qfull x p
        - (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * delStar ell (SstarM ell f M α₀) ^ 2 * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bond_rightinv_M1.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bond_rightinv_M1
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bond_rightinv_M1.header:
theorem bond_rightinv_M1 (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hsmall : 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * delStar ell (SstarM ell f M α₀) ^ 2 * CwE ell ≤ 1 / 4)
    (u : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ∃ x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S)),
      (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).data.Q x = u ∧
      AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ≤ 4 * CwE ell * nD u ∧
      ∀ ν0 : Fin 3, gradW (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ν0 ≤ 4 * CgE ell * nD u

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.psi_le_of_wcol.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.psi_le_of_wcol
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.psi_le_of_wcol.header:
theorem psi_le_of_wcol (P : IngrBParams) (ω : Bond P.Lf → ℝ) (CΨ SJ : ℝ) (hCΨ : 0 ≤ CΨ) (hSJ : 0 ≤ SJ)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.psi1u_le_of_wcol.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.psi1u_le_of_wcol
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.psi1u_le_of_wcol.header:
theorem psi1u_le_of_wcol (P : IngrBParams) (ω : Bond P.Lf → ℝ) (CH1 SJ : ℝ) (hCH1 : 0 ≤ CH1) (hSJ : 0 ≤ SJ)

      ∑ b, ω b * ‖(P.H1in (WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single e v) : BondFnL2 P.Lu)) b‖ ≤ CH1 * ‖v‖)
    (hJ : ∀ b, ‖P.Jf b‖ ≤ SJ * ω b) : ‖psi1u P e‖ ≤ CH1 * SJ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.delta2_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.delta2_strat
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.delta2_strat.header:
theorem delta2_strat (P : IngrBParams) (Sψ K2 CW : ℝ) (hS : 0 ≤ Sψ) (hK2 : 0 ≤ K2)
    (hψ : ∀ p, ‖psiD P p‖ ≤ Sψ)
    (hC : ∀ z : BondFnL2 P.Lf, ∑ p, ‖C2fullOf P.G P.U z p‖ ≤ K2 * wnormSq P.S P.ell P.k z)
    (hW : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp P.G), wnormSq P.S P.ell P.k (Wop P.G P.U P.a (iE P.G A))
      ≤ CW * wnormSq P.S P.ell P.k (A : BondFnL2 P.Lf))
    (A : ↥(bondSupp P.G)) :
    |⟪A, P.data.Delta2 P.data_laws A⟫| ≤ 2 * Sψ * K2 * CW * wnormSq P.S P.ell P.k (A : BondFnL2 P.Lf)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.hJ_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.hJ_strat
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.hJ_strat.header:
theorem hJ_strat (P : IngrBParams) (ω : Bond P.Lf → ℝ) (CH1 SJ KD : ℝ) (hCH1 : 0 ≤ CH1) (hSJ : 0 ≤ SJ)
    (hcol : ∀ (e : Bond P.Lu) (v : SuTwo),
      ∑ b, ω b * ‖(P.H1in (WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single e v) : BondFnL2 P.Lu)) b‖ ≤ CH1 * ‖v‖)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.dparts_bounds.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.dparts_bounds
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.dparts_bounds.header:
theorem dparts_bounds (P : IngrBParams) (ω : Bond P.Lf → ℝ) (SJ CΨ K2 CW CH1 KD : ℝ)
