AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Jf_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Jf_strat
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.Jf_strat.header:
theorem Jf_strat (ell M R k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ)
    (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hRM : 4 ≤ R * M)
    (hU : M1Regular ell M 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U) (hsm : 4 * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀) ≤ 1)
    (b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ‖(gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).Jf b‖ ≤ (400 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀)) * omJ S ell k b

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.RMap_sub_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.RMap_sub_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.RMap_sub_le.header:
theorem RMap_sub_le (g : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (v : SuTwo) :
    ‖RMap g v - v‖ ≤ 2 * frobNorm ((g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.RMap_inv_sub_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.RMap_inv_sub_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.RMap_inv_sub_le.header:
theorem RMap_inv_sub_le (g : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (v : SuTwo) :
    ‖RMap g⁻¹ v - v‖ ≤ 2 * frobNorm ((g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bstrat_next.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bstrat_next
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.bstrat_next.header:
theorem bstrat_next (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    bstrat S k (periodicLatticeShift x μ, ν) ≤ bstrat S k (x, μ) + 1

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.grad_sub.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.grad_sub
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.grad_sub.header:
theorem grad_sub (B : BondFnL2 Lf) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf, ‖B (periodicLatticeShift x μ, ν) - B (x, ν)‖ ^ 2 ≤ gradW B μ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.gradW_le_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.gradW_le_sum
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.gradW_le_sum.header: theorem gradW_le_sum (B : BondFnL2 Lf) (μ : Fin 3) : gradW B μ ≤ ∑ ν : Fin 3, gradW B ν

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.wdir_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.wdir_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.wdir_le.header:
theorem wdir_le (B : BondFnL2 Lf) (ν : Fin 3) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf, (((ell : ℝ) ^ bstrat S k (x, ν))⁻¹) ^ 2 * ‖B (x, ν)‖ ^ 2 ≤ wnormSq S ell k B

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.link_term.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.link_term
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.link_term.header:
theorem link_term (V : Cfg Lf) (ρL : ℝ) (hρL : 0 ≤ ρL)
    (hlink : ∀ b : Bond Lf, frobNorm (((V b : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
      ≤ ρL / (ell : ℝ) ^ bstrat S k b)
    (B : BondFnL2 Lf) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    ‖RMap (V (x, μ)) (B (periodicLatticeShift x μ, ν)) - B (periodicLatticeShift x μ, ν)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 4 * ρL ^ 2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2
        * ((((ell : ℝ) ^ bstrat S k (periodicLatticeShift x μ, ν))⁻¹) ^ 2 * ‖B (periodicLatticeShift x μ, ν)‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.curl_upper.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.curl_upper
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.curl_upper.header:
theorem curl_upper (V : Cfg Lf) (ρL : ℝ) (hρL : 0 ≤ ρL)
    (hlink : ∀ b : Bond Lf, frobNorm (((V b : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
      ≤ ρL / (ell : ℝ) ^ bstrat S k b)
    (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖plaqMask (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) (curlCovariantLM_L2 V B)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 24 * ∑ ν : Fin 3, gradW B ν + 96 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * ρL ^ 2 * wnormSq S ell k B

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.div_upper.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.div_upper
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.div_upper.header:
theorem div_upper (V : Cfg Lf) (ρL : ℝ) (hρL : 0 ≤ ρL)
    (hlink : ∀ b : Bond Lf, frobNorm (((V b : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
      ≤ ρL / (ell : ℝ) ^ bstrat S k b)
    (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖gradAdj V B‖ ^ 2 ≤ 6 * ∑ ν : Fin 3, gradW B ν + 24 * ρL ^ 2 * wnormSq S ell k B

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.etaS.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.etaS
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.etaS.header: noncomputable def etaS (ell W : ℕ) (cs ρ ε1 : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.etaS_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.etaS_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.etaS_nonneg.header:
theorem etaS_nonneg (ell W : ℕ) (cs ρ ε1 : ℝ) (hcs : 0 < cs) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1)
    (hd : 0 ≤ Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1) : 0 ≤ etaS ell W cs ρ ε1

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ginv_upper.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ginv_upper
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.ginv_upper.header:
theorem ginv_upper (hell0 : 0 < ell) (V : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a cs : ℝ)
    (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) V a cs)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k V ρ) (ε1 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1)
    (ρL : ℝ) (hρL : 0 ≤ ρL)
    (hlink : ∀ b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      frobNorm (((V b : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρL / (ell : ℝ) ^ bstrat S k b)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (A : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫
      ≤ (1 + etaS ell W cs ρ ε1) * (30 * ∑ ν : Fin 3, gradW (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ν
          + (96 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 + 24) * ρL ^ 2 * wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
          + ‖Ymass (geomOf ell k S) V a (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))‖ ^ 2)
        + 2 * ((17 / Real.sqrt 2) * 12 * (ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)) * wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.hext_of_rightinv.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.hext_of_rightinv
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.hext_of_rightinv.header:
theorem hext_of_rightinv (hell0 : 0 < ell) (V : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a cs : ℝ)
    (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) V a cs)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k V ρ) (ε1 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1)
    (ρL : ℝ) (hρL : 0 ≤ ρL)
    (hlink : ∀ b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      frobNorm (((V b : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρL / (ell : ℝ) ^ bstrat S k b)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (cW cG : ℝ) (hcW : 0 ≤ cW) (hcG : 0 ≤ cG)
    (hR : ∀ u : FSp (geomOf ell k S), ∃ x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S)),
      (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).data.Q x = u ∧
      wnormSq S ell k (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ≤ cW * nD u ∧
      ∀ ν0 : Fin 3, gradW (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ν0 ≤ cG * nD u)
    (v : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ∃ g : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S)), (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).data.Q g = v ∧
      ⟪g, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).data.Ginv g⟫
        ≤ ((1 + etaS ell W cs ρ ε1) * (90 * cG + (96 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 + 24) * ρL ^ 2 * cW) / a
            + 2 * ((17 / Real.sqrt 2) * 12 * (ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)) * cW / a + (1 + etaS ell W cs ρ ε1))
          * ‖diagW (geomOf ell k S) (fun p => Real.sqrt (massW (geomOf ell k S) a p)) v‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uTerm.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uTerm
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uTerm.header: noncomputable def uTerm (S : Tower L) (ell M R i : ℕ) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT.header: noncomputable def uT (S : Tower L) (ell M R i : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uTerm_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uTerm_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uTerm_nonneg.header: theorem uTerm_nonneg (S : Tower L) (ell M R i : ℕ) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 0 ≤ uTerm S ell M R i x y

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_nonneg.header: theorem uT_nonneg (S : Tower L) (ell M R i : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 0 ≤ uT S ell M R i x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_le_one.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_le_one
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_le_one.header: theorem uT_le_one (S : Tower L) (ell M R i : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : uT S ell M R i x ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_zero_of_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_zero_of_mem
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_zero_of_mem.header:
theorem uT_zero_of_mem (S : Tower L) (ell M R i : ℕ) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ S.Om i) :
    uT S ell M R i x = 0

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_one_of_not_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_one_of_not_mem
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_one_of_not_mem.header:
theorem uT_one_of_not_mem {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) {i : ℕ} (hi : 1 ≤ i) (hik : i ≤ k) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∉ S.Om (i - 1)) :
    uT S ell M R i x = 1

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_lip
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_lip.header:
theorem uT_lip (S : Tower L) (ell M R i : ℕ) (x x' : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    |uT S ell M R i x - uT S ell M R i x'| ≤ (pdist x x' : ℝ) / ((R : ℝ) * M * (ell : ℝ) ^ (i - 1))

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_step.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_step
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.uT_step.header:
theorem uT_step {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) {i : ℕ} (hi : 1 ≤ i) (hik : i ≤ k) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    (h1 : strat S k x ≠ i - 1) (h2 : strat S k (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ≠ i - 1) :
    uT S ell M R i (periodicLatticeShift x μ) = uT S ell M R i x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC.header: noncomputable def phiC (S : Tower L) (ell M R k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.sum_uT_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.sum_uT_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.sum_uT_nonneg.header:
theorem sum_uT_nonneg (S : Tower L) (ell M R k : ℕ) (c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (strat S k c), uT S ell M R i x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_nonneg.header:
theorem phiC_nonneg (S : Tower L) (ell M R k : ℕ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    0 ≤ phiC S ell M R k θ c x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_self.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_self
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_self.header:
theorem phiC_self {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (θ : ℝ) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    phiC S ell M R k θ c c = 0

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.sum_uT_step.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.sum_uT_step
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.sum_uT_step.header:
theorem sum_uT_step {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    |∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (strat S k c), uT S ell M R i (periodicLatticeShift x μ)
        - ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (strat S k c), uT S ell M R i x|
      ≤ 2 * (ell : ℝ) / ((R : ℝ) * M * (ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k x)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_step.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_step
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_step.header:
theorem phiC_step {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    |phiC S ell M R k θ c (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - phiC S ell M R k θ c x|
      ≤ 3 * θ * ell / (ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.wTerm_lip_pd.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.wTerm_lip_pd
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.wTerm_lip_pd.header:
theorem wTerm_lip_pd (R M ell s m : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (c x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    |wTerm R M ell s m c x - wTerm R M ell s m c y| ≤ (pdist x y : ℝ) / (ell : ℝ) ^ m

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.stratWeight_block.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.stratWeight_block
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.stratWeight_block.header:
theorem stratWeight_block {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {j : ℕ} {x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : strat S k x = j) (hy : strat S k y = j)
    (hxy : (pdist x y : ℝ) ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ j) :
    |stratWeight S ell M R k c x - stratWeight S ell M R k c y| ≤ 3

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_block.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_block
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_block.header:
theorem phiC_block {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {j : ℕ} {x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hx0 : x ∈ S.Om 0) (hy0 : y ∈ S.Om 0)
    (hx : strat S k x = j) (hy : strat S k y = j) (hxy : (pdist x y : ℝ) ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ j) :
    |phiC S ell M R k θ c x - phiC S ell M R k θ c y| ≤ 6 * θ

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.sum_uT_ge.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.sum_uT_ge
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.sum_uT_ge.header:
theorem sum_uT_ge {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ((strat S k c - 1 - strat S k x : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (strat S k c), uT S ell M R i x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.strat_factor_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.strat_factor_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.strat_factor_le.header:
theorem strat_factor_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 1 ≤ ell) {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq : (ell : ℝ) ^ 4 * q ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (s t : ℕ) : (((ell : ℝ) ^ t)⁻¹) ^ 4 * q ^ (2 * (s - 1 - t)) ≤ (((ell : ℝ) ^ (s - 1))⁻¹) ^ 4

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_colsum.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_colsum
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_colsum.header:
theorem phiC_colsum {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (hq : (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(θ * (R * M))) ≤ 1 / 2) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (((ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k x)⁻¹) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-(2 * phiC S ell M R k θ c x))
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 4 * (64 + 8 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 / θ ^ 3) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k c)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.pdist_block.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.pdist_block
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.pdist_block.header: theorem pdist_block {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {n : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ blockOf y n) : pdist y x ≤ 3 * n

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.strat_block.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.strat_block
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.strat_block.header:
theorem strat_block {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j)
    (hx : x ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j)) : strat S k x = j ∧ x ∈ S.Om 0

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_WtOK.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_WtOK
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_WtOK.header:
theorem phiC_WtOK {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    WtOK (geomOf ell k S) ell (phiC S ell M R k θ c) (3 * θ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) (6 * θ)

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_lip
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.phiC_lip.header:
theorem phiC_lip {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    |phiC S ell M R k θ c (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - phiC S ell M R k θ c x|
      ≤ 3 * θ * ell / (ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k x

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.rowBase_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.rowBase_strat
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.rowBase_strat.header:
theorem rowBase_strat (hRM : ell ≤ R * M) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) :
    (p.1 : ℕ) ≤ strat S k (rowBase (geomOf ell k S) p) + 1

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.hlink_all.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.hlink_all
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.hlink_all.header:
theorem hlink_all {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell M f k : ℕ} (S : Tower L) {α₀ η : ℝ} (U : LinkCfg L)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (A : Bond L → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hU : ∀ e : Bond L, ((periodicGaugeTransform g U e : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
      = NormedSpace.exp (((η : ℂ) * Complex.I) • A e))
    (hB : M1Bounds S ell M f k α₀ η A) (hη : 0 < η) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (ha0 : 0 ≤ (f : ℝ) * M * α₀) (b : Bond L) :
    frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform g U b : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
      ≤ rho1 f M α₀ / (ell : ℝ) ^ bstrat S k b

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.coercive_to_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.coercive_to_gauge
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.coercive_to_gauge.header:
theorem coercive_to_gauge (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (γ : GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (c : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G),
      c * wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ≤ ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫)
    (A' : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) a Lam).G)) :
    c * wnormSq S ell k (A' : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
      ≤ ⟪A', (gparams ell k Lu hell S (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) a Lam).data.Ginv A'⟫

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.dlayer_form_ungauge.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.dlayer_form_ungauge
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.dlayer_form_ungauge.header:
theorem dlayer_form_ungauge (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (γ : GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ A' : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) a Lam).G),
      |⟪A', (gparams ell k Lu hell S (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) a Lam).data.Delta2
          (gparams ell k Lu hell S (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) a Lam).data_laws A'⟫|
        ≤ ε * wnormSq S ell k (A' : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G)) :

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.eps2N_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.eps2N_le
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.eps2N_le.header:
theorem eps2N_le (ell M W : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (a θ α₀ CH cs γ CWb : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hCH : 0 ≤ CH) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α₀)

      (∀ μ, 5 ≤ Lu μ + 1) → (∀ μ, ell < Lu μ + 1) → 0 ≤ α₀ → (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ t₀ →
      ∀ (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)), M1Regular ell M 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U →

      (∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).G),

      ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).G),
        |⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data.Delta2 (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data_laws A⟫|

theorem clause2_Ug (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hW4 : ∀ A' : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S)),

        |⟪(gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).H1in ((gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).D2in Bt),

AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.delta2_conj.name: AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.delta2_conj
AdalyFormal.M1DStrat.delta2_conj.header:
theorem delta2_conj (hell0 : 0 < ell) (V : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (ξ : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → ℝ) (kW : ℝ) (hkW : 0 ≤ kW)
    (hWp : ∀ z, ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (bondWt (-ξ) (Wop (geomOf ell k S) V a (bondWt ξ z)))‖
      ≤ kW * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) z‖)
    (hWm : ∀ z, ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (bondWt ξ (Wop (geomOf ell k S) V a (bondWt (-ξ) z)))‖
      ≤ kW * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) z‖)
    (Ω : ℝ) (hΩ : 0 ≤ Ω)
    (hosc : ∀ p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S), 1 ≤ (p.1 : ℕ) → ∀ e : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      e.1 ∈ Ball p.2.1.1 (rhoT ell p.1) → |ξ e.1 - ξ p.2.1.1| ≤ Ω)
    (Sψ : ℝ) (hSψ : 0 ≤ Sψ) (hψ : ∀ p, ‖psiD (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam) p‖ ≤ Sψ)
    (K2 : ℝ) (hK2 : 0 ≤ K2)
    (hC : ∀ z, ∑ q, ‖C2fullOf (geomOf ell k S) V z q‖ ≤ K2 * ‖wq S ell k z‖ ^ 2)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (A B : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    |⟪eW (geomOf ell k S) ξ A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).data.Delta2 (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).data_laws
        (eW (geomOf ell k S) (-ξ) B)⟫|
      ≤ 2 * Sψ * K2 * Real.exp (2 * Ω) * 44217 * ((ell : ℝ) * kW) ^ 2
        * ‖wq S ell k (iE (geomOf ell k S) A)‖ * ‖wq S ell k (iE (geomOf ell k S) B)‖

        else 0

AdalyFormal.DatumWitness.terminal_posDef.header:

AdalyFormal.DatumWitness.curved_source_b.name: AdalyFormal.DatumWitness.curved_source_bearing_witness_at_noncollapsed_datum
AdalyFormal.DatumWitness.curved_source_b.header:
theorem curved_source_bearing_witness_at_noncollapsed_datum
    (bc : BaseConstant) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps)
    (w : TildeFn witnessL 2) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    (¬ Function.Injective (starDatum bc heps).Q)
    ∧ (∃ k : BondFnL2 fineL, k ≠ 0 ∧ (starDatum bc heps).Q k = 0)
    ∧ (∀ B : BondFnL2 witnessL, ∃ A : BondFnL2 fineL, (starDatum bc heps).Q A = B
        ∧ A ≠ solutionOperator (starDatum bc heps) B
        ∧ (inner ℝ (solutionOperator (starDatum bc heps) B)
              ((starDatum bc heps).Ginv (solutionOperator (starDatum bc heps) B)) : ℝ)
          < inner ℝ A ((starDatum bc heps).Ginv A))
    ∧ ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ 1
      ∧ AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaPrime.holonomyElem (spikeU (torus t))
          AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantOperators.witnessPlaquette ≠ 1
      ∧ 0 < frobSupBond (spikeU (torus t))
      ∧ frobSupBond (spikeU (torus t)) ≤ 1 / (6668 * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3)
      ∧ JsuTwo (spikeU (torus t)) ≠ 0
      ∧ 0 < sourceTerm (starDatum bc heps) (bondQext (JsuTwo (spikeU (torus t))))
            ((starDatum bc heps).Qstar (JsuTwo (spikeU (torus t))))
            (cZero (spikeU (torus t)) 2 (dinvC (spikeU (torus t)) 2) w)
      ∧ 0 < cdcFormTrue (starDatum bc heps) bc
            (bondQext (JsuTwo (spikeU (torus t))))
            ((starDatum bc heps).Qstar (JsuTwo (spikeU (torus t))))
            (spikeU (torus t)) 2 (dinvC (spikeU (torus t)) 2) w

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKWiring.cZero_i.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKWiring.cZero_in_printed_subspace
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKWiring.cZero_i.header:
theorem cZero_in_printed_subspace {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (w : TildeFn L ell) :
    (∀ c : CoarseBond L ell, lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell
        (fun b => (cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w : BondFnL2 L) b) c = 0)
      ∧ (∀ y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y' ∈ CoarseLattice L ell →
          ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y' ell →
          ∀ e ∈ staircasePath y' x, (cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w : BondFnL2 L) e = 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKWiring.pinnedT.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKWiring.inner_c.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKWiring.cdcForm.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKWiring.cdcFormTrue_affine_in_J
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKWiring.cdcForm.header:
theorem cdcFormTrue_affine_in_J (D : BalabanCovarianceData H (BondFnL2 L)) (bc : BaseConstant)
    (Qext : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L) (J : H) (lam : ℝ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKWiring.printed.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKWiring.printed.header:
theorem printed_cdc_closing_statement (D : BalabanCovarianceData H (BondFnL2 L))
    (bc : BaseConstant) (Qext : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L) (J : H)
    (S : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L) (hS : IsSourceOperator D Qext J S)
    {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (w : TildeFn L ell) :
    ((∀ c : CoarseBond L ell, lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell
        (fun b => (cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w : BondFnL2 L) b) c = 0)
      ∧ (∀ y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y' ∈ CoarseLattice L ell →
          ∀ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x ∈ blockOf y' ell →
          ∀ e ∈ staircasePath y' x, (cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w : BondFnL2 L) e = 0))
    ∧ (∀ B : BondFnL2 L, (inner ℝ B (printedDeltaKOp D bc S B) : ℝ) = deltaKForm D bc Qext J B)
    ∧ (inner ℝ w (cdcOp U ell (dinvC U ell) (pinnedT2 D bc S U) w) : ℝ)
        = cdcFormTrue D bc Qext J U ell (dinvC U ell) w
    ∧ (∀ T2 : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L,
        (∀ x : BondFnL2 L, deltaK U T2 x = printedDeltaKOp D bc S x) ↔ T2 = pinnedT2 D bc S U)

theorem tower_recurrence (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (C0 alpha0 c2' : ℝ)
    (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (ha : 0 < alpha0)
    (hcontract : 4 * C0 * alpha0 * (ell : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2 - 1)
    (hc : 2 * alpha0 ≤ c2')
    (hdepth : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell^k ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (hProp1 : ScaleFittedPropagation (L := L) ell C0 c2')
    (hfine : SublatticePlaqBound 1 U (alpha0 * etaSq ell k)) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k →
      SublatticePlaqBound (ell^j) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U j)
        (betaRec ell C0 alpha0 k j)

Prop1.ScaleFittedTest.Composition.depth_.name: Prop1.ScaleFittedTest.Composition.depth_uniformity
Prop1.ScaleFittedTest.Composition.depth_.header:
theorem depth_uniformity (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (C0 alpha0 c2' : ℝ)
    (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (ha : 0 < alpha0)
    (hcontract : 4 * C0 * alpha0 * (ell : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2 - 1)
    (hc : 2 * alpha0 ≤ c2')
    (hdepth : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell^k ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (hProp1 : ScaleFittedPropagation (L := L) ell C0 c2')
    (hfine : ∀ y μ ν,
      frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS 1 U y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ alpha0 * etaSq ell k)
    (j : ℕ) (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    SublatticePlaqBound (ell^j) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U j) (2 * alpha0) ∧
    SublatticePlaqBound (ell^j) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U j)
      (2 * (alpha0 * ((ell : ℝ)^2)^j * etaSq ell k)) ∧
    SublatticePlaqBound (ell^j) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U j)
      ((alpha0 * ((ell : ℝ)^2)^j * etaSq ell k) *
        (1 + 4 * C0 * alpha0 * etaSq ell k * geomS ell j)) ∧
    (j < k → ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell^j) →
      ∀ μ ν : Fin 3,
        frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS (ell^j) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U j) y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1)
          < alpha0)

theorem uniform_at_final_corners (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (C0 alpha0 c2' : ℝ)

    (M : ℝ → (E →L[ℝ] E)) (Δ0 : E →L[ℝ] E) (G1 : ℝ → (E →L[ℝ] E)) (hc : Continuous M)
    (hs : ∀ t x y, ⟪M t x, y⟫ = ⟪x, M t y⟫) (hΔ : ∀ x y, ⟪Δ0 x, y⟫ = ⟪x, Δ0 y⟫)
    (hG1 : ∀ t, IsUnit (M t) → G1 t = M t - Δ0)
    (ta tb : ℝ) (hab : ta < tb) (hu : ∀ t ∈ Icc ta tb, IsUnit (M t))
    (h0 : AdalyFormal.D1Literal.PSD (M ta - Δ0)) (v : E) (hv : ⟪v, (M tb - Δ0) v⟫ < 0) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, ta ≤ t ∧ t < tb ∧ IsUnit (M t) ∧ ¬ IsUnit (G1 t)

    (v : E0 S) (hv : ⟪v, (GinvLit hell0 S a Lam U tb - DeltaLoc0 hell0 S a Lam U) v⟫ < 0) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, ta ≤ t ∧ t < tb ∧ ClassCoupled ell M c k S α₀ η (U t) ∧

      (((pureGauge (gaugeInv (γ i))) b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.termina.header:
theorem terminal_sum_at_star_datum_percube_centre {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (bc : BaseConstant) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps)
    (ε : Bond witnessL → Bool)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) witnessL)
    (r ρ : ℝ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (𝒞 : Finset ι) (Y : ι → Finset (CSite witnessL 2)) (γ : ι → GaugeFn witnessL)
    (hdisj : ∀ i ∈ 𝒞, ∀ j ∈ 𝒞, i ≠ j → Disjoint (Y i) (Y j))
    (hcov : ∀ z : CSite witnessL 2, ∃ i ∈ 𝒞, z ∈ Y i)
    (hclass : ∀ i ∈ 𝒞, ∀ b ∈ bondsOn (Y i), RMapLipschitz.frobNorm
      (((periodicGaugeTransform (γ i) V) b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ r)
    (hrough : ∀ i ∈ 𝒞, ∀ b ∈ bondsOn (Y i), RMapLipschitz.frobNorm
      (((pureGauge (gaugeInv (γ i))) b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ)
    (hsum : r + ρ ≤ 1 / (37664 * (((2 : ℕ)) : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (c M α₀ η Lj : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hηne : η ≠ 0) (hLj : 1 ≤ Lj) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hα0 : 0 ≤ α₀) (hthr : c * M * α₀ < 1 / (1120 * (((2 : ℕ)) : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (𝒞src : Set (Set (Bond witnessL)))
    (hprinted : PrintedCubeClassI c M α₀ η Lj (centralFlipConfig ε V) 𝒞src)
    (hgeom : CubesRefine AdalyFormal.Balaban.CurvedContent.witnessL_dvd
      (Finset.univ : Finset (CSite witnessL 2))
      (fun z => ({z} : Finset (CSite witnessL 2))) 𝒞src)
    (Qext : BondFnL2 witnessL → BondFnL2 witnessL) (J : BondFnL2 fineL)
    (S : BondFnL2 witnessL →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 witnessL)
    (hS : IsSourceOperator (starDatum bc heps) Qext J S) (c₂ : ℝ) (hc₂ : 0 ≤ c₂)
    (hD2 : ∀ B : BondFnL2 witnessL, ‖Dtilde2Shape Qext B‖ ≤ c₂ * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    (R : ℝ) (hJbound : ‖J‖ ≤ R)
    (hRthr : 2 * ‖solutionOperator (starDatum bc heps)‖ * c₂ * R
      < sharpFloorConst (gammaSum 2) (16 * (r + ρ)) (rawSigmaZero 2))
    (w : TildeFn witnessL 2) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    0 < cdcFormTrue (starDatum bc heps) bc Qext J (centralFlipConfig ε V) 2
      (dinvC (centralFlipConfig ε V) 2) w

theorem percube_hypotheses_curved_nonvacuous

    0 < frobSupBond (witU witTdrift)
    ∧ frobSupBond (witU witTdrift) ≤ 1 / (37664 * ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3)
    ∧ (∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.CSite witL3 3)),
        ∀ b ∈ AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.bondsOn
          ({i} : Finset (AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.CSite witL3 3)),
        RMapLipschitz.frobNorm
          (((periodicGaugeTransform (twoGauge z₀ i) (witU witTdrift)) b :
            Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ frobSupBond (witU witTdrift))
    ∧ (∀ i : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.CSite witL3 3, ∀ b : Bond witL3,
        RMapLipschitz.frobNorm
          (((pureGauge (gaugeInv (twoGauge z₀ i))) b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) = 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.percube.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.percube_data_cannot_price_the_drift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.percube.header:
theorem percube_data_cannot_price_the_drift :
    (∀ b : Bond witnessL, RMapLipschitz.frobNorm
        (((periodicGaugeTransform (gaugeInv bumpGauge) bumpU) b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) = 0)
    ∧ (∀ b : Bond witnessL, RMapLipschitz.frobNorm
        (((trivialU witnessL) b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) = 0)
    ∧ plaqEnergy (curlDrift (trivialU witnessL) bumpA) = 0
    ∧ 4 * bondEnergy bumpA ≤ plaqEnergy (curlDrift bumpU bumpA)
    ∧ bondEnergy bumpA = 1
    ∧ (∀ ε : Bond witnessL → Bool, 2 ≤ frobSupBond (centralFlipConfig ε bumpU))
    ∧ GaugeRegular 0 bumpU
    ∧ ¬ (frobSupBond bumpU ≤ 1 / (13336 * (((2 : ℕ)) : ℝ) ^ 3))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.norm_re.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.norm_relDrift_eq

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.plaqsOn.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.plaqsOn.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.plaqsOn.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.family_.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.local_c.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.plaqEne.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.plaqEnergy_curlDrift_percube
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.plaqEne.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.norm_cu.header:

    ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 U X - curlCovariantCLM_L2 (trivialU L) X‖ ≤ 16 * (r + ρ) * ‖X‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.hraw_co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.hraw_composed_of_drift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.hraw_co.header:
theorem hraw_composed_of_drift {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')

    (hκ : ∀ X : BondFnL2 L',
      ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 U X - curlCovariantCLM_L2 (trivialU L') X‖ ≤ κ * ‖X‖)
    (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 U (composedQ h (trivialU L) A)‖
      ≤ rawSigmaZero ell * ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 (trivialU L) A‖
        + κ * ‖composedQ h (trivialU L) A‖

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.halfDri.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.halfDrift_percube
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.halfDri.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.termina.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.terminal_sum_at_star_datum_percube
AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.termina.header:
theorem terminal_sum_at_star_datum_percube {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (bc : BaseConstant) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) witnessL)
    (r ρ : ℝ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (𝒞 : Finset ι) (Y : ι → Finset (CSite witnessL 2)) (γ : ι → GaugeFn witnessL)
    (hdisj : ∀ i ∈ 𝒞, ∀ j ∈ 𝒞, i ≠ j → Disjoint (Y i) (Y j))
    (hcov : ∀ z : CSite witnessL 2, ∃ i ∈ 𝒞, z ∈ Y i)
    (hclass : ∀ i ∈ 𝒞, ∀ b ∈ bondsOn (Y i), RMapLipschitz.frobNorm
      (((periodicGaugeTransform (γ i) U) b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ r)
    (hrough : ∀ i ∈ 𝒞, ∀ b ∈ bondsOn (Y i), RMapLipschitz.frobNorm
      (((pureGauge (gaugeInv (γ i))) b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ)
    (hsum : r + ρ ≤ 1 / (37664 * (((2 : ℕ)) : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (c M α₀ η Lj : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hηne : η ≠ 0) (hLj : 1 ≤ Lj) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hα0 : 0 ≤ α₀) (hthr : c * M * α₀ < 1 / (1120 * (((2 : ℕ)) : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (𝒞src : Set (Set (Bond witnessL)))
    (hprinted : PrintedCubeClassI c M α₀ η Lj U 𝒞src)
    (hgeom : CubesRefine AdalyFormal.Balaban.CurvedContent.witnessL_dvd
      (Finset.univ : Finset (CSite witnessL 2))
      (fun z => ({z} : Finset (CSite witnessL 2))) 𝒞src)
    (Qext : BondFnL2 witnessL → BondFnL2 witnessL) (J : BondFnL2 fineL)
    (S : BondFnL2 witnessL →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 witnessL)
    (hS : IsSourceOperator (starDatum bc heps) Qext J S) (c₂ : ℝ) (hc₂ : 0 ≤ c₂)
    (hD2 : ∀ B : BondFnL2 witnessL, ‖Dtilde2Shape Qext B‖ ≤ c₂ * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    (R : ℝ) (hJbound : ‖J‖ ≤ R)
    (hRthr : 2 * ‖solutionOperator (starDatum bc heps)‖ * c₂ * R
      < sharpFloorConst (gammaSum 2) (16 * (r + ρ)) (rawSigmaZero 2))
    (w : TildeFn witnessL 2) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    0 < cdcFormTrue (starDatum bc heps) bc Qext J U 2 (dinvC U 2) w

AdalyFormal.Balaban.DriftPerCube.trivial.header:

theorem col_ind_le {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (y : Fin N) (T : ℕ) :
    ∑ x : Fin N, (if (x - y).val / n = T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ n

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.row_chi_le.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.row_chi_le
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.row_chi_le.header:
theorem row_chi_le {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (n Nu : ℕ) (hnN : n ∣ N) (x : Fin N) :
    ∑ y : Fin N, (if n ∣ y.val then chi n Nu (x - y).val else 0) ≤ 3

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.col_chi_le.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.col_chi_le
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.col_chi_le.header:
theorem col_chi_le {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (n Nu : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (y : Fin N) :
    ∑ x : Fin N, chi n Nu (x - y).val ≤ 3 * n

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.block_mean.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.block_mean
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.block_mean.header:
theorem block_mean (Nu n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : N = Nu * n) (y y' : Fin N)
    (hy : n ∣ y.val) (hy' : n ∣ y'.val) :
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a : Fin N => y'.val ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < y'.val + n),
      phi n Nu (a - y).val = if y' = y then (n : ℝ) else 0

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.local_sum_sq_.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.local_sum_sq_coarseCurl_le
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.local_sum_sq_.header:
theorem local_sum_sq_coarseCurl_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → ℝ) (d : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections)
    (Y : Finset {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}) (Pd : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L))
    (hY : ∀ y ∈ Y, ∀ x ∈ blockOf y.1 ell, ∀ i ∈ Finset.range ell, ∀ j ∈ Finset.range ell,
      coarseShift (coarseShift x j d.1.2) i d.1.1 ∈ Pd) :
    (ell : ℝ) * ∑ y ∈ Y, (coarseCurlValue hdvd (lineCoarseRestrict ell A) (y, d)) ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ z ∈ Pd, (curlValue A (z, d)) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.norm_sq_suTwo.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.norm_sq_suTwo_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.norm_sq_suTwo.header: theorem norm_sq_suTwo_eq_sum (v : SuTwo) : ‖v‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin 3, (suCoordLM i v) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.sum_by_second.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.sum_by_second
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.sum_by_second.header:
theorem sum_by_second {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (S : Finset (α × β)) (g : α × β → ℝ) :
    ∑ p ∈ S, g p = ∑ b : β, ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).filter (fun a => (a, b) ∈ S), g (a, b)

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.local_stokes_.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.local_stokes_suTwo
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.local_stokes_.header:
theorem local_stokes_suTwo {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (Y : Finset (CoarsePlaquette L ell)) (Pq : Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L))
    (hY : ∀ p ∈ Y, ∀ x ∈ blockOf p.1.1 ell, ∀ i ∈ Finset.range ell, ∀ j ∈ Finset.range ell,
      (coarseShift (coarseShift x j p.2.1.2) i p.2.1.1, p.2) ∈ Pq) :
    (ell : ℝ) * ∑ p ∈ Y, ‖coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd (lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo ell A) p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ q ∈ Pq, ‖flatCurlValue A q‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.lemma24_flat_.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.lemma24_flat_gen
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.lemma24_flat_.header:
theorem lemma24_flat_gen {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < L μ + 1) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (B : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hB : ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell, ∀ x ∈ blockOf y ell, ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, B b = 0)
    (hQ : ∀ c, lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo ell B c = 0) :
    (1 / 54 : ℝ) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) * ∑ b : Bond L, ‖B b‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, ‖flatCurlValue B p‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.lemma24_flat_.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.lemma24_flat_gen'
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.lemma24_flat_.header:
theorem lemma24_flat_gen' {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < L μ + 1) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (B : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hB : ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell, ∀ x ∈ blockOf y ell, ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, B b = 0)
    (hQ : ∀ c, lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo ell B c = 0) :
    (1 / 54 : ℝ) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) * ∑ b : Bond L, ‖B b‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L,
        ‖curlCovariantLM (AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.trivialU L) B p‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.const_le_prin.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.const_le_printed
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.const_le_prin.header:
theorem const_le_printed (ell : ℕ) (h2 : 2 ≤ ell) :
    (1 / 54 : ℝ) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) ≤ (1 / 108) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.Lemma24Su.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.Lemma24Su
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.Lemma24Su.header: def Lemma24Su (ell : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (γ : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.lemma24Su_sha.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.lemma24Su_sharp
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.lemma24Su_sha.header:
theorem lemma24Su_sharp {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < Lu μ + 1) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (Lu μ + 1)) :
    Lemma24Su ell Lu ((1 / 54 : ℝ) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5))

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.lemma24Su_of_.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.lemma24Su_of_scalar
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.lemma24Su_of_.header:
theorem lemma24Su_of_scalar {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (γ : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ B : Bond Lu → ℝ, B ∈ admissibleSubspaceInter Lu ell →
      (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergy ell B + totalCurlEnergy B ≥ γ * bondNormSq B) :
    Lemma24Su ell Lu γ

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.schur.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.schur
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.schur.header:
theorem schur {X Y V : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [SeminormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    (K M : X → Y → ℝ) (hKM : ∀ x y, |K x y| ≤ M x y) (R C : ℝ) (hR0 : 0 ≤ R)
    (hR : ∀ x, ∑ y, M x y ≤ R) (hC : ∀ y, ∑ x, M x y ≤ C) (w : Y → V) :
    ∑ x, ‖∑ y, K x y • w y‖ ^ 2 ≤ R * C * ∑ y, ‖w y‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.pos_of_neZero_eq_mul.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.pos_of_neZero_eq_mul
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.pos_of_neZero_eq_mul.header: theorem pos_of_neZero_eq_mul {N Nu n : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : N = Nu * n) : 0 < Nu

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.abs_phi_step_fin.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.abs_phi_step_fin
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.abs_phi_step_fin.header:
theorem abs_phi_step_fin (Nu n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : N = Nu * n) (a b : Fin N) :
    |phi n Nu (a + 1 - b).val - phi n Nu (a - b).val| ≤ 6 / n * chi n Nu (a - b).val

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.abs_prod3_update_sub.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.abs_prod3_update_sub
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.abs_prod3_update_sub.header:
theorem abs_prod3_update_sub (F G B : Fin 3 → ℝ) (μ : Fin 3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hG : ∀ ν, ν ≠ μ → G ν = F ν) (hF : ∀ ν, |F ν| ≤ B ν) (hD : |G μ - F μ| ≤ c * B μ) :
    |∏ ν, G ν - ∏ ν, F ν| ≤ c * ∏ ν, B ν

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.abs_prod_le_prod.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.abs_prod_le_prod
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.abs_prod_le_prod.header:
theorem abs_prod_le_prod {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (F B : ι → ℝ) (hF : ∀ ν, |F ν| ≤ B ν) :
    |∏ ν, F ν| ≤ ∏ ν, B ν

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.genForm_reduc.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.genForm_reduction_gen
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.genForm_reduc.header:
theorem genForm_reduction_gen (P : IngrBParams) (hU : P.U = flatCfg) (hG : IsUnit P.G1inv)
    (hN : IsUnit (GenP.Nmat P)) (B : BondFnL2 P.Lu) :
    ∃ A : ↥(bondSupp P.G), P.data.Q A = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint P.tau B ∧
      GenP.genForm P B = P.eta * (‖AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.plaqMask (plaqIn P.G.Om0)
          (curlCovariantCLM_L2 (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration
            (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (scaleUp P.ell P.k P.Lu)) (iE P.G A))‖ ^ 2 +
          ‖Tfull P.G P.U (iE P.G A)‖ ^ 2 + ⟪A, P.data.Mass A⟫) - P.a * ‖B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.mass_inner_ge.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.mass_inner_gen
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.mass_inner_ge.header:
theorem mass_inner_gen (P : IngrBParams) (A : ↥(bondSupp P.G)) :
    ⟪A, P.data.Mass A⟫ = ∑ p : BIdx P.G, P.a * (P.ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ) * ‖P.data.Q A p‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.mass_ge_gen.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.mass_ge_gen
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.mass_ge_gen.header:
theorem mass_ge_gen (P : IngrBParams) (ha : 0 ≤ P.a) (A : ↥(bondSupp P.G)) (B : BondFnL2 P.Lu)
    (hQ : P.data.Q A = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint P.tau B)
    (hB : ∀ e : Bond P.Lu, unitBondEmb P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell e ∉ bondsLam P.G P.k → (WithLp.ofLp B) e = 0) :
    P.a * (P.ell : ℝ) ^ P.k * ‖B‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A, P.data.Mass A⟫

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.bgTower_flat.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.bgTower_flat
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.bgTower_flat.header:
theorem bgTower_flat (P : IngrBParams) (hU : P.U = flatCfg) (j : ℕ) :
    bgTower P.G P.U j = flatCfg

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.Qfull_top_gen.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.Qfull_top_gen
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.Qfull_top_gen.header:
theorem Qfull_top_gen (P : IngrBParams) (hU : P.U = flatCfg) (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp P.ell P.k P.Lu))
    (e : Bond P.Lu) (h : unitBondEmb P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell e ∈ bondsLam P.G P.k) :
    (P.sector.Qfull A) (pe P e h)
      = lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo (P.ell ^ P.k) (WithLp.ofLp A) (bondsE P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell e)

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.sum_stepBlock_blockO.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.sum_stepBlock_blockOf
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.sum_stepBlock_blockO.header:
theorem sum_stepBlock_blockOf {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M) :
    ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, ∑ x' ∈ blockOf x s, f x' = ∑ x' ∈ blockOf y (s * ell), f x'

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.blockOf_one.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.blockOf_one
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.blockOf_one.header: theorem blockOf_one (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : blockOf y 1 = {y}

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.Qcomposite_flat.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.Qcomposite_flat
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.Qcomposite_flat.header:
theorem Qcomposite_flat (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (j : ℕ) (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Qcomposite (fun _ => trivialU L) ell j lam y
      = ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ j) • ∑ x ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), lam x

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.Qtop_flat.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.Qtop_flat
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.Qtop_flat.header:
theorem Qtop_flat (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (f : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (y : {y // y ∈ (GF ell k Lu).Lam (GF ell k Lu).k}) :
    Qtop (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _) f y = ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ k) • ∑ x ∈ blockOf y.1 (ell ^ k), f x

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.psi.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.psi
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.psi.header: noncomputable def psi (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.Xi.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.Xi
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.Xi.header: noncomputable def Xi (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE.header:
noncomputable def flatE (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    coarseC (GF ell k Lu) →L[ℝ] SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_apply.header:
theorem flatE_apply (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (w : coarseC (GF ell k Lu))
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    flatE ell k Lu w x = ∑ y : {y // y ∈ (GF ell k Lu).Lam (GF ell k Lu).k}, psi ell k Lu x y.1 • w y

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.dvd_of_lam.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.dvd_of_lam
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.dvd_of_lam.header:
theorem dvd_of_lam (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent)
    (y : {y // y ∈ (GF ell k Lu).Lam (GF ell k Lu).k}) (μ : Fin 3) : ell ^ k ∣ (y.1 μ).val

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.block_sum_psi.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.block_sum_psi
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.block_sum_psi.header:
theorem block_sum_psi (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (y' y : {y // y ∈ (GF ell k Lu).Lam (GF ell k Lu).k}) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf y'.1 (ell ^ k), psi ell k Lu x y.1 = if y' = y then ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3 else 0

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_rightInv.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_rightInv
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_rightInv.header:
theorem flatE_rightInv (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (w : coarseC (GF ell k Lu)) : Qtop (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _) (flatE ell k Lu w) = w

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.abs_psi_le.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.abs_psi_le
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.abs_psi_le.header:
theorem abs_psi_le (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) : |psi ell k Lu x y| ≤ Xi ell k Lu x y

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.Xi_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.Xi_nonneg
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.Xi_nonneg.header:
theorem Xi_nonneg (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    0 ≤ Xi ell k Lu x y

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.row_Xi_le.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.row_Xi_le
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.row_Xi_le.header:
theorem row_Xi_le (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ y : {y // y ∈ (GF ell k Lu).Lam (GF ell k Lu).k}, Xi ell k Lu x y.1 ≤ 27

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.col_Xi_le.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.col_Xi_le
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.col_Xi_le.header:
theorem col_Xi_le (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu), Xi ell k Lu x y ≤ 27 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_norm_sq.header:
theorem flatE_norm_sq (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (w : coarseC (GF ell k Lu)) :
    ‖flatE ell k Lu w‖ ^ 2 ≤ 729 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3 * ‖w‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.gradL2_trivial_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.gradL2_trivial_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.gradL2_trivial_apply.header:
theorem gradL2_trivial_apply {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (f : SiteL2 L) (b : Bond L) :
    (gradL2 (trivialU L) f) b = f (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - f b.1

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.abs_psi_shift_sub_le.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.abs_psi_shift_sub_le
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.abs_psi_shift_sub_le.header:
theorem abs_psi_shift_sub_le (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (μ : Fin 3) :
    |psi ell k Lu (periodicLatticeShift x μ) y - psi ell k Lu x y| ≤ 6 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) * Xi ell k Lu x y

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_grad_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_grad_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_grad_norm_sq.header:
theorem flatE_grad_norm_sq (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (w : coarseC (GF ell k Lu)) :
    ‖gradL2 (trivialU _) (flatE ell k Lu w)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 78732 * (ell : ℝ) ^ k * ‖w‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.norm_le_of_sq.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.norm_le_of_sq
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.norm_le_of_sq.header:
theorem norm_le_of_sq (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (h : a ^ 2 ≤ C * b ^ 2) :
    a ≤ Real.sqrt C * b

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_norm_le.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_norm_le
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_norm_le.header:
theorem flatE_norm_le (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (w : coarseC (GF ell k Lu)) :
    ‖flatE ell k Lu w‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (729 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3) * ‖w‖

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_grad_norm_le.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_grad_norm_le
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.flatE_grad_norm_le.header:
theorem flatE_grad_norm_le (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (w : coarseC (GF ell k Lu)) :
    ‖gradL2 (trivialU _) (flatE ell k Lu w)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (78732 * (ell : ℝ) ^ k) * ‖w‖

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.cell_shift_ar.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.cell_shift_arith
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.cell_shift_ar.header:
theorem cell_shift_arith (U n z r t : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hz : z < U + 1) (hr : r < n) (ht : t ≤ n) :
    ((n * z + r + t) % ((U + 1) * n)) / n = z ∨
      ((n * z + r + t) % ((U + 1) * n)) / n = (z + 1) % (U + 1)

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.ReachP.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.ReachP
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.ReachP.header: def ReachP (μ ν : Fin 3) (a b : ℕ) (x w : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) : Prop

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.reach_refl.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.reach_refl
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.reach_refl.header:
theorem reach_refl (μ ν : Fin 3) (a b : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ReachP ell k Lu μ ν a b x x

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.reach_mono.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.reach_mono
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.reach_mono.header:
theorem reach_mono {μ ν : Fin 3} {a b a' b' : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ a') (hb : b ≤ b')
    {x w : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (h : ReachP ell k Lu μ ν a b x w) :

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.reach_shift_m.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.reach_shift_mu
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.reach_shift_m.header:
theorem reach_shift_mu {μ ν : Fin 3} {a b : ℕ} (hN : ∀ ρ, 1 ≤ scaleUp ell k Lu ρ)
    {x w : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (h : ReachP ell k Lu μ ν a b x w) :

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.reach_shift_n.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.reach_shift_nu
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.reach_shift_n.header:
theorem reach_shift_nu {μ ν : Fin 3} (hμν : μ ≠ ν) {a b : ℕ} (hN : ∀ ρ, 1 ≤ scaleUp ell k Lu ρ)

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.ginv_coercive_FE.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.ginv_coercive_FE
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.ginv_coercive_FE.header:
theorem ginv_coercive_FE (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a + (1 - siteMask (GF ell k Lu).Om0)))
    (PU : ℝ) (hPU : 0 ≤ PU)
    (hPoincU : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) U, ‖ν‖ ≤ PU * ‖gradL2 U ν‖)
    (nsq c1 t e P δ q ε0 : ℝ) (hn : 0 < nsq) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0) (hεa : ε0 * aFE ell k < 1)
    (hsmall : nsq * ((((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * q) * (δ * P
        + (((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * q) * P ^ 2
        * (δ + ((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * ε0)) + δ) ^ 2 + nsq * e < c1)
    (hflat : ∀ y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      c1 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ nsq * (PhiF ell k Lu a (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y
        + ‖Rproj (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (gradAdj (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y)‖ ^ 2))
    (hdrift : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      PhiF ell k Lu a (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) x ≤ (1 + t) * PhiF ell k Lu a U x + e * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hPoinc1 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)),
      ‖ν‖ ≤ P * ‖gradL2 (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ν‖)
    (hd : ∀ f, ‖gradL2 (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) f - gradL2 U f‖ ≤ δ * ‖f‖)
    (hQdrift : ∀ f, ‖Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f - Qtop (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _) f‖ ≤ ε0 * ‖f‖)
    (hQq : ∀ f, ‖Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f‖ ≤ q * ‖f‖)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp (GF ell k Lu))) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ max (2 / ((c1 - nsq * ((((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * q) * (δ * P
        + (((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * q) * P ^ 2
        * (δ + ((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * ε0)) + δ) ^ 2
        - nsq * e) / (1 + t) / nsq)) (2 * PU ^ 2) *
      ⟪x, (IngrBParams.data ⟨ell, k, Lu, hell, fullTower ell k Lu, U, a, Lam⟩).Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.ginv_coercive_FE_nam.name: AdalyFormal.FlatExt.ginv_coercive_FE_named
AdalyFormal.FlatExt.ginv_coercive_FE_nam.header:
theorem ginv_coercive_FE_named (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a + (1 - siteMask (GF ell k Lu).Om0)))
    (PU : ℝ) (hPU : 0 ≤ PU)
    (hPoincU : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) U, ‖ν‖ ≤ PU * ‖gradL2 U ν‖)
    (nsq c1 t θ δm e P δ q ε0 : ℝ) (hn : 0 < nsq) (ht : 0 < t) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hδdef : δ = Real.sqrt 12 * frobSupBond U)
    (hedef : e = (1 + t) * θ + (1 + 1 / t) * ((4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond U) ^ 2 + δm ^ 2))
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0) (hεa : ε0 * aFE ell k < 1)
    (hsmall : nsq * ((((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * q) * (δ * P
        + (((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * q) * P ^ 2
        * (δ + ((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * ε0)) + δ) ^ 2 + nsq * e < c1)
    (hflat : ∀ y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      c1 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ nsq * (PhiF ell k Lu a (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y
        + ‖Rproj (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (gradAdj (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y)‖ ^ 2))
    (hdp : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      |AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc U (plaqIn (GF ell k Lu).Om0) x x| ≤ θ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hm : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      ∑ p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu), a * ((GF ell k Lu).ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ) *
        ‖(bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p - (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2
        ≤ δm ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hPoinc1 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)),
      ‖ν‖ ≤ P * ‖gradL2 (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ν‖)
    (hQdrift : ∀ f, ‖Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f - Qtop (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _) f‖ ≤ ε0 * ‖f‖)
    (hQq : ∀ f, ‖Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f‖ ≤ q * ‖f‖)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp (GF ell k Lu))) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ max (2 / ((c1 - nsq * ((((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * q) * (δ * P
        + (((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * q) * P ^ 2
        * (δ + ((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * ε0)) + δ) ^ 2
        - nsq * e) / (1 + t) / nsq)) (2 * PU ^ 2) *
      ⟪x, (IngrBParams.data ⟨ell, k, Lu, hell, fullTower ell k Lu, U, a, Lam⟩).Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.arith_block.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.arith_block
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.arith_block.header:

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.Cop_props_gen.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.Cop_props_gen
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.Cop_props_gen.header:
theorem Cop_props_gen {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1) (hu : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ)
    {Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)} (hLB : LamBlockSum ell Lam)
    (hb : Function.Bijective (H0 Lam (q1SU2 ell))) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo)
    (hBt : OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt) (hBT : OnLambdaT Lam Bt) :
    (∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice Lu ell, ∀ x ∈ blockOf y ell, ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x,
        Cop Lam (q1SU2 ell) Bt b = 0) ∧
    (∀ c, lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo ell (Cop Lam (q1SU2 ell) Bt) c = 0) ∧
    bondEnergy Bt ≤ ∑ b : Bond Lu, ‖Cop Lam (q1SU2 ell) Bt b‖ ^ 2 ∧
    (∀ e : Bond Lu, Cop Lam (q1SU2 ell) Bt e ≠ 0 → e.1 ∈ Lam ∨ periodicLatticeShift e.1 e.2 ∈ Lam)

AdalyFormal.FlatExt.ginv_coercive_FE_nam.header:
theorem ginv_coercive_FE_named2 (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a + (1 - siteMask (GF ell k Lu).Om0)))
    (PU : ℝ) (hPU : 0 ≤ PU)
    (hPoincU : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) U, ‖ν‖ ≤ PU * ‖gradL2 U ν‖)
    (nsq c1 t θ δm e P δ q ε0 : ℝ) (hn : 0 < nsq) (ht : 0 < t) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hδdef : δ = Real.sqrt 12 * frobSupBond U)
    (hedef : e = (1 + t) * θ + (1 + 1 / t) * ((4 * Real.sqrt 2 * frobSupBond U) ^ 2 + δm ^ 2))
    (hqdef : q = Real.sqrt (1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3) + ε0) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0) (hεa : ε0 * aFE ell k < 1)
    (hsmall : nsq * ((((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * q) * (δ * P
        + (((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * q) * P ^ 2
        * (δ + ((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * ε0)) + δ) ^ 2 + nsq * e < c1)
    (hflat : ∀ y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      c1 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ nsq * (PhiF ell k Lu a (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y
        + ‖Rproj (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (gradAdj (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y)‖ ^ 2))
    (hdp : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      |AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc U (plaqIn (GF ell k Lu).Om0) x x| ≤ θ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hm : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      ∑ p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu), a * ((GF ell k Lu).ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ) *
        ‖(bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p - (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2
        ≤ δm ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hPoinc1 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)),
      ‖ν‖ ≤ P * ‖gradL2 (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ν‖)
    (hQdrift : ∀ f, ‖Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f - Qtop (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _) f‖ ≤ ε0 * ‖f‖)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp (GF ell k Lu))) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ max (2 / ((c1 - nsq * ((((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * q) * (δ * P
        + (((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * q) * P ^ 2
        * (δ + ((bFE ell k + δ * aFE ell k) / (1 - ε0 * aFE ell k)) * ε0)) + δ) ^ 2
        - nsq * e) / (1 + t) / nsq)) (2 * PU ^ 2) *
      ⟪x, (IngrBParams.data ⟨ell, k, Lu, hell, fullTower ell k Lu, U, a, Lam⟩).Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.FloorMembership.terminal_cov.name: AdalyFormal.FloorMembership.terminal_covariant_sumFloor
AdalyFormal.FloorMembership.terminal_cov.header:
theorem terminal_covariant_sumFloor {ell₀ : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (Ufine : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (γ : GaugeFn L)
    (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell₀) (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell₀ < L' ν + 1)
    (hdvd0 : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell₀ ∣ (L' ν + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L')
    (hsmallUGauged : frobSupBond (periodicGaugeTransform (coarseGauge h γ) U)
      ≤ 1 / (26672 * (ell₀ : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (bc : BaseConstant) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hsmallFineGauged : ‖solutionOperator (feedDatumGen h Ufine heps (le_of_lt bc.a_pos))‖
      * rawErrorCoeff ell (periodicGaugeTransform γ Ufine) ≤ 1 / (4708 * (ell₀ : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα : α ≤ sumRadius ell₀)
    (𝒞 : Finset ι) (Y : ι → Finset (CSite L' ell₀)) (γcube : ι → GaugeFn L')
    (hdisj : ∀ i ∈ 𝒞, ∀ j ∈ 𝒞, i ≠ j → Disjoint (Y i) (Y j))
    (hcov : ∀ z : CSite L' ell₀, ∃ i ∈ 𝒞, z ∈ Y i)
    (hclass : ∀ i ∈ 𝒞, ∀ b ∈ bondsOn (tilde hdvd0 (tilde hdvd0 (Y i))),
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNorm
        (((periodicGaugeTransform (γcube i) U) b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α)
    (Qext : BondFnL2 L' → BondFnL2 L') (T : BondFnL2 L' →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L)
    (S : BondFnL2 L' →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L')
    (hS : IsSourceOperator (feedDatumGen h Ufine heps (le_of_lt bc.a_pos)) Qext (T (JsuTwo U)) S)
    (c₂ : ℝ) (hc₂ : 0 < c₂)
    (hD2 : ∀ B : BondFnL2 L', ‖Dtilde2Shape Qext B‖ ≤ c₂ * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hU : LinkDev δ U)
    (hH1 : 0 < ‖solutionOperator (feedDatumGen h Ufine heps (le_of_lt bc.a_pos))‖) (hT : 0 < ‖T‖)
    (hcard : 0 < Fintype.card (Bond L'))
    (hδ : δ < 1 / (5480006400 * (ell₀ : ℝ) ^ 6 * (rawSigmaZero ell) ^ 2
      * ‖solutionOperator (feedDatumGen h Ufine heps (le_of_lt bc.a_pos))‖ * c₂
      * (‖T‖ * Real.sqrt (2 * (Fintype.card (Bond L'))))))
    (w : TildeFn L' ell₀) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    0 < cdcFormTrue (feedDatumGen h Ufine heps (le_of_lt bc.a_pos)) bc Qext (T (JsuTwo U)) U ell₀
      (dinvC U ell₀) w

    (hδ : δ < 1 / (5480006400 * (ell₀ : ℝ) ^ 6 * (rawSigmaZero ell) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FloorMembership.hsmallUGauge.name: AdalyFormal.FloorMembership.hsmallUGauged_of_perCube_sum
AdalyFormal.FloorMembership.hsmallUGauge.header:
theorem hsmallUGauged_of_perCube_sum {ell₀ : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L')
    (assign : PeriodicLatticeSite L' → ι) (γc : ι → GaugeFn L') (r m : ℝ)
    (hclass : ∀ b : Bond L', AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNorm
      (((periodicGaugeTransform (γc (assign b.1)) U) b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ r)
    (hmatch : ∀ b : Bond L', AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNorm
      (((γc (assign b.1) (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)
          * (γc (assign (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)) (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2))⁻¹ :
          Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ m)
    (hsum : r + m ≤ 1 / (26672 * (ell₀ : ℝ) ^ 3)) :
    coarseGauge h (liftCoarseGauge h (gluedGauge assign γc)) = gluedGauge assign γc
    ∧ frobSupBond (periodicGaugeTransform
        (coarseGauge h (liftCoarseGauge h (gluedGauge assign γc))) U)
      ≤ 1 / (26672 * (ell₀ : ℝ) ^ 3)
