    a3LM p (gaugeActA γ A) = cjM (γ p.1) (a3LM p A)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.a2_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.a2_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.a2_gauge.header:
theorem a2_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    a2LM p (gaugeActA γ A) = cjM (γ p.1) (a2LM p A)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.a4_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.a4_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.a4_gauge.header:
theorem a4_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2g L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    a4LM (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) p (gaugeActA γ A) = cjM (γ p.1) (a4LM U p A)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.a1_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.a1_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.a1_gauge.header:
theorem a1_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2g L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    a1LM (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) p (gaugeActA γ A) = cjM (γ p.1) (a1LM U p A)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.cjM_sub_one.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.cjM_sub_one
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.cjM_sub_one.header: theorem cjM_sub_one (g : SU2g) (R : Mat2) : cjM g R - 1 = cjM g (R - 1)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.bilPlaq_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.bilPlaq_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.bilPlaq_gauge.header:
theorem bilPlaq_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2g L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    bilPlaq (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) p (gaugeActA γ A) (gaugeActA γ B) = bilPlaq U p A B

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adB.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adB
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adB.header: def adB (γ : GaugeFn L) : BondFnL2 L →ₗ[ℝ] BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adB_apply.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adB_apply
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adB_apply.header:
theorem adB_apply (γ : GaugeFn L) (f : BondFnL2 L) (b : Bond L) :
    (adB γ f) b = RMap (γ b.1) (f b)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.inner_adB.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.inner_adB
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.inner_adB.header: theorem inner_adB (γ : GaugeFn L) (x y : BondFnL2 L) : ⟪adB γ x, adB γ y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adB_inv.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adB_inv
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adB_inv.header: theorem adB_inv (γ : GaugeFn L) (x : BondFnL2 L) : adB (gaugeInv γ) (adB γ x) = x

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adB_surj.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adB_surj
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adB_surj.header: theorem adB_surj (γ : GaugeFn L) : Function.Surjective (adB γ)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.op_of_form.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.op_of_form
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.op_of_form.header:
theorem op_of_form {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)
    (hA : ∀ x y, ⟪A x, A y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫) (hs : Function.Surjective A) (T T' : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (h : ∀ x y, ⟪A x, T' (A y)⟫ = ⟪x, T y⟫) (y : E) : T' (A y) = A (T y)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.curlL2_apply.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.curlL2_apply
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.curlL2_apply.header:
theorem curlL2_apply (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2g L) (x : BondFnL2 L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    (curlCovariantLM_L2 U x) p = AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantOperators.curlValueCovariant U (WithLp.ofLp x) p

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.curlL2_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.curlL2_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.curlL2_gauge.header:
theorem curlL2_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2g L) (x : BondFnL2 L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    (curlCovariantLM_L2 (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (adB γ x)) p
      = RMap (γ p.1) ((curlCovariantLM_L2 U x) p)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.plaq_form_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.plaq_form_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.plaq_form_gauge.header:
theorem plaq_form_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2g L)
    (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (x y : BondFnL2 L) :
    ⟪plaqMask P (curlCovariantLM_L2 (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (adB γ x)),
      plaqMask P (curlCovariantLM_L2 (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (adB γ y))⟫
    = ⟪plaqMask P (curlCovariantLM_L2 U x), plaqMask P (curlCovariantLM_L2 U y)⟫

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.rawLoc_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.rawLoc_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.rawLoc_gauge.header:
theorem rawLoc_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2g L)
    (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    deltaPrimeBilRawLoc (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) P (gaugeActA γ A) (gaugeActA γ B)
      = deltaPrimeBilRawLoc U P A B

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.bil_form_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.bil_form_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.bil_form_gauge.header:
theorem bil_form_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2g L)
    (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (x y : BondFnL2 L) :
    deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) P (adB γ x) (adB γ y)
      = deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc U P x y

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.form_gauge_Delta.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.form_gauge_Delta
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.form_gauge_Delta.header:
theorem form_gauge_Delta (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2g L)
    (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (x y : BondFnL2 L) :
    ⟪adB γ x, deltaKLocCLM (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) P (adB γ y)⟫ = ⟪x, deltaKLocCLM U P y⟫

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.deltaKLocCLM_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.deltaKLocCLM_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.deltaKLocCLM_gauge.header:
theorem deltaKLocCLM_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2g L)
    (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (y : BondFnL2 L) :
    deltaKLocCLM (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) P (adB γ y) = adB γ (deltaKLocCLM U P y)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGenLM.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGenLM
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGenLM.header:
def adGenLM {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (φ : ι → SU2g) :
    PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGenLM_apply.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGenLM_apply
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGenLM_apply.header:
theorem adGenLM_apply {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (φ : ι → SU2g) (f : PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => SuTwo)) (i : ι) :
    (adGenLM φ f) i = RMap (φ i) (f i)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.inner_adGenLM.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.inner_adGenLM
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.inner_adGenLM.header:
theorem inner_adGenLM {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (φ : ι → SU2g) (x y : PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => SuTwo)) :
    ⟪adGenLM φ x, adGenLM φ y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGenLM_inv.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGenLM_inv
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGenLM_inv.header:
theorem adGenLM_inv {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (φ : ι → SU2g) (x : PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => SuTwo)) :
    adGenLM (fun i => (φ i)⁻¹) (adGenLM φ x) = x

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGen.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGen
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGen.header:
def adGen {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (φ : ι → SU2g) :
    PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => SuTwo) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGen_apply.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGen_apply
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGen_apply.header:
theorem adGen_apply {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (φ : ι → SU2g) (f : PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => SuTwo)) (i : ι) :
    (adGen φ f) i = RMap (φ i) (f i)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGen_symm_apply.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGen_symm_apply
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adGen_symm_apply.header:
theorem adGen_symm_apply {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (φ : ι → SU2g) (f : PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => SuTwo)) (i : ι) :
    ((adGen φ).symm f) i = RMap ((φ i)⁻¹) (f i)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adSL.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adSL
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adSL.header: abbrev adSL (γ : GaugeFn L) : SiteL2 L ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] SiteL2 L

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adBL.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adBL
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adBL.header: abbrev adBL (γ : GaugeFn L) : BondFnL2 L ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adBL_apply.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adBL_apply
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adBL_apply.header: theorem adBL_apply (γ : GaugeFn L) (f : BondFnL2 L) : adBL γ f = adB γ f

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adFL.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adFL
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adFL.header: abbrev adFL (γ : GaugeFn L) (G : TowerGeom L) : FSp G ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] FSp G

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adFL_apply.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adFL_apply
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adFL_apply.header:
theorem adFL_apply (γ : GaugeFn L) (G : TowerGeom L) (f : FSp G) (p : BIdx G) :
    (adFL γ G f) p = RMap (γ p.2.1.1) (f p)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adBL_mem_bondSupp.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adBL_mem_bondSupp
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adBL_mem_bondSupp.header:
theorem adBL_mem_bondSupp (γ : GaugeFn L) (G : TowerGeom L) (A : ↥(bondSupp G)) :
    adBL γ (A : BondFnL2 L) ∈ bondSupp G

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adEL.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adEL
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adEL.header: def adEL (γ : GaugeFn L) (G : TowerGeom L) : ↥(bondSupp G) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] ↥(bondSupp G)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adEL_coe.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adEL_coe
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adEL_coe.header:
theorem adEL_coe (γ : GaugeFn L) (G : TowerGeom L) (A : ↥(bondSupp G)) :
    ((adEL γ G A : ↥(bondSupp G)) : BondFnL2 L) = adBL γ (A : BondFnL2 L)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.conjCfg.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.conjCfg
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.conjCfg.header:
def conjCfg (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :
    PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.prod_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.prod_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.prod_gauge.header:
theorem prod_gauge (s : ℕ) (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :
    (fun b => conjCfg γ V1 b * coarseGaugeTransform s γ V0 b)
      = coarseGaugeTransform s γ (fun b => V1 b * V0 b)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.rProd_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.rProd_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.rProd_gauge.header:
theorem rProd_gauge (s : ℕ) (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    rProd s (coarseGaugeTransform s γ V0) (conjCfg γ V1) y p = γ y * rProd s V0 V1 y p * (γ y)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.sBlock_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.sBlock_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.sBlock_gauge.header:
theorem sBlock_gauge (s ell : ℕ) (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2)
    (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    sBlock s ell (coarseGaugeTransform s γ V0) (conjCfg γ V1) y = adMap (γ y) (sBlock s ell V0 V1 y)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.su2Exp_neg_ad.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.su2Exp_neg_ad
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.su2Exp_neg_ad.header: theorem su2Exp_neg_ad (g : SU2) (X : M2) : su2Exp (-(adMap g X)) = g * su2Exp (-X) * g⁻¹

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.rawStep_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.rawStep_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.rawStep_gauge.header:
theorem rawStep_gauge (s ell : ℕ) (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2)
    (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    rawStep s ell (coarseGaugeTransform s γ V0) (conjCfg γ V1) c
      = γ c.1 * rawStep s ell V0 V1 c * (γ c.1)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.conj_eq_of_equivari.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.conj_eq_of_equivariant
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.conj_eq_of_equivari.header:
theorem conj_eq_of_equivariant (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (f f' : E → E) (h : ∀ x, f' (A x) = A (f x)) :
    f' = ((A : E → E) ∘ f) ∘ (A.symm : E → E)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv_eq_of_equiva.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv_eq_of_equivariant
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv_eq_of_equiva.header:
theorem fderiv_eq_of_equivariant (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (f f' : E → E) (h : ∀ x, f' (A x) = A (f x)) :
    fderiv ℝ f' = fun y => A.arrowCongr A (fderiv ℝ f (A.symm y))

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv_equivariant.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv_equivariant
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv_equivariant.header:
theorem fderiv_equivariant (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (f f' : E → E) (h : ∀ x, f' (A x) = A (f x))
    (x a : E) : fderiv ℝ f' (A x) (A a) = A (fderiv ℝ f x a)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv2_equivariant.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv2_equivariant
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv2_equivariant.header:
theorem fderiv2_equivariant (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (f f' : E → E) (h : ∀ x, f' (A x) = A (f x))
    (x a b : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f') (A x) (A a) (A b) = A (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x a b)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.eX.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.eX
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.eX.header: def eX : BondFnL2 L ≃ₗ[ℝ] XS L

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdXl.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdXl
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdXl.header: def AdXl (γ : GaugeFn L) : XS L ≃ₗ[ℝ] XS L

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdX.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdX
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdX.header: def AdX (γ : GaugeFn L) : XS L ≃L[ℝ] XS L

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdX_apply.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdX_apply
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdX_apply.header:
theorem AdX_apply (γ : GaugeFn L) (a : XS L) (b : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    AdX γ a b = fromM2 ((RMap (γ b.1) ⟨toM2 (a b), toM2_mem _⟩ : SuTwo) : M2)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.suCoord_adBL.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.suCoord_adBL
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.suCoord_adBL.header: theorem suCoord_adBL (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : BondFnL2 L) : suCoord (adBL γ A) = AdX γ (suCoord A)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.suCoordInv_AdX.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.suCoordInv_AdX
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.suCoordInv_AdX.header: theorem suCoordInv_AdX (γ : GaugeFn L) (x : XS L) : suCoordInv (AdX γ x) = adBL γ (suCoordInv x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.expCfgX_AdX.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.expCfgX_AdX
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.expCfgX_AdX.header: theorem expCfgX_AdX (γ : GaugeFn L) (a : XS L) : expCfgX (AdX γ a) = conjCfg γ (expCfgX a)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.qStepX_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.qStepX_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.qStepX_gauge.header:
theorem qStepX_gauge (s ell : ℕ) (γ : GaugeFn L) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (a : XS L) :
    qStepX s ell (coarseGaugeTransform s γ V0) (AdX γ a) = AdX γ (qStepX s ell V0 a)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.qCompX_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.qCompX_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.qCompX_gauge.header:
theorem qCompX_gauge (ell : ℕ) (bg bg' : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (γ : GaugeFn L)
    (hbg : ∀ j, bg' j = coarseGaugeTransform (ell ^ j) γ (bg j)) :
    ∀ j a, qCompX ell bg' j (AdX γ a) = AdX γ (qCompX ell bg j a)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QlinStepX_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QlinStepX_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QlinStepX_gauge.header:
theorem QlinStepX_gauge (s ell : ℕ) (γ : GaugeFn L) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (a : XS L) :
    QlinStepX s ell (coarseGaugeTransform s γ V0) (AdX γ a) = AdX γ (QlinStepX s ell V0 a)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2StepX_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2StepX_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2StepX_gauge.header:
theorem C2StepX_gauge (s ell : ℕ) (γ : GaugeFn L) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (a : XS L) :
    C2StepX s ell (coarseGaugeTransform s γ V0) (AdX γ a) = AdX γ (C2StepX s ell V0 a)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QlinCompX_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QlinCompX_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QlinCompX_gauge.header:
theorem QlinCompX_gauge (ell : ℕ) (bg bg' : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (γ : GaugeFn L)
    (hbg : ∀ j, bg' j = coarseGaugeTransform (ell ^ j) γ (bg j)) (j : ℕ) (a : XS L) :
    QlinCompX ell bg' j (AdX γ a) = AdX γ (QlinCompX ell bg j a)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2CompX_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2CompX_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2CompX_gauge.header:
theorem C2CompX_gauge (ell : ℕ) (bg bg' : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (γ : GaugeFn L)
    (hbg : ∀ j, bg' j = coarseGaugeTransform (ell ^ j) γ (bg j)) (j : ℕ) (a : XS L) :
    C2CompX ell bg' j (AdX γ a) = AdX γ (C2CompX ell bg j a)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.bgTower_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.bgTower_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.bgTower_gauge.header:
theorem bgTower_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (j : ℕ) :
    bgTower G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) j = coarseGaugeTransform (G.ell ^ j) γ (bgTower G U j)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.conj_eq_of_equivari.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.conj_eq_of_equivariant₂
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.conj_eq_of_equivari.header:
theorem conj_eq_of_equivariant₂ (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (B : F ≃L[ℝ] F) (f f' : E → F)
    (h : ∀ x, f' (A x) = B (f x)) : f' = ((B : F → F) ∘ f) ∘ (A.symm : E → E)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv_eq_of_equiva.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv_eq_of_equivariant₂
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv_eq_of_equiva.header:
theorem fderiv_eq_of_equivariant₂ (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (B : F ≃L[ℝ] F) (f f' : E → F)
    (h : ∀ x, f' (A x) = B (f x)) :
    fderiv ℝ f' = fun y => A.arrowCongr B (fderiv ℝ f (A.symm y))

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv_equivariant₂.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv_equivariant₂
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv_equivariant₂.header:
theorem fderiv_equivariant₂ (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (B : F ≃L[ℝ] F) (f f' : E → F)
    (h : ∀ x, f' (A x) = B (f x)) (x a : E) : fderiv ℝ f' (A x) (A a) = B (fderiv ℝ f x a)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv2_equivariant.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv2_equivariant₂
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.fderiv2_equivariant.header:
theorem fderiv2_equivariant₂ (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (B : F ≃L[ℝ] F) (f f' : E → F)
    (h : ∀ x, f' (A x) = B (f x)) (x a b : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f') (A x) (A a) (A b) = B (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x a b)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdX_inv_AdX.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdX_inv_AdX
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdX_inv_AdX.header:
theorem AdX_inv_AdX (γ : GaugeFn L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    AdX (fun x => (γ x)⁻¹) (fun _ => AdX γ (fun _ => v) c) c = v

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdX_AdX_inv.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdX_AdX_inv
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdX_AdX_inv.header:
theorem AdX_AdX_inv (γ : GaugeFn L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    AdX γ (fun _ => AdX (fun x => (γ x)⁻¹) (fun _ => v) c) c = v

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adFib.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adFib
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adFib.header: def adFib (γ : GaugeFn L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : (Fin 3 → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdX_comp.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdX_comp
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.AdX_comp.header: theorem AdX_comp (γ : GaugeFn L) (y : XS L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : AdX γ y c = adFib γ c (y c)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.qStepComp_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.qStepComp_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.qStepComp_gauge.header:
theorem qStepComp_gauge (s ell : ℕ) (γ : GaugeFn L) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (a : XS L) :
    qStepComp s ell (coarseGaugeTransform s γ V0) c (AdX γ a) = adFib γ c (qStepComp s ell V0 c a)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QlinStepL_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QlinStepL_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QlinStepL_gauge.header:
theorem QlinStepL_gauge (s ell : ℕ) (γ : GaugeFn L) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (a : XS L) :
    QlinStepL s ell (coarseGaugeTransform s γ V0) (AdX γ a) = AdX γ (QlinStepL s ell V0 a)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.D2StepL_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.D2StepL_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.D2StepL_gauge.header:
theorem D2StepL_gauge (s ell : ℕ) (γ : GaugeFn L) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (a b : XS L) :
    D2StepL s ell (coarseGaugeTransform s γ V0) (AdX γ a) (AdX γ b) = AdX γ (D2StepL s ell V0 a b)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2StepL_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2StepL_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2StepL_gauge.header:
theorem C2StepL_gauge (s ell : ℕ) (γ : GaugeFn L) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (a : XS L) :
    C2StepL s ell (coarseGaugeTransform s γ V0) (AdX γ a) = AdX γ (C2StepL s ell V0 a)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QlinCompL_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QlinCompL_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QlinCompL_gauge.header:
theorem QlinCompL_gauge (ell : ℕ) (bg bg' : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (γ : GaugeFn L)
    (hbg : ∀ j, bg' j = coarseGaugeTransform (ell ^ j) γ (bg j)) :
    ∀ j a, QlinCompL ell bg' j (AdX γ a) = AdX γ (QlinCompL ell bg j a)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.D2CompL_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.D2CompL_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.D2CompL_gauge.header:
theorem D2CompL_gauge (ell : ℕ) (bg bg' : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (γ : GaugeFn L)
    (hbg : ∀ j, bg' j = coarseGaugeTransform (ell ^ j) γ (bg j)) :
    ∀ j a b, D2CompL ell bg' j (AdX γ a) (AdX γ b) = AdX γ (D2CompL ell bg j a b)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2CompL_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2CompL_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2CompL_gauge.header:
theorem C2CompL_gauge (ell : ℕ) (bg bg' : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (γ : GaugeFn L)
    (hbg : ∀ j, bg' j = coarseGaugeTransform (ell ^ j) γ (bg j)) (j : ℕ) (a : XS L) :
    C2CompL ell bg' j (AdX γ a) = AdX γ (C2CompL ell bg j a)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QlinB_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QlinB_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QlinB_gauge.header:
theorem QlinB_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (j : ℕ) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    QlinB G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) j (adBL γ A) = adBL γ (QlinB G U j A)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2rawB_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2rawB_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2rawB_gauge.header:
theorem C2rawB_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (j : ℕ) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    C2rawB G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) j (adBL γ A) = adBL γ (C2rawB G U j A)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QfullOf_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QfullOf_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.QfullOf_gauge.header:
theorem QfullOf_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    QfullOf G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (adBL γ A) = adFL γ G (QfullOf G U A)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2fullOf_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2fullOf_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2fullOf_gauge.header:
theorem C2fullOf_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    C2fullOf G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (adBL γ A) = adFL γ G (C2fullOf G U A)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adC.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adC
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adC.header: def adC (g : GaugeFn L) (ell : ℕ) (w : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.suCoordF_gaugeActA.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.suCoordF_gaugeActA
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.suCoordF_gaugeActA.header:
theorem suCoordF_gaugeActA (g : GaugeFn L) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    suCoordF (gaugeActA g B) = AdX g (suCoordF B)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.suCoordFInv_AdX.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.suCoordFInv_AdX
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.suCoordFInv_AdX.header:
theorem suCoordFInv_AdX (g : GaugeFn L) (x : XS L) :
    suCoordFInv (AdX g x) = gaugeActA g (suCoordFInv x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Q1jet_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Q1jet_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Q1jet_gauge.header:
theorem Q1jet_gauge (ell : ℕ) (g : GaugeFn L) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    Q1jet ell (periodicGaugeTransform g V0) (gaugeActA g B) = adC g ell (Q1jet ell V0 B)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2tilde_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2tilde_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2tilde_gauge.header:
theorem C2tilde_gauge (ell : ℕ) (g : GaugeFn L) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    C2tilde ell (periodicGaugeTransform g V0) (gaugeActA g B) = adC g ell (C2tilde ell V0 B)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.scaleUp_succ.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.scaleUp_succ
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.scaleUp_succ.header:
theorem scaleUp_succ (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (μ : Fin 3) :
    scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1 = (Lu μ + 1) * ell ^ k

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.embY_coarseShift.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.embY_coarseShift
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.embY_coarseShift.header:
theorem embY_coarseShift (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift (embY ell k Lu hell y) (ell ^ k) μ = embY ell k Lu hell (periodicLatticeShift y μ)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.unitBg_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.unitBg_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.unitBg_gauge.header:
theorem unitBg_gauge (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (γ : GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    unitBg ell k Lu hell (coarseGaugeTransform (ell ^ k) γ V)
      = periodicGaugeTransform (fun y => γ (embY ell k Lu hell y)) (unitBg ell k Lu hell V)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.unitBgU_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.unitBgU_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.unitBgU_gauge.header:
theorem unitBgU_gauge (P : IngrBParams) (γ : GaugeFn P.Lf) :
    unitBg P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell (bgTower P.G (periodicGaugeTransform γ P.U) P.k)
      = periodicGaugeTransform (fun y => γ (embY P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell y)) P.unitBgU

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Q1_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Q1_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Q1_gauge.header:
theorem Q1_gauge (P : IngrBParams) (γ : GaugeFn P.Lf) (B : Bond P.Lu → SuTwo) :
    Q1jet P.ell (unitBg P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell (bgTower P.G (periodicGaugeTransform γ P.U) P.k))
        (gaugeActA (fun y => γ (embY P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell y)) B)
      = adC (fun y => γ (embY P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell y)) P.ell (P.Q1 B)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2tildeU_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2tildeU_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2tildeU_gauge.header:
theorem C2tildeU_gauge (P : IngrBParams) (γ : GaugeFn P.Lf) (B : Bond P.Lu → SuTwo) :
    C2tilde P.ell (unitBg P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell (bgTower P.G (periodicGaugeTransform γ P.U) P.k))
        (gaugeActA (fun y => γ (embY P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell y)) B)
      = adC (fun y => γ (embY P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell y)) P.ell (C2tilde P.ell P.unitBgU B)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adjoint_eqv.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adjoint_eqv
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adjoint_eqv.header:
theorem adjoint_eqv {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    (A : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (B : F ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) (T T' : E →L[ℝ] F) (h : ∀ x, T' (A x) = B (T x)) (y : F) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T' (B y) = A (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T y)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.grad_gauge'.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.grad_gauge'
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.grad_gauge'.header:
theorem grad_gauge' (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) :
    gradValueCovariant (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (fun x => RMap (γ x) (lam x)) b
      = RMap (γ b.1) (gradValueCovariant U lam b)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.gradL2_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.gradL2_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.gradL2_gauge.header:
theorem gradL2_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    gradL2 (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (adSL γ f) = adBL γ (gradL2 U f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.gradAdj_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.gradAdj_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.gradAdj_gauge.header:
theorem gradAdj_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    gradAdj (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (adBL γ x) = adSL γ (gradAdj U x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.lapFull_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.lapFull_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.lapFull_gauge.header:
theorem lapFull_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    lapFull (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (adSL γ f) = adSL γ (lapFull U f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.siteMask_adSL.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.siteMask_adSL
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.siteMask_adSL.header:
theorem siteMask_adSL (γ : GaugeFn L) (S : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    siteMask S (adSL γ f) = adSL γ (siteMask S f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.op_of_form_iso.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.op_of_form_iso
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.op_of_form_iso.header:
theorem op_of_form_iso {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (A : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E)
    (T T' : E →L[ℝ] E) (h : ∀ x y, ⟪A x, T' (A y)⟫ = ⟪x, T y⟫) (y : E) : T' (A y) = A (T y)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Qlev_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Qlev_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Qlev_gauge.header:
theorem Qlev_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (j : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (f : SiteL2 L) :
    Qlev G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) j y (adSL γ f) = RMap (γ y) (Qlev G U j y f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.inner_Qpa_bil.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.inner_Qpa_bil
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.inner_Qpa_bil.header:
theorem inner_Qpa_bil (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (f g : SiteL2 L) :
    ⟪f, Qpa G U a g⟫ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (G.k + 1), ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L,
      if y ∈ G.Lam j then (ajSeq a G.ell j * (G.ell : ℝ) ^ j) * ⟪Qlev G U j y f, Qlev G U j y g⟫ else 0

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Qpa_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Qpa_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Qpa_gauge.header:
theorem Qpa_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    Qpa G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) a (adSL γ f) = adSL γ (Qpa G U a f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.DelpA_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.DelpA_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.DelpA_gauge.header:
theorem DelpA_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    DelpA G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) a (adSL γ f) = adSL γ (DelpA G U a f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.RMap_eq_zero_iff.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.RMap_eq_zero_iff
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.RMap_eq_zero_iff.header: theorem RMap_eq_zero_iff (g : SU2g) (X : SuTwo) : RMap g X = 0 ↔ X = 0

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.mem_NQp_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.mem_NQp_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.mem_NQp_gauge.header:
theorem mem_NQp_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    adSL γ f ∈ NQp G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) ↔ f ∈ NQp G U

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.lapDir_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.lapDir_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.lapDir_gauge.header:
theorem lapDir_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    lapDir G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (adSL γ f) = adSL γ (lapDir G U f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.RImage_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.RImage_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.RImage_gauge.header:
theorem RImage_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) :
    RImage G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U)
      = (RImage G U).map (adSL γ).toLinearIsometry.toLinearMap

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Rproj_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Rproj_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Rproj_gauge.header:
theorem Rproj_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    Rproj G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (adSL γ f) = adSL γ (Rproj G U f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.ringInverse_eqv.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.ringInverse_eqv
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.ringInverse_eqv.header:
theorem ringInverse_eqv {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (A : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (T T' : E →L[ℝ] E) (h : ∀ x, T' (A x) = A (T x)) (x : E) :
    Ring.inverse T' (A x) = A (Ring.inverse T x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Gp_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Gp_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Gp_gauge.header:
theorem Gp_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    Gp G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) a (adSL γ f) = adSL γ (Gp G U a f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Tfull_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Tfull_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Tfull_gauge.header:
theorem Tfull_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    Tfull G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (adBL γ x) = adSL γ (Tfull G U x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Wop_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Wop_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Wop_gauge.header:
theorem Wop_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    Wop G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) a (adBL γ x) = adBL γ (Wop G U a x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.piProj_cjM.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.piProj_cjM
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.piProj_cjM.header: theorem piProj_cjM (g : SU2g) (X : Mat2) : piProj (cjM g X) = cjM g (piProj X)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.cjM_mulgrp.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.cjM_mulgrp
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.cjM_mulgrp.header: theorem cjM_mulgrp (g h : SU2g) (X : Mat2) : cjM (g * h) X = cjM g (cjM h X)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.cjM_one_id.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.cjM_one_id
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.cjM_one_id.header: theorem cjM_one_id (X : Mat2) : cjM (1 : SU2g) X = X

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.cjM_inv_cancel.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.cjM_inv_cancel
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.cjM_inv_cancel.header: theorem cjM_inv_cancel (g : SU2g) (X : Mat2) : cjM g⁻¹ (cjM g X) = X

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.FnuMuLoc_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.FnuMuLoc_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.FnuMuLoc_gauge.header:
theorem FnuMuLoc_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (U : Cfg L)
    (ν μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    FnuMuLoc P (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) ν μ y = cjM (γ y) (FnuMuLoc P U ν μ y)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.DstarDir_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.DstarDir_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.DstarDir_gauge.header:
theorem DstarDir_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (ν : Fin 3)
    (F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Mat2) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    DstarDir (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) ν (fun y => cjM (γ y) (F y)) x = cjM (γ x) (DstarDir U ν F x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.cjM_sum.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.cjM_sum
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.cjM_sum.header:
theorem cjM_sum {ι : Type*} (g : SU2g) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Mat2) :
    cjM g (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, cjM g (f i)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.JfieldLoc_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.JfieldLoc_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.JfieldLoc_gauge.header:
theorem JfieldLoc_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (U : Cfg L)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    JfieldLoc P (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) x μ = cjM (γ x) (JfieldLoc P U x μ)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.JSU2Loc_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.JSU2Loc_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.JSU2Loc_gauge.header:
theorem JSU2Loc_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L) (η : ℝ) (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (U : Cfg L)
    (b : Bond L) :
    JSU2Loc η P (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) b = RMap (γ b.1) (JSU2Loc η P U b)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Jf_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Jf_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Jf_gauge.header:
theorem Jf_gauge (P : IngrBParams) (γ : GaugeFn P.Lf) :
    ({ P with U := periodicGaugeTransform γ P.U } : IngrBParams).Jf = adBL γ P.Jf

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Delta_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Delta_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Delta_gauge.header:
theorem Delta_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    Delta G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) (adBL γ x) = adBL γ (Delta G U x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.DpiFull_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.DpiFull_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.DpiFull_gauge.header:
theorem DpiFull_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    DpiFull G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) a (adBL γ x) = adBL γ (DpiFull G U a x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.scaleUp_succ_b.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.scaleUp_succ_b
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.scaleUp_succ_b.header:
theorem scaleUp_succ_b (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (μ : Fin 3) :
    scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1 = (Lu μ + 1) * ell ^ k

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.coarseShift_embY.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.coarseShift_embY
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.coarseShift_embY.header:
theorem coarseShift_embY (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift (embY ell k Lu hell y) (ell ^ k) μ = embY ell k Lu hell (periodicLatticeShift y μ)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.unitBg_gauge_b.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.unitBg_gauge_b
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.unitBg_gauge_b.header:
theorem unitBg_gauge_b (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (γ : GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Ubar : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2g (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    unitBg ell k Lu hell (AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.coarseGaugeTransform (ell ^ k) γ Ubar)
      = periodicGaugeTransform (fun y => γ (embY ell k Lu hell y)) (unitBg ell k Lu hell Ubar)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.classCoupled_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.classCoupled_gauge

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.classCoupled_gauge_.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.classCoupled_gauge_iff
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.classCoupled_gauge_.header:
theorem classCoupled_gauge_iff {ell M c k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {α₀ η : ℝ} {U : LinkCfg L} (γ : GaugeFn L) :
    ClassCoupled ell M c k S α₀ η (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) ↔ ClassCoupled ell M c k S α₀ η U

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.gaugeActA_eq_zero_i.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.gaugeActA_eq_zero_iff'
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.gaugeActA_eq_zero_i.header:
theorem gaugeActA_eq_zero_iff' {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (g : GaugeFn Lu) (B : Bond Lu → SuTwo) (b : Bond Lu) :
    gaugeActA g B b = 0 ↔ B b = 0

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.onLambdaT_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.onLambdaT_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.onLambdaT_gauge.header:
theorem onLambdaT_gauge {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (g : GaugeFn Lu) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (B : Bond Lu → SuTwo) : OnLambdaT Lam (gaugeActA g B) ↔ OnLambdaT Lam B

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.onLambda_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.onLambda_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.onLambda_gauge.header:
theorem onLambda_gauge {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (g : GaugeFn Lu) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (B : Bond Lu → SuTwo) : OnLambda Lam (gaugeActA g B) ↔ OnLambda Lam B

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.onLambdaTildeIn_gau.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.onLambdaTildeIn_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.onLambdaTildeIn_gau.header:
theorem onLambdaTildeIn_gauge {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (g : GaugeFn Lu) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (ell : ℕ) (B : Bond Lu → SuTwo) : OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell (gaugeActA g B) ↔ OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell B

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.conj_ringInverse.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.conj_ringInverse
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.conj_ringInverse.header:
theorem conj_ringInverse {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    (e : X ≃L[ℝ] X) (M : X →L[ℝ] X) :
    Ring.inverse (e.conjContinuousAlgEquiv M) = e.conjContinuousAlgEquiv (Ring.inverse M)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.ringInverse_intertw.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.ringInverse_intertwine
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.ringInverse_intertw.header:
theorem ringInverse_intertwine {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    (e : X ≃L[ℝ] X) {M M' : X →L[ℝ] X} (h : ∀ x, M' (e x) = e (M x)) (x : X) :
    Ring.inverse M' (e x) = e (Ring.inverse M x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.header:
structure BaseEqv (AE : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (AS : S ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] S) (AF : F ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F)
    (D D' : BaseDataS E S F) : Prop

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.Ts.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.Ts
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.Ts.header: theorem Ts (h : BaseEqv AE AS AF D D') (s : S) : D'.Ts (AS s) = AE (D.Ts s)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.Qs.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.Qs
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.Qs.header: theorem Qs (h : BaseEqv AE AS AF D D') (f : F) : D'.Qs (AF f) = AE (D.Qs f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.Ginv.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.Ginv
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.Ginv.header: theorem Ginv (h : BaseEqv AE AS AF D D') (x : E) : D'.Ginv (AE x) = AE (D.Ginv x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.G.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.G
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.G.header: theorem G (h : BaseEqv AE AS AF D D') (x : E) : D'.G (AE x) = AE (D.G x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.Hgen.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.Hgen
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.Hgen.header:
theorem Hgen (h : BaseEqv AE AS AF D D') {P P' : E →L[ℝ] E} (hP : ∀ x, P' (AE x) = AE (P x))
    (f : F) :
    ((P'.comp D'.Qs).comp (Ring.inverse ((D'.Q.comp P').comp D'.Qs))) (AF f) =
      AE (((P.comp D.Qs).comp (Ring.inverse ((D.Q.comp P).comp D.Qs))) f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.H.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.H
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.H.header: theorem H (h : BaseEqv AE AS AF D D') (f : F) : D'.H (AF f) = AE (D.H f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.K.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.K
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.K.header: theorem K (h : BaseEqv AE AS AF D D') (A : E) : D'.K (AE A) = D.K A

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.conjOp.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.conjOp
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.conjOp.header: def conjOp (AE : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (X : E →L[ℝ] E) : E →L[ℝ] E

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.conjOp_appl.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.conjOp_apply
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.conjOp_appl.header: theorem conjOp_apply (X : E →L[ℝ] E) (x : E) : conjOp AE X (AE x) = AE (X x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.isG1inv.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.isG1inv
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.isG1inv.header:
theorem isG1inv (h : BaseEqv AE AS AF D D') {X : E →L[ℝ] E} (hX : D.IsG1inv X) :
    D'.IsG1inv (conjOp AE X)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.G1inv.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.G1inv
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.G1inv.header:
theorem G1inv (h : BaseEqv AE AS AF D D') {X X' : E →L[ℝ] E} (hX : D.IsG1inv X)
    (hX' : D'.IsG1inv X') (x : E) : X' (AE x) = AE (X x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.G1.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.G1
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.G1.header:
theorem G1 (h : BaseEqv AE AS AF D D') {X X' : E →L[ℝ] E} (hX : D.IsG1inv X)
    (hX' : D'.IsG1inv X') (x : E) : D'.G1 X' (AE x) = AE (D.G1 X x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.H1.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.H1
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.H1.header:
theorem H1 (h : BaseEqv AE AS AF D D') {X X' : E →L[ℝ] E} (hX : D.IsG1inv X)
    (hX' : D'.IsG1inv X') (f : F) : D'.H1 X' (AF f) = AE (D.H1 X f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.QG1Qs.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.QG1Qs
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BaseEqv.QG1Qs.header:
theorem QG1Qs (h : BaseEqv AE AS AF D D') {X X' : E →L[ℝ] E} (hX : D.IsG1inv X)
    (hX' : D'.IsG1inv X') (f : F) :
    D'.Q (D'.G1 X' (D'.Qs (AF f))) = AF (D.Q (D.G1 X (D.Qs f)))

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adjoint_intertwine.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adjoint_intertwine
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adjoint_intertwine.header:
theorem adjoint_intertwine {X Y : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [InnerProductSpace ℝ X]
    [CompleteSpace X] [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Y] [CompleteSpace Y]
    (AX : X ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] X) (AY : Y ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Y) {M M' : X →L[ℝ] Y}
    (h : ∀ x, M' (AX x) = AY (M x)) (y : Y) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint M' (AY y) = AX (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint M y)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BondEqv.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BondEqv
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BondEqv.header:
structure BondEqv (γ : GaugeFn L) (G : TowerGeom L) (U U' : Cfg L) (a : ℝ)
    (S S' : BondSector G) (Jf Jf' : BondFnL2 L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.iE_adEL.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.iE_adEL
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.iE_adEL.header:
theorem iE_adEL (γ : GaugeFn L) (G : TowerGeom L) (A : ↥(bondSupp G)) :
    iE G (adEL γ G A) = adBL γ (iE G A)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.pE_adBL.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.pE_adBL
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.pE_adBL.header:
theorem pE_adBL (γ : GaugeFn L) (G : TowerGeom L) (y : BondFnL2 L) :
    pE G (adBL γ y) = adEL γ G (pE G y)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.diagW_adFL.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.diagW_adFL
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.diagW_adFL.header:
theorem diagW_adFL (γ : GaugeFn L) (G : TowerGeom L) (w : BIdx G → ℝ) (f : FSp G) :
    diagW G w (adFL γ G f) = adFL γ G (diagW G w f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BondEqv.Dpi.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BondEqv.Dpi
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BondEqv.Dpi.header:
theorem Dpi (h : BondEqv γ G U U' a S S' Jf Jf') (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    DpiFull G U' a (adBL γ x) = adBL γ (DpiFull G U a x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BondEqv.Mass.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BondEqv.Mass
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BondEqv.Mass.header:
theorem Mass (h : BondEqv γ G U U' a S S' Jf Jf') (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    MassFull G a S' (adBL γ x) = adBL γ (MassFull G a S x)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BondEqv.baseEqv.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BondEqv.baseEqv
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.BondEqv.baseEqv.header:
theorem baseEqv (h : BondEqv γ G U U' a S S' Jf Jf') :
    BaseEqv (adEL γ G) (adSL γ) (adFL γ G) (baseData G U a S Jf) (baseData G U' a S' Jf')

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adFun.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adFun
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adFun.header: def adFun {ι : Type*} (φ : ι → SU2g) : (ι → SuTwo) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (ι → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adFun_apply.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adFun_apply
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adFun_apply.header:
theorem adFun_apply {ι : Type*} (φ : ι → SU2g) (w : ι → SuTwo) (i : ι) :
    adFun φ w i = RMap (φ i) (w i)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.gaugeActA_eq_adFun.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.gaugeActA_eq_adFun
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.gaugeActA_eq_adFun.header:
theorem gaugeActA_eq_adFun {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (g : GaugeFn L) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    gaugeActA g B = adFun (fun b : Bond L => g b.1) B

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adCg.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adCg
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adCg.header: abbrev adCg : (CoarseBond Lu ell → SuTwo) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (CoarseBond Lu ell → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adD.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adD
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adD.header: abbrev adD : (Dset Lu ell Lam → SuTwo) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Dset Lu ell Lam → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adD2.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adD2
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.adD2.header: abbrev adD2 : (Dset Lu ell Lam → SuTwo) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Dset Lu ell Lam → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.iotaD_adD2.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.iotaD_adD2
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.iotaD_adD2.header:
theorem iotaD_adD2 (w : Dset Lu ell Lam → SuTwo) :
    iotaD ell Lam (adD2 ell Lam g w) = gaugeActA g (iotaD ell Lam w)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.rhoD_adC.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.rhoD_adC
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.rhoD_adC.header:
theorem rhoD_adC (f : CoarseBond Lu ell → SuTwo) :
    rhoD ell Lam (adCg ell g f) = adD ell Lam g (rhoD ell Lam f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.H0_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.H0_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.H0_gauge.header:
theorem H0_gauge (hQ : ∀ B c, Q' (gaugeActA g B) c = RMap (g c.1.1) (Q B c))
    (w : Dset Lu ell Lam → SuTwo) :
    H0 Lam Q' (adD2 ell Lam g w) = adD ell Lam g (H0 Lam Q w)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.H0_bijective_iff.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.H0_bijective_iff
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.H0_bijective_iff.header:
theorem H0_bijective_iff (hQ : ∀ B c, Q' (gaugeActA g B) c = RMap (g c.1.1) (Q B c)) :
    Function.Bijective (H0 Lam Q') ↔ Function.Bijective (H0 Lam Q)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.H0inv_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.H0inv_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.H0inv_gauge.header:
theorem H0inv_gauge (hQ : ∀ B c, Q' (gaugeActA g B) c = RMap (g c.1.1) (Q B c))
    (w : Dset Lu ell Lam → SuTwo) :
    H0inv Lam Q' (adD ell Lam g w) = adD2 ell Lam g (H0inv Lam Q w)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.hLift_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.hLift_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.hLift_gauge.header:
theorem hLift_gauge (hQ : ∀ B c, Q' (gaugeActA g B) c = RMap (g c.1.1) (Q B c))
    (w : CoarseBond Lu ell → SuTwo) :
    hLift Lam Q' (adCg ell g w) = gaugeActA g (hLift Lam Q w)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Cop_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Cop_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Cop_gauge.header:
theorem Cop_gauge (hQ : ∀ B c, Q' (gaugeActA g B) c = RMap (g c.1.1) (Q B c))
    (B : Bond Lu → SuTwo) :
    Cop Lam Q' (gaugeActA g B) = gaugeActA g (Cop Lam Q B)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.D2in_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.D2in_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.D2in_gauge.header:
theorem D2in_gauge (P : IngrBParams) (U' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2g P.Lf)
    (g : GaugeFn P.Lu)
    (hQ1 : ∀ B c, ({ P with U := U' } : IngrBParams).Q1 (gaugeActA g B) c = RMap (g c.1.1) (P.Q1 B c))
    (hC2 : ∀ B c, C2tilde P.ell ({ P with U := U' } : IngrBParams).unitBgU (gaugeActA g B) c =
      RMap (g c.1.1) (C2tilde P.ell P.unitBgU B c))
    (B : BondFnL2 P.Lu) :
    ({ P with U := U' } : IngrBParams).D2in (adBL g B) = adBL g (P.D2in B)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.uOf.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.uOf
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.uOf.header:
def uOf (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (γ : GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) : GaugeFn Lu

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.tauExt_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.tauExt_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.tauExt_gauge.header:
theorem tauExt_gauge (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (γ : GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (f : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    tauExt ell k Lu hell S (adFL γ (geomOf ell k S) f) =
      adBL (uOf ell k Lu hell γ) (tauExt ell k Lu hell S f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.tauExt_adjoint_gaug.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.tauExt_adjoint_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.tauExt_adjoint_gaug.header:
theorem tauExt_adjoint_gauge (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (γ : GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (y : BondFnL2 Lu) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell k Lu hell S) (adBL (uOf ell k Lu hell γ) y) =
      adFL γ (geomOf ell k S) (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell k Lu hell S) y)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.header:
structure GenFormHyps (P : IngrBParams) (U' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2g P.Lf)
    (γ : GaugeFn P.Lf) : Prop

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.data.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.data
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.data.header:
theorem data (h : GenFormHyps P U' γ) :
    BaseEqv (adEL γ P.G) (adSL γ) (adFL γ P.G) P.data ({ P with U := U' } : IngrBParams).data

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.Nmat.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.Nmat
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.Nmat.header:
theorem Nmat (h : GenFormHyps P U' γ) (f : FSp P.G) :
    GenP.Nmat ({ P with U := U' } : IngrBParams) (adFL γ P.G f) = adFL γ P.G (GenP.Nmat P f)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.firstTe.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.firstTerm
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.firstTe.header:
theorem firstTerm (h : GenFormHyps P U' γ) (B : BondFnL2 P.Lu) :
    GenP.firstTerm ({ P with U := U' } : IngrBParams) (adBL (uOf P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell γ) B) =
      GenP.firstTerm P B

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.H1in.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.H1in
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.H1in.header:
theorem H1in (h : GenFormHyps P U' γ) (y : BondFnL2 P.Lu) :
    ({ P with U := U' } : IngrBParams).H1in (adBL (uOf P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell γ) y) =
      adBL γ (P.H1in y)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.genForm.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.genForm
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.GenFormHyps.genForm.header:
theorem genForm (h : GenFormHyps P U' γ) (B : BondFnL2 P.Lu) :
    GenP.genForm ({ P with U := U' } : IngrBParams) (adBL (uOf P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell γ) B) =
      GenP.genForm P B

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.genForm_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.genForm_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.genForm_gauge.header:
theorem genForm_gauge (P : IngrBParams) (γ : GaugeFn P.Lf)
    (hbase : BondEqv γ P.G P.U (periodicGaugeTransform γ P.U) P.a P.sector
      ({ P with U := periodicGaugeTransform γ P.U } : IngrBParams).sector P.Jf
      ({ P with U := periodicGaugeTransform γ P.U } : IngrBParams).Jf)
    (hQ1 : ∀ B c, ({ P with U := periodicGaugeTransform γ P.U } : IngrBParams).Q1
      (gaugeActA (uOf P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell γ) B) c =
        RMap (uOf P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell γ c.1.1) (P.Q1 B c))
    (hC2 : ∀ B c, C2tilde P.ell ({ P with U := periodicGaugeTransform γ P.U } : IngrBParams).unitBgU
      (gaugeActA (uOf P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell γ) B) c =
        RMap (uOf P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell γ c.1.1) (C2tilde P.ell P.unitBgU B c))
    (B : BondFnL2 P.Lu) :
    GenP.genForm ({ P with U := periodicGaugeTransform γ P.U } : IngrBParams)
      (adBL (uOf P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell γ) B) = GenP.genForm P B

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Q1_gauge_pt.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Q1_gauge_pt
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.Q1_gauge_pt.header:
theorem Q1_gauge_pt (P : IngrBParams) (γ : GaugeFn P.Lf) (B : Bond P.Lu → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond P.Lu P.ell) :
    (gaugeP P γ).Q1 (gaugeActA (uOf P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell γ) B) c
      = RMap (uOf P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell γ c.1.1) (P.Q1 B c)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2tilde_gauge_pt.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2tilde_gauge_pt
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.C2tilde_gauge_pt.header:
theorem C2tilde_gauge_pt (P : IngrBParams) (γ : GaugeFn P.Lf) (B : Bond P.Lu → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond P.Lu P.ell) :
    C2tilde P.ell (gaugeP P γ).unitBgU (gaugeActA (uOf P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell γ) B) c
      = RMap (uOf P.ell P.k P.Lu P.hell γ c.1.1) (C2tilde P.ell P.unitBgU B c)

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.bondEqv_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.bondEqv_gauge
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.bondEqv_gauge.header:
theorem bondEqv_gauge (P : IngrBParams) (γ : GaugeFn P.Lf) :
    BondEqv γ P.G P.U (periodicGaugeTransform γ P.U) P.a P.sector (gaugeP P γ).sector P.Jf (gaugeP P γ).Jf

AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.genForm_gauge_main.name: AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.genForm_gauge_main
AdalyFormal.GaugeCov.genForm_gauge_main.header:
theorem genForm_gauge_main (P : IngrBParams) (γ : GaugeFn P.Lf) (B : BondFnL2 P.Lu) :

    (hcov : CoversOm0p ell M 12 k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) {m : ℕ} (hmk : m ≤ k)
    {x0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx0 : x0 ∈ S.Om (m + 1)) {v : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hv : ∀ μ, (v μ).val % bigSide M ell m = 0)
    (hnear : ∀ p ∈ BoxS (bigSide M ell m), pdist (iota v p) x0 + 18 * bigSide M ell m ≤ R * bigSide M ell m)
    {α₀ η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀) {U : LinkCfg L} (hP : PerCubeRegular2 ell M 12 k S α₀ η U)
    (hsm : (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ * ((ell : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ + 12 * M * α₀ * (((ell : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹) ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    {R' : ℕ} (hR' : 1 ≤ R') (hRs : R' + 3 ≤ bigSide M ell m) (hinj : Set.InjOn (iota v) (Box (R' + 3)))
    (ht12 : (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ * ((ell : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ ≤ 2)
    (hsmall : (4 * cB 1152 5 + 1) * (3 * (R' : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 *
      ((1 + 4 * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ * ((ell : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹)) * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ * (((ell : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹) ^ 2)
        + 43 * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ * ((ell : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹) ^ 2) ≤ 1) :
    ∃ gv : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2,
      GChart U gv (lift v (Box R'))
        (KT1 4 1152 * (3 * R' + 2) * ((1 + 4 * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ * ((ell : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹)) *
          ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ * (((ell : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹) ^ 2) + 43 * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ * ((ell : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹) ^ 2))
        (KT2 4 1152 * ((1 + 4 * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ * ((ell : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹)) *
          ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ * (((ell : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹) ^ 2) + 43 * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ * ((ell : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹) ^ 2))

AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.nonwrap_of_thick.name: AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.nonwrap_of_thick
AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.nonwrap_of_thick.header:
theorem nonwrap_of_thick {Lu Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell k j ρ : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hjk : j ≤ k)
    (hf : ∀ μ, Lf μ + 1 = (Lu μ + 1) * ell ^ k) (hthick : ∀ μ, 2 * ρ + 6 < Lu μ + 1)
    (v : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) : Set.InjOn (iota v) (Box (ρ * ell ^ j + 3))

AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.lambda_ball_in_Omk.name: AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.lambda_ball_in_Omk
AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.lambda_ball_in_Omk.header:
theorem lambda_ball_in_Omk {Lu Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower Lf}
    {Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)} (h : LambdaOK ell M R k S Lam) :
    ∃ emb : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu → PeriodicLatticeSite Lf, (∀ y μ, (emb y μ).val = ell ^ k * (y μ).val) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Lam, ∀ y' : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu, pdist y y' ≤ R * M → emb y' ∈ S.Om k

AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.pcd_two_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.pcd_two_le
AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.pcd_two_le.header: theorem pcd_two_le (N a b : ℕ) : 2 * pcd N a b ≤ N

AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.pdist_two_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.pdist_two_le
AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.pdist_two_le.header:
theorem pdist_two_le {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    2 * pdist x y ≤ ∑ μ : Fin 3, (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.lambda_sum_sides.name: AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.lambda_sum_sides
AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.lambda_sum_sides.header:
theorem lambda_sum_sides {Lu Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower Lf}
    {Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)} (h : LambdaOK ell M R k S Lam) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu} (hy : y ∈ Lam)
    (hout : ∃ (emb : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu → PeriodicLatticeSite Lf), (∀ y μ, (emb y μ).val = ell ^ k * (y μ).val) ∧
      ∃ y', emb y' ∉ S.Om k) :
    2 * (R * M) < ∑ μ : Fin 3, (Lu μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.not_injOn_of_small.name: AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.not_injOn_of_small
AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.not_injOn_of_small.header:
theorem not_injOn_of_small {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {r : ℕ} (hr : L 0 + 1 ≤ 2 * r) :
    ¬ Set.InjOn (iota v) (Box r)

AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.thin_torus_counter.name: AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.thin_torus_counterexample
AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.thin_torus_counter.header:
theorem thin_torus_counterexample {ell M k n : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn12 : n ≤ 12) (R : ℕ) :
    ∃ Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent, TorusOK ell M Lu ∧
      Admissible ell M R k (Sk (scaleUp ell k Lu) k) ∧ CoversOm0p ell M 12 k (Sk (scaleUp ell k Lu) k) ∧
      LambdaOK2 (Lu := Lu) (Lf := scaleUp ell k Lu) ell M R k (Sk (scaleUp ell k Lu) k) Set.univ ∧
      (LamPrime ell (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))).Nonempty ∧
      (∀ μ, Lu μ + 1 = n * M) ∧
      ∀ (v : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (r : ℕ), n * M * ell ^ k ≤ 2 * r → ¬ Set.InjOn (iota v) (Box r)

AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.good_overlap.name: AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.good_overlap
AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.good_overlap.header:
theorem good_overlap {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell M k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {s : ℕ} {v v' : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    {C C' : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} (hC : ∀ p ∈ BoxS s, iota v p ∈ C) (hC' : ∀ p ∈ BoxS s, iota v' p ∈ C')
    {a : Z3} (ha : v' = iota v a) {q : Z3} (hq : q ∈ BoxS s) (hqa : a + q ∈ BoxS s) :
    iota v' q ∈ C ∧ iota v' q ∈ C'

AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.corner_bad_vertex.name: AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.corner_bad_vertex
AdalyFormal.M2GlueGeo.corner_bad_vertex.header:
theorem corner_bad_vertex {M R : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hM2 : 2 ∣ M) (hR : 24 ≤ R) :
    ∃ Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent, TorusOK 2 M Lu ∧
    ∃ S : Tower (scaleUp 2 1 Lu), Admissible 2 M R 1 S ∧ CoversOm0p 2 M 12 1 S ∧
    ∃ Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu), LambdaOK2 (Lf := scaleUp 2 1 Lu) 2 M R 1 S Lam ∧
      (LamPrime 2 Lam).Nonempty ∧
    ∃ v : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp 2 1 Lu), (∀ μ, (v μ).val % bigSide M 2 0 = 0) ∧
      BadVertex 2 M 1 S (bigSide M 2 0) v ∧ VertexCubes 2 M 1 S 0 v

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.mkE.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.mkE
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.mkE.header:
noncomputable def mkE {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (f : (ι → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (κ → ℂ)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.mkE_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.mkE_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.mkE_apply.header:
theorem mkE_apply {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (f : (ι → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (κ → ℂ))
    (A : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (k : κ) : mkE f A k = f A.ofLp k

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L1.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L1
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L1.header: noncomputable def L1 (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : TB L →ₗ[ℂ] TP L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L1_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L1_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L1_apply.header:
theorem L1_apply (A : TB L) (x : Site L) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    L1 L A (x, μ, ν) = ((1 / Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (A (x + eU L μ, ν) - A (x, ν) - A (x + eU L ν, μ) + A (x, μ))

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dst.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dst
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dst.header: noncomputable def Dst (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : TB L →ₗ[ℂ] TS L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dst_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dst_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dst_apply.header: theorem Dst_apply (A : TB L) (x : Site L) : Dst L A x = ∑ μ : Fin 3, (A (x - eU L μ, μ) - A (x, μ))

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapC.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapC
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapC.header: noncomputable def lapC (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : TS L →ₗ[ℂ] TS L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapC_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapC_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapC_apply.header:
theorem lapC_apply (φ : TS L) (x : Site L) :
    lapC L φ x = ∑ μ : Fin 3, (2 * φ x - φ (x + eU L μ) - φ (x - eU L μ))

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Coarse.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Coarse
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Coarse.header: def Coarse (n : ℕ) (x : Site L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2.header: noncomputable def L2 (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) : TB L →ₗ[ℂ] TB L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2_apply.header:
theorem L2_apply (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (A : TB L) (x : Site L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    L2 hdvd A (x, μ) = if Coarse n x then ∑ t : Cell n, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, A (x + ιc hdvd t + i • eU L μ, μ) else 0

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.permE.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.permE
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.permE.header: noncomputable def permE {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.permE_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.permE_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.permE_apply.header:
theorem permE_apply {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (f : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (j : ι) :
    permE σ f j = f (σ j)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftE.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftE
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftE.header:
noncomputable def shiftE (n : ℕ) (g : Site L) (β : Type*) [Fintype β] :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftE_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftE_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftE_apply.header:
theorem shiftE_apply (n : ℕ) (g : Site L) (β : Type*) [Fintype β] (f : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β)) (x : Site L) (b : β) :
    shiftE n g β f (x, b) = f (x + n • g, b)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftS.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftS
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftS.header: noncomputable def shiftS (n : ℕ) (g : Site L) : TS L ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] TS L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftS_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftS_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftS_apply.header: theorem shiftS_apply (n : ℕ) (g : Site L) (f : TS L) (x : Site L) : shiftS n g f x = f (x + n • g)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L1_equiv.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L1_equiv
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L1_equiv.header:
theorem L1_equiv (g : Site L) (A : TB L) :
    L1 L (shiftE n g (Fin 3) A) = shiftE n g (Fin 3 × Fin 3) (L1 L A)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dst_equiv.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dst_equiv
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dst_equiv.header:
theorem Dst_equiv (g : Site L) (A : TB L) :
    Dst L (shiftE n g (Fin 3) A) = shiftS n g (Dst L A)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapC_equiv.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapC_equiv
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapC_equiv.header:
theorem lapC_equiv (g : Site L) (φ : TS L) :
    lapC L (shiftS n g φ) = shiftS n g (lapC L φ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coarse_add.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coarse_add
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coarse_add.header: theorem coarse_add (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (x g : Site L) : Coarse n (x + n • g) ↔ Coarse n x

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2_equiv.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2_equiv
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2_equiv.header:
theorem L2_equiv (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (g : Site L) (A : TB L) :
    L2 hdvd (shiftE n g (Fin 3) A) = shiftE n g (Fin 3) (L2 hdvd A)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Wc.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Wc
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Wc.header: def Wc (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) : Submodule ℂ (TS L)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.DW.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.DW
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.DW.header: noncomputable def DW (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) : Submodule ℂ (TS L)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftS_Wc.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftS_Wc
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftS_Wc.header:
theorem shiftS_Wc (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (g : Site L) {φ : TS L} (hφ : φ ∈ Wc (n := n) hdvd) :
    shiftS n g φ ∈ Wc (n := n) hdvd

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.DW_map_shiftS.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.DW_map_shiftS
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.DW_map_shiftS.header:
theorem DW_map_shiftS (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (g : Site L) :
    (DW (n := n) hdvd).map (shiftS n g).toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap = DW (n := n) hdvd

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Pw.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Pw
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Pw.header: noncomputable def Pw (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) : TS L →L[ℂ] TS L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftS_symm.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftS_symm
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftS_symm.header: theorem shiftS_symm (g : Site L) (w : TS L) : (shiftS n g).symm w = shiftS n (-g) w

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftS_mem_DW.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftS_mem_DW
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftS_mem_DW.header:
theorem shiftS_mem_DW (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (g : Site L) {y : TS L} (hy : y ∈ DW (n := n) hdvd) :
    shiftS n g y ∈ DW (n := n) hdvd

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Pw_equiv.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Pw_equiv
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Pw_equiv.header:
theorem Pw_equiv (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (g : Site L) (f : TS L) :
    Pw hdvd (shiftS n g f) = shiftS n g (Pw hdvd f)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L3.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L3
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L3.header: noncomputable def L3 (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) : TB L →ₗ[ℂ] TS L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L3_equiv.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L3_equiv
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L3_equiv.header:
theorem L3_equiv (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (g : Site L) (A : TB L) :
    L3 hdvd (shiftE n g (Fin 3) A) = shiftS n g (L3 hdvd A)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mnum.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mnum
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mnum.header: noncomputable def Mnum (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (n : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mnum_pos.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mnum_pos
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mnum_pos.header: theorem Mnum_pos (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) : 0 < Mnum L n

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.IsEigS.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.IsEigS
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.IsEigS.header: def IsEigS (n : ℕ) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (φ : TS L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.IsEig.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.IsEig
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.IsEig.header: def IsEig {β : Type*} [Fintype β] (n : ℕ) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (F : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β)) : Prop

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sum_site_eq_r.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sum_site_eq_real
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sum_site_eq_r.header:
theorem sum_site_eq_real (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (f : Site L → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ (g x : Site L), f (x + n • g) = f x) :
    ∑ x, f x = Mnum L n * ∑ t : Cell n, f (ιc hdvd t)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.normS_eig.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.normS_eig
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.normS_eig.header:
theorem normS_eig (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (φ : TS L)
    (hφ : IsEigS n χ φ) : ‖φ‖ ^ 2 = Mnum L n * ∑ t : Cell n, ‖φ (ιc hdvd t)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.innerS_eig.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.innerS_eig
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.innerS_eig.header:
theorem innerS_eig (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (φ ψ : TS L)
    (hφ : IsEigS n χ φ) (hψ : IsEigS n χ ψ) :
    ⟪φ, ψ⟫ = (Mnum L n : ℂ) * ∑ t : Cell n, (starRingEnd ℂ) (φ (ιc hdvd t)) * ψ (ιc hdvd t)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sliceB.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sliceB
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sliceB.header: noncomputable def sliceB {β : Type*} [Fintype β] (F : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β)) (b : β) : TS L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.normB_eig.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.normB_eig
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.normB_eig.header:
theorem normB_eig {β : Type*} [Fintype β] (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ)
    (F : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β)) (hF : IsEig n χ F) :
    ‖F‖ ^ 2 = Mnum L n * ∑ b : β, ∑ t : Cell n, ‖F (ιc hdvd t, b)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eig_of_equiv.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eig_of_equiv
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eig_of_equiv.header:
theorem eig_of_equiv {β κ : Type*} [Fintype β] [Fintype κ] (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ)
    (A : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β)) (hA : IsEig n χ A) (Lm : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β) →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × κ))
    (hL : ∀ (g : Site L) (A : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β)), Lm (shiftE n g β A) = shiftE n g κ (Lm A)) :
    IsEig n χ (Lm A)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_neg.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_neg
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_neg.header: theorem ιz_neg (a : Z3) : ιz L (-a) = -ιz L a

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eig_master.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eig_master
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eig_master.header:
theorem eig_master (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (A : TB L)
    (hA : IsEig n χ A) (a : Z3) (ν : Fin 3) (t : Cell n) :
    A (ιc hdvd t + ιz L a, ν) = shiftOp hn (fun μ => ((zOf χ μ : Circle) : ℂ)) a (vOf hdvd A ν) t

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eig_shift.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eig_shift
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eig_shift.header:
theorem eig_shift (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (A : TB L)
    (hA : IsEig n χ A) (μ ν : Fin 3) (t : Cell n) :
    A (ιc hdvd t + eU L μ, ν) = Su hn (zOf χ) μ (vOf hdvd A ν) t

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eig_shift_neg.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eig_shift_neg
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eig_shift_neg.header:
theorem eig_shift_neg (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (A : TB L)
    (hA : IsEig n χ A) (μ ν : Fin 3) (t : Cell n) :
    A (ιc hdvd t - eU L μ, ν) = (Su hn (zOf χ) μ).symm (vOf hdvd A ν) t

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eig_iter.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eig_iter
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eig_iter.header:
theorem eig_iter (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (A : TB L)
    (hA : IsEig n χ A) (μ ν : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) (t : Cell n) :
    A (ιc hdvd t + i • eU L μ, ν) = ((Su hn (zOf χ) μ)^[i] (vOf hdvd A ν)) t

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.vOf_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.vOf_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.vOf_apply.header:
theorem vOf_apply (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (A : TB L) (μ : Fin 3) (t : Cell n) :
    vOf hdvd A μ t = A (ιc hdvd t, μ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L1_cell.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L1_cell
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L1_cell.header:
theorem L1_cell (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (A : TB L)
    (hA : IsEig n χ A) :
    ‖L1 L A‖ ^ 2 = Mnum L n * g1 hn (zOf χ, fun μ => vOf hdvd A μ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Qm_explicit.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Qm_explicit
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Qm_explicit.header:
theorem Qm_explicit (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ : Fin 3) (x : CV n) :
    (cellSym hn z).Qm μ x = ∑ t : Cell n, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ((Su hn z μ)^[i] x) t

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coarse_ιc.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coarse_ιc
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coarse_ιc.header:
theorem coarse_ιc (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (t : Cell n) :
    Coarse n (ιc hdvd t) ↔ t = zeroC hn

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιc_zero.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιc_zero
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιc_zero.header: theorem ιc_zero (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) : ιc hdvd (zeroC hn) = (0 : Site L)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2_cell.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2_cell
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2_cell.header:
theorem L2_cell (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (A : TB L)
    (hA : IsEig n χ A) :
    ‖L2 hdvd A‖ ^ 2 = Mnum L n * g2 hn (zOf χ, fun μ => vOf hdvd A μ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_xh.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_xh
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_xh.header: theorem ιz_xh (x : Site L) : ιz L (xh x) = x

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_sub.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_sub
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_sub.header:
theorem lift_sub (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → ℂ) (v w : CV n) (x : Z3) :
    lift hn z (v - w) x = lift hn z v x - lift hn z w x

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.wu.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.wu
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.wu.header: noncomputable def wu (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → ℂ) (u : CV n) : TS L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.wu_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.wu_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.wu_apply.header: theorem wu_apply (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → ℂ) (u : CV n) (x : Site L) : wu hn z u x = lift hn z u (xh x)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.wu_ιz.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.wu_ιz
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.wu_ιz.header:
theorem wu_ιz (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (z : Fin 3 → Circle)
    (hzM : ∀ μ, ((z μ : Circle) : ℂ) ^ Mc L n μ = 1) (u : CV n) (y : Z3) :
    wu hn (fun μ => (z μ : ℂ)) u (ιz L y) = lift hn (fun μ => (z μ : ℂ)) u y

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.wu_eig.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.wu_eig
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.wu_eig.header:
theorem wu_eig (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ)
    (hzM : ∀ μ, ((zOf χ μ : Circle) : ℂ) ^ Mc L n μ = 1) (u : CV n) :
    IsEigS n χ (wu hn (fun μ => ((zOf χ μ : Circle) : ℂ)) u)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sum_cell_eq_i.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sum_cell_eq_inner
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sum_cell_eq_i.header: theorem sum_cell_eq_inner (u : CV n) : ∑ t : Cell n, u t = ⟪epsV n, u⟫

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.wu_mem_Wc.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.wu_mem_Wc
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.wu_mem_Wc.header:
theorem wu_mem_Wc (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ)
    (hzM : ∀ μ, ((zOf χ μ : Circle) : ℂ) ^ Mc L n μ = 1) (u : CV n) (hu : ⟪epsV n, u⟫ = 0) :
    wu hn (fun μ => ((zOf χ μ : Circle) : ℂ)) u ∈ Wc (n := n) hdvd

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Lap_cell_appl.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Lap_cell_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Lap_cell_appl.header:
theorem Lap_cell_apply (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (u : CV n) (t : Cell n) :
    (cellSym hn z).Lap u t = ∑ μ : Fin 3, (2 * u t - lift hn (fun μ => (z μ : ℂ)) u (cc t + ev μ)
      - lift hn (fun μ => (z μ : ℂ)) u (cc t - ev μ))

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapC_wu_cell.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapC_wu_cell
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapC_wu_cell.header:
theorem lapC_wu_cell (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ)
    (hzM : ∀ μ, ((zOf χ μ : Circle) : ℂ) ^ Mc L n μ = 1) (u : CV n) (t : Cell n) :
    lapC L (wu hn (fun μ => ((zOf χ μ : Circle) : ℂ)) u) (ιc hdvd t) = (cellSym hn (zOf χ)).Lap u t

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eigS_of_equiv.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eigS_of_equiv
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eigS_of_equiv.header:
theorem eigS_of_equiv {β : Type*} [Fintype β] (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (A : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β))
    (hA : IsEig n χ A) (Lm : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β) →ₗ[ℂ] TS L)
    (hL : ∀ (g : Site L) (A : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β)), Lm (shiftE n g β A) = shiftS n g (Lm A)) :
    IsEigS n χ (Lm A)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eigS_lap.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eigS_lap
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eigS_lap.header: theorem eigS_lap (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (φ : TS L) (hφ : IsEigS n χ φ) : IsEigS n χ (lapC L φ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dst_cell.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dst_cell
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dst_cell.header:
theorem Dst_cell (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (A : TB L)
    (hA : IsEig n χ A) (t : Cell n) :
    Dst L A (ιc hdvd t) = (cellSym hn (zOf χ)).Dstar (fun μ => vOf hdvd A μ) t

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L3_ratio.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L3_ratio
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L3_ratio.header:
theorem L3_ratio (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (A : TB L)
    (hA : IsEig n χ A) (hzM : ∀ μ, ((zOf χ μ : Circle) : ℂ) ^ Mc L n μ = 1) (u : CV n)
    (hu : ⟪epsV n, u⟫ = 0) :
    ‖⟪(cellSym hn (zOf χ)).Dstar (fun μ => vOf hdvd A μ), (cellSym hn (zOf χ)).Lap u⟫‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (‖L3 hdvd A‖ ^ 2 / Mnum L n) * ‖(cellSym hn (zOf χ)).Lap u‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.nsmul_eU_zero.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.nsmul_eU_zero
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.nsmul_eU_zero.header: theorem nsmul_eU_zero (μ : Fin 3) : (L μ + 1) • eU L μ = 0

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.twist_pow_one.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.twist_pow_one
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.twist_pow_one.header:
theorem twist_pow_one (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (A : TB L)
    (hA : IsEig n χ A) (hA0 : A ≠ 0) (μ : Fin 3) : ((zOf χ μ : Circle) : ℂ) ^ Mc L n μ = 1

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eigen_coerciv.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eigen_coercive
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eigen_coerciv.header:
theorem eigen_coercive (hn : 0 < n) {c : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (w : Fin 3 → CV n) (S : ℝ), 0 ≤ S →
      (∀ u : CV n, ⟪epsV n, u⟫ = 0 →
        ‖⟪(cellSym hn z).Dstar w, (cellSym hn z).Lap u⟫‖ ^ 2 ≤ S * ‖(cellSym hn z).Lap u‖ ^ 2) →
      c * ∑ μ, ‖w μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ g1 hn (z, w) + g2 hn (z, w) + S)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (A : TB L) (hA : IsEig n χ A) :
    c * ‖A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖L1 L A‖ ^ 2 + ‖L2 hdvd A‖ ^ 2 + ‖L3 hdvd A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftE_zero.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftE_zero
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftE_zero.header:
theorem shiftE_zero (β : Type*) [Fintype β] (f : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β)) :
    shiftE n (0 : Site L) β f = f

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftE_add.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftE_add
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftE_add.header:
theorem shiftE_add (β : Type*) [Fintype β] (g h : Site L) (f : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β)) :
    shiftE n (g + h) β f = shiftE n g β (shiftE n h β f)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Tl.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Tl
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Tl.header:
noncomputable def Tl (n : ℕ) (g : Site L) (β : Type*) [Fintype β] :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β) →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Tl_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Tl_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Tl_apply.header:
theorem Tl_apply (g : Site L) (β : Type*) [Fintype β] (f : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Site L × β)) :
    Tl n g β f = shiftE n g β f

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Tls.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Tls
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Tls.header: noncomputable def Tls (n : ℕ) (g : Site L) : TS L →ₗ[ℂ] TS L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Tls_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Tls_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Tls_apply.header: theorem Tls_apply (g : Site L) (f : TS L) : Tls n g f = shiftS n g f

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.torus_coerciv.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.torus_coercive
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.torus_coerciv.header:
theorem torus_coercive (hn : 0 < n) : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (A : TB L),
    c * ‖A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖L1 L A‖ ^ 2 + ‖L2 hdvd A‖ ^ 2 + ‖L3 hdvd A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.isoProj.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.isoProj
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.isoProj.header: noncomputable def isoProj (T : Γ → H →ₗ[ℂ] H) (χ : AddChar Γ ℂ) (z : H) : H

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.isoProj_eigen.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.isoProj_eigen
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.isoProj_eigen.header:
theorem isoProj_eigen (hTadd : ∀ g h, T (g + h) = (T g).comp (T h)) (χ : AddChar Γ ℂ) (z : H) (h : Γ) :
    T h (isoProj T χ z) = χ h • isoProj T χ z

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sum_isoProj.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sum_isoProj
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sum_isoProj.header: theorem sum_isoProj (hT0 : T 0 = LinearMap.id) (z : H) : ∑ χ : AddChar Γ ℂ, isoProj T χ z = z

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eigen_orth.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eigen_orth
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eigen_orth.header:
theorem eigen_orth (hTunit : ∀ g x y, ⟪T g x, T g y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫) (χ χ' : AddChar Γ ℂ) (hne : χ ≠ χ')
    (u w : H) (hu : ∀ g, T g u = χ' g • u) (hw : ∀ g, T g w = χ g • w) : ⟪u, w⟫ = 0

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.inner_sum_eig.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.inner_sum_eigen
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.inner_sum_eig.header:
theorem inner_sum_eigen (hTunit : ∀ g x y, ⟪T g x, T g y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫)
    (u w : AddChar Γ ℂ → H) (hu : ∀ χ g, T g (u χ) = χ g • u χ) (hw : ∀ χ g, T g (w χ) = χ g • w χ) :
    ⟪∑ χ, u χ, ∑ χ, w χ⟫ = ∑ χ, ⟪u χ, w χ⟫

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.bloch_coerciv.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.bloch_coercive
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.bloch_coerciv.header:
theorem bloch_coercive (hT0 : T 0 = LinearMap.id)
    (hTadd : ∀ g h, T (g + h) = (T g).comp (T h))
    (hTunit : ∀ g x y, ⟪T g x, T g y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫)
    (Φ : H →ₗ[ℂ] H) (hΦ : ∀ g z, Φ (T g z) = T g (Φ z)) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ (χ : AddChar Γ ℂ) (z : H), (∀ g, T g z = χ g • z) → c * ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ (⟪z, Φ z⟫).re)
    (z : H) : c * ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ (⟪z, Φ z⟫).re

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.bloch_coerciv.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.bloch_coercive_sum
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.bloch_coerciv.header:
theorem bloch_coercive_sum (T : Γ → H →ₗ[ℂ] H) (hT0 : T 0 = LinearMap.id)
    (hTadd : ∀ g h, T (g + h) = (T g).comp (T h))
    (hTunit : ∀ g x y, ⟪T g x, T g y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫)
    (U : ∀ i, Γ → K i →ₗ[ℂ] K i) (hUunit : ∀ i g x y, ⟪U i g x, U i g y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫)
    (L : ∀ i, H →ₗ[ℂ] K i) (hL : ∀ i g z, L i (T g z) = U i g (L i z)) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ (χ : AddChar Γ ℂ) (z : H), (∀ g, T g z = χ g • z) → c * ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ‖L i z‖ ^ 2)
    (z : H) : c * ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ‖L i z‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_split.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_split
