AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_split.header:
theorem norm_split (T : Γ → H →ₗ[ℂ] H) (zc : AddChar Γ ℂ → H) {z : H}
    (hev : ∀ χ g, T g (zc χ) = χ g • zc χ) (hsum : ∑ χ, zc χ = z)
    (U : Γ → K →ₗ[ℂ] K) (hU : ∀ g x y, ⟪U g x, U g y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫) (L : H →ₗ[ℂ] K)
    (hL : ∀ g z, L (T g z) = U g (L z)) : ‖L z‖ ^ 2 = ∑ χ, ‖L (zc χ)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.bloch_coerciv.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.bloch_coercive_three
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.bloch_coerciv.header:
theorem bloch_coercive_three (T : Γ → H →ₗ[ℂ] H) (hT0 : T 0 = LinearMap.id)
    (hTadd : ∀ g h, T (g + h) = (T g).comp (T h))
    (hTunit : ∀ g x y, ⟪T g x, T g y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫)
    (U₁ : Γ → K₁ →ₗ[ℂ] K₁) (hU₁ : ∀ g x y, ⟪U₁ g x, U₁ g y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫)
    (U₂ : Γ → K₂ →ₗ[ℂ] K₂) (hU₂ : ∀ g x y, ⟪U₂ g x, U₂ g y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫)
    (U₃ : Γ → K₃ →ₗ[ℂ] K₃) (hU₃ : ∀ g x y, ⟪U₃ g x, U₃ g y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫)
    (L₁ : H →ₗ[ℂ] K₁) (L₂ : H →ₗ[ℂ] K₂) (L₃ : H →ₗ[ℂ] K₃)
    (h₁ : ∀ g z, L₁ (T g z) = U₁ g (L₁ z)) (h₂ : ∀ g z, L₂ (T g z) = U₂ g (L₂ z))
    (h₃ : ∀ g z, L₃ (T g z) = U₃ g (L₃ z)) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ (χ : AddChar Γ ℂ) (z : H), (∀ g, T g z = χ g • z) →
      c * ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖L₁ z‖ ^ 2 + ‖L₂ z‖ ^ 2 + ‖L₃ z‖ ^ 2)
    (z : H) : c * ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖L₁ z‖ ^ 2 + ‖L₂ z‖ ^ 2 + ‖L₃ z‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cc.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cc
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cc.header: def cc {n : ℕ} (t : Cell n) : Z3

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.modc.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.modc
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.modc.header: def modc (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (x : Z3) : Cell n

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cc_modc.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cc_modc
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cc_modc.header:
theorem cc_modc (hn : 0 < n) (x : Z3) (μ : Fin 3) :
    cc (modc n hn x) μ = x μ % (n : ℤ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.modc_cc.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.modc_cc
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.modc_cc.header: theorem modc_cc (hn : 0 < n) (t : Cell n) : modc n hn (cc t) = t

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.modc_add.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.modc_add
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.modc_add.header: theorem modc_add (hn : 0 < n) (x k : Z3) : modc n hn (x + (n : ℤ) • k) = modc n hn x

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eq_cc_modc_ad.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eq_cc_modc_add
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eq_cc_modc_ad.header:
theorem eq_cc_modc_add (hn : 0 < n) (x : Z3) :
    x = cc (modc n hn x) + (n : ℤ) • (fun μ => x μ / (n : ℤ))

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Per.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Per
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Per.header: def Per (n : ℕ) (f : Z3 → ℂ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Per.eq_cell.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Per.eq_cell
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Per.eq_cell.header: theorem Per.eq_cell (hn : 0 < n) {f : Z3 → ℂ} (hf : Per n f) (x : Z3) : f x = f (cc (modc n hn x))

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cint.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cint
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cint.header: def cint (n : ℕ) (h : Z3 → ℂ) : ℂ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cellShift.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cellShift
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cellShift.header: noncomputable def cellShift (hn : 0 < n) (a : Z3) : Equiv.Perm (Cell n)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cint_shift.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cint_shift
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cint_shift.header:
theorem cint_shift (hn : 0 < n) {h : Z3 → ℂ} (hh : Per n h) (a : Z3) :
    cint n (fun x => h (x + a)) = cint n h

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.header: structure SymData (V : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℂ V]

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.inner.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.inner_D
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.inner.header: theorem inner_D (μ : Fin 3) (x y : V) : ⟪sd.D μ x, y⟫ = ⟪x, sd.Ds μ y⟫

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.inner.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.inner_Ds
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.inner.header: theorem inner_Ds (μ : Fin 3) (x y : V) : ⟪sd.Ds μ x, y⟫ = ⟪x, sd.D μ y⟫

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.D_D.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.D_D
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.D_D.header: theorem D_D (μ ν : Fin 3) (x : V) : sd.D μ (sd.D ν x) = sd.D ν (sd.D μ x)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Ds_D.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Ds_D
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Ds_D.header: theorem Ds_D (μ ν : Fin 3) (x : V) : sd.Ds μ (sd.D ν x) = sd.D ν (sd.Ds μ x)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.inner.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.inner_Lap
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.inner.header: theorem inner_Lap (x y : V) : ⟪x, sd.Lap y⟫ = ∑ μ, ⟪sd.D μ x, sd.D μ y⟫

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_s.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_selfadj
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_s.header: theorem Lap_selfadj (x y : V) : ⟪sd.Lap x, y⟫ = ⟪x, sd.Lap y⟫

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.inner.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.inner_Ds_Ds
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.inner.header:
theorem inner_Ds_Ds (w : Fin 3 → V) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    ⟪sd.Ds μ (w μ), sd.Ds ν (w ν)⟫ = ⟪sd.D ν (w μ), sd.D μ (w ν)⟫

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.weitz.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.weitzenbock
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.weitz.header:
theorem weitzenbock (w : Fin 3 → V) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ μ, ∑ ν, ‖sd.D μ (w ν) - sd.D ν (w μ)‖ ^ 2 + ‖∑ μ, sd.Ds μ (w μ)‖ ^ 2
      = ∑ μ, ∑ ν, ‖sd.D ν (w μ)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Sl.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Sl
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Sl.header: noncomputable def Sl (μ : Fin 3) : Module.End ℂ V

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Sl_ap.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Sl_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Sl_ap.header: theorem Sl_apply (μ : Fin 3) (x : V) : sd.Sl μ x = sd.S μ x

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Sl_po.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Sl_pow_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Sl_po.header: theorem Sl_pow_apply (μ : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) (x : V) : (sd.Sl μ ^ m) x = (sd.S μ)^[m] x

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.iter_.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.iter_sub
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.iter_.header:
theorem iter_sub (μ : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) (x y : V) :
    (sd.S μ)^[m] (x - y) = (sd.S μ)^[m] x - (sd.S μ)^[m] y

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Qm.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Qm
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Qm.header: noncomputable def Qm (μ : Fin 3) (x : V) : ℂ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.tele.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.tele
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.tele.header:
theorem tele (μ : Fin 3) (ν : V) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (sd.S μ)^[i] (sd.D μ ν) = (sd.S μ)^[m] ν - ν

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Qm_D.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Qm_D
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Qm_D.header: theorem Qm_D (μ : Fin 3) (ν : V) : sd.Qm μ (sd.D μ ν) = (sd.ph μ - 1) * ⟪sd.eps, ν⟫

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.fixed.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.fixed_zero
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.fixed.header: theorem fixed_zero (μ : Fin 3) (h : sd.ph μ ≠ 1) (x : V) (hx : sd.S μ x = x) : x = 0

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.D_eq_.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.D_eq_zero_iff
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.D_eq_.header: theorem D_eq_zero_iff (μ : Fin 3) (x : V) : sd.D μ x = 0 ↔ sd.S μ x = x

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.norm_.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.norm_sum_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.norm_.header: theorem norm_sum_eq_zero {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (x : ι → V) (h : ∑ i, ‖x i‖ ^ 2 = 0) : ∀ i, x i = 0

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_e.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_e.header: theorem Lap_eq_zero (u : V) (hu : sd.Lap u = 0) : ∀ μ, sd.S μ u = u

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.D_add.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.D_add
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.D_add.header: theorem D_add (μ : Fin 3) (x y : V) : sd.D μ (x + y) = sd.D μ x + sd.D μ y

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.D_sub.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.D_sub
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.D_sub.header: theorem D_sub (μ : Fin 3) (x y : V) : sd.D μ (x - y) = sd.D μ x - sd.D μ y

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Ds_su.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Ds_sub
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Ds_su.header: theorem Ds_sub (μ : Fin 3) (x y : V) : sd.Ds μ (x - y) = sd.Ds μ x - sd.Ds μ y

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.D_smu.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.D_smul
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.D_smu.header: theorem D_smul (μ : Fin 3) (c : ℂ) (x : V) : sd.D μ (c • x) = c • sd.D μ x

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Ds_ad.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Ds_add
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Ds_ad.header: theorem Ds_add (μ : Fin 3) (x y : V) : sd.Ds μ (x + y) = sd.Ds μ x + sd.Ds μ y

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Ds_sm.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Ds_smul
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Ds_sm.header: theorem Ds_smul (μ : Fin 3) (c : ℂ) (x : V) : sd.Ds μ (c • x) = c • sd.Ds μ x

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_a.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_add
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_a.header: theorem Lap_add (x y : V) : sd.Lap (x + y) = sd.Lap x + sd.Lap y

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_s.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_smul
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_s.header: theorem Lap_smul (c : ℂ) (x : V) : sd.Lap (c • x) = c • sd.Lap x

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_s.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_sub
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_s.header: theorem Lap_sub (x y : V) : sd.Lap (x - y) = sd.Lap x - sd.Lap y

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_i.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_inj
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_i.header: theorem Lap_inj (μ0 : Fin 3) (h : sd.ph μ0 ≠ 1) (u : V) (hu : sd.Lap u = 0) : u = 0

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_s.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_surj
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_s.header: theorem Lap_surj [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (μ0 : Fin 3) (h : sd.ph μ0 ≠ 1) (y : V) : ∃ x, sd.Lap x = y

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_g.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_g_eq
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.Lap_g.header:
theorem Lap_g_eq (w : Fin 3 → V)
    (hK : ∀ u, ⟪sd.eps, u⟫ = 0 → ⟪sd.Dstar w, sd.Lap u⟫ = 0) :
    ∃ c : ℂ, sd.Lap (sd.Dstar w) = c • sd.eps

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.grad_.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.grad_zero
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.grad_.header:
theorem grad_zero (w : Fin 3 → V) (hcurl : ∀ μ ν, sd.D μ (w ν) = sd.D ν (w μ))
    (hdiv : sd.Dstar w = 0) : ∀ μ ν, sd.D ν (w μ) = 0

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.symbo.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.symbol_positive
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.SymData.symbo.header:
theorem symbol_positive [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (w : Fin 3 → V)
    (hcurl : ∀ μ ν, sd.D μ (w ν) = sd.D ν (w μ))
    (hQ : ∀ μ, sd.Qm μ (w μ) = 0)
    (hK : ∀ u, ⟪sd.eps, u⟫ = 0 → ⟪sd.Dstar w, sd.Lap u⟫ = 0) : ∀ μ, w μ = 0

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.phase.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.phase
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.phase.header: noncomputable def phase (z : Fin 3 → ℂ) (k : Z3) : ℂ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.phase_add.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.phase_add
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.phase_add.header: theorem phase_add (hz : ∀ μ, z μ ≠ 0) (k k' : Z3) : phase z (k + k') = phase z k * phase z k'

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.phase_ev.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.phase_ev
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.phase_ev.header: theorem phase_ev (μ : Fin 3) : phase z (ev μ) = z μ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_phase.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_phase
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_phase.header: theorem norm_phase (hz : ∀ μ, ‖z μ‖ = 1) (k : Z3) : ‖phase z k‖ = 1

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.phase_one.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.phase_one
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.phase_one.header: theorem phase_one (hz : ∀ μ, z μ = 1) (k : Z3) : phase z k = 1

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift.header: noncomputable def lift (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : CV n) (x : Z3) : ℂ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_qp.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_qp
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_qp.header:
theorem lift_qp (hn : 0 < n) {z : Fin 3 → ℂ} (hz : ∀ μ, z μ ≠ 0) (v : CV n) (x k : Z3) :
    lift hn z v (x + (n : ℤ) • k) = phase z k * lift hn z v x

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_cc.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_cc
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_cc.header: theorem lift_cc (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : CV n) (t : Cell n) : lift hn z v (cc t) = v t

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_add.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_add
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_add.header:
theorem lift_add (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → ℂ) (v w : CV n) (x : Z3) :
    lift hn z (v + w) x = lift hn z v x + lift hn z w x

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_smul.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_smul
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_smul.header:
theorem lift_smul (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (v : CV n) (x : Z3) :
    lift hn z (c • v) x = c * lift hn z v x

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Sl.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Sl
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Sl.header: noncomputable def Sl (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → ℂ) (μ : Fin 3) : CV n →ₗ[ℂ] CV n

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Sl_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Sl_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Sl_apply.header:
theorem Sl_apply (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → ℂ) (μ : Fin 3) (v : CV n) (t : Cell n) :
    Sl hn z μ v t = lift hn z v (cc t + ev μ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_Sl.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_Sl
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_Sl.header:
theorem lift_Sl (hn : 0 < n) {z : Fin 3 → ℂ} (hz : ∀ μ, z μ ≠ 0) (μ : Fin 3) (v : CV n) (x : Z3) :
    lift hn z (Sl hn z μ v) x = lift hn z v (x + ev μ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Sl_iter.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Sl_iter
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Sl_iter.header:
theorem Sl_iter (hn : 0 < n) {z : Fin 3 → ℂ} (hz : ∀ μ, z μ ≠ 0) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) (v : CV n) (t : Cell n) :
    ((Sl hn z μ)^[i] v) t = lift hn z v (cc t + (i : ℤ) • ev μ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_Sl.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_Sl
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_Sl.header:
theorem norm_Sl (hn : 0 < n) {z : Fin 3 → ℂ} (hz : ∀ μ, ‖z μ‖ = 1) (μ : Fin 3) (v : CV n) :
    ‖Sl hn z μ v‖ = ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su.header: noncomputable def Su (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ : Fin 3) : CV n ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] CV n

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_apply.header:
theorem Su_apply (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ : Fin 3) (v : CV n) :
    Su hn z μ v = Sl hn (fun μ => (z μ : ℂ)) μ v

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.z_ne.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.z_ne
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.z_ne.header: theorem z_ne (z : Fin 3 → Circle) : ∀ μ, ((z μ : Circle) : ℂ) ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_comm.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_comm
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_comm.header:
theorem Su_comm (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ ν : Fin 3) (v : CV n) :
    Su hn z μ (Su hn z ν v) = Su hn z ν (Su hn z μ v)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_pow.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_pow
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_pow.header:
theorem Su_pow (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ : Fin 3) (v : CV n) :
    (Su hn z μ)^[n] v = ((z μ : Circle) : ℂ) • v

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.epsV.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.epsV
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.epsV.header: noncomputable def epsV (n : ℕ) : CV n

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.epsV_fixed.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.epsV_fixed
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.epsV_fixed.header:
theorem epsV_fixed (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (hz : ∀ μ, ((z μ : Circle) : ℂ) = 1) (μ : Fin 3) :
    Su hn z μ (epsV n) = epsV n

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.const_of_step.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.const_of_step
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.const_of_step.header: theorem const_of_step (f : Z3 → ℂ) (h : ∀ x μ, f (x + ev μ) = f x) : ∀ x, f x = f 0

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fixed_const.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fixed_const
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fixed_const.header:
theorem fixed_const (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (hz : ∀ μ, ((z μ : Circle) : ℂ) = 1)
    (w : CV n) (hw : ∀ μ, Su hn z μ w = w) : ∀ t, w t = w (modc n hn 0)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fixed_span.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fixed_span
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fixed_span.header:
theorem fixed_span (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (hz : ∀ μ, ((z μ : Circle) : ℂ) = 1)
    (w : CV n) (hw : ∀ μ, Su hn z μ w = w) : ∃ c : ℂ, w = c • epsV n

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cellSym.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cellSym
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cellSym.header: noncomputable def cellSym (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) : SymData (CV n)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftOp.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftOp
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftOp.header: noncomputable def shiftOp (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → ℂ) (a : Z3) (v : CV n) : CV n

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftOp_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftOp_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftOp_apply.header:
theorem shiftOp_apply (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → ℂ) (a : Z3) (v : CV n) (t : Cell n) :
    shiftOp hn z a v t = lift hn z v (cc t + a)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_shiftOp.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_shiftOp
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_shiftOp.header:
theorem lift_shiftOp (hn : 0 < n) {z : Fin 3 → ℂ} (hz : ∀ μ, z μ ≠ 0) (a : Z3) (v : CV n) (x : Z3) :
    lift hn z (shiftOp hn z a v) x = lift hn z v (x + a)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftOp_shift.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftOp_shiftOp
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftOp_shift.header:
theorem shiftOp_shiftOp (hn : 0 < n) {z : Fin 3 → ℂ} (hz : ∀ μ, z μ ≠ 0) (a b : Z3) (v : CV n) :
    shiftOp hn z a (shiftOp hn z b v) = shiftOp hn z (a + b) v

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftOp_zero.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftOp_zero
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftOp_zero.header: theorem shiftOp_zero (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : CV n) : shiftOp hn z 0 v = v

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_eq_shiftOp.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_eq_shiftOp
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_eq_shiftOp.header:
theorem Su_eq_shiftOp (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ : Fin 3) (v : CV n) :
    Su hn z μ v = shiftOp hn (fun μ => (z μ : ℂ)) (ev μ) v

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_symm_eq.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_symm_eq
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_symm_eq.header:
theorem Su_symm_eq (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ : Fin 3) (v : CV n) :
    (Su hn z μ).symm v = shiftOp hn (fun μ => (z μ : ℂ)) (-ev μ) v

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_iter_eq.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_iter_eq
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Su_iter_eq.header:
theorem Su_iter_eq (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) (v : CV n) :
    (Su hn z μ)^[i] v = shiftOp hn (fun μ => (z μ : ℂ)) ((i : ℤ) • ev μ) v

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.continuous_ph.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.continuous_phase
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.continuous_ph.header: theorem continuous_phase (k : Z3) : Continuous (fun z : Fin 3 → Circle => phase (fun μ => (z μ : ℂ)) k)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.continuous_co.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.continuous_coord
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.continuous_co.header: theorem continuous_coord (t : Cell n) : Continuous (fun v : CV n => v t)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.continuous_sh.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.continuous_shiftOp
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.continuous_sh.header:
theorem continuous_shiftOp (hn : 0 < n) (a : Z3) :
    Continuous (fun p : (Fin 3 → Circle) × CV n => shiftOp hn (fun μ => (p.1 μ : ℂ)) a p.2)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_D.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_D
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_D.header:
theorem cont_D (μ : Fin 3) :
    Continuous (fun p : (Fin 3 → Circle) × CV n => (cellSym hn p.1).D μ p.2)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Ds.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Ds
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Ds.header:
theorem cont_Ds (μ : Fin 3) :
    Continuous (fun p : (Fin 3 → Circle) × CV n => (cellSym hn p.1).Ds μ p.2)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Qm.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Qm
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Qm.header:
theorem cont_Qm (μ : Fin 3) :
    Continuous (fun p : (Fin 3 → Circle) × CV n => (cellSym hn p.1).Qm μ p.2)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_pair.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_pair
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_pair.header: theorem cont_pair (ν : Fin 3) : Continuous (fun p : Pn n => ((p.1, p.2 ν) : (Fin 3 → Circle) × CV n))

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Dw.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Dw
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Dw.header: theorem cont_Dw (μ ν : Fin 3) : Continuous (fun p : Pn n => (cellSym hn p.1).D μ (p.2 ν))

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Dstar.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Dstar
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Dstar.header: theorem cont_Dstar : Continuous (fun p : Pn n => (cellSym hn p.1).Dstar p.2)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Lap.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Lap
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Lap.header: theorem cont_Lap (u : CV n) : Continuous (fun z : Fin 3 → Circle => (cellSym hn z).Lap u)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Lap_ne.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Lap_ne
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Lap_ne.header:
theorem Lap_ne (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (u : CV n) (hu : ⟪epsV n, u⟫ = 0) (hu0 : u ≠ 0) :
    (cellSym hn z).Lap u ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g1.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g1
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g1.header: noncomputable def g1 (p : Pn n) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g2.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g2
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g2.header: noncomputable def g2 (p : Pn n) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_g1.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_g1
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_g1.header: theorem cont_g1 : Continuous (g1 hn : Pn n → ℝ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_g2.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_g2
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_g2.header: theorem cont_g2 : Continuous (g2 hn : Pn n → ℝ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Rr.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Rr
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Rr.header: noncomputable def Rr (p : Pn n) (u : CV n) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Rr.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Rr
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cont_Rr.header: theorem cont_Rr (u : UIdx n) : Continuous (fun p : Pn n => Rr hn p u.1)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Rr_le.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Rr_le
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Rr_le.header: theorem Rr_le (p : Pn n) (u : CV n) : Rr hn p u ≤ ‖(cellSym hn p.1).Dstar p.2‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Rr_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Rr_nonneg
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Rr_nonneg.header: theorem Rr_nonneg (p : Pn n) (u : CV n) : 0 ≤ Rr hn p u

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi.header: noncomputable def Phi (p : Pn n) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lsc_Phi.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lsc_Phi
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lsc_Phi.header: theorem lsc_Phi : LowerSemicontinuous (Phi hn : Pn n → ℝ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g1_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g1_nonneg
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g1_nonneg.header: theorem g1_nonneg (p : Pn n) : 0 ≤ g1 hn p

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g2_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g2_nonneg
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g2_nonneg.header: theorem g2_nonneg (p : Pn n) : 0 ≤ g2 hn p

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.bdd_Rr.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.bdd_Rr
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.bdd_Rr.header: theorem bdd_Rr (p : Pn n) : BddAbove (Set.range fun u : UIdx n => Rr hn p u.1)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sup_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sup_nonneg
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sup_nonneg.header: theorem sup_nonneg (p : Pn n) : 0 ≤ ⨆ u : UIdx n, Rr hn p u.1

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi_pos.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi_pos
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi_pos.header: theorem Phi_pos (p : Pn n) (hp : ∑ μ, ‖p.2 μ‖ ^ 2 = 1) : 0 < Phi hn p

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.isCompact_uni.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.isCompact_unitSphere
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.isCompact_uni.header: theorem isCompact_unitSphere (n : ℕ) : IsCompact {w : Fin 3 → CV n | ∑ μ, ‖w μ‖ ^ 2 = 1}

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cell_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cell_coercive_unit
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cell_coercive.header: theorem cell_coercive_unit (hn : 0 < n) : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ p : Pn n, ∑ μ, ‖p.2 μ‖ ^ 2 = 1 → c ≤ Phi hn p

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dstar_smul.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dstar_smul
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dstar_smul.header:
theorem Dstar_smul (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (r : ℂ) (w : Fin 3 → CV n) :
    (cellSym hn z).Dstar (fun μ => r • w μ) = r • (cellSym hn z).Dstar w

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Qm_smul.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Qm_smul
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Qm_smul.header:
theorem Qm_smul (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ : Fin 3) (r : ℂ) (x : CV n) :
    (cellSym hn z).Qm μ (r • x) = r * (cellSym hn z).Qm μ x

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g1_smul.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g1_smul
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g1_smul.header:
theorem g1_smul (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (w : Fin 3 → CV n) :
    g1 hn (z, fun μ => (r : ℂ) • w μ) = r ^ 2 * g1 hn (z, w)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g2_smul.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g2_smul
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.g2_smul.header:
theorem g2_smul (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (w : Fin 3 → CV n) :
    g2 hn (z, fun μ => (r : ℂ) • w μ) = r ^ 2 * g2 hn (z, w)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Rr_smul.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Rr_smul
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Rr_smul.header:
theorem Rr_smul (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (w : Fin 3 → CV n) (u : CV n) :
    Rr hn (z, fun μ => (r : ℂ) • w μ) u = r ^ 2 * Rr hn (z, w) u

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Rr_sup_smul.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Rr_sup_smul
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Rr_sup_smul.header:
theorem Rr_sup_smul (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (w : Fin 3 → CV n) (S : ℝ) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (hhyp : ∀ u : CV n, ⟪epsV n, u⟫ = 0 →
      ‖⟪(cellSym hn z).Dstar w, (cellSym hn z).Lap u⟫‖ ^ 2 ≤ S * ‖(cellSym hn z).Lap u‖ ^ 2) :
    (⨆ u : UIdx n, Rr hn (z, fun μ => (r : ℂ) • w μ) u.1) ≤ r ^ 2 * S

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cell_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cell_coercive
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.cell_coercive.header:
theorem cell_coercive (hn : 0 < n) : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (w : Fin 3 → CV n) (S : ℝ), 0 ≤ S →
    (∀ u : CV n, ⟪epsV n, u⟫ = 0 →
      ‖⟪(cellSym hn z).Dstar w, (cellSym hn z).Lap u⟫‖ ^ 2 ≤ S * ‖(cellSym hn z).Lap u‖ ^ 2) →
    c * ∑ μ, ‖w μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ g1 hn (z, w) + g2 hn (z, w) + S

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eU.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eU
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eU.header: def eU (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (μ : Fin 3) : Site L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shift_eq.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shift_eq
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shift_eq.header: theorem shift_eq (x : Site L) (μ : Fin 3) : periodicLatticeShift x μ = x + eU L μ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.n_le.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.n_le
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.n_le.header: theorem n_le (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (μ : Fin 3) : n ≤ L μ + 1

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιc.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιc
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιc.header: def ιc (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (t : Cell n) : Site L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fmod.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fmod
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fmod.header: def fmod (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (a : ℤ) : Fin N

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fmod_val.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fmod_val
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fmod_val.header: theorem fmod_val (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (a : ℤ) : (((fmod N hN a).val : ℕ) : ℤ) = a % (N : ℤ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fmod_add.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fmod_add
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fmod_add.header: theorem fmod_add (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (a b : ℤ) : fmod N hN (a + b) = fmod N hN a + fmod N hN b

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fmod_zero.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fmod_zero
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fmod_zero.header: theorem fmod_zero (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) : fmod N hN 0 = ⟨0, hN⟩

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz.header: def ιz (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (x : Z3) : Site L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_add.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_add
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_add.header: theorem ιz_add (a b : Z3) : ιz L (a + b) = ιz L a + ιz L b

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_nsmul.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_nsmul
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_nsmul.header: theorem ιz_nsmul (m : ℕ) (a : Z3) : ιz L (m • a) = m • ιz L a

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fmod_one.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fmod_one
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fmod_one.header: theorem fmod_one (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : fmod N (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne N)) 1 = 1

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_ev.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_ev
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_ev.header: theorem ιz_ev (μ : Fin 3) : ιz L (ev μ) = eU L μ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_cc.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_cc
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.ιz_cc.header: theorem ιz_cc (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (t : Cell n) : ιz L (cc t) = ιc hdvd t

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mc.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mc
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mc.header: def Mc (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (n : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mc_mul.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mc_mul
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mc_mul.header: theorem Mc_mul (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (μ : Fin 3) : n * Mc L n μ = L μ + 1

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mc_pos.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mc_pos
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mc_pos.header: theorem Mc_pos (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (μ : Fin 3) : 0 < Mc L n μ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mc_le.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mc_le
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Mc_le.header: theorem Mc_le (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (μ : Fin 3) : Mc L n μ ≤ L μ + 1

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi8.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi8
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi8.header: def Phi8 (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (p : Cell n × (∀ μ : Fin 3, Fin (Mc L n μ))) : Site L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi8_inj.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi8_inj
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi8_inj.header: theorem Phi8_inj (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) : Function.Injective (Phi8 hn hdvd)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.card_cell.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.card_cell
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.card_cell.header: theorem card_cell (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Cell n) = n ^ 3

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi8_bij.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi8_bij
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi8_bij.header: theorem Phi8_bij (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) : Function.Bijective (Phi8 hn hdvd)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fin_val_nsmul.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fin_val_nsmul
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fin_val_nsmul.header: theorem fin_val_nsmul (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (m : ℕ) (x : Fin N) : ((m • x : Fin N) : ℕ) = (m * (x : ℕ)) % N

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi8_eq.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi8_eq
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Phi8_eq.header:
theorem Phi8_eq (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (t : Cell n) (c : ∀ μ : Fin 3, Fin (Mc L n μ)) :
    Phi8 hn hdvd (t, c) = ιc hdvd t + n • (fun μ => (⟨(c μ : ℕ), lt_of_lt_of_le (c μ).isLt (Mc_le hn hdvd μ)⟩ : Fin (L μ + 1)))

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sum_site_eq.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sum_site_eq
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.sum_site_eq.header:
theorem sum_site_eq (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (f : Site L → ℂ)
    (hf : ∀ (g x : Site L), f (x + n • g) = f x) :
    ∑ x, f x = ((∏ μ, Mc L n μ : ℕ) : ℂ) * ∑ t : Cell n, f (ιc hdvd t)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.zOf.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.zOf
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.zOf.header: noncomputable def zOf (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) : Fin 3 → Circle

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.zOf_coe.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.zOf_coe
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.zOf_coe.header: theorem zOf_coe (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (μ : Fin 3) : ((zOf χ μ : Circle) : ℂ) = χ (eU L μ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.chi_ιz.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.chi_ιz
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.chi_ιz.header: theorem chi_ιz (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (k : Z3) : χ (ιz L k) = phase (fun μ => ((zOf χ μ : Circle) : ℂ)) k

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.vOf.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.vOf
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.vOf.header: noncomputable def vOf (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (A : TB L) (μ : Fin 3) : CV n

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_relation.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_relation
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lift_relation.header:
theorem lift_relation (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (χ : AddChar (Site L) ℂ) (A : TB L)
    (hA : ∀ (g : Site L) (x : Site L) (μ : Fin 3), A (x + n • g, μ) = χ g * A (x, μ))
    (μ : Fin 3) (x : Z3) :
    A (ιz L x, μ) = lift hn (fun ν => ((zOf χ ν : Circle) : ℂ)) (vOf hdvd A μ) x

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobSq_conjTranspose.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobSq_conjTranspose
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobSq_conjTranspose.header: theorem frobSq_conjTranspose (A : M2) : frobSq Aᴴ = frobSq A

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_conjTranspo.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_conjTranspose
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_conjTranspo.header: theorem frobNorm_conjTranspose (A : M2) : frobNorm Aᴴ = frobNorm A

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_mul_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_mul_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_mul_le.header: theorem frobNorm_mul_le (A B : M2) : frobNorm (A * B) ≤ frobNorm A * frobNorm B

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_mul_su2.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_mul_su2
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_mul_su2.header: theorem frobNorm_mul_su2 (A : M2) (g : SU2) : frobNorm (A * (g : M2)) = frobNorm A

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_mul_su2_sta.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_mul_su2_star
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_mul_su2_sta.header: theorem frobNorm_mul_su2_star (A : M2) (g : SU2) : frobNorm (A * (g : M2)ᴴ) = frobNorm A

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_su2_mul.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_su2_mul
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_su2_mul.header: theorem frobNorm_su2_mul (g : SU2) (A : M2) : frobNorm ((g : M2) * A) = frobNorm A

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_su2_mul_sta.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_su2_mul_star
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_su2_mul_sta.header: theorem frobNorm_su2_mul_star (g : SU2) (A : M2) : frobNorm ((g : M2)ᴴ * A) = frobNorm A

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_sub_comm.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_sub_comm
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_sub_comm.header: theorem frobNorm_sub_comm (A B : M2) : frobNorm (A - B) = frobNorm (B - A)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_sub_le'.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_sub_le'
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_sub_le'.header: theorem frobNorm_sub_le' (A B C : M2) : frobNorm (A - C) ≤ frobNorm (A - B) + frobNorm (B - C)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_add3_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_add3_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_add3_le.header: theorem frobNorm_add3_le (A B C : M2) : frobNorm (A + B + C) ≤ frobNorm A + frobNorm B + frobNorm C

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_add4_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_add4_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_add4_le.header:
theorem frobNorm_add4_le (A B C D : M2) :
    frobNorm (A + B + C + D) ≤ frobNorm A + frobNorm B + frobNorm C + frobNorm D

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_add5_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_add5_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_add5_le.header:
theorem frobNorm_add5_le (A B C D E : M2) :
    frobNorm (A + B + C + D + E) ≤ frobNorm A + frobNorm B + frobNorm C + frobNorm D + frobNorm E

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_mul3_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_mul3_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_mul3_le.header: theorem frobNorm_mul3_le (A B C : M2) : frobNorm (A * B * C) ≤ frobNorm A * frobNorm B * frobNorm C

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gauge_step_one.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gauge_step_one
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gauge_step_one.header:
theorem gauge_step_one (k0 k1 G : SU2) :
    frobNorm (((k0 * G * k1⁻¹ : SU2) : M2) - 1)
      ≤ frobNorm ((G : M2) - 1) + frobNorm ((k1 : M2) - (k0 : M2))

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gauge_step_two.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gauge_step_two
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gauge_step_two.header:
theorem gauge_step_two (k0 k1 k2 k3 G G' : SU2) :
    frobNorm (((k2 * G' * k3⁻¹ : SU2) : M2) - ((k0 * G * k1⁻¹ : SU2) : M2))
      ≤ frobNorm ((G' : M2) - (G : M2))
        + frobNorm ((G : M2) - 1) * (frobNorm ((k2 : M2) - k0) + frobNorm ((k3 : M2) - k1))
        + frobNorm ((k2 : M2) - k0) * frobNorm ((k3 : M2) - k2)
        + frobNorm ((k3 : M2) - k2 - ((k1 : M2) - k0))

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.resolvent_second_dif.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.resolvent_second_diff
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.resolvent_second_dif.header:
theorem resolvent_second_diff (F X : Fin 4 → M2)
    (hF : ∀ i j : Fin 4, F i - F j = F i * (X j - X i) * F j) {B : ℝ} (hB0 : 0 ≤ B)
    (hB : ∀ i, frobNorm (F i) ≤ B) :
    frobNorm (F 3 - F 2 - (F 1 - F 0))
      ≤ B ^ 2 * frobNorm (X 3 - X 2 - (X 1 - X 0))
        + B ^ 3 * (frobNorm (X 3 - X 1) + frobNorm (X 2 - X 0)) * frobNorm (X 1 - X 0)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.sq_real.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.sq_real
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.sq_real.header: theorem sq_real {Y : M2} (hY : IsSu2 Y) : Y * Y = (-(frobSq Y / 2)) • (1 : M2)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.one_sub_mul_one_add.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.one_sub_mul_one_add
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.one_sub_mul_one_add.header:
theorem one_sub_mul_one_add {Y : M2} (hY : IsSu2 Y) :
    ((1 : M2) - Y) * ((1 : M2) + Y) = (1 + frobSq Y / 2) • (1 : M2)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.one_add_mul_one_sub.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.one_add_mul_one_sub
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.one_add_mul_one_sub.header:
theorem one_add_mul_one_sub {Y : M2} (hY : IsSu2 Y) :
    ((1 : M2) + Y) * ((1 : M2) - Y) = (1 + frobSq Y / 2) • (1 : M2)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.one_sub_mul_cayR.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.one_sub_mul_cayR
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.one_sub_mul_cayR.header: theorem one_sub_mul_cayR {Y : M2} (hY : IsSu2 Y) : ((1 : M2) - Y) * cayR Y = 1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cayR_mul_one_sub.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cayR_mul_one_sub
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cayR_mul_one_sub.header: theorem cayR_mul_one_sub {Y : M2} (hY : IsSu2 Y) : cayR Y * ((1 : M2) - Y) = 1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cayR_resolvent.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cayR_resolvent
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cayR_resolvent.header:
theorem cayR_resolvent {Y Y' : M2} (hY : IsSu2 Y) (hY' : IsSu2 Y') :
    cayR Y - cayR Y' = cayR Y * (Y - Y') * cayR Y'

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobSq_cayR.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobSq_cayR
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobSq_cayR.header: theorem frobSq_cayR {Y : M2} (hY : IsSu2 Y) : frobSq (cayR Y) = 2 / (1 + frobSq Y / 2)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_cayR_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_cayR_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_cayR_le.header: theorem frobNorm_cayR_le {Y : M2} (hY : IsSu2 Y) : frobNorm (cayR Y) ≤ 3 / 2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.aux_c.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.aux_c
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.aux_c.header: theorem aux_c (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) : (1 - q) / (1 + q) = 2 * (1 + q)⁻¹ - 1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cayM_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cayM_eq
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cayM_eq.header:
theorem cayM_eq {Y : M2} : cayM Y
    = ((1 - frobSq Y / 2) / (1 + frobSq Y / 2)) • (1 : M2) + (2 / (1 + frobSq Y / 2)) • Y

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cayM_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cayM_mem
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cayM_mem.header: theorem cayM_mem {Y : M2} (hY : IsSu2 Y) : cayM Y ∈ Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.coe_cay.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.coe_cay
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.coe_cay.header: theorem coe_cay {Y : M2} (hY : IsSu2 Y) : ((cay Y : SU2) : M2) = (2 : ℝ) • cayR Y - 1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cay_sub.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cay_sub
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cay_sub.header:
theorem cay_sub {Y Y' : M2} (hY : IsSu2 Y) (hY' : IsSu2 Y') :
    ((cay Y : SU2) : M2) - ((cay Y' : SU2) : M2) = (2 : ℝ) • (cayR Y - cayR Y')

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_cay_sub_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_cay_sub_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_cay_sub_le.header:
theorem frobNorm_cay_sub_le {Y Y' : M2} (hY : IsSu2 Y) (hY' : IsSu2 Y') :
    frobNorm (((cay Y : SU2) : M2) - ((cay Y' : SU2) : M2)) ≤ (9 / 2) * frobNorm (Y - Y')

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_cay_sub_one.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_cay_sub_one_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_cay_sub_one.header:
theorem frobNorm_cay_sub_one_le {Y : M2} (hY : IsSu2 Y) :
    frobNorm (((cay Y : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ (9 / 2) * frobNorm Y

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_cay_second_.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_cay_second_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_cay_second_.header:
theorem frobNorm_cay_second_le (Y : Fin 4 → M2) (hY : ∀ i, IsSu2 (Y i)) :
    frobNorm (((cay (Y 3) : SU2) : M2) - (cay (Y 2) : SU2) - (((cay (Y 1) : SU2) : M2) - (cay (Y 0) : SU2)))
      ≤ (9 / 2) * frobNorm (Y 3 - Y 2 - (Y 1 - Y 0))
        + (27 / 4) * (frobNorm (Y 3 - Y 1) + frobNorm (Y 2 - Y 0)) * frobNorm (Y 1 - Y 0)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobSq_Yof.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobSq_Yof
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobSq_Yof.header: theorem frobSq_Yof (h : SU2) : frobSq (Yof h) = 2 * (1 - acos2 h ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.acos2_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.acos2_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.acos2_nonneg.header: theorem acos2_nonneg {h : SU2} (hh : frobNorm ((h : M2) - 1) ≤ 2) : 0 ≤ acos2 h

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cay_icay.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cay_icay
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cay_icay.header: theorem cay_icay {h : SU2} (hh : frobNorm ((h : M2) - 1) ≤ 2) : cay (icay h) = h

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.add_star_su2.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.add_star_su2
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.add_star_su2.header: theorem add_star_su2 (h : SU2) : (h : M2) + (h : M2)ᴴ = (2 * acos2 h) • (1 : M2)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.one_add_mul_S.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.one_add_mul_S
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.one_add_mul_S.header: theorem one_add_mul_S {h : SU2} (ha : 0 ≤ acos2 h) : ((1 : M2) + h) * Sres h = 1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.S_mul_one_add.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.S_mul_one_add
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.S_mul_one_add.header: theorem S_mul_one_add {h : SU2} (ha : 0 ≤ acos2 h) : Sres h * ((1 : M2) + h) = 1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.S_resolvent.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.S_resolvent
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.S_resolvent.header:
theorem S_resolvent {h h' : SU2} (ha : 0 ≤ acos2 h) (ha' : 0 ≤ acos2 h') :
    Sres h - Sres h' = Sres h * ((h' : M2) - h) * Sres h'

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_S_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_S_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_S_le.header: theorem frobNorm_S_le {h : SU2} (ha : 0 ≤ acos2 h) : frobNorm (Sres h) ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.icay_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.icay_eq
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.icay_eq.header: theorem icay_eq {h : SU2} (ha : 0 ≤ acos2 h) : icay h = 1 - (2 : ℝ) • Sres h

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.icay_sub.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.icay_sub
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.icay_sub.header:
theorem icay_sub {h h' : SU2} (ha : 0 ≤ acos2 h) (ha' : 0 ≤ acos2 h') :
    icay h - icay h' = (-2 : ℝ) • (Sres h - Sres h')

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_icay_sub_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_icay_sub_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_icay_sub_le.header:
theorem frobNorm_icay_sub_le {h h' : SU2} (ha : 0 ≤ acos2 h) (ha' : 0 ≤ acos2 h') :
    frobNorm (icay h - icay h') ≤ 2 * frobNorm ((h : M2) - h')

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_icay_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_icay_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_icay_le.header:
theorem frobNorm_icay_le {h : SU2} (hh : frobNorm ((h : M2) - 1) ≤ 2) :
    frobNorm (icay h) ≤ frobNorm ((h : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_icay_second.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_icay_second_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_icay_second.header:
theorem frobNorm_icay_second_le (h : Fin 4 → SU2) (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ acos2 (h i)) :
    frobNorm (icay (h 3) - icay (h 2) - (icay (h 1) - icay (h 0)))
      ≤ 2 * frobNorm (((h 3 : SU2) : M2) - h 2 - ((h 1 : M2) - h 0))
        + 2 * (frobNorm (((h 3 : SU2) : M2) - h 1) + frobNorm (((h 2 : SU2) : M2) - h 0))
          * frobNorm (((h 1 : SU2) : M2) - h 0)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_star_sub_on.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_star_sub_one
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.frobNorm_star_sub_on.header: theorem frobNorm_star_sub_one (g : SU2) : frobNorm ((g : M2)ᴴ - 1) = frobNorm ((g : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.trans_one.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.trans_one
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.trans_one.header:
theorem trans_one (h0 h1 GP GQ : SU2) (hrel : h1 = GQ⁻¹ * h0 * GP) :
    frobNorm ((h1 : M2) - (h0 : M2)) ≤ frobNorm ((GP : M2) - 1) + frobNorm ((GQ : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.trans_two.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.trans_two
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.trans_two.header:
theorem trans_two (h0 h1 h2 h3 GP GQ GP' GQ' : SU2) (hrel : h1 = GQ⁻¹ * h0 * GP)
    (hrel' : h3 = GQ'⁻¹ * h2 * GP') :
    frobNorm ((h3 : M2) - (h2 : M2) - ((h1 : M2) - (h0 : M2)))
      ≤ frobNorm ((GP' : M2) - (GP : M2)) + frobNorm ((GQ' : M2) - (GQ : M2))
        + frobNorm ((h2 : M2) - (h0 : M2)) * (frobNorm ((GP : M2) - 1) + frobNorm ((GQ : M2) - 1))
        + frobNorm ((GQ' : M2) - 1) * frobNorm ((GP' : M2) - 1)
        + frobNorm ((GQ : M2) - 1) * frobNorm ((GP : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.leib_one.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.leib_one
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.leib_one.header:
theorem leib_one (c0 c1 : ℝ) (W0 W1 : M2) :
    frobNorm (c1 • W1 - c0 • W0) ≤ |c1 - c0| * frobNorm W1 + |c0| * frobNorm (W1 - W0)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.leib_two.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.leib_two
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.leib_two.header:
theorem leib_two (c0 c1 c2 c3 : ℝ) (W0 W1 W2 W3 : M2) :
    frobNorm (c3 • W3 - c2 • W2 - (c1 • W1 - c0 • W0))
      ≤ |c3 - c2 - c1 + c0| * frobNorm W3 + |c2 - c0| * frobNorm (W3 - W2) + |c1 - c0| * frobNorm (W3 - W1)
        + |c0| * frobNorm (W3 - W2 - (W1 - W0))

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.shift_comm'.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.shift_comm'
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.shift_comm'.header:
theorem shift_comm' (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν = periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x ν) μ

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.GChart.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.GChart
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.GChart.header: def GChart (U : LinkCfg L) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (D : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (t1 t2 : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.trans.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.trans
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.trans.header: def trans (gP gQ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : SU2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.trans_rel.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.trans_rel
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.trans_rel.header:
theorem trans_rel (U : LinkCfg L) (gP gQ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) :
    trans gP gQ (periodicLatticeShift x ν)
      = (periodicGaugeTransform gQ U (x, ν))⁻¹ * trans gP gQ x * periodicGaugeTransform gP U (x, ν)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.kglue.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.kglue
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.kglue.header:
noncomputable def kglue (gP gQ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : SU2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gglue.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gglue
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gglue.header:
noncomputable def gglue (gP gQ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : SU2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gglue_of_one.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gglue_of_one
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gglue_of_one.header:
theorem gglue_of_one {gP gQ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ}
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (h : c x = 1) : gglue gP gQ c x = gQ x

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gglue_of_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gglue_of_zero
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gglue_of_zero.header:
theorem gglue_of_zero {gP gQ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ}
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (h : c x = 0) : gglue gP gQ c x = gP x

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.kglue_of_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.kglue_of_mem

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gauge_gglue.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gauge_gglue
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gauge_gglue.header:
theorem gauge_gglue (U : LinkCfg L) (gP gQ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) :
    periodicGaugeTransform (gglue gP gQ c) U (x, ν)
      = kglue gP gQ c x * periodicGaugeTransform gP U (x, ν) * (kglue gP gQ c (periodicLatticeShift x ν))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.glueK.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.glueK
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.glueK.header: noncomputable def glueK (t1 τ κ1 : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.glueT1.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.glueT1
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.glueT1.header: noncomputable def glueT1 (t1 τ κ1 : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.glueT2.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.glueT2
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.glueT2.header: noncomputable def glueT2 (t1 t2 τ κ1 κ2 : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.collar_bond.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.collar_bond
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.collar_bond.header:
theorem collar_bond {U : LinkCfg L} {gP gQ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ}
    {t1 τ κ1 : ℝ} (hτ2 : τ ≤ 2) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {ν : Fin 3}
    (hP1 : frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform gP U (x, ν) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ t1)
    (hQ1 : frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform gQ U (x, ν) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ t1)
    (hh0 : frobNorm (((trans gP gQ x : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ τ)
    (hh1 : frobNorm (((trans gP gQ (periodicLatticeShift x ν) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ τ)
    (hc0 : 0 ≤ c x ∧ c x ≤ 1) (hcd : |c (periodicLatticeShift x ν) - c x| ≤ κ1) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ1) :
    frobNorm (((kglue gP gQ c (periodicLatticeShift x ν) : SU2) : M2) - (kglue gP gQ c x : SU2))
      ≤ (9 / 2) * glueK t1 τ κ1 ∧
    frobNorm (c (periodicLatticeShift x ν) • icay (trans gP gQ (periodicLatticeShift x ν))
      - c x • icay (trans gP gQ x)) ≤ glueK t1 τ κ1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cay_second4.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cay_second4
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.cay_second4.header:
theorem cay_second4 {Y0 Y1 Y2 Y3 : M2} (h0 : IsSu2 Y0) (h1 : IsSu2 Y1) (h2 : IsSu2 Y2) (h3 : IsSu2 Y3) :
    frobNorm (((cay Y3 : SU2) : M2) - (cay Y2 : M2) - (((cay Y1 : SU2) : M2) - (cay Y0 : M2)))
      ≤ (9 / 2) * frobNorm (Y3 - Y2 - (Y1 - Y0))
        + (27 / 4) * (frobNorm (Y3 - Y1) + frobNorm (Y2 - Y0)) * frobNorm (Y1 - Y0)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.icay_second4.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.icay_second4
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.icay_second4.header:
theorem icay_second4 {h0 h1 h2 h3 : SU2} (a0 : 0 ≤ acos2 h0) (a1 : 0 ≤ acos2 h1) (a2 : 0 ≤ acos2 h2)
    (a3 : 0 ≤ acos2 h3) :
    frobNorm (icay h3 - icay h2 - (icay h1 - icay h0))
      ≤ 2 * frobNorm ((h3 : M2) - (h2 : M2) - ((h1 : M2) - (h0 : M2)))
        + 2 * (frobNorm ((h3 : M2) - (h1 : M2)) + frobNorm ((h2 : M2) - (h0 : M2)))
          * frobNorm ((h1 : M2) - (h0 : M2))

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.glue_two.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.glue_two
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.glue_two.header:
theorem glue_two {U : LinkCfg L} {gP gQ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2}
    {DP DQ D : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ}
    {t1 t2 τ κ1 κ2 : ℝ} (ht1 : 0 ≤ t1) (ht2 : 0 ≤ t2) (hτ0 : 0 ≤ τ) (hτ2 : τ ≤ 2) (hκ1 : 0 ≤ κ1)
    (hκ2 : 0 ≤ κ2)
    (hP : GChart U gP DP t1 t2) (hQ : GChart U gQ DQ t1 t2)
    (hh : ∀ x, x ∈ DP → x ∈ DQ → frobNorm (((trans gP gQ x : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ τ)
    (hc : ∀ x, x ∈ D → 0 ≤ c x ∧ c x ≤ 1)
    (hc1 : ∀ x ν, x ∈ D → periodicLatticeShift x ν ∈ D → |c (periodicLatticeShift x ν) - c x| ≤ κ1)
    (hc2 : ∀ x μ ν, x ∈ D → periodicLatticeShift x ν ∈ D → periodicLatticeShift x μ ∈ D →
      periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν ∈ D →
      |c (periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν) - c (periodicLatticeShift x μ)
      - c (periodicLatticeShift x ν) + c x| ≤ κ2)
    (hbond : ∀ x ν, x ∈ D → periodicLatticeShift x ν ∈ D →
      (c x = 0 ∧ c (periodicLatticeShift x ν) = 0 ∧ x ∈ DP ∧ periodicLatticeShift x ν ∈ DP) ∨
      (c x = 1 ∧ c (periodicLatticeShift x ν) = 1 ∧ x ∈ DQ ∧ periodicLatticeShift x ν ∈ DQ) ∨
      (x ∈ DP ∧ x ∈ DQ ∧ periodicLatticeShift x ν ∈ DP ∧ periodicLatticeShift x ν ∈ DQ))
    (hsten : ∀ x μ ν, x ∈ D → periodicLatticeShift x ν ∈ D → periodicLatticeShift x μ ∈ D →
      periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν ∈ D →
      (∀ y ∈ ({x, periodicLatticeShift x ν, periodicLatticeShift x μ,
          periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν} : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)), c y = 0 ∧ y ∈ DP) ∨
      (∀ y ∈ ({x, periodicLatticeShift x ν, periodicLatticeShift x μ,
          periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν} : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)), c y = 1 ∧ y ∈ DQ) ∨
      (∀ y ∈ ({x, periodicLatticeShift x ν, periodicLatticeShift x μ,
          periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν} : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)), y ∈ DP ∧ y ∈ DQ)) :
    GChart U (gglue gP gQ c) D (glueT1 t1 τ κ1) (glueT2 t1 t2 τ κ1 κ2)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.coe_su2Exp.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.coe_su2Exp
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.coe_su2Exp.header: theorem coe_su2Exp {Z : M2} (hZ : IsSu2 Z) : ((su2Exp Z : SU2) : M2) = NormedSpace.exp Z

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.nu_le_frobNorm.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.nu_le_frobNorm
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.nu_le_frobNorm.header: theorem nu_le_frobNorm (X : M2) : nu X ≤ frobNorm X

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.exp_sub_one_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.exp_sub_one_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.exp_sub_one_le.header: theorem exp_sub_one_le {Z : M2} (hZ : IsSu2 Z) : frobNorm (((su2Exp Z : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ frobNorm Z

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.exp_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.exp_lip
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.exp_lip.header:
theorem exp_lip {Z Z' : M2} (hZ : IsSu2 Z) (hZ' : IsSu2 Z') (hsm : frobNorm Z + frobNorm (Z' - Z) ≤ 1) :
    frobNorm (((su2Exp Z' : SU2) : M2) - (su2Exp Z : M2)) ≤ (1 + 4 * frobNorm Z) * frobNorm (Z' - Z)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.chZ.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.chZ
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.chZ.header: noncomputable def chZ (η : ℝ) (A : M2) : M2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.isSu2_chZ.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.isSu2_chZ
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.isSu2_chZ.header: theorem isSu2_chZ (η : ℝ) {A : M2} (hA : AdalyFormal.StatementLane.HT A) : IsSu2 (chZ η A)

      frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform g U e : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ T1)
    (h2 : ∀ (μ ν : Fin 3) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L), AdalyFormal.StatementLane.pdist w x ≤ r →
      AdalyFormal.StatementLane.pdist w (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ≤ r →
      frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform g U (periodicLatticeShift x μ, ν) : SU2) : M2)
        - (periodicGaugeTransform g U (x, ν) : SU2)) ≤ T2)
    (ha1 : (Real.pi / 2) * T1 < a' * ((ell : ℝ) ^ i)⁻¹)
    (ha2 : (Real.pi / 2) * T2 < a' * (((ell : ℝ) ^ i)⁻¹) ^ 2) :
    AdalyFormal.M2Route.ChartOn ell U η a' i w r

theorem gchart_of_cube {ell M f k : ℕ} {S : AdalyFormal.StatementLane.Tower L} {α₀ η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)

    {sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {j : ℕ} (hq : AdalyFormal.StatementLane.IsClassCube ell M f k S sites j)

    (hell : 0 < ell) :
    ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2, GChart U g sites ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀ * ((ell : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹)
      ((1 + 4 * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀ * ((ell : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹)) * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀ * (((ell : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹) ^ 2))

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.patchCoercive_class_.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.patchCoercive_class_prop
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.patchCoercive_class_.header:
theorem patchCoercive_class_prop {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ cW : ℝ, 0 < cW ∧ ∃ a₀ : ℝ, 0 < a₀ ∧ ∃ D : ℕ, 12 * ell + 10 ≤ D ∧
    (∀ d, D ≤ d → AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.epsNF ell (AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.PkA a) (AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.thetaN ell) d
      ≤ cW / 2) ∧
    ∀ {M R k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell0 : 0 < ell)
      {S : AdalyFormal.StatementLane.Tower (AdalyFormal.StatementLane.scaleUp ell k Lu)}
      (_hS : AdalyFormal.StatementLane.Admissible ell M R k S) (_hM : 0 < M) (_hR1 : 1 ≤ R)
      (_hR24 : 24 ≤ R) (_hRl : 3 * 12 ≤ R * ell)
      (_hR4 : (5 + 4) * 1 * ell ≤ R) (_hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) {d : ℕ} (_hdD : D ≤ d)
      (_hdM : d + 64 * ell ^ 2 + 2 ≤ M)
      {W : ℕ} (_hW : 1 ≤ W) (_hWR : W ≤ R * M * ell)
      (U : LinkCfg (AdalyFormal.StatementLane.scaleUp ell k Lu)) (cs : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (_hp : AdalyFormal.M1IMS.HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
      (ρ : ℝ) (_hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (_hreg : AdalyFormal.M1IMS.HolRegime S ell k U ρ) (ε1 : ℝ) (_hε1 : 0 < ε1)
      (_hη : AdalyFormal.M1IMS.etaC ell W cs ρ ε1 < 1)
      (η : ℝ) (_hη0 : 0 < η) (α₀ : ℝ) (_hα0 : 0 < α₀)
      (_hP : AdalyFormal.StatementLane2.PerCubeRegular2 ell M 12 k S α₀ η U)
      (C : ℝ) (_hC : 1 ≤ C) (_hCa : C * (((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M * α₀) ≤ a₀)
      (_hI : AdalyFormal.M2Route.InterfaceCharts ell M k d S U η (C * (((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M * α₀))),
      AdalyFormal.M1IMS.PatchCoercive ell M k 1 5 Lu hell0 S U a Lam
        ((1 - AdalyFormal.M1IMS.etaC ell W cs ρ ε1) * min a (cW - AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.epsNF ell
          (AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.PkA a) (AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.thetaN ell) d)
          - 2 * AdalyFormal.M1IMS.nuC ell ρ)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.stepS'_lip.header: theorem stepS'_lip (a b : ℝ) : |stepS' b - stepS' a| ≤ 16 * |b - a|

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.stepS_taylor.header: theorem stepS_taylor (a b : ℝ) : |stepS b - stepS a - stepS' a * (b - a)| ≤ 8 * (b - a) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.stepS_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.stepS_lip
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.stepS_lip.header: theorem stepS_lip (a b : ℝ) : |stepS b - stepS a| ≤ 2 * |b - a| + 8 * (b - a) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.switch_glue.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.switch_glue
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.switch_glue.header:
theorem switch_glue {U : LinkCfg L} {gP gQ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {D : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)}
    {φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ} {σ : Fin 3} {a w t1 t2 τ : ℝ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) (ht1 : 0 ≤ t1) (ht2 : 0 ≤ t2)
    (hτ0 : 0 ≤ τ) (hτ2 : τ ≤ 2)
    (hφ : ∀ x μ, x ∈ D → periodicLatticeShift x μ ∈ D →
      φ (periodicLatticeShift x μ) = φ x + (if μ = σ then 1 else 0))
    (hP : GChart U gP {x | x ∈ D ∧ φ x ≤ a + w + 2} t1 t2)
    (hQ : GChart U gQ {x | x ∈ D ∧ a - 2 ≤ φ x} t1 t2)
    (hh : ∀ x, x ∈ D → a - 2 ≤ φ x → φ x ≤ a + w + 2 → frobNorm (((trans gP gQ x : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ τ) :
    GChart U (gglue gP gQ (cutS φ a w)) D (glueT1 t1 τ (kap1 w)) (glueT2 t1 t2 τ (kap1 w) (kap2 w))

AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gauge_flatten.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gauge_flatten
AdalyFormal.M2Glue2.gauge_flatten.header:
theorem gauge_flatten (U : LinkCfg L) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)

      frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform gP U (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1)
        + frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform gQ U (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ β z)

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_coercive_fla.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_coercive_flatExt
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_coercive_fla.header:
theorem ginv_coercive_flatExt (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a + (1 - siteMask (GF ell k Lu).Om0)))
    (PU : ℝ) (hPU : 0 ≤ PU)
    (hPoincU : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) U, ‖ν‖ ≤ PU * ‖gradL2 U ν‖)
    (nsq c1 t e P δ q aE bE ε0 : ℝ) (hn : 0 < nsq) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (haE : 0 ≤ aE) (hbE : 0 ≤ bE) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0) (hεa : ε0 * aE < 1)
    (hsmall : nsq * ((((bE + δ * aE) / (1 - ε0 * aE)) * q) * (δ * P + (((bE + δ * aE) / (1 - ε0 * aE)) * q) * P ^ 2
        * (δ + ((bE + δ * aE) / (1 - ε0 * aE)) * ε0)) + δ) ^ 2 + nsq * e < c1)
    (hflat : ∀ y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      c1 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ nsq * (PhiF ell k Lu a (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y
        + ‖Rproj (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (gradAdj (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y)‖ ^ 2))
    (hdrift : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      PhiF ell k Lu a (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) x ≤ (1 + t) * PhiF ell k Lu a U x + e * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hPoinc1 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)),
      ‖ν‖ ≤ P * ‖gradL2 (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ν‖)
    (hd : ∀ f, ‖gradL2 (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) f - gradL2 U f‖ ≤ δ * ‖f‖)
    (E1 : coarseC (GF ell k Lu) →L[ℝ] SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hQE : ∀ w, Qtop (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _) (E1 w) = w)
    (hEa : ∀ w, ‖E1 w‖ ≤ aE * ‖w‖) (hEb : ∀ w, ‖gradL2 (trivialU _) (E1 w)‖ ≤ bE * ‖w‖)
    (hQdrift : ∀ f, ‖Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f - Qtop (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _) f‖ ≤ ε0 * ‖f‖)
    (hQq : ∀ f, ‖Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f‖ ≤ q * ‖f‖)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp (GF ell k Lu))) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ max (2 / ((c1 - nsq * ((((bE + δ * aE) / (1 - ε0 * aE)) * q) * (δ * P
        + (((bE + δ * aE) / (1 - ε0 * aE)) * q) * P ^ 2 * (δ + ((bE + δ * aE) / (1 - ε0 * aE)) * ε0)) + δ) ^ 2
        - nsq * e) / (1 + t) / nsq)) (2 * PU ^ 2) *
      ⟪x, (IngrBParams.data ⟨ell, k, Lu, hell, fullTower ell k Lu, U, a, Lam⟩).Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.phi_drift_decomp.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.phi_drift_decomp
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.phi_drift_decomp.header:
theorem phi_drift_decomp (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (δc θ δm : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      ‖AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.plaqMask (plaqIn (GF ell k Lu).Om0) (curlCovariantLM_L2 (trivialU _) x)
        - AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.plaqMask (plaqIn (GF ell k Lu).Om0) (curlCovariantLM_L2 U x)‖ ≤ δc * ‖x‖)
    (hdp : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      |AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc U (plaqIn (GF ell k Lu).Om0) x x| ≤ θ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hm : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      ∑ p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu), a * ((GF ell k Lu).ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ) *
        ‖(bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p - (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2
        ≤ δm ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    PhiF ell k Lu a (trivialU _) x
      ≤ (1 + t) * PhiF ell k Lu a U x + ((1 + t) * θ + (1 + 1 / t) * (δc ^ 2 + δm ^ 2)) * ‖x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hc_of_frobSup.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hc_of_frobSup
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hc_of_frobSup.header:
theorem hc_of_frobSup (U : Cfg L) (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (x : BondFnL2 L) :

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.siteMask_univ.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.siteMask_univ
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.siteMask_univ.header: theorem siteMask_univ (f : SiteL2 L) : siteMask (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) f = f

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.lapDir_univ.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.lapDir_univ
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.lapDir_univ.header:
theorem lapDir_univ (G : TowerGeom L) (hOm : G.Om0 = Set.univ) (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    lapDir G U f = lapFull U f

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.gradAdj_Wop.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.gradAdj_Wop
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.gradAdj_Wop.header:
theorem gradAdj_Wop (G : TowerGeom L) (hOm : G.Om0 = Set.univ) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA G U a + (1 - siteMask G.Om0))) (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    gradAdj U (Wop G U a x) = gradAdj U x - Rproj G U (gradAdj U x)

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.norm_grad_Gp_Rpro.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.norm_grad_Gp_Rproj_sq
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.norm_grad_Gp_Rpro.header:
theorem norm_grad_Gp_Rproj_sq (G : TowerGeom L) (hOm : G.Om0 = Set.univ) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA G U a + (1 - siteMask G.Om0))) (s : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖gradL2 U (Gp G U a (Rproj G U s))‖ ^ 2 = ⟪Gp G U a (Rproj G U s), Rproj G U s⟫

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.Rproj_eq_zero_iff.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.Rproj_eq_zero_iff
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.Rproj_eq_zero_iff.header:
theorem Rproj_eq_zero_iff (G : TowerGeom L) (hOm : G.Om0 = Set.univ) (U : Cfg L) (s : SiteL2 L) :
    Rproj G U s = 0 ↔ ∀ ν ∈ NQp G U, ⟪gradL2 U s, gradL2 U ν⟫ = 0

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.slice_of_Wop.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.slice_of_Wop
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.slice_of_Wop.header:
theorem slice_of_Wop (G : TowerGeom L) (hOm : G.Om0 = Set.univ) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA G U a + (1 - siteMask G.Om0))) (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    Rproj G U (gradAdj U (Wop G U a x)) = 0

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.B1_form.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.B1_form
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.B1_form.header:
theorem B1_form (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (S : BondSector G)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA G U a + (1 - siteMask G.Om0)))
    (hB0 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp G U, S.Qfull (gradL2 U ν) = 0) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    ⟪A, DpiFull G U a A⟫ + ‖Tfull G U A‖ ^ 2 + ⟪A, MassFull G a S A⟫
      = ⟪Wop G U a A, Delta G U (Wop G U a A)⟫ + ‖Tfull G U A‖ ^ 2
        + ⟪Wop G U a A, MassFull G a S (Wop G U a A)⟫

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.gauge_part_le.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.gauge_part_le
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.gauge_part_le.header:
theorem gauge_part_le (G : TowerGeom L) (hOm : G.Om0 = Set.univ) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA G U a + (1 - siteMask G.Om0))) (P : ℝ) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hPoinc : ∀ ν ∈ NQp G U, ‖ν‖ ≤ P * ‖gradL2 U ν‖) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    ‖A - Wop G U a A‖ ≤ P * ‖Tfull G U A‖

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_form_eq.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_form_eq
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_form_eq.header:
theorem ginv_form_eq (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (S : BondSector G) (Jf : BondFnL2 L)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp G)) :
    ⟪x, (baseData G U a S Jf).Ginv x⟫
      = ⟪iE G x, DpiFull G U a (iE G x)⟫ + ‖Tfull G U (iE G x)‖ ^ 2
        + ⟪iE G x, MassFull G a S (iE G x)⟫

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_coercive_con.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_coercive_cond
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_coercive_con.header:
theorem ginv_coercive_cond (G : TowerGeom L) (hOm : G.Om0 = Set.univ) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ)
    (S : BondSector G) (Jf : BondFnL2 L)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA G U a + (1 - siteMask G.Om0)))
    (hB0 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp G U, S.Qfull (gradL2 U ν) = 0)
    (P : ℝ) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hPoinc : ∀ ν ∈ NQp G U, ‖ν‖ ≤ P * ‖gradL2 U ν‖)
    (cs : ℝ) (hcs : 0 < cs)
    (hslice : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, Rproj G U (gradAdj U x) = 0 →
      cs * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, Delta G U x⟫ + ⟪x, MassFull G a S x⟫)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp G)) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ max (2 / cs) (2 * P ^ 2) * ⟪x, (baseData G U a S Jf).Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_coercive_ful.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_coercive_fullTower
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_coercive_ful.header:
theorem ginv_coercive_fullTower (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Jf : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) U) k)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) U a
      + (1 - siteMask (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)).Om0)))
    (P : ℝ) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hPoinc : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) U, ‖ν‖ ≤ P * ‖gradL2 U ν‖)
    (cs : ℝ) (hcs : 0 < cs)
    (hslice : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      Rproj (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) U (gradAdj U x) = 0 →
      cs * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, Delta (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) U x⟫
        + ⟪x, MassFull (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) a
            (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) U) x⟫)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)))) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ max (2 / cs) (2 * P ^ 2) *
      ⟪x, (baseData (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) U a
        (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) U) Jf).Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_coercive_ing.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_coercive_ingr
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_coercive_ing.header:
theorem ginv_coercive_ingr (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)

    (P : ℝ) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hPoinc : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) U, ‖ν‖ ≤ P * ‖gradL2 U ν‖)
    (cs : ℝ) (hcs : 0 < cs)
    (hslice : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      Rproj (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) U (gradAdj U x) = 0 →
      cs * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, Delta (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) U x⟫
        + ⟪x, MassFull (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) a
            (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) U) x⟫)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)))) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ max (2 / cs) (2 * P ^ 2) *
      ⟪x, (IngrBParams.data ⟨ell, k, Lu, hell, fullTower ell k Lu, U, a, Lam⟩).Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.Rproj_mem_lap.header:

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.slice_coercive_co.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.slice_coercive_cond
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.slice_coercive_co.header:
theorem slice_coercive_cond (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ)
    (nsq c1 t e P δ b ε q : ℝ) (hn : 0 ≤ nsq) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hflat : ∀ y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      c1 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ nsq * (PhiF ell k Lu a (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y
        + ‖Rproj (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (gradAdj (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y)‖ ^ 2))
    (hdrift : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      PhiF ell k Lu a (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) x ≤ (1 + t) * PhiF ell k Lu a U x + e * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hPoinc1 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)),
      ‖ν‖ ≤ P * ‖gradL2 (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ν‖)
    (hd : ∀ f, ‖gradL2 (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) f - gradL2 U f‖ ≤ δ * ‖f‖)
    (hext : ∀ w : coarseC (GF ell k Lu), ∃ f, Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f = w ∧ ‖gradL2 U f‖ ≤ b * ‖w‖)
    (hQq : ∀ f, ‖Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f‖ ≤ q * ‖f‖)
    (hQN1 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)), ‖Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U ν‖ ≤ ε * ‖ν‖)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hx : Rproj (GF ell k Lu) U (gradAdj U x) = 0) :
    (c1 - nsq * ((b * q) * (δ * P + (b * q) * P ^ 2 * (δ + b * ε)) + δ) ^ 2 - nsq * e) / (1 + t)
        * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ nsq * PhiF ell k Lu a U x

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_coercive_ful.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_coercive_fullTower_named
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.ginv_coercive_ful.header:
theorem ginv_coercive_fullTower_named (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a + (1 - siteMask (GF ell k Lu).Om0)))
    (PU : ℝ) (hPU : 0 ≤ PU)
    (hPoincU : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) U, ‖ν‖ ≤ PU * ‖gradL2 U ν‖)
    (nsq c1 t e P δ b ε q : ℝ) (hn : 0 < nsq) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hsmall : nsq * ((b * q) * (δ * P + (b * q) * P ^ 2 * (δ + b * ε)) + δ) ^ 2 + nsq * e < c1)
    (hflat : ∀ y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      c1 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ nsq * (PhiF ell k Lu a (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y
        + ‖Rproj (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (gradAdj (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y)‖ ^ 2))
    (hdrift : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      PhiF ell k Lu a (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) x ≤ (1 + t) * PhiF ell k Lu a U x + e * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hPoinc1 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)),
      ‖ν‖ ≤ P * ‖gradL2 (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ν‖)
    (hd : ∀ f, ‖gradL2 (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) f - gradL2 U f‖ ≤ δ * ‖f‖)
    (hext : ∀ w : coarseC (GF ell k Lu), ∃ f, Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f = w ∧ ‖gradL2 U f‖ ≤ b * ‖w‖)
    (hQq : ∀ f, ‖Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f‖ ≤ q * ‖f‖)
    (hQN1 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)), ‖Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U ν‖ ≤ ε * ‖ν‖)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp (GF ell k Lu))) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ max (2 / ((c1 - nsq * ((b * q) * (δ * P + (b * q) * P ^ 2 * (δ + b * ε)) + δ) ^ 2 - nsq * e)
        / (1 + t) / nsq)) (2 * PU ^ 2) *
      ⟪x, (IngrBParams.data ⟨ell, k, Lu, hell, fullTower ell k Lu, U, a, Lam⟩).Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hext_of_flatExt.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hext_of_flatExt
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hext_of_flatExt.header:
theorem hext_of_flatExt (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (E1 : coarseC (GF ell k Lu) →L[ℝ] SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a b δ ε0 : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0) (hεa : ε0 * a < 1)
    (hQE : ∀ w, Qtop (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _) (E1 w) = w)
    (hEa : ∀ w, ‖E1 w‖ ≤ a * ‖w‖) (hEb : ∀ w, ‖gradL2 (trivialU _) (E1 w)‖ ≤ b * ‖w‖)
    (hd : ∀ f, ‖gradL2 (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) f - gradL2 U f‖ ≤ δ * ‖f‖)
    (hdrift : ∀ f, ‖Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f - Qtop (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _) f‖ ≤ ε0 * ‖f‖)
    (w : coarseC (GF ell k Lu)) :
    ∃ f, Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f = w ∧ ‖gradL2 U f‖ ≤ (b + δ * a) / (1 - ε0 * a) * ‖w‖

AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hQN1_of_drift.name: AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hQN1_of_drift
AdalyFormal.SliceCoerc.hQN1_of_drift.header:
theorem hQN1_of_drift (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε0 : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.zch_of_gchart.header:

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.qc.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.qc
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.qc.header: noncomputable def qc (p : Z3) (i : Fin 3) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.half_le_abs_qc.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.half_le_abs_qc
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.half_le_abs_qc.header: theorem half_le_abs_qc (p : Z3) (i : Fin 3) : 1 / 2 ≤ |qc p i|

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.qc_add_ev.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.qc_add_ev
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.qc_add_ev.header: theorem qc_add_ev (p : Z3) (μ i : Fin 3) : qc (p + ev μ) i = qc p i + (if i = μ then 1 else 0)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.abs_qc_add_ev_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.abs_qc_add_ev_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.abs_qc_add_ev_le.header: theorem abs_qc_add_ev_le (p : Z3) (μ i : Fin 3) : |qc (p + ev μ) i - qc p i| ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.rho_le_three_mul.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.rho_le_three_mul
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.rho_le_three_mul.header: theorem rho_le_three_mul (p : Z3) : ∀ i, |qc p i| ≤ rho p

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.rho_perturb.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.rho_perturb
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.rho_perturb.header:
theorem rho_perturb {p p' : Z3} {k : ℝ} (h : ∀ i, |qc p' i - qc p i| ≤ k) :
    rho p' ≤ rho p + 3 * k ∧ rho p - 3 * k ≤ rho p'

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_ge.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_ge
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_ge.header: theorem Qf_ge (p : Z3) : rho p ^ 2 ≤ 3 * Qf p

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_le.header: theorem Qf_le (p : Z3) : Qf p ≤ rho p ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_add_ev.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_add_ev
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_add_ev.header: theorem Qf_add_ev (p : Z3) (μ : Fin 3) : Qf (p + ev μ) = Qf p + 2 * qc p μ + 1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Hraw.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Hraw
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Hraw.header: def Hraw (R : ℕ) (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) : Set Z3

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.baseP_abs.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.baseP_abs
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.baseP_abs.header: theorem baseP_abs (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) (i : Fin 3) : |baseP σ b i| ≤ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.baseP_hs.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.baseP_hs
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.baseP_hs.header: theorem baseP_hs (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) (μ : Fin 3) : hsP σ b (baseP σ b) ∧ hsP σ b (baseP σ b + ev μ)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.baseP_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.baseP_mem
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.baseP_mem.header:
theorem baseP_mem {R : ℕ} (hR : 1 ≤ R) (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) :

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.phiA.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.phiA
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.phiA.header:

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.phiA_base.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.phiA_base
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.phiA_base.header:
theorem phiA_base {v : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {R : ℕ} (hinj : Set.InjOn (iota v) (Box (R + 3))) (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) (σ' : Fin 3) : phiA v R σ b σ' (iota v (baseP σ b)) = 0

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.flA.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.flA
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.flA.header:
noncomputable def flA (U : LinkCfg L) (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (R : ℕ)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.flA_gchart.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.flA_gchart
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.flA_gchart.header:
theorem flA_gchart {U : LinkCfg L} {v : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {R : ℕ} (hinj : Set.InjOn (iota v) (Box (R + 3)))
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) {g : Fin 3 → Bool → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {t1 t2 : ℝ} (ht1 : 0 ≤ t1) (ht12 : t1 ≤ 2)
    (hg : ∀ σ b, GChart U (g σ b) (lift v (Hraw R σ b)) t1 t2) (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) :
    GChart U (flA U v R g σ b) (lift v (Hraw R σ b)) ((11 / 2) * t1) (t2 + 43 * t1 ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.flA_base.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.flA_base
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.flA_base.header:
theorem flA_base {U : LinkCfg L} {v : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {R : ℕ} (hinj : Set.InjOn (iota v) (Box (R + 3)))
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) {g : Fin 3 → Bool → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {t1 t2 : ℝ} (ht12 : t1 ≤ 2)
    (hg : ∀ σ b, GChart U (g σ b) (lift v (Hraw R σ b)) t1 t2) (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) (σ' : Fin 3) :
    periodicGaugeTransform (flA U v R g σ b) U (iota v (baseP σ b), σ') = 1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.regLo.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.regLo
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.regLo.header: def regLo (R : ℕ) (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) : Z3

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.regHi.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.regHi
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.regHi.header: def regHi (R : ℕ) (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) (ν : Fin 3) : Z3

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.reg_raw.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.reg_raw
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.reg_raw.header:
theorem reg_raw {R : ℕ} {σ : Fin 3} {b : Bool} {ν : Fin 3} {z : Z3} (i : Fin 3)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.target_in_reg.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.target_in_reg
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.target_in_reg.header:

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.base_in_reg.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.base_in_reg
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.base_in_reg.header:
theorem base_in_reg {R : ℕ} (hR : 1 ≤ R) (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) (ν : Fin 3) :
