AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.flat_prepared.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.flat_prepared
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.flat_prepared.header:
theorem flat_prepared {U : LinkCfg L} {v : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {R : ℕ} (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    {G : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {σ : Fin 3} {b : Bool} {t s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hG : GChart U G (lift v (Hraw R σ b)) t s)
    (hbase : ∀ σ', periodicGaugeTransform G U (iota v (baseP σ b), σ') = 1) :
    ZCh U G v (Hd R σ b) (fun p => 4 * rho p * s) (fun _ => s)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.rho_corner.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.rho_corner
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.rho_corner.header: theorem rho_corner {z : Z3} (hz : isCorner z) : rho z = 3 / 2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.hsP_between.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.hsP_between
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.hsP_between.header:
theorem hsP_between {σ : Fin 3} {b : Bool} {p z w : Z3} (hp : hsP σ b p) (hz : hsP σ b z)
    (h1 : min (p σ) (z σ) ≤ w σ) (h2 : w σ ≤ max (p σ) (z σ)) : hsP σ b w

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.pair_growth.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.pair_growth
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.pair_growth.header:
theorem pair_growth {U : LinkCfg L} {v : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {R : ℕ} (hinj : Set.InjOn (iota v) (Box (R + 2)))
    {P Q : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {σ σ' : Fin 3} {b b' : Bool} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    {TP TQ : Z3 → ℝ}
    (hP : ZCh U P v (Hd R σ b) (fun p => 4 * rho p * s) TP) (hQ : ZCh U Q v (Hd R σ' b') (fun p => 4 * rho p * s) TQ)
    {z p : Z3} (hz : isCorner z) (hza : z ∈ Hd R σ b) (hzb : z ∈ Hd R σ' b') (hpa : p ∈ Hd R σ b)
    (hpb : p ∈ Hd R σ' b') {E : ℝ} (hE : frobNorm (((trans P Q (iota v z) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ E) :
    frobNorm (((trans P Q (iota v p) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ E + 128 * rho p ^ 2 * s

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.frob_trans_symm.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.frob_trans_symm
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.frob_trans_symm.header:
theorem frob_trans_symm (P Q : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    frobNorm (((trans Q P x : SU2) : M2) - 1) = frobNorm (((trans P Q x : SU2) : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.trans_cocycle.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.trans_cocycle
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.trans_cocycle.header:
theorem trans_cocycle (P Q R' : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    trans P R' x = trans Q R' x * trans P Q x

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.pair_via.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.pair_via
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.pair_via.header:
theorem pair_via {U : LinkCfg L} {v : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {R : ℕ} (hinj : Set.InjOn (iota v) (Box (R + 2)))
    {P Q R' : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {σ σ' σc : Fin 3} {b b' bc : Bool} {s B1 B2 : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hB1 : 0 ≤ B1) (hB2 : 0 ≤ B2) {TP TR : Z3 → ℝ}
    (hP : ZCh U P v (Hd R σ b) (fun p => 4 * rho p * s) TP) (hR' : ZCh U R' v (Hd R σ' b') (fun p => 4 * rho p * s) TR)
    (hPQ : ∀ p, p ∈ Hd R σ b → p ∈ Hd R σc bc → frobNorm (((trans P Q (iota v p) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ B1 * rho p ^ 2 * s)
    (hQR : ∀ p, p ∈ Hd R σc bc → p ∈ Hd R σ' b' → frobNorm (((trans Q R' (iota v p) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ B2 * rho p ^ 2 * s)
    {z : Z3} (hz : isCorner z) (hza : z ∈ Hd R σ b) (hzb : z ∈ Hd R σ' b') (hzc : z ∈ Hd R σc bc) :
    ∀ p, p ∈ Hd R σ b → p ∈ Hd R σ' b' →
      frobNorm (((trans P R' (iota v p) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ (128 + B1 + B2) * rho p ^ 2 * s

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.gsN.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.gsN
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.gsN.header:
noncomputable def gsN (n : Fin 3 → Bool → SU2) (U : LinkCfg L) (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (R : ℕ)
    (g : Fin 3 → Bool → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.trans_gsN.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.trans_gsN
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.trans_gsN.header:
theorem trans_gsN (n : Fin 3 → Bool → SU2) (U : LinkCfg L) (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (R : ℕ)
    (g : Fin 3 → Bool → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (σ σ' : Fin 3) (b b' : Bool) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    trans (gsN n U v R g σ b) (gsN n U v R g σ' b') x
      = n σ' b' * trans (flA U v R g σ b) (flA U v R g σ' b') x * (n σ b)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.nrm.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.nrm
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.nrm.header:
noncomputable def nrm (U : LinkCfg L) (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (R : ℕ)
    (g : Fin 3 → Bool → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) : Fin 3 → Bool → SU2
  | 2, true => 1
  | 2, false => (trans (fun x => (trans (flA U v R g 2 true) (flA U v R g 0 true) (iota v (zc 0 true)))⁻¹ *
      flA U v R g 0 true x) (flA U v R g 2 false) (iota v (zc 2 false)))⁻¹
  | σ, b => (trans (flA U v R g 2 true) (flA U v R g σ b) (iota v (zc σ b)))⁻¹

theorem norm_2t (U : LinkCfg L) (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (R : ℕ) (g : Fin 3 → Bool → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2)
    (σ : Fin 3) (hσ : σ ≠ 2) (b : Bool) :
    trans (gsN (nrm U v R g) U v R g 2 true) (gsN (nrm U v R g) U v R g σ b) (iota v (zc σ b)) = 1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.norm_2t.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.norm_2t
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.norm_2t.header:
theorem norm_2t (U : LinkCfg L) (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (R : ℕ) (g : Fin 3 → Bool → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2)
    (σ : Fin 3) (hσ : σ ≠ 2) (b : Bool) :
    trans (gsN (nrm U v R g) U v R g 2 true) (gsN (nrm U v R g) U v R g σ b) (iota v (zc σ b)) = 1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.norm_2f.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.norm_2f
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.norm_2f.header:
theorem norm_2f (U : LinkCfg L) (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (R : ℕ) (g : Fin 3 → Bool → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) :
    trans (gsN (nrm U v R g) U v R g 0 true) (gsN (nrm U v R g) U v R g 2 false) (iota v (zc 2 false)) = 1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.corner_hd.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.corner_hd
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.corner_hd.header: theorem corner_hd {R : ℕ} {z : Z3} (hz : isCorner z) {σ : Fin 3} {b : Bool} (hs : hsP σ b z) : z ∈ Hd R σ b

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.prepZ.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.prepZ
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.prepZ.header:
theorem prepZ {U : LinkCfg L} {v : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {R : ℕ} (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (iota v) (Box (R + 3))) {g : Fin 3 → Bool → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {t1 t2 : ℝ}
    (ht1 : 0 ≤ t1) (ht12 : t1 ≤ 2) (ht2 : 0 ≤ t2) (hg : ∀ σ b, GChart U (g σ b) (lift v (Hraw R σ b)) t1 t2)
    (n : Fin 3 → Bool → SU2) (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) :
    ZCh U (gsN n U v R g σ b) v (Hd R σ b) (fun p => 4 * rho p * (t2 + 43 * t1 ^ 2)) (fun _ => t2 + 43 * t1 ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.pairs_abstract.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.pairs_abstract
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.pairs_abstract.header:
theorem pairs_abstract {U : LinkCfg L} {v : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {R : ℕ}
    (hinj2 : Set.InjOn (iota v) (Box (R + 2))) {G : Fin 3 → Bool → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (Z : ∀ σ b, ZCh U (G σ b) v (Hd R σ b) (fun p => 4 * rho p * s) (fun _ => s))
    (n0t : trans (G 2 true) (G 0 true) (iota v (zc 0 true)) = 1)
    (n0f : trans (G 2 true) (G 0 false) (iota v (zc 0 false)) = 1)
    (n1t : trans (G 2 true) (G 1 true) (iota v (zc 1 true)) = 1)
    (n1f : trans (G 2 true) (G 1 false) (iota v (zc 1 false)) = 1)
    (n2f : trans (G 0 true) (G 2 false) (iota v (zc 2 false)) = 1) :
    ∀ σ b σ' b' p, p ∈ Hd R σ b → p ∈ Hd R σ' b' →
      frobNorm (((trans (G σ b) (G σ' b') (iota v p) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ 1152 * rho p ^ 2 * s

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.pairs_all.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.pairs_all
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.pairs_all.header:
theorem pairs_all {U : LinkCfg L} {v : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {R : ℕ} (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (iota v) (Box (R + 3))) {g : Fin 3 → Bool → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {t1 t2 : ℝ}
    (ht1 : 0 ≤ t1) (ht12 : t1 ≤ 2) (ht2 : 0 ≤ t2) (hg : ∀ σ b, GChart U (g σ b) (lift v (Hraw R σ b)) t1 t2) :
    ∀ σ b σ' b' p, p ∈ Hd R σ b → p ∈ Hd R σ' b' →
      frobNorm (((trans (gsN (nrm U v R g) U v R g σ b) (gsN (nrm U v R g) U v R g σ' b') (iota v p) : SU2) : M2) - 1)
        ≤ 1152 * rho p ^ 2 * (t2 + 43 * t1 ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.frob_flatY_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.frob_flatY_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.frob_flatY_le.header:
theorem frob_flatY_le {U : LinkCfg L} {v : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {R : ℕ} (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (iota v) (Box (R + 3))) {g : Fin 3 → Bool → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {t1 t2 : ℝ}
    (ht12 : t1 ≤ 2) (hg : ∀ σ b, GChart U (g σ b) (lift v (Hraw R σ b)) t1 t2) (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool)
    {p : Z3} (hp : p ∈ Box (R + 2)) :
    frobNorm (flatY U (g σ b) (iota v (baseP σ b)) (phiA v R σ b) (iota v p)) ≤ (rho p + 7 / 2) * t1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.gchart_at_bad_vertex.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.gchart_at_bad_vertex
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.gchart_at_bad_vertex.header:
theorem gchart_at_bad_vertex {U : LinkCfg L} (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {R : ℕ} (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (iota v) (Box (R + 3)))
    (g : Fin 3 → Bool → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) {t1 t2 : ℝ} (ht1 : 0 ≤ t1) (ht12 : t1 ≤ 2) (ht2 : 0 ≤ t2)
    (hg : ∀ σ b, GChart U (g σ b) (lift v (Hraw R σ b)) t1 t2)
    (hsmall : (4 * cB 1152 5 + 1) * (3 * (R : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 * (t2 + 43 * t1 ^ 2) ≤ 1) :
    ∃ gv : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2,
      GChart U gv (lift v (Box R)) (KT1 4 1152 * (3 * R + 2) * (t2 + 43 * t1 ^ 2)) (KT2 4 1152 * (t2 + 43 * t1 ^ 2)) ∧
      ∃ n : Fin 3 → Bool → SU2, ∀ σ b p, p ∈ Box R → hsP σ b p →
        frobNorm (((gv (iota v p) * (g σ b (iota v p))⁻¹ : SU2) : M2) - (n σ b : M2))
          ≤ cB 1152 5 * rho p ^ 2 * (t2 + 43 * t1 ^ 2) + 15 * rho p * t1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.GChart.union3.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.GChart.union3
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.GChart.union3.header:
theorem GChart.union3 {U : LinkCfg L} {g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {D E1 E2 E3 : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)}
    {t1 t2 : ℝ} (h1 : GChart U g E1 t1 t2) (h2 : GChart U g E2 t1 t2) (h3 : GChart U g E3 t1 t2)
    (hb : ∀ x ν, x ∈ D → periodicLatticeShift x ν ∈ D →
      (x ∈ E1 ∧ periodicLatticeShift x ν ∈ E1) ∨ (x ∈ E2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift x ν ∈ E2) ∨
      (x ∈ E3 ∧ periodicLatticeShift x ν ∈ E3))
    (hs : ∀ x μ ν, x ∈ D → periodicLatticeShift x ν ∈ D → periodicLatticeShift x μ ∈ D →
      periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν ∈ D →
      (x ∈ E1 ∧ periodicLatticeShift x ν ∈ E1 ∧ periodicLatticeShift x μ ∈ E1 ∧
          periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν ∈ E1) ∨
      (x ∈ E2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift x ν ∈ E2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift x μ ∈ E2 ∧
          periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν ∈ E2) ∨
      (x ∈ E3 ∧ periodicLatticeShift x ν ∈ E3 ∧ periodicLatticeShift x μ ∈ E3 ∧
          periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν ∈ E3)) :
    GChart U g D t1 t2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweepA.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweepA
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweepA.header:
noncomputable def sweepA (g : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (w : ℝ) :
    ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2
  | 0 => g 0
  | n + 1 => gglue (sweepA g φ a w n) (g (n + 1)) (cutS φ (a (n + 1)) w)

def Slab (D : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (w : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Slab.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Slab
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Slab.header:
def Slab (D : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (w : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweepA_high.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweepA_high
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweepA_high.header:
theorem sweepA_high {g : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ} {a : ℕ → ℝ} {w : ℝ}
    (hw : 0 < w) : ∀ N x, (N = 0 ∨ a N + w ≤ φ x) → sweepA g φ a w N x = g N x

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweepA_low.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweepA_low

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.glueT_ge.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.glueT_ge
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.glueT_ge.header:
theorem glueT_ge {t1 t2 τ w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (ht1 : 0 ≤ t1) (ht2 : 0 ≤ t2) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
    t1 ≤ glueT1 t1 τ (kap1 w) ∧ t2 ≤ glueT2 t1 t2 τ (kap1 w) (kap2 w)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweep_glue.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweep_glue
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweep_glue.header:
theorem sweep_glue {U : LinkCfg L} {D : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ} {σ : Fin 3}
    {a : ℕ → ℝ} {w t1 t2 τ : ℝ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) (ht1 : 0 ≤ t1) (ht2 : 0 ≤ t2) (hτ0 : 0 ≤ τ) (hτ2 : τ ≤ 2)
    (hφ : ∀ x μ, x ∈ D → periodicLatticeShift x μ ∈ D →
      φ (periodicLatticeShift x μ) = φ x + (if μ = σ then 1 else 0))
    (hgap : ∀ k, a k + w + 4 ≤ a (k + 1))
    {g : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} (hg : ∀ k, GChart U (g k) (Slab D φ a w k) t1 t2)
    (hτ : ∀ k x, x ∈ D → a (k + 1) - 2 ≤ φ x → φ x ≤ a (k + 1) + w + 2 →
      frobNorm (((trans (g k) (g (k + 1)) x : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ τ) :
    ∀ N, GChart U (sweepA g φ a w N) {x | x ∈ D ∧ φ x ≤ a (N + 1) + w + 2}
      (glueT1 t1 τ (kap1 w)) (glueT2 t1 t2 τ (kap1 w) (kap2 w))

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweep_last.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweep_last
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweep_last.header:
theorem sweep_last {g : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ} {a : ℕ → ℝ} {w : ℝ}
    (hw : 0 < w) (N : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (h : a N + w ≤ φ x) : sweepA g φ a w N x = g N x

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweep_stable.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweep_stable

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.kglue_close.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.kglue_close

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweep_close.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweep_close
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sweep_close.header:
theorem sweep_close {D : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ}
    {a : ℕ → ℝ} {w τ : ℝ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hτ0 : 0 ≤ τ) (hτ2 : τ ≤ 2) (hgap : ∀ k, a k + w + 4 ≤ a (k + 1))
    {g : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2}
    (hτ : ∀ k x, x ∈ D → a (k + 1) - 2 ≤ φ x → φ x ≤ a (k + 1) + w + 2 →
      frobNorm (((trans (g k) (g (k + 1)) x : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ τ) :
    ∀ N k x, k ≤ N → x ∈ Slab D φ a w k →
      frobNorm (((trans (g k) (sweepA g φ a w N) x : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ (11 / 2) * τ

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.IBox.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.IBox
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.IBox.header: def IBox (lo hi : Z3) : Set Z3

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.ev_sub_add.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.ev_sub_add
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.ev_sub_add.header: theorem ev_sub_add (p : Z3) (i : Fin 3) : p - ev i + ev i = p

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.exists_ne_of_l1.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.exists_ne_of_l1
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.exists_ne_of_l1.header: theorem exists_ne_of_l1 {p p' : Z3} {n : ℕ} (h : l1 p p' = n + 1) : ∃ i, p i ≠ p' i

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.l1_sub_ev.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.l1_sub_ev
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.l1_sub_ev.header:
theorem l1_sub_ev {p p' : Z3} {n : ℕ} {i : Fin 3} (h : l1 p p' = n + 1) (hi : p' i < p i) :

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.l1_add_ev.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.l1_add_ev
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.l1_add_ev.header:
theorem l1_add_ev {p p' : Z3} {n : ℕ} {i : Fin 3} (h : l1 p p' = n + 1) (hi : p i < p' i) :

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sub_ev_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sub_ev_mem
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.sub_ev_mem.header:
theorem sub_ev_mem {lo hi p p' : Z3} {i : Fin 3} (hp : p ∈ IBox lo hi) (hp' : p' ∈ IBox lo hi) (h : p' i < p i) :

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.add_ev_mem_box.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.add_ev_mem_box
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.add_ev_mem_box.header:
theorem add_ev_mem_box {lo hi p p' : Z3} {i : Fin 3} (hp : p ∈ IBox lo hi) (hp' : p' ∈ IBox lo hi) (h : p i < p' i) :

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.walk_box.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.walk_box
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.walk_box.header:
theorem walk_box (v : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {D : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {ν : Fin 3} {lo hi : Z3}
    (hD : ∀ z i, z ∈ IBox lo hi → z + ev i ∈ IBox lo hi →
      iota v z ∈ D ∧ iota v (z + ev ν) ∈ D ∧ iota v (z + ev i) ∈ D ∧ iota v (z + ev i + ev ν) ∈ D)
    {p' : Z3} (hp' : p' ∈ IBox lo hi) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ p, p ∈ IBox lo hi → l1 p p' = n → Walk D ν (iota v p') n (iota v p)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.flat_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.flat_bound
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.flat_bound.header:
theorem flat_bound {v : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {U : LinkCfg L} {g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2}
    {D : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {t1 t2 : ℝ} (hg : GChart U g D t1 t2) {ν : Fin 3} {lo hi b : Z3}
    (hD : ∀ z i, z ∈ IBox lo hi → z + ev i ∈ IBox lo hi →
      iota v z ∈ D ∧ iota v (z + ev ν) ∈ D ∧ iota v (z + ev i) ∈ D ∧ iota v (z + ev i + ev ν) ∈ D)
    (hb : b ∈ IBox lo hi) (hbase : periodicGaugeTransform g U (iota v b, ν) = 1)
    {p : Z3} (hp : p ∈ IBox lo hi) :
    frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform g U (iota v p, ν) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ (l1 p b : ℝ) * t2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.trans_box.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.trans_box
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.trans_box.header:
theorem trans_box {v : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {U : LinkCfg L} {gP gQ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {Rb : ℕ}
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (iota v) (Box (Rb + 1))) {lo hi : Z3} (hbox : IBox lo hi ⊆ Box Rb) {β : ℝ}
    (hβ : ∀ z μ, z ∈ IBox lo hi → z + ev μ ∈ IBox lo hi →
      frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform gP U (iota v z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1)
        + frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform gQ U (iota v z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ β)
    {p p' : Z3} (hp : p ∈ IBox lo hi) (hp' : p' ∈ IBox lo hi) :
    frobNorm (((trans gP gQ (iota v p) : SU2) : M2) - (trans gP gQ (iota v p') : M2)) ≤ (l1 p p' : ℝ) * β

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.l1_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.l1_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.l1_le.header: theorem l1_le (p b : Z3) : (l1 p b : ℝ) ≤ rho p + 3 / 2 + |(b 0 : ℝ)| + |(b 1 : ℝ)| + |(b 2 : ℝ)|

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.inv_le_of.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.inv_le_of
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.inv_le_of.header: theorem inv_le_of {D u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (hD : 1 ≤ u * D) : |1 / D| ≤ u

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.inv_sub_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.inv_sub_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.inv_sub_le.header:
theorem inv_sub_le {D D' u B : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (hD : 1 ≤ u * D) (hD' : 1 ≤ u * D') (hB : |D' - D| ≤ B) :
    |1 / D' - 1 / D| ≤ B * u ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.quot_first.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.quot_first
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.quot_first.header:
theorem quot_first {N0 N1 D0 D1 u A B : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (h0 : 1 ≤ u * D0) (h1 : 1 ≤ u * D1) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hN0 : |N0| ≤ A * D0) (hN : |N1 - N0| ≤ B) (hD : |D1 - D0| ≤ B) :
    |N1 / D1 - N0 / D0| ≤ (1 + A) * B * u

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.hsP.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.hsP
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.hsP.header: def hsP (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) (p : Z3) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC.header: noncomputable def capC (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) (p : Z3) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_mem
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_mem.header: theorem capC_mem (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) (p : Z3) : 0 ≤ capC σ b p ∧ capC σ b p ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.hs_of_capC_pos.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.hs_of_capC_pos
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.hs_of_capC_pos.header: theorem hs_of_capC_pos {σ : Fin 3} {b : Bool} {p : Z3} (h : 0 < capC σ b p) : hsP σ b p

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.big_of_capC_pos.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.big_of_capC_pos
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.big_of_capC_pos.header: theorem big_of_capC_pos {σ : Fin 3} {b : Bool} {p : Z3} (h : 0 < capC σ b p) : Qf p < 8 * qc p σ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_one.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_one
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_one.header:
theorem capC_one {σ : Fin 3} {b : Bool} {p : Z3} (hs : hsP σ b p) (h : Qf p ≤ 4 * qc p σ ^ 2) :

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_zero_of_small.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_zero_of_small
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_zero_of_small.header:
theorem capC_zero_of_small {σ : Fin 3} {b : Bool} {p : Z3} (hq : qc p σ ^ 2 ≤ 9 / 4) (hQ : 18 ≤ Qf p) :
    capC σ b p = 0

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_lt_one_or.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_lt_one_or
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_lt_one_or.header:
theorem capC_lt_one_or {σ : Fin 3} {b : Bool} {p : Z3} (h : capC σ b p < 1) :
    ¬ hsP σ b p ∨ 4 * qc p σ ^ 2 < Qf p

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_of_hs.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_of_hs
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_of_hs.header:
theorem capC_of_hs {σ : Fin 3} {b : Bool} {p : Z3} (hs : hsP σ b p) :
    capC σ b p = stepS (8 * qc p σ ^ 2 / Qf p - 1)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_zero_near_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_zero_near_boundary
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_zero_near_bound.header:
theorem capC_zero_near_boundary {σ : Fin 3} {b : Bool} {p p' : Z3} (hp' : ¬ hsP σ b p')
    (hd : |p σ - p' σ| ≤ 2) (hQ : 18 ≤ Qf p) : capC σ b p = 0

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capN.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capN
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capN.header: noncomputable def capN (σ : Fin 3) (P : Z3) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_eq
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_eq.header:
theorem capC_eq {σ : Fin 3} {b : Bool} {P : Z3} (hs : hsP σ b P) :
    capC σ b P = stepS (capN σ P / Qf P - 1)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capN_step.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capN_step
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capN_step.header:
theorem capN_step (σ : Fin 3) (P : Z3) (μ : Fin 3) :
    |capN σ (P + ev μ) - capN σ P| ≤ 8 * (2 * |qc P σ| + 1)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_step.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_step
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_step.header: theorem Qf_step (P : Z3) (μ : Fin 3) : |Qf (P + ev μ) - Qf P| ≤ 2 * |qc P μ| + 1

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capN_second.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capN_second
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capN_second.header:
theorem capN_second (σ : Fin 3) (P : Z3) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    |capN σ (P + ev μ + ev ν) - capN σ (P + ev μ) - capN σ (P + ev ν) + capN σ P| ≤ 16

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_second.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_second
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_second.header:
theorem Qf_second (P : Z3) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    |Qf (P + ev μ + ev ν) - Qf (P + ev μ) - Qf (P + ev ν) + Qf P| ≤ 16

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capN_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capN_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capN_le.header: theorem capN_le (σ : Fin 3) (P : Z3) : |capN σ P| ≤ 8 * Qf P

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.qc_diff_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.qc_diff_le
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.qc_diff_le.header:
theorem qc_diff_le (p : Z3) (μ ν : Fin 3) (i : Fin 3) :
    |qc (p + ev ν) i - qc p i| ≤ 2 ∧ |qc (p + ev μ) i - qc p i| ≤ 2 ∧ |qc (p + ev μ + ev ν) i - qc p i| ≤ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_lower.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_lower
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_lower.header:
theorem Qf_lower {p P : Z3} (hP : ∀ i, |qc P i - qc p i| ≤ 2) (hρ : 12 ≤ rho p) :
    1 ≤ 12 / rho p ^ 2 * Qf P

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.abs_qc_le_of.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.abs_qc_le_of
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.abs_qc_le_of.header: theorem abs_qc_le_of {p P : Z3} (hP : ∀ i, |qc P i - qc p i| ≤ 2) (σ : Fin 3) : |qc P σ| ≤ rho p + 2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_ge18.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_ge18
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_ge18.header: theorem Qf_ge18 {p P : Z3} (hP : ∀ i, |qc P i - qc p i| ≤ 2) (hρ : 16 ≤ rho p) : 18 ≤ Qf P

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_upper.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_upper
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.Qf_upper.header: theorem Qf_upper (p : Z3) (hρ : 0 < rho p) : 12 / rho p ^ 2 * Qf p ≤ 12

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.ev_coord_abs.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.ev_coord_abs
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.ev_coord_abs.header: theorem ev_coord_abs (p : Z3) (μ σ : Fin 3) : |p σ - (p + ev μ) σ| ≤ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capf_first.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capf_first
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capf_first.header:
theorem capf_first {σ : Fin 3} {p P : Z3} (μ : Fin 3) (hP : ∀ i, |qc P i - qc p i| ≤ 1)
    (hP' : ∀ i, |qc (P + ev μ) i - qc p i| ≤ 2) (hρ : 16 ≤ rho p) :
    |(capN σ (P + ev μ) / Qf (P + ev μ) - 1) - (capN σ P / Qf P - 1)| ≤ 2052 / rho p

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_bond.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_bond
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_bond.header:
theorem capC_bond (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) (p : Z3) (ν : Fin 3) (hρ : 16 ≤ rho p) :
    |capC σ b (p + ev ν) - capC σ b p| ≤ K1 / rho p

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_sten.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_sten
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.capC_sten.header:
theorem capC_sten (σ : Fin 3) (b : Bool) (p : Z3) (μ ν : Fin 3) (hρ : 16 ≤ rho p) :
    |capC σ b (p + ev μ + ev ν) - capC σ b (p + ev μ) - capC σ b (p + ev ν) + capC σ b p| ≤ K2 / rho p ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.win.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.win
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.win.header: def win (S : Set Z3) (p : Z3) : Set Z3

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.win_sub.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.win_sub
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.win_sub.header: theorem win_sub (S : Set Z3) (p : Z3) : win S p ⊆ S

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.self_mem_win.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.self_mem_win
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.self_mem_win.header: theorem self_mem_win {S : Set Z3} {p : Z3} (hp : p ∈ S) : p ∈ win S p

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.ev_mem_win.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.ev_mem_win
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.ev_mem_win.header: theorem ev_mem_win {S : Set Z3} {p : Z3} {ν : Fin 3} (hp : p + ev ν ∈ S) : p + ev ν ∈ win S p

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.ev2_mem_win.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.ev2_mem_win
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.ev2_mem_win.header: theorem ev2_mem_win {S : Set Z3} {p : Z3} {μ ν : Fin 3} (hp : p + ev μ + ev ν ∈ S) : p + ev μ + ev ν ∈ win S p

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.glue_zstep.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.glue_zstep
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.glue_zstep.header:
theorem glue_zstep {U : LinkCfg L} {v : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {Rb : ℕ}
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (iota v) (Box (Rb + 1))) {SP SQ SD : Set Z3} (hSP : SP ⊆ Box Rb) (hSQ : SQ ⊆ Box Rb)
    (hSD : SD ⊆ Box Rb) {gP gQ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {C : Z3 → ℝ} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ p ∈ Box Rb, c (iota v p) = C p)
    {T1 T2 τ k1 k2 W1 W2 Wτ Wk1 Wk2 : Z3 → ℝ}
    (hP : ZCh U gP v SP T1 T2) (hQ : ZCh U gQ v SQ T1 T2)
    (hh : ∀ p, p ∈ SP → p ∈ SQ → frobNorm (((trans gP gQ (iota v p) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ τ p)
    (hC : ∀ p ∈ SD, 0 ≤ C p ∧ C p ≤ 1)
    (hC1 : ∀ p ν, p ∈ SD → p + ev ν ∈ SD → |C (p + ev ν) - C p| ≤ k1 p)
    (hC2 : ∀ p μ ν, p ∈ SD → p + ev ν ∈ SD → p + ev μ ∈ SD → p + ev μ + ev ν ∈ SD →
      |C (p + ev μ + ev ν) - C (p + ev μ) - C (p + ev ν) + C p| ≤ k2 p)
    (hbond : ∀ p ν, p ∈ SD → p + ev ν ∈ SD →
      (C p = 0 ∧ C (p + ev ν) = 0 ∧ p ∈ SP ∧ p + ev ν ∈ SP) ∨
      (C p = 1 ∧ C (p + ev ν) = 1 ∧ p ∈ SQ ∧ p + ev ν ∈ SQ) ∨
      (p ∈ SP ∧ p ∈ SQ ∧ p + ev ν ∈ SP ∧ p + ev ν ∈ SQ))
    (hsten : ∀ p μ ν, p ∈ SD → p + ev ν ∈ SD → p + ev μ ∈ SD → p + ev μ + ev ν ∈ SD →
      (∀ y ∈ ({p, p + ev ν, p + ev μ, p + ev μ + ev ν} : Set Z3), C y = 0 ∧ y ∈ SP) ∨
      (∀ y ∈ ({p, p + ev ν, p + ev μ, p + ev μ + ev ν} : Set Z3), C y = 1 ∧ y ∈ SQ) ∨
      (∀ y ∈ ({p, p + ev ν, p + ev μ, p + ev μ + ev ν} : Set Z3), y ∈ SP ∧ y ∈ SQ))
    (hwin : ∀ p p', p ∈ SD → p' ∈ win SD p →
      T1 p' ≤ W1 p ∧ T2 p' ≤ W2 p ∧ τ p' ≤ Wτ p ∧ k1 p' ≤ Wk1 p ∧ k2 p' ≤ Wk2 p)
    (hW : ∀ p ∈ SD, 0 ≤ W1 p ∧ 0 ≤ W2 p ∧ 0 ≤ Wτ p ∧ Wτ p ≤ 2 ∧ 0 ≤ Wk1 p ∧ 0 ≤ Wk2 p) :
    ZCh U (gglue gP gQ c) v SD (fun p => glueT1 (W1 p) (Wτ p) (Wk1 p))
      (fun p => glueT2 (W1 p) (W2 p) (Wτ p) (Wk1 p) (Wk2 p))

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.cA.header:
noncomputable def cA (A0 B0 : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => A0
  | j + 1 => 38 * cA A0 B0 j + 36 * K1 * cB B0 j

noncomputable def cC (A0 B0 : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 1
  | j + 1 => 19 * cC A0 B0 j + 72 * K2 * cB B0 j + 144 * K1 * cA A0 B0 j
      + 18 * cA A0 B0 j * cG (cA A0 B0 j) (cB B0 j) + 504 * cA A0 B0 j ^ 2
      + (135 / 4) * cG (cA A0 B0 j) (cB B0 j) ^ 2

theorem cB_nonneg {B0 : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ B0) (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ cB B0 j

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.cC.header:
noncomputable def cC (A0 B0 : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 1

      + (135 / 4) * cG (cA A0 B0 j) (cB B0 j) ^ 2

theorem cB_nonneg {B0 : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ B0) (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ cB B0 j

    {gs : Fin 3 → Bool → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {A0 B0 s : ℝ} (hA0 : 0 ≤ A0) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B0) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s)
    (hZ : ∀ σ b, ZCh U (gs σ b) v (Hd R σ b) (fun p => A0 * rho p * s) (fun _ => s))
    (hpair : ∀ σ b σ' b' p, p ∈ Hd R σ b → p ∈ Hd R σ' b' →
      frobNorm (((trans (gs σ b) (gs σ' b') (iota v p) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ B0 * rho p ^ 2 * s)
    (hsmall : ∀ p ∈ Box R, (4 * cB B0 5 + 1) * rho p ^ 2 * s ≤ 1) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ 5 → ZCh U (Aseq v R gs j) v (Fseq R j) (fun p => cA A0 B0 j * rho p * s)
      (fun _ => cC A0 B0 j * s)

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.frob_sub_le_of.header:

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.crude_bond.header:

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.crude_sten.name: AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.crude_sten
AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.crude_sten.header:
theorem crude_sten {k0 k1 k2 k3 G G' : SU2} {e g t : ℝ} (he : 0 ≤ e)
    (h0 : frobNorm ((k0 : M2) - 1) ≤ e) (h1 : frobNorm ((k1 : M2) - 1) ≤ e)
    (h2 : frobNorm ((k2 : M2) - 1) ≤ e) (h3 : frobNorm ((k3 : M2) - 1) ≤ e)
    (hG : frobNorm ((G : M2) - 1) ≤ g) (hGG : frobNorm ((G' : M2) - (G : M2)) ≤ t) :
    frobNorm (((k2 * G' * k3⁻¹ : SU2) : M2) - ((k0 * G * k1⁻¹ : SU2) : M2)) ≤ t + g * (4 * e) + 4 * e ^ 2 + 4 * e

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.KT1.header: noncomputable def KT1 (A0 B0 : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M2Glue3.KT2.header: noncomputable def KT2 (A0 B0 : ℝ) : ℝ

    {gs : Fin 3 → Bool → PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2} {A0 B0 s : ℝ} (hA0 : 0 ≤ A0) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B0) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s)

      frobNorm (((trans (gs σ b) (gs σ' b') (iota v p) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ B0 * rho p ^ 2 * s)
    (hsmall : ∀ p ∈ Box R, (4 * cB B0 5 + 1) * rho p ^ 2 * s ≤ 1) :
    ZCh U (Aseq v R gs 5) v (Box R) (fun p => KT1 A0 B0 * rho p * s) (fun _ => KT2 A0 B0 * s) ∧
    ∀ p ∈ Box R, ∀ σ b, p ∈ Hd R σ b →
      frobNorm (((trans (gs σ b) (Aseq v R gs 5) (iota v p) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ cB B0 5 * rho p ^ 2 * s

AdalyFormal.M1GaugeW4.ne_zero_adBL_iff.name: AdalyFormal.M1GaugeW4.ne_zero_adBL_iff
AdalyFormal.M1GaugeW4.ne_zero_adBL_iff.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Gamma1Positive.pertu.header:

      ∧ (∀ A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3),
          |(inner ℝ A (wK2 ε A) : ℝ) - inner ℝ A (wK1 A)| ≤ ε * ‖A‖ ^ 2))
    ∧ ((inner ℝ wA1 (wK2 ε wA1) : ℝ) = -2 * ε ∧ wA1 ≠ 0 ∧ wQ wA1 = 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Gamma1Positive.gamma.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Gamma1Positive.gamma_floor_from_interp_and_poincare
AdalyFormal.Balaban.Gamma1Positive.gamma.header:
theorem gamma_floor_from_interp_and_poincare {W : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup W]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ W] (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks) (a γc γP : ℝ)
    (Kop : Hs →L[ℝ] Hs) (hs : IsAQuadSplit D a Kop) (C₀ : W →L[ℝ] Ks)
    (hC : ∀ w : W, ‖w‖ ≤ ‖C₀ w‖) (E : Ks → ℝ) (hγc : 0 ≤ γc) (hγP : 0 ≤ γP)
    (hinterp : ∀ w : W,
      γc * E (C₀ w) ≤ (inner ℝ (solutionOperator D (C₀ w)) (Kop (solutionOperator D (C₀ w))) : ℝ))
    (hpoin : ∀ w : W, γP * ‖C₀ w‖ ^ 2 ≤ E (C₀ w)) (w : W) :
    (γc * γP) * ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤ deltaKQuadForm D a (C₀ w)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.Gamma1Positive.comp_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.Gamma1Positive.comp_lower_holds_while_gamma_fails

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvClass.lemma2.header:

    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (ell : ℕ)

    bondEnergy (gaugeActA γ A) = bondEnergy A

      = (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergyCov U ell A + curlEnergyCov U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvClass.covari.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvClass.covariant_lemma24_orbit
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvClass.covari.header:
theorem covariant_lemma24_orbit {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (α : ℝ) (hreg : GaugeRegular α U)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (hadm : SuAdmissible L ell A) :
    ((1 / 360) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) - 96 * α ^ 2) * bondEnergy A
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergyCov U ell A + curlEnergyCov U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvClass.covari.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvClass.covariant_lemma24_orbit_positive
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvClass.covari.header:

    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hreg : GaugeRegular (1 / (186 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3)) U)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (hadm : SuAdmissible L ell A) :
    0 < (1 / 360) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) - 96 * (1 / (186 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3)) ^ 2
    ∧ ((1 / 360) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) - 96 * (1 / (186 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3)) ^ 2) * bondEnergy A
        ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergyCov U ell A + curlEnergyCov U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvClass.old_hy.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvClass.old_hypothesis_not_gauge_invariant
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvClass.old_hy.header:
theorem old_hypothesis_not_gauge_invariant
    (hdvd2 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1)) {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht : t < 2 * Real.sqrt 2) :
    ¬ (frobSupBond (centerU L) ≤ t)
    ∧ (∃ δ : GaugeFn L, frobSupBond (periodicGaugeTransform δ (centerU L)) ≤ t)
    ∧ (GaugeRegular t (centerU L) ↔ GaugeRegular t (centerU L))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvClass.center.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvClass.center_inside_orbit_class_outside_old
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvClass.center.header:
theorem center_inside_orbit_class_outside_old {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (hdvd2 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (2 : ℕ) ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (hadm : SuAdmissible L ell A) :
    ¬ (frobSupBond (centerU L) ≤ 1 / (186 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))
    ∧ (1 / 360) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) - 96 * frobSupBond (centerU L) ^ 2 < 0
    ∧ GaugeRegular 0 (centerU L)
    ∧ 0 < (1 / 360) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5)
    ∧ ((1 / 360) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5)) * bondEnergy A
        ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergyCov (centerU L) ell A + curlEnergyCov (centerU L) A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvLocalize.coa.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvLocalize.loc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvLocalize.localized_floor_sums
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvLocalize.loc.header:
theorem localized_floor_sums {ell : ℕ} (coef : ℝ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (𝒞 : Finset ι) (Sb : ι → Finset (Bond L)) (Sc : ι → Finset (CoarseBond L ell))
    (Sp : ι → Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L))
    (hbd : (𝒞 : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint Sb) (hbu : 𝒞.biUnion Sb = Finset.univ)
    (hcd : (𝒞 : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint Sc) (hcu : 𝒞.biUnion Sc = Finset.univ)
    (hpd : (𝒞 : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint Sp) (hpu : 𝒞.biUnion Sp = Finset.univ)
    (hloc : ∀ i ∈ 𝒞, coef * bondEnergyOn (Sb i) A
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergyOn (Sc i) U A + curlEnergyOn (Sp i) U A) :
    coef * bondEnergy A ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergyCov U ell A + curlEnergyCov U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvLocalize.loc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvLocalize.localized_floor_sums_of_gauged
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvLocalize.loc.header:
theorem localized_floor_sums_of_gauged {ell : ℕ} (coef : ℝ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (𝒞 : Finset ι) (Sb : ι → Finset (Bond L)) (Sc : ι → Finset (CoarseBond L ell))
    (Sp : ι → Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (γ : ι → GaugeFn L)
    (hbd : (𝒞 : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint Sb) (hbu : 𝒞.biUnion Sb = Finset.univ)
    (hcd : (𝒞 : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint Sc) (hcu : 𝒞.biUnion Sc = Finset.univ)
    (hpd : (𝒞 : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint Sp) (hpu : 𝒞.biUnion Sp = Finset.univ)
    (hloc : ∀ i ∈ 𝒞, coef * bondEnergyOn (Sb i) (gaugeActA (γ i) A)
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergyOn (Sc i) (periodicGaugeTransform (γ i) U) (gaugeActA (γ i) A)
        + curlEnergyOn (Sp i) (periodicGaugeTransform (γ i) U) (gaugeActA (γ i) A)) :
    coef * bondEnergy A ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergyCov U ell A + curlEnergyCov U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvLocalize.cov.header:
theorem covering_is_load_bearing :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.negO.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.negOneElem_comm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.negO.header:
theorem negOneElem_comm (g : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.negO.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.negOneElem_pow_comm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.negO.header:
theorem negOneElem_pow_comm (k : ℕ) (g : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    g * negOneElem ^ k = negOneElem ^ k * g

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.negO.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.negOneElem_pow_odd
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.negO.header:
theorem negOneElem_pow_odd {k : ℕ} (hk : k % 2 = 1) :
    negOneElem ^ k = (negOneElem : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrapPath
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.header: def wrapPath (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (μ : Fin 3) : List (Fin 3 × Bool)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrapPath_length
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.header: theorem wrapPath_length (μ : Fin 3) : (wrapPath L μ).length = L μ + 1

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.path.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.pathSite_succ_left
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.path.header:
theorem pathSite_succ_left (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (k : ℕ) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite x μ (k + 1)
      = AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite (periodicLatticeShift x μ) μ k

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.add_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.add_mod_middle
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.add_.header: theorem add_mod_middle (a b c n : ℕ) : (a + b % n + c) % n = (a + b + c) % n

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.endp.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.endpoint_replicate
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.endp.header:
theorem endpoint_replicate (μ : Fin 3) (k : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    periodicPathEndpoint x (List.replicate k (μ, true))
      = AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite x μ k

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.path.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.pathSite_val
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.path.header:
theorem pathSite_val (μ : Fin 3) (k : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ((AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite x μ k) μ).val = ((x μ).val + k) % (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.path.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.pathSite_off
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.path.header:
theorem pathSite_off (μ : Fin 3) (k : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) (hν : ν ≠ μ) :
    (AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite x μ k) ν = x ν

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrapPath_closed
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.header:
theorem wrapPath_closed (μ : Fin 3) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    periodicPathEndpoint x (wrapPath L μ) = x

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrapHol_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.header:
theorem wrapHol_gauge (γ : GaugeFn L)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    wrapHol (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) x μ = γ x * wrapHol U x μ * (γ x)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap_holonomy_le_of_gaugeRegular
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.header:
theorem wrap_holonomy_le_of_gaugeRegular {α : ℝ}
    {U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L}
    (hreg : GaugeRegular α U) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∃ γ : GaugeFn L,
      frobNorm (((γ x * wrapHol U x μ * (γ x)⁻¹ :
          Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
        ≤ ((L μ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrapHol_centerU_pow
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.header:
theorem wrapHol_centerU_pow (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    wrapHol (centerU L) x μ = negOneElem ^ (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrapHol_centerU_odd
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.header:
theorem wrapHol_centerU_odd {μ : Fin 3} (hodd : (L μ + 1) % 2 = 1)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    wrapHol (centerU L) x μ = negOneElem

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrapHol_centerU_gauge
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.header:
theorem wrapHol_centerU_gauge {μ : Fin 3} (hodd : (L μ + 1) % 2 = 1) (γ : GaugeFn L)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    γ x * wrapHol (centerU L) x μ * (γ x)⁻¹ = negOneElem

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.cent.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.centerU_odd_not_gaugeRegular
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.cent.header:
theorem centerU_odd_not_gaugeRegular {α : ℝ} {μ : Fin 3} (hodd : (L μ + 1) % 2 = 1)
    (hα : ((L μ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α < 2 * Real.sqrt 2) :
    ¬ GaugeRegular α (centerU L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.cent.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.centerU_flat_off_wrap
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.cent.header:
theorem centerU_flat_off_wrap (hbig : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ≤ L μ)
    (hodd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (L μ + 1) % 2 = 1) (b : Bond L) (hb : ¬ Wraps b) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.PerC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.PerCubeRegular
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.PerC.header:
def PerCubeRegular (α : ℝ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.perCubeRegular_mono
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.perCube_not_implies_global
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.perC.header:
theorem perCube_not_implies_global {α : ℝ} (hbig : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ≤ L μ)
    (hodd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (L μ + 1) % 2 = 1)
    (hα : ((L 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α < 2 * Real.sqrt 2) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.odd_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.odd_torus_exists
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.odd_.header:
theorem odd_torus_exists :
    (∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ≤ (fun _ : Fin 3 => 2 : PeriodicLatticeExtent) μ)
    ∧ (∀ μ : Fin 3, ((fun _ : Fin 3 => 2 : PeriodicLatticeExtent) μ + 1) % 2 = 1)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.no_g.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.no_go_covers_campaign_threshold
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.no_g.header:
theorem no_go_covers_campaign_threshold {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) :
    (3 : ℝ) * (1 / (186 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3)) < 2 * Real.sqrt 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrapping_bond_exists
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPerCube.wrap.header:
theorem wrapping_bond_exists (μ : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPrinted.gaug.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPrinted.gaugeT_eq_periodicGaugeTransform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPrinted.gaug.header:
theorem gaugeT_eq_periodicGaugeTransform

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPrinted.perC.header:
theorem perCubeRegular_of_printedCubeClassI (c M α₀ η Lj : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hηne : η ≠ 0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPrinted.perC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPrinted.perCubeRegular_at_threshold_of_printed

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPrinted.perC.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPrinted.perCubeRegular_at_threshold_of_printed_rational
AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPrinted.perC.header:
theorem perCubeRegular_at_threshold_of_printed_rational {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.GaugeInvPrinted.prin.header:
theorem printed_class_does_not_reach_the_consumer {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)

HConstruction.MassU1.mass.name: HConstruction.MassU1.mass
HConstruction.MassU1.mass.header: def mass (A : Fine M (n := n)) : ℝ

HConstruction.MassU1.mass_eq_phaseR.name: HConstruction.MassU1.mass_eq_phaseR
HConstruction.MassU1.mass_eq_phaseR.header:
theorem mass_eq_phaseR (A : Fine M (n := n)) :
    mass M A = RegU.mass n (bfl2Equiv A)

HConstruction.MassU1.delta_inner.name: HConstruction.MassU1.delta_inner
HConstruction.MassU1.delta_inner.header:
lemma delta_inner (f g : Site M (n := n)) :
    inner ℝ (siteDelta M f) g = inner ℝ (grad M f) (grad M g)

HConstruction.MassU1.delta_symmetric.name: HConstruction.MassU1.delta_symmetric
HConstruction.MassU1.delta_symmetric.header:
lemma delta_symmetric (f g : Site M (n := n)) :
    inner ℝ (siteDelta M f) g = inner ℝ f (siteDelta M g)

HConstruction.MassU1.grad_zero_of_delta_.name: HConstruction.MassU1.grad_zero_of_delta_zero
HConstruction.MassU1.grad_zero_of_delta_.header:
lemma grad_zero_of_delta_zero (f : Site M (n := n)) (hf : siteDelta M f = 0) :
    grad M f = 0

HConstruction.MassU1.delta_mem_image.name: HConstruction.MassU1.delta_mem_image
HConstruction.MassU1.delta_mem_image.header:
lemma delta_mem_image (f : Site M (n := n)) (hf : siteAverage M f = 0) :
    siteDelta M f ∈ gaugeImage M

HConstruction.MassU1.R_delta.name: HConstruction.MassU1.R_delta
HConstruction.MassU1.R_delta.header:
lemma R_delta (f : Site M (n := n)) (hf : siteAverage M f = 0) :
    R M (siteDelta M f) = siteDelta M f

HConstruction.MassU1.pure_gauge_excluded.name: HConstruction.MassU1.pure_gauge_excluded
HConstruction.MassU1.pure_gauge_excluded.header:
theorem pure_gauge_excluded (f : Site M (n := n)) (hf : siteAverage M f = 0)
    (hg : gaugeConstraint M (grad M f) = 0) : grad M f = 0

HConstruction.MassU1.divergence_gaugePi.name: HConstruction.MassU1.divergence_gaugePi
HConstruction.MassU1.divergence_gaugePi.header:
lemma divergence_gaugePi (A : Fine M (n := n)) :
    (grad M).adjoint (gaugePi M A) =
      (grad M).adjoint A - R M ((grad M).adjoint A)

HConstruction.MassU1.divergence_pythagor.name: HConstruction.MassU1.divergence_pythagoras
HConstruction.MassU1.divergence_pythagor.header:
theorem divergence_pythagoras (A : Fine M (n := n)) :
    ‖(grad M).adjoint A‖^2 = ‖(grad M).adjoint (gaugePi M A)‖^2 +
      ‖R M ((grad M).adjoint A)‖^2

HConstruction.MassU1.divergence_contract.name: HConstruction.MassU1.divergence_contraction
HConstruction.MassU1.divergence_contract.header:
theorem divergence_contraction (A : Fine M (n := n)) :
    ‖(grad M).adjoint (gaugePi M A)‖^2 ≤ ‖(grad M).adjoint A‖^2

HConstruction.MassU1.gaugePi_of_feasible.name: HConstruction.MassU1.gaugePi_of_feasible
HConstruction.MassU1.gaugePi_of_feasible.header:
lemma gaugePi_of_feasible (A : Fine M (n := n)) (hA : gaugeConstraint M A = 0) :
    gaugePi M A = A

HConstruction.MassU1.gaugePi_fixed_iff.name: HConstruction.MassU1.gaugePi_fixed_iff
HConstruction.MassU1.gaugePi_fixed_iff.header:
theorem gaugePi_fixed_iff (A : Fine M (n := n)) :
    gaugePi M A = A ↔ gaugeConstraint M A = 0

HConstruction.MassU1.gaugePi_idempotent.name: HConstruction.MassU1.gaugePi_idempotent
HConstruction.MassU1.gaugePi_idempotent.header:
theorem gaugePi_idempotent (A : Fine M (n := n)) :
    gaugePi M (gaugePi M A) = gaugePi M A

HConstruction.MassU1.gaugePi_grad_null.name: HConstruction.MassU1.gaugePi_grad_null
HConstruction.MassU1.gaugePi_grad_null.header:
theorem gaugePi_grad_null (f : Site M (n := n)) (hf : siteAverage M f = 0) :
    gaugePi M (grad M f) = 0

HConstruction.MassU1.gaugePi_orbit_invar.name: HConstruction.MassU1.gaugePi_orbit_invariant
HConstruction.MassU1.gaugePi_orbit_invar.header:
theorem gaugePi_orbit_invariant (A : Fine M (n := n))
    (f : Site M (n := n)) (hf : siteAverage M f = 0) :
    gaugePi M (A+grad M f) = gaugePi M A

HConstruction.MassU1.feasible_iff_div_or.name: HConstruction.MassU1.feasible_iff_div_orthogonal
HConstruction.MassU1.feasible_iff_div_or.header:
theorem feasible_iff_div_orthogonal (A : Fine M (n := n)) :
    gaugeConstraint M A = 0 ↔ (grad M).adjoint A ∈ (gaugeImage M)ᗮ

HConstruction.MassU1.feasible_iff_delta_.name: HConstruction.MassU1.feasible_iff_delta_div
HConstruction.MassU1.feasible_iff_delta_.header:
theorem feasible_iff_delta_div (A : Fine M (n := n)) :
    gaugeConstraint M A = 0 ↔
      ∀ f : Site M (n := n), siteAverage M f = 0 →
        inner ℝ (siteDelta M ((grad M).adjoint A)) f = 0

HConstruction.MassU1.divergence_orbit_mi.name: HConstruction.MassU1.divergence_orbit_minimum
HConstruction.MassU1.divergence_orbit_mi.header:
theorem divergence_orbit_minimum (A : Fine M (n := n))
    (f : Site M (n := n)) (hf : siteAverage M f = 0) :
    ‖(grad M).adjoint (gaugePi M A)‖^2 ≤
      ‖(grad M).adjoint (A+grad M f)‖^2

HConstruction.MassU1.mass_balance.name: HConstruction.MassU1.mass_balance
HConstruction.MassU1.mass_balance.header:
theorem mass_balance (A : Fine M (n := n)) :
    mass M (gaugePi M A) = mass M A -
      (1/(n:ℝ)^3)*‖grad M (gaugePotential M A)‖^2 -
      2*(1/(n:ℝ)^3)*inner ℝ ((grad M).adjoint (gaugePi M A)) (gaugePotential M A)

HConstruction.MassU1.physicalH_mass_bala.name: HConstruction.MassU1.physicalH_mass_balance
HConstruction.MassU1.physicalH_mass_bala.header:
theorem physicalH_mass_balance (hn : 0 < n) (B : Unit M) :
    mass M (physicalH M hn B) = mass M (H M hn B) -
      (1/(n:ℝ)^3)*‖grad M (gaugePotential M (H M hn B))‖^2 -
      2*(1/(n:ℝ)^3)*inner ℝ ((grad M).adjoint (physicalH M hn B))
        (gaugePotential M (H M hn B))

HConstruction.MassU1.physicalH_delta_div.name: HConstruction.MassU1.physicalH_delta_div
HConstruction.MassU1.physicalH_delta_div.header:
theorem physicalH_delta_div (hn : 0 < n) (B : Unit M)
    (f : Site M (n := n)) (hf : siteAverage M f = 0) :
    inner ℝ (siteDelta M ((grad M).adjoint (physicalH M hn B))) f = 0

HConstruction.MassU1.energy_eq_phaseR.name: HConstruction.MassU1.energy_eq_phaseR
HConstruction.MassU1.energy_eq_phaseR.header:
theorem energy_eq_phaseR (A : Fine M (n := n)) :
    fineEnergy M A = RegU.energy n
      (AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.trivialU _) (bfl2Equiv A)

HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.isUnit_of_po.name: HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.isUnit_of_positive
HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.isUnit_of_po.header:
theorem isUnit_of_positive (T : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (h : ∀ X, X ≠ 0 → (0 : ℝ) < inner ℝ X (T X)) : IsUnit T

HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.inverse_norm.name: HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.inverse_norm_of_lower
HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.inverse_norm.header:
theorem inverse_norm_of_lower (T : E →L[ℝ] E) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hl : ∀ X, c*‖X‖^2 ≤ (inner ℝ X (T X) : ℝ)) : ‖Ring.inverse T‖ ≤ 1/c

HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.neumann_eq_i.name: HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.neumann_eq_inverse
HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.neumann_eq_i.header:
theorem neumann_eq_inverse (T P : E →L[ℝ] E) (hT : IsUnit T) (hTP : IsUnit (T-P))
    (hn : ‖P * Ring.inverse T‖ < 1) :
    HConstruction.Covariance.Reproduced.gOneOfNeumann (Ring.inverse T) P = Ring.inverse (T-P)

HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.small_precis.name: HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.small_precision_unit
HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.small_precis.header:
theorem small_precision_unit (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ workingThreshold) :
    IsUnit (precisionU (nonflatU t) 1)

HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.actualG0_rig.name: HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.actualG0_right
HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.actualG0_rig.header:
theorem actualG0_right (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ workingThreshold) :
    precisionU (nonflatU t) 1 * actualG0 t = 1

HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.actualG0_lef.name: HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.actualG0_left
HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.actualG0_lef.header:
theorem actualG0_left (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ workingThreshold) :
    actualG0 t * precisionU (nonflatU t) 1 = 1

HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.gauge_radius.name: HConstruction.G0CoerceFinal.gauge_radius_exists

theorem gc_class_gap {F ell m R : ℕ} (hell : 3 ≤ ell) (hF2 : 2 * F ≤ ell) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hFR : F ≤ R + 1) :
    ∃ (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell 1 Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 1 Lu)),
      TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧ Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R 1 S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) R 1 S Lam ∧ Lam.Nonempty ∧
      OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧
      x ∈ S.Om 0 ∧
      (∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 1 Lu))) (j : ℕ), IsClassSetW ell (ell ^ m) F 1 S sites j → x ∉ sites) ∧
      (∀ (f : ℕ) (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 1 Lu))) (j : ℕ), f ≤ F →
        IsClassCubeG ell (ell ^ m) f 1 S sites j → x ∉ sites) ∧
      ¬ CoversOm0G ell (ell ^ m) F 1 S ∧
      (∀ α₀ : ℝ, 0 < α₀ → ∀ v : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ,
        PerCubeRegularG ell (ell ^ m) F 1 S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ 1)⁻¹ (Function.update (fun _ => 1) ((x, 1) : Bond _) v)) ∧
      (∀ (α₀ η : ℝ) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell 1 Lu)), PerCubeRegularG ell (ell ^ m) F 1 S α₀ η U →
        ∀ v : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ,
          PerCubeRegularG ell (ell ^ m) F 1 S α₀ η (Function.update U ((x, 1) : Bond _) v)) ∧
      pStar x ∈ plaqIn (S.Om 0) ∧ ((x, 1) : Bond _) ∈ periodicPlaquetteBoundaryEdges (pStar x) ∧
      periodicPlaquetteHolonomy (Function.update (fun _ => (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)) ((x, 1) : Bond _) negOne)
        (pStar x) = negOne

AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.pcd_le_diff.header: theorem pcd_le_diff (N a b : ℕ) : pcd N a b ≤ (if a ≤ b then b - a else a - b)

AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.pdist_three.name: AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.pdist_three

theorem pdist_three {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pdist x y = pcd (L 0 + 1) (x 0).val (y 0).val + pcd (L 1 + 1) (x 1).val (y 1).val + pcd (L 2 + 1) (x 2).val (y 2).val

AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.blk_of_div.name: AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.blk_of_div
AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.blk_of_div.header: theorem blk_of_div {M x y : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hx : M ∣ x) (h : y / M = x / M) : x ≤ y ∧ y < x + M

AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.winTip.name: AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.winTip
AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.winTip.header:
theorem winTip (N x z A lo W M : ℕ) (hxN : x < N) (hzN : z < N) (hx : lo ≤ x ∧ x < lo + W)
    (h1 : (x + N - z) % N < A) (hA : 10 * M ≤ A) (hW : W ≤ 7 * M) (hlo : 2 * M ≤ lo) (hN : lo + W + M < N) :
    (lo + W + M + N - z) % N < A ∨ (lo - 2 * M + N - z) % N < A

AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.xtG.name: AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.xtG
AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.xtG.header: def xtG (ell M R : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (hM : 0 < M) : GSite ell M R

AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.xtG_val.name: AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.xtG_val
AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.xtG_val.header:
theorem xtG_val {ell M R : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hM : 0 < M) :
    ((xtG ell M R hell hM) 0).val = ncP1' ell M R + M * ell + R * M - M ∧
    ((xtG ell M R hell hM) 1).val = M * ell ∧ ((xtG ell M R hell hM) 2).val = M * ell

AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.tip_mem.name: AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.tip_mem
AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.tip_mem.header:
theorem tip_mem {ell M R : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (p : GSite ell M R)
    (h0 : (p 0).val / M = (ncP1' ell M R + M * ell + R * M - M) / M)
    (h1 : M * ell ≤ (p 1).val ∧ (p 1).val < 2 * (M * ell)) (h2 : M * ell ≤ (p 2).val ∧ (p 2).val < 2 * (M * ell)) :
    p ∈ (gcS ell M R).Om 0

AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.xtG_om0.name: AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.xtG_om0
AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.xtG_om0.header:
theorem xtG_om0 {ell M R : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) :
    xtG ell M R (by omega) hM ∈ (gcS ell M R).Om 0

AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.tip_far.name: AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.tip_far
AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.tip_far.header:
theorem tip_far {ell M R : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (w : GSite ell M R)
    (h0 : (w 0).val = ncP1' ell M R + M * ell + R * M - M)
    (h1 : (w 1).val = 2 * (M * ell) + M ∨ (w 1).val = M * ell - 2 * M) : w ∉ (gcS ell M R).Om 0

AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.gc_tip_uncovere.name: AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.gc_tip_uncovered
AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.gc_tip_uncovere.header:
theorem gc_tip_uncovered {ell M R : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hell7 : ell ≤ 7) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (f : ℕ) (sites : Set (GSite ell M R)) (j : ℕ) (hq : IsClassCubeG ell M f 1 (gcS ell M R) sites j) :
    xtG ell M R (by omega) hM ∉ sites

AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.pStar_plaqIn_ti.name: AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.pStar_plaqIn_tip
AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.pStar_plaqIn_ti.header:
theorem pStar_plaqIn_tip {ell M R : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM2 : 2 ≤ M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) :
    pStar (xtG ell M R (by omega) (by omega)) ∈ plaqIn ((gcS ell M R).Om 0)

AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.gc_tip_gap.name: AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.gc_tip_gap
AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.gc_tip_gap.header:
theorem gc_tip_gap {ell m R : ℕ} (hell : 3 ≤ ell) (hell7 : ell ≤ 7) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hR : 1 ≤ R) :
    ∃ (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell 1 Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 1 Lu)),
      TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧ Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R 1 S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) R 1 S Lam ∧ Lam.Nonempty ∧
      OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧
      x ∈ S.Om 0 ∧
      (∀ (f : ℕ) (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 1 Lu))) (j : ℕ),
        IsClassCubeG ell (ell ^ m) f 1 S sites j → x ∉ sites) ∧
      (∀ F : ℕ, ¬ CoversOm0G ell (ell ^ m) F 1 S) ∧
      (∀ (F : ℕ) (α₀ : ℝ), 0 < α₀ → ∀ v : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ,
        PerCubeRegularG ell (ell ^ m) F 1 S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ 1)⁻¹ (Function.update (fun _ => 1) ((x, 1) : Bond _) v)) ∧
      (∀ (F : ℕ) (α₀ η : ℝ) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell 1 Lu)), PerCubeRegularG ell (ell ^ m) F 1 S α₀ η U →
        ∀ v : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ,
          PerCubeRegularG ell (ell ^ m) F 1 S α₀ η (Function.update U ((x, 1) : Bond _) v)) ∧
      pStar x ∈ plaqIn (S.Om 0) ∧ ((x, 1) : Bond _) ∈ periodicPlaquetteBoundaryEdges (pStar x) ∧
      periodicPlaquetteHolonomy (Function.update (fun _ => (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)) ((x, 1) : Bond _) negOne)
        (pStar x) = negOne

AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.gc_tip_forces_u.name: AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.gc_tip_forces_unit
AdalyFormal.GeneralClass.gc_tip_forces_u.header:
theorem gc_tip_forces_unit {F : ℕ} (hF : 1 ≤ F) (h : P428Target8G F) :
    ∀ (ell : ℕ) (hell : 3 ≤ ell), ell ≤ 7 → ∀ (a : ℝ), 0 < a →
      ∃ m₀ : ℕ, 1 ≤ m₀ ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, m₀ ≤ m → ∃ R₀ : ℕ, ∀ R : ℕ, R₀ ≤ R → 1 ≤ R →
        ∀ v : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ,
        IsUnit (gparams ell 1 (ncLu (ell ^ m) R) (by omega) (gcS ell (ell ^ m) R)
          (Function.update (fun _ => 1) ((xtG ell (ell ^ m) R (by omega) (pow_pos (by omega) m), 1) : Bond _) v) a
          (ncLam (ell ^ m) R)).data.Ginv

HConstruction.GenK.incoming.name: HConstruction.GenK.incoming
HConstruction.GenK.incoming.header: def incoming : Fine M (n := n) →L[ℝ] Unit M

HConstruction.GenK.incoming_apply.name: HConstruction.GenK.incoming_apply
HConstruction.GenK.incoming_apply.header:
lemma incoming_apply (A : Fine M (n := n)) (b : Bond M) :

HConstruction.GenK.lift.name: HConstruction.GenK.lift
HConstruction.GenK.lift.header: def lift : Unit M →L[ℝ] Fine M (n := n)

HConstruction.GenK.lift_apply.name: HConstruction.GenK.lift_apply
HConstruction.GenK.lift_apply.header:
lemma lift_apply (B : Unit M) : bfl2Equiv (lift M hn B) =
    suTwoLift n (fun c => bfl2Equiv B ((bonds M hn).symm c))

HConstruction.GenK.incoming_lift.name: HConstruction.GenK.incoming_lift
HConstruction.GenK.incoming_lift.header: lemma incoming_lift (B : Unit M) : incoming M hn (lift M hn B) = B

HConstruction.GenK.curl.name: HConstruction.GenK.curl
HConstruction.GenK.curl.header: def curl : Fine M (n := n) →L[ℝ] Plaq M (n := n)

lemma curl_apply (A : Fine M (n := n)) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (fineExtent M n)) :

HConstruction.GenK.curl_norm.header: lemma curl_norm (A : Fine M (n := n)) : ‖curl M A‖^2 = curlEnergy (bfl2Equiv A)

HConstruction.GenK.fineEnergy.header: def fineEnergy (A : Fine M (n := n)) : ℝ

lemma physical_density (A : Fine M (n := n)) :

HConstruction.GenK.comparison.name: HConstruction.GenK.comparison
HConstruction.GenK.comparison.header:
theorem comparison (A : Fine M (n := n)) :

HConstruction.GenK.every_extension_lower.name: HConstruction.GenK.every_extension_lower
HConstruction.GenK.every_extension_lower.header:
theorem every_extension_lower (hM : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ M μ)
    (heven : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2 ∣ (M μ+1))
    (A : Fine M (n := n))
    (hAx : Axial (bfl2Equiv (incoming M hn A)))
    (hQ : ∀ c, lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo 2 (bfl2Equiv (incoming M hn A)) c = 0) :

HConstruction.GenK.composite_flat_line.header:
theorem composite_flat_line (k : ℕ) (hd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 2^k ∣ L μ+1) (A : BFL2 L) :
    qCompositeBond (fun _ => trivialU L) 2 k (fineCoordinates A) =
      lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) (2^k) (bfl2Equiv A)

HConstruction.GenK.incoming_composite.name: HConstruction.GenK.incoming_composite
HConstruction.GenK.incoming_composite.header:
theorem incoming_composite (M : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (k : ℕ)
    (A : Fine M (n := 2^k)) (b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.Bond M) :
    bfl2Equiv (incoming M (pow_pos (by decide : 0<2) k) A) b =
      qCompositeBond (fun _ => trivialU (fineExtent M (2^k))) 2 k (fineCoordinates A)
        (bonds M (pow_pos (by decide : 0<2) k) b)

HConstruction.GenK.incoming_source.name: HConstruction.GenK.incoming_source
HConstruction.GenK.incoming_source.header:
theorem incoming_source (M : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (k : ℕ)
    (A : Fine M (n := 2^k)) (b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.Bond M) :
    bfl2Equiv (incoming M (pow_pos (by decide : 0<2) k) A) b =
      AdalyQIdentification.QJ.QjInChart (fun _ => trivialU (fineExtent M (2^k))) 2 k
        (fineCoordinates A) (bonds M (pow_pos (by decide : 0<2) k) b)

HConstruction.GenK.grad.name: HConstruction.GenK.grad
HConstruction.GenK.grad.header: def grad : Site M (n := n) →L[ℝ] Fine M (n := n)

HConstruction.GenK.grad_apply.name: HConstruction.GenK.grad_apply

lemma grad_apply (f : Site M (n := n)) (b : Bond (fineExtent M n)) :

HConstruction.GenK.siteAverage.name: HConstruction.GenK.siteAverage
HConstruction.GenK.siteAverage.header: def siteAverage : Site M (n := n) →ₗ[ℝ] (Centers M (n := n) → SuTwo)

HConstruction.GenK.siteAverage_apply.header:
lemma siteAverage_apply (f : Site M (n := n)) (y : Centers M (n := n)) :

HConstruction.GenK.incoming_grad_kernel.name: HConstruction.GenK.incoming_grad_kernel
HConstruction.GenK.incoming_grad_kernel.header:
lemma incoming_grad_kernel (f : Site M (n := n)) (hf : siteAverage M f = 0) :

HConstruction.GenK.curl_grad.name: HConstruction.GenK.curl_grad
HConstruction.GenK.curl_grad.header: lemma curl_grad (f : Site M (n := n)) : curl M (grad M f) = 0

HConstruction.GenK.siteNull.name: HConstruction.GenK.siteNull
HConstruction.GenK.siteNull.header: def siteNull : Submodule ℝ (Site M (n := n))

HConstruction.GenK.siteDelta.name: HConstruction.GenK.siteDelta
HConstruction.GenK.siteDelta.header: def siteDelta : Site M (n := n) →L[ℝ] Site M (n := n)

HConstruction.GenK.restrictedSiteDelta.name: HConstruction.GenK.restrictedSiteDelta
HConstruction.GenK.restrictedSiteDelta.header: def restrictedSiteDelta : siteNull M (n := n) →ₗ[ℝ] Site M (n := n)

HConstruction.GenK.gaugeImage.name: HConstruction.GenK.gaugeImage
HConstruction.GenK.gaugeImage.header: def gaugeImage : Submodule ℝ (Site M (n := n))

HConstruction.GenK.R.name: HConstruction.GenK.R
HConstruction.GenK.R.header: def R : Site M (n := n) →L[ℝ] Site M (n := n)

HConstruction.GenK.gaugeConstraint.name: HConstruction.GenK.gaugeConstraint
HConstruction.GenK.gaugeConstraint.header: def gaugeConstraint : Fine M (n := n) →L[ℝ] Site M (n := n)

HConstruction.GenK.gaugeSection.name: HConstruction.GenK.gaugeSection
HConstruction.GenK.gaugeSection.header: def gaugeSection : gaugeImage M (n := n) →ₗ[ℝ] siteNull M (n := n)

HConstruction.GenK.gaugeSection_right.name: HConstruction.GenK.gaugeSection_right
HConstruction.GenK.gaugeSection_right.header:
lemma gaugeSection_right (v : gaugeImage M (n := n)) :

HConstruction.GenK.gaugePotential.name: HConstruction.GenK.gaugePotential
HConstruction.GenK.gaugePotential.header: def gaugePotential : Fine M (n := n) →L[ℝ] Site M (n := n)

HConstruction.GenK.gaugePi.name: HConstruction.GenK.gaugePi
HConstruction.GenK.gaugePi.header: def gaugePi : Fine M (n := n) →L[ℝ] Fine M (n := n)

HConstruction.GenK.potential_kernel.name: HConstruction.GenK.potential_kernel
HConstruction.GenK.potential_kernel.header: lemma potential_kernel (A : Fine M (n := n)) : siteAverage M (gaugePotential M A) = 0

HConstruction.GenK.potential_laplacian.name: HConstruction.GenK.potential_laplacian
HConstruction.GenK.potential_laplacian.header:
lemma potential_laplacian (A : Fine M (n := n)) :
    siteDelta M (gaugePotential M A) = R M ((grad M).adjoint A)

HConstruction.GenK.gaugePi_incoming.name: HConstruction.GenK.gaugePi_incoming
HConstruction.GenK.gaugePi_incoming.header: lemma gaugePi_incoming (A : Fine M (n := n)) : incoming M hn (gaugePi M A) = incoming M hn A

HConstruction.GenK.gaugePi_curl.name: HConstruction.GenK.gaugePi_curl
HConstruction.GenK.gaugePi_curl.header: lemma gaugePi_curl (A : Fine M (n := n)) : curl M (gaugePi M A) = curl M A

HConstruction.GenK.gaugePi_feasible.name: HConstruction.GenK.gaugePi_feasible
HConstruction.GenK.gaugePi_feasible.header: lemma gaugePi_feasible (A : Fine M (n := n)) : gaugeConstraint M (gaugePi M A) = 0

HConstruction.GenK.physicalH.name: HConstruction.GenK.physicalH
HConstruction.GenK.physicalH.header: def physicalH : Unit M →L[ℝ] Fine M (n := n)

HConstruction.GenK.physicalH_Q.name: HConstruction.GenK.physicalH_Q
HConstruction.GenK.physicalH_Q.header: theorem physicalH_Q (B : Unit M) : incoming M hn (physicalH M hn B) = B

HConstruction.GenK.physicalH_gauge.name: HConstruction.GenK.physicalH_gauge
HConstruction.GenK.physicalH_gauge.header: theorem physicalH_gauge (B : Unit M) : gaugeConstraint M (physicalH M hn B) = 0

HConstruction.GenK.physical_pullback.name: HConstruction.GenK.physical_pullback
HConstruction.GenK.physical_pullback.header:
theorem physical_pullback (B : Unit M) :
    (inner ℝ B (Delta M hn B) : ℝ) = fineEnergy M (physicalH M hn B)

HConstruction.GenK.simultaneous_minimum.name: HConstruction.GenK.simultaneous_minimum
HConstruction.GenK.simultaneous_minimum.header:
theorem simultaneous_minimum (B : Unit M) :
    incoming M hn (physicalH M hn B) = B ∧ gaugeConstraint M (physicalH M hn B) = 0 ∧
    ∀ A : Fine M (n := n), incoming M hn A = B → gaugeConstraint M A = 0 →
      fineEnergy M (physicalH M hn B) ≤ fineEnergy M A

HConstruction.GenK.massiveAction.name: HConstruction.GenK.massiveAction
HConstruction.GenK.massiveAction.header: def massiveAction (A : Fine M (n := n)) : ℝ

HConstruction.GenK.massive_at_minimum.name: HConstruction.GenK.massive_at_minimum
HConstruction.GenK.massive_at_minimum.header:
lemma massive_at_minimum (B : Unit M) : massiveAction M hn (physicalH M hn B) =
    (inner ℝ B (Delta M hn B) : ℝ) + ‖B‖^2

HConstruction.GenK.massive_minimum.name: HConstruction.GenK.massive_minimum
HConstruction.GenK.massive_minimum.header:
theorem massive_minimum (A : Fine M (n := n)) (B : Unit M)
    (hq : incoming M hn A = B) :
    massiveAction M hn (physicalH M hn B) ≤ massiveAction M hn A

HConstruction.GenK.fineSide.name: HConstruction.GenK.fineSide
HConstruction.GenK.fineSide.header:
lemma fineSide (M : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (μ : Fin 3) :

HConstruction.GenK.fineTiling.name: HConstruction.GenK.fineTiling
HConstruction.GenK.fineTiling.header:
lemma fineTiling (M : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :

HConstruction.GenK.embed.name: HConstruction.GenK.embed
HConstruction.GenK.embed.header: def embed (x : PeriodicLatticeSite M) : PeriodicLatticeSite (fineExtent M n)

HConstruction.GenK.embed_coarse.name: HConstruction.GenK.embed_coarse
HConstruction.GenK.embed_coarse.header: lemma embed_coarse (x : PeriodicLatticeSite M) : embed M hn x ∈ CoarseLattice (fineExtent M n) n

HConstruction.GenK.sites.name: HConstruction.GenK.sites
HConstruction.GenK.sites.header:
def sites : PeriodicLatticeSite M ≃ {x : PeriodicLatticeSite (fineExtent M n) //
    x ∈ CoarseLattice (fineExtent M n) n}

HConstruction.GenK.sites_shift.name: HConstruction.GenK.sites_shift
HConstruction.GenK.sites_shift.header:
lemma sites_shift (x : PeriodicLatticeSite M) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (sites M hn (periodicLatticeShift x μ)).1 =
      coarseShift (sites M hn x).1 n μ

HConstruction.GenK.bonds.name: HConstruction.GenK.bonds
HConstruction.GenK.bonds.header: def bonds : Bond M ≃ CoarseBond (fineExtent M n) n

HConstruction.GenK.plaquettes.name: HConstruction.GenK.plaquettes
HConstruction.GenK.plaquettes.header: def plaquettes : PeriodicLatticePlaquette M ≃ CoarsePlaquette (fineExtent M n) n

HConstruction.GenK.unitField.name: HConstruction.GenK.unitField
HConstruction.GenK.unitField.header: def unitField (A : CoarseBond (fineExtent M n) n → SuTwo) : Bond M → SuTwo

HConstruction.GenK.curl_reindex.name: HConstruction.GenK.curl_reindex
HConstruction.GenK.curl_reindex.header:
lemma curl_reindex (A : CoarseBond (fineExtent M n) n → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette M) :
    flatCurlValue (unitField M hn A) p =
      coarseCurlSuTwo (fineTiling M hn) A (plaquettes M hn p)

HConstruction.GenK.curlEnergy_reindex.name: HConstruction.GenK.curlEnergy_reindex
HConstruction.GenK.curlEnergy_reindex.header:
lemma curlEnergy_reindex (A : CoarseBond (fineExtent M n) n → SuTwo) :
    curlEnergy (unitField M hn A) = coarseCurlEnergySuTwo (fineTiling M hn) A

HConstruction.GenK.nullSpace.name: HConstruction.GenK.nullSpace
HConstruction.GenK.nullSpace.header: def nullSpace : Submodule ℝ (Fine M (n := n))

HConstruction.GenK.nullCurl.name: HConstruction.GenK.nullCurl
HConstruction.GenK.nullCurl.header: def nullCurl : nullSpace M hn →ₗ[ℝ] Plaq M (n := n)

HConstruction.GenK.curlImage.name: HConstruction.GenK.curlImage
HConstruction.GenK.curlImage.header: def curlImage : Submodule ℝ (Plaq M (n := n))

HConstruction.GenK.imageSection.name: HConstruction.GenK.imageSection
HConstruction.GenK.imageSection.header: def imageSection : curlImage M hn →ₗ[ℝ] nullSpace M hn

HConstruction.GenK.imageSection_right.name: HConstruction.GenK.imageSection_right
HConstruction.GenK.imageSection_right.header:
lemma imageSection_right (v : curlImage M hn) :
    nullCurl M hn (imageSection M hn v) = v

HConstruction.GenK.correction.name: HConstruction.GenK.correction
HConstruction.GenK.correction.header: def correction : Unit M →L[ℝ] Fine M (n := n)

HConstruction.GenK.H.name: HConstruction.GenK.H
HConstruction.GenK.H.header: def H : Unit M →L[ℝ] Fine M (n := n)

HConstruction.GenK.correction_in_kernel.name: HConstruction.GenK.correction_in_kernel
HConstruction.GenK.correction_in_kernel.header: lemma correction_in_kernel (B : Unit M) : incoming M hn (correction M hn B) = 0

HConstruction.GenK.curl_correction.name: HConstruction.GenK.curl_correction
HConstruction.GenK.curl_correction.header:
lemma curl_correction (B : Unit M) :

HConstruction.GenK.H_interpolates.name: HConstruction.GenK.H_interpolates
HConstruction.GenK.H_interpolates.header: lemma H_interpolates (B : Unit M) : incoming M hn (H M hn B) = B

HConstruction.GenK.curl_H.name: HConstruction.GenK.curl_H

lemma curl_H (B : Unit M) :

HConstruction.GenK.curl_sub_lift_mem.name: HConstruction.GenK.curl_sub_lift_mem
HConstruction.GenK.curl_sub_lift_mem.header:
lemma curl_sub_lift_mem (A : Fine M (n := n)) (B : Unit M)

HConstruction.GenK.curl_H_eq_residual.name: HConstruction.GenK.curl_H_eq_residual
HConstruction.GenK.curl_H_eq_residual.header:
lemma curl_H_eq_residual (A : Fine M (n := n)) (B : Unit M)

HConstruction.GenK.minimum.name: HConstruction.GenK.minimum
HConstruction.GenK.minimum.header:
theorem minimum (A : Fine M (n := n)) (B : Unit M) (hq : incoming M hn A = B) :
    fineEnergy M (H M hn B) ≤ fineEnergy M A

HConstruction.GenK.Delta.name: HConstruction.GenK.Delta
HConstruction.GenK.Delta.header: def Delta : Unit M →L[ℝ] Unit M

HConstruction.GenK.pullback.name: HConstruction.GenK.pullback
HConstruction.GenK.pullback.header:

      = (Matrix.trace (smulILM (f A) * g B * imHolonomy U p)).re
        - (Matrix.trace (smulILM (g B) * f A * imHolonomy U p)).re

HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.firstBi.name: HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.firstBilPlaq_apply
HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.firstBi.header:
theorem firstBilPlaq_apply
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    firstBilPlaq U p A B
      = (Matrix.trace (smulILM (curlMatLM U p A) * smulILM (curlMatLM U p B)
          * (reHolonomy U p - 1))).re

HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.secondB.name: HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.secondBilPlaq_apply
HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.secondB.header:
theorem secondBilPlaq_apply
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    secondBilPlaq U p A B
      = pairBil U p (b1LM U p) (b2LM p) A B + pairBil U p (b1LM U p) (b3LM p) A B
        + pairBil U p (b1LM U p) (b4LM U p) A B + pairBil U p (b2LM p) (b3LM p) A B
        + pairBil U p (b2LM p) (b4LM U p) A B + pairBil U p (b3LM p) (b4LM U p) A B

HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.bilPlaq.name: HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.bilPlaq_apply
HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.bilPlaq.header:
theorem bilPlaq_apply
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    bilPlaq U p A B = firstBilPlaq U p A B + secondBilPlaq U p A B

HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.bilPlaq.name: HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.bilPlaq_atoms
HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.bilPlaq.header:
theorem bilPlaq_atoms
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    bilPlaq U p A B
      = (Matrix.trace (smulILM (curlMatLM U p A) * smulILM (curlMatLM U p B)
            * (reHolonomy U p - 1))).re
        + ((Matrix.trace (smulILM (b1LM U p A) * b2LM p B * imHolonomy U p)).re
            - (Matrix.trace (smulILM (b2LM p B) * b1LM U p A * imHolonomy U p)).re)
        + ((Matrix.trace (smulILM (b1LM U p A) * b3LM p B * imHolonomy U p)).re
            - (Matrix.trace (smulILM (b3LM p B) * b1LM U p A * imHolonomy U p)).re)
        + ((Matrix.trace (smulILM (b1LM U p A) * b4LM U p B * imHolonomy U p)).re
            - (Matrix.trace (smulILM (b4LM U p B) * b1LM U p A * imHolonomy U p)).re)
        + ((Matrix.trace (smulILM (b2LM p A) * b3LM p B * imHolonomy U p)).re
            - (Matrix.trace (smulILM (b3LM p B) * b2LM p A * imHolonomy U p)).re)
        + ((Matrix.trace (smulILM (b2LM p A) * b4LM U p B * imHolonomy U p)).re
            - (Matrix.trace (smulILM (b4LM U p B) * b2LM p A * imHolonomy U p)).re)
        + ((Matrix.trace (smulILM (b3LM p A) * b4LM U p B * imHolonomy U p)).re
            - (Matrix.trace (smulILM (b4LM U p B) * b3LM p A * imHolonomy U p)).re)

HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.firstBi.name: HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.firstBilPlaq_diag
HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.firstBi.header:
theorem firstBilPlaq_diag
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    firstBilPlaq U p A A = deltaPrimeFirstTermTransported U A p

HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.secondB.name: HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.secondBilPlaq_diag
HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.secondB.header:
theorem secondBilPlaq_diag
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    secondBilPlaq U p A A = deltaPrimeSecondTermTransported U A p

HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.bilPlaq.name: HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.bilPlaq_diag
HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.bilPlaq.header:
theorem bilPlaq_diag
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    bilPlaq U p A A
      = deltaPrimeFirstTermTransported U A p + deltaPrimeSecondTermTransported U A p

HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPr.name: HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPrimeBilRaw
HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPr.header:
noncomputable def deltaPrimeBilRaw
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    (Bond L → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] (Bond L → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ

HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPr.name: HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPrimeBilRaw_apply
HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPr.header:
theorem deltaPrimeBilRaw_apply
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    deltaPrimeBilRaw U A B = ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, bilPlaq U p A B

HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPr.name: HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPrimeBilRaw_diag
HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPr.header:
theorem deltaPrimeBilRaw_diag
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    deltaPrimeBilRaw U A A = deltaPrimeQuadFormTransported U A

HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPr.name: HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPrimeBil
HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPr.header:
noncomputable def deltaPrimeBil
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :
    (Bond L → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] (Bond L → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ

HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPr.name: HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPrimeBil_apply
HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPr.header:
theorem deltaPrimeBil_apply
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    deltaPrimeBil U A B
      = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (deltaPrimeBilRaw U A B + deltaPrimeBilRaw U B A)

HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPr.name: HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPrimeBil_symm
HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPr.header:
theorem deltaPrimeBil_symm
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    deltaPrimeBil U A B = deltaPrimeBil U B A

HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPr.name: HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPrimeBil_diag
HConstruction.SmallNF.Reproduced.deltaPr.header:
theorem deltaPrimeBil_diag
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    deltaPrimeBil U A A = deltaPrimeQuadFormTransported U A

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.ScaleQuotient.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.ScaleQuotient
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.ScaleQuotient.header: def ScaleQuotient (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) (L' : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : Prop

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.ell_pos_of_scal.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.ell_pos_of_scale
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.ell_pos_of_scal.header: theorem ell_pos_of_scale {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L') : 0 < ell

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.dvd_of_scale.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.dvd_of_scale
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.dvd_of_scale.header: theorem dvd_of_scale {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L') (μ : Fin 3) : ell ∣ (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteFwd.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteFwd
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteFwd.header:
def coarseSiteFwd {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (y : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}) : PeriodicLatticeSite L'

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteBwd.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteBwd
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteBwd.header:
def coarseSiteBwd {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L') (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L') :
