AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteEquiv.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteEquiv
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteEquiv.header:
def coarseSiteEquiv {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L') :
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell} ≃ PeriodicLatticeSite L'

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteEquiv.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteEquiv_val
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteEquiv.header:
theorem coarseSiteEquiv_val {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (y : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((coarseSiteEquiv h y) μ).val = (y.1 μ).val / ell

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteEquiv.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteEquiv_symm_val
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteEquiv.header:
theorem coarseSiteEquiv_symm_val {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L') (μ : Fin 3) :
    (((coarseSiteEquiv h).symm z).1 μ).val = ell * (z μ).val

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.shift_val_eq.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.shift_val_eq
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.shift_val_eq.header:
theorem shift_val_eq (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L') (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((periodicLatticeShift z μ) μ).val = ((z μ).val + 1) % (L' μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteEquiv.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteEquiv_coarseShift
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseSiteEquiv.header:
theorem coarseSiteEquiv_coarseShift {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (y : {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L // y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell}) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseSiteEquiv h ⟨coarseShift y.1 ell μ,
        coarseShift_mem_coarseLattice (dvd_of_scale h) y.2 μ⟩
      = periodicLatticeShift (coarseSiteEquiv h y) μ

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseBondEquiv.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseBondEquiv
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseBondEquiv.header: def coarseBondEquiv {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L') : CoarseBond L ell ≃ Bond L'

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqEquiv.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqEquiv
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqEquiv.header:
def coarsePlaqEquiv {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L') :
    CoarsePlaquette L ell ≃ PeriodicLatticePlaquette L'

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseBondEquiv.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseBondEquiv_apply
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseBondEquiv.header:
theorem coarseBondEquiv_apply {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L') (b : CoarseBond L ell) :
    coarseBondEquiv h b = (coarseSiteEquiv h b.1, b.2)

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqEquiv.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqEquiv_apply
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqEquiv.header:
theorem coarsePlaqEquiv_apply {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L') (p : CoarsePlaquette L ell) :
    coarsePlaqEquiv h p = (coarseSiteEquiv h p.1, p.2)

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseFnL2Equiv.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseFnL2Equiv
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseFnL2Equiv.header:
noncomputable def coarseFnL2Equiv {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L') :
    CoarseFnL2 L ell ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] BondFnL2 L'

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqFnL2E.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqFnL2Equiv
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqFnL2E.header:
noncomputable def coarsePlaqFnL2Equiv {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L') :
    AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.CoarsePlaqFnL2 L ell ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] PlaqFnL2 L'

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.norm_coarseFnL2.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.norm_coarseFnL2Equiv
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.norm_coarseFnL2.header:
theorem norm_coarseFnL2Equiv {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L') (B : CoarseFnL2 L ell) :
    ‖coarseFnL2Equiv h B‖ = ‖B‖

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.inner_coarseFnL.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.inner_coarseFnL2Equiv
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.inner_coarseFnL.header:
theorem inner_coarseFnL2Equiv {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L') (B C : CoarseFnL2 L ell) :
    (inner ℝ (coarseFnL2Equiv h B) (coarseFnL2Equiv h C) : ℝ) = inner ℝ B C

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.norm_coarsePlaq.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.norm_coarsePlaqFnL2Equiv
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.norm_coarsePlaq.header:
theorem norm_coarsePlaqFnL2Equiv {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (F : AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.CoarsePlaqFnL2 L ell) :
    ‖coarsePlaqFnL2Equiv h F‖ = ‖F‖

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseFnL2Equiv.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseFnL2Equiv_apply
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseFnL2Equiv.header:
theorem coarseFnL2Equiv_apply {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L') (B : CoarseFnL2 L ell)
    (b : Bond L') :
    WithLp.ofLp (coarseFnL2Equiv h B) b = WithLp.ofLp B ((coarseBondEquiv h).symm b)

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqFnL2E.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqFnL2Equiv_apply
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqFnL2E.header:
theorem coarsePlaqFnL2Equiv_apply {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (F : AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.CoarsePlaqFnL2 L ell) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L') :
    WithLp.ofLp (coarsePlaqFnL2Equiv h F) p = WithLp.ofLp F ((coarsePlaqEquiv h).symm p)

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseBondEquiv.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseBondEquiv_symm_apply
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseBondEquiv.header:
theorem coarseBondEquiv_symm_apply {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L') (ρ : Fin 3) :
    (coarseBondEquiv h).symm (z, ρ) = ((coarseSiteEquiv h).symm z, ρ)

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlSuTwo.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlSuTwo_transport
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlSuTwo.header:
theorem coarseCurlSuTwo_transport {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo)
    (p : CoarsePlaquette L ell) :
    coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd B p
      = curlValueCovariant (trivialU L') (fun b => B ((coarseBondEquiv h).symm b))
          (coarsePlaqEquiv h p)

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlSuTwo.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlSuTwoCov
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlSuTwo.header:
noncomputable def coarseCurlSuTwoCov {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V : CoarseLinkConfiguration L ell) (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo)
    (p : CoarsePlaquette L ell) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.trivialCoarseU.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.trivialCoarseU
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.trivialCoarseU.header: def trivialCoarseU (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) : CoarseLinkConfiguration L ell

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlSuTwo.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlSuTwoCov_trivial
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlSuTwo.header:
theorem coarseCurlSuTwoCov_trivial {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (p : CoarsePlaquette L ell) :
    coarseCurlSuTwoCov hdvd (trivialCoarseU L ell) B p = coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd B p

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlSuTwo.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlSuTwoCov_transport
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlSuTwo.header:
theorem coarseCurlSuTwoCov_transport {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (V : CoarseLinkConfiguration L ell)
    (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (p : CoarsePlaquette L ell) :
    coarseCurlSuTwoCov hdvd V B p
      = curlValueCovariant (fun b => V ((coarseBondEquiv h).symm b))
          (fun b => B ((coarseBondEquiv h).symm b)) (coarsePlaqEquiv h p)

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlSuTwo.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlSuTwoCov_sub_flat
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlSuTwo.header:
theorem coarseCurlSuTwoCov_sub_flat {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (V : CoarseLinkConfiguration L ell)
    (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (p : CoarsePlaquette L ell) :
    coarseCurlSuTwoCov hdvd V B p - coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd B p
      = AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.curlDrift
          (fun b => V ((coarseBondEquiv h).symm b))
          (fun b => B ((coarseBondEquiv h).symm b)) (coarsePlaqEquiv h p)

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarse_drift_en.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarse_drift_energy_le
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarse_drift_en.header:
theorem coarse_drift_energy_le {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (V : CoarseLinkConfiguration L ell)
    (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (hα : ∀ b : CoarseBond L ell,
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((V b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α) :
    Real.sqrt (∑ P : CoarsePlaquette L ell,
        ‖coarseCurlSuTwoCov hdvd V B P - coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd B P‖ ^ 2)
      ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * α * Real.sqrt (∑ b : CoarseBond L ell, ‖B b‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlCovLM.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlCovLM
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlCovLM.header:
noncomputable def coarseCurlCovLM {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V : CoarseLinkConfiguration L ell) :
    (CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] (CoarsePlaquette L ell → SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlCovCL.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlCovCLM_L2
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlCovCL.header:
noncomputable def coarseCurlCovCLM_L2 {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V : CoarseLinkConfiguration L ell) :
    CoarseFnL2 L ell →L[ℝ] AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.CoarsePlaqFnL2 L ell

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlCovCL.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlCovCLM_L2_apply
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarseCurlCovCL.header:
theorem coarseCurlCovCLM_L2_apply {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V : CoarseLinkConfiguration L ell) (B : CoarseFnL2 L ell) (p : CoarsePlaquette L ell) :
    WithLp.ofLp (coarseCurlCovCLM_L2 hdvd V B) p
      = coarseCurlSuTwoCov hdvd V (WithLp.ofLp B) p

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.ofLp_curlCovari.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.ofLp_curlCovariantCLM_L2
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.ofLp_curlCovari.header:
theorem ofLp_curlCovariantCLM_L2
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (X : BondFnL2 L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    WithLp.ofLp (curlCovariantCLM_L2 U X) p = curlValueCovariant U (WithLp.ofLp X) p

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqFnL2E.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqFnL2Equiv_coarseCurlCLM_L2
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqFnL2E.header:
theorem coarsePlaqFnL2Equiv_coarseCurlCLM_L2 {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (B : CoarseFnL2 L ell) :
    coarsePlaqFnL2Equiv h (AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.coarseCurlCLM_L2 hdvd B)
      = curlCovariantCLM_L2 (trivialU L') (coarseFnL2Equiv h B)

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqFnL2E.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqFnL2Equiv_coarseCurlCovCLM_L2
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.coarsePlaqFnL2E.header:
theorem coarsePlaqFnL2Equiv_coarseCurlCovCLM_L2 {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (V : CoarseLinkConfiguration L ell)
    (B : CoarseFnL2 L ell) :
    coarsePlaqFnL2Equiv h (coarseCurlCovCLM_L2 hdvd V B)
      = curlCovariantCLM_L2 (fun b => V ((coarseBondEquiv h).symm b)) (coarseFnL2Equiv h B)

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.norm_coarseCurl.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.norm_coarseCurlCLM_L2_eq
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.norm_coarseCurl.header:
theorem norm_coarseCurlCLM_L2_eq {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (B : CoarseFnL2 L ell) :
    ‖AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.coarseCurlCLM_L2 hdvd B‖
      = ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 (trivialU L') (coarseFnL2Equiv h B)‖

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.composedQ.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.composedQ
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.composedQ.header:
noncomputable def composedQ {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')
    (Ufine : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) :

AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.hraw_composed_o.name: AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.hraw_composed_of_lower_bound
AdalyFormal.HrawCarriers.hraw_composed_o.header:
theorem hraw_composed_of_lower_bound {ell : ℕ} (h : ScaleQuotient L ell L')

    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L')
    (hsmall : AdalyFormal.Balaban.RegularUPerturbation.frobSupBond U
      ≤ 1 / (6668 * (ell₀ : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (bc : BaseConstant) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps)
    (Qext : BondFnL2 L' → BondFnL2 L') (T : BondFnL2 L' →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L)
    (S : BondFnL2 L' →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L')
    (hS : IsSourceOperator (feedDatum h heps (le_of_lt bc.a_pos)) Qext (T (JsuTwo U)) S)
    (c₂ : ℝ) (hc₂ : 0 < c₂)
    (hD2 : ∀ B : BondFnL2 L', ‖Dtilde2Shape Qext B‖ ≤ c₂ * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hU : LinkDev δ U)
    (hH1 : 0 < ‖solutionOperator (feedDatum h heps (le_of_lt bc.a_pos))‖) (hT : 0 < ‖T‖)
    (hcard : 0 < Fintype.card (Bond L'))
    (hδ : δ < 1 / (1370001600 * (ell₀ : ℝ) ^ 6
      * (AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.rawSigmaZero ell) ^ 2
      * ‖solutionOperator (feedDatum h heps (le_of_lt bc.a_pos))‖ * c₂
      * (‖T‖ * Real.sqrt (2 * (Fintype.card (Bond L'))))))
    (w : TildeFn L' ell₀) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    0 < cdcFormTrue (feedDatum h heps (le_of_lt bc.a_pos)) bc Qext (T (JsuTwo U)) U ell₀

AdalyFormal.L0NV.nonvac_core_L0.name: AdalyFormal.L0NV.nonvac_core_L0
AdalyFormal.L0NV.nonvac_core_L0.header:
theorem nonvac_core_L0 {ell M R T : ℕ} (Φ : Set ℕ) (hne : Φ.Nonempty) (hΦ : ∀ f ∈ Φ, 10 ≤ f ∧ f ≤ T)
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hRT : R ≤ T) (hT : 1 ≤ T)
    {a₀ : ℝ} (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
      2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell M Lu ∧ Admissible ell M R k S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell M R k S Lam ∧
      0 < α₀ ∧ (∀ f ∈ Φ, (f : ℝ) * (M : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀) ∧
      ClassCoupledP level0ClassW ell M (famL Φ (scaleUp ell k Lu)) k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
      ClassCoupledCap ell M (famL Φ (scaleUp ell k Lu)) k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
      (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 2) ∧
      (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
      (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
      (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
      Lam.Nonempty ∧ (LamPrime ell Lam).Nonempty ∧
      OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ μ : Fin 3, M < Lu μ + 1) ∧
      (∀ f ∈ Φ, ∃ C : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)), (C, 0, f) ∈ famL Φ (scaleUp ell k Lu) ∧
        DescribedAt0 ell M f S C ∧ (∃ x ∈ C, x ∉ S.Om 0) ∧ (∃ x ∈ C, x ∈ S.Om 0) ∧
        ∀ (f' j : ℕ), ¬ IsClassCube ell M f' k S C j)

AdalyFormal.L0NV.level0_instance_inequal.name: AdalyFormal.L0NV.level0_instance_inequality
AdalyFormal.L0NV.level0_instance_inequal.header:
theorem level0_instance_inequality (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ m₁ : ℕ, 1 ≤ m₁ ∧ ∃ R₁ : ℕ, ∃ (a₀ γ₀ : ℝ), 0 < a₀ ∧ 0 < γ₀ ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, m₁ ≤ m → ∀ R : ℕ, max (max R₁ 1) (21 * ell) ≤ R →
      ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
        (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
        2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧ Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R k S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) R k S Lam ∧
        0 < α₀ ∧ (12 * (ell : ℝ)) * ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀ ∧
        ClassCoupledCap ell (ell ^ m) (famL (Phi12 ell) (scaleUp ell k Lu)) k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
        (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
        (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
        (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
        Lam.Nonempty ∧ OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ f ∈ Phi12 ell, ∃ C : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)), (C, 0, f) ∈ famL (Phi12 ell) (scaleUp ell k Lu) ∧
          DescribedAt0 ell (ell ^ m) f S C ∧ (∃ x ∈ C, x ∉ S.Om 0) ∧ (∃ x ∈ C, x ∈ S.Om 0) ∧
          ∀ (f' j : ℕ), ¬ IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) f' k S C j) ∧
        GenP.WellDefG (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) ∧
        γ₀ * bondEnergy Bt ≤
          GenP.genForm (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam)
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) Bt))

    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3)) (transport : SU2) :
    AdalySI1.IngredientDeriv.dirDeriv V0 A y (p.map (fun μ => (μ, true))) transport
      = (RMap transport (OneStep124.lineIntegral 1 V0 (fineDirToUnitBond A hah htr) y p) : M2)

lineIntegral_replicate_eq_sum_range.name: lineIntegral_replicate_eq_sum_range
lineIntegral_replicate_eq_sum_range.header:
theorem lineIntegral_replicate_eq_sum_range (ell : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) :
    OneStep124.lineIntegral ell V B y (List.replicate m μ)
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m,
          if h : pathSite y μ (i * ell) ∈ CoarseLattice L ell then
            RMap (coarsePathHolonomy ell V y (List.replicate i μ))
              (B (⟨pathSite y μ (i * ell), h⟩, μ))
          else 0

unitToCoarseCov_one_eq_sum_blockOf.name: unitToCoarseCov_one_eq_sum_blockOf
unitToCoarseCov_one_eq_sum_blockOf.header:
theorem unitToCoarseCov_one_eq_sum_blockOf (m : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (B : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo)
    (c : CoarseBond L (1 * m)) :
    unitToCoarseCov 1 m V B c
      = (1 / (m : ℝ) ^ 4) • ∑ x ∈ blockOf c.1.1 m,
          RMap (coarsePathHolonomy 1 V c.1.1 (coarseGammaPath 1 c.1.1 x))
            (OneStep124.lineIntegral 1 V B x (List.replicate m c.2))

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.p0_last.header: theorem p0_last (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : p0 n (n - 1) = 1 + lam n * bstar n

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.p0_first.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.p0_first

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.kk_block_mean.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.kk_block_mean
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.kk_block_mean.header:
theorem kk_block_mean (Nu n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : N = Nu * n) (y y' : Fin N)
    (hy : n ∣ y.val) (hy' : n ∣ y'.val) :
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a : Fin N => y'.val ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < y'.val + n),
      kk n Nu (a - y).val = if y' = y then (n : ℝ) else 0

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.chi_corner.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.chi_corner
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.chi_corner.header:
theorem chi_corner (Nu n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : N = Nu * n) (x a : Fin N) (ha : n ∣ a.val)
    (hchi : chi n Nu (x - a).val ≠ 0) :
    a.val = n * (x.val / n) ∨ a.val = (n * (x.val / n) + n) % N ∨ (a.val + n) % N = n * (x.val / n)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.scalar_core.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.scalar_core
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.scalar_core.header:
theorem scalar_core (D : S →L[ℝ] B) (mass : B → ℝ) (K : Submodule ℝ S) (ε : S → ℝ) (E : S → S)
    (C1 C2 n a : ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (ha : 0 < a) (hC1 : 0 ≤ C1) (hC2 : 0 ≤ C2)
    (hE_avg : ∀ w ∈ K, ∀ v ∈ K, ⟪v, E w⟫ = ⟪v, w⟫)
    (hE_grad : ∀ w ∈ K, ‖D (E w)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C1 * n * ε w)
    (hM1 : ∀ w ∈ K, ε w ≤ C2 * (n / a) * mass (D w))
    (hεG : ∀ w ∈ K, ε w ≤ 12 / n ^ 3 * ‖w‖ ^ 2)
    (φ ψ : S) (hψ : ψ ∈ K) (hφψ : ∀ v ∈ K, ⟪v, φ⟫ = ⟪v, ψ⟫) (hmass : mass (D ψ) = mass (D φ))
    (hm0 : 0 ≤ mass (D φ))
    (hG : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D (D φ) ∈ K) :
    ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D (D φ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 12 * C1 ^ 2 * C2 / a * mass (D φ)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.flatCfg_eq.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.flatCfg_eq
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.flatCfg_eq.header: theorem flatCfg_eq : (flatCfg : Cfg L) = trivialU L

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bg_flat_triv.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bg_flat_triv
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bg_flat_triv.header: theorem bg_flat_triv (G : TowerGeom L) : bgTower G (flatCfg : Cfg L) = fun _ => trivialU L

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qlev_flat.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qlev_flat
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qlev_flat.header:
theorem Qlev_flat (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (i : ℕ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    Qlev G (flatCfg : Cfg L) i z f = ((1 / (G.ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ i) • ∑ x ∈ blockOf z (G.ell ^ i), f.ofLp x

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qcomp_flat.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qcomp_flat
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qcomp_flat.header:
theorem Qcomp_flat (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (i : ℕ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    Qcomposite (bgTower G (flatCfg : Cfg L)) G.ell i f z = ((1 / (G.ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ i) • ∑ x ∈ blockOf z (G.ell ^ i), f x

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.regTower_flat.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.regTower_flat
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.regTower_flat.header: theorem regTower_flat (G : TowerGeom L) (J : ℕ) : RegTower G.ell (bgTower G (flatCfg : Cfg L)) J

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.QfullOf_grad_flat.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.QfullOf_grad_flat
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.QfullOf_grad_flat.header:
theorem QfullOf_grad_flat (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (hdiv : ∀ μ : Fin 3, G.ell ^ G.k ∣ L μ + 1)
    (ν : SiteL2 L) (p : BIdx G)
    (hlat0 : OnLat (G.ell ^ (p.1 : ℕ)) p.2.1.1)
    (hlat1 : OnLat (G.ell ^ (p.1 : ℕ)) (coarseShift p.2.1.1 (G.ell ^ (p.1 : ℕ)) p.2.1.2)) :
    (QfullOf G (flatCfg : Cfg L) (gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) ν)).ofLp p
      = (((G.ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ))⁻¹) •
        (Qcomposite (bgTower G (flatCfg : Cfg L)) G.ell p.1 (WithLp.ofLp ν) (coarseShift p.2.1.1 (G.ell ^ (p.1 : ℕ)) p.2.1.2)
          - Qcomposite (bgTower G (flatCfg : Cfg L)) G.ell p.1 (WithLp.ofLp ν) p.2.1.1)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_val.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_val
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_val.header: theorem corner_val (m : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : (corner m x μ).val = (x μ).val / m * m

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_blockOf_iff_cor.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_blockOf_iff_corner
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_blockOf_iff_cor.header:
theorem mem_blockOf_iff_corner {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (z x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : ∀ μ : Fin 3, m ∣ (z μ).val) :
    x ∈ blockOf z m ↔ corner m x = z

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_div.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_div
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_div.header:
theorem corner_div {m M : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hmM : m ∣ M) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (corner m x μ).val / M = (x μ).val / M

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_corner.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_corner
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_corner.header:
theorem corner_corner {m m' : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hmm : m ∣ m') (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    corner m' (corner m x) = corner m' x

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_idem.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_idem
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_idem.header: theorem corner_idem {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : corner m (corner m x) = corner m x

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.massP.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.massP
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.massP.header: noncomputable def massP (G : TowerGeom L) (a : ℝ) (y : BondFnL2 L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.massP_eq.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.massP_eq
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.massP_eq.header:
theorem massP_eq (G : TowerGeom L) (a : ℝ) (y : BondFnL2 L) :
    massP G a y = ∑ p : BIdx G, a * (G.ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ) * ‖(QfullOf G (flatCfg : Cfg L) y).ofLp p‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.massP_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.massP_nonneg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.massP_nonneg.header: theorem massP_nonneg (G : TowerGeom L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (y : BondFnL2 L) : 0 ≤ massP G a y

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.PhiP_grad.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.PhiP_grad
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.PhiP_grad.header:
theorem PhiP_grad (G : TowerGeom L) (a : ℝ) (φ : SiteL2 L) :
    PhiP G (flatCfg : Cfg L) a (gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) φ) = massP G a (gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) φ)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_mem_Rg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_mem_Rg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_mem_Rg.header:
theorem corner_mem_Rg {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hmN : m ∣ ell ^ (j + 1)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    corner m x ∈ Rg ↔ x ∈ Rg

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_Rg_of_block.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_Rg_of_block
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_Rg_of_block.header:
theorem mem_Rg_of_block {z y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hz : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ (z μ).val)
    (hy : y ∈ blockOf z (ell ^ (j + 1))) : y ∈ Rg ↔ z ∈ Rg

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_Rg_of_small_blo.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_Rg_of_small_block
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_Rg_of_small_blo.header:
theorem mem_Rg_of_small_block {z y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hz : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ j ∣ (z μ).val)
    (hy : y ∈ blockOf z (ell ^ j)) : y ∈ Rg ↔ z ∈ Rg

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cc.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cc
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cc.header: noncomputable def cc (ell j : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.block_iff_cc.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.block_iff_cc
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.block_iff_cc.header:
theorem block_iff_cc (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ j + 1) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hz : z ∈ (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)).Lam i) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    x ∈ blockOf z (ell ^ i) ↔ cc ell j Rg x ∈ blockOf z (ell ^ i)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.single_diff_mem.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.single_diff_mem
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.single_diff_mem.header:
theorem single_diff_mem (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : SuTwo) :
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single x s - Pi.single (cc ell j Rg x) s) : SiteL2 L)
      ∈ NQp (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) (flatCfg : Cfg L)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.orth_cc.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.orth_cc
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.orth_cc.header:
theorem orth_cc (v : SiteL2 L) (hv : v ∈ (NQp (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) (flatCfg : Cfg L))ᗮ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : v.ofLp x = v.ofLp (cc ell j Rg x)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.orth_cell.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.orth_cell
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.orth_cell.header:
theorem orth_cell (v : SiteL2 L) (hv : v ∈ (NQp (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) (flatCfg : Cfg L))ᗮ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : v.ofLp x = v.ofLp (corner (ell ^ j) x)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.orth_big.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.orth_big
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.orth_big.header:
theorem orth_big (v : SiteL2 L) (hv : v ∈ (NQp (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) (flatCfg : Cfg L))ᗮ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ Rg) : v.ofLp x = v.ofLp (corner (ell ^ (j + 1)) x)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cell_sum.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cell_sum
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cell_sum.header:
theorem cell_sum (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ L μ + 1) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)
    (hw : ∀ x, w x = w (corner (ell ^ j) x)) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hc : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ j ∣ (c μ).val) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf c (ell ^ j), w x = ((ell ^ j : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3 • w c

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ext3_sub_mem.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ext3_sub_mem
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ext3_sub_mem.header:
theorem ext3_sub_mem (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ L μ + 1) (Nu : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hNu : ∀ μ : Fin 3, L μ + 1 = Nu μ * ell ^ j) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)
    (hw : ∀ x, w x = w (corner (ell ^ j) x)) :
    ext3 (ell ^ j) Nu w - WithLp.toLp 2 w ∈ NQp (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) (flatCfg : Cfg L)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.massP_add_NQp.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.massP_add_NQp
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.massP_add_NQp.header:
theorem massP_add_NQp (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ L μ + 1) (a : ℝ) (y : BondFnL2 L) (ν : SiteL2 L)
    (hν : ν ∈ NQp (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) (flatCfg : Cfg L)) :
    massP (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) a (y + gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) ν)
      = massP (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) a y

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.OnLatN.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.OnLatN
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.OnLatN.header: def OnLatN (n : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.K1.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.K1
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.K1.header: noncomputable def K1 (n Nu : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (s a : Fin N) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.X1.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.X1
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.X1.header: noncomputable def X1 (n Nu : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (s a : Fin N) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ker3.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ker3
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ker3.header: noncomputable def ker3 (n : ℕ) (Nu : Fin 3 → ℕ) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.maj3.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.maj3
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.maj3.header: noncomputable def maj3 (n : ℕ) (Nu : Fin 3 → ℕ) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ext3.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ext3
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ext3.header: noncomputable def ext3 (n : ℕ) (Nu : Fin 3 → ℕ) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : SiteL2 L

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ext3_apply.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ext3_apply
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ext3_apply.header:
theorem ext3_apply (n : ℕ) (Nu : Fin 3 → ℕ) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (ext3 n Nu w).ofLp x = ∑ y, ker3 n Nu x y • w y

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.epsMu.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.epsMu
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.epsMu.header: noncomputable def epsMu (n : ℕ) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.epsN.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.epsN
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.epsN.header: noncomputable def epsN (n : ℕ) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.X1_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.X1_nonneg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.X1_nonneg.header: theorem X1_nonneg {N0 : ℕ} (s a : Fin N0) (m : ℕ) : 0 ≤ X1 n m s a

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.abs_K1_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.abs_K1_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.abs_K1_le.header: theorem abs_K1_le (μ : Fin 3) (s a : Fin (L μ + 1)) : |K1 n (Nu μ) s a| ≤ 2 * X1 n (Nu μ) s a

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.abs_K1_step.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.abs_K1_step
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.abs_K1_step.header:
theorem abs_K1_step (μ : Fin 3) (s a : Fin (L μ + 1)) :
    |K1 n (Nu μ) (s + 1) a - K1 n (Nu μ) s a| ≤ 7 / n * X1 n (Nu μ) s a

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.K1_partition.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.K1_partition
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.K1_partition.header: theorem K1_partition (μ : Fin 3) (s : Fin (L μ + 1)) : ∑ a, K1 n (Nu μ) s a = 1

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.K1_block.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.K1_block
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.K1_block.header:
theorem K1_block (μ : Fin 3) (c a : Fin (L μ + 1)) (hc : n ∣ c.val) :
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun s : Fin (L μ + 1) => c.val ≤ s.val ∧ s.val < c.val + n), K1 n (Nu μ) s a
      = if a = c then (n : ℝ) else 0

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.blockOf_pi.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.blockOf_pi
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.blockOf_pi.header:
theorem blockOf_pi (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    blockOf c n = Fintype.piFinset (fun μ => Finset.univ.filter
      (fun a : Fin (L μ + 1) => (c μ).val ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < (c μ).val + n))

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ker3_block.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ker3_block
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ker3_block.header:
theorem ker3_block (c y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hc : OnLatN n c) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf c n, ker3 n Nu x y = if y = c then ((n : ℝ)) ^ 3 else 0

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ext3_block_sum.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ext3_block_sum
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ext3_block_sum.header:
theorem ext3_block_sum (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hc : OnLatN n c) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf c n, (ext3 n Nu w).ofLp x = ((n : ℝ) ^ 3) • w c

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ker3_partition.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ker3_partition
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ker3_partition.header: theorem ker3_partition (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ∑ y, ker3 n Nu x y = 1

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_update_split.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_update_split
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_update_split.header:
theorem sum_update_split {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] (μ : Fin 3) (c : Fin (L μ + 1))
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → E) :
    ∑ y, f y = ∑ a : Fin (L μ + 1), ∑ y' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L => y' μ = c),
      f (Function.update y' μ a)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_mu_cancel.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_mu_cancel
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_mu_cancel.header:
theorem sum_mu_cancel {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] (μ : Fin 3) (G : Fin (L μ + 1) → ℝ)
    (hG : ∑ a, G a = 0) (F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → E) (hF : ∀ y a, F (Function.update y μ a) = F y) :
    ∑ y, G (y μ) • F y = 0

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.gradL2_flat_apply.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.gradL2_flat_apply
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.gradL2_flat_apply.header:
theorem gradL2_flat_apply (f : SiteL2 L) (b : Bond L) :
    (gradL2 (trivialU L) f).ofLp b = f.ofLp (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - f.ofLp b.1

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.coarseShift_full.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.coarseShift_full
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.coarseShift_full.header: theorem coarseShift_full (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : coarseShift y (L μ + 1) μ = y

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.coarseShift_add.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.coarseShift_add
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.coarseShift_add.header:
theorem coarseShift_add (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a b : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift (coarseShift y a μ) b μ = coarseShift y (a + b) μ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cornerC.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cornerC
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cornerC.header: def cornerC (n : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (s : Fin N) : Fin N

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.periodicLatticeShif.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.periodicLatticeShift_ne
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.periodicLatticeShif.header:
theorem periodicLatticeShift_ne (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) (h : ν ≠ μ) :
    periodicLatticeShift x μ ν = x ν

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.periodicLatticeShif.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.periodicLatticeShift_self
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.periodicLatticeShif.header:
theorem periodicLatticeShift_self (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    periodicLatticeShift x μ μ = x μ + 1

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ker3_diff.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ker3_diff
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ker3_diff.header:
theorem ker3_diff (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ker3 n Nu (periodicLatticeShift x μ) y - ker3 n Nu x y
      = (K1 n (Nu μ) (x μ + 1) (y μ) - K1 n (Nu μ) (x μ) (y μ))
        * ∏ ν ∈ Finset.univ.erase μ, K1 n (Nu ν) (x ν) (y ν)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ker3_diff_cancel.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ker3_diff_cancel
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ker3_diff_cancel.header:
theorem ker3_diff_cancel (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∑ y, (ker3 n Nu (periodicLatticeShift x μ) y - ker3 n Nu x y) • w (Function.update y μ (cornerC n (x μ))) = 0

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.abs_ker3_diff_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.abs_ker3_diff_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.abs_ker3_diff_le.header:
theorem abs_ker3_diff_le (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    |ker3 n Nu (periodicLatticeShift x μ) y - ker3 n Nu x y| ≤ 28 / n * maj3 n Nu x y

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.maj3_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.maj3_nonneg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.maj3_nonneg.header: theorem maj3_nonneg (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 0 ≤ maj3 n Nu x y

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.row_maj3_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.row_maj3_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.row_maj3_le.header: theorem row_maj3_le (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ∑ y, maj3 n Nu x y ≤ 27

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.col_maj3_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.col_maj3_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.col_maj3_le.header: theorem col_maj3_le (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ∑ x, maj3 n Nu x y ≤ 27 * (n : ℝ) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.backN.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.backN
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.backN.header: noncomputable def backN (μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.shift_backN.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.shift_backN
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.shift_backN.header: theorem shift_backN (μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : coarseShift (backN n μ y) n μ = y

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.backN_shift.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.backN_shift
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.backN_shift.header: theorem backN_shift (μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : backN n μ (coarseShift y n μ) = y

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_coarseShift.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_coarseShift
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_coarseShift.header:
theorem onLat_coarseShift (μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (m : ℕ) (hm : n ∣ m) (hy : OnLatN n y) :
    OnLatN n (coarseShift y m μ)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_backN.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_backN
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_backN.header: theorem onLat_backN (μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : OnLatN n y) : OnLatN n (backN n μ y)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.diff_le_edges.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.diff_le_edges
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.diff_le_edges.header:
theorem diff_le_edges (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    (hy : OnLatN n y) (hX : X1 n (Nu μ) (x μ) (y μ) ≠ 0) :
    ‖w y - w (Function.update y μ (cornerC n (x μ)))‖
      ≤ ‖w (coarseShift y n μ) - w y‖ + ‖w (coarseShift (backN n μ y) n μ) - w (backN n μ y)‖

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.aEdge.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.aEdge
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.aEdge.header: noncomputable def aEdge (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.aEdge_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.aEdge_nonneg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.aEdge_nonneg.header:
theorem aEdge_nonneg (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    0 ≤ aEdge n w μ y

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.pointwise_grad.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.pointwise_grad
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.pointwise_grad.header:
theorem pointwise_grad (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ‖(ext3 n Nu w).ofLp (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - (ext3 n Nu w).ofLp x‖
      ≤ ∑ y, (28 / n * maj3 n Nu x y) * aEdge n w μ y

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_aEdge_sq.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_aEdge_sq
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_aEdge_sq.header:
theorem sum_aEdge_sq (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∑ y, aEdge n w μ y ^ 2 ≤ 4 * epsMu n w μ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ext3_grad.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ext3_grad
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.ext3_grad.header:
theorem ext3_grad (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ‖gradL2 (trivialU L) (ext3 n Nu w)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2286144 * n * epsN n w

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.norm_sub_le_path_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.norm_sub_le_path_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.norm_sub_le_path_le.header:
theorem norm_sub_le_path_le (f : ℕ → E) (m s k : ℕ) (hk : s + k < m) :
    ‖f (s + k) - f s‖ ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (m - 1), ‖f (t + 1) - f t‖

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.norm_sub_le_path.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.norm_sub_le_path
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.norm_sub_le_path.header:
theorem norm_sub_le_path (f : ℕ → E) (m s s' : ℕ) (hs : s < m) (hs' : s' < m) :
    ‖f s - f s'‖ ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (m - 1), ‖f (t + 1) - f t‖

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_cube.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_cube
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_cube.header: theorem mem_cube (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ) : i ∈ cube m ↔ ∀ ν, i ν < m

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeE.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeE
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeE.header: noncomputable def cubeE (m : ℕ) (W : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → E) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeE_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeE_nonneg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeE_nonneg.header: theorem cubeE_nonneg (m : ℕ) (W : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → E) : 0 ≤ cubeE m W

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.line_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.line_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.line_le.header:
theorem line_le (m : ℕ) (W : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → E) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hi : i ∈ cube m) (ν : Fin 3) :
    ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (m - 1), ‖W (Function.update i ν (t + 1)) - W (Function.update i ν t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ cubeE m W

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.line_sq_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.line_sq_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.line_sq_le.header:
theorem line_sq_le (m : ℕ) (W : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → E) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hi : i ∈ cube m) (ν : Fin 3) :
    (∑ t ∈ Finset.range (m - 1), ‖W (Function.update i ν (t + 1)) - W (Function.update i ν t)‖) ^ 2
      ≤ m * cubeE m W

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.seg_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.seg_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.seg_le.header:
theorem seg_le (m : ℕ) (W : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → E) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hi : i ∈ cube m) (ν : Fin 3) (s : ℕ) (hs : s < m) :
    ‖W i - W (Function.update i ν s)‖
      ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (m - 1), ‖W (Function.update i ν (t + 1)) - W (Function.update i ν t)‖

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_path.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_path
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_path.header:
theorem cube_path (m : ℕ) (W : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → E) (i i' : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hi : i ∈ cube m) (hi' : i' ∈ cube m) :
    ‖W i - W i'‖ ^ 2 ≤ 9 * m * cubeE m W

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_dev.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_dev
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_dev.header:
theorem cube_dev (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (W : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → E) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hi : i ∈ cube m) :
    ‖W i - ((1 : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) ^ 3) • ∑ i' ∈ cube m, W i'‖ ^ 2 ≤ 9 * m * cubeE m W

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_poincare.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_poincare
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_poincare.header:
theorem cube_poincare (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (W : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → E) :
    ∑ i ∈ cube m, ‖W i - ((1 : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) ^ 3) • ∑ i' ∈ cube m, W i'‖ ^ 2 ≤ 9 * (m : ℝ) ^ 4 * cubeE m W

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_comp_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_comp_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_comp_le.header:
theorem sum_comp_le {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β) (f : α → β) (g : β → ℝ) (M : ℕ)
    (hmap : ∀ a ∈ s, f a ∈ t) (hfib : ∀ b ∈ t, (s.filter (fun a => f a = b)).card ≤ M) (hg : ∀ b ∈ t, 0 ≤ g b) :
    ∑ a ∈ s, g (f a) ≤ M * ∑ b ∈ t, g b

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota.header: def iota (n : ℕ) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.idx.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.idx
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.idx.header: def idx (n N : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Fin 3 → ℕ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_val_mod.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_val_mod
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_val_mod.header:
theorem iota_val_mod (n : ℕ) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (iota n Y i μ).val = ((Y μ).val + n * i μ) % (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.shift_iota.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.shift_iota
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.shift_iota.header:
theorem shift_iota (n : ℕ) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    coarseShift (iota n Y i) n ν = iota n Y (Function.update i ν (i ν + 1))

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.fit_big.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.fit_big
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.fit_big.header:
theorem fit_big (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hY : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ (Y μ).val) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (Y μ).val + ell ^ (j + 1) ≤ L μ + 1

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_lt.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_lt
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_lt.header:
theorem iota_lt (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hY : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ (Y μ).val) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hi : i ∈ cube ell) (μ : Fin 3) : (Y μ).val + ell ^ j * i μ < (Y μ).val + ell ^ (j + 1)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_val.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_val
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_val.header:
theorem iota_val (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hY : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ (Y μ).val) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hi : i ∈ cube ell) (μ : Fin 3) : (iota (ell ^ j) Y i μ).val = (Y μ).val + ell ^ j * i μ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_mem_block.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_mem_block
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_mem_block.header:
theorem iota_mem_block (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hY : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ (Y μ).val) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hi : i ∈ cube ell) : iota (ell ^ j) Y i ∈ blockOf Y (ell ^ (j + 1))

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_onLat.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_onLat
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_onLat.header:
theorem iota_onLat (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hY : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ (Y μ).val) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hi : i ∈ cube ell) (μ : Fin 3) : ell ^ j ∣ (iota (ell ^ j) Y i μ).val

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_iota.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_iota
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.corner_iota.header:
theorem corner_iota (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hY : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ (Y μ).val) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hi : i ∈ cube ell) : corner (ell ^ (j + 1)) (iota (ell ^ j) Y i) = Y

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.idx_mem_cube.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.idx_mem_cube
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.idx_mem_cube.header:
theorem idx_mem_cube (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ j ∣ (y μ).val) :
    idx (ell ^ j) (ell ^ (j + 1)) y ∈ cube ell

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_idx.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_idx
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_idx.header:
theorem iota_idx (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ j ∣ (y μ).val) :
    iota (ell ^ j) (corner (ell ^ (j + 1)) y) (idx (ell ^ j) (ell ^ (j + 1)) y) = y

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.idx_iota.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.idx_iota
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.idx_iota.header:
theorem idx_iota (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hY : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ (Y μ).val) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hi : i ∈ cube ell) : idx (ell ^ j) (ell ^ (j + 1)) (iota (ell ^ j) Y i) = i

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_inj.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_inj
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_inj.header:
theorem iota_inj (Y Y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hY : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ (Y μ).val)
    (hY' : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ (Y' μ).val) (i i' : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hi : i ∈ cube ell) (hi' : i' ∈ cube ell)
    (h : iota (ell ^ j) Y i = iota (ell ^ j) Y' i') : Y = Y' ∧ i = i'

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_stepBlock_cube.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_stepBlock_cube
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_stepBlock_cube.header:
theorem sum_stepBlock_cube {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hY : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ (Y μ).val) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M) :
    ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf Y (ell ^ j) ell, g x = ∑ i ∈ cube ell, g (iota (ell ^ j) Y i)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.GQ.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.GQ
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.GQ.header: abbrev GQ (ell j : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) : TowerGeom L

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qa.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qa
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qa.header:
noncomputable def Qa (ell j : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ) (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qa_flat.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qa_flat
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qa_flat.header:
theorem Qa_flat (ell j : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ)
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Qa ell j Rg i f z = ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ i) • ∑ x ∈ blockOf z (ell ^ i), f x

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.rowE.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.rowE
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.rowE.header:
noncomputable def rowE (ell j : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (a : ℝ) (i : ℕ)
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.rowF.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.rowF
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.rowF.header:
noncomputable def rowF (ell j : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (a : ℝ) (i : ℕ)
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.rowS.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.rowS
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.rowS.header:
noncomputable def rowS (ell j : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (a : ℝ) (i : ℕ)
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.rowE_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.rowE_nonneg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.rowE_nonneg.header:
theorem rowE_nonneg (ell j : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (i : ℕ)
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) : 0 ≤ rowE ell j Rg a i f b

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.rowF_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.rowF_nonneg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.rowF_nonneg.header:
theorem rowF_nonneg (ell j : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (i : ℕ)
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) : 0 ≤ rowF ell j Rg a i f b

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.norm_add3_sq_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.norm_add3_sq_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.norm_add3_sq_le.header:
theorem norm_add3_sq_le {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (x y z : E) :
    ‖x + y + z‖ ^ 2 ≤ 3 * (‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖y‖ ^ 2 + ‖z‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_subtype_ite.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_subtype_ite
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_subtype_ite.header:
theorem sum_subtype_ite {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (S : Set α) [DecidablePred (· ∈ S)] {F : Fintype {x // x ∈ S}}
    (g : α → ℝ) : ∑ x : {x // x ∈ S}, g x.1 = ∑ x, if x ∈ S then g x else 0

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.row_lat.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.row_lat
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.row_lat.header:
theorem row_lat (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ j + 1) (b : Bond L) (hb : b ∈ bondsLam (GQ ell j Rg) i) :
    OnLat (ell ^ i) b.1 ∧ OnLat (ell ^ i) (coarseShift b.1 (ell ^ i) b.2)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mass_term.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mass_term
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mass_term.header:
theorem mass_term (v : SiteL2 L) (a : ℝ) (p : BIdx (GQ ell j Rg)) :
    a * ((GQ ell j Rg).ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ) * ‖(QfullOf (GQ ell j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg L) (gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) v)).ofLp p‖ ^ 2
      = rowE ell j Rg a p.1 v.ofLp p.2.1

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mass_ge.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mass_ge
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mass_ge.header:
theorem mass_ge (v : SiteL2 L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    rowS ell j Rg a j v.ofLp + rowS ell j Rg a (j + 1) v.ofLp
      ≤ massP (GQ ell j Rg) a (gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) v)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qa_cell.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qa_cell
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qa_cell.header:
theorem Qa_cell (v : SiteL2 L) (hv : v ∈ (NQp (GQ ell j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg L))ᗮ) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hc : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ j ∣ (c μ).val) : Qa ell j Rg j v.ofLp c = v.ofLp c

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qa_Rg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qa_Rg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qa_Rg.header:
theorem Qa_Rg (v : SiteL2 L) (hv : v ∈ (NQp (GQ ell j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg L))ᗮ) (Z : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hZ : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ (Z μ).val) (hZR : Z ∈ Rg) : Qa ell j Rg (j + 1) v.ofLp Z = v.ofLp Z

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qa_big.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qa_big
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Qa_big.header:
theorem Qa_big (v : SiteL2 L) (hv : v ∈ (NQp (GQ ell j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg L))ᗮ) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hY : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ (Y μ).val) :
    Qa ell j Rg (j + 1) v.ofLp Y = ((1 : ℝ) / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) • ∑ i ∈ cube ell, v.ofLp (iota (ell ^ j) Y i)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.omGe_Rg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.omGe_Rg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.omGe_Rg.header: theorem omGe_Rg (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (h : OmGe (GQ ell j Rg) (j + 1) z) : z ∈ Rg

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.crossing.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.crossing
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.crossing.header:
theorem crossing (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ j ∣ (y μ).val) (μ : Fin 3)
    (hne : corner (ell ^ (j + 1)) (coarseShift y (ell ^ j) μ) ≠ corner (ell ^ (j + 1)) y) :
    corner (ell ^ (j + 1)) (coarseShift y (ell ^ j) μ) = coarseShift (corner (ell ^ (j + 1)) y) (ell ^ (j + 1)) μ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.dev.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.dev
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.dev.header:
noncomputable def dev (ell j : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.dev_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.dev_nonneg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.dev_nonneg.header:
theorem dev_nonneg (ell j : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 0 ≤ dev ell j Rg f z

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Dsum.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Dsum
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Dsum.header: noncomputable def Dsum (ell j : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.NuOf.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.NuOf
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.NuOf.header: def NuOf (n : ℕ) (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : Fin 3 → ℕ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.hNuOf.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.hNuOf
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.hNuOf.header: theorem hNuOf : ∀ μ : Fin 3, L μ + 1 = NuOf (ell ^ j) L μ * ell ^ j

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.dev_ge.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.dev_ge
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.dev_ge.header:
theorem dev_ge (v : SiteL2 L) (hv : v ∈ (NQp (GQ ell j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg L))ᗮ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ‖v.ofLp z - Qa ell j Rg (j + 1) v.ofLp (corner (ell ^ (j + 1)) z)‖ ^ 2 ≤ dev ell j Rg v.ofLp z

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.edge_bound.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.edge_bound
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.edge_bound.header:
theorem edge_bound (v : SiteL2 L) (hv : v ∈ (NQp (GQ ell j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg L))ᗮ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ j ∣ (y μ).val) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ‖v.ofLp (coarseShift y (ell ^ j) μ) - v.ofLp y‖ ^ 2
      ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ j / a) * rowF ell j Rg a j v.ofLp (y, μ)
        + 3 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) / a) * rowF ell j Rg a (j + 1) v.ofLp (corner (ell ^ (j + 1)) y, μ)
        + 3 * dev ell j Rg v.ofLp (coarseShift y (ell ^ j) μ) + 3 * dev ell j Rg v.ofLp y

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.fiber_card.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.fiber_card
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.fiber_card.header:
theorem fiber_card (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun y : PeriodicLatticeSite L => OnLatN (ell ^ j) y)).filter
      (fun y => corner (ell ^ (j + 1)) y = Y)).card ≤ ell ^ 3

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_fiber.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_fiber
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_fiber.header:
theorem sum_fiber (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (hg : ∀ Y, 0 ≤ g Y) :
    ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if OnLatN (ell ^ j) y then g (corner (ell ^ (j + 1)) y) else 0)
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * ∑ Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, g Y

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_shift_corner.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_shift_corner
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_shift_corner.header:
theorem sum_shift_corner (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if OnLatN (ell ^ j) y then g (coarseShift y (ell ^ j) μ) else 0)
      = ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if OnLatN (ell ^ j) y then g y else 0)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.epsN_split.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.epsN_split
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.epsN_split.header:
theorem epsN_split (v : SiteL2 L) (hv : v ∈ (NQp (GQ ell j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg L))ᗮ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    epsN (ell ^ j) v.ofLp
      ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ j / a) * rowS ell j Rg a j v.ofLp
        + 3 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) / a) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * rowS ell j Rg a (j + 1) v.ofLp)
        + 18 * Dsum ell j Rg v.ofLp

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Eblk.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Eblk
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Eblk.header:
noncomputable def Eblk (ell j : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (a : ℝ) (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)
    (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Eblk_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Eblk_nonneg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Eblk_nonneg.header:
theorem Eblk_nonneg (ell j : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 0 ≤ Eblk ell j Rg a f Y

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_edge.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_edge
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_edge.header:
theorem cube_edge (v : SiteL2 L) (hv : v ∈ (NQp (GQ ell j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg L))ᗮ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hY : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ (Y μ).val) (hYR : Y ∉ Rg)
    (ν : Fin 3) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hi : i ∈ cube ell) (hiν : i ν + 1 < ell) :
    ‖v.ofLp (iota (ell ^ j) Y (Function.update i ν (i ν + 1))) - v.ofLp (iota (ell ^ j) Y i)‖ ^ 2
      = (ell : ℝ) ^ j / a * rowF ell j Rg a j v.ofLp (iota (ell ^ j) Y i, ν)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.dev_le_cube.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.dev_le_cube
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.dev_le_cube.header:
theorem dev_le_cube (v : SiteL2 L) (hv : v ∈ (NQp (GQ ell j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg L))ᗮ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : OnLatN (ell ^ j) y) (hyR : y ∉ Rg) :
    dev ell j Rg v.ofLp y ≤ 9 * ell * ((ell : ℝ) ^ j / a) * Eblk ell j Rg a v.ofLp (corner (ell ^ (j + 1)) y)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_cube_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_cube_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_cube_le.header:
theorem sum_cube_le (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (ν : Fin 3) :
    ∑ Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if (∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ (Y μ).val) then
        ∑ i ∈ (cube ell).filter (fun i => i ν + 1 < ell), rowF ell j Rg a j f (iota (ell ^ j) Y i, ν) else 0)
      ≤ ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, rowF ell j Rg a j f (y, ν)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Dsum_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Dsum_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Dsum_le.header:
theorem Dsum_le (v : SiteL2 L) (hv : v ∈ (NQp (GQ ell j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg L))ᗮ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    Dsum ell j Rg v.ofLp ≤ 9 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ j / a) * rowS ell j Rg a j v.ofLp

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.epsN_le_mass.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.epsN_le_mass
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.epsN_le_mass.header:
theorem epsN_le_mass (v : SiteL2 L) (hv : v ∈ (NQp (GQ ell j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg L))ᗮ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    epsN (ell ^ j) v.ofLp
      ≤ (1 + 165 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ j / a) * massP (GQ ell j Rg) a (gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) v)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.CS.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.CS
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.CS.header: noncomputable def CS (ell : ℕ) (a : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_cells.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_cells
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_cells.header:
theorem sum_cells (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, g x
      = ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if OnLatN (ell ^ j) y then ∑ x ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), g x else 0)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.epsN_le_norm.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.epsN_le_norm
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.epsN_le_norm.header:
theorem epsN_le_norm (w : SiteL2 L) (hw : ∀ x, w.ofLp x = w.ofLp (corner (ell ^ j) x)) :
    epsN (ell ^ j) w.ofLp ≤ 12 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ j) ^ 3 * ‖w‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemS_patch.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemS_patch
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemS_patch.header:
theorem lemS_patch (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (φ : SiteL2 L)
    (hφ : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GQ ell j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg L), ⟪gradAdj (flatCfg : Cfg L) (gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) φ), ν⟫ = 0) :
    ‖gradAdj (flatCfg : Cfg L) (gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) φ)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ CS ell a * PhiP (GQ ell j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg L) a (gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) φ)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemS.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemS
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemS.header:
theorem lemS (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∀ (j : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu))),
      BlockClosed (ell ^ (j + 1)) Rg →
      ∀ φ : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu),
        (∀ ν ∈ NQp (GP ell j Lu Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg _), ⟪gradAdj (flatCfg : Cfg _) (gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg _) φ), ν⟫ = 0) →
        ‖gradAdj (flatCfg : Cfg _) (gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg _) φ)‖ ^ 2
          ≤ CS ell a * PhiP (GP ell j Lu Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg _) a (gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg _) φ)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.LemV.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.LemV
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.LemV.header: def LemV (ell : ℕ) (a K : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.hodge_split.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.hodge_split
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.hodge_split.header:
theorem hodge_split (y : BondFnL2 L) :
    ∃ φ : SiteL2 L, gradAdj (flatCfg : Cfg L) (y - gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) φ) = 0

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemIFlat_of_lemV.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemIFlat_of_lemV
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemIFlat_of_lemV.header:
theorem lemIFlat_of_lemV (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (a K : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hV : LemV ell a K) :
    LemIFlat ell a (CS ell a * K)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.w3flat_of_LemV.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.w3flat_of_LemV
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.w3flat_of_LemV.header:
theorem w3flat_of_LemV {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a K : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hV : LemV ell a K) :
    W3FlatStmt ell (by omega) a

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off.header: def off (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (u : Fin 3 → ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_add.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_add
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_add.header: theorem off_add (u v : Fin 3 → ℕ) : off L (u + v) = off L u + off L v

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_smul.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_smul
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_smul.header: theorem off_smul (m : ℕ) (u : Fin 3 → ℕ) : off L (m • u) = m • off L u

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_val.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_val
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_val.header: theorem off_val (u : Fin 3 → ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : ((off L u) μ).val = u μ % (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_single.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_single
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_single.header: theorem off_single (μ : Fin 3) (t : ℕ) : off L (Pi.single μ t) = t • eU L μ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_eq_sum.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_eq_sum.header:
theorem off_eq_sum (u : Fin 3 → ℕ) :
    off L u = u 0 • eU L 0 + u 1 • eU L 1 + u 2 • eU L 2

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.E1.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.E1
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.E1.header: noncomputable def E1 (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.E1_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.E1_nonneg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.E1_nonneg.header: theorem E1_nonneg (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : 0 ≤ E1 f

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv.header: noncomputable def tv (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (d : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : SiteL2 L

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv_norm_sq.header:
theorem tv_norm_sq (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (d : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ‖tv f d‖ ^ 2 = ∑ x, ‖f (x + d) - f x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_translate.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_translate
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_translate.header:
theorem sum_translate {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M) (d : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ∑ x, g (x + d) = ∑ x, g x

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv_add.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv_add
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv_add.header:
theorem tv_add (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (d d' : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ‖tv f (d + d')‖ ≤ ‖tv f d‖ + ‖tv f d'‖

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv_nsmul.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv_nsmul
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv_nsmul.header:
theorem tv_nsmul (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (d : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (m : ℕ) :
    ‖tv f (m • d)‖ ≤ m * ‖tv f d‖

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv_off.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv_off
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv_off.header:
theorem tv_off (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (u : Fin 3 → ℕ) :
    ‖tv f (off L u)‖ ≤ u 0 * ‖tv f (eU L 0)‖ + u 1 * ‖tv f (eU L 1)‖ + u 2 * ‖tv f (eU L 2)‖

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.E1_eq.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.E1_eq
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.E1_eq.header:
theorem E1_eq (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    E1 f = ‖tv f (eU L 0)‖ ^ 2 + ‖tv f (eU L 1)‖ ^ 2 + ‖tv f (eU L 2)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv_off_sq.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv_off_sq
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tv_off_sq.header:
theorem tv_off_sq (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (u : Fin 3 → ℕ) :
    ‖tv f (off L u)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((l1 u : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * E1 f

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.trans_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.trans_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.trans_le.header:
theorem trans_le (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (a b : Fin 3 → ℕ) :
    ∑ x, ‖f (x + off L a) - f (x + off L b)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 2 * (((l1 a : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 + ((l1 b : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) * E1 f

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.norm_sum_sq_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.norm_sum_sq_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.norm_sum_sq_le.header:
theorem norm_sum_sq_le {ι E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → E) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ s, w i‖ ^ 2 ≤ s.card * ∑ i ∈ s, ‖w i‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cross_eq.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cross_eq
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cross_eq.header:
theorem cross_eq (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (a (x + eU L μ, ν) - a (x, ν)) * (a (x + eU L ν, μ) - a (x, μ))
      = ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (a (x - eU L μ, μ) - a (x, μ)) * (a (x - eU L ν, ν) - a (x, ν))

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.hodge_real.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.hodge_real
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.hodge_real.header:
theorem hodge_real :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ ν : Fin 3, (a (x + eU L ν, μ) - a (x, μ)) ^ 2
      = ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ ν : Fin 3, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (crl a x μ ν) ^ 2
        + ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (∑ μ : Fin 3, (a (x - eU L μ, μ) - a (x, μ))) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum4_comm.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum4_comm
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum4_comm.header:
theorem sum4_comm {A B C D : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype C] [Fintype D] (F : A → B → C → D → ℝ) :
    ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ d, F a b c d = ∑ d, ∑ c, ∑ a, ∑ b, F a b c d

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.hodge.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.hodge
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.hodge.header:
theorem hodge (c : BondFnL2 L) :
    ∑ μ : Fin 3, E1 (fun x => c.ofLp (x, μ))
      = ‖AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKFull.curlCovariantCLM_L2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) c‖ ^ 2
        + ‖gradAdj (flatCfg : Cfg L) c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.coarseShift_eq.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.coarseShift_eq
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.coarseShift_eq.header: theorem coarseShift_eq (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (m : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : coarseShift y m μ = y + m • eU L μ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.final_alg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.final_alg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.final_alg.header:
theorem final_alg (l2 Gs Gb Fsm Fbg Sx Bx Dx Lx DPh FBs LPh LFv X M Er : ℝ) (hl2 : 1 ≤ l2)
    (hGs : 0 ≤ Gs) (hGb : 0 ≤ Gb) (hFsm : 0 ≤ Fsm) (hFbg : 0 ≤ Fbg)
    (hId : Sx + l2 * Bx = Dx + Lx)
    (hS : 2 * |Sx| ≤ (1 - 1 / (4 * l2)) * Gs + Fsm / (1 - 1 / (4 * l2)))
    (hB : 2 * |Bx| ≤ 6 / 5 * Gb + Fbg / (6 / 5))
    (hD : 2 * |Dx| ≤ l2 * (3 / 4 * DPh + FBs / (3 / 4))) (hDP : DPh ≤ 2 / l2 * Gs) (hFB : FBs ≤ Fbg)
    (hL : 2 * |Lx| ≤ 1 / (432 * l2 ^ 2) * LPh + LFv / (1 / (432 * l2 ^ 2)))
    (hLP : LPh ≤ 54 * l2 ^ 2 * Gs) (hLF : LFv ≤ X)
    (hMf : Gs + Gb + Fsm + Fbg + 2 * Sx + 2 * Bx ≤ 2 * M + Er) :
    Gs + Gb ≤ 64 * l2 * M + 32 * l2 * Er + 3456 * l2 ^ 2 * X

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.term_ineq.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.term_ineq
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.term_ineq.header:
theorem term_ineq (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (d F q : SuTwo) :
    m⁻¹ * ‖d‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ⟪d, F⟫ + m * ‖F‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (m * ‖m⁻¹ • d + q‖ ^ 2) + 2 * (m * ‖q - F‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mask_univ.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mask_univ
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mask_univ.header:
theorem mask_univ (f : AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantHjMinimizer.PlaqFnL2 L) :
    AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.plaqMask (plaqIn (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L))) f = f

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_rows_j.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_rows_j
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_rows_j.header:
theorem mem_rows_j (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((x, μ) : Bond L) ∈ bondsLam (GQ ell j Rg) j ↔ OnLatN (ell ^ j) x ∧ x ∉ Rg ∧ x + ell ^ j • eU L μ ∉ Rg

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_rows_succ.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_rows_succ
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_rows_succ.header:
theorem mem_rows_succ (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((x, μ) : Bond L) ∈ bondsLam (GQ ell j Rg) (j + 1)
      ↔ OnLatN (ell ^ j * ell) x ∧ (x ∈ Rg ∨ x + (ell ^ j * ell) • eU L μ ∈ Rg)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.PhiP_patch.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.PhiP_patch
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.PhiP_patch.header:
theorem PhiP_patch (a : ℝ) (y : BondFnL2 L) :
    PhiP (GQ ell j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg L) a y
      = ‖AdalyFormal.Balaban.DeltaKFull.curlCovariantCLM_L2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) y‖ ^ 2 + massP (GQ ell j Rg) a y

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.level_j_rows.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.level_j_rows
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.level_j_rows.header:
theorem level_j_rows (a : ℝ) (y : BondFnL2 L) :
    ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b => b ∈ bondsLam (GQ ell j Rg) j), a * (ell : ℝ) ^ j * ‖AdalyFormal.M1Patch.rv ell y j b‖ ^ 2
      = a * ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ z ∈ latF L (ell ^ j), (if z ∉ Rg ∧ z + ell ^ j • eU L μ ∉ Rg then
          ((ell ^ j : ℕ) : ℝ) * ‖Rw (ell ^ j) y.ofLp z μ‖ ^ 2 else 0)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.level_succ_rows.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.level_succ_rows
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.level_succ_rows.header:
theorem level_succ_rows (a : ℝ) (y : BondFnL2 L) :
    ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b => b ∈ bondsLam (GQ ell j Rg) (j + 1)),
        a * (ell : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) * ‖AdalyFormal.M1Patch.rv ell y (j + 1) b‖ ^ 2
      = a * ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ Z ∈ latF L (ell ^ j * ell), (if Z ∈ Rg ∨ Z + (ell ^ j * ell) • eU L μ ∈ Rg then
          ((ell ^ j * ell : ℕ) : ℝ) * ‖Rw (ell ^ j * ell) y.ofLp Z μ‖ ^ 2 else 0)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.massP_rows.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.massP_rows
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.massP_rows.header:
theorem massP_rows (a : ℝ) (y : BondFnL2 L) :
    massP (GQ ell j Rg) a y = a * (∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ z ∈ latF L (ell ^ j), (if z ∉ Rg ∧ z + ell ^ j • eU L μ ∉ Rg then
          ((ell ^ j : ℕ) : ℝ) * ‖Rw (ell ^ j) y.ofLp z μ‖ ^ 2 else 0)
      + ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ Z ∈ latF L (ell ^ j * ell), (if Z ∈ Rg ∨ Z + (ell ^ j * ell) • eU L μ ∈ Rg then
          ((ell ^ j * ell : ℕ) : ℝ) * ‖Rw (ell ^ j * ell) y.ofLp Z μ‖ ^ 2 else 0))

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.KV.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.KV
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.KV.header: noncomputable def KV (ell : ℕ) (a : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemV_patch.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemV_patch
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemV_patch.header:
theorem lemV_patch (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (φ : SiteL2 L) (c : BondFnL2 L) (hc : gradAdj (flatCfg : Cfg L) c = 0) :
    PhiP (GQ ell j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg L) a (gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) φ)
      ≤ KV ell a * PhiP (GQ ell j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg L) a (gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) φ + c)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemV.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemV
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemV.header: theorem lemV (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : LemV ell a (KV ell a)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.KV_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.KV_nonneg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.KV_nonneg.header: theorem KV_nonneg (ell : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : 0 ≤ KV ell a

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemIFlat.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemIFlat
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lemIFlat.header: theorem lemIFlat (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) : LemIFlat ell a (CS ell a * KV ell a)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.w3flat.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.w3flat
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.w3flat.header: theorem w3flat {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : W3FlatStmt ell (by omega) a

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.face.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.face
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.face.header: def face (m : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : Finset (Fin 3 → ℕ)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_face.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_face
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_face.header: theorem mem_face (m : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (u : Fin 3 → ℕ) : u ∈ face m μ ↔ (∀ ν, u ν < m) ∧ u μ = 0

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_split.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_split
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_split.header:
theorem cube_split {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (m : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (h : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → M) :
    ∑ u ∈ cube m, h u = ∑ u ∈ face m μ, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range m, h (Function.update u μ t)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.card_face.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.card_face
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.card_face.header: theorem card_face (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (μ : Fin 3) : (face m μ).card = m ^ 2

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_decomp.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_decomp
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_decomp.header:
theorem cube_decomp {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (n ℓ : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (g : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → M) :
    ∑ U ∈ cube (n * ℓ), g U = ∑ k ∈ cube ℓ, ∑ v ∈ cube n, g (n • k + v)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.face_decomp.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.face_decomp
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.face_decomp.header:
theorem face_decomp {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (n ℓ : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (μ : Fin 3) (g : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → M) :
    ∑ U ∈ face (n * ℓ) μ, g U = ∑ k ∈ face ℓ μ, ∑ v ∈ face n μ, g (n • k + v)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_update.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_update
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_update.header:
theorem off_update (u : Fin 3 → ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (hu : u μ = 0) (t : ℕ) :
    off L (Function.update u μ t) = off L u + t • eU L μ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.add_off_val.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.add_off_val
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.add_off_val.header:
theorem add_off_val (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (u : Fin 3 → ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((z + off L u) μ).val = ((z μ).val + u μ) % (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_eq_off.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_eq_off
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.iota_eq_off.header: theorem iota_eq_off (n : ℕ) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ) : iota n Y i = Y + off L (n • i)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.block_cube.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.block_cube
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.block_cube.header:
theorem block_cube {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (m : ℕ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hfit : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (z μ).val + m ≤ L μ + 1) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf z m, g x = ∑ u ∈ cube m, g (z + off L u)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.fit_of_lat.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.fit_of_lat
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.fit_of_lat.header:
theorem fit_of_lat {m : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, m ∣ L μ + 1) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : OnLatN m z)
    (μ : Fin 3) : (z μ).val + m ≤ L μ + 1

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tiling.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tiling
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tiling.header:
theorem tiling {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, n ∣ L μ + 1)
    (H : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M) :
    ∑ x, H x = ∑ z : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if OnLatN n z then ∑ u ∈ cube n, H (z + off L u) else 0)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_add_iff.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_add_iff
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_add_iff.header:
theorem onLat_add_iff {m : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, m ∣ L μ + 1) (z w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hw : OnLatN m w) :
    OnLatN m (z + w) ↔ OnLatN m z

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_smul_eU.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_smul_eU
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_smul_eU.header: theorem onLat_smul_eU {m : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, m ∣ L μ + 1) (μ : Fin 3) : OnLatN m (m • eU L μ)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_neg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_neg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_neg.header:
theorem onLat_neg {m : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, m ∣ L μ + 1) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hw : OnLatN m w) :
    OnLatN m (-w)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lat_translate.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lat_translate
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.lat_translate.header:
theorem lat_translate {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] {m : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, m ∣ L μ + 1)
    (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hw : OnLatN m w) (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M) :
    ∑ z : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if OnLatN m z then h (z + w) else 0)
      = ∑ z : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if OnLatN m z then h z else 0)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.avg_sq_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.avg_sq_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.avg_sq_le.header:
theorem avg_sq_le {ι E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (s : Finset ι) (K : ℝ)
    (hK : (s.card : ℝ) = K) (hKp : 0 < K) (w : ι → E) :
    ‖K⁻¹ • ∑ i ∈ s, w i‖ ^ 2 ≤ K⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ s, ‖w i‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.flx.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.flx
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.flx.header: noncomputable def flx (m : ℕ) (c : Bond L → SuTwo) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Fl.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Fl
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Fl.header: noncomputable def Fl (n m : ℕ) (c : Bond L → SuTwo) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.box_div.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.box_div
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.box_div.header:
theorem box_div (c : Bond L → SuTwo) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∑ u ∈ cube m, (c (w + off L u - eU L μ, μ) - c (w + off L u, μ))
      = ∑ u ∈ face m μ, (c (w + off L u - eU L μ, μ) - c (w + off L u + (m - 1) • eU L μ, μ))

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.flx_cons.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.flx_cons
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.flx_cons.header:
theorem flx_cons (c : BondFnL2 L) (hc : gradAdj (flatCfg : Cfg L) c = 0) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ∑ μ : Fin 3, (flx m c.ofLp (w - m • eU L μ) μ - flx m c.ofLp w μ) = 0

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Fl_cons.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Fl_cons
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Fl_cons.header:
theorem Fl_cons (c : BondFnL2 L) (hc : gradAdj (flatCfg : Cfg L) c = 0) (n m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ∑ μ : Fin 3, (Fl n m c.ofLp (z - m • eU L μ) μ - Fl n m c.ofLp z μ) = 0

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Rw.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Rw
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Rw.header: noncomputable def Rw (m : ℕ) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Phm.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Phm
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Phm.header: noncomputable def Phm (m : ℕ) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Rw_lcr.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Rw_lcr
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Rw_lcr.header:
theorem Rw_lcr (m : ℕ) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.CoarseBond L m)
    (hfit : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ((b.1 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) μ).val + m ≤ L μ + 1) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.LineIntegralCovariant.lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo m A b = Rw m A b.1 b.2

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Rw_add.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Rw_add
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Rw_add.header:
theorem Rw_add (m : ℕ) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    Rw m (A + B) z μ = Rw m A z μ + Rw m B z μ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Rw_grad.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Rw_grad
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Rw_grad.header:
theorem Rw_grad (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (φ : SiteL2 L) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    Rw m (gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) φ).ofLp z μ
      = (((m : ℝ))⁻¹) • (Phm m φ.ofLp (z + m • eU L μ) - Phm m φ.ofLp z)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.l1_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.l1_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.l1_le.header: theorem l1_le (u : Fin 3 → ℕ) (R : ℕ) (h : ∀ ν, u ν ≤ R) : l1 u ≤ 3 * R

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.latF.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.latF
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.latF.header: noncomputable def latF (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (n : ℕ) : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_latF.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_latF
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.mem_latF.header: theorem mem_latF (n : ℕ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : z ∈ latF L n ↔ OnLatN n z

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_latF.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_latF
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_latF.header:
theorem sum_latF {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (n : ℕ) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M) :
    ∑ z ∈ latF L n, g z = ∑ z : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if OnLatN n z then g z else 0)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tiling'.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tiling'
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tiling'.header:
theorem tiling' {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, n ∣ L μ + 1)
    (H : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M) :
    ∑ x, H x = ∑ z ∈ latF L n, ∑ u ∈ cube n, H (z + off L u)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.fsum4.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.fsum4
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.fsum4.header:
theorem fsum4 {A B C D M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (s1 : Finset A) (s2 : Finset B) (s3 : Finset C) (s4 : Finset D)
    (F : A → B → C → D → M) :
    ∑ a ∈ s1, ∑ b ∈ s2, ∑ c ∈ s3, ∑ d ∈ s4, F a b c d = ∑ c ∈ s3, ∑ d ∈ s4, ∑ a ∈ s1, ∑ b ∈ s2, F a b c d

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.pair_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.pair_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.pair_le.header:
theorem pair_le (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, n ∣ L μ + 1)
    {α β : Type*} (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) (hA : 0 < A.card) (hB : 0 < B.card)
    (a : α → Fin 3 → ℕ) (b : β → Fin 3 → ℕ) (R : ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ ν, a x ν ≤ R) (hb : ∀ y ∈ B, ∀ ν, b y ν ≤ R) :
    ∑ z ∈ latF L n,
        ‖((n : ℝ) ^ 3 * A.card)⁻¹ • ∑ u ∈ cube n, ∑ x ∈ A, f (z + off L u + off L (a x))
          - ((n : ℝ) ^ 3 * B.card)⁻¹ • ∑ u ∈ cube n, ∑ y ∈ B, f (z + off L u + off L (b y))‖ ^ 2
      ≤ ((n : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ * (36 * (R : ℝ) ^ 2) * E1 f

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.single_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.single_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.single_le.header: theorem single_le (μ ν : Fin 3) (t : ℕ) : (Pi.single μ t : Fin 3 → ℕ) ν ≤ t

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.face_coord.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.face_coord
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.face_coord.header:
theorem face_coord (m : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (x : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hx : x ∈ face m μ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    (x + (Pi.single μ (m - 1) : Fin 3 → ℕ)) ν ≤ m

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Rw_pair.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Rw_pair
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Rw_pair.header:
theorem Rw_pair (m : ℕ) (c : Bond L → SuTwo) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    Rw m c z μ = ((m : ℝ) ^ 3 * (Finset.range m).card)⁻¹ •
      ∑ u ∈ cube m, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range m, c (z + off L u + off L ((Pi.single μ t : Fin 3 → ℕ)), μ)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Fl_pair.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Fl_pair
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Fl_pair.header:
theorem Fl_pair (n m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (c : Bond L → SuTwo) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    (a : Fin 3 → ℕ) :
    Fl n m c (z + off L a) μ = ((n : ℝ) ^ 3 * (face m μ).card)⁻¹ •
      ∑ v ∈ cube n, ∑ x ∈ face m μ, c (z + off L v + off L (a + (x + (Pi.single μ (m - 1) : Fin 3 → ℕ))), μ)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.err_small.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.err_small
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.err_small.header:
theorem err_small (c : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, n ∣ L ν + 1) :
    ∑ z ∈ latF L n, (n : ℝ) * ‖Rw n c z μ - Fl n n c z μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ 36 * E1 (fun x => c (x, μ))
