AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.err_big.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.err_big
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.err_big.header:
theorem err_big (c : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) {n ℓ : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ)
    (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, n ∣ L ν + 1) :
    ∑ Z ∈ latF L (n * ℓ), ((n * ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) * ‖Rw (n * ℓ) c Z μ - Fl n (n * ℓ) c Z μ‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 144 * (ℓ : ℝ) ^ 3 * E1 (fun x => c (x, μ))

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Fl_shift.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Fl_shift
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Fl_shift.header:
theorem Fl_shift (c : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, n ∣ L ν + 1)
    (a b : Fin 3 → ℕ) (R : ℕ) (ha : ∀ ν, a ν ≤ R) (hb : ∀ ν, b ν ≤ R) :
    ∑ z ∈ latF L n, ‖Fl n n c (z + off L a) μ - Fl n n c (z + off L b) μ‖ ^ 2
      ≤ ((n : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ * (36 * ((R + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) * E1 (fun x => c (x, μ))

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.parts_small.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.parts_small
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.parts_small.header:
theorem parts_small :
    ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ z ∈ latF L m,
        (if z ∉ Rg ∧ z + m • eU L μ ∉ Rg then ⟪Φ (z + m • eU L μ) - Φ z, F z μ⟫ else 0)
      = ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ z ∈ latF L m,
        (if z ∉ Rg then
          ((if z + m • eU L μ ∈ Rg then ⟪Φ z, F z μ⟫ else 0)
            - (if z - m • eU L μ ∈ Rg then ⟪Φ z, F (z - m • eU L μ) μ⟫ else 0)) else 0)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.parts_big.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.parts_big
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.parts_big.header:
theorem parts_big :
    ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ Z ∈ latF L m,
        (if Z ∈ Rg ∨ Z + m • eU L μ ∈ Rg then ⟪Φ (Z + m • eU L μ) - Φ Z, F Z μ⟫ else 0)
      = ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ Z ∈ latF L m,
        (if Z ∉ Rg then
          ((if Z - m • eU L μ ∈ Rg then ⟪Φ Z, F (Z - m • eU L μ) μ⟫ else 0)
            - (if Z + m • eU L μ ∈ Rg then ⟪Φ Z, F Z μ⟫ else 0)) else 0)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_layer.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_layer
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cube_layer.header:
theorem cube_layer {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (m : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (s : ℕ) (hs : s < m)
    (g : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → M) :
    ∑ i ∈ cube m, (if i μ = s then g i else 0) = ∑ k ∈ face m μ, g (Function.update k μ s)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.face_le_cube.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.face_le_cube
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.face_le_cube.header:
theorem face_le_cube (m : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (s : ℕ) (hs : s < m) (g : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → ℝ) (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ g i) :
    ∑ k ∈ face m μ, g (Function.update k μ s) ≤ ∑ i ∈ cube m, g i

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.card_face_real.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.card_face_real
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.card_face_real.header: theorem card_face_real (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (μ : Fin 3) : ((face m μ).card : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.layer_alg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.layer_alg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.layer_alg.header:
theorem layer_alg {ι E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (s : Finset ι)
    (Φ F : ι → E) (P Fb : E) (K : ℝ) (hK0 : K ≠ 0) (hK : (s.card : ℝ) = K) (hF : ∑ k ∈ s, F k = K • Fb) :
    ∑ k ∈ s, ⟪Φ k, F k⟫ - K * ⟪P, Fb⟫
      = K * ⟪K⁻¹ • ∑ k ∈ s, Φ k - P, Fb⟫ + ∑ k ∈ s, ⟪Φ k - P, F k - Fb⟫

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.amgm.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.amgm
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.amgm.header:
theorem amgm {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (x y : E) (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    2 * |⟪x, y⟫| ≤ p * ‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖y‖ ^ 2 / p

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeEd.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeEd
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeEd.header: noncomputable def cubeEd {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (m : ℕ) (W : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → E) (μ : Fin 3) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeE_eq.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeE_eq
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeE_eq.header:
theorem cubeE_eq {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (m : ℕ) (W : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → E) :
    cubeE m W = ∑ μ : Fin 3, cubeEd m W μ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeEd_eq.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeEd_eq
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeEd_eq.header:
theorem cubeEd_eq {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (m : ℕ) (W : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → E) (μ : Fin 3) :
    cubeEd m W μ = ∑ k ∈ face m μ, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (m - 1),
      ‖W (Function.update k μ (t + 1)) - W (Function.update k μ t)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.layer_dev.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.layer_dev
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.layer_dev.header:
theorem layer_dev {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (W : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → E) (μ : Fin 3) (s : ℕ) (hs : s < m) :
    ‖((m : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ • ∑ k ∈ face m μ, W (Function.update k μ s) - ((m : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ • ∑ i ∈ cube m, W i‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (m : ℝ)⁻¹ * cubeEd m W μ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tz.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tz
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tz.header: def tz (n ℓ : ℕ) (Z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (k : Fin 3 → ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bz.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bz
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bz.header: def bz (n : ℕ) (Z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (k : Fin 3 → ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_smul_update.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_smul_update
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.off_smul_update.header:
theorem off_smul_update (n : ℕ) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (s : ℕ) :
    off L (n • i) = off L (n • Function.update i μ s) + (n * i μ) • eU L μ - (n * s) • eU L μ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.nat_layer.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.nat_layer
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.nat_layer.header: theorem nat_layer (n ℓ : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) : n * (ℓ - 1) + (n - 1) = n * ℓ - 1

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.face_rel.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.face_rel
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.face_rel.header:
theorem face_rel (c : Bond L → SuTwo) (n ℓ : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (Z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    Fl n (n * ℓ) c Z μ = (((ℓ : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ∑ k ∈ face ℓ μ, Fl n n c (tz n ℓ Z k μ) μ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.regroup.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.regroup
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.regroup.header:
theorem regroup {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M) :
    ∑ z ∈ latF L (ell ^ j), h z = ∑ Z ∈ latF L (ell ^ j * ell), ∑ i ∈ cube ell, h (Z + off L (ell ^ j • i))

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cell_Rg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cell_Rg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cell_Rg.header:
theorem cell_Rg (Z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hZ : OnLatN (ell ^ j * ell) Z) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hi : i ∈ cube ell) :
    Z + off L (ell ^ j • i) ∈ Rg ↔ Z ∈ Rg

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.up_Rg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.up_Rg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.up_Rg.header:
theorem up_Rg (Z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hZ : OnLatN (ell ^ j * ell) Z) (hZR : Z ∉ Rg) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hi : i ∈ cube ell) (μ : Fin 3) :
    Z + off L (ell ^ j • i) + ell ^ j • eU L μ ∈ Rg ↔ (i μ = ell - 1 ∧ Z + (ell ^ j * ell) • eU L μ ∈ Rg)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.down_Rg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.down_Rg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.down_Rg.header:
theorem down_Rg (Z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hZ : OnLatN (ell ^ j * ell) Z) (hZR : Z ∉ Rg) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hi : i ∈ cube ell) (μ : Fin 3) :
    Z + off L (ell ^ j • i) - ell ^ j • eU L μ ∈ Rg ↔ (i μ = 0 ∧ Z - (ell ^ j * ell) • eU L μ ∈ Rg)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Ptop.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Ptop
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Ptop.header: noncomputable def Ptop (Z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Pbot.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Pbot
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.Pbot.header: noncomputable def Pbot (Z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tz_eq.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tz_eq
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tz_eq.header:
theorem tz_eq (n ℓ : ℕ) (Z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (k : Fin 3 → ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (hk : k ∈ face ℓ μ) :
    Z + off L (n • Function.update k μ (ℓ - 1)) = tz n ℓ Z k μ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bz_eq.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bz_eq
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bz_eq.header:
theorem bz_eq (n ℓ : ℕ) (Z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (k : Fin 3 → ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (hk : k ∈ face ℓ μ) :
    Z + off L (n • Function.update k μ 0) = bz n Z k

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tz_down.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tz_down
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.tz_down.header:
theorem tz_down (n ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (Z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (k : Fin 3 → ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    tz n ℓ (Z - (n * ℓ) • eU L μ) k μ = bz n Z k - n • eU L μ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.hdn.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.hdn
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.hdn.header: theorem hdn : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ j ∣ L μ + 1

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.small_regroup.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.small_regroup
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.small_regroup.header:
theorem small_regroup (X Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ z ∈ latF L (ell ^ j),
      (if z ∉ Rg then ((if z + ell ^ j • eU L μ ∈ Rg then X z μ else 0)
        - (if z - ell ^ j • eU L μ ∈ Rg then Y z μ else 0)) else 0)
    = ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ Z ∈ latF L (ell ^ j * ell),
      (if Z ∉ Rg then ((if Z + (ell ^ j * ell) • eU L μ ∈ Rg then ∑ k ∈ face ell μ, X (tz (ell ^ j) ell Z k μ) μ else 0)
        - (if Z - (ell ^ j * ell) • eU L μ ∈ Rg then ∑ k ∈ face ell μ, Y (bz (ell ^ j) Z k) μ else 0)) else 0)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.key_identity.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.key_identity
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.key_identity.header:
theorem key_identity (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (c : BondFnL2 L) (hc : gradAdj (flatCfg : Cfg L) c = 0) :
    Sx ell j Rg φ c.ofLp + (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Bx ell j Rg φ c.ofLp = Dx ell j Rg φ c.ofLp + Lx ell j Rg φ c.ofLp

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.two_abs_sum_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.two_abs_sum_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.two_abs_sum_le.header:
theorem two_abs_sum_le {ι κ : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (a b : ι → κ → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ k ∈ t, 2 * |a i k| ≤ b i k) :
    2 * |∑ i ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ t, a i k| ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ t, b i k

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.dev_avg.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.dev_avg
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.dev_avg.header:
theorem dev_avg {ι E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (s : Finset ι) (K : ℝ)
    (hK : (s.card : ℝ) = K) (hKp : 0 < K) (x : ι → E) (k : ι) :
    ‖x k - K⁻¹ • ∑ k' ∈ s, x k'‖ ^ 2 ≤ K⁻¹ * ∑ k' ∈ s, ‖x k - x k'‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_mul_smul.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_mul_smul
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.onLat_mul_smul.header:
theorem onLat_mul_smul {m : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, m ∣ L μ + 1) (r : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    OnLatN m ((m * r) • eU L μ)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.two_abs_ite.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.two_abs_ite
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.two_abs_ite.header:
theorem two_abs_ite (C : Prop) [Decidable C] (x y : ℝ) (h : C → 2 * |x| ≤ y) :
    2 * |(if C then x else 0)| ≤ (if C then y else 0)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.two_abs_ite_sub.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.two_abs_ite_sub
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.two_abs_ite_sub.header:
theorem two_abs_ite_sub (A B : Prop) [Decidable A] [Decidable B] (a b a' b' : ℝ)
    (ha : A → 2 * |a| ≤ a') (hb : B → 2 * |b| ≤ b') :
    2 * |(if A then a else 0) - (if B then b else 0)| ≤ (if A then a' else 0) + (if B then b' else 0)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_lin2.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_lin2
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.sum_lin2.header:
theorem sum_lin2 {ι κ : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (f g h : ι → κ → ℝ) (A B : ℝ)
    (hpt : ∀ i k, f i k = A * g i k + h i k * B) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ t, f i k = A * ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ t, g i k + (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ t, h i k) * B

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.two_abs_inner_sum.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.two_abs_inner_sum
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.two_abs_inner_sum.header:
theorem two_abs_inner_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (x y : ι → SuTwo) (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    2 * |∑ k ∈ s, ⟪x k, y k⟫| ≤ ∑ k ∈ s, (p * ‖x k‖ ^ 2 + ‖y k‖ ^ 2 / p)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_S.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_S
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_S.header:
theorem bound_S (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    2 * |Sx ell j Rg φ c| ≤ α * Gs ell j Rg φ + Fsm ell j Rg c / α

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_B.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_B
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_B.header:
theorem bound_B (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    2 * |Bx ell j Rg φ c| ≤ t * Gb ell j Rg φ + Fbg ell j Rg c / t

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_D.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_D
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_D.header:
theorem bound_D (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    2 * |Dx ell j Rg φ c| ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * (τ * DPh ell j Rg φ + FBs ell j Rg c / τ)

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_L.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_L
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_L.header:
theorem bound_L (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    2 * |Lx ell j Rg φ c| ≤ ρ * LPh ell j Rg φ + LF ell j Rg c / ρ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.phm_big.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.phm_big
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.phm_big.header:
theorem phm_big (n ℓ : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (Z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Phm (n * ℓ) φ Z = (((ℓ : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹) • ∑ i ∈ cube ℓ, Phm n φ (Z + off L (n • i))

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cell_up.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cell_up
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cell_up.header:
theorem cell_up (n : ℕ) (Z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (i : Fin 3 → ℕ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    Z + off L (n • Function.update i ν (i ν + 1)) = Z + off L (n • i) + n • eU L ν

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.le_ite_self.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.le_ite_self
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.le_ite_self.header: theorem le_ite_self (A : Prop) [Decidable A] (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : (if A then x else 0) ≤ x

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeE_le.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeE_le
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.cubeE_le.header:
theorem cubeE_le (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ Z ∈ latF L (ell ^ j * ell), (if Z ∉ Rg then cubeE ell (fun i => Phm (ell ^ j) φ (Z + off L (ell ^ j • i))) else 0)
      ≤ ((ell ^ j : ℕ) : ℝ) * Gs ell j Rg φ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_DPh.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_DPh
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_DPh.header:
theorem bound_DPh (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    DPh ell j Rg φ ≤ 2 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Gs ell j Rg φ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_LPh.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_LPh
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_LPh.header:
theorem bound_LPh (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    LPh ell j Rg φ ≤ 54 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4 * Gs ell j Rg φ

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_FBs.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_FBs
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_FBs.header:
theorem bound_FBs (c : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    FBs ell j Rg c ≤ Fbg ell j Rg c

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.layer_var.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.layer_var
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.layer_var.header:
theorem layer_var (c : Bond L → SuTwo) (μ : Fin 3) (σ : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hσ : OnLatN (ell ^ j) σ) :
    ∑ Z ∈ latF L (ell ^ j * ell), ∑ k ∈ face ell μ, ((ell ^ j : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      ‖Fl (ell ^ j) (ell ^ j) c (Z + σ + off L (ell ^ j • k)) μ
        - (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ∑ k' ∈ face ell μ, Fl (ell ^ j) (ell ^ j) c (Z + σ + off L (ell ^ j • k')) μ‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 36 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((ell : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * E1 (fun x => c (x, μ))

AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_LF.name: AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_LF
AdalyFormal.LemIFlat.bound_LF.header:
theorem bound_LF (c : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    LF ell j Rg c ≤ 72 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((ell : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * ∑ μ : Fin 3, E1 (fun x => c (x, μ))

HConstruction.DRepair.Reproduced.stepLif.name: HConstruction.DRepair.Reproduced.stepLift
HConstruction.DRepair.Reproduced.stepLif.header:
noncomputable def stepLift (s ell : ℕ) (F : CoarseBond L (s * ell) → SuTwo)
    (e : CoarseBond L s) : SuTwo

HConstruction.DRepair.Reproduced.stepLif.name: HConstruction.DRepair.Reproduced.stepLift_add
HConstruction.DRepair.Reproduced.stepLif.header:
theorem stepLift_add (s ell : ℕ) (F G : CoarseBond L (s * ell) → SuTwo) (e : CoarseBond L s) :
    stepLift s ell (F + G) e = stepLift s ell F e + stepLift s ell G e

HConstruction.DRepair.Reproduced.stepLif.name: HConstruction.DRepair.Reproduced.stepLift_smul
HConstruction.DRepair.Reproduced.stepLif.header:
theorem stepLift_smul (s ell : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (F : CoarseBond L (s * ell) → SuTwo)
    (e : CoarseBond L s) : stepLift s ell (r • F) e = r • stepLift s ell F e

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.bondEnergyS
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.b.header: noncomputable def bondEnergyS (S : Finset (Bond L)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.coarseQS
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.c.header:
noncomputable def coarseQS (S : Finset (CoarseBond L ell))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.curlS
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.c.header:
noncomputable def curlS (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.bondEnergyS_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.b.header: theorem bondEnergyS_nonneg (S : Finset (Bond L)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) : 0 ≤ bondEnergyS S A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.coarseQS_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.c.header:
theorem coarseQS_nonneg (S : Finset (CoarseBond L ell))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    0 ≤ coarseQS S U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.curlS_nonneg
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.c.header:
theorem curlS_nonneg (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    0 ≤ curlS S U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.bondEnergyS_mono
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.b.header:
theorem bondEnergyS_mono {S T : Finset (Bond L)} (h : S ⊆ T) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    bondEnergyS S A ≤ bondEnergyS T A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.bondEnergyS_univ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.b.header:
theorem bondEnergyS_univ (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    bondEnergyS (Finset.univ : Finset (Bond L)) A = bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.coarseQS_univ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.c.header:
theorem coarseQS_univ (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    coarseQS (Finset.univ : Finset (CoarseBond L ell)) U A = coarseQEnergyCov U ell A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.curlS_univ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.c.header:
theorem curlS_univ (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    curlS (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) U A = curlEnergyCov U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.b.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.bondEnergyS_eq_sum_comp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.b.header:
theorem bondEnergyS_eq_sum_comp (S : Finset (Bond L)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    bondEnergyS S A = ∑ i : Fin 3, bondEnergyR S (suComp i A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.curlS_trivialU_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.c.header:
theorem curlS_trivialU_eq_sum (S : Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    curlS S (trivialU L) A = ∑ i : Fin 3, curlEnergyR S (suComp i A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.c.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.coarseQS_trivialU_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.c.header:
theorem coarseQS_trivialU_eq_sum (S : Finset (CoarseBond L ell)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    coarseQS S (trivialU L) A = ∑ i : Fin 3, coarseQEnergyR S (suComp i A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.l.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.local_suTwo_flat
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.l.header:
theorem local_suTwo_flat (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (hadm : SuAdmissible L ell A) (Y : Finset (CSite L ell)) :
    (1 / 180) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) * bondEnergyS (bondsOn Y) A
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQS (coarseOn Y) (trivialU L) A
        + curlS (plaqsOn (tilde hdvd Y)) (trivialU L) A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.l.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.local_coarseQ_flat_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.l.header:
theorem local_coarseQ_flat_le (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (Y : Finset (CSite L ell)) :
    coarseQS (coarseOn Y) (trivialU L) A
      ≤ 2 * coarseQS (coarseOn Y) U A
        + 2 * ((64 / (ell : ℝ)) * frobSupBond U ^ 2 * bondEnergyS (bondsOn (tilde hdvd Y)) A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.l.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.local_curl_flat_le
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.l.header:
theorem local_curl_flat_le (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (Y : Finset (CSite L ell))
    (hα : ∀ b ∈ bondsOn (tilde hdvd Y),
      RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α) :
    curlS (plaqsOn (tilde hdvd Y)) (trivialU L) A
      ≤ 2 * curlS (plaqsOn (tilde hdvd Y)) U A
        + 2 * (32 * α ^ 2 * bondEnergyS (bondsOn (tilde hdvd (tilde hdvd Y))) A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.l.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.local_covariant_lemma24
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.l.header:
theorem local_covariant_lemma24 (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (hadm : SuAdmissible L ell A) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (Y : Finset (CSite L ell))
    (hα : ∀ b ∈ bondsOn (tilde hdvd Y),
      RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α) :
    (1 / 360) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) * bondEnergyS (bondsOn Y) A
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQS (coarseOn Y) U A + curlS (plaqsOn (tilde hdvd Y)) U A
        + (64 * frobSupBond U ^ 2 * bondEnergyS (bondsOn (tilde hdvd Y)) A
           + 32 * α ^ 2 * bondEnergyS (bondsOn (tilde hdvd (tilde hdvd Y))) A)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.l.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.local_covariant_lemma24_uniform
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.l.header:
theorem local_covariant_lemma24_uniform (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (hadm : SuAdmissible L ell A) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (hsup : frobSupBond U ≤ α) (Y : Finset (CSite L ell)) :
    (1 / 360) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) * bondEnergyS (bondsOn Y) A
        - 96 * α ^ 2 * bondEnergyS (bondsOn (tilde hdvd (tilde hdvd Y))) A
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQS (coarseOn Y) U A + curlS (plaqsOn (tilde hdvd Y)) U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.l.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.local_covariant_lemma24_univ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.l.header:
theorem local_covariant_lemma24_univ (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.h.header:
theorem holonomy_cons_fwd {G : Type*} [Group G] (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (rest : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) :
    periodicPathHolonomy U x ((μ, true) :: rest)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.h.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.holonomy_replicate_congr
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.h.header:
theorem holonomy_replicate_congr {G : Type*} [Group G] (U U' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)
    (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
      (∀ j < n, U (pathSite z μ j, μ) = U' (pathSite z μ j, μ)) →
      periodicPathHolonomy U z (List.replicate n (μ, true))
        = periodicPathHolonomy U' z (List.replicate n (μ, true))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.h.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.holonomy_straight_congr

    (h : ∀ j < coordSteps a b μ, U (pathSite a μ j, μ) = U' (pathSite a μ j, μ)) :
    periodicPathHolonomy U a (straightSegment a b μ)
      = periodicPathHolonomy U' a (straightSegment a b μ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.h.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.holonomy_transportPath_congr

theorem floor_sums_multiplicity {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (coef d : ℝ) (hcoef : 0 ≤ coef) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (Mq Mp Md : ℕ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (𝒞 : Finset ι) (Sb Sd : ι → Finset (Bond L)) (Sc : ι → Finset (CoarseBond L ell))
    (Sp : ι → Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L))
    (hbcov : ∀ b : Bond L, 1 ≤ (𝒞.filter (fun i => b ∈ Sb i)).card)
    (hcmul : ∀ c : CoarseBond L ell, (𝒞.filter (fun i => c ∈ Sc i)).card ≤ Mq)
    (hpmul : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, (𝒞.filter (fun i => p ∈ Sp i)).card ≤ Mp)
    (hdmul : ∀ b : Bond L, (𝒞.filter (fun i => b ∈ Sd i)).card ≤ Md)
    (hloc : ∀ i ∈ 𝒞, coef * bondEnergyS (Sb i) A
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQS (Sc i) U A + curlS (Sp i) U A + d * bondEnergyS (Sd i) A) :
    (coef - d * (Md : ℝ)) * bondEnergy A
      ≤ (Mq : ℝ) * ((ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergyCov U ell A) + (Mp : ℝ) * curlEnergyCov U A

AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.f.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.floor_sums_gauged_multiplicity
AdalyFormal.Balaban.LocalizedEstimates.f.header:
theorem floor_sums_gauged_multiplicity {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (coef d : ℝ) (hcoef : 0 ≤ coef) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (Mq Mp Md : ℕ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (𝒞 : Finset ι) (Sb Sd : ι → Finset (Bond L)) (Sc : ι → Finset (CoarseBond L ell))
    (Sp : ι → Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (γ : ι → GaugeFn L)
    (hbcov : ∀ b : Bond L, 1 ≤ (𝒞.filter (fun i => b ∈ Sb i)).card)
    (hcmul : ∀ c : CoarseBond L ell, (𝒞.filter (fun i => c ∈ Sc i)).card ≤ Mq)
    (hpmul : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, (𝒞.filter (fun i => p ∈ Sp i)).card ≤ Mp)
    (hdmul : ∀ b : Bond L, (𝒞.filter (fun i => b ∈ Sd i)).card ≤ Md)
    (hloc : ∀ i ∈ 𝒞, coef * bondEnergyS (Sb i) (gaugeActA (γ i) A)
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * coarseQS (Sc i) (periodicGaugeTransform (γ i) U) (gaugeActA (γ i) A)
        + curlS (Sp i) (periodicGaugeTransform (γ i) U) (gaugeActA (γ i) A)
        + d * bondEnergyS (Sd i) (gaugeActA (γ i) A)) :
    (coef - d * (Md : ℝ)) * bondEnergy A
      ≤ (Mq : ℝ) * ((ell : ℝ) * coarseQEnergyCov U ell A) + (Mp : ℝ) * curlEnergyCov U A

theorem holonomyFactors_append_prod {G : Type*} [Group G]

    (holonomyFactors 1 V y (p ++ q)).prod =

    (y0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ)
    (acc rest : List (Fin 3)) (delta : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L,
      su2Angle (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy V p) ≤ delta)

SmallnessBridge.Assemble.surfaceAlong_pr.name: SmallnessBridge.Assemble.surfaceAlong_prod
SmallnessBridge.Assemble.surfaceAlong_pr.header:
theorem surfaceAlong_prod (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ)
    (acc rest : List (Fin 3)) :
    ((holonomyFactors 1 V y0 acc).prod
        * segmentHol V (coarsePathEndpoint 1 y0 acc) μ ell
        * (holonomyFactors 1 V (coarseShift y0 ell μ) acc).prod⁻¹
        * (segmentHol V y0 μ ell)⁻¹
        * (surfaceAlong V y0 μ ell acc rest).prod) =
      ((holonomyFactors 1 V y0 (List.append acc rest)).prod
        * segmentHol V (coarsePathEndpoint 1 y0 (List.append acc rest)) μ ell
        * (holonomyFactors 1 V (coarseShift y0 ell μ) (List.append acc rest)).prod⁻¹
        * (segmentHol V y0 μ ell)⁻¹)

    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hR21 : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    {a₀ : ℝ} (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))

      (∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide (ell ^ m) ell k < scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1) ∧
      Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R k S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) R k S Lam ∧

      (∀ f ∈ M12.Phi12 ell, ∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ),

      (∃ x ∈ S.Om 0, ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ),
        IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) 12 k S sites j ∧ x ∈ sites ∧
        (sites, j, 12) ∈ MXQ.Total.famPhi (M12.Phi12 ell) (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ∧
      (∃ x ∈ S.Om 0, ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ),
        IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) (12 * ell) k S sites j ∧ x ∈ sites ∧
        (sites, j, 12 * ell) ∈ MXQ.Total.famPhi (M12.Phi12 ell) (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ∧
      Cube5Q ell (ell ^ m) k Lu S

      Lam.Nonempty ∧ OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧

      GenP.WellDefG (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) ∧

M12NV.factors12_instance_inequality.header:
theorem factors12_instance_inequality (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ m₁ : ℕ, 1 ≤ m₁ ∧ ∃ R₁ : ℕ, ∃ (a₀ γ₀ : ℝ), 0 < a₀ ∧ 0 < γ₀ ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, m₁ ≤ m → ∀ R : ℕ, max R₁ (21 * ell) ≤ R →
      ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
      2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧ (∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ m < Lu μ + 1) ∧
      (∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide (ell ^ m) ell k < scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1) ∧
      Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R k S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) R k S Lam ∧
      0 < α₀ ∧ (12 * (ell : ℝ)) * ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀ ∧
      MXP.AllC.ClassCoupledΦ ell (ell ^ m) (M12.Phi12 ell) k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
      MXQ.AllC.ClassCoupledQ ell (ell ^ m) (MXQ.Total.famPhi (M12.Phi12 ell)) k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
      (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
      (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
      Lam.Nonempty ∧ OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧
      (∃ x ∈ S.Om 0, ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ),
        IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) 12 k S sites j ∧ x ∈ sites) ∧
      (∃ x ∈ S.Om 0, ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ),
        IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) (12 * ell) k S sites j ∧ x ∈ sites) ∧
      GenP.WellDefG (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) ∧
      γ₀ * bondEnergy Bt ≤
        GenP.genForm (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam)
          (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) Bt))

theorem off_cases (N a z : ℕ) (ha : a < N) (hz : z < N) :
    (a + N - z) % N = if z ≤ a then a - z else a + N - z

AdalyFormal.M1.pcd_slab_far.name: AdalyFormal.M1.pcd_slab_far
AdalyFormal.M1.pcd_slab_far.header:
theorem pcd_slab_far (R a b N : ℕ) (hN : N = 18 * R + 216) (ha : a < N) (hb : b < N)
    (hx : ¬ (6 * R + 18 ≤ a ∧ a < 12 * R + 108)) (hy : 9 * R + 18 ≤ b ∧ b < 9 * R + 108) : 3 * R < pcd N a b

AdalyFormal.M1.pcd_slab_clamp.name: AdalyFormal.M1.pcd_slab_clamp
AdalyFormal.M1.pcd_slab_clamp.header:
theorem pcd_slab_clamp (R a N : ℕ) (hN : N = 18 * R + 216) (hx : 6 * R + 18 ≤ a ∧ a < 12 * R + 108) :
    pcd N a (if a < 9 * R + 18 then 9 * R + 18 else if a < 9 * R + 108 then a else 9 * R + 107) ≤ 3 * R

AdalyFormal.M1.pcd_slab_near.name: AdalyFormal.M1.pcd_slab_near
AdalyFormal.M1.pcd_slab_near.header:
theorem pcd_slab_near (R a b N : ℕ) (hN : N = 18 * R + 216) (ha : a < N) (hb : b < N)
    (hy : 9 * R + 18 ≤ b ∧ b < 9 * R + 108) (h : pcd N a b ≤ 3 * R) : 6 * R + 18 ≤ a ∧ a < 12 * R + 108

AdalyFormal.M1.TS_admissible.name: AdalyFormal.M1.TS_admissible
AdalyFormal.M1.TS_admissible.header: theorem TS_admissible (R : ℕ) (hN : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = 18 * R + 216) : Admissible 3 3 R 1 (TS R L)

AdalyFormal.M1.xmid.name: AdalyFormal.M1.xmid
AdalyFormal.M1.xmid.header: def xmid (R : ℕ) (hN : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = 18 * R + 216) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.M1.xmid0.name: AdalyFormal.M1.xmid0
AdalyFormal.M1.xmid0.header: theorem xmid0 (R : ℕ) (hN : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = 18 * R + 216) : ((xmid R hN) 0).val = 9 * R + 63

AdalyFormal.M1.xmid_no_cube.name: AdalyFormal.M1.xmid_no_cube
AdalyFormal.M1.xmid_no_cube.header:
theorem xmid_no_cube (R : ℕ) (hN : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = 18 * R + 216) (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (j : ℕ)
    (hq : IsClassCube 3 3 12 1 (TS R L) sites j) : xmid R hN ∉ sites

AdalyFormal.M1.xmid_om0.name: AdalyFormal.M1.xmid_om0
AdalyFormal.M1.xmid_om0.header: theorem xmid_om0 (R : ℕ) (hN : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = 18 * R + 216) : xmid R hN ∈ (TS R L).Om 0

AdalyFormal.M1.slab_not_covered.name: AdalyFormal.M1.slab_not_covered
AdalyFormal.M1.slab_not_covered.header: theorem slab_not_covered (R : ℕ) (hN : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = 18 * R + 216) : ¬ CoversOm0p 3 3 12 1 (TS R L)

AdalyFormal.M1.slab_no_class.name: AdalyFormal.M1.slab_no_class
AdalyFormal.M1.slab_no_class.header:
theorem slab_no_class (R : ℕ) (hN : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = 18 * R + 216) (α₀ η : ℝ) (U : LinkCfg L) :
    ¬ ClassCoupled 3 3 12 1 (TS R L) α₀ η U

AdalyFormal.M1.coverage_fails_slab.name: AdalyFormal.M1.coverage_fails_slab
AdalyFormal.M1.coverage_fails_slab.header:
theorem coverage_fails_slab (R : ℕ) :
    ∃ Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent, TorusOK 3 3 Lu ∧ Admissible 3 3 R 1 (TS R (scaleUp 3 1 Lu)) ∧
      ¬ CoversOm0p 3 3 12 1 (TS R (scaleUp 3 1 Lu))

AdalyFormal.M1.StratLip.name: AdalyFormal.M1.StratLip
AdalyFormal.M1.StratLip.header: def StratLip (S : Tower L) (k ell : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M1.stratLip_site.name: AdalyFormal.M1.stratLip_site
AdalyFormal.M1.stratLip_site.header:
theorem stratLip_site {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) {φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ} (h : StratLip S k ell θ φ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    |φ (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - φ x| ≤ θ * ell / (ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k x

AdalyFormal.M1.wTerm.name: AdalyFormal.M1.wTerm
AdalyFormal.M1.wTerm.header: noncomputable def wTerm (R M : ℕ) (ell s m : ℕ) (c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1.Icc_nonempty.name: AdalyFormal.M1.Icc_nonempty
AdalyFormal.M1.Icc_nonempty.header: theorem Icc_nonempty (s k : ℕ) (h : s ≤ k) : (Finset.Icc (s + 1) (k + 1)).Nonempty

AdalyFormal.M1.stratWeight.name: AdalyFormal.M1.stratWeight
AdalyFormal.M1.stratWeight.header: noncomputable def stratWeight (S : Tower L) (ell M R k : ℕ) (c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1.wTerm_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1.wTerm_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1.wTerm_nonneg.header: theorem wTerm_nonneg (R M ell s m : ℕ) (c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 0 ≤ wTerm R M ell s m c x

AdalyFormal.M1.stratWeight_self.name: AdalyFormal.M1.stratWeight_self
AdalyFormal.M1.stratWeight_self.header: theorem stratWeight_self (S : Tower L) (ell M R k : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : stratWeight S ell M R k c c = 0

AdalyFormal.M1.stratWeight_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1.stratWeight_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1.stratWeight_nonneg.header: theorem stratWeight_nonneg (S : Tower L) (ell M R k : ℕ) (c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 0 ≤ stratWeight S ell M R k c x

AdalyFormal.M1.inf'_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1.inf'_lip
AdalyFormal.M1.inf'_lip.header:
theorem inf'_lip {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι) (hI : I.Nonempty) (f g : ι → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (h : ∀ i ∈ I, |f i - g i| ≤ δ) :
    |I.inf' hI f - I.inf' hI g| ≤ δ

AdalyFormal.M1.inf'_eq_of_dom.name: AdalyFormal.M1.inf'_eq_of_dom
AdalyFormal.M1.inf'_eq_of_dom.header:
theorem inf'_eq_of_dom {ι : Type*} (I J : Finset ι) (hI : I.Nonempty) (hJ : J.Nonempty) (hJI : J ⊆ I) (f : ι → ℝ)
    (hdom : ∀ i ∈ I, ∃ j ∈ J, f j ≤ f i) : I.inf' hI f = J.inf' hJ f

AdalyFormal.M1.wTerm_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1.wTerm_lip
AdalyFormal.M1.wTerm_lip.header:
theorem wTerm_lip (R M ell s m : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    |wTerm R M ell s m c (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - wTerm R M ell s m c x| ≤ 1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ m

AdalyFormal.M1.wTerm_dom.name: AdalyFormal.M1.wTerm_dom
AdalyFormal.M1.wTerm_dom.header:
theorem wTerm_dom {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    {c z : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {b m : ℕ} (hb : strat S k c + 2 ≤ b) (hbz : b ≤ strat S k z)
    (hm1 : strat S k c + 1 ≤ m) (hmb : m < b) :
    wTerm R M ell (strat S k c) b c z ≤ wTerm R M ell (strat S k c) m c z

AdalyFormal.M1.stratWeight_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1.stratWeight_lip
AdalyFormal.M1.stratWeight_lip.header:
theorem stratWeight_lip {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : StratLip S k ell 1 (stratWeight S ell M R k c)

AdalyFormal.M1.inv_one_sub_exp_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1.inv_one_sub_exp_le
AdalyFormal.M1.inv_one_sub_exp_le.header: theorem inv_one_sub_exp_le {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : 1 / (1 - Real.exp (-a)) ≤ 1 + 1 / a

AdalyFormal.M1.exp_off_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M1.exp_off_sum
AdalyFormal.M1.exp_off_sum.header:
theorem exp_off_sum (N K : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∑ t : Fin N, Real.exp (-(a * (((t.val + K) % N : ℕ) : ℝ))) ≤ 1 / (1 - Real.exp (-a))

AdalyFormal.M1.exp_pcd_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M1.exp_pcd_sum
AdalyFormal.M1.exp_pcd_sum.header:
theorem exp_pcd_sum (N : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (y : ℕ) (hy : y < N) :
    ∑ t : Fin N, Real.exp (-(a * (pcd N t.val y : ℝ))) ≤ 2 / (1 - Real.exp (-a))

AdalyFormal.M1.exp_pdist_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M1.exp_pdist_sum
AdalyFormal.M1.exp_pdist_sum.header:
theorem exp_pdist_sum (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, Real.exp (-(a * (pdist c x : ℝ))) ≤ (2 / (1 - Real.exp (-a))) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.M1.strat_geom_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M1.strat_geom_sum
AdalyFormal.M1.strat_geom_sum.header:
theorem strat_geom_sum {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hell : 1 ≤ ell) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, Real.exp (-(2 * θ * stratWeight S ell M R k c x))
      ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc (strat S k c + 1) (k + 1),
          Real.exp (-(θ * (((m - (strat S k c + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * (R * M)))) * (2 + (ell : ℝ) ^ m / θ) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.M1.strat_geom_sum_flat.name: AdalyFormal.M1.strat_geom_sum_flat
AdalyFormal.M1.strat_geom_sum_flat.header:
theorem strat_geom_sum_flat {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hell : 1 ≤ ell) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (hq : (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(θ * (R * M))) ≤ 1 / 2) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, Real.exp (-(2 * θ * stratWeight S ell M R k c x))
      ≤ 64 + 8 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k c / θ) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.M1.gsp.name: AdalyFormal.M1.gsp
AdalyFormal.M1.gsp.header: def gsp (ell M κ j : ℕ) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.M1.bigSide_succ.name: AdalyFormal.M1.bigSide_succ
AdalyFormal.M1.bigSide_succ.header: theorem bigSide_succ (M ell j : ℕ) : bigSide M ell (j + 1) = bigSide M ell j * ell

AdalyFormal.M1.gsp_pos.name: AdalyFormal.M1.gsp_pos
AdalyFormal.M1.gsp_pos.header: theorem gsp_pos {ell M κ : ℕ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 0 < ell) (j : ℕ) : 0 < gsp ell M κ j

AdalyFormal.M1.cellCorner.name: AdalyFormal.M1.cellCorner
AdalyFormal.M1.cellCorner.header: def cellCorner (g : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.M1.cellCorner_div.name: AdalyFormal.M1.cellCorner_div
AdalyFormal.M1.cellCorner_div.header:
theorem cellCorner_div {g : ℕ} (hg : 0 < g) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((cellCorner g x) μ).val / g = (x μ).val / g

AdalyFormal.M1.pdist_cellCorner_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1.pdist_cellCorner_le
AdalyFormal.M1.pdist_cellCorner_le.header:
theorem pdist_cellCorner_le {g : ℕ} (hg : 0 < g) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pdist (cellCorner g x) x ≤ 3 * (g - 1)

AdalyFormal.M1.eq_cellCorner.name: AdalyFormal.M1.eq_cellCorner
AdalyFormal.M1.eq_cellCorner.header:
theorem eq_cellCorner {g : ℕ} {w x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hw : GridCorner g w)
    (hq : ∀ μ, (x μ).val / g = (w μ).val / g) : w = cellCorner g x

AdalyFormal.M1.IsPatch.name: AdalyFormal.M1.IsPatch
AdalyFormal.M1.IsPatch.header: def IsPatch (ell M k κ : ℕ) (S : Tower L) (j : ℕ) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M1.patch.name: AdalyFormal.M1.patch
AdalyFormal.M1.patch.header: def patch (ell M κ c j : ℕ) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.M1.pcore.name: AdalyFormal.M1.pcore
AdalyFormal.M1.pcore.header: def pcore (ell M κ j : ℕ) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.M1.pcore_sub_patch.name: AdalyFormal.M1.pcore_sub_patch
AdalyFormal.M1.pcore_sub_patch.header:
theorem pcore_sub_patch {ell M κ c j : ℕ} (hc : 4 ≤ c) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pcore ell M κ j w ⊆ patch ell M κ c j w

AdalyFormal.M1.IsPatch.anchor.name: AdalyFormal.M1.IsPatch.anchor
AdalyFormal.M1.IsPatch.anchor.header:
theorem IsPatch.anchor {ell M k κ : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {j : ℕ} {w : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hp : IsPatch ell M k κ S j w) :
    ∃ x₀ : PeriodicLatticeSite L, x₀ ∈ S.Om j ∧ strat S k x₀ = j ∧ pdist x₀ w ≤ 3 * gsp ell M κ j

AdalyFormal.M1.patch_strat_bounds.name: AdalyFormal.M1.patch_strat_bounds
AdalyFormal.M1.patch_strat_bounds.header:
theorem patch_strat_bounds {ell M R k κ c : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hR : (c + 3) * κ * ell ≤ R) {j : ℕ} {w : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hp : IsPatch ell M k κ S j w)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ patch ell M κ c j w) : j ≤ strat S k y + 1 ∧ strat S k y ≤ j + 1

AdalyFormal.M1.patch_two_strata.name: AdalyFormal.M1.patch_two_strata
AdalyFormal.M1.patch_two_strata.header:
theorem patch_two_strata {ell M R k κ c : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hR1 : (c + 3) * κ * ell ≤ R) (hR2 : 2 * (c + 3) * κ ≤ R) {j : ℕ} {w : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hp : IsPatch ell M k κ S j w) {y y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ patch ell M κ c j w)
    (hy' : y' ∈ patch ell M κ c j w) : strat S k y ≤ strat S k y' + 1

AdalyFormal.M1.patch_strata_pair.name: AdalyFormal.M1.patch_strata_pair
AdalyFormal.M1.patch_strata_pair.header:
theorem patch_strata_pair {ell M R k κ c : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hR1 : (c + 3) * κ * ell ≤ R) (hR2 : 2 * (c + 3) * κ ≤ R) {j : ℕ} {w : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hp : IsPatch ell M k κ S j w) :
    ∃ i : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ patch ell M κ c j w, strat S k y = i ∨ strat S k y = i + 1

AdalyFormal.M1.patch_cover.name: AdalyFormal.M1.patch_cover
AdalyFormal.M1.patch_cover.header:
theorem patch_cover {ell M k κ : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ S.Om 0) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∃ (j : ℕ) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L), IsPatch ell M k κ S j w ∧ x ∈ pcore ell M κ j w ∧
      periodicLatticeShift x μ ∈ pcore ell M κ j w

AdalyFormal.M1.off_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1.off_le
AdalyFormal.M1.off_le.header:
theorem off_le (N t a c : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (ha : a < N) (hc : c < N) (hd : pcd N a c ≤ t) :
    (a + (N - c) + t) % N ≤ 2 * t

AdalyFormal.M1.card_grid_near1.name: AdalyFormal.M1.card_grid_near1
AdalyFormal.M1.card_grid_near1.header:
theorem card_grid_near1 (N G c y : ℕ) (hG : 0 < G) (hy : y < N) :
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)).filter (fun t => t.val % G = 0 ∧ pcd N t.val y ≤ c * G)).card ≤ 3 * (2 * c + 1)

AdalyFormal.M1.card_grid_near.name: AdalyFormal.M1.card_grid_near
AdalyFormal.M1.card_grid_near.header:
theorem card_grid_near (G c : ℕ) (hG : 0 < G) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)).filter (fun z => GridCorner G z ∧ pdist z y ≤ c * G)).card
      ≤ (3 * (2 * c + 1)) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.M1.patchesAt.name: AdalyFormal.M1.patchesAt
AdalyFormal.M1.patchesAt.header:
noncomputable def patchesAt (ell M k κ c : ℕ) (S : Tower L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Finset (Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.M1.patch_mult.name: AdalyFormal.M1.patch_mult
AdalyFormal.M1.patch_mult.header:
theorem patch_mult {ell M R k κ c : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hR : (c + 3) * κ * ell ≤ R) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (patchesAt ell M k κ c S y).card ≤ 3 * (3 * (2 * c + 1)) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.M1.clamp_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1.clamp_lip
AdalyFormal.M1.clamp_lip.header: theorem clamp_lip (u v : ℝ) : |max 0 (min 1 u) - max 0 (min 1 v)| ≤ |u - v|

AdalyFormal.M1.bump.name: AdalyFormal.M1.bump
AdalyFormal.M1.bump.header: noncomputable def bump (ell M κ c j : ℕ) (w y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1.bump_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1.bump_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1.bump_nonneg.header: theorem bump_nonneg (ell M κ c j : ℕ) (w y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 0 ≤ bump ell M κ c j w y

AdalyFormal.M1.bump_le_one.name: AdalyFormal.M1.bump_le_one
AdalyFormal.M1.bump_le_one.header: theorem bump_le_one (ell M κ c j : ℕ) (w y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : bump ell M κ c j w y ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M1.bump_core.name: AdalyFormal.M1.bump_core
AdalyFormal.M1.bump_core.header:
theorem bump_core {ell M κ c j : ℕ} (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hG : 0 < gsp ell M κ j) {w y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hy : y ∈ pcore ell M κ j w) : bump ell M κ c j w y = 1

AdalyFormal.M1.bump_supp.name: AdalyFormal.M1.bump_supp
AdalyFormal.M1.bump_supp.header:
theorem bump_supp {ell M κ c j : ℕ} (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hG : 0 < gsp ell M κ j) {w y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (h : bump ell M κ c j w y ≠ 0) : y ∈ patch ell M κ c j w

AdalyFormal.M1.bump_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1.bump_lip
AdalyFormal.M1.bump_lip.header:
theorem bump_lip {ell M κ c j : ℕ} (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hG : 0 < gsp ell M κ j) (w y y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    |bump ell M κ c j w y - bump ell M κ c j w y'| ≤ (pdist y y' : ℝ) / (((c : ℝ) - 4) * gsp ell M κ j)

AdalyFormal.M1.psi.name: AdalyFormal.M1.psi
AdalyFormal.M1.psi.header:
noncomputable def psi (ell M k κ c : ℕ) (S : Tower L) (p : Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1.psiSq.name: AdalyFormal.M1.psiSq
AdalyFormal.M1.psiSq.header: noncomputable def psiSq (ell M k κ c : ℕ) (S : Tower L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1.hpart.name: AdalyFormal.M1.hpart
AdalyFormal.M1.hpart.header:
noncomputable def hpart (ell M k κ c : ℕ) (S : Tower L) (p : Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1.psi_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1.psi_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1.psi_nonneg.header:
theorem psi_nonneg {ell M k κ c : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (p : Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    0 ≤ psi ell M k κ c S p y

AdalyFormal.M1.psi_supp.name: AdalyFormal.M1.psi_supp
AdalyFormal.M1.psi_supp.header:
theorem psi_supp {ell M k κ c : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {p : Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite L} {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (h : psi ell M k κ c S p y ≠ 0) :
    p ∈ patchesAt ell M k κ c S y

AdalyFormal.M1.psiSq_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1.psiSq_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1.psiSq_nonneg.header: theorem psiSq_nonneg {ell M k κ c : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 0 ≤ psiSq ell M k κ c S y

AdalyFormal.M1.psiSq_ge_one.name: AdalyFormal.M1.psiSq_ge_one
AdalyFormal.M1.psiSq_ge_one.header:
theorem psiSq_ge_one {ell M k κ c : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ S.Om 0) : 1 ≤ psiSq ell M k κ c S y

AdalyFormal.M1.hpart_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1.hpart_nonneg

AdalyFormal.M1.psi_diff_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1.psi_diff_le
AdalyFormal.M1.psi_diff_le.header:
theorem psi_diff_le {ell M R k κ c : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hR1 : 1 ≤ R) (hR : (c + 3) * κ * ell ≤ R) (hc : 5 ≤ c) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    (p : Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hp : p ∈ patchesAt ell M k κ c S y ∪ patchesAt ell M k κ c S (periodicLatticeShift y μ)) :
    |psi ell M k κ c S p y - psi ell M k κ c S p (periodicLatticeShift y μ)|
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 / (((c : ℝ) - 4) * κ * M * (ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k y)

AdalyFormal.M1.sqrt_sub_sq_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1.sqrt_sub_sq_le
AdalyFormal.M1.sqrt_sub_sq_le.header:
theorem sqrt_sub_sq_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a b : ι → ℝ) :
    (Real.sqrt (∑ i, a i ^ 2) - Real.sqrt (∑ i, b i ^ 2)) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, (a i - b i) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1.hpart_grad_sq.name: AdalyFormal.M1.hpart_grad_sq
AdalyFormal.M1.hpart_grad_sq.header:
theorem hpart_grad_sq {ell M R k κ c : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hR1 : 1 ≤ R) (hR : (c + 3) * κ * ell ≤ R) (hc : 5 ≤ c) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hy : y ∈ S.Om 0) (μ : Fin 3) (hy' : periodicLatticeShift y μ ∈ S.Om 0) :
    ∑ p, (hpart ell M k κ c S p y - hpart ell M k κ c S p (periodicLatticeShift y μ)) ^ 2
      ≤ 4 * (6 * (3 * (2 * c + 1)) ^ 3 : ℕ) *
        ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 / (((c : ℝ) - 4) * κ * M * (ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k y)) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1.hpart_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1.hpart_lip
AdalyFormal.M1.hpart_lip.header:
theorem hpart_lip {ell M R k κ c : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hR1 : 1 ≤ R) (hR : (c + 3) * κ * ell ≤ R) (hc : 5 ≤ c) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hy : y ∈ S.Om 0) (μ : Fin 3) (hy' : periodicLatticeShift y μ ∈ S.Om 0) (p : Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    |hpart ell M k κ c S p y - hpart ell M k κ c S p (periodicLatticeShift y μ)|
      ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt ((6 * (3 * (2 * c + 1)) ^ 3 : ℕ)) *
        ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 / (((c : ℝ) - 4) * κ * M * (ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k y))

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.coordSpec_prof.header:
theorem coordSpec_prof {f : ℕ → ℝ} {τ1 τ2 : ℝ} {lo hi n : ℕ} (hs : ProfSpec f τ1 τ2 lo hi) (hn : hi + 1 ≤ n) :
    CoordSpec n f τ1 τ2

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.coordSpec_one.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.coordSpec_one
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.coordSpec_one.header: theorem coordSpec_one {n : ℕ} {τ1 τ2 : ℝ} (h1 : 0 ≤ τ1) (h2 : 0 ≤ τ2) : CoordSpec n (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) τ1 τ2

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Fprod.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Fprod
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Fprod.header: def Fprod (F : Fin 3 → ℕ → ℝ) (O : Fin 3 → ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Fprod_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Fprod_eq
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Fprod_eq.header:
theorem Fprod_eq (F : Fin 3 → ℕ → ℝ) (O : Fin 3 → ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    Fprod F O = F μ (O μ) * ∏ σ ∈ univ.erase μ, F σ (O σ)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Fprod_update.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Fprod_update
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Fprod_update.header:
theorem Fprod_update (F : Fin 3 → ℕ → ℝ) (O : Fin 3 → ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (v : ℕ) :
    Fprod F (Function.update O μ v) = F μ v * ∏ σ ∈ univ.erase μ, F σ (O σ)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.rest_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.rest_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.rest_nonneg.header:
theorem rest_nonneg {F : Fin 3 → ℕ → ℝ} (h0 : ∀ σ o, 0 ≤ F σ o) (O : Fin 3 → ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    0 ≤ ∏ σ ∈ univ.erase μ, F σ (O σ)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.rest_le_one.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.rest_le_one
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.rest_le_one.header:
theorem rest_le_one {F : Fin 3 → ℕ → ℝ} (h0 : ∀ σ o, 0 ≤ F σ o) (h1 : ∀ σ o, F σ o ≤ 1) (O : Fin 3 → ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∏ σ ∈ univ.erase μ, F σ (O σ) ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Fprod_update2.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Fprod_update2
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Fprod_update2.header:
theorem Fprod_update2 (F : Fin 3 → ℕ → ℝ) (O : Fin 3 → ℕ) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hne : ν ≠ μ) (v w : ℕ) :
    Fprod F (Function.update (Function.update O ν w) μ v)
      = F μ v * F ν w * ∏ σ ∈ (univ.erase μ).erase ν, F σ (O σ)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi.header: def chi (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (F : Fin 3 → ℕ → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.offc_shift_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.offc_shift_eq
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.offc_shift_eq.header:
theorem offc_shift_eq (hL : ∀ σ, 1 ≤ L σ) (z x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    offc z (periodicLatticeShift x μ) = Function.update (offc z x) μ ((offc z x μ + 1) % (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.offc_shiftBack_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.offc_shiftBack_eq
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.offc_shiftBack_eq.header:
theorem offc_shiftBack_eq (hL : ∀ σ, 1 ≤ L σ) (z x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    offc z (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ) = Function.update (offc z x) μ ((offc z x μ + L μ) % (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.offc_near.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.offc_near
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.offc_near.header:
theorem offc_near {N z u v o ρ : ℕ} (hz : z < N) (hu : u < N) (hv : v < N) (ho : o = (u + (N - z)) % N)
    (hlo : ρ ≤ o) (hhi : o + ρ < N) (hp : pcd N u v ≤ ρ) : (v + (N - z)) % N ≤ o + ρ

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Reach.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Reach
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Reach.header: def Reach (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (σ : Fin 3) (s : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.reach_prof.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.reach_prof
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.reach_prof.header:
theorem reach_prof (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (σ : Fin 3) {s : ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℝ} {τ1 τ2 : ℝ} {lo hi : ℕ}
    (hs : ProfSpec f τ1 τ2 lo hi) (hlo : 6 ≤ lo) (hhi : hi + 6 < s) (hsN : s ≤ L σ + 1) : Reach z σ s f

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.reach_one.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.reach_one
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.reach_one.header: theorem reach_one (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (σ : Fin 3) {s : ℕ} (hw : L σ + 1 < s) : Reach z σ s (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_self.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_self
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_self.header:
theorem chi_self (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    chi z F x = F μ (offc z x μ) * ∏ σ ∈ univ.erase μ, F σ (offc z x σ)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_shift.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_shift
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_shift.header:
theorem chi_shift (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    chi z F (periodicLatticeShift x μ) = F μ (offc z x μ + 1) * ∏ σ ∈ univ.erase μ, F σ (offc z x σ)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_shiftBack.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_shiftBack
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_shiftBack.header:
theorem chi_shiftBack (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    chi z F (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ) = F μ (offc z x μ - 1) * ∏ σ ∈ univ.erase μ, F σ (offc z x σ)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_nonneg.header: theorem chi_nonneg (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 0 ≤ chi z F x

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_le_one.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_le_one
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_le_one.header: theorem chi_le_one (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : chi z F x ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_first_fwd.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_first_fwd
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_first_fwd.header:
theorem chi_first_fwd (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    |chi z F (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - chi z F x| ≤ τ1

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_first_bwd.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_first_bwd
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_first_bwd.header:
theorem chi_first_bwd (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    |chi z F (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ) - chi z F x| ≤ τ1

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_second.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_second
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_second.header:
theorem chi_second (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) :
    |chi z F (periodicLatticeShift x ν) + chi z F (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν) - 2 * chi z F x| ≤ τ2

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_mixed.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_mixed
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_mixed.header:
theorem chi_mixed (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hne : ν ≠ μ) :
    |(chi z F (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - chi z F x)
      - (chi z F (periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν) μ) - chi z F (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν))| ≤ τ1 ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_one.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_one
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_one.header: theorem chi_one (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (h : ∀ σ, F σ (offc z x σ) = 1) : chi z F x = 1

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_support_box.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_support_box
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.chi_support_box.header:
theorem chi_support_box {s : ℕ} (hR : ∀ σ, Reach z σ s (F σ))
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : chi z F x ≠ 0) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : pdist x y ≤ 6) :
    y ∈ siteBox z s

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutF.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutF
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutF.header: noncomputable def cutF (s w : ℕ) : ℕ → ℝ

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutF_spec.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutF_spec
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutF_spec.header:
theorem cutF_spec {s w : ℕ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hs : 7 ≤ s) :
    ProfSpec (cutF s w) (1 / (w : ℝ)) (2 / (w : ℝ) ^ 2) 6 (s - 7)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutF_one.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutF_one
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutF_one.header: theorem cutF_one {s w o : ℕ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) (h1 : 2 * w + 4 ≤ o) (h2 : o + 2 * w + 5 ≤ s) : cutF s w o = 1

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutFam.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutFam
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutFam.header: noncomputable def cutFam (s w : ℕ) (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : Fin 3 → ℕ → ℝ

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutFam_coord.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutFam_coord
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutFam_coord.header:
theorem cutFam_coord {s w : ℕ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hs : 7 ≤ s) (σ : Fin 3) :
    CoordSpec (L σ) (cutFam s w L σ) (1 / (w : ℝ)) (2 / (w : ℝ) ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutFam_reach.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutFam_reach
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutFam_reach.header:
theorem cutFam_reach (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {s w : ℕ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hs : 7 ≤ s) (σ : Fin 3) :
    Reach z σ s (cutFam s w L σ)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.CutSpec.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.CutSpec
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.CutSpec.header: structure CutSpec (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (τ1 τ2 : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutoff_spec.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutoff_spec
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutoff_spec.header:
theorem cutoff_spec (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {s w : ℕ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hs : 7 ≤ s) (hL : ∀ σ, 1 ≤ L σ) :
    CutSpec (siteBox z s) (chi z (cutFam s w L)) (1 / (w : ℝ)) (2 / (w : ℝ) ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutoff_core.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutoff_core
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutoff_core.header:
theorem cutoff_core (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {s w : ℕ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hs : 7 ≤ s) (hL : ∀ σ, 1 ≤ L σ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hx : ∀ σ, s ≤ L σ + 1 → 2 * w + 4 ≤ offc z x σ ∧ offc z x σ + 2 * w + 5 ≤ s) : chi z (cutFam s w L) x = 1

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_smul.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_smul
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_smul.header: theorem frob_smul (r : ℝ) (X : M2m) : frobNorm (r • X) = |r| * frobNorm X

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_add_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_add_le
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_add_le.header: theorem frob_add_le (X Y : M2m) : frobNorm (X + Y) ≤ frobNorm X + frobNorm Y

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_neg.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_neg
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_neg.header: theorem frob_neg (X : M2m) : frobNorm (-X) = frobNorm X

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_sub_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_sub_le
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_sub_le.header: theorem frob_sub_le (X Y : M2m) : frobNorm (X - Y) ≤ frobNorm X + frobNorm Y

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_sum_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_sum_le
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_sum_le.header: theorem frob_sum_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → M2m) : frobNorm (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, frobNorm (f i)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_scaled.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_scaled
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob_scaled.header: theorem frob_scaled {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) {Δ : M2m} {c : ℝ} (h : frobNorm ((η⁻¹ : ℝ) • Δ) ≤ c) : frobNorm Δ ≤ η * c

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutA.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutA
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutA.header: noncomputable def cutA (χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (A : Bond L → M2m) : Bond L → M2m

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.ddA_def.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.ddA_def
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.ddA_def.header:
theorem ddA_def (η : ℝ) (B : Bond L → M2m) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ddA η B x μ = (η⁻¹ : ℝ) • ∑ ν ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ν : Fin 3 => ν ≠ μ),
      (curlA η B (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν) ν μ - curlA η B x ν μ)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.ddTerm_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.ddTerm_eq
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.ddTerm_eq.header:
theorem ddTerm_eq (η : ℝ) (B : Bond L → M2m) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    curlA η B (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν) ν μ - curlA η B x ν μ
      = (η⁻¹ : ℝ) • (B (x, μ) - B (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν, μ)
          - B (periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν) μ, ν) + B (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν, ν)
          - B (periodicLatticeShift x ν, μ) + B (x, μ) + B (periodicLatticeShift x μ, ν) - B (x, ν))

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Rid.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Rid
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Rid.header:
theorem Rid (χ0 χP χM χQ χR : ℝ) (a0 aP aM bP b0 cM dM : M2m) :
    ((χ0 • a0 - χM • aM - χR • cM + χM • dM - χP • aP + χ0 • a0 + χQ • bP - χ0 • b0)
      - χ0 • (a0 - aM - cM + dM - aP + a0 + bP - b0))
    = (-(χP - χ0)) • (aP - a0) - (χM - χ0) • (aM - a0) + (χQ - χ0) • (bP - b0) - (χR - χ0) • (cM - b0)
      + (χM - χ0) • (dM - b0) - ((χP - χ0) + (χM - χ0)) • a0
      + (((χQ - χ0) - (χR - χ0)) + (χM - χ0)) • b0

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.pdist_self'.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.pdist_self'
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.pdist_self'.header: theorem pdist_self' (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : pdist x x = 0

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.pdist_shiftBack_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.pdist_shiftBack_le
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.pdist_shiftBack_le.header: theorem pdist_shiftBack_le (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) : pdist x (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν) ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cut_hx4.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cut_hx4

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cubeBond_of_near.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cubeBond_of_near
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cubeBond_of_near.header:
theorem cubeBond_of_near {sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hx : ∀ y, pdist x y ≤ 4 → y ∈ sites) {e : Bond L} (he : pdist x e.1 ≤ 3) : CubeBond sites e

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.curlReads_of_near.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.curlReads_of_near

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.CubeData.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.CubeData
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.CubeData.header: structure CubeData (ell M f k : ℕ) (α₀ η : ℝ) (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ) (A : Bond L → M2m) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Rv.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Rv
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Rv.header: noncomputable def Rv (χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (A : Bond L → M2m) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) : M2m

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.ddTerm_cut.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.ddTerm_cut
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.ddTerm_cut.header:
theorem ddTerm_cut (η : ℝ) (χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (A : Bond L → M2m) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    (curlA η (cutA χ A) (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν) ν μ - curlA η (cutA χ A) x ν μ)
      - χ x • (curlA η A (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν) ν μ - curlA η A x ν μ)
    = (η⁻¹ : ℝ) • Rv χ A x μ ν

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.ddA_cut_decomp.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.ddA_cut_decomp
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.ddA_cut_decomp.header:
theorem ddA_cut_decomp (η : ℝ) (χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (A : Bond L → M2m) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ddA η (cutA χ A) x μ = χ x • ddA η A x μ
      + (η⁻¹ : ℝ) • ∑ ν ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ν : Fin 3 => ν ≠ μ), (η⁻¹ : ℝ) • Rv χ A x μ ν

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.term_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.term_le
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.term_le.header:
theorem term_le {c : ℝ} {m : M2m} {s B : ℝ} (hc : |c| ≤ s) (hm : frobNorm m ≤ B) :
    frobNorm (c • m) ≤ s * B

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob7.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob7
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.frob7.header:
theorem frob7 (u1 u2 u3 u4 u5 u6 u7 : M2m) :
    frobNorm (u1 - u2 + u3 - u4 + u5 - u6 + u7)
      ≤ frobNorm u1 + frobNorm u2 + frobNorm u3 + frobNorm u4 + frobNorm u5 + frobNorm u6 + frobNorm u7

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Rv_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Rv_bound
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.Rv_bound.header:
theorem Rv_bound (hd : CubeData ell M f k α₀ η sites i A) (hc : CutSpec sites χ τ1 τ2) (hη : 0 < η)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx4 : ∀ y, pdist x y ≤ 4 → y ∈ sites) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hne : ν ≠ μ) :
    frobNorm (Rv χ A x μ ν)
      ≤ 8 * τ1 * (η * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀ * (((ell : ℝ) ^ i * η)⁻¹ ^ 2)))
        + (τ2 + τ1 ^ 2) * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀ * (((ell : ℝ) ^ i * η)⁻¹ ^ 1))

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cubeBond_of_chi.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cubeBond_of_chi
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cubeBond_of_chi.header: theorem cubeBond_of_chi (hc : CutSpec sites χ τ1 τ2) {e : Bond L} (h : χ e.1 ≠ 0) : CubeBond sites e

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutA_pos.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutA_pos
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cutA_pos.header:
theorem cutA_pos (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hα : 0 < α₀) (hη : 0 < η) (j p : ℕ) :
    0 < (f : ℝ) * M * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀)) * (((ell : ℝ) ^ j * η)⁻¹ ^ p)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.lt_transfer.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.lt_transfer

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cut_c1.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cut_c1
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cut_c1.header:
theorem cut_c1 (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hα : 0 < α₀) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hq : IsClassCube ell M f k S sites i) (hd : CubeData ell M f k α₀ η sites i A) (hc : CutSpec sites χ τ1 τ2) :
    ∀ (e : Bond L) (j : ℕ), j ≤ bstrat S k e →
      frobNorm (cutA χ A e) < (f : ℝ) * M * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀)) * (((ell : ℝ) ^ j * η)⁻¹ ^ 1)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cut_ht.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cut_ht
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cut_ht.header:
theorem cut_ht (hc : CutSpec sites χ τ1 τ2) (hd : CubeData ell M f k α₀ η sites i A) :
    ∀ e : Bond L, HT (cutA χ A e)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cut_c2.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cut_c2
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cut_c2.header:
theorem cut_c2 (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hα : 0 < α₀) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hq : IsClassCube ell M f k S sites i) (hd : CubeData ell M f k α₀ η sites i A) (hc : CutSpec sites χ τ1 τ2)
    (h1 : 64 * τ1 * (ell : ℝ) ^ i ≤ 1) :
    ∀ (μ ν : Fin 3) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (j : ℕ),
      j ≤ bstrat S k (x, ν) → j ≤ bstrat S k (periodicLatticeShift x μ, ν) →
      frobNorm ((η⁻¹ : ℝ) • (cutA χ A (periodicLatticeShift x μ, ν) - cutA χ A (x, ν)))
        < (f : ℝ) * M * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀)) * (((ell : ℝ) ^ j * η)⁻¹ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.exists_ne.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.exists_ne
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.exists_ne.header: theorem exists_ne (μ : Fin 3) : ∃ ν : Fin 3, ν ≠ μ

AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cut_c3.name: AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cut_c3
AdalyFormal.M2Bridge.cut_c3.header:
theorem cut_c3 (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hα : 0 < α₀) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hq : IsClassCube ell M f k S sites i) (hd : CubeData ell M f k α₀ η sites i A) (hc : CutSpec sites χ τ1 τ2)
    (h1 : 64 * τ1 * (ell : ℝ) ^ i ≤ 1) (h2 : 24 * (τ2 + τ1 ^ 2) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ i) ^ 2 ≤ 1) :
    ∀ (μ : Fin 3) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (j : ℕ),

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.fform_lower.header:
theorem fform_lower (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρ) (ε1 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1)
    (hT : (1 + 1 / ε1) * (12 * ρ ^ 2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 8 * (4 * ell / cs) ^ 2)
        + 2 * ((17 / Real.sqrt 2) * 12 * (ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)) *
          ((ell : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (12 / cs) + Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1) * (4 / cs))) ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    (1 - ε1) * ‖plaqMask (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) (curlCovariantLM_L2 U B)‖ ^ 2 + ‖Ymass (geomOf ell k S) U a B‖ ^ 2
      - 2 * ((17 / Real.sqrt 2) * 12 * (ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)) * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) B‖ ^ 2
      ≤ Fform S ell k U a B

    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ)
    (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) (hT : TorusOK ell M Lu)
    (hL : LambdaOK2 ell M R k S Lam)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (A : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ e : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu), ((periodicGaugeTransform g U e : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
        Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) = NormedSpace.exp (((((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ : ℝ) * Complex.I) • A e))
    (hb : AdalyFormal.M1.M1Bounds S ell M 12 k α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ A)
    (hα : 0 ≤ α₀) (hsm : KDsmall ell (12 * M * α₀)) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b, ‖Cop Lam (gparams ell k Lu hell S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).Q1 Bt b - Cop Lam (q1SU2 ell) Bt b‖ ^ 2
        ≤ (dCof ell (kapM1 (12 * M * α₀))) ^ 2 *
          ∑ b, ‖Cop Lam (gparams ell k Lu hell S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).Q1 Bt b‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ∑ b, ‖Cop Lam (gparams ell k Lu hell S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).Q1 Bt b‖ ^ 2
        ≤ ((1 + (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * Real.sqrt (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3)) / (1 - dCof ell (kapM1 (12 * M * α₀)))) ^ 2
          * bondEnergy Bt

AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.chart_config.name: AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.chart_config
AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.chart_config.header:
theorem chart_config {ell M R k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hR8 : 8 * ell ≤ R) (hT : TorusOK ell M Lu) (hLu5 : ∀ μ, 5 ≤ Lu μ + 1)
    {Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)} (hL : LambdaOK2 ell M R k S Lam)
    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (A0 : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) {α₀ : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α₀)
    (hUg : ∀ e : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu), ((periodicGaugeTransform g U e : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
        Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) = NormedSpace.exp (((((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ : ℝ) * Complex.I) • A0 e))
    (hB : AdalyFormal.M1.M1Bounds S ell M 12 k α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ A0)
    (ha1 : ((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ 1)
    (hsm4 : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * rho1 12 M α₀ ≤ 1)
    (hsmA : (1 + 3 * Real.pi) * rho1 12 M α₀ ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4))
    (hrr : Real.pi / 2 * ((SmallnessBridge.Assemble.loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * rho1 12 M α₀))
        < AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.r0)
    (hKD : KDsmall ell (12 * M * α₀))
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ε1 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1) (hε1' : ε1 < 1)
    (hN : W4Num ell M 12 (R * M * ell) a α₀ ε1)
    (hWD : GenP.WellDef (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam))
    (cw ε2s εJ : ℝ) (hcw : 0 < cw) (hε2 : 0 ≤ ε2s) (hεJ : 0 ≤ εJ) (hε2cw : ε2s ≤ cw)
    (hcoer : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).G),
      cw * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
        ≤ ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫)
    (hD2 : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).G),
      |⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).data.Delta2
          (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).data_laws A⟫|
        ≤ ε2s * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hJ : ∀ Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo, OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt → OnLambdaT Lam Bt →
      |⟪(gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).H1in
          ((gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).D2in
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (Cop Lam (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).Q1 Bt))),
          (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).Jf⟫|
        ≤ εJ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (Cop Lam (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).Q1 Bt) :
            BondFnL2 Lu)‖ ^ 2)
    (Et : ℝ) (hEt : (8 * ((17 / Real.sqrt 2) * 12 * (rho1 12 M α₀ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)) / (1 - ε1)
        + 4 * (32 * rho1 12 M α₀ ^ 2) + 128 * (3 * delStar ell (SstarM ell 12 M α₀) ^ 2)) / cw ≤ Et) :
    ∀ Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo, OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt → OnLambdaT Lam Bt →
      gam1 (1 / 54 * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5)) a (ε2s / cw) εJ ε1 Et (dCof ell (kapM1 (12 * M * α₀)))
          ((1 + (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * Real.sqrt (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3)) / (1 - dCof ell (kapM1 (12 * M * α₀)))) * bondEnergy Bt
        ≤ GenP.genForm (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam)
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam) Bt))

theorem gam1_ge (Γ a ε' εJ ε1 Et dC cB cBm : ℝ) (hΓ : 0 < Γ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hε1 : 0 < ε1) (hε1' : ε1 < 1)
    (hε'0 : 0 ≤ ε') (hε'1 : ε' ≤ 1 / 2) (hεJ : 0 ≤ εJ) (hEt0 : 0 ≤ Et) (hEt1 : Et ≤ 1) (hdC : 0 ≤ dC)
    (hcB0 : 0 ≤ cB) (hcB : cB ≤ cBm)
    (hC2 : (Et * a + 128 * dC ^ 2) * cBm ^ 2 ≤ Γ / 4)
    (hC4 : (ε' * a + 2 * εJ) * cBm ^ 2 ≤ Γ / (8 * (4 / (1 - ε1) + 1))) :
    Γ / (4 * (4 / (1 - ε1) + 1)) ≤ gam1 Γ a ε' εJ ε1 Et dC cB

AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.cwW4_ge_Psi.header:
theorem cwW4_ge_Psi {ell M R d : ℕ} {a cW α₀ ε1 ε2 : ℝ} (hε2 : 0 < ε2)
    (hdD : epsNF ell (PkA a) (thetaN ell) d ≤ cW / 2)
    (hη0 : 0 ≤ etaC ell (R * M * ell) (csOf a (rhoT ell 12 M α₀)) (rho1 12 M α₀) ε1)
    (hη1 : etaC ell (R * M * ell) (csOf a (rhoT ell 12 M α₀)) (rho1 12 M α₀) ε1 < 1) :

      ≤ cwW4 ell M 1 5 (R * M * ell) a (rhoT ell 12 M α₀) (rho1 12 M α₀) ε1 ε2
          (cPnf ell (R * M * ell) d a cW α₀ ε1 12 M)
          (epsXnum ell (R * M * ell) a (rhoT ell 12 M α₀)) (CMcStar ell M 1 5 a (SstarM ell 12 M α₀))

    (hUg : ∀ e : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu), ((periodicGaugeTransform g U e : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :

    (hN : W4Num ell M 12 (R * M * ell) a α₀ ε1)

    (cw ε2s εJ : ℝ) (hcw : 0 < cw) (hε2 : 0 ≤ ε2s) (hεJ : 0 ≤ εJ) (hε2cw : ε2s ≤ cw)
    (hcoer : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).G),
      cw * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
        ≤ ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫)
    (hD2 : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).G),
      |⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).data.Delta2
          (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).data_laws A⟫|
        ≤ ε2s * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hJ : ∀ Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo, OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt → OnLambdaT Lam Bt →
      |⟪(gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).H1in
          ((gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).D2in
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (Cop Lam (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).Q1 Bt))),
          (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).Jf⟫|
        ≤ εJ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (Cop Lam (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).Q1 Bt) :
            BondFnL2 Lu)‖ ^ 2)
    (Γ : ℝ) (hΓ : Γ = 1 / 54 * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5)) (cBm : ℝ)
    (hcBm : cBm = 2 * (1 + (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * Real.sqrt (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3)))
    (hw1 : Etf ell ε1 cw ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀) ≤ 1)
    (hw2 : dCof ell (kapM1 ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀)) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hw3 : (Etf ell ε1 cw ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀) * a + 128 * dCof ell (kapM1 ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀)) ^ 2) * cBm ^ 2 ≤ Γ / 4)
    (he1 : ε2s / cw ≤ 1 / 2)
    (he2 : (ε2s / cw * a + 2 * εJ) * cBm ^ 2 ≤ Γ / (8 * (4 / (1 - ε1) + 1))) :
    InstIneq ell k (by omega) a Lu (Γ / (4 * (4 / (1 - ε1) + 1))) S Lam U

AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.local_unit_st.name: AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.local_unit_stokes_good
AdalyFormal.FlatEllGeneral.local_unit_st.header:

AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.good_bonds_tail.header:

AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.flat_floor_good.name: AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.flat_floor_good
AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.flat_floor_good.header:
theorem flat_floor_good {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < Lu μ + 1) (hd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1)
    {Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)} (hLB : LamBlockSum ell Lam)
    (hb : Function.Bijective (H0 Lam (q1SU2 ell))) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo)
    (hBt : OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt) (hBT : OnLambdaT Lam Bt)
    {M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hRM : 3 ≤ R * M) (hL : LambdaOK ell M R k S Lam)

        + 64 * ∑ b ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Bond Lu)).filter (fun b => embY ell k Lu (by omega) b.1 ∈ S.Om k),
              ‖Bf b - Cop Lam (q1SU2 ell) Bt b‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.norm_curlDrift_sq.name: AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.norm_curlDrift_sq_loc
AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.norm_curlDrift_sq.header:
theorem norm_curlDrift_sq_loc (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)

    (h2 : frobNorm ((U (p.1, p.2.1.2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α) :

AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.curlDrift_good.name: AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.curlDrift_good
AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.curlDrift_good.header:
theorem curlDrift_good (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)

    (hRU : ∀ b ∈ R, frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α)

AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.flat_sum_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.flat_sum_le
AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.flat_sum_le.header:

AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.rows_drift.header:

AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.ginv_eq_Fform.name: AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.ginv_eq_Fform
AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.ginv_eq_Fform.header:

AdalyFormal.M1Assembly.mass_eq_Ymass.header:
