AdalyFormal.M0Finish.fin_sub_val.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.fin_sub_val
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.fin_sub_val.header: theorem fin_sub_val {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a b : Fin N) : (a - b).val = (N - b.val + a.val) % N

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.dvd_sub_val.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.dvd_sub_val
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.dvd_sub_val.header:
theorem dvd_sub_val {N n : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hnN : n ∣ N) (z y : Fin N) (hz : n ∣ z.val) (hy : n ∣ y.val) :
    n ∣ (z - y).val

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.block_reindex.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.block_reindex
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.block_reindex.header:
theorem block_reindex {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (n : ℕ) (z : Fin N) (hzn : z.val + n ≤ N) (F : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ a ∈ univ.filter (fun a : Fin N => z.val ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < z.val + n), F a.val
      = ∑ r ∈ range n, F (z.val + r)

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.coord_fit.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.coord_fit
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.coord_fit.header: theorem coord_fit {N n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n ∣ N) (z : Fin N) (hz : n ∣ z.val) : z.val + n ≤ N

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.line_factor.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.line_factor
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.line_factor.header:
theorem line_factor {M n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n ∣ M + 1) (z y : Fin (M + 1)) (hz : n ∣ z.val) (hy : n ∣ y.val) :
    ∑ a ∈ univ.filter (fun a : Fin (M + 1) => z.val ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < z.val + n),
      ∑ i ∈ range n, gprof n ((a + i • (1 : Fin (M + 1)) - y).val) = if z = y then (n : ℝ) ^ 2 else 0

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.ind_factor.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.ind_factor
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.ind_factor.header:
theorem ind_factor {M n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n ∣ M + 1) (z y : Fin (M + 1)) (hz : n ∣ z.val) (hy : n ∣ y.val) :
    ∑ a ∈ univ.filter (fun a : Fin (M + 1) => z.val ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < z.val + n),
      (if (a - y).val < n then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = if z = y then (n : ℝ) else 0

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.Hf.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.Hf
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.Hf.header: noncomputable def Hf (n : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) (a : Fin (L ν + 1)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.line_prod.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.line_prod
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.line_prod.header:
theorem line_prod (n : ℕ) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∑ i ∈ range n, ∏ ν : Fin 3, fac n μ ν (((pathSite x μ i) ν - y ν).val) = ∏ ν : Fin 3, Hf n μ y ν (x ν)

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.blockOf_pi.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.blockOf_pi
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.blockOf_pi.header:
theorem blockOf_pi (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ) :
    blockOf z n = Fintype.piFinset (fun ν => univ.filter
      (fun a : Fin (L ν + 1) => (z ν).val ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < (z ν).val + n))

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.block_line_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.block_line_sum
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.block_line_sum.header:
theorem block_line_sum (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : z ∈ CoarseLattice L n) (μ : Fin 3) (c : CoarseBond L n) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf z n, ∑ i ∈ range n, bK n (pathSite x μ i) μ c
      = if c = (⟨z, hz⟩, μ) then (n : ℝ) ^ 4 else 0

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.bondE_rightInv.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.bondE_rightInv
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.bondE_rightInv.header:
theorem bondE_rightInv (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo)
    (c0 : CoarseBond L n) : lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n (bondE n W) c0 = W c0

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.bM.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.bM
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.bM.header: noncomputable def bM (n : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (c : CoarseBond L n) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.abs_fac_le.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.abs_fac_le
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.abs_fac_le.header:
theorem abs_fac_le (n : ℕ) (μ ν : Fin 3) (t : ℕ) :
    |fac n μ ν t| ≤ (if ν = μ then 4 else 1) * (if t < n then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.abs_bK_le.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.abs_bK_le
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.abs_bK_le.header:
theorem abs_bK_le (n : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (c : CoarseBond L n) :
    |bK n x μ c| ≤ bM n x μ c

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.coarse_pi.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.coarse_pi
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.coarse_pi.header:
theorem coarse_pi (n : ℕ) :
    CoarseLattice L n = Fintype.piFinset (fun ν => univ.filter (fun t : Fin (L ν + 1) => t.val % n = 0))

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.row_coord_le.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.row_coord_le
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.row_coord_le.header:
theorem row_coord_le {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n ∣ N) (x : Fin N) :
    ∑ t ∈ univ.filter (fun t : Fin N => t.val % n = 0), (if (x - t).val < n then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.col_coord_le.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.col_coord_le
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.col_coord_le.header:
theorem col_coord_le {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (y : Fin N) :
    ∑ a : Fin N, (if (a - y).val < n then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ n

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.bM_row.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.bM_row
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.bM_row.header:
theorem bM_row (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (b : Bond L) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L n, bM n b.1 b.2 c ≤ 4

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.bM_col.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.bM_col
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.bM_col.header:
theorem bM_col (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (c : CoarseBond L n) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, bM n b.1 b.2 c ≤ 4 * (n : ℝ) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.bondE_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.bondE_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.bondE_norm_sq.header:
theorem bondE_norm_sq (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ‖bondE n W b‖ ^ 2 ≤ 16 * (n : ℝ) ^ 3 * ∑ c : CoarseBond L n, ‖W c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.qs_injective_PU.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.qs_injective_PU
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.qs_injective_PU.header:
theorem qs_injective_PU (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (δm : ℝ)
    (hC1 : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      ∑ p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu), a * ((GF ell k Lu).ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ) *
        ‖(bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p - (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2
        ≤ δm ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hsm : 16 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * δm ^ 2 < a) :
    Function.Injective (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Qs

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.units_PU.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.units_PU
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.units_PU.header:
theorem units_PU (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (C0 ε2 : ℝ) (hC0 : 0 < C0) (hε2C : ε2 * C0 < 1)
    (hcoer : ∀ y : ↥(bondSupp (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G),
      ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ C0 * ⟪y, (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Ginv y⟫)
    (hD2 : ‖(PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Delta2 (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data_laws‖ ≤ ε2)
    (hQs : Function.Injective (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Qs) :
    IsUnit (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).G1inv ∧ IsUnit (GenP.Nmat (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam))

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.fineDir_suCoordF.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.fineDir_suCoordF
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.fineDir_suCoordF.header:
theorem fineDir_suCoordF (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    fineDirToUnitBond (fun e => toM2 (suCoordF B e)) (fun e => (toM2_mem (suCoordF B e)).1)
        (fun e => (toM2_mem (suCoordF B e)).2) = bondToUnit B

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.Q1jet_eq_q124.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.Q1jet_eq_q124
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.Q1jet_eq_q124.header:
theorem Q1jet_eq_q124 (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hreg : RegBg 1 ell V0)
    (hnc : ∀ c : CoarseBond L ell, ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1.1 1 ell,
      loopVar 1 ell V0 (c.1.1, c.2) x ≠ su2NegOne)
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    Q1jet ell V0 B c
      = q124Principal 1 ell V0 (bondToUnit B)
          (⟨⟨c.1.1, by rw [one_mul]; exact c.1.2⟩, c.2⟩ : CoarseBond L (1 * ell))

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.Q1jet_sub_flat_l.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.Q1jet_sub_flat_le
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.Q1jet_sub_flat_l.header:
theorem Q1jet_sub_flat_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0) (hsmall : rhoOf ell ε0 < Real.pi / 2)
    (hreg : RegBg 1 ell V) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hB : ∀ b, ‖B b‖ ≤ M)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    ‖Q1jet ell V B c - Q1jet ell flatCfg B c‖
      ≤ (8 * ell * ε0 + 8 * e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ε0)) * M

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.norm_iotaD_le.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.norm_iotaD_le
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.norm_iotaD_le.header:
theorem norm_iotaD_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (w : Dset L ell Lam → SuTwo) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hw : ∀ c, ‖w c‖ ≤ M) (b : Bond L) : ‖iotaD ell Lam w b‖ ≤ M

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.H0_injective_of_.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.H0_injective_of_small
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.H0_injective_of_.header:
theorem H0_injective_of_small {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ε0 : ℝ)
    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0) (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0)
    (hsmall : rhoOf ell ε0 < Real.pi / 2) (hreg : RegBg 1 ell V)
    (hε : 8 * ell * ε0 + 8 * e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ε0) < 1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) :
    Function.Injective (H0 Lam (Q1jet ell V))

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.H0_bijective_of_.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.H0_bijective_of_small
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.H0_bijective_of_.header:
theorem H0_bijective_of_small {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ε0 : ℝ)
    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0) (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0)
    (hsmall : rhoOf ell ε0 < Real.pi / 2) (hreg : RegBg 1 ell V)
    (hε : 8 * ell * ε0 + 8 * e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ε0) < 1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) :
    Function.Bijective (H0 Lam (Q1jet ell V))

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.hb_of_small.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.hb_of_small
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.hb_of_small.header:
theorem hb_of_small (P : IngrBParams) (hdvd : ∀ μ, P.ell ∣ (P.Lu μ + 1)) (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0)
    (hle : ε0 ≤ 1 / (1000 * (P.ell : ℝ) ^ 4))
    (hr : Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound P.ell : ℝ) * ε0) < r0)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((P.unitBgU e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0) :
    Function.Bijective (H0 P.Lam P.Q1)

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.Q1jet_surjective.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.Q1jet_surjective_of_small
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.Q1jet_surjective.header:
theorem Q1jet_surjective_of_small {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0)
    (hle : ε0 ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4))
    (hr : Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ε0) < r0)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0) :
    Function.Surjective (Q1jet ell V)

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.l1_gA_bondToUnit.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.l1_gA_bondToUnit
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.l1_gA_bondToUnit.header: theorem l1_gA_bondToUnit (B : Bond L → SuTwo) : l1 (gA (bondToUnit B)) = bondEnergy B

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.iotaD_energy.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.iotaD_energy
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.iotaD_energy.header:
theorem iotaD_energy {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (w : Dset L ell Lam → SuTwo) :
    bondEnergy (iotaD ell Lam w) = ∑ c : Dset L ell Lam, ‖w c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.delta_flat_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.delta_flat_zero
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.delta_flat_zero.header:
theorem delta_flat_zero {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell)) :
    delta124 1 ell (trivialU L)
      (AdalyFormal.DeltaKR85.Coeff124.ofPrincipalBackground 1 ell (trivialU L)) (bondToUnit B) c = 0

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.Q1jet_sub_flat_l.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.Q1jet_sub_flat_l2
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.Q1jet_sub_flat_l.header:
theorem Q1jet_sub_flat_l2 {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0) (hsmall : rhoOf ell ε0 < Real.pi / 2)
    (hreg : RegBg 1 ell V) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L ell, ‖Q1jet ell V B c - Q1jet ell flatCfg B c‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (384 * (ell * ε0) ^ 2 + 480 * (e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ε0)) ^ 2) * bondEnergy B

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.Cop_apply'.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.Cop_apply'
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.Cop_apply'.header:
theorem Cop_apply' {ell : ℕ} (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L))
    (Q : (Bond L → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] (CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo)) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    Cop Lam Q B = B - iotaD ell Lam (H0inv Lam Q (rhoD ell Lam (Q B)))

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.cop_pert.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.cop_pert
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.cop_pert.header:
theorem cop_pert {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0) (hsmall : rhoOf ell ε0 < Real.pi / 2)
    (hreg : RegBg 1 ell V) (hbV : Function.Bijective (H0 Lam (Q1jet ell V))) (Bt : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ‖Cop Lam (Q1jet ell V) Bt b - Cop Lam (q1SU2 ell) Bt b‖ ^ 2
      ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ 2 * (384 * (ell * ε0) ^ 2 + 480 * (e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ε0)) ^ 2)
        * ∑ b : Bond L, ‖Cop Lam (Q1jet ell V) Bt b‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.cop_flat_le.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.cop_flat_le
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.cop_flat_le.header:
theorem cop_flat_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (Bt : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    Real.sqrt (∑ b : Bond L, ‖Cop Lam (q1SU2 ell) Bt b‖ ^ 2)
      ≤ Real.sqrt (bondEnergy Bt) + (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * Real.sqrt (∑ c : CoarseBond L ell, ‖q1SU2 ell Bt c‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.q1_flat_l2.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.q1_flat_l2
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.q1_flat_l2.header:
theorem q1_flat_l2 {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L ell, ‖q1SU2 ell B c‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) * bondEnergy B

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.cop_bounds.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.cop_bounds
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.R7.cop_bounds.header:
theorem cop_bounds {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0) (hsmall : rhoOf ell ε0 < Real.pi / 2)
    (hreg : RegBg 1 ell V) (hbV : Function.Bijective (H0 Lam (Q1jet ell V)))
    (dC : ℝ) (hdC : dC = (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * Real.sqrt (384 * (ell * ε0) ^ 2 + 480 * (e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ε0)) ^ 2))
    (hdC1 : dC < 1) (Bt : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ‖Cop Lam (Q1jet ell V) Bt b - Cop Lam (q1SU2 ell) Bt b‖ ^ 2
        ≤ dC ^ 2 * ∑ b : Bond L, ‖Cop Lam (Q1jet ell V) Bt b‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ∑ b : Bond L, ‖Cop Lam (Q1jet ell V) Bt b‖ ^ 2
        ≤ ((1 + (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * Real.sqrt (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3)) / (1 - dC)) ^ 2 * bondEnergy Bt

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.dCM0.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.dCM0
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.dCM0.header: noncomputable def dCM0 (ell : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.cBM0.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.cBM0
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.cBM0.header: noncomputable def cBM0 (ell : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.kap_le_kapHat.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.kap_le_kapHat
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.kap_le_kapHat.header:
theorem kap_le_kapHat (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (e q0 : ℝ) (he0 : 0 ≤ e) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) :
    kap ell e q0 k ≤ kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.hC1_M0.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.hC1_M0
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.hC1_M0.header:
theorem hC1_M0 (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a t e q0 : ℝ)
    (R : M0RegimeR ell k Lu U a t e q0) (H : KUSmall ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)) :
    ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      ∑ p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu), a * ((GF ell k Lu).ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ) *
        ‖(bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p - (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2
        ≤ (Real.sqrt a * phiC ell (3600 * (ell : ℝ) * rhoM0 ell k e q0) / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.phi_sq_small.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.phi_sq_small
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.phi_sq_small.header:
theorem phi_sq_small (ell : ℕ) (a t ρ : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ht : 0 < t) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hs : ThetaM0 ell a t ρ < min a 1 / 1000) : phiC ell (3600 * (ell : ℝ) * ρ) ^ 2 < 1 / 1000

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.instIneq_M0_kunifor.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.instIneq_M0_kuniform
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.instIneq_M0_kunifor.header:
theorem instIneq_M0_kuniform (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (a t e q0 : ℝ) (R : M0RegimeR ell k Lu U a t e q0) (H : KUSmall ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0))
    (HU : UnitSmall ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0))
    (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < Lu μ + 1) (hd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (hLB : LamBlockSum ell Lam)
    (ε2s εJ : ℝ) (hε2s : 0 ≤ ε2s) (hεJ : 0 ≤ εJ)
    (hε' : ε2s * KhatM0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) < 1)
    (hD2 : ‖(PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Delta2 (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data_laws‖
      ≤ ε2s / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2)
    (hJ : ∀ Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo, OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt → OnLambdaT Lam Bt →
        |⟪(PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).H1in ((PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).D2in
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (Cop Lam (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Q1 Bt))), (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Jf⟫|
          ≤ εJ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (Cop Lam (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Q1 Bt) : BondFnL2 Lu)‖ ^ 2) :
    InstIneq ell k hell a Lu
      (gam0M0 ell a t (rhoM0 ell k e q0) ε2s εJ (dCM0 ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)) (cBM0 ell (rhoM0 ell k e q0)))
      (fullTower ell k Lu) Lam U

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.delta2_zero_of_J.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.delta2_zero_of_J
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.delta2_zero_of_J.header:
theorem delta2_zero_of_J {E S F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S] [FiniteDimensional ℝ S]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    (D : BaseDataS E S F) (hL : D.Laws) (hJ : D.J = 0) : D.Delta2 hL = 0

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.rhoM0_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.rhoM0_zero
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.rhoM0_zero.header: theorem rhoM0_zero (ell k : ℕ) : rhoM0 ell k 0 0 = 0

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.phiC_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.phiC_zero
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.phiC_zero.header: theorem phiC_zero (ell : ℕ) : phiC ell (3600 * (ell : ℝ) * 0) = 0

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.EbarM0_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.EbarM0_zero
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.EbarM0_zero.header: theorem EbarM0_zero (ell : ℕ) (a t : ℝ) : EbarM0 ell a t 0 = 0

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.gam0M0_flat.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.gam0M0_flat
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.gam0M0_flat.header:
theorem gam0M0_flat (ell : ℕ) (a t : ℝ) :
    gam0M0 ell a t 0 0 0 (dCM0 ell 0) (cBM0 ell 0) = (1 / 54) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) / 4

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.ThetaM0_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.ThetaM0_zero
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.ThetaM0_zero.header: theorem ThetaM0_zero (ell : ℕ) (a t : ℝ) : ThetaM0 ell a t 0 = 0

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.instIneq_M0_flat.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.instIneq_M0_flat
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.instIneq_M0_flat.header:
theorem instIneq_M0_flat (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (a t : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < Lu μ + 1) (hd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (hLB : LamBlockSum ell Lam) :
    InstIneq ell k (by omega) a Lu ((1 / 54) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) / 4) (fullTower ell k Lu) Lam flatCfg

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.kapHat_two_le.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.kapHat_two_le
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.kapHat_two_le.header: theorem kapHat_two_le (ρ : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (h1 : ρ ≤ 1 / 1000) : kapHat 2 ρ ≤ 45000 * ρ

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.witness_M0_nonD.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.witness_M0_nonD
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.witness_M0_nonD.header:
theorem witness_M0_nonD (k : ℕ) :
    M0RegimeR 2 k Lu3 (UK k (epsK k)) 1 1 (Real.sqrt 2 * epsK k) (4 * Real.sqrt 2 * epsK k) ∧
    KUSmall 2 (rhoM0 2 k (Real.sqrt 2 * epsK k) (4 * Real.sqrt 2 * epsK k)) ∧
    UnitSmall 2 (rhoM0 2 k (Real.sqrt 2 * epsK k) (4 * Real.sqrt 2 * epsK k)) ∧
    ∃ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp 2 k Lu3), 0 < dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy (UK k (epsK k)) p)

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.rhoM0_class.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.rhoM0_class
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.rhoM0_class.header:
theorem rhoM0_class (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (α : ℝ) :
    rhoM0 ell k (α / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) (α / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2) = (1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α

AdalyFormal.M0Finish.instIneq_M0_class.name: AdalyFormal.M0Finish.instIneq_M0_class
AdalyFormal.M0Finish.instIneq_M0_class.header:
theorem instIneq_M0_class (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a t α : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ht : 0 < t) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < Lu μ + 1) (hd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (hLB : LamBlockSum ell Lam)
                                         
    (hlinks : ∀ b, dv (U b) ≤ α / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (hplaq : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell k Lu), dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy U p) ≤ α / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2)
                                                 
    (hcb : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * α ≤ 1)
    (h216 : 216 * ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α) ^ 2 < 1)
    (h1000 : (1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (hsmallU : ThetaM0 ell a t ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α) < min a 1 / 1000)
    (H : KUSmall ell ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α)) (HU : UnitSmall ell ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α))
                               
    (ε2s εJ : ℝ) (hε2s : 0 ≤ ε2s) (hεJ : 0 ≤ εJ)
    (hε' : ε2s * KhatM0 ell a t ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α) < 1)
    (hD2 : ‖(PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data.Delta2 (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).data_laws‖
      ≤ ε2s / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2)
    (hJ : ∀ Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo, OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt → OnLambdaT Lam Bt →
        |⟪(PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).H1in ((PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).D2in
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (Cop Lam (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Q1 Bt))), (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Jf⟫|
          ≤ εJ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (Cop Lam (PU ell k Lu hell U a Lam).Q1 Bt) : BondFnL2 Lu)‖ ^ 2) :
    InstIneq ell k hell a Lu
      (gam0M0 ell a t ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α) ε2s εJ (dCM0 ell ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α))
        (cBM0 ell ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * α)))
      (fullTower ell k Lu) Lam U

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_inner_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_inner_le
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_inner_le.header:
theorem sum_inner_le (u c : ι → F) :
    |∑ i, ⟪u i, c i⟫| ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ i, ‖u i‖ ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∑ i, ‖c i‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_sq_two_sided.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_sq_two_sided
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_sq_two_sided.header:
theorem ims_sq_two_sided (Y : E → F) (m : ι → E → E) (P : ι → F → F)
    (hP : ∀ y, ∑ i, ‖P i y‖ ^ 2 = ‖y‖ ^ 2) (A : E) :
    |∑ i, ‖Y (m i A)‖ ^ 2 - ‖Y A‖ ^ 2|
      ≤ 2 * ‖Y A‖ * Real.sqrt (∑ i, ‖Y (m i A) - P i (Y A)‖ ^ 2) + ∑ i, ‖Y (m i A) - P i (Y A)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_sq_upper.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_sq_upper
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_sq_upper.header:
theorem ims_sq_upper (Y : E → F) (m : ι → E → E) (P : ι → F → F)
    (hP : ∀ y, ∑ i, ‖P i y‖ ^ 2 = ‖y‖ ^ 2) (A : E) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∑ i, ‖Y (m i A)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ε) * ‖Y A‖ ^ 2 + (1 + 1 / ε) * ∑ i, ‖Y (m i A) - P i (Y A)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_sq_lower.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_sq_lower
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_sq_lower.header:
theorem ims_sq_lower (Y : E → F) (m : ι → E → E) (P : ι → F → F)
    (hP : ∀ y, ∑ i, ‖P i y‖ ^ 2 = ‖y‖ ^ 2) (A : E) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (1 - ε) * ‖Y A‖ ^ 2 - (1 + 1 / ε) * ∑ i, ‖Y (m i A) - P i (Y A)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ‖Y (m i A)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_assembly.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_assembly
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_assembly.header:
theorem ims_assembly (K N : E → ℝ) (m : ι → E → E) (hN : ∀ A, ∑ i, N (m i A) = N A) (cP ε e : ℝ)
    (hims : ∀ A, ∑ i, K (m i A) ≤ (1 + ε) * K A + e * N A)
    (hpatch : ∀ i A, cP * N (m i A) ≤ K (m i A)) (A : E) :
    (cP - e) * N A ≤ (1 + ε) * K A

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_assembly_div.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_assembly_div
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_assembly_div.header:
theorem ims_assembly_div (K N : E → ℝ) (m : ι → E → E) (hN : ∀ A, ∑ i, N (m i A) = N A) (cP ε e : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hims : ∀ A, ∑ i, K (m i A) ≤ (1 + ε) * K A + e * N A)
    (hpatch : ∀ i A, cP * N (m i A) ≤ K (m i A)) (A : E) :
    ((cP - e) / (1 + ε)) * N A ≤ K A

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hvec.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hvec
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hvec.header: noncomputable def hvec (h : ι → PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hvec_dist_sq.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hvec_dist_sq
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hvec_dist_sq.header:
theorem hvec_dist_sq (h : ι → PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    dist (hvec h x) (hvec h y) ^ 2 = ∑ i, (h i x - h i y) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hvec_path.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hvec_path
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hvec_path.header:
theorem hvec_path (h : ι → PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (B : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (s0 : ℝ)
    (hstep : ∀ z ∈ B, ∀ μ : Fin 3, periodicLatticeShift z μ ∈ B →
      dist (hvec h z) (hvec h (periodicLatticeShift z μ)) ≤ s0) :
    ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L), PathIn2 B B 1 y p →
      dist (hvec h y) (hvec h (coarsePathEndpoint 1 y p)) ≤ p.length * s0

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.gammaPath_length_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.gammaPath_length_le
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.gammaPath_length_le.header:
theorem gammaPath_length_le {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {n : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ blockOf y n) :
    (coarseGammaPath 1 y x).length ≤ 3 * (n - 1)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hfam.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hfam
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hfam.header:
noncomputable def hfam {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell M k κ c : ℕ) (S : Tower Lf) :
    Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.osc_block.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.osc_block
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.osc_block.header:
theorem osc_block (q : QIdx (geomOf ell k S)) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf}
    (hx : x ∈ blockOf (yq q) (ell ^ jq q)) :
    ∑ p, (AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p (yq q) - AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p x) ^ 2
      ≤ 9 * KG ell M κ c

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypMul.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypMul
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypMul.header: noncomputable def ypMul (G : TowerGeom L) (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) : YP G →L[ℝ] YP G

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypMul_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypMul_apply
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypMul_apply.header:
theorem ypMul_apply (G : TowerGeom L) (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (v : YP G) (p : PIdx G) :
    ypMul G h v p = h (rowSite p) • v p

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQ_row.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQ_row
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQ_row.header:
theorem cQ_row (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (h : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 Lf) (q : QIdx (geomOf ell k S)) :
    (ypMul (geomOf ell k S) h (QpP (geomOf ell k S) U a f) - QpP (geomOf ell k S) U a (siteMul h f)) (Sum.inl q)
      = Real.sqrt (wq (geomOf ell k S) a (jq q)) •
          Qlev (geomOf ell k S) U (jq q) (yq q) (siteMul (fun x => h (yq q) - h x) (siteMask (geomOf ell k S).Om0 f))

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQ_pad.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQ_pad
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQ_pad.header:
theorem cQ_pad (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (h : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 Lf) (x : OffIdx (geomOf ell k S)) :
    (ypMul (geomOf ell k S) h (QpP (geomOf ell k S) U a f) - QpP (geomOf ell k S) U a (siteMul h f)) (Sum.inr x) = 0

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQ_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQ_sum
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQ_sum.header:
theorem cQ_sum (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (f : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ∑ p, ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S))
        (ypMul (geomOf ell k S) (AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p) (QpP (geomOf ell k S) U a f)
          - QpP (geomOf ell k S) U a (siteMul (AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p) f))‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 9 * a * KG ell M κ c * ‖f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dsite.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dsite
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dsite.header: noncomputable def dsite (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (e : SuTwo) : SiteL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.inner_dsite.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.inner_dsite
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.inner_dsite.header: theorem inner_dsite (F : SiteL2 L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (e : SuTwo) : ⟪F, dsite x e⟫ = ⟪F x, e⟫

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.eq_of_inner_all.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.eq_of_inner_all
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.eq_of_inner_all.header: theorem eq_of_inner_all {u v : SuTwo} (h : ∀ e : SuTwo, ⟪u, e⟫ = ⟪v, e⟫) : u = v

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Kq_supp.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Kq_supp
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Kq_supp.header:
theorem Kq_supp (U : Cfg L) (j : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (c : SuTwo) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hx : x ∉ boxF y (G.ell ^ j)) : (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Qlev G U j y) c) x = 0

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qlev_norm_sq_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qlev_norm_sq_le
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qlev_norm_sq_le.header:
theorem Qlev_norm_sq_le (U : Cfg L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (j : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (g : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖Qlev G U j y g‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((1 / (G.ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ j) * ‖g‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Kq_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Kq_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Kq_norm_sq.header:
theorem Kq_norm_sq (U : Cfg L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (j : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (c : SuTwo) :
    ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Qlev G U j y) c‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((1 / (G.ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ j) * ‖c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.QpP_adj_on.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.QpP_adj_on
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.QpP_adj_on.header:
theorem QpP_adj_on (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (v : YP G) (q : QIdx G) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hx : x ∈ blockOf (yq q) (ell ^ jq q)) :
    (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (QpP G U a) v) x
      = Real.sqrt (wq G a (jq q)) • (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Qlev G U (jq q) (yq q)) (v (Sum.inl q))) x

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.QpP_adj_off.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.QpP_adj_off
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.QpP_adj_off.header:
theorem QpP_adj_off (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (v : YP G) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∉ G.Om0) :
    (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (QpP G U a) v) x = v (Sum.inr ⟨x, hx⟩)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQs_on.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQs_on
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQs_on.header:
theorem cQs_on (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (h : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (v : YP (geomOf ell k S))
    (q : QIdx (geomOf ell k S)) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf} (hx : x ∈ blockOf (yq q) (ell ^ jq q)) :
    (siteMul h (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (QpP (geomOf ell k S) U a) v)
        - ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (QpP (geomOf ell k S) U a) (ypMul (geomOf ell k S) h v)) x
      = (Real.sqrt (wq (geomOf ell k S) a (jq q)) * (h x - h (yq q))) •
          (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Qlev (geomOf ell k S) U (jq q) (yq q)) (v (Sum.inl q)) : SiteL2 Lf) x

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQs_off.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQs_off
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQs_off.header:
theorem cQs_off (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (h : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (v : YP (geomOf ell k S))
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf} (hx : x ∉ (geomOf ell k S).Om0) :
    (siteMul h (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (QpP (geomOf ell k S) U a) v)
        - ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (QpP (geomOf ell k S) U a) (ypMul (geomOf ell k S) h v)) x = 0

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQs_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQs_sum
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cQs_sum.header:
theorem cQs_sum (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (v : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ∑ p, ‖siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S) + sigG (geomOf ell k S))
        (siteMul (AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p) (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (QpP (geomOf ell k S) U a) v)
          - ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (QpP (geomOf ell k S) U a)
              (ypMul (geomOf ell k S) (AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p) v))‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 9 * a * KG ell M κ c * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) v‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dpFirst_le_p.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dpFirst_le_p
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dpFirst_le_p.header:
theorem dpFirst_le_p {α₀ : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)
    (hpl : frobNorm ((holonomyElem U p : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * α₀) :
    |deltaPrimeFirstTerm U A p| ≤ 16 * α₀ * ‖curlValueCovariant U A p‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dpSecond_le_p.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dpSecond_le_p
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dpSecond_le_p.header:
theorem dpSecond_le_p {α₀ : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)
    (hpl : frobNorm ((holonomyElem U p : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * α₀) :
    |deltaPrimeSecondTerm U A p| ≤ 72 * α₀ * plaqBondSq A p

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bilPlaq_quad_le_p.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bilPlaq_quad_le_p
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bilPlaq_quad_le_p.header:
theorem bilPlaq_quad_le_p (U : Cfg L) {α₀ : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)
    (hpl : frobNorm ((holonomyElem U p : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * α₀) :
    |bilPlaq U p A A| ≤ 136 * α₀ * plaqBondSq A p

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bilPlaq_dv.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bilPlaq_dv
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bilPlaq_dv.header:
theorem bilPlaq_dv (U : Cfg L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    |bilPlaq U p A A| ≤ (34 / Real.sqrt 2) * AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy U p)
      * plaqBondSq A p

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.HolRegime.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.HolRegime
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.HolRegime.header: def HolRegime (S : Tower Lf) (ell k : ℕ) (U : Cfg Lf) (ρ : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.strat_near.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.strat_near
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.strat_near.header:
theorem strat_near {x y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf} (h : pdist x y ≤ 2) :
    AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k y ≤ AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k x + 1

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.pdist_corner1.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.pdist_corner1
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.pdist_corner1.header: theorem pdist_corner1 (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (μ : Fin 3) : pdist x (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ≤ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.pdist_corner2.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.pdist_corner2
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.pdist_corner2.header:
theorem pdist_corner2 (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    pdist x (periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν) ≤ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hol_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hol_strat
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hol_strat.header:
theorem hol_strat (U : Cfg Lf) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρ) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette Lf)
    (hp : p ∈ plaqIn (S.Om 0)) :
    AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy U p)
      ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k p.1) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.plaqMul.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.plaqMul
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.plaqMul.header: noncomputable def plaqMul (h : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → ℝ) : PlaqFnL2 L →L[ℝ] PlaqFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.plaqMul_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.plaqMul_apply
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.plaqMul_apply.header:
theorem plaqMul_apply (h : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → ℝ) (f : PlaqFnL2 L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    plaqMul h f p = h p • f p

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.deltaPrime_diag.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.deltaPrime_diag
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.deltaPrime_diag.header:
theorem deltaPrime_diag (U : Cfg L) (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc U P x x
      = (1 / 2) * ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, if p ∈ P then bilPlaq U p (WithLp.ofLp x) (WithLp.ofLp x) else 0

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.exp_neg_sig_sq.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.exp_neg_sig_sq
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.exp_neg_sig_sq.header:
theorem exp_neg_sig_sq (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) :
    Real.exp (-sigG (geomOf ell k S) x) ^ 2 = 1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k x) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.inv_strat_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.inv_strat_le
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.inv_strat_le.header:
theorem inv_strat_le {x z : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf} (hz : pdist x z ≤ 2) :
    1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k x) ^ 2 ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k z) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.deltaPrime_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.deltaPrime_strat
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.deltaPrime_strat.header:
theorem deltaPrime_strat (U : Cfg Lf) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρ) (x : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    |deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc U (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) x x|
      ≤ (17 / Real.sqrt 2) * 12 * (ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.curlLM_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.curlLM_apply
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.curlLM_apply.header:
theorem curlLM_apply (U : Cfg L) (A : BondFnL2 L) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    (curlCovariantLM_L2 U A) p = curlValueCovariant U (WithLp.ofLp A) p

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.corners_of_plaqIn.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.corners_of_plaqIn
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.corners_of_plaqIn.header:
theorem corners_of_plaqIn {S : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L} (hp : p ∈ plaqIn S) :
    p.1 ∈ S ∧ periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1 ∈ S ∧ periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2 ∈ S ∧
      periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1) p.2.1.2 ∈ S

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.curv_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.curv_strat
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.curv_strat.header:
theorem curv_strat (U : Cfg Lf) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρ) (lam : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ‖plaqMask (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) (curlCovariantLM_L2 U (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U lam))‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 12 * ρ ^ 2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 8 * ‖siteWt (-(sigG (geomOf ell k S) + sigG (geomOf ell k S))) lam‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.plaq_partition.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.plaq_partition
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.plaq_partition.header:
theorem plaq_partition (g : PlaqFnL2 Lf) :
    ∑ p, ‖plaqMul (fun q => AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p q.1) (plaqMask (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) g)‖ ^ 2
      = ‖plaqMask (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) g‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cC_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cC_sum
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cC_sum.header:
theorem cC_sum (U : Cfg Lf) (A : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ∑ p, ‖plaqMul (fun q => AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p q.1)
          (plaqMask (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) (curlCovariantLM_L2 U A))
        - plaqMask (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) (curlCovariantLM_L2 U (bondMul (hbond ell M k κ c S p) A))‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 12 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * KG ell M κ c * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Rproj_norm_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Rproj_norm_le
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Rproj_norm_le.header: theorem Rproj_norm_le (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (s : SiteL2 L) : ‖Rproj G U s‖ ≤ ‖s‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Q_row_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Q_row_bound
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Q_row_bound.header:
theorem Q_row_bound (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (f : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (QpP (geomOf ell k S) U a f)‖ ^ 2 ≤ max a 1 * ‖f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qs_row_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qs_row_bound
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qs_row_bound.header:
theorem Qs_row_bound (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (v : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S) + sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (QpP (geomOf ell k S) U a) v)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ max a 1 * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) v‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.norm_sum5_sq.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.norm_sum5_sq
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.norm_sum5_sq.header:
theorem norm_sum5_sq {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] (a b c d e : V) :
    ‖a + b + c + d + e‖ ^ 2 ≤ 5 * (‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2 + ‖c‖ ^ 2 + ‖d‖ ^ 2 + ‖e‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cX_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cX_sum
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cX_sum.header:
theorem cX_sum (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ∑ p, ‖siteMul (AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p) (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a u)
        - Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a (ypMul (geomOf ell k S) (AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p) u)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 5 * ((ell * Real.sqrt (48 / cs)) ^ 2 * (3 * KG ell M κ c * ‖Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a u‖ ^ 2)
        + (4 * ell / cs) ^ 2 * (3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4 * KG ell M κ c *
            ‖bondWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a u))‖ ^ 2)
        + (4 * ell / cs) ^ 2 * (max a 1 * (9 * a * KG ell M κ c * ‖Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a u‖ ^ 2))
        + (4 * ell / cs) ^ 2 * (9 * a * KG ell M κ c * (max a 1 * ‖Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a u‖ ^ 2))
        + (4 * ell / cs) ^ 2 * (9 * a * KG ell M κ c * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖ ^ 2))

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.T_ims_concrete.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.T_ims_concrete
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.T_ims_concrete.header:
theorem T_ims_concrete (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (Gi : YP (geomOf ell k S) →L[ℝ] YP (geomOf ell k S))
    (hG1 : ∀ u, (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) ∘L Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) (Gi u) = u)
    (hG2 : ∀ u, Gi ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) ∘L Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) u) = u)
    (γ : ℝ) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hγ : ∀ u, ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖ ≤ γ * ‖Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a u‖)
    (A : BondFnL2 Lf) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∑ p, ‖Tfull (geomOf ell k S) U (bondMul (hbond ell M k κ c S p) A)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (1 + ε) * ‖Tfull (geomOf ell k S) U A‖ ^ 2
        + 2 * (1 + 1 / ε) *
          ((5 * ((ell * Real.sqrt (48 / cs)) ^ 2 * (3 * KG ell M κ c)
              + (4 * ell / cs) ^ 2 * (3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4 * KG ell M κ c) *
                  ((ell * (Real.sqrt (12 / cs) + Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1) * (4 / cs)))
                    * Real.sqrt (max a 1) * γ) ^ 2
              + (4 * ell / cs) ^ 2 * (max a 1 * (9 * a * KG ell M κ c))
              + (4 * ell / cs) ^ 2 * (9 * a * KG ell M κ c * max a 1)
              + (4 * ell / cs) ^ 2 * (9 * a * KG ell M κ c * γ ^ 2)))
            * ((ell * (Real.sqrt (12 / cs) + Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1) * (4 / cs)))
                * Real.sqrt (max a 1) * γ) ^ 2
            + 3 * KG ell M κ c) * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_sq_upper'.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_sq_upper'
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ims_sq_upper'.header:
theorem ims_sq_upper' {ι E F : Type*} [Fintype ι] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] (Y : E → F) (m : ι → E → E) (P : ι → F → F) (A : E)
    (hP : ∑ i, ‖P i (Y A)‖ ^ 2 = ‖Y A‖ ^ 2) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∑ i, ‖Y (m i A)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ε) * ‖Y A‖ ^ 2 + (1 + 1 / ε) * ∑ i, ‖Y (m i A) - P i (Y A)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sandwich_ims.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sandwich_ims
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sandwich_ims.header:
theorem sandwich_ims {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (Gi G0 Ni : ι → ℝ) (GA G0A NA η ν C1 ε2 : ℝ)
    (hη0 : 0 ≤ η) (hη1 : η < 1) (hε2 : 0 ≤ ε2) (hν : 0 ≤ ν) (hNA : 0 ≤ NA)
    (hup : ∀ i, Gi i ≤ (1 + η) * G0 i + ν * Ni i)
    (hlow : (1 - η) * G0A - ν * NA ≤ GA)
    (hims : ∑ i, G0 i ≤ (1 + ε2) * G0A + C1 * NA)
    (hN : ∑ i, Ni i = NA) :
    ∑ i, Gi i ≤ ((1 + η) * (1 + ε2) / (1 - η)) * GA
      + ((1 + η) * (1 + ε2) * ν / (1 - η) + (1 + η) * C1 + ν) * NA

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.norm_sub_sq_bounds.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.norm_sub_sq_bounds
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.norm_sub_sq_bounds.header:
theorem norm_sub_sq_bounds {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (x y : V) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ε) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 + (1 + 1 / ε) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ∧
      (1 - ε) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 - (1 / ε) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖x - y‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Ymass.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Ymass
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Ymass.header: noncomputable def Ymass (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] FSp G

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.inner_MassFull_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.inner_MassFull_eq
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.inner_MassFull_eq.header:
theorem inner_MassFull_eq (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    ⟪A, MassFull G a (bondSectorOf G U) A⟫ = ‖Ymass G U a A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.rowMul.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.rowMul
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.rowMul.header: noncomputable def rowMul (G : TowerGeom L) (h : BIdx G → ℝ) : FSp G →L[ℝ] FSp G

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.rowBase.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.rowBase
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.rowBase.header: noncomputable def rowBase (G : TowerGeom L) (p : BIdx G) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.rowBase_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.rowBase_mem
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.rowBase_mem.header:
theorem rowBase_mem {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower Lf} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) : rowBase (geomOf ell k S) p ∈ S.Om 0

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hrow.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hrow
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hrow.header:
noncomputable def hrow {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell M k κ c : ℕ) (S : Tower Lf) (i : Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)
    (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.row_partition.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.row_partition
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.row_partition.header:
theorem row_partition {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell M R k κ c : ℕ} {S : Tower Lf} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 0 < ell) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ∑ i, ‖rowMul (geomOf ell k S) (hrow ell M k κ c S i) y‖ ^ 2 = ‖y‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.MassComm.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.MassComm
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.MassComm.header: def MassComm {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell M k κ c : ℕ) (S : Tower Lf) (U : Cfg Lf) (a CM : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteMask_norm_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteMask_norm_le
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteMask_norm_le.header: theorem siteMask_norm_le (Sset : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (f : SiteL2 L) : ‖siteMask Sset f‖ ≤ ‖f‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Wop_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Wop_eq
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Wop_eq.header:
theorem Wop_eq (hu : IsUnit (LP (geomOf ell k S) U a)) (B : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    Wop (geomOf ell k S) U a B = B - Dm (geomOf ell k S) U (Gp (geomOf ell k S) U a (Tfull (geomOf ell k S) U B))

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginv_form.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginv_form
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginv_form.header:
theorem ginv_form (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hu : IsUnit (LP (geomOf ell k S) U a))
    (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).G)) :
    ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫
      = ‖plaqMask (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) (curlCovariantLM_L2 U ((A : BondFnL2 _) - Dm (geomOf ell k S) U
            (Gp (geomOf ell k S) U a (Tfull (geomOf ell k S) U A))))‖ ^ 2
        + deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc U (plaqIn (S.Om 0))
            ((A : BondFnL2 _) - Dm (geomOf ell k S) U (Gp (geomOf ell k S) U a (Tfull (geomOf ell k S) U A)))
            ((A : BondFnL2 _) - Dm (geomOf ell k S) U (Gp (geomOf ell k S) U a (Tfull (geomOf ell k S) U A)))
        + ‖Tfull (geomOf ell k S) U A‖ ^ 2 + ‖Ymass (geomOf ell k S) U a A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Fform.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Fform
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Fform.header: noncomputable def Fform (S : Tower Lf) (ell k : ℕ) (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.G0form.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.G0form
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.G0form.header: noncomputable def G0form (S : Tower Lf) (ell k : ℕ) (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sandwich.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sandwich
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sandwich.header:
theorem sandwich (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρ) (ε1 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    (1 - (ε1 + (1 + 1 / ε1) * (12 * ρ ^ 2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 8 * (4 * ell / cs) ^ 2)
        + 2 * ((17 / Real.sqrt 2) * 12 * (ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)) *
          ((ell : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (12 / cs) + Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1) * (4 / cs))) ^ 2))
        * G0form S ell k U a B
      - 2 * ((17 / Real.sqrt 2) * 12 * (ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)) * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) B‖ ^ 2
      ≤ Fform S ell k U a B ∧
    Fform S ell k U a B
      ≤ (1 + (ε1 + (1 + 1 / ε1) * (12 * ρ ^ 2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 8 * (4 * ell / cs) ^ 2)
        + 2 * ((17 / Real.sqrt 2) * 12 * (ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)) *
          ((ell : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (12 / cs) + Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1) * (4 / cs))) ^ 2))
        * G0form S ell k U a B
      + 2 * ((17 / Real.sqrt 2) * 12 * (ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)) * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hbond.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hbond
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hbond.header: noncomputable def hbond (ell M k κ c : ℕ) (S : Tower L) (p : Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite L) (b : Bond L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hbond_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hbond_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hbond_nonneg.header:
theorem hbond_nonneg (ell M k κ c : ℕ) (S : Tower L) (p : Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite L) (b : Bond L) :
    0 ≤ hbond ell M k κ c S p b

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_hbond_sq.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_hbond_sq
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_hbond_sq.header:
theorem sum_hbond_sq {ell M k κ c : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {b : Bond L} (hb : b.1 ∈ S.Om 0 ∨ periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ S.Om 0) :
    ∑ p, hbond ell M k κ c S p b ^ 2 = 1

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hbond_supp.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hbond_supp
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hbond_supp.header:
theorem hbond_supp {ell M k κ c : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {p : Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite L} {b : Bond L} (h : hbond ell M k κ c S p b ≠ 0) :
    IsPatch ell M k κ S p.1.val p.2 ∧
      (b.1 ∈ patch ell M κ c p.1.val p.2 ∨ periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ patch ell M κ c p.1.val p.2)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.locF.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.locF
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.locF.header:
noncomputable def locF (ell M k κ c : ℕ) (S : Tower L) (p : Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.locF_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.locF_apply
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.locF_apply.header:
theorem locF_apply (ell M k κ c : ℕ) (S : Tower L) (p : Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite L) (A : BondFnL2 L)
    (b : Bond L) : (WithLp.ofLp (locF ell M k κ c S p A)) b = hbond ell M k κ c S p b • (WithLp.ofLp A) b

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wnormSq_locF.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wnormSq_locF
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wnormSq_locF.header:
theorem wnormSq_locF (ell M k κ c : ℕ) (S : Tower L) (p : Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    wnormSq S ell k (locF ell M k κ c S p A)
      = ∑ b : Bond L, (((ell : ℝ) ^ bstrat S k b)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (hbond ell M k κ c S p b ^ 2 * ‖(WithLp.ofLp A) b‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wnorm_partition.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wnorm_partition
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wnorm_partition.header:
theorem wnorm_partition {ell M k κ c : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (A : BondFnL2 L) (hA : ∀ b : Bond L, ¬ (b.1 ∈ S.Om 0 ∨ periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ S.Om 0) → (WithLp.ofLp A) b = 0) :
    ∑ p, wnormSq S ell k (locF ell M k κ c S p A) = wnormSq S ell k A

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.locF_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.locF_mem
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.locF_mem.header:
theorem locF_mem (p : Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G)) :
    locF ell M k κ c S p (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ∈ bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.locB.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.locB
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.locB.header:
noncomputable def locB (p : Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G)) : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginvForm.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginvForm
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginvForm.header: noncomputable def ginvForm (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wN.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wN
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wN.header: noncomputable def wN (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginvForm_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginvForm_zero
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginvForm_zero.header: theorem ginvForm_zero : ginvForm ell k Lu hell S U a Lam 0 = 0

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.patch_of_PatchCoercive.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.patch_of_PatchCoercive
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.patch_of_PatchCoercive.header:
theorem patch_of_PatchCoercive (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (cP : ℝ)
    (hP : PatchCoercive ell M k κ c Lu hell S U a Lam cP) (p : Fin (k + 1) × PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G)) :
    cP * wN ell k Lu hell S U a Lam (locB ell M k κ c Lu hell S U a Lam p A)
      ≤ ginvForm ell k Lu hell S U a Lam (locB ell M k κ c Lu hell S U a Lam p A)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wN_partition.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wN_partition
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wN_partition.header:
theorem wN_partition (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G)) :
    ∑ p, wN ell k Lu hell S U a Lam (locB ell M k κ c Lu hell S U a Lam p A) = wN ell k Lu hell S U a Lam A

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginv_weighted_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginv_weighted_coercive_of
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginv_weighted_coercive.header:
theorem ginv_weighted_coercive_of (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (ε e cP : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hims : GinvIMS ell M k κ c Lu hell S U a Lam ε e) (hP : PatchCoercive ell M k κ c Lu hell S U a Lam cP)
    (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G)) :
    ((cP - e) / (1 + ε)) * wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
      ≤ ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.N_le_wnorm.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.N_le_wnorm
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.N_le_wnorm.header:
theorem N_le_wnorm (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell0 : 0 < ell) (B : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) B‖ ^ 2 ≤ AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k B

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.nsum_partition.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.nsum_partition
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.nsum_partition.header:
theorem nsum_partition (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (hell0 : 0 < ell)
    (B : BondFnL2 Lf) (hB : ∀ b : Bond Lf, ¬ (b.1 ∈ S.Om 0 ∨ periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ S.Om 0) → B b = 0) :
    ∑ p, ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (bondMul (hbond ell M k κ c S p) B)‖ ^ 2
      = ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wnormSq_ge.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wnormSq_ge
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wnormSq_ge.header:
theorem wnormSq_ge (S : Tower L) {ell : ℕ} (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (k : ℕ) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ‖A‖ ^ 2 ≤ wnormSq S ell k A

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.G1inv_coercive_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.G1inv_coercive_strat
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.G1inv_coercive_strat.header:
theorem G1inv_coercive_strat (cw ε2 : ℝ)
    (hcoer : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G),
      cw * wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ≤ ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫)
    (hD2 : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G),
      |⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).data.Delta2 (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).data_laws A⟫|
        ≤ ε2 * wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G)) :
    (cw - ε2) * wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
      ≤ ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G1inv A⟫

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.G1inv_coercive_plain.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.G1inv_coercive_plain
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.G1inv_coercive_plain.header:
theorem G1inv_coercive_plain (cw ε2 : ℝ) (hε : ε2 ≤ cw)
    (hcoer : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G),
      cw * wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ≤ ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫)
    (hD2 : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G),
      |⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).data.Delta2 (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).data_laws A⟫|
        ≤ ε2 * wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G)) :
    ((cw - ε2) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ ^ 2) * ‖A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G1inv A⟫

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.units_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.units_strat
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.units_strat.header:
theorem units_strat (cw ε2 : ℝ) (hε : ε2 < cw)
    (hcoer : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G),
      cw * wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ≤ ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫)
    (hD2 : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G),
      |⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).data.Delta2 (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).data_laws A⟫|
        ≤ ε2 * wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hQs : Function.Injective (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).data.Qs) :
    IsUnit (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).G1inv ∧ IsUnit (GenP.Nmat (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam))

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.CTc.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.CTc
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.CTc.header: noncomputable def CTc (ell M κ c W : ℕ) (a cs γ : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.nuC.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.nuC
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.nuC.header: noncomputable def nuC (ell : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.etaC.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.etaC
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.etaC.header: noncomputable def etaC (ell W : ℕ) (cs ρ ε1 : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.C1c.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.C1c
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.C1c.header: noncomputable def C1c (ell M κ c W : ℕ) (a cs γ CM ε2 : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginvIMS_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginvIMS_of
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginvIMS_of.header:
theorem ginvIMS_of (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a cs : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (Gi : YP (geomOf ell k S) →L[ℝ] YP (geomOf ell k S))
    (hG1 : ∀ u, (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) ∘L Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) (Gi u) = u)
    (hG2 : ∀ u, Gi ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) ∘L Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) u) = u)
    (γ : ℝ) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hγ : ∀ u, ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖ ≤ γ * ‖Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a u‖)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρ)
    (CM : ℝ) (hCM : 0 ≤ CM) (hMass : MassComm ell M k κ c S U a CM)
    (ε1 ε2 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1) (hε2 : 0 < ε2) (hη : etaC ell W cs ρ ε1 < 1) :
    GinvIMS ell M k κ c Lu hell0 S U a Lam
      ((1 + etaC ell W cs ρ ε1) * (1 + ε2) / (1 - etaC ell W cs ρ ε1) - 1)
      ((1 + etaC ell W cs ρ ε1) * (1 + ε2) * (2 * nuC ell ρ) / (1 - etaC ell W cs ρ ε1)
        + (1 + etaC ell W cs ρ ε1) * C1c ell M κ c W a cs γ CM ε2 + 2 * nuC ell ρ)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginv_weighted_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginv_weighted_coercive
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginv_weighted_coercive.header:
theorem ginv_weighted_coercive (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a cs : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (Gi : YP (geomOf ell k S) →L[ℝ] YP (geomOf ell k S))
    (hG1 : ∀ u, (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) ∘L Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) (Gi u) = u)
    (hG2 : ∀ u, Gi ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) ∘L Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) u) = u)
    (γ : ℝ) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hγ : ∀ u, ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖ ≤ γ * ‖Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a u‖)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρ)
    (CM : ℝ) (hCM : 0 ≤ CM) (hMass : MassComm ell M k κ c S U a CM)
    (ε1 ε2 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1) (hε2 : 0 < ε2) (hη : etaC ell W cs ρ ε1 < 1)
    (cP : ℝ) (hP : PatchCoercive ell M k κ c Lu hell0 S U a Lam cP)
    (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).G)) :
    ((cP - ((1 + etaC ell W cs ρ ε1) * (1 + ε2) * (2 * nuC ell ρ) / (1 - etaC ell W cs ρ ε1)
        + (1 + etaC ell W cs ρ ε1) * C1c ell M κ c W a cs γ CM ε2 + 2 * nuC ell ρ))
      / (1 + ((1 + etaC ell W cs ρ ε1) * (1 + ε2) / (1 - etaC ell W cs ρ ε1) - 1)))
      * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
      ≤ ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp.header: noncomputable def tp (n t : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_pos.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_pos
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_pos.header: theorem tp_pos {n t : ℕ} (ht : t < n) : 0 < tp n t

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_le
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_le.header: theorem tp_le {n t : ℕ} : tp n t ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / 4

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_step.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_step
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_step.header: theorem tp_step {n t : ℕ} (ht : t + 1 < n) : |tp n (t + 1) - tp n t| ≤ n

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_zero
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_zero.header: theorem tp_zero (n : ℕ) : tp n 0 = n

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_last.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_last
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_last.header: theorem tp_last {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : tp n (n - 1) = n

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_range_succ_cast.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_range_succ_cast
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_range_succ_cast.header: theorem sum_range_succ_cast (n : ℕ) : ∑ t ∈ range n, ((t : ℝ) + 1) = (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) / 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_sum
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_sum.header: theorem tp_sum (n : ℕ) : ∑ t ∈ range n, tp n t = (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 2) / 6

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.blockSum_prod.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.blockSum_prod
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.blockSum_prod.header:
theorem blockSum_prod {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ)
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1) (f : Fin 3 → ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf y n, ∏ μ : Fin 3, f μ ((x μ).val - (y μ).val)
      = ∏ μ : Fin 3, ∑ t ∈ range n, f μ t

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.row_drift_gen.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.row_drift_gen
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.row_drift_gen.header:
theorem row_drift_gen (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (ell : ℕ) (hellG : G.ell = ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (j : ℕ)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ j)) (hdvdj : ∀ μ, ell ^ j ∣ L μ + 1)
    (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i)
    (hT : ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower G U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ i)
    (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖Qlev G U j y f - Qlev G (trivialU L) j y f‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ i) ^ 2 * ((1 / ((ell ^ j : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3) * ∑ x, ‖f x‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Sn_pos.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Sn_pos
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Sn_pos.header: theorem Sn_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : 0 < Sn n

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB.header: noncomputable def phiB (n : ℕ) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_nonneg.header: theorem phiB_nonneg (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : 0 ≤ phiB n y x

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_sum
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_sum.header:
theorem phiB_sum (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf y n, phiB n y x = (n : ℝ) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_le
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_le.header: theorem phiB_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : phiB n y x ≤ 4

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_coef.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_coef
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_coef.header:
theorem phiB_coef (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (n : ℝ) ^ 3 / Sn n ^ 3 * ((n : ℝ) * (((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / 4) ^ 2) ≤ 14 / n

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_nonneg_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_nonneg_of
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tp_nonneg_of.header: theorem tp_nonneg_of {n t : ℕ} (ht : t < n) : 0 ≤ tp n t

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.erase_prod_bounds.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.erase_prod_bounds
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.erase_prod_bounds.header:
theorem erase_prod_bounds {n : ℕ} {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ blockOf y n) (μ : Fin 3) :
    0 ≤ ∏ ν ∈ univ.erase μ, tp n ((x ν).val - (y ν).val)
      ∧ ∏ ν ∈ univ.erase μ, tp n ((x ν).val - (y ν).val) ≤ (((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / 4) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_split.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_split
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_split.header:
theorem phiB_split (n : ℕ) {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ blockOf y n) (μ : Fin 3) :
    phiB n y x = (n : ℝ) ^ 3 / Sn n ^ 3 * (tp n ((x μ).val - (y μ).val) * ∏ ν ∈ univ.erase μ, tp n ((x ν).val - (y ν).val))

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_edge_val.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_edge_val
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_edge_val.header:
theorem phiB_edge_val (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ blockOf y n) (μ : Fin 3)
    (ht : tp n ((x μ).val - (y μ).val) = n) : phiB n y x ≤ 14 / n

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_out.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_out
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_out.header:
theorem phiB_out (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1)
    (hx : x ∈ blockOf y n) (μ : Fin 3) (hout : periodicLatticeShift x μ ∉ blockOf y n) : phiB n y x ≤ 14 / n

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_in.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_in
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_in.header:
theorem phiB_in (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (μ : Fin 3)
    (hin : periodicLatticeShift x μ ∈ blockOf y n) (hx : x ∉ blockOf y n) :
    phiB n y (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ≤ 14 / n

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_step.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_step
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.phiB_step.header:
theorem phiB_step (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1)
    (hx : x ∈ blockOf y n) (μ : Fin 3) (hh : periodicLatticeShift x μ ∈ blockOf y n) :
    |phiB n y (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - phiB n y x| ≤ 14 / n

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.grad_tent_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.grad_tent_le
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.grad_tent_le.header:
theorem grad_tent_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (U : Cfg L) (yb : ι → PeriodicLatticeSite L) (nb : ι → ℕ)
    (hfit : ∀ i, ∀ μ, (yb i μ).val + nb i ≤ L μ + 1)
    (hdisj : ∀ i i', i ≠ i' → Disjoint (blockOf (yb i) (nb i)) (blockOf (yb i') (nb i')))
    (c : ι → SuTwo) (φ : ι → PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (Gf : SiteL2 L)
    (hon : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ blockOf (yb i) (nb i), Gf x = φ i x • c i)
    (hoff : ∀ x, (∀ i, x ∉ blockOf (yb i) (nb i)) → Gf x = 0)
    (Φ s e : ι → ℝ) (hφ0 : ∀ i x, 0 ≤ φ i x) (hφΦ : ∀ i x, φ i x ≤ Φ i)
    (hstep : ∀ i, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds (yb i) (nb i), |φ i (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - φ i b.1| ≤ s i)
    (hout : ∀ i x (μ : Fin 3), x ∈ blockOf (yb i) (nb i) → periodicLatticeShift x μ ∉ blockOf (yb i) (nb i) → φ i x ≤ e i)
    (hin : ∀ i x (μ : Fin 3), periodicLatticeShift x μ ∈ blockOf (yb i) (nb i) → x ∉ blockOf (yb i) (nb i) →
      φ i (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ≤ e i)
    (δ : ι → ℝ) (hδ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i)
    (hU : ∀ i, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds (yb i) (nb i), frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ i) :
    ‖gradL2 U Gf‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, (3 * (nb i : ℝ) ^ 3 * (8 * Φ i ^ 2 * δ i ^ 2 + 2 * s i ^ 2)
      + 12 * ((nb i : ℝ) * nb i) * e i ^ 2) * ‖c i‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.extT.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.extT
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.extT.header: noncomputable def extT (G : TowerGeom L) (ell : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (u : YP G) : SiteL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tentF.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tentF
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tentF.header: noncomputable def tentF (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ) (c : SuTwo) : SiteL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.extT_on.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.extT_on
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.extT_on.header:
theorem extT_on (u : YP G) (q : QIdx G) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ blockOf (yq q) (ell ^ jq q)) :
    extT G ell a u x = phiB (ell ^ jq q) (yq q) x • cq G a u q

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.extT_off.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.extT_off
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.extT_off.header:
theorem extT_off (u : YP G) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∉ G.Om0) :
    extT G ell a u x = u (Sum.inr ⟨x, hx⟩)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.mask_extT_on.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.mask_extT_on
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.mask_extT_on.header:
theorem mask_extT_on (u : YP G) (q : QIdx G) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ blockOf (yq q) (ell ^ jq q)) :
    siteMask G.Om0 (extT G ell a u) x = phiB (ell ^ jq q) (yq q) x • cq G a u q

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.mask_extT_off.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.mask_extT_off

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.QpP_extT_inr.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.QpP_extT_inr
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.QpP_extT_inr.header:
theorem QpP_extT_inr (U : Cfg L) (u : YP G) (x : OffIdx G) :
    QpP G U a (extT G ell a u) (Sum.inr x) = u (Sum.inr x)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qlev_flat_tent.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qlev_flat_tent
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qlev_flat_tent.header:
theorem Qlev_flat_tent (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (j : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (G.ell ^ j)) (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + G.ell ^ j ≤ L μ + 1) (c : SuTwo) :
    Qlev G (trivialU L) j y (tentF y (G.ell ^ j) c) = c

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tentF_sq.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tentF_sq
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tentF_sq.header:
theorem tentF_sq (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1) (c : SuTwo) :
    ∑ x, ‖tentF y n c x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (n : ℝ) ^ 3 * ‖c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.extT_row.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.extT_row
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.extT_row.header:
theorem extT_row (u : YP G) (q : QIdx G) :
    ‖QpP G U a (extT G ell a u) (Sum.inl q) - u (Sum.inl q)‖ ≤ 12 * ρ * ‖u (Sum.inl q)‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.extT_energy.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.extT_energy
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.extT_energy.header:
theorem extT_energy (u : YP G) :
    ⟪extT G ell a u, LP G U a (extT G ell a u)⟫ ≤ ((1 + 12 * ρ) ^ 2 + (512 * ρ ^ 2 + 4704) / a) * ‖u‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.gamma_lower_approx.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.gamma_lower_approx
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.gamma_lower_approx.header:
theorem gamma_lower_approx (H : SiteHyp S E Y) (q b η : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hη : η ≤ 1)
    (hQ : ‖H.Qp‖ ≤ q) (u : Y) (g : S)
    (hrow : (1 - η) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪H.Qp g, u⟫) (hgL : ⟪g, H.L g⟫ ≤ b * ‖u‖ ^ 2) :
    (1 - η) ^ 2 * ‖u‖ ≤ q * b * ‖H.X u‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypWt_le_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypWt_le_of
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypWt_le_of.header:
theorem ypWt_le_of (G : TowerGeom Lf) (φ χ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (h : ∀ x, φ x ≤ χ x) (v : YP G) :
    ‖ypWt G φ v‖ ≤ ‖ypWt G χ v‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypWt_add_const.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypWt_add_const
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypWt_add_const.header:
theorem ypWt_add_const (G : TowerGeom Lf) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (v : YP G) :
    ypWt G (fun x => φ x + c) v = Real.exp c • ypWt G φ v

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteWt_zero_fn.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteWt_zero_fn
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteWt_zero_fn.header: theorem siteWt_zero_fn (f : SiteL2 Lf) : siteWt (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) f = f

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.QpP_siteWt_sig.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.QpP_siteWt_sig
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.QpP_siteWt_sig.header:
theorem QpP_siteWt_sig (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (f : SiteL2 Lf) :
    QpP (geomOf ell k S) U a (siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) f)
      = ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (QpP (geomOf ell k S) U a f)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qh_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qh_le
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qh_le.header:
theorem Qh_le (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (f : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ‖Qh (geomOf ell k S) U a f‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (max a 1) * ‖f‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qh_opnorm.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qh_opnorm
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qh_opnorm.header:
theorem Qh_opnorm (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ‖Qh (geomOf ell k S) U a‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (max a 1)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatX_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatX_eq
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatX_eq.header:
theorem hatX_eq (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    (psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).X u = siteWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a u)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.yp_sig_le_psi.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.yp_sig_le_psi
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.yp_sig_le_psi.header:
theorem yp_sig_le_psi (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖ ≤ (ell : ℝ) * ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (psiW S W ell k) u‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hat_ext.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hat_ext
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hat_ext.header:
theorem hat_ext (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hU : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hT : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j),
      z ∈ CoarseLattice Lf (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3, coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower (geomOf ell k S) U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    (1 - 12 * ρ) * ‖u‖ ^ 2
        ≤ ⟪(psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).Qp
            (siteWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (extT (geomOf ell k S) ell a u)), u⟫
      ∧ ⟪siteWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (extT (geomOf ell k S) ell a u),
          (psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).L (siteWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (extT (geomOf ell k S) ell a u))⟫
        ≤ ((1 + 12 * ρ) ^ 2 + (512 * ρ ^ 2 + 4704) / a) * ‖u‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.gamma_sharp.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.gamma_sharp
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.gamma_sharp.header:
theorem gamma_sharp (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (h12 : 12 * ρ ≤ 1)
    (hU : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hT : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j),
      z ∈ CoarseLattice Lf (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3, coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower (geomOf ell k S) U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hsm : Real.sqrt (max a 1) * ((1 + 12 * ρ) ^ 2 + (512 * ρ ^ 2 + 4704) / a)
        * (psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).epsX (Real.sqrt (max a 1)) < (1 - 12 * ρ) ^ 2)
    (u : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖ypWt (geomOf ell k S) (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) u‖
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (max a 1) * ((1 + 12 * ρ) ^ 2 + (512 * ρ ^ 2 + 4704) / a))
          / ((1 - 12 * ρ) ^ 2 - Real.sqrt (max a 1) * ((1 + 12 * ρ) ^ 2 + (512 * ρ ^ 2 + 4704) / a)
              * (psiHypP hS hW hell hR hM hWR U a cs hp).epsX (Real.sqrt (max a 1)))
        * ‖Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a u‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.csOf.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.csOf
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.csOf.header: noncomputable def csOf (a ρ : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatPack_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatPack_of
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatPack_of.header:
theorem hatPack_of (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (h216 : 216 * ρ ^ 2 < 1)
    (hU : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hT : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j),
      z ∈ CoarseLattice Lf (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3, coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower (geomOf ell k S) U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hsm : 24 * ((Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2
          + 1 * (Real.sqrt a * (Real.exp (3 * (ell : ℝ) * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2) ≤ csOf a ρ)
    (hsmD : 4 * (Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2 ≤ csOf a ρ) :
    HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a (csOf a ρ)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.gamC.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.gamC
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.gamC.header: noncomputable def gamC (ell : ℕ) (a ρ eX : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginv_weighted_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginv_weighted_coercive_M1
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginv_weighted_coercive.header:
theorem ginv_weighted_coercive_M1 (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (h216 : 216 * ρ ^ 2 < 1) (h12 : 12 * ρ ≤ 1)
    (hU : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hT : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j),
      z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3, coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower (geomOf ell k S) U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hsm : 24 * ((Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2
          + 1 * (Real.sqrt a * (Real.exp (3 * (ell : ℝ) * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2) ≤ csOf a ρ)
    (hsmD : 4 * (Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2 ≤ csOf a ρ)
    (hgs : Real.sqrt (max a 1) * ((1 + 12 * ρ) ^ 2 + (512 * ρ ^ 2 + 4704) / a)
        * (psiHypP hS hW hell hR1 (by omega) hWR U a (csOf a ρ)
            (hatPack_of hS hell U a ha ρ hρ h216 hU hT hsm hsmD)).epsX (Real.sqrt (max a 1)) < (1 - 12 * ρ) ^ 2)
    (ρh : ℝ) (hρh : 0 ≤ ρh) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρh)
    (CM : ℝ) (hCM : 0 ≤ CM) (hMass : MassComm ell M k κ c S U a CM)
    (ε1 ε2 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1) (hε2 : 0 < ε2) (hη : etaC ell W (csOf a ρ) ρh ε1 < 1)
    (cP : ℝ) (hP : PatchCoercive ell M k κ c Lu hell0 S U a Lam cP)
    (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).G)) :
    ((cP - ((1 + etaC ell W (csOf a ρ) ρh ε1) * (1 + ε2) * (2 * nuC ell ρh) / (1 - etaC ell W (csOf a ρ) ρh ε1)
        + (1 + etaC ell W (csOf a ρ) ρh ε1) * C1c ell M κ c W a (csOf a ρ)
            (gamC ell a ρ ((psiHypP hS hW hell hR1 (by omega) hWR U a (csOf a ρ)
              (hatPack_of hS hell U a ha ρ hρ h216 hU hT hsm hsmD)).epsX (Real.sqrt (max a 1)))) CM ε2
        + 2 * nuC ell ρh))
      / (1 + ((1 + etaC ell W (csOf a ρ) ρh ε1) * (1 + ε2) / (1 - etaC ell W (csOf a ρ) ρh ε1) - 1)))
      * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
      ≤ ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qrow_local.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qrow_local
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qrow_local.header:
theorem Qrow_local (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S))
    (hx : ∀ b, Foot ell (p.1 : ℕ) p.2.1 b → x b = 0) :

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qrow_restr.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qrow_restr
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qrow_restr.header:
theorem Qrow_restr (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k)
    (y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) :
    (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) U).Qfull y p
