AdalyFormal.M1IMS.row_aligned.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.row_aligned
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.row_aligned.header:
theorem row_aligned (hell : 0 < ell) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) :
    p.2.1.1 ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ (p.1 : ℕ))

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.EQ.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.EQ
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.EQ.header: noncomputable def EQ (ell k : ℕ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.EQ_pos.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.EQ_pos
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.EQ_pos.header: theorem EQ_pos (ell k : ℕ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) : 0 < EQ ell k ε

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qrow_norm.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qrow_norm
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qrow_norm.header:
theorem Qrow_norm (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) U).Qfull y p‖
      ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ))⁻¹ * ((rr ell) ^ (p.1 : ℕ) * EQ ell k ε) * ‖y‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.pdist_of_reach.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.pdist_of_reach
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.pdist_of_reach.header: theorem pdist_of_reach {m : ℕ} {x z : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (h : Reach m x z) : pdist x z ≤ m

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hvec_reach.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hvec_reach
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hvec_reach.header:
theorem hvec_reach (h : ι → PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (s0 : ℝ) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s0) :
    ∀ (l : List (Fin 3)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (m : ℕ), l.length ≤ m →
      (∀ w, pdist x w < m → ∀ μ, dist (hvec h w) (hvec h (periodicLatticeShift w μ)) ≤ s0) →

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ginv_weighted_coercive.header:

    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (h216 : 216 * ρ ^ 2 < 1) (h12 : 12 * ρ ≤ 1)
    (hU : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),

    (hT : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j),

        * (psiHypP hS hW hell hR1 (by omega) hWR U a (csOf a ρ)
            (hatPack_of hS hell U a ha ρ hρ h216 hU hT hsm hsmD)).epsX (Real.sqrt (max a 1)) < (1 - 12 * ρ) ^ 2)
    (ρh : ℝ) (hρh : 0 ≤ ρh) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρh)
    (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hregT : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)

      ≤ ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫

      z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3, coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower (geomOf ell k S) U' i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hsm : 24 * ((Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2
          + 1 * (Real.sqrt a * (Real.exp (3 * (ell : ℝ) * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2) ≤ csOf a ρ)
    (hsmD : 4 * (Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2 ≤ csOf a ρ)
    (hgs : Real.sqrt (max a 1) * ((1 + 12 * ρ) ^ 2 + (512 * ρ ^ 2 + 4704) / a)
        * (psiHypP hS hW hell hR1 (by omega) hWR U' a (csOf a ρ)
            (hatPack_of hS hell U' a ha ρ hρ h216 hU hT hsm hsmD)).epsX (Real.sqrt (max a 1)) < (1 - 12 * ρ) ^ 2)
    (ρh : ℝ) (hρh : 0 ≤ ρh) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U' ρh)
    (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hregT : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U') k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U' ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsmε : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (ε1 ε2 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1) (hε2 : 0 < ε2) (hη : etaC ell W (csOf a ρ) ρh ε1 < 1)
    (cP : ℝ) (hP : PatchCoercive ell M k κ c Lu hell0 S U a Lam0 cP)
    (ε2' : ℝ)
    (hlt : ε2' < cwW4 ell M κ c W a ρ ρh ε1 ε2 cP
        ((psiHypP hS hW hell hR1 (by omega) hWR U' a (csOf a ρ)
          (hatPack_of hS hell U' a ha ρ hρ h216 hU hT hsm hsmD)).epsX (Real.sqrt (max a 1)))
        (CMc ell M κ c k a ε))
    (hD2 : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U' a Lam0).G),
      |⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U' a Lam0).data.Delta2 (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U' a Lam0).data_laws A⟫|
        ≤ ε2' * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hQs : Function.Injective (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U' a Lam0).data.Qs)
    (hd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1) (e0 : ℝ) (he0 : 0 ≤ e0) (hle : e0 ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4))
    (hr : Real.pi / 2 * ((SmallnessBridge.Assemble.loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * e0) < r0)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm (((gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U' a Lam0).unitBgU e : M2) - 1) ≤ e0) :
    GenP.WellDef (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam0)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.T_loc_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.T_loc_le
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.T_loc_le.header:
theorem T_loc_le (Dst : E →L[ℝ] S) (X : Y →L[ℝ] S) (R : S →L[ℝ] S) (hR : ∀ s, ‖R s‖ ≤ ‖s‖)
    (hRX : ∀ u, R (X u) = 0) (hE : E →L[ℝ] E) (hS : S →L[ℝ] S) (hY : Y →L[ℝ] Y) (A : E) (u : Y)
    (hdec : Dst A = R (Dst A) + X u) :
    ‖R (Dst (hE A))‖ ≤ ‖hS (R (Dst A))‖ + ‖hS (X u) - X (hY u)‖ + ‖Dst (hE A) - hS (Dst A)‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_sq3_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_sq3_le
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_sq3_le.header:
theorem sum_sq3_le (a b c : ι → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∑ i, (a i + b i + c i) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ε) * ∑ i, a i ^ 2 + 2 * (1 + 1 / ε) * (∑ i, b i ^ 2 + ∑ i, c i ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.T_ims_upper.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.T_ims_upper
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.T_ims_upper.header:
theorem T_ims_upper (Dst : E →L[ℝ] S) (X : Y →L[ℝ] S) (R : S →L[ℝ] S) (hR : ∀ s, ‖R s‖ ≤ ‖s‖)
    (hRX : ∀ u, R (X u) = 0) (hE : ι → E →L[ℝ] E) (hS : ι → S →L[ℝ] S) (hY : ι → Y →L[ℝ] Y) (A : E) (u : Y)
    (hdec : Dst A = R (Dst A) + X u) (hpart : ∑ i, ‖hS i (R (Dst A))‖ ^ 2 = ‖R (Dst A)‖ ^ 2) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∑ i, ‖R (Dst (hE i A))‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ε) * ‖R (Dst A)‖ ^ 2
      + 2 * (1 + 1 / ε) * (∑ i, ‖hS i (X u) - X (hY i u)‖ ^ 2 + ∑ i, ‖Dst (hE i A) - hS i (Dst A)‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.commInv.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.commInv
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.commInv.header:
theorem commInv (L G h : S →L[ℝ] S) (hLG : ∀ s, L (G s) = s) (hGL : ∀ s, G (L s) = s) (s : S) :
    h (G s) - G (h s) = G (L (h (G s)) - h (L (G s)))

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.commL_expand.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.commL_expand
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.commL_expand.header:
theorem commL_expand (D : S →L[ℝ] E) (Q : S →L[ℝ] Y) (hS : S →L[ℝ] S) (hE : E →L[ℝ] E) (hY : Y →L[ℝ] Y) (f : S) :
    (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D ∘L D + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q ∘L Q) (hS f)
      - hS ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D ∘L D + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q ∘L Q) f)
    = -(ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D (hE (D f) - D (hS f))
        + (hS (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D (D f)) - ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D (hE (D f)))
        + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q (hY (Q f) - Q (hS f))
        + (hS (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q (Q f)) - ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q (hY (Q f))))

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cX_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cX_eq
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cX_eq.header:
theorem cX_eq (D : S →L[ℝ] E) (Q : S →L[ℝ] Y) (G : S →L[ℝ] S)
    (hLG : ∀ s, (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D ∘L D + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q ∘L Q) (G s) = s)
    (hGL : ∀ s, G ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D ∘L D + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q ∘L Q) s) = s)
    (hS : S →L[ℝ] S) (hE : E →L[ℝ] E) (hY : Y →L[ℝ] Y) (u : Y) :
    hS (G (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q u)) - G (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q (hY u))
      = -G (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D (hE (D (G (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q u)))
              - D (hS (G (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q u))))
          + (hS (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D (D (G (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q u))))
              - ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D (hE (D (G (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q u)))))
          + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q (hY (Q (G (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q u)))
              - Q (hS (G (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q u))))
          + (hS (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q (Q (G (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q u))))
              - ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q (hY (Q (G (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q u))))))
        + G (hS (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q u) - ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q (hY u))

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.f_sq_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.f_sq_eq
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.f_sq_eq.header:
theorem f_sq_eq (Dst : E →L[ℝ] S) (X : Y →L[ℝ] S) (R : S →L[ℝ] S) (hRs : ∀ s t, ⟪R s, t⟫ = ⟪s, R t⟫)
    (hRX : ∀ u, R (X u) = 0) (A : E) (u : Y) (hdec : Dst A = R (Dst A) + X u) :
    ‖X u‖ ^ 2 = ⟪X u, Dst A⟫

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.capW.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.capW
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.capW.header: noncomputable def capW (W ell m : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dcap.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dcap
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dcap.header: noncomputable def dcap (S : Tower L) (W ell m : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw.header: noncomputable def tw (S : Tower L) (W ell m : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiW.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiW
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiW.header: noncomputable def psiW (S : Tower L) (W ell k : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.capW_pos.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.capW_pos
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.capW_pos.header: theorem capW_pos {W ell : ℕ} (hW : 1 ≤ W) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (m : ℕ) : 0 < capW W ell m

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dcap_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dcap_le
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dcap_le.header: theorem dcap_le (S : Tower L) (W ell m : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : dcap S W ell m x ≤ capW W ell m

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dcap_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dcap_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dcap_nonneg.header:
theorem dcap_nonneg (S : Tower L) {W ell : ℕ} (hW : 1 ≤ W) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (m : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    0 ≤ dcap S W ell m x

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dcap_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dcap_lip
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dcap_lip.header:
theorem dcap_lip (S : Tower L) (W ell m : ℕ) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    |dcap S W ell m x - dcap S W ell m y| ≤ (pdist x y : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dcap_off.header:
theorem dcap_off (S : Tower L) {W ell : ℕ} (hW : 1 ≤ W) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (m : ℕ) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hx : x ∉ S.Om (m + 1)) : dcap S W ell m x = 0

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dcap_deep.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dcap_deep

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw_nonneg.header:
theorem tw_nonneg (S : Tower L) {W ell : ℕ} (hW : 1 ≤ W) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (m : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    0 ≤ tw S W ell m x

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw_le_one.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw_le_one
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw_le_one.header:
theorem tw_le_one (S : Tower L) {W ell : ℕ} (hW : 1 ≤ W) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (m : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    tw S W ell m x ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw_lip
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw_lip.header:
theorem tw_lip (S : Tower L) {W ell : ℕ} (hW : 1 ≤ W) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (m : ℕ) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    |tw S W ell m x - tw S W ell m y| ≤ (pdist x y : ℝ) / capW W ell m

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw_of_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw_of_strat
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw_of_strat.header:
theorem tw_of_strat {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) {W : ℕ} (hW : 1 ≤ W)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hWR : W ≤ R * M * ell) {m : ℕ} (hm : m < k) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (strat S k x ≤ m → tw S W ell m x = 0) ∧ (m + 2 ≤ strat S k x → tw S W ell m x = 1)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiW_bounds.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiW_bounds
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiW_bounds.header:
theorem psiW_bounds {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) {W : ℕ} (hW : 1 ≤ W)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hWR : W ≤ R * M * ell) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    0 ≤ psiW S W ell k x ∧ psiW S W ell k x ≤ (strat S k x : ℝ) * Real.log ell ∧
      ((strat S k x : ℝ) - 1) * Real.log ell ≤ psiW S W ell k x

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw_eq_of_adj.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw_eq_of_adj
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.tw_eq_of_adj.header:
theorem tw_eq_of_adj {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) {W : ℕ} (hW : 1 ≤ W)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hWR : W ≤ R * M * ell) {m : ℕ} (hm : m < k)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (hne : strat S k x ≠ m + 1)
    (hne' : strat S k (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ≠ m + 1) :
    tw S W ell m x = tw S W ell m (periodicLatticeShift x μ)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiW_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiW_lip
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiW_lip.header:
theorem psiW_lip {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) {W : ℕ} (hW : 1 ≤ W)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hWR : W ≤ R * M * ell) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    |psiW S W ell k x - psiW S W ell k (periodicLatticeShift x μ)|
        ≤ (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) / (ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ∧
      |psiW S W ell k x - psiW S W ell k (periodicLatticeShift x μ)|
        ≤ (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) / (ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k x

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiW_osc.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiW_osc
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiW_osc.header:
theorem psiW_osc {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) {W : ℕ} (hW : 1 ≤ W)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hWR : W ≤ R * M * ell) {j : ℕ} {x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hx : strat S k x = j) (hy : strat S k y = j) :
    |psiW S W ell k x - psiW S W ell k y| ≤ Real.log ell * ((pdist x y : ℝ) / capW W ell (j - 1))

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.findGreatest_eq_sSup.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.findGreatest_eq_sSup
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.findGreatest_eq_sSup.header:
theorem findGreatest_eq_sSup (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (k : ℕ) :
    Nat.findGreatest P k = sSup {j | j ≤ k ∧ P j}

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.strat_eq_stratG.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.strat_eq_stratG
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.strat_eq_stratG.header:
theorem strat_eq_stratG {ell M R k : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {S : Tower Lf} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) : AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k x = stratG (geomOf ell k S) x

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sigG.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sigG
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sigG.header: noncomputable def sigG (G : TowerGeom L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.exp_sig.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.exp_sig
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.exp_sig.header:
theorem exp_sig (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteWt_comm.header:
theorem siteWt_comm (φ χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) :

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteWt_adjoint.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteWt_adjoint
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteWt_adjoint.header:
theorem siteWt_adjoint (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (siteWt φ) = siteWt φ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Dh.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Dh
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Dh.header: noncomputable def Dh (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) : SiteL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Qh.header: noncomputable def Qh (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) : SiteL2 L →L[ℝ] YP G

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Linvh.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Linvh
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Linvh.header: noncomputable def Linvh (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) : SiteL2 L →L[ℝ] SiteL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Lh_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Lh_eq
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Lh_eq.header:
theorem Lh_eq (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ wq G a j) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dh G U) ∘L Dh G U + (1 : ℝ) • (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Qh G U a) ∘L Qh G U a)
      = siteWt (sigG G) ∘L LP G U a ∘L siteWt (sigG G)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Lh_Linvh.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Lh_Linvh
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Lh_Linvh.header:
theorem Lh_Linvh (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ wq G a j) (hu : IsUnit (LP G U a))
    (x : SiteL2 L) :
    (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dh G U) ∘L Dh G U + (1 : ℝ) • (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Qh G U a) ∘L Qh G U a))
      (Linvh G U a x) = x

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Linvh_Lh.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Linvh_Lh
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Linvh_Lh.header:
theorem Linvh_Lh (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ wq G a j) (hu : IsUnit (LP G U a))
    (x : SiteL2 L) :
    Linvh G U a ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dh G U) ∘L Dh G U
      + (1 : ℝ) • (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Qh G U a) ∘L Qh G U a)) x) = x

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatCoer.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatCoer
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatCoer.header:
theorem hatCoer {G : TowerGeom L} {ell k : ℕ} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg L) (a cs : ℝ)
    (hcs1 : cs ≤ 1) (hS1 : ∀ f, cs * wNormSq G f ≤ ⟪f, DelpA G U a f⟫) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    cs * ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪siteWt (sigG G) f, LP G U a (siteWt (sigG G) f)⟫

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.rowSite.header: def rowSite {G : TowerGeom L} : PIdx G → PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypWt.header: noncomputable def ypWt (G : TowerGeom L) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) : YP G →L[ℝ] YP G

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypWt_apply.header:
theorem ypWt_apply (G : TowerGeom L) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (v : YP G) (p : PIdx G) :
    ypWt G φ v p = Real.exp (φ (rowSite p)) • v p

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypWt_neg_cancel.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypWt_neg_cancel
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypWt_neg_cancel.header:
theorem ypWt_neg_cancel (G : TowerGeom L) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (v : YP G) :

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypWt_cancel_neg.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypWt_cancel_neg

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypWt_symm.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.ypWt_symm

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatD_comm.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatD_comm
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatD_comm.header:
theorem hatD_comm {G : TowerGeom L} {ell k : ℕ} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg L)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hφ : ∀ b : Bond L, periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ G.Om0 →
      |φ b.1 - φ (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)| ≤ θ / (ell : ℝ) ^ stratG G (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2))
    (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖(cjp (siteWP φ) (bondWP φ) (Dh G U) - Dh G U) f‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp θ - 1) * ‖f‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_blocks_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_blocks_le
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_blocks_le.header:
theorem sum_blocks_le {G : TowerGeom L} {ell k : ℕ} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ∑ q : QIdx G, ∑ x ∈ blockOf (yq q) (ell ^ jq q), ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatQ_comm.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatQ_comm
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatQ_comm.header:
theorem hatQ_comm {G : TowerGeom L} {ell k : ℕ} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (U : Cfg L)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (δ0 : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ0)
    (hφ : ∀ q : QIdx G, ∀ x ∈ blockOf (yq q) (ell ^ jq q), |φ (yq q) - φ x| ≤ δ0)
    (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖(cjp (siteWP φ) (ypWP G φ) (Qh G U a) - Qh G U a) f‖ ≤ Real.sqrt a * (Real.exp δ0 - 1) * ‖f‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatSiteHyp.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatSiteHyp
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hatSiteHyp.header:
noncomputable def hatSiteHyp (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ wq G a j) (hu : IsUnit (LP G U a))
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (c δD δQ : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hδD : 0 ≤ δD) (hδQ : 0 ≤ δQ)
    (hcoer : ∀ f, c * ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪siteWt (sigG G) f, LP G U a (siteWt (sigG G) f)⟫)
    (hDp : ‖cjp (siteWP φ) (bondWP φ) (Dh G U) - Dh G U‖ ≤ δD)
    (hDm : ‖cjm (siteWP φ) (bondWP φ) (Dh G U) - Dh G U‖ ≤ δD)
    (hQp : ‖cjp (siteWP φ) (ypWP G φ) (Qh G U a) - Qh G U a‖ ≤ δQ)
    (hQm : ‖cjm (siteWP φ) (ypWP G φ) (Qh G U a) - Qh G U a‖ ≤ δQ)
    (hsmall : 24 * (δD ^ 2 + 1 * δQ ^ 2) ≤ c) (hsmallD : 4 * δD ^ 2 ≤ c) :
    SiteHyp (SiteL2 L) (BondFnL2 L) (YP G)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjm_site_bond.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjm_site_bond
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjm_site_bond.header:
theorem cjm_site_bond (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (T : SiteL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L) :
    cjm (siteWP φ) (bondWP φ) T = cjp (siteWP (-φ)) (bondWP (-φ)) T

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjm_site_yp.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjm_site_yp
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjm_site_yp.header:
theorem cjm_site_yp (G : TowerGeom L) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (T : SiteL2 L →L[ℝ] YP G) :
    cjm (siteWP φ) (ypWP G φ) T = cjp (siteWP (-φ)) (ypWP G (-φ)) T

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.pdist_block_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.pdist_block_le
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.pdist_block_le.header: theorem pdist_block_le {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf} {n : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ blockOf y n) : pdist y x ≤ 3 * (n - 1)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_bond.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_bond
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_bond.header:
theorem psi_bond (b : Bond Lf) :
    |psiW S W ell k b.1 - psiW S W ell k (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)|
      ≤ (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) / (ell : ℝ) ^ stratG (geomOf ell k S) (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_bond_neg.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_bond_neg
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_bond_neg.header:
theorem psi_bond_neg (b : Bond Lf) :
    |(-psiW S W ell k) b.1 - (-psiW S W ell k) (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)|
      ≤ (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) / (ell : ℝ) ^ stratG (geomOf ell k S) (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_block.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_block
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_block.header:
theorem psi_block (q : QIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (hx : x ∈ blockOf (yq q) (ell ^ jq q)) :
    |psiW S W ell k (yq q) - psiW S W ell k x| ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) * Real.log ell / W

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_block_neg.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_block_neg
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_block_neg.header:
theorem psi_block_neg (q : QIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (hx : x ∈ blockOf (yq q) (ell ^ jq q)) :
    |(-psiW S W ell k) (yq q) - (-psiW S W ell k) x| ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) * Real.log ell / W

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.theta_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.theta_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.theta_nonneg.header: theorem theta_nonneg : 0 ≤ 2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.delta0_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.delta0_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.delta0_nonneg.header: theorem delta0_nonneg : 0 ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) * Real.log ell / W

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_hD.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_hD
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_hD.header:
theorem psi_hD (U : Cfg Lf) :
    ‖cjp (siteWP (psiW S W ell k)) (bondWP (psiW S W ell k)) (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U) - Dh (geomOf ell k S) U‖
        ≤ Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1) ∧
      ‖cjm (siteWP (psiW S W ell k)) (bondWP (psiW S W ell k)) (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U) - Dh (geomOf ell k S) U‖
        ≤ Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_hQ.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_hQ
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psi_hQ.header:
theorem psi_hQ (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ‖cjp (siteWP (psiW S W ell k)) (ypWP (geomOf ell k S) (psiW S W ell k)) (Qh (geomOf ell k S) U a)
        - Qh (geomOf ell k S) U a‖ ≤ Real.sqrt a * (Real.exp (3 * (ell : ℝ) * Real.log ell / W) - 1) ∧
      ‖cjm (siteWP (psiW S W ell k)) (ypWP (geomOf ell k S) (psiW S W ell k)) (Qh (geomOf ell k S) U a)
        - Qh (geomOf ell k S) U a‖ ≤ Real.sqrt a * (Real.exp (3 * (ell : ℝ) * Real.log ell / W) - 1)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteWt_le_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteWt_le_of
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteWt_le_of.header:
theorem siteWt_le_of (φ χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (h : ∀ x, φ x ≤ χ x) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖siteWt φ f‖ ≤ ‖siteWt χ f‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bondWt_le_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bondWt_le_of
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bondWt_le_of.header:
theorem bondWt_le_of (φ χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (h : ∀ x, φ x ≤ χ x) (f : BondFnL2 L) :
    ‖bondWt φ f‖ ≤ ‖bondWt χ f‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteWt_add_const.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteWt_add_const
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteWt_add_const.header:
theorem siteWt_add_const (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    siteWt (fun x => φ x + c) f = Real.exp c • siteWt φ f

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bondWt_add_const.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bondWt_add_const
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bondWt_add_const.header:
theorem bondWt_add_const (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (f : BondFnL2 L) :
    bondWt (fun x => φ x + c) f = Real.exp c • bondWt φ f

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteWt_mul.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteWt_mul
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteWt_mul.header:
theorem siteWt_mul (φ χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    siteWt φ (siteWt χ f) = siteWt (φ + χ) f

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bondWt_adjoint.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bondWt_adjoint
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bondWt_adjoint.header:
theorem bondWt_adjoint (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (bondWt φ) = bondWt φ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.norm_exp_log_smul.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.norm_exp_log_smul
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.norm_exp_log_smul.header:
theorem norm_exp_log_smul {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (v : V) :
    ‖Real.exp (Real.log ell) • v‖ = (ell : ℝ) * ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.HatPack.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.HatPack
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.HatPack.header: structure HatPack (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (cs : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sig_psi.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sig_psi
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sig_psi.header:
theorem sig_psi (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) :
    psiW S W ell k x ≤ sigG (geomOf ell k S) x ∧ sigG (geomOf ell k S) x ≤ psiW S W ell k x + Real.log ell

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hw_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hw_of
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hw_of.header: theorem hw_of (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) : ∀ j, 0 ≤ wq (geomOf ell k S) a j

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dD_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dD_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dD_nonneg.header: theorem dD_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dQ_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dQ_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.dQ_nonneg.header: theorem dQ_nonneg (a : ℝ) : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt a * (Real.exp (3 * (ell : ℝ) * Real.log ell / W) - 1)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiHypP.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiHypP
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiHypP.header:
noncomputable def psiHypP (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs) :
    SiteHyp (SiteL2 Lf) (BondFnL2 Lf) (YP (geomOf ell k S))

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjp_neg_site_bond.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjp_neg_site_bond
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjp_neg_site_bond.header:
theorem cjp_neg_site_bond (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (T : SiteL2 Lf →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 Lf) :
    cjp (siteWP (-φ)) (bondWP (-φ)) T = cjm (siteWP φ) (bondWP φ) T

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjm_neg_site_bond.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjm_neg_site_bond
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjm_neg_site_bond.header:
theorem cjm_neg_site_bond (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (T : SiteL2 Lf →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 Lf) :
    cjm (siteWP (-φ)) (bondWP (-φ)) T = cjp (siteWP φ) (bondWP φ) T

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjp_neg_site_yp.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjp_neg_site_yp
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjp_neg_site_yp.header:
theorem cjp_neg_site_yp (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (T : SiteL2 Lf →L[ℝ] YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    cjp (siteWP (-φ)) (ypWP (geomOf ell k S) (-φ)) T = cjm (siteWP φ) (ypWP (geomOf ell k S) φ) T

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjm_neg_site_yp.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjm_neg_site_yp
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjm_neg_site_yp.header:
theorem cjm_neg_site_yp (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (T : SiteL2 Lf →L[ℝ] YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    cjm (siteWP (-φ)) (ypWP (geomOf ell k S) (-φ)) T = cjp (siteWP φ) (ypWP (geomOf ell k S) φ) T

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiHypN.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiHypN
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.psiHypN.header:
noncomputable def psiHypN (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs) :
    SiteHyp (SiteL2 Lf) (BondFnL2 Lf) (YP (geomOf ell k S))

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.LinvP_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.LinvP_eq
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.LinvP_eq.header:
theorem LinvP_eq (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (y : SiteL2 Lf) :
    LinvP (geomOf ell k S) U a y
      = siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) U a (siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) y))

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sig_le_psi_norm.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sig_le_psi_norm
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sig_le_psi_norm.header:
theorem sig_le_psi_norm (f : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ‖siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) f‖ ≤ (ell : ℝ) * ‖siteWt (psiW S W ell k) f‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bsig_le_psi_norm.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bsig_le_psi_norm
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bsig_le_psi_norm.header:
theorem bsig_le_psi_norm (f : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖bondWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) f‖ ≤ (ell : ℝ) * ‖bondWt (psiW S W ell k) f‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjp_Linv_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjp_Linv_apply
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cjp_Linv_apply.header:
theorem cjp_Linv_apply (H : SiteHyp (SiteL2 Lf) (BondFnL2 Lf) (YP (geomOf ell k S))) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ)
    (hωS : H.ωS = siteWP φ) (w : SiteL2 Lf) :
    siteWt φ (H.Linv w) = cjp H.ωS H.ωS H.Linv (siteWt φ w)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.g1.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.g1
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.g1.header:
theorem g1 (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs) (y : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ‖LinvP (geomOf ell k S) U a y‖
      ≤ (4 * ell / cs) * ‖siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S) + sigG (geomOf ell k S)) y‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.g1'.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.g1'
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.g1'.header:
theorem g1' (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs) (y : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ‖siteWt (-(sigG (geomOf ell k S) + sigG (geomOf ell k S))) (LinvP (geomOf ell k S) U a y)‖
      ≤ (4 * ell / cs) * ‖y‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Dh_adjoint.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Dh_adjoint
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Dh_adjoint.header:
theorem Dh_adjoint (U : Cfg Lf) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U)
      = siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.g2.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.g2
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.g2.header:
theorem g2 (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs) (w : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ‖LinvP (geomOf ell k S) U a (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U) w)‖
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (48 / cs) * ‖bondWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) w‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.DmLinvP_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.DmLinvP_eq
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.DmLinvP_eq.header:
theorem DmLinvP_eq (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (y : SiteL2 Lf) :
    Dm (geomOf ell k S) U (LinvP (geomOf ell k S) U a y)
      = Dh (geomOf ell k S) U (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) U a (siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) y))

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wD_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wD_bound
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.wD_bound.header:
theorem wD_bound (H : SiteHyp (SiteL2 Lf) (BondFnL2 Lf) (YP (geomOf ell k S))) (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ)
    (hωS : H.ωS = siteWP φ) (hωE : H.ωE = bondWP φ) (hD : H.D = Dh (geomOf ell k S) U)
    (hLinv : H.Linv = Linvh (geomOf ell k S) U a) (w : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ‖bondWt φ (Dh (geomOf ell k S) U (Linvh (geomOf ell k S) U a w))‖
      ≤ (Real.sqrt (12 / H.c) + H.δD * (4 / H.c)) * ‖siteWt φ w‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.g3.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.g3
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.g3.header:
theorem g3 (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs) (y : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ‖bondWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U (LinvP (geomOf ell k S) U a y))‖
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (12 / cs)
          + Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1) * (4 / cs))
        * ‖siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S) + sigG (geomOf ell k S)) y‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.g5.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.g5
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.g5.header:
theorem g5 (U : Cfg Lf) (a cs : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs) (y : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U (LinvP (geomOf ell k S) U a y))‖
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (12 / cs)
          + Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1) * (4 / cs)) * ‖y‖

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteMul.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteMul
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteMul.header: noncomputable def siteMul (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) : SiteL2 L →L[ℝ] SiteL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteMul_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteMul_apply
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteMul_apply.header:
theorem siteMul_apply (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    siteMul h f x = h x • f x

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bondMul.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bondMul
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bondMul.header: noncomputable def bondMul (h : Bond L → ℝ) : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bondMul_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bondMul_apply
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.bondMul_apply.header: theorem bondMul_apply (h : Bond L → ℝ) (f : BondFnL2 L) (b : Bond L) : bondMul h f b = h b • f b

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteMask_siteMul.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteMask_siteMul
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.siteMask_siteMul.header:
theorem siteMask_siteMul (S : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    siteMask S (siteMul h f) = siteMul h (siteMask S f)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_shiftBack.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_shiftBack
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.sum_shiftBack.header:
theorem sum_shiftBack {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β] (μ : Fin 3) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → β) :
    ∑ x, g (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ) = ∑ z, g z

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.KG.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.KG
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.KG.header: noncomputable def KG (ell M κ c : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.KG_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.KG_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.KG_nonneg.header: theorem KG_nonneg (ell M κ c : ℕ) : 0 ≤ KG ell M κ c

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hpart_step.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hpart_step
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hpart_step.header:
theorem hpart_step (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hR1 : 1 ≤ R)
    (hR : (c + 3) * κ * ell ≤ R) (hc : 5 ≤ c) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf} (hy : y ∈ S.Om 0) (μ : Fin 3)
    (hy' : periodicLatticeShift y μ ∈ S.Om 0) :
    ∑ p, (AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p y - AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p (periodicLatticeShift y μ)) ^ 2
      ≤ KG ell M κ c / ((ell : ℝ) ^ AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k y) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hpart_step_w.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hpart_step_w
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.hpart_step_w.header:
theorem hpart_step_w {y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf} (hy : y ∈ S.Om 0) (μ : Fin 3)
    (hy' : periodicLatticeShift y μ ∈ S.Om 0) :
    ((ell : ℝ) ^ stratG (geomOf ell k S) y) ^ 2 *
      ∑ p, (AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p y - AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p (periodicLatticeShift y μ)) ^ 2
      ≤ KG ell M κ c

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cD_pt.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cD_pt
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cD_pt.header:
theorem cD_pt (U : Cfg Lf) (f : SiteL2 Lf) (b : Bond Lf) :
    ∑ p, ‖bondWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (bondMul (hbond ell M k κ c S p) (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U f)
        - Dm (geomOf ell k S) U (siteMul (AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p) f)) b‖ ^ 2
      ≤ KG ell M κ c * ‖f (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cD_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cD_sum
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cD_sum.header:
theorem cD_sum (U : Cfg Lf) (f : SiteL2 Lf) :
    ∑ p, ‖bondWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (bondMul (hbond ell M k κ c S p) (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U f)
        - Dm (geomOf ell k S) U (siteMul (AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p) f))‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 3 * KG ell M κ c * ‖f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Dm_adjoint'.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Dm_adjoint'
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Dm_adjoint'.header:
theorem Dm_adjoint' (U : Cfg Lf) :

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Dm_adj_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Dm_adj_apply
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.Dm_adj_apply.header:
theorem Dm_adj_apply (U : Cfg Lf) (w : BondFnL2 Lf) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U) w x
      = if x ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Om0 then gradCovariantAdjointValue U (WithLp.ofLp w) x else 0

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cDs_pt.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cDs_pt
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cDs_pt.header:
theorem cDs_pt (U : Cfg Lf) (w : BondFnL2 Lf) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) :
    ∑ p, ‖siteMul (AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p) (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U) w) x
        - ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U) (bondMul (hbond ell M k κ c S p) w) x‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 3 * ∑ μ : Fin 3, (if x ∈ S.Om 0 ∧ periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ ∈ S.Om 0 then
          (∑ p, (AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ)
            - AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p x) ^ 2) * ‖w (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ, μ)‖ ^ 2 else 0)

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cDs_sum0.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cDs_sum0
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cDs_sum0.header:
theorem cDs_sum0 (U : Cfg Lf) (A : BondFnL2 Lf) :

        - ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U) (bondMul (hbond ell M k κ c S p) A)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 3 * KG ell M κ c * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cDs_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cDs_sum
AdalyFormal.M1IMS.cDs_sum.header:
theorem cDs_sum (U : Cfg Lf) (w : BondFnL2 Lf) :
    ∑ p, ‖siteWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S) + sigG (geomOf ell k S))
        (siteMul (AdalyFormal.M1.hpart ell M k κ c S p) (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U) w)
          - ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm (geomOf ell k S) U) (bondMul (hbond ell M k κ c S p) w))‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4 * KG ell M κ c * ‖bondWt (sigG (geomOf ell k S)) w‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Route.inst_chart.name: AdalyFormal.M2Route.inst_chart
AdalyFormal.M2Route.inst_chart.header:
theorem inst_chart {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a Ci : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hCi : 0 ≤ Ci) (hI : LemIFlat ell a Ci)
    (a₀ : ℝ) (ha₀1 : a₀ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hsmall : ∀ a' : ℝ, 0 ≤ a' → a' ≤ a₀ →
      KUSmall ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ∧
      432 * kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ^ 2 ≤ 1 ∧
      kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ∧
      kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ≤ 1 ∧
      324 * lamC ell * kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ≤ 1 ∧
      2 * ThetaP ell a (kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a'))) ≤ 1 / Kflat a Ci ∧
      8 * (272 * (kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) / (3 * Real.pi)) / (4 * Real.sqrt 2)) ≤ 1 / Kflat a Ci)
    {M R k c : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (i : ℕ) (hik : i + 1 ≤ k) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (G : ℕ)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 12 * ell + 10 ≤ d)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (a' : ℝ) (ha'0 : 0 < a') (ha'a : a' ≤ a₀) (U : Cfg L)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (A : Bond L → M2) (hHT : ∀ e, AdalyFormal.StatementLane.HT (A e))
    (hUA : ∀ e : Bond L, pdist w e.1 ≤ c * G + d * ell ^ i + 64 * ell ^ (i + 2) →
      ((periodicGaugeTransform g U e : SU2) : M2) = NormedSpace.exp (((η : ℂ) * Complex.I) • A e))
    (h1 : ∀ e : Bond L, pdist w e.1 ≤ c * G + d * ell ^ i + 64 * ell ^ (i + 2) →
      frobNorm (A e) < a' * (((ell : ℝ) ^ i * η)⁻¹ ^ 1))
    (h2 : ∀ (μ ν : Fin 3) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L), pdist w x ≤ c * G + d * ell ^ i + 64 * ell ^ (i + 2) →
      pdist w (periodicLatticeShift x μ) ≤ c * G + d * ell ^ i + 64 * ell ^ (i + 2) →
      frobNorm ((η⁻¹ : ℝ) • (A (periodicLatticeShift x μ, ν) - A (x, ν))) < a' * (((ell : ℝ) ^ i * η)⁻¹ ^ 2)) :
    ∃ Up : Cfg L,
      (∀ e : Bond L, pdist w e.1 ≤ c * G + d * ell ^ i + 32 * ell ^ (i + 2) → U e = Up e) ∧
      ∀ B : BondFnL2 L, (∀ b : Bond L, (WithLp.ofLp B) b ≠ 0 →
          b.1 ∈ Ball w (c * G) ∨ periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ Ball w (c * G)) →
        (1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * KG0 a Ci) - epsNF ell (PkA a) (thetaN ell) d)
            * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1))) ell (i + 1) B
          ≤ locG0 (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1))) ell (i + 1) Up a (Ball w (c * G + d * ell ^ i)) B

AdalyFormal.M2Route.patchCoercive_charts.name: AdalyFormal.M2Route.patchCoercive_charts
AdalyFormal.M2Route.patchCoercive_charts.header:
theorem patchCoercive_charts {a Ci : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hCi : 0 ≤ Ci) (hI : LemIFlat ell a Ci)
    (a₀ : ℝ) (ha₀1 : a₀ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hsmall : ∀ a' : ℝ, 0 ≤ a' → a' ≤ a₀ →
      KUSmall ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ∧
      432 * kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ^ 2 ≤ 1 ∧
      kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ∧
      kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ≤ 1 ∧
      324 * lamC ell * kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ≤ 1 ∧
      2 * ThetaP ell a (kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a'))) ≤ 1 / Kflat a Ci ∧
      8 * (272 * (kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) / (3 * Real.pi)) / (4 * Real.sqrt 2)) ≤ 1 / Kflat a Ci)
    (hd : 12 * ell + 10 ≤ d)
    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (cs : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρ) (ε1 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1) (hη : etaC ell W cs ρ ε1 < 1)
    (η : ℝ) (hη0 : 0 < η) (a' : ℝ) (ha'0 : 0 < a') (ha'a : a' ≤ a₀)
    (hch : PatchCharts ell M k κ c d S U η a') :
    PatchCoercive ell M k κ c Lu hell0 S U a Lam
      ((1 - etaC ell W cs ρ ε1) * min a (1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * KG0 a Ci) - epsNF ell (PkA a) (thetaN ell) d)
        - 2 * nuC ell ρ)

AdalyFormal.M2Route.patchCoercive_charts.name: AdalyFormal.M2Route.patchCoercive_charts_exists
AdalyFormal.M2Route.patchCoercive_charts.header:
theorem patchCoercive_charts_exists {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ cW : ℝ, 0 < cW ∧ ∃ a₀ : ℝ, 0 < a₀ ∧ ∃ D : ℕ, 12 * ell + 10 ≤ D ∧
    (∀ d, D ≤ d → epsNF ell (PkA a) (thetaN ell) d ≤ cW / 2) ∧
    ∀ {M R k κ c : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell0 : 0 < ell)
      {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (_hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (_hκ : 0 < κ) (_hM : 0 < M) (_hR1 : 1 ≤ R)
      (_hR4 : (c + 4) * κ * ell ≤ R) (_hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) {d : ℕ} (_hdD : D ≤ d)
      (_hdM : d + 64 * ell ^ 2 ≤ κ * M)
      {W : ℕ} (_hW : 1 ≤ W) (_hWR : W ≤ R * M * ell)
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (cs : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (_hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
      (ρ : ℝ) (_hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (_hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρ) (ε1 : ℝ) (_hε1 : 0 < ε1) (_hη : etaC ell W cs ρ ε1 < 1)
      (η : ℝ) (_hη0 : 0 < η) (a' : ℝ) (_ha'0 : 0 < a') (_ha'a : a' ≤ a₀)
      (_hch : PatchCharts ell M k κ c d S U η a'),
      PatchCoercive ell M k κ c Lu hell0 S U a Lam
        ((1 - etaC ell W cs ρ ε1) * min a (cW - epsNF ell (PkA a) (thetaN ell) d) - 2 * nuC ell ρ)

AdalyFormal.M2Route.vtm_corner.header:
theorem vtm_corner {M R : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hM2 : 2 ∣ M) (hR : 18 ≤ R) {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hLu : ∀ μ, Lu μ + 1 = 13 * M) :
    TorusOK 2 M Lu ∧ Admissible 2 M R 1 (VTM (scaleUp 2 1 Lu) M) ∧ CoversOm0p 2 M 12 1 (VTM (scaleUp 2 1 Lu) M) ∧
      ∃ x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp 2 1 Lu),
        ¬ ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp 2 1 Lu))) (i : ℕ),
          IsClassCube 2 M 12 1 (VTM (scaleUp 2 1 Lu) M) sites i ∧ x ∈ sites ∧ ∀ σ, periodicLatticeShift x σ ∈ sites

AdalyFormal.M1Site.wq.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.wq
AdalyFormal.M1Site.wq.header: noncomputable def wq (G : TowerGeom L) (a : ℝ) (j : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Site.QpP.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.QpP
AdalyFormal.M1Site.QpP.header: noncomputable def QpP (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) : SiteL2 L →L[ℝ] YP G

AdalyFormal.M1Site.QpP_inl.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.QpP_inl
AdalyFormal.M1Site.QpP_inl.header:
theorem QpP_inl (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) (q : QIdx G) :

AdalyFormal.M1Site.QpP_inr.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.QpP_inr
AdalyFormal.M1Site.QpP_inr.header:
theorem QpP_inr (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) (x : OffIdx G) :
    QpP G U a f (Sum.inr x) = f x.1

AdalyFormal.M1Site.Dm.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.Dm
AdalyFormal.M1Site.Dm.header: noncomputable def Dm (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) : SiteL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP
AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP.header: noncomputable def LP (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) : SiteL2 L →L[ℝ] SiteL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1Site.LinvP.header: noncomputable def LinvP (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) : SiteL2 L →L[ℝ] SiteL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1Site.Gp_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.Gp_eq
AdalyFormal.M1Site.Gp_eq.header: theorem Gp_eq (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) : Gp G U a = LinvP G U a ∘L siteMask G.Om0

AdalyFormal.M1Site.Xop.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.Xop
AdalyFormal.M1Site.Xop.header: noncomputable def Xop (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) : YP G →L[ℝ] SiteL2 L

AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteMask_adjoint.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteMask_adjoint
AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteMask_adjoint.header:
theorem siteMask_adjoint (S : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) :

AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteMask_off.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteMask_off
AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteMask_off.header:
theorem siteMask_off (S : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (f : SiteL2 L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∉ S) :
    siteMask S f x = 0

AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteMask_on.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteMask_on
AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteMask_on.header:
theorem siteMask_on (S : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (f : SiteL2 L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ S) :
    siteMask S f x = f x

AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteMask_eq_self.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteMask_eq_self
AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteMask_eq_self.header:
theorem siteMask_eq_self (S : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (f : SiteL2 L) (hf : ∀ x, x ∉ S → f x = 0) :
    siteMask S f = f

AdalyFormal.M1Site.inner_one_sub_mask.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.inner_one_sub_mask
AdalyFormal.M1Site.inner_one_sub_mask.header:
theorem inner_one_sub_mask (G : TowerGeom L) (f g : SiteL2 L) :
    ⟪g, (1 - siteMask G.Om0) f⟫ = ∑ x : OffIdx G, ⟪g x.1, f x.1⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Site.inner_Qpa_rows.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.inner_Qpa_rows
AdalyFormal.M1Site.inner_Qpa_rows.header:
theorem inner_Qpa_rows (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (g f : SiteL2 L) :
    ⟪g, Qpa G U a f⟫ = ∑ q : QIdx G, wq G a q.1.1.val * ⟪Qlev G U q.1.1.val q.1.2 g, Qlev G U q.1.1.val q.1.2 f⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Site.DelpA_eq_L_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.DelpA_eq_L_strat
AdalyFormal.M1Site.DelpA_eq_L_strat.header:
theorem DelpA_eq_L_strat (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (g f : SiteL2 L) :
    ⟪g, DelpA G U a f⟫ = ⟪Dm G U g, Dm G U f⟫
      + ∑ q : QIdx G, wq G a q.1.1.val *
          ⟪Qlev G U q.1.1.val q.1.2 (siteMask G.Om0 g), Qlev G U q.1.1.val q.1.2 (siteMask G.Om0 f)⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Site.inner_QpP.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.inner_QpP
AdalyFormal.M1Site.inner_QpP.header:
theorem inner_QpP (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ wq G a j) (g f : SiteL2 L) :
    ⟪QpP G U a g, QpP G U a f⟫ = ∑ q : QIdx G, wq G a q.1.1.val *
          ⟪Qlev G U q.1.1.val q.1.2 (siteMask G.Om0 g), Qlev G U q.1.1.val q.1.2 (siteMask G.Om0 f)⟫
      + ∑ x : OffIdx G, ⟪g x.1, f x.1⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Site.inner_LP.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.inner_LP
AdalyFormal.M1Site.inner_LP.header:
theorem inner_LP (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ wq G a j) (g f : SiteL2 L) :
    ⟪g, LP G U a f⟫ = ⟪Dm G U g, Dm G U f⟫ + ⟪QpP G U a g, QpP G U a f⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_eq_L.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_eq_L
AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_eq_L.header:
theorem LP_eq_L (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ wq G a j) :
    LP G U a = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm G U) ∘L Dm G U
      + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (QpP G U a) ∘L QpP G U a

AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_symm.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_symm
AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_symm.header:
theorem LP_symm (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ wq G a j) (f g : SiteL2 L) :
    ⟪LP G U a f, g⟫ = ⟪f, LP G U a g⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Site.QpP_eq_zero_iff.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.QpP_eq_zero_iff
AdalyFormal.M1Site.QpP_eq_zero_iff.header:
theorem QpP_eq_zero_iff (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < wq G a j) (μ : SiteL2 L) :

AdalyFormal.M1Site.Qpa_of_NQp.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.Qpa_of_NQp
AdalyFormal.M1Site.Qpa_of_NQp.header:
theorem Qpa_of_NQp (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (μ : SiteL2 L) (hμ : μ ∈ NQp G U) :

AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_of_NQp.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_of_NQp
AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_of_NQp.header:
theorem LP_of_NQp (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (μ : SiteL2 L) (hμ : μ ∈ NQp G U) :

AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_LinvP.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_LinvP
AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_LinvP.header: theorem LP_LinvP (x : SiteL2 L) : LP G U a (LinvP G U a x) = x

AdalyFormal.M1Site.LinvP_LP.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.LinvP_LP
AdalyFormal.M1Site.LinvP_LP.header: theorem LinvP_LP (x : SiteL2 L) : LinvP G U a (LP G U a x) = x

AdalyFormal.M1Site.LinvP_symm.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.LinvP_symm
AdalyFormal.M1Site.LinvP_symm.header: theorem LinvP_symm (x y : SiteL2 L) : ⟪LinvP G U a x, y⟫ = ⟪x, LinvP G U a y⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Site.LinvP_adjoint.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.LinvP_adjoint
AdalyFormal.M1Site.LinvP_adjoint.header: theorem LinvP_adjoint : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (LinvP G U a) = LinvP G U a

AdalyFormal.M1Site.adjXop_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.adjXop_apply
AdalyFormal.M1Site.adjXop_apply.header:
theorem adjXop_apply (v : SiteL2 L) :

AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_Xop.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_Xop
AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_Xop.header: theorem LP_Xop (z : YP G) : LP G U a (Xop G U a z) = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (QpP G U a) z

AdalyFormal.M1Site.RImage_mask.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.RImage_mask
AdalyFormal.M1Site.RImage_mask.header:
theorem RImage_mask (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (w : SiteL2 L) (hw : w ∈ RImage G U) :

AdalyFormal.M1Site.Rproj_mask_right.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.Rproj_mask_right
AdalyFormal.M1Site.Rproj_mask_right.header:
theorem Rproj_mask_right (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (v : SiteL2 L) :

AdalyFormal.M1Site.Rproj_mask_left.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.Rproj_mask_left
AdalyFormal.M1Site.Rproj_mask_left.header:
theorem Rproj_mask_left (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (v : SiteL2 L) :

AdalyFormal.M1Site.Rproj_eq_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.Rproj_eq_strat
AdalyFormal.M1Site.Rproj_eq_strat.header:
theorem Rproj_eq_strat (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < wq G a j) (hu : IsUnit (LP G U a))

AdalyFormal.M1Site.Dm_adjoint.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.Dm_adjoint
AdalyFormal.M1Site.Dm_adjoint.header: theorem Dm_adjoint : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Dm G U) = siteMask G.Om0 ∘L gradAdj U

AdalyFormal.M1Site.Tfull_eq_T_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.Tfull_eq_T_strat
AdalyFormal.M1Site.Tfull_eq_T_strat.header: theorem Tfull_eq_T_strat : Tfull G U = H.T

AdalyFormal.M1Site.Wop_eq_W_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.Wop_eq_W_strat
AdalyFormal.M1Site.Wop_eq_W_strat.header: theorem Wop_eq_W_strat : Wop G U a = H.W

AdalyFormal.M1Site.le_stratG_of_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.le_stratG_of_mem
AdalyFormal.M1Site.le_stratG_of_mem.header:
theorem le_stratG_of_mem {ell M R k : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {S : Tower Lf} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)

AdalyFormal.M1Site.div_pow_mono.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.div_pow_mono
AdalyFormal.M1Site.div_pow_mono.header:
theorem div_pow_mono (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) :

AdalyFormal.M1Site.hlink_of_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.hlink_of_strat
AdalyFormal.M1Site.hlink_of_strat.header:
theorem hlink_of_strat {ell M R k : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {S : Tower Lf} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (U : Cfg Lf) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (h : ∀ b : Bond Lf, b.1 ∈ S.Om 0 → periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ S.Om 0 →

    ∀ j0, j0 ≤ k → ∀ b : Bond Lf, b.1 ∈ S.Om j0 → periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ S.Om j0 →
      dv (U b) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j0

AdalyFormal.M1Site.cornerStrat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.cornerStrat
AdalyFormal.M1Site.cornerStrat.header: noncomputable def cornerStrat (G : TowerGeom Lf) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (ν μ : Fin 3) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.M1Site.hplaq_of_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.hplaq_of_strat
AdalyFormal.M1Site.hplaq_of_strat.header:
theorem hplaq_of_strat {ell M R k : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {S : Tower Lf} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (U : Cfg Lf) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (h : ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (ν μ : Fin 3),
      y ∈ S.Om 0 → coarseShift y 1 ν ∈ S.Om 0 → coarseShift y 1 μ ∈ S.Om 0 →
      coarseShift (coarseShift y 1 ν) 1 μ ∈ S.Om 0 →
      dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * cornerStrat (geomOf ell k S) y ν μ)) :
    ∀ j0, j0 ≤ k → ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (ν μ : Fin 3),
      y ∈ S.Om j0 → coarseShift y 1 ν ∈ S.Om j0 → coarseShift y 1 μ ∈ S.Om j0 →
      coarseShift (coarseShift y 1 ν) 1 μ ∈ S.Om j0 → dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * j0)

AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_M1_stra.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_M1_strat
AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_M1_stra.header:
theorem site_coercive_M1_strat (ell M R k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {S : Tower Lf} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (hRM : 18 ≤ R * M) (hbig : ∀ σ, 4 * ell ^ k < Lf σ + 1)
    (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hsmall : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * ρ ≤ 1)
    (hl : ∀ b : Bond Lf, b.1 ∈ S.Om 0 → periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ S.Om 0 →
      dv (U b) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ (min (stratG (geomOf ell k S) b.1) (stratG (geomOf ell k S) (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2))))
    (hp : ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (ν μ : Fin 3),
      y ∈ S.Om 0 → coarseShift y 1 ν ∈ S.Om 0 → coarseShift y 1 μ ∈ S.Om 0 →
      coarseShift (coarseShift y 1 ν) 1 μ ∈ S.Om 0 →
      dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * cornerStrat (geomOf ell k S) y ν μ))
    (f : SiteL2 Lf) :
    (1 - 216 * (((ell : ℝ) + 3 * Real.pi * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * ρ) ^ 2) * wNormSq (geomOf ell k S) f
      ≤ max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ⟪f, DelpA (geomOf ell k S) U a f⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Site.fac_ge_one.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.fac_ge_one
AdalyFormal.M1Site.fac_ge_one.header: theorem fac_ge_one (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) : 1 ≤ (ell : ℝ) + 3 * Real.pi * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Site.hU_of_regime.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.hU_of_regime
AdalyFormal.M1Site.hU_of_regime.header:
theorem hU_of_regime (ell M R k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {S : Tower Lf} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (U : Cfg Lf) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hlink : ∀ j0, j0 ≤ k → ∀ b : Bond Lf, b.1 ∈ S.Om j0 → periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ S.Om j0 →
      dv (U b) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j0) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ((ell : ℝ) + 3 * Real.pi * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j

AdalyFormal.M1Site.isUnit_LP_M1.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.isUnit_LP_M1
AdalyFormal.M1Site.isUnit_LP_M1.header:
theorem isUnit_LP_M1 (h216 : 216 * (((ell : ℝ) + 3 * Real.pi * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * ρ) ^ 2 < 1) (ha : 0 < a) :
    IsUnit (LP (geomOf ell k S) U a)

AdalyFormal.M1Site.gamma_lower_M1.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.gamma_lower_M1
AdalyFormal.M1Site.gamma_lower_M1.header:
theorem gamma_lower_M1 (h216 : 216 * (((ell : ℝ) + 3 * Real.pi * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * ρ) ^ 2 < 1) (ha : 0 < a)
    (v : YP (geomOf ell k S)) :
    (1 - 6 * (((ell : ℝ) + 3 * Real.pi * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * ρ)) ^ 2 *
        ∑ p, ‖v p‖ ^ 2 / betaS (geomOf ell k S) ell a (((ell : ℝ) + 3 * Real.pi * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * ρ) p
      ≤ (12 + a) * ‖Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a v‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Site.exists_Gami_M1.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.exists_Gami_M1
AdalyFormal.M1Site.exists_Gami_M1.header:
theorem exists_Gami_M1 (h216 : 216 * (((ell : ℝ) + 3 * Real.pi * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * ρ) ^ 2 < 1) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ Gi : YP (geomOf ell k S) →L[ℝ] YP (geomOf ell k S),
      (∀ u, (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) ∘L Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) (Gi u) = u) ∧
      (∀ u, Gi ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) ∘L Xop (geomOf ell k S) U a) u) = u)

AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteCT_inv_M1.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteCT_inv_M1
AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteCT_inv_M1.header:
theorem siteCT_inv_M1 (ha : 0 < a) (hu : IsUnit (DelpA (geomOf ell k S) U a + (1 - siteMask (geomOf ell k S).Om0)))
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hφ : ∀ b : Bond Lf, periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Om0 →
      |φ b.1 - φ (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)| ≤ θ / (ell : ℝ) ^ stratG (geomOf ell k S) (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2))
    (δ0 : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ0)
    (hbox : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ x ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), |φ x - φ y| ≤ δ0)
    (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c)
    (hc : c ≤ (1 / 2) * ((1 - 216 * (((ell : ℝ) + 3 * Real.pi * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * ρ) ^ 2) / max 6 (16 / (3 * a)))
      - (9 * (Real.exp θ - 1) ^ 2 + 3 * a * (Real.exp δ0 - 1) ^ 2))
    (g : SiteL2 Lf) :
    c * wNormSq (geomOf ell k S) (siteWt φ (Gp (geomOf ell k S) U a (siteWt (-φ) g)))
        ≤ ⟪siteWt φ (Gp (geomOf ell k S) U a (siteWt (-φ) g)), siteMask (geomOf ell k S).Om0 g⟫
      ∧ c ^ 2 * wNormSq (geomOf ell k S) (siteWt φ (Gp (geomOf ell k S) U a (siteWt (-φ) g)))
        ≤ dualNormSq (geomOf ell k S) g

AdalyFormal.M1Site.wNormSq_pos.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.wNormSq_pos
AdalyFormal.M1Site.wNormSq_pos.header:
theorem wNormSq_pos (G : TowerGeom Lf) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (f : SiteL2 Lf) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)
    (hx : x ∈ G.Om0) (hfx : f x ≠ 0) : 0 < wNormSq G f

AdalyFormal.M1Site.form_pos_M1.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.form_pos_M1
AdalyFormal.M1Site.form_pos_M1.header:
theorem form_pos_M1 (ell M R k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {S : Tower Lf} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (hRM : 18 ≤ R * M) (hbig : ∀ σ, 4 * ell ^ k < Lf σ + 1)
    (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hsmall : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * ρ ≤ 1)
    (hlink : ∀ j0, j0 ≤ k → ∀ b : Bond Lf, b.1 ∈ S.Om j0 → periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ S.Om j0 →
      dv (U b) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j0)
    (hplaq : ∀ j0, j0 ≤ k → ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (ν μ : Fin 3),
      y ∈ S.Om j0 → coarseShift y 1 ν ∈ S.Om j0 → coarseShift y 1 μ ∈ S.Om j0 →
      coarseShift (coarseShift y 1 ν) 1 μ ∈ S.Om j0 → dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * j0))
    (h216 : 216 * (((ell : ℝ) + 3 * Real.pi * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * ρ) ^ 2 < 1)
    (f : SiteL2 Lf) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (hx : x ∈ S.Om 0) (hfx : f x ≠ 0) :
    0 < ⟪f, DelpA (geomOf ell k S) U a f⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Site.regime_flat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.regime_flat
AdalyFormal.M1Site.regime_flat.header:
theorem regime_flat (ell M R k : ℕ) {S : Tower Lf} (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) :
    (∀ j0, j0 ≤ k → ∀ b : Bond Lf, b.1 ∈ S.Om j0 → periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ S.Om j0 →
      dv (trivialU Lf b) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j0) ∧
    (∀ j0, j0 ≤ k → ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (ν μ : Fin 3),
      y ∈ S.Om j0 → coarseShift y 1 ν ∈ S.Om j0 → coarseShift y 1 μ ∈ S.Om j0 →
      coarseShift (coarseShift y 1 ν) 1 μ ∈ S.Om j0 → dv (pw 1 (trivialU Lf) y ν μ) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * j0))

AdalyFormal.M1Site.coarseShift_one.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.coarseShift_one
AdalyFormal.M1Site.coarseShift_one.header: theorem coarseShift_one (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (ν : Fin 3) : coarseShift y 1 ν = periodicLatticeShift y ν

AdalyFormal.M1Site.hplaq_of_holonomy.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.hplaq_of_holonomy
AdalyFormal.M1Site.hplaq_of_holonomy.header:
theorem hplaq_of_holonomy (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) {S : Tower Lf} (U : Cfg Lf) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (h : ∀ j0, j0 ≤ k → ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette Lf,
      p.1 ∈ S.Om j0 → periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1 ∈ S.Om j0 → periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2 ∈ S.Om j0 →
      periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1) p.2.1.2 ∈ S.Om j0 →
      dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy U p) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * j0)) :
    ∀ j0, j0 ≤ k → ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf) (ν μ : Fin 3),
      y ∈ S.Om j0 → coarseShift y 1 ν ∈ S.Om j0 → coarseShift y 1 μ ∈ S.Om j0 →
      coarseShift (coarseShift y 1 ν) 1 μ ∈ S.Om j0 → dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * j0)

AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_M1_hol.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_M1_hol
AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_M1_hol.header:
theorem site_coercive_M1_hol (ell M R k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {S : Tower Lf} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (hRM : 18 ≤ R * M) (hbig : ∀ σ, 4 * ell ^ k < Lf σ + 1)
    (U : Cfg Lf) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hsmall : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * ρ ≤ 1)
    (hlink : ∀ j0, j0 ≤ k → ∀ b : Bond Lf, b.1 ∈ S.Om j0 → periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ S.Om j0 →
      dv (U b) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j0)
    (hhol : ∀ j0, j0 ≤ k → ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette Lf,
      p.1 ∈ S.Om j0 → periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1 ∈ S.Om j0 → periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2 ∈ S.Om j0 →
      periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1) p.2.1.2 ∈ S.Om j0 →
      dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy U p) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * j0))
    (f : SiteL2 Lf) :
    (1 - 216 * (((ell : ℝ) + 3 * Real.pi * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * ρ) ^ 2) * wNormSq (geomOf ell k S) f
      ≤ max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ⟪f, DelpA (geomOf ell k S) U a f⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Site.stratG.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.stratG
AdalyFormal.M1Site.stratG.header: noncomputable def stratG (G : TowerGeom L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.M1Site.wNormSq.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.wNormSq
AdalyFormal.M1Site.wNormSq.header: noncomputable def wNormSq (G : TowerGeom L) (f : SiteL2 L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Site.stratG_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.stratG_eq
AdalyFormal.M1Site.stratG_eq.header:
theorem stratG_eq {G : TowerGeom L} {ell k : ℕ} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ G.Lam j) {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j)) :
    stratG G x = j

AdalyFormal.M1Site.wNormSq_blocks.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.wNormSq_blocks
AdalyFormal.M1Site.wNormSq_blocks.header:
theorem wNormSq_blocks {G : TowerGeom L} {ell k : ℕ} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    wNormSq G f = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ∑ y ∈ LamF G j, ∑ x ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j),
      ‖siteMask G.Om0 f x‖ ^ 2 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ j) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Site.wNormSq_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.wNormSq_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1Site.wNormSq_nonneg.header: theorem wNormSq_nonneg (G : TowerGeom L) (f : SiteL2 L) : 0 ≤ wNormSq G f

AdalyFormal.M1Site.levelGeom.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.levelGeom
AdalyFormal.M1Site.levelGeom.header: noncomputable def levelGeom (G : TowerGeom L) (j : ℕ) : TowerGeom L

AdalyFormal.M1Site.levelGeom_proper.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.levelGeom_proper
AdalyFormal.M1Site.levelGeom_proper.header:
theorem levelGeom_proper {G : TowerGeom L} {ell k : ℕ} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) :
    ProperTower (levelGeom G j) ell j

AdalyFormal.M1Site.levelGeom_LamF.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.levelGeom_LamF
AdalyFormal.M1Site.levelGeom_LamF.header: theorem levelGeom_LamF (G : TowerGeom L) (j : ℕ) : LamF (levelGeom G j) j = LamF G j

AdalyFormal.M1Site.levelGeom_Rj.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.levelGeom_Rj
AdalyFormal.M1Site.levelGeom_Rj.header: theorem levelGeom_Rj (G : TowerGeom L) (ell j : ℕ) : Rj (levelGeom G j) ell j = Rj G ell j

AdalyFormal.M1Site.levelGeom_bg.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.levelGeom_bg
AdalyFormal.M1Site.levelGeom_bg.header: theorem levelGeom_bg (G : TowerGeom L) (j : ℕ) (U : Cfg L) : bgTower (levelGeom G j) U = bgTower G U

AdalyFormal.M1Site.shift_injective.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.shift_injective
AdalyFormal.M1Site.shift_injective.header: theorem shift_injective (μ : Fin 3) : Function.Injective (fun x : PeriodicLatticeSite L => periodicLatticeShift x μ)

AdalyFormal.M1Site.sum_inBlock_head_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.sum_inBlock_head_le
AdalyFormal.M1Site.sum_inBlock_head_le.header:
theorem sum_inBlock_head_le (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) :
    ∑ b ∈ inBlockBonds y n, φ (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) ≤ 3 * ∑ x ∈ blockOf y n, φ x

AdalyFormal.M1Site.gradL2_apply'.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.gradL2_apply'
AdalyFormal.M1Site.gradL2_apply'.header:
theorem gradL2_apply' (U : Cfg L) (g : SiteL2 L) (b : Bond L) :
    gradL2 U g b = RMap (U b) (g (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)) - g b.1

AdalyFormal.M1Site.flat_le_cov.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.flat_le_cov
AdalyFormal.M1Site.flat_le_cov.header:
theorem flat_le_cov (U : Cfg L) (g : SiteL2 L) (b : Bond L) (δ : ℝ) (_hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hb : frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ) :
    ‖g (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - g b.1‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 2 * ‖gradL2 U g b‖ ^ 2 + 8 * δ ^ 2 * ‖g (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_weighte.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_weighted_core
AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_weighte.header:
theorem site_coercive_weighted_core (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1)
    {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hU : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hT : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower G U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (g : SiteL2 L) :
    (1 - 216 * ρ ^ 2) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ∑ x ∈ Rj G ell j, ‖g x‖ ^ 2 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ j) ^ 2)
      ≤ max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * (‖gradL2 U g‖ ^ 2 + ⟪g, Qpa G U a g⟫)

AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_weighte.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_weighted
AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_weighte.header:
theorem site_coercive_weighted (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1)
    {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hU : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hT : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower G U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (f : SiteL2 L) :
    (1 - 216 * ρ ^ 2) * wNormSq G f ≤ max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ⟪f, DelpA G U a f⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteWt_mask.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteWt_mask
AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteWt_mask.header:
theorem siteWt_mask (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (S : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    siteWt φ (siteMask S f) = siteMask S (siteWt φ f)

AdalyFormal.M1Site.boxF_eq_blockOf.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.boxF_eq_blockOf
AdalyFormal.M1Site.boxF_eq_blockOf.header: theorem boxF_eq_blockOf (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (m : ℕ) : boxF y m = blockOf y m

AdalyFormal.M1Site.sum_head_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.sum_head_eq
AdalyFormal.M1Site.sum_head_eq.header:
theorem sum_head_eq (ψ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ψ (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) = 3 * ∑ x, ψ x

AdalyFormal.M1Site.exp_div_sub_one_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.exp_div_sub_one_le
AdalyFormal.M1Site.exp_div_sub_one_le.header:
theorem exp_div_sub_one_le (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Real.exp (t / n) - 1 ≤ (Real.exp t - 1) / n

AdalyFormal.M1Site.ajSeq_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.ajSeq_le
AdalyFormal.M1Site.ajSeq_le.header: theorem ajSeq_le (ell j : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : ajSeq a ell j ≤ a

AdalyFormal.M1Site.row_conj_lower.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.row_conj_lower
AdalyFormal.M1Site.row_conj_lower.header:
theorem row_conj_lower (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (j : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (δ m : ℝ) (hm0 : 0 ≤ m)
    (hbox : ∀ x ∈ boxF y (G.ell ^ j), |φ x - φ y| ≤ δ) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    (1 / 2) * (m * ‖Qlev G U j y f‖ ^ 2)
        - 3 * m * ((1 / (G.ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ j) * (Real.exp δ - 1) ^ 2 * ∑ x ∈ boxF y (G.ell ^ j), ‖f x‖ ^ 2
      ≤ m * ⟪Qlev G U j y (siteWt φ f), Qlev G U j y (siteWt (-φ) f)⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Site.ctErr.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.ctErr
AdalyFormal.M1Site.ctErr.header: noncomputable def ctErr (G : TowerGeom L) (a : ℝ) (Θ : Bond L → ℝ) (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteCT_gen.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteCT_gen
AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteCT_gen.header:
theorem siteCT_gen (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ ajSeq a G.ell j)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (Θ : Bond L → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ b : Bond L, |φ b.1 - φ (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)| ≤ Θ b)
    (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hbox : ∀ j, j ≤ G.k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ x ∈ boxF y (G.ell ^ j), |φ x - φ y| ≤ δ j)
    (f : SiteL2 L) :
    (1 / 2) * ⟪f, DelpA G U a f⟫ - ctErr G a Θ δ f ≤ ⟪f, siteWt φ (DelpA G U a (siteWt (-φ) f))⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Site.ctErr_le_wNorm.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.ctErr_le_wNorm
AdalyFormal.M1Site.ctErr_le_wNorm.header:
theorem ctErr_le_wNorm (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : ProperTower G ell k)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (θ δ0 : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ0)
    (Θ : Bond L → ℝ) (hΘ0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ Θ b)
    (hΘ : ∀ b : Bond L, periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ G.Om0 →
      Θ b ≤ θ / (ell : ℝ) ^ stratG G (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2))
    (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδp : ∀ j, 0 ≤ δ j) (hδ : ∀ j, δ j ≤ δ0) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ctErr G a Θ δ f ≤ (9 * (Real.exp θ - 1) ^ 2 + 3 * a * (Real.exp δ0 - 1) ^ 2) * wNormSq G f

AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteCT_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteCT_strat
AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteCT_strat.header:
theorem siteCT_strat (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : ProperTower G ell k)
    (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hφ : ∀ b : Bond L, periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ G.Om0 →
      |φ b.1 - φ (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)| ≤ θ / (ell : ℝ) ^ stratG G (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2))
    (δ0 : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ0)
    (hbox : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ x ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), |φ x - φ y| ≤ δ0)
    (f : SiteL2 L) :
    (1 / 2) * ⟪f, DelpA G U a f⟫ - (9 * (Real.exp θ - 1) ^ 2 + 3 * a * (Real.exp δ0 - 1) ^ 2) * wNormSq G f
      ≤ ⟪f, siteWt φ (DelpA G U a (siteWt (-φ) f))⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Site.dualNormSq.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.dualNormSq
AdalyFormal.M1Site.dualNormSq.header: noncomputable def dualNormSq (G : TowerGeom L) (g : SiteL2 L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Site.inner_mask_sq_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.inner_mask_sq_le
AdalyFormal.M1Site.inner_mask_sq_le.header:
theorem inner_mask_sq_le (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (h g : SiteL2 L) :
    ⟪h, siteMask G.Om0 g⟫ ^ 2 ≤ wNormSq G h * dualNormSq G g

AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteCT_inv_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteCT_inv_strat
AdalyFormal.M1Site.siteCT_inv_strat.header:
theorem siteCT_inv_strat (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1)
    {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hU : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hT : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.RMapLipschitz.frobNorm ((bgTower G U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
        ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA G U a + (1 - siteMask G.Om0)))
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hφ : ∀ b : Bond L, periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ G.Om0 →
      |φ b.1 - φ (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)| ≤ θ / (ell : ℝ) ^ stratG G (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2))
    (δ0 : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ0)
    (hbox : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ x ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), |φ x - φ y| ≤ δ0)
    (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c)
    (hc : c ≤ (1 / 2) * ((1 - 216 * ρ ^ 2) / max 6 (16 / (3 * a)))
      - (9 * (Real.exp θ - 1) ^ 2 + 3 * a * (Real.exp δ0 - 1) ^ 2))
    (g : SiteL2 L) :
    c * wNormSq G (siteWt φ (Gp G U a (siteWt (-φ) g))) ≤ ⟪siteWt φ (Gp G U a (siteWt (-φ) g)), siteMask G.Om0 g⟫
    ∧ c ^ 2 * wNormSq G (siteWt φ (Gp G U a (siteWt (-φ) g))) ≤ dualNormSq G g

AdalyFormal.M1Site.sum_QIdx.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.sum_QIdx
AdalyFormal.M1Site.sum_QIdx.header:
theorem sum_QIdx (G : TowerGeom L) (F : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ∑ q : QIdx G, F q.1.1.val q.1.2 = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (G.k + 1), ∑ y ∈ LamF G j, F j y

AdalyFormal.M1Site.norm_sq_split.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.norm_sq_split
AdalyFormal.M1Site.norm_sq_split.header:
theorem norm_sq_split (G : TowerGeom L) (x : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ‖siteMask G.Om0 x‖ ^ 2 + ∑ z : OffIdx G, ‖x z.1‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Site.grad_sq_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.grad_sq_le
AdalyFormal.M1Site.grad_sq_le.header: theorem grad_sq_le (U : Cfg L) (g : SiteL2 L) : ‖gradL2 U g‖ ^ 2 ≤ 12 * ‖g‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_form_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_form_le
AdalyFormal.M1Site.LP_form_le.header:
theorem LP_form_le (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : ProperTower G ell k)
    (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (x : SiteL2 L) :
    ⟪x, LP G U a x⟫ ≤ (12 + a) * ‖x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Site.form_cs.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.form_cs
AdalyFormal.M1Site.form_cs.header:
theorem form_cs (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ wq G a j) (x y : SiteL2 L) :
    ⟪x, LP G U a y⟫ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, LP G U a x⟫ * ⟪y, LP G U a y⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Site.gamma_lower_approx.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.gamma_lower_approx
AdalyFormal.M1Site.gamma_lower_approx.header:
theorem gamma_lower_approx (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ wq G a j)
    (hu : IsUnit (LP G U a)) (K : ℝ) (hK0 : 0 ≤ K) (hK : ∀ x, ⟪x, LP G U a x⟫ ≤ K * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (β : PIdx G → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (hη : η ≤ 1) (v : YP G) (g : SiteL2 L)
    (hgE : ⟪g, LP G U a g⟫ ≤ ∑ p, ‖v p‖ ^ 2 / β p)
    (hr : |⟪v, QpP G U a g⟫ - ∑ p, ‖v p‖ ^ 2 / β p| ≤ η * ∑ p, ‖v p‖ ^ 2 / β p)
    (hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ p, ‖v p‖ ^ 2 / β p) :
    (1 - η) ^ 2 * ∑ p, ‖v p‖ ^ 2 / β p ≤ K * ‖Xop G U a v‖ ^ 2

    (hfit : ∀ i, ∀ μ, (yb i μ).val + nb i ≤ L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.M1Site.row_drift.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.row_drift
AdalyFormal.M1Site.row_drift.header:
theorem row_drift (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (ell : ℕ) (hellG : G.ell = ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (j : ℕ)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ j)) (hdvdj : ∀ μ, ell ^ j ∣ L μ + 1)
    (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i)
    (hT : ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower G U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ i)
    (c : SuTwo) :
    ‖Qlev G U j y (bcF (blockOf y (ell ^ j)) c) - Qlev G (trivialU L) j y (bcF (blockOf y (ell ^ j)) c)‖
      ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ i) * ‖c‖

AdalyFormal.M1Site.isUnit_LP_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.isUnit_LP_strat
AdalyFormal.M1Site.isUnit_LP_strat.header:
theorem isUnit_LP_strat (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1)

    (hU : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hT : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower G U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j) :
    IsUnit (LP G U a)

AdalyFormal.M1Site.exists_Gami_strat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.exists_Gami_strat
AdalyFormal.M1Site.exists_Gami_strat.header:
theorem exists_Gami_strat (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1)

    (h216 : 216 * ρ ^ 2 < 1)
    (hU : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hT : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower G U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j) :
    ∃ Gi : YP G →L[ℝ] YP G,
      (∀ u, (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop G U a) ∘L Xop G U a) (Gi u) = u) ∧
      (∀ u, Gi ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Xop G U a) ∘L Xop G U a) u) = u)

AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_weighte.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_weighted_gauge
AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_weighte.header:
theorem site_coercive_weighted_gauge (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1)
    {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (U : Cfg L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hU : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
      frobNorm ((((periodicGaugeTransform γ U b : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
        ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hT : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
        ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (f : SiteL2 L) :
    (1 - 216 * ρ ^ 2) * wNormSq G f ≤ max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ⟪f, DelpA G U a f⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_weighte.name: AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_weighted_perblock
AdalyFormal.M1Site.site_coercive_weighte.header:
theorem site_coercive_weighted_perblock (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1)
    {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (U : Cfg L) (γB : QIdx G → GaugeFn L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hU : ∀ q : QIdx G, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds (yq q) (ell ^ jq q),
      frobNorm ((((periodicGaugeTransform (γB q) U b : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)) :
        Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ jq q)
    (hT : ∀ q : QIdx G, ∀ i, i < jq q → ∀ z ∈ blockOf (yq q) (ell ^ jq q), z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) →

    (hδ0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i) (J : ℕ) (Zs : ℕ → Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L))
    (hdvd : ∀ i, i < J → ∀ ν, ell ^ i ∣ L ν + 1)
    (hZc : ∀ i, i ≤ J → Zs i ⊆ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i))
    (hchain : ∀ i, i < J → Zs i = upZ (ell ^ i) ell (Zs (i + 1)))
    (hfit : ∀ i, i < J → ∀ y ∈ Zs (i + 1), ∀ μ, (y μ).val + ell ^ i * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    (hV : ∀ i, i < J → ∀ y ∈ Zs (i + 1), ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ i * ell), z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) →
      ∀ μ : Fin 3, coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ i * ell) →
        frobNorm ((bg i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ i)
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ J → NsZ (ell ^ j) (Zs j)
        (Qcomposite bg ell j f - Qcomposite (fun _ => trivialU L) ell j f)
      ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ i) * NsZ 1 (Zs 0) f

AdalyFormal.M1Site.level_data_al.header:
theorem level_data_al (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1)
    {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (U : Cfg L) (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k)
    (hT : ∀ i, i < j → ∀ y0 ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ z ∈ blockOf y0 (ell ^ j), z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y0 (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower G U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ i)
    (E : ℝ) (hE : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ i ≤ E)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    (∑ x ∈ Rj G ell j, ‖g x‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 3 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ j) ^ 2 * ∑ y ∈ LamF G j, ∑ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
            ‖g (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - g b.1‖ ^ 2
        + 2 * NsZ (ell ^ j) (LamF G j) (Qcomposite (fun _ => trivialU L) ell j g) ^ 2)
    ∧ NsZ (ell ^ j) (LamF G j) (Qcomposite (fun _ => trivialU L) ell j g)
        ≤ NsZ (ell ^ j) (LamF G j) (Qcomposite (bgTower G U) ell j g) + E * NsZ 1 (Rj G ell j) g

AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.phiC_blk.header:

AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.blk_card_ge.header:

AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.card_U.header:

AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.card_T.name: AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.card_T
AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.card_T.header:

    (Finset.univ.filter (fun r : Fin 3 → Fin b => ∃ a c : Fin 3, a ≠ c ∧ NPf (r a) ∧ NPf (r c))).card ≤ 12 * b

AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.count_le.header:

AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.unc_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.unc_sum
AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.unc_sum.header:
theorem unc_sum {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (P : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ x, P x → 1 ≤ strat S k x ∧ ∃ a a' : Fin 3, a ≠ a' ∧ NP (ell ^ (strat S k x - 1)) (x a).val ∧
      NP (ell ^ (strat S k x - 1)) (x a').val) :
    ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter P, (((ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k x)⁻¹) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(2 * phiC S ell M R k θ c x))
      ≤ 12 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (12 * θ) *
        ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (((ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k x)⁻¹) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-(2 * phiC S ell M R k θ c x))

AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.exists_ne3.header: theorem exists_ne3 (μ : Fin 3) : ∃ ν : Fin 3, ν ≠ μ
