AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.Jf_covered.name: AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.Jf_covered
AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.Jf_covered.header:
theorem Jf_covered {ell M R k c : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 0 < ell)
    {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} {α₀ : ℝ} {U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)}
    (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hRM : 4 ≤ R * M)
    (hU : PerCubeRegular2 ell M c k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀) (hsm : 4 * ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀) ≤ 1)
    (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hb2 : 2 ≤ bstrat S k b)
    {Q : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))} {i : ℕ} (hq : IsClassCube ell M c k S Q i)
    (hcr : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ν ≠ b.2 → CurlReads Q (periodicLatticeShiftBack b.1 ν) ν b.2 ∧ CurlReads Q b.1 ν b.2) :
    ‖(gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).Jf b‖ ≤ (400 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * ((c : ℝ) * M * α₀)) * omJ S ell k b

AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.Unc.header: def Unc {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell M k : ℕ) (S : Tower L) (b : Bond L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.Jf_split.name: AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.Jf_split
AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.Jf_split.header:
theorem Jf_split {ell M R k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 0 < ell)
    {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} {α₀ : ℝ} {U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)}
    (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hRM : 4 ≤ R * M)
    (hU : ClassCoupled ell M 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀) (hsm : 4 * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀) ≤ 1)
    (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ‖(gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).Jf b‖
      ≤ (400 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀)) * omJ S ell k b
        + (if Unc ell M k S b then
            4 * (2 * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀) + 6 * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀) ^ 2 + 1024 * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀) ^ 3)
              * omU S ell k b else 0)

AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.geo_split.name: AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.geo_split
AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.geo_split.header:
theorem geo_split {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hRM : 3 ≤ R * M) (hcov : CoversOm0p ell M 12 k S) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, (omS ell M k S b * (ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k b.1 * Real.exp (-(phiC S ell M R k θ c b.1))) ^ 2
      ≤ 6 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 6 * (1 + 12 * Real.exp (12 * θ)) *
        ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (((ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k x)⁻¹) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-(2 * phiC S ell M R k θ c x))

AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.col_cs.name: AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.col_cs
AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.col_cs.header:
theorem col_cs {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (ω u y : ι → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, 0 < u i) (G Q : ℝ)
    (hG : ∑ i, (ω i / u i) ^ 2 ≤ G) (hQ : ∑ i, (u i * y i) ^ 2 ≤ Q) :
    ∑ i, ω i * y i ≤ Real.sqrt G * Real.sqrt Q

AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.col_class.header:

    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hRM : 3 ≤ R * M) (hcov : CoversOm0p ell M 12 k S) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (hq : (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(θ * (R * M))) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hb : Bond L → ℝ) (hb0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ hb b) (K vn : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hvn : 0 ≤ vn)
    (hL2 : ∑ b : Bond L, ((((ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k b.1)⁻¹) * Real.exp (phiC S ell M R k θ c b.1) * hb b) ^ 2
      ≤ K ^ 2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ strat S k c * vn ^ 2) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, omS ell M k S b * hb b ≤ (Real.sqrt (Ageo ell θ) * K) * vn

AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.dlayerStrat_class.name: AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.dlayerStrat_class
AdalyFormal.M2DLayer.dlayerStrat_class.header:
theorem dlayerStrat_class {ell M R k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} {α₀ : ℝ} {U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (a : ℝ)

    {KH KH1 K2 CW KD : ℝ} (hKH : 0 ≤ KH) (hKH1 : 0 ≤ KH1) (hK2 : 0 ≤ K2)

    DLayerStrat ell k Lu hell S U a Lam ε2s εJ

AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.coarseCurlCLM_.header:

AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.pilp_norm_eq_s.header:
theorem pilp_norm_eq_sqrt_sum {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (x : PiLp 2 (fun _ : ι => SuTwo)) :
    ‖x‖ = Real.sqrt (∑ i : ι, ‖WithLp.ofLp x i‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.norm_bondFnL2.header:

    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 U (WithLp.toLp 2 A)‖

AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.ofLp_qCLM.name: AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.ofLp_qCLM
AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.ofLp_qCLM.header:

AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.norm_coarseCur.name: AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.norm_coarseCurl_qCLM
AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.norm_coarseCur.header:
theorem norm_coarseCurl_qCLM {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ‖coarseCurlCLM_L2 hdvd (qCLM U ell (WithLp.toLp 2 A))‖
      = Real.sqrt (∑ P : CoarsePlaquette L ell,
          ‖coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A) P‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.rawErrorCoeff_.header:
theorem rawErrorCoeff_nonneg (ell : ℕ)

AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.hraw_op.name: AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.hraw_op
AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.hraw_op.header:

    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    ‖coarseCurlCLM_L2 hdvd (qCLM U ell A)‖

AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.hK_lattice.header:

AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.perturbed_chai.name: AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.perturbed_chain_op
AdalyFormal.MechEdges.G16.perturbed_chai.header:
theorem perturbed_chain_op {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (D : AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.BalabanCovarianceData
          (BondFnL2 L) (CoarseFnL2 L ell))
    (hQ : D.Q = qCLM U ell) (B : CoarseFnL2 L ell) :
    ‖coarseCurlCLM_L2 hdvd B‖
      ≤ rawSigmaZero ell *
          ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 U
            (AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.solutionOperator D B)‖
        + (rawErrorCoeff ell U *
            ‖AdalyFormal.Balaban.VariationalProjectorH1.solutionOperator D‖) * ‖B‖

HConstruction.MassU1.physicalH_energy_py.name: HConstruction.MassU1.physicalH_energy_pythagoras
HConstruction.MassU1.physicalH_energy_py.header:

HConstruction.MassU1.actual_normal_equat.name: HConstruction.MassU1.actual_normal_equations_every_depth
HConstruction.MassU1.actual_normal_equat.header:
theorem actual_normal_equations_every_depth (k : ℕ) (B : Unit M) :

HConstruction.MassU1.minimizer_differenc.header:

    (hq : incoming M hn A = B) (hg : gaugeConstraint M A = 0)
    (he : fineEnergy M A = fineEnergy M (physicalH M hn B)) :

AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.EndpointCh.name: AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.EndpointChartDomain
AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.EndpointCh.header:
def EndpointChartDomain (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ)

AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.endpointAv.name: AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.endpointAvg_coe_eq_of_chartDomain

theorem endpointAvg_coe_eq_of_chartDomain (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ)

AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.endpointCh.name: AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.endpointChartDomain_trivialU_right

theorem endpointChartDomain_trivialU_right (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ)

AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.endpointAv.name: AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.endpointAvg_exponent_mem_su2Alg

theorem endpointAvg_exponent_mem_su2Alg (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ)

    (∑ x ∈ blockOf y ell, ((ell : ℚ) ^ 3)⁻¹ • su2Log (rZeroPath V0 V1 y (GammaPath y x)))

AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.endpointCh.header:
theorem endpointChartDomain_always (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ)

AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.EndpointCh.name: AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.EndpointChartMargin

AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.endpointCh.name: AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.endpointChartMargin_trivialU_right
AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.endpointCh.header:

AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.cPlus.name: AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.cPlus
AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.cPlus.header: def cPlus (ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.modifiedAv.name: AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.modifiedAverage
AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.modifiedAv.header:
noncomputable def modifiedAverage (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ)

AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.modifiedAv.name: AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.modifiedAverage_trivialU
AdalySI1.ModifiedAverageDeriv.modifiedAv.header:
theorem modifiedAverage_trivialU (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    modifiedAverage V0 ell (trivialU L) c = 1

AdalySI1.Multiscale.boxed_one_step_certi.name: AdalySI1.Multiscale.boxed_one_step_certified
AdalySI1.Multiscale.boxed_one_step_certi.header:
theorem boxed_one_step_certified (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent)
    (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2)
    (hah : ∀ e, (A e)ᴴ = -(A e)) (htr : ∀ e, Matrix.trace (A e) = 0)
    (ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hcell : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hnc2 : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 1 ell, loopVar 1 ell V0 c x ≠ su2NegOne)
    (h : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => su2Log (modifiedAverage V0 ell (fun e => su2Exp ((h * t) • A e)) c))
      (Lh ell h •
        ((q124Principal 1 ell V0 (fineDirToUnitBond A hah htr)
          (⟨⟨c.1, by rw [one_mul]; exact hcell⟩, c.2⟩ : CoarseBond L (1 * ell))
          : SuTwo) : M2))
      0

AdalySI1.Multiscale.qCompositeBond.name: AdalySI1.Multiscale.qCompositeBond
AdalySI1.Multiscale.qCompositeBond.header:
noncomputable def qCompositeBond
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ) :
    (j : ℕ) → (CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] (CoarseBond L (ell ^ j) → SuTwo)
  | 0 => LinearMap.id
  | (j + 1) => (q124Principal (ell ^ j) ell (bg j)).comp (qCompositeBond bg ell j)

                                                                      
theorem qCompositeBond_zero
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ) :
    qCompositeBond bg ell 0 = LinearMap.id

AdalySI1.Multiscale.qCompositeBond_zero.name: AdalySI1.Multiscale.qCompositeBond_zero
AdalySI1.Multiscale.qCompositeBond_zero.header:
theorem qCompositeBond_zero
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ) :
    qCompositeBond bg ell 0 = LinearMap.id

AdalySI1.Multiscale.qCompositeBond_succ.name: AdalySI1.Multiscale.qCompositeBond_succ
AdalySI1.Multiscale.qCompositeBond_succ.header:
theorem qCompositeBond_succ
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell j : ℕ) :
    qCompositeBond bg ell (j + 1)
      = (q124Principal (ell ^ j) ell (bg j)).comp (qCompositeBond bg ell j)

AdalySI1.Multiscale.bondSupport.name: AdalySI1.Multiscale.bondSupport
AdalySI1.Multiscale.bondSupport.header: def bondSupport (s ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalySI1.Multiscale.maskExtend.name: AdalySI1.Multiscale.maskExtend
AdalySI1.Multiscale.maskExtend.header:
noncomputable def maskExtend (s : ℕ) (S : CoarseBond L s → Prop) :

AdalySI1.Multiscale.maskedQCompositeBond.name: AdalySI1.Multiscale.maskedQCompositeBond
AdalySI1.Multiscale.maskedQCompositeBond.header:

AdalySI1.Multiscale.maskedModifiedAverag.header:

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.nu_le_frob.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.nu_le_frob
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.nu_le_frob.header: theorem nu_le_frob (X : M2) : AdalyFormal.Balaban.Bch2.nu X ≤ frobNorm X

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.frob_sum_le.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.frob_sum_le
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.frob_sum_le.header: theorem frob_sum_le : ∀ l : List M2, frobNorm l.sum ≤ (l.map frobNorm).sum

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.multi_bch.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.multi_bch
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.multi_bch.header:
theorem multi_bch : ∀ (as : List M2), (∀ a ∈ as, IsSu2 a) →
    (as.map frobNorm).sum ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.pi) →
    su2Exp (su2Log ((as.map su2Exp).prod)) = (as.map su2Exp).prod ∧
    frobNorm (su2Log ((as.map su2Exp).prod) - as.sum)
      ≤ 2 * Real.pi * ((as.map frobNorm).sum) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off.header: def off (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (σ : Fin 3) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_lt.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_lt
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_lt.header: theorem off_lt (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (σ : Fin 3) : off y x σ < L σ + 1

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_self.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_self
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_self.header: theorem off_self (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (σ : Fin 3) : off y y σ = 0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_shift_self.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_shift_self
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_shift_self.header:
theorem off_shift_self (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ) (ρ : Fin 3) :
    off y (coarseShift x n ρ) ρ = (off y x ρ + n) % (L ρ + 1)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_shift_ne.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_shift_ne
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_shift_ne.header:
theorem off_shift_ne (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ) {ρ σ : Fin 3} (h : σ ≠ ρ) :
    off y (coarseShift x n ρ) σ = off y x σ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_add.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_add
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_add.header:
theorem off_add (y c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (σ : Fin 3)
    (h : off c x σ + off y c σ < L σ + 1) : off y x σ = off c x σ + off y c σ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.endpoint_rep.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.endpoint_rep
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.endpoint_rep.header:
theorem endpoint_rep (s : ℕ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ) (ρ : Fin 3) :
    coarsePathEndpoint s z (List.replicate n ρ) = coarseShift z (s * n) ρ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.gamma_eq.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.gamma_eq
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.gamma_eq.header:
theorem gamma_eq (s : ℕ) (c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    coarseGammaPath s c x = List.replicate (off c x 2 / s) 2 ++
      (List.replicate (off c x 1 / s) 1 ++ List.replicate (off c x 0 / s) 0)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pathBonds_append.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pathBonds_append
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pathBonds_append.header:
theorem pathBonds_append (s : ℕ) : ∀ (p q : List (Fin 3)) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
    pathBonds s z (p ++ q) = pathBonds s z p ++ pathBonds s (coarsePathEndpoint s z p) q

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.mem_pathBonds_rep.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.mem_pathBonds_rep
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.mem_pathBonds_rep.header:
theorem mem_pathBonds_rep (s : ℕ) (ρ : Fin 3) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (b : PeriodicLatticeEdge L), b ∈ pathBonds s z (List.replicate n ρ) →
      ∃ t < n, b = (coarseShift z (s * t) ρ, ρ)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.finK_off.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.finK_off
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.finK_off.header: theorem finK_off (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (σ : Fin 3) : finK (L σ) (off y x σ) = x σ - y σ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.gamma_end.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.gamma_end
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.gamma_end.header:
theorem gamma_end (s : ℕ) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (h : ∀ σ, s ∣ off y x σ) :
    coarsePathEndpoint s y (coarseGammaPath s y x) = x

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cornerGauge.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cornerGauge
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cornerGauge.header:
def cornerGauge (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shift_mul_aligned.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shift_mul_aligned
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.shift_mul_aligned.header:
theorem shift_mul_aligned (s : ℕ) (hdvd : ∀ ρ, s ∣ L ρ + 1) (ρ : Fin 3) :
    ∀ (a : ℕ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L), z ∈ CoarseLattice L s →
      coarseShift z (s * a) ρ ∈ CoarseLattice L s

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.hol_one_step.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.hol_one_step
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.hol_one_step.header:
theorem hol_one_step (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (ρ : Fin 3) : coarsePathHolonomy s V z [ρ] = V (z, ρ)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_step_self.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_step_self
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_step_self.header:
theorem off_step_self (s : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ρ : Fin 3)
    (hnw : off y x ρ + s < L ρ + 1) :
    off y (coarseShift x s ρ) ρ / s = off y x ρ / s + 1

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_step_ne.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_step_ne
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_step_ne.header:
theorem off_step_ne (s : ℕ) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {ρ σ : Fin 3} (h : σ ≠ ρ) :
    off y (coarseShift x s ρ) σ / s = off y x σ / s

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.endpoint_one.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.endpoint_one
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.endpoint_one.header:
theorem endpoint_one (s : ℕ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ρ : Fin 3) :
    coarsePathEndpoint s z [ρ] = coarseShift z s ρ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.gamma_ends.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.gamma_ends
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.gamma_ends.header:
theorem gamma_ends (s : ℕ) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hal : ∀ σ, s ∣ off y x σ) :
    coarseShift (coarseShift (coarseShift y (s * (off y x 2 / s)) 2) (s * (off y x 1 / s)) 1)
      (s * (off y x 0 / s)) 0 = x

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.axial0.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.axial0
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.axial0.header:
theorem axial0 (s : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hal : ∀ σ, s ∣ off y x σ) (hnw : off y x 0 + s < L 0 + 1) :
    cornerGauge s V y x * V (x, 0) * (cornerGauge s V y (coarseShift x s 0))⁻¹ = 1

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.axial1.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.axial1
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.axial1.header:
theorem axial1 (s : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hal : ∀ σ, s ∣ off y x σ) (hnw : off y x 1 + s < L 1 + 1) :
    ∃ g : SU2, cornerGauge s V y x * V (x, 1) * (cornerGauge s V y (coarseShift x s 1))⁻¹
      = g * ladS s V (coarseShift (coarseShift y (s * (off y x 2 / s)) 2) (s * (off y x 1 / s)) 1)
          (List.replicate (off y x 0 / s) 0) 1 1 * g⁻¹

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.axial2.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.axial2
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.axial2.header:
theorem axial2 (s : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hal : ∀ σ, s ∣ off y x σ) (hnw : off y x 2 + s < L 2 + 1) :
    ∃ g : SU2, cornerGauge s V y x * V (x, 2) * (cornerGauge s V y (coarseShift x s 2))⁻¹
      = g * ladS s V (coarseShift y (s * (off y x 2 / s)) 2)
          (List.replicate (off y x 1 / s) 1 ++ List.replicate (off y x 0 / s) 0) 2 1 * g⁻¹

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_cgauge.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_cgauge
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pw_cgauge.header:
theorem pw_cgauge (m : ℕ) (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) :
    pw m (coarseGaugeTransform m γ U) y ν μ = γ y * pw m U y ν μ * (γ y)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_pw_cgauge.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_pw_cgauge
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dv_pw_cgauge.header:
theorem dv_pw_cgauge (m : ℕ) (γ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) :
    dv (pw m (coarseGaugeTransform m γ U) y ν μ) = dv (pw m U y ν μ)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.chart_small.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.chart_small
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.chart_small.header:
theorem chart_small (g : SU2) (h : dv g ≤ 1) :
    su2Exp (su2Log g) = g ∧ IsSu2 (su2Log g) ∧ frobNorm (su2Log g) ≤ 2 * dv g

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.axial_link.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.axial_link
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.axial_link.header:
theorem axial_link (s : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L s) (hdvd : ∀ ρ, s ∣ L ρ + 1)
    (P : ℝ) (hP : ∀ z ∈ CoarseLattice L s, ∀ ν μ : Fin 3, dv (pw s V z ν μ) ≤ P)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ρ : Fin 3) (hal : ∀ σ, s ∣ off y x σ)
    (hnw : off y x ρ + s < L ρ + 1) :
    dv (coarseGaugeTransform s (cornerGauge s V y) V (x, ρ))
      ≤ (((off y x 0 / s : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((off y x 1 / s : ℕ) : ℝ)) * P

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.Box.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.Box
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.Box.header: def Box (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s B : ℕ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.box_shift.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.box_shift
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.box_shift.header:
theorem box_shift (y z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s B t : ℕ) (ρ : Fin 3) (hz : Box y s B z)
    (h : off y z ρ + s * t ≤ B) (hB : B < L ρ + 1) : Box y s B (coarseShift z (s * t) ρ)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_shift_val.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_shift_val
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.off_shift_val.header:
theorem off_shift_val (y z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ) (ρ : Fin 3)
    (h : off y z ρ + n < L ρ + 1) : off y (coarseShift z n ρ) ρ = off y z ρ + n

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.box_rep.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.box_rep
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.box_rep.header:
theorem box_rep (y z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s B n : ℕ) (ρ : Fin 3) (hz : Box y s B z)
    (h : off y z ρ + s * n ≤ B + s) (hB : B < L ρ + 1) :
    ∀ b ∈ pathBonds s z (List.replicate n ρ), Box y s B b.1

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.box_stair.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.box_stair
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.box_stair.header:
theorem box_stair (y z0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s B a0 a1 a2 : ℕ) (hz : Box y s B z0)
    (h2 : off y z0 2 + s * a2 ≤ B) (h1 : off y z0 1 + s * a1 ≤ B) (h0 : off y z0 0 + s * a0 ≤ B)
    (hB : ∀ ρ, B < L ρ + 1) :
    ∀ b ∈ pathBonds s z0 (List.replicate a2 2 ++ (List.replicate a1 1 ++ List.replicate a0 0)),
      Box y s B b.1

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dvd_lt_add.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dvd_lt_add
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.dvd_lt_add.header: theorem dvd_lt_add {s a m : ℕ} (ha : s ∣ a) (hm : s ∣ m) (h : a < m) : a + s ≤ m

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.block_offsets.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.block_offsets
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.block_offsets.header:
theorem block_offsets (s ell : ℕ) (c x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hfit : ∀ σ, (c σ).val + s * ell ≤ L σ + 1) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c s ell) (σ : Fin 3) :
    s ∣ off c x σ ∧ off c x σ + s ≤ s * ell

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cone_box.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cone_box
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cone_box.header:
theorem cone_box (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hN : ∀ ρ, 2 * (s * ell) < L ρ + 1) (hm : s ≤ s * ell)
    (hc : Box y s (s * ell) c.1) (hc2 : off y c.1 c.2 = 0)
    (hfit : ∀ σ, (c.1 σ).val + s * ell ≤ L σ + 1) :
    (∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, ∀ b ∈ loopBonds s ell c x, Box y s (2 * (s * ell) - s) b.1) ∧
    ∀ b ∈ pathBonds s c.1 (List.replicate ell c.2), Box y s (2 * (s * ell) - s) b.1

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.mem_rungPlaqs.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.mem_rungPlaqs
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.mem_rungPlaqs.header:
theorem mem_rungPlaqs (s : ℕ) (ν μ : Fin 3) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (t : PlaqT L),
    t ∈ rungPlaqs s ν μ z n → ∃ j < n, t = (coarseShift z (s * j) μ, ν, μ)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.mem_ladPlaqs_rep.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.mem_ladPlaqs_rep
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.mem_ladPlaqs_rep.header:
theorem mem_ladPlaqs_rep (s : ℕ) (ν μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) : ∀ (n' : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (t : PlaqT L), t ∈ ladPlaqs s μ n x (List.replicate n' ν) →
      ∃ i < n', ∃ j < n, t = (coarseShift (coarseShift x (s * i) ν) (s * j) μ, ν, μ)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladder_box.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladder_box
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladder_box.header:
theorem ladder_box (s ell : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) (hνμ : ν ≠ μ)
    (hN : ∀ ρ, 2 * (s * ell) < L ρ + 1)
    (hfit : ∀ σ, (y σ).val + s * ell ≤ L σ + 1)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell)
    (t : PlaqT L) (ht : t ∈ ladPlaqs s μ ell x (List.replicate ell ν)) :
    Box y s (2 * (s * ell) - s) t.1 ∧ Box y s (2 * (s * ell) - s) (coarseShift t.1 s t.2.1) ∧
    Box y s (2 * (s * ell) - s) (coarseShift t.1 s t.2.2)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.chart_of_box.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.chart_of_box
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.chart_of_box.header:
theorem chart_of_box (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L s) (hdvd : ∀ ρ, s ∣ L ρ + 1)
    (hN : ∀ ρ, 2 * (s * ell) < L ρ + 1) (P : ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ z ∈ CoarseLattice L s, ∀ ν μ : Fin 3, dv (pw s V z ν μ) ≤ P)
    (hsm : 4 * (ell : ℝ) * P ≤ 1) (b : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hb : Box y s (2 * (s * ell) - s) b.1) :
    Chart (coarseGaugeTransform s (cornerGauge s V y) V)
      (fun e => su2Log (coarseGaugeTransform s (cornerGauge s V y) V e)) (8 * ell * P) b

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.prop1_level.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.prop1_level
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.prop1_level.header:
theorem prop1_level (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (P : ℝ) (hP0 : 0 ≤ P)
    (hδ : (ell : ℝ) ^ 4 * P ≤ 1 / 100000)
    (hdvd : ∀ ρ, s * ell ∣ L ρ + 1) (hN : ∀ ρ, 2 * (s * ell) < L ρ + 1)
    (hP : ∀ z ∈ CoarseLattice L s, ∀ ν μ : Fin 3, dv (pw s V z ν μ) ≤ P)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (s * ell)) (ν μ : Fin 3) :
    dv (pw (s * ell) (ubarSU2 s ell V) y ν μ)
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * P + 1000000 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 4 * P ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord.header: def coord (i j : Fin 2) (b : Bool) (X : M2) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_add.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_add
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_add.header:
theorem coord_add (i j : Fin 2) (b : Bool) (X Y : M2) :
    coord i j b (X + Y) = coord i j b X + coord i j b Y

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_sub.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_sub
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_sub.header:
theorem coord_sub (i j : Fin 2) (b : Bool) (X Y : M2) :
    coord i j b (X - Y) = coord i j b X - coord i j b Y

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_zero
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_zero.header: theorem coord_zero (i j : Fin 2) (b : Bool) : coord i j b (0 : M2) = 0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_smul.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_smul
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_smul.header:
theorem coord_smul (i j : Fin 2) (b : Bool) (r : ℝ) (X : M2) :
    coord i j b (r • X) = r * coord i j b X

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_sum.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_sum
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_sum.header:
theorem coord_sum {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (i j : Fin 2) (b : Bool) (f : ι → M2) :
    coord i j b (∑ x ∈ S, f x) = ∑ x ∈ S, coord i j b (f x)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ext_coord.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ext_coord
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ext_coord.header: theorem ext_coord {X Y : M2} (h : ∀ i j b, coord i j b X = coord i j b Y) : X = Y

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pathM.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pathM
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pathM.header:
def pathM (s : ℕ) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) : PeriodicLatticeSite L → List (Fin 3) → M2
  | _, [] => 0
  | y, μ :: rest => A (y, μ) + pathM s A (coarseShift y s μ) rest

def cf (i j : Fin 2) (b : Bool) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cf.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cf
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cf.header: def cf (i j : Fin 2) (b : Bool) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_pathM.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_pathM
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_pathM.header:
theorem coord_pathM (s : ℕ) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (i j : Fin 2) (b : Bool) :
    ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
      coord i j b (pathM s A y p) = pathAngle s (cf i j b A) y p

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.bondM.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.bondM
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.bondM.header: def bondM (s ell : ℕ) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : M2

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopM.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopM
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopM.header:
def loopM (s ell : ℕ) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : M2

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.blkM.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.blkM
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.blkM.header: def blkM (s ell : ℕ) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : M2

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curlM.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curlM
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curlM.header: def curlM (s : ℕ) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) : M2

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM.header:
def ladAM (s : ℕ) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3))
    (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) : M2

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_blkM.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_blkM
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_blkM.header:
theorem coord_blkM (s ell : ℕ) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (i j : Fin 2) (b : Bool)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : coord i j b (blkM s ell A c) = blkAngle s ell (cf i j b A) c

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cf_blkM.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cf_blkM
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cf_blkM.header:
theorem cf_blkM (s ell : ℕ) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (i j : Fin 2) (b : Bool) :
    cf i j b (blkM s ell A) = blkAngle s ell (cf i j b A)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_curlM.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_curlM
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_curlM.header:
theorem coord_curlM (s : ℕ) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (i j : Fin 2) (b : Bool)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) :
    coord i j b (curlM s A y ν μ) = curlS s (cf i j b A) y ν μ

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_ladAM.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_ladAM
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.coord_ladAM.header:
theorem coord_ladAM (s : ℕ) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (i j : Fin 2) (b : Bool)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    coord i j b (ladAM s A y p μ n) = ladA s (cf i j b A) y p μ n

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curlM_blk_identity.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curlM_blk_identity
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curlM_blk_identity.header:
theorem curlM_blk_identity (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3)
    (hdvd : ∀ ρ, s * ell ∣ L ρ + 1) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (s * ell)) :
    curlM (s * ell) (blkM s ell A) y ν μ
      = ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ • ladAM s A x (List.replicate ell ν) μ ell

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM_cons.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM_cons
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM_cons.header:
theorem ladAM_cons (s : ℕ) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (ν : Fin 3) (p : List (Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    ladAM s A y (ν :: p) μ n = ladAM s A (coarseShift y s ν) p μ n + ladAM s A y [ν] μ n

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM_rung.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM_rung
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM_rung.header:
theorem ladAM_rung (s : ℕ) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (ν μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    ladAM s A y [ν] μ (n + 1) = curlM s A y ν μ + ladAM s A (coarseShift y s μ) [ν] μ n

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM_zero
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM_zero.header:
theorem ladAM_zero (s : ℕ) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (ν μ : Fin 3) : ladAM s A y [ν] μ 0 = 0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM_nil.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM_nil
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM_nil.header:
theorem ladAM_nil (s : ℕ) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) : ladAM s A y [] μ n = 0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM_le.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM_le
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladAM_le.header:
theorem ladAM_le (s : ℕ) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (Q : ℝ) :
    ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
      (∀ t ∈ ladPlaqs s μ n y p, frobNorm (curlM s A t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ Q) →
      frobNorm (ladAM s A y p μ n) ≤ (p.length : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) * Q)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.geom_le.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.geom_le
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.geom_le.header: theorem geom_le (r : ℝ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) : ∀ l : ℕ, ∑ m ∈ Finset.range l, r ^ m ≤ r ^ l

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cl_one.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cl_one
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cl_one.header: theorem cl_one (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : y ∈ CoarseLattice L 1

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curv_tower_na.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curv_tower_na
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curv_tower_na.header:
theorem curv_tower_na (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (q0 : ℝ)
    (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (h0 : ∀ y ν μ, dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ q0) (n : ℕ)
    (hdvd : ∀ ρ, ell ^ n ∣ L ρ + 1) (hN : ∀ ρ, 2 * ell ^ n < L ρ + 1)
    (hsmall : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ n * q0) ≤ 1) :
    ∀ l ≤ n, ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ l), ∀ ν μ : Fin 3,
      dv (pw (ell ^ l) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l) y ν μ) ≤ 2 * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_tower_align.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_tower_aligned
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_tower_align.header:
theorem defect_tower_aligned (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (q0 C : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (n : ℕ) (hdvd : ∀ ρ, ell ^ n ∣ L ρ + 1)
    (hP : ∀ l < n, ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ l), ∀ ν μ : Fin 3,
      dv (pw (ell ^ l) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l) y ν μ) ≤ C * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0) :
    ∀ l ≤ n, ∀ c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ l) →
      dv (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l c * (strT ell U l c)⁻¹)
        ≤ 3 * Real.pi / 2 * C * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.link_tower_na.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.link_tower_na
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.link_tower_na.header:
theorem link_tower_na (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (q0 e : ℝ)
    (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (h0 : ∀ y ν μ, dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ q0) (he : ∀ b, dv (U b) ≤ e) (n : ℕ)
    (hdvd : ∀ ρ, ell ^ n ∣ L ρ + 1) (hN : ∀ ρ, 2 * ell ^ n < L ρ + 1)
    (hsmall : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ n * q0) ≤ 1)
    (l : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ n) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (hc : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ l)) :
    dv (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l c) ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ l * e + 3 * Real.pi * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladPlaqs_one_base.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladPlaqs_one_base
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.ladPlaqs_one_base.header:
theorem ladPlaqs_one_base (s : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (t : PlaqT L), t ∈ ladPlaqs s μ 1 z p → ∃ b ∈ pathBonds s z p, t.1 = b.1

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.axial_link_loc.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.axial_link_loc
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.axial_link_loc.header:
theorem axial_link_loc (s : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L s) (hdvd : ∀ ρ, s ∣ L ρ + 1)
    (B : ℕ) (hB : ∀ ρ, B < L ρ + 1) (P : ℝ) (hP0 : 0 ≤ P)
    (hP : ∀ z ∈ CoarseLattice L s, Box y s B z → ∀ ν μ : Fin 3, dv (pw s V z ν μ) ≤ P)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ρ : Fin 3) (hx : Box y s B x)
    (hnw : off y x ρ + s < L ρ + 1) :
    dv (coarseGaugeTransform s (cornerGauge s V y) V (x, ρ))
      ≤ (((off y x 0 / s : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((off y x 1 / s : ℕ) : ℝ)) * P

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.chart_of_box_loc.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.chart_of_box_loc
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.chart_of_box_loc.header:
theorem chart_of_box_loc (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L s) (hdvd : ∀ ρ, s ∣ L ρ + 1)
    (hN : ∀ ρ, 2 * (s * ell) < L ρ + 1) (P : ℝ)
    (hP0 : 0 ≤ P)
    (hP : ∀ z ∈ CoarseLattice L s, Box y s (2 * (s * ell) - s) z → ∀ ν μ : Fin 3, dv (pw s V z ν μ) ≤ P)
    (hsm : 4 * (ell : ℝ) * P ≤ 1) (b : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hb : Box y s (2 * (s * ell) - s) b.1) :
    Chart (coarseGaugeTransform s (cornerGauge s V y) V)
      (fun e => su2Log (coarseGaugeTransform s (cornerGauge s V y) V e)) (8 * ell * P) b

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.prop1_level_loc.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.prop1_level_loc
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.prop1_level_loc.header:
theorem prop1_level_loc (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (P : ℝ) (hP0 : 0 ≤ P)
    (hδ : (ell : ℝ) ^ 4 * P ≤ 1 / 100000)
    (hdvd : ∀ ρ, s * ell ∣ L ρ + 1) (hN : ∀ ρ, 2 * (s * ell) < L ρ + 1)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (s * ell))
    (hP : ∀ z ∈ CoarseLattice L s, Box y s (2 * (s * ell) - s) z → ∀ ν μ : Fin 3, dv (pw s V z ν μ) ≤ P)
    (ν μ : Fin 3) :
    dv (pw (s * ell) (ubarSU2 s ell V) y ν μ)
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * P + 1000000 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 4 * P ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.GoodPl.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.GoodPl
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.GoodPl.header:
def GoodPl (ell : ℕ) (R : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Prop) : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite L → Prop
  | 0, y => R y
  | l + 1, y => ∀ z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ l), Box y (ell ^ l) (2 * (ell ^ l * ell) - ell ^ l) z →
      GoodPl ell R l z

theorem goodPl_univ (ell : ℕ) : ∀ (l : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L), GoodPl ell (fun _ => True) l y

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodPl_univ.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodPl_univ
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodPl_univ.header: theorem goodPl_univ (ell : ℕ) : ∀ (l : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L), GoodPl ell (fun _ => True) l y

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curv_tower_na_loc.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curv_tower_na_loc
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curv_tower_na_loc.header:
theorem curv_tower_na_loc (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (q0 : ℝ)
    (R : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Prop)
    (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (h0 : ∀ y, R y → ∀ ν μ, dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ q0) (n : ℕ)
    (hdvd : ∀ ρ, ell ^ n ∣ L ρ + 1) (hN : ∀ ρ, 2 * ell ^ n < L ρ + 1)
    (hsmall : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ n * q0) ≤ 1) :
    ∀ l ≤ n, ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ l), GoodPl ell R l y → ∀ ν μ : Fin 3,
      dv (pw (ell ^ l) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l) y ν μ) ≤ 2 * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.GoodBd.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.GoodBd
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.GoodBd.header:
def GoodBd (ell : ℕ) (R : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Prop) : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop
  | 0, _ => True
  | l + 1, c =>
      (∀ b ∈ pathBonds (ell ^ l) c.1 (List.replicate ell c.2), GoodBd ell R l b) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 (ell ^ l) ell,
        ∀ t ∈ ladPlaqs (ell ^ l) c.2 ell c.1 (coarseGammaPath (ell ^ l) c.1 x), GoodPl ell R l t.1)

theorem goodBd_univ (ell : ℕ) : ∀ (l : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L),
    GoodBd ell (fun _ => True) l c

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodBd_univ.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodBd_univ
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.goodBd_univ.header:
theorem goodBd_univ (ell : ℕ) : ∀ (l : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L),
    GoodBd ell (fun _ => True) l c

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_tower_align.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_tower_aligned_loc
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.defect_tower_align.header:
theorem defect_tower_aligned_loc (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (R : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Prop) (q0 C : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (n : ℕ)
    (hdvd : ∀ ρ, ell ^ n ∣ L ρ + 1)
    (hP : ∀ l < n, ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ l), GoodPl ell R l y → ∀ ν μ : Fin 3,
      dv (pw (ell ^ l) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l) y ν μ) ≤ C * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0) :
    ∀ l ≤ n, ∀ c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ l) → GoodBd ell R l c →
      dv (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l c * (strT ell U l c)⁻¹)
        ≤ 3 * Real.pi / 2 * C * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.link_tower_na_loc.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.link_tower_na_loc
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.link_tower_na_loc.header:
theorem link_tower_na_loc (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (R : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Prop) (Rl : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop) (q0 e : ℝ)
    (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (h0 : ∀ y, R y → ∀ ν μ, dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ q0)
    (he : ∀ b, Rl b → dv (U b) ≤ e) (n : ℕ)
    (hdvd : ∀ ρ, ell ^ n ∣ L ρ + 1) (hN : ∀ ρ, 2 * ell ^ n < L ρ + 1)
    (hsmall : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ n * q0) ≤ 1)
    (l : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ n) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (hc : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ l))
    (hgB : GoodBd ell R l c) (hgL : goodL ell Rl l c) :
    dv (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l c) ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ l * e + 3 * Real.pi * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cube_tower_class_n.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cube_tower_class_na
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.cube_tower_class_n.header:
theorem cube_tower_class_na (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    {U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {B : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → Prop} {η a : ℝ} (j : ℕ)
    (hη : 0 < η) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1)
    (K : CubeChart U B η (a * (((ell : ℝ) ^ j * η)⁻¹ ^ 1)) (a * (((ell : ℝ) ^ j * η)⁻¹ ^ 2)))
    (hdvd : ∀ ρ, ell ^ j ∣ L ρ + 1) (hN : ∀ ρ, 2 * ell ^ j < L ρ + 1)
    (hsm : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * a) ≤ 1)
    (l : ℕ) (hlj : l ≤ j) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (hc : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ l))
    (hgB : GoodBd ell (fun y => ∀ ν μ : Fin 3, plaqIn B (y, ν, μ)) l c) (hgL : goodL ell B l c) :
    dv (ubarTowerSU2 ell (periodicGaugeTransform K.g U) l c)
      ≤ a * (1 + 3 * Real.pi * (4 * Real.pi + 4)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ l / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.witness_hyps.header:

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.hol_eq_prod.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.hol_eq_prod
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.hol_eq_prod.header:

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.sum_pathBonds.header:

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.inv_prod_exp.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.inv_prod_exp
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.inv_prod_exp.header:
theorem inv_prod_exp (l : List M2) (h : ∀ a ∈ l, IsSu2 a) :

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.normsum_neg_rev.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.normsum_neg_rev
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.normsum_neg_rev.header:
theorem normsum_neg_rev (l : List M2) :

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.normsum_le.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.normsum_le
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.normsum_le.header:

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.length_pathBonds.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.length_pathBonds

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.Chart.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.Chart
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.Chart.header:
def Chart (W : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (k : ℝ)
    (b : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pl_facts.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pl_facts
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.pl_facts.header:
theorem pl_facts (s : ℕ) (W : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2)
    (k : ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3))
    (h : ∀ b ∈ pathBonds s y p, Chart W A k b) :
    coarsePathHolonomy s W y p = ((pl s A y p).map su2Exp).prod ∧
    (coarsePathHolonomy s W y p)⁻¹ = ((plInv s A y p).map su2Exp).prod ∧
    (pl s A y p).sum = pathM s A y p ∧ (plInv s A y p).sum = -pathM s A y p ∧
    (∀ a ∈ pl s A y p, IsSu2 a) ∧ (∀ a ∈ plInv s A y p, IsSu2 a) ∧
    ((pl s A y p).map frobNorm).sum ≤ p.length * k ∧
    ((plInv s A y p).map frobNorm).sum ≤ p.length * k

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopList.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopList
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopList.header:

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopList_facts.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopList_facts
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.loopList_facts.header:
theorem loopList_facts (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (W : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell)
    (h : ∀ b ∈ loopBonds s ell c x, Chart W A k b) :
    loopVar s ell W c x = ((loopList s ell A c x).map su2Exp).prod ∧
    (loopList s ell A c x).sum = loopM s ell A c x ∧
    (∀ a ∈ loopList s ell A c x, IsSu2 a) ∧
    ((loopList s ell A c x).map frobNorm).sum ≤ 8 * ell * k

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.log_ubar_lin.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.log_ubar_lin
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.log_ubar_lin.header:
theorem log_ubar_lin (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (W : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    (hsm : 8 * (ell : ℝ) * k ≤ 1 / (8 * Real.pi)) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell, ∀ b ∈ loopBonds s ell c x, Chart W A k b)
    (hc : ∀ b ∈ pathBonds s c.1 (List.replicate ell c.2), Chart W A k b) :
    su2Exp (su2Log (ubarSU2 s ell W c)) = ubarSU2 s ell W c ∧
    frobNorm (su2Log (ubarSU2 s ell W c) - blkM s ell A c)
      ≤ 200 * Real.pi * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * k ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.four_list.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.four_list
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.four_list.header:
theorem four_list (a b c e : M2) (ha : IsSu2 a) (hb : IsSu2 b) (hc : IsSu2 c) (he : IsSu2 e) :
    (([a, b, -c, -e] : List M2).map su2Exp).prod
      = su2Exp a * su2Exp b * (su2Exp c)⁻¹ * (su2Exp e)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curlM_le_plaq.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curlM_le_plaq
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.curlM_le_plaq.header:
theorem curlM_le_plaq (s : ℕ) (W : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2)
    (k P : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hk4 : 4 * k ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.pi)) (hP : P ≤ 1)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3)
    (h1 : Chart W A k (y, ν)) (h2 : Chart W A k (coarseShift y s ν, μ))
    (h3 : Chart W A k (coarseShift y s μ, ν)) (h4 : Chart W A k (y, μ))
    (hpw : dv (pw s W y ν μ) ≤ P) :
    frobNorm (curlM s A y ν μ) ≤ P + P ^ 3 / 8 + 32 * Real.pi * k ^ 2

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.blkM_norm.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.blkM_norm
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.blkM_norm.header:
theorem blkM_norm (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (W : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)

    (hc : ∀ b ∈ pathBonds s c.1 (List.replicate ell c.2), Chart W A k b) :

AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.prop1_chart.name: AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.prop1_chart
AdalyFormal.CurvBlock.prop1_chart.header:
theorem prop1_chart (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (W : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (k P : ℝ)
    (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hP0 : 0 ≤ P) (hP1 : P ≤ 1)
    (hsm : 8 * (ell : ℝ) * k ≤ 1 / (8 * Real.pi))
    (hR : 4 * (9 * (ell : ℝ) * k + 200 * Real.pi * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * k ^ 2)) ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.pi))
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3)
    (hdvd : ∀ ρ, s * ell ∣ L ρ + 1) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (s * ell))
    (h1 : BondOK s ell W A k (y, ν)) (h2 : BondOK s ell W A k (coarseShift y (s * ell) ν, μ))
    (h3 : BondOK s ell W A k (coarseShift y (s * ell) μ, ν)) (h4 : BondOK s ell W A k (y, μ))
    (hq : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, ∀ t ∈ ladPlaqs s μ ell x (List.replicate ell ν),
      PlaqOK s W A k P t) :
    dv (pw (s * ell) (ubarSU2 s ell W) y ν μ)
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * (P + P ^ 3 / 8 + 32 * Real.pi * k ^ 2)
        + 800 * Real.pi * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * k ^ 2)
        + 2 * Real.pi * (4 * (9 * (ell : ℝ) * k + 200 * Real.pi * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * k ^ 2))) ^ 2

theorem nc_class_gap {ell m R : ℕ} (hell : 3 ≤ ell) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hR : 1 ≤ R) :
    ∃ (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell 1 Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 1 Lu)),
      TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧ Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R 1 S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) R 1 S Lam ∧ Lam.Nonempty ∧
      OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧
      x ∈ S.Om 0 ∧
      (∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 1 Lu))) (j : ℕ), IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) 12 1 S sites j → x ∉ sites) ∧
      ¬ CoversOm0p ell (ell ^ m) 12 1 S ∧
      (∀ (α₀ η : ℝ) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell 1 Lu)), ¬ ClassCoupled ell (ell ^ m) 12 1 S α₀ η U) ∧
      (∀ α₀ : ℝ, 0 < α₀ → ∀ v : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ,
        PerCubeRegular2 ell (ell ^ m) 12 1 S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ 1)⁻¹ (Function.update (fun _ => 1) ((x, 1) : Bond _) v)) ∧
      (∀ (α₀ η : ℝ) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell 1 Lu)), PerCubeRegular2 ell (ell ^ m) 12 1 S α₀ η U →
        ∀ v : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ,
          PerCubeRegular2 ell (ell ^ m) 12 1 S α₀ η (Function.update U ((x, 1) : Bond _) v)) ∧
      pStar x ∈ plaqIn (S.Om 0) ∧ ((x, 1) : Bond _) ∈ periodicPlaquetteBoundaryEdges (pStar x) ∧
      periodicPlaquetteHolonomy (Function.update (fun _ => (1 : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)) ((x, 1) : Bond _) negOne)
        (pStar x) = negOne

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.e2Majorant_le_twe.header: theorem e2Majorant_le_twelve {ρ : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (h1 : ρ ≤ 1 / 10) : e2Majorant ρ ≤ 12 * ρ

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.loopFactorBound_l.header: theorem loopFactorBound_le (ell : ℕ) : (SmallnessBridge.Assemble.loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) ≤ 8 * ell

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.rhoOf_le.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.rhoOf_le
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.rhoOf_le.header: theorem rhoOf_le {ell : ℕ} (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0) : rhoOf ell ε0 ≤ 8 * ell * (6 / 5 * ε0)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.numeric_small.header:

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.frobNorm_loopVar_.header:
theorem frobNorm_loopVar_le {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ε0 : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.mem_LogReg_of_fro.header: theorem mem_LogReg_of_frob_lt {g : M2} (h : frobNorm (g - 1) < r0) : g ∈ LogReg

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_unitSites_eq.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_unitSites_eq
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_unitSites_eq.header:

    ∑ u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) y, F u.1 = ∑ x ∈ blockOf y ell, F x

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.T1_eq_stepBondAvg.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.T1_eq_stepBondAvgAt
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.T1_eq_stepBondAvg.header:
theorem T1_eq_stepBondAvgAt (ell : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (B : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo)
    (c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell)) :
    unitToCoarseCov 1 ell V B c = stepBondAvgAt 1 V ell B c.1.1 c.2

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.T1_eq_lineCoarseR.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.T1_eq_lineCoarseRestrictCov
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.T1_eq_lineCoarseR.header:
theorem T1_eq_lineCoarseRestrictCov {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    unitToCoarseCov 1 ell U (bondToUnit A)
        (⟨⟨c.1.1, by rw [one_mul]; exact c.1.2⟩, c.2⟩ : CoarseBond L (1 * ell))
      = lineCoarseRestrictCov U ell A c

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.foldl_rZeroPathSt.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.foldl_rZeroPathStepS
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.foldl_rZeroPathSt.header:
theorem foldl_rZeroPathStepS (s : ℕ) (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (h pr : SU2),
      (p.foldl (rZeroPathStepS s V0 V1) (y, h, pr)).2.2
        = pr * (h * coarsePathHolonomy s (fun b => V1 b * V0 b) y p
            * (coarsePathHolonomy s V0 y p)⁻¹ * h⁻¹)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.rProd_eq_rZeroPat.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.rProd_eq_rZeroPathS
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.rProd_eq_rZeroPat.header:
theorem rProd_eq_rZeroPathS (s : ℕ) (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.su2Exp_neg_of_mem.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.su2Exp_neg_of_mem
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.su2Exp_neg_of_mem.header:
theorem su2Exp_neg_of_mem {X : M2} (hah : Xᴴ = -X) (htr : Matrix.trace X = 0) :

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sBlock_mem.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sBlock_mem
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sBlock_mem.header:

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.endpointAvgS_eq_s.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.endpointAvgS_eq_su2Exp_sBlock
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.endpointAvgS_eq_s.header:
theorem endpointAvgS_eq_su2Exp_sBlock (s ell : ℕ) (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)

    endpointAvgS s V0 V1 ell y = su2Exp (sBlock s ell V0 V1 y)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.rawStep_eq_modifi.header:

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.pathSite_succ_add.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.pathSite_succ_add
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.pathSite_succ_add.header:
theorem pathSite_succ_add (u : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :
    pathSite u μ (i + 1) = pathSite (u + Pi.single μ 1) μ i

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.pathSum_rep.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.pathSum_rep
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.pathSum_rep.header:

    pathSum f u (List.replicate n μ) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f (pathSite u μ i, μ)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.T1_drift_term.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.T1_drift_term
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.T1_drift_term.header:
theorem T1_drift_term {ell : ℕ} (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0) (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0)
    (A : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell))
    (u : {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L // z ∈ CoarseLattice L 1}) (hu : u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) c.1.1) :
    ‖(∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
          if h : pathSite u.1 c.2 (i * 1) ∈ CoarseLattice L 1 then
            RMap (coarsePathHolonomy 1 V c.1.1 (coarseTransportPath 1 c.1.1 u.1 c.2 i))
              (A (⟨pathSite u.1 c.2 (i * 1), h⟩, c.2)) else 0)
        - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
          if h : pathSite u.1 c.2 (i * 1) ∈ CoarseLattice L 1 then
            RMap (coarsePathHolonomy 1 (trivialU L) c.1.1 (coarseTransportPath 1 c.1.1 u.1 c.2 i))
              (A (⟨pathSite u.1 c.2 (i * 1), h⟩, c.2)) else 0‖
      ≤ 8 * ell * ε0 * N2 ell A c u.1

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.T1_drift_row.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.T1_drift_row
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.T1_drift_row.header:
theorem T1_drift_row {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0) (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0)
    (A : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell)) :
    ‖unitToCoarseCov 1 ell V A c - unitToCoarseCov 1 ell (trivialU L) A c‖
      ≤ 8 * ell * ε0 * ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * ∑ u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) c.1.1, N2 ell A c u.1)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_x2.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_x2
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_x2.header:
theorem sum_x2 {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (A : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell), ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * ∑ u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) c.1.1, N2 ell A c u.1) ^ 2
      ≤ 3 * l1 (gA A)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.T1_drift_l2.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.T1_drift_l2
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.T1_drift_l2.header:
theorem T1_drift_l2 {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0) (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0)
    (A : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell),
        ‖unitToCoarseCov 1 ell V A c - unitToCoarseCov 1 ell (trivialU L) A c‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 192 * (ell * ε0) ^ 2 * l1 (gA A)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.fromM2Lin_apply.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.fromM2Lin_apply
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.fromM2Lin_apply.header: theorem fromM2Lin_apply (X : M2) : fromM2Lin X = fromM2 X

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.fromM2Lin_Lh.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.fromM2Lin_Lh
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.fromM2Lin_Lh.header: theorem fromM2Lin_Lh (ell : ℕ) (X : M2) : fromM2Lin (Lh ell 1 • X) = (ell : ℝ) • fromM2 X

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.expCfgX_smul.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.expCfgX_smul
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.expCfgX_smul.header:
theorem expCfgX_smul (a : XS L) (t : ℝ) :
    expCfgX (t • a) = fun e => su2Exp ((1 * t) • toM2 (a e))

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.qStepX_line.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.qStepX_line
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.qStepX_line.header:
theorem qStepX_line (ell : ℕ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (a : XS L) (t : ℝ)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    qStepX 1 ell V0 (t • a) c
      = fromM2 (su2Log (modifiedAverageS 1 V0 ell (fun e => su2Exp ((1 * t) • toM2 (a e))) c))

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.fderiv_qStepX_one.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.fderiv_qStepX_one_apply
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.fderiv_qStepX_one.header:
theorem fderiv_qStepX_one_apply (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ)
    (hreg : RegBg 1 ell V0) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hcell : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (hnc2 : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 1 ell, loopVar 1 ell V0 c x ≠ su2NegOne)
    (a : XS L) :
    fderiv ℝ (qStepX 1 ell V0) 0 a c
      = (ell : ℝ) • fromM2
          ((q124Principal 1 ell V0
              (fineDirToUnitBond (fun e => toM2 (a e)) (fun e => (toM2_mem (a e)).1)
                (fun e => (toM2_mem (a e)).2))
              (⟨⟨c.1, by rw [one_mul]; exact hcell⟩, c.2⟩ : CoarseBond L (1 * ell)) : SuTwo) : M2)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.bondToUnit.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.bondToUnit
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.bondToUnit.header: def bondToUnit (B : Bond L → SuTwo) : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.cbEquiv.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.cbEquiv
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.cbEquiv.header: def cbEquiv (ell : ℕ) : CoarseBond L ell ≃ CoarseBond L (1 * ell)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.norm_lineIntegral.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.norm_lineIntegral_le
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.norm_lineIntegral.header:
theorem norm_lineIntegral_le (ell : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.shift_sub_eq.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.shift_sub_eq
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.shift_sub_eq.header:
theorem shift_sub_eq (a b : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (k : ℕ) (ν : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.coarseCoordSteps_.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.coarseCoordSteps_shift
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.coarseCoordSteps_.header:
theorem coarseCoordSteps_shift (a b : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (k : ℕ) (ν : Fin 3) :
    coarseCoordSteps 1 (pathSite a μ k) (pathSite b μ k) ν = coarseCoordSteps 1 a b ν

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.norm_delta124_le_.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.norm_delta124_le_terms
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.norm_delta124_le_.header:
theorem norm_delta124_le_terms (ell m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (K : Coeff124 L ell m) (A : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L (ell * m)) :
    ‖delta124 ell m V K A c‖
      ≤ (1 / (m : ℝ) ^ 4) *
          (∑ u ∈ unitSitesOf ell (ell * m) c.1.1,
            (‖K.E1 c u.1‖ * ‖lineIntegral ell V A c.1.1 (coarseGammaPath ell c.1.1 u.1)‖
             + ‖K.E1 c u.1‖ * ‖lineIntegral ell V A u.1 (List.replicate m c.2)‖
             + ‖K.E2 c u.1‖ *
                 ‖lineIntegral ell V A (cPlus c) (coarseGammaPath ell (cPlus c) (partner c u.1))‖))
        + (1 / (m : ℝ)) * (‖K.E3 c‖ * ‖lineIntegral ell V A c.1.1 (List.replicate m c.2)‖)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.inBlock_of_mem_un.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.inBlock_of_mem_unitSites
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.inBlock_of_mem_un.header:
theorem inBlock_of_mem_unitSites {ell : ℕ} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.near_len_le.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.near_len_le
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.near_len_le.header:
theorem near_len_le {ell : ℕ} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (u : {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L // z ∈ CoarseLattice L 1})
    (hu : u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) y) : (coarseGammaPath 1 y u.1).length ≤ 3 * ell

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.far_len_le.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.far_len_le
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.far_len_le.header:
theorem far_len_le {ell : ℕ} (c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell))

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.norm_delta124_le_.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.norm_delta124_le_sup
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.norm_delta124_le_.header:
theorem norm_delta124_le_sup {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (K : Coeff124 L 1 ell) (c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell)) (kap M : ℝ) (hkap : 0 ≤ kap) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hE1 : ∀ u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) c.1.1, ‖K.E1 c u.1‖ ≤ kap)
    (hE2 : ∀ u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) c.1.1, ‖K.E2 c u.1‖ ≤ kap)
    (hE3 : ‖K.E3 c‖ ≤ kap)
    (A : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) (hA : ∀ b, ‖A b‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖delta124 1 ell V K A c‖ ≤ 8 * kap * M

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.frob_hol_le.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.frob_hol_le
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.frob_hol_le.header:
theorem frob_hol_le (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ε0 : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.norm_T1_drift_le.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.norm_T1_drift_le
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.norm_T1_drift_le.header:
theorem norm_T1_drift_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0) (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.mem_blockOf_of_me.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.mem_blockOf_of_mem_unitSites
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.mem_blockOf_of_me.header:

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.e1Majorant_le_e2M.header: theorem e1Majorant_le_e2Majorant {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) : e1Majorant ρ ≤ e2Majorant ρ

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.E_bounds.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.E_bounds
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.E_bounds.header:
theorem E_bounds {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0) (hsmall : rhoOf ell ε0 < Real.pi / 2)
    (c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell)) :
    (∀ u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) c.1.1,
        ‖(Coeff124.ofPrincipalBackground 1 ell V).E1 c u.1‖ ≤ e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ε0)) ∧
    (∀ u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) c.1.1,
        ‖(Coeff124.ofPrincipalBackground 1 ell V).E2 c u.1‖ ≤ e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ε0)) ∧
    ‖(Coeff124.ofPrincipalBackground 1 ell V).E3 c‖ ≤ e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ε0)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.loop_ne_negOne.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.loop_ne_negOne
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.loop_ne_negOne.header:

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.loopVar_flat.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.loopVar_flat

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.q124_sub_T1_le.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.q124_sub_T1_le
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.q124_sub_T1_le.header:
theorem q124_sub_T1_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0) (hsmall : rhoOf ell ε0 < Real.pi / 2)
    (A : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hA : ∀ b, ‖A b‖ ≤ M)
    (c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell)) :
    ‖q124Principal 1 ell V A c - unitToCoarseCov 1 ell V A c‖
      ≤ 8 * e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ε0) * M

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.q124_sub_flat_le.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.q124_sub_flat_le
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.q124_sub_flat_le.header:
theorem q124_sub_flat_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm ((V e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0) (hsmall : rhoOf ell ε0 < Real.pi / 2)
    (A : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hA : ∀ b, ‖A b‖ ≤ M)
    (c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell)) :
    ‖q124Principal 1 ell V A c - q124Principal 1 ell (trivialU L) A c‖
      ≤ (8 * ell * ε0 + 8 * e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ε0)) * M

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.s_pos_of.header: theorem s_pos_of (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) : 0 < s

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embS.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embS
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embS.header: def embS (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lq) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embS_val.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embS_val

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embS_injective.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embS_injective
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embS_injective.header: theorem embS_injective (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) : Function.Injective (embS hs)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embS_shift_gen.header:

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embE.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embE
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embE.header: def embE (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lq) : PeriodicLatticeEdge L

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.resV.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.resV
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.resV.header:

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embS_shift_one.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embS_shift_one
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embS_shift_one.header:
theorem embS_shift_one (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lq) (μ : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.hol_emb.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.hol_emb
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.hol_emb.header:

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embS_update.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embS_update
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.embS_update.header:
theorem embS_update (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (a b : PeriodicLatticeSite Lq) (μ : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.coarseCoordSteps_.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.coarseCoordSteps_emb
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.coarseCoordSteps_.header:
theorem coarseCoordSteps_emb (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (a b : PeriodicLatticeSite Lq)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.coarseGammaPath_e.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.coarseGammaPath_emb
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.coarseGammaPath_e.header:
theorem coarseGammaPath_emb (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (a b : PeriodicLatticeSite Lq) :

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.cPlusS_emb.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.cPlusS_emb
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.cPlusS_emb.header:
theorem cPlusS_emb (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lq) :
    cPlusS s ell (embE hs c) = embS hs (cPlusS 1 ell c)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.stepBlockOf_emb.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.stepBlockOf_emb
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.stepBlockOf_emb.header:
theorem stepBlockOf_emb (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (ell : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lq) :
    stepBlockOf (embS hs y) s ell = (stepBlockOf y 1 ell).image (embS hs)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.loopVar_emb.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.loopVar_emb
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.loopVar_emb.header:
theorem loopVar_emb (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (ell : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lq) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lq) :
    loopVar s ell V (embE hs c) (embS hs x) = loopVar 1 ell (resV hs V) c x

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.stridedBlockedGau.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.stridedBlockedGauge_emb
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.stridedBlockedGau.header:
theorem stridedBlockedGauge_emb (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (ell : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lq) :
    stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp s ell V (embE hs c)
      = stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp 1 ell (resV hs V) c

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sBlock_emb.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sBlock_emb
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sBlock_emb.header:
theorem sBlock_emb (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (ell : ℕ)
    (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lq) :
    sBlock s ell V0 V1 (embS hs y) = sBlock 1 ell (resV hs V0) (resV hs V1) y

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.rawStep_emb.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.rawStep_emb
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.rawStep_emb.header:
theorem rawStep_emb (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (ell : ℕ)
    (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lq) :
    rawStep s ell V0 V1 (embE hs c) = rawStep 1 ell (resV hs V0) (resV hs V1) c

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.resA.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.resA
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.resA.header: def resA (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (a : XS L) : XS Lq

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.resV_expCfgX.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.resV_expCfgX
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.resV_expCfgX.header:
theorem resV_expCfgX (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (a : XS L) :
    resV hs (expCfgX a) = expCfgX (resA hs a)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.qStepX_emb.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.qStepX_emb
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.qStepX_emb.header:
theorem qStepX_emb (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (ell : ℕ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (a : XS L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lq) :
    qStepX s ell V0 a (embE hs c) = qStepX 1 ell (resV hs V0) (resA hs a) c

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.fderiv_qStepX_str.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.fderiv_qStepX_stride_apply
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.fderiv_qStepX_str.header:
theorem fderiv_qStepX_stride_apply (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = s * (Lq μ + 1)) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (ell : ℕ) (hreg : RegBg s ell V0) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lq)
    (hcell : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice Lq ell) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (Lq μ + 1))
    (hnc2 : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 1 ell, loopVar 1 ell (resV hs V0) c x ≠ su2NegOne)
    (a : XS L) :
    fderiv ℝ (qStepX s ell V0) 0 a (embE hs c)
      = (ell : ℝ) • fromM2
          ((q124Principal 1 ell (resV hs V0)
              (fineDirToUnitBond (fun e => toM2 (resA hs a e)) (fun e => (toM2_mem (resA hs a e)).1)
                (fun e => (toM2_mem (resA hs a e)).2))
              (⟨⟨c.1, by rw [one_mul]; exact hcell⟩, c.2⟩ : CoarseBond Lq (1 * ell)) : SuTwo) : M2)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.QlinCompX_succ_ap.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.QlinCompX_succ_apply_emb
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.QlinCompX_succ_ap.header:
theorem QlinCompX_succ_apply_emb (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (J : ℕ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell bg J) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < J)
    (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = ell ^ j * (Lq μ + 1)) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (Lq μ + 1)) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lq)
    (hcell : c.1 ∈ CoarseLattice Lq ell)
    (hnc2 : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 1 ell, loopVar 1 ell (resV hs (bg j)) c x ≠ su2NegOne)
    (a : XS L) :
    QlinCompX ell bg (j + 1) a (embE hs c)
      = (ell : ℝ) • fromM2
          ((q124Principal 1 ell (resV hs (bg j))
              (fineDirToUnitBond (fun e => toM2 (resA hs (QlinCompX ell bg j a) e))
                (fun e => (toM2_mem (resA hs (QlinCompX ell bg j a) e)).1)
                (fun e => (toM2_mem (resA hs (QlinCompX ell bg j a) e)).2))
              (⟨⟨c.1, by rw [one_mul]; exact hcell⟩, c.2⟩ : CoarseBond Lq (1 * ell)) : SuTwo) : M2)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.level_jet_sub_T1_.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.level_jet_sub_T1_le
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.level_jet_sub_T1_.header:
theorem level_jet_sub_T1_le (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (J : ℕ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell bg J) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < J)
    (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = ell ^ j * (Lq μ + 1)) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (Lq μ + 1)) (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm (((resV hs (bg j)) e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0) (hsmall : rhoOf ell ε0 < Real.pi / 2)
    (a : XS L) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hY : ∀ e, ‖suOf (resA hs (QlinCompX ell bg j a) e)‖ ≤ M) (c : CoarseBond Lq ell) :
    ‖suOf ((ell : ℝ)⁻¹ • QlinCompX ell bg (j + 1) a (embE hs (c.1.1, c.2)))
        - unitToCoarseCov 1 ell (resV hs (bg j))
            (fun b : CoarseBond Lq 1 => suOf (resA hs (QlinCompX ell bg j a) (b.1.1, b.2)))
            (⟨⟨c.1.1, by rw [one_mul]; exact c.1.2⟩, c.2⟩ : CoarseBond Lq (1 * ell))‖
      ≤ 8 * e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ε0) * M

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.level_jet_sub_T1_.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.level_jet_sub_T1_l2
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.level_jet_sub_T1_.header:
theorem level_jet_sub_T1_l2 (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (J : ℕ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell bg J) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < J)
    (hs : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = ell ^ j * (Lq μ + 1)) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (Lq μ + 1)) (ε0 : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm (((resV hs (bg j)) e : M2) - 1) ≤ ε0) (hsmall : rhoOf ell ε0 < Real.pi / 2)
    (a : XS L) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond Lq ell,
        ‖suOf ((ell : ℝ)⁻¹ • QlinCompX ell bg (j + 1) a (embE hs (c.1.1, c.2)))
          - unitToCoarseCov 1 ell (resV hs (bg j))
              (fun b : CoarseBond Lq 1 => suOf (resA hs (QlinCompX ell bg j a) (b.1.1, b.2)))
              (cbEquiv ell c)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 240 * (e2Majorant (rhoOf ell ε0)) ^ 2 *
          ∑ e : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lq, ‖suOf (resA hs (QlinCompX ell bg j a) e)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.shift_eq_add.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.shift_eq_add
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.shift_eq_add.header:
theorem shift_eq_add (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    periodicLatticeShift y μ = y + Pi.single μ 1

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.coarseShift_one_a.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.coarseShift_one_add
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.coarseShift_one_a.header:
theorem coarseShift_one_add (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.bondsOf.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.bondsOf
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.bondsOf.header:
def bondsOf (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : List (Fin 3) → List (PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
  | [] => []
  | μ :: rest => (y, μ) :: bondsOf (y + Pi.single μ 1) rest

theorem bondsOf_add (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    bondsOf (x + y) p = (bondsOf y p).map (fun e => (x + e.1, e.2))

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.bondsOf_add.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.bondsOf_add
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.bondsOf_add.header:
theorem bondsOf_add (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    bondsOf (x + y) p = (bondsOf y p).map (fun e => (x + e.1, e.2))

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.bondsOf_length.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.bondsOf_length
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.bondsOf_length.header:
theorem bondsOf_length (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    (bondsOf y p).length = p.length

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.pathSum.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.pathSum
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.pathSum.header: def pathSum (f : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.norm_lineIntegral.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.norm_lineIntegral_le_pathSum
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.norm_lineIntegral.header:
theorem norm_lineIntegral_le_pathSum (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) (p : List (Fin 3)) :

      ‖lineIntegral 1 V A y p‖ ≤ pathSum (fun e => ‖A (⟨e.1, AdalyFormal.Balaban.StridedAveraging.mem_coarseLattice_one e.1⟩, e.2)‖) y p

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.coarseGammaPath_o.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.coarseGammaPath_one_eq_stair
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.coarseGammaPath_o.header:
theorem coarseGammaPath_one_eq_stair (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    coarseGammaPath 1 y x = stair (x - y)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.pathSite_eq_add.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.pathSite_eq_add
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.pathSite_eq_add.header:
theorem pathSite_eq_add (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    pathSite x μ n = x + n • Pi.single μ 1

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.partner_sub_cPlus.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.partner_sub_cPlus
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.partner_sub_cPlus.header:
theorem partner_sub_cPlus (u c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.l1.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.l1
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.l1.header: def l1 (g : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_translate.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_translate
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_translate.header:
theorem sum_translate (g : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (a : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) :
    ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, g (y + a, ν) = ∑ z : PeriodicLatticeSite L, g (z, ν)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_le_l1.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_le_l1
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_le_l1.header:
theorem sum_le_l1 (g : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (hg : ∀ e, 0 ≤ g e) (ν : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.list_sum_swap.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.list_sum_swap
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.list_sum_swap.header:
theorem list_sum_swap {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] (B : List α) (h : ι → α → ℝ) :
    ∑ y : ι, (B.map (h y)).sum = (B.map (fun e => ∑ y : ι, h y e)).sum

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.list_sum_le.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.list_sum_le
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.list_sum_le.header:
theorem list_sum_le {α : Type*} (B : List α) (F : α → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (h : ∀ e, F e ≤ c) :

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_pathSum_trans.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_pathSum_translate
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_pathSum_trans.header:
theorem sum_pathSum_translate (g : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (hg : ∀ e, 0 ≤ g e)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.Doff.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.Doff
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.Doff.header: def Doff (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell : ℕ) : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.card_Doff_le.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.card_Doff_le
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.card_Doff_le.header: theorem card_Doff_le (ell : ℕ) : (Doff L ell).card ≤ ell ^ 3

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sub_mem_Doff.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sub_mem_Doff
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sub_mem_Doff.header:

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_rows_le.header:

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.fam_bound.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.fam_bound
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.fam_bound.header:
theorem fam_bound {ell : ℕ} (g : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (hg : ∀ e, 0 ≤ g e) (m : ℕ)
    (a : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Fin 3 → PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (q : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Fin 3 → List (Fin 3))
    (hq : ∀ d ∈ Doff L ell, ∀ μ, (q d μ).length ≤ m) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell), ∑ u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) c.1.1,
        pathSum g (c.1.1 + a (u.1 - c.1.1) c.2) (q (u.1 - c.1.1) c.2)
      ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * m * l1 g

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.list_sq_sum_le.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.list_sq_sum_le
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.list_sq_sum_le.header: theorem list_sq_sum_le (l : List ℝ) : l.sum ^ 2 ≤ l.length * (l.map (fun x => x ^ 2)).sum

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.pathSum_sq_le.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.pathSum_sq_le
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.pathSum_sq_le.header:
theorem pathSum_sq_le (f : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3)) :

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.delta_pointwise.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.delta_pointwise
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.delta_pointwise.header:
theorem delta_pointwise {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (K : Coeff124 L 1 ell) (c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell)) (kap : ℝ) (hkap : 0 ≤ kap)
    (hE1 : ∀ u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) c.1.1, ‖K.E1 c u.1‖ ≤ kap)
    (hE2 : ∀ u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) c.1.1, ‖K.E2 c u.1‖ ≤ kap)
    (hE3 : ‖K.E3 c‖ ≤ kap) (A : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) :
    ‖delta124 1 ell V K A c‖
      ≤ kap * ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * ∑ u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) c.1.1,
            (N1 ell A c u.1 + N2 ell A c u.1 + N3 ell A c u.1) + (1 / (ell : ℝ)) * N4 ell A c)

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.cs_block.header:

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_family.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_family
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.sum_family.header:
theorem sum_family {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (A : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) (m : ℕ)
    (a : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Fin 3 → PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (q : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Fin 3 → List (Fin 3))
    (hq : ∀ d ∈ Doff L ell, ∀ μ, (q d μ).length ≤ m) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell),
        ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * ∑ u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) c.1.1,
          pathSum (fA A) (c.1.1 + a (u.1 - c.1.1) c.2) (q (u.1 - c.1.1) c.2)) ^ 2
      ≤ (m / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) * (3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * m * l1 (gA A))

AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.delta124_l2.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.delta124_l2
AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.delta124_l2.header:
theorem delta124_l2 {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (K : Coeff124 L 1 ell) (kap : ℝ) (hkap : 0 ≤ kap)
    (hE1 : ∀ c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell), ∀ u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) c.1.1, ‖K.E1 c u.1‖ ≤ kap)
    (hE2 : ∀ c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell), ∀ u ∈ unitSitesOf 1 (1 * ell) c.1.1, ‖K.E2 c u.1‖ ≤ kap)
    (hE3 : ∀ c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell), ‖K.E3 c‖ ≤ kap) (A : CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) :
    ∑ c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell), ‖delta124 1 ell V K A c‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 240 * kap ^ 2 * l1 (gA A)

AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.mx_left_facts.name: AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.mx_left_facts
AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.mx_left_facts.header:
theorem mx_left_facts (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hq : R ≤ q) :
    ∃ d t : ℕ, ell ^ 2 = d + 1 ∧ ell ^ 2 - 1 = d ∧ ell * (R + ell * q) = q + t ∧ d * (R + ell * q) + R = ell * t ∧

AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.slabGeo_mix.header:

    (hwT : R + ell * q ≤ T) :
    SlabGeo M ell R (nvcN ell M T) (mxP0 ell M R q) (nvcQ0 ell M R T) (mxP1 ell M R q) (nvcQ1 ell M T)
      (mxP2 ell M R q) (nvcQ2 ell M T)

AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.mx_widths.name: AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.mx_widths
AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.mx_widths.header:
theorem mx_widths (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hq : R ≤ q) (hT : 1 ≤ T)
    (hwT : R + ell * q ≤ T) {f : ℕ} (hfw : f ≤ R + ell * q) :
    mxP0 ell M R q + f * M ≤ mxP2 ell M R q ∧ nvcQ2 ell M T + f * M ≤ nvcQ0 ell M R T ∧
      mxP1 ell M R q + f * (M * ell) ≤ nvcQ1 ell M T ∧ mxP2 ell M R q + f * (M * ell ^ 2) ≤ nvcQ2 ell M T ∧
      nvcQ0 ell M R T < nvcN ell M T ∧ mxP1 ell M R q < mxP2 ell M R q ∧ nvcQ2 ell M T < nvcQ1 ell M T ∧
      nvcQ1 ell M T < nvcQ0 ell M R T

AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.mx_covers.header:

AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.upd0_mem.name: AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.upd0_mem
AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.upd0_mem.header:

AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.mx_right_cube.header:
