AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.nonvac_core_mix.name: AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.nonvac_core_mix
AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.nonvac_core_mix.header:
theorem nonvac_core_mix {ell M R T q f₁ f₂ : ℕ} {Φ : Set ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (hq : R ≤ q) (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hwT : R + ell * q ≤ T)
    (hΦ : ∀ f ∈ Φ, 10 ≤ f ∧ f ≤ T) (hf₁ : f₁ ∈ Φ) (hf₂ : f₂ ∈ Φ)
    (h1w : f₁ ≤ R + ell * q) (hwf2 : R + ell * q < f₂) {a₀ : ℝ} (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
      2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell M Lu ∧ Admissible ell M R k S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell M R k S Lam ∧
      0 < α₀ ∧ (∀ f ∈ Φ, (f : ℝ) * (M : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀) ∧
      MXP.AllC.ClassCoupledΦ ell M Φ k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
      (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 2) ∧
      (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
      (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
      (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
      Lam.Nonempty ∧ (LamPrime ell Lam).Nonempty ∧
      OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ f ∈ Φ, ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ μ : Fin 3, 6 * (f * bigSide M ell j) ≤ scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1) ∧
      (∀ f ∈ Φ, ∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ),
        IsClassCube ell M f k S sites j → ∃ x, x ∉ sites) ∧
      (∀ g : ℕ, 2 ≤ g → (CoversOm0c ell M g k S ↔ g ≤ R + ell * q)) ∧
      CoversOm0p ell M f₁ k S ∧ ¬ CoversOm0c ell M f₂ k S ∧ f₁ ≠ f₂ ∧
      (∃ x ∈ S.Om 0, ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ),
        IsClassCube ell M f₂ k S sites j ∧ x ∈ sites)

AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.exists_q.name: AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.exists_q
AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.exists_q.header:
theorem exists_q {ell R f₁ f₂ : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hf : max f₁ (R * (1 + ell)) + ell ≤ f₂) :
    ∃ q : ℕ, R ≤ q ∧ f₁ ≤ R + ell * q ∧ R + ell * q < f₂

AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.headline_regime_no.name: AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.headline_regime_nonvacuousMixed
AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.headline_regime_no.header:
theorem headline_regime_nonvacuousMixed {ell m R q f₁ f₂ F : ℕ} {Φ : Set ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    {a₀ : ℝ} (ha₀ : 0 < a₀)
    (hΦ : ∀ f ∈ Φ, 10 ≤ f ∧ f ≤ F) (hf₁ : f₁ ∈ Φ) (hf₂ : f₂ ∈ Φ)
    (hq : R ≤ q) (h1w : f₁ ≤ R + ell * q) (hwf2 : R + ell * q < f₂) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
      2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧ Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R k S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) R k S Lam ∧
      0 < α₀ ∧ (∀ f ∈ Φ, (f : ℝ) * ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀) ∧
      MXP.AllC.ClassCoupledΦ ell (ell ^ m) Φ k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
      (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 2) ∧
      (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
      (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
      (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
      Lam.Nonempty ∧ (LamPrime ell Lam).Nonempty ∧
      OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ f ∈ Φ, ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ μ : Fin 3, 6 * (f * bigSide (ell ^ m) ell j) ≤ scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1) ∧
      (∀ f ∈ Φ, ∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ),
        IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) f k S sites j → ∃ x, x ∉ sites) ∧
      (∀ g : ℕ, 2 ≤ g → (CoversOm0c ell (ell ^ m) g k S ↔ g ≤ R + ell * q)) ∧
      CoversOm0p ell (ell ^ m) f₁ k S ∧ ¬ CoversOm0c ell (ell ^ m) f₂ k S ∧ f₁ ≠ f₂ ∧
      (∃ x ∈ S.Om 0, ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ),
        IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) f₂ k S sites j ∧ x ∈ sites)

AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.headline_regime_no.name: AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.headline_regime_nonvacuousMixed_gap
AdalyFormal.NonVacMix.headline_regime_no.header:
theorem headline_regime_nonvacuousMixed_gap {ell m R f₁ f₂ F : ℕ} {Φ : Set ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    {a₀ : ℝ} (ha₀ : 0 < a₀)
    (hΦ : ∀ f ∈ Φ, 10 ≤ f ∧ f ≤ F) (hf₁ : f₁ ∈ Φ) (hf₂ : f₂ ∈ Φ)
    (hgap : max f₁ (R * (1 + ell)) + ell ≤ f₂) :
    ∃ q : ℕ, R ≤ q ∧ f₁ ≤ R + ell * q ∧ R + ell * q < f₂ ∧
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
      2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧ Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R k S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) R k S Lam ∧
      0 < α₀ ∧ (∀ f ∈ Φ, (f : ℝ) * ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀) ∧
      MXP.AllC.ClassCoupledΦ ell (ell ^ m) Φ k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
      (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 2) ∧
      (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
      (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
      (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
      Lam.Nonempty ∧ (LamPrime ell Lam).Nonempty ∧
      OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ f ∈ Φ, ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ μ : Fin 3, 6 * (f * bigSide (ell ^ m) ell j) ≤ scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1) ∧
      (∀ f ∈ Φ, ∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ),
        IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) f k S sites j → ∃ x, x ∉ sites) ∧
      (∀ g : ℕ, 2 ≤ g → (CoversOm0c ell (ell ^ m) g k S ↔ g ≤ R + ell * q)) ∧
      CoversOm0p ell (ell ^ m) f₁ k S ∧ ¬ CoversOm0c ell (ell ^ m) f₂ k S ∧ f₁ ≠ f₂ ∧
      (∃ x ∈ S.Om 0, ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ),
        IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) f₂ k S sites j ∧ x ∈ sites)

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.grad_cov.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.grad_cov
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.grad_cov.header:
theorem grad_cov (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) (b : Bond L) :
    (gradL2 U f) b = RMap (U b) (f (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)) - f b.1

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.lap_cov.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.lap_cov
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.lap_cov.header:
theorem lap_cov (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (lapFull U f) x = ∑ μ : Fin 3, ((2 : ℝ) • f x - RMap (U (x, μ)) (f (periodicLatticeShift x μ))
      - RMap (U (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ, μ))⁻¹ (f (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ)))

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.normSq_grad_cov.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.normSq_grad_cov
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.normSq_grad_cov.header:
theorem normSq_grad_cov (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖gradL2 U f‖ ^ 2 = ∑ x, ∑ μ : Fin 3, ‖RMap (U (x, μ)) (f (periodicLatticeShift x μ)) - f x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.normSq_grad_cov_ba.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.normSq_grad_cov_back
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.normSq_grad_cov_ba.header:
theorem normSq_grad_cov_back (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ∑ x, ∑ μ : Fin 3, ‖RMap (U (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ, μ))⁻¹ (f (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ)) - f x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.grad_norm_le_cov.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.grad_norm_le_cov
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.grad_norm_le_cov.header: theorem grad_norm_le_cov (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) : ‖gradL2 U f‖ ^ 2 ≤ 12 * ‖f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.lap_norm_le_cov.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.lap_norm_le_cov
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.lap_norm_le_cov.header: theorem lap_norm_le_cov (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) : ‖lapFull U f‖ ≤ 12 * ‖f‖

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.comm_bound_cov.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.comm_bound_cov
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.comm_bound_cov.header:
theorem comm_bound_cov (U : Cfg L) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) (Dm c : ℝ) (hDm0 : 0 ≤ Dm)
    (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hD : ∀ x, |lapR φ x| ≤ Dm)
    (hS : ∀ x (μ : Fin 3), |φ x - φ (periodicLatticeShift x μ)| ≤ c)
    (hB : ∀ x (μ : Fin 3), |φ x - φ (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ)| ≤ c) :
    ‖lapFull U (mulR φ f) - mulR φ (lapFull U f)‖ ≤ Dm * ‖f‖ + Real.sqrt 12 * c * ‖gradL2 U f‖

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.lap_zero_far_cov.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.lap_zero_far_cov
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.lap_zero_far_cov.header:

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.w3loc_any.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.w3loc_any
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.w3loc_any.header:
theorem w3loc_any {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a Ci : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hCi : 0 ≤ Ci) (hI : LemIFlat ell a Ci)
    (i : ℕ) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (i + 1) ∣ L μ + 1) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L))
    (hRg : BlockClosed (ell ^ (i + 1)) Rg) (V : Cfg L) (e q0 θ : ℝ) (he0 : 0 ≤ e) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hlinks : ∀ b, dv (V b) ≤ e) (h0 : ∀ y ν μ, dv (pw 1 V y ν μ) ≤ q0)
    (hlinkθ : e ≤ θ / (ell : ℝ) ^ (i + 1))
    (hdiff : ∀ (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3),
      frobNorm (((V (x, μ) : SU2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
        - ((V (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ, μ) : SU2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) ≤ θ / ((ell : ℝ) ^ (i + 1)) ^ 2)
    (H : KUSmall ell (rhoM0 ell (i + 1) e q0))
    (hs1 : 432 * kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell (i + 1) e q0) ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (hs2 : kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell (i + 1) e q0) ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (hs3 : kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell (i + 1) e q0) ≤ 1)
    (hs4 : 324 * lamC ell * kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell (i + 1) e q0) ≤ 1)
    (hs5 : 2 * ThetaP ell a (kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell (i + 1) e q0)) ≤ 1 / Kflat a Ci)
    (hs6 : 8 * (272 * (kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell (i + 1) e q0) / (3 * Real.pi)) / (4 * Real.sqrt 2)) ≤ 1 / Kflat a Ci)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 12 * ell + 10 ≤ d) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ) (A : BondFnL2 L)
    (hA : ∀ b : Bond L, (WithLp.ofLp A) b ≠ 0 → b.1 ∈ Ball w s ∨ periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ Ball w s) :
    (1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * KG0 a Ci) - epsNF ell (PkA a) θ d) * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq (patchTower i Rg) ell (i + 1) A
      ≤ locG0 (patchTower i Rg) ell (i + 1) V a (Ball w (s + d * ell ^ i)) A

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.smallA.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.smallA
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.smallA.header:
theorem smallA (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a Ci : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hCi : 0 ≤ Ci) :
    ∃ a₀ : ℝ, 0 < a₀ ∧ a₀ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ ∀ a' : ℝ, 0 ≤ a' → a' ≤ a₀ →
      KUSmall ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ∧
      432 * kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ^ 2 ≤ 1 ∧
      kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ∧
      kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ≤ 1 ∧
      324 * lamC ell * kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ≤ 1 ∧
      2 * ThetaP ell a (kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a'))) ≤ 1 / Kflat a Ci ∧
      8 * (272 * (kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) / (3 * Real.pi)) / (4 * Real.sqrt 2)) ≤ 1 / Kflat a Ci

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.inst_local.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.inst_local
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.inst_local.header:
theorem inst_local {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a Ci : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hCi : 0 ≤ Ci) (hI : LemIFlat ell a Ci)
    (a₀ : ℝ) (ha₀1 : a₀ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hsmall : ∀ a' : ℝ, 0 ≤ a' → a' ≤ a₀ →
      KUSmall ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ∧
      432 * kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ^ 2 ≤ 1 ∧
      kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ∧
      kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ≤ 1 ∧
      324 * lamC ell * kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) ≤ 1 ∧
      2 * ThetaP ell a (kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a'))) ≤ 1 / Kflat a Ci ∧
      8 * (272 * (kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell (2 * a')) / (3 * Real.pi)) / (4 * Real.sqrt 2)) ≤ 1 / Kflat a Ci)
    {M R k κ c : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M)
    (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (hik : i + 1 ≤ k) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hZi : Ball w ((c + 1) * gsp ell M κ j) ⊆ S.Om i)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 12 * ell + 10 ≤ d) (hdM : d + 64 * ell ^ 2 ≤ κ * M)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (α₀ : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α₀) (hαa : (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ a₀) (U : Cfg L)
    (hM1 : AdalyFormal.M1.M1Regular ell M 12 k S α₀ η U) :
    ∃ Up : Cfg L,
      (∀ e : Bond L, pdist w e.1 ≤ c * gsp ell M κ j + d * ell ^ i + 32 * ell ^ (i + 2) → U e = Up e) ∧
      ∀ B : BondFnL2 L, (∀ b : Bond L, (WithLp.ofLp B) b ≠ 0 →
          b.1 ∈ Ball w (c * gsp ell M κ j) ∨ periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ Ball w (c * gsp ell M κ j)) →
        (1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * KG0 a Ci) - epsNF ell (PkA a) (thetaN ell) d)
            * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1))) ell (i + 1) B
          ≤ locG0 (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1))) ell (i + 1) Up a (Ball w (c * gsp ell M κ j + d * ell ^ i)) B

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.g0_caseB_nf.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.g0_caseB_nf
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.g0_caseB_nf.header:
theorem g0_caseB_nf {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j) (hik : i + 1 ≤ k) {w : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hZi : Ball w ((c + 1) * gsp ell M κ j) ⊆ S.Om i)
    (hZ2 : ∀ z ∈ Ball w ((c + 1) * gsp ell M κ j), z ∉ S.Om (i + 2))
    (U Up : Cfg L)
    (hU : ∀ e : Bond L, pdist w e.1 ≤ c * gsp ell M κ j + d * ell ^ i + 32 * ell ^ (i + 2) → U e = Up e)
    (a cW : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hW3 : ∀ B : BondFnL2 L, (∀ b : Bond L, (WithLp.ofLp B) b ≠ 0 →
          b.1 ∈ Ball w (c * gsp ell M κ j) ∨ periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ Ball w (c * gsp ell M κ j)) →
        cW * wnormSq (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1))) ell (i + 1) B
          ≤ locG0 (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1))) ell (i + 1) Up a (Ball w (c * gsp ell M κ j + d * ell ^ i)) B)
    (B : BondFnL2 L)
    (hB : ∀ b : Bond L, (WithLp.ofLp B) b ≠ 0 → b.1 ∈ Ball w (c * gsp ell M κ j) ∨
      periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ Ball w (c * gsp ell M κ j)) :
    cW * wnormSq S ell k B ≤ G0form S ell k U a B

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.patchCoercive_inst.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.patchCoercive_inst
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.patchCoercive_inst.header:
theorem patchCoercive_inst (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a cs : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρ) (ε1 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1) (hη : etaC ell W cs ρ ε1 < 1)
    (cW : ℝ)
    (hinst : ∀ j w, IsPatch ell M k κ S j w → ∀ i, i ≤ j → i + 1 ≤ k →
      Ball w ((c + 1) * gsp ell M κ j) ⊆ S.Om i →
      ∃ Up : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu),
        (∀ e : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu), pdist w e.1 ≤ c * gsp ell M κ j + d * ell ^ i + 32 * ell ^ (i + 2) → U e = Up e) ∧
        ∀ B : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu), (∀ b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu), (WithLp.ofLp B) b ≠ 0 →
            b.1 ∈ Ball w (c * gsp ell M κ j) ∨ periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ Ball w (c * gsp ell M κ j)) →
          cW * wnormSq (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1))) ell (i + 1) B
            ≤ locG0 (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1))) ell (i + 1) Up a (Ball w (c * gsp ell M κ j + d * ell ^ i)) B) :
    PatchCoercive ell M k κ c Lu hell0 S U a Lam ((1 - etaC ell W cs ρ ε1) * min a cW - 2 * nuC ell ρ)

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.patchCoercive_nonf.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.patchCoercive_nonflat
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.patchCoercive_nonf.header:
theorem patchCoercive_nonflat {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ cW : ℝ, 0 < cW ∧ ∃ a₀ : ℝ, 0 < a₀ ∧ ∃ D : ℕ, 12 * ell + 10 ≤ D ∧
    (∀ d, D ≤ d → epsNF ell (PkA a) (thetaN ell) d ≤ cW / 2) ∧
    ∀ {M R k κ c : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell0 : 0 < ell)
      {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (_hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (_hκ : 0 < κ) (_hM : 0 < M) (_hR1 : 1 ≤ R)
      (_hR4 : (c + 4) * κ * ell ≤ R) (_hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) {d : ℕ} (_hdD : D ≤ d)
      (_hdM : d + 64 * ell ^ 2 ≤ κ * M)
      {W : ℕ} (_hW : 1 ≤ W) (_hWR : W ≤ R * M * ell)
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (cs : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (_hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
      (ρ : ℝ) (_hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (_hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρ) (ε1 : ℝ) (_hε1 : 0 < ε1) (_hη : etaC ell W cs ρ ε1 < 1)
      (α₀ : ℝ) (_hα0 : 0 < α₀) (_hαa : (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ a₀)
      (_hM1 : AdalyFormal.M1.M1Regular ell M 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U),
      PatchCoercive ell M k κ c Lu hell0 S U a Lam
        ((1 - etaC ell W cs ρ ε1) * min a (cW - epsNF ell (PkA a) (thetaN ell) d) - 2 * nuC ell ρ)

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.ginv_weighted_coer.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.ginv_weighted_coercive_nonflat
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.ginv_weighted_coer.header:
theorem ginv_weighted_coercive_nonflat {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ cW : ℝ, 0 < cW ∧ ∃ a₀ : ℝ, 0 < a₀ ∧ ∃ D : ℕ, 12 * ell + 10 ≤ D ∧
    (∀ d, D ≤ d → epsNF ell (PkA a) (thetaN ell) d ≤ cW / 2) ∧
    ∀ {M R k κ c : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell0 : 0 < ell)
      {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (hR1 : 1 ≤ R)
      (hR4 : (c + 4) * κ * ell ≤ R) (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) {d : ℕ} (_hdD : D ≤ d)
      (hdM : d + 64 * ell ^ 2 ≤ κ * M)
      {W : ℕ} (hW : 1 ≤ W) (hWR : W ≤ R * M * ell)
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (h216 : 216 * ρ ^ 2 < 1) (h12 : 12 * ρ ≤ 1)
      (hU : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
        frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
      (hT : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j),
        z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3, coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
        frobNorm ((bgTower (geomOf ell k S) U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
          ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
      (hsm : 24 * ((Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2
            + 1 * (Real.sqrt a * (Real.exp (3 * (ell : ℝ) * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2) ≤ csOf a ρ)
      (hsmD : 4 * (Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2 ≤ csOf a ρ)
      (hgs : Real.sqrt (max a 1) * ((1 + 12 * ρ) ^ 2 + (512 * ρ ^ 2 + 4704) / a)
          * (psiHypP hS hW hell hR1 (by omega) hWR U a (csOf a ρ)
              (hatPack_of hS hell U a ha ρ hρ h216 hU hT hsm hsmD)).epsX (Real.sqrt (max a 1)) < (1 - 12 * ρ) ^ 2)
      (ρh : ℝ) (hρh : 0 ≤ ρh) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρh)
      (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hregT : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
      (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsmε : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
      (ε1 ε2 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1) (hε2 : 0 < ε2) (hη : etaC ell W (csOf a ρ) ρh ε1 < 1)
      (α₀ : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α₀) (hαa : (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ a₀)
      (hM1 : AdalyFormal.M1.M1Regular ell M 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U)
      (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).G)),
      cwW4 ell M κ c W a ρ ρh ε1 ε2
          ((1 - etaC ell W (csOf a ρ) ρh ε1) * min a (cW - epsNF ell (PkA a) (thetaN ell) d) - 2 * nuC ell ρh)
          ((psiHypP hS hW hell hR1 (by omega) hWR U a (csOf a ρ)
            (hatPack_of hS hell U a ha ρ hρ h216 hU hT hsm hsmD)).epsX (Real.sqrt (max a 1)))
          (CMc ell M κ c k a ε)
        * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
        ≤ ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫

        frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
      (hT : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j),
        z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3, coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →

            + 1 * (Real.sqrt a * (Real.exp (3 * (ell : ℝ) * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2) ≤ csOf a ρ)
      (hsmD : 4 * (Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2 ≤ csOf a ρ)
      (hgs : Real.sqrt (max a 1) * ((1 + 12 * ρ) ^ 2 + (512 * ρ ^ 2 + 4704) / a)

              (hatPack_of hS hell U a ha ρ hρ h216 hU hT hsm hsmD)).epsX (Real.sqrt (max a 1)) < (1 - 12 * ρ) ^ 2)
      (ρh : ℝ) (hρh : 0 ≤ ρh) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρh)
      (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hregT : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
      (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsmε : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
      (ε1 ε2 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1) (hε2 : 0 < ε2) (hη : etaC ell W (csOf a ρ) ρh ε1 < 1)
      (α₀ : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α₀) (hαa : (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ a₀)
      (hM1 : AdalyFormal.M1.M1Regular ell M 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U)
      (ε2' : ℝ)

          ((psiHypP hS hW hell hR1 (by omega) hWR U a (csOf a ρ)

      (hD2 : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).G),

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.ClassesC.S_bound_c.header:
theorem S_bound_cov (U : Cfg L) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (μ : SiteL2 L) (Pk Kq : ℝ) (hPk : 1 ≤ Pk)
    (hKq : 0 ≤ Kq)
    (hP : ‖μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ Pk * ((ell : ℝ) * B) ^ 2 * ‖gradL2 U μ‖ ^ 2)
    (K : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L))
    (hperp : ∀ x, (∀ z ∈ Cl.cls x, z ∈ K) →
      ∑ z ∈ Cl.cls x, ⟪lapFull U (lapFull U μ) z, μ z⟫ = 0)
    (hkC : 24 ≤ B → ∀ x, (∀ z ∈ Cl.cls x, z ∈ K) →
      ∑ z ∈ Cl.cls x, ‖lapFull U (lapFull U μ) z‖ ^ 2
        ≤ Kq ^ 2 * ((Cl.nn x : ℝ) ^ 4)⁻¹ * ∑ z ∈ Cl.cls x, ‖lapFull U μ z‖ ^ 2)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (R : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R) (hRB : B ≤ R)
    (hg0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) (hglip : LipP g (1 / R)) (hglap : ∀ x, |lapR g x| ≤ 6 / ((R : ℝ) * R))
    (hgK : ∀ x, g x ≠ 0 → ∀ z ∈ Cl.cls x, z ∈ K) :
    ∑ x, g x * ‖lapFull U μ x‖ ^ 2 ≤ CAc ell Pk Kq * ((B : ℝ) / R) * ‖lapFull U μ‖ ^ 2

    (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s ρY : ℕ) (hρY : s + 2 + B + 6 * (ell * B) ≤ ρY)
    (hKY : ∀ x, pdist w x ≤ s + 1 + B → ∀ z ∈ Cl.cls x, z ∈ K) :
    gradOn U (Ball w s) (lapFull U μ)
      ≤ CBc Kq / (B : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ x, (if pdist w x ≤ ρY then ‖lapFull U μ x‖ ^ 2 else 0)

theorem lap_cov_const_dev (U : Cfg L) (ψ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (c : SuTwo) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (a1 a2 lip : ℝ) (hψ0 : 0 ≤ ψ x) (hψ1 : ψ x ≤ 1)
    (hlipF : ∀ μ : Fin 3, |ψ (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - ψ x| ≤ lip)
    (hlipB : ∀ μ : Fin 3, |ψ (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ) - ψ x| ≤ lip)
    (h1 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, frobNorm (((U (x, μ) : SU2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ a1)
    (h1b : ∀ μ : Fin 3, frobNorm (((U (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ, μ) : SU2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ a1)
    (h2 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, frobNorm (((U (x, μ) : SU2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
      - ((U (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ, μ) : SU2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) ≤ a2)
    (ha1 : 0 ≤ a1) (hlip : 0 ≤ lip) :
    ‖(lapFull U (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun z => ψ z • c))) x - lapR ψ x • c‖
      ≤ 3 * (4 * a1 ^ 2 + 2 * a2 + 4 * lip * a1) * ‖c‖

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.bump_cov.header:
theorem bump_cov (U : Cfg L) (h : SiteL2 L) (ℓ : SiteL2 L →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo) (c : SuTwo)
    (hrep : ∀ f : SiteL2 L, (∀ z, z ∉ blockOf y n → f z = 0) → ⟪lapFull U h, f⟫ = ⟪c, ℓ f⟫)
    (hnorm : ∀ f : SiteL2 L, ‖ℓ f‖ ≤ ((n : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ * ∑ z ∈ blockOf y n, ‖f z‖)
    (D : ℝ) (hD : D ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hdrift : ∀ f : SiteL2 L, ‖ℓ f - ((n : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ • ∑ z ∈ blockOf y n, f z‖
      ≤ D * (((n : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ * ∑ z ∈ blockOf y n, ‖f z‖))
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hV1 : ∀ z ∈ blockOf y n, ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((U (z, μ) : SU2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ θ / n ∧
      frobNorm (((U (periodicLatticeShiftBack z μ, μ) : SU2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ θ / n)
    (hV2 : ∀ z ∈ blockOf y n, ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((U (z, μ) : SU2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
        - ((U (periodicLatticeShiftBack z μ, μ) : SU2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) ≤ θ / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) :
    ∑ z ∈ blockOf y n, ‖lapFull U h z‖ ^ 2 ≤ Kq θ ^ 2 * (((n : ℝ) ^ 4)⁻¹ * ∑ z ∈ blockOf y n, ‖h z‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.cc_lam.header:
theorem cc_lam (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    cc ell i Rg x ∈ (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)).Lam (lev ell i Rg x)

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.cc_coarse.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.cc_coarse
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.cc_coarse.header:
theorem cc_coarse (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    cc ell i Rg x ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ lev ell i Rg x)

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.inv_pow_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.inv_pow_eq
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.inv_pow_eq.header:
theorem inv_pow_eq (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ lev ell i Rg x = (((pnn ell i Rg x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.cls_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.cls_eq
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.cls_eq.header:
theorem cls_eq (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (patchClasses hell hRg hdvd).cls x = blockOf (cc ell i Rg x) (ell ^ lev ell i Rg x)

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.rowx.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.rowx
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.rowx.header: noncomputable abbrev rowx (U : Cfg L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : SiteL2 L →L[ℝ] SuTwo

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.row_norm.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.row_norm
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.row_norm.header:
theorem row_norm (U : Cfg L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖rowx (ell := ell) (i := i) (Rg := Rg) U x f‖
      ≤ (((pnn ell i Rg x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ * ∑ z ∈ (patchClasses hell hRg hdvd).cls x, ‖f z‖

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.row_local.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.row_local
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.row_local.header:
theorem row_local (U : Cfg L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (f g : SiteL2 L)
    (hfg : ∀ z ∈ (patchClasses hell hRg hdvd).cls x, f z = g z) :
    rowx (ell := ell) (i := i) (Rg := Rg) U x f = rowx (ell := ell) (i := i) (Rg := Rg) U x g

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.row_drift.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.row_drift
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.row_drift.header:
theorem row_drift (U : Cfg L) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (D : ℝ)
    (hbg : ∀ j, j < i + 1 → ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ j), ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((bgTower (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)) U j (y, μ) : _) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ a j)
    (hD : ∀ j, j ≤ i + 1 → AdalyFormal.BondComposite.dsum ell a j ≤ D)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖rowx (ell := ell) (i := i) (Rg := Rg) U x f
        - (((pnn ell i Rg x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ • ∑ z ∈ (patchClasses hell hRg hdvd).cls x, f z‖
      ≤ D * ((((pnn ell i Rg x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ * ∑ z ∈ (patchClasses hell hRg hdvd).cls x, ‖f z‖)

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.row_hit.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.row_hit
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.row_hit.header:
theorem row_hit (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (j : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hy : y ∈ (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)).Lam j) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hzB : z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j)) (hzC : z ∈ (patchClasses hell hRg hdvd).cls x) :
    j = lev ell i Rg x ∧ y = cc ell i Rg x

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.nk_of_class.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.nk_of_class
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.nk_of_class.header:
theorem nk_of_class (U : Cfg L) (K : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hK : ∀ z ∈ (patchClasses hell hRg hdvd).cls x, z ∈ K) (f : SiteL2 L)
    (hf : ∀ z, z ∉ (patchClasses hell hRg hdvd).cls x → f z = 0)
    (h0 : rowx (ell := ell) (i := i) (Rg := Rg) U x f = 0) :
    f ∈ NK (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)) U K

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.rep_of_perp.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.rep_of_perp
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.rep_of_perp.header:
theorem rep_of_perp (U : Cfg L) (K : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (k : SiteL2 L)
    (hk : ∀ f ∈ NK (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)) U K, ⟪k, f⟫ = 0)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hK : ∀ z ∈ (patchClasses hell hRg hdvd).cls x, z ∈ K) :
    ∃ c : SuTwo, ∀ f : SiteL2 L, (∀ z, z ∉ (patchClasses hell hRg hdvd).cls x → f z = 0) →
      ⟪k, f⟫ = ⟪c, rowx (ell := ell) (i := i) (Rg := Rg) U x f⟫

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.perp_class.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.perp_class
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.perp_class.header:
theorem perp_class (U : Cfg L) (K : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (k : SiteL2 L)
    (hk : ∀ f ∈ NK (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)) U K, ⟪k, f⟫ = 0)
    (μ : SiteL2 L) (hμ : μ ∈ NQp (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)) U)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hK : ∀ z ∈ (patchClasses hell hRg hdvd).cls x, z ∈ K) :
    ∑ z ∈ (patchClasses hell hRg hdvd).cls x, ⟪k z, μ z⟫ = 0

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.epsNF.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.epsNF
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.epsNF.header: noncomputable def epsNF (ell : ℕ) (Pk θ : ℝ) (d : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.CBc_pos.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.CBc_pos
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.CBc_pos.header: theorem CBc_pos {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) : 0 < CBc (Kq θ)

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.CAc_pos.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.CAc_pos
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.CAc_pos.header: theorem CAc_pos {ell : ℕ} (hell : 1 ≤ ell) {Pk θ : ℝ} (hPk : 1 ≤ Pk) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) : 0 < CAc ell Pk (Kq θ)

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.epsNF_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.epsNF_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.epsNF_nonneg.header:
theorem epsNF_nonneg (ell : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) {Pk θ : ℝ} (hPk : 1 ≤ Pk) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (d : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ epsNF ell Pk θ d

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.epsNF_small.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.epsNF_small
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.epsNF_small.header:
theorem epsNF_small (ell : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) {Pk θ : ℝ} (hPk : 1 ≤ Pk) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ D : ℕ, 12 * ell + 10 ≤ D ∧ ∀ d, D ≤ d → epsNF ell Pk θ d ≤ δ

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.harmDecay_nf.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.harmDecay_nf
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.harmDecay_nf.header:
theorem harmDecay_nf {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (i : ℕ) {Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)}
    (hRg : BlockClosed (ell ^ (i + 1)) Rg) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (i + 1) ∣ L μ + 1)
    (U : Cfg L) (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hU1 : ∀ b : Bond L, frobNorm (((U b : SU2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ θ / (ell : ℝ) ^ (i + 1))
    (hU2 : ∀ (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3), frobNorm (((U (x, μ) : SU2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
        - ((U (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ, μ) : SU2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) ≤ θ / ((ell : ℝ) ^ (i + 1)) ^ 2)
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (D : ℝ) (hD12 : D ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hbg : ∀ j, j < i + 1 → ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ j), ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((bgTower (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)) U j (y, μ) : _) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ a j)
    (hdsum : ∀ j, j ≤ i + 1 → AdalyFormal.BondComposite.dsum ell a j ≤ D)
    (Pk : ℝ) (hPk : 1 ≤ Pk)
    (hPoinc : ∀ ν ∈ NQp (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)) U,
      ‖ν‖ ^ 2 ≤ Pk * ((ell : ℝ) * ((ell ^ i : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ 2 * ‖gradL2 U ν‖ ^ 2)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 12 * ell + 10 ≤ d) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ) (h : SiteL2 L)
    (hh : h ∈ HK (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)) U (Ball w (s + d * ell ^ i))) :
    gradOn U (Ball w s) h ≤ epsNF ell Pk θ d * (((ell : ℝ) ^ (i + 1))⁻¹) ^ 2 * ‖h‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.mem_NK_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.mem_NK_gauge
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.mem_NK_gauge.header:
theorem mem_NK_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (K : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    adSL γ f ∈ NK G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) K ↔ f ∈ NK G U K

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.VK_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.VK_gauge
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.VK_gauge.header:
theorem VK_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (K : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) :
    VK G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) K = (VK G U K).map (adSL γ).toLinearIsometry.toLinearMap

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.VKproj_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.VKproj_gauge
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.VKproj_gauge.header:
theorem VKproj_gauge (G : TowerGeom L) (γ : GaugeFn L) (U : Cfg L) (K : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    (VK G (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) K).starProjection (adSL γ f) = adSL γ ((VK G U K).starProjection f)

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.locG0_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.locG0_gauge
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.locG0_gauge.header:
theorem locG0_gauge (S : Tower L) (ell k : ℕ) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (γ : GaugeFn L) (K : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L))
    (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    locG0 S ell k (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) a K (adBL γ A) = locG0 S ell k U a K A

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.supp_adBL.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.supp_adBL
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.supp_adBL.header:
theorem supp_adBL (γ : GaugeFn L) (A : BondFnL2 L) (b : Bond L) :
    (WithLp.ofLp (adBL γ A)) b ≠ 0 ↔ (WithLp.ofLp A) b ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.optDecay_lev.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.optDecay_lev
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.optDecay_lev.header:
theorem optDecay_lev (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg L) (i : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (d : ℕ) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ)
    (hharm : ∀ h ∈ HK (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)) U (Ball w (s + d * ell ^ i)),
      gradOn U (Ball w s) h ≤ ε * (((ell : ℝ) ^ (i + 1))⁻¹) ^ 2 * ‖h‖ ^ 2)
    (A : BondFnL2 L)
    (hA : ∀ b : Bond L, (WithLp.ofLp A) b ≠ 0 → b.1 ∈ Ball w s ∨ periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ Ball w s) :
    defK (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)) U (Ball w (s + d * ell ^ i)) A
      ≤ ε * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq (patchTower i Rg) ell (i + 1) A

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.w3loc_lev.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.w3loc_lev
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.w3loc_lev.header:
theorem w3loc_lev (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg L) (i : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (a cW ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (d : ℕ) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ)
    (hharm : ∀ h ∈ HK (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)) U (Ball w (s + d * ell ^ i)),
      gradOn U (Ball w s) h ≤ ε * (((ell : ℝ) ^ (i + 1))⁻¹) ^ 2 * ‖h‖ ^ 2)
    (A : BondFnL2 L)
    (hA : ∀ b : Bond L, (WithLp.ofLp A) b ≠ 0 → b.1 ∈ Ball w s ∨ periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ Ball w s)
    (hG0 : cW * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq (patchTower i Rg) ell (i + 1) A ≤ G0form (patchTower i Rg) ell (i + 1) U a A) :
    (cW - ε) * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq (patchTower i Rg) ell (i + 1) A
      ≤ locG0 (patchTower i Rg) ell (i + 1) U a (Ball w (s + d * ell ^ i)) A

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.dv_eq_frob.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.dv_eq_frob
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.dv_eq_frob.header: theorem dv_eq_frob (g : SU2) : dv g = frobNorm (((g : SU2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.decay_chart.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.decay_chart
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.decay_chart.header:
theorem decay_chart (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (d : ℕ) (hd : 12 * ell + 10 ≤ d) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu))
    (s : ℕ) (h : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu))
    (hh : h ∈ HK (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) V (Ball w (s + d * ell ^ j))) :
    gradOn V (Ball w s) h ≤ epsNF ell (PkA a) θ d * (((ell : ℝ) ^ (j + 1))⁻¹) ^ 2 * ‖h‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.w3loc_chart.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.w3loc_chart
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.w3loc_chart.header:
theorem w3loc_chart {a Ci : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hCi : 0 ≤ Ci) (hI : LemIFlat ell a Ci)
    (hs3 : kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell (j + 1) e q0) ≤ 1)
    (hs4 : 324 * lamC ell * kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell (j + 1) e q0) ≤ 1)
    (hs5 : 2 * ThetaP ell a (kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell (j + 1) e q0)) ≤ 1 / Kflat a Ci)
    (hs6 : 8 * (272 * (kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell (j + 1) e q0) / (3 * Real.pi)) / (4 * Real.sqrt 2)) ≤ 1 / Kflat a Ci)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 12 * ell + 10 ≤ d) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)) (s : ℕ)
    (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu))
    (hA : ∀ b : Bond (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu), (WithLp.ofLp A) b ≠ 0 →
      b.1 ∈ Ball w s ∨ periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ Ball w s) :
    (1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * KG0 a Ci) - epsNF ell (PkA a) θ d) * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq (patchTower j Rg) ell (j + 1) A
      ≤ locG0 (patchTower j Rg) ell (j + 1) V a (Ball w (s + d * ell ^ j)) A

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Achi.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Achi
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Achi.header: noncomputable def Achi (A : Bond L → M2) (χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (e : Bond L) : M2

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Vchi.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Vchi
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Vchi.header: noncomputable def Vchi (η : ℝ) (A : Bond L → M2) (χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) : Cfg L

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Upc.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Upc
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Upc.header:
noncomputable def Upc (η : ℝ) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (A : Bond L → M2) (χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    Cfg L

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.gauge_Upc.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.gauge_Upc
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.gauge_Upc.header:
theorem gauge_Upc (η : ℝ) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (A : Bond L → M2) (χ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    periodicGaugeTransform g (Upc η g A χ) = Vchi η A χ

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.HTm_smul.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.HTm_smul
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.HTm_smul.header: theorem HTm_smul (r : ℝ) {X : M2} (h : HTm X) : HTm (r • X)

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.frobNorm_rsmul.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.frobNorm_rsmul
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.frobNorm_rsmul.header: theorem frobNorm_rsmul (r : ℝ) (X : M2) : frobNorm (r • X) = |r| * frobNorm X

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Vchi_coe.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Vchi_coe
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Vchi_coe.header:
theorem Vchi_coe (e : Bond L) :
    ((Vchi η A χ e : SU2) : M2) = NormedSpace.exp (((η : ℂ) * Complex.I) • Achi A χ e)

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Upc_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Upc_eq
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Upc_eq.header: theorem Upc_eq (e : Bond L) (h1 : χ e.1 = 1) : Upc η g A χ e = U e

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.chart_Upc.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.chart_Upc
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.chart_Upc.header: noncomputable def chart_Upc : CubeChart (Upc η g A χ) (fun _ => True) η c1 (c2 + lip * c1 / η)

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.frob_sub_eq_dv.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.frob_sub_eq_dv
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.frob_sub_eq_dv.header:
theorem frob_sub_eq_dv (V1 V2 : SU2) :
    frobNorm ((V1 : M2) - (V2 : M2)) = dv (V1 * V2⁻¹)

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Vchi_link.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Vchi_link
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Vchi_link.header: theorem Vchi_link (e : Bond L) : dv (Vchi η A χ e) ≤ η * c1

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Vchi_plaq.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Vchi_plaq
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Vchi_plaq.header:
theorem Vchi_plaq (hsmall : η * c1 ≤ 1) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3) :
    dv (pw 1 (Vchi η A χ) y ν μ) ≤ 2 * (η ^ 2 * (c2 + lip * c1 / η)) + (4 * Real.pi + 2) * (η * c1) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Vchi_diff.name: AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Vchi_diff
AdalyFormal.M1NonFlat.Vchi_diff.header:
theorem Vchi_diff (hsmall : η * c1 ≤ 1) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    frobNorm (((Vchi η A χ (x, μ) : SU2) : M2) - ((Vchi η A χ (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ, μ) : SU2) : M2))
      ≤ η ^ 2 * (c2 + lip * c1 / η) + 2 * Real.pi * (η * c1) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.NonVac.slab3.name: AdalyFormal.NonVac.slab3
AdalyFormal.NonVac.slab3.header: def slab3 (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (P0 Q0 P1 Q1 P2 Q2 : ℕ) : Tower L

AdalyFormal.NonVac.om0_mem.name: AdalyFormal.NonVac.om0_mem
AdalyFormal.NonVac.om0_mem.header:
theorem om0_mem (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    x ∈ (slab3 L P0 Q0 P1 Q1 P2 Q2).Om 0 ↔ P0 ≤ (x 0).val ∧ (x 0).val < Q0

AdalyFormal.NonVac.om1_mem.name: AdalyFormal.NonVac.om1_mem
AdalyFormal.NonVac.om1_mem.header:
theorem om1_mem (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    x ∈ (slab3 L P0 Q0 P1 Q1 P2 Q2).Om 1 ↔ P1 ≤ (x 0).val ∧ (x 0).val < Q1

AdalyFormal.NonVac.om2_mem.name: AdalyFormal.NonVac.om2_mem
AdalyFormal.NonVac.om2_mem.header:
theorem om2_mem (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    x ∈ (slab3 L P0 Q0 P1 Q1 P2 Q2).Om 2 ↔ P2 ≤ (x 0).val ∧ (x 0).val < Q2

AdalyFormal.NonVac.om3_mem.name: AdalyFormal.NonVac.om3_mem
AdalyFormal.NonVac.om3_mem.header:
theorem om3_mem (j : ℕ) (hj : 3 ≤ j) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    x ∉ (slab3 L P0 Q0 P1 Q1 P2 Q2).Om j

AdalyFormal.NonVac.SlabGeo.name: AdalyFormal.NonVac.SlabGeo
AdalyFormal.NonVac.SlabGeo.header: structure SlabGeo (M ell R N P0 Q0 P1 Q1 P2 Q2 : ℕ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.NonVac.pcd_gt_left.name: AdalyFormal.NonVac.pcd_gt_left
AdalyFormal.NonVac.pcd_gt_left.header: theorem pcd_gt_left {N a b D : ℕ} (hab : a + D < b) (hb : b + D < N) : D < pcd N a b

AdalyFormal.NonVac.pcd_gt_right.name: AdalyFormal.NonVac.pcd_gt_right
AdalyFormal.NonVac.pcd_gt_right.header: theorem pcd_gt_right {N a b D : ℕ} (ha : a < N) (hba : b + D < a) (hD : D ≤ b) : D < pcd N a b

AdalyFormal.NonVac.pcd_self'.name: AdalyFormal.NonVac.pcd_self'

theorem cube_of_region {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {N : ℕ} (hN : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = N) {ell M : ℕ} {S : Tower L}
    (hnest : ∀ j, S.Om (j + 1) ⊆ S.Om j) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) {lo hi : ℕ}
    (hs : 0 < bigSide M ell j) (hlo : bigSide M ell j ∣ lo) (hhi : bigSide M ell j ∣ hi)
    (hwid : lo + 12 * bigSide M ell j ≤ hi) (hhiN : hi ≤ N)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (w : ℕ) (hvlo : lo ≤ (x 0).val) (hvw : (x 0).val ≤ w) (hw1 : w ≤ (x 0).val + 1)
    (hwhi : w < hi) (hx1 : (x 0).val + 1 < N)
    (hreg : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, lo ≤ (y 0).val → (y 0).val < hi →
      y ∈ towerBj S j ∪ towerBj S (j + 1))
    (hwit : ∃ t : ℕ, (t = (x 0).val ∨ t = (x 0).val + 1) ∧ t ≤ w ∧
      ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (y 0).val = t → y ∈ towerBj S j) :

      ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, Adj N x y → (y 0).val ≤ w → y ∈ sites

AdalyFormal.NonVac.nonvac_core.name: AdalyFormal.NonVac.nonvac_core
AdalyFormal.NonVac.nonvac_core.header:
theorem nonvac_core {ell M R : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 18 ≤ R)
    {a₀ : ℝ} (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
      2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell M Lu ∧ Admissible ell M R k S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell M R k S Lam ∧
      0 < α₀ ∧ ((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (M : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀ ∧
      ClassCoupled ell M 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
      (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 2) ∧
      (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
      (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
      (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
      Lam.Nonempty ∧ (LamPrime ell Lam).Nonempty ∧
      OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.NonVac.headline_regime_nonva.header:
theorem headline_regime_nonvacuous {ell m R : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hR : 18 ≤ R)
    {a₀ : ℝ} (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
      2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧ Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R k S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) R k S Lam ∧
      0 < α₀ ∧ ((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀ ∧
      ClassCoupled ell (ell ^ m) 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
      (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 2) ∧
      (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
      (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
      (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
      Lam.Nonempty ∧ (LamPrime ell Lam).Nonempty ∧
      OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.NonVac.headline_instance_ine.name: AdalyFormal.NonVac.headline_instance_inequality
AdalyFormal.NonVac.headline_instance_ine.header:
theorem headline_instance_inequality (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ m₀ : ℕ, 1 ≤ m₀ ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, m₀ ≤ m → ∃ R₀ : ℕ, ∀ R : ℕ, R₀ ≤ R →
      ∃ (a₀ γ₀ : ℝ), 0 < a₀ ∧ 0 < γ₀ ∧
      ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
        (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
        2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧ Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R k S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) R k S Lam ∧
        0 < α₀ ∧ ((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀ ∧
        ClassCoupled ell (ell ^ m) 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
        (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 2) ∧ (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
        (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
        (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
        Lam.Nonempty ∧ (LamPrime ell Lam).Nonempty ∧
        OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧
        γ₀ * bondEnergy Bt ≤
          GenP.genForm (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam)
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) Bt))

AdalyFormal.NonVacC.nonvac_core.name: AdalyFormal.NonVacC.nonvac_core
AdalyFormal.NonVacC.nonvac_core.header:
theorem nonvac_core {ell M R T c : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hRT : R ≤ T)
    (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hcT : c ≤ 2 * T + 1) (hcT' : c ≤ T) (hc10 : 10 ≤ c)
    {a₀ : ℝ} (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
      2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell M Lu ∧ Admissible ell M R k S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell M R k S Lam ∧
      0 < α₀ ∧ ((c : ℕ) : ℝ) * (M : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀ ∧
      ClassCoupled ell M c k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
      (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 2) ∧
      (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
      (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
      (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
      Lam.Nonempty ∧ (LamPrime ell Lam).Nonempty ∧
      OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ μ : Fin 3, 6 * (c * bigSide M ell j) ≤ scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1) ∧
      (∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ), IsClassCube ell M c k S sites j → ∃ x, x ∉ sites)

AdalyFormal.NonVacC.headline_regime_nonv.header:
theorem headline_regime_nonvacuousC {ell m R c : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hc : 10 ≤ c) (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    {a₀ : ℝ} (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
      2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧ Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R k S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) R k S Lam ∧
      0 < α₀ ∧ ((c : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀ ∧
      ClassCoupled ell (ell ^ m) c k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
      (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 2) ∧
      (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
      (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
      (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
      Lam.Nonempty ∧ (LamPrime ell Lam).Nonempty ∧
      OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ μ : Fin 3, 6 * (c * bigSide (ell ^ m) ell j) ≤ scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1) ∧
      (∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ), IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) c k S sites j → ∃ x, x ∉ sites)

AdalyFormal.NonVacC.headline_instance_in.name: AdalyFormal.NonVacC.headline_instance_inequalityC
AdalyFormal.NonVacC.headline_instance_in.header:
theorem headline_instance_inequalityC (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (c : ℕ) (hc : 10 ≤ c) :
    ∃ m₁ : ℕ, 1 ≤ m₁ ∧ ∃ R₁ : ℕ, ∃ (a₀ γ₀ : ℝ), 0 < a₀ ∧ 0 < γ₀ ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, m₁ ≤ m → ∀ R : ℕ, max R₁ 1 ≤ R →
      ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
        (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
        2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧ Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R k S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) R k S Lam ∧
        0 < α₀ ∧ ((c : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀ ∧
        ClassCoupled ell (ell ^ m) c k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
        (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 2) ∧ (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
        (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
        (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
        Lam.Nonempty ∧ (LamPrime ell Lam).Nonempty ∧
        OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ μ : Fin 3, 6 * (c * bigSide (ell ^ m) ell j) ≤ scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1) ∧
        (∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ),
          IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) c k S sites j → ∃ x, x ∉ sites) ∧
        GenP.WellDefG (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) ∧
        γ₀ * bondEnergy Bt ≤
          GenP.genForm (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam)
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) Bt))

theorem witness_not_both_coverage (c : ℕ) (hc : 10 ≤ c) (ell : ℕ) (hell3 : 3 ≤ ell) (hE : AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.StagOK ell)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (a₀ γ : ℝ) (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (hγ : 0 < γ) (m₁ R₁ : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, m₁ ≤ m ∧ ∃ R : ℕ, R₁ ≤ R ∧ ∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ ∃ Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent, ∃ α₀ : ℝ, 0 < α₀ ∧
      (c : ℝ) * ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀ ∧ TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧
      ∃ S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu), Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R k S ∧
      ∃ Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu), LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) R k S Lam ∧
      ∃ U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu),
        PerCubeRegularF ell (ell ^ m) (constFam c (scaleUp ell k Lu)) k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
        GenP.WellDefG (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) ∧
        ¬ (CovSitesF ell (ell ^ m) (constFam c (scaleUp ell k Lu)) k S ∧ CovPlaqF ell (ell ^ m) (constFam c (scaleUp ell k Lu)) k S) ∧
        ∃ Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo, OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧
          GenP.genForm (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam)
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) Bt)) < γ * bondEnergy Bt

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fld.header: noncomputable def fld (A0 A1 : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ

theorem fld_add (A0 A1 B0 B1 : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fld_smul.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fld_smul
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.fld_smul.header:
theorem fld_smul (r : ℝ) (A0 A1 : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    r • (fld A0 A1 : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) = fld (fun a b c => r * A0 a b c) (fun a b c => r * A1 a b c)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_fld_rep0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_fld_rep0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_fld_rep0.header:
theorem pathAngG_fld_rep0 (s : ℕ) (A0 A1 : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, pathAngG s (fld A0 A1) y (List.replicate n 0) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, A0 (((y 0).val + s * j) % (L 0 + 1)) (y 1).val (y 2).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_fld_rep1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_fld_rep1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_fld_rep1.header:
theorem pathAngG_fld_rep1 (s : ℕ) (A0 A1 : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, pathAngG s (fld A0 A1) y (List.replicate n 1) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, A1 (y 0).val (((y 1).val + s * j) % (L 1 + 1)) (y 2).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_fld_rep2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_fld_rep2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_fld_rep2.header:
theorem pathAngG_fld_rep2 (s : ℕ) (A0 A1 : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, pathAngG s (fld A0 A1) y (List.replicate n 2) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_fld_gamm.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_fld_gamma
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathAngG_fld_gamm.header:
theorem pathAngG_fld_gamma (s : ℕ) (A0 A1 : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (w y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pathAngG s (fld A0 A1) w (coarseGammaPath s y x) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s),
        A1 (w 0).val (((w 1).val + s * j) % (L 1 + 1)) (((w 2).val + s * (((x 2 - y 2).val) / s)) % (L 2 + 1)) +
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (((x 0 - (Function.update (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1 (x 1)) 0).val) / s),
        A0 (((w 0).val + s * i) % (L 0 + 1)) (((w 1).val + s * (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s)) % (L 1 + 1))
          (((w 2).val + s * (((x 2 - y 2).val) / s)) % (L 2 + 1))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_fin_window_ab.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_fin_window_abs
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_fin_window_ab.header:
theorem sum_fin_window_abs (N y ell : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ a : Fin N, (if y ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < y + ell then g (a.val - y) else 0) = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (min ell (N - y)), g n

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_block_gen.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_block_gen
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_block_gen.header:
theorem sum_block_gen (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) (g0 g1 g2 : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf z 1 ell, g0 ((x 0).val - (z 0).val) * g1 ((x 1).val - (z 1).val) * g2 ((x 2).val - (z 2).val) =
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (min ell (L 0 + 1 - (z 0).val)), g0 n) * (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (min ell (L 1 + 1 - (z 1).val)), g1 n) *
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (min ell (L 2 + 1 - (z 2).val)), g2 n

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_altN.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_altN
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_altN.header: theorem sum_altN (m : ℕ) : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, (2 * altN n - 1) = -((m % 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_pmN.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_pmN
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_pmN.header: theorem sum_pmN (m : ℕ) : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, pmN n = ((m % 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAng_stag_dir.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAng_stag_dir0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAng_stag_dir.header:
theorem blockAng_stag_dir0 (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ * ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf z 1 ell, stagPhi c t 0 ell z x = Dfun c ell (L 0 + 1) (z 0).val * Ubg ell t z

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAng_stag_dir.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAng_stag_dir1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAng_stag_dir.header:
theorem blockAng_stag_dir1 (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hO : ell % 2 = 1) (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ * ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf z 1 ell, stagPhiO c t 1 ell z x + pathAng c t 1 z (List.replicate ell 1) =
      t * sgnNat (z 1).val * ((if (z 0).val = c then 1 else 0) +
        ((((min ell (L 2 + 1 - (z 2).val)) * ((min ell (L 1 + 1 - (z 1).val)) % 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) *
          ((if (z 0).val ≤ c ∧ c < (z 0).val + min ell (L 0 + 1 - (z 0).val) then 1 else 0)
            - ((min ell (L 0 + 1 - (z 0).val) : ℕ) : ℝ) * (if (z 0).val = c then 1 else 0)))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dfun_ne_zero_le.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dfun_ne_zero_le
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.dfun_ne_zero_le.header:
theorem dfun_ne_zero_le {c ell N0 z0 : ℕ} (hc1 : ell ≤ c) (hc2 : c + ell ≤ N0) (hz : z0 < N0)
    (hD : Dfun c ell N0 z0 ≠ 0) : z0 ≤ c

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAng_stag_odd.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAng_stag_odd
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.blockAng_stag_odd.header:
theorem blockAng_stag_odd (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hO : ell % 2 = 1) (c : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (hc1 : ell ≤ c) (hc2 : c + ell ≤ L 0 + 1)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    blockAngG 1 ell (stagφ c t) z μ = phi1o L c ell t (z, μ)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sgn_shift.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sgn_shift
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sgn_shift.header: theorem sgn_shift (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ∣ N) (s b j : ℕ) (hs : s % 2 = 1) : sgnNat ((b + s * j) % N) = sgnNat b * pmN j

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shapeFld.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shapeFld
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shapeFld.header: noncomputable def shapeFld (t : ℝ) (D T Ef : ℕ → ℝ) (a p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.seg0_shape.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.seg0_shape
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.seg0_shape.header:
theorem seg0_shape (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) (s ell : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (D T Ef : ℕ → ℝ) (a p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pathAngG s (shapeFld t D T Ef a p) z (List.replicate ell 0) =
      t * sgnNat (z 1).val * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, D (((z 0).val + s * j) % (L 0 + 1))) * a (z 1).val (z 2).val)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.seg1_shape.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.seg1_shape
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.seg1_shape.header:
theorem seg1_shape (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) (s ell : ℕ) (hs : s % 2 = 1) (t : ℝ) (D T Ef : ℕ → ℝ) (a p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pathAngG s (shapeFld t D T Ef a p) z (List.replicate ell 1) =
      t * sgnNat (z 1).val * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, pmN j * (T (z 0).val + Ef (z 0).val * p (((z 1).val + s * j) % (L 1 + 1)) (z 2).val))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.seg2_shape.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.seg2_shape
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.seg2_shape.header:
theorem seg2_shape (s ell : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (D T Ef : ℕ → ℝ) (a p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pathAngG s (shapeFld t D T Ef a p) z (List.replicate ell 2) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.gamma_shape.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.gamma_shape
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.gamma_shape.header:
theorem gamma_shape (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) (s : ℕ) (hs : s % 2 = 1) (t : ℝ) (D T Ef : ℕ → ℝ) (a p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (w y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pathAngG s (shapeFld t D T Ef a p) w (coarseGammaPath s y x) =
      t * sgnNat (w 1).val *
        ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s),
            pmN j * (T (w 0).val + Ef (w 0).val * p (((w 1).val + s * j) % (L 1 + 1)) (((w 2).val + s * (((x 2 - y 2).val) / s)) % (L 2 + 1)))) +
         pmN (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s) *
          ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (((x 0 - (Function.update (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1 (x 1)) 0).val) / s),
              D (((w 0).val + s * i) % (L 0 + 1))) *
            a (((w 1).val + s * (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s)) % (L 1 + 1))
              (((w 2).val + s * (((x 2 - y 2).val) / s)) % (L 2 + 1))))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cPlusS_val.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cPlusS_val
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cPlusS_val.header:
theorem cPlusS_val (s ell : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) :

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_shape_dir2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_shape_dir2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_shape_dir2.header:
theorem loop_shape_dir2 (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) (s ell : ℕ) (hs : s % 2 = 1) (t : ℝ) (D T Ef : ℕ → ℝ) (a p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    loopAngG s ell (shapeFld t D T Ef a p) y 2 x =
      t * sgnNat (y 1).val *
        ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s),
            pmN j * (T (y 0).val + Ef (y 0).val * p (((y 1).val + s * j) % (L 1 + 1)) (((y 2).val + s * (((x 2 - y 2).val) / s)) % (L 2 + 1)))) +
         pmN (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s) *
          ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (((x 0 - (Function.update (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1 (x 1)) 0).val) / s),
              D (((y 0).val + s * i) % (L 0 + 1))) *
            a (((y 1).val + s * (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s)) % (L 1 + 1))
              (((y 2).val + s * (((x 2 - y 2).val) / s)) % (L 2 + 1)))) -
      t * sgnNat (y 1).val *
        ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s),
            pmN j * (T (y 0).val + Ef (y 0).val * p (((y 1).val + s * j) % (L 1 + 1))
              ((((y 2).val + s * ell) % (L 2 + 1) + s * (((x 2 - y 2).val) / s)) % (L 2 + 1)))) +
         pmN (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s) *
          ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (((x 0 - (Function.update (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1 (x 1)) 0).val) / s),
              D (((y 0).val + s * i) % (L 0 + 1))) *
            a (((y 1).val + s * (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s)) % (L 1 + 1))
              ((((y 2).val + s * ell) % (L 2 + 1) + s * (((x 2 - y 2).val) / s)) % (L 2 + 1))))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_shape_dir0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_shape_dir0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_shape_dir0.header:
theorem loop_shape_dir0 (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) (s ell : ℕ) (hs : s % 2 = 1) (t : ℝ) (D T Ef : ℕ → ℝ) (a p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    loopAngG s ell (shapeFld t D T Ef a p) y 0 x =
      t * sgnNat (y 1).val *
        ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s),
            pmN j * (T (y 0).val + Ef (y 0).val * p (((y 1).val + s * j) % (L 1 + 1)) (((y 2).val + s * (((x 2 - y 2).val) / s)) % (L 2 + 1)))) +
         pmN (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s) *
          ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (((x 0 - (Function.update (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1 (x 1)) 0).val) / s),
              D (((y 0).val + s * i) % (L 0 + 1))) *
            a (((y 1).val + s * (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s)) % (L 1 + 1))
              (((y 2).val + s * (((x 2 - y 2).val) / s)) % (L 2 + 1)))) +
      t * sgnNat (x 1).val * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, D (((x 0).val + s * j) % (L 0 + 1))) * a (x 1).val (x 2).val) -
      t * sgnNat (y 1).val *
        ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s),
            pmN j * (T (((y 0).val + s * ell) % (L 0 + 1)) + Ef (((y 0).val + s * ell) % (L 0 + 1)) *
              p (((y 1).val + s * j) % (L 1 + 1)) (((y 2).val + s * (((x 2 - y 2).val) / s)) % (L 2 + 1)))) +
         pmN (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s) *
          ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (((x 0 - (Function.update (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1 (x 1)) 0).val) / s),
              D (((((y 0).val + s * ell) % (L 0 + 1)) + s * i) % (L 0 + 1))) *
            a (((y 1).val + s * (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s)) % (L 1 + 1))
              (((y 2).val + s * (((x 2 - y 2).val) / s)) % (L 2 + 1)))) -
      t * sgnNat (y 1).val * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, D (((y 0).val + s * j) % (L 0 + 1))) * a (y 1).val (y 2).val)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_shape_dir1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_shape_dir1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_shape_dir1.header:
theorem loop_shape_dir1 (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) (s ell : ℕ) (hs : s % 2 = 1) (t : ℝ) (D T Ef : ℕ → ℝ) (a p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    loopAngG s ell (shapeFld t D T Ef a p) y 1 x =
      t * sgnNat (y 1).val *
        ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s),

         pmN (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s) *
          ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (((x 0 - (Function.update (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1 (x 1)) 0).val) / s),
              D (((y 0).val + s * i) % (L 0 + 1))) *
            a (((y 1).val + s * (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s)) % (L 1 + 1))
              (((y 2).val + s * (((x 2 - y 2).val) / s)) % (L 2 + 1)))) +
      t * sgnNat (x 1).val * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, pmN j * (T (x 0).val + Ef (x 0).val * p (((x 1).val + s * j) % (L 1 + 1)) (x 2).val)) -
      t * sgnNat (((y 1).val + s * ell) % (L 1 + 1)) *
        ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s),
            pmN j * (T (y 0).val + Ef (y 0).val * p ((((y 1).val + s * ell) % (L 1 + 1) + s * j) % (L 1 + 1))
              (((y 2).val + s * (((x 2 - y 2).val) / s)) % (L 2 + 1)))) +
         pmN (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s) *
          ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (((x 0 - (Function.update (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1 (x 1)) 0).val) / s),
              D (((y 0).val + s * i) % (L 0 + 1))) *
            a ((((y 1).val + s * ell) % (L 1 + 1) + s * (((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s)) % (L 1 + 1))
              (((y 2).val + s * (((x 2 - y 2).val) / s)) % (L 2 + 1)))) -
      t * sgnNat (y 1).val * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, pmN j * (T (y 0).val + Ef (y 0).val * p (((y 1).val + s * j) % (L 1 + 1)) (y 2).val))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.alt_sum_one_dev.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.alt_sum_one_dev
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.alt_sum_one_dev.header:
theorem alt_sum_one_dev (n : ℕ) (m : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ m j) (h1 : ∀ j, m j ≤ 1)
    (hone : ∀ j j', j < n → j' < n → m j < 1 → m j' < 1 → j = j') :
    |∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, pmN j * m j| ≤ 2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.seam_once.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.seam_once
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.seam_once.header:
theorem seam_once (N ell b : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (hN : ell * ell + ell < N) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ ell) (j j' : ℕ)
    (hj : j < n) (hj' : j' < n) (h1 : N - ell < (b + ell * j) % N) (h2 : N - ell < (b + ell * j') % N) : j = j'

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.phi1o_eq_shape.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.phi1o_eq_shape
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.phi1o_eq_shape.header:
theorem phi1o_eq_shape (c ell : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    (phi1o L c ell t : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) =
      shapeFld t (fun v => Dfun c ell (L 0 + 1) v) (fun v => if v = c then 1 else 0) (Efun c ell) (aAmp L ell) (pAmp L ell)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Dsum_tel.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Dsum_tel
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Dsum_tel.header:
theorem Dsum_tel (c ell N0 : ℕ) (v n : ℕ) (hN0 : 0 < N0) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Dfun c ell N0 ((v + ell * i) % N0) =
      (if v % N0 = c then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if (v + ell * n) % N0 = c then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mAmp.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mAmp
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mAmp.header: noncomputable def mAmp (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell v : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uAmp.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uAmp
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uAmp.header: noncomputable def uAmp (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell z2 : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pAmp_eq.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pAmp_eq
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pAmp_eq.header: theorem pAmp_eq (ell z1 z2 : ℕ) : pAmp L ell z1 z2 = uAmp L ell z2 * mAmp L ell z1

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mAmp_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mAmp_nonneg
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mAmp_nonneg.header: theorem mAmp_nonneg (ell v : ℕ) : 0 ≤ mAmp L ell v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mAmp_le_one.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mAmp_le_one
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mAmp_le_one.header: theorem mAmp_le_one (ell v : ℕ) : mAmp L ell v ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mAmp_eq_one.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mAmp_eq_one
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mAmp_eq_one.header: theorem mAmp_eq_one {ell v : ℕ} (hO : ell % 2 = 1) (hv : v + ell ≤ L 1 + 1) : mAmp L ell v = 1

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uAmp_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uAmp_nonneg
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uAmp_nonneg.header: theorem uAmp_nonneg (ell z2 : ℕ) : 0 ≤ uAmp L ell z2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uAmp_le.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uAmp_le
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.uAmp_le.header: theorem uAmp_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (z2 : ℕ) : uAmp L ell z2 ≤ 1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.aAmp_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.aAmp_nonneg
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.aAmp_nonneg.header: theorem aAmp_nonneg (ell z1 z2 : ℕ) : 0 ≤ aAmp L ell z1 z2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.aAmp_le.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.aAmp_le
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.aAmp_le.header: theorem aAmp_le {ell : ℕ} (hO : ell % 2 = 1) (hell : 0 < ell) (z1 z2 : ℕ) : aAmp L ell z1 z2 ≤ ((ell : ℝ) - 1) / (2 * ell)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Efun_abs_le.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Efun_abs_le
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Efun_abs_le.header: theorem Efun_abs_le {c ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (v : ℕ) : |Efun c ell v| ≤ (ell : ℝ) - 1

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Efun_ne_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Efun_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Efun_ne_zero.header: theorem Efun_ne_zero {c ell v : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (h : Efun c ell v ≠ 0) : v ≤ c ∧ c < v + ell

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.altP_bound.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.altP_bound
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.altP_bound.header:
theorem altP_bound {ell : ℕ} (hO : ell % 2 = 1) (hell : 0 < ell) (hN : ell * ell + ell < L 1 + 1) (b n z2 : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ ell) :
    |∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, pmN j * pAmp L ell ((b + ell * j) % (L 1 + 1)) z2| ≤ 2 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop1_real.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop1_real
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop1_real.header:
theorem loop1_real (T0 Tx Dsum E0 Ex e1 e2 e3 e4 a1 a2 pm1 n1odd A Em ε : ℝ)
    (hT0 : T0 = 0 ∨ T0 = 1) (hTx : Tx = 0 ∨ Tx = 1) (hD : Dsum = T0 - Tx)
    (hpm : (pm1 = 1 ∧ n1odd = 0) ∨ (pm1 = -1 ∧ n1odd = 1))
    (ha1 : 0 ≤ a1) (ha1' : a1 ≤ A) (ha2 : 0 ≤ a2) (ha2' : a2 ≤ A) (hA : 2 * A ≤ 1)
    (hE0 : |E0| ≤ Em) (hEx : |Ex| ≤ Em) (he1 : |e1| ≤ ε) (he2 : |e2| ≤ ε) (he3 : |e3| ≤ ε) (he4 : |e4| ≤ ε)
    (hz1 : T0 = 1 → Tx = 0 → Ex = 0) (hz2 : T0 = 0 → Tx = 1 → E0 = 0)
    (hEm : 0 ≤ Em) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hEε : Em * ε ≤ 1) :
    |(2 * n1odd * T0 + pm1 * Tx - T0 + pm1 * Dsum * (a1 + a2)) + (E0 * (e1 + e2 - e4) + pm1 * Ex * e3)| ≤ 1 + 3 * Em * ε

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop0_real.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop0_real
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop0_real.header:
theorem loop0_real (X Ed e1 a1 ay pm1 n1odd A Em ε : ℝ)
    (hX : X = -1 ∨ X = 0 ∨ X = 1) (hpm : (pm1 = 1 ∧ n1odd = 0) ∨ (pm1 = -1 ∧ n1odd = 1))
    (ha1 : 0 ≤ a1) (ha1' : a1 ≤ A) (hay : 0 ≤ ay) (hay' : ay ≤ A) (hA : 2 * A ≤ 1)
    (hEd : |Ed| ≤ Em) (he1 : |e1| ≤ ε) (hEm : 0 ≤ Em) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    |n1odd * X + Ed * e1 + X * (pm1 * a1 - ay)| ≤ 1 + 3 * Em * ε

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop2_real.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop2_real
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop2_real.header:
theorem loop2_real (Dsum E0 e1 e2 a1 a2 pm1 A Em ε : ℝ)
    (hD : Dsum = -1 ∨ Dsum = 0 ∨ Dsum = 1) (hpm : pm1 = 1 ∨ pm1 = -1)
    (ha1 : 0 ≤ a1) (ha1' : a1 ≤ A) (ha2 : 0 ≤ a2) (ha2' : a2 ≤ A) (hA : 2 * A ≤ 1)
    (hE0 : |E0| ≤ Em) (he1 : |e1| ≤ ε) (he2 : |e2| ≤ ε) (hEm : 0 ≤ Em) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    |E0 * (e1 - e2) + pm1 * Dsum * (a1 - a2)| ≤ 1 + 3 * Em * ε

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.block_facts.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.block_facts
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.block_facts.header:
theorem block_facts {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) :
    ∃ n0 n1 n2 : ℕ, n0 < ell ∧ n1 < ell ∧ n2 < ell ∧ (x 0).val = (y 0).val + s * n0 ∧ (x 1).val = (y 1).val + s * n1 ∧
      (x 2).val = (y 2).val + s * n2 ∧ ((x 1 - (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1).val) / s = n1 ∧
      ((x 0 - (Function.update (Function.update y 2 (x 2)) 1 (x 1)) 0).val) / s = n0 ∧ ((x 2 - y 2).val) / s = n2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_pm_TE.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_pm_TE
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_pm_TE.header:
theorem sum_pm_TE (n : ℕ) (T E : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, pmN j * (T + E * f j) = ((n % 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * T + E * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, pmN j * f j

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pmN_cases.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pmN_cases
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pmN_cases.header: theorem pmN_cases (n : ℕ) : (pmN n = 1 ∧ ((n % 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 0) ∨ (pmN n = -1 ∧ ((n % 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pmN_odd.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pmN_odd
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pmN_odd.header: theorem pmN_odd {ell : ℕ} (hO : ell % 2 = 1) : pmN ell = -1

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_phi1o_dir1_e.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_phi1o_dir1_eq
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_phi1o_dir1_e.header:
theorem loop_phi1o_dir1_eq (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hO : ell % 2 = 1) (c : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (t : ℝ)
    (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y ell ell) :
    ∃ n0 n1 n2 : ℕ, n0 < ell ∧ n1 < ell ∧ n2 < ell ∧ (x 0).val = (y 0).val + ell * n0 ∧ (x 1).val = (y 1).val + ell * n1 ∧
      loopAngG ell ell (phi1o L c ell t) y 1 x = t * sgnNat (y 1).val *
        ((2 * ((n1 % 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (if (y 0).val = c then 1 else 0) + pmN n1 * (if (x 0).val = c then 1 else 0) - (if (y 0).val = c then 1 else 0) +
            pmN n1 * ((if (y 0).val = c then 1 else 0) - (if (x 0).val = c then 1 else 0)) *
              (aAmp L ell (x 1).val (x 2).val + aAmp L ell ((((y 1).val + ell * ell) % (L 1 + 1) + ell * n1) % (L 1 + 1)) (x 2).val)) +
         (Efun c ell (y 0).val *
              (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n1, pmN j * pAmp L ell (((y 1).val + ell * j) % (L 1 + 1)) (x 2).val +
               ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n1, pmN j * pAmp L ell ((((y 1).val + ell * ell) % (L 1 + 1) + ell * j) % (L 1 + 1)) (x 2).val -
               ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, pmN j * pAmp L ell (((y 1).val + ell * j) % (L 1 + 1)) (y 2).val) +
          pmN n1 * Efun c ell (x 0).val * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, pmN j * pAmp L ell (((x 1).val + ell * j) % (L 1 + 1)) (x 2).val))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_phi1o_dir1_b.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_phi1o_dir0_b.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_phi1o_dir2_e.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_phi1o_dir2_eq
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_phi1o_dir2_e.header:
theorem loop_phi1o_dir2_eq (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hO : ell % 2 = 1) (c : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (t : ℝ)
    (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y ell ell) :
    ∃ n0 n1 n2 : ℕ, n0 < ell ∧ n1 < ell ∧ n2 < ell ∧ (x 0).val = (y 0).val + ell * n0 ∧ (x 1).val = (y 1).val + ell * n1 ∧
      (x 2).val = (y 2).val + ell * n2 ∧
      loopAngG ell ell (phi1o L c ell t) y 2 x = t * sgnNat (y 1).val *
        (Efun c ell (y 0).val *
            ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range n1, pmN j * pAmp L ell (((y 1).val + ell * j) % (L 1 + 1)) (x 2).val) -
              (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n1, pmN j * pAmp L ell (((y 1).val + ell * j) % (L 1 + 1)) ((((y 2).val + ell * ell) % (L 2 + 1) + ell * n2) % (L 2 + 1)))) +
          pmN n1 * ((if (y 0).val = c then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if (x 0).val = c then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) *
            (aAmp L ell (x 1).val (x 2).val - aAmp L ell (x 1).val ((((y 2).val + ell * ell) % (L 2 + 1) + ell * n2) % (L 2 + 1))))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_phi1o_dir0_e.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_phi1o_dir0_eq
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop_phi1o_dir0_e.header:
theorem loop_phi1o_dir0_eq (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hO : ell % 2 = 1) (c : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (t : ℝ)
    (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y ell ell) :
    ∃ n0 n1 n2 : ℕ, n0 < ell ∧ n1 < ell ∧ n2 < ell ∧ (x 0).val = (y 0).val + ell * n0 ∧ (x 1).val = (y 1).val + ell * n1 ∧
      (x 2).val = (y 2).val + ell * n2 ∧
      loopAngG ell ell (phi1o L c ell t) y 0 x = t * sgnNat (y 1).val *
        (((n1 % 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            ((if (y 0).val = c then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if ((y 0).val + ell * ell) % (L 0 + 1) = c then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) +
          (Efun c ell (y 0).val - Efun c ell (((y 0).val + ell * ell) % (L 0 + 1))) *
            (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n1, pmN j * pAmp L ell (((y 1).val + ell * j) % (L 1 + 1)) (x 2).val) +
          ((if (y 0).val = c then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if ((y 0).val + ell * ell) % (L 0 + 1) = c then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) *
            (pmN n1 * aAmp L ell (x 1).val (x 2).val - aAmp L ell (y 1).val (y 2).val))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.W1al.header: noncomputable def W1al (c ell Y0 a b : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.W1al_eq.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.W1al_eq
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.W1al_eq.header:
theorem W1al_eq (c ell Y0 a b : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop1_aligned.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop1_aligned

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.W0al_eq.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.W0al_eq
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.W0al_eq.header:
theorem W0al_eq (c ell Y0 b : ℕ) :

      (((if Y0 = c then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if (Y0 + ell * ell) % (L 0 + 1) = c then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * (1 - 2 * aInt ell) +
        (Efun c ell Y0 - Efun c ell ((Y0 + ell * ell) % (L 0 + 1))) * pInt ell)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.phi2_dir0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.phi2_dir0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.phi2_dir0.header:

    blockAngG ell ell (phi1o L c ell t) Y 0 = t * sgnNat (Y 1).val *

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.phi2_dir2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.phi2_dir2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.phi2_dir2.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.unit_loop_dir1.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.phiu_eq_unitFld.header:
theorem phiu_eq_unitFld (hell : 0 < ell) {c : ℕ} (G : OddGeo (scaleUp ell 2 Lu) ell c) (cu : ℕ) (hcu : c = ell * ell * cu) (t : ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.qF_zero_vec.header: theorem qF_zero_vec {n : ℕ} (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : qF C c (0 : Fin n → ℝ) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.crossing_lower.header:
