AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube.header: def cube (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → E) (n a b c : ℕ) : E

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_range_mul_spl.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_range_mul_split
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_range_mul_spl.header:
theorem sum_range_mul_split (f : ℕ → E) (n ell : ℕ) :
    ∑ m ∈ range (ell * n), f m = ∑ i ∈ range ell, ∑ r ∈ range n, f (n * i + r)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube_tower.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube_tower
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube_tower.header:
theorem cube_tower (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → E) (n ell a b c : ℕ) :
    cube g (ell * n) a b c = ∑ i ∈ range ell, ∑ j ∈ range ell, ∑ k ∈ range ell,
      cube g n (a + n * i) (b + n * j) (c + n * k)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube_one.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube_one
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube_one.header: theorem cube_one (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → E) (a b c : ℕ) : cube g 1 a b c = g a b c

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube_congr.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube_congr
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube_congr.header:
theorem cube_congr (g g' : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → E) (n a b c : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i j k, i < n → j < n → k < n → g (a + i) (b + j) (c + k) = g' (a + i) (b + j) (c + k)) :
    cube g n a b c = cube g' n a b c

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube_const.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube_const
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube_const.header:
theorem cube_const (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → E) (n a b c : ℕ) (v : E)
    (h : ∀ i j k, i < n → j < n → k < n → g (a + i) (b + j) (c + k) = v) :
    cube g n a b c = ((n : ℝ) ^ 3) • v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube_zero_of.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube_zero_of
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube_zero_of.header:
theorem cube_zero_of (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → E) (n a b c : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i j k, i < n → j < n → k < n → g (a + i) (b + j) (c + k) = 0) :
    cube g n a b c = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.smul_pow_eq_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.smul_pow_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.smul_pow_eq_zero.header: theorem smul_pow_eq_zero {v : E} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {m : ℕ} (h : ((n : ℝ) ^ m) • v = 0) : v = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.const_chain.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.const_chain
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.const_chain.header:
theorem const_chain (f : ℕ → E) (s n K : ℕ) (h : ∀ m, m < K → f (s + (m + 1) * n) = f (s + m * n)) :
    ∀ m, m ≤ K → f (s + m * n) = f s

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.step_le.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.step_le
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.step_le.header: theorem step_le {m x y : ℕ} (hx : m ∣ x) (hy : m ∣ y) (h : x < y) : x + m ≤ y

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_gen.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_gen
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_gen.header:
theorem chain_gen (f : ℕ → E) (m lo hi : ℕ)
    (hrel : ∀ Y, m ∣ Y → lo ≤ Y → Y + m ≤ hi → f (Y + m) = f Y) :
    ∀ s t, m ∣ s → m ∣ t → lo ≤ s → s ≤ t → t ≤ hi → f t = f s

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum3_const.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum3_const
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum3_const.header:
theorem sum3_const (ell : ℕ) (v : E) :
    ∑ i ∈ range ell, ∑ j ∈ range ell, ∑ k ∈ range ell, v = ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3) • v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube2_split.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube2_split
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube2_split.header:
theorem cube2_split (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → E) (ell a b c : ℕ) :
    cube g (ell ^ 2) a b c = ∑ i ∈ range ell, ∑ j ∈ range ell, ∑ k ∈ range ell,
      cube g ell (a + ell * i) (b + ell * j) (c + ell * k)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube2_of_const.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube2_of_const
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.cube2_of_const.header:
theorem cube2_of_const (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → E) (ell a b c : ℕ) (v : E)
    (h : ∀ i j k, i < ell → j < ell → k < ell → cube g ell (a + ell * i) (b + ell * j) (c + ell * k) = v) :
    cube g (ell ^ 2) a b c = ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3) • v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_main.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_main
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.chain_main.header:
theorem chain_main (ell p1 a' b' a b q1 N : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hNd : ell ^ 2 ∣ N)
    (d1p : ell ∣ p1) (d1q : ell ∣ q1)
    (d2a' : ell ^ 2 ∣ a') (d2b' : ell ^ 2 ∣ b') (d2a : ell ^ 2 ∣ a) (d2b : ell ^ 2 ∣ b)
    (hNpos : 0 < N) (hp : ell ≤ p1) (hpa : p1 + ell ^ 2 ≤ a') (hab : a' < b') (hba : b' + ell ^ 2 ≤ a) (hab2 : a < b)
    (hbq : b + ell ^ 2 ≤ q1)
    (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → E) (κ : E)
    (hL : ∀ x, x < p1 → ∀ y z, g x y z = 0)
    (hR : ∀ x, q1 ≤ x → x < q1 + ell → ∀ y z, g x y z = κ)
    (h1 : ∀ Y0 Y1 Y2, ell ∣ Y0 → ell ∣ Y1 → ell ∣ Y2 → Y1 < N → Y2 < N →
        ((p1 ≤ Y0 + ell ∧ Y0 + 2 * ell ≤ a') ∨ (b' ≤ Y0 ∧ Y0 + 2 * ell ≤ a) ∨ (b ≤ Y0 ∧ Y0 + ell ≤ q1)) →
        cube g ell (Y0 + ell) Y1 Y2 = cube g ell Y0 Y1 Y2)
    (h1y : ∀ Y0 Y1 Y2, ell ∣ Y0 → ell ∣ Y1 → ell ∣ Y2 → Y1 + ell < N → Y2 < N → b' ≤ Y0 → Y0 + ell ≤ a →
        cube g ell Y0 (Y1 + ell) Y2 = cube g ell Y0 Y1 Y2)
    (h1z : ∀ Y0 Y1 Y2, ell ∣ Y0 → ell ∣ Y1 → ell ∣ Y2 → Y1 < N → Y2 + ell < N → b' ≤ Y0 → Y0 + ell ≤ a →
        cube g ell Y0 Y1 (Y2 + ell) = cube g ell Y0 Y1 Y2)
    (h2 : ∀ Y0 Y1 Y2, ell ^ 2 ∣ Y0 → ell ^ 2 ∣ Y1 → ell ^ 2 ∣ Y2 → Y1 < N → Y2 < N →
        ((a' ≤ Y0 + ell ^ 2 ∧ Y0 + ell ^ 2 ≤ b') ∨ (a ≤ Y0 + ell ^ 2 ∧ Y0 + ell ^ 2 ≤ b)) →
        cube g (ell ^ 2) (Y0 + ell ^ 2) Y1 Y2 = cube g (ell ^ 2) Y0 Y1 Y2) :
    κ = 0 ∧
    (∀ Y0 Y1 Y2, ell ∣ Y0 → ell ∣ Y1 → ell ∣ Y2 → Y1 < N → Y2 < N →
      ((p1 ≤ Y0 ∧ Y0 < a') ∨ (b' ≤ Y0 ∧ Y0 < a) ∨ (b ≤ Y0 ∧ Y0 < q1)) → cube g ell Y0 Y1 Y2 = 0) ∧
    (∀ Y0 Y1 Y2, ell ^ 2 ∣ Y0 → ell ^ 2 ∣ Y1 → ell ^ 2 ∣ Y2 → Y1 < N → Y2 < N →
      ((a' ≤ Y0 ∧ Y0 < b') ∨ (a ≤ Y0 ∧ Y0 < b)) → cube g (ell ^ 2) Y0 Y1 Y2 = 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS.header: def mkS (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (a b c : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_val.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_val
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_val.header: theorem mkS_val (a b c : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : ((mkS L a b c) μ).val = (![a, b, c] μ) % (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_val0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_val0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_val0.header: theorem mkS_val0 (a b c : ℕ) : ((mkS L a b c) 0).val = a % (L 0 + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_val1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_val1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_val1.header: theorem mkS_val1 (a b c : ℕ) : ((mkS L a b c) 1).val = b % (L 1 + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_val2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_val2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_val2.header: theorem mkS_val2 (a b c : ℕ) : ((mkS L a b c) 2).val = c % (L 2 + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_eta.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_eta
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_eta.header: theorem mkS_eta (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : mkS L (x 0).val (x 1).val (x 2).val = x

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_ext.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_ext
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_ext.header:
theorem mkS_ext {a b c a' b' c' : ℕ} (h0 : a % (L 0 + 1) = a' % (L 0 + 1)) (h1 : b % (L 1 + 1) = b' % (L 1 + 1))
    (h2 : c % (L 2 + 1) = c' % (L 2 + 1)) : mkS L a b c = mkS L a' b' c'

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shift_val_self.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shift_val_self
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shift_val_self.header:
theorem shift_val_self (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((periodicLatticeShift x μ) μ).val = ((x μ).val + 1) % (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shift_val_ne.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shift_val_ne
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shift_val_ne.header:
theorem shift_val_ne (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) (h : ν ≠ μ) :
    ((periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν) = x ν

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shift_mkS0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shift_mkS0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shift_mkS0.header: theorem shift_mkS0 (a b c : ℕ) : periodicLatticeShift (mkS L a b c) 0 = mkS L (a + 1) b c

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shift_mkS1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shift_mkS1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shift_mkS1.header: theorem shift_mkS1 (a b c : ℕ) : periodicLatticeShift (mkS L a b c) 1 = mkS L a (b + 1) c

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shift_mkS2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shift_mkS2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.shift_mkS2.header: theorem shift_mkS2 (a b c : ℕ) : periodicLatticeShift (mkS L a b c) 2 = mkS L a b (c + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathSite_mkS0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathSite_mkS0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathSite_mkS0.header: theorem pathSite_mkS0 (a b c i : ℕ) : pathSite (mkS L a b c) 0 i = mkS L (a + i) b c

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathSite_mkS1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathSite_mkS1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathSite_mkS1.header: theorem pathSite_mkS1 (a b c i : ℕ) : pathSite (mkS L a b c) 1 i = mkS L a (b + i) c

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathSite_mkS2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathSite_mkS2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.pathSite_mkS2.header: theorem pathSite_mkS2 (a b c i : ℕ) : pathSite (mkS L a b c) 2 i = mkS L a b (c + i)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_mem_block.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_mem_block
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.mkS_mem_block.header:
theorem mkS_mem_block (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ) (hfit : ∀ μ, (Y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1)
    (i j k : ℕ) (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n) (hk : k < n) :
    mkS L ((Y 0).val + i) ((Y 1).val + j) ((Y 2).val + k) ∈ blockOf Y n

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_block_eq_cube.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_block_eq_cube
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.sum_block_eq_cube.header:
theorem sum_block_eq_cube {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ)
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (Y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1) (F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → E) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf Y n, F x = cube (fun a b c => F (mkS L a b c)) n (Y 0).val (Y 1).val (Y 2).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bgTower_flat.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bgTower_flat
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bgTower_flat.header:
theorem bgTower_flat (G : TowerGeom L) (j : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Qfull_flat_row.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Qfull_flat_row
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Qfull_flat_row.header:
theorem Qfull_flat_row (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (J : ℕ) (hdvdJ : ∀ ν, G.ell ^ J ∣ L ν + 1)
    (p : BIdx G) (hpJ : (p.1 : ℕ) ≤ J) (hc : p.2.1.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (G.ell ^ (p.1 : ℕ))) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    (QfullOf G (flatCfg : Cfg L) A) p
      = lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo (G.ell ^ (p.1 : ℕ)) (WithLp.ofLp A) ⟨⟨p.2.1.1, hc⟩, p.2.1.2⟩

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lcr_dir0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lcr_dir0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lcr_dir0.header:
theorem lcr_dir0 (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (ξ' : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → SuTwo) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ)
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (Y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1) (hc : Y ∈ CoarseLattice L n)
    (hrel : ∀ a b c, (Y 0).val ≤ a → a < (Y 0).val + 2 * n → (Y 1).val ≤ b → b < (Y 1).val + n →
      (Y 2).val ≤ c → c < (Y 2).val + n → A (mkS L a b c, 0) = ξ' (a + 1) b c - ξ' a b c) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n A ⟨⟨Y, hc⟩, 0⟩
      = (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 4) • (cube ξ' n ((Y 0).val + n) (Y 1).val (Y 2).val - cube ξ' n (Y 0).val (Y 1).val (Y 2).val)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lcr_dir1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lcr_dir1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lcr_dir1.header:
theorem lcr_dir1 (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (ξ' : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → SuTwo) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ)
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (Y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1) (hc : Y ∈ CoarseLattice L n)
    (hrel : ∀ a b c, (Y 0).val ≤ a → a < (Y 0).val + n → (Y 1).val ≤ b → b < (Y 1).val + 2 * n →
      (Y 2).val ≤ c → c < (Y 2).val + n → A (mkS L a b c, 1) = ξ' a (b + 1) c - ξ' a b c) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n A ⟨⟨Y, hc⟩, 1⟩
      = (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 4) • (cube ξ' n (Y 0).val ((Y 1).val + n) (Y 2).val - cube ξ' n (Y 0).val (Y 1).val (Y 2).val)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lcr_dir2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lcr_dir2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lcr_dir2.header:
theorem lcr_dir2 (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (ξ' : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → SuTwo) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ)
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (Y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1) (hc : Y ∈ CoarseLattice L n)
    (hrel : ∀ a b c, (Y 0).val ≤ a → a < (Y 0).val + n → (Y 1).val ≤ b → b < (Y 1).val + n →
      (Y 2).val ≤ c → c < (Y 2).val + 2 * n → A (mkS L a b c, 2) = ξ' a b (c + 1) - ξ' a b c) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n A ⟨⟨Y, hc⟩, 2⟩
      = (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 4) • (cube ξ' n (Y 0).val (Y 1).val ((Y 2).val + n) - cube ξ' n (Y 0).val (Y 1).val (Y 2).val)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.flat_ginv_form.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.flat_ginv_form
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.flat_ginv_form.header:
theorem flat_ginv_form (P : IngrBParams) (hU : P.U = flatCfg) (x : ↥(bondSupp P.G)) :
    ⟪x, P.data.Ginv x⟫ =
      ‖AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.plaqMask (plaqIn P.G.Om0)
        (curlCovariantCLM_L2 (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) P.Lf) (iE P.G x))‖ ^ 2
      + ‖Tfull P.G P.U (iE P.G x)‖ ^ 2
      + ∑ p : BIdx P.G, P.a * (P.ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ) * ‖P.sector.Qfull (iE P.G x) p‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.flat_ginv_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.flat_ginv_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.flat_ginv_zero.header:
theorem flat_ginv_zero (P : IngrBParams) (hU : P.U = flatCfg) (ha : 0 < P.a) (x : ↥(bondSupp P.G))
    (h0 : ⟪x, P.data.Ginv x⟫ = 0) :
    AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.plaqMask (plaqIn P.G.Om0)
        (curlCovariantCLM_L2 (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) P.Lf) (iE P.G x)) = 0
      ∧ Tfull P.G P.U (iE P.G x) = 0 ∧ P.sector.Qfull (iE P.G x) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.siteMask_eq_self_.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.siteMask_eq_self_of_supp
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.siteMask_eq_self_.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lapDir_eq_mask_la.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lapDir_eq_mask_lap
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.lapDir_eq_mask_la.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.bondsLam0_of.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.edge_vertex_x0'.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.edge_vertex_x0'

       (((periodicLatticeShift e.1 e.2) 0).val = (p.1 0).val ∨ ((periodicLatticeShift e.1 e.2) 0).val = ((p.1 0).val + 1) % n))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.rel_g.header:
theorem rel_g (A : BondFnL2 L) (φ : SiteL2 L) (c : Fin 3 → SuTwo)
    (hb : ∀ b : Bond L, A b = φ (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - φ b.1 + c b.2)
    (h1 : c 1 = 0) (h2 : c 2 = 0) :
    (∀ a b d, A (mkS L a b d, 0) = gpot φ (c 0) (a + 1) b d - gpot φ (c 0) a b d) ∧
    (∀ a b d, A (mkS L a b d, 1) = gpot φ (c 0) a (b + 1) d - gpot φ (c 0) a b d) ∧
    (∀ a b d, A (mkS L a b d, 2) = gpot φ (c 0) a b (d + 1) - gpot φ (c 0) a b d)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.row_cube0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.row_cube0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.row_cube0.header:
theorem row_cube0 (hP : PGeo ell M R) {x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))} (hk : KD ell M R x)
    (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → SuTwo)
    (rel0 : ∀ a b d, x (mkS (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) a b d, 0) = g (a + 1) b d - g a b d)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) (Y0 Y1 Y2 : ℕ)
    (h0 : Y0 + ell ^ j ≤ neN ell M R) (h1 : Y1 + ell ^ j ≤ neN ell M R) (h2 : Y2 + ell ^ j ≤ neN ell M R)
    (d0 : ell ^ j ∣ Y0) (d1 : ell ^ j ∣ Y1) (d2 : ell ^ j ∣ Y2)
    (hmem : (mkS (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) Y0 Y1 Y2, (0 : Fin 3)) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) j) :
    cube g (ell ^ j) (Y0 + ell ^ j) Y1 Y2 = cube g (ell ^ j) Y0 Y1 Y2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.row_cube1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.row_cube1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.row_cube1.header:

    (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → SuTwo)
    (rel1 : ∀ a b d, x (mkS (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) a b d, 1) = g a (b + 1) d - g a b d)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) (Y0 Y1 Y2 : ℕ)
    (h0 : Y0 + ell ^ j ≤ neN ell M R) (h1 : Y1 + ell ^ j ≤ neN ell M R) (h2 : Y2 + ell ^ j ≤ neN ell M R)
    (d0 : ell ^ j ∣ Y0) (d1 : ell ^ j ∣ Y1) (d2 : ell ^ j ∣ Y2)
    (hmem : (mkS (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) Y0 Y1 Y2, (1 : Fin 3)) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) j) :
    cube g (ell ^ j) Y0 (Y1 + ell ^ j) Y2 = cube g (ell ^ j) Y0 Y1 Y2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.row_cube2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.row_cube2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.row_cube2.header:
theorem row_cube2 (hP : PGeo ell M R) {x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))} (hk : KD ell M R x)
    (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → SuTwo)

      cube (fun a b d => g a b d - g 0 0 0) ell Y0 Y1 Y2 = 0) ∧
    (∀ Y0 Y1 Y2, ell ^ 2 ∣ Y0 → ell ^ 2 ∣ Y1 → ell ^ 2 ∣ Y2 → Y1 < neN ell M R → Y2 < neN ell M R →
      ((neA' ell M R ≤ Y0 ∧ Y0 < neB' ell M R) ∨ (neA ell M R ≤ Y0 ∧ Y0 < neB ell M R)) →
      cube (fun a b d => g a b d - g 0 0 0) (ell ^ 2) Y0 Y1 Y2 = 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.hit_extract.header:
theorem hit_extract (Y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ' μ : Fin 3) (n n' : ℕ) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hit : 0 < hits Y' μ' n' (pathSite Y μ (n - 1), μ)) :
    μ' = μ ∧ ∃ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (∀ ν, (Y' ν).val ≤ (y ν).val ∧ (y ν).val < (Y' ν).val + n') ∧
      ∃ i, i < n' ∧ (∀ ν, ν ≠ μ → (y ν).val = (Y ν).val) ∧
        ((y μ).val + i) % (L μ + 1) = ((Y μ).val + (n - 1)) % (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rw0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rw0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.Rw0.header:
def Rw0 (ell M R : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop
  | 0, v => (neP0 ell M R ≤ v + 1 ∧ v + 2 ≤ neP1 ell M R) ∨ (neQ1 ell M R ≤ v ∧ v + 1 ≤ neQ0 ell M R)
  | 1, v => (neP1 ell M R ≤ v + ell ∧ v + 2 * ell ≤ neA' ell M R) ∨ (neB' ell M R ≤ v ∧ v + 2 * ell ≤ neA ell M R) ∨
      (neB ell M R ≤ v ∧ v + ell ≤ neQ1 ell M R)
  | 2, v => (neA' ell M R ≤ v + ell ^ 2 ∧ v + ell ^ 2 ≤ neB' ell M R) ∨ (neA ell M R ≤ v + ell ^ 2 ∧ v + ell ^ 2 ≤ neB ell M R)
  | _, _ => False

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.alt_sum_one_dev_r.header:

    (n % 2 = 0 → -1 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, pmN j * m j ∧ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, pmN j * m j ≤ 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.altP_range.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.altP_range
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.altP_range.header:
theorem altP_range {ell : ℕ} (hO : ell % 2 = 1) (hell : 0 < ell) (hN : ell * ell + ell < L 1 + 1) (b n z2 : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ ell) :
    (n % 2 = 1 → 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, pmN j * pAmp L ell ((b + ell * j) % (L 1 + 1)) z2 ∧
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, pmN j * pAmp L ell ((b + ell * j) % (L 1 + 1)) z2 ≤ 2 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ∧
    (n % 2 = 0 → -(1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, pmN j * pAmp L ell ((b + ell * j) % (L 1 + 1)) z2 ∧
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, pmN j * pAmp L ell ((b + ell * j) % (L 1 + 1)) z2 ≤ 1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.prod_both.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.prod_both
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.prod_both.header:

    (E = -Em → -(Em * hi) ≤ E * e ∧ E * e ≤ -(Em * lo)) ∧ (0 ≤ E → E ≤ 1 → lo ≤ E * e ∧ E * e ≤ hi)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop1_real2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop1_real2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop1_real2.header:
theorem loop1_real2 (T0 Tx Dsum E0 Ex e1 e2 e3 e4 a1 a2 pm1 n1odd A Em u : ℝ)
    (hT0 : T0 = 0 ∨ T0 = 1) (hTx : Tx = 0 ∨ Tx = 1) (hD : Dsum = T0 - Tx)
    (hpm : (pm1 = 1 ∧ n1odd = 0) ∨ (pm1 = -1 ∧ n1odd = 1))
    (ha1 : 0 ≤ a1) (ha1' : a1 ≤ A) (ha2 : 0 ≤ a2) (ha2' : a2 ≤ A) (hA : 2 * A ≤ 1)
    (hE0 : (T0 = 1 → E0 = -Em) ∧ (T0 = 0 → 0 ≤ E0 ∧ E0 ≤ 1))
    (hEx : (Tx = 1 → Ex = -Em) ∧ (Tx = 0 → 0 ≤ Ex ∧ Ex ≤ 1))
    (he12o : n1odd = 1 → 0 ≤ e1 ∧ e1 ≤ 2 * u ∧ 0 ≤ e2 ∧ e2 ≤ 2 * u)
    (he12e : n1odd = 0 → -u ≤ e1 ∧ e1 ≤ u ∧ -u ≤ e2 ∧ e2 ≤ u)
    (he3 : 0 ≤ e3 ∧ e3 ≤ 2 * u) (he4 : 0 ≤ e4 ∧ e4 ≤ 2 * u)
    (hz1 : T0 = 1 → Tx = 0 → Ex = 0) (hz2 : T0 = 0 → Tx = 1 → E0 = 0)
    (hEm : 2 ≤ Em) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    |(2 * n1odd * T0 + pm1 * Tx - T0 + pm1 * Dsum * (a1 + a2)) + (E0 * (e1 + e2 - e4) + pm1 * Ex * e3)| ≤ 1 + 2 * Em * (2 * u)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop0_real2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop0_real2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop0_real2.header:
theorem loop0_real2 (X Ed e1 a1 ay pm1 n1odd A Em ε : ℝ)
    (hX : X = -1 ∨ X = 0 ∨ X = 1) (hpm : (pm1 = 1 ∧ n1odd = 0) ∨ (pm1 = -1 ∧ n1odd = 1))
    (ha1 : 0 ≤ a1) (ha1' : a1 ≤ A) (hay : 0 ≤ ay) (hay' : ay ≤ A) (hA : 2 * A ≤ 1)
    (hEd : |Ed| ≤ Em) (he1 : |e1| ≤ ε) (hEm : 0 ≤ Em) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    |n1odd * X + Ed * e1 + X * (pm1 * a1 - ay)| ≤ 1 + 2 * Em * ε

AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop2_real2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmega.loop2_real2

    (β : E → E → ℝ) (hβ : ∀ x, TE x = x → 0 ≤ β x x) (S : Set ℝ) (h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ S)
    (hid : ∀ w ∈ S, ∀ x x', TE x = x → TE x' = x' → ⟪x', A w x⟫ = ⟪x', A 1 x⟫ + (w - 1) * β x' x) :
    ∃ H0 B : E →L[ℝ] E, Sym H0 ∧ Sym B ∧ (∀ a, 0 ≤ ⟪a, B a⟫) ∧ (∀ x, H0 (TE x) = TE (H0 x)) ∧ (∀ x, B (TE x) = TE (B x)) ∧
      ∀ w ∈ S, ∀ x, TE x = x → A w x = H0 x + w • B x

AdalyNcwdhTwo.Bridge.fixed_antifixed_zer.header: theorem fixed_antifixed_zero {TE : E →L[ℝ] E} {u v : E} (hu : TE u = u) (hv : TE v = -v) (h : u + v = 0) : u = 0 ∧ v = 0

AdalyNcwdhTwo.Bridge.Nhat_unit.name: AdalyNcwdhTwo.Bridge.Nhat_unit
AdalyNcwdhTwo.Bridge.Nhat_unit.header:
theorem Nhat_unit {TE : E →L[ℝ] E} {TF : F →L[ℝ] F} (hTE2 : ∀ x, TE (TE x) = x) (hTF2 : ∀ y, TF (TF y) = y)
    (Q0 : E →L[ℝ] F) (Q0s : F →L[ℝ] E) (hQ0 : ∀ x y, ⟪Q0 x, y⟫ = ⟪x, Q0s y⟫)
    (hQ0c : ∀ x, Q0 (TE x) = TF (Q0 x)) (hQ0sc : ∀ y, Q0s (TF y) = TE (Q0s y))
    (hinj : ∀ y, Q0s y = 0 → y = 0)
    {A : E →L[ℝ] E} (hAc : ∀ x, A (TE x) = TE (A x)) (hA : IsUnit A) {Nw : F →L[ℝ] F}
    (hNfix : ∀ y, TF y = y → Nw y = Q0 (Ring.inverse A (Q0s y))) (hNunit : IsUnit Nw) :
    IsUnit (Q0.comp ((Ring.inverse (A * Pr TE + (1 - Pr TE))).comp Q0s))

AdalyNcwdhTwo.Bridge.Nhat_apply_fixed.name: AdalyNcwdhTwo.Bridge.Nhat_apply_fixed
AdalyNcwdhTwo.Bridge.Nhat_apply_fixed.header:
theorem Nhat_apply_fixed {TE : E →L[ℝ] E} {TF : F →L[ℝ] F} (hTE2 : ∀ x, TE (TE x) = x)
    (Q0 : E →L[ℝ] F) (Q0s : F →L[ℝ] E) (hQ0sc : ∀ y, Q0s (TF y) = TE (Q0s y))
    {A : E →L[ℝ] E} (hAc : ∀ x, A (TE x) = TE (A x)) (hA : IsUnit A) {y : F} (hy : TF y = y) :
    (Q0.comp ((Ring.inverse (A * Pr TE + (1 - Pr TE))).comp Q0s)) y = Q0 (Ring.inverse A (Q0s y))

AdalyNcwdhTwo.Bridge.hhat_isUnit.name: AdalyNcwdhTwo.Bridge.hhat_isUnit
AdalyNcwdhTwo.Bridge.hhat_isUnit.header:

AdalyNcwdhTwo.Bridge.monotone_bridge.name: AdalyNcwdhTwo.Bridge.monotone_bridge
AdalyNcwdhTwo.Bridge.monotone_bridge.header:
theorem monotone_bridge
    {TE : E →L[ℝ] E} {TF : F →L[ℝ] F} (hTE2 : ∀ x, TE (TE x) = x) (hTEs : Sym TE)
    (hTF2 : ∀ y, TF (TF y) = y)
    {H0 B : E →L[ℝ] E} (hH0s : Sym H0) (hBs : Sym B) (hBpsd : ∀ a, 0 ≤ ⟪a, B a⟫)
    (hH0c : ∀ x, H0 (TE x) = TE (H0 x)) (hBc : ∀ x, B (TE x) = TE (B x))
    (Q0 : E →L[ℝ] F) (Q0s : F →L[ℝ] E) (hQ0 : ∀ x y, ⟪Q0 x, y⟫ = ⟪x, Q0s y⟫)
    (hQ0c : ∀ x, Q0 (TE x) = TF (Q0 x)) (hQ0sc : ∀ y, Q0s (TF y) = TE (Q0s y)) (hinj : ∀ y, Q0s y = 0 → y = 0)
    (A : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (Q : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] F) (Qs : ℝ → F →L[ℝ] E) {lo hi : ℝ}
    (hAc : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc lo hi, ∀ x, A w (TE x) = TE (A w x))
    (hAff : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc lo hi, ∀ x, TE x = x → A w x = H0 x + w • B x)
    (hQ : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc lo hi, ∀ x, TE x = x → Q w x = Q0 x)
    (hQs : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc lo hi, ∀ y, TF y = y → Qs w y = Q0s y)
    (hQc : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc lo hi, ∀ x, Q w (TE x) = TF (Q w x))
    (hQsc : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc lo hi, ∀ y, Qs w (TF y) = TE (Qs w y))
    (hunit : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc lo hi, IsUnit (A w) ∧ IsUnit ((Q w).comp ((Ring.inverse (A w)).comp (Qs w))))
    (y : F) (hy : TF y = y) :
    MonotoneOn (fun w => ⟪y, Ring.inverse ((Q w).comp ((Ring.inverse (A w)).comp (Qs w))) y⟫) (Set.Icc lo hi)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.bF1.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.bF1
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.bF1.header: def bF1 (C : ℕ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1.header: def qF1 (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1.header: def BF1 (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e f : Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.bF1_cont.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.bF1_cont
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.bF1_cont.header: theorem bF1_cont (C : ℕ) : Continuous (fun e : Fin n → ℝ => bF1 C e)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.bF1_smul.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.bF1_smul
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.bF1_smul.header: theorem bF1_smul (C : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) : bF1 C (r • e) = r ^ 2 * bF1 C e

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.bF1_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.bF1_nonneg
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.bF1_nonneg.header: theorem bF1_nonneg (C : ℕ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) : 0 ≤ bF1 C e

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_add.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_add
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_add.header: theorem qF1_add (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e f : Fin n → ℝ) : qF1 C c (e + f) = qF1 C c e + 2 * BF1 C c e f + qF1 C c f

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_smul_right.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_smul_right
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_smul_right.header: theorem BF1_smul_right (C : ℕ) (c t : ℝ) (e f : Fin n → ℝ) : BF1 C c e (t • f) = t * BF1 C c e f

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_add_right.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_add_right
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_add_right.header: theorem BF1_add_right (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e f g : Fin n → ℝ) : BF1 C c e (f + g) = BF1 C c e f + BF1 C c e g

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_comm.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_comm
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_comm.header: theorem BF1_comm (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e f : Fin n → ℝ) : BF1 C c e f = BF1 C c f e

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_self.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_self
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_self.header: theorem BF1_self (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) : BF1 C c e e = qF1 C c e

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_smul_left.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_smul_left
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_smul_left.header: theorem BF1_smul_left (C : ℕ) (c t : ℝ) (e f : Fin n → ℝ) : BF1 C c (t • e) f = t * BF1 C c e f

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_add_left.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_add_left
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_add_left.header: theorem BF1_add_left (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e f g : Fin n → ℝ) : BF1 C c (e + f) g = BF1 C c e g + BF1 C c f g

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_smul.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_smul
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_smul.header: theorem qF1_smul (C : ℕ) (c t : ℝ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) : qF1 C c (t • e) = t ^ 2 * qF1 C c e

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_affine.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_affine
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_affine.header: theorem qF1_affine (C : ℕ) (c cs : ℝ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) : qF1 C c e = qF1 C cs e + (c - cs) * bF1 C e

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.radical_of_psd1.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.radical_of_psd1
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.radical_of_psd1.header:
theorem radical_of_psd1 (rowOf : ℕ → ℕ) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (es : Fin n → ℝ) (hes : es ∈ Vsub rowOf)
    (hpsd : ∀ e : Fin n → ℝ, e ∈ Vsub rowOf → 0 ≤ qF1 C c e) (h0 : qF1 C c es = 0) :
    ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF1 C c es d = 0

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.chain_crossing1.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.chain_crossing1
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.chain_crossing1.header:
theorem chain_crossing1 (rowOf : ℕ → ℕ) (C : ℕ) (c1 : ℝ) (hc1 : c1 < 1) (e1 : Fin n → ℝ) (he1 : e1 ∈ Vsub rowOf)
    (hneg : qF1 C c1 e1 < 0) :
    ∃ cs : ℝ, c1 < cs ∧ cs < 1 ∧ (∃ es : Fin n → ℝ, es ∈ Vsub rowOf ∧ es ≠ 0 ∧ qF1 C cs es = 0) ∧
      (∀ e : Fin n → ℝ, e ∈ Vsub rowOf → 0 ≤ qF1 C cs e) ∧
      (∀ c : ℝ, cs < c → c ≤ 1 → ∀ e : Fin n → ℝ, e ∈ Vsub rowOf → e ≠ 0 → 0 < qF1 C c e) ∧
      (∀ es : Fin n → ℝ, es ∈ Vsub rowOf → qF1 C cs es = 0 → ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF1 C cs es d = 0)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.chain_mult_const1.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.chain_mult_const1
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.chain_mult_const1.header:
theorem chain_mult_const1 (rowOf : ℕ → ℕ) (C : ℕ) (cs : ℝ) (es : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF1 C cs es d = 0) (x x' : Fin n) (hxx : rowOf x.val = rowOf x'.val) :
    BF1 C cs es (Pi.single x 1) = BF1 C cs es (Pi.single x' 1)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.W1.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.W1
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.W1.header: noncomputable def W1 (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (y : ℤ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.W1_eq.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.W1_eq
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.W1_eq.header: theorem W1_eq (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (y : ℕ) : W1 C c (y : ℤ) = 1 - (1 - c) * (if y = C then 1 else 0)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_eq_sum.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_eq_sum.header:
theorem BF1_eq_sum (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hC : C + 1 < n) (e f : Fin n → ℝ) :
    BF1 C c e f = ∑ y ∈ range (n - 1), W1 C c (y : ℤ) * (dlt e y * dlt f y)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_single.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_single
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_single.header:
theorem BF1_single (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hC : C + 1 < n) (e : Fin n → ℝ) (x : Fin n) :
    BF1 C c e (Pi.single x 1) =
      W1 C c ((x.val : ℤ) - 1) * (nx e (x.val : ℤ) - nx e ((x.val : ℤ) - 1)) -
        W1 C c (x.val : ℤ) * (nx e ((x.val : ℤ) + 1) - nx e (x.val : ℤ))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.rowMu1.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.rowMu1
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.rowMu1.header: noncomputable def rowMu1 (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) (st : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.rowEL_raw1.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.rowEL_raw1
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.rowEL_raw1.header:
theorem rowEL_raw1 {a b R : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) (C : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hC : C + 1 < n) {e : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hrad : ∀ d : Fin n → ℝ, d ∈ Vsub rowOf → BF1 C c e d = 0) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < R) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, j < ln i →
      W1 C c (((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) * (nx e ((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ) - nx e (((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1)) -
        W1 C c ((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ) * (nx e (((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1) - nx e ((st i + j : ℕ) : ℤ)) = rowMu1 C c e st i

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.FSt.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.FSt
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.FSt.header: def FSt (e f : ℤ → ℝ) (s : ℤ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost.header: noncomputable def ghost (e f : ℤ → ℝ) (s : ℤ) (L : ℕ) : ℤ → ℝ

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost_mid.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost_mid
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost_mid.header: theorem ghost_mid (hL : 1 ≤ L) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < L) : ghost e f s L (s + j) = e (s + j)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost_left.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost_left
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost_left.header: theorem ghost_left : ghost e f s L (s - 1) = e s - f (s - 1)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost_right.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost_right
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost_right.header: theorem ghost_right (hL : 1 ≤ L) : ghost e f s L (s + L) = e (s + L - 1) + f (s + L - 1)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost_blockELs.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost_blockELs
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost_blockELs.header:
theorem ghost_blockELs (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hf : ∀ y, f y = W y * (e (y + 1) - e y))
    (hint : ∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < L → W (s + j) = 1)
    (hEL : ∀ j : ℕ, j < L → f (s + j - 1) - f (s + j) = μ) :

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost_sums.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost_sums
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ghost_sums.header: theorem ghost_sums (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hS : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, e (s + j) = 0) : BlockSums s L (ghost e f s L)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.row_fwd.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.row_fwd
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.row_fwd.header:
theorem row_fwd (hL : 2 ≤ L) (hf : ∀ y, f y = W y * (e (y + 1) - e y)) (hWL : W (s + L - 1) ≠ 0)
    (hint : ∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < L → W (s + j) = 1)
    (hEL : ∀ j : ℕ, j < L → f (s + j - 1) - f (s + j) = μ)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.row_bwd.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.row_bwd
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.row_bwd.header:
theorem row_bwd (hL : 2 ≤ L) (hf : ∀ y, f y = W y * (e (y + 1) - e y)) (hWL : W (s + L - 1) ≠ 0)
    (hint : ∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < L → W (s + j) = 1)
    (hEL : ∀ j : ℕ, j < L → f (s + j - 1) - f (s + j) = μ)
    (hS : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, e (s + j) = 0) (hz : FSt e f (s + L)) :
    μ = 0 ∧ (∀ j : ℕ, j < L → e (s + j) = 0) ∧ FSt e f s

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.uc_rows.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.uc_rows
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.uc_rows.header:
theorem uc_rows (hW : ∀ y, W y ≠ 0) (hf : ∀ y, f y = W y * (e (y + 1) - e y))
    (hstS : ∀ i, st (i + 1) = st i + ln i) (hlnL : ∀ i, i < a → ln i = 1)
    (hlnI : ∀ i, a ≤ i → i + b < R → 2 ≤ ln i) (hlnR : ∀ i, R ≤ i + b → i < R → ln i = 1)
    (hint : ∀ i, i < R → ∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < ln i → W (st i + j) = 1)
    (hEL : ∀ i, i < R → ∀ j : ℕ, j < ln i → f (st i + j - 1) - f (st i + j) = μ i)
    (hS : ∀ i, i < R → ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (ln i), e (st i + j) = 0)
    {i1 : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ i1) (hb : i1 + b < R) (hz : FSt e f (st i1)) :
    ∀ i, i < R → ∀ j : ℕ, j < ln i → e (st i + j) = 0

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.pair_lemma.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.pair_lemma
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.pair_lemma.header:
theorem pair_lemma {L : ℕ} (hL : 2 ≤ L) {e : ℤ → ℝ} {m : ℕ → ℝ} {s0 : ℤ}
    (hEL : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 3 → BlockELs (s0 + (k : ℤ) * L) L e (m k))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.neC0_ge_P0.header: theorem neC0_ge_P0 (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) : neP0 ell M R ≤ neC0 ell M R

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.neC0_lt_Q0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.neC0_lt_Q0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.neC0_lt_Q0.header: theorem neC0_lt_Q0 (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) : neC0 ell M R + 1 < neQ0 ell M R

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.G1inv_zfield0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.G1inv_zfield0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.G1inv_zfield0.header:
theorem G1inv_zfield0 (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ)
    (hf : (zfield (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) ∈ bondSupp (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R))) :
    (((Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).G1inv ⟨zfield (fe (neP0 ell M R) e), hf⟩ :
        ↥(bondSupp (Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).G)) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) =
      zfield (ginvProf0 ell (isRowN ell M R) (fun v => neP0 ell M R ≤ v ∧ v < neQ0 ell M R) (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R) 0)
        (neC0 ell M R) t a (fe (neP0 ell M R) e))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.xE.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.xE
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.xE.header:
noncomputable def xE (hg : NGeo ell M R) (hell3 : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.inner_G1inv_zfield0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.inner_G1inv_zfield0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.inner_G1inv_zfield0.header:
theorem inner_G1inv_zfield0 (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ (xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e)
        ((Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).G1inv (xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e)) : ℝ) =
      c0 * ((((scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) 1 + 1) * ((scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) 2 + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        qF1 (neC0 ell M R - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos (2 * t)) e +
      (inner ℝ (zfield (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))
        (zfield (CoverOmega.Wt ell (isRowN ell M R) (fun j u => a * fSum ell j (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) u))) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.tvs_zero_of_big.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.tvs_zero_of_big
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.tvs_zero_of_big.header: theorem tvs_zero_of_big {k : ℕ} (h : 9 ≤ k) : tvs k = 0

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.tvec.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.tvec
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.tvec.header: def tvec (s n : ℕ) : Fin n → ℝ

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ex_tvec.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ex_tvec
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ex_tvec.header: theorem ex_tvec (s : ℕ) (hn : s + 9 ≤ n) (z : ℕ) : ex (tvec s n) z = tvs (z - s)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.dlt_tvec.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.dlt_tvec
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.dlt_tvec.header: theorem dlt_tvec (s : ℕ) (hn : s + 9 ≤ n) (y : ℕ) : dlt (tvec s n) y = tvs (y + 1 - s) - tvs (y - s)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.aF_tvec.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.aF_tvec
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.aF_tvec.header: theorem aF_tvec (s : ℕ) (hn : s + 10 ≤ n) : aF (tvec s n) = 28

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.dlt_tvec_layer.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.dlt_tvec_layer
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.dlt_tvec_layer.header: theorem dlt_tvec_layer (s : ℕ) (hn : s + 9 ≤ n) : dlt (tvec s n) (s + 4) = 4

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_tvec.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_tvec
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_tvec.header: theorem qF1_tvec (s : ℕ) (hn : s + 10 ≤ n) (c : ℝ) : qF1 (s + 4) c (tvec s n) = 28 - 16 * (1 - c)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_tvec_neg.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_tvec_neg
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_tvec_neg.header: theorem qF1_tvec_neg (s : ℕ) (hn : s + 10 ≤ n) : qF1 (s + 4) (-4 / 5) (tvec s n) < 0

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.tvec_mem_Vsub.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.tvec_mem_Vsub
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.tvec_mem_Vsub.header:
theorem tvec_mem_Vsub {R a b : ℕ} {st ln rowOf : ℕ → ℕ} (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) (s : ℕ) (hn : s + 10 ≤ n)
    {i0 : ℕ} (hi0 : i0 + 1 < R) (hst : st i0 = s + 1) (hl0 : ln i0 = 4) (hl1 : ln (i0 + 1) = 4) :
    tvec s n ∈ Vsub rowOf

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_zero_pos.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_zero_pos
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_zero_pos.header:
theorem qF1_zero_pos (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (C : ℕ) (hC : C + 1 < n)
    {e : Fin n → ℝ} (he : e ∈ Vsub rowOf) (hne : e ≠ 0) : 0 < qF1 C 0 e

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.cs_neg.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.cs_neg
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.cs_neg.header:
theorem cs_neg (g : RowGeomD n R a b st ln rowOf) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (C : ℕ) (hC : C + 1 < n)
    {cs : ℝ} {es : Fin n → ℝ} (hes : es ∈ Vsub rowOf) (hne : es ≠ 0) (h0 : qF1 C cs es = 0) : cs < 0

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.vals2.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.vals2
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.vals2.header:
theorem vals2 (M R : ℕ) :
    neA' 2 M R = 4 * (R * M) + 4 * M ∧ neB' 2 M R = 4 * (R * M) + 4 * (CfData.cf * M) ∧
    neA 2 M R = 4 * (R * M) + 4 * (CfData.cf * M) + 4 * M ∧ neB 2 M R = 12 * (R * M) + 4 * (CfData.cf * M) + 16 * M ∧
    neP1 2 M R = 2 * (R * M) + 4 * M ∧ neP0 2 M R = R * M + 4 * M ∧
    neQ1 2 M R = 14 * (R * M) + 4 * (CfData.cf * M) + 16 * M ∧ neQ0 2 M R = 15 * (R * M) + 4 * (CfData.cf * M) + 16 * M ∧
    neN 2 M R = 16 * (R * M) + 8 * (CfData.cf * M) + 24 * M ∧ neLo M R = 2 * (R * M) + CfData.cf * M + 2 * M

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.neC0_val2.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.neC0_val2
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.neC0_val2.header: theorem neC0_val2 (hM : 0 < M) : neC0 2 M R + 1 = 4 * (R * M) + 4 * M + 2 * (CfData.cf * M) - 2 * M

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.layer_isRow2.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.layer_isRow2
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.layer_isRow2.header:
theorem layer_isRow2 (hg : NGeo 2 M R) (hdvd : 2 ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) :
    isRowN 2 M R 2 (neC0 2 M R + 1) ∧ isRowN 2 M R 2 (neC0 2 M R + 1 - 4)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.layer_rows2.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.layer_rows2
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.layer_rows2.header:
theorem layer_rows2 (hg : NGeo 2 M R) (hdvd : 2 ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) :
    ∃ i0, i0 + 1 < RN hg ∧ neP0 2 M R + stN 2 M R i0 = neC0 2 M R + 1 - 4 ∧ lnN 2 M R i0 = 4 ∧ lnN 2 M R (i0 + 1) = 4

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.win_isRow2.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.win_isRow2
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.win_isRow2.header:
theorem win_isRow2 (hg : NGeo 2 M R) (hM4 : 4 ≤ M) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ 3) :
    isRowN 2 M R 2 (4 * (neLo M R + k))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.window_rows2.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.window_rows2
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.window_rows2.header:
theorem window_rows2 (hg : NGeo 2 M R) (hM4 : 4 ≤ M) :
    ∃ i1, R * M ≤ i1 ∧ i1 + 3 + R * M < RN hg ∧ (∀ k, k ≤ 3 → lnN 2 M R (i1 + k) = 4) ∧
      (∀ k, k ≤ 3 → neP0 2 M R + stN 2 M R (i1 + k) = 4 * (neLo M R + k))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.f0pair.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.f0pair
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.f0pair.header: noncomputable def f0pair (hg : NGeo 2 M R) (i1 p : ℕ) (hp : i1 + p + 1 < RN hg) : Fin (nN 2 M R) → ℝ

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_f0pair.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_f0pair
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.BF1_f0pair.header:
theorem BF1_f0pair (hg : NGeo 2 M R) (Cc : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (es : Fin (nN 2 M R) → ℝ) {i1 p : ℕ} (hp : i1 + p + 1 < RN hg) :
    BF1 Cc c es (f0pair hg i1 p hp) = rowMu1 Cc c es (stN 2 M R) (i1 + p) - rowMu1 Cc c es (stN 2 M R) (i1 + p + 1)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.chain_instance.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.chain_instance
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.chain_instance.header:
theorem chain_instance (hdvd : 2 ∣ M) (hM4 : 4 ≤ M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) :
    ∃ cs : ℝ, -4 / 5 < cs ∧ cs < 0 ∧
      (∀ e : Fin (nN 2 M R) → ℝ, e ∈ Vsub (rowOfN 2 M R) → 0 ≤ qF1 (neC0 2 M R - neP0 2 M R) cs e) ∧
      (∀ c : ℝ, cs < c → c ≤ 1 → ∀ e : Fin (nN 2 M R) → ℝ, e ∈ Vsub (rowOfN 2 M R) → e ≠ 0 →
        0 < qF1 (neC0 2 M R - neP0 2 M R) c e) ∧
      ∃ es : Fin (nN 2 M R) → ℝ, es ∈ Vsub (rowOfN 2 M R) ∧ es ≠ 0 ∧ qF1 (neC0 2 M R - neP0 2 M R) cs es = 0 ∧
        ∃ i1 p : ℕ, (p = 0 ∨ p = 2) ∧ R * M ≤ i1 ∧ i1 + 3 + R * M < RN (nGeo_two (le_refl 2) hdvd (by omega) hR) ∧
          (∀ k, k ≤ 3 → lnN 2 M R (i1 + k) = 4) ∧ (∀ k, k ≤ 3 → neP0 2 M R + stN 2 M R (i1 + k) = 4 * (neLo M R + k)) ∧
          ∃ hp : i1 + p + 1 < RN (nGeo_two (le_refl 2) hdvd (by omega) hR),
            BF1 (neC0 2 M R - neP0 2 M R) cs es (f0pair (nGeo_two (le_refl 2) hdvd (by omega) hR) i1 p hp) ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_cont_c.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_cont_c
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qF1_cont_c.header: theorem qF1_cont_c (C : ℕ) (e : Fin n → ℝ) : Continuous (fun c : ℝ => qF1 C c e)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.trial_neg.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.trial_neg
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.trial_neg.header:
theorem trial_neg (C : ℕ) (cs : ℝ) (es f0 : Fin n → ℝ) (hqes : qF1 C cs es = 0) (hΩ : BF1 C cs es f0 ≠ 0) (M0 : ℝ) :
    ∃ τ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, cs < c → c < cs + ε → qF1 C c (f0 + τ • es) < M0

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zfield_smul.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zfield_smul
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zfield_smul.header: theorem zfield_smul (r : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) : (zfield (r • f) : BondFnL2 L) = r • zfield f

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zfield_zero.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zfield_zero
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zfield_zero.header: theorem zfield_zero : (zfield (0 : ℕ → ℝ) : BondFnL2 L) = 0

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zrow_add.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zrow_add
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zrow_add.header: theorem zrow_add (G : TowerGeom L) (ρ ρ' : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) : zrow G (ρ + ρ') = zrow G ρ + zrow G ρ'

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zrow_smul.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zrow_smul
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zrow_smul.header: theorem zrow_smul (G : TowerGeom L) (r : ℝ) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) : zrow G (r • ρ) = r • zrow G ρ

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.WZ.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.WZ
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.WZ.header: def WZ (G : TowerGeom L) : Submodule ℝ ↥(bondSupp G)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ZF.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ZF
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ZF.header: def ZF (G : TowerGeom L) : Submodule ℝ (FSp G)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.dgS_eq_zero.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.dgS_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.dgS_eq_zero.header: theorem dgS_eq_zero {a : ℝ} (h : dgS a = 0) : a = 0

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zrow_rows_zero.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zrow_rows_zero
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zrow_rows_zero.header:
theorem zrow_rows_zero (hg : NGeo ell M R) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (h : zrow (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) ρ = 0) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ 2 → ∀ r, isRowN ell M R j r → ρ j r = 0

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.row_level.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.row_level
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.row_level.header:
theorem row_level (hg : NGeo ell M R) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < RN hg) :
    ∃ j, j ≤ 2 ∧ isRowN ell M R j (neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R i) ∧ lnN ell M R i = ell ^ j

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.rowsum_eq_fSum.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.rowsum_eq_fSum
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.rowsum_eq_fSum.header:
theorem rowsum_eq_fSum (hg : NGeo ell M R) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < RN hg) (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ) :
    ∃ j, j ≤ 2 ∧ isRowN ell M R j (neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R i) ∧
      ∑ x ∈ (univ.filter (fun x : Fin (nN ell M R) => rowOfN ell M R x.val = i)), e x =
        fSum ell j (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) (neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R i)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.chainOf.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.chainOf
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.chainOf.header: def chainOf (P0 n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) : Fin n → ℝ

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.fe_chainOf.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.fe_chainOf
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.fe_chainOf.header:
theorem fe_chainOf {P0 n L0 : ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : ∀ v, v ≤ L0 → ¬ (P0 ≤ v ∧ v < P0 + n) → f v = 0) {v : ℕ}
    (hvL : v ≤ L0) : fe P0 (chainOf P0 n f) v = f v

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zfield_vanish_outsi.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zfield_vanish_outside
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zfield_vanish_outsi.header:
theorem zfield_vanish_outside (hg : NGeo ell M R) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (f : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : (zfield f : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) ∈ bondSupp (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R))) (v : ℕ)
    (hv : v ≤ scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R) 0) (hJ : ¬ (neP0 ell M R ≤ v ∧ v < neQ0 ell M R)) : f v = 0

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.wz_chain.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.wz_chain
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.wz_chain.header:
theorem wz_chain (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) {d : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)))} (hd : d ∈ WZ (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)))
    (hQ : (Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).data.Q d = 0) :
    ∃ e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ, e ∈ Vsub (rowOfN ell M R) ∧ d = xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.G1inv_zfield_gen.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.G1inv_zfield_gen
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.G1inv_zfield_gen.header:
theorem G1inv_zfield_gen (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) (f : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : (zfield f : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) ∈ bondSupp (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R))) :
    (((Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).G1inv ⟨zfield f, hf⟩ :
        ↥(bondSupp (Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).G)) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) =
      zfield (ginvProf0 ell (isRowN ell M R) (fun v => neP0 ell M R ≤ v ∧ v < neQ0 ell M R) (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R) 0)
        (neC0 ell M R) t a f)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.G1inv_mem_WZ.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.G1inv_mem_WZ
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.G1inv_mem_WZ.header:
theorem G1inv_mem_WZ (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) {x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)))} (hx : x ∈ WZ (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R))) :
    (Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).G1inv x ∈ WZ (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qs_mem_WZ.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qs_mem_WZ
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qs_mem_WZ.header:
theorem Qs_mem_WZ (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) {z : FSp (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R))} (hz : z ∈ ZF (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R))) :
    (Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).data.Qs z ∈ WZ (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Q_mem_ZF.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Q_mem_ZF
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Q_mem_ZF.header:
theorem Q_mem_ZF (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) {x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)))} (hx : x ∈ WZ (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R))) :
    (Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).data.Q x ∈ ZF (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Kz_eq.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Kz_eq
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Kz_eq.header:
theorem Kz_eq (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ (zfield (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))
        (zfield (CoverOmega.Wt ell (isRowN ell M R) (fun j u => a * fSum ell j (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) u))) : ℝ) =
      (inner ℝ ((Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).data.Q (xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e))
        (diagW (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) (massW (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) a)
          ((Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).data.Q (xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e))) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zblock_ineq.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zblock_ineq
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zblock_ineq.header:
theorem zblock_ineq (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2)
    (hG1 : IsUnit (Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).G1inv)
    (hN : IsUnit (GenP.Nmat (Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a)))
    (hpsd : ∀ e' : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ, e' ∈ Vsub (rowOfN ell M R) → 0 ≤ qF1 (neC0 ell M R - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos (2 * t)) e')
    (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ ((Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).data.Q (xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e))
        (Ring.inverse (GenP.Nmat (Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a))
          ((Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).data.Q (xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e))) : ℝ) ≤
      c0 * ((((scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) 1 + 1) * ((scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) 2 + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        qF1 (neC0 ell M R - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos (2 * t)) e +
      (inner ℝ ((Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).data.Q (xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e))
        (diagW (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) (massW (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) a)
          ((Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).data.Q (xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e))) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.sum_site_prod.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.sum_site_prod
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.sum_site_prod.header:
theorem sum_site_prod (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (φ0 φ1 φ2 : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, φ0 (x 0).val * φ1 (x 1).val * φ2 (x 2).val =
      (∑ v ∈ range (L 0 + 1), φ0 v) * (∑ v ∈ range (L 1 + 1), φ1 v) * (∑ v ∈ range (L 2 + 1), φ2 v)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.sum_range_odd.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.sum_range_odd
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.sum_range_odd.header: theorem sum_range_odd (m : ℕ) : ∑ v ∈ range (2 * m), (if v % 2 = 1 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = m

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.betaPat.header: noncomputable def betaPat (uE : ℕ) (u : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.thetaOf_Bpat.header: theorem thetaOf_Bpat (uE : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : thetaOf (WithLp.ofLp (Bpat uE : BondFnL2 L)) (x, 1) = betaPat uE x

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.sum_betaPat.header:
theorem sum_betaPat (uE : ℕ) (huE : uE + 1 < L 0 + 1) (h1 : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) (h2 : 2 ∣ L 2 + 1) (g : ℕ → ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.rowsum_single.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.rowsum_single
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.rowsum_single.header:
theorem rowsum_single (hg : NGeo 2 M R) {i i' : ℕ} (hi' : i' < RN hg) :
    ∑ y ∈ (univ.filter (fun y : Fin (nN 2 M R) => rowOfN 2 M R y.val = i)),
      (Pi.single (⟨stN 2 M R i', by
        have := stN_strictMono hg hi'; rw [stN_RN hg] at this; exact this⟩ : Fin (nN 2 M R)) (1 : ℝ) : Fin (nN 2 M R) → ℝ) y =
      if i' = i then 1 else 0

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qx_pair.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qx_pair
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qx_pair.header:
theorem Qx_pair (hdvd : 2 ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ) (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) {i1 p uE : ℕ}
    (hp : i1 + p + 1 < RN (nGeo_two (le_refl 2) hdvd hM hR))
    (hlnE : lnN 2 M R (i1 + p) = 4) (hlnO : lnN 2 M R (i1 + p + 1) = 4)
    (hsE : neP0 2 M R + stN 2 M R (i1 + p) = 4 * uE) (hsO : neP0 2 M R + stN 2 M R (i1 + p + 1) = 4 * (uE + 1))
    {es : Fin (nN 2 M R) → ℝ} (hes : es ∈ Vsub (rowOfN 2 M R)) (τ : ℝ) :
    (Pt 2 M R (by norm_num) (neC0 2 M R) t a).data.Q
        (xE (nGeo_two (le_refl 2) hdvd hM hR) (le_refl 2) hM hR (f0pair (nGeo_two (le_refl 2) hdvd hM hR) i1 p hp + τ • es)) =
      zrow (geomOf 2 2 (neS 2 M R)) (rhoY 2 (gbar uE))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.sum_block_prod.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.sum_block_prod
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.sum_block_prod.header:
theorem sum_block_prod (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ell : ℕ) (g0 g1 g2 : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf z 1 ell, g0 (x 0).val * g1 (x 1).val * g2 (x 2).val =
      (∑ n ∈ range (min ell (L 0 + 1 - (z 0).val)), g0 ((z 0).val + n)) *
      (∑ n ∈ range (min ell (L 1 + 1 - (z 1).val)), g1 ((z 1).val + n)) *
      (∑ n ∈ range (min ell (L 2 + 1 - (z 2).val)), g2 ((z 2).val + n))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.pathAng_pat.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.pathAng_pat
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.pathAng_pat.header:
theorem pathAng_pat (uE : ℕ) (hN1 : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    pathAngG 1 (thetaOf (Bpatf (L := L) uE)) x (List.replicate 2 1) =
      2 * (if (x 0).val = uE + 1 then (-1 / 4 : ℝ) else 0) +
        (if (x 0).val = uE then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * (if (x 2).val % 2 = 1 then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.fit_aligned.header:

    (μ : Fin 3) :
    (∀ ν : Fin 3, (y ν).val + 1 * 2 ≤ L ν + 1) ∧ (∀ ν : Fin 3, ((cPlusS 1 2 (y, μ)) ν).val + 1 * 2 ≤ L ν + 1)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Rsig_pat_zero.header:

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.suCoordF_sig.header: theorem suCoordF_sig (Bf : Bond L → SuTwo) (hB : SigB Bf) : suCoordF Bf = aF (thetaOf Bf)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Q1jet_sig.header:
theorem Q1jet_sig {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} {θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ}
    (hV : V0 = cartanOf θ) (hφ : ∀ cc : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf cc.1 1 ell, |loopAngG 1 ell θ cc.1 cc.2 x| < Real.pi)
    (hreg : RegBg2 1 ell V0) (Bf : Bond L → SuTwo) (hB : SigB Bf) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    Q1jet ell V0 Bf c = ((ell : ℝ)⁻¹) • dgS (Rsig 1 ell (thetaOf Bf) (c.1.1, c.2))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.C2tilde_sig.header:

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Pt_unit_cartan.header:
theorem Pt_unit_cartan (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (a t : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) :
    ∃ θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge (neLu M R) → ℝ, (Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).unitBgU = cartanOf θ ∧
      (∀ cc : PeriodicLatticeEdge (neLu M R), ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf cc.1 1 ell, |loopAngG 1 ell θ cc.1 cc.2 x| < Real.pi) ∧
      RegBg2 1 ell (Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).unitBgU

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.tauAdj_zfield_eq.header:
theorem tauAdj_zfield_eq (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (g : ℕ → ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.val_split.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.val_split
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.val_split.header:
theorem val_split (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2)
    (hG1 : IsUnit (Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a).G1inv)
    (hN : IsUnit (GenP.Nmat (Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a)))
    (uE : ℕ) (huE : uE + 1 < neLu M R 0 + 1) (h1 : 2 ∣ neLu M R 1 + 1) (h2 : 2 ∣ neLu M R 2 + 1) :
    (inner ℝ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS ell M R)) (Bpat uE))
      (Ring.inverse (GenP.Nmat (Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a))
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS ell M R)) (Bpat uE))) : ℝ) =
    (inner ℝ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS ell M R)) (zfield (gbar uE)))
      (Ring.inverse (GenP.Nmat (Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a))
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS ell M R)) (zfield (gbar uE)))) : ℝ) +
    (inner ℝ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS ell M R)) (Bperp uE))
      (Ring.inverse (GenP.Nmat (Pt ell M R (by omega) (neC0 ell M R) t a))
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS ell M R)) (Bperp uE))) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.val0_bound.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.val0_bound
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.val0_bound.header:
theorem val0_bound (hdvd : 2 ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ) (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2)
    (hG1 : IsUnit (Pt 2 M R (by norm_num) (neC0 2 M R) t a).G1inv)
    (hN : IsUnit (GenP.Nmat (Pt 2 M R (by norm_num) (neC0 2 M R) t a)))
    (hpsd : ∀ e' : Fin (nN 2 M R) → ℝ, e' ∈ Vsub (rowOfN 2 M R) → 0 ≤ qF1 (neC0 2 M R - neP0 2 M R) (Real.cos (2 * t)) e')
    {i1 p uE : ℕ} (hp : i1 + p + 1 < RN (nGeo_two (le_refl 2) hdvd hM hR))
    (hlnE : lnN 2 M R (i1 + p) = 4) (hlnO : lnN 2 M R (i1 + p + 1) = 4)
    (hsE : neP0 2 M R + stN 2 M R (i1 + p) = 4 * uE) (hsO : neP0 2 M R + stN 2 M R (i1 + p + 1) = 4 * (uE + 1))
    {es : Fin (nN 2 M R) → ℝ} (hes : es ∈ Vsub (rowOfN 2 M R)) (τ : ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt 2 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS 2 M R)) (zfield (gbar uE)))
      (Ring.inverse (GenP.Nmat (Pt 2 M R (by norm_num) (neC0 2 M R) t a))
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt 2 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS 2 M R)) (zfield (gbar uE)))) : ℝ) ≤
      c0 * ((((scaleUp 2 2 (neLu M R)) 1 + 1) * ((scaleUp 2 2 (neLu M R)) 2 + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        qF1 (neC0 2 M R - neP0 2 M R) (Real.cos (2 * t)) (f0pair (nGeo_two (le_refl 2) hdvd hM hR) i1 p hp + τ • es) +
      (inner ℝ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt 2 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS 2 M R)) (zfield (gbar uE)))
        (diagW (geomOf 2 2 (neS 2 M R)) (massW (geomOf 2 2 (neS 2 M R)) a)
          (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt 2 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS 2 M R)) (zfield (gbar uE)))) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.genForm_pat_eq.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.genForm_pat_eq
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.genForm_pat_eq.header:
theorem genForm_pat_eq (hdvd : 2 ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (a t : ℝ) (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) (uE : ℕ) (huE : uE % 2 = 0) :
    GenP.genForm (Pt 2 M R (by norm_num) (neC0 2 M R) t a)
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (Pt 2 M R (by norm_num) (neC0 2 M R) t a) (Bpatf uE))) =
      (Pt 2 M R (by norm_num) (neC0 2 M R) t a).eta *
        (inner ℝ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt 2 2 (neLu M R) (by norm_num) (neS 2 M R)) (Bpat uE))
          (Ring.inverse (GenP.Nmat (Pt 2 M R (by norm_num) (neC0 2 M R) t a))
            (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt 2 2 (neLu M R) (by norm_num) (neS 2 M R)) (Bpat uE))) : ℝ) -
      a * (inner ℝ (Bpat uE : BondFnL2 (neLu M R)) (Bpat uE) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.main_neg_two.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.main_neg_two
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.main_neg_two.header:
theorem main_neg_two (hdvd : 2 ∣ M) (hM4 : 4 ≤ M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hinj : ∀ y : FSp (geomOf 2 2 (neS 2 M R)), (Pt 2 M R (by norm_num) (neC0 2 M R) 0 a).data.Qs y = 0 → y = 0)
    (h0 : UnitsFour (Pt 2 M R (by norm_num) (neC0 2 M R) 0 a)) :
    ∃ uE : ℕ, uE % 2 = 0 ∧ neLo M R ≤ uE ∧ uE + 1 < neLo M R + M ∧
      ∃ t : ℝ, |t| < Real.pi / 2 ∧ GenP.WellDefG (Pt 2 M R (by norm_num) (neC0 2 M R) t a) ∧
        GenP.genForm (Pt 2 M R (by norm_num) (neC0 2 M R) t a)
          (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (Pt 2 M R (by norm_num) (neC0 2 M R) t a) (Bpatf uE))) < 0

AdalyNcwdhTwo.Min.ainv_symm.name: AdalyNcwdhTwo.Min.ainv_symm
AdalyNcwdhTwo.Min.ainv_symm.header:
theorem ainv_symm {A : E →L[ℝ] E} (hAs : ∀ x y, ⟪A x, y⟫ = ⟪x, A y⟫) (hA : IsUnit A) (x y : E) :

AdalyNcwdhTwo.Min.ainv_mem.header:
theorem ainv_mem {A : E →L[ℝ] E} (hA : IsUnit A) (W : Submodule ℝ E) (hAW : ∀ x ∈ W, A x ∈ W) {w : E} (hw : w ∈ W) :
    (Ring.inverse A) w ∈ W

AdalyNcwdhTwo.Min.minPrinciple.name: AdalyNcwdhTwo.Min.minPrinciple
AdalyNcwdhTwo.Min.minPrinciple.header:
theorem minPrinciple {A : E →L[ℝ] E} (hAs : ∀ x y, ⟪A x, y⟫ = ⟪x, A y⟫) (hA : IsUnit A)
    {Q : E →L[ℝ] F} {Qs : F →L[ℝ] E} (hQ : ∀ x y, ⟪Q x, y⟫ = ⟪x, Qs y⟫)
    (hN : IsUnit (Q.comp ((Ring.inverse A).comp Qs)))
    (W : Submodule ℝ E) (Z : Submodule ℝ F) (hAW : ∀ x ∈ W, A x ∈ W) (hQsZ : ∀ z ∈ Z, Qs z ∈ W)
    (hQW : ∀ x ∈ W, Q x ∈ Z) {y : F} (hy : y ∈ Z) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ W) (hQx : Q x = y)
    (hpsd : ∀ d ∈ W, Q d = 0 → 0 ≤ ⟪d, A d⟫) :
    ⟪y, (Ring.inverse (Q.comp ((Ring.inverse A).comp Qs))) y⟫ ≤ ⟪x, A x⟫

AdalyNcwdhTwo.Min.split_inner.name: AdalyNcwdhTwo.Min.split_inner
AdalyNcwdhTwo.Min.split_inner.header:
theorem split_inner {A : E →L[ℝ] E} (hAs : ∀ x y, ⟪A x, y⟫ = ⟪x, A y⟫) (hA : IsUnit A)
    {Q : E →L[ℝ] F} {Qs : F →L[ℝ] E} (hQ : ∀ x y, ⟪Q x, y⟫ = ⟪x, Qs y⟫)
    (hN : IsUnit (Q.comp ((Ring.inverse A).comp Qs)))
    (W : Submodule ℝ E) (Z : Submodule ℝ F) (hAW : ∀ x ∈ W, A x ∈ W) (hQsZ : ∀ z ∈ Z, Qs z ∈ W)
    (hQW : ∀ x ∈ W, Q x ∈ Z) {y0 y1 : F} (hy0 : y0 ∈ Z) (horth : ∀ z ∈ Z, ⟪y1, z⟫ = 0) :
    ⟪y0 + y1, (Ring.inverse (Q.comp ((Ring.inverse A).comp Qs))) (y0 + y1)⟫ =
      ⟪y0, (Ring.inverse (Q.comp ((Ring.inverse A).comp Qs))) y0⟫ +
        ⟪y1, (Ring.inverse (Q.comp ((Ring.inverse A).comp Qs))) y1⟫

AdalyNcwdhTwo.Mono.Hc.header: noncomputable def Hc (H0 B : X →L[ℝ] X) (c : ℝ) : X →L[ℝ] X

AdalyNcwdhTwo.Mono.Phi_apply.name: AdalyNcwdhTwo.Mono.Phi_apply
AdalyNcwdhTwo.Mono.Phi_apply.header: theorem Phi_apply (Q : X →L[ℝ] Y) (Qs : Y →L[ℝ] X) (T : X →L[ℝ] X) : Phi Q Qs T = Q.comp (T.comp Qs)

AdalyNcwdhTwo.Mono.hasDerivAt_Nc.name: AdalyNcwdhTwo.Mono.hasDerivAt_Nc
AdalyNcwdhTwo.Mono.hasDerivAt_Nc.header:
theorem hasDerivAt_Nc (H0 B : X →L[ℝ] X) (Q : X →L[ℝ] Y) (Qs : Y →L[ℝ] X) {c : ℝ} (hc : IsUnit (Hc H0 B c)) :
    HasDerivAt (Nc H0 B Q Qs)
      (Q.comp ((-(Ring.inverse (Hc H0 B c) * B * Ring.inverse (Hc H0 B c))).comp Qs)) c

AdalyNcwdhTwo.Mono.hasDerivAt_phi.header:
theorem hasDerivAt_phi (H0 B : X →L[ℝ] X) (Q : X →L[ℝ] Y) (Qs : Y →L[ℝ] X) (y : Y) {c : ℝ}
    (hH : IsUnit (Hc H0 B c)) (hN : IsUnit (Nc H0 B Q Qs c)) :
    HasDerivAt (phi H0 B Q Qs y)
      ⟪y, (Ring.inverse (Nc H0 B Q Qs c))
        (Q ((Ring.inverse (Hc H0 B c)) (B ((Ring.inverse (Hc H0 B c)) (Qs ((Ring.inverse (Nc H0 B Q Qs c)) y))))))⟫ c

AdalyNcwdhTwo.Mono.deriv_phi_nonneg.header:

    (hH : IsUnit (Hc H0 B c)) (hN : IsUnit (Nc H0 B Q Qs c))
    (hH0 : Sym H0) (hB : Sym B) (hBpsd : ∀ a, 0 ≤ ⟪a, B a⟫) (hQ : ∀ a b, ⟪Q a, b⟫ = ⟪a, Qs b⟫) :
    0 ≤ ⟪y, (Ring.inverse (Nc H0 B Q Qs c))
        (Q ((Ring.inverse (Hc H0 B c)) (B ((Ring.inverse (Hc H0 B c)) (Qs ((Ring.inverse (Nc H0 B Q Qs c)) y))))))⟫

AdalyNcwdhTwo.Mono.monotoneOn_phi.name: AdalyNcwdhTwo.Mono.monotoneOn_phi
AdalyNcwdhTwo.Mono.monotoneOn_phi.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS.header: def mkS (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (a b c : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_val.header: theorem mkS_val (a b c : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : ((mkS L a b c) μ).val = (![a, b, c] μ) % (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_val0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_val0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_val0.header: theorem mkS_val0 (a b c : ℕ) : ((mkS L a b c) 0).val = a % (L 0 + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_val1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_val1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_val1.header: theorem mkS_val1 (a b c : ℕ) : ((mkS L a b c) 1).val = b % (L 1 + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_val2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_val2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_val2.header: theorem mkS_val2 (a b c : ℕ) : ((mkS L a b c) 2).val = c % (L 2 + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_eta.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_eta
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_eta.header: theorem mkS_eta (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : mkS L (x 0).val (x 1).val (x 2).val = x

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_ext.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_ext
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_ext.header:
theorem mkS_ext {a b c a' b' c' : ℕ} (h0 : a % (L 0 + 1) = a' % (L 0 + 1)) (h1 : b % (L 1 + 1) = b' % (L 1 + 1))
    (h2 : c % (L 2 + 1) = c' % (L 2 + 1)) : mkS L a b c = mkS L a' b' c'

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_val_self.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_val_self
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_val_self.header:
theorem shift_val_self (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((periodicLatticeShift x μ) μ).val = ((x μ).val + 1) % (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_val_ne.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_val_ne
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_val_ne.header:
theorem shift_val_ne (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) (h : ν ≠ μ) :
    ((periodicLatticeShift x μ) ν) = x ν

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_mkS0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_mkS0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_mkS0.header: theorem shift_mkS0 (a b c : ℕ) : periodicLatticeShift (mkS L a b c) 0 = mkS L (a + 1) b c

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_mkS1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_mkS1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_mkS1.header: theorem shift_mkS1 (a b c : ℕ) : periodicLatticeShift (mkS L a b c) 1 = mkS L a (b + 1) c

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_mkS2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_mkS2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_mkS2.header: theorem shift_mkS2 (a b c : ℕ) : periodicLatticeShift (mkS L a b c) 2 = mkS L a b (c + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pathSite_mkS0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pathSite_mkS0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pathSite_mkS0.header: theorem pathSite_mkS0 (a b c i : ℕ) : pathSite (mkS L a b c) 0 i = mkS L (a + i) b c

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pathSite_mkS1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pathSite_mkS1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pathSite_mkS1.header: theorem pathSite_mkS1 (a b c i : ℕ) : pathSite (mkS L a b c) 1 i = mkS L a (b + i) c

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pathSite_mkS2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pathSite_mkS2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pathSite_mkS2.header: theorem pathSite_mkS2 (a b c i : ℕ) : pathSite (mkS L a b c) 2 i = mkS L a b (c + i)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_mem_block.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_mem_block
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_mem_block.header:
theorem mkS_mem_block (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ) (hfit : ∀ μ, (Y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1)
    (i j k : ℕ) (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n) (hk : k < n) :
    mkS L ((Y 0).val + i) ((Y 1).val + j) ((Y 2).val + k) ∈ blockOf Y n

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.sum_block_eq_c.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.sum_block_eq_cube
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.sum_block_eq_c.header:
theorem sum_block_eq_cube {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ)
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (Y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1) (F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → E) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf Y n, F x = cube (fun a b c => F (mkS L a b c)) n (Y 0).val (Y 1).val (Y 2).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.bgTower_flat.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.bgTower_flat
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.bgTower_flat.header:
theorem bgTower_flat (G : TowerGeom L) (j : ℕ) :
    bgTower G (flatCfg : Cfg L) j = flatCfg

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.Qfull_flat_row.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.Qfull_flat_row
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.Qfull_flat_row.header:
theorem Qfull_flat_row (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (J : ℕ) (hdvdJ : ∀ ν, G.ell ^ J ∣ L ν + 1)
    (p : BIdx G) (hpJ : (p.1 : ℕ) ≤ J) (hc : p.2.1.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (G.ell ^ (p.1 : ℕ))) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    (QfullOf G (flatCfg : Cfg L) A) p
      = lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo (G.ell ^ (p.1 : ℕ)) (WithLp.ofLp A) ⟨⟨p.2.1.1, hc⟩, p.2.1.2⟩

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lcr_dir0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lcr_dir0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lcr_dir0.header:
theorem lcr_dir0 (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (ξ' : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → SuTwo) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ)
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (Y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1) (hc : Y ∈ CoarseLattice L n)
    (hrel : ∀ a b c, (Y 0).val ≤ a → a < (Y 0).val + 2 * n → (Y 1).val ≤ b → b < (Y 1).val + n →
      (Y 2).val ≤ c → c < (Y 2).val + n → A (mkS L a b c, 0) = ξ' (a + 1) b c - ξ' a b c) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n A ⟨⟨Y, hc⟩, 0⟩
      = (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 4) • (cube ξ' n ((Y 0).val + n) (Y 1).val (Y 2).val - cube ξ' n (Y 0).val (Y 1).val (Y 2).val)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lcr_dir1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lcr_dir1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lcr_dir1.header:
theorem lcr_dir1 (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (ξ' : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → SuTwo) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ)
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (Y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1) (hc : Y ∈ CoarseLattice L n)
    (hrel : ∀ a b c, (Y 0).val ≤ a → a < (Y 0).val + n → (Y 1).val ≤ b → b < (Y 1).val + 2 * n →
      (Y 2).val ≤ c → c < (Y 2).val + n → A (mkS L a b c, 1) = ξ' a (b + 1) c - ξ' a b c) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n A ⟨⟨Y, hc⟩, 1⟩
      = (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 4) • (cube ξ' n (Y 0).val ((Y 1).val + n) (Y 2).val - cube ξ' n (Y 0).val (Y 1).val (Y 2).val)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lcr_dir2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lcr_dir2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lcr_dir2.header:
theorem lcr_dir2 (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (ξ' : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → SuTwo) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ)
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (Y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1) (hc : Y ∈ CoarseLattice L n)
    (hrel : ∀ a b c, (Y 0).val ≤ a → a < (Y 0).val + n → (Y 1).val ≤ b → b < (Y 1).val + n →
      (Y 2).val ≤ c → c < (Y 2).val + 2 * n → A (mkS L a b c, 2) = ξ' a b (c + 1) - ξ' a b c) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n A ⟨⟨Y, hc⟩, 2⟩
      = (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 4) • (cube ξ' n (Y 0).val (Y 1).val ((Y 2).val + n) - cube ξ' n (Y 0).val (Y 1).val (Y 2).val)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.flat_ginv_form.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.flat_ginv_form
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.flat_ginv_form.header:
theorem flat_ginv_form (P : IngrBParams) (hU : P.U = flatCfg) (x : ↥(bondSupp P.G)) :
    ⟪x, P.data.Ginv x⟫ =
      ‖AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.plaqMask (plaqIn P.G.Om0)
        (curlCovariantCLM_L2 (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) P.Lf) (iE P.G x))‖ ^ 2
      + ‖Tfull P.G P.U (iE P.G x)‖ ^ 2
      + ∑ p : BIdx P.G, P.a * (P.ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ) * ‖P.sector.Qfull (iE P.G x) p‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.flat_ginv_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.flat_ginv_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.flat_ginv_zero.header:
theorem flat_ginv_zero (P : IngrBParams) (hU : P.U = flatCfg) (ha : 0 < P.a) (x : ↥(bondSupp P.G))
    (h0 : ⟪x, P.data.Ginv x⟫ = 0) :
    AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.plaqMask (plaqIn P.G.Om0)
        (curlCovariantCLM_L2 (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) P.Lf) (iE P.G x)) = 0
      ∧ Tfull P.G P.U (iE P.G x) = 0 ∧ P.sector.Qfull (iE P.G x) = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.siteMask_eq_se.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.siteMask_eq_self_of_supp
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.siteMask_eq_se.header:
theorem siteMask_eq_self_of_supp (S : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (ξ : SiteL2 L) (h : ∀ x, x ∉ S → ξ x = 0) :

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lapDir_eq_mask.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lapDir_eq_mask_lap
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lapDir_eq_mask.header:
theorem lapDir_eq_mask_lap (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (ξ : SiteL2 L) (h : ∀ x, x ∉ G.Om0 → ξ x = 0) :

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.final_step.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.final_step
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.final_step.header:
theorem final_step (G : TowerGeom L) (ξ : SiteL2 L) (hξ : ξ ∈ NQp G (flatCfg : Cfg L))
    (hT : Tfull G (flatCfg : Cfg L) (gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) ξ) = 0) : gradL2 (flatCfg : Cfg L) ξ = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.PGeo.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.PGeo
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.PGeo.header: structure PGeo (ell M R : ℕ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pgeo.header: theorem pgeo {ell M R : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) : PGeo ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.bondsLam0_of.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.bondsLam0_of

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.curl_flat_appl.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.curl_flat_apply
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.curl_flat_appl.header:

    (curlCovariantCLM_L2 (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) x) p
      = flatCurlValue (WithLp.ofLp x) p

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.vtx_arith.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.vtx_arith
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.vtx_arith.header:
theorem vtx_arith (w0 s N p0 p1 q1 q0 : ℕ) (hw : w0 < N) (hN : q0 ≤ N) (hp0 : 1 ≤ p0)
    (h : s = w0 ∨ s = (w0 + 1) % N) (hs : p1 ≤ s ∧ s < q1) (hp : p0 + 2 ≤ p1) (hq : q1 + 2 ≤ q0) :
    ∀ t, (t = w0 ∨ t = (w0 + 1) % N) → p0 ≤ t ∧ t < q0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_x0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_x0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.shift_x0.header:
theorem shift_x0 (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((periodicLatticeShift z μ) 0).val = if μ = 0 then ((z 0).val + 1) % (L 0 + 1) else (z 0).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.edge_vertex_x0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.edge_vertex_x0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.edge_vertex_x0.header:
theorem edge_vertex_x0 (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    ∀ e ∈ periodicPlaquetteBoundaryEdges p,
      (((e.1 0).val = (p.1 0).val ∨ (e.1 0).val = ((p.1 0).val + 1) % (L 0 + 1)) ∧
       (((periodicLatticeShift e.1 e.2) 0).val = (p.1 0).val ∨ ((periodicLatticeShift e.1 e.2) 0).val = ((p.1 0).val + 1) % (L 0 + 1)))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.edge_vertex_x0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.edge_vertex_x0'
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.edge_vertex_x0.header:
theorem edge_vertex_x0' (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (n : ℕ) (hn : L 0 + 1 = n) :
    ∀ e ∈ periodicPlaquetteBoundaryEdges p,
      (((e.1 0).val = (p.1 0).val ∨ (e.1 0).val = ((p.1 0).val + 1) % n) ∧
       (((periodicLatticeShift e.1 e.2) 0).val = (p.1 0).val ∨ ((periodicLatticeShift e.1 e.2) 0).val = ((p.1 0).val + 1) % n))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.plaq_of_touch.header:
theorem plaq_of_touch (hP : PGeo ell M R) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.KD.curl_zero.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.hodge_pot.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.hodge_pot
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.hodge_pot.header:
theorem hodge_pot (A : BondFnL2 L)

    ∃ (φ : SiteL2 L) (c : Fin 3 → SuTwo), ∀ b : Bond L,

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.gpot.header: noncomputable def gpot (φ : SiteL2 L) (c0 : SuTwo) (a b c : ℕ) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.c1_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.c1_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.c1_zero.header:
theorem c1_zero (A : BondFnL2 L) (φ : SiteL2 L) (c : Fin 3 → SuTwo)
    (hb : ∀ b : Bond L, A b = φ (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - φ b.1 + c b.2)
    (a0 b0 : ℕ) (hz : ∀ t, A (mkS L a0 t b0, 1) = 0) : c 1 = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.c2_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.c2_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.c2_zero.header:
theorem c2_zero (A : BondFnL2 L) (φ : SiteL2 L) (c : Fin 3 → SuTwo)
    (hb : ∀ b : Bond L, A b = φ (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - φ b.1 + c b.2)
    (a0 b0 : ℕ) (hz : ∀ t, A (mkS L a0 b0 t, 2) = 0) : c 2 = 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.rel_g.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.rel_g
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.rel_g.header:
theorem rel_g (A : BondFnL2 L) (φ : SiteL2 L) (c : Fin 3 → SuTwo)
    (hb : ∀ b : Bond L, A b = φ (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - φ b.1 + c b.2)
    (h1 : c 1 = 0) (h2 : c 2 = 0) :
    (∀ a b d, A (mkS L a b d, 0) = gpot φ (c 0) (a + 1) b d - gpot φ (c 0) a b d) ∧
    (∀ a b d, A (mkS L a b d, 1) = gpot φ (c 0) a (b + 1) d - gpot φ (c 0) a b d) ∧
    (∀ a b d, A (mkS L a b d, 2) = gpot φ (c 0) a b (d + 1) - gpot φ (c 0) a b d)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.hNL.header: theorem hNL (hP : PGeo ell M R) : scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R) 0 + 1 = neN ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.sh_x0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.sh_x0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.sh_x0.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.bondsLam_trans.header:
theorem bondsLam_trans_iff (hP : PGeo ell M R) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) (μ : Fin 3) (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) :
    (y, μ) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) j ↔ (Crs (ell ^ j) y ∧ isRowN ell M R j (y 0).val)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.bondsLam_dir0_.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.bondsLam_dir0_lvl0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.bondsLam_dir0_.header:
theorem bondsLam_dir0_lvl0 (hP : PGeo ell M R) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))
    (h : (neP0 ell M R ≤ (y 0).val + 1 ∧ (y 0).val + 2 ≤ neP1 ell M R) ∨
         (neQ1 ell M R ≤ (y 0).val ∧ (y 0).val + 1 ≤ neQ0 ell M R)) :
    (y, (0 : Fin 3)) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.bondsLam_dir0_.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.bondsLam_dir0_lvl1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.bondsLam_dir0_.header:
theorem bondsLam_dir0_lvl1 (hP : PGeo ell M R) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))
    (hc : Crs ell y)
    (h : (neP1 ell M R ≤ (y 0).val + ell ∧ (y 0).val + 2 * ell ≤ neA' ell M R) ∨
         (neB' ell M R ≤ (y 0).val ∧ (y 0).val + 2 * ell ≤ neA ell M R) ∨
         (neB ell M R ≤ (y 0).val ∧ (y 0).val + ell ≤ neQ1 ell M R)) :
    (y, (0 : Fin 3)) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) 1

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.bondsLam_dir0_.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.bondsLam_dir0_lvl2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.bondsLam_dir0_.header:
theorem bondsLam_dir0_lvl2 (hP : PGeo ell M R) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))

    (y, (0 : Fin 3)) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) 2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.hNLμ.header: theorem hNLμ (hP : PGeo ell M R) (μ : Fin 3) : scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R) μ + 1 = neN ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_val_lt.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_val_lt
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_val_lt.header:
theorem mkS_val_lt (hP : PGeo ell M R) (a b c : ℕ) (ha : a < neN ell M R) (hb : b < neN ell M R) (hc : c < neN ell M R) :

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_crs.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_crs
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.mkS_crs.header:

    (da : n ∣ a) (db : n ∣ b) (dc : n ∣ c) :
    mkS (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) a b c ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) n

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.row_cube0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.row_cube0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.row_cube0.header:
theorem row_cube0 (hP : PGeo ell M R) {x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))} (hk : KD ell M R x)
    (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → SuTwo)
    (rel0 : ∀ a b d, x (mkS (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) a b d, 0) = g (a + 1) b d - g a b d)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) (Y0 Y1 Y2 : ℕ)
    (h0 : Y0 + ell ^ j ≤ neN ell M R) (h1 : Y1 + ell ^ j ≤ neN ell M R) (h2 : Y2 + ell ^ j ≤ neN ell M R)
    (d0 : ell ^ j ∣ Y0) (d1 : ell ^ j ∣ Y1) (d2 : ell ^ j ∣ Y2)
    (hmem : (mkS (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) Y0 Y1 Y2, (0 : Fin 3)) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) j) :
    cube g (ell ^ j) (Y0 + ell ^ j) Y1 Y2 = cube g (ell ^ j) Y0 Y1 Y2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.row_cube1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.row_cube1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.row_cube1.header:
theorem row_cube1 (hP : PGeo ell M R) {x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))} (hk : KD ell M R x)
    (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → SuTwo)
    (rel1 : ∀ a b d, x (mkS (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) a b d, 1) = g a (b + 1) d - g a b d)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) (Y0 Y1 Y2 : ℕ)
    (h0 : Y0 + ell ^ j ≤ neN ell M R) (h1 : Y1 + ell ^ j ≤ neN ell M R) (h2 : Y2 + ell ^ j ≤ neN ell M R)
    (d0 : ell ^ j ∣ Y0) (d1 : ell ^ j ∣ Y1) (d2 : ell ^ j ∣ Y2)
    (hmem : (mkS (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) Y0 Y1 Y2, (1 : Fin 3)) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) j) :
    cube g (ell ^ j) Y0 (Y1 + ell ^ j) Y2 = cube g (ell ^ j) Y0 Y1 Y2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.row_cube2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.row_cube2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.row_cube2.header:
theorem row_cube2 (hP : PGeo ell M R) {x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))} (hk : KD ell M R x)
    (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → SuTwo)
    (rel2 : ∀ a b d, x (mkS (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) a b d, 2) = g a b (d + 1) - g a b d)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) (Y0 Y1 Y2 : ℕ)
    (h0 : Y0 + ell ^ j ≤ neN ell M R) (h1 : Y1 + ell ^ j ≤ neN ell M R) (h2 : Y2 + ell ^ j ≤ neN ell M R)
    (d0 : ell ^ j ∣ Y0) (d1 : ell ^ j ∣ Y1) (d2 : ell ^ j ∣ Y2)
    (hmem : (mkS (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) Y0 Y1 Y2, (2 : Fin 3)) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) j) :
    cube g (ell ^ j) Y0 Y1 (Y2 + ell ^ j) = cube g (ell ^ j) Y0 Y1 Y2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.nat_chain.header:
theorem nat_chain {E : Type*} (f : ℕ → E) (K : ℕ) (h : ∀ n, n < K → f (n + 1) = f n) :

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.nat_chain_from.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.nat_chain_from
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.nat_chain_from.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.x_zero0.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.x_zero1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.x_zero1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.x_zero1.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.x_zero2.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.x_zero2
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.x_zero2.header:
theorem x_zero2 (hP : PGeo ell M R) (hk : KD ell M R x) (a b d : ℕ) (ha : a < neN ell M R)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.trans_const.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.right_const.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.right_const
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.right_const.header:
theorem right_const (hP : PGeo ell M R) (hk : KD ell M R x) (hpd : PD ell M R x g) :
    ∀ a, neQ1 ell M R ≤ a → a < neN ell M R → ∀ b d, g a b d = g (neQ1 ell M R) 0 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.cube_sub_const.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.cube_sub_const
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.cube_sub_const.header:
theorem cube_sub_const {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → E) (v : E) (n a b c : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.dvd_N1.header: theorem dvd_N1 (hP : PGeo ell M R) : ell ∣ neN ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.chain_apply.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.chain_apply
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.chain_apply.header:
theorem chain_apply (hP : PGeo ell M R) (hk : KD ell M R x) (hpd : PD ell M R x g) :
    (g (neQ1 ell M R) 0 0 - g 0 0 0 = 0) ∧
    (∀ Y0 Y1 Y2, ell ∣ Y0 → ell ∣ Y1 → ell ∣ Y2 → Y1 < neN ell M R → Y2 < neN ell M R →
      ((neP1 ell M R ≤ Y0 ∧ Y0 < neA' ell M R) ∨ (neB' ell M R ≤ Y0 ∧ Y0 < neA ell M R) ∨
        (neB ell M R ≤ Y0 ∧ Y0 < neQ1 ell M R)) →
      cube (fun a b d => g a b d - g 0 0 0) ell Y0 Y1 Y2 = 0) ∧
    (∀ Y0 Y1 Y2, ell ^ 2 ∣ Y0 → ell ^ 2 ∣ Y1 → ell ^ 2 ∣ Y2 → Y1 < neN ell M R → Y2 < neN ell M R →
      ((neA' ell M R ≤ Y0 ∧ Y0 < neB' ell M R) ∨ (neA ell M R ≤ Y0 ∧ Y0 < neB ell M R)) →
      cube (fun a b d => g a b d - g 0 0 0) (ell ^ 2) Y0 Y1 Y2 = 0)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.Qlev_flat_cube.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.Qlev_flat_cube
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.Qlev_flat_cube.header:
theorem Qlev_flat_cube (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (j : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (G.ell ^ j)) (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + G.ell ^ j ≤ L μ + 1) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    Qlev G (flatCfg : Cfg L) j y f
      = (1 / (((G.ell ^ j : ℕ)) : ℝ) ^ 3) •
        cube (fun a b c => (WithLp.ofLp f) (mkS L a b c)) (G.ell ^ j) (y 0).val (y 1).val (y 2).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.xiOf.header: noncomputable def xiOf (ell M R : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → SuTwo) : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))
