AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.right_zero.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.right_zero
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.right_zero.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.dir0_row_lvl0.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.cs_wrap.header:

    (h : neN ell M R ≤ (y 0).val + n) : ((coarseShift y n 0) 0).val = (y 0).val + n - neN ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.dir0_row_lvl1.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.dir0_row_lvl1
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.dir0_row_lvl1.header:
theorem dir0_row_lvl1 (hP : PGeo ell M R) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))
    (h : (y, (0 : Fin 3)) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) 1) :
    Crs ell y ∧
    ((neP1 ell M R ≤ (y 0).val + ell ∧ (y 0).val + 2 * ell ≤ neA' ell M R) ∨
     (neB' ell M R ≤ (y 0).val ∧ (y 0).val + 2 * ell ≤ neA ell M R) ∨
     (neB ell M R ≤ (y 0).val ∧ (y 0).val + ell ≤ neQ1 ell M R))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.dir0_row_lvl2.header:
theorem dir0_row_lvl2 (hP : PGeo ell M R) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))
    (h : (y, (0 : Fin 3)) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) 2) :
    Crs (ell ^ 2) y ∧
    ((neA' ell M R ≤ (y 0).val + ell ^ 2 ∧ (y 0).val + ell ^ 2 ≤ neB' ell M R) ∨
     (neA ell M R ≤ (y 0).val + ell ^ 2 ∧ (y 0).val + ell ^ 2 ≤ neB ell M R))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pathSite_ne.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pathSite_ne
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pathSite_ne.header: theorem pathSite_ne (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) (h : ν ≠ μ) (i : ℕ) : pathSite x μ i ν = x ν

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pathSite_self_.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pathSite_self_val
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pathSite_self_.header:
theorem pathSite_self_val (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.dB.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.dB
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.dB.header: noncomputable def dB (β : Bond L) (v : SuTwo) : BondFnL2 L

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.dB_apply.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.dB_apply
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.dB_apply.header: theorem dB_apply (β : Bond L) (v : SuTwo) (b : Bond L) : (WithLp.ofLp (dB β v)) b = if b = β then v else 0

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.hits.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.hits
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.hits.header: noncomputable def hits (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (β : Bond L) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lcr_single.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lcr_single
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lcr_single.header:
theorem lcr_single (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (hc : Y ∈ CoarseLattice L n)
    (β : Bond L) (v : SuTwo) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n (WithLp.ofLp (dB β v)) ⟨⟨Y, hc⟩, μ⟩ = ((1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 4) * (hits Y μ n β : ℝ)) • v

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.hits_pos.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.hits_pos
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.hits_pos.header:
theorem hits_pos (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    0 < hits Y μ n (pathSite Y μ (n - 1), μ)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.hit_extract.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.hit_extract
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.hit_extract.header:
theorem hit_extract (Y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ' μ : Fin 3) (n n' : ℕ) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hit : 0 < hits Y' μ' n' (pathSite Y μ (n - 1), μ)) :
    μ' = μ ∧ ∃ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (∀ ν, (Y' ν).val ≤ (y ν).val ∧ (y ν).val < (Y' ν).val + n') ∧
      ∃ i, i < n' ∧ (∀ ν, ν ≠ μ → (y ν).val = (Y ν).val) ∧
        ((y μ).val + i) % (L μ + 1) = ((Y μ).val + (n - 1)) % (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.Rw0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.Rw0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.Rw0.header:
def Rw0 (ell M R : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop
  | 0, v => (neP0 ell M R ≤ v + 1 ∧ v + 2 ≤ neP1 ell M R) ∨ (neQ1 ell M R ≤ v ∧ v + 1 ≤ neQ0 ell M R)
  | 1, v => (neP1 ell M R ≤ v + ell ∧ v + 2 * ell ≤ neA' ell M R) ∨ (neB' ell M R ≤ v ∧ v + 2 * ell ≤ neA ell M R) ∨
      (neB ell M R ≤ v ∧ v + ell ≤ neQ1 ell M R)
  | 2, v => (neA' ell M R ≤ v + ell ^ 2 ∧ v + ell ^ 2 ≤ neB' ell M R) ∨ (neA ell M R ≤ v + ell ^ 2 ∧ v + ell ^ 2 ≤ neB ell M R)
  | _, _ => False

theorem row0_cond (hP : PGeo ell M R) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))
    (hb : (Y, (0 : Fin 3)) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) j) :
    Rw0 ell M R j (Y 0).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.row0_cond.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.row0_cond
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.row0_cond.header:
theorem row0_cond (hP : PGeo ell M R) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))
    (hb : (Y, (0 : Fin 3)) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) j) :
    Rw0 ell M R j (Y 0).val

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.rw0_bound.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.rw0_bound
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.rw0_bound.header:
theorem rw0_bound (hP : PGeo ell M R) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) {v : ℕ} (h : Rw0 ell M R j v) :
    v + 2 * ell ^ j ≤ neN ell M R

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.eq_of_window.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.eq_of_window
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.eq_of_window.header: theorem eq_of_window {n a b : ℕ} (ha : n ∣ a) (hb : n ∣ b) (h1 : a ≤ b) (h2 : b < a + n) : a = b

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.site_ext.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.site_ext
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.site_ext.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.nc_dir0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.nc_dir0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.nc_dir0.header:
theorem nc_dir0 (hP : PGeo ell M R) {j j' : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) (hj' : j' ≤ 2) (hjj : j' ≤ j)
    (Y Y' : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))
    (hb : (Y, (0 : Fin 3)) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) j)
    (hb' : (Y', (0 : Fin 3)) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) j')
    (hit : 0 < hits Y' 0 (ell ^ j') (pathSite Y 0 (ell ^ j - 1), 0)) : j' = j ∧ Y' = Y

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.nc_trans.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.nc_trans
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.nc_trans.header:
theorem nc_trans (hP : PGeo ell M R) {j j' : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) (hj' : j' ≤ 2) (hjj : j' ≤ j)
    (Y Y' : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) (μ : Fin 3) (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    (hb : (Y, μ) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) j)
    (hb' : (Y', μ) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) j')
    (hit : 0 < hits Y' μ (ell ^ j') (pathSite Y μ (ell ^ j - 1), μ)) : j' = j ∧ Y' = Y

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.rw0_peak.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.rw0_peak
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.rw0_peak.header:
theorem rw0_peak (hP : PGeo ell M R) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) {v : ℕ} (h : Rw0 ell M R j v) :
    (neP0 ell M R ≤ v + (ell ^ j - 1) ∧ v + (ell ^ j - 1) < neQ0 ell M R) ∨
    (neP0 ell M R ≤ v + ell ^ j ∧ v + ell ^ j < neQ0 ell M R)

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.peak_mem_Om0.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.peak_mem_Om0
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.peak_mem_Om0.header:
theorem peak_mem_Om0 (hP : PGeo ell M R) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2) (Y : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))
    (μ : Fin 3) (hb : (Y, μ) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) j) :
    (pathSite Y μ (ell ^ j - 1), μ) ∈ bondsOm0 (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R))

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.Q_single.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.Q_single
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.Q_single.header:
theorem Q_single (hP : PGeo ell M R) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ) (β : Bond (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) (v : SuTwo)
    (q : BIdx (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R))) :

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lev_le.name: AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lev_le
AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lev_le.header: theorem lev_le (p : BIdx (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R))) : (p.1 : ℕ) ≤ 2

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.pt_unitsFour.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.block_Om0.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverOmegaTwo.lam_crs_fit.header:

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.qs_injective_flat_t.header:

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.pathAngG_stag0φ.header:

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.loopAngG_stag0φ.header:
theorem loopAngG_stag0φ (xs : ℕ) (t : ℝ) {s ell : ℕ} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) :
    loopAngG s ell (stag0φ xs t) y μ x = uPhi s ell (D0 xs) (uSt t) y μ x

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.stag0_hphi0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.stag0_hphi0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.stag0_hphi0.header:
theorem stag0_hphi0 {ell : ℕ} (hN0 : ell ≤ L 0 + 1) (xs : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) :
    ∀ cc : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf cc.1 1 ell, |loopAngG 1 ell (stag0φ xs t) cc.1 cc.2 x| < Real.pi

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.phi1z.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.phi1z
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.phi1z.header: noncomputable def phi1z (ell xs : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.bg1_eq_stag0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.bg1_eq_stag0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.bg1_eq_stag0.header:
theorem bg1_eq_stag0 {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hN0 : ell ≤ L 0 + 1) (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) (hE : 2 ∣ ell)
    {xs : ℕ} (hxs1 : ell ≤ xs) (hxs2 : xs + ell ≤ L 0 + 1) (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) :
    stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp 1 ell (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) = cartanOf (phi1z ell xs t)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.pathAngG_phi1z.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.pathAngG_phi1z
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.pathAngG_phi1z.header:
theorem pathAngG_phi1z (ell xs : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, pathAngG s (phi1z ell xs t) y p = uAng s (Sw0 xs ell (L 0 + 1)) (u1s (L := L) ell t) y p

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.stag0_hphi1.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.stag0_hphi1
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.stag0_hphi1.header:
theorem stag0_hphi1 {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (xs : ℕ) (hNN : ell * ell ≤ L 0 + 1) (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) :
    ∀ cc : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf cc.1 ell ell, |loopAngG ell ell (phi1z ell xs t) cc.1 cc.2 x| < Real.pi

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.stag0_regTower_gen.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.stag0_regTower_gen
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.stag0_regTower_gen.header:
theorem stag0_regTower_gen {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) {xs : ℕ} (hxs1 : ell ≤ xs)
    (hxs2 : xs + ell ≤ L 0 + 1) (hNN : ell * ell ≤ L 0 + 1) (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) :
    RegTower2 ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)) 2

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.stag0_levels_sigma3.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.stag0_levels_sigma3
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.stag0_levels_sigma3.header:
theorem stag0_levels_sigma3 (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) {ell : ℕ} (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hell : 0 < ell) {xs : ℕ} (t : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) (hxs1 : ell ≤ xs) (hxs2 : xs + ell * ell < L 0 + 1) (θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ) :
    QlinCompX ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)) 1 (aF θ) = aF (thetaSeq ell 1 θ) ∧
    QlinCompX ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)) 2 (aF θ) = aF (thetaSeq ell 2 θ) ∧
    C2CompX ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)) 1 (aF θ) = 0 ∧
    C2CompX ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)) 2 (aF θ) = 0

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Z0Hyp.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Z0Hyp
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Z0Hyp.header: structure Z0Hyp (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell xs : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Z0Hyp.regTower.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Z0Hyp.regTower
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Z0Hyp.regTower.header:
theorem Z0Hyp.regTower (Z : Z0Hyp L ell xs t) :
    RegTower2 ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)) 2

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.stag0_QlinCompX_Z.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.stag0_QlinCompX_Z
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.stag0_QlinCompX_Z.header:
theorem stag0_QlinCompX_Z (Z : Z0Hyp L ell xs t) {f : ℕ → ℝ} {θ : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → ℝ} (hθ : FormF 1 f θ) :
    QlinCompX ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)) 1 (aF θ) = aF (thetaSeq ell 1 θ) ∧
    QlinCompX ell (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)) 2 (aF θ) = aF (thetaSeq ell 2 θ) ∧
    FormF ell (fSum ell 1 f) (thetaSeq ell 1 θ) ∧ FormF (ell ^ 2) (fSum ell 2 f) (thetaSeq ell 2 θ)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.QlinB_zfield0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.QlinB_zfield0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.QlinB_zfield0.header:
theorem QlinB_zfield0 (Z : Z0Hyp L ell xs t) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (G : TowerGeom L) (hG : G.ell = ell) :
    (QlinB G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t) 1 (zfield f) : BondFnL2 L) = suCoordInv (aF (thetaSeq ell 1 (thetaF f))) ∧
    (QlinB G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t) 2 (zfield f) : BondFnL2 L) = suCoordInv (aF (thetaSeq ell 2 (thetaF f)))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.QlinB_zfield_apply0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.QlinB_zfield_apply0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.QlinB_zfield_apply0.header:
theorem QlinB_zfield_apply0 (Z : Z0Hyp L ell xs t) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (G : TowerGeom L) (hG : G.ell = ell) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 2)
    (b : Bond L) (hb : Crs (ell ^ j) b.1) :
    ((QlinB G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t) j (zfield f) : BondFnL2 L) b : SuTwo) =
      (if b.2 = 1 then dgS (fSum ell j f (b.1 0).val) else (0 : SuTwo))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qfull_zfield0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qfull_zfield0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qfull_zfield0.header:
theorem Qfull_zfield0 (Z : Z0Hyp L ell xs t) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (G : TowerGeom L) (hG : G.ell = ell) (hk : G.k = 2)
    (hcrs : ∀ p : BIdx G, Crs (ell ^ (p.1 : ℕ)) p.2.1.1) (p : BIdx G) :
    (QfullOf G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t) (zfield f) : FSp G) p =
      ((ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ))⁻¹ • (if p.2.1.2 = 1 then dgS (fSum ell (p.1 : ℕ) f (p.2.1.1 0).val) else (0 : SuTwo))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.C2rawB_sig0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.C2rawB_sig0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.C2rawB_sig0.header:
theorem C2rawB_sig0 (Z : Z0Hyp L ell xs t) (G : TowerGeom L) (hG : G.ell = ell) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 2)
    (A : BondFnL2 L) (hA : SigB (WithLp.ofLp A)) :
    C2rawB G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t) j A = 0

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.C2fullOf_sig0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.C2fullOf_sig0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.C2fullOf_sig0.header:
theorem C2fullOf_sig0 (Z : Z0Hyp L ell xs t) (G : TowerGeom L) (hG : G.ell = ell) (hk : G.k = 2)
    (A : BondFnL2 L) (hA : SigB (WithLp.ofLp A)) :
    C2fullOf G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t) A = 0

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Z0Setup.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Z0Setup
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Z0Setup.header: structure Z0Setup (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell xs : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (G : TowerGeom L) (isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) : Prop

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.QlinB_sig0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.QlinB_sig0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.QlinB_sig0.header:
theorem QlinB_sig0 (Z : Z0Hyp L ell xs t) (G : TowerGeom L) (hG : G.ell = ell) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 2)
    (A : BondFnL2 L) (hA : SigB (WithLp.ofLp A)) :
    QlinB G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t) j A = suCoordInv (aF (thetaSeq ell j (thetaOf (WithLp.ofLp A))))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.pair_levels0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.pair_levels0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.pair_levels0.header:
theorem pair_levels0 {G : TowerGeom L} {isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (S : Z0Setup L ell xs t G isRow)
    (w : BondFnL2 L) (hw : SigB (WithLp.ofLp w)) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ (QfullOf G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t) w) (zrow G ρ) : ℝ) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range 3, (((ell : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹) * c0 *
        ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (if Crs (ell ^ j) y then Hrow isRow ρ j (y 0).val * thetaSeq ell j (thetaOf (WithLp.ofLp w)) (y, 1) else 0)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.pair_Q_zrow0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.pair_Q_zrow0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.pair_Q_zrow0.header:
theorem pair_Q_zrow0 {G : TowerGeom L} {isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (S : Z0Setup L ell xs t G isRow)
    (w : BondFnL2 L) (hw : SigB (WithLp.ofLp w)) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ (QfullOf G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t) w) (zrow G ρ) : ℝ) =
      c0 * ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, thetaOf (WithLp.ofLp w) (x, 1) * CoverOmega.Wt ell isRow ρ (x 0).val

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qfull_adBL0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qfull_adBL0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qfull_adBL0.header:
theorem Qfull_adBL0 (G : TowerGeom L) (w : BondFnL2 L) :
    QfullOf G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t) (adBL (hGauge L) w) = adFL (hGauge L) G (QfullOf G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t) w)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.inner_Q_zrow0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.inner_Q_zrow0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.inner_Q_zrow0.header:
theorem inner_Q_zrow0 {G : TowerGeom L} {isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (S : Z0Setup L ell xs t G isRow)
    (w : BondFnL2 L) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ (QfullOf G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t) w) (zrow G ρ) : ℝ) = inner ℝ w (zfield (CoverOmega.Wt ell isRow ρ))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qfull_zfield_eq_zro.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qfull_zfield_eq_zrow0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qfull_zfield_eq_zro.header:
theorem Qfull_zfield_eq_zrow0 {G : TowerGeom L} {isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (S : Z0Setup L ell xs t G isRow)
    (f : ℕ → ℝ) : QfullOf G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t) (zfield f) = zrow G (fun j v => ((ell : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹ * fSum ell j f v)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qstar_zrow0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qstar_zrow0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Qstar_zrow0.header:
theorem Qstar_zrow0 {G : TowerGeom L} {isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (S : Z0Setup L ell xs t G isRow)
    (ρ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (QfullOf G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t)) (zrow G ρ) = zfield (CoverOmega.Wt ell isRow ρ)

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.MassFull_zfield0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.MassFull_zfield0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.MassFull_zfield0.header:
theorem MassFull_zfield0 {G : TowerGeom L} {isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (S : Z0Setup L ell xs t G isRow)
    (a : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    MassFull G a (bondSectorOf G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t)) (zfield f) =
      zfield (CoverOmega.Wt ell isRow (fun j v => a * fSum ell j f v))

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.omega1.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.omega1
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.omega1.header: noncomputable def omega1 (J : ℕ → Prop) (N0 xs : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (v : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.hω_stag0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.hω_stag0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.hω_stag0.header:
theorem hω_stag0 (hN : 2 ∣ L 1 + 1) (J : ℕ → Prop) (xs : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (if (x, q01) ∈ plaqIn {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L | J (z 0).val} then
        holCos (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (x, q01) else 0) =
      omega1 J (L 0) xs t (x 0).val

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zprof_supp0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zprof_supp0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.zprof_supp0.header:
theorem zprof_supp0 (J : ℕ → Prop) (N xs : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ N) (hJ : ¬ J v) :
    zprof N (omega1 J N xs t) f v = 0

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ginvProf0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ginvProf0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.ginvProf0.header: noncomputable def ginvProf0 (ell : ℕ) (isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) (J : ℕ → Prop) (N0 xs : ℕ) (t a : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (v : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Ginv_zfield0.name: AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Ginv_zfield0
AdalyFormal.NcwdhTwo.Ginv_zfield0.header:
theorem Ginv_zfield0 {G : TowerGeom L} {isRow : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (S : Z0Setup L ell xs t G isRow) (J : ℕ → Prop)
    (hOm : G.Om0 = {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L | J (z 0).val})
    (hrowJ : ∀ j, j ≤ 2 → ∀ v, isRow j (ell ^ j * (v / ell ^ j)) → J v)
    (a : ℝ) (Jf : BondFnL2 L) (f : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : (zfield f : BondFnL2 L) ∈ bondSupp G) :
    (((baseData G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t) a (bondSectorOf G (stag0Cfg (L := L) xs t)) Jf).Ginv ⟨zfield f, hf⟩ : ↥(bondSupp G)) : BondFnL2 L) =
      zfield (ginvProf0 ell isRow J (L 0) xs t a f)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.flatAvg_sig.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.flatQ_sig.header: theorem flatQ_sig (ell : ℕ) : ∀ (j : ℕ) {lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo}, SigFn lam → SigFn (flatQ ell j lam)

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.stepAverage_sig.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.stepAverage_sig
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.stepAverage_sig.header:
theorem stepAverage_sig {V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L} (hV : CartanCfg V)
    (s ell : ℕ) {lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo} (h : SigFn lam) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.Qlev_sig_eq.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.lapDir_sig_eq.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.lapDir_sig_eq
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.lapDir_sig_eq.header:
theorem lapDir_sig_eq (G : TowerGeom L) {U V : Cfg L} (hU : CartanCfg U) (hV : CartanCfg V) {f : SiteL2 L} (hf : SigS f) :

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.NQp_sig_iff.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.NQp_sig_iff
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.NQp_sig_iff.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.RImage_pwDiag.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.Rproj_sig_eq.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.Rproj_sig_eq
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.Rproj_sig_eq.header:

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.diagP_inner_left.header: theorem diagP_inner_left {s : SuTwo} (hs : diagP s = s) (X : SuTwo) : ⟪s, X⟫ = ⟪s, diagP X⟫

AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.Qlev_diagP'.name: AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.Qlev_diagP'
AdalyFormal.CoverJacobi.Qlev_diagP'.header:
theorem Qlev_diagP' (G : TowerGeom L) {U : Cfg L} (hU : CartanCfg U) (j : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (f : SiteL2 L) :

    (Sec Sec0 : BondSector G) (Jf Jf0 : BondFnL2 L)
    (hXU : IsUnit (DelpA G U a + (1 - siteMask G.Om0))) (hXU0 : IsUnit (DelpA G U0 a + (1 - siteMask G.Om0)))
    (hQfl : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, SigB' x → Sec.Qfull x = Sec0.Qfull x)
    (Pl : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) {ω ω0 : ℝ}
    (hω : ∀ p, holCos U p = if p ∈ Pl then ω else 1) (hω0 : ∀ p, holCos U0 p = if p ∈ Pl then ω0 else 1)
    (x' x : ↥(bondSupp G)) (hx' : SigB' (iE G x')) (hx : SigB' (iE G x)) :
    ⟪x', (baseData G U a Sec Jf).Ginv x⟫ =
      ⟪x', (baseData G U0 a Sec0 Jf0).Ginv x⟫ +
        (ω - ω0) * bPl (plaqIn G.Om0) Pl (Wop G U0 a (iE G x')) (Wop G U0 a (iE G x))

    (hWp : ∀ z, ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (bondWt (-ξ) (Wop (geomOf ell k S) U a (bondWt ξ z)))‖
      ≤ kW * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) z‖)
    (hWm : ∀ z, ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) (bondWt ξ (Wop (geomOf ell k S) U a (bondWt (-ξ) z)))‖
      ≤ kW * ‖bondWt (-sigG (geomOf ell k S)) z‖)
    (Ω : ℝ) (hΩ : 0 ≤ Ω)
    (hosc : ∀ p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S), 1 ≤ (p.1 : ℕ) → ∀ e : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      e.1 ∈ AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.Ball p.2.1.1 (AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rhoT ell p.1) → |ξ e.1 - ξ p.2.1.1| ≤ Ω)
    (A B : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S))) :
    |⟪eW (geomOf ell k S) ξ A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data.Delta2 (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data_laws
        (eW (geomOf ell k S) (-ξ) B)⟫|
      ≤ 2 * ((Real.sqrt (Ageo ell θ) * KH) * (400 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * ((12 : ℝ) * M * α₀))) * K2 * Real.exp (2 * Ω)
          * 44217 * ((ell : ℝ) * kW) ^ 2
        * ‖wq S ell k (iE (geomOf ell k S) A)‖ * ‖wq S ell k (iE (geomOf ell k S) B)‖

theorem hHL2_cfg (CH : ℝ) (hCH0 : 0 ≤ CH)
    (hκ : kapN ell B.a B.cs B.Θ B.Δ B.γ (3 * B.θ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) (3 * B.θ * ell) ρ cw Sstar < 1)
    (hcN : ENF (kapN ell B.a B.cs B.Θ B.Δ B.γ (3 * B.θ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) (3 * B.θ * ell) ρ cw Sstar)
        (CQN ell B.a B.cs B.Θ B.Δ B.γ ρ cw) (d3c ell B.a Sstar (3 * B.θ * ell)) cw < 1 / bN)
    (hCH : CHwF (kapN ell B.a B.cs B.Θ B.Δ B.γ (3 * B.θ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) (3 * B.θ * ell) ρ cw Sstar)
        (CQN ell B.a B.cs B.Θ B.Δ B.γ ρ cw) (d3c ell B.a Sstar (3 * B.θ * ell)) cw bN ≤ CH) :
    ∀ (p : BIdx (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S B.U B.a Lam).G) (v : SuTwo), ∃ c : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      ∑ b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu), ((((ell : ℝ) ^ AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k b.1)⁻¹)
        * Real.exp (phiC S ell M R k B.θ c b.1)
        * ‖(iE (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S B.U B.a Lam).G ((gparams ell k Lu hell0 S B.U B.a Lam).data.H
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single p v) : FSp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S B.U B.a Lam).G))) b‖) ^ 2
        ≤ (CH * Real.sqrt (B.a * ell)) ^ 2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k c * ‖v‖ ^ 2

theorem norm_delta124_le (ell m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (K : Coeff124 L ell m) (A : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L (ell * m)) :
    ‖delta124 ell m V K A c‖
      ≤ (1 / (m : ℝ) ^ 4) *
          (∑ u ∈ unitSitesOf ell (ell * m) c.1.1,
            (‖K.E1 c u.1‖ * ‖lineIntegral ell V A c.1.1 (coarseGammaPath ell c.1.1 u.1)‖
             + ‖K.E1 c u.1‖ * ‖lineIntegral ell V A u.1 (List.replicate m c.2)‖
             + ‖K.E2 c u.1‖ *
                 ‖lineIntegral ell V A (cPlus c) (coarseGammaPath ell (cPlus c) (partner c u.1))‖))
        + (1 / (m : ℝ)) * (‖K.E3 c‖ * ‖lineIntegral ell V A c.1.1 (List.replicate m c.2)‖)

AdalyFormal.P409L.localOm0_sub_Om0.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.localOm0_sub_Om0
AdalyFormal.P409L.localOm0_sub_Om0.header:
theorem localOm0_sub_Om0 {ell M R k j p : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R) (hA : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (hD : IsDCube ell M k S j c) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hp : 2 * p ≤ M) :
    localOm0 ell p (bigSide M ell j) j c ⊆ S.Om 0

AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_box_lower.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_box_lower
AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_box_lower.header:
theorem tg_box_lower {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {N ell M A0 A B B0 : ℕ} (hN : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = N)
    (hA0 : A0 + 1 ≤ A) (hAB : A < B) (hBB0 : B ≤ B0) (hAN : A < N)
    (r0 : ℕ) (hr1 : 1 ≤ r0) (hNr : 4 * r0 ≤ N)
    (F : ℕ) (hF : F * M < 2 * r0) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hw0 : (w 0).val = A) (hw1 : (w 1).val = 0)
    (hw2 : (w 2).val = 0) :
    ¬ ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ), i ≤ 1 ∧
      sites ⊆ towerBj (TG A0 A B B0 L) i ∪ towerBj (TG A0 A B B0 L) (i + 1) ∧
      (∃ z : PeriodicLatticeSite L, sites ⊆ siteBox z (F * bigSide M ell i)) ∧
      (cubeR w r0 ∩ (TG A0 A B B0 L).Om 0) ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_setup.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_setup
AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_setup.header:
theorem tg_setup {ell M R : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hLf : ∀ μ, Lf μ + 1 = M * ell * (4 * R + 8)) :
    ∃ A0 A B B0 : ℕ, ∃ w : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf,
      Admissible ell M R 1 (TG A0 A B B0 Lf) ∧ IsDCube ell M 1 (TG A0 A B B0 Lf) 1 w ∧
      (∀ μ, Lf μ + 1 = M * ell * (4 * R + 8)) ∧ A0 + 1 ≤ A ∧ A < B ∧ B ≤ B0 ∧ A < M * ell * (4 * R + 8) ∧
      (w 0).val = A ∧ (w 1).val = 0 ∧ (w 2).val = 0 ∧
      (∃ q : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf, q ∈ towerBj (TG A0 A B B0 Lf) 0) ∧
      (∃ q : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf, q ∈ towerBj (TG A0 A B B0 Lf) 1) ∧
      (∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell 1 < Lf μ + 1) ∧ M ∣ A0 ∧ 0 < A0

AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_local_lower.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_local_lower
AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_local_lower.header:
theorem tg_local_lower {ell M p R : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {A0 A B B0 : ℕ} {w : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hp : 0 < p) (hp2 : 2 * p ≤ M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hN : ∀ μ, Lf μ + 1 = M * ell * (4 * R + 8)) (hA0 : A0 + 1 ≤ A) (hAB : A < B) (hBB0 : B ≤ B0)
    (hAN : A < M * ell * (4 * R + 8)) (hw0 : (w 0).val = A) (hw1 : (w 1).val = 0) (hw2 : (w 2).val = 0) :
    ∀ f : ℕ, f ≤ 10 * ell → ∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)) (i : ℕ),
      DescribedAt ell M f 1 (TG A0 A B B0 Lf) sites i →
        ¬ localOm0 ell p (bigSide M ell 1) 1 w ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.P409L.local_print_fails.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.local_print_fails
AdalyFormal.P409L.local_print_fails.header:
theorem local_print_fails {ell M p R : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hp : 0 < p) (hp2 : 2 * p ≤ M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hLf : ∀ μ, Lf μ + 1 = M * ell * (4 * R + 8)) :
    ∃ (S : Tower Lf) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf), Admissible ell M R 1 S ∧ IsDCube ell M 1 S 1 c ∧
      (∃ q, q ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ q, q ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧
      localOm0 ell p (bigSide M ell 1) 1 c ⊆ printedCube5 (bigSide M ell 1) c ∧
      localOm0 ell p (bigSide M ell 1) 1 c ⊆ S.Om 0 ∧
      ∀ f : ℕ, f ≤ 10 * ell → ∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)) (i : ℕ),
        DescribedAt ell M f 1 S sites i → ¬ localOm0 ell p (bigSide M ell 1) 1 c ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.P409L.cubeR_eq_siteBox.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.cubeR_eq_siteBox
AdalyFormal.P409L.cubeR_eq_siteBox.header: theorem cubeR_eq_siteBox (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (r : ℕ) : cubeR c r = siteBox (zsite c r) (2 * r)

AdalyFormal.P409L.cube5_is_class_box.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.cube5_is_class_box
AdalyFormal.P409L.cube5_is_class_box.header:
theorem cube5_is_class_box {ell M R k j : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hgt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k < L μ + 1)
    (hD : IsDCube ell M k S j c) (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    ∃ i f : ℕ, ((i = j ∧ f = 12) ∨ (i + 1 = j ∧ f = 12 * ell)) ∧ 10 ≤ f ∧
      DescribedAt ell M f k S (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell j) c) i ∧
      IsClassCubeG ell M f k S (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell j) c) i

AdalyFormal.P409L.local_in_class_box.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.local_in_class_box
AdalyFormal.P409L.local_in_class_box.header:
theorem local_in_class_box {ell M R k j p : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hgt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k < L μ + 1)
    (hD : IsDCube ell M k S j c) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hp : 2 * p ≤ M) :
    ∃ i f : ℕ, ((i = j ∧ f = 12) ∨ (i + 1 = j ∧ f = 12 * ell)) ∧
      IsClassCubeG ell M f k S (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell j) c) i ∧
      localOm0 ell p (bigSide M ell j) j c ⊆ printedCube5 (bigSide M ell j) c

AdalyFormal.P409L.local_in_union.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.local_in_union
AdalyFormal.P409L.local_in_union.header:
theorem local_in_union {ell M R k j p : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hgt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k < L μ + 1)
    (hD : IsDCube ell M k S j c) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hp : 2 * p ≤ M) :
    ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ),
      IsClassSetW ell M (12 * ell) k S sites i ∧ UNI.AllC.IsClassUnion ell M k S sites i ∧
      BlockClosed (bigSide M ell i) sites ∧ localOm0 ell p (bigSide M ell j) j c ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.P409L.DescribedAt0.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.DescribedAt0
AdalyFormal.P409L.DescribedAt0.header: def DescribedAt0 (ell M f : ℕ) (S : Tower L) (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) : Prop

AdalyFormal.P409L.j0_print_box.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.j0_print_box
AdalyFormal.P409L.j0_print_box.header:
theorem j0_print_box {ell M R k a : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R) (hA : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (hD : IsDCubePrint ell M k S 0 c) (ha1 : 1 ≤ a) (ha6 : a ≤ 6) :
    DescribedAt0 ell M (2 * a) S (cubeR c (a * M))

AdalyFormal.P409L.j0_print_holds.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.j0_print_holds
AdalyFormal.P409L.j0_print_holds.header:
theorem j0_print_holds {ell M R k p : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R) (hA : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (hD : IsDCubePrint ell M k S 0 c) :
    localOm0 ell p (bigSide M ell 0) 0 c = cubeR c (5 * M) ∧
      DescribedAt0 ell M 10 S (cubeR c (5 * M)) ∧ DescribedAt0 ell M 12 S (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell 0) c)

AdalyFormal.P409L.j0_p396_fails.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.j0_p396_fails
AdalyFormal.P409L.j0_p396_fails.header:
theorem j0_p396_fails {ell M p R : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hLf : ∀ μ, Lf μ + 1 = M * ell * (4 * R + 8)) :
    ∃ (S : Tower Lf) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf), Admissible ell M R 1 S ∧ IsDCube ell M 1 S 0 c ∧
      (∃ q, q ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ q, q ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ (f i : ℕ) (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)), DescribedAt ell M f 1 S sites i) ∧
      ∀ (f i : ℕ) (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)), DescribedAt ell M f 1 S sites i →
        ¬ localOm0 ell p (bigSide M ell 0) 0 c ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.P409L.local_window.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.local_window
AdalyFormal.P409L.local_window.header:
theorem local_window {ell M p R : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hp : 0 < p) (hp2 : 2 * p ≤ M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hLf : ∀ μ, Lf μ + 1 = M * ell * (4 * R + 8)) :
    ∃ (S : Tower Lf) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf), Admissible ell M R 1 S ∧ IsDCube ell M 1 S 1 c ∧
      (∃ q, q ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ q, q ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧
      localOm0 ell p (bigSide M ell 1) 1 c ⊆ printedCube5 (bigSide M ell 1) c ∧
      (∀ f : ℕ, f ≤ 10 * ell → ∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)) (i : ℕ),
        DescribedAt ell M f 1 S sites i → ¬ localOm0 ell p (bigSide M ell 1) 1 c ⊆ sites) ∧
      ∃ i : ℕ, IsClassCubeG ell M (12 * ell) 1 S (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell 1) c) i

AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_nonvacuous.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_nonvacuous.header:
theorem tg_nonvacuous {ell M R : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hLf : ∀ μ, Lf μ + 1 = M * ell * (4 * R + 8)) :
    ∃ (S : Tower Lf) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf), Admissible ell M R 1 S ∧ IsDCube ell M 1 S 1 c ∧
      (∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell 1 < Lf μ + 1) ∧ (∃ q, q ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ q, q ∈ towerBj S 1)

AdalyFormal.P409L.anyr0_print_fails.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.anyr0_print_fails
AdalyFormal.P409L.anyr0_print_fails.header:
theorem anyr0_print_fails {ell M R r0 : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hLf : ∀ μ, Lf μ + 1 = M * ell * (4 * R + 8))
    (hr5 : 5 * bigSide M ell 1 ≤ r0) (hr6 : r0 ≤ 6 * bigSide M ell 1) :
    ∃ (S : Tower Lf) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf), Admissible ell M R 1 S ∧ IsDCube ell M 1 S 1 c ∧
      (∃ q, q ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ q, q ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧
      cubeR c r0 ⊆ printedCube5 (bigSide M ell 1) c ∧ tildeCube 4 (bigSide M ell 1) c ⊆ cubeR c r0 ∧
      ∀ f : ℕ, f + 1 ≤ 10 * ell → ∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)) (i : ℕ),
        DescribedAt ell M f 1 S sites i → ¬ cubeR c r0 ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.P409L.off_eq.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.off_eq
AdalyFormal.P409L.off_eq.header:
theorem off_eq (N a z : ℕ) (ha : a < N) (hz : z < N) :
    (a + N - z) % N = if z ≤ a then a - z else a + N - z

AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_aligned_lower.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_aligned_lower
AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_aligned_lower.header:
theorem tg_aligned_lower {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {N ell M A0 A B B0 a : ℕ} (hN : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = N)
    (hMN : M ∣ N) (hM : 0 < M) (ha1 : 1 ≤ a) (hA0 : A0 + 1 ≤ A) (hAB : A < B) (hBB0 : B ≤ B0) (hAN : A < N)
    (r0 : ℕ) (hr1 : 1 ≤ r0) (hNr : 8 * r0 ≤ N) (hra : M * a < r0)
    (F : ℕ) (hF : F ≤ 2 * a + 1) (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hw0 : (w 0).val = A) (hw1 : (w 1).val = 0) :
    ¬ ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ), i ≤ 1 ∧
      sites ⊆ towerBj (TG A0 A B B0 L) i ∪ towerBj (TG A0 A B B0 L) (i + 1) ∧
      (∃ z : PeriodicLatticeSite L, GridCorner (bigSide M ell i) z ∧ sites ⊆ siteBox z (F * bigSide M ell i)) ∧
      (cubeR w r0 ∩ (TG A0 A B B0 L).Om 0) ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_setup2.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_setup2
AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_setup2.header:
theorem tg_setup2 {ell M R : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hLf : ∀ μ, Lf μ + 1 = M * ell * (4 * R + 8)) :
    ∃ A0 A B B0 : ℕ, ∃ w : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf,
      Admissible ell M R 1 (TG A0 A B B0 Lf) ∧ IsDCube ell M 1 (TG A0 A B B0 Lf) 1 w ∧
      A0 + R * M = A ∧ A = M * ell * R + M * ell ∧ B = 3 * (M * ell * R) + 4 * (M * ell) ∧ B0 = B + R * M ∧
      A0 + 1 ≤ A ∧ A < B ∧ B ≤ B0 ∧ A < M * ell * (4 * R + 8) ∧ B0 < M * ell * (4 * R + 8) ∧
      (w 0).val = A ∧ (w 1).val = 0 ∧ (w 2).val = 0

AdalyFormal.P409L.coord_of_cubeR.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.coord_of_cubeR
AdalyFormal.P409L.coord_of_cubeR.header:
theorem coord_of_cubeR {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {w y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {ρ a : ℕ} (μ : Fin 3)
    (hy : y ∈ cubeR w ρ) (hw : (w μ).val = a) (h1 : ρ ≤ a) (h2 : a + ρ ≤ L μ + 1) :
    a - ρ ≤ (y μ).val ∧ (y μ).val < a + ρ

AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_local_upper.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_local_upper
AdalyFormal.P409L.tg_local_upper.header:
theorem tg_local_upper {ell M R : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hLf : ∀ μ, Lf μ + 1 = M * ell * (4 * R + 8))
    {A0 A B B0 : ℕ} {w : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf}
    (hA0 : A0 + R * M = A) (hA : A = M * ell * R + M * ell) (hB : B = 3 * (M * ell * R) + 4 * (M * ell)) (hB0 : B0 = B + R * M)
    (hw0 : (w 0).val = A) (hw1 : (w 1).val = 0) (hw2 : (w 2).val = 0) :
    DescribedAt ell M (10 * ell + 2) 1 (TG A0 A B B0 Lf) (cubeR w (5 * (M * ell) + M)) 0

AdalyFormal.P409L.local_box_window.name: AdalyFormal.P409L.local_box_window
AdalyFormal.P409L.local_box_window.header:
theorem local_box_window {ell M p R : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hp : 0 < p) (hp2 : 2 * p ≤ M) (hR : 21 * ell ≤ R)
    (hLf : ∀ μ, Lf μ + 1 = M * ell * (4 * R + 8)) :
    ∃ (S : Tower Lf) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf), Admissible ell M R 1 S ∧ IsDCube ell M 1 S 1 c ∧
      (∃ q, q ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ q, q ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧
      (∀ f : ℕ, f ≤ 10 * ell + 1 → ∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)) (i : ℕ),
        DescribedAt ell M f 1 S sites i → ¬ localOm0 ell p (bigSide M ell 1) 1 c ⊆ sites) ∧
      ∃ sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf), DescribedAt ell M (10 * ell + 2) 1 S sites 0 ∧
        localOm0 ell p (bigSide M ell 1) 1 c ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.G1inv_form_eq_Phi.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.G1inv_form_eq_Phi
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.G1inv_form_eq_Phi.header:
theorem G1inv_form_eq_Phi (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ⟪(⟨y, bondSupp_G ell k Lu y⟩ : ↥(bondSupp (PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).G)),
        (PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).G1inv ⟨y, bondSupp_G ell k Lu y⟩⟫
      = PhiF ell k Lu a (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y
        + ‖Rproj (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (gradAdj (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hflat_ported.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hflat_ported
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hflat_ported.header:
theorem hflat_ported (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    min a 1 / 1000 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * k)) *
      (PhiF ell k Lu a (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y
        + ‖Rproj (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (gradAdj (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) y)‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.scaleUp_dvd.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.scaleUp_dvd
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.scaleUp_dvd.header:
theorem scaleUp_dvd (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.geomOf_eq_fullGeom.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.geomOf_eq_fullGeom
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.geomOf_eq_fullGeom.header:
theorem geomOf_eq_fullGeom {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell k : ℕ) (S : Tower L)
    (hle : ∀ j, j ≤ k → S.Om j = Set.univ) (hgt : ∀ j, k < j → S.Om j = ∅) :
    geomOf ell k S = fullGeom L ell k

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.GF_eq_fullGeom.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.GF_eq_fullGeom
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.GF_eq_fullGeom.header:
theorem GF_eq_fullGeom (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    GF ell k Lu = fullGeom (scaleUp ell k Lu) ell k

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.site_coercive_GF.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.site_coercive_GF
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.site_coercive_GF.header:
theorem site_coercive_GF (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hU : frobSupBond U ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (hT : ∀ i, i < k → frobSupBond (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U i) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (f : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    (1 - 216 * ρ ^ 2) * ‖f‖ ^ 2
      ≤ max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * ⟪f, DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a f⟫

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.mM_pos.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.mM_pos
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.mM_pos.header:
theorem mM_pos (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) :
    0 < max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hu_ported.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hu_ported
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hu_ported.header:
theorem hu_ported (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : 216 * ρ ^ 2 < 1)
    (hU : frobSupBond U ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (hT : ∀ i, i < k → frobSupBond (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U i) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) :
    IsUnit (DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a + (1 - siteMask (GF ell k Lu).Om0))

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.poincare_ported.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.poincare_ported
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.poincare_ported.header:
theorem poincare_ported (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : 216 * ρ ^ 2 < 1)
    (hU : frobSupBond U ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (hT : ∀ i, i < k → frobSupBond (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U i) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) :
    ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) U,
      ‖ν‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 / (1 - 216 * ρ ^ 2))
        * ‖AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.gradL2 U ν‖

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.trivialU_tower_zer.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.trivialU_tower_zero
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.trivialU_tower_zer.header:
theorem trivialU_tower_zero (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (i : ℕ) :
    frobSupBond (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) i) ≤ 0

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hu_flat.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hu_flat
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hu_flat.header:
theorem hu_flat (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    IsUnit (DelpA (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) a + (1 - siteMask (GF ell k Lu).Om0))

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.poincare_flat.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.poincare_flat
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.poincare_flat.header:
theorem poincare_flat (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)),
      ‖ν‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2)
        * ‖AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.gradL2 (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ν‖

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.site_coercive_GF_g.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.site_coercive_GF_gen
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.site_coercive_GF_g.header:
theorem site_coercive_GF_gen (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (α E : ℝ)
    (hU : frobSupBond U ≤ α / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) (δ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hδ : ∀ i, i < k → frobSupBond (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U i) ≤ δ i)
    (hE : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ i ≤ E)
    (f : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    (1 - 72 * α ^ 2 - 4 * E ^ 2) * ‖f‖ ^ 2
      ≤ max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * ⟪f, DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a f⟫

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hu_gen.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hu_gen
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hu_gen.header:
theorem hu_gen (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (α E : ℝ) (hpos : 72 * α ^ 2 + 4 * E ^ 2 < 1)
    (hU : frobSupBond U ≤ α / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) (δ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hδ : ∀ i, i < k → frobSupBond (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U i) ≤ δ i)
    (hE : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ i ≤ E) :
    IsUnit (DelpA (GF ell k Lu) U a + (1 - siteMask (GF ell k Lu).Om0))

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.poincare_gen.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.poincare_gen
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.poincare_gen.header:
theorem poincare_gen (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (α E : ℝ) (hpos : 72 * α ^ 2 + 4 * E ^ 2 < 1)
    (hU : frobSupBond U ≤ α / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) (δ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hδ : ∀ i, i < k → frobSupBond (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U i) ≤ δ i)
    (hE : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ i ≤ E) :
    ∀ ν ∈ NQp (GF ell k Lu) U,
      ‖ν‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 / (1 - 72 * α ^ 2 - 4 * E ^ 2))
        * ‖AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.gradL2 U ν‖

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.theta_ported.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.theta_ported
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.theta_ported.header:
theorem theta_ported (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) {α₀ : ℝ}
    (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hpl : AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.PlaqDef α₀ U) (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    |AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc U (plaqIn (GF ell k Lu).Om0) x x|
      ≤ (272 * α₀) * ‖x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.norm_frob_eq.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.norm_frob_eq
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.norm_frob_eq.header: theorem norm_frob_eq (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : ‖M‖ = frobNorm M

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.exists_chart_radiu.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.exists_chart_radius
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.exists_chart_radiu.header: theorem exists_chart_radius : ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ g : M2, frobNorm (g - 1) < r → g ∈ LogReg

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.regTower_of_frobSu.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.regTower_of_frobSup
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.regTower_of_frobSu.header:
theorem regTower_of_frobSup {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (J : ℕ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hV : ∀ j, j < J → frobSupBond (bg j) ≤ ε j)
    (rL : ℝ) (hrL : ∀ g : M2, frobNorm (g - 1) < rL → g ∈ LogReg)
    (hr : ∀ j, j < J → (8 * (ell : ℝ) - 6) * ε j < rL) :
    RegTower ell bg J

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.frobSup_bgTower_le.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.frobSup_bgTower_le
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.frobSup_bgTower_le.header:
theorem frobSup_bgTower_le {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (U : Cfg L) (j : ℕ) :
    frobSupBond (bgTower G U j)
      ≤ (AdalyFormal.Balaban.ClassPropagationUbar.blkConstOf G.ell) ^ j * frobSupBond U

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.Ns_Qcomposite_le.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.Ns_Qcomposite_le
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.Ns_Qcomposite_le.header:
theorem Ns_Qcomposite_le (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantOperators.SuTwo) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, Ns (ell ^ j) (Qcomposite bg ell j f) ≤ Ns 1 f

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.bgTower_trivialU.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.bgTower_trivialU
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.bgTower_trivialU.header:
theorem bgTower_trivialU {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : TowerGeom L) (j : ℕ) :
    bgTower G (trivialU L) j = trivialU L

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.mem_Lam_k_iff.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.mem_Lam_k_iff
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.mem_Lam_k_iff.header:
theorem mem_Lam_k_iff (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    x ∈ (GF ell k Lu).Lam (GF ell k Lu).k ↔ x ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ k)

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.coarseC_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.coarseC_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.coarseC_norm_sq.header:
theorem coarseC_norm_sq (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantOperators.SuTwo) :
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun y : {y // y ∈ (GF ell k Lu).Lam (GF ell k Lu).k} => g y.1) : coarseC (GF ell k Lu))‖ ^ 2
      = ∑ y ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ k), ‖g y‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.Ns_sq_coarse.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.Ns_sq_coarse
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.Ns_sq_coarse.header:
theorem Ns_sq_coarse (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantOperators.SuTwo) :
    Ns (ell ^ k) g ^ 2 = ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3 *
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun y : {y // y ∈ (GF ell k Lu).Lam (GF ell k Lu).k} => g y.1) : coarseC (GF ell k Lu))‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.Qtop_eq.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.Qtop_eq
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.Qtop_eq.header:
theorem Qtop_eq (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (f : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f
      = WithLp.toLp 2 (fun y : {y // y ∈ (GF ell k Lu).Lam (GF ell k Lu).k} =>
          Qcomposite (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) ell k (WithLp.ofLp f) y.1)

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hQq_ported.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hQq_ported
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hQq_ported.header:
theorem hQq_ported (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (f : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ‖Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3) * ‖f‖

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hQdrift_ported.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hQdrift_ported
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.hQdrift_ported.header:
theorem hQdrift_ported (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ : ∀ i, i < k → frobSupBond (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U i) ≤ δ i)
    (f : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ‖Qtop (GF ell k Lu) U f - Qtop (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) f‖
      ≤ (Real.sqrt (1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ i) * ‖f‖

AdalyFormal.PortSlice.ginv_coercive_port.name: AdalyFormal.PortSlice.ginv_coercive_ported
AdalyFormal.PortSlice.ginv_coercive_port.header:
theorem ginv_coercive_ported (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
                                                                  
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : 216 * ρ ^ 2 < 1)
    (hU : frobSupBond U ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (hT : ∀ i, i < k → frobSupBond (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U i) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (rL : ℝ) (hrL : ∀ g : M2, frobNorm (g - 1) < rL → g ∈ LogReg)
    (hchart : ∀ j, j < k → (8 * (ell : ℝ) - 6) * (ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ j / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) < rL)
                             
    (α₀ : ℝ) (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α₀) (hpl : AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.PlaqDef α₀ U)
                                              
    (t δm : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (hδm : 0 ≤ δm)
    (hC1 : ∀ x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      ∑ p : BIdx (GF ell k Lu), a * ((GF ell k Lu).ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ) *
        ‖(bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p - (bondSectorOf (GF ell k Lu) U).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2
        ≤ δm ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
                            
    (aE bE : ℝ) (haE : 0 ≤ aE) (hbE : 0 ≤ bE)
    (E1 : coarseC (GF ell k Lu) →L[ℝ] SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hQE : ∀ w, Qtop (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU _) (E1 w) = w)
    (hEa : ∀ w, ‖E1 w‖ ≤ aE * ‖w‖) (hEb : ∀ w, ‖gradL2 (trivialU _) (E1 w)‖ ≤ bE * ‖w‖)
                                                                        
    (nsq c1 e P PU δ q ε0 : ℝ)
    (hnsq : nsq = (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * k)) (hc1 : c1 = min a 1 / 1000)
    (he : e = (1 + t) * (272 * α₀) + (1 + 1 / t) * ((4 * Real.sqrt 2 * (ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)) ^ 2 + δm ^ 2))
    (hP : P = Real.sqrt (max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2))
    (hPU : PU = Real.sqrt (max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 / (1 - 216 * ρ ^ 2)))
    (hδ : δ = Real.sqrt 12 * (ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ k))
    (hq : q = Real.sqrt (1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3))
    (hε0 : ε0 = q * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * (ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ k))
    (hεa : ε0 * aE < 1)
    (hsmall : nsq * ((((bE + δ * aE) / (1 - ε0 * aE)) * q) * (δ * P + (((bE + δ * aE) / (1 - ε0 * aE)) * q) * P ^ 2
        * (δ + ((bE + δ * aE) / (1 - ε0 * aE)) * ε0)) + δ) ^ 2 + nsq * e < c1)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp (GF ell k Lu))) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ max (2 / ((c1 - nsq * ((((bE + δ * aE) / (1 - ε0 * aE)) * q) * (δ * P
        + (((bE + δ * aE) / (1 - ε0 * aE)) * q) * P ^ 2 * (δ + ((bE + δ * aE) / (1 - ε0 * aE)) * ε0)) + δ) ^ 2
        - nsq * e) / (1 + t) / nsq)) (2 * PU ^ 2) *
      ⟪x, (IngrBParams.data ⟨ell, k, Lu, (by omega : 0 < ell), fullTower ell k Lu, U, a, Lam⟩).Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_sq_const.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_sq_constBond
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_sq_const.header:
theorem norm_sq_constBond (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (c : Fin 3 → SuTwo) :
    ‖constBond L c‖ ^ 2 = (∏ μ : Fin 3, ((L μ : ℝ) + 1)) * ∑ μ : Fin 3, ‖c μ‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_sq_const.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_sq_constBond_scaleUp
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_sq_const.header:
theorem norm_sq_constBond_scaleUp (hell : 0 < ell) (c : Fin 3 → SuTwo) :
    ‖constBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) c‖ ^ 2 = (ell : ℝ) ^ (3 * k) * ‖Bconst Lu c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.constMode_for.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.constMode_form
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.constMode_for.header:
theorem constMode_form (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ) (c : Fin 3 → SuTwo) :
    ⟪(⟨constBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) c, bondSupp_G ell k Lu _⟩ : ↥(bondSupp (PP).G)),
      (PP).G1inv ⟨constBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) c, bondSupp_G ell k Lu _⟩⟫
      = a * (ell : ℝ) ^ k * ‖Bconst Lu c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.flat_Ginv_con.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.flat_Ginv_const_mode
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.flat_Ginv_con.header:
theorem flat_Ginv_const_mode (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ) (c : Fin 3 → SuTwo) :
    ⟪(⟨constBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) c, bondSupp_G ell k Lu _⟩ : ↥(bondSupp (PP).G)),
      (PP).G1inv ⟨constBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) c, bondSupp_G ell k Lu _⟩⟫ * (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * k)
      = a * ‖(⟨constBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) c, bondSupp_G ell k Lu _⟩ : ↥(bondSupp (PP).G))‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.constBond_ne_.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.constBond_ne_zero
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.constBond_ne_.header:
theorem constBond_ne_zero (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (X : SuTwo) (hX : X ≠ 0) :
    constBond L (fun _ => X) ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coercivity_co.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coercivity_constant_le
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coercivity_co.header:
theorem coercivity_constant_le (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ x : ↥(bondSupp (PP).G), c * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, (PP).G1inv x⟫) :
    c * (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) ≤ a

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.no_k_uniform_.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.no_k_uniform_coercivity
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.no_k_uniform_.header:
theorem no_k_uniform_coercivity (ell : ℕ) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ x : ↥(bondSupp (PK ell k Lu (by omega) a Set.univ).G), x ≠ 0 ∧
      ⟪x, (PK ell k Lu (by omega) a Set.univ).G1inv x⟫ < c * ‖x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eb.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eb
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.eb.header: noncomputable def eb : OrthonormalBasis JJ ℝ SuTwo

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd.header: noncomputable def crd (v : SuTwo) (j : JJ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_add.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_add
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_add.header: theorem crd_add (v w : SuTwo) (j : JJ) : crd (v + w) j = crd v j + crd w j

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_sub.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_sub
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_sub.header: theorem crd_sub (v w : SuTwo) (j : JJ) : crd (v - w) j = crd v j - crd w j

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_smul.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_smul
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_smul.header: theorem crd_smul (c : ℝ) (v : SuTwo) (j : JJ) : crd (c • v) j = c * crd v j

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_sq_crd.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_sq_crd
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_sq_crd.header: theorem norm_sq_crd (v : SuTwo) : ‖v‖ ^ 2 = ∑ j, (crd v j) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coordB.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coordB
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coordB.header: noncomputable def coordB (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (j : JJ) : TB L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coordB_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coordB_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coordB_apply.header:
theorem coordB_apply (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (j : JJ) (p : Site L × Fin 3) :
    coordB A j p = ((crd (A p) j : ℝ) : ℂ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_bond.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_bond
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_bond.header: theorem norm_bond (A : BondFnL2 L) : ‖A‖ ^ 2 = ∑ j, ‖coordB (WithLp.ofLp A) j‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fin3_sym.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fin3_sym
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.fin3_sym.header:
theorem fin3_sym (G : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hs : ∀ μ ν, G ν μ = G μ ν) (hd : ∀ μ, G μ μ = 0) :
    ∑ μ, ∑ ν, G μ ν = 2 * (G 0 1 + G 0 2 + G 1 2)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.subtype_pairs.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.subtype_pairs
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.subtype_pairs.header:
theorem subtype_pairs (F : Fin 3 × Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    ∑ d : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections, F d.1 = F (0, 1) + F (0, 2) + F (1, 2)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crl.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crl
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crl.header: noncomputable def crl (a : Site L × Fin 3 → ℝ) (x : Site L) (μ ν : Fin 3) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crl_anti.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crl_anti
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crl_anti.header: theorem crl_anti (a : Site L × Fin 3 → ℝ) (x : Site L) (μ ν : Fin 3) : crl a x ν μ = - crl a x μ ν

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crl_diag.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crl_diag
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crl_diag.header: theorem crl_diag (a : Site L × Fin 3 → ℝ) (x : Site L) (μ : Fin 3) : crl a x μ μ = 0

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_flatCurl.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_flatCurl
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_flatCurl.header:
theorem crd_flatCurl (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (x : Site L) (d : PeriodicPlaquetteDirections) (j : JJ) :
    crd (flatCurlValue A (x, d)) j = crl (fun p => crd (A p) j) x d.1.1 d.1.2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L1_coord_norm.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L1_coord_norm
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L1_coord_norm.header:
theorem L1_coord_norm (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (j : JJ) :
    ‖L1 L (coordB A j)‖ ^ 2 = ∑ x : Site L, ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ ν : Fin 3,
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (crl (fun p => crd (A p) j) x μ ν) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.curl_energy.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.curl_energy
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.curl_energy.header:
theorem curl_energy (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) A‖ ^ 2
      = ∑ j, ‖L1 L (coordB (WithLp.ofLp A) j)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.pathSite_eq.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.pathSite_eq
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.pathSite_eq.header: theorem pathSite_eq (x : Site L) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) : pathSite x μ i = x + i • eU L μ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coarse_iff.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coarse_iff
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coarse_iff.header: theorem coarse_iff (y : Site L) : Coarse n y ↔ ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val % n = 0

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coarse_val_ad.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coarse_val_add
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.coarse_val_ad.header:
theorem coarse_val_add (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (y : Site L) (hy : Coarse n y) (t : Cell n) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((y + ιc hdvd t) μ : ℕ) = (y μ : ℕ) + (t μ : ℕ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.block_sum_eq.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.block_sum_eq
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.block_sum_eq.header:
theorem block_sum_eq (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : Site L → M)
    (y : Site L) (hy : Coarse n y) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf y n, f x = ∑ t : Cell n, f (y + ιc hdvd t)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_sum.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_sum
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_sum.header: theorem crd_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → SuTwo) (j : JJ) : crd (∑ i ∈ s, f i) j = ∑ i ∈ s, crd (f i) j

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.LCR_crd.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.LCR_crd
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.LCR_crd.header:
theorem LCR_crd (hn : 0 < n) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : CoarseBond L n) (j : JJ) :
    crd (lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n A b) j
      = (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 4) * ∑ x ∈ blockOf b.1.1 n, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, crd (A (pathSite x b.2 i, b.2)) j

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2_coord_coar.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2_coord_coarse
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2_coord_coar.header:
theorem L2_coord_coarse (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (j : JJ) (y : Site L)
    (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L n) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ‖L2 hdvd (coordB A j) (y, μ)‖ ^ 2
      = ((n : ℝ) ^ 4 * crd (lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n A (⟨y, hy⟩, μ)) j) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2_coord_not.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2_coord_not
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.L2_coord_not.header:
theorem L2_coord_not (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (j : JJ) (y : Site L)
    (hy : ¬ y ∈ CoarseLattice L n) (μ : Fin 3) : L2 hdvd (coordB A j) (y, μ) = 0

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Qsum.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Qsum
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Qsum.header:
theorem Qsum (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b : CoarseBond L n, ‖lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n A b‖ ^ 2
      = (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 8) * ∑ j, ‖L2 hdvd (coordB A j)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS.header: noncomputable def conjS (φ : TS L) : TS L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_apply.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_apply.header: theorem conjS_apply (φ : TS L) (x : Site L) : conjS φ x = (starRingEnd ℂ) (φ x)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_conjS.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_conjS
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_conjS.header: theorem conjS_conjS (φ : TS L) : conjS (conjS φ) = φ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_add.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_add
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_add.header: theorem conjS_add (φ ψ : TS L) : conjS (φ + ψ) = conjS φ + conjS ψ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_smul_re.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_smul_real
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_smul_re.header: theorem conjS_smul_real (r : ℝ) (φ : TS L) : conjS ((r : ℂ) • φ) = (r : ℂ) • conjS φ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.inner_conjS.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.inner_conjS
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.inner_conjS.header: theorem inner_conjS (φ ψ : TS L) : ⟪conjS φ, conjS ψ⟫ = (starRingEnd ℂ) ⟪φ, ψ⟫

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_lap.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_lap
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_lap.header: theorem conjS_lap (φ : TS L) : conjS (lapC L φ) = lapC L (conjS φ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_mem_Wc.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_mem_Wc
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_mem_Wc.header: theorem conjS_mem_Wc (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) {φ : TS L} (hφ : φ ∈ Wc (n := n) hdvd) : conjS φ ∈ Wc (n := n) hdvd

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_mem_DW.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_mem_DW
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_mem_DW.header: theorem conjS_mem_DW (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) {y : TS L} (hy : y ∈ DW (n := n) hdvd) : conjS y ∈ DW (n := n) hdvd

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Pw_conj.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Pw_conj
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Pw_conj.header: theorem Pw_conj (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (f : TS L) : Pw hdvd (conjS f) = conjS (Pw hdvd f)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.exists_real_p.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.exists_real_preimage
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.exists_real_p.header:
theorem exists_real_preimage (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (f : TS L) (hf : conjS f = f) :
    ∃ w : Site L → ℝ, (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun x => ((w x : ℝ) : ℂ)) : TS L) ∈ Wc (n := n) hdvd ∧
      lapC L (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun x => ((w x : ℝ) : ℂ))) = Pw hdvd f

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.hunit_of_coer.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.hunit_of_coercive
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.hunit_of_coer.header:
theorem hunit_of_coercive (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hco : ∀ x : ↥(bondSupp (PP).G), c * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, (PP).G1inv x⟫) :
    IsUnit (((PP).Qin.comp (PP).G1in).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (PP).Qin))

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.hunit_chain_t.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.hunit_chain_threshold
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.hunit_chain_t.header:
theorem hunit_chain_threshold (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ) (c ε : ℝ) (hcε : ε < c)
    (hc : ∀ x : ↥(bondSupp (PP).G), c * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, (PP).data.Ginv x⟫) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    ε * (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) < a

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.mem_NQp_of_bl.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.mem_NQp_of_blocks
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.mem_NQp_of_bl.header:
theorem mem_NQp_of_blocks (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (φ : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hker : ∀ z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ k), ∑ x ∈ blockOf z (ell ^ k), WithLp.ofLp φ x = 0) :
    φ ∈ NQp (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration
      (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (scaleUp ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapDir_flat.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapDir_flat
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapDir_flat.header:
theorem lapDir_flat (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    lapDir (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration
      (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (scaleUp ell k Lu)) = lapFull flatCfg

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftBack_eq.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftBack_eq
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.shiftBack_eq.header: theorem shiftBack_eq {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (y : Site L) (μ : Fin 3) : periodicLatticeShiftBack y μ = y - eU L μ

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.gradAdj_flat_.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.gradAdj_flat_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.gradAdj_flat_.header:
theorem gradAdj_flat_apply {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (A : BondFnL2 L) (x : Site L) :
    (gradAdj (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) A) x
      = ∑ μ : Fin 3, (WithLp.ofLp A (x - eU L μ, μ) - WithLp.ofLp A (x, μ))

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapFull_flat_.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapFull_flat_apply
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.lapFull_flat_.header:
theorem lapFull_flat_apply {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (φ : SiteL2 L) (x : Site L) :
    (lapFull (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) φ) x
      = ∑ μ : Fin 3, (2 • WithLp.ofLp φ x - WithLp.ofLp φ (x + eU L μ) - WithLp.ofLp φ (x - eU L μ))

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_sub_sum.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_sub_sum
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_sub_sum.header:
theorem crd_sub_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → SuTwo) (j : JJ) :
    crd (∑ i ∈ s, f i) j = ∑ i ∈ s, crd (f i) j

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dst_coord.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dst_coord
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Dst_coord.header:
theorem Dst_coord (A : BondFnL2 L) (j : JJ) (x : Site L) :
    Dst L (coordB (WithLp.ofLp A) j) x
      = ((crd ((gradAdj (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) A) x) j : ℝ) : ℂ)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_Dst_coo.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_Dst_coord
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.conjS_Dst_coo.header: theorem conjS_Dst_coord (A : BondFnL2 L) (j : JJ) : conjS (Dst L (coordB (WithLp.ofLp A) j)) = Dst L (coordB (WithLp.ofLp A) j)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.embS.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.embS
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.embS.header: noncomputable def embS (w : JJ → Site L → ℝ) : SiteL2 L

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_embS.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_embS
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_embS.header: theorem crd_embS (w : JJ → Site L → ℝ) (x : Site L) (j : JJ) : crd (WithLp.ofLp (embS w) x) j = w j x

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_sq_site.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_sq_site
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.norm_sq_site.header: theorem norm_sq_site (f : SiteL2 L) : ‖f‖ ^ 2 = ∑ j, ∑ x : Site L, (crd (WithLp.ofLp f x) j) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.inner_site.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.inner_site
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.inner_site.header:
theorem inner_site (f g : SiteL2 L) :
    inner ℝ f g = ∑ j, ∑ x : Site L, crd (WithLp.ofLp f x) j * crd (WithLp.ofLp g x) j

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_eq_zero.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.crd_eq_zero.header: theorem crd_eq_zero (v : SuTwo) (h : ∀ j, crd v j = 0) : v = 0

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.R_lower.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.R_lower
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.R_lower.header:
theorem R_lower (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ j, ‖L3 (scaleUp_tiling ell k Lu hell) (coordB (WithLp.ofLp A) j)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ ‖Rproj (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration
          (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (gradAdj flatCfg A)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.comb_real.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.comb_real
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.comb_real.header:
theorem comb_real (c0 m κ S1 S2 S3 B : ℝ) (hm1 : m ≤ 1) (hm2 : m ≤ κ) (hmp : 0 < m)
    (h : c0 * B ≤ S1 + S2 + S3) (hc0 : 0 < c0) (s1 : 0 ≤ S1) (s2 : 0 ≤ S2) (s3 : 0 ≤ S3) :
    c0 * m * B ≤ S1 + κ * S2 + S3

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Qnorm_eq.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Qnorm_eq
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.Qnorm_eq.header:
theorem Qnorm_eq (x : ↥(bondSupp (PP).G)) :
    ‖(PP).data.Q x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ b : CoarseBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ k),
      ‖lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo (ell ^ k) (WithLp.ofLp (iE (PP).G x)) b‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.G1inv_coerciv.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.G1inv_coercive_volume_free
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.G1inv_coerciv.header:
theorem G1inv_coercive_volume_free (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (x : ↥(bondSupp (PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).G)), c * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ x ((PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).G1inv x)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.flat_G1inv_ch.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.flat_G1inv_characterisation
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.flat_G1inv_ch.header:
theorem flat_G1inv_characterisation (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (x : ↥(bondSupp (PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).G)), c * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, (PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).G1inv x⟫) ∧
    (∀ (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (c : ℝ),
      (∀ x : ↥(bondSupp (PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).G), c * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, (PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).G1inv x⟫) →
        c * (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) ≤ a)

AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.hunit_volume_.name: AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.hunit_volume_free
AdalyFormal.FlatCoercivity.hunit_volume_.header:
theorem hunit_volume_free (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)),
      (∀ x : ↥(bondSupp (PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).G), c * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, (PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).G1inv x⟫) ∧
      IsUnit ((((PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).Qin.comp (PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).G1in).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).Qin)))

AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.farCorner.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.farCorner
AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.farCorner.header: def farCorner (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.norm_curl_grad_.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.norm_curl_grad_le
AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.norm_curl_grad_.header:
theorem norm_curl_grad_le (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    ‖curlValueCovariant U (gradValueCovariant U lam) p‖
      ≤ 2 * frobNorm ((holonomyElem U p : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) * ‖lam (farCorner p)‖

AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.sum_farCorner_s.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.sum_farCorner_sq
AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.sum_farCorner_s.header:
theorem sum_farCorner_sq (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, ‖lam (farCorner p)‖ ^ 2 = 3 * ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ‖lam x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.sum_norm_sq_cur.name: AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.sum_norm_sq_curl_grad_le
AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.sum_norm_sq_cur.header:
theorem sum_norm_sq_curl_grad_le (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) {ζ : ℝ} (hζ0 : 0 ≤ ζ)
    (hζ : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, frobNorm ((holonomyElem U p : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ζ) :
    ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, ‖curlValueCovariant U (gradValueCovariant U lam) p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 12 * ζ ^ 2 * ∑ x : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ‖lam x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.OneGap12.pdist_shift112.name: AdalyFormal.OneGap12.pdist_shift112
AdalyFormal.OneGap12.pdist_shift112.header:
theorem pdist_shift112 {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {x w : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {n : ℕ} (h : pdist x w ≤ n) (d : Fin 3) :
    pdist x (coarseShift w 1 d) ≤ n + 1

AdalyFormal.OneGap12.BInT12.name: AdalyFormal.OneGap12.BInT12
AdalyFormal.OneGap12.BInT12.header: def BInT12 (S : Tower L) (j0 : ℕ) (e : Bond L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.OneGap12.m1ChartT12.name: AdalyFormal.OneGap12.m1ChartT12
AdalyFormal.OneGap12.m1ChartT12.header:
def m1ChartT12 {ell M f k : ℕ} (S : Tower L) {α₀ η : ℝ} (U : LinkCfg L)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (A : Bond L → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hU : ∀ e : Bond L, ((periodicGaugeTransform g U e : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
        = NormedSpace.exp (((η : ℂ) * Complex.I) • A e))
    (hB : M1Bounds12 S ell M f k α₀ η A) (j0 : ℕ) (hj0 : j0 ≤ k) :
    CubeChart U (BInT12 S j0) η ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀ * (((ell : ℝ) ^ j0 * η)⁻¹ ^ 1))
      ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀ * (((ell : ℝ) ^ j0 * η)⁻¹ ^ 2))

AdalyFormal.OneGap12.m1_link_loc12.name: AdalyFormal.OneGap12.m1_link_loc12
AdalyFormal.OneGap12.m1_link_loc12.header:
theorem m1_link_loc12 (hη : 0 < η) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (ha0 : 0 ≤ (f : ℝ) * M * α₀) (j0 : ℕ) (hj0 : j0 ≤ k) (b : Bond L)
    (h1 : b.1 ∈ S.Om j0) (h2 : periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ S.Om j0) :
    dv (periodicGaugeTransform g U b) ≤ (4 * Real.pi + 4) * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀) / (ell : ℝ) ^ j0

AdalyFormal.OneGap12.m1_plaq_loc12.name: AdalyFormal.OneGap12.m1_plaq_loc12
AdalyFormal.OneGap12.m1_plaq_loc12.header:
theorem m1_plaq_loc12 (hη : 0 < η) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (ha0 : 0 ≤ (f : ℝ) * M * α₀) (ha1 : (f : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ 1)
    (j0 : ℕ) (hj0 : j0 ≤ k) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3)
    (h1 : y ∈ S.Om j0) (h2 : coarseShift y 1 ν ∈ S.Om j0) (h3 : coarseShift y 1 μ ∈ S.Om j0)
    (h4 : coarseShift (coarseShift y 1 ν) 1 μ ∈ S.Om j0) :
    dv (pw 1 (periodicGaugeTransform g U) y ν μ) ≤ (4 * Real.pi + 4) * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀) / (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * j0)

AdalyFormal.OneGap12.tower_link_loc12.name: AdalyFormal.OneGap12.tower_link_loc12
AdalyFormal.OneGap12.tower_link_loc12.header:
theorem tower_link_loc12 {ell M k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hT3 : ∀ μ, 3 ≤ Lu μ + 1) {f : ℕ} {α₀ η : ℝ}
    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (A : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hU : ∀ e : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu), ((periodicGaugeTransform g U e : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
        Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) = NormedSpace.exp (((η : ℂ) * Complex.I) • A e))
    (hB : M1Bounds12 S ell M f k α₀ η A) (hη : 0 < η)
    (ha0 : 0 ≤ (f : ℝ) * M * α₀) (ha1 : (f : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ 1)
    (hsm : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀)) ≤ 1)
    (j0 l : ℕ) (hj0 : j0 ≤ k) (hl : l ≤ j0) (hlk : l < k)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hz : z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ l)) (μ : Fin 3)
    (hcone : ∀ w, pdist z w ≤ 14 * ell ^ l → w ∈ S.Om j0) :
    dv (AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.ubarTowerSU2 ell (periodicGaugeTransform g U) l (z, μ))
