AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.oneLevelGeom_.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.oneLevelGeom_Lam1
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.oneLevelGeom_.header: theorem oneLevelGeom_Lam1 : (oneLevelGeom M n).Lam 1 = ((CoarseLattice (fineExtent M n) n : Finset _) : Set _)

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.n2_inner_Delp.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.n2_inner_DelpA
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.n2_inner_Delp.header:
theorem n2_inner_DelpA (U : Cfg (fineExtent M n)) (a : ℝ) (f : SiteL2 (fineExtent M n)) :
    (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * ⟪f, DelpA (oneLevelGeom M n) U a f⟫
      = ‖covGrad M U f‖ ^ 2 + (a * (n : ℝ) ^ 3) * ‖covQPrime M U f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive_oneLevel
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive.header:
theorem site_coercive_oneLevel (hn : 0 < n) (U : Cfg (fineExtent M n)) (α : ℝ)
    (hsmall : frobSupBond U ≤ α / (n : ℝ)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (f : SiteL2 (fineExtent M n)) :
    min a 1 * ((1 / 6 - 48 * α ^ 2) * ‖f‖ ^ 2) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * ⟪f, DelpA (oneLevelGeom M n) U a f⟫

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.PathIn.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.PathIn
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.PathIn.header:
def PathIn (B : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (s : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L → List (Fin 3) → Prop
  | _, [] => True
  | y, μ :: rest => y ∈ B ∧ PathIn B s (coarseShift y s μ) rest

theorem PathIn_append (B : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (s : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p q : List (Fin 3)) :
    PathIn B s y (p ++ q) ↔ PathIn B s y p ∧ PathIn B s (coarsePathEndpoint s y p) q

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.PathIn_append.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.PathIn_append
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.PathIn_append.header:
theorem PathIn_append (B : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (s : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p q : List (Fin 3)) :
    PathIn B s y (p ++ q) ↔ PathIn B s y p ∧ PathIn B s (coarsePathEndpoint s y p) q

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.hol_dev_local.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.hol_dev_local
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.hol_dev_local.header:
theorem hol_dev_local (B : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (s : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {δ : ℝ}
    (hV : ∀ z ∈ B, ∀ μ : Fin 3, frobNorm ((V (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ) :
    ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L), PathIn B s y p →
      frobNorm (((coarsePathHolonomy s V y p : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
        Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ (p.length : ℝ) * δ

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.coarseShift_v.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.coarseShift_val_ne'
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.coarseShift_v.header:
theorem coarseShift_val_ne' (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a : ℕ) {μ ν : Fin 3} (h : ν ≠ μ) :
    (coarseShift z a μ ν).val = (z ν).val

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.PathIn_replic.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.PathIn_replicate_box
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.PathIn_replic.header:
theorem PathIn_replicate_box (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (m s : ℕ) (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + m ≤ L μ + 1)
    (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L), z ∈ blockOf y m → (z μ).val + s * n < (y μ).val + m →
      PathIn (↑(blockOf y m) : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) s z (List.replicate n μ)

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.coarseShift_v.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.coarseShift_val_lt
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.coarseShift_v.header:
theorem coarseShift_val_lt (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (hlt : (z μ).val + a < L μ + 1) :
    (coarseShift z a μ μ).val = (z μ).val + a

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.fin3_cases.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.fin3_cases
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.fin3_cases.header: theorem fin3_cases (ν : Fin 3) : ν = 0 ∨ ν = 1 ∨ ν = 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.pathSite_eq_c.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.pathSite_eq_coarseShift
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.pathSite_eq_c.header:
theorem pathSite_eq_coarseShift (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (a : ℕ) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.QOne.pathSite z μ a = coarseShift z a μ

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.gammaPath_Pat.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.gammaPath_PathIn
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.gammaPath_Pat.header:
theorem gammaPath_PathIn {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + s * ell ≤ L μ + 1) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) :
    PathIn (↑(blockOf y (s * ell)) : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) s y (coarseGammaPath s y x)

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ.header: noncomputable def NsZ (s : ℕ) (Z : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_nonneg
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_nonneg.header:
theorem NsZ_nonneg (s : ℕ) (Z : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    0 ≤ NsZ s Z g

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_sq.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_sq
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_sq.header:
theorem NsZ_sq (s : ℕ) (Z : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    NsZ s Z g ^ 2 = (s : ℝ) ^ 3 * ∑ y ∈ Z, ‖g y‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_sub_le.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_sub_le
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_sub_le.header:
theorem NsZ_sub_le (s : ℕ) (Z : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (g h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    NsZ s Z (g - h) ≤ NsZ s Z g + NsZ s Z h

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_add_le.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_add_le
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_add_le.header:
theorem NsZ_add_le (s : ℕ) (Z : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (g h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    NsZ s Z (g + h) ≤ NsZ s Z g + NsZ s Z h

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_zero.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_zero
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_zero.header: theorem NsZ_zero (s : ℕ) (Z : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) : NsZ s Z (0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) = 0

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_mono.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_mono
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_mono.header:
theorem NsZ_mono (s : ℕ) {Z Z' : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} (h : Z ⊆ Z') (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    NsZ s Z g ≤ NsZ s Z' g

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.upZ.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.upZ
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.upZ.header: def upZ (s ell : ℕ) (Z : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_upZ.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_upZ

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.upZ_subset_co.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.upZ_subset_coarse
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.upZ_subset_co.header:
theorem upZ_subset_coarse {s ell : ℕ} {Z : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} (hZ : Z ⊆ CoarseLattice L (s * ell)) :
    upZ s ell Z ⊆ CoarseLattice L s

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_stepAvera.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_stepAverage_le
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_stepAvera.header:
theorem NsZ_stepAverage_le (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    {Z : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} (hZ : Z ⊆ CoarseLattice L (s * ell))
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    NsZ (s * ell) Z (stepAverage s V ell g) ≤ NsZ s (upZ s ell Z) g

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepAverage_d.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepAverage_drift_sq_local
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepAverage_d.header:
theorem stepAverage_drift_sq_local (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + s * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    (hV : ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (s * ell), ∀ μ : Fin 3, frobNorm ((V (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ‖stepAverage s V ell g y - stepAverage s (trivialU L) ell g y‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ) ^ 2 * ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) * ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, ‖g x‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_stepAvera.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_stepAverage_drift
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_stepAvera.header:
theorem NsZ_stepAverage_drift (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ)
    {Z : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} (hZ : Z ⊆ CoarseLattice L (s * ell))
    (hfit : ∀ y ∈ Z, ∀ μ, (y μ).val + s * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    (hV : ∀ y ∈ Z, ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (s * ell), ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm ((V (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    NsZ (s * ell) Z (stepAverage s V ell g - stepAverage s (trivialU L) ell g)
      ≤ (6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ) * NsZ s (upZ s ell Z) g

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_flat_le_c.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_flat_le_chain
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_flat_le_c.header:
theorem NsZ_flat_le_chain (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (J : ℕ) (Zs : ℕ → Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L))
    (hZc : ∀ i, i ≤ J → Zs i ⊆ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i))
    (hchain : ∀ i, i < J → Zs i = upZ (ell ^ i) ell (Zs (i + 1)))
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ J → NsZ (ell ^ j) (Zs j) (Qcomposite (fun _ => trivialU L) ell j f) ≤ NsZ 1 (Zs 0) f

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_telescope.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_telescope_local
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.NsZ_telescope.header:
theorem NsZ_telescope_local (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (δ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hδ0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i) (J : ℕ) (Zs : ℕ → Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L))
    (hZc : ∀ i, i ≤ J → Zs i ⊆ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i))
    (hchain : ∀ i, i < J → Zs i = upZ (ell ^ i) ell (Zs (i + 1)))
    (hfit : ∀ i, i < J → ∀ y ∈ Zs (i + 1), ∀ μ, (y μ).val + ell ^ i * ell ≤ L μ + 1)
    (hV : ∀ i, i < J → ∀ y ∈ Zs (i + 1), ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ i * ell), ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm ((bg i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ i)
    (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ J → NsZ (ell ^ j) (Zs j)
        (Qcomposite bg ell j f - Qcomposite (fun _ => trivialU L) ell j f)
      ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ i) * NsZ 1 (Zs 0) f

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inBlockBonds.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inBlockBonds
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inBlockBonds.header: noncomputable def inBlockBonds (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (n : ℕ) : Finset (Bond L)

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.mem_inBlockBo.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.mem_inBlockBonds
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.mem_inBlockBo.header:
theorem mem_inBlockBonds {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {n : ℕ} {b : Bond L} :
    b ∈ inBlockBonds y n ↔ b.1 ∈ blockOf y n ∧ periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ blockOf y n

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inBlockBonds_.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inBlockBonds_disjoint
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inBlockBonds_.header:
theorem inBlockBonds_disjoint {y y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {n n' : ℕ}
    (h : Disjoint (blockOf y n) (blockOf y' n')) : Disjoint (inBlockBonds y n) (inBlockBonds y' n')

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.block_energy_.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.block_energy_le_inBlock
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.block_energy_.header:
theorem block_energy_le_inBlock {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {n : ℕ}
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1) (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    cE0 n (fun p => lam (chart y n p)) + cE1 n (fun p => lam (chart y n p))
        + cE2 n (fun p => lam (chart y n p))
      ≤ ∑ b ∈ inBlockBonds y n, (AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.gradValue lam b) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.block_poincar.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.block_poincare_scalar
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.block_poincar.header:
theorem block_poincare_scalar {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1) (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf y n, (f x) ^ 2 ≤
      3 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ b ∈ inBlockBonds y n, (AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.gradValue f b) ^ 2
        + 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 3 * ((1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 3) * ∑ x ∈ blockOf y n, f x) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.block_poincar.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.block_poincare_vector
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.block_poincar.header:
theorem block_poincare_vector {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hfit : ∀ μ, (y μ).val + n ≤ L μ + 1) (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf y n, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ≤
      3 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ b ∈ inBlockBonds y n, ‖f (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - f b.1‖ ^ 2
        + 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 3 * ‖(1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 3) • ∑ x ∈ blockOf y n, f x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.chainZ.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.chainZ
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.chainZ.header:
noncomputable def chainZ (ell : ℕ) : ℕ → Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L) → ℕ → Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)
  | 0, Λ, _ => Λ
  | j + 1, Λ, i => if i = j + 1 then Λ else chainZ ell j (upZ (ell ^ j) ell Λ) i

theorem chainZ_top (ell : ℕ) : ∀ (j : ℕ) (Λ : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)), chainZ ell j Λ j = Λ

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.chainZ_top.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.chainZ_top
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.chainZ_top.header: theorem chainZ_top (ell : ℕ) : ∀ (j : ℕ) (Λ : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)), chainZ ell j Λ j = Λ

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.chainZ_sub.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.chainZ_sub
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.chainZ_sub.header:
theorem chainZ_sub (ell : ℕ) : ∀ (j : ℕ) (Λ : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)), Λ ⊆ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ j) →
    ∀ i, i ≤ j → chainZ ell j Λ i ⊆ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i)

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.chainZ_step.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.chainZ_step
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.chainZ_step.header:
theorem chainZ_step (ell : ℕ) : ∀ (j : ℕ) (Λ : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)), Λ ⊆ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ j) →
    ∀ i, i < j → chainZ ell j Λ i = upZ (ell ^ i) ell (chainZ ell j Λ (i + 1))

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.chainZ_blocks.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.chainZ_blocks
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.chainZ_blocks.header:
theorem chainZ_blocks (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) : ∀ (j : ℕ) (Λ : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)),
    Λ ⊆ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ j) → ∀ i, i ≤ j → ∀ c ∈ chainZ ell j Λ i,
      blockOf c (ell ^ i) ⊆ Λ.biUnion (fun y => blockOf y (ell ^ j))

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.LamF.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.LamF
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.LamF.header: noncomputable def LamF (G : TowerGeom L) (j : ℕ) : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.mem_LamF.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.mem_LamF
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.mem_LamF.header: theorem mem_LamF {G : TowerGeom L} {j : ℕ} {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} : y ∈ LamF G j ↔ y ∈ G.Lam j

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.ProperTower.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.ProperTower
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.ProperTower.header: structure ProperTower (G : TowerGeom L) (ell k : ℕ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Rj.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Rj
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Rj.header: noncomputable def Rj (G : TowerGeom L) (ell j : ℕ) : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.IdxB.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.IdxB
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.IdxB.header: noncomputable def IdxB (G : TowerGeom L) (k : ℕ) : Finset (Σ _ : ℕ, PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.IdxB_disj.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.IdxB_disj
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.IdxB_disj.header:
theorem IdxB_disj {G : TowerGeom L} {ell k : ℕ} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) :
    ∀ p ∈ IdxB G k, ∀ q ∈ IdxB G k, p ≠ q → Disjoint (blockOf p.2 (ell ^ p.1)) (blockOf q.2 (ell ^ q.1))

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_partition.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_partition
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_partition.header:
theorem sum_partition {G : TowerGeom L} {ell k : ℕ} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ x, x ∉ G.Om0 → φ x = 0) :
    ∑ x, φ x = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ∑ y ∈ LamF G j, ∑ x ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), φ x

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_blockbond.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_blockbonds_le
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_blockbond.header:
theorem sum_blockbonds_le {G : TowerGeom L} {ell k : ℕ} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (φ : Bond L → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ b, 0 ≤ φ b) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ∑ y ∈ LamF G j, ∑ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j), φ b ≤ ∑ b, φ b

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.blocks_disj_l.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.blocks_disj_level
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.blocks_disj_l.header:
theorem blocks_disj_level {G : TowerGeom L} {ell k : ℕ} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) :
    ∀ y ∈ LamF G j, ∀ y' ∈ LamF G j, y ≠ y' → Disjoint (blockOf y (ell ^ j)) (blockOf y' (ell ^ j))

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_Rj.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_Rj
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_Rj.header:
theorem sum_Rj {G : TowerGeom L} {ell k : ℕ} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k)
    (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ∑ x ∈ Rj G ell j, φ x = ∑ y ∈ LamF G j, ∑ x ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), φ x

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.level_data.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.level_data
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.level_data.header:
theorem level_data (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1)
    {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (U : Cfg L) (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i)
    (hT : ∀ i, i < k → ∀ z ∈ G.Om0, ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm ((bgTower G U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ i)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) (E : ℝ) (hE : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ i ≤ E)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    (∑ x ∈ Rj G ell j, ‖g x‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 3 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ j) ^ 2 * ∑ y ∈ LamF G j, ∑ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
            ‖g (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - g b.1‖ ^ 2
        + 2 * NsZ (ell ^ j) (LamF G j) (Qcomposite (fun _ => trivialU L) ell j g) ^ 2)
    ∧ NsZ (ell ^ j) (LamF G j) (Qcomposite (fun _ => trivialU L) ell j g)
        ≤ NsZ (ell ^ j) (LamF G j) (Qcomposite (bgTower G U) ell j g) + E * NsZ 1 (Rj G ell j) g

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.gradL2_drift_.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.gradL2_drift_local
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.gradL2_drift_.header:
theorem gradL2_drift_local (U : Cfg L) (R : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) {δ0 : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ0)
    (h : ∀ b : Bond L, periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ R → frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ0)
    (g : SiteL2 L) (hg : ∀ x, x ∉ R → g x = 0) :
    ‖gradL2 U g - gradL2 (trivialU L) g‖ ^ 2 ≤ 12 * δ0 ^ 2 * ‖g‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive_proper_core
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive.header:
theorem site_coercive_proper_core (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1)
    {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (α E : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hU : ∀ b : Bond L, periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ G.Om0 →
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i)
    (hT : ∀ i, i < k → ∀ z ∈ G.Om0, ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm ((bgTower G U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ i)
    (hE : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ i ≤ E)
    (g : SiteL2 L) (hg : ∀ x, x ∉ G.Om0 → g x = 0) :
    (1 - 72 * α ^ 2 - 4 * E ^ 2) * ‖g‖ ^ 2
      ≤ max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * (‖gradL2 U g‖ ^ 2 + ⟪g, Qpa G U a g⟫)

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inner_DelpA_m.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inner_DelpA_mask
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inner_DelpA_m.header:
theorem inner_DelpA_mask (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ⟪f, DelpA G U a f⟫ = ‖gradL2 U (siteMask G.Om0 f)‖ ^ 2 + ⟪siteMask G.Om0 f, Qpa G U a (siteMask G.Om0 f)⟫

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.mask_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.mask_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.mask_norm_sq.header:
theorem mask_norm_sq (G : TowerGeom L) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖f‖ ^ 2 = ‖siteMask G.Om0 f‖ ^ 2 + ‖f - siteMask G.Om0 f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inner_mask_se.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inner_mask_self
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inner_mask_se.header:
theorem inner_mask_self (G : TowerGeom L) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ⟪f, siteMask G.Om0 f⟫ = ‖siteMask G.Om0 f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inner_X_ge.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inner_X_ge
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inner_X_ge.header:
theorem inner_X_ge (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc0 : 0 < c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1)
    (hc : ∀ f : SiteL2 L, c * ‖siteMask G.Om0 f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪f, DelpA G U a f⟫) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    c * ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪f, (DelpA G U a + (1 - siteMask G.Om0)) f⟫

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.unit_Gp_of_ma.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.unit_Gp_of_masked_coercive
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.unit_Gp_of_ma.header:
theorem unit_Gp_of_masked_coercive (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc0 : 0 < c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1)
    (hc : ∀ f : SiteL2 L, c * ‖siteMask G.Om0 f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪f, DelpA G U a f⟫) :
    IsUnit (DelpA G U a + (1 - siteMask G.Om0)) ∧ ∀ s : SiteL2 L, ‖Gp G U a s‖ ≤ (1 / c) * ‖s‖

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive_proper
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive.header:
theorem site_coercive_proper (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1)
    {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (α E : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hU : ∀ b : Bond L, periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ G.Om0 →
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i)
    (hT : ∀ i, i < k → ∀ z ∈ G.Om0, ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm ((bgTower G U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ i)
    (hE : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ i ≤ E) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    (1 - 72 * α ^ 2 - 4 * E ^ 2) * ‖siteMask G.Om0 f‖ ^ 2
      ≤ max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * ⟪f, DelpA G U a f⟫

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.proper_unit_G.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.proper_unit_Gp
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.proper_unit_G.header:
theorem proper_unit_Gp (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1)
    {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (α E : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hU : ∀ b : Bond L, periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ G.Om0 →
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i)
    (hT : ∀ i, i < k → ∀ z ∈ G.Om0, ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm ((bgTower G U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ i)
    (hE : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ i ≤ E) (hpos : 72 * α ^ 2 + 4 * E ^ 2 < 1) :
    IsUnit (DelpA G U a + (1 - siteMask G.Om0)) ∧
      ∀ s : SiteL2 L, ‖Gp G U a s‖ ≤
        (max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 / (1 - 72 * α ^ 2 - 4 * E ^ 2)) * ‖s‖

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive_proper_towerclass
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive.header:
theorem site_coercive_proper_towerclass (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1)
    {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hU : ∀ b : Bond L, periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ G.Om0 →
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (hT : ∀ i, i < k → ∀ z ∈ G.Om0, ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm ((bgTower G U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (f : SiteL2 L) :
    (1 - 216 * ρ ^ 2) * ‖siteMask G.Om0 f‖ ^ 2
      ≤ max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * ⟪f, DelpA G U a f⟫

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.unit_of_site_.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.unit_of_site_coercive
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.unit_of_site_.header:
theorem unit_of_site_coercive (G : TowerGeom L) (hOm : G.Om0 = Set.univ) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc0 : 0 < c)
    (hc : ∀ f : SiteL2 L, c * ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪f, DelpA G U a f⟫) :
    IsUnit (DelpA G U a + (1 - siteMask G.Om0))

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Gp_norm_le_of.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Gp_norm_le_of_site_coercive
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Gp_norm_le_of.header:
theorem Gp_norm_le_of_site_coercive (G : TowerGeom L) (hOm : G.Om0 = Set.univ) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc0 : 0 < c)
    (hc : ∀ f : SiteL2 L, c * ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪f, DelpA G U a f⟫) (g : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖Gp G U a g‖ ≤ (1 / c) * ‖g‖

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.coeff_pos_of_.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.coeff_pos_of_le
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.coeff_pos_of_.header: theorem coeff_pos_of_le {x : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ x) (h1 : x ≤ 1 / 545) : 0 < 1 - 384 * x ^ 2 - 544 * x

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Qpa_form_zero.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Qpa_form_zero_of_NQp
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Qpa_form_zero.header:
theorem Qpa_form_zero_of_NQp (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) {ν : SiteL2 L} (hν : ν ∈ NQp G U) :
    ⟪ν, Qpa G U a ν⟫ = 0

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.poincare_NQp_.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.poincare_NQp_proper
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.poincare_NQp_.header:
theorem poincare_NQp_proper (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1)
    {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (α E : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hU : ∀ b : Bond L, periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ G.Om0 →
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ α / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i)
    (hT : ∀ i, i < k → ∀ z ∈ G.Om0, ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm ((bgTower G U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ i)
    (hE : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ i ≤ E)
    {ν : SiteL2 L} (hν : ν ∈ NQp G U) :
    (1 - 72 * α ^ 2 - 4 * E ^ 2) * ‖ν‖ ^ 2
      ≤ max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * ‖gradL2 U ν‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.nat_unique.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.nat_unique
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.nat_unique.header:
theorem nat_unique {s a b d : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (ha1 : s * a ≤ d) (ha2 : d < s * a + s)
    (hb1 : s * b ≤ d) (hb2 : d < s * b + s) : a = b

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.blockOf_disjo.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.blockOf_disjoint
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.blockOf_disjo.header:
theorem blockOf_disjoint {y c c' : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hc : c ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) (hc' : c' ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) (hne : c ≠ c') :
    Disjoint (blockOf c s) (blockOf c' s)

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.blockOf_biUni.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.blockOf_biUnion
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.blockOf_biUni.header:
theorem blockOf_biUnion {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (stepBlockOf y s ell).biUnion (fun c => blockOf c s) = blockOf y (s * ell)

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_blockOf_s.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_blockOf_stepBlock
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_blockOf_s.header:
theorem sum_blockOf_stepBlock {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M) :
    ∑ c ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, ∑ x ∈ blockOf c s, g x = ∑ x ∈ blockOf y (s * ell), g x

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepBlock_mem.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepBlock_mem_coarse
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepBlock_mem.header:
theorem stepBlock_mem_coarse {y c : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {s ell : ℕ}
    (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (s * ell)) (hc : c ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) : c ∈ CoarseLattice L s

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Qflat_eq_bloc.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Qflat_eq_blockMean
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Qflat_eq_bloc.header:
theorem Qflat_eq_blockMean (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ∀ (j : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L), y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ j) →
      Qcomposite (fun _ => trivialU L) ell j g y
        = (1 / (((ell ^ j : ℕ)) : ℝ) ^ 3) • ∑ x ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), g x

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.jensen_block.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.jensen_block
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.jensen_block.header:
theorem jensen_block (B : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hcard : B.card ≤ m ^ 3)
    (a : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ((1 / (m : ℝ) ^ 3) * ∑ x ∈ B, a x) ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (m : ℝ) ^ 3) * ∑ x ∈ B, a x ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepAverage_s.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepAverage_sq_le
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepAverage_s.header:
theorem stepAverage_sq_le (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ‖stepAverage s V ell g y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) * ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, ‖g x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepAverage_d.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepAverage_drift_sq
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepAverage_d.header:
theorem stepAverage_drift_sq (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : frobSupBond V ≤ δ)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ‖stepAverage s V ell g y - stepAverage s (trivialU L) ell g y‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ) ^ 2 * ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) * ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, ‖g x‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepBlock_dis.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepBlock_disjoint
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepBlock_dis.header:
theorem stepBlock_disjoint {y y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (s * ell)) (hy' : y' ∈ CoarseLattice L (s * ell)) (hne : y ≠ y') :
    Disjoint (stepBlockOf y s ell) (stepBlockOf y' s ell)

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_stepBlock.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_stepBlock_le
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_stepBlock.header:
theorem sum_stepBlock_le {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ x, 0 ≤ F x) :
    ∑ y ∈ CoarseLattice L (s * ell), ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, F x ≤ ∑ x ∈ CoarseLattice L s, F x

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.plY.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.plY
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.plY.header:
noncomputable def plY (Y : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    PiLp 2 (fun _ : Y => SuTwo)

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Nf.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Nf
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Nf.header: noncomputable def Nf (Y : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Nf_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Nf_nonneg
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Nf_nonneg.header: theorem Nf_nonneg (Y : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : 0 ≤ Nf Y g

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Nf_sq.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Nf_sq
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Nf_sq.header:
theorem Nf_sq (Y : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    Nf Y g ^ 2 = ∑ y ∈ Y, ‖g y‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Nf_add_le.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Nf_add_le
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Nf_add_le.header:
theorem Nf_add_le (Y : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (g h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    Nf Y (g + h) ≤ Nf Y g + Nf Y h

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Nf_sub_le.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Nf_sub_le
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Nf_sub_le.header:
theorem Nf_sub_le (Y : Finset (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (g h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    Nf Y (g - h) ≤ Nf Y g + Nf Y h

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns.header: noncomputable def Ns (s : ℕ) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_nonneg
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_nonneg.header: theorem Ns_nonneg (s : ℕ) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : 0 ≤ Ns s g

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_sq.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_sq
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_sq.header:
theorem Ns_sq (s : ℕ) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    Ns s g ^ 2 = (s : ℝ) ^ 3 * ∑ y ∈ CoarseLattice L s, ‖g y‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_sub_le.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_sub_le
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_sub_le.header: theorem Ns_sub_le (s : ℕ) (g h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : Ns s (g - h) ≤ Ns s g + Ns s h

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_add_le.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_add_le
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_add_le.header: theorem Ns_add_le (s : ℕ) (g h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : Ns s (g + h) ≤ Ns s g + Ns s h

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.le_of_sq_le_s.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.le_of_sq_le_sq'
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.le_of_sq_le_s.header: theorem le_of_sq_le_sq' {a b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (h : a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2) : a ≤ b

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_stepAverag.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_stepAverage_le
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_stepAverag.header:
theorem Ns_stepAverage_le (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    Ns (s * ell) (stepAverage s V ell g) ≤ Ns s g

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_stepAverag.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_stepAverage_drift
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_stepAverag.header:
theorem Ns_stepAverage_drift (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : frobSupBond V ≤ δ)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    Ns (s * ell) (stepAverage s V ell g - stepAverage s (trivialU L) ell g)
      ≤ (6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ) * Ns s g

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepAverage_s.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepAverage_sub
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.stepAverage_s.header:
theorem stepAverage_sub (s ell : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (g h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    stepAverage s V ell (g - h) y = stepAverage s V ell g y - stepAverage s V ell h y

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_zero.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_zero
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_zero.header: theorem Ns_zero (s : ℕ) : Ns s (0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) = 0

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_flat_le.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_flat_le
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_flat_le.header:
theorem Ns_flat_le (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, Ns (ell ^ j) (Qcomposite (fun _ => trivialU L) ell j f) ≤ Ns 1 f

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_telescope.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_telescope
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_telescope.header:
theorem Ns_telescope (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (δ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (J : ℕ) (hδ : ∀ i, i < J → frobSupBond (bg i) ≤ δ i) (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ J → Ns (ell ^ j) (Qcomposite bg ell j f - Qcomposite (fun _ => trivialU L) ell j f)
      ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ i) * Ns 1 f

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.fullGeom.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.fullGeom
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.fullGeom.header: noncomputable def fullGeom (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (ell k : ℕ) : TowerGeom L

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.fullGeom_Lam_.header: theorem fullGeom_Lam_lt (ell k : ℕ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≠ k) : (fullGeom L ell k).Lam j = ∅

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.fullGeom_Lam_.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.fullGeom_Lam_k
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.fullGeom_Lam_.header:
theorem fullGeom_Lam_k (ell k : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inner_DelpA_f.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inner_DelpA_full
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inner_DelpA_f.header:
theorem inner_DelpA_full (ell k : ℕ) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ⟪f, DelpA (fullGeom L ell k) U a f⟫
      = ‖gradL2 U f‖ ^ 2 + ajSeq a ell k * (ell : ℝ) ^ k *
          ∑ y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ k),
            ‖Qcomposite (bgTower (fullGeom L ell k) U) ell k (WithLp.ofLp f) y‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.norm_sq_gradL.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.norm_sq_gradL2'
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.norm_sq_gradL.header:
theorem norm_sq_gradL2' (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖gradL2 U f‖ ^ 2 = ∑ b, ‖gradValueCovariant U (WithLp.ofLp f) b‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.norm_sq_site.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.norm_sq_site
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.norm_sq_site.header: theorem norm_sq_site (f : SiteL2 L) : ‖f‖ ^ 2 = ∑ x, ‖f x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_flat_eq.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_flat_eq
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.sum_flat_eq.header:
theorem sum_flat_eq (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ‖f (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - f b.1‖ ^ 2 = ‖gradL2 (trivialU L) f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.gradL2_drift.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.gradL2_drift
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.gradL2_drift.header:
theorem gradL2_drift (U : Cfg L) {δ0 : ℝ} (h : frobSupBond U ≤ δ0) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖gradL2 U f - gradL2 (trivialU L) f‖ ^ 2 ≤ 12 * δ0 ^ 2 * ‖f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_one.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_one
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.Ns_one.header: theorem Ns_one (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) : Ns 1 f ^ 2 = ∑ x, ‖f x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.ajSeq_ge.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.ajSeq_ge
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.ajSeq_ge.header: theorem ajSeq_ge (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : (3 / 4 : ℝ) * a ≤ ajSeq a ell k

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive_nested
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive.header:
theorem site_coercive_nested (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1) (U : Cfg L)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (α E : ℝ) (hU : frobSupBond U ≤ α / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) (δ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hδ : ∀ i, i < k → frobSupBond (bgTower (fullGeom L ell k) U i) ≤ δ i)
    (hE : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * δ i ≤ E) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    (1 - 72 * α ^ 2 - 4 * E ^ 2) * ‖f‖ ^ 2
      ≤ max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * ⟪f, DelpA (fullGeom L ell k) U a f⟫

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.geom_tower_su.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.geom_tower_sum
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.geom_tower_su.header:
theorem geom_tower_sum (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * (ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) ≤ 6 * ρ

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive_towerclass
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive.header:
theorem site_coercive_towerclass (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1) (U : Cfg L)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hU : frobSupBond U ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (hT : ∀ i, i < k → frobSupBond (bgTower (fullGeom L ell k) U i) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (f : SiteL2 L) :
    (1 - 216 * ρ ^ 2) * ‖f‖ ^ 2
      ≤ max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * ⟪f, DelpA (fullGeom L ell k) U a f⟫

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.blkConstOf_po.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.blkConstOf_pos
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.blkConstOf_po.header: theorem blkConstOf_pos (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) : 0 < blkConstOf ell

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.frobSupBond_b.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.frobSupBond_bgTower_le
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.frobSupBond_b.header:
theorem frobSupBond_bgTower_le (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg L) :
    ∀ i : ℕ, frobSupBond (bgTower (fullGeom L ell k) U i) ≤ (blkConstOf ell) ^ i * frobSupBond U

AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive_small
AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.site_coercive.header:
theorem site_coercive_small (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1) (U : Cfg L)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (α : ℝ) (hU : frobSupBond U ≤ α / (ell : ℝ) ^ k) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    (1 - 72 * α ^ 2 - 4 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, 6 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * ((blkConstOf ell) ^ i * (α / (ell : ℝ) ^ k))) ^ 2)
        * ‖f‖ ^ 2
      ≤ max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 * ⟪f, DelpA (fullGeom L ell k) U a f⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.r1_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.r1_coercive
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.r1_coercive.header:
theorem r1_coercive (D : S →L[ℝ] E) (N : Submodule ℝ S) (R : S →L[ℝ] S) (Φ : E → ℝ)
    (hΦ0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Φ x) (hΦinv : ∀ x, ∀ ν ∈ N, Φ (x + D ν) = Φ x)
    (hRfix : ∀ ν ∈ N, R (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D (D ν)) = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D (D ν))
    (hRc : ∀ s, ‖R s‖ ≤ ‖s‖)
    (P cH Ci : ℝ) (hP0 : 0 ≤ P) (hcH : 0 < cH) (hCi : 0 ≤ Ci)
    (hP : ∀ ν ∈ N, ‖ν‖ ≤ P * ‖D ν‖)
    (hH : ∀ y, cH * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ Φ y + ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D y‖ ^ 2)
    (hI : ∀ y, (∀ ν ∈ N, ⟪ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D y, ν⟫ = 0) →
      ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D y‖ ^ 2 ≤ Ci * Φ y)
    (x : E) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ Kr1 cH Ci P * (Φ x + ‖R (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D x)‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.Kq.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.Kq
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.Kq.header: noncomputable def Kq (cq Ci P : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.r1q_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.r1q_coercive
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.r1q_coercive.header:
theorem r1q_coercive (D : S →L[ℝ] E) (N : Submodule ℝ S) (R : S →L[ℝ] S) (Φ : E → ℝ)
    (hΦinv : ∀ x, ∀ ν ∈ N, Φ (x + D ν) = Φ x)
    (hRfix : ∀ ν ∈ N, R (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D (D ν)) = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D (D ν))
    (hRc : ∀ s, ‖R s‖ ≤ ‖s‖)
    (P cq Ci : ℝ) (hP0 : 0 ≤ P) (hcq : 0 < cq) (hCi : 0 ≤ Ci)
    (hP : ∀ ν ∈ N, ‖ν‖ ≤ P * ‖D ν‖)
    (hQ : ∀ y, (∀ ν ∈ N, ⟪ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D y, ν⟫ = 0) → cq * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ Φ y)
    (hI : ∀ y, (∀ ν ∈ N, ⟪ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D y, ν⟫ = 0) →
      ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D y‖ ^ 2 ≤ Ci * Φ y)
    (x : E) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ Kq cq Ci P * (Φ x + ‖R (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D x)‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.patch_B0.header:
theorem patch_B0 (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ L μ + 1) (U : Cfg L)

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.PhiP.header: noncomputable def PhiP (A : BondFnL2 L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.PhiP_inv.header:

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.Pc.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.Pc
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.Pc.header: noncomputable def Pc (ell k : ℕ) (a ρ : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.poincare_patch.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.poincare_patch
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.poincare_patch.header:
theorem poincare_patch {ell k : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ L μ + 1)
    {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : ProperTower G ell k) (hOm : G.Om0 = Set.univ) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (h216 : 216 * ρ ^ 2 < 1)
    (hU : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hT : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower G U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (ν : SiteL2 L) (hν : ν ∈ NQp G U) : ‖ν‖ ≤ Pc ell k a ρ * ‖gradL2 U ν‖

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.suCoordFInv_suCoord.header: theorem suCoordFInv_suCoord (A : BondFnL2 L) : suCoordFInv (suCoord A) = WithLp.ofLp A

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.qfull_flat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.qfull_flat
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.qfull_flat.header:
theorem qfull_flat (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, G.ell ^ G.k ∣ L μ + 1) (A : BondFnL2 L)
    (p : BIdx G) (hc : p.2.1.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (G.ell ^ (p.1 : ℕ))) :
    (QfullOf G (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) A).ofLp p
      = lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo (G.ell ^ (p.1 : ℕ)) (WithLp.ofLp A) (⟨p.2.1.1, hc⟩, p.2.1.2)

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.lcr_succ.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.lcr_succ
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.lcr_succ.header:
theorem lcr_succ {n ell : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n * ell ∣ L μ + 1)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L (n * ell)) (hcn : c.1.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L n) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo (n * ell) v c
      = (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) • ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1.1 n ell, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
          (if h : pathSite x c.2 (i * n) ∈ CoarseLattice L n then
            lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n v (⟨pathSite x c.2 (i * n), h⟩, c.2) else 0)

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.norm_sum_sq_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.norm_sum_sq_le
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.norm_sum_sq_le.header:
theorem norm_sum_sq_le {ι V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → V) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ ^ 2 ≤ (s.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.lcr_succ_sq.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.lcr_succ_sq
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.lcr_succ_sq.header:
theorem lcr_succ_sq {n ell : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n * ell ∣ L μ + 1)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L (n * ell)) (hcn : c.1.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L n) :
    ‖lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo (n * ell) v c‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1.1 n ell, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
          ‖(if h : pathSite x c.2 (i * n) ∈ CoarseLattice L n then
            lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n v (⟨pathSite x c.2 (i * n), h⟩, c.2) else 0)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.massF.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.massF
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.massF.header: noncomputable def massF (G : TowerGeom L) (a : ℝ) (A : BondFnL2 L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.rv.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.rv
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.rv.header: noncomputable def rv (ell : ℕ) (A : BondFnL2 L) (i : ℕ) (b : Bond L) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.sum_BIdx.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.sum_BIdx
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.sum_BIdx.header:
theorem sum_BIdx (G : TowerGeom L) (F : ℕ → Bond L → ℝ) :
    ∑ p : BIdx G, F (p.1 : ℕ) p.2.1
      = ∑ i : Fin (G.k + 1), ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b => b ∈ bondsLam G i), F i b

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.massF_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.massF_eq
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.massF_eq.header:
theorem massF_eq (ell k : ℕ) {S : Tower L} (a : ℝ) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    massF (geomOf ell k S) a A = ∑ i : Fin (k + 1), ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b => b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) i),
      a * (ell : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * ‖rv ell A i b‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.rv_flat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.rv_flat
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.rv_flat.header:
theorem rv_flat {ell J : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ^ J ∣ L μ + 1) (A : BondFnL2 L) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ J)
    (b : Bond L) (hc : b.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i)) :
    rv ell A i b = lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo (ell ^ i) (WithLp.ofLp A) (⟨b.1, hc⟩, b.2)

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.coarse_of_coarse_mul.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.coarse_of_coarse_mul
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.coarse_of_coarse_mul.header:
theorem coarse_of_coarse_mul {n m : ℕ} {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (h : x ∈ CoarseLattice L (n * m)) :
    x ∈ CoarseLattice L n

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.sum_partition.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.sum_partition
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.sum_partition.header:
theorem sum_partition {n ell : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n * ell ∣ L μ + 1)
    (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ∑ y ∈ CoarseLattice L (n * ell), ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y n ell, h x = ∑ x ∈ CoarseLattice L n, h x

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.pathSite_inj.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.pathSite_inj
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.pathSite_inj.header: theorem pathSite_inj (μ : Fin 3) (k : ℕ) {x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (h : pathSite x μ k = pathSite y μ k) : x = y

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.sum_shift_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.sum_shift_le
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.sum_shift_le.header:
theorem sum_shift_le {n : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) :
    ∑ x ∈ CoarseLattice L n, g (pathSite x μ (i * n)) ≤ ∑ x ∈ CoarseLattice L n, g x

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.not_omGe_of_not_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.not_omGe_of_not_mem
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.not_omGe_of_not_mem.header:
theorem not_omGe_of_not_mem (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : z ∉ Rg) :
    ¬ OmGe (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) (j + 1) z

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.not_row_lt_univ.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.not_row_lt_univ
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.not_row_lt_univ.header:
theorem not_row_lt_univ {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ j) (b : Bond L) :
    b ∉ bondsLam (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)))) i

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.row_univ_coarse.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.row_univ_coarse
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.row_univ_coarse.header:
theorem row_univ_coarse (b : Bond L)
    (hb : b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)))) (j + 1)) :
    OnLat (ell ^ (j + 1)) b.1

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.row_diff_out.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.row_diff_out
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.row_diff_out.header:
theorem row_diff_out (b : Bond L)
    (hb : b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)))) (j + 1))
    (hnb : b ∉ bondsLam (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) (j + 1)) :
    b.1 ∉ Rg ∧ coarseShift b.1 (ell ^ (j + 1)) b.2 ∉ Rg

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.row_j_of_out.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.row_j_of_out
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.row_j_of_out.header:
theorem row_j_of_out (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : OnLat (ell ^ j) x) (μ : Fin 3) (h0 : x ∉ Rg)
    (h1 : coarseShift x (ell ^ j) μ ∉ Rg) :
    ((x, μ) : Bond L) ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) j

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.div_window.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.div_window
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.div_window.header: theorem div_window {N t z : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (h1 : N * t ≤ z) (h2 : z < N * t + N) : z / N = t

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.div_same.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.div_same
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.div_same.header: theorem div_same {N t a b : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (ha : a = N * t) (h1 : N * t ≤ b) (h2 : b < N * t + N) : a / N = b / N

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.shift_out.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.shift_out
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.shift_out.header:
theorem shift_out (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hc : OnLat (ell ^ (j + 1)) c) (μ : Fin 3) (hc0 : c ∉ Rg)
    (hc1 : coarseShift c (ell ^ (j + 1)) μ ∉ Rg) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ blockOf c (ell ^ (j + 1)))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : (x μ).val + k < (c μ).val + 2 * ell ^ (j + 1)) :
    coarseShift x k μ ∉ Rg

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.lcr_succ_sq'.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.lcr_succ_sq'
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.lcr_succ_sq'.header:
theorem lcr_succ_sq' {n ell N : ℕ} (hNe : N = n * ell) (hn : 0 < n) (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ, N ∣ L μ + 1)
    (v : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L N) (hcn : c.1.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L n) :
    ‖lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo N v c‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1.1 n ell, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
          ‖(if h : pathSite x c.2 (i * n) ∈ CoarseLattice L n then
            lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n v (⟨pathSite x c.2 (i * n), h⟩, c.2) else 0)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.onLat_iff_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.onLat_iff_mem
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.onLat_iff_mem.header: theorem onLat_iff_mem {m : ℕ} (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : OnLat m x ↔ x ∈ CoarseLattice L m

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.gcut.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.gcut
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.gcut.header: noncomputable def gcut (ell j : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (A : BondFnL2 L) (w : Bond L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.gcut_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.gcut_nonneg
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.gcut_nonneg.header: theorem gcut_nonneg (w : Bond L) : 0 ≤ gcut ell j Rg A w

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.Tsum.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.Tsum
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.Tsum.header: noncomputable def Tsum (ell j : ℕ) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (A : BondFnL2 L) (b : Bond L) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.row_bound.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.row_bound
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.row_bound.header:
theorem row_bound (b : Bond L)
    (hb : b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)))) (j + 1))
    (hnb : b ∉ bondsLam (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) (j + 1)) :
    ‖rv ell A (j + 1) b‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * Tsum ell j Rg A b

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.tsum_count.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.tsum_count
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.tsum_count.header: theorem tsum_count : ∑ b : Bond L, Tsum ell j Rg A b ≤ (ell : ℝ) * ∑ w : Bond L, gcut ell j Rg A w

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.massF_univ_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.massF_univ_le
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.massF_univ_le.header:
theorem massF_univ_le (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    massF (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)))) a A
      ≤ massF (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) a A

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.GP.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.GP
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.GP.header:
abbrev GP (ell j : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu))) :
    TowerGeom (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.LemIFlat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.LemIFlat
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.LemIFlat.header: def LemIFlat (ell : ℕ) (a Ci : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.Kflat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.Kflat
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.Kflat.header: noncomputable def Kflat (a Ci : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.dvd_scaleUp.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.dvd_scaleUp
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.dvd_scaleUp.header:
theorem dvd_scaleUp (ell j : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) :
    ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu μ + 1

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.delta_flat_eq_dpi.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.delta_flat_eq_dpi
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.delta_flat_eq_dpi.header:
theorem delta_flat_eq_dpi {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G G' : TowerGeom L) (hG : G.Om0 = Set.univ)
    (hG' : G'.Om0 = Set.univ) (a : ℝ) (y : BondFnL2 L) :
    ⟪y, Delta G (flatCfg : Cfg L) y⟫ = ⟪y, DpiFull G' (flatCfg : Cfg L) a y⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.qc_flat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.qc_flat
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.qc_flat.header:
theorem qc_flat {ell j : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) {Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu))}
    (hRg : BlockClosed (ell ^ (j + 1)) Rg) {a Ci : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hCi : 0 ≤ Ci)
    (y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu))
    (hI : ‖gradAdj (flatCfg : Cfg _) y‖ ^ 2 ≤ Ci * PhiP (GP ell j Lu Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg _) a y) :
    (min a 1 / 1000) / (((ell : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) ^ 2 * (1 + Ci)) * ‖y‖ ^ 2
      ≤ PhiP (GP ell j Lu Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg _) a y

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.flat_hU.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.flat_hU
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.flat_hU.header:
theorem flat_hU (ell k : ℕ) {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : TowerGeom L) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ b ∈ AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
      frobNorm (((flatCfg : Cfg L) b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ (0 : ℝ) / (ell : ℝ) ^ j

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.flat_hT.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.flat_hT
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.flat_hT.header:
theorem flat_hT (ell k : ℕ) {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : TowerGeom L) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.blockOf y (ell ^ j),
      z ∈ AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoarseCurl.coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower G (flatCfg : Cfg L) i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ (0 : ℝ) * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.w3_flat_plain.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.w3_flat_plain
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.w3_flat_plain.header:
theorem w3_flat_plain {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a Ci : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hCi : 0 ≤ Ci) (hI : LemIFlat ell a Ci)
    (j : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)))
    (hRg : BlockClosed (ell ^ (j + 1)) Rg) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (x : ↥(bondSupp (GP ell j Lu Rg))) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) ^ 2 * Kflat a Ci *
      ⟪x, (gparams ell (j + 1) Lu (by omega) (patchTower j Rg) (flatCfg : Cfg _) a Lam).data.Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.W3FlatStmt.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.W3FlatStmt
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.W3FlatStmt.header: def W3FlatStmt (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.W3Stmt.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.W3Stmt
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.W3Stmt.header: def W3Stmt (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.W3Stmt.toFlat.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.W3Stmt.toFlat
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.W3Stmt.toFlat.header: theorem W3Stmt.toFlat {ell : ℕ} {hell : 0 < ell} {a : ℝ} (h : W3Stmt ell hell a) : W3FlatStmt ell hell a

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.wnorm_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.wnorm_le
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.wnorm_le.header:
theorem wnorm_le (ell j : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    wnormSq (patchTower j Rg) ell (j + 1) A ≤ (((ell : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹) ^ 2 * ‖A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.w3flat_of_LemI.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.w3flat_of_LemI
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.w3flat_of_LemI.header:
theorem w3flat_of_LemI {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a Ci : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hCi : 0 ≤ Ci) (hI : LemIFlat ell a Ci) :
    W3FlatStmt ell (by omega) a

AdalyFormal.M1Patch.w3_of_QI.name: AdalyFormal.M1Patch.w3_of_QI
AdalyFormal.M1Patch.w3_of_QI.header:
theorem w3_of_QI {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (j : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent)
    (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu))) (hRg : BlockClosed (ell ^ (j + 1)) Rg)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (h216 : 216 * ρ ^ 2 < 1)
    (hU : ∀ i, i ≤ j + 1 → ∀ y ∈ (GP ell j Lu Rg).Lam i, ∀ b ∈ AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inBlockBonds y (ell ^ i),
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ i)
    (hT : ∀ i, i ≤ j + 1 → ∀ y ∈ (GP ell j Lu Rg).Lam i, ∀ i', i' < i → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ i),
      z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu) (ell ^ i') → ∀ μ : Fin 3, coarseShift z (ell ^ i') μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ i) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower (GP ell j Lu Rg) U i' (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i' / (ell : ℝ) ^ i)
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GP ell j Lu Rg) U) (j + 1))
    (cq Ci : ℝ) (hcq : 0 < cq) (hCi : 0 ≤ Ci)
    (hQ : ∀ y, (∀ ν ∈ NQp (GP ell j Lu Rg) U, ⟪gradAdj U y, ν⟫ = 0) → cq * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ PhiP (GP ell j Lu Rg) U a y)
    (hI : ∀ y, (∀ ν ∈ NQp (GP ell j Lu Rg) U, ⟪gradAdj U y, ν⟫ = 0) →
      ‖gradAdj U y‖ ^ 2 ≤ Ci * PhiP (GP ell j Lu Rg) U a y)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (x : ↥(bondSupp (GP ell j Lu Rg))) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ Kq cq Ci (Pc ell (j + 1) a ρ) *
      ⟪x, (gparams ell (j + 1) Lu (by omega) (patchTower j Rg) U a Lam).data.Ginv x⟫

HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.derivativ.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.derivative_paths_supported
HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.derivativ.header:
theorem derivative_paths_supported : ∀ (a b d : Fin 2) (mu : Fin 3),
    coarseOutput a b d mu ∉ exceptionalRows →
    ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf (coarseOutput a b d mu).1.1 1 2,
      derivativePathCount (coarseOutput a b d mu) x = 0

HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.other_der.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.other_derivative_paths_zero
HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.other_der.header:
theorem other_derivative_paths_zero (c : Output) (hc : c ∉ exceptionalRows) :
    ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1.1 1 2, derivativePathCount c x = 0

HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.exception.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.exceptionalRows_exact
HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.exception.header:
theorem exceptionalRows_exact : ∀ (a b d : Fin 2) (mu : Fin 3),
    coarseOutput a b d mu ∈ exceptionalRows ↔
      ∃ x ∈ stepBlockOf (coarseOutput a b d mu).1.1 1 2,
        derivativePathCount (coarseOutput a b d mu) x ≠ 0

HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.sixth_row.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.sixth_row_witness
HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.sixth_row.header:
theorem sixth_row_witness :
    ∃ x ∈ stepBlockOf (coarseOutput 1 0 0 0).1.1 1 2,
      derivativePathCount (coarseOutput 1 0 0 0) x ≠ 0 ∧
      loopWord (coarseOutput 1 0 0 0) x = 0

HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.tree_word.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.tree_word_support
HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.tree_word.header:
theorem tree_word_support : ∀ (a b d : Fin 2),
    ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf (coarseOutput a b d 0).1.1 1 2,
    wordCount (coarseOutput a b d 0).1.1
      (coarseGammaPath 1 (coarseOutput a b d 0).1.1 x) =
      if (coarseOutput a b d 0).1.1 = witnessY ∧ x = specialEndpoint then 1 else 0

HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.tree_word.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.tree_word_support_output
HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.tree_word.header:
theorem tree_word_support_output (c : Output) (x : Site)
    (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1.1 1 2) :
    wordCount c.1.1 (coarseGammaPath 1 c.1.1 x) =
      if c.1.1 = witnessY ∧ x = specialEndpoint then 1 else 0

HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.lineInteg.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.lineIntegral_eq_flat_of_wordCount_zero
HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.lineInteg.header:
theorem lineIntegral_eq_flat_of_wordCount_zero (t : ℝ)
    (A : CoarseBond witnessL 1 → SuTwo) (y : Site) (p : List (Fin 3))
    (h : wordCount y p = 0) :

AdalySI1Noloop.ProdAssemble.hasDerivAt_m.header:
theorem hasDerivAt_modifiedAverage_coe_configMul_noloop
    (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (hah : ∀ e, (A e)ᴴ = -(A e))
    (htr : ∀ e, Matrix.trace (A e) = 0) (ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (hnc2 : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 1 ell, loopVar 1 ell V0 c x ≠ su2NegOne) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ((modifiedAverage V0 ell (fun e => su2Exp (t • A e)) c : SU2) : M2))
      ((∑ x ∈ AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.blockOf c.1 ell,
            ((ell : ℚ) ^ 3)⁻¹ • AdalySI1.IngredientDeriv.dirDeriv V0 A c.1
              (AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.GammaPath c.1 x) 1)ᴴ
        + ((fderiv ℝ NormedSpace.exp (AdalySI1.RawUbarDerivNoLoop.ubarBracket V0 ell c))
              (∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 1 ell, ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ •
                deriv (fun t : ℝ =>
                  su2Log (loopVar 1 ell (configMul (fun e => su2Exp (t • A e)) V0) c x)) 0)
              * ((AdalyFormal.Balaban.UbarTowerCov.coarseBondVar 1 ell V0 c : SU2) : M2)
            + ((su2Exp (AdalySI1.RawUbarDerivNoLoop.ubarBracket V0 ell c) : SU2) : M2)
              * AdalySI1.RawAverageDeriv.holonomyDirDeriv V0 A 1 c.1 (List.replicate ell c.2))
          * ((ubarSU2 1 ell V0 c : SU2) : M2)ᴴ
        + ((ubarSU2 1 ell V0 c : SU2) : M2)
          * (∑ x ∈ AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.blockOf (cPlus ell c) ell,
              ((ell : ℚ) ^ 3)⁻¹ • AdalySI1.IngredientDeriv.dirDeriv V0 A (cPlus ell c)
                (AdalyFormal.Balaban.Q1Real.GammaPath (cPlus ell c) x) 1)
          * ((ubarSU2 1 ell V0 c : SU2) : M2)ᴴ) 0

theorem cover_main {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {N ell M A0 A B B0 : ℕ} (hN : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = N)
    (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hMA0 : M ∣ A0) (hMB0 : M ∣ B0) (hgA : M * ell ∣ A) (hgB : M * ell ∣ B)
    (hA0pos : 0 < A0) (hApos : 0 < A)
    (hW0 : A0 + 12 * M ≤ B0) (hW1 : A + 12 * (M * ell) ≤ B) (hB0N : B0 ≤ N) (hBN : B ≤ N)
    (hNb : 12 * M + 12 * (M * ell) ≤ N)
    (D : Fin 3 → Prop) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hT : ∀ y, AdjD N D x y → y ∈ (TU A0 A B B0 L).Om 0) :
    ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (j : ℕ), IsClassCube ell M 12 1 (TU A0 A B B0 L) sites j ∧
      ∀ y, AdjD N D x y → y ∈ sites

AdalyFormal.P409.TU_coversp.name: AdalyFormal.P409.TU_coversp
AdalyFormal.P409.TU_coversp.header:
theorem TU_coversp {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {N ell M A0 A B B0 : ℕ} (hN : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = N) (hN1 : 1 < N)
    (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hMA0 : M ∣ A0) (hMB0 : M ∣ B0) (hgA : M * ell ∣ A) (hgB : M * ell ∣ B)
    (hA0pos : 0 < A0) (hApos : 0 < A)
    (hW0 : A0 + 12 * M ≤ B0) (hW1 : A + 12 * (M * ell) ≤ B) (hB0N : B0 ≤ N) (hBN : B ≤ N)
    (hNb : 12 * M + 12 * (M * ell) ≤ N) :
    CoversOm0p ell M 12 1 (TU A0 A B B0 L)

AdalyFormal.P409.LFail.name: AdalyFormal.P409.LFail
AdalyFormal.P409.LFail.header: def LFail (ell M R : ℕ) (Lu Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent) : Prop

AdalyFormal.P409.lf_counterexample.name: AdalyFormal.P409.lf_counterexample
AdalyFormal.P409.lf_counterexample.header:
theorem lf_counterexample {ell M R : ℕ} {Lu Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hellM : ell ∣ M) (hR : 12 ≤ R)
    (hLu : ∀ μ, Lu μ + 1 = M * (4 * R + 8)) (hLf : ∀ μ, Lf μ + 1 = M * ell * (4 * R + 8)) :
    LFail ell M R Lu Lf

AdalyFormal.P409.lf_counterexample_exist.name: AdalyFormal.P409.lf_counterexample_exists
AdalyFormal.P409.lf_counterexample_exist.header:
theorem lf_counterexample_exists {ell M R : ℕ}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hellM : ell ∣ M) (hR : 12 ≤ R) :
    ∃ Lu Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent, (∀ μ, Lu μ + 1 = M * (4 * R + 8)) ∧ (∀ μ, Lf μ + 1 = M * ell * (4 * R + 8)) ∧
      LFail ell M R Lu Lf

AdalyFormal.P409.lf_counterexample_pow.name: AdalyFormal.P409.lf_counterexample_pow
AdalyFormal.P409.lf_counterexample_pow.header:
theorem lf_counterexample_pow {ell m R : ℕ} {Lu Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hm : 5 ≤ m) (hR : 45 * ell + 30 ≤ R)
    (hLu : ∀ μ, Lu μ + 1 = ell ^ m * (4 * R + 8)) (hLf : ∀ μ, Lf μ + 1 = ell ^ m * ell * (4 * R + 8)) :
    LFail ell (ell ^ m) R Lu Lf

AdalyFormal.P409W.mod_add_cases.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.mod_add_cases
AdalyFormal.P409W.mod_add_cases.header:
theorem mod_add_cases (a s N : ℕ) (ha : a < N) (hs : s ≤ N) :
    (a + s < N ∧ (a + s) % N = a + s) ∨ (N ≤ a + s ∧ (a + s) % N = a + s - N)

AdalyFormal.P409W.pcd_shift_le.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.pcd_shift_le
AdalyFormal.P409W.pcd_shift_le.header:
theorem pcd_shift_le (N a s : ℕ) (ha : a < N) (hs : s ≤ N) :
    pcd N a ((a + s) % N) ≤ s ∧ pcd N a ((a + s) % N) ≤ N - s

AdalyFormal.P409W.blocks_ne.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.blocks_ne
AdalyFormal.P409W.blocks_ne.header:
theorem blocks_ne (g N a s : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (hgN : g ∣ N) (hgs : g ∣ s) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hsN : s < N)
    (ha : a < N) : ((a + s) % N) / g ≠ a / g

AdalyFormal.P409W.div_shift.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.div_shift
AdalyFormal.P409W.div_shift.header:
theorem div_shift (M N a a' s : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) (hMN : M ∣ N) (hMs : M ∣ s) (h : a / M = a' / M) :
    ((a + s) % N) / M = ((a' + s) % N) / M

AdalyFormal.P409W.pcd_toward.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.pcd_toward
AdalyFormal.P409W.pcd_toward.header:
theorem pcd_toward (N M a b : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) (h2 : 2 * M ≤ N) (ha : a < N) (hb : b < N) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, (s = M ∨ s + M = N) ∧
      ((M ≤ pcd N a b → pcd N ((a + s) % N) b + M ≤ pcd N a b) ∧
       (pcd N a b < M → pcd N ((a + s) % N) b ≤ M))

AdalyFormal.P409W.coord_box.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.coord_box
AdalyFormal.P409W.coord_box.header:
theorem coord_box (N a r s : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (ha : a < N) (hs : 2 * r + 1 ≤ s) :
    ∃ z : ℕ, z < N ∧ (z = 0 ∨ (r ≤ a ∧ z = a - r) ∨ (a < r ∧ z = a + N - r)) ∧
      ∀ b : ℕ, b < N → pcd N a b ≤ r → (b + N - z) % N < s

AdalyFormal.P409W.pcd_le_pdist_coord.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.pcd_le_pdist_coord
AdalyFormal.P409W.pcd_le_pdist_coord.header:
theorem pcd_le_pdist_coord (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (σ : Fin 3) :
    pcd (L σ + 1) (x σ).val (y σ).val ≤ pdist x y

AdalyFormal.P409W.box_site.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.box_site
AdalyFormal.P409W.box_site.header:
theorem box_site (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (r s : ℕ) (hs : 2 * r + 1 ≤ s) :
    ∃ z : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, pdist w y ≤ r → y ∈ siteBox z s

AdalyFormal.P409W.coord_box_cell.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.coord_box_cell
AdalyFormal.P409W.coord_box_cell.header:
theorem coord_box_cell (N g a r : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (hgN : g ∣ N) (hga : g ∣ a) (hgr : g ∣ r) (ha : a < N) :
    ∃ z : ℕ, z < N ∧ ∀ b b' : ℕ, b < N → b' < N → b / g = b' / g → pcd N a b ≤ r → (b' + N - z) % N < 2 * r + g

AdalyFormal.P409W.box_site_cell.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.box_site_cell
AdalyFormal.P409W.box_site_cell.header:
theorem box_site_cell (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (r g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (hgN : ∀ μ : Fin 3, g ∣ L μ + 1)
    (hgw : ∀ μ : Fin 3, g ∣ (w μ).val) (hgr : g ∣ r) :
    ∃ z : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ∀ y y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L, pdist w y ≤ r →
      (∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val / g = (y' μ).val / g) → y' ∈ siteBox z (2 * r + g)

AdalyFormal.P409W.sh.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.sh
AdalyFormal.P409W.sh.header: def sh (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (s : ℕ) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.P409W.sh_self.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.sh_self
AdalyFormal.P409W.sh_self.header:
theorem sh_self (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (s : ℕ) :
    ((sh x μ s) μ).val = ((x μ).val + s) % (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.P409W.sh_ne.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.sh_ne
AdalyFormal.P409W.sh_ne.header: theorem sh_ne (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) (s : ℕ) (h : ν ≠ μ) : (sh x μ s) ν = x ν

AdalyFormal.P409W.pdist_sh_le.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.pdist_sh_le
AdalyFormal.P409W.pdist_sh_le.header:
theorem pdist_sh_le (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (s : ℕ) (hs : s ≤ L μ + 1) :
    pdist x (sh x μ s) ≤ s ∧ pdist x (sh x μ s) ≤ L μ + 1 - s

AdalyFormal.P409W.pdist_swap.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.pdist_swap
AdalyFormal.P409W.pdist_swap.header:
theorem pdist_swap (x y t : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (h : ∀ ν, ν ≠ μ → y ν = x ν) :
    pdist y t + pcd (L μ + 1) (x μ).val (t μ).val = pdist x t + pcd (L μ + 1) (y μ).val (t μ).val

AdalyFormal.P409W.bigSide_zero.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.bigSide_zero
AdalyFormal.P409W.bigSide_zero.header: theorem bigSide_zero (M ell : ℕ) : bigSide M ell 0 = M

AdalyFormal.P409W.bigSide_pos'.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.bigSide_pos'
AdalyFormal.P409W.bigSide_pos'.header: theorem bigSide_pos' {M ell : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 0 < ell) (i : ℕ) : 0 < bigSide M ell i

AdalyFormal.P409W.bigSide_mono'.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.bigSide_mono'
AdalyFormal.P409W.bigSide_mono'.header: theorem bigSide_mono' {M ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) : bigSide M ell i ≤ bigSide M ell j

AdalyFormal.P409W.toward_site.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.toward_site
AdalyFormal.P409W.toward_site.header:
theorem toward_site (M R : ℕ) (z y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 4 ≤ R)
    (hN : ∀ μ, 2 * M ≤ L μ + 1) (hd : pdist z y ≤ R * M) :
    ∃ (μ : Fin 3) (s : ℕ), (s = M ∨ s + M = L μ + 1) ∧ pdist (sh z μ s) y ≤ R * M

AdalyFormal.P409W.setw_core.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.setw_core
AdalyFormal.P409W.setw_core.header:
theorem setw_core {ell M R k c j : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {w : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hc : 4 ≤ c) (hR : (c + 3) * ell ≤ R)
    (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hgt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k < L μ + 1)
    (hp : IsPatch ell M k 1 S j w) :
    ∃ i : ℕ, i ≤ j ∧ bigSide M ell i ∣ bigSide M ell j ∧ bigSide M ell j ≤ ell * bigSide M ell i ∧
      (∀ y, y ∈ patch ell M 1 c j w → y ∈ S.Om 0 → y ∈ towerBj S i ∪ towerBj S (i + 1)) ∧
      (∃ y, y ∈ patch ell M 1 c j w ∧ y ∈ S.Om 0 ∧ y ∈ towerBj S i) ∧
      (∃ a b : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (a ∈ patch ell M 1 c j w ∧ a ∈ S.Om 0) ∧ (b ∈ patch ell M 1 c j w ∧ b ∈ S.Om 0) ∧
        ∃ μ : Fin 3, (a μ).val / bigSide M ell i ≠ (b μ).val / bigSide M ell i)

AdalyFormal.P409W.setw_contains.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.setw_contains
AdalyFormal.P409W.setw_contains.header:
theorem setw_contains {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell M R k c j : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {w : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hc : 4 ≤ c) (hR : (c + 3) * ell ≤ R)
    (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hgt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k < L μ + 1)
    (hp : IsPatch ell M k 1 S j w) :
    ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ), IsClassSetW ell M (2 * c * ell + 1) k S sites i ∧
      {y | y ∈ patch ell M 1 c j w ∧ y ∈ S.Om 0} ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.P409W.p409_setw_holds.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.p409_setw_holds
AdalyFormal.P409W.p409_setw_holds.header:
theorem p409_setw_holds {ell M R k j : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hLu : ∀ μ : Fin 3, M < Lu μ + 1) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)
    {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S)
    {w : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hp : IsPatch ell M k 1 S j w) :
    ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (i : ℕ),
      IsClassSetW ell M (10 * ell + 1) k S sites i ∧
      {y | y ∈ patch ell M 1 5 j w ∧ y ∈ S.Om 0} ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.P409W.p409_setw_holds_genera.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.p409_setw_holds_general
AdalyFormal.P409W.p409_setw_holds_genera.header:
theorem p409_setw_holds_general {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell M R k c j : ℕ} {S : Tower L}
    {w : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hc : 4 ≤ c) (hR : (c + 3) * ell ≤ R)
    (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hgt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k < L μ + 1)
    (hp : IsPatch ell M k 1 S j w) :
    ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ), IsClassSetW ell M (2 * c * ell + 1) k S sites i ∧
      {y | y ∈ patch ell M 1 c j w ∧ y ∈ S.Om 0} ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.P409W.TUniv.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.TUniv
AdalyFormal.P409W.TUniv.header: def TUniv (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (k : ℕ) : Tower L

AdalyFormal.P409W.TUniv_om_le.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.TUniv_om_le
AdalyFormal.P409W.TUniv_om_le.header: theorem TUniv_om_le {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {k j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ k) : (TUniv L k).Om j = Set.univ

AdalyFormal.P409W.TUniv_om_gt.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.TUniv_om_gt
AdalyFormal.P409W.TUniv_om_gt.header: theorem TUniv_om_gt {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {k j : ℕ} (h : k < j) : (TUniv L k).Om j = ∅

AdalyFormal.P409W.degenerate_admissible.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.degenerate_admissible
AdalyFormal.P409W.degenerate_admissible.header:
theorem degenerate_admissible {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell M k : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, L μ + 1 = bigSide M ell k) : Admissible ell M R k (TUniv L k)

AdalyFormal.P409W.degenerate_patch.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.degenerate_patch
AdalyFormal.P409W.degenerate_patch.header:
theorem degenerate_patch {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell M k : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, L μ + 1 = bigSide M ell k) :
    ∃ w : PeriodicLatticeSite L, IsPatch ell M k 1 (TUniv L k) k w

AdalyFormal.P409W.degenerate_no_setw.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.degenerate_no_setw
AdalyFormal.P409W.degenerate_no_setw.header:
theorem degenerate_no_setw {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell M k : ℕ}
    (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, L μ + 1 = bigSide M ell k) (F : ℕ)
    (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ) :
    ¬ IsClassSetW ell M F k (TUniv L k) sites i

AdalyFormal.P409W.bigSide_dvd'.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.bigSide_dvd'
AdalyFormal.P409W.bigSide_dvd'.header: theorem bigSide_dvd' (M ell : ℕ) {i t : ℕ} (h : i ≤ t) : bigSide M ell i ∣ bigSide M ell t

AdalyFormal.P409W.om_cell.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.om_cell
AdalyFormal.P409W.om_cell.header:
theorem om_cell {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) {i t : ℕ} (hit : i ≤ t)
    {x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ S.Om t)
    (hxy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val / bigSide M ell i = (x μ).val / bigSide M ell i) : y ∈ S.Om t

AdalyFormal.P409W.setwB_contains.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.setwB_contains
AdalyFormal.P409W.setwB_contains.header:
theorem setwB_contains {ell M R k c j : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {w : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hc : 4 ≤ c) (hR : (c + 3) * ell ≤ R)
    (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hgt : ∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k < L μ + 1)
    (hp : IsPatch ell M k 1 S j w) :
    ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ), IsClassSetW ell M (2 * c * ell + 1) k S sites i ∧
      BlockClosed (bigSide M ell i) sites ∧
      {y | y ∈ patch ell M 1 c j w ∧ y ∈ S.Om 0} ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.P409W.p409_setwB_holds.name: AdalyFormal.P409W.p409_setwB_holds
AdalyFormal.P409W.p409_setwB_holds.header:
theorem p409_setwB_holds {ell M R k j : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hLu : ∀ μ : Fin 3, M < Lu μ + 1) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)
    {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hA : Admissible ell M R k S)
    {w : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hp : IsPatch ell M k 1 S j w) :
    ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (i : ℕ),
      IsClassSetW ell M (10 * ell + 1) k S sites i ∧ BlockClosed (bigSide M ell i) sites ∧
      {y | y ∈ patch ell M 1 5 j w ∧ y ∈ S.Om 0} ⊆ sites

AdalyQIdentification.QJ.chiBond.name: AdalyQIdentification.QJ.chiBond
AdalyQIdentification.QJ.chiBond.header:
noncomputable def chiBond (s : ℕ) :
    (CoarseBond L s → hermTraceless) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (CoarseBond L s → SuTwo)

AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQ124.name: AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQ124
AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQ124.header:
noncomputable def sourceQ124 (s ell : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :
    (CoarseBond L s → hermTraceless) →ₗ[ℝ]
      (CoarseBond L (s * ell) → hermTraceless)

AdalyQIdentification.QJ.chiBond_sourceQ1.name: AdalyQIdentification.QJ.chiBond_sourceQ124
AdalyQIdentification.QJ.chiBond_sourceQ1.header:
theorem chiBond_sourceQ124 (s ell : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (A : CoarseBond L s → hermTraceless) :
    chiBond (s * ell) (sourceQ124 s ell V A) =
      q124Principal s ell V (chiBond s A)

AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQV_eq_sour.name: AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQV_eq_sourceQ124
AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQV_eq_sour.header:
theorem sourceQV_eq_sourceQ124 (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (A : CoarseBond L 1 → hermTraceless) (c : CoarseBond L (1 * ell))
    (hnc : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1.1 1 ell,
      loopVar 1 ell V (c.1.1, c.2) x ≠ su2NegOne)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : η ≠ 0) :
    sourceQV V ell η A c = ((sourceQ124 1 ell V A c : hermTraceless) : M2)

AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj.name: AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj
AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj.header:
noncomputable def sourceQj (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ) :
    (j : ℕ) → (CoarseBond L 1 → hermTraceless) →ₗ[ℝ]
      (CoarseBond L (ell ^ j) → hermTraceless)
  | 0 => LinearMap.id
  | j + 1 => (sourceQ124 (ell ^ j) ell (bg j)).comp (sourceQj bg ell j)

theorem sourceQj_zero (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ) :
    sourceQj bg ell 0 = LinearMap.id

AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_zero.name: AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_zero
AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_zero.header:
theorem sourceQj_zero (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ) :
    sourceQj bg ell 0 = LinearMap.id

AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_succ.name: AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_succ
AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_succ.header:
theorem sourceQj_succ (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell j : ℕ) :
    sourceQj bg ell (j + 1) =
      (sourceQ124 (ell ^ j) ell (bg j)).comp (sourceQj bg ell j)

AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_one.name: AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_one
AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_one.header:
theorem sourceQj_one (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ) :
    sourceQj bg ell 1 = sourceQ124 1 ell (bg 0)

AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_two.name: AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_two
AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_two.header:
theorem sourceQj_two (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : CoarseBond L 1 → hermTraceless) (c : CoarseBond L (ell ^ (1 + 1))) :
    sourceQj bg ell (1 + 1) A c =
      sourceQ124 (ell ^ 1) ell (bg 1) (sourceQj bg ell 1 A) c

AdalyQIdentification.QJ.chiBond_sourceQj.name: AdalyQIdentification.QJ.chiBond_sourceQj
AdalyQIdentification.QJ.chiBond_sourceQj.header:
theorem chiBond_sourceQj (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell j : ℕ)
    (A : CoarseBond L 1 → hermTraceless) :
    chiBond (ell ^ j) (sourceQj bg ell j A) =
      qCompositeBond bg ell j (chiBond 1 A)

AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_eq_inve.name: AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_eq_inverse_chart
AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_eq_inve.header:
theorem sourceQj_eq_inverse_chart (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (ell j : ℕ) (A : CoarseBond L 1 → hermTraceless) :
    sourceQj bg ell j A =
      (chiBond (ell ^ j)).symm (qCompositeBond bg ell j (chiBond 1 A))

AdalyQIdentification.QJ.QjInChart.name: AdalyQIdentification.QJ.QjInChart
AdalyQIdentification.QJ.QjInChart.header:
noncomputable def QjInChart (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell j : ℕ) :
    (CoarseBond L 1 → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] (CoarseBond L (ell ^ j) → SuTwo)

AdalyQIdentification.QJ.QjInChart_eq_qCo.name: AdalyQIdentification.QJ.QjInChart_eq_qCompositeBond
AdalyQIdentification.QJ.QjInChart_eq_qCo.header:
theorem QjInChart_eq_qCompositeBond
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell j : ℕ) :
    QjInChart bg ell j = qCompositeBond bg ell j

AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_matrix_.name: AdalyQIdentification.QJ.sourceQj_matrix_chart
