AdalyQIdentification.QJ.unnormalizedLine.header:
noncomputable def unnormalizedLinearChain
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ) (η : ℝ) :
    (j : ℕ) → (CoarseBond L 1 → hermTraceless) →ₗ[ℝ]
      (CoarseBond L (ell ^ j) → hermTraceless)
  | 0 => η • LinearMap.id
  | j + 1 => ((ell : ℝ) • sourceQ124 (ell ^ j) ell (bg j)).comp
      (unnormalizedLinearChain bg ell η j)

                                                                
theorem unnormalizedLinearChain_eq
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    unnormalizedLinearChain bg ell η j = ((ell : ℝ) ^ j * η) • sourceQj bg ell j

AdalyQIdentification.QJ.unnormalizedLine.header:
theorem unnormalizedLinearChain_eq

AdalyQIdentification.QJ.normalize_unnorm.header:

QSurjRInverse.mem_cornerLine_iff.name: QSurjRInverse.mem_cornerLine_iff
QSurjRInverse.mem_cornerLine_iff.header:
theorem mem_cornerLine_iff {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))

    (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    (μ : Fin 3) {s : ℕ} (hs : s < ell) :

QSurjRInverse.norm_secFun_apply.name: QSurjRInverse.norm_secFun_apply
QSurjRInverse.norm_secFun_apply.header:
theorem norm_secFun_apply (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (F : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (bd : Bond L) :
    ‖secFun U hell F bd‖

QSurjRInverse.exists_transport_uniform_b.header:

HConstruction.Coeff.quarterTurn_as_rotat.name: HConstruction.Coeff.quarterTurn_as_rotations
HConstruction.Coeff.quarterTurn_as_rotat.header:
theorem quarterTurn_as_rotations (X : SuTwo) :

AdalyQIdentification.QV.source_positive_.header:

    configMul (fun b => su2Exp (τ • unitBondDir (fun c => chi (A c)) b)) V e =

AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.rProdAux.header:
def rProdAux (s : ℕ) (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :
    SU2 → PeriodicLatticeSite L → List (Fin 3) → SU2
  | _, _, [] => 1
  | h, y, μ :: rest =>
      (h * V1 (y, μ) * h⁻¹) * rProdAux s V0 V1 (h * V0 (y, μ)) (coarseShift y s μ) rest

                                                      
def rProd (s : ℕ) (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (p : List (Fin 3)) : SU2

AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.rProdAux_.name: AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.rProdAux_eq
AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.rProdAux_.header:
theorem rProdAux_eq (s : ℕ) (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    ∀ (h : SU2) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L),
      rProdAux s V0 V1 h y p
        = h * coarsePathHolonomy s (fun b => V1 b * V0 b) y p * (coarsePathHolonomy s V0 y p)⁻¹
          * h⁻¹

AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.rProd_eq.name: AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.rProd_eq
AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.rProd_eq.header:

    (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    rProd s V0 V1 y p
      = coarsePathHolonomy s (fun b => V1 b * V0 b) y p * (coarsePathHolonomy s V0 y p)⁻¹

AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.rawStep_s.name: AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.rawStep_simp
AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.rawStep_s.header:
theorem rawStep_simp (s ell : ℕ) (V0 V1 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    rawStep s ell V0 V1 c
      = su2Exp (-(sBlock s ell V0 V1 c.1))
        * stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp s ell (fun b => V1 b * V0 b) c
        * su2Exp (sBlock s ell V0 V1 (cPlusS s ell c))
        * (stridedBlockedGauge su2LogExp s ell V0 c)⁻¹

    (hreg : RegTower ell bg J) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < J) :

    C2CompX ell bg (j + 1) a

AdalyFormal.ReadsetComplete.compQ.name: AdalyFormal.ReadsetComplete.compQ
AdalyFormal.ReadsetComplete.compQ.header:
noncomputable def compQ (QS : ℕ → (XS L →L[ℝ] XS L)) : ℕ → (XS L →L[ℝ] XS L)
  | 0 => ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (XS L)
  | j + 1 => (QS j).comp (compQ QS j)

noncomputable def compD (QS : ℕ → (XS L →L[ℝ] XS L)) (DS : ℕ → (XS L →ₗ[ℝ] XS L →ₗ[ℝ] XS L)) :
    ℕ → (XS L →ₗ[ℝ] XS L →ₗ[ℝ] XS L)
  | 0 => 0
  | j + 1 => LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ
      (fun a b => QS j (compD QS DS j a b) + DS j (compQ QS j a) (compQ QS j b))
      (fun a a' b => by simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; abel)
      (fun r a b => by simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_add])
      (fun a b b' => by simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; abel)
      (fun r a b => by simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_add])

theorem compQ_succ_apply (QS : ℕ → (XS L →L[ℝ] XS L)) (j : ℕ) (v : XS L) :
    compQ QS (j + 1) v = QS j (compQ QS j v)

  | 0 => 0
  | j + 1 => LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ
      (fun a b => QS j (compD QS DS j a b) + DS j (compQ QS j a) (compQ QS j b))
      (fun a a' b => by simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; abel)
      (fun r a b => by simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_add])
      (fun a b b' => by simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; abel)

theorem compQ_succ_apply (QS : ℕ → (XS L →L[ℝ] XS L)) (j : ℕ) (v : XS L) :
    compQ QS (j + 1) v = QS j (compQ QS j v)

AdalyFormal.ReadsetComplete.compQ_succ_a.header:

AdalyFormal.ReadsetComplete.compD_succ_a.header:
theorem compD_succ_apply (QS : ℕ → (XS L →L[ℝ] XS L)) (DS : ℕ → (XS L →ₗ[ℝ] XS L →ₗ[ℝ] XS L)) (j : ℕ) (v w : XS L) :

AdalyFormal.ReadsetComplete.QlinCompL_eq.name: AdalyFormal.ReadsetComplete.QlinCompL_eq_compQ
AdalyFormal.ReadsetComplete.QlinCompL_eq.header:
theorem QlinCompL_eq_compQ (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :
    ∀ j, QlinCompL ell bg j = compQ (fun l => QlinStepL (ell ^ l) ell (bg l)) j
  | 0 => rfl
  | j + 1 => by rw [QlinCompL_succ, QlinCompL_eq_compQ ell bg j]; rfl

theorem D2CompL_eq_compD (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :
    ∀ j, D2CompL ell bg j = compD (fun l => QlinStepL (ell ^ l) ell (bg l)) (fun l => D2StepL (ell ^ l) ell (bg l)) j
  | 0 => rfl
  | j + 1 => by
      refine LinearMap.ext (fun a => LinearMap.ext (fun b => ?_))
      show QlinStepL (ell ^ j) ell (bg j) (D2CompL ell bg j a b)
          + D2StepL (ell ^ j) ell (bg j) (QlinCompL ell bg j a) (QlinCompL ell bg j b) = _
      rw [D2CompL_eq_compD ell bg j, QlinCompL_eq_compQ ell bg j]
      rfl

  | j + 1 => by

          + D2StepL (ell ^ j) ell (bg j) (QlinCompL ell bg j a) (QlinCompL ell bg j b) = _
      rw [D2CompL_eq_compD ell bg j, QlinCompL_eq_compQ ell bg j]
      rfl

theorem comp_congr (ell : ℕ) (QS QS' : ℕ → (XS L →L[ℝ] XS L)) (DS DS' : ℕ → (XS L →ₗ[ℝ] XS L →ₗ[ℝ] XS L)) :

AdalyFormal.M2RightInv.bound_of_perturbe.header:
theorem bound_of_perturbed {H : Type*} [AddCommGroup H] [Module ℝ H] (ν : H → ℝ)
    (hν0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ν x) (hνadd : ∀ x y, ν (x + y) ≤ 2 * ν x + 2 * ν y) (hνneg : ∀ x, ν (-x) = ν x)
    (N S T : H →ₗ[ℝ] H) (hT : ∀ y, T y = y + N y + S y) (hNN : ∀ y, N (N y) = 0)
    (A s : ℝ) (hN : ∀ y, ν (N y) ≤ A * ν y) (hS : ∀ y, ν (S y) ≤ s * ν y) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hsmall : 4 * s * (1 + A) ≤ 1 / 2) (y : H) : ν y ≤ 8 * (1 + A) * ν (T y)

AdalyFormal.M2RightInv.nD_sum_sparse.header:
theorem nD_sum_sparse (hell : 0 < ell) (m0 : ℕ) (v : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → FSp (geomOf ell k S))
    (hsupp : ∀ p p' : BIdx (geomOf ell k S), ¬ Inter p' p → v p p' = 0)

AdalyFormal.M2RightInv.gauges_of_balls.header:

    {U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hB : BallChartsAt ell M k S U C α₀ η)

    (hr' : ∀ j' l : ℕ, Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) *

AdalyFormal.M2RightInv.num_RI.name: AdalyFormal.M2RightInv.num_RI

theorem num_RI (ell : ℕ) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) :

AdalyFormal.M2RightInv.rightInv_cfg.header:

    {C α₀ η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hα0 : 0 ≤ C * α₀)
    (ha1 : ((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M * (C * α₀) ≤ 1)
    {U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hB : BallChartsAt ell M k S U C α₀ η)
    (ρs : ℝ) (hnum : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 ≤ ρ → ρ ≤ ρs →
      ρ ≤ 1 ∧ 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4 * ρ ≤ 1 ∧
      (∀ j' l : ℕ, rhoOf ell (epsC ell ρ j' l) < Real.pi / 2) ∧
      (∀ j' l : ℕ, Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * epsC ell ρ j' l) < r0) ∧
      (∀ j' : ℕ, ∑ l ∈ range j', thetaOf ell (epsC ell ρ j' l) ≤ SstarC ell ρ) ∧
      4 * sD ell (cSof ell (SstarC ell ρ)) * (1 + AD ell (cSof ell (SstarC ell ρ)) (cTof ell (SstarC ell ρ))) ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
      AD ell (cSof ell (SstarC ell ρ)) (cTof ell (SstarC ell ρ)) ≤ Abar ell)
    (hρ : (4 * Real.pi + 4) * (((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M * (C * α₀)) ≤ ρs)
    (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (u : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ∃ x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S)),
      (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam).data.Q x = u ∧
      AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ≤ cWR ell * nD u ∧

    (hN : ∀ ρ', 2 * ell ^ k < scaleUp ell k Lu ρ' + 1)
    (hlinks : ∀ b, dv (U b) ≤ e)
    (hplaq : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell k Lu), dv (periodicPlaquetteHolonomy U p) ≤ q0)
    (hcb : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ k * q0) ≤ 1)
    (η ρ : ℝ) (hη : η = e + 3 * Real.pi * (((ell : ℝ) ^ k) * q0)) (hρ : ρ = (ell : ℝ) ^ k * η)
    (hρ216 : 216 * ρ ^ 2 < 1) (hρ1000 : ρ ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k)
    (nsq c1 θ δm e' P PU δ q ε0 : ℝ)
    (hnsq : nsq = (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * k)) (hc1 : c1 = min a 1 / 1000)
    (hθ : θ = 272 * (q0 / (4 * Real.sqrt 2)))
    (hδm : δm = Real.sqrt a * phiC ell (3600 * (ell : ℝ) * ρ) / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (he' : e' = (1 + t) * θ + (1 + 1 / t) * ((4 * Real.sqrt 2 * (ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)) ^ 2 + δm ^ 2))
    (hP : P = Real.sqrt (max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2))
    (hPU : PU = Real.sqrt (max 6 (16 / (3 * a)) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 / (1 - 216 * ρ ^ 2)))
    (hδ : δ = Real.sqrt 12 * (ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ k))
    (hq : q = Real.sqrt (1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3))
    (hε0 : ε0 = 6 * ρ * q)
    (hsmall : nsq * Sexp ell k δ P q ε0 ^ 2 + nsq * e' < c1)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp (GF ell k Lu))) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ max (2 / ((c1 - nsq * Sexp ell k δ P q ε0 ^ 2 - nsq * e') / (1 + t) / nsq)) (2 * PU ^ 2) *
      ⟪x, (IngrBParams.data ⟨ell, k, Lu, (by omega : 0 < ell), fullTower ell k Lu, U, a, Lam⟩).Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.avgM.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.avgM
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.avgM.header: def avgM (s ell : ℕ) (f : Fld L) : Fld L

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Gs.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Gs
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Gs.header: def Gs (s ell : ℕ) (f : Fld L) : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M2

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Es.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Es
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Es.header: def Es (s ell : ℕ) (f : Fld L) : Fld L

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.blkM_decomp.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.blkM_decomp
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.blkM_decomp.header:
theorem blkM_decomp (s ell : ℕ) (f : Fld L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    blkM s ell f c = avgM s ell f c + grad (s * ell) (Gs s ell f) c + Es s ell f c

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.frob_add.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.frob_add
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.frob_add.header: theorem frob_add (X Y : M2) : frobNorm (X + Y) ≤ frobNorm X + frobNorm Y

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.frob_sub.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.frob_sub
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.frob_sub.header: theorem frob_sub (X Y : M2) : frobNorm (X - Y) ≤ frobNorm X + frobNorm Y

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.frob_smul.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.frob_smul
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.frob_smul.header: theorem frob_smul (r : ℝ) (X : M2) : frobNorm (r • X) = |r| * frobNorm X

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.frob_sum.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.frob_sum
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.frob_sum.header: theorem frob_sum {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (f : ι → M2) : frobNorm (∑ i ∈ S, f i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, frobNorm (f i)

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.pathM_le.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.pathM_le
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.pathM_le.header:
theorem pathM_le (s : ℕ) (f : Fld L) (M : ℝ) (hf : ∀ b, frobNorm (f b) ≤ M) :
    ∀ (p : List (Fin 3)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L), frobNorm (pathM s f y p) ≤ (p.length : ℝ) * M

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.card_le_real.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.card_le_real
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.card_le_real.header:
theorem card_le_real (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    ((stepBlockOf y s ell).card : ℝ) ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.avgM_le.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.avgM_le
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.avgM_le.header:
theorem avgM_le (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (f : Fld L) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hf : ∀ b, frobNorm (f b) ≤ M) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    frobNorm (avgM s ell f c) ≤ (ell : ℝ) * M

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Gs_le.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Gs_le
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Gs_le.header:
theorem Gs_le (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (f : Fld L) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hf : ∀ b, frobNorm (f b) ≤ M) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    frobNorm (Gs s ell f z) ≤ 3 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * M

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.grad_le.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.grad_le
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.grad_le.header:
theorem grad_le (s : ℕ) (Λ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M2) (K : ℝ) (hΛ : ∀ z, frobNorm (Λ z) ≤ K)
    (b : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) : frobNorm (grad s Λ b) ≤ 2 * K

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.omega.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.omega
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.omega.header: def omega (s : ℕ) (z x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Fin 3 → ℕ

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.gamma_eq_stair.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.gamma_eq_stair
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.gamma_eq_stair.header: theorem gamma_eq_stair (s : ℕ) (z x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : coarseGammaPath s z x = stair (omega s z x)

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.fits.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.fits
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.fits.header: def fits (s : ℕ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (m : Fin 3 → ℕ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.mem_box.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.mem_box
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.mem_box.header: theorem mem_box {ell : ℕ} {m : Fin 3 → ℕ} : m ∈ box ell ↔ ∀ σ, m σ < ell

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.omega_facts.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.omega_facts
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.omega_facts.header:
theorem omega_facts (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (z x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf z s ell) :
    ∀ σ, (x σ).val = (z σ).val + s * omega s z x σ ∧ omega s z x σ < ell

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.image_omega.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.image_omega
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.image_omega.header:
theorem image_omega (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (stepBlockOf z s ell).image (omega s z) = (box ell).filter (fits s z)

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.omega_injOn.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.omega_injOn
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.omega_injOn.header:
theorem omega_injOn (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    Set.InjOn (omega s z) (stepBlockOf z s ell)

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.sum_block_eq.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.sum_block_eq
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.sum_block_eq.header:
theorem sum_block_eq (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (F : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → M2) :
    ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf z s ell, F (omega s z x) = ∑ m ∈ (box ell).filter (fits s z), F m

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.fits_shift_iff.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.fits_shift_iff
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.fits_shift_iff.header:
theorem fits_shift_iff (s n : ℕ) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (β : Fin 3) (m : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hm : m β = 0) :
    fits s (coarseShift z n β) m ↔ fits s z m

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.stair_length_le.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.stair_length_le
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.stair_length_le.header:
theorem stair_length_le (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (m : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hm : m ∈ box ell) :
    ((stair m).length : ℝ) ≤ 3 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1)

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.card_box_ne.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.card_box_ne
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.card_box_ne.header:
theorem card_box_ne (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (β : Fin 3) :
    (((box ell).filter (fun m => m β ≠ 0)).card : ℝ) = ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Es_le.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Es_le
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Es_le.header:
theorem Es_le (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (f : Fld L) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hf : ∀ b, frobNorm (f b) ≤ M) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    frobNorm (Es s ell f c) ≤ 3 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 / ell * M

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp.header:
def Tcomp (ell a : ℕ) : ℕ → Fld L → Fld L
  | 0, f => f
  | m + 1, f => blkM (ell ^ (a + m)) ell (Tcomp ell a m f)

theorem Tcomp_add (ell a : ℕ) : ∀ (m : ℕ) (f g : Fld L), Tcomp ell a m (f + g) = Tcomp ell a m f + Tcomp ell a m g

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_add.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_add
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_add.header: theorem Tcomp_add (ell a : ℕ) : ∀ (m : ℕ) (f g : Fld L), Tcomp ell a m (f + g) = Tcomp ell a m f + Tcomp ell a m g

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_sub.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_sub
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_sub.header: theorem Tcomp_sub (ell a : ℕ) : ∀ (m : ℕ) (f g : Fld L), Tcomp ell a m (f - g) = Tcomp ell a m f - Tcomp ell a m g

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_zero.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_zero
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_zero.header: theorem Tcomp_zero (ell a : ℕ) : ∀ (m : ℕ), Tcomp ell a m (0 : Fld L) = 0

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_sum.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_sum
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_sum.header:
theorem Tcomp_sum (ell a m : ℕ) {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (F : ι → Fld L) :
    Tcomp ell a m (∑ i ∈ S, F i) = ∑ i ∈ S, Tcomp ell a m (F i)

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.blkM_sum.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.blkM_sum
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.blkM_sum.header:
theorem blkM_sum (s ell : ℕ) {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (F : ι → Fld L) :
    blkM s ell (∑ i ∈ S, F i) = ∑ i ∈ S, blkM s ell (F i)

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.grad_add.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.grad_add
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.grad_add.header: theorem grad_add (s : ℕ) (Λ Λ' : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M2) : grad s (Λ + Λ') = grad s Λ + grad s Λ'

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.grad_zero.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.grad_zero
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.grad_zero.header: theorem grad_zero (s : ℕ) : grad s (0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M2) = 0

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Abar.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Abar
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Abar.header:
def Abar (ell a : ℕ) (f : Fld L) : ℕ → Fld L
  | 0 => f
  | i + 1 => avgM (ell ^ (a + i)) ell (Abar ell a f i)

                                            
def Lam (ell a : ℕ) (f : Fld L) : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite L → M2
  | 0 => 0
  | i + 1 => Lam ell a f i + Gs (ell ^ (a + i)) ell (Abar ell a f i)

                                    
def Rem (ell a : ℕ) (f : Fld L) : ℕ → Fld L
  | 0 => 0
  | i + 1 => blkM (ell ^ (a + i)) ell (Rem ell a f i) + Es (ell ^ (a + i)) ell (Abar ell a f i)

theorem Tcomp_decomp (ell a : ℕ) (f : Fld L) :
    ∀ m, Tcomp ell a m f = Abar ell a f m + grad (ell ^ (a + m)) (Lam ell a f m) + Rem ell a f m

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Lam.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Lam
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Lam.header:
def Lam (ell a : ℕ) (f : Fld L) : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite L → M2
  | 0 => 0
  | i + 1 => Lam ell a f i + Gs (ell ^ (a + i)) ell (Abar ell a f i)

                                    
def Rem (ell a : ℕ) (f : Fld L) : ℕ → Fld L
  | 0 => 0
  | i + 1 => blkM (ell ^ (a + i)) ell (Rem ell a f i) + Es (ell ^ (a + i)) ell (Abar ell a f i)

theorem Tcomp_decomp (ell a : ℕ) (f : Fld L) :
    ∀ m, Tcomp ell a m f = Abar ell a f m + grad (ell ^ (a + m)) (Lam ell a f m) + Rem ell a f m

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Rem.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Rem
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Rem.header:
def Rem (ell a : ℕ) (f : Fld L) : ℕ → Fld L
  | 0 => 0
  | i + 1 => blkM (ell ^ (a + i)) ell (Rem ell a f i) + Es (ell ^ (a + i)) ell (Abar ell a f i)

theorem Tcomp_decomp (ell a : ℕ) (f : Fld L) :
    ∀ m, Tcomp ell a m f = Abar ell a f m + grad (ell ^ (a + m)) (Lam ell a f m) + Rem ell a f m

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_decomp.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_decomp
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_decomp.header:
theorem Tcomp_decomp (ell a : ℕ) (f : Fld L) :
    ∀ m, Tcomp ell a m f = Abar ell a f m + grad (ell ^ (a + m)) (Lam ell a f m) + Rem ell a f m

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Rem_unroll.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Rem_unroll
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Rem_unroll.header:
theorem Rem_unroll (ell a : ℕ) (f : Fld L) :
    ∀ m, Rem ell a f m = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Tcomp ell (a + i + 1) (m - 1 - i) (Es (ell ^ (a + i)) ell (Abar ell a f i))

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Abar_le.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Abar_le
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Abar_le.header:
theorem Abar_le (ell a : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (f : Fld L) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hf : ∀ b, frobNorm (f b) ≤ M) :
    ∀ i b, frobNorm (Abar ell a f i b) ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ i * M

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Lam_le.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Lam_le
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Lam_le.header:
theorem Lam_le (ell a : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (f : Fld L) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hf : ∀ b, frobNorm (f b) ≤ M) :
    ∀ i z, frobNorm (Lam ell a f i z) ≤ 3 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ i - 1) * M

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.lamK_lt_sq.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.lamK_lt_sq
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.lamK_lt_sq.header: theorem lamK_lt_sq (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) : lamK ell < (ell : ℝ) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.geom_bound.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.geom_bound
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.geom_bound.header:
theorem geom_bound (lam l E : ℝ) (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hE : 0 ≤ E) (h : l + E ≤ lam) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, l ^ m + E * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, lam ^ (m - 1 - i) * l ^ i ≤ lam ^ m

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_le.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_le
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Tcomp_le.header:
theorem Tcomp_le (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lamK ell ≤ lam) :
    ∀ (m a : ℕ) (f : Fld L) (M : ℝ), 0 ≤ M → (∀ b, frobNorm (f b) ≤ M) →
      ∀ b, frobNorm (Tcomp ell a m f b) ≤ 7 * lam ^ m * M

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Alog.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Alog
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Alog.header: def Alog (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) : Fld L

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.step_bg.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.step_bg
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.step_bg.header:
theorem step_bg (ell l : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    (hsm : 8 * (ell : ℝ) * k ≤ 1 / (8 * Real.pi))
    (hch : ∀ b, Chart (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l) (Alog (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l)) k b) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    su2Exp (Alog (ubarTowerSU2 ell U (l + 1)) c) = ubarTowerSU2 ell U (l + 1) c ∧
    frobNorm (Alog (ubarTowerSU2 ell U (l + 1)) c - blkM (ell ^ l) ell (Alog (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l)) c)
      ≤ 200 * Real.pi * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * k ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.step_st.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.step_st
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.step_st.header:
theorem step_st (ell l : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    (hsm : (ell : ℝ) * k ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.pi))
    (hch : ∀ b, Chart (strT ell U l) (Alog (strT ell U l)) k b) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    frobNorm (Alog (strT ell U (l + 1)) c - bondM (ell ^ l) ell (Alog (strT ell U l)) c)
      ≤ 2 * Real.pi * ((ell : ℝ) * k) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.loopM_eq_ladAM.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.loopM_eq_ladAM
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.loopM_eq_ladAM.header:
theorem loopM_eq_ladAM (s ell : ℕ) (A : Fld L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell) :
    loopM s ell A c x = ladAM s A c.1 (coarseGammaPath s c.1 x) c.2 ell

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.src_st.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.src_st
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.src_st.header:
theorem src_st (ell l : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (q0 k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    (hk4 : 4 * k ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.pi)) (h0 : ∀ y ν μ, dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ q0)
    (hP : ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0 ≤ 1)
    (hch : ∀ b, Chart (strT ell U l) (Alog (strT ell U l)) k b) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    frobNorm (blkM (ell ^ l) ell (Alog (strT ell U l)) c - bondM (ell ^ l) ell (Alog (strT ell U l)) c)
      ≤ 3 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * (ell : ℝ) *
        (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0 + (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * q0) ^ 3 / 8 + 32 * Real.pi * k ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Bnd.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Bnd
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Bnd.header: def Bnd (ell : ℕ) (e q0 : ℝ) (l : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.kap.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.kap
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.kap.header: def kap (ell : ℕ) (e q0 : ℝ) (l : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.TowerSmall.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.TowerSmall
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.TowerSmall.header: structure TowerSmall (ell k : ℕ) (e q0 : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.sig_pos.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.sig_pos
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.sig_pos.header: theorem sig_pos (ell : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) : 0 < sig ell

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Kc_pos.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Kc_pos
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.Kc_pos.header: theorem Kc_pos (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) : 0 < Kc ell

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.unroll_gen.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.unroll_gen
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.unroll_gen.header:
theorem unroll_gen (ell : ℕ) (X Y : ℕ → Fld L) (h0 : X 0 = 0)
    (hX : ∀ i, X (i + 1) = blkM (ell ^ i) ell (X i) + Y i) :
    ∀ m, X m = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Tcomp ell (i + 1) (m - 1 - i) (Y i)

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.unroll.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.unroll
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.unroll.header:
theorem unroll (ell : ℕ) (X : ℕ → Fld L) (h0 : X 0 = 0) :
    ∀ m, X m = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Tcomp ell (i + 1) (m - 1 - i) (X (i + 1) - blkM (ell ^ i) ell (X i))

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.geom_sum_le.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.geom_sum_le
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.geom_sum_le.header:
theorem geom_sum_le (lam mu : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ lam) (h : lam ≤ mu) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, (mu - lam) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, lam ^ (m - 1 - i) * mu ^ i ≤ mu ^ m

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.src_arith.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.src_arith
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.src_arith.header:
theorem src_arith (ell : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (a p b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (hb2 : b ^ 2 ≤ p + a ^ 2) :
    200 * Real.pi * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * (2 * a + b) ^ 2) + 2 * Real.pi * ((ell : ℝ) * (2 * a)) ^ 2
      + 3 * ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * (ell : ℝ) * (p + p ^ 3 / 8 + 32 * Real.pi * (2 * a) ^ 2)
      ≤ sig ell * (p + a ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.tower_allbond.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.tower_allbond
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.tower_allbond.header:
theorem tower_allbond (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (e q0 : ℝ)
    (he0 : 0 ≤ e) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (hlinks : ∀ b, dv (U b) ≤ e) (h0 : ∀ y ν μ, dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ q0)
    (S : TowerSmall ell k e q0) :
    ∀ L', L' ≤ k → ∀ l, l ≤ L' → ∀ b,
      Chart (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l) (Alog (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l)) (kap ell e q0 l) b ∧
      frobNorm ((Alog (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l) - Alog (strT ell U l)) b) ≤ Bnd ell e q0 l

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.dv_bg_le.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.dv_bg_le
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.dv_bg_le.header:
theorem dv_bg_le (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (e q0 : ℝ)
    (he0 : 0 ≤ e) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (hlinks : ∀ b, dv (U b) ≤ e) (h0 : ∀ y ν μ, dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ q0)
    (S : TowerSmall ell k e q0) (l : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ k) (b : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    dv (ubarTowerSU2 ell U l b) ≤ kap ell e q0 l

AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.regTower_allbond.name: AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.regTower_allbond
AdalyFormal.RegBgKU.regTower_allbond.header:

theorem raw_bond_log_linearization {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s * ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L (s * ell)) (μ : Fin 3)
    (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrsmall : r ≤ 1/64)
    (hG : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell,
      frobNorm (((gammaVarStrided s ell V (y, μ) x : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ r)
    (hC : frobNorm (((coarseBondVar s ell V (y, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ r) :
    frobNorm (su2Log (ubarSU2 s ell V (y, μ)) -
      ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell,
        ((ell : ℚ)^3)⁻¹ • su2Log (gammaVarStrided s ell V (y, μ) x)) ≤ 84 * r ^ 2

DepthUniformity.RawTower.LevelPlaqBound.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.LevelPlaqBound
DepthUniformity.RawTower.LevelPlaqBound.header: def LevelPlaqBound (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (ell j : ℕ) (β : ℝ) : Prop

DepthUniformity.RawTower.OneStepPropagat.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.OneStepPropagationRaw
DepthUniformity.RawTower.OneStepPropagat.header: def OneStepPropagationRaw (ell : ℕ) (C0 c2' : ℝ) : Prop

DepthUniformity.RawTower.OneStepPropagat.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.OneStepPropagationRaw_iff_ubarSU2
DepthUniformity.RawTower.OneStepPropagat.header:
theorem OneStepPropagationRaw_iff_ubarSU2 (ell : ℕ) (C0 c2' : ℝ) :
    OneStepPropagationRaw (L := L) ell C0 c2' ↔
      ∀ (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (β : ℝ),
        0 ≤ β → β ≤ c2' →
        (∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3),
          frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS s V y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ β) →
        ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3),
          frobNorm
              (((orientedPlaqHolS (s * ell) (ubarSU2 s ell V) y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤
            (ell : ℝ)^2 * β + C0 * ((ell : ℝ)^2 * β)^2

DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec
DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec.header:
def betaRec (ell : ℕ) (C0 alpha0 : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => alpha0 * etaSq ell k
  | j + 1 => (ell : ℝ)^2 * betaRec ell C0 alpha0 k j +
      C0 * ((ell : ℝ)^2 * betaRec ell C0 alpha0 k j)^2

                                                                      
def geomS (ell : ℕ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 0
  | j + 1 => geomS ell j + ((ell : ℝ)^2)^(j + 1)

theorem etaSq_nonneg (ell k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ etaSq ell k

DepthUniformity.RawTower.geomS.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.geomS
DepthUniformity.RawTower.geomS.header:
def geomS (ell : ℕ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 0
  | j + 1 => geomS ell j + ((ell : ℝ)^2)^(j + 1)

theorem etaSq_nonneg (ell k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ etaSq ell k

DepthUniformity.RawTower.etaSq_nonneg.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.etaSq_nonneg
DepthUniformity.RawTower.etaSq_nonneg.header: theorem etaSq_nonneg (ell k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ etaSq ell k

DepthUniformity.RawTower.geomS_succ.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.geomS_succ
DepthUniformity.RawTower.geomS_succ.header:
theorem geomS_succ (ell j : ℕ) :
    geomS ell (j + 1) = geomS ell j + ((ell : ℝ)^2)^(j + 1)

DepthUniformity.RawTower.geomS_nonneg.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.geomS_nonneg
DepthUniformity.RawTower.geomS_nonneg.header: theorem geomS_nonneg (ell : ℕ) (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ geomS ell j

DepthUniformity.RawTower.geomS_mono.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.geomS_mono
DepthUniformity.RawTower.geomS_mono.header: theorem geomS_mono (ell : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (h : j ≤ k) : geomS ell j ≤ geomS ell k

DepthUniformity.RawTower.geomS_mul_sub.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.geomS_mul_sub
DepthUniformity.RawTower.geomS_mul_sub.header:
theorem geomS_mul_sub (ell : ℕ) (j : ℕ) :
    geomS ell j * ((ell : ℝ)^2 - 1) = (ell : ℝ)^2 * (((ell : ℝ)^2)^j - 1)

DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_zero.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_zero
DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_zero.header:
theorem betaRec_zero (ell : ℕ) (C0 alpha0 : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    betaRec ell C0 alpha0 k 0 = alpha0 * etaSq ell k

DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_succ.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_succ
DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_succ.header:
theorem betaRec_succ (ell : ℕ) (C0 alpha0 : ℝ) (k j : ℕ) :
    betaRec ell C0 alpha0 k (j + 1) =
      (ell : ℝ)^2 * betaRec ell C0 alpha0 k j +
        C0 * ((ell : ℝ)^2 * betaRec ell C0 alpha0 k j)^2

DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_nonneg.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_nonneg
DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_nonneg.header:
theorem betaRec_nonneg (ell : ℕ) (C0 alpha0 : ℝ) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hα0 : 0 < alpha0) (k j : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ betaRec ell C0 alpha0 k j

DepthUniformity.RawTower.etaSq_geomS_key.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.etaSq_geomS_key_bound
DepthUniformity.RawTower.etaSq_geomS_key.header:
theorem etaSq_geomS_key_bound (ell : ℕ) (C0 alpha0 : ℝ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hα0 : 0 < alpha0)
    (hC0α0 : 4 * C0 * alpha0 * (ell : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2 - 1) (k : ℕ) :
    4 * C0 * alpha0 * (etaSq ell k * geomS ell k) ≤ 1

DepthUniformity.RawTower.gamma_le_two.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.gamma_le_two
DepthUniformity.RawTower.gamma_le_two.header:
theorem gamma_le_two (ell : ℕ) (C0 alpha0 : ℝ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hα0 : 0 < alpha0)
    (hC0α0 : 4 * C0 * alpha0 * (ell : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2 - 1) {k j : ℕ} (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    1 + 4 * C0 * alpha0 * etaSq ell k * geomS ell j ≤ 2

DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_le.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_le
DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_le.header:
theorem betaRec_le (ell : ℕ) (C0 alpha0 : ℝ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hα0 : 0 < alpha0)
    (hC0α0 : 4 * C0 * alpha0 * (ell : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2 - 1) {k : ℕ} :
    ∀ (j : ℕ), j ≤ k →
      betaRec ell C0 alpha0 k j ≤
        (alpha0 * ((ell : ℝ)^2)^j * etaSq ell k) *
          (1 + 4 * C0 * alpha0 * etaSq ell k * geomS ell j)

DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_le_two_.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_le_two_alpha0
DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_le_two_.header:
theorem betaRec_le_two_alpha0 (ell : ℕ) (C0 alpha0 : ℝ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hα0 : 0 < alpha0)
    (hC0α0 : 4 * C0 * alpha0 * (ell : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2 - 1) {k j : ℕ} (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    betaRec ell C0 alpha0 k j ≤ 2 * alpha0

DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_le_two_.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_le_two_a
DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_le_two_.header:
theorem betaRec_le_two_a (ell : ℕ) (C0 alpha0 : ℝ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hα0 : 0 < alpha0)
    (hC0α0 : 4 * C0 * alpha0 * (ell : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2 - 1) {k j : ℕ} (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    betaRec ell C0 alpha0 k j ≤ 2 * (alpha0 * ((ell : ℝ)^2)^j * etaSq ell k)

DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_lt_alph.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_lt_alpha0_of_lt
DepthUniformity.RawTower.betaRec_lt_alph.header:
theorem betaRec_lt_alpha0_of_lt (ell : ℕ) (C0 alpha0 : ℝ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hα0 : 0 < alpha0)
    (hC0α0 : 4 * C0 * alpha0 * (ell : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2 - 1) {k j : ℕ} (hjk : j < k) :
    betaRec ell C0 alpha0 k j ≤ alpha0 / 2 ∧ betaRec ell C0 alpha0 k j < alpha0

DepthUniformity.RawTower.levelPlaqBound_.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.levelPlaqBound_tower
DepthUniformity.RawTower.levelPlaqBound_.header:
theorem levelPlaqBound_tower (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (C0 alpha0 c2' : ℝ)
    (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hα0 : 0 < alpha0)
    (hC0α0 : 4 * C0 * alpha0 * (ell : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2 - 1) (hc2 : 2 * alpha0 ≤ c2')
    (k : ℕ) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (hProp1 : OneStepPropagationRaw (L := L) ell C0 c2')
    (hFine : LevelPlaqBound (ubarTowerSU2 ell U) ell 0 (betaRec ell C0 alpha0 k 0)) :
    ∀ (j : ℕ), j ≤ k →
      LevelPlaqBound (ubarTowerSU2 ell U) ell j (betaRec ell C0 alpha0 k j)

DepthUniformity.RawTower.loopRhoPlaq_mon.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.loopRhoPlaq_mono
DepthUniformity.RawTower.loopRhoPlaq_mon.header:
theorem loopRhoPlaq_mono {ell : ℕ} {eps0 eps1 : ℝ} (h : eps0 ≤ eps1) :

DepthUniformity.RawTower.nu_loopVar_towe.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.nu_loopVar_tower_uniform
DepthUniformity.RawTower.nu_loopVar_towe.header:
theorem nu_loopVar_tower_uniform
    (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (C0 alpha0 c2' : ℝ) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hα0 : 0 < alpha0)
    (hC0α0 : 4 * C0 * alpha0 * (ell : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2 - 1) (hc2 : 2 * alpha0 ≤ c2')
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (hProp1 : OneStepPropagationRaw (L := L) ell C0 c2')
    (hFine : ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3),
      frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS 1 U y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ alpha0 * etaSq ell k)
    (j : ℕ) (hjk : j ≤ k)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 (ell ^ j) ell)
    (hπ : loopRhoPlaq (2 * alpha0) ell < Real.pi / 2) :
    nu ((principalSuTwoLog (loopVar (ell ^ j) ell (ubarTowerSU2 ell U j) c x) :
          SuTwo) : M2) ≤
        loopRhoPlaq (2 * alpha0) ell ∧
      loopRhoPlaq (2 * alpha0) ell < Real.pi / 2

DepthUniformity.RawTower.nu_loopVar_towe.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.nu_loopVar_tower_perlevel
DepthUniformity.RawTower.nu_loopVar_towe.header:
theorem nu_loopVar_tower_perlevel
    (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (C0 alpha0 c2' : ℝ) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hα0 : 0 < alpha0)
    (hC0α0 : 4 * C0 * alpha0 * (ell : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2 - 1) (hc2 : 2 * alpha0 ≤ c2')
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (hProp1 : OneStepPropagationRaw (L := L) ell C0 c2')
    (hFine : ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3),
      frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS 1 U y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ alpha0 * etaSq ell k)
    (j : ℕ) (hjk : j ≤ k)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 (ell ^ j) ell)
    (hπ : loopRhoPlaq (2 * alpha0) ell < Real.pi / 2) :
    nu ((principalSuTwoLog (loopVar (ell ^ j) ell (ubarTowerSU2 ell U j) c x) :
          SuTwo) : M2) ≤
        loopRhoPlaq (2 * (alpha0 * ((ell : ℝ)^2)^j * etaSq ell k)) ell

DepthUniformity.RawTower.loopRhoPlaq_two.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.loopRhoPlaq_two_alpha0_eq
DepthUniformity.RawTower.loopRhoPlaq_two.header:
theorem loopRhoPlaq_two_alpha0_eq (ell : ℕ) (alpha0 : ℝ) :
    loopRhoPlaq (2 * alpha0) ell =
      (3 * ell * (ell - 1) : ℕ) * (Real.pi / (2 * Real.sqrt 2)) * (2 * alpha0)

DepthUniformity.RawTower.levelPlaqBound_.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.levelPlaqBound_zero_of_printed
DepthUniformity.RawTower.levelPlaqBound_.header:
theorem levelPlaqBound_zero_of_printed (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (δ : ℝ)

DepthUniformity.RawTower.nu_loopVar_towe.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.nu_loopVar_tower_uniform_printed
DepthUniformity.RawTower.nu_loopVar_towe.header:
theorem nu_loopVar_tower_uniform_printed
    (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (C0 alpha0 c2' : ℝ) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hα0 : 0 < alpha0)
    (hC0α0 : 4 * C0 * alpha0 * (ell : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2 - 1) (hc2 : 2 * alpha0 ≤ c2')
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (hProp1 : OneStepPropagationRaw (L := L) ell C0 c2')
    (hPrint : ∀ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L,
      frobNorm ((periodicPlaquetteHolonomy (G := SU2) U p : M2) - 1) ≤ alpha0 * etaSq ell k)
    (j : ℕ) (hjk : j ≤ k)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 (ell ^ j) ell)
    (hπ : loopRhoPlaq (2 * alpha0) ell < Real.pi / 2) :
    nu ((principalSuTwoLog (loopVar (ell ^ j) ell (ubarTowerSU2 ell U j) c x) :
          SuTwo) : M2) ≤

DepthUniformity.RawTower.orientedPlaqHol.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.orientedPlaqHolS_trivialU
DepthUniformity.RawTower.orientedPlaqHol.header:
theorem orientedPlaqHolS_trivialU (s : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) :

DepthUniformity.RawTower.plaq_gauge.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.plaq_gauge
DepthUniformity.RawTower.plaq_gauge.header:
theorem plaq_gauge {G : Type*} [Group G] (s : ℕ)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → G) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    orientedPlaqHolS s (coarseGaugeTransform s g V) y μ ν =
      g y * orientedPlaqHolS s V y μ ν * (g y)⁻¹

DepthUniformity.RawTower.plaq_gauge_norm.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.plaq_gauge_norm
DepthUniformity.RawTower.plaq_gauge_norm.header:
theorem plaq_gauge_norm (s : ℕ) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS s (coarseGaugeTransform s g V) y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1) =
      frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS s V y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1)

DepthUniformity.RawTower.pureGauge.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.pureGauge
DepthUniformity.RawTower.pureGauge.header: def pureGauge (s : ℕ) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L

DepthUniformity.RawTower.orientedPlaqHol.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.orientedPlaqHolS_pureGauge
DepthUniformity.RawTower.orientedPlaqHol.header:
theorem orientedPlaqHolS_pureGauge (s : ℕ) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2)

DepthUniformity.RawTower.ubarSU2_pureGau.header:
theorem ubarSU2_pureGauge (s ell : ℕ) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) :

DepthUniformity.RawTower.orientedPlaqHol.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.orientedPlaqHolS_ubar_pureGauge
DepthUniformity.RawTower.orientedPlaqHol.header:
theorem orientedPlaqHolS_ubar_pureGauge (s ell : ℕ) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2)

DepthUniformity.RawTower.prop1_poly_nonn.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.prop1_poly_nonneg
DepthUniformity.RawTower.prop1_poly_nonn.header:
theorem prop1_poly_nonneg (ell : ℕ) (C0 β : ℝ) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) :

DepthUniformity.RawTower.pureGauge_input.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.pureGauge_input_frob_eq_zero
DepthUniformity.RawTower.pureGauge_input.header:
theorem pureGauge_input_frob_eq_zero (s : ℕ) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2)

DepthUniformity.RawTower.pureGauge_raw_o.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.pureGauge_raw_output_frob_eq_zero
DepthUniformity.RawTower.pureGauge_raw_o.header:
theorem pureGauge_raw_output_frob_eq_zero (s ell : ℕ) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) :

DepthUniformity.RawTower.OneStepPropagat.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.OneStepPropagationRaw_holds_at_pureGauge
DepthUniformity.RawTower.OneStepPropagat.header:
theorem OneStepPropagationRaw_holds_at_pureGauge
    (ell : ℕ) (C0 c2' : ℝ) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0)
    (s : ℕ) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) (β : ℝ)

DepthUniformity.RawTower.flat_pureGauge_.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.flat_pureGauge_does_not_refute
DepthUniformity.RawTower.flat_pureGauge_.header:

            (((orientedPlaqHolS (s * ell) (ubarSU2 s ell (pureGauge s g)) y μ ν : SU2) :

DepthUniformity.RawTower.OneStepPropagat.header:
theorem OneStepPropagationRaw_holds_at_trivialU
    (ell : ℕ) (C0 c2' : ℝ) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0)

DepthUniformity.RawTower.ubarTowerSU2_pu.name: DepthUniformity.RawTower.ubarTowerSU2_pureGauge
DepthUniformity.RawTower.ubarTowerSU2_pu.header:
theorem ubarTowerSU2_pureGauge (ell : ℕ) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SU2) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, ubarTowerSU2 ell (pureGauge 1 g) j = pureGauge (ell ^ j) g
  | 0 => by
      rw [ubarTowerSU2_zero, pow_zero]
  | j + 1 => by
      rw [ubarTowerSU2_succ, ubarTowerSU2_pureGauge ell g j, ubarSU2_pureGauge, pow_succ, mul_comm]

AdalySI1.RawUbarDerivNoLoop.qsmul_eq_rsm.name: AdalySI1.RawUbarDerivNoLoop.qsmul_eq_rsmul
AdalySI1.RawUbarDerivNoLoop.qsmul_eq_rsm.header:
theorem qsmul_eq_rsmul (ell : ℕ) (X : M2) :

AdalySI1.RawUbarDerivNoLoop.hasDerivAt_c.name: AdalySI1.RawUbarDerivNoLoop.hasDerivAt_coarsePathHolonomy_configMul
AdalySI1.RawUbarDerivNoLoop.hasDerivAt_c.header:
theorem hasDerivAt_coarsePathHolonomy_configMul (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (hah : ∀ e, (A e)ᴴ = -(A e))
    (htr : ∀ e, Matrix.trace (A e) = 0) (ell : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => ((coarsePathHolonomy ell (configMul (fun e => su2Exp (t • A e)) V0) y p : SU2)

          * (((coarsePathHolonomy 1 V0 (cPlusS 1 ell c) (coarseGammaPath 1 c.1 x) : SU2) : M2))ᴴ

    (hformR : OnMinimizerRange D (PrintedG1FormAt D (usedAt bc 0) d pen))
    (hrawR : OnMinimizerRange D (HrawAt D U d σ₀ κ))

EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.norm_Q_le.name: EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.norm_Q_le
EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.norm_Q_le.header: theorem norm_Q_le (Z : SuTwo) (h : 0 < nu (Z : M2)) : ‖Q Z‖ ≤ 1

EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.norm_P_le.name: EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.norm_P_le
EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.norm_P_le.header: theorem norm_P_le (Z : SuTwo) (h : 0 < nu (Z : M2)) : ‖P Z‖ ≤ 1

EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.radial_perp_de.name: EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.radial_perp_decomposition
EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.radial_perp_de.header:
theorem radial_perp_decomposition (Z X : SuTwo) (h : 0 < nu (Z : M2)) :
    X = P Z X + Q Z X ∧ ip (Z : M2) ((Q Z X : SuTwo) : M2) = 0

EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.real_rotation_.name: EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.real_rotation_block
EstimatesLayer.NormBounds.real_rotation_.header:
theorem real_rotation_block (Z X : SuTwo) (h : 0 < nu (Z : M2)) :
    adOp Z (P Z X) = 0 ∧
    adOp Z (Q Z X) = (2 * nu (Z : M2)) • J Z X ∧
    adOp Z (J Z X) = (-2 * nu (Z : M2)) • Q Z X

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.SigmaOK.header: def SigmaOK (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (σ : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sigmaOK_pi.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sigmaOK_pi
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sigmaOK_pi.header: theorem sigmaOK_pi (z : Fin 3 → Circle) : SigmaOK z (2 / Real.pi)

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.abs_sin_eq.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.abs_sin_eq
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.abs_sin_eq.header: theorem abs_sin_eq (y : ℝ) (h : |y| ≤ Real.pi) : |Real.sin y| = Real.sin |y|

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sigmaOK_sma.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sigmaOK_small
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sigmaOK_sma.header: theorem sigmaOK_small (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (h : ∀ μ, |th z μ| ≤ 1) : SigmaOK z (15 / 16)

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Tm_lower_σ.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Tm_lower_σ
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Tm_lower_σ.header:
theorem Tm_lower_σ (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (σ : ℝ) (hσ0 : 0 ≤ σ) (hσ1 : σ ≤ 1)
    (hσ : SigmaOK z σ) (μ : Fin 3) : σ * (n : ℝ) ≤ ‖Tm n z hn μ‖

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_prodT_.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_prodT_σ
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_prodT_.header:
theorem norm_prodT_σ (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (σ : ℝ) (hσ0 : 0 ≤ σ) (hσ1 : σ ≤ 1)
    (hσ : SigmaOK z σ) : (σ * (n : ℝ)) ^ 3 ≤ ‖∏ μ, Tm n z hn μ‖

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_e0_lower.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_e0_lower_σ
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_e0_lower.header:
theorem Qm_e0_lower_σ (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (σ : ℝ) (hσ0 : 0 ≤ σ) (hσ1 : σ ≤ 1)
    (hσ : SigmaOK z σ) (μ : Fin 3) :
    cn n * (σ * (n : ℝ)) ^ 4 ≤ ‖(cellSym hn z).Qm μ (pk n z (k0 hn))‖

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_e0_ep.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_e0_eps_lower_σ
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_e0_ep.header:
theorem inner_e0_eps_lower_σ (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (σ : ℝ) (hσ0 : 0 ≤ σ) (hσ1 : σ ≤ 1)
    (hσ : SigmaOK z σ) :
    (cn n) ^ 2 * (σ * (n : ℝ)) ^ 6 ≤ ‖⟪pk n z (k0 hn), epsV n⟫‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.zeta_ge_σ.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.zeta_ge_σ
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.zeta_ge_σ.header:
theorem zeta_ge_σ (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (σ : ℝ) (hσ0 : 0 ≤ σ) (hσ : SigmaOK z σ) :
    σ ^ 2 * Th2 z ≤ ∑ μ, ‖((z μ : Circle) : ℂ) - 1‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lam0_ge.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lam0_ge
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lam0_ge.header:
theorem lam0_ge (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) :
    4 / Real.pi ^ 2 * Th2 z ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * lam n z (k0 hn)

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ncomp2.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ncomp2
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ncomp2.header:
theorem Ncomp2 {E x y q G K A q0 l0 : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hG : 0 < G) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hA : 0 < A) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (hl0 : 0 ≤ l0) (hE : l0 * x ^ 2 + G * y ^ 2 ≤ E)
    (hqq : q0 * x - A * y ≤ q) :
    max (min l0 G) (min (K * q0 ^ 2 / 4) (G * q0 ^ 2 / (4 * A ^ 2 + q0 ^ 2))) * (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
      ≤ E + K * q ^ 2

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lamN2.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lamN2
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lamN2.header: noncomputable def lamN2 (κ l0 G A q0 : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lamN2_nonne.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lamN2_nonneg
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lamN2_nonne.header: theorem lamN2_nonneg (κ l0 G A q0 : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hl0 : 0 ≤ l0) (hG : 0 ≤ G) : 0 ≤ lamN2 κ l0 G A q0

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.comp_N2.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.comp_N2
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.comp_N2.header:
theorem comp_N2 (κ A q0 : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hA : 0 < A) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (hq : ∀ μ, q0 ≤ ‖sd.Qm μ md.e0‖) (hAq : ∀ μ x, ‖sd.Qm μ x‖ ≤ A * ‖x‖) (μ : Fin 3) (f : V) :
    lamN2 κ md.l0 md.G A q0 * ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ Ef sd f + κ * ‖sd.Qm μ f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.N_coercive2.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.N_coercive2
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.N_coercive2.header:
theorem N_coercive2 (κ A q0 : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hA : 0 < A) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (hq : ∀ μ, q0 ≤ ‖sd.Qm μ md.e0‖) (hAq : ∀ μ x, ‖sd.Qm μ x‖ ≤ A * ‖x‖) (w : Fin 3 → V) :
    lamN2 κ md.l0 md.G A q0 * ∑ μ, ‖w μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ Eb sd w + κ * g2b sd w

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_abstra.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_abstract_trivial_gen
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_abstra.header:
theorem cell_abstract_trivial_gen (md : ModeData sd) (κ lN : ℝ)
    (hNw : ∀ w : Fin 3 → V, lN * ∑ μ, ‖w μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ Eb sd w + κ * g2b sd w)
    (hall : ∀ μ, sd.ph μ = 1) (w : Fin 3 → V) (S : ℝ) (hS0 : 0 ≤ S)
    (hS : ∀ u, ⟪sd.eps, u⟫ = 0 → ‖⟪sd.Dstar w, sd.Lap u⟫‖ ^ 2 ≤ S * ‖sd.Lap u‖ ^ 2) :
    lN * ∑ μ, ‖w μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ g1b sd w + κ * g2b sd w + S

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_abstra.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_abstract_nontrivial_gen
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_abstra.header:
theorem cell_abstract_nontrivial_gen (md : ModeData sd) (κ A β lN : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hl0 : 0 < md.l0) (hlN : 0 ≤ lN)
    (hNw : ∀ w : Fin 3 → V, lN * ∑ μ, ‖w μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ Eb sd w + κ * g2b sd w)
    (hAq : ∀ μ x, ‖sd.Qm μ x‖ ≤ A * ‖x‖) (hβ : β ≤ ‖⟪md.e0, sd.eps⟫‖ ^ 2) (hβ0 : 0 ≤ β)
    (μ0 : Fin 3) (hμ0 : sd.ph μ0 ≠ 1) (w : Fin 3 → V) (S : ℝ) (hS0 : 0 ≤ S)
    (hS : ∀ u, ⟪sd.eps, u⟫ = 0 → ‖⟪sd.Dstar w, sd.Lap u⟫‖ ^ 2 ≤ S * ‖sd.Lap u‖ ^ 2) :
    mu0c κ ((∑ μ, ‖sd.ph μ - 1‖ ^ 2) * β / md.l0 ^ 2) (A ^ 2 * (1 / md.l0 + 1 / md.G))
        / (1 + mu0c κ ((∑ μ, ‖sd.ph μ - 1‖ ^ 2) * β / md.l0 ^ 2) (A ^ 2 * (1 / md.l0 + 1 / md.G)))
        * lN * ∑ μ, ‖w μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ g1b sd w + κ * g2b sd w + S

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.muF.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.muF
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.muF.header: noncomputable def muF (σ a x : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.LmF.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.LmF
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.LmF.header: noncomputable def LmF (σ a : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.rat_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.rat_nonneg
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.rat_nonneg.header: theorem rat_nonneg {m : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ m) : 0 ≤ rat m

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.rat_le_one.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.rat_le_one
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.rat_le_one.header: theorem rat_le_one {m : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ m) : rat m ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.muF_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.muF_nonneg
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.muF_nonneg.header: theorem muF_nonneg {σ a x : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ muF σ a x

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.muF_anti.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.muF_anti
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.muF_anti.header:
theorem muF_anti {σ a x x' : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hx : 0 < x) (hxx : x ≤ x') :
    muF σ a x' ≤ muF σ a x

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.LmF_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.LmF_nonneg
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.LmF_nonneg.header: theorem LmF_nonneg {σ a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) : 0 ≤ LmF σ a

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.rat_muF.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.rat_muF
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.rat_muF.header:
theorem rat_muF {σ a y : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    rat (muF σ a y) = a * σ ^ 8 / (y * (1 + a / 4) + a + a * σ ^ 8)

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_core_n.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_core_nontrivial
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_core_n.header:
theorem cell_core_nontrivial (hn : 0 < n) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ0 : 0 < σ) (hσ1 : σ ≤ 1) (hσ : SigmaOK z σ) (μ0 : Fin 3) (hμ0 : ((z μ0 : Circle) : ℂ) ≠ 1)
    (w : Fin 3 → CV n) (S : ℝ) (hS0 : 0 ≤ S)
    (hS : ∀ u : CV n, ⟪epsV n, u⟫ = 0 →
      ‖⟪(cellSym hn z).Dstar w, (cellSym hn z).Lap u⟫‖ ^ 2 ≤ S * ‖(cellSym hn z).Lap u‖ ^ 2) :
    rat (muF σ (κ * (n : ℝ) ^ 7) ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 * lam n z (k0 hn))) *
        max (min ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 * lam n z (k0 hn)) 4) (LmF σ (κ * (n : ℝ) ^ 7)) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2
        * ∑ μ, ‖w μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ g1 hn (z, w) + κ * g2 hn (z, w) + S

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lamN_eq.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lamN_eq
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lamN_eq.header:
theorem lamN_eq (hn : 0 < n) (σ κ : ℝ) :
    lamN κ (4 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) ((n : ℝ) * ‖epsV n‖) (cn n * (σ * (n : ℝ)) ^ 4)
      = LmF σ (κ * (n : ℝ) ^ 7) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_core_t.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_core_trivial
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_core_t.header:
theorem cell_core_trivial (hn : 0 < n) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ0 : 0 < σ) (hσ1 : σ ≤ 1) (hσ : SigmaOK z σ) (hall : ∀ μ, ((z μ : Circle) : ℂ) = 1)
    (w : Fin 3 → CV n) (S : ℝ) (hS0 : 0 ≤ S)
    (hS : ∀ u : CV n, ⟪epsV n, u⟫ = 0 →
      ‖⟪(cellSym hn z).Dstar w, (cellSym hn z).Lap u⟫‖ ^ 2 ≤ S * ‖(cellSym hn z).Lap u‖ ^ 2) :
    LmF σ (κ * (n : ℝ) ^ 7) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ μ, ‖w μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ g1 hn (z, w) + κ * g2 hn (z, w) + S

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Th2_le_thre.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Th2_le_three
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Th2_le_thre.header: theorem Th2_le_three (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (h : ∀ μ, |th z μ| ≤ 1) : Th2 z ≤ 3

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.th_eq_zero_.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.th_eq_zero_of_one
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.th_eq_zero_.header: theorem th_eq_zero_of_one (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ : Fin 3) (h : ((z μ : Circle) : ℂ) = 1) : th z μ = 0

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_coerci.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_coercive_explicit2
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_coerci.header:
theorem cell_coercive_explicit2 (hn : 0 < n) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (w : Fin 3 → CV n)
    (S : ℝ) (hS0 : 0 ≤ S)
    (hS : ∀ u : CV n, ⟪epsV n, u⟫ = 0 →
      ‖⟪(cellSym hn z).Dstar w, (cellSym hn z).Lap u⟫‖ ^ 2 ≤ S * ‖(cellSym hn z).Lap u‖ ^ 2) :
    hfun2 (κ * (n : ℝ) ^ 7) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ μ, ‖w μ‖ ^ 2
      ≤ g1 hn (z, w) + κ * g2 hn (z, w) + S

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.elem_combin.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.elem_combine
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.elem_combin.header:
theorem elem_combine {F N T X lN μ0 : ℝ} (hF : F = N - T) (hN : lN * X ≤ N) (hμ : μ0 * T ≤ F)
    (hμ0 : 0 ≤ μ0) : μ0 * lN * X ≤ (1 + μ0) * F

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.margin_quad.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.margin_quad
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.margin_quad.header:
theorem margin_quad {α β r s q : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (h : α * s - β * r ≤ q) : α ^ 2 * s ^ 2 ≤ (1 + β ^ 2) * (r ^ 2 + q ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ncomp.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ncomp
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ncomp.header:
theorem Ncomp {E x y q G K A q0 : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hG : 0 < G) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hA : 0 < A) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (hE : G * y ^ 2 ≤ E) (hqq : q0 * x - A * y ≤ q) :
    min (K * q0 ^ 2 / 4) (G * q0 ^ 2 / (4 * A ^ 2 + q0 ^ 2)) * (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) ≤ E + K * q ^ 2

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.S2comp.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.S2comp
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.S2comp.header:
theorem S2comp {E x y q G l0 A : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hG : 0 < G) (hl0 : 0 < l0)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hE : l0 * x ^ 2 + G * y ^ 2 ≤ E) (hqq : q ≤ A * (x + y)) :
    q ^ 2 ≤ A ^ 2 * (1 / l0 + 1 / G) * E

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Eb.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Eb
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Eb.header: noncomputable def Eb (w : Fin 3 → V) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.g1b.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.g1b
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.g1b.header: noncomputable def g1b (w : Fin 3 → V) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.g2b.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.g2b
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.g2b.header: noncomputable def g2b (w : Fin 3 → V) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ef_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ef_nonneg
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ef_nonneg.header: theorem Ef_nonneg (f : V) : 0 ≤ Ef sd f

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Eb_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Eb_nonneg
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Eb_nonneg.header: theorem Eb_nonneg (w : Fin 3 → V) : 0 ≤ Eb sd w

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.g2b_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.g2b_nonneg
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.g2b_nonneg.header: theorem g2b_nonneg (w : Fin 3 → V) : 0 ≤ g2b sd w

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.weitz_b.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.weitz_b
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.weitz_b.header: theorem weitz_b (w : Fin 3 → V) : g1b sd w + ‖sd.Dstar w‖ ^ 2 = Eb sd w

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ef_eq.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ef_eq
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ef_eq.header: theorem Ef_eq (f : V) : ((Ef sd f : ℝ) : ℂ) = ⟪f, sd.Lap f⟫

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.D_sum.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.D_sum
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.D_sum.header:
theorem D_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (μ : Fin 3) (f : ι → V) :
    sd.D μ (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, sd.D μ (f i)

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Lap_D.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Lap_D
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Lap_D.header: theorem Lap_D (μ : Fin 3) (x : V) : sd.Lap (sd.D μ x) = sd.D μ (sd.Lap x)

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_add.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_add
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_add.header: theorem Qm_add (μ : Fin 3) (x y : V) : sd.Qm μ (x + y) = sd.Qm μ x + sd.Qm μ y

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_smul.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_smul
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_smul.header: theorem Qm_smul (μ : Fin 3) (c : ℂ) (x : V) : sd.Qm μ (c • x) = c * sd.Qm μ x

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_sub.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_sub
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_sub.header: theorem Qm_sub (μ : Fin 3) (x y : V) : sd.Qm μ (x - y) = sd.Qm μ x - sd.Qm μ y

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_iter.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_iter
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_iter.header: theorem norm_iter (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) (x : V) : ‖(sd.S μ)^[i] x‖ = ‖x‖

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_norm_le.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_norm_le
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_norm_le.header: theorem Qm_norm_le (μ : Fin 3) (x : V) : ‖sd.Qm μ x‖ ≤ (sd.n : ℝ) * ‖sd.eps‖ * ‖x‖

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_eps_D.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_eps_Ds
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_eps_D.header: theorem inner_eps_Ds (hall : ∀ μ, sd.ph μ = 1) (μ : Fin 3) (y : V) : ⟪sd.eps, sd.Ds μ y⟫ = 0

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_eps_D.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_eps_Dstar
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_eps_D.header: theorem inner_eps_Dstar (hall : ∀ μ, sd.ph μ = 1) (w : Fin 3 → V) : ⟪sd.eps, sd.Dstar w⟫ = 0

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.decomp_norm.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.decomp_norm
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.decomp_norm.header:
theorem decomp_norm (md : ModeData sd) (c : ℂ) (h : V) (hh : ⟪md.e0, h⟫ = 0) :
    ‖c • md.e0 + h‖ ^ 2 = ‖c‖ ^ 2 + ‖h‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.decomp_Ef.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.decomp_Ef
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.decomp_Ef.header:
theorem decomp_Ef (md : ModeData sd) (c : ℂ) (h : V) (hh : ⟪md.e0, h⟫ = 0) :
    Ef sd (c • md.e0 + h) = md.l0 * ‖c‖ ^ 2 + Ef sd h

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.decomp_exis.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.decomp_exists
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.decomp_exis.header:
theorem decomp_exists (md : ModeData sd) (f : V) :
    ∃ (c : ℂ) (h : V), f = c • md.e0 + h ∧ ⟪md.e0, h⟫ = 0

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.spec_low.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.spec_low
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.spec_low.header:
theorem spec_low (md : ModeData sd) (f : V) :
    md.l0 * ‖⟪md.e0, f⟫‖ ^ 2 + md.G * (‖f‖ ^ 2 - ‖⟪md.e0, f⟫‖ ^ 2) ≤ Ef sd f

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ef_ge_gap.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ef_ge_gap
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ef_ge_gap.header:
theorem Ef_ge_gap (f : V) (c : ℂ) (h : V) (hf : f = c • md.e0 + h) (hh : ⟪md.e0, h⟫ = 0) :
    md.G * ‖h‖ ^ 2 ≤ Ef sd f

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.comp_N.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.comp_N
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.comp_N.header:
theorem comp_N (κ A q0 : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hA : 0 < A) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (hq : ∀ μ, q0 ≤ ‖sd.Qm μ md.e0‖) (hAq : ∀ μ x, ‖sd.Qm μ x‖ ≤ A * ‖x‖) (μ : Fin 3) (f : V) :
    min (κ * q0 ^ 2 / 4) (md.G * q0 ^ 2 / (4 * A ^ 2 + q0 ^ 2)) * ‖f‖ ^ 2
      ≤ Ef sd f + κ * ‖sd.Qm μ f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.comp_S2.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.comp_S2
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.comp_S2.header:
theorem comp_S2 (hl0 : 0 < md.l0) (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hAq : ∀ μ x, ‖sd.Qm μ x‖ ≤ A * ‖x‖)
    (μ : Fin 3) (f : V) :
    ‖sd.Qm μ f‖ ^ 2 ≤ A ^ 2 * (1 / md.l0 + 1 / md.G) * Ef sd f

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.N_coercive.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.N_coercive
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.N_coercive.header:
theorem N_coercive (κ A q0 : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hA : 0 < A) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (hq : ∀ μ, q0 ≤ ‖sd.Qm μ md.e0‖) (hAq : ∀ μ x, ‖sd.Qm μ x‖ ≤ A * ‖x‖) (w : Fin 3 → V) :
    min (κ * q0 ^ 2 / 4) (md.G * q0 ^ 2 / (4 * A ^ 2 + q0 ^ 2)) * ∑ μ, ‖w μ‖ ^ 2
      ≤ Eb sd w + κ * g2b sd w

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.S2_bound.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.S2_bound
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.S2_bound.header:
theorem S2_bound (hl0 : 0 < md.l0) (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hAq : ∀ μ x, ‖sd.Qm μ x‖ ≤ A * ‖x‖)
    (w : Fin 3 → V) : g2b sd w ≤ A ^ 2 * (1 / md.l0 + 1 / md.G) * Eb sd w

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Lap_eps_tri.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Lap_eps_trivial
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Lap_eps_tri.header: theorem Lap_eps_trivial (hall : ∀ μ, sd.ph μ = 1) : sd.Lap sd.eps = 0

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Lap_range_t.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Lap_range_trivial
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Lap_range_t.header:
theorem Lap_range_trivial (hall : ∀ μ, sd.ph μ = 1) (f : V) (hf : ⟪sd.eps, f⟫ = 0) :
    ∃ u, ⟪sd.eps, u⟫ = 0 ∧ sd.Lap u = f

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.S_ge_trivia.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.S_ge_trivial
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.S_ge_trivia.header:
theorem S_ge_trivial (hall : ∀ μ, sd.ph μ = 1) (w : Fin 3 → V) (S : ℝ) (hS0 : 0 ≤ S)
    (hS : ∀ u, ⟪sd.eps, u⟫ = 0 → ‖⟪sd.Dstar w, sd.Lap u⟫‖ ^ 2 ≤ S * ‖sd.Lap u‖ ^ 2) :
    ‖sd.Dstar w‖ ^ 2 ≤ S

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.S_ge_nontri.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.S_ge_nontrivial
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.S_ge_nontri.header:
theorem S_ge_nontrivial (g : V) (hg : sd.Lap g = sd.eps) (hg0 : g ≠ 0) (μ0 : Fin 3) (hμ0 : sd.ph μ0 ≠ 1)
    (w : Fin 3 → V) (S : ℝ) (hS0 : 0 ≤ S)
    (hS : ∀ u, ⟪sd.eps, u⟫ = 0 → ‖⟪sd.Dstar w, sd.Lap u⟫‖ ^ 2 ≤ S * ‖sd.Lap u‖ ^ 2) :
    ‖sd.Dstar w‖ ^ 2 - ‖⟪g, sd.Dstar w⟫‖ ^ 2 / ‖g‖ ^ 2 ≤ S

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lamN.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lamN
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lamN.header: noncomputable def lamN (κ G A q0 : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.mu0c.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.mu0c
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.mu0c.header: noncomputable def mu0c (κ G2 S2 : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_abstra.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_abstract_trivial
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_abstra.header:
theorem cell_abstract_trivial (md : ModeData sd) (κ A q0 : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hA : 0 < A) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (hq : ∀ μ, q0 ≤ ‖sd.Qm μ md.e0‖) (hAq : ∀ μ x, ‖sd.Qm μ x‖ ≤ A * ‖x‖)
    (hall : ∀ μ, sd.ph μ = 1) (w : Fin 3 → V) (S : ℝ) (hS0 : 0 ≤ S)
    (hS : ∀ u, ⟪sd.eps, u⟫ = 0 → ‖⟪sd.Dstar w, sd.Lap u⟫‖ ^ 2 ≤ S * ‖sd.Lap u‖ ^ 2) :
    lamN κ md.G A q0 * ∑ μ, ‖w μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ g1b sd w + κ * g2b sd w + S

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.expand_form.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.expand_form
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.expand_form.header:
theorem expand_form (x y : V) (c : ℂ) :
    ⟪x - c • y, sd.Lap (x - c • y)⟫ =
      ⟪x, sd.Lap x⟫ - c * ⟪x, sd.Lap y⟫ - (starRingEnd ℂ) c * ⟪y, sd.Lap x⟫
        + (starRingEnd ℂ) c * c * ⟪y, sd.Lap y⟫

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qv.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qv
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qv.header: noncomputable def Qv (sd : SymData V) (y : Fin 3 → V) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3)

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_Qv_sq.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_Qv_sq
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_Qv_sq.header: theorem norm_Qv_sq (y : Fin 3 → V) : ‖Qv sd y‖ ^ 2 = g2b sd y

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qv_decomp.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qv_decomp
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qv_decomp.header:
theorem Qv_decomp (v wt : Fin 3 → V) (c : ℂ) (w : Fin 3 → V) (hw : ∀ μ, w μ = v μ + c • wt μ) :
    Qv sd w = Qv sd v + c • Qv sd wt

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_abstra.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_abstract_nontrivial
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cell_abstra.header:
theorem cell_abstract_nontrivial (md : ModeData sd) (κ A q0 β : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (hl0 : 0 < md.l0) (hq : ∀ μ, q0 ≤ ‖sd.Qm μ md.e0‖)
    (hAq : ∀ μ x, ‖sd.Qm μ x‖ ≤ A * ‖x‖) (hβ : β ≤ ‖⟪md.e0, sd.eps⟫‖ ^ 2) (hβ0 : 0 ≤ β)
    (μ0 : Fin 3) (hμ0 : sd.ph μ0 ≠ 1) (w : Fin 3 → V) (S : ℝ) (hS0 : 0 ≤ S)
    (hS : ∀ u, ⟪sd.eps, u⟫ = 0 → ‖⟪sd.Dstar w, sd.Lap u⟫‖ ^ 2 ≤ S * ‖sd.Lap u‖ ^ 2) :
    mu0c κ ((∑ μ, ‖sd.ph μ - 1‖ ^ 2) * β / md.l0 ^ 2) (A ^ 2 * (1 / md.l0 + 1 / md.G))
        / (1 + mu0c κ ((∑ μ, ‖sd.ph μ - 1‖ ^ 2) * β / md.l0 ^ 2) (A ^ 2 * (1 / md.l0 + 1 / md.G)))
        * lamN κ md.G A q0 * ∑ μ, ‖w μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ g1b sd w + κ * g2b sd w + S

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.th.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.th
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.th.header: noncomputable def th (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ : Fin 3) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.th_mem.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.th_mem
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.th_mem.header: theorem th_mem (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ : Fin 3) : -Real.pi < th z μ ∧ th z μ ≤ Real.pi

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.z_eq_exp.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.z_eq_exp
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.z_eq_exp.header:
theorem z_eq_exp (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (z μ : ℂ) = Complex.exp (Complex.I * (th z μ : ℝ))

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg.header: noncomputable def sg (n : ℕ) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) (μ : Fin 3) : ℂ

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_sg.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_sg
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_sg.header: theorem norm_sg (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) (μ : Fin 3) : ‖sg n z k μ‖ = 1

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg_ne.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg_ne
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg_ne.header: theorem sg_ne (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) (μ : Fin 3) : sg n z k μ ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg_pow.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg_pow
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg_pow.header:
theorem sg_pow (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (sg n z k μ) ^ n = (z μ : ℂ)

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pw.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pw
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pw.header: noncomputable def pw (n : ℕ) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) (x : Z3) : ℂ

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pw_add.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pw_add
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pw_add.header: theorem pw_add (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) (x y : Z3) : pw n z k (x + y) = pw n z k x * pw n z k y

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pw_ev.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pw_ev
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pw_ev.header: theorem pw_ev (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) (μ : Fin 3) : pw n z k (ev μ) = sg n z k μ

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pw_nsmul.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pw_nsmul
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pw_nsmul.header:
theorem pw_nsmul (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) (m : Z3) :
    pw n z k ((n : ℤ) • m) = phase (fun μ => (z μ : ℂ)) m

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pw_qp.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pw_qp
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pw_qp.header:
theorem pw_qp (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) (x m : Z3) :
    pw n z k (x + (n : ℤ) • m) = phase (fun μ => (z μ : ℂ)) m * pw n z k x

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pwv.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pwv
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pwv.header: noncomputable def pwv (n : ℕ) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) : CV n

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lift_pwv.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lift_pwv
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lift_pwv.header:
theorem lift_pwv (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) (x : Z3) :
    lift hn (fun μ => (z μ : ℂ)) (pwv n z k) x = pw n z k x

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Su_pwv.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Su_pwv
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Su_pwv.header:
theorem Su_pwv (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) (μ : Fin 3) :
    Su hn z μ (pwv n z k) = sg n z k μ • pwv n z k

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_pw.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_pw
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_pw.header: theorem norm_pw (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) (x : Z3) : ‖pw n z k x‖ = 1

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.card_cell.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.card_cell
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.card_cell.header: theorem card_cell (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Cell n) = n ^ 3

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_pwv_sq.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_pwv_sq
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_pwv_sq.header: theorem norm_pwv_sq (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) : ‖pwv n z k‖ ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg_inj.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg_inj
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg_inj.header:
theorem sg_inj (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k k' : Cell n) (μ : Fin 3)
    (h : sg n z k μ = sg n z k' μ) : k μ = k' μ

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_pwv.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_pwv
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_pwv.header:
theorem inner_pwv (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k k' : Cell n) :
    ⟪pwv n z k, pwv n z k'⟫ = if k = k' then ((n : ℂ) ^ 3) else 0

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cn_sq.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cn_sq
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cn_sq.header: theorem cn_sq (hn : 0 < n) : cn n ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 3 = 1

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pk.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pk
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.pk.header: noncomputable def pk (n : ℕ) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) : CV n

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_pk.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_pk
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_pk.header:
theorem inner_pk (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k k' : Cell n) :
    ⟪pk n z k, pk n z k'⟫ = if k = k' then 1 else 0

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.orth_pk.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.orth_pk
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.orth_pk.header: theorem orth_pk (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) : Orthonormal ℂ (pk n z)

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.onb.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.onb
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.onb.header: noncomputable def onb (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) : OrthonormalBasis (Cell n) ℂ (CV n)

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.onb_apply.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.onb_apply
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.onb_apply.header: theorem onb_apply (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) : onb hn z k = pk n z k

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lam.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lam
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lam.header: noncomputable def lam (n : ℕ) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lam_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lam_nonneg
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lam_nonneg.header: theorem lam_nonneg (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) : 0 ≤ lam n z k

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.D_pwv.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.D_pwv
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.D_pwv.header:
theorem D_pwv (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (cellSym hn z).D μ (pwv n z k) = (sg n z k μ - 1) • pwv n z k

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ds_pwv.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ds_pwv
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ds_pwv.header:
theorem Ds_pwv (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (cellSym hn z).Ds μ (pwv n z k) = ((sg n z k μ)⁻¹ - 1) • pwv n z k

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Lap_pwv.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Lap_pwv
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Lap_pwv.header:
theorem Lap_pwv (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) :
    (cellSym hn z).Lap (pwv n z k) = ((lam n z k : ℝ) : ℂ) • pwv n z k

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Lap_pk.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Lap_pk
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Lap_pk.header:
theorem Lap_pk (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) :
    (cellSym hn z).Lap (pk n z k) = ((lam n z k : ℝ) : ℂ) • pk n z k

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ef_parseval.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ef_parseval
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Ef_parseval.header:
theorem Ef_parseval (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (f : CV n) :
    Ef (cellSym hn z) f = ∑ k : Cell n, lam n z k * ‖⟪pk n z k, f⟫‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.parseval_pk.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.parseval_pk
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.parseval_pk.header:
theorem parseval_pk (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (f : CV n) :
    ∑ k : Cell n, ‖⟪pk n z k, f⟫‖ ^ 2 = ‖f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sin_lower.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sin_lower
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sin_lower.header:
theorem sin_lower (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (θ : ℝ) (hθ1 : -Real.pi < θ) (hθ2 : θ ≤ Real.pi) (m : ℕ)
    (hm1 : 1 ≤ m) (hm2 : m < n) : 1 / (n : ℝ) ≤ Real.sin ((θ + 2 * Real.pi * (m : ℝ)) / (2 * n))

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg_sub_one_.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg_sub_one_ge
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg_sub_one_.header:
theorem sg_sub_one_ge (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) (μ : Fin 3) (hk : k μ ≠ ⟨0, hn⟩) :
    4 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ ‖sg n z k μ - 1‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lam_ge.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lam_ge
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.lam_ge.header:
theorem lam_ge (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) (hk : k ≠ k0 hn) :
    4 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ lam n z k

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.gap_cell.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.gap_cell
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.gap_cell.header:
theorem gap_cell (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (f : CV n) (hf : ⟪pk n z (k0 hn), f⟫ = 0) :
    4 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ Ef (cellSym hn z) f

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_pk.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_pk
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_pk.header: theorem norm_pk (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (k : Cell n) : ‖pk n z k‖ = 1

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cellMode.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cellMode
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.cellMode.header: noncomputable def cellMode (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) : ModeData (cellSym hn z)

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Tm.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Tm
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Tm.header: noncomputable def Tm (n : ℕ) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (hn : 0 < n) (μ : Fin 3) : ℂ

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg0.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg0
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.sg0.header:
theorem sg0 (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ : Fin 3) :
    sg n z (k0 hn) μ = Complex.exp (Complex.I * (((th z μ) / (n : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ))

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.abs_sin_ge.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.abs_sin_ge
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.abs_sin_ge.header: theorem abs_sin_ge (y : ℝ) (h : |y| ≤ Real.pi / 2) : 2 / Real.pi * |y| ≤ |Real.sin y|

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Tm_lower.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Tm_lower
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Tm_lower.header:
theorem Tm_lower (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ : Fin 3) :
    2 * (n : ℝ) / Real.pi ≤ ‖Tm n z hn μ‖

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_eps_p.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_eps_pwv0
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.inner_eps_p.header:
theorem inner_eps_pwv0 (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) :
    ⟪epsV n, pwv n z (k0 hn)⟫ = ∏ μ, Tm n z hn μ

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.iter_pwv0.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.iter_pwv0
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.iter_pwv0.header:
theorem iter_pwv0 (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :
    (Su hn z μ)^[i] (pwv n z (k0 hn)) = (sg n z (k0 hn) μ) ^ i • pwv n z (k0 hn)

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_pwv0.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_pwv0
AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.Qm_pwv0.header:
theorem Qm_pwv0 (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin 3 → Circle) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (cellSym hn z).Qm μ (pwv n z (k0 hn)) = Tm n z hn μ * ∏ ν, Tm n z hn ν

AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_prodT.name: AdalyFormal.ScaledCoercivity.norm_prodT

AdalyFormal.M2F123.blockGauge_of_chart.header:
theorem blockGauge_of_chart {ell M R k : ℕ} {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hRM : 18 ≤ R * M) (hbig : ∀ σ : Fin 3, 4 * ell ^ k < L σ + 1)
    {α₀ η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀)
    (ha1 : (12 : ℝ) * M * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀)) ≤ 1)
    (hsm4 : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rho1 12 M ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀)) ≤ 1)
    (U : LinkCfg L) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j)
    (hch : AnchorChart ell M k S U α₀ η y (7 * ell ^ j)) :
    ∃ γ : GaugeFn L,
      (∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
        frobNorm ((((periodicGaugeTransform γ U b : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
          ≤ ((ell : ℝ) + 3 * Real.pi * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rho1 12 M ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀)) / (ell : ℝ) ^ j) ∧
      (∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
        coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
        frobNorm ((bgTower (geomOf ell k S) (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
          ≤ ((ell : ℝ) + 3 * Real.pi * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rho1 12 M ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀)) * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)

    (hL : ∀ σ : Fin 3, 1 ≤ L σ) {α₀ η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀)
    (ha1 : (12 : ℝ) * M * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀)) ≤ 1)
    (hsm4 : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rho1 12 M ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀)) ≤ 1)
    (U : LinkCfg L)
    (hch : ∀ q : QIdx (geomOf ell k S), 1 ≤ jq q → AnchorChart ell M k S U α₀ η (yq q) (7 * ell ^ jq q)) :
    ∃ γB : QIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn L,
      (∀ q : QIdx (geomOf ell k S), ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds (yq q) (ell ^ jq q),
        frobNorm ((((periodicGaugeTransform (γB q) U b : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
          ≤ ((ell : ℝ) + 3 * Real.pi * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rho1 12 M ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀)) / (ell : ℝ) ^ jq q) ∧
      (∀ q : QIdx (geomOf ell k S), ∀ i, i < jq q → ∀ z ∈ blockOf (yq q) (ell ^ jq q), z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) →
        ∀ μ : Fin 3, coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf (yq q) (ell ^ jq q) →
        frobNorm ((bgTower (geomOf ell k S) (periodicGaugeTransform (γB q) U) i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
          ≤ ((ell : ℝ) + 3 * Real.pi * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rho1 12 M ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀)) * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ jq q)
