AdalyFormal.M2F123.glue_gauges.name: AdalyFormal.M2F123.glue_gauges
AdalyFormal.M2F123.glue_gauges.header:
theorem glue_gauges {ell k : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {G : TowerGeom L} (hP : AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.ProperTower G ell k)
    (U : Cfg L) (γB : QIdx G → GaugeFn L) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hU : ∀ q : QIdx G, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds (yq q) (ell ^ jq q),
      frobNorm ((((periodicGaugeTransform (γB q) U b : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)) :
        Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ jq q)
    (hT : ∀ q : QIdx G, ∀ i, i < jq q → ∀ z ∈ blockOf (yq q) (ell ^ jq q), z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) →
      ∀ μ : Fin 3, coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf (yq q) (ell ^ jq q) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower G (periodicGaugeTransform (γB q) U) i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
        ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ jq q) :
    ∃ Γ : GaugeFn L,
      (∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
        frobNorm ((((periodicGaugeTransform Γ U b : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
          ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j) ∧
      (∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j), z ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
        coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
        frobNorm ((bgTower G (periodicGaugeTransform Γ U) i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
          ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)

AdalyFormal.M2F123.rowBound_of_charts.name: AdalyFormal.M2F123.rowBound_of_charts
AdalyFormal.M2F123.rowBound_of_charts.header:
theorem rowBound_of_charts {ell M R k : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hRM : 18 ≤ R * M) (hbig : ∀ σ : Fin 3, 4 * ell ^ k < L σ + 1)
    (hL : ∀ σ : Fin 3, 1 ≤ L σ) (hR1 : 1 ≤ R) (hM1 : 1 ≤ M) {α₀ η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀)
    (ha1 : (12 : ℝ) * M * ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀)) ≤ 1)
    (hsm4 : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rho1 12 M ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀)) ≤ 1)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ε1 : ℝ)
    (hN : AdalyFormal.M1GaugeW4.W4Num ell M 12 (R * M * ell) a (AdalyFormal.M2Skel.alpha1 ell α₀) ε1)
    (U : LinkCfg L)
    (hch : ∀ q : QIdx (geomOf ell k S), 1 ≤ jq q → AnchorChart ell M k S U α₀ η (yq q) (7 * ell ^ jq q)) :
    AdalyFormal.M2Skel.RowBound ell k S U a
      (gamC ell a (AdalyFormal.M1GaugeW4.rhoT ell 12 M (AdalyFormal.M2Skel.alpha1 ell α₀))
        (AdalyFormal.M1GaugeW4.epsXnum ell (R * M * ell) a (AdalyFormal.M1GaugeW4.rhoT ell 12 M (AdalyFormal.M2Skel.alpha1 ell α₀))))

AdalyFormal.M2F123.row_comm_sum_row.name: AdalyFormal.M2F123.row_comm_sum_row
AdalyFormal.M2F123.row_comm_sum_row.header:
theorem row_comm_sum_row (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Sstar : ℝ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (hQ : RowQ ell k Lu S U Sstar p) :

AdalyFormal.P409S.pcd_translate.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.pcd_translate
AdalyFormal.P409S.pcd_translate.header:
theorem pcd_translate (N a b c : ℕ) (ha : a < N) (hb : b < N) (hc : c < N) :

AdalyFormal.P409S.off_back.header: theorem off_back (N a c : ℕ) (ha : a < N) (hc : c < N) : (((a + N - c) % N) + c) % N = a

AdalyFormal.P409S.corner_off.header:
theorem corner_off (N h r A v : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hhN : h ∣ N) (hhr : h ∣ r) (hA : A + h = r) (hv : v < N)
    (hw : v < r ∨ N ≤ v + r) :
    ∃ v' : ℕ, v' < N ∧ v' / h = v / h ∧ (v' ≤ A ∨ N ≤ v' + A + 1)

AdalyFormal.P409S.pcd_near.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.pcd_near
AdalyFormal.P409S.pcd_near.header:
theorem pcd_near (N u w A B : ℕ) (hu : u < N) (hw : w < N)
    (h1 : u ≤ A ∨ N ≤ u + A + 1) (h2 : w ≤ B ∨ N ≤ w + B + 1) : pcd N u w ≤ A + B + 1

AdalyFormal.P409S.cube_off.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.cube_off
AdalyFormal.P409S.cube_off.header:
theorem cube_off (N c r y : ℕ) (hy : y < N) (hc : c < N) (t : ℤ) (ht1 : -(r : ℤ) ≤ t) (ht2 : t < (r : ℤ))
    (h : (y : ℤ) ≡ (c : ℤ) + t [ZMOD (N : ℤ)]) :
    (y + N - c) % N < r ∨ N ≤ (y + N - c) % N + r

AdalyFormal.P409S.pcd_le_natAbs_aux.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.pcd_le_natAbs_aux
AdalyFormal.P409S.pcd_le_natAbs_aux.header: theorem pcd_le_natAbs_aux (N a b : ℕ) : pcd N a b ≤ (if a ≤ b then b - a else a - b)

AdalyFormal.P409S.coord_pair.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.coord_pair
AdalyFormal.P409S.coord_pair.header:
theorem coord_pair (N c h1 r1 A1 h2 r2 A2 a b : ℕ) (hc : c < N)
    (hh1 : 0 < h1) (hh1N : h1 ∣ N) (hh1c : h1 ∣ c) (hh1r : h1 ∣ r1) (hA1 : A1 + h1 = r1)
    (hh2 : 0 < h2) (hh2N : h2 ∣ N) (hh2c : h2 ∣ c) (hh2r : h2 ∣ r2) (hA2 : A2 + h2 = r2)
    (ha : a < N) (hb : b < N)
    (hra : (a + N - c) % N < r1 ∨ N ≤ (a + N - c) % N + r1)
    (hrb : (b + N - c) % N < r2 ∨ N ≤ (b + N - c) % N + r2) :
    ∃ a' b' : ℕ, a' < N ∧ b' < N ∧ a' / h1 = a / h1 ∧ b' / h2 = b / h2 ∧ pcd N a' b' ≤ A1 + A2 + 1

AdalyFormal.P409S.site_pair.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.site_pair
AdalyFormal.P409S.site_pair.header:
theorem site_pair (c y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (h1 r1 A1 h2 r2 A2 : ℕ)
    (hh1 : 0 < h1) (hh1N : ∀ μ : Fin 3, h1 ∣ L μ + 1) (hh1c : ∀ μ : Fin 3, h1 ∣ (c μ).val) (hh1r : h1 ∣ r1) (hA1 : A1 + h1 = r1)
    (hh2 : 0 < h2) (hh2N : ∀ μ : Fin 3, h2 ∣ L μ + 1) (hh2c : ∀ μ : Fin 3, h2 ∣ (c μ).val) (hh2r : h2 ∣ r2) (hA2 : A2 + h2 = r2)
    (hy : y ∈ cubeR c r1) (hx : x ∈ cubeR c r2) :
    ∃ y' x' : PeriodicLatticeSite L, (∀ μ : Fin 3, (y' μ).val / h1 = (y μ).val / h1) ∧
      (∀ μ : Fin 3, (x' μ).val / h2 = (x μ).val / h2) ∧ pdist y' x' ≤ 3 * (A1 + A2 + 1)

AdalyFormal.P409S.far_lower.header:

AdalyFormal.P409S.deep_dcube.header:

AdalyFormal.P409S.deep_near_not_in.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.deep_near_not_in
AdalyFormal.P409S.deep_near_not_in.header:
theorem deep_near_not_in {ell M R k j : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hjk : j ≤ k)

AdalyFormal.P409S.deep_strata.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.deep_strata
AdalyFormal.P409S.deep_strata.header:

AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_sharp_all.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_sharp_all
AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_sharp_all.header:
theorem cube5_sharp_all {ell M R k j' : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hcol : collarOK ell M R (j' + 1)) (hjk : j' + 1 ≤ k)
    (hdiv : ∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k ∣ Lf μ + 1)
    (hbig : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (5 * R + 40) * bigSide M ell k ≤ Lf μ + 1) :
    ∃ (S : Tower Lf) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf),
      Admissible ell M R k S ∧ (∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k < Lf μ + 1) ∧ IsDCube ell M k S (j' + 1) c ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ∃ q, q ∈ towerBj S i) ∧
      (∀ F : ℕ, F + 1 ≤ 12 * ell → ∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)) (i : ℕ), i ≤ k →
        sites ⊆ towerBj S i ∪ towerBj S (i + 1) →
        (∃ z : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf, sites ⊆ siteBox z (F * bigSide M ell i)) →
        ¬ printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) c ⊆ sites) ∧
      (∀ F : ℕ, F + 1 ≤ 12 * ell → ¬ ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)) (i : ℕ),
        IsClassSetW ell M F k S sites i ∧ printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) c ⊆ sites) ∧
      (∀ (i f : ℕ), DescribedAt ell M f k S (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) c) i → i ≤ j' ∧ 12 * ell ≤ f) ∧
      DescribedAt ell M (12 * ell) k S (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) c) j' ∧
      IsClassCubeG ell M (12 * ell) k S (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) c) j'

AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_fails_below_deep.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_fails_below_deep
AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_fails_below_deep.header:
theorem cube5_fails_below_deep {ell M R k j' : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hjk : j' + 1 ≤ k)
    (hlow : (R + 3) * bigSide M ell j' < 18 * bigSide M ell (j' + 1) + 3)
    (hdiv : ∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k ∣ Lf μ + 1)
    (hbig : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (5 * R + 40) * bigSide M ell k ≤ Lf μ + 1) :
    ∃ (S : Tower Lf) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf),
      Admissible ell M R k S ∧ (∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k < Lf μ + 1) ∧ IsDCube ell M k S (j' + 1) c ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ k → ∃ q, q ∈ towerBj S i) ∧
      (∃ y ∈ printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) c, y ∉ S.Om j') ∧
      (∀ (i f : ℕ) (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)), j' ≤ i → DescribedAt ell M f k S sites i →
        ¬ printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) c ⊆ sites) ∧
      ¬ ∃ i f : ℕ, ((i = j' + 1 ∧ f = 12) ∨ (i + 1 = j' + 1 ∧ f = 12 * ell)) ∧
        DescribedAt ell M f k S (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) c) i

AdalyFormal.P409S.ceil3_spec.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.ceil3_spec
AdalyFormal.P409S.ceil3_spec.header: theorem ceil3_spec {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) : 3 ≤ ceil3 h * h ∧ (ceil3 h - 1) * h < 3

AdalyFormal.P409S.collarOK_iff_Rstar.header:

AdalyFormal.P409S.collarOK_iff_of_three.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.collarOK_iff_of_three
AdalyFormal.P409S.collarOK_iff_of_three.header:

AdalyFormal.P409S.collarOK_iff_of_two.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.collarOK_iff_of_two
AdalyFormal.P409S.collarOK_iff_of_two.header:
theorem collarOK_iff_of_two {ell M R j' : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (h2 : bigSide M ell j' = 2) :

AdalyFormal.P409S.collarOK_iff_of_one.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.collarOK_iff_of_one
AdalyFormal.P409S.collarOK_iff_of_one.header:
theorem collarOK_iff_of_one {ell M R j' : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (h1 : bigSide M ell j' = 1) :

AdalyFormal.P409S.torus_hyps_satisfiable.header:
theorem torus_hyps_satisfiable (ell M R k : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) :

AdalyFormal.P409S.inst_sharp.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.inst_sharp
AdalyFormal.P409S.inst_sharp.header:
theorem inst_sharp :
    ∃ (Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower Lf) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf),
      Admissible 2 1 36 1 S ∧ IsDCube 2 1 1 S 1 c ∧ (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ 1 → ∃ q, q ∈ towerBj S i) ∧
      IsClassCubeG 2 1 24 1 S (printedCube5 (bigSide 1 2 1) c) 0 ∧
      (∀ F : ℕ, F + 1 ≤ 24 → ¬ ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)) (i : ℕ),
        IsClassSetW 2 1 F 1 S sites i ∧ printedCube5 (bigSide 1 2 1) c ⊆ sites)

AdalyFormal.P409S.inst_fails.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.inst_fails
AdalyFormal.P409S.inst_fails.header:
theorem inst_fails :
    ∃ (Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower Lf) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf),
      Admissible 2 1 35 1 S ∧ IsDCube 2 1 1 S 1 c ∧ (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ 1 → ∃ q, q ∈ towerBj S i) ∧
      (∃ y ∈ printedCube5 (bigSide 1 2 1) c, y ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
      ¬ ∃ i f : ℕ, ((i = 1 ∧ f = 12) ∨ (i + 1 = 1 ∧ f = 12 * 2)) ∧
        DescribedAt 2 1 f 1 S (printedCube5 (bigSide 1 2 1) c) i

AdalyFormal.P409S.local_in_class_box_sha.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.local_in_class_box_sharp
AdalyFormal.P409S.local_in_class_box_sha.header:
theorem local_in_class_box_sharp {ell M R k j' p : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}

      IsClassCubeG ell M f k S (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) c) i ∧
      localOm0 ell p (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) (j' + 1) c ⊆ printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) c

AdalyFormal.P409S.localOm0_sub_Om0_sharp.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.localOm0_sub_Om0_sharp
AdalyFormal.P409S.localOm0_sub_Om0_sharp.header:
theorem localOm0_sub_Om0_sharp {ell M R k j' p : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}

AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_described.header:

AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_is_class_box_sha.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_is_class_box_sharp
AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_is_class_box_sha.header:
theorem cube5_is_class_box_sharp {ell M R k j' : ℕ} {S : Tower L} {c : PeriodicLatticeSite L}

AdalyFormal.P409S.lone_admissible.header:

AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_fails_below.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_fails_below
AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_fails_below.header:
theorem cube5_fails_below {ell M R k j' : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hjk : j' + 1 ≤ k)
    (hlow : (R + 3) * bigSide M ell j' < 18 * bigSide M ell (j' + 1) + 3)
    (hdiv : ∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k ∣ Lf μ + 1)
    (hbig : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (3 * R + 30) * bigSide M ell (j' + 1) ≤ Lf μ + 1) :
    ∃ (S : Tower Lf) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf), Admissible ell M R k S ∧ IsDCube ell M k S (j' + 1) c ∧
      (∃ y ∈ printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) c, y ∉ S.Om j') ∧
      (∀ (i f : ℕ) (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)), j' ≤ i → DescribedAt ell M f k S sites i →
        ¬ printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) c ⊆ sites) ∧
      ¬ ∃ i f : ℕ, ((i = j' + 1 ∧ f = 12) ∨ (i + 1 = j' + 1 ∧ f = 12 * ell)) ∧
        DescribedAt ell M f k S (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) c) i

AdalyFormal.P409S.sharp_lower_gen.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.sharp_lower_gen
AdalyFormal.P409S.sharp_lower_gen.header:
theorem sharp_lower_gen {ell M R k j : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {S : Tower Lf} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hnest : ∀ i : ℕ, S.Om (i + 1) ⊆ S.Om i)
    (hbig : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (3 * R + 30) * bigSide M ell j ≤ Lf μ + 1)
    (hvX : sitePt Lf ((R + 6) * bigSide M ell j) ∉ S.Om j) :
    ∀ F : ℕ, F + 1 ≤ 12 * ell → ∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)) (i : ℕ), i ≤ k →
      sites ⊆ towerBj S i ∪ towerBj S (i + 1) →
      (∃ z : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf, sites ⊆ siteBox z (F * bigSide M ell i)) →
      ¬ printedCube5 (bigSide M ell j) (loneC Lf ell M R j) ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.P409S.loneT_sharp_lower.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.loneT_sharp_lower
AdalyFormal.P409S.loneT_sharp_lower.header:
theorem loneT_sharp_lower {ell M R k j : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M)

    ∀ F : ℕ, F + 1 ≤ 12 * ell → ∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)) (i : ℕ), i ≤ k →

AdalyFormal.P409S.sharp_core_gen.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.sharp_core_gen
AdalyFormal.P409S.sharp_core_gen.header:
theorem sharp_core_gen {ell M R k j' : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {S : Tower Lf}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hcol : collarOK ell M R (j' + 1))
    (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (hD : IsDCube ell M k S (j' + 1) (loneC Lf ell M R (j' + 1)))
    (hbig : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (3 * R + 30) * bigSide M ell (j' + 1) ≤ Lf μ + 1)
    (hvX : sitePt Lf ((R + 6) * bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) ∉ S.Om (j' + 1)) :
    (∀ F : ℕ, F + 1 ≤ 12 * ell → ∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)) (i : ℕ), i ≤ k →
      sites ⊆ towerBj S i ∪ towerBj S (i + 1) →
      (∃ z : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf, sites ⊆ siteBox z (F * bigSide M ell i)) →
      ¬ printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) (loneC Lf ell M R (j' + 1)) ⊆ sites) ∧
    DescribedAt ell M (12 * ell) k S (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) (loneC Lf ell M R (j' + 1))) j' ∧
    IsClassCubeG ell M (12 * ell) k S (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) (loneC Lf ell M R (j' + 1))) j' ∧
    (∀ (i f : ℕ), DescribedAt ell M f k S (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) (loneC Lf ell M R (j' + 1))) i →
      i ≤ j' ∧ 12 * ell ≤ f)

AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_sharp_core.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_sharp_core
AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_sharp_core.header:
theorem cube5_sharp_core {ell M R k j' : ℕ} {Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent}
    (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hcol : collarOK ell M R (j' + 1)) (hjk : j' + 1 ≤ k)
    (hdiv : ∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k ∣ Lf μ + 1)
    (hbig : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (3 * R + 30) * bigSide M ell (j' + 1) ≤ Lf μ + 1) :
    Admissible ell M R k (loneT (L := Lf) ell M R (j' + 1)) ∧
    IsDCube ell M k (loneT ell M R (j' + 1)) (j' + 1) (loneC Lf ell M R (j' + 1)) ∧
    (∀ F : ℕ, F + 1 ≤ 12 * ell → ∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lf)) (i : ℕ), i ≤ k →
      sites ⊆ towerBj (loneT ell M R (j' + 1)) i ∪ towerBj (loneT ell M R (j' + 1)) (i + 1) →
      (∃ z : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf, sites ⊆ siteBox z (F * bigSide M ell i)) →
      ¬ printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) (loneC Lf ell M R (j' + 1)) ⊆ sites) ∧
    DescribedAt ell M (12 * ell) k (loneT ell M R (j' + 1)) (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) (loneC Lf ell M R (j' + 1))) j' ∧
    IsClassCubeG ell M (12 * ell) k (loneT ell M R (j' + 1)) (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) (loneC Lf ell M R (j' + 1))) j' ∧
    (∀ (i f : ℕ), DescribedAt ell M f k (loneT ell M R (j' + 1)) (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) (loneC Lf ell M R (j' + 1))) i →
      i ≤ j' ∧ 12 * ell ≤ f)

AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_threshold_iff.name: AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_threshold_iff
AdalyFormal.P409S.cube5_threshold_iff.header:
theorem cube5_threshold_iff {ell M R k j' : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hjk : j' + 1 ≤ k) :
    (∀ (Lf : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower Lf) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf),
        Admissible ell M R k S → (∀ μ : Fin 3, bigSide M ell k < Lf μ + 1) → IsDCube ell M k S (j' + 1) c →
        ∃ i f : ℕ, ((i = j' + 1 ∧ f = 12) ∨ (i + 1 = j' + 1 ∧ f = 12 * ell)) ∧
          DescribedAt ell M f k S (printedCube5 (bigSide M ell (j' + 1)) c) i) ↔
      collarOK ell M R (j' + 1)

AdalySI1.SI1Assemble.genList.name: AdalySI1.SI1Assemble.genList
AdalySI1.SI1Assemble.genList.header:
noncomputable def genList (t : ℝ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) :
    PeriodicLatticeSite L → List (Fin 3 × Bool) → SU2 → List M2
  | _, [], _ => []
  | x, s :: rest, transport =>
      (t • adMap transport (A (x, s.1))) ::
        genList t V0 A (periodicLatticeStep x s) rest (transport * V0 (x, s.1))

theorem genList_sum (t : ℝ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) :
    ∀ (base : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (steps : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) (transport : SU2),
      (genList t V0 A base steps transport).sum = t • dirDeriv V0 A base steps transport
  | _, [], _ => by simp [genList, dirDeriv]
  | x, s :: rest, transport => by
      show t • adMap transport (A (x, s.1)) +
          (genList t V0 A (periodicLatticeStep x s) rest (transport * V0 (x, s.1))).sum
        = t • dirDeriv V0 A x (s :: rest) transport
      rw [genList_sum t V0 A (periodicLatticeStep x s) rest (transport * V0 (x, s.1))]
      show t • adMap transport (A (x, s.1)) + t • dirDeriv V0 A (periodicLatticeStep x s) rest
          (transport * V0 (x, s.1))
        = t • (adMap transport (A (x, s.1))
            + dirDeriv V0 A (periodicLatticeStep x s) rest (transport * V0 (x, s.1)))
      rw [smul_add]

theorem genList_isSu2 (t : ℝ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) (hah : ∀ e, (A e)ᴴ = -(A e))

      ∀ X ∈ genList t V0 A base steps transport, IsSu2 X
  | _, [], _ => by simp [genList]
  | x, s :: rest, transport => by
      intro X hX
      simp only [genList, List.mem_cons] at hX
      rcases hX with hX | hX
      · subst hX
        have hAsu2 : IsSu2 (A (x, s.1))

theorem genList_frobNorm_sum (t : ℝ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (A : PeriodicLatticeEdge L → M2) :
    ∀ (base : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (steps : List (Fin 3 × Bool)) (transport : SU2),
      ((genList t V0 A base steps transport).map frobNorm).sum
        = |t| * pathNormSum A base steps
  | _, [], _ => by simp [genList, pathNormSum]
  | x, s :: rest, transport => by
      show frobNorm (t • adMap transport (A (x, s.1))) +
          ((genList t V0 A (periodicLatticeStep x s) rest (transport * V0 (x, s.1))).map
            frobNorm).sum
        = |t| * pathNormSum A x (s :: rest)
      rw [genList_frobNorm_sum t V0 A (periodicLatticeStep x s) rest (transport * V0 (x, s.1))]
      have hsmul : frobNorm (t • adMap transport (A (x, s.1))) =
          |t| * frobNorm (adMap transport (A (x, s.1)))

theorem chart_core_class {ell M R k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell0 : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hRM3 : 3 ≤ R * M)
    (hT : TorusOK ell M Lu) {Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)} (hL : LambdaOK2 ell M R k S Lam)
    (V : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hWD : GenP.WellDef (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam))
    (cw ε2s εJ : ℝ) (hcw : 0 < cw) (hε2 : 0 ≤ ε2s) (hεJ : 0 ≤ εJ) (hε2cw : ε2s ≤ cw)
    (hcoer : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).G),
      cw * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
        ≤ ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫)
    (hD2 : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).G),
      |⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).data.Delta2 (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).data_laws A⟫|
        ≤ ε2s * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hJ : ∀ Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo, OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt → OnLambdaT Lam Bt →
      |⟪(gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).H1in ((gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).D2in
          (WithLp.toLp 2 (Cop Lam (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).Q1 Bt))), (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).Jf⟫|
        ≤ εJ * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (Cop Lam (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).Q1 Bt) : BondFnL2 Lu)‖ ^ 2)
    {W : ℕ} (hW : 1 ≤ W) (hWR : W ≤ R * M * ell) (hR1 : 1 ≤ R) (hM1 : 1 ≤ M)
    (cs ρ ε1 : ℝ) (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) V a cs) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hreg : HolRegime S ell k V ρ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1) (hε1' : ε1 < 1)
    (hTT : (1 + 1 / ε1) * (12 * ρ ^ 2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 8 * (4 * ell / cs) ^ 2)
        + 2 * ((17 / Real.sqrt 2) * 12 * (ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)) *
          ((ell : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (12 / cs) + Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1)
            * (4 / cs))) ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (cUc c1 c2 : ℝ) (hcU : 0 < cUc) (hc1 : 0 < c1) (hc2 : 0 ≤ c2)
    (hfloor : ∀ Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo, OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt → OnLambdaT Lam Bt →
      ∀ y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull y = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam).tau
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam) Bt)) →
      (cUc * ∑ b : Bond Lu, ‖GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam) Bt b‖ ^ 2
        ≤ c1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ k *
            ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell k Lu))).filter
                (fun p => p ∈ plaqIn (S.Om k)), ‖curlValueCovariant V (WithLp.ofLp y) p‖ ^ 2
          + c2 / (ell : ℝ) ^ k * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k y)
      ∧ bondEnergy Bt ≤ ∑ b : Bond Lu, ‖GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam) Bt b‖ ^ 2)
    (Et : ℝ) (hEt : (8 * ((17 / Real.sqrt 2) * 12 * (ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)) / (1 - ε1) + 4 * (c2 / c1)) / cw ≤ Et)
    (hg0 : 0 ≤ gam1 (4 * cUc / c1) a (ε2s / cw) εJ ε1 Et 0 1) :
    ∀ Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo, OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt → OnLambdaT Lam Bt →
      gam1 (4 * cUc / c1) a (ε2s / cw) εJ ε1 Et 0 1 * bondEnergy Bt
        ≤ GenP.genForm (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam)
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S V a Lam) Bt))

DepthUniformity.Fitted.sublatticePlaqBou.header:
theorem sublatticePlaqBound_tower
    (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (C0 alpha0 c2' : ℝ)
    (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hα0 : 0 < alpha0)
    (hC0α0 : 4 * C0 * alpha0 * (ell : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2 - 1)
    (hc2 : 2 * alpha0 ≤ c2') (k : ℕ)
    (hdepth : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ k ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (hProp1 : ScaleFittedPropagation (L := L) ell C0 c2')
    (hFine : SublatticePlaqBound 1 U (alpha0 * etaSq ell k)) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k →
      SublatticePlaqBound (ell ^ j) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U j)
        (betaRec ell C0 alpha0 k j)

DepthUniformity.Fitted.sublatticePlaqBou.name: DepthUniformity.Fitted.sublatticePlaqBound_tower_uniform
DepthUniformity.Fitted.sublatticePlaqBou.header:
theorem sublatticePlaqBound_tower_uniform
    (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (C0 alpha0 c2' : ℝ)
    (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hα0 : 0 < alpha0)
    (hC0α0 : 4 * C0 * alpha0 * (ell : ℝ)^2 ≤ (ell : ℝ)^2 - 1)
    (hc2 : 2 * alpha0 ≤ c2')
    (hdepth : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ^ k ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (hProp1 : ScaleFittedPropagation (L := L) ell C0 c2')
    (hFine : ∀ y μ ν,
      frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS 1 U y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ alpha0 * etaSq ell k)
    (j : ℕ) (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    SublatticePlaqBound (ell ^ j) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U j) (2 * alpha0) ∧
    SublatticePlaqBound (ell ^ j) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U j)
      (2 * (alpha0 * ((ell : ℝ)^2)^j * etaSq ell k)) ∧
    (j < k → ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ j) →
      ∀ μ ν : Fin 3,
        frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS (ell ^ j) (ubarTowerSU2 ell U j) y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1)
          < alpha0)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.schur_flo.header:
theorem schur_floor_on_printed_carrier {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hthr : frobSupBond U ≤ 1 / (186 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs (BondFnL2 L)) (a : ℝ) (Kop : Hs →L[ℝ] Hs)
    (hs : IsAQuadSplit D a Kop) (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (sigsq : ℝ) (hsig : 0 < sigsq)
    (hKcurl : ∀ A : Hs, ‖d A‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ A (Kop A) : ℝ))
    (hcontract : ∀ A : Hs, curlForm U (D.Q A) ≤ sigsq * ‖d A‖ ^ 2)
    (w : TildeFn L ell) :
    ((1 / sigsq) * gammaBrick ell) * ‖w‖ ^ 2
      ≤ deltaKQuadForm D a (cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.schur_flo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.schur_floor_on_printed_carrier_of_chain
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.schur_flo.header:
theorem schur_floor_on_printed_carrier_of_chain {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hthr : frobSupBond U ≤ 1 / (186 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs (BondFnL2 L)) (a : ℝ) (Kop : Hs →L[ℝ] Hs)
    (hs : IsAQuadSplit D a Kop) (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (d₁ : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] P₂) (S : P₁ →L[ℝ] P₂)
    (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hchain : ∀ A : Hs, d₁ (D.Q A) = S (d A)) (hS : ∀ f : P₁, ‖S f‖ ≤ σ * ‖f‖)
    (hKcurl : ∀ A : Hs, ‖d A‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ A (Kop A) : ℝ))
    (hcurlEq : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, curlForm U x = ‖d₁ x‖ ^ 2)
    (w : TildeFn L ell) :
    ((1 / σ ^ 2) * gammaBrick ell) * ‖w‖ ^ 2
      ≤ deltaKQuadForm D a (cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.reading_b.header:

    ∧ (∀ A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), (0 : ℝ) ≤ inner ℝ A (wKop A))
    ∧ (∀ A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), sQ A = 0 → (2 : ℝ) * ‖A‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ A (wKop A))
    ∧ (∀ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ →
        ¬ (∀ A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), γ * ‖sQ A‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ A (wKop A) : ℝ)))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.sQ_kernel.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.sQ_kernel_nontrivial
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.sQ_kernel.header: theorem sQ_kernel_nontrivial : sQ wA1 = 0 ∧ wA1 ≠ (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.sQ2_norm_.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.sQ2_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.sQ2_norm_.header:
theorem sQ2_norm_sq (A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    ‖sQ2 A‖ ^ 2 = (ofLp A 0 + ofLp A 1) ^ 2 + (2 * ofLp A 2) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.contracti.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.contraction_needs_hQ
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.contracti.header:
theorem contraction_needs_hQ :
    (∀ A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), (1 : ℝ) * ‖A‖ ^ 2
        ≤ (inner ℝ A ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))) A) : ℝ))
    ∧ ¬ (∀ A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), (1 : ℝ) * ‖sQ2 A‖ ^ 2
        ≤ (inner ℝ A ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))) A) : ℝ))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.contracti.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.contraction_transfers_fine_floor_fires
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.contracti.header:
theorem contraction_transfers_fine_floor_fires (A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :
    (1 : ℝ) * ‖sQ A‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ A ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))) A) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.gamma_flo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.gamma_floor_of_interp_and_weakPoincare
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.gamma_flo.header:
theorem gamma_floor_of_interp_and_weakPoincare {W : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup W]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ W] (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks) (a γc γP : ℝ) (Kop : Hs →L[ℝ] Hs)
    (hs : IsAQuadSplit D a Kop) (C₀ : W →ₗ[ℝ] Ks) (E : Ks → ℝ) (hγc : 0 ≤ γc)
    (hinterp : ∀ w : W,
      γc * E (C₀ w) ≤ (inner ℝ (solutionOperator D (C₀ w)) (Kop (solutionOperator D (C₀ w))) : ℝ))
    (hpoin : ∀ w : W, γP * ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤ E (C₀ w)) (w : W) :
    (γc * γP) * ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤ deltaKQuadForm D a (C₀ w)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.interp_of.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.interp_of_energy_contraction
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.interp_of.header:
theorem interp_of_energy_contraction (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks) (Kop : Hs →L[ℝ] Hs)
    (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (E : Ks → ℝ) (sigsq : ℝ) (hsig : 0 < sigsq)
    (hcontract : ∀ A : Hs, E (D.Q A) ≤ sigsq * ‖d A‖ ^ 2)
    (hKcurl : ∀ A : Hs, ‖d A‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ A (Kop A) : ℝ)) (B : Ks) :
    (1 / sigsq) * E B
      ≤ (inner ℝ (solutionOperator D B) (Kop (solutionOperator D B)) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.energy_co.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.energy_contraction_of_chain
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.energy_co.header:
theorem energy_contraction_of_chain (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks) (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁)
    (d₁ : Ks →L[ℝ] P₂) (S : P₁ →L[ℝ] P₂) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hchain : ∀ A : Hs, d₁ (D.Q A) = S (d A)) (hS : ∀ f : P₁, ‖S f‖ ≤ σ * ‖f‖) (A : Hs) :
    ‖d₁ (D.Q A)‖ ^ 2 ≤ σ ^ 2 * ‖d A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.weakPoinc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.weakPoincare_composition_instantiated
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SchurFloor.weakPoinc.header:
theorem weakPoincare_composition_instantiated (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :
    ((4 : ℝ) * 1) * ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤ deltaKQuadForm wData 1 (wC0 w)

HConstruction.SectBP1.covGrad.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.covGrad
HConstruction.SectBP1.covGrad.header: def covGrad (U : Links M (n := n)) : Site M (n := n) →L[ℝ] Fine M (n := n)

HConstruction.SectBP1.covGrad_apply.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.covGrad_apply
HConstruction.SectBP1.covGrad_apply.header:
theorem covGrad_apply (U : Links M (n := n)) (f : Site M (n := n))
    (b : Bond (fineExtent M n)) :
    bfl2Equiv (covGrad M U f) b = (n:ℝ) •
      (RMap (U b) (f (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)) - f b.1)

HConstruction.SectBP1.covGrad_trivialU.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.covGrad_trivialU
HConstruction.SectBP1.covGrad_trivialU.header: theorem covGrad_trivialU : covGrad M (trivialU (fineExtent M n)) = grad M

HConstruction.SectBP1.covQPrime.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.covQPrime
HConstruction.SectBP1.covQPrime.header: def covQPrime (U : Links M (n := n)) : Site M (n := n) →L[ℝ] CoarseSites M n

HConstruction.SectBP1.covQPrime_apply.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.covQPrime_apply
HConstruction.SectBP1.covQPrime_apply.header:
theorem covQPrime_apply (U : Links M (n := n)) (f : Site M (n := n))
    (y : Centers M (n := n)) :
    covQPrime M U f y = coarseRestrictSiteCovariantU U n (fun x => f x) y.1

HConstruction.SectBP1.covQPrime_trivialU.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.covQPrime_trivialU
HConstruction.SectBP1.covQPrime_trivialU.header: theorem covQPrime_trivialU : covQPrime M (trivialU (fineExtent M n)) = flatQPrime M

HConstruction.SectBP1.covDeltaPrime.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.covDeltaPrime
HConstruction.SectBP1.covDeltaPrime.header:
def covDeltaPrime (U : Links M (n := n)) (k : ℕ) :
    Site M (n := n) →L[ℝ] Site M (n := n)

HConstruction.SectBP1.covDeltaPrime_triv.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.covDeltaPrime_trivialU
HConstruction.SectBP1.covDeltaPrime_triv.header:
theorem covDeltaPrime_trivialU (k : ℕ) :
    covDeltaPrime M (trivialU (fineExtent M n)) k = flatDeltaPrime M k

HConstruction.SectBP1.covDeltaPrime_form.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.covDeltaPrime_form
HConstruction.SectBP1.covDeltaPrime_form.header:
theorem covDeltaPrime_form (U : Links M (n := n)) (k : ℕ) (f : Site M (n := n)) :
    (inner ℝ f (covDeltaPrime M U k f) : ℝ) =
      ‖covGrad M U f‖^2 + (topWeight k*(n:ℝ)^3)*‖covQPrime M U f‖^2

HConstruction.SectBBase.flatQPrime.name: HConstruction.SectBBase.flatQPrime
HConstruction.SectBBase.flatQPrime.header: def flatQPrime : GenK.Site M (n := n) →L[ℝ] CoarseSites M n

HConstruction.SectBBase.flatQPrime_apply.name: HConstruction.SectBBase.flatQPrime_apply
HConstruction.SectBBase.flatQPrime_apply.header:
lemma flatQPrime_apply (f : GenK.Site M (n := n)) (y : GenK.Centers M (n := n)) :
    flatQPrime M f y = GenK.siteAverage M f y

HConstruction.SectBBase.weightIter.name: HConstruction.SectBBase.weightIter
HConstruction.SectBBase.weightIter.header:
def weightIter : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 1
  | j + 1 => weightIter j / (1/4 + weightIter j)

def topWeight (k : ℕ) : ℝ

HConstruction.SectBBase.topWeight_next.name: HConstruction.SectBBase.topWeight_next
HConstruction.SectBBase.topWeight_next.header:
theorem topWeight_next (k : ℕ) :
    topWeight (k + 2) = topWeight (k + 1) / (1/4 + topWeight (k + 1))

HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime.name: HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime
HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime.header: def flatDeltaPrime (k : ℕ) : GenK.Site M (n := n) →L[ℝ] GenK.Site M (n := n)

HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime_f.name: HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime_form
HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime_f.header:
theorem flatDeltaPrime_form (k : ℕ) (f : GenK.Site M (n := n)) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (1/(n:ℝ)^3) * (inner ℝ f (flatDeltaPrime M k f) : ℝ) =
      (1/(n:ℝ)^3) * ‖GenK.grad M f‖^2 + topWeight k * ‖flatQPrime M f‖^2

HConstruction.SectBBase.flatQPrime_block.name: HConstruction.SectBBase.flatQPrime_block
HConstruction.SectBBase.flatQPrime_block.header:
theorem flatQPrime_block (f : GenK.Site M (n := n)) (y : GenK.Centers M (n := n)) :
    flatQPrime M f y = (1 / (n:ℝ)^3) •
      ∑ x ∈ AdalyFormal.Balaban.AdmissibleSubspace.blockOf y.1 n, f x

HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime_k.name: HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime_kernel
HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime_k.header:
theorem flatDeltaPrime_kernel (k : ℕ) (f : GenK.Site M (n := n)) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hf : flatDeltaPrime M k f = 0) : f = 0

HConstruction.SectBAstra.vector_graph_bo.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.vector_graph_bound
HConstruction.SectBAstra.vector_graph_bo.header:
theorem vector_graph_bound {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ+1) (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ∑ x, ‖f x‖^2 ≤ 3*(n:ℝ)^2 *
      ∑ b : Bond L, ‖f (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - f b.1‖^2 +
      2*(n:ℝ)^3 * ∑ y ∈ CoarseLattice L n,
        ‖(1/(n:ℝ)^3) • ∑ x ∈ blockOf y n, f x‖^2

HConstruction.SectBAstra.site_graph_boun.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.site_graph_bound
HConstruction.SectBAstra.site_graph_boun.header:
theorem site_graph_bound (f : Site M (n := n)) :
    ‖f‖^2 ≤ 3 * ‖grad M f‖^2 + 2*(n:ℝ)^3 * ‖flatQPrime M f‖^2

HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatDeltaPrime_.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatDeltaPrime_coercive
HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatDeltaPrime_.header:
theorem flatDeltaPrime_coercive (k : ℕ) (f : Site M (n := n)) :
    (1/3:ℝ)*‖f‖^2 ≤ (inner ℝ f (flatDeltaPrime M k f) : ℝ)

HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatDeltaPrime_.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatDeltaPrime_physical_coercive
HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatDeltaPrime_.header:
theorem flatDeltaPrime_physical_coercive (k : ℕ) (f : Site M (n := n)) :
    (1/3:ℝ) * ((1/(n:ℝ)^3)*‖f‖^2) ≤
      (1/(n:ℝ)^3)*‖grad M f‖^2 + topWeight k*‖flatQPrime M f‖^2

HConstruction.SectBP1.qDrift.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.qDrift
HConstruction.SectBP1.qDrift.header: def qDrift (U : Links M (n := n)) : Site M (n := n) →L[ℝ] CoarseSites M n

HConstruction.SectBP1.gradientDrift.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.gradientDrift
HConstruction.SectBP1.gradientDrift.header: def gradientDrift (U : Links M (n := n)) : Site M (n := n) →L[ℝ] Fine M (n := n)

HConstruction.SectBP1.perturbation.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.perturbation
HConstruction.SectBP1.perturbation.header:
def perturbation (U : Links M (n := n)) (k : ℕ) :
    Site M (n := n) →L[ℝ] Site M (n := n)

HConstruction.SectBP1.qPerturbation_exac.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.qPerturbation_exact
HConstruction.SectBP1.qPerturbation_exac.header:
theorem qPerturbation_exact (U : Links M (n := n)) :
    ((flatQPrime M).adjoint.comp (flatQPrime M) -
      (covQPrime M U).adjoint.comp (covQPrime M U)) =
      - ((qDrift M U).adjoint.comp (flatQPrime M) +
        (flatQPrime M).adjoint.comp (qDrift M U) +
        (qDrift M U).adjoint.comp (qDrift M U))

HConstruction.SectBP1.gradientPerturbati.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.gradientPerturbation_exact
HConstruction.SectBP1.gradientPerturbati.header:
theorem gradientPerturbation_exact (U : Links M (n := n)) :
    siteDelta M - (covGrad M U).adjoint.comp (covGrad M U) =
      - ((grad M).adjoint.comp (gradientDrift M U) +
        (gradientDrift M U).adjoint.comp (grad M) +
        (gradientDrift M U).adjoint.comp (gradientDrift M U))

HConstruction.SectBP1.perturbation_exact.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.perturbation_exact
HConstruction.SectBP1.perturbation_exact.header:
theorem perturbation_exact (U : Links M (n := n)) (k : ℕ) :
    perturbation M U k =
      (siteDelta M - (covGrad M U).adjoint.comp (covGrad M U)) -
      (topWeight k*(n:ℝ)^3) •
        ((qDrift M U).adjoint.comp (flatQPrime M) +
          (flatQPrime M).adjoint.comp (qDrift M U) +
          (qDrift M U).adjoint.comp (qDrift M U))

HConstruction.SectBP1.factorization.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.factorization
HConstruction.SectBP1.factorization.header:
theorem factorization (U : Links M (n := n)) (k : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    covDeltaPrime M U k =
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _ - (perturbation M U k).comp (flatGPrime M hn k)).comp
        (flatDeltaPrime M k)

HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime_i.name: HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime_injective
HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime_i.header:
theorem flatDeltaPrime_injective (k : ℕ) : Function.Injective
    (flatDeltaPrime M (n := n) k)

HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime_s.name: HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime_surjective
HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime_s.header:
theorem flatDeltaPrime_surjective (k : ℕ) : Function.Surjective
    (flatDeltaPrime M (n := n) k)

HConstruction.SectBBase.flatGPrime.name: HConstruction.SectBBase.flatGPrime
HConstruction.SectBBase.flatGPrime.header: def flatGPrime (k : ℕ) : GenK.Site M (n := n) →L[ℝ] GenK.Site M (n := n)

HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime_f.name: HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime_flatGPrime
HConstruction.SectBBase.flatDeltaPrime_f.header:
theorem flatDeltaPrime_flatGPrime (k : ℕ) (f : GenK.Site M (n := n)) :
    flatDeltaPrime M k (flatGPrime M hn k f) = f

HConstruction.SectBBase.flatGPrime_flatD.name: HConstruction.SectBBase.flatGPrime_flatDeltaPrime
HConstruction.SectBBase.flatGPrime_flatD.header:
theorem flatGPrime_flatDeltaPrime (k : ℕ) (f : GenK.Site M (n := n)) :
    flatGPrime M hn k (flatDeltaPrime M k f) = f

HConstruction.SectBAstra.cube_with_mean.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.cube_with_mean
HConstruction.SectBAstra.cube_with_mean.header:
theorem cube_with_mean (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (f : Cube n → ℝ) :
    cSumSq n f ≤ 3 * (n:ℝ)^2 * (cE0 n f + cE1 n f + cE2 n f) +
      2 * (n:ℝ)^3 * ((1/(n:ℝ)^3) * ∑ p, f p)^2

HConstruction.SectBAstra.scalar_graph_bo.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.scalar_graph_bound
HConstruction.SectBAstra.scalar_graph_bo.header:
theorem scalar_graph_bound {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ+1) (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) :
    ∑ x, (f x)^2 ≤ 3*(n:ℝ)^2 *
      ∑ b : Bond L, (AdalyFormal.Balaban.LatticeOperators.gradValue f b)^2 +
      2*(n:ℝ)^3 * ∑ y ∈ CoarseLattice L n,
        ((1/(n:ℝ)^3) * ∑ x ∈ blockOf y n, f x)^2

HConstruction.SectBAstra.weightIter_boun.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.weightIter_bounds
HConstruction.SectBAstra.weightIter_boun.header: theorem weightIter_bounds (j : ℕ) : (3/4:ℝ) ≤ weightIter j ∧ weightIter j ≤ 1

HConstruction.SectBAstra.topWeight_bound.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.topWeight_bounds
HConstruction.SectBAstra.topWeight_bound.header: theorem topWeight_bounds (k : ℕ) : (3/4:ℝ) ≤ topWeight k ∧ topWeight k ≤ 1

HConstruction.SectBP1.covDeltaPrime_floo.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.covDeltaPrime_floor
HConstruction.SectBP1.covDeltaPrime_floo.header:
theorem covDeltaPrime_floor (U : Links M (n := n)) (k : ℕ) (α : ℝ)
    (hsmall : frobSupBond U ≤ α/(n:ℝ)) (f : Site M (n := n)) :
    ((1/6:ℝ)-48*α^2)*‖f‖^2 ≤ (inner ℝ f (covDeltaPrime M U k f) : ℝ)

HConstruction.SectBP1.path_action_drift.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.path_action_drift
HConstruction.SectBP1.path_action_drift.header:
theorem path_action_drift (U : Links M (n := n)) (δ : ℝ)
    (hlink : ∀ b : Bond (fineExtent M n),
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ δ)
    (bs : List (Bond (fineExtent M n))) (X : SuTwo) :
    ‖RMap (pathTransport U bs) X - X‖ ≤ 2*δ*(bs.length:ℝ)*‖X‖

HConstruction.SectBP1.staircase_action_d.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.staircase_action_drift
HConstruction.SectBP1.staircase_action_d.header:
theorem staircase_action_drift (hn : 0 < n) (U : Links M (n := n))
    (α : ℝ) (hsmall : frobSupBond U ≤ α/(n:ℝ))
    (y : Centers M (n := n)) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (fineExtent M n))
    (hx : x ∈ blockOf y.1 n) (X : SuTwo) :
    ‖RMap (staircaseTransport U y.1 x) X-X‖ ≤ 6*α*‖X‖

HConstruction.SectBP1.qDrift_block_small.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.qDrift_block_small
HConstruction.SectBP1.qDrift_block_small.header:
theorem qDrift_block_small (hn : 0 < n) (U : Links M (n := n))
    (α : ℝ) (hsmall : frobSupBond U ≤ α/(n:ℝ))
    (y : Centers M (n := n)) (f : Site M (n := n)) :
    ‖qDrift M U f y‖ ≤
      (1/(n:ℝ)^3) * (∑ x ∈ blockOf y.1 n, 6*α*‖f x‖)

HConstruction.SectBP1.gradientDrift_bond.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.gradientDrift_bond
HConstruction.SectBP1.gradientDrift_bond.header:
theorem gradientDrift_bond (U : Links M (n := n)) (α : ℝ)
    (hsmall : frobSupBond U ≤ α / (n:ℝ)) (f : Site M (n := n))
    (b : Bond (fineExtent M n)) :
    ‖bfl2Equiv (gradientDrift M U f) b‖ ≤
      2*α*‖f (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2)‖

HConstruction.SectBP1.gradientDrift_sq.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.gradientDrift_sq
HConstruction.SectBP1.gradientDrift_sq.header:
theorem gradientDrift_sq (U : Links M (n := n)) (α : ℝ)
    (hsmall : frobSupBond U ≤ α / (n:ℝ)) (f : Site M (n := n)) :
    ‖gradientDrift M U f‖^2 ≤ 12*α^2*‖f‖^2

HConstruction.SectBP1.qDrift_block_sq.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.qDrift_block_sq
HConstruction.SectBP1.qDrift_block_sq.header:
theorem qDrift_block_sq (U : Links M (n := n)) (α : ℝ)
    (hsmall : frobSupBond U ≤ α/(n:ℝ)) (f : Site M (n := n))
    (y : Centers M (n := n)) :
    ‖qDrift M U f y‖^2 ≤ 36*α^2*(1/(n:ℝ)^3)*
      ∑ x ∈ blockOf y.1 n, ‖f x‖^2

HConstruction.SectBP1.qDrift_sq.name: HConstruction.SectBP1.qDrift_sq
HConstruction.SectBP1.qDrift_sq.header:
theorem qDrift_sq (U : Links M (n := n)) (α : ℝ)
    (hsmall : frobSupBond U ≤ α/(n:ℝ)) (f : Site M (n := n)) :
    ‖qDrift M U f‖^2 ≤ 36*α^2*(1/(n:ℝ)^3)*‖f‖^2

HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_boun.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_bound
HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_boun.header:
theorem flatGPrime_bound (k : ℕ) (f : Site M (n := n)) :
    ‖flatGPrime M hn k f‖ ≤ 3*‖f‖

HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_opNo.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_opNorm
HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_opNo.header: theorem flatGPrime_opNorm (k : ℕ) : ‖flatGPrime M hn k‖ ≤ 3

HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_grad.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_gradient_sq
HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_grad.header:
theorem flatGPrime_gradient_sq (k : ℕ) (f : Site M (n := n)) :
    ‖grad M (flatGPrime M hn k f)‖^2 ≤ 3*‖f‖^2

HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_grad.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_gradient_opNorm
HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_grad.header:
theorem flatGPrime_gradient_opNorm (k : ℕ) :
    ‖(grad M).comp (flatGPrime M hn k)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 3

HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_dive.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_divergence_estimates
HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_dive.header:
theorem flatGPrime_divergence_estimates (k : ℕ) (A : Fine M (n := n)) :
    ‖flatGPrime M hn k ((grad M).adjoint A)‖^2 ≤ 3*‖A‖^2 ∧
    ‖grad M (flatGPrime M hn k ((grad M).adjoint A))‖ ≤ ‖A‖

HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_dive.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_divergence_opNorm
HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_dive.header:
theorem flatGPrime_divergence_opNorm (k : ℕ) :
    ‖(flatGPrime M hn k).comp (grad M).adjoint‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 3

HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_grad.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_gradient_divergence_opNorm
HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_grad.header:
theorem flatGPrime_gradient_divergence_opNorm (k : ℕ) :
    ‖(grad M).comp ((flatGPrime M hn k).comp (grad M).adjoint)‖ ≤ 1

HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_phys.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_physical_bounds
HConstruction.SectBAstra.flatGPrime_phys.header:
theorem flatGPrime_physical_bounds (k : ℕ) (f : Site M (n := n)) :
    (1/(n:ℝ)^3)*‖flatGPrime M hn k f‖^2 ≤ 9*((1/(n:ℝ)^3)*‖f‖^2) ∧
    (1/(n:ℝ)^3)*‖grad M (flatGPrime M hn k f)‖^2 ≤
      3*((1/(n:ℝ)^3)*‖f‖^2)

HConstruction.SectBAstra.flat_base_every.name: HConstruction.SectBAstra.flat_base_every_depth

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SmoothLog.fderiv_fde.header:

    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (Φ ∘ g)) x h k =

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SmoothLog.fderiv_fde.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SmoothLog.fderiv_fderiv_su2Log_comp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SmoothLog.fderiv_fde.header:
theorem fderiv_fderiv_su2Log_comp (G : E → SU2)
    (hG : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun A => (G A : M2)) 0) (hG0 : G 0 = 1) (h k : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun A => su2Log (G A))) 0 h k =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun A => (G A : M2))) 0 h k
        - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (fderiv ℝ (fun A => (G A : M2)) 0 h * fderiv ℝ (fun A => (G A : M2)) 0 k
            + fderiv ℝ (fun A => (G A : M2)) 0 k * fderiv ℝ (fun A => (G A : M2)) 0 h)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SmoothLog.iteratedFD.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SmoothLog.iteratedFDeriv_two_su2Log_comp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SmoothLog.iteratedFD.header:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_two_su2Log_comp (G : E → SU2)

    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (fun A => su2Log (G A)) 0 ![h, k] =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (fun A => (G A : M2)) 0 ![h, k]
        - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (fderiv ℝ (fun A => (G A : M2)) 0 h * fderiv ℝ (fun A => (G A : M2)) 0 k

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SmoothLog.fderiv_fde.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SmoothLog.fderiv_fderiv_su2Log_comp_diag
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SmoothLog.fderiv_fde.header:
theorem fderiv_fderiv_su2Log_comp_diag (G : E → SU2)

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.so_vals.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.so_vals
AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.so_vals.header:
theorem so_vals {ell M R c : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hrel : SoRel ell c) (hc : 10 ≤ c) :
    neA' ell M R = ell * (ell * (R * M)) + ell * (ell * M) ∧
    neB' ell M R = ell * (ell * (R * M)) + ell * (ell * M) + 2 * ((c - 1) * (ell * M)) ∧
    neA ell M R = ell * (ell * (R * M)) + 2 * (ell * (ell * M)) + 2 * ((c - 1) * (ell * M)) ∧
    neB ell M R = 3 * (ell * (ell * (R * M))) + 5 * (ell * (ell * M)) + 2 * ((c - 1) * (ell * M)) ∧
    neP1 ell M R + ell * (R * M) = ell * (ell * (R * M)) + ell * (ell * M) ∧
    neP0 ell M R + R * M = neP1 ell M R ∧
    neQ1 ell M R = neB ell M R + ell * (R * M) ∧ neQ0 ell M R = neQ1 ell M R + R * M ∧
    neN ell M R = 4 * (ell * (ell * (R * M))) + 8 * (ell * (ell * M)) + 4 * ((c - 1) * (ell * M))

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.so_order.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.so_order
AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.so_order.header:
theorem so_order {ell M R c : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hrel : SoRel ell c) (hc : 10 ≤ c) :
    neP0 ell M R < neP1 ell M R ∧ neP1 ell M R < neA' ell M R ∧ neA' ell M R < neB' ell M R ∧ neB' ell M R < neA ell M R ∧
      neA ell M R < neB ell M R ∧ neB ell M R < neQ1 ell M R ∧ neQ1 ell M R < neQ0 ell M R ∧ neQ0 ell M R < neN ell M R

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.bc_disj.header:

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.mkCube.header:
theorem mkCube {ell M R c : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hrel : SoRel ell c) (hc : 10 ≤ c) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ 2)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) (s : ℕ)
    (hs : bigSide M ell j ∣ s) (hsx : s ≤ (x 0).val ∧ (x 0).val < s + c * bigSide M ell j)
    (hsN : s + c * bigSide M ell j ≤ neN ell M R)
    (hsub : ∀ w, s ≤ w → w < s + c * bigSide M ell j → Bc ell M R j w ∨ Bc ell M R (j + 1) w)
    (hmeet : ∃ w, s ≤ w ∧ w < s + c * bigSide M ell j ∧ Bc ell M R j w) :
    ∃ sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))),
      IsClassCube ell M c 2 (neS ell M R) sites j ∧ x ∈ sites

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.cov_arith.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.cov_arith
AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.cov_arith.header:
theorem cov_arith {ell M R c : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M) (hc : 10 ≤ c) (hRc : c ≤ R) :

      c * M ≤ R * M ∧ c * (ell * M) ≤ ell * (R * M) ∧ c * (ell * (ell * M)) ≤ ell * (ell * (R * M))

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.G1inv_zfield0.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.G1inv_zfield0
AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.G1inv_zfield0.header:
theorem G1inv_zfield0 (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ)
    (hf : (zfield (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) ∈ bondSupp (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R))) :
    (((Pt ell M R (by omega) (C) t a).G1inv ⟨zfield (fe (neP0 ell M R) e), hf⟩ :
        ↥(bondSupp (Pt ell M R (by omega) (C) t a).G)) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R))) =
      zfield (ginvProf0 ell (isRowN ell M R) (fun v => neP0 ell M R ≤ v ∧ v < neQ0 ell M R) (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R) 0)
        (C) t a (fe (neP0 ell M R) e))

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.inner_G1inv_zfield.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.inner_G1inv_zfield0
AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.inner_G1inv_zfield.header:
theorem inner_G1inv_zfield0 (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ (xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e)
        ((Pt ell M R (by omega) (C) t a).G1inv (xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e)) : ℝ) =
      c0 * ((((scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) 1 + 1) * ((scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) 2 + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        qF1 (C - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos (2 * t)) e +
      (inner ℝ (zfield (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))
        (zfield (CoverOmega.Wt ell (isRowN ell M R) (fun j u => a * fSum ell j (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) u))) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.tvec_mem_Vsub_L.header:

    {i0 : ℕ} (hi0 : i0 + 1 < R) (hst : st i0 + L = s + 5) (hl0 : ln i0 = L) (hl1 : ln (i0 + 1) = L) :

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.layer_isRow_so.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.layer_isRow_so
AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.layer_isRow_so.header:
theorem layer_isRow_so {c : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hrel : SoRel ell c) (hc : 10 ≤ c) :
    isRowN ell M R 2 (soC ell M R c + 1) ∧ isRowN ell M R 2 (soC ell M R c + 1 - ell ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.layer_rows_so.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.layer_rows_so
AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.layer_rows_so.header:
theorem layer_rows_so {c : ℕ} (hg : NGeo ell M R) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hrel : SoRel ell c) (hc : 10 ≤ c) :
    ∃ i0, i0 + 1 < RN hg ∧ neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R i0 = soC ell M R c + 1 - ell ^ 2 ∧ lnN ell M R i0 = ell ^ 2 ∧
      lnN ell M R (i0 + 1) = ell ^ 2

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.window_rows_so.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.window_rows_so
AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.window_rows_so.header:
theorem window_rows_so (hg : NGeo ell M R) (hell3 : 3 ≤ ell) (hMe : ell ≤ M) :
    ∃ i1, R * M ≤ i1 ∧ i1 + 3 + R * M < RN hg ∧ (∀ k, k ≤ 3 → lnN ell M R (i1 + k) = ell ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ k, k ≤ 3 → neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R (i1 + k) = ell ^ 2 * (u0N M R + (ell - 3) + k))

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.soC_bounds.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.soC_bounds
AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.soC_bounds.header:
theorem soC_bounds {c : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hrel : SoRel ell c) (hc : 10 ≤ c) :
    neP0 ell M R + ell ^ 2 ≤ soC ell M R c + 1 ∧ neP0 ell M R + 4 ≤ soC ell M R c ∧ soC ell M R c + 10 ≤ neQ0 ell M R ∧
      soC ell M R c + 1 < neB' ell M R

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.f0pair.header: noncomputable def f0pair (hg : NGeo ell M R) (i1 p : ℕ) (hp : i1 + p + 1 < RN hg) : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.BF1_f0pair.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.BF1_f0pair
AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.BF1_f0pair.header:
theorem BF1_f0pair (hg : NGeo ell M R) (Cc : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (es : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ) {i1 p : ℕ} (hp : i1 + p + 1 < RN hg) :
    BF1 Cc c es (f0pair hg i1 p hp) = rowMu1 Cc c es (stN ell M R) (i1 + p) - rowMu1 Cc c es (stN ell M R) (i1 + p + 1)

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.chain_instance_S.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.chain_instance_S
AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.chain_instance_S.header:
theorem chain_instance_S {c : ℕ} (hell3 : 3 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hrel : SoRel ell c) (hc : 10 ≤ c) :
    ∃ cs : ℝ, -4 / 5 < cs ∧ cs < 0 ∧
      (∀ e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ, e ∈ Vsub (rowOfN ell M R) → 0 ≤ qF1 (soC ell M R c - neP0 ell M R) cs e) ∧
      (∀ c' : ℝ, cs < c' → c' ≤ 1 → ∀ e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ, e ∈ Vsub (rowOfN ell M R) → e ≠ 0 →
        0 < qF1 (soC ell M R c - neP0 ell M R) c' e) ∧
      ∃ es : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ, es ∈ Vsub (rowOfN ell M R) ∧ es ≠ 0 ∧ qF1 (soC ell M R c - neP0 ell M R) cs es = 0 ∧
        ∃ i1 p : ℕ, (p = 0 ∨ p = 2) ∧ R * M ≤ i1 ∧ i1 + 3 + R * M < RN (nGeo_two (by omega : 2 ≤ ell) hdvd hM hR) ∧
          (∀ k, k ≤ 3 → lnN ell M R (i1 + k) = ell ^ 2) ∧
          (∀ k, k ≤ 3 → neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R (i1 + k) = ell ^ 2 * (u0N M R + (ell - 3) + k)) ∧
          ∃ hp : i1 + p + 1 < RN (nGeo_two (by omega : 2 ≤ ell) hdvd hM hR),
            BF1 (soC ell M R c - neP0 ell M R) cs es (f0pair (nGeo_two (by omega : 2 ≤ ell) hdvd hM hR) i1 p hp) ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.wz_chain.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.wz_chain
AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.wz_chain.header:
theorem wz_chain (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.G1inv_zfield_gen.header:

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.G1inv_mem_WZ.header:

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.Qs_mem_WZ.header:
theorem Qs_mem_WZ (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.Q_mem_ZF.header:

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.Kz_eq.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.Kz_eq
AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.Kz_eq.header:
theorem Kz_eq (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2) (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ (zfield (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)))
        (zfield (CoverOmega.Wt ell (isRowN ell M R) (fun j u => a * fSum ell j (fe (neP0 ell M R) e) u))) : ℝ) =
      (inner ℝ ((Pt ell M R (by omega) (C) t a).data.Q (xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e))
        (diagW (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) (massW (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) a)
          ((Pt ell M R (by omega) (C) t a).data.Q (xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e))) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.zblock_ineq.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.zblock_ineq
AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.zblock_ineq.header:
theorem zblock_ineq (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2)
    (hG1 : IsUnit (Pt ell M R (by omega) (C) t a).G1inv)
    (hN : IsUnit (GenP.Nmat (Pt ell M R (by omega) (C) t a)))
    (hpsd : ∀ e' : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ, e' ∈ Vsub (rowOfN ell M R) → 0 ≤ qF1 (C - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos (2 * t)) e')
    (e : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ ((Pt ell M R (by omega) (C) t a).data.Q (xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e))
        (Ring.inverse (GenP.Nmat (Pt ell M R (by omega) (C) t a))
          ((Pt ell M R (by omega) (C) t a).data.Q (xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e))) : ℝ) ≤
      c0 * ((((scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) 1 + 1) * ((scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) 2 + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        qF1 (C - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos (2 * t)) e +
      (inner ℝ ((Pt ell M R (by omega) (C) t a).data.Q (xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e))
        (diagW (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) (massW (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) a)
          ((Pt ell M R (by omega) (C) t a).data.Q (xE (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) hell2 hM hR e))) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.so_thin_atoms.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.so_thin_atoms
AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.so_thin_atoms.header:

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.soC_succ.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.soC_succ

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.so_gap_atoms.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.so_gap_atoms

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.so_bond_uncovered.name: AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.so_bond_uncovered

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.val_split.header:
theorem val_split (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2)
    (hG1 : IsUnit (Pt ell M R (by omega) C t a).G1inv)
    (hN : IsUnit (GenP.Nmat (Pt ell M R (by omega) C t a)))
    (uE : ℕ) (huE : uE + 1 < neLu M R 0 + 1) (h1 : ell ∣ neLu M R 1 + 1) (h2 : ell ∣ neLu M R 2 + 1) :
    (inner ℝ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS ell M R)) (Bpat ell uE))
      (Ring.inverse (GenP.Nmat (Pt ell M R (by omega) C t a))
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS ell M R)) (Bpat ell uE))) : ℝ) =
    (inner ℝ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS ell M R)) (zfield (gbar ell uE)))
      (Ring.inverse (GenP.Nmat (Pt ell M R (by omega) C t a))
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS ell M R)) (zfield (gbar ell uE)))) : ℝ) +
    (inner ℝ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS ell M R)) (Bperp ell uE))
      (Ring.inverse (GenP.Nmat (Pt ell M R (by omega) C t a))
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS ell M R)) (Bperp ell uE))) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.val0_bound.header:
theorem val0_bound (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hE : 2 ∣ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (t a : ℝ) (ht : |t| < Real.pi / 2)
    (hG1 : IsUnit (Pt ell M R (by omega) C t a).G1inv)
    (hN : IsUnit (GenP.Nmat (Pt ell M R (by omega) C t a)))
    (hpsd : ∀ e' : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ, e' ∈ Vsub (rowOfN ell M R) → 0 ≤ qF1 (C - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos (2 * t)) e')
    {i1 p uE : ℕ} (hp : i1 + p + 1 < RN (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR))
    (hlnE : lnN ell M R (i1 + p) = ell ^ 2) (hlnO : lnN ell M R (i1 + p + 1) = ell ^ 2)
    (hsE : neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R (i1 + p) = ell ^ 2 * uE) (hsO : neP0 ell M R + stN ell M R (i1 + p + 1) = ell ^ 2 * (uE + 1))
    {es : Fin (nN ell M R) → ℝ} (hes : es ∈ Vsub (rowOfN ell M R)) (τ : ℝ) :
    (inner ℝ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS ell M R)) (zfield (gbar ell uE)))
      (Ring.inverse (GenP.Nmat (Pt ell M R (by omega) C t a))
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS ell M R)) (zfield (gbar ell uE)))) : ℝ) ≤
      c0 * ((((scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) 1 + 1) * ((scaleUp ell 2 (neLu M R)) 2 + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        qF1 (C - neP0 ell M R) (Real.cos (2 * t)) (f0pair (nGeo_two hell2 hdvd hM hR) i1 p hp + τ • es) +
      (inner ℝ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS ell M R)) (zfield (gbar ell uE)))
        (diagW (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) (massW (geomOf ell 2 (neS ell M R)) a)
          (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (tauExt ell 2 (neLu M R) (by omega) (neS ell M R)) (zfield (gbar ell uE)))) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.SitesOnly.main_neg_S.header:

HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.source_li.name: HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.source_lineIntegrals_flat
HConstruction.G0Final.Locality.source_li.header:
theorem source_lineIntegrals_flat (t : ℝ) (A : CoarseBond witnessL 1 → SuTwo)
    (c : Output) (x : Site) (hc : c ∉ exceptionalRows)
    (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1.1 1 2) :
    OneStep124.lineIntegral 1 (nonflatU t) A c.1.1 (coarseGammaPath 1 c.1.1 x) =
      OneStep124.lineIntegral 1 (fun _ => 1) A c.1.1 (coarseGammaPath 1 c.1.1 x) ∧
    OneStep124.lineIntegral 1 (nonflatU t) A x [c.2,c.2] =
      OneStep124.lineIntegral 1 (fun _ => 1) A x [c.2,c.2] ∧
    OneStep124.lineIntegral 1 (nonflatU t) A (OneStep124.cPlus c)
        (coarseGammaPath 1 (OneStep124.cPlus c) (OneStep124.partner c x)) =
      OneStep124.lineIntegral 1 (fun _ => 1) A (OneStep124.cPlus c)
        (coarseGammaPath 1 (OneStep124.cPlus c) (OneStep124.partner c x)) ∧
    OneStep124.lineIntegral 1 (nonflatU t) A c.1.1 [c.2,c.2] =
      OneStep124.lineIntegral 1 (fun _ => 1) A c.1.1 [c.2,c.2]

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SourceWired.wired_co.header:
theorem wired_coercive_uniform_in_U (D : BalabanCovarianceData H (BondFnL2 L)) (bc : BaseConstant)
    (Qext : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L)
    (Jof : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L → H)
    (Sof : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L →
      (BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L))
    (hS : ∀ U, IsSourceOperator D Qext (Jof U) (Sof U))
    (γ₁ c₂ R : ℝ) (hc₂ : 0 ≤ c₂)
    (hfloor : ∀ B : BondFnL2 L, γ₁ * ‖B‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ B (deltaKQuadOp D bc B) : ℝ))
    (hD2 : ∀ B : BondFnL2 L, ‖Dtilde2Shape Qext B‖ ≤ c₂ * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    (hR : ∀ U, ‖Jof U‖ ≤ R)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (B : BondFnL2 L) :
    (γ₁ - 2 * ‖solutionOperator D‖ * c₂ * R) * ‖B‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ B (printedDeltaKOp D bc (Sof U) B) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SourceWired.wired_po.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.SourceWired.wired_posDef_uniform_in_U
AdalyFormal.Balaban.SourceWired.wired_po.header:

    (Jof : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L → H)
    (Sof : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L →
      (BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L))
    (hS : ∀ U, IsSourceOperator D Qext (Jof U) (Sof U))
    (γ₁ c₂ R : ℝ) (hc₂ : 0 ≤ c₂)
    (hfloor : ∀ B : BondFnL2 L, γ₁ * ‖B‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ B (deltaKQuadOp D bc B) : ℝ))
    (hD2 : ∀ B : BondFnL2 L, ‖Dtilde2Shape Qext B‖ ≤ c₂ * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    (hR : ∀ U, ‖Jof U‖ ≤ R)
    (hthr : 2 * ‖solutionOperator D‖ * c₂ * R < γ₁)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (B : BondFnL2 L)
    (hB : B ≠ 0) :
    0 < (inner ℝ B (printedDeltaKOp D bc (Sof U) B) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.SourceWired.wired_po.header:
theorem wired_posDef_of_linkDev (D : BalabanCovarianceData H (BondFnL2 L)) (bc : BaseConstant)

    (Sof : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L →
      (BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L))
    (hS : ∀ U, IsSourceOperator D Qext (T (JsuTwo U)) (Sof U))
    (γ₁ c₂ δ : ℝ) (hc₂ : 0 ≤ c₂)
    (hfloor : ∀ B : BondFnL2 L, γ₁ * ‖B‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ B (deltaKQuadOp D bc B) : ℝ))
    (hD2 : ∀ B : BondFnL2 L, ‖Dtilde2Shape Qext B‖ ≤ c₂ * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    (hthr : 2 * ‖solutionOperator D‖ * c₂
      * (‖T‖ * (Real.sqrt (2 * (Fintype.card (Bond L))) * (495 * δ))) < γ₁)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hU : ∀ U' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L, LinkDev δ U')
    (B : BondFnL2 L) (hB : B ≠ 0) :
    0 < (inner ℝ B (printedDeltaKOp D bc (Sof U) B) : ℝ)

SolP409Review.cube5_rejects_patch_factor.header:
theorem cube5_rejects_patch_factor {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {N ell M A0 A B B0 : ℕ}
    (hN : ∀ μ, L μ + 1 = N) (hM : 2 ≤ M) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hA0 : A0 + 1 ≤ A) (hAB : A < B) (hBB0 : B ≤ B0) (hAN : A < N)
    (hN24 : 24 * (M * ell) ≤ N)
    (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hw0 : (w 0).val = A)
    (hw1 : (w 1).val = 0) (hw2 : (w 2).val = 0) :
    ¬ ∃ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (i : ℕ),
      IsClassSetW ell M (10 * ell + 1) 1 (TG A0 A B B0 L) sites i ∧
      {y | (∀ μ : Fin 3, pcd (L μ + 1) (w μ).val (y μ).val ≤ 6 * (M * ell) - 1) ∧
        y ∈ (TG A0 A B B0 L).Om 0} ⊆ sites

AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.sqrt_sum_sq_eq_no.header:
theorem sqrt_sum_sq_eq_norm {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]

theorem sqrt_sum_sq_add_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]

    Real.sqrt (∑ i, ‖f i + g i‖ ^ 2)
      ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ i, ‖f i‖ ^ 2) + Real.sqrt (∑ i, ‖g i‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.sqrt_sum_sq_sub_l.name: AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.sqrt_sum_sq_sub_le
AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.sqrt_sum_sq_sub_l.header:

AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.norm_four_term_sq.header:

AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.coarseCurl_energy.name: AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.coarseCurl_energy_le
AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.coarseCurl_energy.header:
theorem coarseCurl_energy_le {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) :
    (∑ P : CoarsePlaquette L ell, ‖coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd B P‖ ^ 2) ≤ 32 * coarseBondEnergy B

AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.coarseCurlSuTwo_s.name: AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.coarseCurlSuTwo_sub
AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.coarseCurlSuTwo_s.header:
theorem coarseCurlSuTwo_sub {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (B1 B2 : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (p : CoarsePlaquette L ell) :
    coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd (fun b => B1 b - B2 b) p
      = coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd B1 p - coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd B2 p

AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.coarseBondEnergy_.name: AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.coarseBondEnergy_drift_le
AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.coarseBondEnergy_.header:
theorem coarseBondEnergy_drift_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    coarseBondEnergy (fun b : CoarseBond L ell =>
        lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A b - lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell A b)
      ≤ (64 / (ell : ℝ)) * frobSupBond U ^ 2 * bondEnergy A

AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.hraw_lattice.name: AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.hraw_lattice
AdalyFormal.StokesHraw.hraw_lattice.header:
theorem hraw_lattice {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    Real.sqrt (∑ P : CoarsePlaquette L ell,
        ‖coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM U ell A) P‖ ^ 2)
      ≤ (1 / Real.sqrt (ell : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (plaqEnergy (curlValueCovariant U A))
        + (36 * Real.sqrt 2 / Real.sqrt (ell : ℝ)) * frobSupBond U * Real.sqrt (bondEnergy A)

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Lattice.window_s.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Lattice.window_sum_eq
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Lattice.window_s.header:
theorem window_sum_eq {ell : ℕ} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν)
    {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α] (F : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → α) :
    ∑ t ∈ windowSet ell y, F (windowPlaq hlt t)
      = ∑ x ∈ blockOf y ell, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell,
          F (pathSite (pathSite x μ i) ν j, ⟨(μ, ν), hlt⟩)

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Lattice.card_win.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Lattice.card_windowSet
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Lattice.card_win.header:
theorem card_windowSet {ell : ℕ} (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell) :
    (windowSet ell y).card = ell ^ 5

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Lattice.coarseCu.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Lattice.coarseCurl_sq_le_window
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Lattice.coarseCu.header:
theorem coarseCurl_sq_le_window {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (A : Bond L → SuTwo) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell)
    {μ ν : Fin 3} (hlt : μ < ν) :
    ‖coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell A)
        ((⟨y, hy⟩, ⟨(μ, ν), hlt⟩) : CoarsePlaquette L ell)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) *
          ∑ t ∈ windowSet ell y, ‖curlValueCovariant (trivialU L) A (windowPlaq hlt t)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Lattice.sum_wind.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Lattice.sum_window_incidence
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Lattice.sum_wind.header:
theorem sum_window_incidence {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (F : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → SuTwo) :
    (∑ P : CoarsePlaquette L ell, ∑ t ∈ windowSet ell P.1.1, ‖F (windowPlaq P.2.2 t)‖ ^ 2)
      = ((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) * plaqEnergy F

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Lattice.coarseCu.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Lattice.coarseCurl_energy_le_flat
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Lattice.coarseCu.header:
theorem coarseCurl_energy_le_flat {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)

        ‖coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd (lineCoarseRestrictCovLM (trivialU L) ell A) P‖ ^ 2)
      ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ)) * plaqEnergy (curlValueCovariant (trivialU L) A)

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.interp_.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.interp_energy_of_onesided
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.interp_.header:
theorem interp_energy_of_onesided (Q : Hs →L[ℝ] Ks) (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (d₁ : Ks →L[ℝ] P₂)
    (Kop : Hs →L[ℝ] Hs) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) (A : Hs) (B : Ks) (hQA : Q A = B)
    (hstep : ‖d₁ (Q A)‖ ≤ σ * ‖d A‖)
    (hK : ‖d A‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ A (Kop A) : ℝ)) :
    (1 / σ ^ 2) * ‖d₁ B‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ A (Kop A) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.oneside.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.onesided_of_chain
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.oneside.header:
theorem onesided_of_chain (Q : Hs →L[ℝ] Ks) (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (d₁ : Ks →L[ℝ] P₂)
    (S : P₁ →L[ℝ] P₂) (σ : ℝ)
    (hchain : ∀ A : Hs, d₁ (Q A) = S (d A)) (hS : ∀ f : P₁, ‖S f‖ ≤ σ * ‖f‖) (A : Hs) :
    ‖d₁ (Q A)‖ ≤ σ * ‖d A‖

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.ker_sub.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.ker_subset_of_onesided
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.ker_sub.header:
theorem ker_subset_of_onesided (Q : Hs →L[ℝ] Ks) (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (d₁ : Ks →L[ℝ] P₂) (σ : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ A : Hs, ‖d₁ (Q A)‖ ≤ σ * ‖d A‖) (A : Hs) (hA : d A = 0) : d₁ (Q A) = 0

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.not_one.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.not_onesided_of_defect
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.not_one.header:
theorem not_onesided_of_defect (Q : Hs →L[ℝ] Ks) (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (d₁ : Ks →L[ℝ] P₂)
    (A₀ : Hs) (h0 : d A₀ = 0) (hne : d₁ (Q A₀) ≠ 0) (σ : ℝ) :
    ¬ (∀ A : Hs, ‖d₁ (Q A)‖ ≤ σ * ‖d A‖)

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.gamma_f.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.gamma_floor_of_perturbed_chain
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.gamma_f.header:
theorem gamma_floor_of_perturbed_chain (Q : Hs →L[ℝ] Ks) (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (d₁ : Ks →L[ℝ] P₂)
    (Kop : Hs →L[ℝ] Hs) (σ₀ κ γP : ℝ) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (A : Hs)
    (hpert : ‖d₁ (Q A)‖ ≤ σ₀ * ‖d A‖ + κ * ‖Q A‖)
    (hpoin : γP * ‖Q A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖d₁ (Q A)‖ ^ 2)
    (hK : ‖d A‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ A (Kop A) : ℝ)) :
    ((γP - 2 * κ ^ 2) / (2 * σ₀ ^ 2)) * ‖Q A‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ A (Kop A) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.absorbe.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.absorbed_constant_pos
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.absorbe.header:
theorem absorbed_constant_pos (σ₀ κ γP : ℝ) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀) (hsmall : 2 * κ ^ 2 < γP) :
    0 < (γP - 2 * κ ^ 2) / (2 * σ₀ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.absorbe.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.absorbed_constant_nonpos
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.absorbe.header:
theorem absorbed_constant_nonpos (σ₀ κ γP : ℝ) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀) (hbig : γP ≤ 2 * κ ^ 2) :
    (γP - 2 * κ ^ 2) / (2 * σ₀ ^ 2) ≤ 0

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.perturb.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.perturbed_chain_of_meanPoincare
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.perturb.header:
theorem perturbed_chain_of_meanPoincare (Q : Hs →L[ℝ] Ks) (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (d₁ : Ks →L[ℝ] P₂)
    (σ₀ c K₁ K₂ : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hK₁ : 0 ≤ K₁) (hK₂ : 0 ≤ K₂) (A : Hs)
    (hraw : ‖d₁ (Q A)‖ ≤ σ₀ * ‖d A‖ + c * ‖A‖)
    (hmean : ‖A‖ ^ 2 ≤ K₁ * ‖d A‖ ^ 2 + K₂ * ‖Q A‖ ^ 2) :
    ‖d₁ (Q A)‖ ≤ (σ₀ + c * Real.sqrt K₁) * ‖d A‖ + (c * Real.sqrt K₂) * ‖Q A‖

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.not_mea.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.not_meanPoincare_of_kernel
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.not_mea.header:
theorem not_meanPoincare_of_kernel (Q : Hs →L[ℝ] Ks) (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁)
    (A₀ : Hs) (hne : A₀ ≠ 0) (hd : d A₀ = 0) (hQ : Q A₀ = 0) (K₁ K₂ : ℝ) :
    ¬ (∀ A : Hs, ‖A‖ ^ 2 ≤ K₁ * ‖d A‖ ^ 2 + K₂ * ‖Q A‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.inner_r.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.inner_real
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.inner_r.header: theorem inner_real (x y : ℝ) : (inner ℝ x y : ℝ) = x * y

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.witness.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.witness_absorption
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.witness.header:
theorem witness_absorption (t : ℝ) :
    ((1 - 2 * (1/2 : ℝ) ^ 2) / (2 * (1 : ℝ) ^ 2)) * ‖t‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ t (wKop t) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.witness.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.witness_perturbed_strictly_weaker
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.witness.header:
theorem witness_perturbed_strictly_weaker :
    (∀ B : ℝ, ‖wd1 B‖ ≤ 0 * ‖wdBad B‖ + 1 * ‖B‖) ∧
      (∀ σ : ℝ, ¬ (∀ A : ℝ, ‖wd1 (wQ A)‖ ≤ σ * ‖wdBad A‖))

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.witness.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.witness_no_meanPoincare
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.witness.header:
theorem witness_no_meanPoincare (K₁ K₂ : ℝ) :
    ¬ (∀ A : ℝ, ‖A‖ ^ 2 ≤ K₁ * ‖wdBad A‖ ^ 2 + K₂ * ‖(0 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) A‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.junk_ze.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.junk_zero
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.junk_ze.header: theorem junk_zero (σ₀ κ γP : ℝ) : ((γP - 2 * κ ^ 2) / (2 * σ₀ ^ 2)) * ‖(0 : ℝ)‖ ^ 2 = 0

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.junk_ze.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.junk_zero_operators
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.OneSided.junk_ze.header:
theorem junk_zero_operators (t : ℝ) :
    (1 / (1 : ℝ) ^ 2) * ‖wd1 ((0 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) t)‖ ^ 2 = 0

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.eq_ze.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.eq_zero_of_minimizer_of_Q_eq_zero
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.eq_ze.header:
theorem eq_zero_of_minimizer_of_Q_eq_zero (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks) (B : Ks)

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.no_ke.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.no_kernel_witness_among_minimizers
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.no_ke.header:
theorem no_kernel_witness_among_minimizers (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks) (B : Ks)
    (hne : solutionOperator D B ≠ 0) : D.Q (solutionOperator D B) ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.meanP.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.meanPoincare_at_minimizer
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.meanP.header:
theorem meanPoincare_at_minimizer (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks) (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (B : Ks) :
    ‖solutionOperator D B‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 0 * ‖d (solutionOperator D B)‖ ^ 2 + ‖solutionOperator D‖ ^ 2 * ‖B‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.pertu.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.perturbed_chain_at_minimizer
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.pertu.header:
theorem perturbed_chain_at_minimizer (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks)
    (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (d₁ : Ks →L[ℝ] P₂) (σ₀ c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hraw : ∀ A : Hs, ‖d₁ (D.Q A)‖ ≤ σ₀ * ‖d A‖ + c * ‖A‖) (B : Ks) :
    ‖d₁ B‖ ≤ σ₀ * ‖d (solutionOperator D B)‖ + (c * ‖solutionOperator D‖) * ‖B‖

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.gamma.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.gamma_floor_at_minimizer
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.gamma.header:
theorem gamma_floor_at_minimizer (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks)
    (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (d₁ : Ks →L[ℝ] P₂) (Kop : Hs →L[ℝ] Hs) (σ₀ c γP : ℝ)
    (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hraw : ∀ A : Hs, ‖d₁ (D.Q A)‖ ≤ σ₀ * ‖d A‖ + c * ‖A‖)
    (hpoin : ∀ B : Ks, γP * ‖B‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖d₁ B‖ ^ 2)
    (hK : ∀ A : Hs, ‖d A‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ A (Kop A) : ℝ)) (B : Ks) :
    ((γP - 2 * (c * ‖solutionOperator D‖) ^ 2) / (2 * σ₀ ^ 2)) * ‖B‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ (solutionOperator D B) (Kop (solutionOperator D B)) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.floor.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.floor_pos_iff_small
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.floor.header:
theorem floor_pos_iff_small (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks) (σ₀ c γP : ℝ) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀) :
    (2 * (c * ‖solutionOperator D‖) ^ 2 < γP →
        0 < (γP - 2 * (c * ‖solutionOperator D‖) ^ 2) / (2 * σ₀ ^ 2)) ∧
      (γP ≤ 2 * (c * ‖solutionOperator D‖) ^ 2 →
        (γP - 2 * (c * ‖solutionOperator D‖) ^ 2) / (2 * σ₀ ^ 2) ≤ 0)

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.norm_.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.norm_solutionOperator_le
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.norm_.header:
theorem norm_solutionOperator_le (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks) :

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.upper.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.upper_and_lower_are_compatible
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.upper.header:

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.not_o.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.not_onesided_at_minimizers_of_defect
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.not_o.header:
theorem not_onesided_at_minimizers_of_defect (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks)

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.no_mi.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.no_minimizer_defect_of_chain
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.no_mi.header:

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.one_l.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.one_le_norm_Q_mul_norm_solutionOperator
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.one_l.header:

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.wData.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.wData
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.wData.header: noncomputable def wData : BalabanCovarianceData ℝ ℝ

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.witne.header:

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.junk_.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.junk_B_zero
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.junk_.header:
theorem junk_B_zero (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks) (σ₀ c γP : ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.gamma.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.gamma_floor_at_minimizer_weakened
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.gamma.header:
theorem gamma_floor_at_minimizer_weakened (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks)
    (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (d₁ : Ks →L[ℝ] P₂) (Kop : Hs →L[ℝ] Hs) (σ₀ c γP : ℝ)
    (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hraw : ∀ A : Hs, ‖d₁ (D.Q A)‖ ≤ σ₀ * ‖d A‖ + c * ‖A‖)
    (hpoin : ∀ B : Ks, γP * ‖B‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖d₁ B‖ ^ 2)
    (hK : ∀ A : Hs, ‖d A‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ A (Kop A) : ℝ)) (B : Ks) :
    ((γP - 2 * (c * ‖solutionOperator D‖) ^ 2) / (2 * σ₀ ^ 2) - 1000) * ‖B‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ (solutionOperator D B) (Kop (solutionOperator D B)) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.pertu.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.perturbed_chain_at_minimizer_weakened
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.pertu.header:
theorem perturbed_chain_at_minimizer_weakened (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks)

AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.junk_.name: AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.junk_c_zero
AdalyFormal.StokesCommu.Restricted.junk_.header:
theorem junk_c_zero (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks)

theorem holonomyFactors_append_prod_S {G : Type*} [Group G] (s : ℕ)

DepthUniformity.Strided.segmentHolS_succ.name: DepthUniformity.Strided.segmentHolS_succ
DepthUniformity.Strided.segmentHolS_succ.header:
theorem segmentHolS_succ {G : Type*} [Group G] (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    segmentHolS s V y μ (n + 1) =
      V (y, μ) * segmentHolS s V (coarseShift y s μ) μ n

DepthUniformity.Strided.segmentHolS_snoc.name: DepthUniformity.Strided.segmentHolS_snoc
DepthUniformity.Strided.segmentHolS_snoc.header:
theorem segmentHolS_snoc {G : Type*} [Group G] (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    segmentHolS s V y μ (n + 1) =
      segmentHolS s V y μ n * V (coarseShift y (s * n) μ, μ)

DepthUniformity.Strided.ladderFactorsS_l.header:

DepthUniformity.Strided.ladderHolS_succ_.name: DepthUniformity.Strided.ladderHolS_succ_eq
DepthUniformity.Strided.ladderHolS_succ_.header:
theorem ladderHolS_succ_eq
    (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    {μ ν : Fin 3} (hμν : μ ≠ ν) (n : ℕ) :
    ladderHolS s V y μ ν (n + 1) =
      (segmentHolS s V (coarseShift y s μ) μ n)⁻¹
        * ((V (y, μ))⁻¹ * (orientedPlaqHolS s V y μ ν)⁻¹ * V (y, μ))
        * segmentHolS s V (coarseShift y s μ) μ n
        * ladderHolS s V (coarseShift y s μ) μ ν n

DepthUniformity.Strided.ladderFactorsS_p.header:

DepthUniformity.Strided.su2Angle_mem_sur.name: DepthUniformity.Strided.su2Angle_mem_surfaceAlongS
DepthUniformity.Strided.su2Angle_mem_sur.header:
theorem su2Angle_mem_surfaceAlongS (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ)
    (acc rest : List (Fin 3)) (delta : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ (y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ' ν' : Fin 3), μ' ≠ ν' →
      su2Angle (orientedPlaqHolS s V y' μ' ν') ≤ delta)
