DepthUniformity.Strided.surfaceAlongS_pr.name: DepthUniformity.Strided.surfaceAlongS_prod
DepthUniformity.Strided.surfaceAlongS_pr.header:
theorem surfaceAlongS_prod (s : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (y0 : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (ell : ℕ)
    (acc rest : List (Fin 3)) :
    ((holonomyFactors s V y0 acc).prod
        * segmentHolS s V (coarsePathEndpoint s y0 acc) μ ell
        * (holonomyFactors s V (coarseShift y0 (s * ell) μ) acc).prod⁻¹
        * (segmentHolS s V y0 μ ell)⁻¹
        * (surfaceAlongS s V y0 μ ell acc rest).prod) =
      ((holonomyFactors s V y0 (List.append acc rest)).prod
        * segmentHolS s V (coarsePathEndpoint s y0 (List.append acc rest)) μ ell
        * (holonomyFactors s V (coarseShift y0 (s * ell) μ) (List.append acc rest)).prod⁻¹
        * (segmentHolS s V y0 μ ell)⁻¹)

DepthUniformity.Strided.nu_loopVar_le_su.name: DepthUniformity.Strided.nu_loopVar_le_surface_mul_S
DepthUniformity.Strided.nu_loopVar_le_su.header:
theorem nu_loopVar_le_surface_mul_S (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (delta : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ delta)
    (h : ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3), μ ≠ ν →
      su2Angle (orientedPlaqHolS s V y μ ν) ≤ delta)
    (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell)
    (hsmall : (loopSurfaceBound ell : ℝ) * delta < Real.pi / 2) :
    nu ((principalSuTwoLog (loopVar s ell V c x) : SuTwo) : M2) ≤
        (loopSurfaceBound ell : ℝ) * delta ∧
      (loopSurfaceBound ell : ℝ) * delta < Real.pi / 2

DepthUniformity.Strided.su2Angle_oriente.name: DepthUniformity.Strided.su2Angle_orientedPlaqHolS_le
DepthUniformity.Strided.su2Angle_oriente.header:
theorem su2Angle_orientedPlaqHolS_le (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (s : ℕ)
    (eps0 : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ eps0)
    (hV : ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3),
      frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS s V y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ eps0)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3) :
    su2Angle (orientedPlaqHolS s V y μ ν) ≤ (Real.pi / (2 * Real.sqrt 2)) * eps0

DepthUniformity.Strided.nu_loopVar_le_rh.header:
theorem nu_loopVar_le_rhoPlaq_S (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)

    (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)

    (hV : ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ ν : Fin 3),
      frobNorm (((orientedPlaqHolS s V y μ ν : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ eps0)
    (hsmall : loopRhoPlaq eps0 ell < Real.pi / 2) :
    nu ((principalSuTwoLog (loopVar s ell V c x) : SuTwo) : M2) ≤
        loopRhoPlaq eps0 ell ∧
      loopRhoPlaq eps0 ell < Real.pi / 2

OneStep124.lineIntegral.name: OneStep124.lineIntegral
OneStep124.lineIntegral.header:
def lineIntegral (ell : ℕ) (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) : PeriodicLatticeSite L → List (Fin 3) → SuTwo
  | _, [] => 0
  | y, μ :: rest =>
      (if h : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell then A (⟨y, h⟩, μ) else 0)
        + RMap (V (y, μ)) (lineIntegral ell V A (coarseShift y ell μ) rest)

@[simp] theorem lineIntegral_nil (ell : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    lineIntegral ell V A y [] = 0

OneStep124.lineIntegral_cons.header:
theorem lineIntegral_cons (ell : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (rest : List (Fin 3)) :
    lineIntegral ell V A y (μ :: rest)
      = (if h : y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell then A (⟨y, h⟩, μ) else 0)
        + RMap (V (y, μ)) (lineIntegral ell V A (coarseShift y ell μ) rest)

OneStep124.lineIntegral_append.name: OneStep124.lineIntegral_append
OneStep124.lineIntegral_append.header:
theorem lineIntegral_append (ell : ℕ)
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (A : CoarseBond L ell → SuTwo) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p q : List (Fin 3)) :
    lineIntegral ell V A y (p ++ q)
      = lineIntegral ell V A y p
        + RMap (coarsePathHolonomy ell V y p) (lineIntegral ell V A (coarsePathEndpoint ell y p) q)

AdalyFormal.NonVacC.thin_nonvac_core.name: AdalyFormal.NonVacC.thin_nonvac_core
AdalyFormal.NonVacC.thin_nonvac_core.header:
theorem thin_nonvac_core {ell M R Rb T c : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hRb : R < Rb) (hRbT : Rb ≤ T) (hRT : R ≤ T)
    (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hcT : c ≤ 2 * T + 1) (hcT' : c ≤ T) (hc10 : 10 ≤ c)
    {a₀ : ℝ} (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
      2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell M Lu ∧ Admissible ell M R k S ∧ AdmSplit ell M R (fun _ => Rb) k S ∧ ¬ Admissible ell M Rb k S ∧
      LambdaOK2 ell M Rb k S Lam ∧
      0 < α₀ ∧ ((c : ℕ) : ℝ) * (M : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀ ∧
      ClassCoupled ell M c k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
      (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 2) ∧
      (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
      (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
      (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
      Lam.Nonempty ∧ (LamPrime ell Lam).Nonempty ∧
      OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ μ : Fin 3, 6 * (c * bigSide M ell j) ≤ scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1) ∧
      (∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ), IsClassCube ell M c k S sites j → ∃ x, x ∉ sites)

AdalyFormal.NonVacC.thin_headline_regime.name: AdalyFormal.NonVacC.thin_headline_regime_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.NonVacC.thin_headline_regime.header:
theorem thin_headline_regime_nonvacuous {ell m R Rb c : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hc : 10 ≤ c) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hRb : R < Rb)
    {a₀ : ℝ} (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
      2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧ Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R k S ∧ AdmSplit ell (ell ^ m) R (fun _ => Rb) k S ∧
      ¬ Admissible ell (ell ^ m) Rb k S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) Rb k S Lam ∧
      0 < α₀ ∧ ((c : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀ ∧
      ClassCoupled ell (ell ^ m) c k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
      (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 2) ∧
      (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
      (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
      (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
      Lam.Nonempty ∧ (LamPrime ell Lam).Nonempty ∧
      OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ μ : Fin 3, 6 * (c * bigSide (ell ^ m) ell j) ≤ scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1) ∧
      (∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ), IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) c k S sites j → ∃ x, x ∉ sites)

AdalyFormal.NonVacC.thin_instance_inequa.name: AdalyFormal.NonVacC.thin_instance_inequality
AdalyFormal.NonVacC.thin_instance_inequa.header:
theorem thin_instance_inequality (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ m₁ : ℕ, 1 ≤ m₁ ∧ ∃ R₁ : ℕ, ∃ (a₀ γ₀ : ℝ), 0 < a₀ ∧ 0 < γ₀ ∧ ∀ c : ℕ, 10 ≤ c → ∀ m : ℕ, m₁ ≤ m →
      ∀ R : ℕ, max R₁ 1 ≤ R → ∀ Rb : ℕ, R < Rb →
      ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
        (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
        2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧ Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R k S ∧ AdmSplit ell (ell ^ m) R (fun _ => Rb) k S ∧
        ¬ Admissible ell (ell ^ m) Rb k S ∧ LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) Rb k S Lam ∧
        0 < α₀ ∧ ((c : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀ ∧
        ClassCoupled ell (ell ^ m) c k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
        (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 2) ∧ (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
        (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
        (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
        Lam.Nonempty ∧ (LamPrime ell Lam).Nonempty ∧
        OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ μ : Fin 3, 6 * (c * bigSide (ell ^ m) ell j) ≤ scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1) ∧
        (∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ),
          IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) c k S sites j → ∃ x, x ∉ sites) ∧
        GenP.WellDefG (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) ∧
        γ₀ * bondEnergy Bt ≤
          GenP.genForm (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam)
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) Bt))

AdalyFormal.NonVacC.asym_nonvac_core.name: AdalyFormal.NonVacC.asym_nonvac_core
AdalyFormal.NonVacC.asym_nonvac_core.header:
theorem asym_nonvac_core {ell M R Rb T c : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hdvd : ell ∣ M) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hRb : R < Rb) (hRbT : Rb ≤ T) (hRT : R ≤ T)
    (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hcT : c ≤ 2 * T + 1) (hcT' : c ≤ T) (hc10 : 10 ≤ c)
    {a₀ : ℝ} (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
      2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell M Lu ∧ AdmSplitNB ell M R (fun _ => Rb) k S ∧ (∀ (R0 : ℕ) (Rs : ℕ → ℕ), ¬ AdalyFormal.ThinLayer.AdmSplit ell M R0 Rs k S) ∧
      LambdaOK2 ell M Rb k S Lam ∧
      0 < α₀ ∧ ((c : ℕ) : ℝ) * (M : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀ ∧
      ClassCoupled ell M c k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
      (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 2) ∧
      (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
      (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
      (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
      Lam.Nonempty ∧ (LamPrime ell Lam).Nonempty ∧
      OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ μ : Fin 3, 6 * (c * bigSide M ell j) ≤ scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1) ∧
      (∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ), IsClassCube ell M c k S sites j → ∃ x, x ∉ sites)

AdalyFormal.NonVacC.asym_headline_regime.name: AdalyFormal.NonVacC.asym_headline_regime_nonvacuous
AdalyFormal.NonVacC.asym_headline_regime.header:
theorem asym_headline_regime_nonvacuous {ell m R Rb c : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hc : 10 ≤ c) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hRb : R < Rb)
    {a₀ : ℝ} (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
      2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧ AdmSplitNB ell (ell ^ m) R (fun _ => Rb) k S ∧
      (∀ (R0 : ℕ) (Rs : ℕ → ℕ), ¬ AdalyFormal.ThinLayer.AdmSplit ell (ell ^ m) R0 Rs k S) ∧
      LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) Rb k S Lam ∧
      0 < α₀ ∧ ((c : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀ ∧
      ClassCoupled ell (ell ^ m) c k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
      (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 2) ∧
      (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
      (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
      (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
      Lam.Nonempty ∧ (LamPrime ell Lam).Nonempty ∧
      OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ μ : Fin 3, 6 * (c * bigSide (ell ^ m) ell j) ≤ scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1) ∧
      (∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ), IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) c k S sites j → ∃ x, x ∉ sites)

AdalyFormal.NonVacC.asym_instance_inequa.name: AdalyFormal.NonVacC.asym_instance_inequality
AdalyFormal.NonVacC.asym_instance_inequa.header:
theorem asym_instance_inequality (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ m₁ : ℕ, 1 ≤ m₁ ∧ ∃ R₁ : ℕ, ∃ (a₀ γ₀ : ℝ), 0 < a₀ ∧ 0 < γ₀ ∧ ∀ c : ℕ, 10 ≤ c → ∀ m : ℕ, m₁ ≤ m →
      ∀ R : ℕ, max R₁ 1 ≤ R → ∀ Rb : ℕ, R < Rb →
      ∃ (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
        (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (α₀ : ℝ) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
        2 ≤ k ∧ TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧ AdmSplitNB ell (ell ^ m) R (fun _ => Rb) k S ∧
        (∀ (R0 : ℕ) (Rs : ℕ → ℕ), ¬ AdalyFormal.ThinLayer.AdmSplit ell (ell ^ m) R0 Rs k S) ∧
        LambdaOK2 ell (ell ^ m) Rb k S Lam ∧
        0 < α₀ ∧ ((c : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀ ∧
        ClassCoupled ell (ell ^ m) c k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U ∧
        (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 0) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 1) ∧ (∃ p, p ∈ towerBj S 2) ∧ (∃ p, p ∉ S.Om 0) ∧
        (∃ z, z ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ periodicLatticeShift z 0 ∈ S.Om 2 ∧ plaq U z ≠ 1) ∧
        (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
        Lam.Nonempty ∧ (LamPrime ell Lam).Nonempty ∧
        OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧ Bt ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ μ : Fin 3, 6 * (c * bigSide (ell ^ m) ell j) ≤ scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1) ∧
        (∀ (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j : ℕ),
          IsClassCube ell (ell ^ m) c k S sites j → ∃ x, x ∉ sites) ∧
        GenP.WellDefG (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) ∧
        γ₀ * bondEnergy Bt ≤
          GenP.genForm (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam)
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) Bt))

AdalyFormal.Thin.truncX.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.truncX
AdalyFormal.Thin.truncX.header: noncomputable def truncX (Lx : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (s : ℕ) : XS Lx →L[ℝ] XS Lx

AdalyFormal.Thin.truncX_apply.header:
theorem truncX_apply (Lx : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (s : ℕ) (x : XS Lx) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lx) :
    truncX Lx s x e = if Aligned s e.1 then x e else 0

AdalyFormal.Thin.phiOK_refl_zero.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.phiOK_refl_zero
AdalyFormal.Thin.phiOK_refl_zero.header: theorem phiOK_refl_zero (hp : PhiOK h o (s * ell)) : PhiOK (Covers.refl Lt) (fun _ => 0) (s * ell)

AdalyFormal.Thin.qStepComp_trunc.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.qStepComp_trunc
AdalyFormal.Thin.qStepComp_trunc.header:
theorem qStepComp_trunc (hp : PhiOK h o (s * ell)) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) (V0t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 Lt)
    {c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt} (hc : Aligned (s * ell) c.1) (x : XS Lt) :
    qStepComp s ell V0t c x = qStepComp s ell V0t c (truncX Lt s x)

AdalyFormal.Thin.qStepComp_ell.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.qStepComp_ell
AdalyFormal.Thin.qStepComp_ell.header:
theorem qStepComp_ell (hp : PhiOK h o (s * ell)) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {V0t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 Lt} {V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} (h0 : AgreeAligned h o s V0t V0)
    {c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt} (hc : Aligned (s * ell) c.1) (a : XS L) :
    qStepComp s ell V0t c (ellX h o a) = qStepComp s ell V0 (phiE h o c) a

AdalyFormal.Thin.fderiv_comp_trunc.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.fderiv_comp_trunc
AdalyFormal.Thin.fderiv_comp_trunc.header:

    (f : XS Lx → F) (s : ℕ) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f 0) (hP : ∀ x, f x = f (truncX Lx s x)) :
    fderiv ℝ f 0 = (fderiv ℝ f 0).comp (truncX Lx s)

AdalyFormal.Thin.QlinStepL_row_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.QlinStepL_row_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.QlinStepL_row_nat.header:
theorem QlinStepL_row_nat (hp : PhiOK h o (s * ell)) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {V0t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 Lt} {V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} (h0 : AgreeAligned h o s V0t V0)
    {c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt} (hc : Aligned (s * ell) c.1) (hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (qStepComp s ell V0t c) 0)
    (x : XS Lt) (a : XS L) (hxa : ∀ e : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt, Aligned s e.1 → x e = a (phiE h o e)) :
    QlinStepL s ell V0t x c = QlinStepL s ell V0 a (phiE h o c)

AdalyFormal.Thin.QlinCompL_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.QlinCompL_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.QlinCompL_nat.header:
theorem QlinCompL_nat (hell : 0 < ell) (bgt : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 Lt) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, PhiOK h o (ell ^ j) →
      (∀ l, l < j → AgreeAligned h o (ell ^ l) (bgt l) (bg l)) →
      (∀ l, l < j → ∀ c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt, Aligned (ell ^ (l + 1)) c.1 →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (qStepComp (ell ^ l) ell (bgt l) c) 0) →
      ∀ (a : XS L) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt), Aligned (ell ^ j) e.1 →
        QlinCompL ell bgt j (ellX h o a) e = QlinCompL ell bg j a (phiE h o e)

AdalyFormal.Thin.fderiv2_comp_clm.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.fderiv2_comp_clm
AdalyFormal.Thin.fderiv2_comp_clm.header:
theorem fderiv2_comp_clm {E F G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (f : E → F) (T : G →L[ℝ] E) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f 0) (x y : G) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ T)) 0 x y = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) 0 (T x) (T y)

AdalyFormal.Thin.D2StepL_row_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.D2StepL_row_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.D2StepL_row_nat.header:
theorem D2StepL_row_nat (hp : PhiOK h o (s * ell)) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {V0t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 Lt} {V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} (h0 : AgreeAligned h o s V0t V0)
    {c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt} (hc : Aligned (s * ell) c.1) (hC2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (qStepComp s ell V0t c) 0)
    (x y : XS Lt) (a b : XS L) (hxa : ∀ e : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt, Aligned s e.1 → x e = a (phiE h o e))
    (hyb : ∀ e : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt, Aligned s e.1 → y e = b (phiE h o e)) :
    D2StepL s ell V0t x y c = D2StepL s ell V0 a b (phiE h o c)

AdalyFormal.Thin.D2CompL_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.D2CompL_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.D2CompL_nat.header:
theorem D2CompL_nat (hell : 0 < ell) (bgt : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 Lt) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, PhiOK h o (ell ^ j) →
      (∀ l, l < j → AgreeAligned h o (ell ^ l) (bgt l) (bg l)) →
      (∀ l, l < j → ∀ c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt, Aligned (ell ^ (l + 1)) c.1 →
        ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (qStepComp (ell ^ l) ell (bgt l) c) 0) →
      ∀ (a b : XS L) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt), Aligned (ell ^ j) e.1 →
        D2CompL ell bgt j (ellX h o a) (ellX h o b) e = D2CompL ell bg j a b (phiE h o e)

AdalyFormal.Thin.fderiv_comp_T.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.fderiv_comp_T
AdalyFormal.Thin.fderiv_comp_T.header:
theorem fderiv_comp_T {Lx : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (f : XS Lx → F) (T : XS Lx →L[ℝ] XS Lx) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f 0) (hP : ∀ x, f x = f (T x)) :
    fderiv ℝ f 0 = (fderiv ℝ f 0).comp T

AdalyFormal.Thin.QlinStepL_row_natT.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.QlinStepL_row_natT
AdalyFormal.Thin.QlinStepL_row_natT.header:
theorem QlinStepL_row_natT (hp : PhiOK h o (s * ell)) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {V0t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 Lt} {V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} (h0 : AgreeAligned h o s V0t V0)
    {c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt} (hc : Aligned (s * ell) c.1) (hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (qStepComp s ell V0t c) 0)
    (T : XS Lt →L[ℝ] XS Lt) (hT : ∀ z, qStepComp s ell V0t c z = qStepComp s ell V0t c (T z))
    (x : XS Lt) (a : XS L) (hxa : T x = T (ellX h o a)) :
    QlinStepL s ell V0t x c = QlinStepL s ell V0 a (phiE h o c)

AdalyFormal.Thin.D2StepL_row_natT.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.D2StepL_row_natT
AdalyFormal.Thin.D2StepL_row_natT.header:
theorem D2StepL_row_natT (hp : PhiOK h o (s * ell)) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {V0t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 Lt} {V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} (h0 : AgreeAligned h o s V0t V0)
    {c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt} (hc : Aligned (s * ell) c.1) (hC2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (qStepComp s ell V0t c) 0)
    (T : XS Lt →L[ℝ] XS Lt) (hT : ∀ z, qStepComp s ell V0t c z = qStepComp s ell V0t c (T z))
    (x y : XS Lt) (a b : XS L) (hxa : T x = T (ellX h o a)) (hyb : T y = T (ellX h o b)) :
    D2StepL s ell V0t x y c = D2StepL s ell V0 a b (phiE h o c)

AdalyFormal.Thin.QlinCompL_natR.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.QlinCompL_natR
AdalyFormal.Thin.QlinCompL_natR.header:
theorem QlinCompL_natR (hell : 0 < ell) (bgt : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 Lt) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, PhiOK h o (ell ^ j) →
      (∀ l, l < j → AgreeAligned h o (ell ^ l) (bgt l) (bg l)) →
      ∀ (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt), Aligned (ell ^ j) e.1 →
      (∀ l e', ReadRow ell j e l e' → DifferentiableAt ℝ (qStepComp (ell ^ l) ell (bgt l) e') 0) →

AdalyFormal.Thin.D2CompL_natR.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.D2CompL_natR
AdalyFormal.Thin.D2CompL_natR.header:
theorem D2CompL_natR (hell : 0 < ell) (bgt : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 Lt) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :

      (∀ l, l < j → AgreeAligned h o (ell ^ l) (bgt l) (bg l)) →
      ∀ (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt), Aligned (ell ^ j) e.1 →
      (∀ l e', ReadRow ell j e l e' → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (qStepComp (ell ^ l) ell (bgt l) e') 0) →
      ∀ (a b : XS L), D2CompL ell bgt j (ellX h o a) (ellX h o b) e = D2CompL ell bg j a b (phiE h o e)

AdalyFormal.Thin.QlinB_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.QlinB_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.QlinB_nat.header:
theorem QlinB_nat {o : Fin 3 → ℕ} (hp : PhiOK h o (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k)
    (hreg : JetReg ell k (towerPull h o S) (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (pullCfg h o U))) (A : BondFnL2 L) {b : Bond Lt}
    (hb : Aligned (ell ^ j) b.1) (hbL : b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k (towerPull h o S)) j) :
    (QlinB (geomOf ell k (towerPull h o S)) (pullCfg h o U) j (liftF (phiE h o) A)).ofLp b =

AdalyFormal.Thin.bHφ_tau.header:
theorem bHφ_tau (hp : PhiOK h (fun _ => 0) (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (d : DeckIdx Lt L) :
    ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∀ b, b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)) j →
      phiE (Covers.refl Lt) (fun μ => (d μ).val * (L μ + 1)) b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)) j

AdalyFormal.Thin.covBIdx_pi.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.covBIdx_pi
AdalyFormal.Thin.covBIdx_pi.header:
theorem covBIdx_pi (hp : PhiOK h (fun _ => 0) (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) :
    (covBIdx h S hp hell).π = bidxMap ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S) S (phiE h (fun _ => 0)) (bHφ_pi h hp hell S)

AdalyFormal.Thin.covBIdx_tau.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.covBIdx_tau
AdalyFormal.Thin.covBIdx_tau.header:
theorem covBIdx_tau (hp : PhiOK h (fun _ => 0) (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (d : DeckIdx Lt L) :
    ⇑((covBIdx h S hp hell).τ d) = bidxMap ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S) (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)
      (phiE (Covers.refl Lt) (fun μ => (d μ).val * (L μ + 1))) (bHφ_tau h hp hell S d)

AdalyFormal.Thin.QfullOf_apply.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.QfullOf_apply
AdalyFormal.Thin.QfullOf_apply.header:
theorem QfullOf_apply {L' : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : TowerGeom L') (U : Cfg L') (A : BondFnL2 L') (p : BIdx G) :
    QfullOf G U A p = (((G.ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ))⁻¹) • (WithLp.ofLp (QlinB G U p.1 A)) p.2.1

AdalyFormal.Thin.QfullOf_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.QfullOf_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.QfullOf_nat.header:
theorem QfullOf_nat {o : Fin 3 → ℕ} (hp : PhiOK h o (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L)
    (hreg : JetReg ell k (towerPull h o S) (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (pullCfg h o U))) (A : BondFnL2 L) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k (towerPull h o S))) :
    QfullOf (geomOf ell k (towerPull h o S)) (pullCfg h o U) (liftF (phiE h o) A) p =
      QfullOf (geomOf ell k S) U A
        (bidxMap ell k (towerPull h o S) S (phiE h o)
          (fun j b hb => (bondsLam_iff hp hell (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp j.2) b).mp hb) p)

AdalyFormal.Thin.QfullOf_nat'.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.QfullOf_nat'
AdalyFormal.Thin.QfullOf_nat'.header:
theorem QfullOf_nat' {o : Fin 3 → ℕ} (hp : PhiOK h o (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L)
    (St : Tower Lt) (hSt : St = towerPull h o S) (Ut : Cfg Lt) (hUt : Ut = pullCfg h o U)
    (hreg : JetReg ell k St (UbarTower su2LogExp ell Ut)) (hφ : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∀ b, b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k St) j →
      phiE h o b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j)
    (A : BondFnL2 L) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k St)) :
    QfullOf (geomOf ell k St) Ut (liftF (phiE h o) A) p =
      QfullOf (geomOf ell k S) U A (bidxMap ell k St S (phiE h o) hφ p)

AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_QfullOf.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_QfullOf
AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_QfullOf.header:
theorem desc_QfullOf [Nonempty (DeckIdx Lt L)] (hp : PhiOK h (fun _ => 0) (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L)
    (hreg : JetReg ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S) (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U))) :
    Desc (covE h) (covBIdx h S hp hell) (QfullOf (geomOf ell k S) U)
      (QfullOf (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)) (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U))

AdalyFormal.Thin.D2B_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.D2B_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.D2B_nat.header:
theorem D2B_nat {o : Fin 3 → ℕ} (hp : PhiOK h o (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k)
    (hreg : JetReg ell k (towerPull h o S) (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (pullCfg h o U))) (A B : BondFnL2 L) {b : Bond Lt}
    (hb : Aligned (ell ^ j) b.1) (hbL : b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k (towerPull h o S)) j) :
    (D2B (geomOf ell k (towerPull h o S)) (pullCfg h o U) j (liftF (phiE h o) A) (liftF (phiE h o) B)).ofLp b =
      (D2B (geomOf ell k S) U j A B).ofLp (phiE h o b)

AdalyFormal.Thin.C2fullOf_apply.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.C2fullOf_apply
AdalyFormal.Thin.C2fullOf_apply.header:
theorem C2fullOf_apply {L' : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : TowerGeom L') (U : Cfg L') (A : BondFnL2 L') (p : BIdx G) :
    C2fullOf G U A p = (((G.ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ))⁻¹) • (WithLp.ofLp (C2rawB G U p.1 A)) p.2.1

AdalyFormal.Thin.C2fullOf_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.C2fullOf_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.C2fullOf_nat.header:
theorem C2fullOf_nat {o : Fin 3 → ℕ} (hp : PhiOK h o (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L)
    (St : Tower Lt) (hSt : St = towerPull h o S) (Ut : Cfg Lt) (hUt : Ut = pullCfg h o U)
    (hreg : JetReg ell k St (UbarTower su2LogExp ell Ut)) (hφ : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∀ b, b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k St) j →
      phiE h o b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j)
    (A : BondFnL2 L) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k St)) :
    C2fullOf (geomOf ell k St) Ut (liftF (phiE h o) A) p =
      C2fullOf (geomOf ell k S) U A (bidxMap ell k St S (phiE h o) hφ p)

AdalyFormal.Thin.bondSupp_pull.header:

AdalyFormal.Thin.bondSupp_pull_adj.header:

AdalyFormal.Thin.iE0.header: noncomputable def iE0 {L' : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : TowerGeom L') : ↥(bondSupp G) →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L'

AdalyFormal.Thin.iE0_eq.header: theorem iE0_eq {L' : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : TowerGeom L') : iE0 G = iE G

AdalyFormal.Thin.FnuMuLoc_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.FnuMuLoc_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.FnuMuLoc_nat.header:
theorem FnuMuLoc_nat (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (U : Cfg L) (ν μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) :

AdalyFormal.Thin.DstarDir_nat.header:

AdalyFormal.Thin.JfieldLoc_nat.header:

AdalyFormal.Thin.JSU2Loc_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.JSU2Loc_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.JSU2Loc_nat.header:

AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_pE.header:

AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_Dpi.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_Dpi
AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_Dpi.header:
theorem hdesc_Dpi (hp : PhiOK h (fun _ => 0) (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)) (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U) a +
      (1 - siteMask (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)).Om0))) :
    HDesc (hE0 (ell := ell) (k := k) h S) (hE0 (ell := ell) (k := k) h S)
      ((pE (geomOf ell k S)).comp ((DpiFull (geomOf ell k S) U a).comp (iE (geomOf ell k S))))
      ((pE (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S))).comp
        ((DpiFull (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)) (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U) a).comp
          (iE (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)))))

AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_T.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_T
AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_T.header:
theorem hdesc_T (hp : PhiOK h (fun _ => 0) (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L) :
    HDesc (hE0 (ell := ell) (k := k) h S) (cSite h)
      ((Tfull (geomOf ell k S) U).comp (iE (geomOf ell k S)))
      ((Tfull (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)) (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U)).comp
        (iE (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S))))

AdalyFormal.Thin.diagW_eq_diagOp.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.diagW_eq_diagOp
AdalyFormal.Thin.diagW_eq_diagOp.header:
theorem diagW_eq_diagOp {L' : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : TowerGeom L') (w : BIdx G → ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_Qfull.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_Qfull
AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_Qfull.header:
theorem hdesc_Qfull (hp : PhiOK h (fun _ => 0) (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L)
    (hreg : JetReg ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S) (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U))) :
    HDesc (cB h) (cFSp h hp hell S) (QfullOf (geomOf ell k S) U)
      (QfullOf (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)) (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U))

AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_Q.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_Q
AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_Q.header:
theorem hdesc_Q (hp : PhiOK h (fun _ => 0) (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L)
    (hreg : JetReg ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S) (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U))) :
    HDesc (hE0 (ell := ell) (k := k) h S) (cFSp h hp hell S)
      ((QfullOf (geomOf ell k S) U).comp (iE (geomOf ell k S)))
      ((QfullOf (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)) (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U)).comp
        (iE (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S))))

AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_MassFull.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_MassFull
AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_MassFull.header:
theorem hdesc_MassFull (hp : PhiOK h (fun _ => 0) (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ)
    (hreg : JetReg ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S) (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U))) :
    HDesc (cB h) (cB h)
      (MassFull (geomOf ell k S) a (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) U))
      (MassFull (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)) a
        (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)) (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U)))

AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_Mass.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_Mass
AdalyFormal.Thin.hdesc_Mass.header:
theorem hdesc_Mass (hp : PhiOK h (fun _ => 0) (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ)
    (hreg : JetReg ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S) (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U))) :
    HDesc (hE0 (ell := ell) (k := k) h S) (hE0 (ell := ell) (k := k) h S)
      ((pE (geomOf ell k S)).comp ((MassFull (geomOf ell k S) a (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) U)).comp (iE (geomOf ell k S))))
      ((pE (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S))).comp
        ((MassFull (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)) a
          (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)) (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U))).comp
          (iE (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)))))

AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink
AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.header: structure BDLink (D : BaseDataS E S F) (Dt : BaseDataS Et St Ft) (cE : HCov Dd E Et) (cS : HCov Dd S St) (cF : HCov Dd F Ft) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Thin.BaseDataS.Ts_eq.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.BaseDataS.Ts_eq
AdalyFormal.Thin.BaseDataS.Ts_eq.header: theorem BaseDataS.Ts_eq (D : BaseDataS E S F) : D.Ts = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D.T

AdalyFormal.Thin.BaseDataS.Qs_eq.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.BaseDataS.Qs_eq
AdalyFormal.Thin.BaseDataS.Qs_eq.header: theorem BaseDataS.Qs_eq (D : BaseDataS E S F) : D.Qs = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D.Q

AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.ts.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.ts
AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.ts.header: theorem BDLink.ts (hl : BDLink (Dd := Dd) D Dt cE cS cF) : HDesc cS cE D.Ts Dt.Ts

AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.qs.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.qs
AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.qs.header: theorem BDLink.qs (hl : BDLink (Dd := Dd) D Dt cE cS cF) : HDesc cF cE D.Qs Dt.Qs

AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.ginv.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.ginv
AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.ginv.header: theorem BDLink.ginv (hl : BDLink (Dd := Dd) D Dt cE cS cF) : HDesc cE cE D.Ginv Dt.Ginv

AdalyFormal.Thin.HCov.inner_ell.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.HCov.inner_ell
AdalyFormal.Thin.HCov.inner_ell.header: theorem HCov.inner_ell (c : HCov Dd H Ht) (x y : H) : ⟪c.ell x, c.ell y⟫ = (Fintype.card Dd : ℝ) * ⟪x, y⟫

AdalyFormal.Thin.HCov.inner_rho.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.HCov.inner_rho
AdalyFormal.Thin.HCov.inner_rho.header: theorem HCov.inner_rho (c : HCov Dd H Ht) (d : Dd) (x y : Ht) : ⟪c.rho d x, c.rho d y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫

AdalyFormal.Thin.he1_of_equi_descent.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.he1_of_equi_descent
AdalyFormal.Thin.he1_of_equi_descent.header:
theorem he1_of_equi_descent [Nonempty Dd] (c : HCov Dd H Ht) (Ot : Ht →L[ℝ] Ht) (he : HEqui c c Ot) :
    HE1 c c ((1 / (Fintype.card Dd : ℝ)) • c.sig.comp (Ot.comp c.ell)) Ot

AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.G.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.G
AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.G.header:
theorem BDLink.G [Nonempty Dd] (hl : BDLink (Dd := Dd) D Dt cE cS cF) (hu : IsUnit Dt.Ginv) :
    IsUnit D.Ginv ∧ HDesc cE cE D.G Dt.G

AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.H.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.H
AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.H.header:
theorem BDLink.H [Nonempty Dd] (hl : BDLink (Dd := Dd) D Dt cE cS cF) (hu : IsUnit Dt.Ginv)
    (hM : IsUnit ((Dt.Q.comp Dt.G).comp Dt.Qs)) : HDesc cF cE D.H Dt.H

AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.K_ell.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.K_ell
AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.K_ell.header:
theorem BDLink.K_ell (hl : BDLink (Dd := Dd) D Dt cE cS cF) (hH : HDesc cF cE D.H Dt.H) (A : E) :
    Dt.K (cE.ell A) = (Fintype.card Dd : ℝ) * D.K A

AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.K_rho.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.K_rho
AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.K_rho.header:
theorem BDLink.K_rho (hl : BDLink (Dd := Dd) D Dt cE cS cF) (hH : HDesc cF cE D.H Dt.H) (d : Dd) (A : Et) :
    Dt.K (cE.rho d A) = Dt.K A

AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.G1inv.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.G1inv
AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.G1inv.header:
theorem BDLink.G1inv [Nonempty Dd] (hl : BDLink (Dd := Dd) D Dt cE cS cF) (hH : HDesc cF cE D.H Dt.H)
    {X : E →L[ℝ] E} (hX : D.IsG1inv X) {Xt : Et →L[ℝ] Et} (hXt : Dt.IsG1inv Xt) : HDesc cE cE X Xt

AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.G1.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.G1
AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.G1.header:
theorem BDLink.G1 [Nonempty Dd] (_hl : BDLink (Dd := Dd) D Dt cE cS cF) {X : E →L[ℝ] E} {Xt : Et →L[ℝ] Et} (hX : HDesc cE cE X Xt) (hu : IsUnit Xt) :
    IsUnit X ∧ HDesc cE cE (D.G1 X) (Dt.G1 Xt)

AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.Nmat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.Nmat

AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.H1.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.BDLink.H1

AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.reindex.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.reindex
AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.reindex.header: def Cov.reindex (c : Cov D Xt X) (e : D' ≃ D) : Cov D' Xt X

AdalyFormal.Thin.nn_scaleUp.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.nn_scaleUp
AdalyFormal.Thin.nn_scaleUp.header:
theorem nn_scaleUp (hell : 0 < ell) (μ : Fin 3) :
    nn (scaleUp ell k Lut) (scaleUp ell k Lu) μ = nn Lut Lu μ

AdalyFormal.Thin.eUnit.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.eUnit
AdalyFormal.Thin.eUnit.header: def eUnit (hell : 0 < ell) : DeckIdx (scaleUp ell k Lut) (scaleUp ell k Lu) ≃ DeckIdx Lut Lu

AdalyFormal.Thin.eUnit_val.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.eUnit_val
AdalyFormal.Thin.eUnit_val.header:
theorem eUnit_val (hell : 0 < ell) (d : DeckIdx (scaleUp ell k Lut) (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ((eUnit (Lut := Lut) (Lu := Lu) ell k hell d) μ).val = (d μ).val

AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_emb.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_emb
AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_emb.header:
theorem phiS_emb (hell : 0 < ell) (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lut) :
    phiS (covers_scaleUp ell k hell hu) (fun μ => ell ^ k * o μ) (embY ell k Lut hell y) =
      embY ell k Lu hell (phiS hu o y)

AdalyFormal.Thin.unitBg_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.unitBg_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.unitBg_nat.header:
theorem unitBg_nat (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hp : PhiOK (covers_scaleUp ell k hell hu) (fun μ => ell ^ k * o μ) (ell ^ k))
    {Vt : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell k Lut)} {V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)}
    (hV : AgreeAligned (covers_scaleUp ell k hell hu) (fun μ => ell ^ k * o μ) (ell ^ k) Vt V) :
    unitBg ell k Lut hell Vt = fun e => unitBg ell k Lu hell V (phiE hu o e)

AdalyFormal.Thin.coarse_aligned.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.coarse_aligned
AdalyFormal.Thin.coarse_aligned.header: theorem coarse_aligned (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lut) (hy : y ∈ CoarseLattice Lut ell) : Aligned ell y

AdalyFormal.Thin.cbMap.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.cbMap
AdalyFormal.Thin.cbMap.header: def cbMap (hp : PhiOK hu o ell) (c : CoarseBond Lut ell) : CoarseBond Lu ell

AdalyFormal.Thin.Q1jet_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.Q1jet_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.Q1jet_nat.header:
theorem Q1jet_nat (hp : PhiOK hu o ell) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {V0t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 Lut} {V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 Lu} (h0 : AgreeAligned hu o 1 V0t V0)
    (B : Bond Lu → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond Lut ell)
    (hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (qStepComp 1 ell V0t (c.1.1, c.2)) 0) :
    Q1jet ell V0t (fun e => B (phiE hu o e)) c = Q1jet ell V0 B (cbMap hp c)

AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_mem_blockOf.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_mem_blockOf
AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_mem_blockOf.header:
theorem phiS_mem_blockOf (hp : PhiOK hu o ell) (hell : 0 < ell) {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lut} (hy : Aligned ell y)
    (hx : x ∈ blockOf y ell) : phiS hu o x ∈ blockOf (phiS hu o y) ell

AdalyFormal.Thin.exists_lift_blockOf.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.exists_lift_blockOf
AdalyFormal.Thin.exists_lift_blockOf.header:
theorem exists_lift_blockOf (hp : PhiOK hu o ell) (hell : 0 < ell) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lut} (hy : Aligned ell y)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu} (hx : x ∈ blockOf (phiS hu o y) ell) : ∃ x' ∈ blockOf y ell, phiS hu o x' = x

AdalyFormal.Thin.LamPrime_pull.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.LamPrime_pull
AdalyFormal.Thin.LamPrime_pull.header:
theorem LamPrime_pull (hp : PhiOK hu o ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lut) :
    y ∈ LamPrime ell (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) ↔ phiS hu o y ∈ LamPrime ell Lam

AdalyFormal.Thin.pathSite_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.pathSite_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.pathSite_nat.header:
theorem pathSite_nat (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lut) (μ : Fin 3) (i : ℕ) :
    phiS hu o (pathSite y μ i) = pathSite (phiS hu o y) μ i

AdalyFormal.Thin.dropped_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.dropped_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.dropped_nat.header:
theorem dropped_nat (hp : PhiOK hu o ell) (c : CoarseBond Lut ell) :
    phiE hu o (droppedBondLast ell c) = droppedBondLast ell (cbMap hp c)

AdalyFormal.Thin.CRowIn_pull.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.CRowIn_pull
AdalyFormal.Thin.CRowIn_pull.header:
theorem CRowIn_pull (hp : PhiOK hu o ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (c : CoarseBond Lut ell) :
    CRowIn ell (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) c ↔ CRowIn ell Lam (cbMap hp c)

AdalyFormal.Thin.pathSite_sbIter.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.pathSite_sbIter
AdalyFormal.Thin.pathSite_sbIter.header:
theorem pathSite_sbIter {L' : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L') (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    pathSite ((fun z => periodicLatticeShiftBack z μ)^[n] y) μ n = y

AdalyFormal.Thin.sbIter_pathSite.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.sbIter_pathSite
AdalyFormal.Thin.sbIter_pathSite.header:
theorem sbIter_pathSite {L' : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L') (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    (fun z => periodicLatticeShiftBack z μ)^[n] (pathSite y μ n) = y

AdalyFormal.Thin.sbIter_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.sbIter_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.sbIter_nat.header:
theorem sbIter_nat (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lut) (μ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    phiS hu o ((fun z => periodicLatticeShiftBack z μ)^[n] y) = (fun z => periodicLatticeShiftBack z μ)^[n] (phiS hu o y)

AdalyFormal.Thin.isDropped_pull.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.isDropped_pull
AdalyFormal.Thin.isDropped_pull.header:
theorem isDropped_pull (hp : PhiOK hu o ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (b : Bond Lut) :
    IsDroppedIn (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) ell b ↔ IsDroppedIn Lam ell (phiE hu o b)

AdalyFormal.Thin.seg_pull.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.seg_pull
AdalyFormal.Thin.seg_pull.header:
theorem seg_pull (hp : PhiOK hu o ell) (hell : 0 < ell) {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lut} (hy : Aligned ell y)
    (hxb : ∀ ν, (y ν).val ≤ (x ν).val ∧ (x ν).val < (y ν).val + ell)
    (base : PeriodicLatticeSite Lut) (base' : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu) (μ : Fin 3)
    (hbase : ∀ ν, ν ≠ μ → phiS hu o base ν = base' ν) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lut)
    (he : e ∈ axisSegment base μ (y μ).val (x μ).val) :
    phiE hu o e ∈ axisSegment base' μ (phiS hu o y μ).val (phiS hu o x μ).val

AdalyFormal.Thin.staircase_pull.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.staircase_pull
AdalyFormal.Thin.staircase_pull.header:
theorem staircase_pull (hp : PhiOK hu o ell) (hell : 0 < ell) {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lut} (hy : Aligned ell y)
    (hx : x ∈ blockOf y ell) {b : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lut} (hb : b ∈ staircasePath y x) :
    phiE hu o b ∈ staircasePath (phiS hu o y) (phiS hu o x)

AdalyFormal.Thin.onLambdaTildeIn_pull.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.onLambdaTildeIn_pull
AdalyFormal.Thin.onLambdaTildeIn_pull.header:
theorem onLambdaTildeIn_pull (hp : PhiOK hu o ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo)
    (h : OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt) : OnLambdaTildeIn (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) ell (fun e => Bt (phiE hu o e))

AdalyFormal.Thin.onLambdaT_pull.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.onLambdaT_pull
AdalyFormal.Thin.onLambdaT_pull.header:
theorem onLambdaT_pull (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo) (h : OnLambdaT Lam Bt) :
    OnLambdaT (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) (fun e => Bt (phiE hu o e))

AdalyFormal.Thin.bondEnergy_pull.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.bondEnergy_pull
AdalyFormal.Thin.bondEnergy_pull.header:
theorem bondEnergy_pull (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo) :
    bondEnergy (fun e => Bt (phiE hu (fun _ => 0) e)) = (Fintype.card (DeckIdx Lut Lu) : ℝ) * bondEnergy Bt

AdalyFormal.Thin.C2tilde_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.C2tilde_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.C2tilde_nat.header:
theorem C2tilde_nat (hp : PhiOK hu o ell) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {V0t : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 Lut} {V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 Lu} (h0 : AgreeAligned hu o 1 V0t V0)
    (B : Bond Lu → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond Lut ell)
    (hC2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (qStepComp 1 ell V0t (c.1.1, c.2)) 0) :
    C2tilde ell V0t (fun e => B (phiE hu o e)) c = C2tilde ell V0 B (cbMap hp c)

AdalyFormal.Thin.dropped_injective.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.dropped_injective
AdalyFormal.Thin.dropped_injective.header: theorem dropped_injective {L' : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell : ℕ) : Function.Injective (droppedBondLast (L := L') ell)

AdalyFormal.Thin.dmap.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.dmap
AdalyFormal.Thin.dmap.header:
def dmap (hp : PhiOK hu o ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (c : Dset Lut ell (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam)) :
    Dset Lu ell Lam

AdalyFormal.Thin.iotaD_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.iotaD_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.iotaD_nat.header:
theorem iotaD_nat (hp : PhiOK hu o ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (w : Dset Lu ell Lam → SuTwo) :
    iotaD ell (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) (fun c => w (dmap hp hell Lam c)) = fun b => iotaD ell Lam w (phiE hu o b)

AdalyFormal.Thin.rhoD_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.rhoD_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.rhoD_nat.header:
theorem rhoD_nat (hp : PhiOK hu o ell) (hell : 0 < ell) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (f : CoarseBond Lu ell → SuTwo) :
    rhoD ell (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) (fun c => f (cbMap hp c)) = fun c => rhoD ell Lam f (dmap hp hell Lam c)

AdalyFormal.Thin.hLift_congr_rows.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.hLift_congr_rows

AdalyFormal.Thin.H0_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.H0_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.H0_nat.header:
theorem H0_nat (hQ : ∀ B : Bond Lu → SuTwo, ∀ c : CoarseBond Lut ell, CRowIn ell (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) c →
      Qt (fun e => B (phiE hu o e)) c = Q B (cbMap hp c))
    (w : Dset Lu ell Lam → SuTwo) :
    H0 (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) Qt (fun c => w (dmap hp hell Lam c)) = fun c => H0 Lam Q w (dmap hp hell Lam c)

AdalyFormal.Thin.H0inv_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.H0inv_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.H0inv_nat.header:
theorem H0inv_nat (hQ : ∀ B : Bond Lu → SuTwo, ∀ c : CoarseBond Lut ell, CRowIn ell (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) c →
      Qt (fun e => B (phiE hu o e)) c = Q B (cbMap hp c))
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (dmap hp hell Lam)) (hbt : Function.Bijective (H0 (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) Qt))
    (w : Dset Lu ell Lam → SuTwo) :
    Function.Bijective (H0 Lam Q) ∧
    H0inv (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) Qt (fun c => w (dmap hp hell Lam c)) = fun c => H0inv Lam Q w (dmap hp hell Lam c)

AdalyFormal.Thin.hLift_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.hLift_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.hLift_nat.header:
theorem hLift_nat (hQ : ∀ B : Bond Lu → SuTwo, ∀ c : CoarseBond Lut ell, CRowIn ell (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) c →
      Qt (fun e => B (phiE hu o e)) c = Q B (cbMap hp c))
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (dmap hp hell Lam)) (hbt : Function.Bijective (H0 (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) Qt))
    (f : CoarseBond Lu ell → SuTwo) :
    hLift (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) Qt (fun c => f (cbMap hp c)) = fun b => hLift Lam Q f (phiE hu o b)

AdalyFormal.Thin.Cop_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.Cop_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.Cop_nat.header:
theorem Cop_nat (hQ : ∀ B : Bond Lu → SuTwo, ∀ c : CoarseBond Lut ell, CRowIn ell (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) c →
      Qt (fun e => B (phiE hu o e)) c = Q B (cbMap hp c))
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (dmap hp hell Lam)) (hbt : Function.Bijective (H0 (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) Qt))
    (B : Bond Lu → SuTwo) :
    Cop (phiS hu o ⁻¹' Lam) Qt (fun e => B (phiE hu o e)) = fun b => Cop Lam Q B (phiE hu o b)

AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_emb0.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_emb0
AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_emb0.header:
theorem phiS_emb0 (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lut) :
    phiS (covers_scaleUp ell k hell hu) (fun _ => 0) (embY ell k Lut hell y) = embY ell k Lu hell (phiS hu (fun _ => 0) y)

AdalyFormal.Thin.covEU.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.covEU
AdalyFormal.Thin.covEU.header: noncomputable def covEU : Cov (DeckIdx (scaleUp ell k Lut) (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (PeriodicLatticeEdge Lut) (PeriodicLatticeEdge Lu)

AdalyFormal.Thin.covEU_pi.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.covEU_pi
AdalyFormal.Thin.covEU_pi.header: theorem covEU_pi : (covEU hu ell k hell).π = phiE hu (fun _ => 0)

AdalyFormal.Thin.covEU_tau.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.covEU_tau
AdalyFormal.Thin.covEU_tau.header:
theorem covEU_tau (d : DeckIdx (scaleUp ell k Lut) (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ((covEU hu ell k hell).τ d : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lut → PeriodicLatticeEdge Lut) =
      phiE (Covers.refl Lut) (fun μ => (d μ).val * (Lu μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_emb_gen.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_emb_gen
AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_emb_gen.header:
theorem phiS_emb_gen (of ou : Fin 3 → ℕ) (ho : ∀ μ, of μ = ell ^ k * ou μ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lut) :
    phiS (covers_scaleUp ell k hell hu) of (embY ell k Lut hell y) = embY ell k Lu hell (phiS hu ou y)

AdalyFormal.Thin.phiE_emb_gen.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.phiE_emb_gen
AdalyFormal.Thin.phiE_emb_gen.header:
theorem phiE_emb_gen (of ou : Fin 3 → ℕ) (ho : ∀ μ, of μ = ell ^ k * ou μ) (e : Bond Lut) :
    phiE (covers_scaleUp ell k hell hu) of (unitBondEmb ell k Lut hell e) = unitBondEmb ell k Lu hell (phiE hu ou e)

AdalyFormal.Thin.tauExt_apply.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.tauExt_apply
AdalyFormal.Thin.tauExt_apply.header:
theorem tauExt_apply {L' : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : Tower (scaleUp ell k L')) (f : FSp (geomOf ell k G)) (e : Bond L') :
    tauExt ell k L' hell G f e = if hb : unitBondEmb ell k L' hell e ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k G) k
      then WithLp.ofLp f ⟨Fin.last k, ⟨unitBondEmb ell k L' hell e, hb⟩⟩ else 0

AdalyFormal.Thin.tauExt_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.tauExt_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.tauExt_nat.header:
theorem tauExt_nat (of ou : Fin 3 → ℕ) (ho : ∀ μ, of μ = ell ^ k * ou μ)
    (hp : PhiOK (covers_scaleUp ell k hell hu) of (ell ^ k)) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (St : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lut)) (hSt : St = towerPull (covers_scaleUp ell k hell hu) of S)
    (hφ : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∀ b, b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k St) j →
      phiE (covers_scaleUp ell k hell hu) of b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j)
    (f : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) (e : Bond Lut) :
    tauExt ell k Lut hell St (liftF (bidxMap ell k St S (phiE (covers_scaleUp ell k hell hu) of) hφ) f) e =
      tauExt ell k Lu hell S f (phiE hu ou e)

AdalyFormal.Thin.hf_ho_zero.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.hf_ho_zero
AdalyFormal.Thin.hf_ho_zero.header: theorem hf_ho_zero : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (fun _ : Fin 3 => 0) μ = ell ^ k * (fun _ : Fin 3 => 0) μ

AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_tau.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_tau
AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_tau.header:
theorem desc_tau [Nonempty (DeckIdx (scaleUp ell k Lut) (scaleUp ell k Lu))]
    (hp : PhiOK (covers_scaleUp ell k hell hu) (fun _ => 0) (ell ^ k)) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    Desc (covBIdx (covers_scaleUp ell k hell hu) S hp hell) (covEU hu ell k hell) (tauExt ell k Lu hell S)
      (tauExt ell k Lut hell (towerPull (covers_scaleUp ell k hell hu) (fun _ => 0) S))

AdalyFormal.Thin.JfOf_def.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.JfOf_def
AdalyFormal.Thin.JfOf_def.header:
theorem JfOf_def {L' : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : TowerGeom L') (U : Cfg L') :
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b => -(JSU2Loc 1 (plaqIn G.Om0) U b)) : BondFnL2 L') =
      WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b => -(JSU2Loc 1 (plaqIn G.Om0) U b))

AdalyFormal.Thin.Jf_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.Jf_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.Jf_nat.header:
theorem Jf_nat (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L) :
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Bond Lt => -(JSU2Loc 1 (plaqIn (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)).Om0) (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U) b)) : BondFnL2 Lt) =
      liftF (phiE h (fun _ => 0))
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Bond L => -(JSU2Loc 1 (plaqIn (geomOf ell k S).Om0) U b)) : BondFnL2 L)

AdalyFormal.Thin.C2full_E1.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.C2full_E1
AdalyFormal.Thin.C2full_E1.header:
theorem C2full_E1 (hp : PhiOK h (fun _ => 0) (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L)
    (hreg : JetReg ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S) (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U))) (z : BondFnL2 L) :
    C2fullOf (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)) (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U) ((covE h).ell z) =
      (covBIdx h S hp hell).ell (C2fullOf (geomOf ell k S) U z)

AdalyFormal.Thin.C2full_equi.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.C2full_equi
AdalyFormal.Thin.C2full_equi.header:
theorem C2full_equi (hp : PhiOK h (fun _ => 0) (ell ^ k)) (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L)
    (hreg : JetReg ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S) (UbarTower su2LogExp ell (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U))) (d : DeckIdx Lt L) (z : BondFnL2 Lt) :
    C2fullOf (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)) (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U) ((covE h).pull d z) =
      (covBIdx h S hp hell).pull d (C2fullOf (geomOf ell k (towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S)) (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U) z)

AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_comm.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_comm
AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_comm.header: theorem pcd_comm (N a b : ℕ) : pcd N a b = pcd N b a

AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_mod_le_aux.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_mod_le_aux
AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_mod_le_aux.header:
theorem pcd_mod_le_aux (m n a b : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (ha : a < m * n) (hb : b ≤ a) :
    pcd m (a % m) (b % m) ≤ pcd (m * n) a b

AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_mod_le.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_mod_le
AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_mod_le.header:
theorem pcd_mod_le (m n a b : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (ha : a < m * n) (hb : b < m * n) :
    pcd m (a % m) (b % m) ≤ pcd (m * n) a b

AdalyFormal.Thin.lift_displace.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.lift_displace
AdalyFormal.Thin.lift_displace.header:
theorem lift_displace (N m a y t : ℕ) (hmN : m ∣ N) (ha : a < N) (ht : t ≤ N) (hmod : (a % m + t) % m = y) :
    ∃ b, b < N ∧ b % m = y ∧ pcd N a b ≤ t ∧ pcd N a b ≤ N - t

AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_mod_le'.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_mod_le'
AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_mod_le'.header:
theorem pcd_mod_le' (m a y : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hy : y < m) :
    pcd m (a % m) y = min ((y + m - a % m) % m) ((a % m + m - y) % m)

AdalyFormal.Thin.aux_back.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.aux_back
AdalyFormal.Thin.aux_back.header:
theorem aux_back (m s c y : ℕ) (hc : c < m) (hy : y < m) (hs : 0 < s) :
    (c + (m * s - (c + m - y) % m)) % m = y

AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_lift.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_lift
AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_lift.header:
theorem pcd_lift (N m a y : ℕ) (hmN : m ∣ N) (hm : 0 < m) (ha : a < N) (hy : y < m) :
    ∃ b, b < N ∧ b % m = y ∧ pcd N a b ≤ pcd m (a % m) y

AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_proj.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_proj
AdalyFormal.Thin.pcd_proj.header:
theorem pcd_proj (m N a b : ℕ) (hmN : m ∣ N) (hm : 0 < m) (ha : a < N) (hb : b < N) :
    pcd m (a % m) (b % m) ≤ pcd N a b

AdalyFormal.Thin.pdist_proj_le.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.pdist_proj_le
AdalyFormal.Thin.pdist_proj_le.header:
theorem pdist_proj_le {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) :
    pdist (projS h x) (projS h y) ≤ pdist x y

AdalyFormal.Thin.exists_lift_site.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.exists_lift_site
AdalyFormal.Thin.exists_lift_site.header:
theorem exists_lift_site {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    ∃ w : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt, projS h w = y ∧ pdist z w ≤ pdist (projS h z) y

AdalyFormal.Thin.liftTower.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.liftTower
AdalyFormal.Thin.liftTower.header: def liftTower {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (S : Tower L) : Tower Lt

AdalyFormal.Thin.mem_liftTower.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.mem_liftTower
AdalyFormal.Thin.mem_liftTower.header:
theorem mem_liftTower {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (S : Tower L) (j : ℕ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) : x ∈ (liftTower h S).Om j ↔ projS h x ∈ S.Om j

AdalyFormal.Thin.div_mod_block.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.div_mod_block
AdalyFormal.Thin.div_mod_block.header:
theorem div_mod_block (s m a b : ℕ) (hsm : s ∣ m) (hab : a / s = b / s) :
    (a % m) / s = (b % m) / s

AdalyFormal.Thin.projS_block.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.projS_block
AdalyFormal.Thin.projS_block.header:
theorem projS_block {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (s : ℕ) (hs : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s ∣ L μ + 1)
    (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) (hxy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val / s = (x μ).val / s) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (projS h y μ).val / s = (projS h x μ).val / s

AdalyFormal.Thin.blockClosed_lift.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.blockClosed_lift
AdalyFormal.Thin.blockClosed_lift.header:
theorem blockClosed_lift {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (s : ℕ) (hs : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s ∣ L μ + 1)
    (A : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (hA : BlockClosed s A) : BlockClosed s (projS h ⁻¹' A)

AdalyFormal.Thin.block_lift_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.block_lift_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.block_lift_nat.header:
theorem block_lift_nat (s m N a z : ℕ) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hsm : s ∣ m) (hmN : m ∣ N) (ha : a < N)
    (hz : z < m) (hzb : z / s = (a % m) / s) : ∃ b, b < N ∧ b % m = z ∧ b / s = a / s

AdalyFormal.Thin.exists_lift_in_block.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.exists_lift_in_block
AdalyFormal.Thin.exists_lift_in_block.header:
theorem exists_lift_in_block {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (s : ℕ) (hs0 : 0 < s)
    (hs : ∀ μ : Fin 3, s ∣ L μ + 1) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hz : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (z μ).val / s = (projS h x μ).val / s) :
    ∃ w : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt, projS h w = z ∧ ∀ μ : Fin 3, (w μ).val / s = (x μ).val / s

AdalyFormal.Thin.admissible_lift.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.admissible_lift
AdalyFormal.Thin.admissible_lift.header:
theorem admissible_lift {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L}
    (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) : Admissible ell M R k (liftTower h S)

AdalyFormal.Thin.scaleUp_add_one.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.scaleUp_add_one
AdalyFormal.Thin.scaleUp_add_one.header:
theorem scaleUp_add_one (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (μ : Fin 3) :
    scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1 = (Lu μ + 1) * ell ^ k

AdalyFormal.Thin.covers_scaleUp.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.covers_scaleUp
AdalyFormal.Thin.covers_scaleUp.header:
theorem covers_scaleUp (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) {Lut Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lut Lu) :
    Covers (scaleUp ell k Lut) (scaleUp ell k Lu)

AdalyFormal.Thin.torusOK_lift.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.torusOK_lift
AdalyFormal.Thin.torusOK_lift.header:
theorem torusOK_lift {Lut Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lut Lu) {ell M : ℕ}
    (hT : TorusOK ell M Lu) : TorusOK ell M Lut

AdalyFormal.Thin.lambdaOK_lift.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.lambdaOK_lift
AdalyFormal.Thin.lambdaOK_lift.header:
theorem lambdaOK_lift {Lut Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hu : Covers Lut Lu) {ell M R k : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hT : TorusOK ell M Lu) {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} {Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)}
    (hL : LambdaOK ell M R k S Lam) :
    LambdaOK ell M R k (liftTower (covers_scaleUp ell k hell hu) S) (projS hu ⁻¹' Lam)

AdalyFormal.Thin.inBlock_iff_div.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.inBlock_iff_div
AdalyFormal.Thin.inBlock_iff_div.header:
theorem inBlock_iff_div {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hy : ∀ μ : Fin 3, (y μ).val % ell = 0) :
    inBlock y ell x ↔ ∀ μ : Fin 3, (x μ).val / ell = (y μ).val / ell

AdalyFormal.Thin.lamBlockSum_lift.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.lamBlockSum_lift

AdalyFormal.Thin.off.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.off
AdalyFormal.Thin.off.header: def off (m z x : ℕ) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.Thin.off_proj.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.off_proj
AdalyFormal.Thin.off_proj.header:
theorem off_proj (m N x z : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hmN : m ∣ N) (hx : x < N) (hz : z < N) :
    off m (z % m) (x % m) = off N z x % m

AdalyFormal.Thin.lift_off.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.lift_off
AdalyFormal.Thin.lift_off.header:
theorem lift_off (N m a y t : ℕ) (hmN : m ∣ N) (ha : a < N) (ht : t < N) (hmod : (a % m + t) % m = y) :
    ∃ b, b < N ∧ b % m = y ∧ (b + N - a) % N = t

AdalyFormal.Thin.mem_siteBox_iff.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.mem_siteBox_iff
AdalyFormal.Thin.mem_siteBox_iff.header:
theorem mem_siteBox_iff {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (z x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ) :
    x ∈ siteBox z s ↔ ∀ μ : Fin 3, off (L μ + 1) (z μ).val (x μ).val < s

AdalyFormal.Thin.box_proj_subset.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.box_proj_subset
AdalyFormal.Thin.box_proj_subset.header:
theorem box_proj_subset {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (z x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) (s : ℕ)
    (hx : x ∈ siteBox z s) : projS h x ∈ siteBox (projS h z) s

AdalyFormal.Thin.box_proj_surj.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.box_proj_surj
AdalyFormal.Thin.box_proj_surj.header:
theorem box_proj_surj {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ) (hy : y ∈ siteBox (projS h z) s) :
    ∃ x ∈ siteBox z s, projS h x = y

AdalyFormal.Thin.off_lt.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.off_lt
AdalyFormal.Thin.off_lt.header: theorem off_lt (m z x : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : off m z x < m

AdalyFormal.Thin.off_spec.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.off_spec
AdalyFormal.Thin.off_spec.header: theorem off_spec (m z x : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hz : z < m) : (z + off m z x) % m = x % m

AdalyFormal.Thin.off_unique.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.off_unique
AdalyFormal.Thin.off_unique.header:
theorem off_unique (m z x t : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hz : z < m) (ht : t < m) (h : (z + t) % m = x % m) :
    off m z x = t

AdalyFormal.Thin.corner_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.corner_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.corner_nat.header:
theorem corner_nat (b m N s x z : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hbm : b ∣ m) (hmN : m ∣ N) (hbN : b < N) (hbs : b < s)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hz : z < m) (hzb : z % b = 0) (hx : x < N) (p : ℕ)
    (hin0 : off m z (x % m) < s) (hin1 : p = 1 → off m z ((x + 1) % m) < s) :
    ∃ w, w < N ∧ w % b = 0 ∧ (w % m = z ∨ m ≤ s) ∧ off N w x < s ∧
      (p = 1 → off N w ((x + 1) % N) < s)

AdalyFormal.Thin.projE.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.projE
AdalyFormal.Thin.projE.header: def projE {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt) : PeriodicLatticeEdge L

AdalyFormal.Thin.liftU.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.liftU
AdalyFormal.Thin.liftU.header: def liftU {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (U : LinkCfg L) : LinkCfg Lt

AdalyFormal.Thin.projE_shift.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.projE_shift
AdalyFormal.Thin.projE_shift.header:
theorem projE_shift {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt) :
    projS h (periodicLatticeShift e.1 e.2) = periodicLatticeShift (projE h e).1 (projE h e).2

AdalyFormal.Thin.shift_injective.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.shift_injective
AdalyFormal.Thin.shift_injective.header:
theorem shift_injective {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3)
    (h : periodicLatticeShift x μ = periodicLatticeShift y μ) : x = y

AdalyFormal.Thin.projS_shiftBack.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.projS_shiftBack
AdalyFormal.Thin.projS_shiftBack.header:
theorem projS_shiftBack {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) (μ : Fin 3) :
    projS h (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ) = periodicLatticeShiftBack (projS h x) μ

AdalyFormal.Thin.gauge_lift.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.gauge_lift
AdalyFormal.Thin.gauge_lift.header:
theorem gauge_lift {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (U : LinkCfg L) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt) :
    periodicGaugeTransform (fun x => g (projS h x)) (liftU h U) e = periodicGaugeTransform g U (projE h e)

AdalyFormal.Thin.isClassCube_of_describe.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.isClassCube_of_described

AdalyFormal.Thin.lift1.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.lift1
AdalyFormal.Thin.lift1.header:
theorem lift1 (N m z y s : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hmN : m ∣ N) (hz : z < N) (hy : y < m) (hs : off m (z % m) y < s) :
    ∃ b, b < N ∧ b % m = y ∧ off N z b < s

AdalyFormal.Thin.CompatCorner.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.CompatCorner
AdalyFormal.Thin.CompatCorner.header:
def CompatCorner {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (zt : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Thin.corner_site.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.corner_site
AdalyFormal.Thin.corner_site.header:
theorem corner_site {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, L μ + 1 < Lt μ + 1)
    (b s : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hbs : b < s) (hbd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, b ∣ L μ + 1)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hzb : GridCorner b z) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) (pf : Fin 3 → ℕ)
    (hin0 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, off (L μ + 1) (z μ).val ((x μ).val % (L μ + 1)) < s)
    (hin1 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, pf μ = 1 → off (L μ + 1) (z μ).val (((x μ).val + 1) % (L μ + 1)) < s) :
    ∃ zt : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt, GridCorner b zt ∧ CompatCorner h zt z s ∧
      ∀ μ : Fin 3, off (Lt μ + 1) (zt μ).val (x μ).val < s ∧
        (pf μ = 1 → off (Lt μ + 1) (zt μ).val (((x μ).val + 1) % (Lt μ + 1)) < s)

AdalyFormal.Thin.liftA.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.liftA
AdalyFormal.Thin.liftA.header:
def liftA {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (A : Bond L → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    Bond Lt → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ

AdalyFormal.Thin.cubeBond_lift.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.cubeBond_lift
AdalyFormal.Thin.cubeBond_lift.header:
theorem cubeBond_lift {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) {zt : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt} {s : ℕ}
    {e : Bond Lt} (he : CubeBond (siteBox zt s) e) : CubeBond (siteBox (projS h zt) s) (projE h e)

AdalyFormal.Thin.curlReads_lift.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.curlReads_lift

AdalyFormal.Thin.curlA_lift.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.curlA_lift
AdalyFormal.Thin.curlA_lift.header:
theorem curlA_lift {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (η : ℝ)
    (A : Bond L → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) (a b : Fin 3) :
    curlA η (liftA h A) x a b = curlA η A (projS h x) a b

AdalyFormal.Thin.ddA_lift.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.ddA_lift
AdalyFormal.Thin.ddA_lift.header:
theorem ddA_lift {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (η : ℝ)
    (A : Bond L → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ddA η (liftA h A) x μ = ddA η A (projS h x) μ

AdalyFormal.Thin.perCube_lift.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.perCube_lift

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.tower_FG_gen.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.tower_FG_gen
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.tower_FG_gen.header:
theorem tower_FG_gen (hell : 0 < ell) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell bg k)
    (hcl : ∀ j, j < k → ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ j), ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((bg j (y, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ ε j)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (a : XS (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ k →
      nrm (ell ^ j) (QlinCompX ell bg j a)
        ≤ (rr ell) ^ j * Real.exp ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, thetaOf ell (ε i)) / rr ell) * nrm 1 a
      ∧ nrm (ell ^ j) (QlinCompX ell bg j a - QlinCompX ell (flatBg ell k Lu) j a)
        ≤ (rr ell) ^ j * ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, thetaOf ell (ε i)) / rr ell)
            * Real.exp ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, thetaOf ell (ε i)) / rr ell) * nrm 1 a

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rows_sum_le.header:

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rows_FG_loc.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rows_FG_loc
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rows_FG_loc.header:
theorem rows_FG_loc (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (W : ℕ → Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hcl : ∀ l, l < k → ∀ z ∈ W l, z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ l) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((bg l (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ ε l)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (hr : ∀ j, j < k → Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ε j) < r0)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) (X : Finset (PeriodicLatticeEdge (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hX : ∀ b ∈ X, b.1 ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ j))
    (hW : ∀ b ∈ X, ∀ l, l < j → Ball b.1 (rhoT ell j - rhoT ell l) ⊆ W l)
    (a : XS (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    (∑ b ∈ X, ‖suOf (QlinCompL ell bg j a b)‖ ^ 2
        ≤ ((rr ell) ^ j * Real.exp ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, thetaOf ell (ε i)) / rr ell) * nrm 1 a) ^ 2)
    ∧ (∑ b ∈ X, ‖suOf ((QlinCompL ell bg j a - QlinCompL ell (flatBg ell k Lu) j a) b)‖ ^ 2
        ≤ ((rr ell) ^ j * ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, thetaOf ell (ε i)) / rr ell)
            * Real.exp ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, thetaOf ell (ε i)) / rr ell) * nrm 1 a) ^ 2)

theorem cut_reg (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)

    (W : ℕ → Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hcl : ∀ l, l < k → ∀ z ∈ W l, z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ l) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((bg l (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ ε l)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j)
    (hr : ∀ j, j < k → Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ε j) < r0) :
    RegTower ell (bgCut ell bg W) k

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.compL_row_local_loc.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.compL_row_local_loc
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.compL_row_local_loc.header:

    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (W : ℕ → Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hcl : ∀ l, l < k → ∀ z ∈ W l, z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ l) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((bg l (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ ε l)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j)
    (hr : ∀ j, j < k → Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ε j) < r0)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) (b : PeriodicLatticeEdge (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hb : b.1 ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ j))
    (hW : ∀ l, l < j → Ball b.1 (rhoT ell j - rhoT ell l) ⊆ W l)
    (v : XS (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hv : ∀ e, Foot ell j b e → v e = 0) :
    QlinCompL ell bg j v b = 0

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.compL_row_local_fla.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.compL_row_local_flat
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.compL_row_local_fla.header:

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.delLoc.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.delLoc

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.level_drift_loc.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.level_drift_loc
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.level_drift_loc.header:
theorem level_drift_loc (hell : 0 < ell) (V : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (W : ℕ → Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hcl : ∀ l, l < k → ∀ z ∈ W l, z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ l) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((bgTower (GF ell k Lu) V l (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ ε l)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (hr : ∀ j, j < k → Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ε j) < r0)
    (j : Fin (k + 1))
    (hW : ∀ r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j}, ∀ l, l < (j : ℕ) →
      Ball r.1.1 (rhoT ell j - rhoT ell l) ⊆ W l)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j},
      ((ell : ℝ) ^ (j : ℕ)) ^ 3 * ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull x ⟨j, r⟩
        - (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull x ⟨j, r⟩‖ ^ 2
      ≤ delLoc ell ε j ^ 2 * ‖bondRestr (FootL (S := S) j) x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.τ_inj.header: theorem Cov.τ_inj (x0 : Xt) : Function.Injective (fun d => c.τ d x0)

AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.fibre_card.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.fibre_card
AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.fibre_card.header: theorem Cov.fibre_card (x : X) : (Finset.univ.filter (fun xt => c.π xt = x)).card = Fintype.card D

AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.sig.header: noncomputable def Cov.sig : PiLp 2 (fun _ : Xt => E) →L[ℝ] PiLp 2 (fun _ : X => E)

AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.sig_apply.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.sig_apply

AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.sig_ell.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.sig_ell
AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.sig_ell.header: theorem Cov.sig_ell (f : PiLp 2 (fun _ : X => E)) : c.sig (c.ell f) = (Fintype.card D : ℝ) • f

AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.pull_ell.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.pull_ell
AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.pull_ell.header: theorem Cov.pull_ell (d : D) (f : PiLp 2 (fun _ : X => E)) : c.pull d (c.ell f) = c.ell f

AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.sum_pull.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.sum_pull
AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.sum_pull.header: theorem Cov.sum_pull (f : PiLp 2 (fun _ : Xt => E)) : ∑ d, c.pull d f = c.ell (c.sig f)

theorem liftF_perm_cancel (g : Equiv.Perm Z) (u : PiLp 2 (fun _ : Z => E)) :

theorem adjoint_liftF_perm (g : Equiv.Perm Z) :

AdalyFormal.Thin.liftF_perm_cancel'.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.liftF_perm_cancel'
AdalyFormal.Thin.liftF_perm_cancel'.header:
theorem liftF_perm_cancel' (g : Equiv.Perm Z) (u : PiLp 2 (fun _ : Z => E)) :

AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_starProjection.header:

    (Φ : PiLp 2 (fun _ : X => E) →L[ℝ] PiLp 2 (fun _ : X => E))
    (Φt : PiLp 2 (fun _ : Xt => E) →L[ℝ] PiLp 2 (fun _ : Xt => E)) (hΦ : Desc cX cX Φ Φt)

    (ha : ∀ f ∈ N, cX.ell f ∈ Nt) (hb : ∀ f ∈ Nt, cX.sig f ∈ N)

    (K : Submodule ℝ (PiLp 2 (fun _ : X => E))) (Kt : Submodule ℝ (PiLp 2 (fun _ : Xt => E)))
    (memK : ∀ w, w ∈ K ↔ ∃ m ∈ N, Φ m = w) (memKt : ∀ w, w ∈ Kt ↔ ∃ m ∈ Nt, Φt m = w) :
