AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.drift_F_loc.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.drift_F_loc
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.drift_F_loc.header:
theorem drift_F_loc (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)
    (V : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (W : ℕ → ℕ → Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hcl : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∀ l, l < k → ∀ z ∈ W j l, z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ l) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((bgTower (GF ell k Lu) V l (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ ε j l)
    (hε0 : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∀ l, l < k → 0 ≤ ε j l)
    (hsm : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∀ l, l < k → rhoOf ell (ε j l) < Real.pi / 2)
    (hr : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∀ l, l < k → Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ε j l) < r0)
    (hW : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1),
      ∀ r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j}, ∀ l, l < (j : ℕ) →
        Ball r.1.1 (rhoT ell j - rhoT ell l) ⊆ W j l)
    (Sstar : ℝ) (hSstar : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∑ l ∈ range (j : ℕ), thetaOf ell (ε j l) ≤ Sstar)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ p, wF p * ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull x p
        - (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 3 * delStar ell Sstar ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.qs_injective_loc.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.qs_injective_loc
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.qs_injective_loc.header:
theorem qs_injective_loc (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (ε : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (W : ℕ → ℕ → Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hcl : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∀ l, l < k → ∀ z ∈ W j l, z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ l) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U l (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ ε j l)
    (hε0 : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∀ l, l < k → 0 ≤ ε j l)
    (hsm : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∀ l, l < k → rhoOf ell (ε j l) < Real.pi / 2)
    (hr : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∀ l, l < k → Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ε j l) < r0)
    (hW : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1),
      ∀ r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j}, ∀ l, l < (j : ℕ) →
        Ball r.1.1 (rhoT ell j - rhoT ell l) ⊆ W j l)
    (Sstar : ℝ) (hSstar : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), ∑ l ∈ range (j : ℕ), thetaOf ell (ε j l) ≤ Sstar)
    (hsmall : 3 * delStar ell Sstar ^ 2 * CEp < 1) :
    Function.Injective (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).data.Qs

AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_decomp.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_decomp
AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_decomp.header:
theorem tau_decomp (x m n d : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hx : x < m * n) :
    (x + d * m) % (m * n) = x % m + m * (((x / m) + d) % n)

AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_lt.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_lt
AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_lt.header: theorem tau_lt (x m n d : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hx : x < m * n) : (x + d * m) % (m * n) < m * n

AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_free.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_free
AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_free.header:
theorem tau_free (x y m n : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hx : x < m * n) (hy : y < m * n) (hxy : x % m = y % m) :
    ∃ d, d < n ∧ (x + d * m) % (m * n) = y

AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_unique.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_unique
AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_unique.header:
theorem tau_unique (x m n d d' : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hx : x < m * n) (hd : d < n) (hd' : d' < n)
    (h : (x + d * m) % (m * n) = (x + d' * m) % (m * n)) : d = d'

AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_inv_left.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_inv_left
AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_inv_left.header:
theorem tau_inv_left (x m n d : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hx : x < m * n) (hd : d ≤ n) :
    ((x + d * m) % (m * n) + (n - d) * m) % (m * n) = x

AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_inv_left'.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_inv_left'
AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_inv_left'.header:
theorem tau_inv_left' (x N m n d : ℕ) (hN : m * n = N) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hx : x < N) (hd : d ≤ n) :
    ((x + d * m) % N + (n - d) * m) % N = x

AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_free'.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_free'
AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_free'.header:
theorem tau_free' (x y N m n : ℕ) (hN : m * n = N) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hx : x < N) (hy : y < N)
    (hxy : x % m = y % m) : ∃ d, d < n ∧ (x + d * m) % N = y

AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_unique'.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_unique'
AdalyFormal.Thin.tau_unique'.header:
theorem tau_unique' (x N m n d d' : ℕ) (hN : m * n = N) (hm : 0 < m) (hx : x < N) (hd : d < n) (hd' : d' < n)
    (h : (x + d * m) % N = (x + d' * m) % N) : d = d'

AdalyFormal.Thin.nn.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.nn
AdalyFormal.Thin.nn.header: def nn (Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (μ : Fin 3) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.Thin.mul_nn.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.mul_nn
AdalyFormal.Thin.mul_nn.header: theorem mul_nn {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (μ : Fin 3) : (L μ + 1) * nn Lt L μ = Lt μ + 1

AdalyFormal.Thin.nn_pos.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.nn_pos
AdalyFormal.Thin.nn_pos.header: theorem nn_pos {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (μ : Fin 3) : 0 < nn Lt L μ

AdalyFormal.Thin.deckIdx_nonempty.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.deckIdx_nonempty
AdalyFormal.Thin.deckIdx_nonempty.header: theorem deckIdx_nonempty {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) : Nonempty (DeckIdx Lt L)

AdalyFormal.Thin.tauS.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.tauS
AdalyFormal.Thin.tauS.header:
def tauS {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (d : DeckIdx Lt L) :
    Equiv.Perm (PeriodicLatticeSite Lt)

AdalyFormal.Thin.tauS_val.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.tauS_val
AdalyFormal.Thin.tauS_val.header:
theorem tauS_val {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (d : DeckIdx Lt L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (tauS h d x μ).val = ((x μ).val + (d μ).val * (L μ + 1)) % (Lt μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.Thin.projS_tauS.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.projS_tauS
AdalyFormal.Thin.projS_tauS.header:
theorem projS_tauS {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (d : DeckIdx Lt L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) :
    projS h (tauS h d x) = projS h x

AdalyFormal.Thin.projS_surj.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.projS_surj
AdalyFormal.Thin.projS_surj.header: theorem projS_surj {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) : Function.Surjective (projS h)

AdalyFormal.Thin.site_free.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.site_free
AdalyFormal.Thin.site_free.header:
theorem site_free {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt)
    (hxy : projS h x = projS h y) : ∃! d : DeckIdx Lt L, tauS h d x = y

AdalyFormal.Thin.covS.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.covS
AdalyFormal.Thin.covS.header: def covS {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) : Cov (DeckIdx Lt L) (PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.prodR.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.prodR
AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.prodR.header: def Cov.prodR (c : Cov D Xt X) (K : Type) [Fintype K] : Cov D (Xt × K) (X × K)

AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.sub.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.sub
AdalyFormal.Thin.Cov.sub.header: def Cov.sub (c : Cov D Xt X) (P : X → Prop) : Cov D {xt : Xt // P (c.π xt)} {x : X // P x}

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.pdist_shift1.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.pdist_shift1
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.pdist_shift1.header:
theorem pdist_shift1 {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {x w : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {n : ℕ} (h : pdist x w ≤ n) (d : Fin 3) :
    pdist x (coarseShift w 1 d) ≤ n + 1

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.BInT.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.BInT
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.BInT.header: def BInT (S : Tower L) (j0 : ℕ) (e : Bond L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.m1ChartT.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.m1ChartT
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.m1ChartT.header:
def m1ChartT {ell M f k : ℕ} (S : Tower L) {α₀ η : ℝ} (U : LinkCfg L)
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite L → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (A : Bond L → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hU : ∀ e : Bond L, ((periodicGaugeTransform g U e : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
        = NormedSpace.exp (((η : ℂ) * Complex.I) • A e))
    (hB : M1Bounds S ell M f k α₀ η A) (j0 : ℕ) (hj0 : j0 ≤ k) :
    CubeChart U (BInT S j0) η ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀ * (((ell : ℝ) ^ j0 * η)⁻¹ ^ 1))
      ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀ * (((ell : ℝ) ^ j0 * η)⁻¹ ^ 2))

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.m1_link_loc.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.m1_link_loc
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.m1_link_loc.header:
theorem m1_link_loc (hη : 0 < η) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (ha0 : 0 ≤ (f : ℝ) * M * α₀) (j0 : ℕ) (hj0 : j0 ≤ k) (b : Bond L)
    (h1 : b.1 ∈ S.Om j0) (h2 : periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ S.Om j0) :
    dv (periodicGaugeTransform g U b) ≤ (4 * Real.pi + 4) * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀) / (ell : ℝ) ^ j0

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.m1_plaq_loc.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.m1_plaq_loc
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.m1_plaq_loc.header:
theorem m1_plaq_loc (hη : 0 < η) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (ha0 : 0 ≤ (f : ℝ) * M * α₀) (ha1 : (f : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ 1)
    (j0 : ℕ) (hj0 : j0 ≤ k) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν μ : Fin 3)
    (h1 : y ∈ S.Om j0) (h2 : coarseShift y 1 ν ∈ S.Om j0) (h3 : coarseShift y 1 μ ∈ S.Om j0)
    (h4 : coarseShift (coarseShift y 1 ν) 1 μ ∈ S.Om j0) :
    dv (pw 1 (periodicGaugeTransform g U) y ν μ) ≤ (4 * Real.pi + 4) * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀) / (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * j0)

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.tower_link_loc.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.tower_link_loc
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.tower_link_loc.header:
theorem tower_link_loc {ell M k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hT3 : ∀ μ, 3 ≤ Lu μ + 1) {f : ℕ} {α₀ η : ℝ}
    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (A : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hU : ∀ e : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu), ((periodicGaugeTransform g U e : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
        Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) = NormedSpace.exp (((η : ℂ) * Complex.I) • A e))
    (hB : M1Bounds S ell M f k α₀ η A) (hη : 0 < η)
    (ha0 : 0 ≤ (f : ℝ) * M * α₀) (ha1 : (f : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ 1)
    (hsm : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀)) ≤ 1)
    (j0 l : ℕ) (hj0 : j0 ≤ k) (hl : l ≤ j0) (hlk : l < k)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hz : z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ l)) (μ : Fin 3)
    (hcone : ∀ w, pdist z w ≤ 14 * ell ^ l → w ∈ S.Om j0) :
    dv (AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.ubarTowerSU2 ell (periodicGaugeTransform g U) l (z, μ))
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ l * ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀) / (ell : ℝ) ^ j0)
        + 3 * Real.pi * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * ((f : ℝ) * M * α₀) / (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * j0)))

AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS
AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS.header: def phiS {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (_h : Covers Lt L) (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_val.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_val
AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_val.header:
theorem phiS_val {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (phiS h o x μ).val = ((x μ).val + o μ) % (L μ + 1)

AdalyFormal.Thin.mod_shift_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.mod_shift_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.mod_shift_nat.header: theorem mod_shift_nat (a o m N : ℕ) (hmN : m ∣ N) : ((a + 1) % N + o) % m = ((a + o) % m + 1) % m

AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_shift.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_shift
AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_shift.header:
theorem phiS_shift {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) (μ : Fin 3) :
    phiS h o (periodicLatticeShift x μ) = periodicLatticeShift (phiS h o x) μ

AdalyFormal.Thin.projS_eq_phiS.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.projS_eq_phiS
AdalyFormal.Thin.projS_eq_phiS.header: theorem projS_eq_phiS {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) : projS h = phiS h (fun _ => 0)

AdalyFormal.Thin.tauS_eq_phiS.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.tauS_eq_phiS
AdalyFormal.Thin.tauS_eq_phiS.header:
theorem tauS_eq_phiS {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (d : DeckIdx Lt L) :
    (tauS h d : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt → PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) = phiS (Covers.refl Lt) (fun μ => (d μ).val * (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Thin.phiE.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.phiE
AdalyFormal.Thin.phiE.header: def phiE {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt) : PeriodicLatticeEdge L

AdalyFormal.Thin.covE.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.covE
AdalyFormal.Thin.covE.header:
def covE {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) :
    Cov (DeckIdx Lt L) (PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt) (PeriodicLatticeEdge L)

AdalyFormal.Thin.covE_pi.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.covE_pi
AdalyFormal.Thin.covE_pi.header: theorem covE_pi {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) : (covE h).π = phiE h (fun _ => 0)

AdalyFormal.Thin.covE_tau.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.covE_tau
AdalyFormal.Thin.covE_tau.header:
theorem covE_tau {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (d : DeckIdx Lt L) :
    ((covE h).τ d : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt → PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt) =
      phiE (Covers.refl Lt) (fun μ => (d μ).val * (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Thin.pullCfg.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.pullCfg
AdalyFormal.Thin.pullCfg.header: def pullCfg {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (U : Cfg L) : Cfg Lt

AdalyFormal.Thin.gradL2_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.gradL2_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.gradL2_nat.header:
theorem gradL2_nat {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (U : Cfg L)
    (f : SiteL2 L) :
    gradL2 (pullCfg h o U) (liftF (phiS h o) f) = liftF (phiE h o) (gradL2 U f)

AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_shiftBack.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_shiftBack
AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_shiftBack.header:
theorem phiS_shiftBack {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) (μ : Fin 3) :
    phiS h o (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ) = periodicLatticeShiftBack (phiS h o x) μ

AdalyFormal.Thin.gradAdj_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.gradAdj_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.gradAdj_nat.header:
theorem gradAdj_nat {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (U : Cfg L)
    (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    gradAdj (pullCfg h o U) (liftF (phiE h o) A) = liftF (phiS h o) (gradAdj U A)

AdalyFormal.Thin.siteMask_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.siteMask_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.siteMask_nat.header:
theorem siteMask_nat {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (S : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L))
    (f : SiteL2 L) :
    siteMask (phiS h o ⁻¹' S) (liftF (phiS h o) f) = liftF (phiS h o) (siteMask S f)

AdalyFormal.Thin.covS_pi.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.covS_pi
AdalyFormal.Thin.covS_pi.header: theorem covS_pi {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) : (covS h).π = phiS h (fun _ => 0)

AdalyFormal.Thin.covS_tau.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.covS_tau
AdalyFormal.Thin.covS_tau.header:
theorem covS_tau {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (d : DeckIdx Lt L) :
    ((covS h).τ d : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt → PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) =
      phiS (Covers.refl Lt) (fun μ => (d μ).val * (L μ + 1))

AdalyFormal.Thin.pullCfg_tau.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.pullCfg_tau
AdalyFormal.Thin.pullCfg_tau.header:
theorem pullCfg_tau {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (d : DeckIdx Lt L) (U : Cfg L) :
    pullCfg (Covers.refl Lt) (fun μ => (d μ).val * (L μ + 1)) (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U) = pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U

AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_of_nat_phi.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_of_nat_phi
AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_of_nat_phi.header:
theorem desc_of_nat_phi {D X Xt Y Yt : Type} [Fintype D] [Fintype X] [Fintype Xt] [Fintype Y] [Fintype Yt]
    [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Xt] [DecidableEq Y] [DecidableEq Yt] [Nonempty D]
    {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (cX : Cov D Xt X) (cY : Cov D Yt Y)
    (O : PiLp 2 (fun _ : X => E) →L[ℝ] PiLp 2 (fun _ : Y => E))
    (Ot : PiLp 2 (fun _ : Xt => E) →L[ℝ] PiLp 2 (fun _ : Yt => E))
    (φX : Xt → X) (φY : Yt → Y) (ψX : D → Xt → Xt) (ψY : D → Yt → Yt)
    (hπX : cX.π = φX) (hπY : cY.π = φY) (hτX : ∀ d, ⇑(cX.τ d) = ψX d) (hτY : ∀ d, ⇑(cY.τ d) = ψY d)
    (e1 : ∀ f, Ot (liftF φX f) = liftF φY (O f))
    (eq : ∀ d f, Ot (liftF (ψX d) f) = liftF (ψY d) (Ot f)) : Desc cX cY O Ot

AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_gradL2.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_gradL2
AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_gradL2.header:
theorem desc_gradL2 {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (U : Cfg L) :
    Desc (covS h) (covE h) (gradL2 U) (gradL2 (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U))

AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_gradAdj.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_gradAdj
AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_gradAdj.header:
theorem desc_gradAdj {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (U : Cfg L) :
    Desc (covE h) (covS h) (gradAdj U) (gradAdj (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U))

AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_siteMask.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_siteMask
AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_siteMask.header:
theorem desc_siteMask {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (S : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) :
    Desc (covS h) (covS h) (siteMask S) (siteMask (phiS h (fun _ => 0) ⁻¹' S))

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rho1.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rho1
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rho1.header: def rho1 (f M : ℕ) (α₀ : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.epsM.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.epsM
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.epsM.header: def epsM (ell f M : ℕ) (α₀ : ℝ) (j l : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.SstarM.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.SstarM
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.SstarM.header: def SstarM (ell f M : ℕ) (α₀ : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rho1_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rho1_nonneg
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.rho1_nonneg.header: theorem rho1_nonneg (f M : ℕ) (α₀ : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀) : 0 ≤ rho1 f M α₀

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.epsM_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.epsM_nonneg
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.epsM_nonneg.header: theorem epsM_nonneg (ell f M : ℕ) (α₀ : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀) (j l : ℕ) : 0 ≤ epsM ell f M α₀ j l

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.epsM_le.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.epsM_le
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.epsM_le.header:
theorem epsM_le (ell f M : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (α₀ : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀) (j l : ℕ) :
    epsM ell f M α₀ j l ≤ (1 + 3 * Real.pi) * rho1 f M α₀

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.geom_le.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.geom_le
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.geom_le.header:
theorem geom_le (x : ℝ) (hx : 2 ≤ x) (j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    ∑ l ∈ range j, x ^ l ≤ 2 * x ^ (j - 1)

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.sum_epsM.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.sum_epsM
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.sum_epsM.header:
theorem sum_epsM (ell f M : ℕ) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (α₀ : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀) (j : ℕ) :
    ∑ l ∈ range j, epsM ell f M α₀ j l ≤ 2 * (1 + 3 * Real.pi) * rho1 f M α₀

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.theta_le.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.theta_le
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.theta_le.header:
theorem theta_le (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (ε : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hle : ε ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)) :
    thetaOf ell ε ≤ Ctheta * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * ε

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.sum_theta_epsM.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.sum_theta_epsM
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.sum_theta_epsM.header:
theorem sum_theta_epsM (ell f M : ℕ) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (α₀ : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀)
    (hsmA : (1 + 3 * Real.pi) * rho1 f M α₀ ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4)) (j : ℕ) :
    ∑ l ∈ range j, thetaOf ell (epsM ell f M α₀ j l) ≤ SstarM ell f M α₀

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.WM.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.WM
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.WM.header: def WM (ell k : ℕ) (S : Tower L) (j l : ℕ) : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.cone_in_Om.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.cone_in_Om
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.cone_in_Om.header:
theorem cone_in_Om {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) {j l : ℕ} (hjk : j ≤ k) {z : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hz : z ∈ WM ell k S j l)
    (w : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hw : pdist z w ≤ 14 * ell ^ l) : w ∈ S.Om (j - 1)

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.hcl_M1.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.hcl_M1
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.hcl_M1.header:
theorem hcl_M1 (j : Fin (k + 1)) (l : ℕ) (hlk : l < k) (z : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hzW : z ∈ WM ell k S j l) (hzA : z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ l)) (μ : Fin 3) :
    frobNorm (((bgTower (GF ell k Lu) (periodicGaugeTransform g U) l (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1)
      ≤ epsM ell f M α₀ j l

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.drift_F_M1.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.drift_F_M1
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.drift_F_M1.header:
theorem drift_F_M1 (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R) (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ p, wF p * ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (periodicGaugeTransform g U)).Qfull x p
        - (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 3 * delStar ell (SstarM ell f M α₀) ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.qs_injective_M1.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.qs_injective_M1
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.qs_injective_M1.header:
theorem qs_injective_M1 (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hsmall : 3 * delStar ell (SstarM ell f M α₀) ^ 2 * CEp < 1) :
    Function.Injective (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).data.Qs

AdalyFormal.Thin.dstarDLoc_eq_comp.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.dstarDLoc_eq_comp
AdalyFormal.Thin.dstarDLoc_eq_comp.header:
theorem dstarDLoc_eq_comp {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (U : Cfg L) (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) :
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (dstarDLoc U P) =
      (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (curlCovariantCLM_L2 U)).comp
        ((LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (plaqMask P)).comp (curlCovariantCLM_L2 U))

AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_dstarDLoc.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_dstarDLoc
AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_dstarDLoc.header:
theorem desc_dstarDLoc {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (U : Cfg L) (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) :
    Desc (covE h) (covE h) (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (dstarDLoc U P))
      (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (dstarDLoc (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U) (phiP h (fun _ => 0) ⁻¹' P)))

AdalyFormal.Thin.raw_pull.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.raw_pull
AdalyFormal.Thin.raw_pull.header:
theorem raw_pull {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (U : Cfg L)
    (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    deltaPrimeBilRawLoc (pullCfg h o U) (phiP h o ⁻¹' P) (pullBond h o A) (pullBond h o B) =
      ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette Lt, (fun q => if q ∈ P then bilPlaq U q A B else 0) (phiP h o p)

AdalyFormal.Thin.normLoc_apply.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.normLoc_apply
AdalyFormal.Thin.normLoc_apply.header:
theorem normLoc_apply {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (U : Cfg L) (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (A B : Bond L → SuTwo) :
    deltaPrimeBilNormLoc U P A B = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (deltaPrimeBilRawLoc U P A B + deltaPrimeBilRawLoc U P B A))

AdalyFormal.Thin.bilL2_apply.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.bilL2_apply
AdalyFormal.Thin.bilL2_apply.header:
theorem bilL2_apply {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (U : Cfg L) (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (x y : BondFnL2 L) :
    deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc U P x y = deltaPrimeBilNormLoc U P (WithLp.ofLp x) (WithLp.ofLp y)

AdalyFormal.Thin.bil_periodic.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.bil_periodic
AdalyFormal.Thin.bil_periodic.header:
theorem bil_periodic {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (U : Cfg L)
    (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (y x : BondFnL2 L) :
    deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U) (phiP h (fun _ => 0) ⁻¹' P) (liftF (phiE h (fun _ => 0)) y)
      (liftF (phiE h (fun _ => 0)) x) = (Fintype.card (DeckIdx Lt L) : ℝ) * deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc U P y x

AdalyFormal.Thin.raw_deck.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.raw_deck
AdalyFormal.Thin.raw_deck.header:
theorem raw_deck {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (d : DeckIdx Lt L) (U : Cfg L)
    (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (a b : Bond Lt → SuTwo) :
    deltaPrimeBilRawLoc (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U) (phiP h (fun _ => 0) ⁻¹' P)
      (pullBond (Covers.refl Lt) (fun μ => (d μ).val * (L μ + 1)) a) (pullBond (Covers.refl Lt) (fun μ => (d μ).val * (L μ + 1)) b)
    = deltaPrimeBilRawLoc (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U) (phiP h (fun _ => 0) ⁻¹' P) a b

AdalyFormal.Thin.bil_deck.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.bil_deck
AdalyFormal.Thin.bil_deck.header:
theorem bil_deck {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (d : DeckIdx Lt L) (U : Cfg L)
    (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) (u v : BondFnL2 Lt) :
    deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U) (phiP h (fun _ => 0) ⁻¹' P) ((covE h).pull d u) ((covE h).pull d v) =
      deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U) (phiP h (fun _ => 0) ⁻¹' P) u v

AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_deltaPrimeOpLoc.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_deltaPrimeOpLoc
AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_deltaPrimeOpLoc.header:
theorem desc_deltaPrimeOpLoc {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (U : Cfg L) (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) :
    Desc (covE h) (covE h) (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (deltaPrimeOpLoc U P))
      (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (deltaPrimeOpLoc (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U) (phiP h (fun _ => 0) ⁻¹' P)))

AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_deltaKLoc.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_deltaKLoc
AdalyFormal.Thin.desc_deltaKLoc.header:
theorem desc_deltaKLoc {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (U : Cfg L) (P : Set (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)) :
    Desc (covE h) (covE h) (deltaKLocCLM U P)
      (deltaKLocCLM (pullCfg h (fun _ => 0) U) (phiP h (fun _ => 0) ⁻¹' P))

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.RegData.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.RegData
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.RegData.header:

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.Qrow_restr_loc.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.Qrow_restr_loc
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.Qrow_restr_loc.header:
theorem Qrow_restr_loc (hell : 0 < ell) (D : RegData ell k Lu S V Sstar)
    (y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) :
    (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull y p

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.Qrow_norm_loc.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.Qrow_norm_loc
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.Qrow_norm_loc.header:
theorem Qrow_norm_loc (hell : 0 < ell) (D : RegData ell k Lu S V Sstar)
    (y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull y p‖
      ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ))⁻¹ * ((rr ell) ^ (p.1 : ℕ) * Estar ell Sstar) * ‖y‖

AdalyFormal.Thin.Aligned.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.Aligned
AdalyFormal.Thin.Aligned.header: def Aligned {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (s : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Thin.PhiOK.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.PhiOK
AdalyFormal.Thin.PhiOK.header: structure PhiOK {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (s : ℕ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.Thin.PhiOK.mono.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.PhiOK.mono
AdalyFormal.Thin.PhiOK.mono.header:

AdalyFormal.Thin.aligned_phiS.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.aligned_phiS
AdalyFormal.Thin.aligned_phiS.header:
theorem aligned_phiS {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {h : Covers Lt L} {o : Fin 3 → ℕ} {s : ℕ} (hp : PhiOK h o s)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) : Aligned s (phiS h o x) ↔ Aligned s x

AdalyFormal.Thin.aligned_coarseShift.header:
theorem aligned_coarseShift {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {s : ℕ} (hs : ∀ μ, s ∣ L μ + 1) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L}

AdalyFormal.Thin.coarseShift_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.coarseShift_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.coarseShift_nat.header:
theorem coarseShift_nat {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt)
    (s : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : phiS h o (coarseShift y s μ) = coarseShift (phiS h o y) s μ

AdalyFormal.Thin.AgreeAligned.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.AgreeAligned

AdalyFormal.Thin.coarsePathHolonomy_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.coarsePathHolonomy_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.coarsePathHolonomy_nat.header:
theorem coarsePathHolonomy_nat {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {h : Covers Lt L} {o : Fin 3 → ℕ} {s : ℕ} (hp : PhiOK h o s)
    {Vt : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) Lt}
    {V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L} (hV : AgreeAligned h o s Vt V)
    (p : List (Fin 3)) : ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt, Aligned s y →

AdalyFormal.Thin.blockval_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.blockval_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.blockval_nat.header:
theorem blockval_nat (b m o y x : ℕ) (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : b ∣ m) (ho : b ∣ o) (hy : b ∣ y) (hb : 0 < b) (hyx : y ≤ x) (hxb : x < y + b) :
    (x + o) % m = (y + o) % m + (x - y)

AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_val_in_block.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_val_in_block
AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_val_in_block.header:
theorem phiS_val_in_block {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {h : Covers Lt L} {o : Fin 3 → ℕ} {b : ℕ} (hp : PhiOK h o b)
    (hb : 0 < b) {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt} (hy : Aligned b y) (μ : Fin 3) (h1 : (y μ).val ≤ (x μ).val)
    (h2 : (x μ).val < (y μ).val + b) :
    (phiS h o x μ).val = (phiS h o y μ).val + ((x μ).val - (y μ).val)

AdalyFormal.Thin.aligned_add_le.header: theorem aligned_add_le (b N y : ℕ) (hb : b ∣ N) (hy : b ∣ y) (hyN : y < N) : y + b ≤ N

AdalyFormal.Thin.stepBlock_sum.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.stepBlock_sum
AdalyFormal.Thin.stepBlock_sum.header:
theorem stepBlock_sum {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {h : Covers Lt L} {o : Fin 3 → ℕ} {s ell : ℕ}
    (hp : PhiOK h o (s * ell)) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt} (hy : Aligned (s * ell) y)
    {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (F : PeriodicLatticeSite L → M) :
    ∑ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, F (phiS h o x) = ∑ w ∈ stepBlockOf (phiS h o y) s ell, F w

AdalyFormal.Thin.fin_sub_val_of_le.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.fin_sub_val_of_le
AdalyFormal.Thin.fin_sub_val_of_le.header: theorem fin_sub_val_of_le {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin (n + 1)) (h : a.val ≤ b.val) : (b - a).val = b.val - a.val

AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_update.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_update
AdalyFormal.Thin.phiS_update.header:
theorem phiS_update {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (y x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) (μ : Fin 3) :
    phiS h o (Function.update y μ (x μ)) = Function.update (phiS h o y) μ (phiS h o x μ)

AdalyFormal.Thin.coarseCoordSteps_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.coarseCoordSteps_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.coarseCoordSteps_nat.header:
theorem coarseCoordSteps_nat {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {h : Covers Lt L} {o : Fin 3 → ℕ} {b : ℕ} (hp : PhiOK h o b) (hb : 0 < b)
    (s : ℕ) {y a x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt} (hy : Aligned b y) (ν : Fin 3) (hay : a ν = y ν)
    (h1 : (y ν).val ≤ (x ν).val) (h2 : (x ν).val < (y ν).val + b) :
    coarseCoordSteps s (phiS h o a) (phiS h o x) ν = coarseCoordSteps s a x ν

AdalyFormal.Thin.coarseGammaPath_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.coarseGammaPath_nat

AdalyFormal.Thin.aligned_of_mul.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.aligned_of_mul
AdalyFormal.Thin.aligned_of_mul.header:
theorem aligned_of_mul {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {s ell : ℕ} {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : Aligned (s * ell) y) :
    Aligned s y

AdalyFormal.Thin.stepAverage_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.stepAverage_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.stepAverage_nat.header:
theorem stepAverage_nat {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {h : Covers Lt L} {o : Fin 3 → ℕ} {s ell : ℕ}
    (hp : PhiOK h o (s * ell)) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {Vt : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) Lt}
    {V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L} (hV : AgreeAligned h o s Vt V)
    (lamt : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt → AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantOperators.SuTwo)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantOperators.SuTwo)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt} (hy : Aligned (s * ell) y)
    (hlam : ∀ x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell, lamt x = lam (phiS h o x)) :
    AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAverage s Vt ell lamt y =
      AdalyFormal.Balaban.QjComposite.stepAverage s V ell lam (phiS h o y)

AdalyFormal.Thin.aligned_of_block.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.aligned_of_block
AdalyFormal.Thin.aligned_of_block.header:
theorem aligned_of_block {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {s ell : ℕ} {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hy : Aligned s y) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) : Aligned s x

AdalyFormal.Thin.Qcomposite_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.Qcomposite_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.Qcomposite_nat.header:
theorem Qcomposite_nat {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {h : Covers Lt L} {o : Fin 3 → ℕ} {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (bgt : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) Lt)
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → AdalyFormal.Balaban.CovariantOperators.SuTwo) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, PhiOK h o (ell ^ j) → (∀ l, l < j → AgreeAligned h o (ell ^ l) (bgt l) (bg l)) →
      ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt, Aligned (ell ^ j) y →
        Qcomposite bgt ell j (fun x => lam (phiS h o x)) y = Qcomposite bg ell j lam (phiS h o y)

AdalyFormal.Thin.cPlusS_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.cPlusS_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.cPlusS_nat.header:
theorem cPlusS_nat (h : Covers Lt L) (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (s ell : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt) :
    phiS h o (cPlusS s ell c) = cPlusS s ell (phiE h o c)

AdalyFormal.Thin.aligned_cPlusS.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.aligned_cPlusS
AdalyFormal.Thin.aligned_cPlusS.header:
theorem aligned_cPlusS {L' : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hs : ∀ μ, s * ell ∣ L' μ + 1) {c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L'}
    (hc : Aligned (s * ell) c.1) : Aligned (s * ell) (cPlusS s ell c)

AdalyFormal.Thin.coarseBondVar_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.coarseBondVar_nat

AdalyFormal.Thin.gammaVarStrided_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.gammaVarStrided_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.gammaVarStrided_nat.header:
theorem gammaVarStrided_nat (hp : PhiOK h o (s * ell)) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {Vt : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2c Lt} {V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2c L}
    (hV : AgreeAligned h o s Vt V) {c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt} (hc : Aligned (s * ell) c.1)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell) :
    gammaVarStrided s ell Vt c x = gammaVarStrided s ell V (phiE h o c) (phiS h o x)

AdalyFormal.Thin.loopVar_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.loopVar_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.loopVar_nat.header:
theorem loopVar_nat (hp : PhiOK h o (s * ell)) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {Vt : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2c Lt} {V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2c L}
    (hV : AgreeAligned h o s Vt V) {c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt} (hc : Aligned (s * ell) c.1)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf c.1 s ell) :
    loopVar s ell Vt c x = loopVar s ell V (phiE h o c) (phiS h o x)

AdalyFormal.Thin.stridedBlockedGauge_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.stridedBlockedGauge_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.stridedBlockedGauge_nat.header:
theorem stridedBlockedGauge_nat {𝔤 : Type*} [AddCommGroup 𝔤] [Module ℚ 𝔤] (P : AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.LogExpAd SU2c 𝔤)
    (hp : PhiOK h o (s * ell)) (hs : 0 < s) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {Vt : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2c Lt} {V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2c L}
    (hV : AgreeAligned h o s Vt V) {c : PeriodicLatticeEdge Lt} (hc : Aligned (s * ell) c.1) :
    stridedBlockedGauge P s ell Vt c = stridedBlockedGauge P s ell V (phiE h o c)

AdalyFormal.Thin.UbarTower_nat.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.UbarTower_nat
AdalyFormal.Thin.UbarTower_nat.header:
theorem UbarTower_nat {𝔤 : Type*} [AddCommGroup 𝔤] [Module ℚ 𝔤] (P : AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.LogExpAd SU2c 𝔤)
    (hell : 0 < ell) (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2c L) :
    ∀ l : ℕ, PhiOK h o (ell ^ l) →
      AgreeAligned h o (ell ^ l) (UbarTower P ell (fun e => U (phiE h o e)) l) (UbarTower P ell U l)

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.row_comm_sum_loc.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.row_comm_sum_loc
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.row_comm_sum_loc.header:
theorem row_comm_sum_loc (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Sstar : ℝ) (D : RegData ell k Lu S U Sstar) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ∑ i, ‖(rowMul (geomOf ell k S) (hrow ell M k κ c S i) (Ymass (geomOf ell k S) U a A)
      - Ymass (geomOf ell k S) U a (bondMul (hbond ell M k κ c S i) A)) p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ a * Estar ell Sstar ^ 2 * (49 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * KG ell M κ c)
        * ((((ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ))⁻¹) ^ 2 * ∑ e, (if Foot ell (p.1 : ℕ) p.2.1 e then ‖A e‖ ^ 2 else 0))

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.CMcStar.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.CMcStar
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.CMcStar.header: noncomputable def CMcStar (ell M κ c : ℕ) (a Sstar : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.massComm_proper_loc.name: AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.massComm_proper_loc
AdalyFormal.TowerLoc.massComm_proper_loc.header:
theorem massComm_proper_loc (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Sstar : ℝ) (D : RegData ell k Lu S U Sstar) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    MassComm ell M k κ c S U a (CMcStar ell M κ c a Sstar)

AdalyFormal.Thin.towerPull.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.towerPull
AdalyFormal.Thin.towerPull.header: def towerPull {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (o : Fin 3 → ℕ) (S : Tower L) : Tower Lt

AdalyFormal.Thin.liftTower_eq.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.liftTower_eq
AdalyFormal.Thin.liftTower_eq.header:
theorem liftTower_eq {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (h : Covers Lt L) (S : Tower L) :
    liftTower h S = towerPull h (fun _ => 0) S

AdalyFormal.Thin.mod_mod_dvd_val.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.mod_mod_dvd_val
AdalyFormal.Thin.mod_mod_dvd_val.header:
theorem mod_mod_dvd_val {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {h : Covers Lt L} {o : Fin 3 → ℕ} {b : ℕ} (hp : PhiOK h o b)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) (μ : Fin 3) : (phiS h o x μ).val % b = (x μ).val % b

AdalyFormal.Thin.mod_eq_sub_of_aligned_b.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.mod_eq_sub_of_aligned_block
AdalyFormal.Thin.mod_eq_sub_of_aligned_b.header:
theorem mod_eq_sub_of_aligned_block (b y z : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hy : b ∣ y) (h1 : y ≤ z) (h2 : z < y + b) :
    z % b = z - y

AdalyFormal.Thin.exists_lift_block.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.exists_lift_block
AdalyFormal.Thin.exists_lift_block.header:
theorem exists_lift_block {Lt L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {h : Covers Lt L} {o : Fin 3 → ℕ} {b : ℕ} (hp : PhiOK h o b)
    (hb : 0 < b) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : Aligned b y)
    (hyx : ∀ μ, (y μ).val ≤ (phiS h o x μ).val ∧ (phiS h o x μ).val < (y μ).val + b) :
    ∃ y' : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt, Aligned b y' ∧ phiS h o y' = y ∧ ∀ μ, (y' μ).val ≤ (x μ).val ∧ (x μ).val < (y' μ).val + b

AdalyFormal.Thin.phiOK_le.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.phiOK_le
AdalyFormal.Thin.phiOK_le.header: theorem phiOK_le {hp : PhiOK h o (ell ^ k)} {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) : PhiOK h o (ell ^ j)

AdalyFormal.Thin.lam_iff.name: AdalyFormal.Thin.lam_iff
AdalyFormal.Thin.lam_iff.header:
theorem lam_iff (hp : PhiOK h o (ell ^ k)) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite Lt) :

    (hj : 2 ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k) (hR : 24 * ell + 25 ≤ R) {w x₀ : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ S.Om j)
    (hw : pdist w x₀ ≤ 3 * (M * ell ^ j)) {p : Z3}
    (hp : ∀ μ, wo w μ / ((bigSide M ell (j - 2) : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((7 * ell ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ cellZ ((bigSide M ell (j - 2) : ℕ) : ℤ) (wo w) p μ ∧
      cellZ ((bigSide M ell (j - 2) : ℕ) : ℤ) (wo w) p μ ≤ wo w μ / ((bigSide M ell (j - 2) : ℕ) : ℤ) + ((7 * ell ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) :
    pdist w (iota w p) ≤ (21 * ell + 3) * bigSide M ell (j - 1) ∧ iota w p ∈ S.Om (j - 1)

AdalyFormal.Total.box_idxT.name: AdalyFormal.Total.box_idxT
AdalyFormal.Total.box_idxT.header:
theorem box_idxT {fc : ℕ} {ell M R k j : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hadm : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hj : 2 ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k) (hR : 24 * ell + 25 ≤ R) {w x₀ : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ S.Om j)
    (hw : pdist w x₀ ≤ 3 * (M * ell ^ j)) {p : Z3}
    (hp : ∀ μ, wo w μ / ((bigSide M ell (j - 2) : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((7 * ell ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ cellZ ((bigSide M ell (j - 2) : ℕ) : ℤ) (wo w) p μ ∧
      cellZ ((bigSide M ell (j - 2) : ℕ) : ℤ) (wo w) p μ ≤ wo w μ / ((bigSide M ell (j - 2) : ℕ) : ℤ) + ((7 * ell ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ))
    {sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {i : ℕ} (hcl : IsClassCube ell M fc k S sites i) (hq : iota w p ∈ sites) :
    j - 2 ≤ i

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.can.header: noncomputable def canonicalKop (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks) (a : ℝ) : Hs →L[ℝ] Hs

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.inn.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.inner_Qstar_Q

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.isA.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.sig.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.signed_penalty_breaks_hKcurl
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.sig.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.pur.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.sha.header: noncomputable def sharpFloorConst (γP κ σ₀ : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.flo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.floor_of_hraw_sharp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.flo.header:

    (hpert : ‖d₁ (Q A)‖ ≤ σ₀ * ‖d A‖ + κ * ‖Q A‖)
    (hpoin : γP * ‖Q A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖d₁ (Q A)‖ ^ 2)
    (hK : ‖d A‖ ^ 2 ≤ (inner ℝ A (Kop A) : ℝ)) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.sha.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.sharpFloorConst_ge_crude
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.sha.header:
theorem sharpFloorConst_ge_crude (γP κ σ₀ : ℝ) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀) (hγP : 0 ≤ γP) :
    (γP - 2 * κ ^ 2) / (2 * σ₀ ^ 2) ≤ sharpFloorConst γP κ σ₀
    ∧ sharpFloorConst γP 0 σ₀ = 2 * (γP / (2 * σ₀ ^ 2))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.psd.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.psd_form_cauchy_schwarz
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.psd.header:
theorem psd_form_cauchy_schwarz (T : Hs →L[ℝ] Hs)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.nor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.normSq_le_opNorm_mul_form
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.nor.header:
theorem normSq_le_opNorm_mul_form (T : Hs →L[ℝ] Hs)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.nor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.norm_solutionOperator_le_of_lift
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.nor.header:
theorem norm_solutionOperator_le_of_lift (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks) (Cm M : ℝ)

    (hcoer : ∀ A : Hs, ‖A‖ ^ 2 ≤ Cm * (inner ℝ A (D.Ginv A) : ℝ))
    (Rq : Ks →L[ℝ] Hs) (hRq : ∀ B : Ks, D.Q (Rq B) = B)
    (hlift : ∀ B : Ks, (inner ℝ (Rq B) (D.Ginv (Rq B)) : ℝ) ≤ M * ‖B‖ ^ 2) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.lif.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.nor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.norm_solutionOperator_le_of_printedG1Form
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.nor.header:
theorem norm_solutionOperator_le_of_printedG1Form (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs Ks) (a : ℝ)
    (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (pen : Hs →L[ℝ] P₃) (hform : IsPrintedG1Form D a d pen) (ha : 0 ≤ a)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.cdc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.cdc_floor_at_cZero_norm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.cdc.header:
theorem cdc_floor_at_cZero_norm {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (w : TildeFn L ell) :
    ((1 / 360) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) - 96 * frobSupBond U ^ 2)
        * ‖cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ (cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w)
          (dstarDCLM U (cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w)) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.cdc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.cdc_floor_class_uniform_at_cZero_norm
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.cdc.header:
theorem cdc_floor_class_uniform_at_cZero_norm {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hthr : frobSupBond U ≤ 1 / (186 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (w : TildeFn L ell) :
    gammaBrick ell * ‖cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ (cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w)
          (dstarDCLM U (cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w)) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.nor.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.normSq_curlCLM_eq_dstarDCLM_form
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.nor.header:
theorem normSq_curlCLM_eq_dstarDCLM_form
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 U x‖ ^ 2 = (inner ℝ x (dstarDCLM U x) : ℝ)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.hpo.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.hpoin_at_cZero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.hpo.header:
theorem hpoin_at_cZero {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)

    (hthr : frobSupBond U ≤ 1 / (186 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.sch.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.schur_floor_hraw_at_cZero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.sch.header:
theorem schur_floor_hraw_at_cZero {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hthr : frobSupBond U ≤ 1 / (186 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))
    {P₁ P₃ : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P₁] [InnerProductSpace ℝ P₁]
    [NormedAddCommGroup P₃] [InnerProductSpace ℝ P₃]
    (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs (BondFnL2 L)) (a : ℝ) (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (pen : Hs →L[ℝ] P₃)
    (hform : IsPrintedG1Form D a d pen) (σ₀ κ : ℝ) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)

    (hraw : ∀ A : Hs, ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 U (D.Q A)‖ ≤ σ₀ * ‖d A‖ + κ * ‖D.Q A‖)
    (w : TildeFn L ell) :
    sharpFloorConst (gammaBrick ell) κ σ₀ * ‖cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w‖ ^ 2
      ≤ deltaKQuadForm D a (cZero U ell (dinvC U ell) w)

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.amb.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.ambient_hfloor_forces_gamma_nonpos
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.amb.header:
theorem ambient_hfloor_forces_gamma_nonpos (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs (BondFnL2 L))

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.cdc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.cdcFormTrue_coercive_at_cZero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.cdc.header:
theorem cdcFormTrue_coercive_at_cZero {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (D : BalabanCovarianceData H (BondFnL2 L)) (bc : BaseConstant)
    (Qext : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L) (J : H) (S : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L)
    (hS : IsSourceOperator D Qext J S) (γ₁ c₂ : ℝ) (hc₂ : 0 ≤ c₂)
    (hD2 : ∀ B : BondFnL2 L, ‖Dtilde2Shape Qext B‖ ≤ c₂ * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {ell : ℕ}
    (Dinv : CoarseBond L ell → (SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo)) (w : TildeFn L ell)
    (hfloorAt : γ₁ * ‖cZero U ell Dinv w‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ (cZero U ell Dinv w) (deltaKQuadOp D bc (cZero U ell Dinv w)) : ℝ)) :
    (γ₁ - 2 * ‖solutionOperator D‖ * c₂ * ‖J‖) * ‖cZero U ell Dinv w‖ ^ 2
      ≤ cdcFormTrue D bc Qext J U ell Dinv w

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.cdc.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.cdcFormTrue_posDef_at_cZero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.cdc.header:
theorem cdcFormTrue_posDef_at_cZero {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (D : BalabanCovarianceData H (BondFnL2 L)) (bc : BaseConstant)
    (Qext : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L) (J : H) (S : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L)
    (hS : IsSourceOperator D Qext J S) (γ₁ c₂ : ℝ) (hc₂ : 0 ≤ c₂)
    (hD2 : ∀ B : BondFnL2 L, ‖Dtilde2Shape Qext B‖ ≤ c₂ * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) {ell : ℕ}
    (Dinv : CoarseBond L ell → (SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] SuTwo)) (w : TildeFn L ell) (hw : w ≠ 0)
    (hfloorAt : γ₁ * ‖cZero U ell Dinv w‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (inner ℝ (cZero U ell Dinv w) (deltaKQuadOp D bc (cZero U ell Dinv w)) : ℝ))
    (hthr : 2 * ‖solutionOperator D‖ * c₂ * ‖J‖ < γ₁) :
    0 < cdcFormTrue D bc Qext J U ell Dinv w

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.del.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.deltaKQuadForm_eq_inner_deltaKQuadOp
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.del.header:

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.ter.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.terminal_printed_posDef
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.ter.header:
theorem terminal_printed_posDef {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell < L ν + 1) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L ν + 1))
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hthr : frobSupBond U ≤ 1 / (186 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))
    {P₁ P₃ : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P₁] [InnerProductSpace ℝ P₁]
    [NormedAddCommGroup P₃] [InnerProductSpace ℝ P₃]
    (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs (BondFnL2 L)) (bc : BaseConstant)
    (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (pen : Hs →L[ℝ] P₃)
    (hform : IsPrintedG1Form D (usedAt bc 0) d pen)
    (σ₀ κ : ℝ) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hκγ : κ ≤ Real.sqrt (gammaBrick ell))
    (hraw : ∀ A : Hs, ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 U (D.Q A)‖ ≤ σ₀ * ‖d A‖ + κ * ‖D.Q A‖)
    (Qext : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L) (J : Hs) (S : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L)
    (hS : IsSourceOperator D Qext J S) (c₂ : ℝ) (hc₂ : 0 ≤ c₂)
    (hD2 : ∀ B : BondFnL2 L, ‖Dtilde2Shape Qext B‖ ≤ c₂ * ‖B‖ ^ 2)
    (hsmall : 2 * ‖solutionOperator D‖ * c₂ * ‖J‖ < sharpFloorConst (gammaBrick ell) κ σ₀)
    (w : TildeFn L ell) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    0 < cdcFormTrue D bc Qext J U ell (dinvC U ell) w

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.sha.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.sharpFloorConst_eq_at_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.sha.header:
theorem sharpFloorConst_eq_at_zero {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (σ₀ : ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.sha.name: AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.sharpFloorConst_lower_at_zero
AdalyFormal.Balaban.TerminalAssembly.sha.header:

    [NormedAddCommGroup P₃] [InnerProductSpace ℝ P₃]
    (D : BalabanCovarianceData Hs (BondFnL2 L)) (bc : BaseConstant)
    (d : Hs →L[ℝ] P₁) (pen : Hs →L[ℝ] P₃)
    (hform : IsPrintedG1Form D (usedAt bc 0) d pen)
    (σ₀ κ : ℝ) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (hhalf : κ ≤ Real.sqrt (gammaBrick ell) / 2)
    (hraw : ∀ A : Hs, ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 U (D.Q A)‖ ≤ σ₀ * ‖d A‖ + κ * ‖D.Q A‖)
    (Qext : BondFnL2 L → BondFnL2 L) (T : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] Hs)
    (S : BondFnL2 L →L[ℝ] BondFnL2 L) (hS : IsSourceOperator D Qext (T (JsuTwo U)) S)
    (c₂ : ℝ) (hc₂ : 0 < c₂)
    (hD2 : ∀ B : BondFnL2 L, ‖Dtilde2Shape Qext B‖ ≤ c₂ * ‖B‖ ^ 2)

    (hH1 : 0 < ‖solutionOperator D‖) (hT : 0 < ‖T‖)
    (hcard : 0 < Fintype.card (Bond L))
    (hδ : δ < 1 / (1370001600 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 6 * σ₀ ^ 2 * ‖solutionOperator D‖ * c₂
      * (‖T‖ * Real.sqrt (2 * (Fintype.card (Bond L))))))
    (w : TildeFn L ell) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    0 < cdcFormTrue D bc Qext (T (JsuTwo U)) U ell (dinvC U ell) w

            (tildeSpike (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 3) witL3_hyps.2)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ deltaKQuadForm (assemblyDatum (witU witT) ha) a
          (cZero (witU witT) 3 (dinvC (witU witT) 3)
            (tildeSpike (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 3) witL3_hyps.2))

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.lemma24Q_su2.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.lemma24Q_su2
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.lemma24Q_su2.header:
theorem lemma24Q_su2 {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < L μ + 1) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (B : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hB : ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell, ∀ x ∈ blockOf y ell, ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, B b = 0) :
    (1 / 54 : ℝ) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) * ∑ b : Bond L, ‖B b‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (ell : ℝ) * ∑ c : CoarseBond L ell, ‖lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo ell B c‖ ^ 2
        + ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, ‖flatCurlValue B p‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hmul_apply.header: theorem hmul_apply (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (X : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) : hmul h X b = h b.1 • X b

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.flatCurl_hmul.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.flatCurl_hmul
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.flatCurl_hmul.header:
theorem flatCurl_hmul (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (X : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    flatCurlValue (hmul h X) p = h p.1 • flatCurlValue X p
      + ((h (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1) - h p.1) • X (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1, p.2.1.2)
        - (h (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2) - h p.1) • X (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1))

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.q1_hmul.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.q1_hmul
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.q1_hmul.header:
theorem q1_hmul (ell : ℕ) (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (X : Bond L → SuTwo) (c : CoarseBond L ell) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo ell (hmul h X) c = h c.1.1 • lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo ell X c
      + (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) • ∑ x ∈ blockOf c.1.1 ell, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell,
          (h (pathSite x c.2 j) - h c.1.1) • X (pathSite x c.2 j, c.2)

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sq_add_young.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sq_add_young
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sq_add_young.header:

    ‖x + y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ε) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 + (1 + 1 / ε) * ‖y‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sq_add_two.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sq_add_two
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sq_add_two.header:
theorem sq_add_two {E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (x y : E) :
    ‖x + y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sq_smul_sub_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sq_smul_sub_le
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sq_smul_sub_le.header:
theorem sq_smul_sub_le {E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (a b : ℝ) (x y : E) :
    ‖a • x - b • y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * a ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 + 2 * b ^ 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sq_sum_le_card.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sq_sum_le_card

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sum_pathSite.header:
theorem sum_pathSite (f : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (μ : Fin 3) (j : ℕ) :

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sum_path_bonds.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sum_path_bonds
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sum_path_bonds.header:
theorem sum_path_bonds {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (f : Bond L → ℝ) :

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.cutBall_small.header:

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.q1_drift_row.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.q1_drift_row
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.q1_drift_row.header:
theorem q1_drift_row {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (W : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hρ : rhoOf ell κ < Real.pi / 2)
    (hrg : Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * κ) < r0) (c : CoarseBond L ell)
    (hnear : ∀ z ∈ Ball c.1.1 (4 * (1 * ell)), ∀ μ : Fin 3, frobNorm (((W (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ κ)

    ‖Q1jet ell W Z c - AdalyFormal.IngredientFamily.q1SU2 ell Z c‖ ^ 2
      ≤ kapQ ell κ ^ 2 * ∑ e ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun e => VisStep 1 ell (c.1.1, c.2) e), ‖Z e‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sum_vis_sq_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sum_vis_sq_le
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sum_vis_sq_le.header:
theorem sum_vis_sq_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (Z : Bond L → SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.norm_gaugeActA.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.norm_gaugeActA
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.norm_gaugeActA.header: theorem norm_gaugeActA (γ : GaugeFn L) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) : ‖gaugeActA γ B b‖ = ‖B b‖

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.curlDrift_sq_loc.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.curlDrift_sq_loc
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.curlDrift_sq_loc.header:
theorem curlDrift_sq_loc (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)
    (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 ≤ α)
    (h1 : frobNorm (((U (p.1, p.2.1.1) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ α)
    (h2 : frobNorm (((U (p.1, p.2.1.2) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ α) :
    ‖curlDrift U A p‖ ^ 2 ≤
      8 * α ^ 2 * (‖A (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1, p.2.1.2)‖ ^ 2
        + ‖A (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1)‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.flat_eq_cov_sub_drift.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.flat_eq_cov_sub_drift
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.flat_eq_cov_sub_drift.header:

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.Eims.header: noncomputable def Eims (ell : ℕ) (Dp Dq κ ε : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.curl_part_pt.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.curl_part_pt
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.curl_part_pt.header:
theorem curl_part_pt {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (W : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (B : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (h : ι → PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (u : ι → GaugeFn L) (Dp κ ε : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hP1' : ∀ x, ∑ i, h i x ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (hDp : ∀ x (μ : Fin 3), ∑ i, (h i (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - h i x) ^ 2 ≤ Dp ^ 2)
    (hS : ∀ i x, h i x ≠ 0 → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform (u i) W (x, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ κ)
    (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) :
    ∑ i, ‖flatCurlValue (hmul (h i) (gaugeActA (u i) B)) p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (1 + ε) * ‖curlValueCovariant W B p‖ ^ 2
        + (1 + 1 / ε) * (4 * Dp ^ 2 + 16 * κ ^ 2) *
          (‖B (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.1, p.2.1.2)‖ ^ 2 + ‖B (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1)‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.q_part_pt.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.q_part_pt
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.q_part_pt.header:
theorem q_part_pt {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (W : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (B : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (h : ι → PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (u : ι → GaugeFn L) (Dq κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (hρ : rhoOf ell κ < Real.pi / 2) (hrg : Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * κ) < r0)
    (hP1' : ∀ x, ∑ i, h i x ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (hDq : ∀ c : CoarseBond L ell, ∀ x ∈ blockOf c.1.1 ell, ∀ j ∈ Finset.range ell,
      ∑ i, (h i (pathSite x c.2 j) - h i c.1.1) ^ 2 ≤ Dq ^ 2)
    (hS : ∀ i x, h i x ≠ 0 → ∀ z ∈ Ball x (4 * (1 * ell)), ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform (u i) W (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ κ)
    (c : CoarseBond L ell)
    (hQ0 : Q1jet ell W B c = 0 ∨ ∀ x ∈ blockOf c.1.1 ell, ∀ j ∈ Finset.range ell, B (pathSite x c.2 j, c.2) = 0) :
    ∑ i, ‖lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo ell (hmul (h i) (gaugeActA (u i) B)) c‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 2 * kapQ ell κ ^ 2 * ∑ e ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun e => VisStep 1 ell (c.1.1, c.2) e), ‖B e‖ ^ 2
        + 2 * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) * Dq ^ 2 *
          ∑ x ∈ blockOf c.1.1 ell, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ell, ‖B (pathSite x c.2 j, c.2)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.norm_part.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.norm_part
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.norm_part.header:
theorem norm_part {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (B : Bond L → SuTwo) (h : ι → PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (u : ι → GaugeFn L)
    (hP1 : ∀ b : Bond L, B b ≠ 0 → ∑ i, h i b.1 ^ 2 = 1) :
    ∑ i, ∑ b : Bond L, ‖hmul (h i) (gaugeActA (u i) B) b‖ ^ 2 = ∑ b : Bond L, ‖B b‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.cov_floor_ims.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.cov_floor_ims
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.cov_floor_ims.header:
theorem cov_floor_ims {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {ell : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < L μ + 1) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1))
    (W : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (B : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (hax : ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L ell, ∀ x ∈ blockOf y ell, ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, B b = 0)
    (hQ0 : ∀ c : CoarseBond L ell, Q1jet ell W B c = 0 ∨
      ∀ x ∈ blockOf c.1.1 ell, ∀ j ∈ Finset.range ell, B (pathSite x c.2 j, c.2) = 0)
    (h : ι → PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (u : ι → GaugeFn L) (Dp Dq κ ε : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hρ : rhoOf ell κ < Real.pi / 2) (hrg : Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * κ) < r0)
    (hP1 : ∀ b : Bond L, B b ≠ 0 → ∑ i, h i b.1 ^ 2 = 1)
    (hP1' : ∀ x, ∑ i, h i x ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (hDp : ∀ x (μ : Fin 3), ∑ i, (h i (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - h i x) ^ 2 ≤ Dp ^ 2)
    (hDq : ∀ c : CoarseBond L ell, ∀ x ∈ blockOf c.1.1 ell, ∀ j ∈ Finset.range ell,
      ∑ i, (h i (pathSite x c.2 j) - h i c.1.1) ^ 2 ≤ Dq ^ 2)
    (hS : ∀ i x, h i x ≠ 0 → ∀ z ∈ Ball x (4 * (1 * ell)), ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform (u i) W (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ κ) :
    (1 / 54 : ℝ) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) * ∑ b : Bond L, ‖B b‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (1 + ε) * ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, ‖curlValueCovariant W B p‖ ^ 2
        + Eims ell Dp Dq κ ε * ∑ b : Bond L, ‖B b‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.Cop_props_Q.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.Cop_props_Q
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.Cop_props_Q.header:
theorem Cop_props_Q {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1) (hu : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ)
    {Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)} (hLB : LamBlockSum ell Lam)
    (Q : (Bond Lu → SuTwo) →ₗ[ℝ] (CoarseBond Lu ell → SuTwo))
    (hb : Function.Bijective (H0 Lam Q)) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo)
    (hBt : OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt) (hBT : OnLambdaT Lam Bt) :
    (∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice Lu ell, ∀ x ∈ blockOf y ell, ∀ b ∈ staircasePath y x, Cop Lam Q Bt b = 0) ∧
    (∀ c : CoarseBond Lu ell, Q (Cop Lam Q Bt) c = 0 ∨
      ∀ x ∈ blockOf c.1.1 ell, ∀ j ∈ Finset.range ell, Cop Lam Q Bt (pathSite x c.2 j, c.2) = 0) ∧
    bondEnergy Bt ≤ ∑ b : Bond Lu, ‖Cop Lam Q Bt b‖ ^ 2 ∧
    (∀ e : Bond Lu, Cop Lam Q Bt e ≠ 0 → e.1 ∈ Lam ∨ periodicLatticeShift e.1 e.2 ∈ Lam)

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sum_two.header:

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.psi1_cross.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.psi1_cross
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.psi1_cross.header:
theorem psi1_cross {M K t : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hK : 2 ≤ K) (ht : t < K * M) :

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.psi1_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.psi1_lip
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.psi1_lip.header:
theorem psi1_lip {M K t : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hK : 2 ≤ K) (ht : t < K * M) :

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.Kc_mul.header: theorem Kc_mul {M : ℕ} (h : PartOK L M) (μ : Fin 3) : Kc L M μ * M = L μ + 1

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.Kc_two.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.Kc_two
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.Kc_two.header: theorem Kc_two {M : ℕ} (h : PartOK L M) (μ : Fin 3) : 2 ≤ Kc L M μ

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.coord_lt.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.coord_lt
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.coord_lt.header: theorem coord_lt {M : ℕ} (h : PartOK L M) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : (x μ).val < Kc L M μ * M

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sum_prod_axes.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sum_prod_axes
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sum_prod_axes.header:
theorem sum_prod_axes (M : ℕ) (f : (μ : Fin 3) → Fin (Kc L M μ) → ℝ) :
    ∑ m : (μ : Fin 3) → Fin (Kc L M μ), ∏ μ : Fin 3, f μ (m μ) = ∏ μ : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin (Kc L M μ), f μ j

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hpart_sumsq.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hpart_sumsq
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hpart_sumsq.header:
theorem hpart_sumsq {M : ℕ} (h : PartOK L M) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.shift_val_self.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.shift_val_self
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.shift_val_self.header:

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.shift_val_ne.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.shift_val_ne
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.shift_val_ne.header:
theorem shift_val_ne (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) {μ ν : Fin 3} (hν : ν ≠ μ) :

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hpart_cross.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hpart_cross
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hpart_cross.header:
theorem hpart_cross {M : ℕ} (h : PartOK L M) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∑ m, hpart M m x * hpart M m (periodicLatticeShift x μ) = Real.cos (Real.pi / (2 * M))

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hpart_lip.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hpart_lip
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hpart_lip.header:
theorem hpart_lip {M : ℕ} (h : PartOK L M) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∑ m, (hpart M m (periodicLatticeShift x μ) - hpart M m x) ^ 2 ≤ (Real.pi / (2 * M)) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hres_sq_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hres_sq_eq
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hres_sq_eq.header:

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hres_diff_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hres_diff_le
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hres_diff_le.header:
theorem hres_diff_le (M : ℕ) (I : Set ((μ : Fin 3) → Fin (Kc L M μ))) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hvec.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hvec
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hvec.header: noncomputable def hvec (M : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : EuclideanSpace ℝ ((μ : Fin 3) → Fin (Kc L M μ))

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hvec_dist_sq.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hvec_dist_sq
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hvec_dist_sq.header:

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hvec_step.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hvec_step
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.hvec_step.header:

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.Dq_part.header:
theorem Dq_part {ell M : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) (hP : PartOK L M) (I : Set ((μ : Fin 3) → Fin (Kc L M μ)))

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.lemma24_cov_C.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.lemma24_cov_C
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.lemma24_cov_C.header:
theorem lemma24_cov_C {ell M : ℕ} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hstrict : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell < L μ + 1) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, ell ∣ (L μ + 1)) (hP : PartOK L M)
    {Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} (hLB : LamBlockSum ell Lam)
    (W : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (hb : Function.Bijective (H0 Lam (Q1jet ell W)))
    (Bt : Bond L → SuTwo) (hBt : OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt) (hBT : OnLambdaT Lam Bt)
    (I : Set ((μ : Fin 3) → Fin (Kc L M μ)))
    (hI : ∀ m (b : Bond L), (b.1 ∈ Lam ∨ periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ Lam) → hpart M m b.1 ≠ 0 → m ∈ I)
    (u : ((μ : Fin 3) → Fin (Kc L M μ)) → GaugeFn L) (κ ε : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hρ : rhoOf ell κ < Real.pi / 2) (hrg : Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * κ) < r0)
    (hS : ∀ m ∈ I, ∀ x, hpart M m x ≠ 0 → ∀ z ∈ Ball x (4 * (1 * ell)), ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform (u m) W (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ κ) :
    (1 / 54 : ℝ) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) * ∑ b : Bond L, ‖Cop Lam (Q1jet ell W) Bt b‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (1 + ε) * ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, ‖curlValueCovariant W (Cop Lam (Q1jet ell W) Bt) p‖ ^ 2
        + Eims ell (Real.pi / (2 * M)) ((4 * ell : ℕ) * (Real.pi / (2 * M))) κ ε
          * ∑ b : Bond L, ‖Cop Lam (Q1jet ell W) Bt b‖ ^ 2
    ∧ bondEnergy Bt ≤ ∑ b : Bond L, ‖Cop Lam (Q1jet ell W) Bt b‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.unitBgU_chart_small.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.unitBgU_chart_small
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.unitBgU_chart_small.header:
theorem unitBgU_chart_small {ell M R k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hA : Admissible ell M R k S) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hL : LambdaOK2 ell M R k S Lam) (hT3 : ∀ μ, 3 ≤ Lu μ + 1)
    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (γ : GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (V : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (e1 q1 : ℝ) (hq1 : 0 ≤ q1)
    (hlink : ∀ e : PeriodicLatticeEdge (scaleUp ell k Lu), BK S k e → dv (V e) ≤ e1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (hplaq : ∀ t : PlaqT (scaleUp ell k Lu), plaqIn (BK S k) t → dv (pw 1 V t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) ≤ q1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2)
    (hsm : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * q1 ≤ 1)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu) (hag : AgreeAt (Ball (embY ell k Lu hell z) (rhoT ell k)) (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) V)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu} (hy : y ∈ Lam) (hz : pdist y z + 17 ≤ R * M) (μ : Fin 3) :
    frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform (fun w => γ (embY ell k Lu hell w))
        (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).unitBgU (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ e1 + 3 * Real.pi * q1

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.winSum_mono.header:

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.stokes_pt_scalar.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.stokes_pt_scalar
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.stokes_pt_scalar.header:
theorem stokes_pt_scalar {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, n ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → ℝ)
    (p : CoarsePlaquette L n) :
    (coarseCurlValue hdvd (lineCoarseRestrict n A) p) ^ 2
      ≤ (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 3) * winSum n (fun z => (curlValue A z) ^ 2) p

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.stokes_pt.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.stokes_pt
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.stokes_pt.header:
theorem stokes_pt {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ : Fin 3, n ∣ (L μ + 1)) (A : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (p : CoarsePlaquette L n) :
    (n : ℝ) * ‖coarseCurlSuTwo hdvd (lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n A) p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * winSum n (fun z => ‖flatCurlValue A z‖ ^ 2) p

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.winSum_count.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.winSum_count
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.winSum_count.header:
theorem winSum_count {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (f : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L → ℝ) (hf : ∀ q, 0 ≤ f q)
    (Y : Finset (CoarsePlaquette L n)) (Pq : Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette L))
    (hY : ∀ p ∈ Y, ∀ x ∈ blockOf p.1.1 n, ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, ∀ j ∈ Finset.range n, winPl p.2 x i j ∈ Pq) :
    ∑ p ∈ Y, winSum n f p ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ q ∈ Pq, f q

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sq_four_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sq_four_le
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.sq_four_le.header:
theorem sq_four_le {E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (a b c d : E) :

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.norm_gaugeActA'.header:
theorem norm_gaugeActA' {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (γ : GaugeFn L) (B : Bond L → SuTwo) (b : Bond L) :

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.norm_curl_gauge.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.norm_curl_gauge
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.norm_curl_gauge.header:

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.stokes_chart.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.stokes_chart
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.stokes_chart.header:
theorem stokes_chart {ell k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 0 < ell) (hu : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ)
    (U : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (W : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 Lu)
    (y : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) → SuTwo) (B : Bond Lu → SuTwo) (q : PeriodicLatticePlaquette Lu)
    (γ : GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (s κ ε : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hwin : ∀ x ∈ blockOf (embY ell k Lu hell q.1) (ell ^ k), ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (ell ^ k), ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (ell ^ k),
      frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform γ U ((winPl q.2 x i j).1, q.2.1.1) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ s / (ell : ℝ) ^ k ∧
      frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform γ U ((winPl q.2 x i j).1, q.2.1.2) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ s / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)
    (hW1 : frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform (fun w => γ (embY ell k Lu hell w)) W (q.1, q.2.1.1) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ κ)
    (hW2 : frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform (fun w => γ (embY ell k Lu hell w)) W (q.1, q.2.1.2) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ κ) :
    (ell : ℝ) ^ k * ‖curlValueCovariant W B q‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (1 + ε) * ((1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2) *
            winSum (ell ^ k) (Gwin U y (s / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)) (plaqE ell k Lu hell q))
        + (1 + 1 / ε) * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k * (16 * κ ^ 2 * (‖B (periodicLatticeShift q.1 q.2.1.1, q.2.1.2)‖ ^ 2
            + ‖B (periodicLatticeShift q.1 q.2.1.2, q.2.1.1)‖ ^ 2) + 8 * Dq hell γ y B q))

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.rows_drift_sub.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.rows_drift_sub
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.rows_drift_sub.header:
theorem rows_drift_sub (hell : 0 < ell) (V : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (W : ℕ → Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hcl : ∀ l, l < k → ∀ z ∈ W l, z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ l) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((bgTower (GF ell k Lu) V l (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ ε l)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (hr : ∀ j, j < k → Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ε j) < r0)
    (j : Fin (k + 1)) (Rw : Finset {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j})
    (hW : ∀ r ∈ Rw, ∀ l, l < (j : ℕ) → Ball r.1.1 (rhoT ell j - rhoT ell l) ⊆ W l)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ r ∈ Rw, ((ell : ℝ) ^ (j : ℕ)) ^ 3 * ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull x ⟨j, r⟩
        - (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull x ⟨j, r⟩‖ ^ 2
      ≤ delLoc ell ε j ^ 2 * ‖bondRestr (fun e => ∃ r ∈ Rw, Foot ell (j : ℕ) r.1 e) x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.row_identity.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.row_identity
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.row_identity.header:
theorem row_identity {ell k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (V : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (B : BondFnL2 Lu)
    (hQ : (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull y = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (gparams ell k Lu hell S V a Lam).tau B)
    (b : Bond Lu) (hb : unitBondEmb ell k Lu hell b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) k) :
    ‖lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo (ell ^ k) (WithLp.ofLp y) (bondsE ell k Lu hell b) - (WithLp.ofLp B) b‖
      = ‖(WithLp.ofLp ((bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull y)) (pe (gparams ell k Lu hell S V a Lam) b hb)
          - (WithLp.ofLp ((bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull y)) (pe (gparams ell k Lu hell S V a Lam) b hb)‖

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.Qgauge.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.Qgauge
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.Qgauge.header:
theorem Qgauge {ell k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (B : BondFnL2 Lu)
    (hQ : (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) U).Qfull y = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).tau B)
    (γ : GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (periodicGaugeTransform γ U)).Qfull (adBL γ y)
      = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (gparams ell k Lu hell S (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) a Lam).tau
          (adBL (uOf ell k Lu hell γ) B)

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.norm_bondRestr_adBL.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.norm_bondRestr_adBL
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.norm_bondRestr_adBL.header:

    (y : BondFnL2 L) : ‖bondRestr P (adBL γ y)‖ = ‖bondRestr P y‖

AdalyFormal.M2Unit.chart_bond_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2Unit.chart_bond_le
AdalyFormal.M2Unit.chart_bond_le.header:
theorem chart_bond_le {ell k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (B : BondFnL2 Lu)
    (hQ : (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) U).Qfull y = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).tau B)
    (γ : GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (W : ℕ → Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hcl : ∀ l, l < k → ∀ z ∈ W l, z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ l) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((bgTower (GF ell k Lu) (periodicGaugeTransform γ U) l (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ ε l)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (hr : ∀ j, j < k → Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ε j) < r0)
    (b : Bond Lu) (hb : unitBondEmb ell k Lu hell b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) k)
    (hW : ∀ l, l < k → Ball (embY ell k Lu hell b.1) (rhoT ell k - rhoT ell l) ⊆ W l) :
    ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 3 * ‖lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo (ell ^ k) (gaugeActA γ (WithLp.ofLp y)) (bondsE ell k Lu hell b)
        - gaugeActA (uOf ell k Lu hell γ) (WithLp.ofLp B) b‖ ^ 2
      ≤ delLoc ell ε (Fin.last k) ^ 2 * ‖bondRestr (Foot ell k (unitBondEmb ell k Lu hell b)) y‖ ^ 2

    (hgood : ∀ q ∈ Qs, ∀ c, InBox q.1 c → embY ell k Lu (by omega) c ∈ S.Om k) :
    (1 / 54 : ℝ) * (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 5) * ∑ b : Bond Lu, ‖GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) Bt b‖ ^ 2

              * ∑ b : Bond Lu, ‖GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) Bt b‖ ^ 2
            + 8 * 7776 * (1 / ((ell : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2) * delLoc ell εr (Fin.last k) ^ 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2))
