AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.zc_val.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.zc_val
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.zc_val.header:
theorem zc_val {N B a : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (h12 : 12 * B ≤ N) (ha : a < N) :
    (5 * B ≤ a / B * B ∧ zc N B a = a / B * B - 5 * B) ∨ (a / B * B < 5 * B ∧ zc N B a = a / B * B + N - 5 * B)

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.off_bounds.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.off_bounds
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.off_bounds.header:
theorem off_bounds {N B r a b : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (h12 : 12 * B ≤ N) (ha : a < N) (hb : b < N) (hr : r ≤ 5 * B)
    (hp : pcd N a b ≤ r) :
    5 * B ≤ offN N (zc N B a) b + r ∧ offN N (zc N B a) b + 1 ≤ 6 * B + r

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.pcd_of_off.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.pcd_of_off
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.pcd_of_off.header:
theorem pcd_of_off {N B a b : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (h12 : 12 * B ≤ N) (ha : a < N) (hb : b < N)
    (hoff : offN N (zc N B a) b < 12 * B) : pcd N a b ≤ 7 * B

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.pcd_mul.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.pcd_mul
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.pcd_mul.header: theorem pcd_mul (Nu n a b : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : pcd (Nu * n) (n * a) (n * b) = n * pcd Nu a b

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.hb_class.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.hb_class
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.hb_class.header:
theorem hb_class {ell M R k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hT : TorusOK ell M Lu) (hMb : 4 * ell + 141 ≤ 5 * M) (hRM : 21 * M + 2 * ell + 12 ≤ R * M)
    (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (hL : LambdaOK2 ell M R k S Lam)
    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (α₀ : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α₀)
    (hU : ClassCoupled ell M 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U)
    (α₁ : ℝ) (hα1 : α₁ = (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀)) (hsm : KDsmall ell (12 * M * α₁)) :
    Function.Bijective (H0 Lam (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam).Q1)

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.unit_floor_clas.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.unit_floor_class_nohb
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.unit_floor_clas.header:
theorem unit_floor_class_nohb {ell M R k Mc : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hT : TorusOK ell M Lu) (hMc : M = ell * Mc) (hMc0 : 0 < Mc)
    (hMbig : 6 * Mc + 4 * ell + 165 ≤ 5 * M) (hRM : 21 * M + 2 * ell + 12 ≤ R * M)
    (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (hL : LambdaOK2 ell M R k S Lam)
    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (α₀ : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α₀)
    (hU : ClassCoupled ell M 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U)
    (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo) (hBt : OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt) (hBT : OnLambdaT Lam Bt)
    (α₁ : ℝ) (hα1 : α₁ = (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀))
    (ha1 : (12 : ℝ) * M * α₁ ≤ 1)
    (hsm4 : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * rho1 12 M α₁ ≤ 1)
    (hsmq : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * qM1 (12 * M * α₁) ≤ 1)
    (hsmA : (1 + 3 * Real.pi) * rho1 12 M α₁ ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4))
    (hrr : Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * rho1 12 M α₁)) < r0)
    (hsm : AdalyFormal.M1DK.KDsmall ell (12 * M * α₁))
    (hρ : rhoOf ell (kapM1 (12 * M * α₁)) < Real.pi / 2)
    (hrg : Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * kapM1 (12 * M * α₁)) < r0)
    (ε ε' : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε' : 0 < ε')
    (hcoef : 0 ≤ cU ell Mc (kapM1 (12 * M * α₁)) ε ε')
    (y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hQ : (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) U).Qfull y = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam).tau
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) Bt))) :
    (cU ell Mc (kapM1 (12 * M * α₁)) ε ε' * bondEnergy Bt
      ≤ 2 * (1 + ε) * (1 + ε') / (ell : ℝ) ^ k *
          ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell k Lu))).filter
              (fun p => p ∈ plaqIn (S.Om k)), ‖curlValueCovariant U (WithLp.ofLp y) p‖ ^ 2
        + (1 + ε) / (ell : ℝ) ^ k * ((1 + ε') * 64 * rho1 12 M α₁ ^ 2
            + (1 + 1 / ε') * 62208 * delStar ell (SstarM ell 12 M α₁) ^ 2)
          * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k y)
    ∧ (cU ell Mc (kapM1 (12 * M * α₁)) ε ε'
          * ∑ b : Bond Lu, ‖GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) Bt b‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 2 * (1 + ε) * (1 + ε') / (ell : ℝ) ^ k *
          ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell k Lu))).filter
              (fun p => p ∈ plaqIn (S.Om k)), ‖curlValueCovariant U (WithLp.ofLp y) p‖ ^ 2
        + (1 + ε) / (ell : ℝ) ^ k * ((1 + ε') * 64 * rho1 12 M α₁ ^ 2
            + (1 + 1 / ε') * 62208 * delStar ell (SstarM ell 12 M α₁) ^ 2)
          * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k y)
    ∧ bondEnergy Bt ≤ ∑ b : Bond Lu, ‖GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) Bt b‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.chart_of_class_.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.chart_of_class_nonvac
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.chart_of_class_.header:
theorem chart_of_class_nonvac {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hLu : ∀ μ, Lu μ + 1 = 384) {α₀ : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α₀)
    (χ : Bond (scaleUp 2 1 Lu) → ℝ) (hχ : ∀ e, |χ e| ≤ α₀ * ((((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 1)⁻¹) ^ 2 / 10) :
    ∃ (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp 2 1 Lu)) (g : GaugeFn (scaleUp 2 1 Lu)) (V : LinkCfg (scaleUp 2 1 Lu)),
      PerCubeRegular2 2 32 12 1 (AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.fullTower 2 1 Lu) α₀ ((((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 1)⁻¹) U ∧
      M1Regular 2 32 12 1 (AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.fullTower 2 1 Lu) (((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀)) ((((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 1)⁻¹) V ∧
      AgreeAt (Ball (embY 2 1 Lu (by norm_num) (fun _ => 0)) 32) (periodicGaugeTransform g U) V

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.headline_numeri.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.headline_numerics
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.headline_numeri.header:
theorem headline_numerics {ell m R : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hm : 8 ≤ m) (hR : 22 ≤ R) :
    ell ^ m = ell * ell ^ (m - 1) ∧ 0 < ell ^ (m - 1) ∧
    6 * ell ^ (m - 1) + 4 * ell + 165 ≤ 5 * ell ^ m ∧
    21 * ell ^ m + 2 * ell + 12 ≤ R * ell ^ m

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.scaleUp_succ.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.scaleUp_succ
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.scaleUp_succ.header:
theorem scaleUp_succ (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (σ : Fin 3) :
    scaleUp ell k Lu σ + 1 = (Lu σ + 1) * ell ^ k

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.offc_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.offc_eq
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.offc_eq.header:
theorem offc_eq {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (z x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (σ : Fin 3) :
    offc z x σ = offN (L σ + 1) (z σ).val (x σ).val

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.pcd_le_pdist.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.pcd_le_pdist
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.pcd_le_pdist.header:
theorem pcd_le_pdist {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (σ : Fin 3) :
    pcd (L σ + 1) (x σ).val (y σ).val ≤ pdist x y

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.cornerOf.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.cornerOf
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.cornerOf.header: def cornerOf {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (B : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : PeriodicLatticeSite L

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.cornerOf_grid.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.cornerOf_grid
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.cornerOf_grid.header:
theorem cornerOf_grid {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {B : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (hBN : ∀ σ : Fin 3, B ∣ L σ + 1)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : GridCorner B (cornerOf B x)

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.corner_off_ball.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.corner_off_ball
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.corner_off_ball.header:
theorem corner_off_ball {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {B r : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (hr : r ≤ 5 * B)
    {x x' : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (σ : Fin 3) (hx : 12 * B ≤ L σ + 1) (hp : pdist x x' ≤ r) :
    5 * B ≤ offc (cornerOf B x) x' σ + r ∧ offc (cornerOf B x) x' σ + 1 ≤ 6 * B + r

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.box_pcd.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.box_pcd
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.box_pcd.header:
theorem box_pcd {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {B : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (x x'' : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hbox : x'' ∈ siteBox (cornerOf B x) (12 * B)) (σ : Fin 3) :
    pcd (L σ + 1) (x σ).val (x'' σ).val ≤ 7 * B

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.embY_mem_Om.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.embY_mem_Om
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.embY_mem_Om.header:
theorem embY_mem_Om {ell M R k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 0 < ell)
    {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} {Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)} (hL : AdalyFormal.StatementLane.LambdaOK ell M R k S Lam)
    {y0 : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu} (hy0 : y0 ∈ Lam) {u : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu} (hu : pdist y0 u ≤ R * M) :
    embY ell k Lu hell u ∈ S.Om k

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.near_mem_Om.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.near_mem_Om
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.near_mem_Om.header:
theorem near_mem_Om {ell M R k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 0 < ell)
    {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) {Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)}
    (hL : AdalyFormal.StatementLane.LambdaOK ell M R k S Lam)
    {y0 : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu} (hy0 : y0 ∈ Lam) (q : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)
    (hD : pdist y0 q + 21 * M ≤ R * M) (x'' : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hn : ∀ σ : Fin 3, pcd (scaleUp ell k Lu σ + 1) (embY ell k Lu hell q σ).val (x'' σ).val ≤ 7 * (M * ell ^ k)) :
    x'' ∈ S.Om k

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.om_anti.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.om_anti
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.om_anti.header:
theorem om_anti {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {S : Tower L} (h : ∀ j : ℕ, S.Om (j + 1) ⊆ S.Om j) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j) :
    S.Om j ⊆ S.Om i

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.class_cube_at.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.class_cube_at
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.class_cube_at.header:
theorem class_cube_at {ell M R k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 0 < ell) (hM : 0 < M)
    {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) {Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)}
    (hL : AdalyFormal.StatementLane.LambdaOK ell M R k S Lam)
    {y0 : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu} (hy0 : y0 ∈ Lam) (q : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)
    (hD : pdist y0 q + 21 * M ≤ R * M) (r : ℕ) (hr : r + 128 * ell ^ k + 5 ≤ 5 * (M * ell ^ k)) :
    ∃ z : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      IsClassCube ell M 12 k S (siteBox z (12 * bigSide M ell k)) k ∧
      ∀ x' ∈ Ball (embY ell k Lu hell q) r, ∀ σ : Fin 3, 12 * bigSide M ell k ≤ scaleUp ell k Lu σ + 1 →
        2 * (64 * ell ^ k) + 4 ≤ offc z x' σ ∧ offc z x' σ + 2 * (64 * ell ^ k) + 5 ≤ 12 * bigSide M ell k

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.chart_of_class.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.chart_of_class
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.chart_of_class.header:
theorem chart_of_class {ell M R k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 0 < ell) (hM : 0 < M)
    {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) {Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)}
    (hL : AdalyFormal.StatementLane.LambdaOK ell M R k S Lam)
    {y0 : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu} (hy0 : y0 ∈ Lam) (q : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)
    (hD : pdist y0 q + 21 * M ≤ R * M) (r : ℕ) (hr : r + 128 * ell ^ k + 5 ≤ 5 * (M * ell ^ k))
    (hLu : ∀ σ : Fin 3, 1 ≤ scaleUp ell k Lu σ) {α₀ : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α₀) {U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)}
    (hP : PerCubeRegular2 ell M 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U) :
    ∃ (g : GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (V : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)),
      AdalyFormal.M1.M1Regular ell M 12 k S ((ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀)) ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ V ∧
      AgreeAt (Ball (embY ell k Lu hell q) r) (periodicGaugeTransform g U) V

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.pcd_next.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.pcd_next
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.pcd_next.header: theorem pcd_next (N a : ℕ) (ha : a < N) : pcd N a ((a + 1) % N) ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.inBox_pdist.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.inBox_pdist
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.inBox_pdist.header: theorem inBox_pdist {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {z c : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu} (h : InBox z c) : pdist z c ≤ 3

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.psi1_supp.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.psi1_supp
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.psi1_supp.header:
theorem psi1_supp {M K : ℕ} (m : Fin K) (t : ℕ) (h : psi1 M K m t ≠ 0) :
    m.val = t / M ∨ m.val = (t / M + K - 1) % K

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.prev_val.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.prev_val
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.prev_val.header:
theorem prev_val {K a : ℕ} (ha : a < K) :
    (a = 0 ∧ (a + K - 1) % K = K - 1) ∨ (a ≠ 0 ∧ (a + K - 1) % K = a - 1)

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.psi1_pcd.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.psi1_pcd
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.psi1_pcd.header:
theorem psi1_pcd {M K : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hK : 2 ≤ K) (m : Fin K) {t t' : ℕ} (ht : t < K * M) (ht' : t' < K * M)
    (h : psi1 M K m t ≠ 0) (h' : psi1 M K m t' ≠ 0) : pcd (K * M) t t' ≤ 2 * M

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.hpart_pdist.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.hpart_pdist
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.hpart_pdist.header:
theorem hpart_pdist {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {Mc : ℕ} (hP : PartOK Lu Mc) (m : (μ : Fin 3) → Fin (Kc Lu Mc μ))
    {x x' : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu} (h : hpart Mc m x ≠ 0) (h' : hpart Mc m x' ≠ 0) : pdist x x' ≤ 6 * Mc

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.pdist_embY.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.pdist_embY
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.pdist_embY.header:
theorem pdist_embY {ell k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 0 < ell) (a b : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu) :
    pdist (embY ell k Lu hell a) (embY ell k Lu hell b) = ell ^ k * pdist a b

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.genC_support.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.genC_support
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.genC_support.header:
theorem genC_support {ell k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (U : AdalyFormal.Balaban.CoercUMainDesigned.LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo) (hBT : OnLambdaT Lam Bt) (b : Bond Lu)
    (hb : AdalyFormal.StatementLaneG.GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam) Bt b ≠ 0) :
    ∃ y0 ∈ Lam, pdist y0 b.1 ≤ 2 * ell

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.qs_near.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.qs_near
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.qs_near.header:
theorem qs_near {ell k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell : 0 < ell) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo)
    (hBT : OnLambdaT Lam Bt) (q : PeriodicLatticePlaquette Lu) (b : Bond Lu)
    (hb : GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam) Bt b ≠ 0) (hbq : pdist b.1 q.1 ≤ 1) :
    ∃ y0 ∈ Lam, pdist y0 q.1 ≤ 2 * ell + 1

AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.unit_floor_clas.name: AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.unit_floor_class
AdalyFormal.M2UnitCharts.unit_floor_clas.header:
theorem unit_floor_class {ell M R k Mc : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hT : TorusOK ell M Lu) (hMc : M = ell * Mc) (hMc0 : 0 < Mc)
    (hMbig : 6 * Mc + 4 * ell + 165 ≤ 5 * M) (hRM : 21 * M + 2 * ell + 12 ≤ R * M)
    (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (hL : LambdaOK2 ell M R k S Lam)
    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (α₀ : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α₀)
    (hU : ClassCoupled ell M 12 k S α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ U)
    (hb : Function.Bijective (IngredientFamilyR2.H0 Lam (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam).Q1))
    (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo) (hBt : OnLambdaTildeIn Lam ell Bt) (hBT : OnLambdaT Lam Bt)
    (α₁ : ℝ) (hα1 : α₁ = (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * (2 * α₀))
    (ha1 : (12 : ℝ) * M * α₁ ≤ 1)
    (hsm4 : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * rho1 12 M α₁ ≤ 1)
    (hsmq : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * qM1 (12 * M * α₁) ≤ 1)
    (hsmA : (1 + 3 * Real.pi) * rho1 12 M α₁ ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4))
    (hrr : Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * rho1 12 M α₁)) < r0)
    (hρ : rhoOf ell (kapM1 (12 * M * α₁)) < Real.pi / 2)
    (hrg : Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * kapM1 (12 * M * α₁)) < r0)
    (ε ε' : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε' : 0 < ε')
    (hcoef : 0 ≤ cU ell Mc (kapM1 (12 * M * α₁)) ε ε')
    (y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hQ : (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) U).Qfull y = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam).tau
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) Bt))) :
    (cU ell Mc (kapM1 (12 * M * α₁)) ε ε' * bondEnergy Bt
      ≤ 2 * (1 + ε) * (1 + ε') / (ell : ℝ) ^ k *
          ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell k Lu))).filter
              (fun p => p ∈ plaqIn (S.Om k)), ‖curlValueCovariant U (WithLp.ofLp y) p‖ ^ 2
        + (1 + ε) / (ell : ℝ) ^ k * ((1 + ε') * 64 * rho1 12 M α₁ ^ 2
            + (1 + 1 / ε') * 62208 * delStar ell (SstarM ell 12 M α₁) ^ 2)
          * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k y)
    ∧ (cU ell Mc (kapM1 (12 * M * α₁)) ε ε'
          * ∑ b : Bond Lu, ‖GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) Bt b‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 2 * (1 + ε) * (1 + ε') / (ell : ℝ) ^ k *
          ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell k Lu))).filter
              (fun p => p ∈ plaqIn (S.Om k)), ‖curlValueCovariant U (WithLp.ofLp y) p‖ ^ 2
        + (1 + ε) / (ell : ℝ) ^ k * ((1 + ε') * 64 * rho1 12 M α₁ ^ 2
            + (1 + 1 / ε') * 62208 * delStar ell (SstarM ell 12 M α₁) ^ 2)
          * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k y)
    ∧ bondEnergy Bt ≤ ∑ b : Bond Lu, ‖GenP.genC (gparams ell k Lu (by omega) S U a Lam) Bt b‖ ^ 2

UNI.Strict.strict_hyps.header:
theorem strict_hyps (ell m R k : ℕ) (a₀ : ℝ) (hell3 : 3 ≤ ell) (hell10 : ell ≤ 10) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (ha₁ : a₀ * (ell : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) ≤ 1) :
    ∃ (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (α₀ : ℝ), 0 < α₀ ∧
      ∃ F : CubeFam (scaleUp ell k Lu),
        (∀ (s : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j f : ℕ), (s, j, f) ∈ F →
            10 ≤ f ∧ (f : ℝ) * ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀) ∧
        TorusOK ell (ell ^ m) Lu ∧
        ∃ S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu), Admissible ell (ell ^ m) R k S ∧
        ∃ Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu), AdalyFormal.StatementLaneG.LambdaOK2 (Lu := Lu) (Lf := scaleUp ell k Lu) ell (ell ^ m) R k S Lam ∧
        ∃ U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu),
          ClassCoupledU ell (ell ^ m) F k S α₀ (((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹) U ∧
          ∀ F' : CubeFam (scaleUp ell k Lu),
            (∀ (s : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))) (j f : ℕ), (s, j, f) ∈ F' →
              10 ≤ f ∧ (f : ℝ) * ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₀) →
            ¬ ClassCoupledP boxClass ell (ell ^ m) F' k S α₀ (((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹) U

theorem InstAtWD_congr_classΦ {ell k : ℕ} (hell0 : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ) {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (γ₀ : ℝ)
    {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} {Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)} {M R : ℕ} {Fm : CF} (h : LocHyp ell M R k S Lam)
    (hM : 2 ≤ M) (hcov : CoversOmQ ell M Fm k S) {U U' : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)}
    (hUU : ∀ e : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu), ClassBondQ ell M Fm k S e → U e = U' e) :
    InstAtWD ell k hell0 a Lu γ₀ S Lam U ↔ InstAtWD ell k hell0 a Lu γ₀ S Lam U'

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Av.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Av
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Av.header: noncomputable def Av (τ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (f : Z3 → M2) (x : Z3) : M2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.D1.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.D1
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.D1.header: def D1 (τ : Fin 3) (f : Z3 → M2) (D : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.SupB.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.SupB
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.SupB.header: def SupB (f : Z3 → M2) (B : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.frobNorm_sum_le.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.frobNorm_sum_le
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.frobNorm_sum_le.header:
theorem frobNorm_sum_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → M2) :
    frobNorm (∑ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, frobNorm (g i)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_shift.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_shift
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_shift.header:
theorem av_shift (τ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (f : Z3 → M2) (x e : Z3) :
    Av τ n f (x + e) = Av τ n (fun y => f (y + e)) x

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_sub.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_sub
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_sub.header:
theorem av_sub (τ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (f g : Z3 → M2) (x : Z3) :
    Av τ n f x - Av τ n g x = Av τ n (fun y => f y - g y) x

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_sup.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_sup
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_sup.header:
theorem av_sup {τ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {f : Z3 → M2} {B : ℝ} (h : ∀ y, frobNorm (f y) ≤ B) (x : Z3) :
    frobNorm (Av τ n f x) ≤ B

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.tele.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.tele
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.tele.header:
theorem tele (τ : Fin 3) (f : Z3 → M2) (x : Z3) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, (f (x + ((k : ℤ) + 1) • ev τ) - f (x + (k : ℤ) • ev τ)) = f (x + (m : ℤ) • ev τ) - f x

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.d1_far.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.d1_far
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.d1_far.header:
theorem d1_far {τ : Fin 3} {f : Z3 → M2} {D : ℝ} (h : D1 τ f D) (x : Z3) (m : ℕ) :
    frobNorm (f (x + (m : ℤ) • ev τ) - f x) ≤ m * D

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_diff.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_diff
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_diff.header:
theorem av_diff (τ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (f : Z3 → M2) (x : Z3) :
    Av τ n f (x + ev τ) - Av τ n f x
      = ((2 * (n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹) • (f (x + ((n : ℤ) + 1) • ev τ) - f (x - (n : ℤ) • ev τ))

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_d1_sup.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_d1_sup
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_d1_sup.header:
theorem av_d1_sup {τ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {h : Z3 → M2} {B : ℝ} (hB : SupB h B) (x : Z3) :
    frobNorm (Av τ n h (x + ev τ) - Av τ n h x) ≤ 2 * B / (2 * n + 1)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_d1.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_d1
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_d1.header:
theorem av_d1 {τ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {f : Z3 → M2} {D : ℝ} (hD : D1 τ f D) (x : Z3) :
    frobNorm (Av τ n f (x + ev τ) - Av τ n f x) ≤ D

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_step.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_step
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_step.header:
theorem av_step (τ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (f : Z3 → M2) (x : Z3) :
    Av τ (n + 1) f x - Av τ n f x
      = ((2 * (n : ℝ) + 3)⁻¹) • (f (x + ((n : ℤ) + 1) • ev τ) + f (x - ((n : ℤ) + 1) • ev τ) - (2 : ℝ) • Av τ n f x)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_sup_win.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_sup_win
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_sup_win.header:
theorem av_sup_win {τ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {f : Z3 → M2} {B : ℝ} (x : Z3)
    (h : ∀ k : ℕ, k < 2 * n + 1 → frobNorm (f (x + ((k : ℤ) - n) • ev τ)) ≤ B) :
    frobNorm (Av τ n f x) ≤ B

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_const.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_const
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_const.header: theorem av_const (τ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (g : M2) (x : Z3) : Av τ n (fun _ => g) x = g

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.d1_far_int.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.d1_far_int
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.d1_far_int.header:
theorem d1_far_int {τ : Fin 3} {f : Z3 → M2} {D : ℝ} (h : D1 τ f D) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (x : Z3) (a b : ℤ) :
    frobNorm (f (x + a • ev τ) - f (x + b • ev τ)) ≤ ((|a - b| : ℤ) : ℝ) * D

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.far_av.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.far_av
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.far_av.header:
theorem far_av {τ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {f : Z3 → M2} {D : ℝ} (h : D1 τ f D) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (x : Z3) (a : ℤ)
    (ha : |a| = n + 1) : frobNorm (f (x + a • ev τ) - Av τ n f x) ≤ (2 * n + 1) * D

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_step_d1.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_step_d1
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_step_d1.header:
theorem av_step_d1 {τ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {f : Z3 → M2} {D : ℝ} (h : D1 τ f D) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (x : Z3) :
    frobNorm (Av τ (n + 1) f x - Av τ n f x) ≤ 2 * D

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_step_sup.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_step_sup
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_step_sup.header:
theorem av_step_sup {τ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {h : Z3 → M2} {B : ℝ} (hB : SupB h B) (x : Z3) :
    frobNorm (Av τ (n + 1) h x - Av τ n h x) ≤ 4 * B / (2 * n + 3)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_step_dd.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_step_dd
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_step_dd.header:
theorem av_step_dd {τ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {f : Z3 → M2} {D : ℝ} (h : D1 τ f D) (x : Z3) :
    frobNorm ((Av τ (n + 1) f (x + ev τ) - Av τ n f (x + ev τ)) - (Av τ (n + 1) f x - Av τ n f x))
      ≤ 4 * D / (2 * n + 3)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_step2.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_step2
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_step2.header:
theorem av_step2 {τ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {f : Z3 → M2} {D : ℝ} (h : D1 τ f D) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (x : Z3) :
    frobNorm ((Av τ (n + 2) f x - Av τ (n + 1) f x) - (Av τ (n + 1) f x - Av τ n f x)) ≤ 10 * D / (2 * n + 5)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.step_scaled.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.step_scaled
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.step_scaled.header:
theorem step_scaled {o1 o2 n1 n2 η A Y : ℝ} {w : ℕ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hsm : A * w * w * Y ≤ 1) (ho1 : 0 ≤ o1) (hn1 : 0 ≤ n1) (hη : 0 ≤ η) (ho2 : 0 ≤ o2) (hn2 : 0 ≤ n2)
    (bo1 : o1 ≤ A * w * Y) (bn1 : n1 ≤ A * w * Y) (bo2 : o2 ≤ A * Y) (bn2 : n2 ≤ A * Y) (bη : η ≤ A * Y) :
    T1st o1 o2 n1 n2 η w ≤ Kst * (A * w * Y) ∧ T2st o1 o2 n1 n2 η w ≤ Kst * (A * Y)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.holB_mono.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.holB_mono
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.holB_mono.header:
theorem holB_mono {W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2} {D D' : Set Z3} {η η' : ℝ} (h : HolB W D η) (hD : D' ⊆ D) (hη : η ≤ η') :
    HolB W D' η'

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Ch.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Ch
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Ch.header: def Ch (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (S : Set Z3) (B : ℝ) (w : ℕ) (Y : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Ch.mono.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Ch.mono
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Ch.mono.header:
theorem Ch.mono {W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2} {S S' : Set Z3} {B B' : ℝ} {w : ℕ} {Y : ℝ} (h : Ch W S B w Y) (hS : S' ⊆ S)
    (hB : B ≤ B') (hY : 0 ≤ Y) : Ch W S' B' w Y

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stack_dir.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stack_dir
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stack_dir.header:
theorem stack_dir (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) {σ τ₁ τ₂ : Fin 3} (hτ : ∀ ν, ν ≠ σ → ν = τ₁ ∨ ν = τ₂) (h1σ : τ₁ ≠ σ)
    (h2σ : τ₂ ≠ σ) {lo hi : Z3} (hlh : ∀ ν, ν ≠ σ → lo ν ≤ hi ν) {s a0 : ℤ} (hs : 2 ≤ s) {w : ℕ} (hw : 1 ≤ w)
    {Y A : ℝ} (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, Kst ^ N * A * w * w * Y ≤ 1 →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ N → Ch W (SlabS σ lo hi (a0 + (i : ℤ) * s) (a0 + ((i : ℤ) + 1) * s)) A w Y) →
      HolB W (SlabS σ lo hi a0 (a0 + ((N : ℤ) + 1) * s)) (A * Y) →
      Ch W (SlabS σ lo hi a0 (a0 + ((N : ℤ) + 1) * s)) (Kst ^ N * A) w Y

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Box3.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Box3
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Box3.header: def Box3 (lo hi : Z3) : Set Z3

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cb.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cb
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cb.header: def cb (base : Z3) (s : ℤ) (lo hi : Fin 3 → ℕ) : Set Z3

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cb_slab.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cb_slab
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cb_slab.header:
theorem cb_slab (base : Z3) (s : ℤ) (lo hi : Fin 3 → ℕ) (σ : Fin 3) (a b : ℕ) :
    cb base s (Function.update lo σ a) (Function.update hi σ b)
      = SlabS σ (fun μ => base μ + (lo μ : ℤ) * s) (fun μ => base μ + ((hi μ : ℤ) + 1) * s - 1)
          (base σ + (a : ℤ) * s) (base σ + ((b : ℤ) + 1) * s)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stack_cb.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stack_cb
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stack_cb.header:
theorem stack_cb (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) {σ τ₁ τ₂ : Fin 3} (hτ : ∀ ν, ν ≠ σ → ν = τ₁ ∨ ν = τ₂) (h1σ : τ₁ ≠ σ)
    (h2σ : τ₂ ≠ σ) (base : Z3) {s : ℤ} (hs : 2 ≤ s) (lo hi : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hlh : ∀ ν, lo ν ≤ hi ν) (hlo : lo σ = 0)
    (N : ℕ) (hhi : hi σ = N) {w : ℕ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) {Y A : ℝ} (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hsm : Kst ^ N * A * w * w * Y ≤ 1)
    (hp : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ N → Ch W (cb base s (Function.update lo σ i) (Function.update hi σ i)) A w Y)
    (hH : HolB W (cb base s lo hi) (A * Y)) : Ch W (cb base s lo hi) (Kst ^ N * A) w Y

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cellBox_eq.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cellBox_eq
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cellBox_eq.header:
theorem cellBox_eq {s : ℤ} (hs : 0 < s) (o I : Z3) (idx : Fin 3 → ℕ) :
    cellBox s o (fun μ => I μ + (idx μ : ℤ)) = cb (fun μ => I μ * s - o μ) s idx idx

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cb_sub_BoxR.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cb_sub_BoxR
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cb_sub_BoxR.header:
theorem cb_sub_BoxR {s : ℤ} (hs : 0 < s) (o : Z3) (n : ℕ) (lo hi : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hhi : ∀ μ, hi μ ≤ 2 * n) :
    cb (fun μ => (o μ / s - n) * s - o μ) s lo hi ⊆ BoxR s o n

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.BoxR_sub_cb.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.BoxR_sub_cb
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.BoxR_sub_cb.header:
theorem BoxR_sub_cb {s : ℤ} (hs : 0 < s) (o : Z3) (n : ℕ) (lo hi : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hlo : ∀ μ, lo μ = 0)
    (hhi : ∀ μ, hi μ = 2 * n) : BoxR s o n ⊆ cb (fun μ => (o μ / s - n) * s - o μ) s lo hi

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.upd0.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.upd0
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.upd0.header: theorem upd0 (a b c x : ℕ) : Function.update ![a, b, c] 0 x = ![x, b, c]

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.upd1.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.upd1
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.upd1.header: theorem upd1 (a b c x : ℕ) : Function.update ![a, b, c] 1 x = ![a, x, c]

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.upd2.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.upd2
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.upd2.header: theorem upd2 (a b c x : ℕ) : Function.update ![a, b, c] 2 x = ![a, b, x]

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.le3.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.le3
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.le3.header: theorem le3 {a b c n : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ n) (hb : b ≤ n) (hc : c ≤ n) : ∀ μ, (![a, b, c] : Fin 3 → ℕ) μ ≤ n

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.lehi.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.lehi
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.lehi.header:
theorem lehi {a b c a' b' c' : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ a') (hb : b ≤ b') (hc : c ≤ c') :
    ∀ μ, (![a, b, c] : Fin 3 → ℕ) μ ≤ (![a', b', c'] : Fin 3 → ℕ) μ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.box_chart.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.box_chart
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.box_chart.header:
theorem box_chart (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) {s : ℤ} (hs : 2 ≤ s) (o : Z3) (n : ℕ) {w : ℕ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) {Y c : ℝ}
    (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hsm : Kst ^ (2 * n) * (Kst ^ (2 * n) * (Kst ^ (2 * n) * c)) * w * w * Y ≤ 1)
    (hcell : ∀ cc : Z3, (∀ μ, o μ / s - n ≤ cc μ ∧ cc μ ≤ o μ / s + n) →
      ∃ G : Z3 → SU2, C1 W G (cellBox s o cc) (c * (w * Y)) ∧ C2 W G (cellBox s o cc) (c * Y))
    (hH : HolB W (BoxR s o n) (c * Y)) :
    Ch W (BoxR s o n) (Kst ^ (2 * n) * (Kst ^ (2 * n) * (Kst ^ (2 * n) * c))) w Y

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.D1v.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.D1v
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.D1v.header: def D1v (e : Z3) (f : Z3 → M2) (D : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.D1v_of_D1.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.D1v_of_D1
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.D1v_of_D1.header: theorem D1v_of_D1 {τ : Fin 3} {f : Z3 → M2} {D : ℝ} (h : D1 τ f D) : D1v (ev τ) f D

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_diff_v.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_diff_v
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_diff_v.header:
theorem av_diff_v (τ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (f : Z3 → M2) (x e : Z3) :
    Av τ n f (x + e) - Av τ n f x = Av τ n (fun y => f (y + e) - f y) x

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_D1v.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_D1v
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_D1v.header: theorem av_D1v {τ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {f : Z3 → M2} {e : Z3} {D : ℝ} (h : D1v e f D) : D1v e (Av τ n f) D

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_SupB.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_SupB
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_SupB.header: theorem av_SupB {τ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {f : Z3 → M2} {B : ℝ} (h : SupB f B) : SupB (Av τ n f) B

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.P2.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.P2
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.P2.header: noncomputable def P2 (τ₁ τ₂ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (f : Z3 → M2) : Z3 → M2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_d1.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_d1
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_d1.header: theorem p2_d1 {τ₁ τ₂ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {f : Z3 → M2} {e : Z3} {D : ℝ} (h : D1v e f D) : D1v e (P2 τ₁ τ₂ n f) D

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_sup.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_sup
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_sup.header: theorem p2_sup {τ₁ τ₂ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {f : Z3 → M2} {B : ℝ} (h : SupB f B) : SupB (P2 τ₁ τ₂ n f) B

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.dlt.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.dlt
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.dlt.header: def dlt (e : Z3) (f : Z3 → M2) : Z3 → M2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.dlt_sup.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.dlt_sup
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.dlt_sup.header: theorem dlt_sup {e : Z3} {f : Z3 → M2} {D : ℝ} (h : D1v e f D) : SupB (dlt e f) D

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.dlt_av.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.dlt_av
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.dlt_av.header: theorem dlt_av (τ : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (f : Z3 → M2) (e : Z3) : dlt e (Av τ n f) = Av τ n (dlt e f)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.dlt_D1v.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.dlt_D1v
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.dlt_D1v.header: theorem dlt_D1v {e e' : Z3} {f : Z3 → M2} {D : ℝ} (h : D1v e f D) : D1v e (dlt e' f) (2 * D)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.dlt_comm.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.dlt_comm
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.dlt_comm.header: theorem dlt_comm (e e' : Z3) (f : Z3 → M2) : dlt e' (dlt e f) = dlt e (dlt e' f)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stencil_eq.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stencil_eq
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stencil_eq.header:
theorem stencil_eq (g : Z3 → M2) (x e e' : Z3) :
    g (x + e + e') - g (x + e) - g (x + e') + g x = dlt e' (dlt e g) x

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_dd.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_dd
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_dd.header:
theorem p2_dd {τ₁ τ₂ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {f : Z3 → M2} {D : ℝ} (h1 : D1 τ₁ f D) (h2 : D1 τ₂ f D)
    {e' : Z3} (he' : D1v e' f D) (μ : Fin 3) (hμ : μ = τ₁ ∨ μ = τ₂) (x : Z3) :
    frobNorm (P2 τ₁ τ₂ n f (x + ev μ + e') - P2 τ₁ τ₂ n f (x + ev μ) - P2 τ₁ τ₂ n f (x + e') + P2 τ₁ τ₂ n f x)
      ≤ 2 * D / (2 * n + 1)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Pk.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Pk
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Pk.header: noncomputable def Pk (τ₁ τ₂ : Fin 3) (k j : ℕ) (f : Z3 → M2) : Z3 → M2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_step.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_step
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_step.header:
theorem p2_step {τ₁ τ₂ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {f : Z3 → M2} {D : ℝ} (h1 : D1 τ₁ f D) (h2 : D1 τ₂ f D) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (x : Z3) : frobNorm (P2 τ₁ τ₂ (n + 1) f x - P2 τ₁ τ₂ n f x) ≤ 4 * D

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_step_d.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_step_d
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_step_d.header:
theorem p2_step_d {τ₁ τ₂ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {f : Z3 → M2} {D : ℝ} (h1 : D1 τ₁ f D) (h2 : D1 τ₂ f D) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (μ : Fin 3) (hμ : μ = τ₁ ∨ μ = τ₂) (x : Z3) :
    frobNorm ((P2 τ₁ τ₂ (n + 1) f (x + ev μ) - P2 τ₁ τ₂ n f (x + ev μ)) - (P2 τ₁ τ₂ (n + 1) f x - P2 τ₁ τ₂ n f x))
      ≤ 8 * D / (2 * n + 1)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_step2.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_step2
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.p2_step2.header:
theorem p2_step2 {τ₁ τ₂ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {f : Z3 → M2} {D : ℝ} (h1 : D1 τ₁ f D) (h2 : D1 τ₂ f D) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (x : Z3) :
    frobNorm ((P2 τ₁ τ₂ (n + 2) f x - P2 τ₁ τ₂ (n + 1) f x) - (P2 τ₁ τ₂ (n + 1) f x - P2 τ₁ τ₂ n f x))
      ≤ 36 * D / (2 * n + 3)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta.header: noncomputable def zeta (w : ℕ) (t : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf.header: noncomputable def cf (w t : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta_mem.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta_mem
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta_mem.header: theorem zeta_mem (t : ℕ) : 0 ≤ zeta w t ∧ zeta w t ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta_of_le.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta_of_le
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta_of_le.header: theorem zeta_of_le {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ w) : zeta w t = 1

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta_of_ge.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta_of_ge
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta_of_ge.header: theorem zeta_of_ge {t : ℕ} (ht : 2 * w ≤ t) : zeta w t = 0

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf_nonneg
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf_nonneg.header: theorem cf_nonneg (t : ℕ) : 0 ≤ cf w t

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf_le.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf_le
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf_le.header: theorem cf_le (t : ℕ) : cf w t ≤ t

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf_le_2w.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf_le_2w
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf_le_2w.header: theorem cf_le_2w (t : ℕ) : cf w t ≤ 2 * w

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta_d1.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta_d1
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta_d1.header: theorem zeta_d1 (t : ℕ) : |zeta w (t + 1) - zeta w t| ≤ 10 / w

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta_d2.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta_d2
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.zeta_d2.header: theorem zeta_d2 (t : ℕ) : |zeta w (t + 2) - zeta w (t + 1) - (zeta w (t + 1) - zeta w t)| ≤ 32 / w ^ 2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf_d1.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf_d1
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf_d1.header: theorem cf_d1 (t : ℕ) : |cf w (t + 1) - cf w t| ≤ 21

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf_d2.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf_d2
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cf_d2.header: theorem cf_d2 (t : ℕ) : |cf w (t + 2) - cf w (t + 1) - (cf w (t + 1) - cf w t)| ≤ 84 / w

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.PFam.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.PFam
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.PFam.header: structure PFam (P : ℕ → Z3 → M2) (τ₁ τ₂ : Fin 3) (VB D : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.pfam_P2.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.pfam_P2
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.pfam_P2.header:
theorem pfam_P2 {τ₁ τ₂ : Fin 3} {f : Z3 → M2} {VB D : ℝ} (hsup : SupB f VB) (h1 : D1 τ₁ f D) (h2 : D1 τ₂ f D)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D) : PFam (fun n => P2 τ₁ τ₂ n f) τ₁ τ₂ VB D

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Phi.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Phi
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Phi.header: noncomputable def Phi (w : ℕ) (P : ℕ → Z3 → M2) (t : ℕ) (x : Z3) : M2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_zero.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_zero
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_zero.header: theorem phi_zero (x : Z3) : Phi w P 0 x = 0

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_one.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_one
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_one.header: theorem phi_one (x : Z3) : Phi w P 1 x = P 0 x

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_dt.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_dt
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_dt.header: theorem phi_dt (t : ℕ) (x : Z3) : frobNorm (Phi w P (t + 1) x - Phi w P t x) ≤ 21 * VB + 8 * w * D

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_dx.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_dx
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_dx.header:
theorem phi_dx (t : ℕ) (x : Z3) (μ : Fin 3) (hμ : μ = τ₁ ∨ μ = τ₂) :
    frobNorm (Phi w P t (x + ev μ) - Phi w P t x) ≤ 2 * w * D

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_dxx.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_dxx
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_dxx.header:
theorem phi_dxx (t : ℕ) (x : Z3) (μ ν : Fin 3) (hμ : μ = τ₁ ∨ μ = τ₂) (hν : ν = τ₁ ∨ ν = τ₂) :
    frobNorm (Phi w P t (x + ev μ + ev ν) - Phi w P t (x + ev μ) - Phi w P t (x + ev ν) + Phi w P t x) ≤ 2 * D

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_dtx.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_dtx
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_dtx.header:
theorem phi_dtx (t : ℕ) (x : Z3) (μ : Fin 3) (hμ : μ = τ₁ ∨ μ = τ₂) :
    frobNorm ((Phi w P (t + 1) (x + ev μ) - Phi w P t (x + ev μ)) - (Phi w P (t + 1) x - Phi w P t x)) ≤ 29 * D

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_dtt.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_dtt
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.phi_dtt.header:
theorem phi_dtt (t : ℕ) (x : Z3) :
    frobNorm ((Phi w P (t + 2) x - Phi w P (t + 1) x) - (Phi w P (t + 1) x - Phi w P t x)) ≤ 84 * VB / w + 186 * D

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.mul_diff.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.mul_diff
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.mul_diff.header:
theorem mul_diff (a b a' b' : SU2) :
    frobNorm (((a * b : SU2) : M2) - ((a' * b' : SU2) : M2)) ≤ frobNorm ((a : M2) - a') + frobNorm ((b : M2) - b')

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.inv_diff.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.inv_diff
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.inv_diff.header: theorem inv_diff (a a' : SU2) : frobNorm (((a⁻¹ : SU2) : M2) - ((a'⁻¹ : SU2) : M2)) = frobNorm ((a : M2) - a')

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.prod4_diff.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.prod4_diff
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.prod4_diff.header:
theorem prod4_diff (a b c d a' b' c' d' : SU2) :
    frobNorm (((a * b * c * d : SU2) : M2) - ((a' * b' * c' * d' : SU2) : M2))
      ≤ frobNorm ((a : M2) - a') + frobNorm ((b : M2) - b') + frobNorm ((c : M2) - c') + frobNorm ((d : M2) - d')

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.prod4_sub_one.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.prod4_sub_one
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.prod4_sub_one.header:
theorem prod4_sub_one (a b c d : SU2) :
    frobNorm (((a * b * c * d : SU2) : M2) - 1)
      ≤ frobNorm ((a : M2) - 1) + frobNorm ((b : M2) - 1) + frobNorm ((c : M2) - 1) + frobNorm ((d : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.su2_sub_rel.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.su2_sub_rel
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.su2_sub_rel.header:
theorem su2_sub_rel {Y k Z k' : SU2} (h : Y = k * Z * k'⁻¹) :
    frobNorm ((k' : M2) - k) ≤ frobNorm ((Y : M2) - 1) + frobNorm ((Z : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.conj_diff.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.conj_diff
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.conj_diff.header:
theorem conj_diff (c c' Y Y' : SU2) :
    frobNorm (((c' * Y' * c'⁻¹ : SU2) : M2) - ((c * Y * c⁻¹ : SU2) : M2))
      ≤ frobNorm ((Y' : M2) - Y) + 2 * frobNorm ((c' : M2) - c) * frobNorm ((Y : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.comm_bound.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.comm_bound
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.comm_bound.header:
theorem comm_bound (X Y : SU2) :
    frobNorm (((X * Y : SU2) : M2) - ((Y * X : SU2) : M2)) ≤ 2 * frobNorm ((X : M2) - 1) * frobNorm ((Y : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.su2_sub_one_inv.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.su2_sub_one_inv
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.su2_sub_one_inv.header: theorem su2_sub_one_inv (a : SU2) : frobNorm (((a⁻¹ : SU2) : M2) - 1) = frobNorm ((a : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.TrB.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.TrB
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.TrB.header: def TrB (σ : Fin 3) (lo hi : Z3) (p : Z3) : Prop

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.SlabS.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.SlabS
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.SlabS.header: def SlabS (σ : Fin 3) (lo hi : Z3) (a b : ℤ) : Set Z3

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp.header: def bp (σ : Fin 3) (c : ℤ) (p : Z3) : Z3

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Tz.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Tz
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Tz.header: def Tz (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (σ : Fin 3) (Go Gn : Z3 → SU2) (x : Z3) : SU2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Az.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Az
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Az.header: def Az (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (σ : Fin 3) (Go : Z3 → SU2) (x : Z3) : SU2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.kap0.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.kap0
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.kap0.header: def kap0 (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (σ : Fin 3) (Go Gn : Z3 → SU2) (x : Z3) : SU2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.G0.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.G0
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.G0.header: def G0 (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (σ : Fin 3) (c : ℤ) (Go Gn : Z3 → SU2) (p : Z3) : SU2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Vf.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Vf
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Vf.header: noncomputable def Vf (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (σ : Fin 3) (c : ℤ) (Go Gn : Z3 → SU2) (x : Z3) : M2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp_add_self.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp_add_self
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp_add_self.header: theorem bp_add_self (σ : Fin 3) (c : ℤ) (p : Z3) : bp σ c (p + ev σ) = bp σ c p

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp_add_ne.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp_add_ne
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp_add_ne.header: theorem bp_add_ne (σ : Fin 3) (c : ℤ) (p : Z3) {ν : Fin 3} (h : ν ≠ σ) : bp σ c (p + ev ν) = bp σ c p + ev ν

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp_of_plane.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp_of_plane
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp_of_plane.header: theorem bp_of_plane (σ : Fin 3) {c : ℤ} {p : Z3} (h : p σ = c) : bp σ c p = p

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g0_plane_val.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g0_plane_val
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g0_plane_val.header:
theorem g0_plane_val (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (σ : Fin 3) (c : ℤ) (Go Gn : Z3 → SU2) {x : Z3} (hxc : x σ = c) :
    G0 W σ c Go Gn x = (Az W σ Go x)⁻¹ * Go (x - ev σ) * W (x - ev σ) σ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g0_plane.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g0_plane
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g0_plane.header:
theorem g0_plane (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (σ : Fin 3) (c : ℤ) (Go Gn : Z3 → SU2) {x : Z3} (hxc : x σ = c) {ν : Fin 3} (hν : ν ≠ σ) :
    gt W (G0 W σ c Go Gn) x ν
      = (Az W σ Go x)⁻¹ * (Go (x - ev σ) * (hol W (x - ev σ) ν σ)⁻¹ * (Go (x - ev σ))⁻¹)
        * gt W Go (x - ev σ) ν * Az W σ Go (x + ev ν)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp_mem.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp_mem
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp_mem.header: theorem bp_mem {p : Z3} (hp : p ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) : bp σ c p ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.plane_below.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.plane_below
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.plane_below.header:
theorem plane_below {x : Z3} (hx : x ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (hxc : x σ = c) :
    x - ev σ ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c0 c ∧ x - ev σ - ev σ ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c0 c

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.slab_mono.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.slab_mono
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.slab_mono.header:
theorem slab_mono {σ : Fin 3} {lo hi : Z3} {a b a' b' : ℤ} (h1 : a' ≤ a) (h2 : b ≤ b') {p : Z3} (hp : p ∈ SlabS σ lo hi a b) :
    p ∈ SlabS σ lo hi a' b'

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.tr_add_ne.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.tr_add_ne
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.tr_add_ne.header: theorem tr_add_ne {σ : Fin 3} {lo hi : Z3} {p : Z3} {ν : Fin 3} (hν : ν = σ) (hp : TrB σ lo hi p) : TrB σ lo hi (p + ev ν)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.plane_N.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.plane_N
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.plane_N.header: theorem plane_N {σ : Fin 3} {lo hi : Z3} {c ch : ℤ} (hch : c + 2 ≤ ch) {x : Z3} (hx : x ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (hxc : x σ = c) : x + ev σ ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.K0c.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.K0c
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.K0c.header: noncomputable def K0c (o1 n1 η : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp_plane.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp_plane
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bp_plane.header: theorem bp_plane (σ : Fin 3) (c : ℤ) (p : Z3) : (bp σ c p) σ = c

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gt_G0.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gt_G0
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gt_G0.header:
theorem gt_G0 (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (σ : Fin 3) (c : ℤ) (Go Gn : Z3 → SU2) (p : Z3) (ν : Fin 3) :
    gt W (G0 W σ c Go Gn) p ν
      = kap0 W σ Go Gn (bp σ c p) * gt W Gn p ν * (kap0 W σ Go Gn (bp σ c (p + ev ν)))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g01c.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g01c
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g01c.header: noncomputable def g01c (o1 n1 η : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g02c.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g02c
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g02c.header: noncomputable def g02c (o1 o2 n1 n2 η : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bracket_bound.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bracket_bound
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.bracket_bound.header:
theorem bracket_bound (K0 K1 K2 K3 : SU2) (D0 D2 : M2) :
    frobNorm ((K2 : M2) * D2 * (K3 : M2)ᴴ - (K0 : M2) * D0 * (K1 : M2)ᴴ)
      ≤ frobNorm ((K2 : M2) - (K0 : M2)) * frobNorm D2 + frobNorm (D2 - D0)
        + frobNorm D0 * frobNorm ((K3 : M2) - (K1 : M2))

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gt_coe.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gt_coe
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gt_coe.header:
theorem gt_coe (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (κ G : Z3 → SU2) (p : Z3) (ν : Fin 3) :
    ((κ p * gt W G p ν * (κ (p + ev ν))⁻¹ : SU2) : M2) = (κ p : M2) * (gt W G p ν : M2) * (κ (p + ev ν) : M2)ᴴ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.az_bound.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.az_bound
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.az_bound.header:
theorem az_bound {x : Z3} (hx : x ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (hxc : x σ = c) :
    frobNorm (((Az W σ Go x : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ o1

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g0_plane_bond.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g0_plane_bond
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g0_plane_bond.header:
theorem g0_plane_bond {x : Z3} (hx : x ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (hxc : x σ = c) {ν : Fin 3} (hν : ν ≠ σ)
    (hxν : x + ev ν ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) :
    frobNorm (((gt W (G0 W σ c Go Gn) x ν : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ 3 * o1 + η

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.kap0_d1.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.kap0_d1
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.kap0_d1.header:
theorem kap0_d1 {x : Z3} (hx : x ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (hxc : x σ = c) {ν : Fin 3} (hν : ν ≠ σ)
    (hxν : x + ev ν ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) :
    frobNorm (((kap0 W σ Go Gn (x + ev ν) : SU2) : M2) - kap0 W σ Go Gn x) ≤ K0c o1 n1 η

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g0_c1.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g0_c1
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g0_c1.header:
theorem g0_c1 (ho1 : 0 ≤ o1) (hn1 : 0 ≤ n1) (hη : 0 ≤ η) :
    C1 W (G0 W σ c Go Gn) (SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (g01c o1 n1 η)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g0_c2.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g0_c2
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.g0_c2.header:
theorem g0_c2 (ho1 : 0 ≤ o1) (hn1 : 0 ≤ n1) (hη : 0 ≤ η) (ho2 : 0 ≤ o2) (hn2 : 0 ≤ n2) :
    C2 W (G0 W σ c Go Gn) (SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (g02c o1 o2 n1 n2 η)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.clampP.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.clampP
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.clampP.header: def clampP (σ : Fin 3) (c : ℤ) (lo hi : Z3) (y : Z3) : Z3

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.clampP_mem.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.clampP_mem
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.clampP_mem.header:
theorem clampP_mem (σ : Fin 3) (c ch : ℤ) (hch : c < ch) (lo hi : Z3) (hlh : ∀ ν, ν ≠ σ → lo ν ≤ hi ν) (y : Z3) :
    clampP σ c lo hi y ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch ∧ (clampP σ c lo hi y) σ = c

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.clampP_of_mem.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.clampP_of_mem
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.clampP_of_mem.header:
theorem clampP_of_mem {σ : Fin 3} {c : ℤ} {lo hi : Z3} {x : Z3} (hx : TrB σ lo hi x) (hxc : x σ = c) :

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.clampP_add_self.header: theorem clampP_add_self (σ : Fin 3) (c : ℤ) (lo hi : Z3) (y : Z3) : clampP σ c lo hi (y + ev σ) = clampP σ c lo hi y

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.clampP_add_ne.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.clampP_add_ne
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.clampP_add_ne.header:
theorem clampP_add_ne (σ : Fin 3) (c : ℤ) (lo hi : Z3) (y : Z3) {τ : Fin 3} (hτ : τ ≠ σ) :
    clampP σ c lo hi (y + ev τ) = clampP σ c lo hi y ∨ clampP σ c lo hi (y + ev τ) = clampP σ c lo hi y + ev τ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.isSu2_av.header: theorem isSu2_av {τ : Fin 3} {n : ℕ} {f : Z3 → M2} (h : ∀ y, IsSu2 (f y)) (x : Z3) : IsSu2 (Av τ n f x)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_zero_radius.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_zero_radius
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.av_zero_radius.header: theorem av_zero_radius (τ : Fin 3) (f : Z3 → M2) (x : Z3) : Av τ 0 f x = f x

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.hV.header: def hV (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (σ : Fin 3) (c : ℤ) (Go Gn : Z3 → SU2) (x : Z3) : SU2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.tp.header: def tp (σ : Fin 3) (c : ℤ) (p : Z3) : ℕ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Fz.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Fz
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Fz.header: noncomputable def Fz (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (σ τ₁ τ₂ : Fin 3) (c : ℤ) (lo hi : Z3) (Go Gn : Z3 → SU2) (w : ℕ) (p : Z3) : M2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.VBc.header: noncomputable def VBc (o1 n1 : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Dvc.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Dvc
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Dvc.header: noncomputable def Dvc (o1 o2 n1 n2 η : ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.F1c.header: noncomputable def F1c (o1 o2 n1 n2 η : ℝ) (w : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.tp_add_self.header: theorem tp_add_self {σ : Fin 3} {c : ℤ} {p : Z3} (h : c ≤ p σ) : tp σ c (p + ev σ) = tp σ c p + 1

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.tp_add_ne.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.tp_add_ne
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.tp_add_ne.header: theorem tp_add_ne {σ : Fin 3} {c : ℤ} (p : Z3) {ν : Fin 3} (h : ν ≠ σ) : tp σ c (p + ev ν) = tp σ c p

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.tp_plane.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.tp_plane
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.tp_plane.header: theorem tp_plane {σ : Fin 3} {c : ℤ} {p : Z3} (h : p σ = c) : tp σ c p = 0

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.hv_bound.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.hv_bound
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.hv_bound.header:
theorem hv_bound {x : Z3} (hx : x ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (hxc : x σ = c) :
    frobNorm (((hV W σ c Go Gn x : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ VBc o1 n1

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.vf_bound.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.vf_bound
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.vf_bound.header:
theorem vf_bound {x : Z3} (hx : x ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (hxc : x σ = c) :
    frobNorm (Vf W σ c Go Gn x) ≤ VBc o1 n1

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cay_vf.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cay_vf
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cay_vf.header: theorem cay_vf {x : Z3} (hx : x ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (hxc : x σ = c) : cay (Vf W σ c Go Gn x) = hV W σ c Go Gn x

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.vf_d1.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.vf_d1
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.vf_d1.header:
theorem vf_d1 {x : Z3} (hx : x ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (hxc : x σ = c) {ν : Fin 3} (hν : ν ≠ σ)
    (hxν : x + ev ν ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) :
    frobNorm (Vf W σ c Go Gn (x + ev ν) - Vf W σ c Go Gn x) ≤ Dvc o1 o2 n1 n2 η

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fh_sup.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fh_sup
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fh_sup.header: theorem fh_sup : SupB (fh W σ c lo hi Go Gn) (VBc o1 n1)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fh_d1.header: theorem fh_d1 {τ : Fin 3} (hτσ : τ ≠ σ) : D1 τ (fh W σ c lo hi Go Gn) (Dvc o1 o2 n1 n2 η)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fh_su2.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fh_su2
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fh_su2.header: theorem fh_su2 (y : Z3) : IsSu2 (fh W σ c lo hi Go Gn y)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.pfam_fh.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.pfam_fh
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.pfam_fh.header: theorem pfam_fh : PFam (fun n => P2 τ₁ τ₂ n (fh W σ c lo hi Go Gn)) τ₁ τ₂ (VBc o1 n1) (Dvc o1 o2 n1 n2 η)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fz_su2.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fz_su2
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fz_su2.header: theorem fz_su2 (p : Z3) : IsSu2 (Fz W σ τ₁ τ₂ c lo hi Go Gn w p)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fz_plane.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fz_plane
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fz_plane.header: theorem fz_plane {p : Z3} (hp : p σ = c) : Fz W σ τ₁ τ₂ c lo hi Go Gn w p = 0

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fz_one.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fz_one
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fz_one.header:
theorem fz_one {p : Z3} (hp : p ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (hp1 : p σ = c + 1) :
    Fz W σ τ₁ τ₂ c lo hi Go Gn w p = Vf W σ c Go Gn (bp σ c p)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fz_d1.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fz_d1
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fz_d1.header:
theorem fz_d1 {p : Z3} {ν : Fin 3} (hp : p ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (hpν : p + ev ν ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) :
    frobNorm (Fz W σ τ₁ τ₂ c lo hi Go Gn w (p + ev ν) - Fz W σ τ₁ τ₂ c lo hi Go Gn w p) ≤ F1c o1 o2 n1 n2 η w

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fz_d2.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fz_d2
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.fz_d2.header:
theorem fz_d2 {p : Z3} {μ ν : Fin 3} (h0 : p ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (h1 : p + ev ν ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch)
    (h2 : p + ev μ ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (h3 : p + ev μ + ev ν ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) :
    frobNorm (Fz W σ τ₁ τ₂ c lo hi Go Gn w (p + ev μ + ev ν) - Fz W σ τ₁ τ₂ c lo hi Go Gn w (p + ev μ)
      - (Fz W σ τ₁ τ₂ c lo hi Go Gn w (p + ev ν) - Fz W σ τ₁ τ₂ c lo hi Go Gn w p)) ≤ F2c o1 o2 n1 n2 η w

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Cy1c.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Cy1c
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Cy1c.header: noncomputable def Cy1c (o1 o2 n1 n2 η : ℝ) (w : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Cy2c.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Cy2c
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Cy2c.header: noncomputable def Cy2c (o1 o2 n1 n2 η : ℝ) (w : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.T1st.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.T1st
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.T1st.header: noncomputable def T1st (o1 o2 n1 n2 η : ℝ) (w : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.T2st.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.T2st
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.T2st.header: noncomputable def T2st (o1 o2 n1 n2 η : ℝ) (w : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.Gst.header:
noncomputable def Gst (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (σ τ₁ τ₂ : Fin 3) (c ch : ℤ) (lo hi : Z3) (Go Gn : Z3 → SU2) (w : ℕ) :
    Z3 → SU2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.su2_cross_bound.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.su2_cross_bound
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.su2_cross_bound.header:
theorem su2_cross_bound (A H X A' : SU2) :
    frobNorm (((A⁻¹ * H * X * A' : SU2) : M2) - (X : M2))
      ≤ frobNorm ((H : M2) - 1) + frobNorm ((A' : M2) - A) + 2 * frobNorm ((X : M2) - 1) * frobNorm ((A : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.memO.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.memO
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.memO.header: theorem memO {σ : Fin 3} {lo hi : Z3} {c0 c ch : ℤ} {p : Z3} (hp : p ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c0 ch) (h : p σ < c) : p ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c0 c

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.memN.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.memN
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.memN.header: theorem memN {σ : Fin 3} {lo hi : Z3} {c0 c ch : ℤ} {p : Z3} (hp : p ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c0 ch) (h : c ≤ p σ) : p ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gst_O.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gst_O
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gst_O.header: theorem gst_O {p : Z3} (hp : p ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c0 c) : Gst W σ τ₁ τ₂ c ch lo hi Go Gn w p = Go p

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gst_N.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gst_N
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gst_N.header:
theorem gst_N {p : Z3} (hp : p ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) :
    Gst W σ τ₁ τ₂ c ch lo hi Go Gn w p = cay (Fz W σ τ₁ τ₂ c lo hi Go Gn w p) * G0 W σ c Go Gn p

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gst_bond_N.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gst_bond_N
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gst_bond_N.header:
theorem gst_bond_N {p : Z3} {ν : Fin 3} (hp : p ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (hpν : p + ev ν ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) :
    gt W (Gst W σ τ₁ τ₂ c ch lo hi Go Gn w) p ν
      = cay (Fz W σ τ₁ τ₂ c lo hi Go Gn w p) * gt W (G0 W σ c Go Gn) p ν
        * (cay (Fz W σ τ₁ τ₂ c lo hi Go Gn w (p + ev ν)))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gst_cross.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gst_cross
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gst_cross.header:
theorem gst_cross {q : Z3} (hq : q ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c0 c) (hqN : q + ev σ ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) :
    gt W (Gst W σ τ₁ τ₂ c ch lo hi Go Gn w) q σ = Az W σ Go (q + ev σ)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.az_diff.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.az_diff
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.az_diff.header:
theorem az_diff {x : Z3} (hx : x ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (hxc : x σ = c) {μ : Fin 3} (hμ : μ ≠ σ)
    (hxμ : x + ev μ ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) :
    frobNorm (((Az W σ Go (x + ev μ) : SU2) : M2) - ((Az W σ Go x : SU2) : M2)) ≤ o2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.nonnegs.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.nonnegs
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.nonnegs.header:
theorem nonnegs : 0 ≤ K0c o1 n1 η ∧ 0 ≤ g01c o1 n1 η ∧ 0 ≤ g02c o1 o2 n1 n2 η ∧ 0 ≤ VBc o1 n1 ∧
    0 ≤ Dvc o1 o2 n1 n2 η ∧ 0 ≤ F1c o1 o2 n1 n2 η w ∧ 0 ≤ F2c o1 o2 n1 n2 η w ∧
    0 ≤ Cy1c o1 o2 n1 n2 η w ∧ 0 ≤ Cy2c o1 o2 n1 n2 η w

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stack2_c1.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stack2_c1
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stack2_c1.header: theorem stack2_c1 : C1 W (Gst W σ τ₁ τ₂ c ch lo hi Go Gn w) (SlabS σ lo hi c0 ch) (T1st o1 o2 n1 n2 η w)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stack2_c2_N.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stack2_c2_N
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stack2_c2_N.header:
theorem stack2_c2_N {p : Z3} {μ ν : Fin 3} (h0 : p ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (h1 : p + ev ν ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch)
    (h2 : p + ev μ ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) (h3 : p + ev μ + ev ν ∈ SlabS σ lo hi c ch) :
    frobNorm (((gt W (Gst W σ τ₁ τ₂ c ch lo hi Go Gn w) (p + ev μ) ν : SU2) : M2)
      - ((gt W (Gst W σ τ₁ τ₂ c ch lo hi Go Gn w) p ν : SU2) : M2))
      ≤ g02c o1 o2 n1 n2 η + g01c o1 n1 η * (2 * Cy1c o1 o2 n1 n2 η w)
        + Cy1c o1 o2 n1 n2 η w * Cy1c o1 o2 n1 n2 η w + Cy2c o1 o2 n1 n2 η w

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stack2_c2.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stack2_c2
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stack2_c2.header: theorem stack2_c2 : C2 W (Gst W σ τ₁ τ₂ c ch lo hi Go Gn w) (SlabS σ lo hi c0 ch) (T2st o1 o2 n1 n2 η w)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gt.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gt
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gt.header: def gt (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (G : Z3 → SU2) (p : Z3) (ν : Fin 3) : SU2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.C1.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.C1
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.C1.header: def C1 (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (G : Z3 → SU2) (S : Set Z3) (t : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.hol.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.hol
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.hol.header: def hol (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (p : Z3) (μ ν : Fin 3) : SU2

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.C1.mono.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.C1.mono
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.C1.mono.header:
theorem C1.mono {W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2} {G : Z3 → SU2} {S S' : Set Z3} {t t' : ℝ} (h : C1 W G S t) (hS : S' ⊆ S)
    (ht : t ≤ t') : C1 W G S' t'

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.n_conj.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.n_conj
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.n_conj.header: theorem n_conj (C A : SU2) : frobNorm (((C * A * C⁻¹ : SU2) : M2) - 1) = frobNorm (((A : SU2) : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.n_inv.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.n_inv
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.n_inv.header: theorem n_inv (A : SU2) : frobNorm (((A⁻¹ : SU2) : M2) - 1) = frobNorm (((A : SU2) : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.n_mul.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.n_mul
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.n_mul.header: theorem n_mul (A B : SU2) : frobNorm (((A * B : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ frobNorm (((A : SU2) : M2) - 1) + frobNorm (((B : SU2) : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.n_twist.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.n_twist
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.n_twist.header:
theorem n_twist (κ κ' A : SU2) :
    frobNorm (((κ * A * κ'⁻¹ : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ frobNorm (((A : SU2) : M2) - 1) + frobNorm (((κ⁻¹ * κ' : SU2) : M2) - 1)

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gt_mul.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gt_mul
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.gt_mul.header:
theorem gt_mul (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) (κ G : Z3 → SU2) (p : Z3) (ν : Fin 3) :
    gt W (fun q => κ q * G q) p ν = κ p * gt W G p ν * (κ (p + ev ν))⁻¹

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.ev_sub_add.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.ev_sub_add
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.ev_sub_add.header: theorem ev_sub_add (q : Z3) (σ : Fin 3) : q + ev σ - ev σ = q

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.sub_add_ev.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.sub_add_ev
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.sub_add_ev.header: theorem sub_add_ev (q : Z3) (σ : Fin 3) : q - ev σ + ev σ = q

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stackP.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stackP
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stackP.header:
theorem stackP (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) {O N : Set Z3} (σ : Fin 3) {Go Gn : Z3 → SU2} {tO tN η : ℝ}
    (htO : 0 ≤ tO) (htN : 0 ≤ tN) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hO : C1 W Go O tO) (hN : C1 W Gn N tN) (b : Z3 → Z3)
    (hbN : ∀ p ∈ N, b p ∈ N) (hbO : ∀ p ∈ N, b p - ev σ ∈ O)
    (hcol : ∀ p ∈ N, p + ev σ ∈ N → b (p + ev σ) = b p)
    (htr : ∀ p ∈ N, ∀ ν, ν ≠ σ → p + ev ν ∈ N → b (p + ev ν) = b p + ev ν)
    (hcross : ∀ p ∈ O, ∀ ν, p + ev ν ∈ N → ν = σ ∧ b (p + ev σ) = p + ev σ)
    (hno : ∀ p ∈ N, ∀ ν, p + ev ν ∈ O → False)
    (hdisj : ∀ p ∈ N, p ∉ O)
    (hpl : ∀ q ∈ O, ∀ ν, ν ≠ σ → q + ev ν ∈ O → q + ev σ ∈ N → q + ev σ + ev ν ∈ N →
      frobNorm (((hol W q ν σ : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ η) :
    ∃ G : Z3 → SU2, C1 W G (O ∪ N) (tO + 2 * tN + η) ∧ ∀ p ∈ O, G p = Go p

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stackM.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stackM
AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.stackM.header:
theorem stackM (W : Z3 → Fin 3 → SU2) {O N : Set Z3} (σ : Fin 3) {Go Gn : Z3 → SU2} {tO tN η : ℝ}
    (htO : 0 ≤ tO) (htN : 0 ≤ tN) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hO : C1 W Go O tO) (hN : C1 W Gn N tN) (b : Z3 → Z3)
    (hbN : ∀ p ∈ N, b p ∈ N) (hbO : ∀ p ∈ N, b p + ev σ ∈ O)
    (hcol : ∀ p ∈ N, p + ev σ ∈ N → b (p + ev σ) = b p)
    (htr : ∀ p ∈ N, ∀ ν, ν ≠ σ → p + ev ν ∈ N → b (p + ev ν) = b p + ev ν)
    (hcross : ∀ p ∈ N, ∀ ν, p + ev ν ∈ O → ν = σ ∧ b p = p)
    (hno : ∀ p ∈ O, ∀ ν, p + ev ν ∈ N → False)
    (hdisj : ∀ p ∈ N, p ∉ O)
    (hpl : ∀ B ∈ N, ∀ ν, ν ≠ σ → B + ev ν ∈ N → B + ev σ ∈ O → B + ev ν + ev σ ∈ O →
      frobNorm (((hol W B ν σ : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ η) :
    ∃ G : Z3 → SU2, C1 W G (O ∪ N) (tO + 2 * tN + η) ∧ ∀ p ∈ O, G p = Go p

AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cellZ.name: AdalyFormal.UnifLane.Z.cellZ

AdalyFormal.M1W2.Tfull_apply.header:
theorem Tfull_apply (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    Tfull G U A = (RImage G U).starProjection (gradAdj U A)

AdalyFormal.M1W2.T_cmp.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.T_cmp
AdalyFormal.M1W2.T_cmp.header:
theorem T_cmp (G₁ G₂ : TowerGeom L) (U₁ U₂ : Cfg L) (K : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (A : BondFnL2 L)
    (hN : ∀ f ∈ NK G₂ U₂ K, f ∈ NQp G₁ U₁)
    (hL : ∀ f ∈ NK G₂ U₂ K, lapDir G₁ U₁ f = lapDir G₂ U₂ f)
    (hD : gradAdj U₁ A = gradAdj U₂ A) :
    ‖Tfull G₂ U₂ A‖ ^ 2 - defK G₂ U₂ K A ≤ ‖Tfull G₁ U₁ A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1W2.G0_cmp.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.G0_cmp
AdalyFormal.M1W2.G0_cmp.header:
theorem G0_cmp {ell k₁ k₂ : ℕ} (S₁ S₂ : Tower L) (U₁ U₂ : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (K : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L))
    (A : BondFnL2 L)
    (hC : plaqMask (plaqIn (S₁.Om 0)) (curlCovariantLM_L2 U₁ A) = plaqMask (plaqIn (S₂.Om 0)) (curlCovariantLM_L2 U₂ A))
    (hM : ‖Ymass (geomOf ell k₁ S₁) U₁ a A‖ = ‖Ymass (geomOf ell k₂ S₂) U₂ a A‖)
    (hN : ∀ f ∈ NK (geomOf ell k₂ S₂) U₂ K, f ∈ NQp (geomOf ell k₁ S₁) U₁)
    (hL : ∀ f ∈ NK (geomOf ell k₂ S₂) U₂ K, lapDir (geomOf ell k₁ S₁) U₁ f = lapDir (geomOf ell k₂ S₂) U₂ f)
    (hD : gradAdj U₁ A = gradAdj U₂ A) :
    G0form S₂ ell k₂ U₂ a A - defK (geomOf ell k₂ S₂) U₂ K A ≤ G0form S₁ ell k₁ U₁ a A

AdalyFormal.M1W2.gradAdj_congr.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.gradAdj_congr
AdalyFormal.M1W2.gradAdj_congr.header:
theorem gradAdj_congr (U₁ U₂ : Cfg L) (A : BondFnL2 L)
    (h : ∀ b : Bond L, (WithLp.ofLp A) b ≠ 0 → U₁ b = U₂ b) : gradAdj U₁ A = gradAdj U₂ A

AdalyFormal.M1W2.lapFull_congr_at.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.lapFull_congr_at
AdalyFormal.M1W2.lapFull_congr_at.header:
theorem lapFull_congr_at (U₁ U₂ : Cfg L) (g : SiteL2 L) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (h1 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, U₁ (x, μ) = U₂ (x, μ))
    (h2 : ∀ μ : Fin 3, U₁ (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ, μ) = U₂ (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ, μ)) :
    (lapFull U₁ g) x = (lapFull U₂ g) x

AdalyFormal.M1W2.curl_zero_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.curl_zero_of
AdalyFormal.M1W2.curl_zero_of.header:
theorem curl_zero_of (U : Cfg L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)
    (h : ∀ e ∈ periodicPlaquetteBoundaryEdges p, A e = 0) : curlValueCovariant U A p = 0

AdalyFormal.M1W2.curl_congr_U.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.curl_congr_U
AdalyFormal.M1W2.curl_congr_U.header:
theorem curl_congr_U (U₁ U₂ : Cfg L) (A : Bond L → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L)
    (h : ∀ e ∈ periodicPlaquetteBoundaryEdges p, U₁ e = U₂ e) :
    curlValueCovariant U₁ A p = curlValueCovariant U₂ A p

AdalyFormal.M1W2.Qcomposite_congr_in.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.Qcomposite_congr_in
AdalyFormal.M1W2.Qcomposite_congr_in.header:
theorem Qcomposite_congr_in (bg : ℕ → Cfg L) (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (j : ℕ) :
    ∀ (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (lam lam' : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo),
      (∀ x ∈ Ball y (rhoT ell j), lam x = lam' x) → Qcomposite bg ell j lam y = Qcomposite bg ell j lam' y

AdalyFormal.M1W2.Qcomposite_zero_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.Qcomposite_zero_of
AdalyFormal.M1W2.Qcomposite_zero_of.header:
theorem Qcomposite_zero_of (bg : ℕ → Cfg L) (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (j : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (h : ∀ x ∈ Ball y (rhoT ell j), lam x = 0) :
    Qcomposite bg ell j lam y = 0

AdalyFormal.M1W2.findGreatest_congr_le.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.findGreatest_congr_le
AdalyFormal.M1W2.findGreatest_congr_le.header:
theorem findGreatest_congr_le (P Q : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q] (n₁ n₂ : ℕ) (h12 : n₂ ≤ n₁)
    (hPQ : ∀ m, P m ↔ Q m) (hQ : ∀ m, n₂ < m → ¬ Q m) : Nat.findGreatest P n₁ = Nat.findGreatest Q n₂

AdalyFormal.M1W2.strat_eq_of_agree.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.strat_eq_of_agree
AdalyFormal.M1W2.strat_eq_of_agree.header:
theorem strat_eq_of_agree (S₁ S₂ : Tower L) (k₁ k₂ : ℕ) (h12 : k₂ ≤ k₁) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hag : ∀ m, x ∈ S₁.Om m ↔ x ∈ S₂.Om m) (hvan : ∀ m, k₂ < m → x ∉ S₂.Om m) :
    AdalyFormal.M1.strat S₁ k₁ x = AdalyFormal.M1.strat S₂ k₂ x

AdalyFormal.M1W2.omGe_patch_iff.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.omGe_patch_iff
AdalyFormal.M1W2.omGe_patch_iff.header:
theorem omGe_patch_iff (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    OmGe (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg)) m x ↔ x ∈ (patchTower i Rg).Om m

AdalyFormal.M1W2.blockClosed_of_mul.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.blockClosed_of_mul
AdalyFormal.M1W2.blockClosed_of_mul.header:
theorem blockClosed_of_mul {s t : ℕ} {X : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} (h : BlockClosed (t * s) X) :
    BlockClosed s X

AdalyFormal.M1W2.towerAgree.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.towerAgree
AdalyFormal.M1W2.towerAgree.header:
theorem towerAgree (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : z ∈ Z) (m : ℕ) :
    z ∈ S.Om m ↔ z ∈ (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1))).Om m

AdalyFormal.M1W2.lam_near.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.lam_near
AdalyFormal.M1W2.lam_near.header:
theorem lam_near (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hx : Ball x (32 * ell ^ (i + 2)) ⊆ Z) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ k)
    (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam m) (hxy : pdist x y ≤ 9 * ell ^ m) :
    m = i ∨ m = i + 1

AdalyFormal.M1W2.lam_agree.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.lam_agree
AdalyFormal.M1W2.lam_agree.header:
theorem lam_agree (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ Z) (m : ℕ) :
    y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam m ↔ y ∈ (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1)))).Lam m

AdalyFormal.M1W2.omGe_agree.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.omGe_agree
AdalyFormal.M1W2.omGe_agree.header:
theorem omGe_agree (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hy : y ∈ Z) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    OmGe (geomOf ell k S) m y ↔ OmGe (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1)))) m y

AdalyFormal.M1W2.bondsLam_agree.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.bondsLam_agree
AdalyFormal.M1W2.bondsLam_agree.header:
theorem bondsLam_agree (m : ℕ) (b : Bond L) (h1 : b.1 ∈ Z) (h2 : coarseShift b.1 (ell ^ m) b.2 ∈ Z) :
    b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) m ↔ b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1)))) m

AdalyFormal.M1W2.strat_agree.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.strat_agree
AdalyFormal.M1W2.strat_agree.header:
theorem strat_agree (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : z ∈ Z) :
    AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k z = AdalyFormal.M1.strat (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1))) (i + 1) z

AdalyFormal.M1W2.wnorm_agree.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.wnorm_agree
AdalyFormal.M1W2.wnorm_agree.header:
theorem wnorm_agree (A : BondFnL2 L)
    (hA : ∀ b : Bond L, (WithLp.ofLp A) b ≠ 0 → b.1 ∈ Z ∧ periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ Z) :
    AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k A = AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1))) ell (i + 1) A

AdalyFormal.M1W2.pdist_shiftBack_le'.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.pdist_shiftBack_le'
AdalyFormal.M1W2.pdist_shiftBack_le'.header: theorem pdist_shiftBack_le' (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : pdist x (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ) ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M1W2.bdry_near.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.bdry_near
AdalyFormal.M1W2.bdry_near.header:
theorem bdry_near (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (he : e ∈ periodicPlaquetteBoundaryEdges p) : pdist p.1 e.1 ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M1W2.rvU.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.rvU
AdalyFormal.M1W2.rvU.header: noncomputable def rvU (ell : ℕ) (U : Cfg L) (A : BondFnL2 L) (m : ℕ) (b : Bond L) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.M1W2.rvU_zero_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.rvU_zero_of
AdalyFormal.M1W2.rvU_zero_of.header:
theorem rvU_zero_of (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg L) (A : BondFnL2 L) (m : ℕ) (b : Bond L)
    (h : ∀ e : Bond L, e.1 ∈ Ball b.1 (rhoT ell m) → (WithLp.ofLp A) e = 0) : rvU ell U A m b = 0

AdalyFormal.M1W2.rvU_congr_U.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.rvU_congr_U
AdalyFormal.M1W2.rvU_congr_U.header:
theorem rvU_congr_U (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (U₁ U₂ : Cfg L) (A : BondFnL2 L) (m : ℕ) (b : Bond L)
    (h : AgreeAt (Ball b.1 (2 * rhoT ell m)) U₁ U₂) : rvU ell U₁ A m b = rvU ell U₂ A m b

AdalyFormal.M1W2.ymass_sq_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.ymass_sq_eq
AdalyFormal.M1W2.ymass_sq_eq.header:
theorem ymass_sq_eq (ell k : ℕ) (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (A : BondFnL2 L) :
    ‖Ymass (geomOf ell k S) U a A‖ ^ 2 = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ∑ b : Bond L,
      if b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) m then a * (ell : ℝ) ^ m * ‖rvU ell U A m b‖ ^ 2 else 0

AdalyFormal.M1W2.deep_mem.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.deep_mem
AdalyFormal.M1W2.deep_mem.header:
theorem deep_mem {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ K) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ 32 * ell ^ (i + 2))
    (hxy : pdist x y ≤ r) : y ∈ Z

AdalyFormal.M1W2.near_of_ne.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.near_of_ne
AdalyFormal.M1W2.near_of_ne.header: theorem near_of_ne {b : Bond L} (hb : (WithLp.ofLp A) b ≠ 0) : ∃ x ∈ K, pdist x b.1 ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.M1W2.hD_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.hD_of
AdalyFormal.M1W2.hD_of.header: theorem hD_of : gradAdj U₁ A = gradAdj U₂ A

AdalyFormal.M1W2.hC_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.hC_of
AdalyFormal.M1W2.hC_of.header:
theorem hC_of :
    plaqMask (plaqIn (S.Om 0)) (curlCovariantLM_L2 U₁ A)
      = plaqMask (plaqIn ((patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1))).Om 0)) (curlCovariantLM_L2 U₂ A)

AdalyFormal.M1W2.siteMask_eq_self_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.siteMask_eq_self_of
AdalyFormal.M1W2.siteMask_eq_self_of.header:
theorem siteMask_eq_self_of (Sset : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (f : SiteL2 L) (h : ∀ x, x ∉ Sset → f x = 0) :
    siteMask Sset f = f

AdalyFormal.M1W2.hL_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.hL_of
AdalyFormal.M1W2.hL_of.header:
theorem hL_of (f : SiteL2 L) (hf : f ∈ NK (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1)))) U₂ K) :
    lapDir (geomOf ell k S) U₁ f = lapDir (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1)))) U₂ f

AdalyFormal.M1W2.hN_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.hN_of
AdalyFormal.M1W2.hN_of.header:
theorem hN_of (f : SiteL2 L) (hf : f ∈ NK (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1)))) U₂ K) :
    f ∈ NQp (geomOf ell k S) U₁

AdalyFormal.M1W2.rvU_near.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.rvU_near
AdalyFormal.M1W2.rvU_near.header:
theorem rvU_near (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg L) (A : BondFnL2 L) (m : ℕ) (b : Bond L)
    (hr : rvU ell U A m b ≠ 0) : ∃ e : Bond L, e.1 ∈ Ball b.1 (rhoT ell m) ∧ (WithLp.ofLp A) e ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.M1W2.row_near.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.row_near
AdalyFormal.M1W2.row_near.header:
theorem row_near (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg L) (m : ℕ) (b : Bond L) (hr : rvU ell U A m b ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x ∈ K, pdist x b.1 ≤ 1 + rhoT ell m

AdalyFormal.M1W2.hM_of.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.hM_of
AdalyFormal.M1W2.hM_of.header:
theorem hM_of (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    ‖Ymass (geomOf ell k S) U₁ a A‖ = ‖Ymass (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1)))) U₂ a A‖

AdalyFormal.M1W2.G0_real_ge_patch.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.G0_real_ge_patch
AdalyFormal.M1W2.G0_real_ge_patch.header:
theorem G0_real_ge_patch (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    G0form (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1))) ell (i + 1) U₂ a A
        - defK (geomOf ell (i + 1) (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1)))) U₂ K A
      ≤ G0form S ell k U₁ a A

AdalyFormal.M1W2.wnorm_real_eq_patch.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.wnorm_real_eq_patch
AdalyFormal.M1W2.wnorm_real_eq_patch.header:
theorem wnorm_real_eq_patch :
    AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k A = AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq (patchTower i (S.Om (i + 1))) ell (i + 1) A

AdalyFormal.M1W2.W3G0At.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.W3G0At
AdalyFormal.M1W2.W3G0At.header: def W3G0At (ell : ℕ) (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (U : Cfg L) (a cW : ℝ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M1W2.OptDecayAt.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.OptDecayAt
AdalyFormal.M1W2.OptDecayAt.header: def OptDecayAt (ell : ℕ) (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (U : Cfg L) (δ : ℝ) (d : ℕ) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M1W2.caseB_up.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.caseB_up
AdalyFormal.M1W2.caseB_up.header:
theorem caseB_up {j : ℕ} {w : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hp : IsPatch ell M k κ S j w)
    (hB : ∃ y ∈ Ball w ((c + 1) * gsp ell M κ j), y ∈ S.Om (j + 1)) :
    j + 1 ≤ k ∧ Ball w ((c + 1) * gsp ell M κ j) ⊆ S.Om j ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Ball w ((c + 1) * gsp ell M κ j), z ∉ S.Om (j + 2)

AdalyFormal.M1W2.caseB_down.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.caseB_down
AdalyFormal.M1W2.caseB_down.header:
theorem caseB_down {j : ℕ} {w : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hp : IsPatch ell M k κ S j w) (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    Ball w ((c + 1) * gsp ell M κ j) ⊆ S.Om (j - 1)

AdalyFormal.M1W2.rvU_zero_level.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.rvU_zero_level
AdalyFormal.M1W2.rvU_zero_level.header: theorem rvU_zero_level (ell : ℕ) (U : Cfg L) (A : BondFnL2 L) (b : Bond L) : rvU ell U A 0 b = (WithLp.ofLp A) b

AdalyFormal.M1W2.ymass_ge_lvl0.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.ymass_ge_lvl0
AdalyFormal.M1W2.ymass_ge_lvl0.header:
theorem ymass_ge_lvl0 (ell k : ℕ) (S : Tower L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (A : BondFnL2 L)
    (h0 : ∀ b : Bond L, (WithLp.ofLp A) b ≠ 0 → b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) 0) :
    a * ‖A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖Ymass (geomOf ell k S) U a A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1W2.wnorm_le_sq.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.wnorm_le_sq
AdalyFormal.M1W2.wnorm_le_sq.header: theorem wnorm_le_sq (S : Tower L) (ell k : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (A : BondFnL2 L) : wnormSq S ell k A ≤ ‖A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M1W2.g0_caseB.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.g0_caseB
AdalyFormal.M1W2.g0_caseB.header:
theorem g0_caseB {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j) (hik : i + 1 ≤ k) {w : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hZi : Ball w ((c + 1) * gsp ell M κ j) ⊆ S.Om i)
    (hZ2 : ∀ z ∈ Ball w ((c + 1) * gsp ell M κ j), z ∉ S.Om (i + 2))
    (U Up : Cfg L) (hU : ∀ e : Bond L, pdist w e.1 ≤ (c + 1) * gsp ell M κ j → U e = Up e)
    (a cW δ : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hW3 : W3G0At ell L Up a cW) (hDec : OptDecayAt ell L Up δ d)
    (B : BondFnL2 L)
    (hB : ∀ b : Bond L, (WithLp.ofLp B) b ≠ 0 → b.1 ∈ Ball w (c * gsp ell M κ j) ∨
      periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ Ball w (c * gsp ell M κ j)) :
    (cW - δ) * wnormSq S ell k B ≤ G0form S ell k U a B

AdalyFormal.M1W2.g0_caseA.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.g0_caseA
AdalyFormal.M1W2.g0_caseA.header:
theorem g0_caseA {j : ℕ} {w : PeriodicLatticeSite L}
    (hZ1 : ∀ z ∈ Ball w (c * gsp ell M κ j + 1), z ∉ S.Om 1)
    (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (B : BondFnL2 L)
    (hsupp : ∀ b : Bond L, (WithLp.ofLp B) b ≠ 0 → b.1 ∈ S.Om 0 ∨ periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ S.Om 0)
    (hB : ∀ b : Bond L, (WithLp.ofLp B) b ≠ 0 → b.1 ∈ Ball w (c * gsp ell M κ j) ∨
      periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2 ∈ Ball w (c * gsp ell M κ j)) :
    a * wnormSq S ell k B ≤ G0form S ell k U a B

AdalyFormal.M1W2.wnormSq_nonneg'.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.wnormSq_nonneg'
AdalyFormal.M1W2.wnormSq_nonneg'.header: theorem wnormSq_nonneg' (S' : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (B : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) : 0 ≤ wnormSq S' ell k B

AdalyFormal.M1W2.patchCoercive_W2.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.patchCoercive_W2
AdalyFormal.M1W2.patchCoercive_W2.header:
theorem patchCoercive_W2 (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a cs : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρ) (ε1 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1) (hη : etaC ell W cs ρ ε1 < 1)
    (Up : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hUp : ∀ j w, IsPatch ell M k κ S j w → ∀ e : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      pdist w e.1 ≤ (c + 1) * gsp ell M κ j → U e = Up j w e)
    (cW δ : ℝ)
    (hW3 : ∀ j w, IsPatch ell M k κ S j w → W3G0At ell (scaleUp ell k Lu) (Up j w) a cW)
    (hDec : ∀ j w, IsPatch ell M k κ S j w → OptDecayAt ell (scaleUp ell k Lu) (Up j w) δ d) :
    PatchCoercive ell M k κ c Lu hell0 S U a Lam ((1 - etaC ell W cs ρ ε1) * min a (cW - δ) - 2 * nuC ell ρ)

AdalyFormal.M1W2.ginv_eq_G0_flat.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.ginv_eq_G0_flat
AdalyFormal.M1W2.ginv_eq_G0_flat.header:
theorem ginv_eq_G0_flat (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell0 : 0 < ell) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S (flatCfg : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) a Lam).G)) :
