AdalyFormal.M1W2.patchCoercive_W2_flatW3.header:
theorem patchCoercive_W2_flatW3 {ell M R k κ c : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell0 : 0 < ell)
    {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hR1 : 1 ≤ R)
    (hR4 : (c + 4) * κ * ell ≤ R) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) {d : ℕ} (hdM : d + 32 * ell ^ 2 ≤ κ * M)
    {W : ℕ} (hW : 1 ≤ W) (hWR : W ≤ R * M * ell)
    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a cs : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (hp : HatPack (ell := ell) (k := k) (S := S) (W := W) U a cs)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρ) (ε1 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1) (hη : etaC ell W cs ρ ε1 < 1)
    (hflat : ∀ j w, IsPatch ell M k κ S j w → ∀ e : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      pdist w e.1 ≤ (c + 1) * gsp ell M κ j → U e = (flatCfg : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) e)
    (hF : W3FlatStmt ell hell0 a) (δ : ℝ)
    (hDec : OptDecayAt ell (scaleUp ell k Lu) (flatCfg : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) δ d) :
    ∃ cW : ℝ, 0 < cW ∧
      PatchCoercive ell M k κ c Lu hell0 S U a Lam ((1 - etaC ell W cs ρ ε1) * min a (cW - δ) - 2 * nuC ell ρ)

AdalyFormal.M1W2.ginv_weighted_coercive_.name: AdalyFormal.M1W2.ginv_weighted_coercive_W2
AdalyFormal.M1W2.ginv_weighted_coercive_.header:
theorem ginv_weighted_coercive_W2 (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (h216 : 216 * ρ ^ 2 < 1) (h12 : 12 * ρ ≤ 1)
    (hU : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hT : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j),
      z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3, coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower (geomOf ell k S) U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hsm : 24 * ((Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2
          + 1 * (Real.sqrt a * (Real.exp (3 * (ell : ℝ) * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2) ≤ csOf a ρ)
    (hsmD : 4 * (Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2 ≤ csOf a ρ)
    (hgs : Real.sqrt (max a 1) * ((1 + 12 * ρ) ^ 2 + (512 * ρ ^ 2 + 4704) / a)
        * (psiHypP hS hW hell hR1 (by omega) hWR U a (csOf a ρ)
            (hatPack_of hS hell U a ha ρ hρ h216 hU hT hsm hsmD)).epsX (Real.sqrt (max a 1)) < (1 - 12 * ρ) ^ 2)
    (ρh : ℝ) (hρh : 0 ≤ ρh) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρh)
    (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hregT : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsmε : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (ε1 ε2 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1) (hε2 : 0 < ε2) (hη : etaC ell W (csOf a ρ) ρh ε1 < 1)
    (Up : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hUp : ∀ j w, IsPatch ell M k κ S j w → ∀ e : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      pdist w e.1 ≤ (c + 1) * gsp ell M κ j → U e = Up j w e)
    (cW δ : ℝ)
    (hW3 : ∀ j w, IsPatch ell M k κ S j w → W3G0At ell (scaleUp ell k Lu) (Up j w) a cW)
    (hDec : ∀ j w, IsPatch ell M k κ S j w → OptDecayAt ell (scaleUp ell k Lu) (Up j w) δ d)
    (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).G)) :
    cwW4 ell M κ c W a ρ ρh ε1 ε2 ((1 - etaC ell W (csOf a ρ) ρh ε1) * min a (cW - δ) - 2 * nuC ell ρh)
        ((psiHypP hS hW hell hR1 (by omega) hWR U a (csOf a ρ)
          (hatPack_of hS hell U a ha ρ hρ h216 hU hT hsm hsmD)).epsX (Real.sqrt (max a 1)))
        (CMc ell M κ c k a ε)
      * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
      ≤ ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫

AdalyFormal.M1W2.wellDef_strat_W2.header:
theorem wellDef_strat_W2 (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (h216 : 216 * ρ ^ 2 < 1) (h12 : 12 * ρ ≤ 1)
    (hU : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ b ∈ inBlockBonds y (ell ^ j),
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hT : ∀ j, j ≤ k → ∀ y ∈ (geomOf ell k S).Lam j, ∀ i, i < j → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j),
      z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ i) → ∀ μ : Fin 3, coarseShift z (ell ^ i) μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ j) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower (geomOf ell k S) U i (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ ρ * (ell : ℝ) ^ i / (ell : ℝ) ^ j)
    (hsm : 24 * ((Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2
          + 1 * (Real.sqrt a * (Real.exp (3 * (ell : ℝ) * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2) ≤ csOf a ρ)
    (hsmD : 4 * (Real.sqrt 3 * (Real.exp (2 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log ell / W) - 1)) ^ 2 ≤ csOf a ρ)
    (hgs : Real.sqrt (max a 1) * ((1 + 12 * ρ) ^ 2 + (512 * ρ ^ 2 + 4704) / a)
        * (psiHypP hS hW hell hR1 (by omega) hWR U a (csOf a ρ)
            (hatPack_of hS hell U a ha ρ hρ h216 hU hT hsm hsmD)).epsX (Real.sqrt (max a 1)) < (1 - 12 * ρ) ^ 2)
    (ρh : ℝ) (hρh : 0 ≤ ρh) (hreg : HolRegime S ell k U ρh)
    (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hregT : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsmε : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (ε1 ε2 : ℝ) (hε1 : 0 < ε1) (hε2 : 0 < ε2) (hη : etaC ell W (csOf a ρ) ρh ε1 < 1)
    (Up : ℕ → PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hUp : ∀ j w, IsPatch ell M k κ S j w → ∀ e : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu),
      pdist w e.1 ≤ (c + 1) * gsp ell M κ j → U e = Up j w e)
    (cW δ : ℝ)
    (hW3 : ∀ j w, IsPatch ell M k κ S j w → W3G0At ell (scaleUp ell k Lu) (Up j w) a cW)
    (hDec : ∀ j w, IsPatch ell M k κ S j w → OptDecayAt ell (scaleUp ell k Lu) (Up j w) δ d)
    (ε2' : ℝ)
    (hlt : ε2' < cwW4 ell M κ c W a ρ ρh ε1 ε2 ((1 - etaC ell W (csOf a ρ) ρh ε1) * min a (cW - δ) - 2 * nuC ell ρh)
        ((psiHypP hS hW hell hR1 (by omega) hWR U a (csOf a ρ)
          (hatPack_of hS hell U a ha ρ hρ h216 hU hT hsm hsmD)).epsX (Real.sqrt (max a 1)))
        (CMc ell M κ c k a ε))
    (hD2 : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).G),
      |⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data.Delta2 (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data_laws A⟫|
        ≤ ε2' * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hQs : Function.Injective (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data.Qs)
    (hb : Function.Bijective (H0 (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).Lam (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).Q1)) :
    GenP.WellDef (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam)

AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.w4Num_exists.header:
theorem w4Num_exists (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ W₀ : ℕ, 1 ≤ W₀ ∧ ∃ ε1 : ℝ, 0 < ε1 ∧ ∃ a₁ : ℝ, 0 < a₁ ∧
      ∀ M R : ℕ, 0 < M → W₀ ≤ R → ∀ α₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ α₀ → (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ a₁ →
        1 ≤ R * M * ell ∧ R * M * ell ≤ R * M * ell ∧ W4Num ell M 12 (R * M * ell) a α₀ ε1

AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.w4Num_exists_headlin.name: AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.w4Num_exists_headline
AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.w4Num_exists_headlin.header:
theorem w4Num_exists_headline (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, m₀ ≤ m → ∃ R₀ : ℕ, ∀ R : ℕ, R₀ ≤ R →
      ∃ W : ℕ, 1 ≤ W ∧ W ≤ R * ell ^ m * ell ∧ ∃ ε1 : ℝ, 0 < ε1 ∧ ∃ a₁ : ℝ, 0 < a₁ ∧
        ∀ α₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ α₀ → (12 : ℝ) * ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * α₀ ≤ a₁ → W4Num ell (ell ^ m) 12 W a α₀ ε1

AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.qsNum_small_exists.name: AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.qsNum_small_exists
AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.qsNum_small_exists.header:
theorem qsNum_small_exists (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) :
    ∃ a₂ : ℝ, 0 < a₂ ∧ ∀ M : ℕ, ∀ α₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ α₀ → (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ a₂ → QsNum ell 12 M α₀

AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.aLin_pos.name: AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.aLin_pos
AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.aLin_pos.header: theorem aLin_pos (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) : 0 < aLin ell

AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.lin_small.name: AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.lin_small
AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.lin_small.header:
theorem lin_small (ell M : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (α₀ : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α₀) (ht : (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ aLin ell) :
    ((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ 1 ∧
    4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * rho1 12 M α₀ ≤ 1 ∧
    (1 + 3 * Real.pi) * rho1 12 M α₀ ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4) ∧
    Real.pi / 2 * ((SmallnessBridge.Assemble.loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ((1 + 3 * Real.pi) * rho1 12 M α₀))
      < AdalyFormal.NonflatJet.r0

AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.w4_M1_final.name: AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.w4_M1_final
AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.w4_M1_final.header:
theorem w4_M1_final {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ cW : ℝ, 0 < cW ∧ ∃ a₀ : ℝ, 0 < a₀ ∧ ∃ D : ℕ, 12 * ell + 10 ≤ D ∧
    (∀ d, D ≤ d → epsNF ell (PkA a) (thetaN ell) d ≤ cW / 2) ∧
    ∃ Wmin : ℕ, 1 ≤ Wmin ∧ ∃ ε1 : ℝ, 0 < ε1 ∧ ∃ aS : ℝ, 0 < aS ∧
    ∀ {M R k κ c : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell0 : 0 < ell)
      {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (hR1 : 1 ≤ R)
      (hR4 : (c + 4) * κ * ell ≤ R) (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) {d : ℕ} (hdD : D ≤ d)
      (hdM : d + 64 * ell ^ 2 ≤ κ * M) (hRW : Wmin ≤ R) (hLu5 : ∀ μ, 5 ≤ Lu μ + 1)
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) {α₀ : ℝ}
      (hreg : AdalyFormal.M1.M1Regular ell M 12 k S α₀ (((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹) U) (hα0 : 0 < α₀)
      (hsmall : (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ aS)
      (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (ε2 : ℝ) (hε2 : 0 < ε2)
      (A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).G)),
      cwW4 ell M κ c (R * M * ell) a (rhoT ell 12 M α₀) (rho1 12 M α₀) ε1 ε2
          (cPnf ell (R * M * ell) d a cW α₀ ε1 12 M)
          (epsXnum ell (R * M * ell) a (rhoT ell 12 M α₀)) (CMcStar ell M κ c a (SstarM ell 12 M α₀))
        * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
        ≤ ⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data.Ginv A⟫

AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.hb_M1_of_small.name: AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.hb_M1_of_small
AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.hb_M1_of_small.header:
theorem hb_M1_of_small {ell k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell0 : 0 < ell) (S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1) (e0 : ℝ) (he0 : 0 ≤ e0) (hle : e0 ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 4))
    (hr : Real.pi / 2 * ((SmallnessBridge.Assemble.loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * e0) < r0)
    (hV : ∀ e, frobNorm (((gparams ell k Lu hell0 S (periodicGaugeTransform g U) a Lam).unitBgU e : M2) - 1) ≤ e0) :
    Function.Bijective (H0 (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).Lam (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).Q1)

AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.wellDef_M1_final.name: AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.wellDef_M1_final
AdalyFormal.M1W4Num.wellDef_M1_final.header:
theorem wellDef_M1_final {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ cW : ℝ, 0 < cW ∧ ∃ a₀ : ℝ, 0 < a₀ ∧ ∃ D : ℕ, 12 * ell + 10 ≤ D ∧
    (∀ d, D ≤ d → epsNF ell (PkA a) (thetaN ell) d ≤ cW / 2) ∧
    ∃ Wmin : ℕ, 1 ≤ Wmin ∧ ∃ ε1 : ℝ, 0 < ε1 ∧ ∃ aS : ℝ, 0 < aS ∧
    ∀ {M R k κ c : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell0 : 0 < ell)
      {S : Tower (scaleUp ell k Lu)} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 < M) (hR1 : 1 ≤ R)
      (hR4 : (c + 4) * κ * ell ≤ R) (hc : 5 ≤ c) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) {d : ℕ} (hdD : D ≤ d)
      (hdM : d + 64 * ell ^ 2 ≤ κ * M) (hRW : Wmin ≤ R) (hLu5 : ∀ μ, 5 ≤ Lu μ + 1)
      (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) {α₀ : ℝ}
      (hreg : AdalyFormal.M1.M1Regular ell M 12 k S α₀ (((ell : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹) U) (hα0 : 0 < α₀)
      (hsmall : (12 : ℝ) * M * α₀ ≤ aS)
      (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (ε2 : ℝ) (hε2 : 0 < ε2) (ε2' : ℝ)
      (hlt : ε2' < cwW4 ell M κ c (R * M * ell) a (rhoT ell 12 M α₀) (rho1 12 M α₀) ε1 ε2
          (cPnf ell (R * M * ell) d a cW α₀ ε1 12 M)
          (epsXnum ell (R * M * ell) a (rhoT ell 12 M α₀)) (CMcStar ell M κ c a (SstarM ell 12 M α₀)))
      (hD2 : ∀ A : ↥(bondSupp (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).G),
        |⟪A, (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data.Delta2 (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).data_laws A⟫|
          ≤ ε2' * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
      (hb : Function.Bijective (H0 (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).Lam (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam).Q1)),
      GenP.WellDef (gparams ell k Lu hell0 S U a Lam)

AdalyFormal.W6.ownM.name: AdalyFormal.W6.ownM
AdalyFormal.W6.ownM.header: noncomputable def ownM (n : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W6.nxtM.name: AdalyFormal.W6.nxtM
AdalyFormal.W6.nxtM.header: noncomputable def nxtM (n : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W6.core_line_gen.name: AdalyFormal.W6.core_line_gen
AdalyFormal.W6.core_line_gen.header:
theorem core_line_gen (g : ℕ → ℝ) (N n D : ℕ) (hz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → g t = 0)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hN : n ∣ N) (hD : n ∣ D) (hDN : D < N) :
    ∑ r ∈ range n, ∑ i ∈ range n, g ((D + r + i) % N)
      = (if D = 0 then ownM n g else 0) + (if (D + n) % N = 0 then nxtM n g else 0)

AdalyFormal.W6.next_iff.name: AdalyFormal.W6.next_iff
AdalyFormal.W6.next_iff.header:
theorem next_iff {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (n : ℕ) (z y : Fin N) :
    ((z - y).val + n) % N = 0 ↔ (z.val + n) % N = y.val

AdalyFormal.W6.line_factor_gen.name: AdalyFormal.W6.line_factor_gen
AdalyFormal.W6.line_factor_gen.header:
theorem line_factor_gen (g : ℕ → ℝ) {M n : ℕ} (hz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → g t = 0)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n ∣ M + 1) (z y : Fin (M + 1)) (hz' : n ∣ z.val) (hy : n ∣ y.val) :
    ∑ a ∈ univ.filter (fun a : Fin (M + 1) => z.val ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < z.val + n),
      ∑ i ∈ range n, g ((a + i • (1 : Fin (M + 1)) - y).val)
      = (if z = y then ownM n g else 0) + (if (z.val + n) % (M + 1) = y.val then nxtM n g else 0)

AdalyFormal.W6.cbUp.name: AdalyFormal.W6.cbUp
AdalyFormal.W6.cbUp.header: def cbUp {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (n : ℕ) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (c : CoarseBond L n) : CoarseBond L n

AdalyFormal.W6.block_line_sum_gen.name: AdalyFormal.W6.block_line_sum_gen
AdalyFormal.W6.block_line_sum_gen.header:
theorem block_line_sum_gen {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (g h : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1)
    (hgz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → g t = 0) (hhz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → h t = 0) (m0 : ∑ s ∈ range n, h s = (n : ℝ))
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : z ∈ CoarseLattice L n) (μ : Fin 3) (c : CoarseBond L n) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf z n, ∑ i ∈ range n, gbK g h n (pathSite x μ i) μ c
      = (if c = (⟨z, hz⟩, μ) then (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * ownM n g else 0)
        + (if c = cbUp n hdvd (⟨z, hz⟩, μ) then (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * nxtM n g else 0)

AdalyFormal.W6.uprof.header: noncomputable def uprof (n t : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W6.uprof_eq_zero.header: theorem uprof_eq_zero (n t : ℕ) (h : n ≤ t) : uprof n t = 0

AdalyFormal.W6.pprof_own.name: AdalyFormal.W6.pprof_own
AdalyFormal.W6.pprof_own.header: theorem pprof_own (n : ℕ) : ownM n (pprof n) = (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) / 2

AdalyFormal.W6.pprof_nxt.name: AdalyFormal.W6.pprof_nxt

AdalyFormal.W6.uprof_nxt.name: AdalyFormal.W6.uprof_nxt
AdalyFormal.W6.uprof_nxt.header: theorem uprof_nxt (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : nxtM n (uprof n) = (n : ℝ) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6.tprof_own.name: AdalyFormal.W6.tprof_own
AdalyFormal.W6.tprof_own.header: theorem tprof_own (n : ℕ) : ownM n (tprof n) = (n : ℝ) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6.tprof_nxt.name: AdalyFormal.W6.tprof_nxt
AdalyFormal.W6.tprof_nxt.header: theorem tprof_nxt (n : ℕ) : nxtM n (tprof n) = 0

AdalyFormal.W6.abs_uprof_le.name: AdalyFormal.W6.abs_uprof_le
AdalyFormal.W6.abs_uprof_le.header: theorem abs_uprof_le (n t : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : |uprof n t| ≤ 33

AdalyFormal.W6.uprof_step_le.name: AdalyFormal.W6.uprof_step_le

AdalyFormal.W6.uprof_first_le.name: AdalyFormal.W6.uprof_first_le
AdalyFormal.W6.uprof_first_le.header: theorem uprof_first_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : |uprof n 0| ≤ 240 / n

AdalyFormal.W6.uprof_last_le.name: AdalyFormal.W6.uprof_last_le

AdalyFormal.W6.sprof_uprof.header: theorem sprof_uprof (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : SProf n (uprof n) 33 240

AdalyFormal.W6.pdist_block_le.header: theorem pdist_block_le {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {n : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ blockOf y n) : pdist y x ≤ 3 * n

AdalyFormal.W6.reads_site.header:
theorem reads_site {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ μ, n ∣ L μ + 1) (c : CoarseBond L n)
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hx : x ∈ blockOf c.1.1 n) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < n) :

AdalyFormal.W6.strat_le_of_not.header:

AdalyFormal.W6.row_out.header:

AdalyFormal.W6.coarseShift_inj.header:

AdalyFormal.W6.phi_support.header:
theorem phi_support (hell : 0 < ell) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.W6.phi_supp.header:

theorem EflatL_apply (hell : 0 < ell) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) (b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    (EflatL hell y) b = ∑ p, phiK hell p b • y p

AdalyFormal.W6.EflatL_mem.name: AdalyFormal.W6.EflatL_mem
AdalyFormal.W6.EflatL_mem.header:
theorem EflatL_mem (hell : 0 < ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    EflatL hell y ∈ bondSupp (geomOf ell k S)

AdalyFormal.W6.kap.name: AdalyFormal.W6.kap
AdalyFormal.W6.kap.header: noncomputable def kap (hell : 0 < ell) (p' p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W6.Qflat_E.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Qflat_E
AdalyFormal.W6.Qflat_E.header:
theorem Qflat_E (hell : 0 < ell) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) (p' : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) :
    (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull (EflatL hell y) p' = ∑ p, kap hell p' p • y p

AdalyFormal.W6.kap_zero_of.name: AdalyFormal.W6.kap_zero_of
AdalyFormal.W6.kap_zero_of.header:
theorem kap_zero_of (hell : 0 < ell) (p' p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S))
    (h : ∀ x ∈ blockOf p'.2.1.1 (ell ^ (p'.1 : ℕ)), ∀ i < ell ^ (p'.1 : ℕ),
      phiK hell p (pathSite x p'.2.1.2 i, p'.2.1.2) = 0) : kap hell p' p = 0

AdalyFormal.W6.kap_ne.name: AdalyFormal.W6.kap_ne
AdalyFormal.W6.kap_ne.header:
theorem kap_ne (hell : 0 < ell) {p' p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)} (h : kap hell p' p ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x ∈ blockOf p'.2.1.1 (ell ^ (p'.1 : ℕ)), ∃ i < ell ^ (p'.1 : ℕ),
      phiK hell p (pathSite x p'.2.1.2 i, p'.2.1.2) ≠ 0

AdalyFormal.W6.kap_same.name: AdalyFormal.W6.kap_same
AdalyFormal.W6.kap_same.header:
theorem kap_same (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (p' p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (hl : (p.1 : ℕ) = (p'.1 : ℕ)) :
    kap hell p' p = if p = p' then 1 else 0

AdalyFormal.W6.kap_low.name: AdalyFormal.W6.kap_low
AdalyFormal.W6.kap_low.header:
theorem kap_low (hell : 0 < ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (p' p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S))
    (hl : (p'.1 : ℕ) < (p.1 : ℕ)) : kap hell p' p = 0

AdalyFormal.W6.kap_far.name: AdalyFormal.W6.kap_far
AdalyFormal.W6.kap_far.header:
theorem kap_far (hell : 0 < ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hR : 4 * ell ≤ R)
    (p' p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (hl : (p.1 : ℕ) + 2 ≤ (p'.1 : ℕ)) : kap hell p' p = 0

AdalyFormal.W6.kap_N2.name: AdalyFormal.W6.kap_N2
AdalyFormal.W6.kap_N2.header:
theorem kap_N2 (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)
    (p'' p' p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (h1 : (p'.1 : ℕ) + 1 = (p''.1 : ℕ)) (h2 : (p.1 : ℕ) + 1 = (p'.1 : ℕ)) :
    kap hell p'' p' = 0 ∨ kap hell p' p = 0

AdalyFormal.W6.kap_sq.name: AdalyFormal.W6.kap_sq
AdalyFormal.W6.kap_sq.header:
theorem kap_sq (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)
    (p'' p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ∑ p', kap hell p'' p' * kap hell p' p = 2 * kap hell p'' p - (if p'' = p then 1 else 0)

AdalyFormal.W6.norm_sq_sum_single.name: AdalyFormal.W6.norm_sq_sum_single
AdalyFormal.W6.norm_sq_sum_single.header:
theorem norm_sq_sum_single {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι] [NormedAddCommGroup V] (g : ι → V)
    (h : ∀ a a', g a ≠ 0 → g a' ≠ 0 → a = a') : ‖∑ a, g a‖ ^ 2 = ∑ a, ‖g a‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6.wF.name: AdalyFormal.W6.wF
AdalyFormal.W6.wF.header: noncomputable def wF (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W6.wF_pos.name: AdalyFormal.W6.wF_pos
AdalyFormal.W6.wF_pos.header: theorem wF_pos (hell : 0 < ell) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) : 0 < wF p

AdalyFormal.W6.nF.name: AdalyFormal.W6.nF
AdalyFormal.W6.nF.header: noncomputable def nF (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W6.nF_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.W6.nF_nonneg
AdalyFormal.W6.nF_nonneg.header: theorem nF_nonneg (hell : 0 < ell) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) : 0 ≤ nF y

AdalyFormal.W6.Elev.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Elev
AdalyFormal.W6.Elev.header: noncomputable def Elev (hell : 0 < ell) (j : Fin (k + 1)) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) (b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.W6.Flo.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Flo
AdalyFormal.W6.Flo.header:
noncomputable def Flo (hell : 0 < ell) (j : Fin (k + 1)) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S))
    (r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j})
    (c : CoarseBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ (j : ℕ))) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.W6.Fup.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Fup
AdalyFormal.W6.Fup.header:
noncomputable def Fup (hell : 0 < ell) (j : Fin (k + 1)) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S))
    (r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j})
    (c : CoarseBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ (j : ℕ))) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.W6.Wlo.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Wlo
AdalyFormal.W6.Wlo.header:
noncomputable def Wlo (hell : 0 < ell) (j : Fin (k + 1)) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S))
    (c : CoarseBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ (j : ℕ))) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.W6.Wup.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Wup
AdalyFormal.W6.Wup.header:
noncomputable def Wup (hell : 0 < ell) (j : Fin (k + 1)) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S))
    (c : CoarseBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ (j : ℕ))) : SuTwo

AdalyFormal.W6.rowCBj.name: AdalyFormal.W6.rowCBj
AdalyFormal.W6.rowCBj.header:
def rowCBj (hell : 0 < ell) (j : Fin (k + 1)) (r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j}) :
    CoarseBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ (j : ℕ))

AdalyFormal.W6.Elev_eq.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Elev_eq
AdalyFormal.W6.Elev_eq.header:
theorem Elev_eq (hell : 0 < ell) (j : Fin (k + 1)) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) (b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    Elev hell j y b = gbondE (tprof (ell ^ (j : ℕ))) (pprof (ell ^ (j : ℕ))) (ell ^ (j : ℕ)) (Wlo hell j y) b
      + gbondE (AdalyFormal.W6.uprof (ell ^ (j : ℕ))) (pprof (ell ^ (j : ℕ))) (ell ^ (j : ℕ)) (Wup hell j y) b

AdalyFormal.W6.rowCBj_inj.name: AdalyFormal.W6.rowCBj_inj
AdalyFormal.W6.rowCBj_inj.header:
theorem rowCBj_inj (hell : 0 < ell) (j : Fin (k + 1)) :
    Function.Injective (rowCBj (S := S) hell j)

AdalyFormal.W6.mass_kind.name: AdalyFormal.W6.mass_kind
AdalyFormal.W6.mass_kind.header:
theorem mass_kind {α β V : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [NormedAddCommGroup V] (F : α → β → V) (f : α → β)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hsupp : ∀ a c, F a c ≠ 0 → f a = c) :
    ∑ c, ‖∑ a, F a c‖ ^ 2 = ∑ a, ‖F a (f a)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6.W_mass.name: AdalyFormal.W6.W_mass
AdalyFormal.W6.W_mass.header:
theorem W_mass (hell : 0 < ell) (j : Fin (k + 1)) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ∑ c, ‖Wlo hell j y c‖ ^ 2 + ∑ c, ‖Wup hell j y c‖ ^ 2
      = ∑ r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j}, ‖y ⟨j, r⟩‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6.EflatL_eq_sum.name: AdalyFormal.W6.EflatL_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.W6.EflatL_eq_sum.header:
theorem EflatL_eq_sum (hell : 0 < ell) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) (b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    (EflatL hell y) b = ∑ j : Fin (k + 1), Elev hell j y b

AdalyFormal.W6.Elev_lev.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Elev_lev
AdalyFormal.W6.Elev_lev.header:
theorem Elev_lev (hell : 0 < ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) (b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (i : Fin (k + 1)) (hi : Elev hell i y b ≠ 0) : AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k b.1 = (i : ℕ)

AdalyFormal.W6.EflatL_pt.name: AdalyFormal.W6.EflatL_pt
AdalyFormal.W6.EflatL_pt.header:
theorem EflatL_pt (hell : 0 < ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) (b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ‖(EflatL hell y) b‖ ^ 2 = ∑ j : Fin (k + 1), ‖Elev hell j y b‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6.EflatL_split.name: AdalyFormal.W6.EflatL_split
AdalyFormal.W6.EflatL_split.header:
theorem EflatL_split (hell : 0 < ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖EflatL hell y‖ ^ 2 = ∑ j : Fin (k + 1), ∑ b, ‖Elev hell j y b‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6.norm_add_sq_le2.name: AdalyFormal.W6.norm_add_sq_le2
AdalyFormal.W6.norm_add_sq_le2.header: theorem norm_add_sq_le2 {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] (u v : V) : ‖u + v‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6.comb_le.name: AdalyFormal.W6.comb_le
AdalyFormal.W6.comb_le.header:
theorem comb_le (A B X Y n3 : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hX : 0 ≤ X) (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (hn : 0 ≤ n3) :
    2 * (A * n3 * X) + 2 * (B * n3 * Y) ≤ 2 * (A + B) * (n3 * (X + Y))

AdalyFormal.W6.Elev_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Elev_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.W6.Elev_norm_sq.header:
theorem Elev_norm_sq (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) (j : Fin (k + 1)) :
    ∑ b, ‖Elev hell j y b‖ ^ 2
      ≤ CE * ∑ r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j},
          wF (⟨j, r⟩ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) * ‖y ⟨j, r⟩‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6.EflatL_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.W6.EflatL_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.W6.EflatL_norm_sq.header:
theorem EflatL_norm_sq (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖EflatL hell y‖ ^ 2 ≤ CE * nF y

AdalyFormal.W6.FootL.name: AdalyFormal.W6.FootL
AdalyFormal.W6.FootL.header: def FootL (j : Fin (k + 1)) (e : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)) : Prop

AdalyFormal.W6.SS.name: AdalyFormal.W6.SS
AdalyFormal.W6.SS.header: noncomputable def SS (ell k : ℕ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W6.delW.name: AdalyFormal.W6.delW
AdalyFormal.W6.delW.header: noncomputable def delW (ell k : ℕ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W6.expW.name: AdalyFormal.W6.expW
AdalyFormal.W6.expW.header: noncomputable def expW (ell k : ℕ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W6.bgTower_geom_trivial.name: AdalyFormal.W6.bgTower_geom_trivial
AdalyFormal.W6.bgTower_geom_trivial.header:
theorem bgTower_geom_trivial :
    bgTower (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) = flatBg ell k Lu

AdalyFormal.W6.regTower_triv.name: AdalyFormal.W6.regTower_triv
AdalyFormal.W6.regTower_triv.header: theorem regTower_triv (hell : 0 < ell) : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu))) k

AdalyFormal.W6.bondRestr_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.W6.bondRestr_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.W6.bondRestr_norm_sq.header:
theorem bondRestr_norm_sq (P : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) → Prop) (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ‖bondRestr P x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ e, (if P e then ‖x e‖ ^ 2 else 0)

AdalyFormal.W6.row_restrL.name: AdalyFormal.W6.row_restrL
AdalyFormal.W6.row_restrL.header:
theorem row_restrL (V : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) V) k)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (j : Fin (k + 1))
    (r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j}) :
    (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull x ⟨j, r⟩
      = (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull (bondRestr (FootL (S := S) j) x) ⟨j, r⟩

AdalyFormal.W6.rows_le_nrm.name: AdalyFormal.W6.rows_le_nrm
AdalyFormal.W6.rows_le_nrm.header:
theorem rows_le_nrm (hell : 0 < ell) (j : Fin (k + 1)) (Z : XS (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j}, ‖suOf (Z r.1)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ nrm (ell ^ (j : ℕ)) Z ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6.SS_mono.name: AdalyFormal.W6.SS_mono
AdalyFormal.W6.SS_mono.header:
theorem SS_mono (hell : 0 < ell) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) :
    ∑ i ∈ range j, thetaOf ell (ε i) ≤ SS ell k ε

AdalyFormal.W6.SS_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.W6.SS_nonneg
AdalyFormal.W6.SS_nonneg.header: theorem SS_nonneg (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) : 0 ≤ SS ell k ε

AdalyFormal.W6.scale_one.name: AdalyFormal.W6.scale_one
AdalyFormal.W6.scale_one.header:
theorem scale_one (hell : 0 < ell) (j : ℕ) :
    ((ell : ℝ) ^ j) ^ 3 * (((ell : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹) ^ 2 * ((rr ell) ^ j) ^ 2 = 1

AdalyFormal.W6.level_drift.name: AdalyFormal.W6.level_drift
AdalyFormal.W6.level_drift.header:
theorem level_drift (hell : 0 < ell) (V : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) V) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu V ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (j : Fin (k + 1)) (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j},
      ((ell : ℝ) ^ (j : ℕ)) ^ 3 * ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull x ⟨j, r⟩
        - (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull x ⟨j, r⟩‖ ^ 2
      ≤ delW ell k ε ^ 2 * ‖bondRestr (FootL (S := S) j) x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6.level_size.name: AdalyFormal.W6.level_size
AdalyFormal.W6.level_size.header:
theorem level_size (hell : 0 < ell) (V : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) V) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu V ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (j : Fin (k + 1)) (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j},
      ((ell : ℝ) ^ (j : ℕ)) ^ 3 * ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull x ⟨j, r⟩‖ ^ 2
      ≤ expW ell k ε ^ 2 * ‖bondRestr (FootL (S := S) j) x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6.foot_levels.name: AdalyFormal.W6.foot_levels
AdalyFormal.W6.foot_levels.header:
theorem foot_levels (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ j : Fin (k + 1), ‖bondRestr (FootL (S := S) j) x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 3 * ‖x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6.drift_F.name: AdalyFormal.W6.drift_F
AdalyFormal.W6.drift_F.header:
theorem drift_F (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)
    (V : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) V) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu V ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ p, wF p * ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull x p - (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 3 * delW ell k ε ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6.towerClass_triv.name: AdalyFormal.W6.towerClass_triv
AdalyFormal.W6.towerClass_triv.header: theorem towerClass_triv (hell : 0 < ell) : TowerClass ell k Lu (trivialU (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (fun _ => 0)

AdalyFormal.W6.rhoOf_zero_lt.name: AdalyFormal.W6.rhoOf_zero_lt
AdalyFormal.W6.rhoOf_zero_lt.header: theorem rhoOf_zero_lt (ell : ℕ) : rhoOf ell 0 < Real.pi / 2

AdalyFormal.W6.expW_zero.name: AdalyFormal.W6.expW_zero
AdalyFormal.W6.expW_zero.header: theorem expW_zero (hell : 0 < ell) : expW ell k (fun _ => 0) = 1

AdalyFormal.W6.flat_F.name: AdalyFormal.W6.flat_F
AdalyFormal.W6.flat_F.header:
theorem flat_F (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ p, wF p * ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2 ≤ 3 * ‖x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6.Kop.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Kop
AdalyFormal.W6.Kop.header: noncomputable def Kop (hell : 0 < ell) : FSp (geomOf ell k S) →ₗ[ℝ] FSp (geomOf ell k S)

AdalyFormal.W6.Kop_apply.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Kop_apply
AdalyFormal.W6.Kop_apply.header:
theorem Kop_apply (hell : 0 < ell) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) (p' : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) :
    (Kop hell y) p' = ∑ p, kap hell p' p • y p

AdalyFormal.W6.Kop_eq.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Kop_eq
AdalyFormal.W6.Kop_eq.header:
theorem Kop_eq (hell : 0 < ell) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    Kop hell y = (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull (EflatL hell y)

AdalyFormal.W6.ErightL.name: AdalyFormal.W6.ErightL
AdalyFormal.W6.ErightL.header: noncomputable def ErightL (hell : 0 < ell) : FSp (geomOf ell k S) →ₗ[ℝ] BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)

AdalyFormal.W6.ErightL_apply.name: AdalyFormal.W6.ErightL_apply
AdalyFormal.W6.ErightL_apply.header:
theorem ErightL_apply (hell : 0 < ell) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ErightL hell y = EflatL hell ((2 : ℝ) • y - Kop hell y)

AdalyFormal.W6.Eright_rightInv.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Eright_rightInv
AdalyFormal.W6.Eright_rightInv.header:
theorem Eright_rightInv (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull (ErightL hell y) = y

AdalyFormal.W6.Eright_mem.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Eright_mem
AdalyFormal.W6.Eright_mem.header:
theorem Eright_mem (hell : 0 < ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ErightL hell y ∈ bondSupp (geomOf ell k S)

AdalyFormal.W6.nF_sub_le.name: AdalyFormal.W6.nF_sub_le
AdalyFormal.W6.nF_sub_le.header: theorem nF_sub_le (hell : 0 < ell) (y z : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) : nF (y - z) ≤ 2 * nF y + 2 * nF z

AdalyFormal.W6.nF_smul.name: AdalyFormal.W6.nF_smul
AdalyFormal.W6.nF_smul.header: theorem nF_smul (c : ℝ) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) : nF (c • y) = c ^ 2 * nF y

AdalyFormal.W6.Eright_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Eright_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.W6.Eright_norm_sq.header:
theorem Eright_norm_sq (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ‖ErightL hell y‖ ^ 2 ≤ CEp * nF y

AdalyFormal.W6.eq_zero_of_nF.header: theorem eq_zero_of_nF (hell : 0 < ell) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) (h : nF y ≤ 0) : y = 0

AdalyFormal.W6.qs_injective_strat.header:

AdalyFormal.W6.gradW.name: AdalyFormal.W6.gradW
AdalyFormal.W6.gradW.header: noncomputable def gradW {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (x : BondFnL2 L) (ν : Fin 3) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W6.uprof_grad.name: AdalyFormal.W6.uprof_grad
AdalyFormal.W6.uprof_grad.header:
theorem uprof_grad (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (ν0 : Fin 3)

AdalyFormal.W6.wD.name: AdalyFormal.W6.wD
AdalyFormal.W6.wD.header: noncomputable def wD (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W6.wD_pos.name: AdalyFormal.W6.wD_pos
AdalyFormal.W6.wD_pos.header: theorem wD_pos (hell : 0 < ell) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) : 0 < wD p

AdalyFormal.W6.nD.name: AdalyFormal.W6.nD
AdalyFormal.W6.nD.header: noncomputable def nD (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W6.nD_nonneg.header: theorem nD_nonneg (hell : 0 < ell) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) : 0 ≤ nD y

AdalyFormal.W6.Elev_grad.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Elev_grad
AdalyFormal.W6.Elev_grad.header:

AdalyFormal.W6.Elev_diff_two.name: AdalyFormal.W6.Elev_diff_two
AdalyFormal.W6.Elev_diff_two.header:
theorem Elev_diff_two (hell : 0 < ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S))
    (b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ν0 : Fin 3) (i : Fin (k + 1))
    (hi : Elev hell i y (periodicLatticeShift b.1 ν0, b.2) - Elev hell i y b ≠ 0) :
    i = ⟨AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k (periodicLatticeShift b.1 ν0), Nat.lt_succ_of_le (AdalyFormal.M1.strat_le S k _)⟩

AdalyFormal.W6.wt_bstrat_le.name: AdalyFormal.W6.wt_bstrat_le
AdalyFormal.W6.wt_bstrat_le.header:

AdalyFormal.W6.E_wnorm.name: AdalyFormal.W6.E_wnorm
AdalyFormal.W6.E_wnorm.header:

AdalyFormal.W6.foot_levels_w.name: AdalyFormal.W6.foot_levels_w
AdalyFormal.W6.foot_levels_w.header:
theorem foot_levels_w (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ j : Fin (k + 1), (((ell : ℝ) ^ (j : ℕ))⁻¹) ^ 2 * ‖bondRestr (FootL (S := S) j) x‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k x

AdalyFormal.W6.wD_eq.header: theorem wD_eq (hell : 0 < ell) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) : wD p = (((ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ))⁻¹) ^ 2 * wF p

AdalyFormal.W6.drift_D.header:
theorem drift_D (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)
    (V : AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) V) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu V ε)

    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    ∑ p, wD p * ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull x p - (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * delW ell k ε ^ 2 * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k x

AdalyFormal.W6.flat_D.name: AdalyFormal.W6.flat_D
AdalyFormal.W6.flat_D.header:
theorem flat_D (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)

    ∑ p, wD p * ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k x

AdalyFormal.W6.nD_sub_le.header: theorem nD_sub_le (hell : 0 < ell) (y z : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) : nD (y - z) ≤ 2 * nD y + 2 * nD z

AdalyFormal.W6.nD_add_le.header: theorem nD_add_le (hell : 0 < ell) (y z : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) : nD (y + z) ≤ 2 * nD y + 2 * nD z

AdalyFormal.W6.Kop_D.header:

AdalyFormal.W6.twoK_D.name: AdalyFormal.W6.twoK_D
AdalyFormal.W6.twoK_D.header:

AdalyFormal.W6.Eright_wnorm.header:

AdalyFormal.W6.Eright_grad.header:

AdalyFormal.W6.bond_rightinv_strat.name: AdalyFormal.W6.bond_rightinv_strat
AdalyFormal.W6.bond_rightinv_strat.header:
theorem bond_rightinv_strat (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu))
    (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (hsmall : 3 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * delW ell k ε ^ 2 * CwE ell ≤ 1 / 4) (u : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ∃ x : ↥(bondSupp (geomOf ell k S)), (gparams ell k Lu hell S U a Lam).data.Q x = u ∧
      AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq S ell k (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ≤ 4 * CwE ell * nD u ∧
      ∀ ν0 : Fin 3, gradW (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) ν0 ≤ 4 * CgE ell * nD u

AdalyFormal.W6.qs_injective_of_drift.name: AdalyFormal.W6.qs_injective_of_drift
AdalyFormal.W6.qs_injective_of_drift.header:
theorem qs_injective_of_drift (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M)

AdalyFormal.W6.bond_rightinv_slab.name: AdalyFormal.W6.bond_rightinv_slab
AdalyFormal.W6.bond_rightinv_slab.header:
theorem bond_rightinv_slab (a : ℝ) (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite LuSlab))
    (u : FSp (geomOf 3 1 (AdalyFormal.M1.TS 24 (scaleUp 3 1 LuSlab)))) :

      (gparams 3 1 LuSlab (by norm_num) (AdalyFormal.M1.TS 24 (scaleUp 3 1 LuSlab)) (trivialU _) a Lam).data.Q x = u ∧
      AdalyFormal.M1.wnormSq (AdalyFormal.M1.TS 24 (scaleUp 3 1 LuSlab)) 3 1 (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp 3 1 LuSlab))
        ≤ 4 * CwE 3 * nD u ∧
      ∀ ν0 : Fin 3, gradW (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp 3 1 LuSlab)) ν0 ≤ 4 * CgE 3 * nD u

AdalyFormal.W6P.sum_range_cube_real.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.sum_range_cube_real
AdalyFormal.W6P.sum_range_cube_real.header: theorem sum_range_cube_real (n : ℕ) : ∑ s ∈ range n, (s : ℝ) ^ 3 = ((n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1) / 2) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6P.sum_range_four_real.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.sum_range_four_real
AdalyFormal.W6P.sum_range_four_real.header:

AdalyFormal.W6P.pprof_eq_zero.header: theorem pprof_eq_zero (n t : ℕ) (h : n ≤ t) : pprof n t = 0

AdalyFormal.W6P.abs_tprof_le.header: theorem abs_tprof_le (n t : ℕ) : |tprof n t| ≤ 9

AdalyFormal.W6P.abs_pprof_le.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.abs_pprof_le
AdalyFormal.W6P.abs_pprof_le.header: theorem abs_pprof_le (n t : ℕ) : |pprof n t| ≤ 3 / 2

AdalyFormal.W6P.tprof_first_le.header: theorem tprof_first_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : |tprof n 0| ≤ 72 / n

AdalyFormal.W6P.pprof_step_le.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.pprof_step_le
AdalyFormal.W6P.pprof_step_le.header: theorem pprof_step_le (n t : ℕ) (h : t + 1 < n) : |pprof n (t + 1) - pprof n t| ≤ 6 / n

AdalyFormal.W6P.pprof_first_le.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.pprof_first_le
AdalyFormal.W6P.pprof_first_le.header: theorem pprof_first_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : |pprof n 0| ≤ 6 / n

AdalyFormal.W6P.SProf.F_nonneg.header: theorem SProf.F_nonneg {n : ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℝ} {F D : ℝ} (h : SProf n f F D) : 0 ≤ F

AdalyFormal.W6P.point_cases_g.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.point_cases_g
AdalyFormal.W6P.point_cases_g.header:
theorem point_cases_g (g : ℕ → ℝ) (N n D r i : ℕ) (hz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → g t = 0) (hr : r < n) (hi : i < n)
    (hcase : (D = 0 ∧ N = n) ∨ (D = 0 ∧ 2 * n ≤ N) ∨ (0 < D ∧ D + n = N ∧ 2 * n ≤ N) ∨ (n ≤ D ∧ D + 2 * n ≤ N)) :
    g ((D + r + i) % N)
      = (if D = 0 then (if r + i < n then g (r + i) else 0) else 0)
        + (if (D + n) % N = 0 then (if n ≤ r + i then g (r + i - n) else 0) else 0)

AdalyFormal.W6P.core_line_g.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.core_line_g
AdalyFormal.W6P.core_line_g.header:
theorem core_line_g (g : ℕ → ℝ) (N n D : ℕ) (hz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → g t = 0)
    (m1 : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((s : ℝ) + 1) * g s = (n : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (m2 : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((n : ℝ) - 1 - (s : ℝ)) * g s = 0)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hN : n ∣ N) (hD : n ∣ D) (hDN : D < N) :
    ∑ r ∈ range n, ∑ i ∈ range n, g ((D + r + i) % N) = if D = 0 then (n : ℝ) ^ 2 else 0

AdalyFormal.W6P.core_ind_g.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.core_ind_g
AdalyFormal.W6P.core_ind_g.header:
theorem core_ind_g (g : ℕ → ℝ) (N n D : ℕ) (hz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → g t = 0)
    (m0 : ∑ s ∈ range n, g s = (n : ℝ))
    (hn : 0 < n) (hN : n ∣ N) (hD : n ∣ D) (hDN : D < N) :
    ∑ r ∈ range n, g ((D + r) % N) = if D = 0 then (n : ℝ) else 0

AdalyFormal.W6P.gfac.header: noncomputable def gfac (g h : ℕ → ℝ) (μ ν : Fin 3) (t : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W6P.gbK.header: noncomputable def gbK (g h : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) (c : CoarseBond L n) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W6P.gbondE.header: noncomputable def gbondE (g h : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) : Bond L → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.W6P.line_factor_g.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.line_factor_g
AdalyFormal.W6P.line_factor_g.header:
theorem line_factor_g (g : ℕ → ℝ) {M n : ℕ} (hz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → g t = 0)
    (m1 : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((s : ℝ) + 1) * g s = (n : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (m2 : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((n : ℝ) - 1 - (s : ℝ)) * g s = 0)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n ∣ M + 1) (z y : Fin (M + 1)) (hz' : n ∣ z.val) (hy : n ∣ y.val) :
    ∑ a ∈ univ.filter (fun a : Fin (M + 1) => z.val ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < z.val + n),
      ∑ i ∈ range n, g ((a + i • (1 : Fin (M + 1)) - y).val) = if z = y then (n : ℝ) ^ 2 else 0

AdalyFormal.W6P.ind_factor_g.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.ind_factor_g
AdalyFormal.W6P.ind_factor_g.header:
theorem ind_factor_g (h : ℕ → ℝ) {M n : ℕ} (hz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → h t = 0) (m0 : ∑ s ∈ range n, h s = (n : ℝ))
    (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n ∣ M + 1) (z y : Fin (M + 1)) (hz' : n ∣ z.val) (hy : n ∣ y.val) :
    ∑ a ∈ univ.filter (fun a : Fin (M + 1) => z.val ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < z.val + n),
      h ((a - y).val) = if z = y then (n : ℝ) else 0

AdalyFormal.W6P.Hfg.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.Hfg
AdalyFormal.W6P.Hfg.header: noncomputable def Hfg (g h : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν : Fin 3) (a : Fin (L ν + 1)) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W6P.line_prod_g.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.line_prod_g
AdalyFormal.W6P.line_prod_g.header:
theorem line_prod_g (g h : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ∑ i ∈ range n, ∏ ν : Fin 3, gfac g h μ ν (((pathSite x μ i) ν - y ν).val) = ∏ ν : Fin 3, Hfg g h n μ y ν (x ν)

AdalyFormal.W6P.block_line_sum_g.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.block_line_sum_g
AdalyFormal.W6P.block_line_sum_g.header:
theorem block_line_sum_g (g h : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1)
    (hgz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → g t = 0) (m1 : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((s : ℝ) + 1) * g s = (n : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (m2 : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((n : ℝ) - 1 - (s : ℝ)) * g s = 0)
    (hhz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → h t = 0) (m0 : ∑ s ∈ range n, h s = (n : ℝ))
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : z ∈ CoarseLattice L n) (μ : Fin 3) (c : CoarseBond L n) :
    ∑ x ∈ blockOf z n, ∑ i ∈ range n, gbK g h n (pathSite x μ i) μ c
      = if c = (⟨z, hz⟩, μ) then (n : ℝ) ^ 4 else 0

AdalyFormal.W6P.gbondE_rightInv.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.gbondE_rightInv
AdalyFormal.W6P.gbondE_rightInv.header:
theorem gbondE_rightInv (g h : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1)
    (hgz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → g t = 0) (m1 : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((s : ℝ) + 1) * g s = (n : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (m2 : ∑ s ∈ range n, ((n : ℝ) - 1 - (s : ℝ)) * g s = 0)
    (hhz : ∀ t, n ≤ t → h t = 0) (m0 : ∑ s ∈ range n, h s = (n : ℝ))
    (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) (c0 : CoarseBond L n) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n (gbondE g h n W) c0 = W c0

AdalyFormal.W6P.sbondE.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.sbondE
AdalyFormal.W6P.sbondE.header: noncomputable def sbondE (n : ℕ) (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) : Bond L → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.W6P.sbondE_rightInv.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.sbondE_rightInv
AdalyFormal.W6P.sbondE_rightInv.header:
theorem sbondE_rightInv (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo)
    (c0 : CoarseBond L n) : lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n (sbondE n W) c0 = W c0

AdalyFormal.W6P.row_eqlast_le.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.row_eqlast_le
AdalyFormal.W6P.row_eqlast_le.header:
theorem row_eqlast_le {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (n : ℕ) (a : Fin N) :
    ∑ t ∈ univ.filter (fun t : Fin N => t.val % n = 0), (if (a - t).val = N - 1 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.W6P.col_or_le.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.col_or_le
AdalyFormal.W6P.col_or_le.header:
theorem col_or_le {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (n : ℕ) (t : Fin N) :
    ∑ a : Fin N, (if (a - t).val < n ∨ (a - t).val = N - 1 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ n + 1

AdalyFormal.W6P.row_or_le.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.row_or_le
AdalyFormal.W6P.row_or_le.header:
theorem row_or_le {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hnN : n ∣ N) (a : Fin N) :
    ∑ t ∈ univ.filter (fun t : Fin N => t.val % n = 0),
      (if (a - t).val < n ∨ (a - t).val = N - 1 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 2

AdalyFormal.W6P.prod_schur.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.prod_schur
AdalyFormal.W6P.prod_schur.header:
theorem prod_schur (n : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) (m : Fin 3 → ℕ → ℝ) (hm0 : ∀ ν t, 0 ≤ m ν t) (R C : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hR : ∀ ν (a : Fin (L ν + 1)), ∑ t ∈ univ.filter (fun t : Fin (L ν + 1) => t.val % n = 0), m ν ((a - t).val) ≤ R ν)
    (hC : ∀ ν (t : Fin (L ν + 1)), ∑ a : Fin (L ν + 1), m ν ((a - t).val) ≤ C ν)
    (K : PeriodicLatticeSite L → CoarseBond L n → ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ y c, |K y c| ≤ if c.2 = μ then ∏ ν : Fin 3, m ν ((y ν - c.1.1 ν).val) else 0)
    (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) :
    ∑ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, ‖∑ c : CoarseBond L n, K y c • W c‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (∏ ν : Fin 3, R ν) * (∏ ν : Fin 3, C ν) * ∑ c : CoarseBond L n, ‖(if c.2 = μ then W c else 0)‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6P.sum_dir_split.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.sum_dir_split
AdalyFormal.W6P.sum_dir_split.header:
theorem sum_dir_split (n : ℕ) (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) :
    ∑ μ : Fin 3, ∑ c : CoarseBond L n, ‖(if c.2 = μ then W c else 0)‖ ^ 2 = ∑ c : CoarseBond L n, ‖W c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6P.abs_gfac_le.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.abs_gfac_le
AdalyFormal.W6P.abs_gfac_le.header:
theorem abs_gfac_le {n : ℕ} {g h : ℕ → ℝ} {Fg Dg Fh Dh : ℝ} (hg : SProf n g Fg Dg) (hh : SProf n h Fh Dh)
    (μ ν : Fin 3) (t : ℕ) : |gfac g h μ ν t| ≤ (if ν = μ then Fg else Fh) * (if t < n then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

AdalyFormal.W6P.gbondE_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.gbondE_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.W6P.gbondE_norm_sq.header:
theorem gbondE_norm_sq {n : ℕ} {g h : ℕ → ℝ} {Fg Dg Fh Dh : ℝ} (hg : SProf n g Fg Dg) (hh : SProf n h Fh Dh)
    (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ‖gbondE g h n W b‖ ^ 2 ≤ (Fg * Fh ^ 2) ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 3 * ∑ c : CoarseBond L n, ‖W c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6P.shift_val_sub.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.shift_val_sub
AdalyFormal.W6P.shift_val_sub.header: theorem shift_val_sub {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a c : Fin N) : ((a + 1) - c).val = ((a - c).val + 1) % N

AdalyFormal.W6P.shift_apply.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.shift_apply
AdalyFormal.W6P.shift_apply.header:
theorem shift_apply (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (ν0 ν : Fin 3) :
    (periodicLatticeShift y ν0) ν = if ν = ν0 then y ν + 1 else y ν

AdalyFormal.W6P.gmaj.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.gmaj
AdalyFormal.W6P.gmaj.header: noncomputable def gmaj (n : ℕ) (μ ν0 : Fin 3) (Fg Dg Fh Dh : ℝ) (N : Fin 3 → ℕ) (ν : Fin 3) (t : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W6P.gbK_shift_le.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.gbK_shift_le
AdalyFormal.W6P.gbK_shift_le.header:
theorem gbK_shift_le {n : ℕ} {g h : ℕ → ℝ} {Fg Dg Fh Dh : ℝ} (hg : SProf n g Fg Dg) (hh : SProf n h Fh Dh)
    (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (μ ν0 : Fin 3) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (c : CoarseBond L n) :
    |gbK g h n (periodicLatticeShift y ν0) μ c - gbK g h n y μ c|
      ≤ if c.2 = μ then ∏ ν : Fin 3, gmaj n μ ν0 Fg Dg Fh Dh (fun ν => L ν + 1) ν ((y ν - c.1.1 ν).val) else 0

AdalyFormal.W6P.gbondE_grad_sq.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.gbondE_grad_sq
AdalyFormal.W6P.gbondE_grad_sq.header:
theorem gbondE_grad_sq {n : ℕ} {g h : ℕ → ℝ} {Fg Dg Fh Dh : ℝ} (hg : SProf n g Fg Dg) (hh : SProf n h Fh Dh)
    (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (ν0 : Fin 3) (G : ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 8 * (if ν0 = μ then Dg else Dh) ^ 2 * (n + 1)
        * ∏ ν ∈ ({ν0}ᶜ : Finset (Fin 3)), (if ν = μ then Fg else Fh) ^ 2 ≤ G * n)
    (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ‖gbondE g h n W (periodicLatticeShift b.1 ν0, b.2) - gbondE g h n W b‖ ^ 2
      ≤ G * n * ∑ c : CoarseBond L n, ‖W c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6P.sbondE_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.sbondE_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.W6P.sbondE_norm_sq.header:
theorem sbondE_norm_sq (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ‖sbondE n W b‖ ^ 2 ≤ (9 * (3 / 2) ^ 2) ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 3 * ∑ c : CoarseBond L n, ‖W c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W6P.sbondE_grad_sq.name: AdalyFormal.W6P.sbondE_grad_sq
AdalyFormal.W6P.sbondE_grad_sq.header:
theorem sbondE_grad_sq (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (ν0 : Fin 3) (W : CoarseBond L n → SuTwo) :
    ∑ b : Bond L, ‖sbondE n W (periodicLatticeShift b.1 ν0, b.2) - sbondE n W b‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 419904 * n * ∑ c : CoarseBond L n, ‖W c‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2W6.inj_of_perturbed.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.inj_of_perturbed
AdalyFormal.M2W6.inj_of_perturbed.header:
theorem inj_of_perturbed {H : Type*} [AddCommGroup H] [Module ℝ H] (ν : H → ℝ)
    (hν0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ν x) (hνadd : ∀ x y, ν (x + y) ≤ 2 * ν x + 2 * ν y) (hνneg : ∀ x, ν (-x) = ν x)
    (hνzero : ∀ x, ν x ≤ 0 → x = 0)
    (N S T : H →ₗ[ℝ] H) (hT : ∀ y, T y = y + N y + S y) (hNN : ∀ y, N (N y) = 0)
    (A s : ℝ) (hN : ∀ y, ν (N y) ≤ A * ν y) (hS : ∀ y, ν (S y) ≤ s * ν y) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hsmall : 2 * s * (1 + A) < 1) : Function.Injective T

AdalyFormal.M2W6.compL_far_zero.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.compL_far_zero
AdalyFormal.M2W6.compL_far_zero.header:
theorem compL_far_zero (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (J : ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ l, l < J → ∀ ρ : Fin 3, ell ^ l ∣ L ρ + 1) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ J → ∀ (b : PeriodicLatticeEdge L), b.1 ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ j) → ∀ v : XS L,
      (∀ e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, pdist b.1 e.1 ≤ rhoT ell j → v e = 0) → QlinCompL ell bg j v b = 0

AdalyFormal.M2W6.ball_window.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.ball_window
AdalyFormal.M2W6.ball_window.header:
theorem ball_window (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M)
    (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (e : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (he : pdist p.2.1.1 e ≤ 8 * ell ^ (p.1 : ℕ)) :
    AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k e ≤ (p.1 : ℕ) + 1 ∧ (p.1 : ℕ) ≤ AdalyFormal.M1.strat S k e + 1

AdalyFormal.M2W6.sglL.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.sglL
AdalyFormal.M2W6.sglL.header: noncomputable def sglL (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) : SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] FSp (geomOf ell k S)

AdalyFormal.M2W6.sglL_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.sglL_apply
AdalyFormal.M2W6.sglL_apply.header: theorem sglL_apply (p q : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (w : SuTwo) : (sglL p w) q = if q = p then w else 0

AdalyFormal.M2W6.psiL.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.psiL
AdalyFormal.M2W6.psiL.header: noncomputable def psiL (hell : 0 < ell) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) : SuTwo →ₗ[ℝ] BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)

AdalyFormal.M2W6.psiL_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.psiL_apply
AdalyFormal.M2W6.psiL_apply.header:
theorem psiL_apply (hell : 0 < ell) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (w : SuTwo) (b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    (psiL hell p w) b = phiK hell p b • w

AdalyFormal.M2W6.srcL.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.srcL
AdalyFormal.M2W6.srcL.header:
noncomputable def srcL (hell : 0 < ell) (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.M2W6.EU.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.EU
AdalyFormal.M2W6.EU.header:
noncomputable def EU (hell : 0 < ell) (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :

AdalyFormal.M2W6.EU_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.EU_apply
AdalyFormal.M2W6.EU_apply.header:
theorem EU_apply (hell : 0 < ell) (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) : EU hell γ y = ∑ p, srcL hell γ p (y p)

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Dfun.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Dfun
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Dfun.header:
noncomputable def Dfun (hell : 0 < ell) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.M2W6.rotL.header:

AdalyFormal.M2W6.rotL_self.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.rotL_self
AdalyFormal.M2W6.rotL_self.header:
theorem rotL_self (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S))

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Q_src.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Q_src
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Q_src.header:
theorem Q_src (hell : 0 < ell) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (w : SuTwo) :
    (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) U).Qfull (srcL hell γ p w)
      = (adFL (γ p) (geomOf ell k S)).symm
          ((bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (periodicGaugeTransform (γ p) U)).Qfull
            (psiL hell p (RMap ((γ p) p.2.1.1) w)))

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Q_src_row.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Q_src_row
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Q_src_row.header:
theorem Q_src_row (hell : 0 < ell) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p p' : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (w : SuTwo) :
    ((bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) U).Qfull (srcL hell γ p w)) p'
      = kap hell p' p • rotL γ p' p w
        + RMap ((((γ p) p'.2.1.1)⁻¹)) ((Dfun hell U γ p (RMap ((γ p) p.2.1.1) w)) p')

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nterm.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nterm
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nterm.header:

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nterm_add.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nterm_add
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nterm_add.header:
theorem Nterm_add (hell : 0 < ell) (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nterm_smul.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nterm_smul
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nterm_smul.header:

AdalyFormal.M2W6.NtermL.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.NtermL
AdalyFormal.M2W6.NtermL.header:
noncomputable def NtermL (hell : 0 < ell) (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nlin.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nlin
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nlin.header:
noncomputable def Nlin (hell : 0 < ell) (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    FSp (geomOf ell k S) →ₗ[ℝ] FSp (geomOf ell k S)

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nlin_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nlin_apply
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nlin_apply.header:
theorem Nlin_apply (hell : 0 < ell) (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) (p' : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) :
    (Nlin hell γ y) p' = ∑ p, NtermL hell γ p' p (y p)

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nterm_Nterm.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nterm_Nterm
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nterm_Nterm.header:
theorem Nterm_Nterm (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)
    (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p'' p' p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (w : SuTwo) :
    NtermL hell γ p'' p' (NtermL hell γ p' p w) = 0

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nlin_Nlin.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nlin_Nlin
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Nlin_Nlin.header:
theorem Nlin_Nlin (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)
    (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    Nlin hell γ (Nlin hell γ y) = 0

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tlin.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tlin
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tlin.header:
noncomputable def Tlin (hell : 0 < ell) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    FSp (geomOf ell k S) →ₗ[ℝ] FSp (geomOf ell k S)

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tlin_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tlin_apply
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tlin_apply.header:
theorem Tlin_apply (hell : 0 < ell) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    Tlin hell U γ y = (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) U).Qfull (EU hell γ y)

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Sfun.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Sfun
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Sfun.header:
noncomputable def Sfun (hell : 0 < ell) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) : FSp (geomOf ell k S)

AdalyFormal.M2W6.kap_rot_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.kap_rot_sum
AdalyFormal.M2W6.kap_rot_sum.header:
theorem kap_rot_sum (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)
    (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S))
    (p' : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) :
    ∑ p, kap hell p' p • rotL γ p' p (y p) = y p' + (Nlin hell γ y) p'

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tlin_row.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tlin_row
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tlin_row.header:
theorem Tlin_row (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)
    (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    Tlin hell U γ y = y + Nlin hell γ y + Sfun hell U γ y

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Qfull_zero_of_not_inter.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Qfull_zero_of_not_inter
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Qfull_zero_of_not_inter.header:
theorem Qfull_zero_of_not_inter (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M)
    (V : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p p' : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (hni : ¬ Inter p' p) (w : SuTwo) :
    (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull (psiL (by omega : 0 < ell) p w) p' = 0

AdalyFormal.M2W6.level_FG_src.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.level_FG_src
AdalyFormal.M2W6.level_FG_src.header:
theorem level_FG_src (hell : 0 < ell) (V : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (Pp : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → Prop) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (W : ℕ → Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (hcl : ∀ l, l < k → ∀ z ∈ W l, z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ l) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((bgTower (GF ell k Lu) V l (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ ε l)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (hr : ∀ j, j < k → Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ε j) < r0)
    (j : Fin (k + 1))
    (hW : ∀ r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j}, Pp ⟨j, r⟩ → ∀ l, l < (j : ℕ) →
      Ball r.1.1 (rhoT ell j - rhoT ell l) ⊆ W l)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    (∑ r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j},
        (if Pp ⟨j, r⟩ then wF (⟨j, r⟩ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S))
          * ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull x ⟨j, r⟩‖ ^ 2 else 0)
      ≤ (Real.exp ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j : ℕ), thetaOf ell (ε i)) / rr ell)) ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2) ∧
    (∑ r : {b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) j},
        (if Pp ⟨j, r⟩ then wF (⟨j, r⟩ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S))
          * ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull x ⟨j, r⟩
              - (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull x ⟨j, r⟩‖ ^ 2 else 0)
      ≤ delLoc ell ε j ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.M2W6.mod_cases2.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.mod_cases2
AdalyFormal.M2W6.mod_cases2.header:
theorem mod_cases2 (x N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hx : x < 2 * N) :
    (x < N ∧ x % N = x) ∨ (N ≤ x ∧ x % N = x - N)

AdalyFormal.M2W6.ball_disp.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.ball_disp
AdalyFormal.M2W6.ball_disp.header:
theorem ball_disp (N m c y : ℕ) (hc : c < N) (hy : y < N) (h : pcd N y c ≤ m) :
    (N - y + (c + m) % N) % N ≤ 2 * m

AdalyFormal.M2W6.card_pball_aligned.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.card_pball_aligned
AdalyFormal.M2W6.card_pball_aligned.header:
theorem card_pball_aligned {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν : Fin 3, n ∣ L ν + 1)
    (m : ℕ) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite L) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun y : PeriodicLatticeSite L => (∀ ν, n ∣ (y ν).val) ∧ pdist y c ≤ m)).card
      ≤ (2 * m / n + 1) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.M2W6.card_rows_near.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.card_rows_near
AdalyFormal.M2W6.card_rows_near.header:
theorem card_rows_near (hell : 0 < ell) (l : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ k) (c : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (m : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) => (p.1 : ℕ) = l ∧ pdist p.2.1.1 c ≤ m)).card
      ≤ 3 * (2 * m / ell ^ l + 1) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Inter.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Inter
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Inter.header: def Inter (p' p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) : Prop

AdalyFormal.M2W6.card_inter.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.card_inter
AdalyFormal.M2W6.card_inter.header:
theorem card_inter (hell : 0 < ell) (p' : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) => Inter p' p)).card ≤ 9 * (24 * ell + 1) ^ 3

AdalyFormal.M2W6.levels_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.levels_sum
AdalyFormal.M2W6.levels_sum.header:
theorem levels_sum (k s : ℕ) (f : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hf : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), f j ≤ if s ≤ (j : ℕ) + 1 ∧ (j : ℕ) ≤ s + 1 then c else 0) :
    ∑ j, f j ≤ 3 * c

AdalyFormal.M2W6.source_bounds.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.source_bounds
AdalyFormal.M2W6.source_bounds.header:
theorem source_bounds (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 0 < M) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M)
    (V : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (ε : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hcl : ∀ j' : ℕ, (p.1 : ℕ) ≤ j' + 1 → j' ≤ (p.1 : ℕ) + 1 → ∀ l, l < k → l < j' →
      ∀ z ∈ Ball p.2.1.1 (20 * ell ^ ((p.1 : ℕ) + 1)), z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ l) → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
        frobNorm (((bgTower (GF ell k Lu) V l (z, μ) : SU2) : M2) - 1) ≤ ε j' l)
    (hε0 : ∀ j' l, l < k → 0 ≤ ε j' l) (hsm : ∀ j' l, l < k → rhoOf ell (ε j' l) < Real.pi / 2)
    (hr : ∀ j' l, l < k → Real.pi / 2 * ((loopFactorBound ell : ℝ) * ε j' l) < r0)
    (Sstar : ℝ) (hSstar : ∀ j' : ℕ, j' ≤ k → ∑ l ∈ range j', thetaOf ell (ε j' l) ≤ Sstar) (w : SuTwo) :
    W6.nF ((bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull (psiL (by omega : 0 < ell) p w)
        - (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull (psiL (by omega : 0 < ell) p w))
      ≤ 3 * delStar ell Sstar ^ 2 * ‖psiL (by omega : 0 < ell) p w‖ ^ 2 ∧
    W6.nF ((bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) V).Qfull (psiL (by omega : 0 < ell) p w))
      ≤ 3 * (Real.exp (Sstar / rr ell)) ^ 2 * ‖psiL (by omega : 0 < ell) p w‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2W6.norm_RMap.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.norm_RMap
AdalyFormal.M2W6.norm_RMap.header: theorem norm_RMap (g : Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (v : SuTwo) : ‖RMap g v‖ = ‖v‖

AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_add_le.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_add_le
AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_add_le.header: theorem nF_add_le (hell : 0 < ell) (y z : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) : nF (y + z) ≤ 2 * nF y + 2 * nF z

AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_neg.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_neg
AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_neg.header: theorem nF_neg (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) : nF (-y) = nF y

AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_sglL.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_sglL
AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_sglL.header: theorem nF_sglL (w : SuTwo) (p : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) : nF (sglL p w) = wF p * ‖w‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.M2W6.psiL_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.psiL_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.M2W6.psiL_norm_sq.header:

AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_sum_sparse.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_sum_sparse
AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_sum_sparse.header:
theorem nF_sum_sparse (hell : 0 < ell) (m0 : ℕ) (v : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → FSp (geomOf ell k S))
    (hsupp : ∀ p p' : BIdx (geomOf ell k S), ¬ Inter p' p → v p p' = 0)
    (hcard : ∀ p' : BIdx (geomOf ell k S), (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => Inter p' p)).card ≤ m0) :

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Dvec.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Dvec
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Dvec.header:
noncomputable def Dvec (hell : 0 < ell) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Sfun_eq_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Sfun_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Sfun_eq_sum.header:
theorem Sfun_eq_sum (hell : 0 < ell) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tvec.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tvec
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tvec.header:
noncomputable def Tvec (hell : 0 < ell) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tvec_eq.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tvec_eq
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tvec_eq.header:
theorem Tvec_eq (hell : 0 < ell) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (p p' : BIdx (geomOf ell k S)) (w : SuTwo) :

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tlin_eq_sum.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tlin_eq_sum
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Tlin_eq_sum.header:
theorem Tlin_eq_sum (hell : 0 < ell) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :
    Tlin hell U γ y = ∑ p, Tvec hell U γ p (y p)

AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_rot.header:
theorem nF_rot (hell : 0 < ell) (g : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (f : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :

AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_Tvec.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_Tvec

AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_Sfun.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_Sfun

AdalyFormal.M2W6.nF_Tlin.header:

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Slin.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Slin
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Slin.header:

AdalyFormal.M2W6.Slin_apply.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.Slin_apply
AdalyFormal.M2W6.Slin_apply.header:
theorem Slin_apply (hell : 0 < ell) (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hR : 8 * ell ≤ R)

AdalyFormal.M2W6.T_split.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.T_split
AdalyFormal.M2W6.T_split.header:
theorem T_split (hell : 0 < ell) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (γ : BIdx (geomOf ell k S) → GaugeFn (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (y : FSp (geomOf ell k S)) :

AdalyFormal.M2W6.tower_link_cube.header:
theorem tower_link_cube {ell k : ℕ} {Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (hell2 : 2 ≤ ell) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hT3 : ∀ μ, 3 ≤ Lu μ + 1) (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (sites : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)))
    (i : ℕ) {a η : ℝ}
    (K : CubeChart U (fun b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) => CubeBond sites b) η
      (a * (((ell : ℝ) ^ i * η)⁻¹ ^ 1)) (a * (((ell : ℝ) ^ i * η)⁻¹ ^ 2)))
    (hη : 0 < η) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1)
    (l : ℕ) (hlk : l < k)
    (hsm : 4000000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * a / (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * i))) ≤ 1)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (hz : z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ l)) (μ : Fin 3)
    (hcone : ∀ w, pdist z w ≤ 14 * ell ^ l → w ∈ sites) :
    dv (AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedBackground.ubarTowerSU2 ell (periodicGaugeTransform K.g U) l (z, μ))
      ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ l * ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * a / (ell : ℝ) ^ i)
        + 3 * Real.pi * (((ell : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ l * ((4 * Real.pi + 4) * a / (ell : ℝ) ^ (2 * i)))

AdalyFormal.M2W6.link_bound_mono.name: AdalyFormal.M2W6.link_bound_mono

theorem slice_coercive_gen {C : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup C] [InnerProductSpace ℝ C]
    (G : TowerGeom L) (hOm : G.Om0 = Set.univ) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (QU : SiteL2 L →L[ℝ] C)
    (nsq c1 t e P δ b ε q : ℝ) (hn : 0 ≤ nsq) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hflat : ∀ y : BondFnL2 L,
      c1 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ nsq * (PhiG G a (trivialU L) y + ‖Rproj G (trivialU L) (gradAdj (trivialU L) y)‖ ^ 2))
    (hdrift : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, PhiG G a (trivialU L) x ≤ (1 + t) * PhiG G a U x + e * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hPoinc1 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp G (trivialU L), ‖ν‖ ≤ P * ‖gradL2 (trivialU L) ν‖)
    (hd : ∀ f, ‖gradL2 (trivialU L) f - gradL2 U f‖ ≤ δ * ‖f‖)
    (hNU : ∀ f, QU f = 0 → f ∈ NQp G U)
    (hext : ∀ w : C, ∃ f, QU f = w ∧ ‖gradL2 U f‖ ≤ b * ‖w‖)
    (hQq : ∀ f, ‖QU f‖ ≤ q * ‖f‖)
    (hQN1 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp G (trivialU L), ‖QU ν‖ ≤ ε * ‖ν‖)
    (x : BondFnL2 L) (hx : Rproj G U (gradAdj U x) = 0) :
    (c1 - nsq * gamS P δ b ε q ^ 2 - nsq * e) / (1 + t) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ nsq * PhiG G a U x

AdalyFormal.W3NF.ginv_coercive_gen.header:
theorem ginv_coercive_gen {C : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup C] [InnerProductSpace ℝ C]
    (G : TowerGeom L) (hOm : G.Om0 = Set.univ) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (Jf : BondFnL2 L)
    (hu : IsUnit (DelpA G U a + (1 - siteMask G.Om0)))
    (hB0 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp G U, (bondSectorOf G U).Qfull (gradL2 U ν) = 0)
    (PU : ℝ) (hPU : 0 ≤ PU) (hPoincU : ∀ ν ∈ NQp G U, ‖ν‖ ≤ PU * ‖gradL2 U ν‖)
    (QU : SiteL2 L →L[ℝ] C)
    (nsq c1 t e P δ b ε q : ℝ) (hn : 0 < nsq) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hsmall : nsq * gamS P δ b ε q ^ 2 + nsq * e < c1)
    (hflat : ∀ y : BondFnL2 L,
      c1 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ nsq * (PhiG G a (trivialU L) y + ‖Rproj G (trivialU L) (gradAdj (trivialU L) y)‖ ^ 2))
    (hdrift : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L, PhiG G a (trivialU L) x ≤ (1 + t) * PhiG G a U x + e * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hPoinc1 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp G (trivialU L), ‖ν‖ ≤ P * ‖gradL2 (trivialU L) ν‖)
    (hd : ∀ f, ‖gradL2 (trivialU L) f - gradL2 U f‖ ≤ δ * ‖f‖)
    (hNU : ∀ f, QU f = 0 → f ∈ NQp G U)
    (hext : ∀ w : C, ∃ f, QU f = w ∧ ‖gradL2 U f‖ ≤ b * ‖w‖)
    (hQq : ∀ f, ‖QU f‖ ≤ q * ‖f‖)
    (hQN1 : ∀ ν ∈ NQp G (trivialU L), ‖QU ν‖ ≤ ε * ‖ν‖)
    (x : ↥(bondSupp G)) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ max (2 / csS nsq c1 t e (gamS P δ b ε q)) (2 * PU ^ 2) *
      ⟪x, (baseData G U a (bondSectorOf G U) Jf).Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.W3NF.phi_drift_gen.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.phi_drift_gen
AdalyFormal.W3NF.phi_drift_gen.header:
theorem phi_drift_gen (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (δc θ δm : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L,
      ‖AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.plaqMask (plaqIn G.Om0) (curlCovariantLM_L2 (trivialU L) x)
        - AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.plaqMask (plaqIn G.Om0) (curlCovariantLM_L2 U x)‖ ≤ δc * ‖x‖)
    (hdp : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L,
      |AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR6.deltaPrimeBilL2NormLoc U (plaqIn G.Om0) x x| ≤ θ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hm : ∀ x : BondFnL2 L,
      ∑ p : BIdx G, a * (G.ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ) *
        ‖(bondSectorOf G (trivialU L)).Qfull x p - (bondSectorOf G U).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2 ≤ δm ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    PhiG G a (trivialU L) x ≤ (1 + t) * PhiG G a U x + ((1 + t) * θ + (1 + 1 / t) * (δc ^ 2 + δm ^ 2)) * ‖x‖ ^ 2
