        AdalyFormal.M1.M1Regular ell 1 1 (i + 1) (patchTower i Rg) α₀ ((ell : ℝ) ^ (i + 1))⁻¹ U) →
      AdalyFormal.M1W2.W3G0At ell L U a cW

AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow
AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow.header: noncomputable def Qrow (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) : SiteL2 L →L[ℝ] CRow G

AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_apply.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_apply
AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_apply.header:
theorem Qrow_apply (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) (q : QIdx G) :
    Qrow G U f q = Qlev G U (jq q) (yq q) f

AdalyFormal.W3NF.mem_NQp_of_Qrow.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.mem_NQp_of_Qrow
AdalyFormal.W3NF.mem_NQp_of_Qrow.header:
theorem mem_NQp_of_Qrow (G : TowerGeom L) (hOm : G.Om0 = Set.univ) (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L)
    (hf : Qrow G U f = 0) : f ∈ NQp G U

AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_of_NQp.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_of_NQp
AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_of_NQp.header: theorem Qrow_of_NQp (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) (hf : f ∈ NQp G U) : Qrow G U f = 0

AdalyFormal.W3NF.cpow_aux.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.cpow_aux
AdalyFormal.W3NF.cpow_aux.header:
theorem cpow_aux (ell : ℝ) (hl : 0 < ell) (j : ℕ) :
    ((1 / ell ^ 3) ^ j) ^ 2 * ((ell ^ j) ^ 3) = (1 / ell ^ 3) ^ j

AdalyFormal.W3NF.sum_blocks_q.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.sum_blocks_q
AdalyFormal.W3NF.sum_blocks_q.header:
theorem sum_blocks_q (h : PeriodicLatticeSite L → ℝ) (hh : ∀ x, 0 ≤ h x) :
    ∑ q : QIdx G, ∑ x ∈ blockOf (yq q) (ell ^ jq q), h x ≤ ∑ x, h x

AdalyFormal.W3NF.row_sq_le.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.row_sq_le
AdalyFormal.W3NF.row_sq_le.header:
theorem row_sq_le (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) (q : QIdx G) :
    ‖Qlev G U (jq q) (yq q) f‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ jq q * ∑ x ∈ blockOf (yq q) (ell ^ jq q), ‖f x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_norm_sq.header:
theorem Qrow_norm_sq (hell : 0 < ell) (j0 : ℕ) (hlev : ∀ q : QIdx G, j0 ≤ jq q) (U : Cfg L) (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖Qrow G U f‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ j0 * ‖f‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_drift_sq.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_drift_sq
AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_drift_sq.header:
theorem Qrow_drift_sq (hell : 0 < ell) (j0 : ℕ) (hlev : ∀ q : QIdx G, j0 ≤ jq q) (U : Cfg L)
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hbg : ∀ i, i < k → ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L (ell ^ i), ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      frobNorm (((bgTower G U i (y, μ) : _) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ a i)
    (D : ℝ) (hD0 : 0 ≤ D) (hD : ∀ q : QIdx G, |AdalyFormal.BondComposite.dsum ell a (jq q)| ≤ D)
    (f : SiteL2 L) :
    ‖Qrow G U f - Qrow G (trivialU L) f‖ ^ 2 ≤ D ^ 2 * ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ j0 * ‖f‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.W3NF.corner_div.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.corner_div
AdalyFormal.W3NF.corner_div.header:
theorem corner_div {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (corner m x μ).val / m = (x μ).val / m

AdalyFormal.W3NF.corner_mem_iff.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.corner_mem_iff
AdalyFormal.W3NF.corner_mem_iff.header:
theorem corner_mem_iff {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)}
    (hRg : BlockClosed m Rg) (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) : corner m x ∈ Rg ↔ x ∈ Rg

AdalyFormal.W3NF.GQ.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.GQ
AdalyFormal.W3NF.GQ.header: abbrev GQ : TowerGeom (scaleUp ell j Lu')

AdalyFormal.W3NF.zj_dvd.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.zj_dvd
AdalyFormal.W3NF.zj_dvd.header: theorem zj_dvd (z : ZJ ell j Lu') (μ : Fin 3) : ell ^ j ∣ (z.1 μ).val

AdalyFormal.W3NF.rowOf.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.rowOf
AdalyFormal.W3NF.rowOf.header: noncomputable def rowOf (z : ZJ ell j Lu') : QIdx (GQ ell j Lu' Rg)

AdalyFormal.W3NF.rowOf_in.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.rowOf_in
AdalyFormal.W3NF.rowOf_in.header:
theorem rowOf_in (z : ZJ ell j Lu') (hz : z.1 ∈ Rg) :
    jq (rowOf hell hRg z) = j + 1 ∧ yq (rowOf hell hRg z) = corner (ell ^ (j + 1)) z.1

AdalyFormal.W3NF.rowOf_out.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.rowOf_out
AdalyFormal.W3NF.rowOf_out.header:
theorem rowOf_out (z : ZJ ell j Lu') (hz : z.1 ∉ Rg) :
    jq (rowOf hell hRg z) = j ∧ yq (rowOf hell hRg z) = z.1

AdalyFormal.W3NF.liftL.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.liftL
AdalyFormal.W3NF.liftL.header: noncomputable def liftL : CRow (GQ ell j Lu' Rg) →L[ℝ] coarseC (GF ell j Lu')

AdalyFormal.W3NF.liftL_apply.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.liftL_apply
AdalyFormal.W3NF.liftL_apply.header:
theorem liftL_apply (w : CRow (GQ ell j Lu' Rg)) (z : ZJ ell j Lu') :
    liftL hell hRg w z = w (rowOf hell hRg z)

AdalyFormal.W3NF.mem_stepBlock_rowOf.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.mem_stepBlock_rowOf
AdalyFormal.W3NF.mem_stepBlock_rowOf.header:
theorem mem_stepBlock_rowOf (z : ZJ ell j Lu') :
    z.1 ∈ stepBlockOf (yq (rowOf hell hRg z)) (ell ^ j) ell

AdalyFormal.W3NF.liftL_norm_sq.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.liftL_norm_sq
AdalyFormal.W3NF.liftL_norm_sq.header:
theorem liftL_norm_sq (w : CRow (GQ ell j Lu' Rg)) :
    ‖liftL hell hRg w‖ ^ 2 ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 3 * ‖w‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W3NF.flatE_block.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.flatE_block
AdalyFormal.W3NF.flatE_block.header:
theorem flatE_block (v : coarseC (GF ell j Lu')) (z : ZJ ell j Lu') :
    (1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ j • ∑ x ∈ blockOf z.1 (ell ^ j), (flatE ell j Lu' v) x = v z

AdalyFormal.W3NF.flat_rightInv_patch.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.flat_rightInv_patch
AdalyFormal.W3NF.flat_rightInv_patch.header:
theorem flat_rightInv_patch (w : CRow (GQ ell j Lu' Rg)) :
    Qrow (GQ ell j Lu' Rg) (trivialU _) (flatE ell j Lu' (liftL hell hRg w)) = w

AdalyFormal.W3NF.aEP.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.aEP
AdalyFormal.W3NF.aEP.header: noncomputable def aEP (ell j : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W3NF.bEP.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.bEP
AdalyFormal.W3NF.bEP.header: noncomputable def bEP (ell j : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W3NF.aEP_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.aEP_nonneg
AdalyFormal.W3NF.aEP_nonneg.header: theorem aEP_nonneg (ell j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ aEP ell j

AdalyFormal.W3NF.bEP_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.bEP_nonneg
AdalyFormal.W3NF.bEP_nonneg.header: theorem bEP_nonneg (ell j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ bEP ell j

AdalyFormal.W3NF.flatExt_patch.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.flatExt_patch
AdalyFormal.W3NF.flatExt_patch.header:
theorem flatExt_patch (ell j : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (Lu' : PeriodicLatticeExtent)
    (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell j Lu'))) (hRg : BlockClosed (ell ^ (j + 1)) Rg)
    (hdvd1 : ∀ μ, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ scaleUp ell j Lu' μ + 1) :
    ∃ E1 : CRow (GQ ell j Lu' Rg) →L[ℝ] SiteL2 (scaleUp ell j Lu'),
      (∀ w, Qrow (GQ ell j Lu' Rg) (trivialU _) (E1 w) = w) ∧ (∀ w, ‖E1 w‖ ≤ aEP ell j * ‖w‖) ∧
      (∀ w, ‖gradL2 (trivialU _) (E1 w)‖ ≤ bEP ell j * ‖w‖)

AdalyFormal.W3NF.flatExt_patch_gen.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.flatExt_patch_gen
AdalyFormal.W3NF.flatExt_patch_gen.header:
theorem flatExt_patch_gen (ell j : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (Lu' : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    ∀ (L : PeriodicLatticeExtent), scaleUp ell j Lu' = L → ∀ (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)),
      BlockClosed (ell ^ (j + 1)) Rg → (∀ μ, ell ^ (j + 1) ∣ L μ + 1) →
      ∃ E1 : CRow (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) →L[ℝ] SiteL2 L,
        (∀ w, Qrow (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) (trivialU L) (E1 w) = w) ∧
        (∀ w, ‖E1 w‖ ≤ aEP ell j * ‖w‖) ∧ (∀ w, ‖gradL2 (trivialU L) (E1 w)‖ ≤ bEP ell j * ‖w‖)

AdalyFormal.W3NF.scaleUp_split.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.scaleUp_split
AdalyFormal.W3NF.scaleUp_split.header:
theorem scaleUp_split (ell j : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    scaleUp ell j (scaleUp ell 1 Lu) = scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu

AdalyFormal.W3NF.bondsLam_aligned.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.bondsLam_aligned
AdalyFormal.W3NF.bondsLam_aligned.header:
theorem bondsLam_aligned (hell : 0 < ell) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ k) (b : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (hb : b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) i) : b.1 ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ i)

AdalyFormal.W3NF.rowCB.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.rowCB
AdalyFormal.W3NF.rowCB.header:
def rowCB (hell : 0 < ell) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ k) (b : {b // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) i}) :
    CoarseBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ i)

AdalyFormal.W3NF.rowCB_injective.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.rowCB_injective
AdalyFormal.W3NF.rowCB_injective.header: theorem rowCB_injective (hell : 0 < ell) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ k) : Function.Injective (rowCB ell k Lu S hell i hi)

AdalyFormal.W3NF.lvlB.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.lvlB
AdalyFormal.W3NF.lvlB.header: noncomputable def lvlB (ell : ℕ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.W3NF.mass_level_le.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.mass_level_le
AdalyFormal.W3NF.mass_level_le.header:
theorem mass_level_le (hell : 0 < ell) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell k Lu) U) k) (hcl : TowerClass ell k Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ j, j < k → 0 ≤ ε j) (hsm : ∀ j, j < k → rhoOf ell (ε j) < Real.pi / 2)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (i : Fin (k + 1)) :
    ∑ b : {b // b ∈ bondsLam (geomOf ell k S) (i : ℕ)}, a * (ell : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) *
        ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) (trivialU _)).Qfull x ⟨i, b⟩
          - (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell k S) U).Qfull x ⟨i, b⟩‖ ^ 2
      ≤ a * ((ell : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ))⁻¹ * (lvlB ell ε i * ‖x‖) ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W3NF.lvl_le_deltaM.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.lvl_le_deltaM
AdalyFormal.W3NF.lvl_le_deltaM.header:
theorem lvl_le_deltaM (ell j : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hε0 : ∀ i, i < j + 1 → 0 ≤ ε i) (i : ℕ) (hji : j ≤ i) (hij : i ≤ j + 1) :
    a * ((ell : ℝ) ^ i)⁻¹ * lvlB ell ε i ^ 2 ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ 2 * deltaM ell (j + 1) a ε ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W3NF.hm_patch.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.hm_patch
AdalyFormal.W3NF.hm_patch.header:
theorem hm_patch (ell j : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)))
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hreg : RegTower ell (bgTower (GF ell (j + 1) Lu) U) (j + 1)) (hcl : TowerClass ell (j + 1) Lu U ε)
    (hε0 : ∀ i, i < j + 1 → 0 ≤ ε i) (hsm : ∀ i, i < j + 1 → rhoOf ell (ε i) < Real.pi / 2)
    (x : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)) :
    ∑ p : BIdx (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)), a * ((geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)).ell : ℝ) ^ (p.1 : ℕ) *
        ‖(bondSectorOf (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) (trivialU _)).Qfull x p
          - (bondSectorOf (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg)) U).Qfull x p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ (Real.sqrt 2 * (ell : ℝ) * deltaM ell (j + 1) a ε) ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.W3NF.dsum_nonneg'.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.dsum_nonneg'
AdalyFormal.W3NF.dsum_nonneg'.header:
theorem dsum_nonneg' (ell : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hε0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ε i) (m : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ dsum ell ε m

AdalyFormal.W3NF.dsum_le_class.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.dsum_le_class
AdalyFormal.W3NF.dsum_le_class.header:
theorem dsum_le_class (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hε0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ε i) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (k : ℕ) (hε : ∀ i, i < k → ε i ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ i * η) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ k) :
    |dsum ell ε m| ≤ 6 * ((ell : ℝ) ^ k * η)

AdalyFormal.W3NF.le_mul_of_sq_le.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.le_mul_of_sq_le
AdalyFormal.W3NF.le_mul_of_sq_le.header:
theorem le_mul_of_sq_le {x y c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (h : x ^ 2 ≤ c ^ 2 * y ^ 2) :
    x ≤ c * y

AdalyFormal.W3NF.patch_rows_ge.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.patch_rows_ge
AdalyFormal.W3NF.patch_rows_ge.header:
theorem patch_rows_ge {ell j : ℕ} {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L))
    (q : QIdx (geomOf ell (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg))) : j ≤ jq q

AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_patch_norm.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_patch_norm
AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_patch_norm.header:
theorem Qrow_patch_norm (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)) (f : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)) :
    ‖Qrow (GP ell j Lu Rg) U f‖ ≤ Real.sqrt ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ j) * ‖f‖

AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_patch_drift.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_patch_drift
AdalyFormal.W3NF.Qrow_patch_drift.header:
theorem Qrow_patch_drift (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hcl : TowerClass ell (j + 1) Lu U ε) (D : ℝ) (hD0 : 0 ≤ D)
    (hD : ∀ m, m ≤ j + 1 → |dsum ell ε m| ≤ D) (f : SiteL2 (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)) :
    ‖Qrow (GP ell j Lu Rg) U f - Qrow (GP ell j Lu Rg) (trivialU _) f‖
      ≤ D * Real.sqrt ((1 / (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ^ j) * ‖f‖

AdalyFormal.W3NF.hext_row.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.hext_row
AdalyFormal.W3NF.hext_row.header:
theorem hext_row (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)) (δ ε0 : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε0)
    (hεa : ε0 * aEP ell j < 1)
    (hd : ∀ f, ‖gradL2 (trivialU (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)) f - gradL2 U f‖ ≤ δ * ‖f‖)
    (hdrift : ∀ f, ‖Qrow (GP ell j Lu Rg) U f - Qrow (GP ell j Lu Rg) (trivialU _) f‖ ≤ ε0 * ‖f‖)
    (w : CRow (GP ell j Lu Rg)) :
    ∃ f, Qrow (GP ell j Lu Rg) U f = w ∧
      ‖gradL2 U f‖ ≤ (bEP ell j + δ * aEP ell j) / (1 - ε0 * aEP ell j) * ‖w‖

AdalyFormal.W3NF.hQN1_row.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.hQN1_row
AdalyFormal.W3NF.hQN1_row.header:
theorem hQN1_row {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (ε0 : ℝ)
    (hdrift : ∀ f, ‖Qrow G U f - Qrow G (trivialU L) f‖ ≤ ε0 * ‖f‖) (ν : SiteL2 L)
    (hν : ν ∈ NQp G (trivialU L)) : ‖Qrow G U ν‖ ≤ ε0 * ‖ν‖

AdalyFormal.W3NF.towerClass_patch.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.towerClass_patch
AdalyFormal.W3NF.towerClass_patch.header:
theorem towerClass_patch (ell j : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)) (e q0 : ℝ) (he0 : 0 ≤ e) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (hlinks : ∀ b, dv (U b) ≤ e) (h0 : ∀ y ν μ, dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ q0)
    (S : TowerSmall ell (j + 1) e q0) :
    TowerClass ell (j + 1) Lu U (fun i => kap ell e q0 i)

AdalyFormal.W3NF.kap_nonneg'.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.kap_nonneg'
AdalyFormal.W3NF.kap_nonneg'.header:
theorem kap_nonneg' (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (e q0 : ℝ) (he0 : 0 ≤ e) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (i : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ kap ell e q0 i

AdalyFormal.W3NF.kap_le_class.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.kap_le_class
AdalyFormal.W3NF.kap_le_class.header:
theorem kap_le_class (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (e q0 : ℝ) (he0 : 0 ≤ e) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0) (k i : ℕ) (hik : i ≤ k) :
    kap ell e q0 i ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ i * (kap ell e q0 k / (ell : ℝ) ^ k)

AdalyFormal.W3NF.hU_patch.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.hU_patch
AdalyFormal.W3NF.hU_patch.header:
theorem hU_patch (ell j : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (G : TowerGeom L) (U : Cfg L) (r : ℝ)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hlinks : ∀ b, dv (U b) ≤ r / (ell : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) :
    ∀ i, i ≤ j + 1 → ∀ y ∈ G.Lam i, ∀ b ∈ AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inBlockBonds y (ell ^ i),
      frobNorm ((U b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1) ≤ r / (ell : ℝ) ^ i

AdalyFormal.W3NF.hT_patch.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.hT_patch
AdalyFormal.W3NF.hT_patch.header:
theorem hT_patch (ell j : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent)
    (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu))) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu))
    (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hcl : TowerClass ell (j + 1) Lu U ε)
    (hε : ∀ i, i < j + 1 → ε i ≤ (ell : ℝ) ^ i * (r / (ell : ℝ) ^ (j + 1))) :
    ∀ i, i ≤ j + 1 → ∀ y ∈ (GP ell j Lu Rg).Lam i, ∀ i', i' < i → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ i),
      z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu) (ell ^ i') → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
      coarseShift z (ell ^ i') μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ i) →
      frobNorm ((bgTower (GP ell j Lu Rg) U i' (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
        ≤ r * (ell : ℝ) ^ i' / (ell : ℝ) ^ i

AdalyFormal.W3NF.hflat_patch.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.hflat_patch
AdalyFormal.W3NF.hflat_patch.header:
theorem hflat_patch {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a Ci : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hCi : 0 ≤ Ci) (hI : LemIFlat ell a Ci)
    (j : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)))
    (hRg : BlockClosed (ell ^ (j + 1)) Rg) (y : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)) :
    1 / Kflat a Ci * ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) ^ 2 *
      (PhiG (GP ell j Lu Rg) a (trivialU _) y
        + ‖Rproj (GP ell j Lu Rg) (trivialU _) (gradAdj (trivialU _) y)‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.W3NF.theta_patch.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.theta_patch
AdalyFormal.W3NF.theta_patch.header:
theorem theta_patch (ell j : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)))
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hpl : AdalyFormal.NonflatHunit.PlaqDef α U)

AdalyFormal.W3NF.ginv_patch_nonflat.name: AdalyFormal.W3NF.ginv_patch_nonflat
AdalyFormal.W3NF.ginv_patch_nonflat.header:
theorem ginv_patch_nonflat {ell : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) {a Ci : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hCi : 0 ≤ Ci)
    (hI : LemIFlat ell a Ci) (j : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent)
    (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu))) (hRg : BlockClosed (ell ^ (j + 1)) Rg)
    (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)) (e q0 : ℝ) (he0 : 0 ≤ e) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q0)
    (hlinks : ∀ b, dv (U b) ≤ e) (h0 : ∀ y ν μ, dv (pw 1 U y ν μ) ≤ q0)
    (H : KUSmall ell (rhoM0 ell (j + 1) e q0))
    (hs1 : 432 * kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell (j + 1) e q0) ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (hs2 : kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell (j + 1) e q0) ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3))
    (hs3 : kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell (j + 1) e q0) ≤ 1)
    (hs4 : 324 * lamC ell * kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell (j + 1) e q0) ≤ 1)
    (hs5 : 2 * ThetaP ell a (kapHat ell (rhoM0 ell (j + 1) e q0)) ≤ 1 / Kflat a Ci)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (x : ↥(bondSupp (GP ell j Lu Rg))) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((ell : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) ^ 2 * K0 a Ci *
      ⟪x, (gparams ell (j + 1) Lu (by omega) (patchTower j Rg) U a Lam).data.Ginv x⟫

AdalyFormal.W3NF.regime_of_M1.header:

    (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu))) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)) (α : ℝ)

    (hM : AdalyFormal.M1.M1Regular ell 1 1 (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg) α ((ell : ℝ) ^ (j + 1))⁻¹ U) :
    ∃ g : GaugeFn (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu),
      (∀ b, dv (periodicGaugeTransform g U b) ≤ α / (ell : ℝ) ^ j) ∧
      (∀ y ν μ, dv (pw 1 (periodicGaugeTransform g U) y ν μ)

AdalyFormal.W3NF.smallness.header:
theorem smallness (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (a Ci : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hCi : 0 ≤ Ci) :

      α ≤ 1 ∧ KUSmall ell (rhoM1 ell α) ∧

      kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell α) ≤ 1 / (1000 * (ell : ℝ) ^ 3) ∧
      kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell α) ≤ 1 ∧
      324 * lamC ell * kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell α) ≤ 1 ∧
      2 * ThetaP ell a (kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell α)) ≤ 1 / Kflat a Ci

theorem site_hyps_of_M1 (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (j : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent)
    (Rg : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu))) (U : Cfg (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu)) (α : ℝ)
    (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (hKU : KUSmall ell (rhoM1 ell α))
    (hs1 : 432 * kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell α) ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (hM : AdalyFormal.M1.M1Regular ell 1 1 (j + 1) (patchTower j Rg) α ((ell : ℝ) ^ (j + 1))⁻¹ U) :
    ∃ g : GaugeFn (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu),
      216 * kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell α) ^ 2 < 1 ∧
      (∀ i, i ≤ j + 1 → ∀ y ∈ (GP ell j Lu Rg).Lam i, ∀ b ∈ AdalyFormal.SiteCoercivity.inBlockBonds y (ell ^ i),
        frobNorm (((periodicGaugeTransform g U b : AdalyFormal.Balaban.SuTwoLogExp.SU2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
          ≤ kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell α) / (ell : ℝ) ^ i) ∧
      (∀ i, i ≤ j + 1 → ∀ y ∈ (GP ell j Lu Rg).Lam i, ∀ i', i' < i → ∀ z ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ i),
        z ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell (j + 1) Lu) (ell ^ i') → ∀ μ : Fin 3,
        coarseShift z (ell ^ i') μ ∈ blockOf y (ell ^ i) →
        frobNorm ((bgTower (GP ell j Lu Rg) (periodicGaugeTransform g U) i' (z, μ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) - 1)
          ≤ kapHat ell (rhoM1 ell α) * (ell : ℝ) ^ i' / (ell : ℝ) ^ i) ∧
      RegTower ell (bgTower (GP ell j Lu Rg) (periodicGaugeTransform g U)) (j + 1)

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Qcomp_closed.header:
theorem Qcomp_closed (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L)
    (hbg : ∀ j, bg j = flatCfg) (J : ℕ) (hdvdJ : ∀ ν, ell ^ J ∣ L ν + 1) (a : XS L) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ J → ∀ (n : ℕ), n = ell ^ j → ∀ c : CoarseBond L n,
      suCoordFInv (QlinCompX ell bg j a) (c.1.1, c.2)
        = (n : ℝ) • lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n (suCoordFInv a) c

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.embY_mem_CL.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.embY_mem_CL
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.embY_mem_CL.header:
theorem embY_mem_CL (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu) :
    embY ell k Lu hell y ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ k)

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.scaleUp_tiling.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.scaleUp_tiling
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.scaleUp_tiling.header: theorem scaleUp_tiling (hell : 0 < ell) : ∀ μ, ell ^ k ∣ scaleUp ell k Lu μ + 1

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.sitesE.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.sitesE
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.sitesE.header:
noncomputable def sitesE : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu ≃
    {x : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp ell k Lu) // x ∈ CoarseLattice (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ k)}

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.sitesE_val.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.sitesE_val
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.sitesE_val.header: theorem sitesE_val (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu) : (sitesE ell k Lu hell y).1 = embY ell k Lu hell y

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.sitesE_shift.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.sitesE_shift
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.sitesE_shift.header:
theorem sitesE_shift (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite Lu) (μ : Fin 3) :
    (sitesE ell k Lu hell (periodicLatticeShift y μ)).1 = coarseShift (sitesE ell k Lu hell y).1 (ell ^ k) μ

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.bondsE.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.bondsE
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.bondsE.header: noncomputable def bondsE : Bond Lu ≃ CoarseBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ k)

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.plaqE.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.plaqE
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.plaqE.header: noncomputable def plaqE : PeriodicLatticePlaquette Lu ≃ CoarsePlaquette (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ k)

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.unitField.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.unitField
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.unitField.header: noncomputable def unitField (A : CoarseBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ k) → SuTwo) : Bond Lu → SuTwo

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.curl_reindex.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.curl_reindex
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.curl_reindex.header:
theorem curl_reindex (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ)
    (A : CoarseBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ k) → SuTwo) (p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette Lu) :
    flatCurlValue (unitField ell k Lu hell A) p =
      coarseCurlSuTwo (scaleUp_tiling ell k Lu hell) A (plaqE ell k Lu hell p)

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.curlEnergy_reindex.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.curlEnergy_reindex
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.curlEnergy_reindex.header:
theorem curlEnergy_reindex (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ)
    (A : CoarseBond (scaleUp ell k Lu) (ell ^ k) → SuTwo) :
    ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette Lu, ‖flatCurlValue (unitField ell k Lu hell A) p‖ ^ 2 =
      coarseCurlEnergySuTwo (scaleUp_tiling ell k Lu hell) A

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.stokes_unit.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.stokes_unit
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.stokes_unit.header:
theorem stokes_unit (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ) (A : Bond (scaleUp ell k Lu) → SuTwo) :
    ((ell ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) * ∑ p : PeriodicLatticePlaquette Lu,
        ‖flatCurlValue (unitField ell k Lu hell (lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo (ell ^ k) A)) p‖ ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ p' : PeriodicLatticePlaquette (scaleUp ell k Lu), ‖flatCurlValue A p'‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.firstTerm_core.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.firstTerm_core
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.firstTerm_core.header:
theorem firstTerm_core (hG : IsUnit P.G1inv) (hN : IsUnit (GenP.Nmat P)) (y : FSp P.G) :
    ∃ A : ↥(bondSupp P.G), P.data.Q A = y ∧
      ⟪y, Ring.inverse (GenP.Nmat P) y⟫ = ⟪A, P.G1inv A⟫

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.level_eq.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.level_eq
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.level_eq.header: theorem level_eq (hFS : P.FullSupp) (p : BIdx P.G) : (p.1 : ℕ) = P.k

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.tau_adj_apply.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.tau_adj_apply
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.tau_adj_apply.header:
theorem tau_adj_apply (hFS : P.FullSupp) (B : BondFnL2 P.Lu) (e : Bond P.Lu) :
    (WithLp.ofLp (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint P.tau B)) (P.eqv hFS e) = B e

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.tau_adj_norm.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.tau_adj_norm
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.tau_adj_norm.header:
theorem tau_adj_norm (hFS : P.FullSupp) (B : BondFnL2 P.Lu) :
    ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint P.tau B‖ = ‖B‖

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.mass_inner.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.mass_inner
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.mass_inner.header:
theorem mass_inner (hFS : P.FullSupp) (A : ↥(bondSupp P.G)) :
    ⟪A, P.data.Mass A⟫ = P.a * (P.ell : ℝ) ^ P.k * ‖P.data.Q A‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.genForm_reduct.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.genForm_reduction
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.genForm_reduct.header:
theorem genForm_reduction (hFS : P.FullSupp) (hOm : P.G.Om0 = Set.univ) (hU : P.U = flatCfg) (hG : IsUnit P.G1inv)
    (hN : IsUnit (GenP.Nmat P)) (B : BondFnL2 P.Lu) :
    ∃ A : ↥(bondSupp P.G), (∀ e : Bond P.Lu, (P.sector.Qfull (iE P.G A)) (P.eqv hFS e) = B e) ∧
      GenP.genForm P B = P.eta * (‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration
          (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (scaleUp P.ell P.k P.Lu)) (iE P.G A)‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖Tfull P.G P.U (iE P.G A)‖ ^ 2)

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK.header:
def PK (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) : IngrBParams

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_fullSupp.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_fullSupp
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_fullSupp.header:
theorem PK_fullSupp (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) : (PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).FullSupp

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_Om0_univ.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_Om0_univ
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_Om0_univ.header:
theorem PK_Om0_univ (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) : (PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).G.Om0 = Set.univ

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.bgTower_PK.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.bgTower_PK
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.bgTower_PK.header:
theorem bgTower_PK (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (j : ℕ) :
    bgTower (PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).G (PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).U j = flatCfg

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Qfull_top.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Qfull_top
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Qfull_top.header:
theorem Qfull_top (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (a : ℝ)
    (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) (e : Bond Lu) :
    ((PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).sector.Qfull A)
        ((PK ell k Lu hell a Lam).eqv (PK_fullSupp ell k Lu hell a Lam) e)
      = lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo (ell ^ k) (WithLp.ofLp A) (bondsE ell k Lu hell e)

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.curlnorm_eq.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.curlnorm_eq
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.curlnorm_eq.header:
theorem curlnorm_eq {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (x : BondFnL2 L) :
    ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration
      (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L) x‖ ^ 2
      = ∑ p' : PeriodicLatticePlaquette L, ‖flatCurlValue (WithLp.ofLp x) p'‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.floor_cond.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.floor_cond
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.floor_cond.header:
theorem floor_cond (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ Lu μ)
    (hd : ∀ μ, 2 ∣ Lu μ + 1) (hell : 0 < 2) (a : ℝ)
    (hG : IsUnit (PK 2 k Lu hell a Set.univ).G1inv)
    (hN : IsUnit (GenP.Nmat (PK 2 k Lu hell a Set.univ)))
    (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo) (hBt : OnLambdaTildeIn (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) 2 Bt) :
    (1 / 1728 : ℝ) * bondEnergy Bt ≤
      GenP.genForm (PK 2 k Lu hell a Set.univ)
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (PK 2 k Lu hell a Set.univ) Bt))

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Qcomposite_closed.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Qcomposite_closed
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Qcomposite_closed.header:
theorem Qcomposite_closed (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) L)
    (hbg : ∀ j, bg j = trivialU L) (J : ℕ) (hdvdJ : ∀ ν, ell ^ J ∣ L ν + 1)
    (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ J → ∀ n : ℕ, n = ell ^ j → ∀ y ∈ CoarseLattice L n,
      Qcomposite bg ell j lam y = (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 3) • ∑ x ∈ blockOf y n, lam x

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.LCR_grad.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.LCR_grad
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.LCR_grad.header:
theorem LCR_grad (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (φ : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : z ∈ CoarseLattice L n) (μ : Fin 3) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n (fun b : Bond L => φ (periodicLatticeShift b.1 b.2) - φ b.1) (⟨z, hz⟩, μ)
      = (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 4) • (∑ x ∈ blockOf (coarseShift z n μ) n, φ x - ∑ x ∈ blockOf z n, φ x)

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.LCR_const.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.LCR_const
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.LCR_const.header:
theorem LCR_const (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hdvd : ∀ ν, n ∣ L ν + 1) (c : Fin 3 → SuTwo)
    (z : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (hz : z ∈ CoarseLattice L n) (μ : Fin 3) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n (fun b : Bond L => c b.2) (⟨z, hz⟩, μ) = c μ

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.LCR_add.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.LCR_add
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.LCR_add.header:
theorem LCR_add {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (n : ℕ) (f g : Bond L → SuTwo)
    (b : CoarseBond L n) :
    lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n (f + g) b = lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n f b + lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo n g b

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.pathSite_period.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.pathSite_period
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.pathSite_period.header:
theorem pathSite_period {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    pathSite y μ (L μ + 1) = y

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.G_Om0.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.G_Om0
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.G_Om0.header:
theorem G_Om0 (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) :
    (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)).Om0 = Set.univ

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.siteMask_univ.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.siteMask_univ
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.siteMask_univ.header:
theorem siteMask_univ {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (f : SiteL2 L) :
    siteMask (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) f = f

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.ker_trivial.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.ker_trivial
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.ker_trivial.header:
theorem ker_trivial (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hell : 0 < ell) (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ)
    (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu))
    (h1 : curlCovariantCLM_L2 (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration
      (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (scaleUp ell k Lu)) A = 0)
    (h2 : Tfull (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu)) (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration
      (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (scaleUp ell k Lu)) A = 0)
    (h3 : ∀ e : Bond Lu, lineCoarseRestrictSuTwo (ell ^ k) (WithLp.ofLp A) (bondsE ell k Lu hell e) = 0) :
    A = 0

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.bondSupp_G.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.bondSupp_G
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.bondSupp_G.header:
theorem bondSupp_G (ell k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (A : BondFnL2 (scaleUp ell k Lu)) :
    A ∈ bondSupp (geomOf ell k (fullTower ell k Lu))

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.G1inv_form.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.G1inv_form
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.G1inv_form.header:
theorem G1inv_form (hFS : P.FullSupp) (hOm : P.G.Om0 = Set.univ) (hU : P.U = flatCfg) (x : ↥(bondSupp P.G)) :
    ⟪x, P.G1inv x⟫ = ‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration

      ‖Tfull P.G P.U (iE P.G x)‖ ^ 2 + P.a * (P.ell : ℝ) ^ P.k * ‖P.data.Q x‖ ^ 2

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_pd0.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_pd0
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_pd0.header:
theorem PK_pd0 (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ) (ha : 0 < a) (x : ↥(bondSupp (PP).G))

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_isUnit_G1inv.header: theorem PK_isUnit_G1inv (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ) (ha : 0 < a) : IsUnit (PP).G1inv

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_Q_surj.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_Q_surj
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_Q_surj.header: theorem PK_Q_surj (y : FSp (PP).G) : ∃ x : ↥(bondSupp (PP).G), (PP).data.Q x = y

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_isUnit_Nmat.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_isUnit_Nmat
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_isUnit_Nmat.header: theorem PK_isUnit_Nmat (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ) (ha : 0 < a) : IsUnit (GenP.Nmat (PP))

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_wellDef.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_wellDef
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.PK_wellDef.header:
theorem PK_wellDef (hN : ∀ μ, 1 ≤ Lu μ) (hdvd : ∀ μ, ell ∣ Lu μ + 1) (ha : 0 < a) :

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.closed_point_all_k.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.closed_point_all_k
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.closed_point_all_k.header:
theorem closed_point_all_k (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ Lu μ)
    (hd : ∀ μ, 2 ∣ Lu μ + 1) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    GenP.WellDef (gparams 2 k Lu (by norm_num) (fullTower 2 k Lu) flatCfg a Set.univ) ∧
    ∀ Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo, OnLambdaTildeIn (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) 2 Bt →
      OnLambdaT (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) Bt →
      (1 / 1728 : ℝ) * bondEnergy Bt ≤
        GenP.genForm (gparams 2 k Lu (by norm_num) (fullTower 2 k Lu) flatCfg a Set.univ)
          (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (gparams 2 k Lu (by norm_num) (fullTower 2 k Lu) flatCfg a Set.univ) Bt))

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.floor_all_k.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.floor_all_k
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.floor_all_k.header:
theorem floor_all_k (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ Lu μ)
    (hd : ∀ μ, 2 ∣ Lu μ + 1) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo)
    (hBt : OnLambdaTildeIn (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) 2 Bt) :

      GenP.genForm (PK 2 k Lu (by norm_num) a Set.univ)
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (PK 2 k Lu (by norm_num) a Set.univ) Bt))

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.genuine_point_nonv.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.genuine_point_nonvacuous_k5
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.genuine_point_nonv.header:
theorem genuine_point_nonvacuous_k5 (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (R : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) {α₀ : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < α₀) :
    TorusOK 2 1 L10 ∧
    Admissible 2 1 R k (fullTower 2 k L10) ∧
    CoversOm0p 2 1 12 k (fullTower 2 k L10) ∧
    LambdaOK (Lu := L10) (Lf := scaleUp 2 k L10) 2 1 R k (fullTower 2 k L10) Set.univ ∧
    PerCubeRegular2 2 1 12 k (fullTower 2 k L10) α₀ (((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹
      (flatCfg : LinkCfg (scaleUp 2 k L10)) ∧
    GenP.WellDef (gparams 2 k L10 (by norm_num) (fullTower 2 k L10) flatCfg a Set.univ) ∧
    ∃ Bt : Bond L10 → SuTwo, OnLambdaTildeIn Set.univ 2 Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Set.univ Bt ∧
      OnLambda Set.univ Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.genForm_pos_of.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.genForm_pos_of
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.genForm_pos_of.header:
theorem genForm_pos_of (k : ℕ) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (hL : ∀ μ : Fin 3, 4 ≤ Lu μ)
    (hd : ∀ μ, 2 ∣ Lu μ + 1) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo)
    (hBt : OnLambdaTildeIn (Set.univ : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) 2 Bt)
    (hpos : 0 < bondEnergy Bt) :
    0 < GenP.genForm (PK 2 k Lu (by norm_num) a Set.univ)
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (GenP.genC (PK 2 k Lu (by norm_num) a Set.univ) Bt))

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.firstTermMut.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.firstTermMut
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.firstTermMut.header: noncomputable def firstTermMut (P : IngrBParams) (η' : ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 P.Lu) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.genFormMut.header: noncomputable def genFormMut (P : IngrBParams) (η' s : ℝ) (B : BondFnL2 P.Lu) : ℝ

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.genFormMut_eq.header:
theorem genFormMut_eq (P : IngrBParams) (B : BondFnL2 P.Lu) :

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.genForm_Jsign_blin.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.genForm_Jsign_blind_flat
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.genForm_Jsign_blin.header:

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Bconst.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Bconst
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Bconst.header: def Bconst (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (c : Fin 3 → SuTwo) : BondFnL2 Lu

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.G1inv_nonneg.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.G1inv_nonneg
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.G1inv_nonneg.header:
theorem G1inv_nonneg (hFS : P.FullSupp) (hOm : P.G.Om0 = Set.univ) (hU : P.U = flatCfg) (ha : 0 < P.a) (x : ↥(bondSupp P.G)) :

AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.genForm_le_fib.name: AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.genForm_le_fibre
AdalyFormal.GenuineU1.Gen.genForm_le_fib.header:
theorem genForm_le_fibre (hFS : P.FullSupp) (hOm : P.G.Om0 = Set.univ) (hU : P.U = flatCfg) (hG : IsUnit P.G1inv)
    (hN : IsUnit (GenP.Nmat P)) (ha : 0 < P.a) (B : BondFnL2 P.Lu) (A : ↥(bondSupp P.G))
    (hA : P.data.Q A = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint P.tau B) :
    GenP.genForm P B ≤ P.eta * (‖curlCovariantCLM_L2 (flatCfg : PeriodicLinkConfiguration
        (Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (scaleUp P.ell P.k P.Lu)) (iE P.G A)‖ ^ 2 +

noncomputable def QlinCompL (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) : ℕ → (XS L →L[ℝ] XS L)
  | 0 => ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (XS L)
  | j + 1 => (QlinStepL (ell ^ j) ell (bg j)).comp (QlinCompL ell bg j)

theorem QlinCompL_zero (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) :

AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.C2StepL.header: noncomputable def C2StepL (s ell : ℕ) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (a : XS L) : XS L

AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.D2CompL.name: AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.D2CompL
AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.D2CompL.header:
noncomputable def D2CompL (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) : ℕ → (XS L →ₗ[ℝ] XS L →ₗ[ℝ] XS L)
  | 0 => 0
  | j + 1 => LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ
      (fun a b => QlinStepL (ell ^ j) ell (bg j) (D2CompL ell bg j a b)
        + D2StepL (ell ^ j) ell (bg j) (QlinCompL ell bg j a) (QlinCompL ell bg j b))
      (fun a a' b => by simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; abel)
      (fun r a b => by simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_add])
      (fun a b b' => by simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; abel)
      (fun r a b => by simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_add])

                                                                                     
noncomputable def C2CompL (ell : ℕ) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (j : ℕ) (a : XS L) : XS L

AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.C2CompL_s.name: AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.C2CompL_succ
AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.C2CompL_s.header:

    C2CompL ell bg (j + 1) a
      = QlinStepL (ell ^ j) ell (bg j) (C2CompL ell bg j a) + C2StepL (ell ^ j) ell (bg j) (QlinCompL ell bg j a)

AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.C2StepL_s.name: AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.C2StepL_smul
AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.C2StepL_s.header:

    U (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1) = U' (periodicLatticeShift p.1 p.2.1.2, p.2.1.1) ∧
    U (p.1, p.2.1.2) = U' (p.1, p.2.1.2)

    (∃ p : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf, p ∈ towerBj (TT Lf) 0) ∧
    (∃ p : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf, p ∈ towerBj (TT Lf) 1) ∧
    (∃ p : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf, p ∉ (TT Lf).Om 0) ∧
    LambdaOK (Lu := Lu) (Lf := Lf) 2 1 12 1 (TT Lf) (Lam30 Lu) ∧
    (∃ U : LinkCfg Lf, PerCubeRegularMix 2 1 10 1 (TT Lf) α₀ (((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 1)⁻¹ U ∧
       ¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite Lf → G2, periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧

AdalyFormal.StatementLane2.curlA_rsmul.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLane2.curlA_rsmul
AdalyFormal.StatementLane2.curlA_rsmul.header:
theorem curlA_rsmul {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (η : ℝ) (χ : Bond L → ℝ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (a b : Fin 3) :
    curlA η (fun e => χ e • sig) x a b =
      (η⁻¹ * (χ (periodicLatticeShift x a, b) - χ (x, b) - χ (periodicLatticeShift x b, a)
        + χ (x, a))) • sig

AdalyFormal.StatementLane2.ddA_rsmul.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLane2.ddA_rsmul
AdalyFormal.StatementLane2.ddA_rsmul.header:
theorem ddA_rsmul {L : PeriodicLatticeExtent} (η : ℝ) (χ : Bond L → ℝ)
    (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) :
    ddA η (fun e => χ e • sig) x μ =
      (η⁻¹ * ∑ ν ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ν : Fin 3 => ν ≠ μ),
        (η⁻¹ * (χ (periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν) ν, μ)
            - χ (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν, μ)
            - χ (periodicLatticeShift (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν) μ, ν)
            + χ (periodicLatticeShiftBack x ν, ν))
          - η⁻¹ * (χ (periodicLatticeShift x ν, μ) - χ (x, μ)
            - χ (periodicLatticeShift x μ, ν) + χ (x, ν)))) • sig

AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.Tpath_rep.name: AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.Tpath_replicate_one

AdalyFormal.IngredientFamilyR2.Dtot_flat.header:

AdalyFormal.StatementLane3.form_core.header:
theorem form_core (Q : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (hS : IsUnit ((Q.comp (Ring.inverse ((1 : E →L[ℝ] E) + (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q).comp Q))).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q))) (v : F) :
    ∃ x : E, Q x = v ∧
      ⟪v, Ring.inverse ((Q.comp (Ring.inverse ((1 : E →L[ℝ] E) +
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q).comp Q))).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q)) v⟫
        = ‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖v‖ ^ 2

      (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q))) (v : F) :
    ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪v, Ring.inverse ((Q.comp (Ring.inverse ((1 : E →L[ℝ] E) +
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q).comp Q))).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q)) v⟫
        - ⟪v, v⟫

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.pdist_coarse.header: theorem pdist_coarseShift_le (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (s : ℕ) (μ : Fin 3) : pdist x (coarseShift x s μ) ≤ s

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.Ball.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.Ball
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.Ball.header: def Ball (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (r : ℕ) : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.mem_Ball_sel.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.mem_Ball_self
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.mem_Ball_sel.header: theorem mem_Ball_self (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (r : ℕ) : y ∈ Ball y r

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.Ball_mono.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.Ball_mono
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.Ball_mono.header: theorem Ball_mono {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {r r' : ℕ} (h : r ≤ r') : Ball y r ⊆ Ball y r'

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.Ball_sub.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.Ball_sub
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.Ball_sub.header:
theorem Ball_sub {y y' : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {d r R : ℕ} (hd : pdist y y' ≤ d) (hR : d + r ≤ R) :
    Ball y' r ⊆ Ball y R

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.AgreeAt.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.AgreeAt
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.AgreeAt.header: def AgreeAt {G : Type*} (W : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (U U' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.AgreeAt.mono.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.AgreeAt.mono
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.AgreeAt.mono.header:
theorem AgreeAt.mono {G : Type*} {W W' : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {U U' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L}
    (h : AgreeAt W U U') (hW : W' ⊆ W) : AgreeAt W' U U'

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.AgreeAt.symm.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.AgreeAt.symm
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.AgreeAt.symm.header:
theorem AgreeAt.symm {G : Type*} {W : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {U U' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L}
    (h : AgreeAt W U U') : AgreeAt W U' U

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.pdist_coarse.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.pdist_coarsePathEndpoint_le
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.pdist_coarse.header:
theorem pdist_coarsePathEndpoint_le (s : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (p : List (Fin 3)) :
    pdist y (coarsePathEndpoint s y p) ≤ s * p.length

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.pdist_stepBl.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.pdist_stepBlock_le
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.pdist_stepBl.header:
theorem pdist_stepBlock_le {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {s ell : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) :
    pdist y x ≤ 3 * (s * ell)

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.coarseCoordS.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.coarseCoordSteps_le
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.coarseCoordS.header:
theorem coarseCoordSteps_le {a b : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {s ell : ℕ} (μ : Fin 3) (hs : 0 < s)
    (h1 : (a μ).val ≤ (b μ).val) (h2 : (b μ).val < (a μ).val + s * ell) : coarseCoordSteps s a b μ ≤ ell

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.length_coars.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.length_coarseGammaPath_le
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.length_coars.header:
theorem length_coarseGammaPath_le {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} {s ell : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hx : x ∈ stepBlockOf y s ell) :
    (coarseGammaPath s y x).length ≤ 3 * ell

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.admissible_b.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.admissible_ball
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.admissible_b.header:
theorem admissible_ball {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k)
    {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ S.Om (j + 1)) : Ball y (R * bigSide M ell j) ⊆ S.Om j

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.admissible_m.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.admissible_mono
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.admissible_m.header:
theorem admissible_mono {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) :
    ∀ j, S.Om j ⊆ S.Om 0

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.admissible_b.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.admissible_ball_Om0
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.admissible_b.header:
theorem admissible_ball_Om0 {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) {j : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j)
    (hjk : j ≤ k + 1) {y : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ S.Om j) :
    Ball y (R * (M * ell ^ (j - 1))) ⊆ S.Om 0

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.AgreeX.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.AgreeX
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.AgreeX.header: def AgreeX (W : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (v v' : XS L) : Prop

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.AgreeX.mono.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.AgreeX.mono
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.AgreeX.mono.header: theorem AgreeX.mono {W W' : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)} {v v' : XS L} (h : AgreeX W v v') (hW : W' ⊆ W) : AgreeX W' v v'

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.QlinStepL_co.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.QlinStepL_congr_bg
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.QlinStepL_co.header:
theorem QlinStepL_congr_bg (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) {V0 V0' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (h : AgreeAt (Ball c.1 (4 * (s * ell))) V0 V0') (v : XS L) : QlinStepL s ell V0 v c = QlinStepL s ell V0' v c

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.QlinStepL_co.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.QlinStepL_congr_in
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.QlinStepL_co.header:
theorem QlinStepL_congr_in (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    {v v' : XS L} (h : AgreeX (Ball c.1 (4 * (s * ell))) v v') : QlinStepL s ell V0 v c = QlinStepL s ell V0 v' c

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.D2StepL_cong.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.D2StepL_congr_bg
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.D2StepL_cong.header:
theorem D2StepL_congr_bg (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) {V0 V0' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (h : AgreeAt (Ball c.1 (4 * (s * ell))) V0 V0') (v w : XS L) : D2StepL s ell V0 v w c = D2StepL s ell V0' v w c

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.D2StepL_cong.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.D2StepL_congr_in
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.D2StepL_cong.header:
theorem D2StepL_congr_in (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    {v v' w w' : XS L} (hv : AgreeX (Ball c.1 (4 * (s * ell))) v v') (hw : AgreeX (Ball c.1 (4 * (s * ell))) w w') :
    D2StepL s ell V0 v w c = D2StepL s ell V0 v' w' c

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.C2StepL_cong.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.C2StepL_congr_bg
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.C2StepL_cong.header:
theorem C2StepL_congr_bg (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) {V0 V0' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (h : AgreeAt (Ball c.1 (4 * (s * ell))) V0 V0') (v : XS L) : C2StepL s ell V0 v c = C2StepL s ell V0' v c

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.C2StepL_cong.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.C2StepL_congr_in
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.C2StepL_cong.header:
theorem C2StepL_congr_in (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    {v v' : XS L} (h : AgreeX (Ball c.1 (4 * (s * ell))) v v') : C2StepL s ell V0 v c = C2StepL s ell V0 v' c

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.QlinCompL_co.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.QlinCompL_congr_in
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.QlinCompL_co.header:
theorem QlinCompL_congr_in (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (j : ℕ) :
    ∀ (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) {v v' : XS L}, AgreeX (Ball c.1 (rhoT ell j)) v v' →
      QlinCompL ell bg j v c = QlinCompL ell bg j v' c

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.C2CompL_cong.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.C2CompL_congr_in
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.C2CompL_cong.header:
theorem C2CompL_congr_in (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell) (bg : ℕ → PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (j : ℕ) :
    ∀ (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) {a a' : XS L}, AgreeX (Ball c.1 (rhoT ell j)) a a' →
      C2CompL ell bg j a c = C2CompL ell bg j a' c

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.QlinCompL_co.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.QlinCompL_congr_U
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.QlinCompL_co.header:
theorem QlinCompL_congr_U (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) {U U' : Cfg L} (v : XS L) (j : ℕ) :
    ∀ c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, AgreeAt (Ball c.1 (2 * rhoT G.ell j)) U U' →
      QlinCompL G.ell (bgTower G U) j v c = QlinCompL G.ell (bgTower G U') j v c

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.C2CompL_cong.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.C2CompL_congr_U
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.C2CompL_cong.header:
theorem C2CompL_congr_U (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) {U U' : Cfg L} (a : XS L) (j : ℕ) :
    ∀ c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, AgreeAt (Ball c.1 (2 * rhoT G.ell j)) U U' →
      C2CompL G.ell (bgTower G U) j a c = C2CompL G.ell (bgTower G U') j a c

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.fderiv_mask.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.fderiv_mask
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.fderiv_mask.header:
theorem fderiv_mask (χ : E →L[ℝ] E) (g : E → F) (hg : ∀ x, g x = g (χ x)) (v : E) :
    fderiv ℝ g 0 v = fderiv ℝ g 0 (χ v)

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.germ_mask.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.germ_mask
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.germ_mask.header:
theorem germ_mask (χ : E →L[ℝ] E) (hχ : ∀ x, χ (χ x) = χ x) (g : E → F) (hg : ∀ x, g x = g (χ x)) (x : E) :
    (fun h => g (h + x)) = (fun h => g (h + χ x))

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.fderiv_eq_ma.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.fderiv_eq_mask
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.fderiv_eq_ma.header:
theorem fderiv_eq_mask (χ : E →L[ℝ] E) (hχ : ∀ x, χ (χ x) = χ x) (g : E → F) (hg : ∀ x, g x = g (χ x)) (x : E) :
    fderiv ℝ g x = fderiv ℝ g (χ x)

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.differentiab.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.differentiableAt_mask_iff
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.differentiab.header:
theorem differentiableAt_mask_iff (χ : E →L[ℝ] E) (hχ : ∀ x, χ (χ x) = χ x) (g : E → F) (hg : ∀ x, g x = g (χ x))
    (x : E) : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x ↔ DifferentiableAt ℝ g (χ x)

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.fderiv_comp_.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.fderiv_comp_mask
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.fderiv_comp_.header:
theorem fderiv_comp_mask (χ : E →L[ℝ] E) (hχ : ∀ x, χ (χ x) = χ x) (g : E → F) (hg : ∀ x, g x = g (χ x)) (x : E) :
    fderiv ℝ g x = (fderiv ℝ g x).comp χ

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.fderiv2_mask.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.fderiv2_mask
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.fderiv2_mask.header:
theorem fderiv2_mask (χ : E →L[ℝ] E) (hχ : ∀ x, χ (χ x) = χ x) (g : E → F) (hg : ∀ x, g x = g (χ x)) (v w : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) 0 v w = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) 0 (χ v) (χ w)

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.coarsePathHo.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.coarsePathHolonomy_congr

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.stridedBlock.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.stridedBlockedGauge_congr
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.stridedBlock.header:
theorem stridedBlockedGauge_congr {G 𝔤 : Type*} [Group G] [AddCommGroup 𝔤] [Module ℚ 𝔤]
    (P : AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.LogExpAd G 𝔤) (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s)
    {V V' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L} (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (h : AgreeAt (Ball c.1 (4 * (s * ell))) V V') :
    stridedBlockedGauge P s ell V c = stridedBlockedGauge P s ell V' c

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rhoT.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rhoT
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rhoT.header:
def rhoT (ell : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => 0
  | l + 1 => rhoT ell l + 4 * (ell ^ l * ell)

theorem rhoT_succ (ell l : ℕ) : rhoT ell (l + 1) = rhoT ell l + 4 * (ell ^ l * ell)

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rhoT_succ.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rhoT_succ
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rhoT_succ.header: theorem rhoT_succ (ell l : ℕ) : rhoT ell (l + 1) = rhoT ell l + 4 * (ell ^ l * ell)

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rhoT_le.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rhoT_le
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rhoT_le.header: theorem rhoT_le (ell : ℕ) (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (l : ℕ) : rhoT ell l + 8 ≤ 8 * ell ^ l

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rhoT_mono.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rhoT_mono
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rhoT_mono.header: theorem rhoT_mono (ell : ℕ) {l l' : ℕ} (h : l ≤ l') : rhoT ell l ≤ rhoT ell l'

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.UbarTower_co.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.UbarTower_congr
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.UbarTower_co.header:
theorem UbarTower_congr {G 𝔤 : Type*} [Group G] [AddCommGroup 𝔤] [Module ℚ 𝔤]
    (P : AdalyFormal.Balaban.BlockedGauge.LogExpAd G 𝔤) (ell : ℕ) (hell : 0 < ell)
    {U U' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration G L} (l : ℕ) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, AgreeAt (Ball y (rhoT ell l)) U U' →
      ∀ μ, UbarTower P ell U l (y, μ) = UbarTower P ell U' l (y, μ)

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.bgTower_cong.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.bgTower_congr
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.bgTower_cong.header:
theorem bgTower_congr (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) {U U' : Cfg L} (l : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (h : AgreeAt (Ball y (rhoT G.ell l)) U U') (μ : Fin 3) :
    bgTower G U l (y, μ) = bgTower G U' l (y, μ)

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.bgTower_agre.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.bgTower_agreeAt
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.bgTower_agre.header:
theorem bgTower_agreeAt (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) {U U' : Cfg L} (l : ℕ) (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (r : ℕ)
    (h : AgreeAt (Ball y (r + rhoT G.ell l)) U U') :
    AgreeAt (Ball y r) (bgTower G U l) (bgTower G U' l)

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rProd_congr.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rProd_congr
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rProd_congr.header:
theorem rProd_congr (s : ℕ) {V0 V0' V1 V1' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (p : List (Fin 3)) (h0 : AgreeAt (Ball y (s * p.length)) V0 V0') (h1 : AgreeAt (Ball y (s * p.length)) V1 V1') :
    rProd s V0 V1 y p = rProd s V0' V1' y p

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.sBlock_congr.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.sBlock_congr
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.sBlock_congr.header:
theorem sBlock_congr (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) {V0 V0' V1 V1' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (h0 : AgreeAt (Ball y (3 * (s * ell))) V0 V0') (h1 : AgreeAt (Ball y (3 * (s * ell))) V1 V1') :
    sBlock s ell V0 V1 y = sBlock s ell V0' V1' y

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rawStep_cong.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rawStep_congr
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.rawStep_cong.header:
theorem rawStep_congr (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) {V0 V0' V1 V1' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (h0 : AgreeAt (Ball c.1 (4 * (s * ell))) V0 V0') (h1 : AgreeAt (Ball c.1 (4 * (s * ell))) V1 V1') :
    rawStep s ell V0 V1 c = rawStep s ell V0' V1' c

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.maskX.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.maskX
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.maskX.header: noncomputable def maskX (W : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) : XS L →L[ℝ] XS L

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.maskX_apply.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.maskX_apply
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.maskX_apply.header:
theorem maskX_apply (W : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (a : XS L) (e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) :
    maskX W a e = if e.1 ∈ W then a e else 0

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.maskX_idem.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.maskX_idem
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.maskX_idem.header: theorem maskX_idem (W : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) (a : XS L) : maskX W (maskX W a) = maskX W a

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.maskX_eq_of_.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.maskX_eq_of_agree
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.maskX_eq_of_.header:
theorem maskX_eq_of_agree (W : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite L)) {a a' : XS L} (h : ∀ e : PeriodicLatticeEdge L, e.1 ∈ W → a e = a' e) :
    maskX W a = maskX W a'

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.qStepComp_co.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.qStepComp_congr_bg
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.qStepComp_co.header:
theorem qStepComp_congr_bg (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) {V0 V0' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L} (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L)
    (h : AgreeAt (Ball c.1 (4 * (s * ell))) V0 V0') : qStepComp s ell V0 c = qStepComp s ell V0' c

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.qStepComp_ma.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.qStepComp_mask
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.qStepComp_ma.header:
theorem qStepComp_mask (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (V0 : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L) (c : PeriodicLatticeEdge L) (a : XS L) :
    qStepComp s ell V0 c a = qStepComp s ell V0 c (maskX (Ball c.1 (4 * (s * ell))) a)

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.stepAverage_.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.stepAverage_congr
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.stepAverage_.header:
theorem stepAverage_congr (s ell : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) {V V' : PeriodicLinkConfiguration SU2 L}
    {lam lam' : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo} (y : PeriodicLatticeSite L)
    (hV : AgreeAt (Ball y (3 * (s * ell))) V V') (hl : ∀ x ∈ Ball y (3 * (s * ell)), lam x = lam' x) :
    stepAverage s V ell lam y = stepAverage s V' ell lam' y

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.Qcomposite_c.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.Qcomposite_congr
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.Qcomposite_c.header:
theorem Qcomposite_congr (G : TowerGeom L) (hell : 0 < G.ell) {U U' : Cfg L} (lam : PeriodicLatticeSite L → SuTwo) (j : ℕ) :
    ∀ y : PeriodicLatticeSite L, AgreeAt (Ball y (2 * rhoT G.ell j)) U U' →
      Qcomposite (bgTower G U) G.ell j lam y = Qcomposite (bgTower G U') G.ell j lam y

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.agreeAt_of_b.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.agreeAt_of_both

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.pdist_shiftB.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.pdist_shiftBack_le
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.pdist_shiftB.header: theorem pdist_shiftBack_le (x : PeriodicLatticeSite L) (μ : Fin 3) : pdist x (periodicLatticeShiftBack x μ) ≤ 1

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.room_arith.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.room_arith
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.room_arith.header:
theorem room_arith {ell M R : ℕ} (hell : 2 ≤ ell) (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    ell ^ j + 2 * rhoT ell j + 1 ≤ R * (M * ell ^ (j - 1))

AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.row_ball_Om0.name: AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.row_ball_Om0
AdalyFormal.StatementLaneR8.row_ball_Om0.header:
theorem row_ball_Om0 {ell M R k : ℕ} {S : Tower L} (hS : Admissible ell M R k S) (hell : 2 ≤ ell)
    (hroom : 17 * ell ≤ R * M) {j : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k) {y x : PeriodicLatticeSite L} (hy : y ∈ S.Om j)
    (hxy : pdist y x ≤ ell ^ j) : Ball x (2 * rhoT ell j + 1) ⊆ S.Om 0
